name: Aconitum Lycoctonum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY- acon-1. Aconitum lycoctonum. Great yellow wolfsbane. Aconitum tely- phonum. Badgers bane.
 N. O. Ranunculacee. Tincture of fresh plant when coming into bloom. The only aconite which does not contain
Aconitine. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Allergies. Constipation. Coughs. Diarrhea. Glands, enlargement. Hodgkin's disease. Liver
disorders. Mastitis. Pork, effects. Strangury.
HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of Aeon, lycoctonum, while resembling those of the other Aconites in some
respects, sho w a marked absence of the cutaneous nerve disorders so prominent in their provings.
Swelling of the cervical, axillary glands and breasts. Clarke has used it with good effect in cases of scrofulous
glands and even where Hodgkin's disease has been suspected.
Itching of eyes, nose, anus, and vulva. The skin of the nose is cracked. There is a cough leaving a taste of
blood in the mouth. Diarrhea after eating pork.
MIND - Anxiety. Distraction. Dread of work. Instability of ideas. Laughter. Mania. Ferocity. Abdomen - Right
hypochondrium has bruised pain, tearing pain, starting. When breathing both hypochondria feel bruised.
Sensation of compression in diaphragm. Anxiety, with beatings in abdomen. Sharp pain after drinking milk.
Back - Swelling of the cervical glands. The neck seems to grow larger. Swelling of the neck on one side only.
Pressing pain at the nape of the neck. Shivering in the back. Jerking in the region of the kidneys.
Breasts - Swelling of the breast glands.
Ears - Purulent discharge from ears, redness behind them.
Eyes - Sharp pain in eyes from without inward. Painfulness of lids. Itching in lids. Pressure on lids and difficulty
of raising them. Smarting in canthi, dryness at inner canthus.
Face - Face pale, shining. Pain of excoriation around mouth. Pain in facial bones.
Tension in facial muscles. Hard pimples of face and lips. Skin of face becomes light brown. Numbness of jaw
like incipient paralysis, better by compression and by drinking wine.
Female - Itching at vulva. Fetid menstrual blood. Excoriation of bend of thigh after menses. Leucorrhea, viscid.
Food - Strong relish for dainties, fruits, and cabbage. Increased relish for tobacco in a smoker. Aversion to
food in general, especially fatty things and milk, they cause uneasiness. Keen hunger very soon satisfied.
Constant thirst even when drinking. Burning thirst. Thirst at night.
Head - Sharp pain in head extending across eyes. Sensation as if a nail were driven into head when moving
it. Hammering in temples. Pain like rheumatism in scalp worse by touch.
Kidneys - Desire to urinate with copious emissions. Urging with ineffectual efforts. Hot, turbid urine, depositing
a white sediment. .
Limbs - On stretching legs, hamstrings feel as if shortened. Jerking in legs. Itching at ankles in evening. Sharp
pain at instep when standing. Eruption of hot, red, slightly painful spots on legs and toes. Swelling of axillary
glands. Pressure, sharp pains in shoulder joints. Tearing pain in elbow joints. Stiffness in elbows and wrists.
Sensation of fullness in hands. Sweat on hands.
Modalities - Worse in afternoon (Lyc.), Better mental exertion. Better after wine. Better during digestion,
especially of pork and onions.
Lungs - Difficult respiration. Slight cough with watery expectoration. After a slight chill, leaving a taste of blood
in the mouth.
Mouth - Clayey, astringent taste.
Nose - Itching on nose, sensitiveness, lancinations. Compression at root of nose. Skin of nose cracked. Muco-
purulent discharge from nose.
Rectum - Constipation, anus feels as if strongly contracted. Diarrhea with violent cutting after eating pork.
Whitish stools. After stool, pain in anus as if there was a crack there, shivering. Cramp at anus. Itching at anus.
Tenesmus during night.
Sleep - Drowsiness, he sleeps too long. Aberration of hearing during sleep. During sleep, numbness of the
parts he lies on.
Stomach - Painful belchings. Belchings are rancid like rotten eggs, acid, with weight on stomach. Hiccough.
Inclination to vomit after eating with shivering, vertigo. Vomiting of mucus on getting out of bed, yellowish after
drinking with copious urination.
Teeth - Burning pain in upper teeth. Pressing in teeth. Tearing in lower teeth when opening mouth. Gums
bluish, ulcerated.
Temperature - Goose bumps. Chilliness of one side only as soon as he is uncovered. In morning external
coldness with feeling of heat. Coldness alternating with heat, succeeded by sweat. During fever, pale face,
strong appetite, thirst, pain in bowels, restlessness. Sweat continues after fever.
Vertigo - Vertigo with nausea.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cist, Lap-a., Con., lod., Spong.. Lyc., Carb-an. (2) Puls, in bad effects of pork.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
 ***ACONITUM NAPELLUS
(Monkshood)
PHARMACY - aeon. Aconitum napellus. Monkshood. Wolfsbane. Common Aconite. Aconitum virosum. N. O.
Ranunculacee. Tincture of whole plant with root when beginning to flower. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Amaurosis. Amenorrhea. Anger. Anxiety. Asthma. Blindness. Breast-feeding, disorders.
Bronchitis. Catalepsy. Catheter, fever. Chickenpox. Chills. Cholera. Cholera infantum. Colds. Colic.
Conjunctivitis. Convulsions. Cough. Croup. Cystitis. Dengue fever. Dentition. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dyspepsia.
Dysentery. Dysmenorrhea. Ear, disorders. Enteritis. Erythema. Esophagitri Eye. disorders. Face, flushing.
Fears. Fevers. Fright, effects.
Glossitis. Gonorrhea. Headaches. Heart, attack. Heart, disorders. Hemorrhages. Hemorrhoid. Hip joint,
disease. Hodgkin's disease. Influenza. Jaundice. Labor, pains. Laryngitis. Lumbago. Lungs disorders. Mania.
Mastitis. Measles. Meningitis. Menstruation, disorders. Milk leg. Miscarriage. Mumps. Muscle, pains. Myelitis.
Nephritis. Nervousness. Neuralgias. Nightmares. Numbness. Otitis media. Palpitations. Panic, attacks.
Paralysis. Peritonitis. Pleurisy, pain. Pneumonia. Puerperal fever. Purpura miliaris. Quinsy. Remittent, fever.
Roseola. Scarlatina. Shock. Sleeplessness. Stiff-neck. Strokes. Tachycardia. Tetanus. Tetany. Throat,
disorders. Tingling. Tongue, disorders. Toothache. Traumatic, fever. Tuberculosis. Urethra, stricture.
Urethritis. Urine, retention. Uterus, prolapsed. Vaccination. effects. Vertigo. Whooping, cough. Yellow fever.
HOMEOPATHIC - Aeon, is useful in emergencies and acute diseases. It grows up in the high mountains where
there is a lot of wind, storms and activity. Complaints and tension caused by exposure to dry, cold weather,
winds, draft of cold air, or checked perspiration. Marked affect on the serous membranes and muscular tissue.
Major remedy for inflammation and fevers. A state of fear, shock, anxiety, anguish of mind and body.
Physical and mental restlessness.
Acute, sudden and violent illness with high fever. Rapid action, symptoms set in with great intensity,
specifically heart attacks, influenza, certain fevers and acute inflammations. Attacks of sudden fear, anxiety
and even blindness. Sudden and great sinking of strength. Sudden chills or fever.
Ailments of immune system, especially if caused by suddenly checked sweat or by dry cold air, storms or cold
winds. Painful, hot, swollen glands. Neuritis with tingling. Influenza and colds.
Complaints from very hot weather, especially summer diarrhea. Localized blood congestions and
inflammations. Tension of arteries, emotional and physical tension. Burning in internal parts. Tingling, cold-
ness and numbness. Does not want to be touched.
Muscular rheumatism with high fever. Joint rheumatism, much fever, restlessness and anxiety. Swellings are
red and hot (Bell.), or pale, shifting from one point to another. Shooting, cramps, cracking, loss of power, and
drawing pain in joints and tendons.
MIND - Mental and emotional shocks. Never well since a fright or shock. Ailments from fright. Fear of
death and dying, great anxiety. Nightmares, phobias, panic attacks. Nightmares after horror stories or
movies. Tendency to be startled. Fright followed by panic and shock.
Complaints come suddenly and with great intensity, often with an overwhelming fear of death. Great fear,
anxiety and restlessness accompany every ailment. Fears the future. Panic and anxiety. Fear of death.
Believes that he will soon die, predicts the day. Anxiety about heart.
Forebodings and fears. Panic attacks with restlessness. Agoraphobia. Afraid to go out of the house. Fears a
crowds, crossing busy streets. Terror stricken. Fears of public speaking. Fear of narrow places. Fears of
going to doctors and dentists. Anticipation. Fear of the dark. Fear of ghosts.
Oversensitive to pain. Pains are intolerable, drive him crazy. Despair from the pains. Impatient, beside
himself from intensity of pain. Reproaches others for mere trifles.
Inconsolable anxiety. Ailments from anger, from chagrin, child has spells of rage. Desires company. Ideas
haunt him, can't get rid of them. Confusion, as after drunkenness. Stupefaction alternating with restlessness.
Delirium and high fever with anxiety, worry, fear and desperation. Nocturnal delirium. Desire for light.
Restlessness and tossing about. Loquacity, speech hurried. Fitful moods, laughing, singing, then sad and
fearful. Mania to ridicule.
Music is unbearable, makes her sad (Ambr.). Imagination acute. Clairvoyance. Thinks his thoughts come from
the stomach. Thinks thatparts of his body are abnormally thick. Feels as if what had just been done was a
dream.
Abdomen - Colic, forces to bend double, yet no position relieves. Wind colic after taking cold. Hot, tense,
tympanitic. Sensitive to touch. Abdominal symptoms better after warm soup. Burning in umbilical region. Hot
distended. Incarcerated hernia with bilious vomiting. Burning and cutting pains in intestines. Intestines as if
paralyzed, inactive, worse about transverse colon. Loins as if bruised. Burning pain in umbilical region.
 Umbilical region hard, swollen.
Back - Chilliness and formication down back. Numb, stiff, painful. Numbness in lumbar region. Crawling and
tingling, as if bruised. Stiffness in nape of neck. Pain in the back, prevents taking deep inspiration. Bruised
pain between shoulders and in sacrum. Burning, shooting pain in spine. Sharp pain between scapulae, on
deep breathing. Slightest touch of spine causes spasms. Spinal meningitis after injury or checked sweat.
Bladder - Cystitis. Burning pain in urethra. Hematuria. Urethral chill. Urine suppressed, bloody. Anxiety always
on beginning to urinate. Urination painful, difficult, drop by drop. Retention with screaming and restlessness
and handling of genitals. Retention or suppression of urine in newborn due to cold exposure. Retention of
urine after childbirth. Splashing sensation in region of bladder, during urination. Tenesmus and burning at
neck of bladder.
Breasts - Mastitis. Milk fever with delirium. Increase of milk in breast. Breasts hot. Milk scanty.
Chest - Constant pressure in left chest. ■ Violent congestion of blood in the chest.
Oppression of the chest when moving fast or ascending in heart disease. Blood comes up on hawking. Sharp
pain in chest. Lancinating pain through chest. Tingling in chest after coughing. Pressive weight and burning
under sternum.
Constitutions - Children. Plethoric persons of a lively character, bilious and nervous constitutions, high color,
brown or black hair, are specially suited to Aeon. Persons leading a sedentary life, plethora, etc.
Cough - Cough with nervous excitability. Hoarse, dry, croupy cough, loud, labored breathing. Cough better
lying on back. Cough from walking in open air. Child grasps at throat every time he coughs. Cough, dry, short,
hacking. Cough worse at night and after midnight. Short, barking, ringing or whistling cough, worse every
inspiration, at night. Loud, rough, croaking cough, on expiration. Croupy, dry, coarse, suffocating cough.
Hemoptysis from mental excitement, wine or exposure to dry, cold air. Cough from tobacco smoke. Cough
awakening from sleep. Cough worse after taking cold, drinking cold water.
Ears - Otitis media. External ear hot, red, painful, swollen (Bell.). Earache with pain (Bell., Cham.). Tickling
and sharp pain in the ears. Tingling and buzzing in the ears. Sensation as if drop of water in left ear. Ringing,
humming or roaring noises. Sensitive to noises, music is unbearable. Left ear deaf, with buzzing in whole
head.
Eyes - Red, inflamed. Bloodshot. Pain and inflammation after surgery. Injuries to eyes. Conjunctivitis.
Inflammation from foreign bodies, dust, cinders. Ingrowing eyelashes. Eyes glitter, stare, watery. Eyes feels
dry and hot. Shooting pain in eyeballs. Sensation as if sand in eyes. Swelling of the eyes. Eyelids swollen,
hard and red. Aversion to light. Can't bear reflection of sun from snow. Profuse watering fromreflection of
snow. Profuse lachrymation after exposure to dry, cold winds. Asthenopia from straining eyes. Pupils
contracted then dilated.
Face - Anxious expression. Hippocratic. Face red, hot, flushed, swollen. Pale alternating with red. Burning,
lips and tongue, as after eating pepper or smoking. Lips black, dry, peeling off. One cheek red hot other pale
and cold (Cham., Ip.). Neuralgia, especially on left side with restlessness. Tingling, cheeks and numbness.
Tingling and numbness. Heavy feeling of the whole face. Sweat on side of face lain on. On rising, the red
face becomes deathly pale. Jaw, pain.
Female - Dysmenorrhea has to bend double, but better in no position. Menses too profuse. Menses with
nosebleed. Menses too protracted, late. Frenzy, fury on appearance of menses. Amenorrhea during puberty.
Suppressed menses from fright, cold. Ovaritis from sudden checked menstrual flow. Ovaries congested
and painful. Impending miscarriage from fright or vexation. Active uterine hemorrhage. Sharp, shooting
pains in uterus. Prolapsed uterus. Labor-pains violent. After-pains with fear and restlessness. Suppressed
lochia. Leucorrhea copious, tenacious, yellowish. Vagina dry, hot, sensitive.
Food - Excessive hunger and thirst, but eats slowly. Lively sensation of hunger, renewed soon after eating.
No appetite, loathing of food, qualmishness. Aversion to tobacco. Better warm soup. Better wine. Anxiety better
cold drinks. Desires beer, wine. Desires brandy, bitter drinks. Worse after iced cold drinks. Milk disagrees.
Intense thirst. Thirst for cold water. Thirst burning, unquenchable, during all stages of fever. Thirst for
beer during fever. Thirsty during labor. Everything tastes bitter, except water.
Head - Fullness, pulsating. Hot, heavy, bursting sensation. Burning, undulating sensation. Head excessively
hot. Congestive headaches. Intercranial pressure (Hed.). Burning headache, as if brain were moved by
boiling water (Indg.). Violent squeezing or bursting pain in forehead. Pulsation in forehead. Sensation on vertex
as if hair were pulled or stood on end. Nocturnal furious delirium. Meningitis. Brain affections of children.
Formication of scalp better heat. Scalp sensitive to touch. Scalp sensitive to cold air, strong wind. Sunstroke
from sleeping in rays of sun.
Heart - Heart feels swollen. Hypertrophy of heart. Heart attacks with anxiety andfear. Dreadful oppression
and anxiety about heart. Oppression about heart with burning flushes along back. Heart pains into left shoulder,
 worse sitting erect. Tachycardia. Palpitations with anxiety, after fright. Palpitations fainting and tingling in
fingers, pain down left arm. Palpitations during fever. Palpitations from motion, on waking. Palpitations from
smoking. Arterial tension. Temporal and carotid arteries felt when sitting. Pulse fast, full, hard, tense and
bounding. Pulse quicker than heartbeat. Pulse sometimes intermits. Pulse shaking, forcible and tumultuous.
Pulse wiry, very irritable.
Kidneys - Anxiety on beginning to urinate. Sharp pains in region of kidneys. Stinging and pressing, in renal
region. Scanty, red, hot, painful urine. Kidney region sensitive with shooting pains. Profuse urination with
profuse perspiration and diarrhea. Agonizing dysuria. Profuse urination with profuse sweat and diarrhea.
Diuresis with headache or profuse sweat. Brown, burning urine, with brick-colored sediment. Urine fiery,
scalding hot, red or dark-colored.
Limbs - Numbness and tingling. Numbness of the left arm, tingling in fingers. Shooting pains. Icy coldness
and insensibility of hands and feet. Arms feel lame, bruised, heavy, and numb. Arms hang down limp. Red
finger tips (Cact. Crot-h., Kalm., Tab. ). Hot hands and cold feet. Twitching of fingers and toes. Rheumatic
inflammation of joints, worse at night. Red, shining swelling, very sensitive joints. Legs powerless, feel tired
during repose. Hip joint and thigh feel lame, especially after lying down. Knees unsteady, disposition of foot to
turn (Aesc.). Weak and lax ligaments of all joints. Painless cracking of all joints. Bright red hypothenar
eminences on both hands. Sensation as if drops of water trickled down the thigh. Jerking of left or arm.
Palms hot. Sharp pains in inflamed joints. Trembling.
Liver - Pressure in the region of the liver, with obstruction of breathing. Burning pain, shooting, stinging and
pressure in the liver region, with difficult respiration. Painful sensibility to touch in the region of the liver.
Jaundice in newborn children. Jaundice from fright.
Lungs - Asthma after suppression of acute rash. Asthma from active hyperemia of lungs and brain. Hot feeling
in lungs. Awaking with danger of suffocation, from tickling in throat. Anxious breathing hard, sits erect.
Oppressed breathing on least motion. Agony, sits straight up, can hardly breathe. Deep, slow, sighing. Very
sensitive to inspired air. Shortness of breath. Shortness of breath during sleep. Pleurisy. Stitches through
chest. Croup with fever. Sensation as if lungs will not expand. Bronchitis. Pneumonia. Rusty, thin, frothy,
white mucus streaked with bright blood. Sputum absent. Scanty expectoration, falls in round lumps, dark
cherry-red, in pneumonia. Blood comes up with hawking. Thin, gelatinous sputum, worse mornings and during
day.
Male - Crawling and stinging in glans penis. Orchitis, testicles feel swollen and hard. Bruised pain in testicles,
swollen, hard. Stinging and crawling in glans. Scrotum drawn up. Skin of left side of scrotum studded with
minute vesicles, with a humid discharge. Frequent erections and emissions. Painful erections. Sexual desire
decreased, with relaxed parts, tingling in parts. Fits of lasciviousness. Emissions even after sex.
Modalities - Better in open air. Better from rest. Better warm sweat. Better wine. Better sitting still. Worse
from fright, shock. Worse violent emotions, shock and vexation. Worse from being chilled by cold winds.
Worse dry weather. Worse sleeping in the sun. Worse warm room. Worse evening. Worse at night. Worse
while sweating, Worse pressure, touch. Worse lying on affected side. Worse getting into bed. Worse noise,
music. Worse tobacco smoke. Worse inspiration. Worse light. Worse dentition. Worse during menses.
Mouth - Burning, biting pain in mouth. Numb, dry and tingling. Lips black, dry, peeling off. Tingling,
numbness, burning of lips. Tingling on coughing and swallowing. Gums hot and inflamed. Everything tastes
bitter except water, which has bad taste. Trembling and temporary stammering. Dry burning heat in mouth.
Mouth - Breath cold, in cholera. Breath hot. Orifices of salivary ducts sore, as if corroded. Accumulation of
water in mouth. Saliva generally diminished. Saliva frothy, streaked red, sweetish. Trembling and temporary
stammering.
Nose - Frequent sneezing. Coryza, much sneezing, throbbing in nostrils. Coryza with headache, roaring in
ears, fever, sleeplessness. Hot water runs from nose. Pain at root of nose. Hemorrhage of bright red blood.
Mucus membrane dry. Posterior nares as if dry. Nose stopped up, dry or with but scanty watery coryza.
Numbness with nosebleed. Nosebleed, bright red blood. Smell acutely sensitive.
Perspiration - Bad effects from suppressed sweat. Profuse sweat, wants to uncover. Sweat on uncovered
parts or affected parts. Sweat on parts lain on. Cold or sour sweat. Cold sweat and icy coldness of face.
Drenching sweats. Profuse sweat with copious flow of urine and diarrhea.
Rectum - Pain with nightly itching and stitching in anus. Cholera. Frequent, small stool with tenesmus. Cholera
discharges with collapse, anxiety and restlessness. Constipation. Bleeding hemorrhoids (Ham.). Itching and
sticking at anus. Sensation as if a warm fluid escaping from the anus. Pain from seatworms.
Skin - Red, hot, swollen, dry, burning. Miliary eruptions. Itching relieved by stimulants. Itching unchanged
by scratching. Rash like measles. Purpura miliaris. Goosebumps. Formication and numbness. Papular
erythema. Erythema from sun's rays. Dry, hot skin. Skin as if ice water on it. Rash of children. Spots like flea-
 bites.
Sleep - Starting up in sleep. Sleeplessness with restless and tossing about. Sleeplessness caused by fear,
fright or anxiety. Sleeplessness with fear of the future. Nightly ravings. Insomnia of the elderly. Children cry
and complain, sleepless and restless (Ars., Cham.). Spasmodic yawning. Nightmares. Anxious dreams.
Dreams caused by fear, fright or anxiety. Long dreams with anxiety in chest. Vivid dreams of day's
occurrences.
Stomach - Pressure in stomach with dyspnea. Burning from stomach to esophagus. Tension in stomach better
eructations. Painful hiccough. Nausea and sweating before and after loose stool. Projectile vomiting. Drinks,
vomits and declares he will die. Vomiting of clear water, on sitting up. Vomiting with fear, heat, profuse
sweat and increased urination. Hematemesis. Vomiting, bilious, mucus and bloody, greenish. Vomiting of
lumbrici.
Stools - Bilious diarrhea of infants with colic. Diarrhea from getting wet. Slimy stools alternating with
constipation. Claycolored stools. Involuntary stools, on passing flatus. White stools with red urine. Stools of
pure blood. Slimy, grass green or white stools, worse hot days and cold nights. Green stools like chopped
herbs. Frequent, small stool with tenesmus. Dysentery. Watery diarrhea in children on hot days, restless and
sleepless.
Teeth - Toothache from cold or dry, cold winds. Teeth sensitive to cold. Toothache in sound teeth. Throbbing
in teeth and head. Grinding of the teeth. Gums hot and inflamed. Constantly moves lower jaw as if chewing.
Sensation as if teeth would fall out. Cold feeling in incisors.
Temperature - Cold stage most marked. Coldness and heat alternate. Evening chilliness soon after going to
bed. Cold waves pass through him. Chills down back. Chill passes through him in waves. Chill or coldness
alternating with heat. Chilly if uncovered or touched. Shivering ascends from feet to chest. Dry burning heat in
eyelids, nose, mouth, throat, lungs and palms, must uncover. High fevers. Dry burning heat, red face. Fevers
with mental anguish, restlessness. Thirst and restlessness.
Throat -Acute inflammation of the throat with high fever. Dark redness of throat. Chokes on swallowing,
talking. Tingling in the esophagus. Burning and stinging pains. Stinging pain in throat when swallowing.
Scraping, tingling sensation of strangling, burning and pricking in the throat. Red, dry, constricted. Numbness
and prickling. Sensation of contraction in the throat. Inability to swallow, with hoarseness. Hoarseness with
pain when talking. Hoarseness after speaking or singing. Voice husky, can scarcely speak. Croup with fever.
Croaking voice. Laryngitis with fever. Larynx very sensitive. Uvula as if elongated. Tonsillitis. Tonsils dark red.
Tonsils swollen and dry.
Tongue - Burning vesicles on tip of tongue. Tongue feels as if swollen. Tongue coated white (Ant-c.). Tongue
coated thick yellow white. Tongue swollen. Tongue tip tingles. Middle of tongue as if dry and numb. Sensation
as if cold air passing over tongue. Tongue dry, red on sides, centre thinly coated white. Tongue red and dry.
Vertigo - Vertigo, worse on rising (Nux-v. Op.), and shaking head. Vertigo on rising from bed. Vertigo on
getting up from one's seat. Vertigo on stooping or moving. Sensation of intoxication or dizziness in the head,
loss of consciousness. Vertigo with inclination to fall to right side. Vertigo with nausea and vanishing of sight.
Vertigo from fright, anger. Vertigo after a shock. Vertigo from heat of sun.
Vision - Dim vision or vision entirely lost. Lost vision after fright or shock. Optical illusions in dark colors or
black. Flicker- ings make him anxious, fears he might touch people passing by. Total blindness after catching
cold. Sparks, with burning and twitching in eyes. Obscuration of vision, when shaking head. Black spots and
mist before the eyes.
COMMENTS - Aconite is a tall, upright plant that has dark blue flowers, 4-5 feet tall. Aeon, grows in the damp
and covered parts of almost every mountainous country in north or middle of Europe, especially in Switzerland,
Germany and Sweden. It grows in high altitudes where there is a lot of wind, storms and activity. It is a very
poisonous herb, vinegar in large doses is antidotal to the toxic effects. Aconite in potencies above the 4c is a
perfectly safe medicine for any age.
Before Hahnemann's time Aconite had a reputation as a sudorific and in cases of rheumatism, sciatica and
tumors, but it was not until Hahnemann proved it that its properties were really understood. Aconite was the
remedy by means of which Hahnemann was able to meet most of the conditions, which in his day were treated
by bloodletting.
Dr. Hughes has remarked that the condition to which Aeon, is homeopathic is one of tension. Emotional and
mental tension, as shown in fright or fear and its consequences, anxiety and fear of death, tension of the
systemic vessels, as in the effects of a chill.
Asiatic cholera and hemorrhages. Muscular tension, as in tetanus. Tension of involuntary muscles, as in heart
spasms. Tension of the semi-involuntary muscular apparatus of respiration, as in asthma.
Hahnemann described it as a tempest, Kent, too. This is the idea of the remedy, it’s a storm that has a sudden
 onset and a sudden dissipation. Keynote sudden onset, a major trigger for this is shocking fright. Violent
reactions to fright or weather conditions.
Teste related a remarkable case of an Englishman who had been obliged to take a long sleigh journey in North
Russia in midwinter. He suffered thereafter for two years from violent paroxysms of palpitations and acute
stitching pains in the heart region, threatening brain strokes.
Aneurysm had been diagnosed by leading physicians in England and on the Continent. Teste localized the
affection to neurosis or spasm of the pectoralis major muscle and proved his diagnosis by promptly curing it
with Aeon.
Chill and fever. Fevers with restlessness and tossing about, often accompanied with anxiety that sometimes
leads to fear of death. Aeon, can ward off serious results from chill, fright, injury or surgical operation.
It was the feverish restlessness of the Aeon, provings that led Hahnemann to infer its similarity to fever states.
It is the presence of this restlessness, anxiety, fear and exalted sensibility that are its leading indications in
cases of all kinds.
High fevers, sudden surges of body temperature. Inflammatory fevers (Bell, is also inflammatory, Pyrog. and
Bapt. are septic). Fevers with wakefulness, anxiety, red and flushed.
“Clean” and functional fevers, no tissue changes, no mucus, no toxic symptoms. Can have thirst with the fever.
The skin is dry and hot.
The four keynotes are fear, fright, fast, and fevers. It's a remedy for a lot of fears (Ars.) and any acute problems.
Fright followed by speechlessness or shaky trembling speech, shaking of the hands and limbs, dilated pupils,
and the patient may be frozen with fear and shaking.
Panic with shaking and trembling. Frail, faint, and anxious. Sudden surges of adrenaline through the body
leading to shaking, trembling, fear, panic. Panic attacks with numbness and tingling of fingers or down the
arms, in the extremities. Attacks with feeling of anxiety, heart palpitations, fainting. Fear, not that they're going
to die (Ars.), but that they're dying right now. Conditions after fright. Hypersensitivity after a near death
situation. Fright leading to shock and panic. Fainting and heart attacks where the main feature is fear.
Fear and apprehension. Dread of crossing streets. Fear of the dark, fear of ghosts. Good for agoraphobia, fear
of going outside of the house. They have chronic fears of fatal disasters, fear that something will happen, that
they can't go out of the house because they will get into an accident.
The senses are heightened with sensitiveness to pain and a feeling of numbness in parts. Sensation as if
bound tightly in the limbs and in other parts (Cact.). Plethora may be classed under increased blood tension.
Active, bloody congestions of all kinds, especially those following a chill.
Intolerance to music. Patients may imagine some part of body is deformed, imagine they do all their thinking
from the stomach and predict the hour of their death. They sometimes go so far as to predict the day and hour
of death (clairvoyance). Extreme sensitiveness to light and sound and all sensations.
Extreme sensitivity to pain (Cham., Coff.). Pains are intolerable, driving to desperation. Tearing, cutting,
burning, sharp, stabbing pains, with restlessness, accompanied by numbness, tingling or formication.
Cannot bear the pain, cannot bear to be touched, cannot bear to be covered. Burning pains (Phos.). Feel the
blood rushing everywhere. The child or the person screams with pain. Pain causes fright, specifically from
heart attack or any acute pain. Frozen from the pain and what that pain means.
Bending double relieves the colic and dysmenorrhea pain (Coloc.). Motion aggravates the pains in muscles,
joints and stiffness. There is a great and sudden sinking of strength, fainting on attempting to get up, with
anxiety, restlessness, numbness, tingling, formication.
Hemorrhage and shock due to sudden hemorrhaging of bright blood, causing giddiness, faintness, panic
(Aeon.. Bell., Phos.). Active hemorrhages in stout, full- blooded people. Passes almost pure blood in stool. In
hemoptysis the blood comes up with great ease by hemming and coughing, bright red in large quantities from
cold, dry winds. Bleeding with great fear, anxiety and palpitations.
Toothaches are one-sided with red cheek on same side. Severe toothaches where the teeth are sensitive,
painful and the person is in a panic.
Inflammations of the eyes from cold, injury, foreign objects, dust, surgical operations, scrofulous inflammation
with enlarged glands. Blindness.
Hirsch of Prague recorded two such cases, one in a man of thirty who went to bed well, having walked home
in rough and stormy weather after spending the evening in a hot room. Aeon. 3c was given and the following
night he perspired freely and in the morning his sight was restored.
Hirsch himself suddenly lost his sight while bathing in hot weather. He took Aeon. 3c in water as he had given
it to his patient. In two hours he began to perspire and after a six-hours' sleep awoke well.
Every inspiration increases the cough. Tingling sensation in the chest after coughing. Unquenchable thirst,
everything tastes bitter except water (Chin.). In croup, the child grasps the throat with every coughing fit. Dry,
 hacking cough especially from being exposed to a dry, cold wind
Worse exposed to hot weather or cold weather. Coldness, numbness and tingling characterize the paralyzes
and neuroses. Facial paralysis from exposure to cold, dry winds. Sunstroke. Diarrhea from heat and sun
exposure.
Headaches caused by exposure to the sun, also heat rashes. Headaches are generally better in open air,
worse in warm room, toothache and cough worse in open air. Better from uncovering, the bed is intolerable.
Worse chill with fever. Sweat on affected or covered parts.
After exposure to cold, croup, severe colds and respiratory problems, bronchitis, infants get pneumonia, and
it can go to facial paralysis. Worse cold, dry wind, sudden onset, numbness and tingling of the limbs all
keynotes of Aconite. Chills with ailments. Asthma from exposure to cold, dry weather that brings out panic,
worse around midnight. Earaches from exposure to cold and wind.
In general, for croup, heart attacks, acute bronchitis and colds, and tonsillitis. Sometimes strep throat. First aid
for fright. Infantile pneumonia with sudden onset. Childhood diseases with fevers and restlessness, meningitis.
Retention of the urine, especially in newborn infants.
Generally aggravated at night, particularly about midnight.
RELATIONS - Aconitum napellus is related in its action to the other Aconites and to Aconiti- num, and also to
the Ranunculacee, Act-r., Act- sp.. Paeon., Podo., Ran-b., Staph. Antidoted by: Acet-ac., Alcohol, Paris.
Acids, wine and coffee, lemonade and acid fruits modify its action. Antidotes: Cham., Bell., Coff., Spong.,
Petr., Nux-v., Sep., Sulph. Compare: ( 1) Similar to Ars., Bell., Calend., Ferr-p. (2) Cham, and Coffea intense
pain and sleeplessness. (3) Agrostis acts like Aeon, in fevers and in inflammations, also, Spiranthes. (4) Bapt.
or Pyrogen in high fevers with sudden onset. (5) Puls., Lyc., Sec. and Camph. are also better from uncovering.
(6) Cham., Hep. and Coff. - intolerance of pain. (7) Chin. - white stool. (8) Gels. - effects of bad news, fright,
anger. (9) Nux-v. and Bry. - diarrhea from anger. (10) Bry. - effects of cold, dry winds. (11) Sulph. is
the chronic of Aeon., it will often complete an action that Aeon, begins, and will cure cases in which Aeon, is
apparently indicated but fails to relieve. Complementary to: Coff. - in fever, sleeplessness, intolerance of
pain. Am. in bruises, Calend. injury to eye. Sulphuroften completes a cure begun with Aconite. Follows well:
Am., Coff., Sulph., Verat.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.
keynote:
PHARMACY- acon-1. Aconitum lycoctonum. Great yellow wolfsbane. Aconitum tely- phonum. Badgers bane.
 N. O. Ranunculacee. Tincture of fresh plant when coming into bloom. The only aconite which does not contain
Aconitine. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Allergies. Constipation. Coughs. Diarrhea. Glands, enlargement. Hodgkin's disease. Liver
disorders. Mastitis. Pork, effects. Strangury.
HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of Aeon, lycoctonum, while resembling those of the other Aconites in some

name: Actea Spicata
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - act-sp. Actea spicata. Baneberry. Herb Christopher. Radix christophoriana. N. O.
Ranunculacee. Europe and Asia. Tincture of root obtained in autumn. Historical dose: Tincture and all
potencies.
CLINICAL -Arthritis. Cancer, stomach. Fright, effects. Headaches. Hepatitis. Insomnia. Joint, pain. Pleurisy.
Rheumatism. Toothache. Wrist, pain.
HOMEOPATHIC - Rheumatism (Cimic.), particularly affecting the small joints and wrists (Caul.). Rheumatism
of the wrist, particularly the right wrist and arm. Joints are swollen and pains are worse by touch and
movement. Slight fatigue causes swelling of the joints. Violent tearing, drawing and tingling pains. Pains are
worse from touch and motion.
Rheumatism like pains in the face. Pains mnning from decayed tooth to temples. Symptoms are liable to
appear from fright and fatigue. Shortness of breath on exposure to cold. Old age. Hypersensitive to cold,
weakness. Paralytic weakness of affected part. Pulsations over whole body, especially liver and kidney region.
Cardiovascular spasms. Hepatitis. Pleurisy.
MIND - Fearful, starts easily, confused. Fear of death, especially at night in bed. Furious delirium, also during
the fever. Effects of exertion of mind, fright, or mental anxiety.
Abdomen - Spasmodic retraction. Sticking pain and distention of hypogastrium. Pain and tenderness in liver
region.
Constitutions - Weak, nervous, cold sweat. Rheumatic diathesis. It is especially suited to men (Cimic. to
women).
Ears - Twitching pain on sneezing or blowing the nose.
Eyes - Objects seem colored blue. Sharp pains through eyes into head.
Face - Violent pain in upper jaw, running from teeth through malar bones, to temples. Perspiration on face and
head. The cheek he lies on sweats. Yellow around mouth. Lips are chapped. Submaxillary glands hurt when
chewing.
Female - Menses suppressed by fright or cold.
Food - Hunger with aversion to food. More appetite in morning. Disgust for food. Shuddering after drinking.
 Head - Rush of blood to head, excited by drinking coffee. Throbbing in brain. Pain from crown to between
eyebrows, heat in forehead, pain in left frontal eminence as if bone were crushed. Itching of scalp alternating
with heat. Warm sweat on head. Small pimples on scalp.
Heart - Urging sensation in heart towards abdomen and region of liver with great anxiety at night.
Kidneys - Throbbing in region of kidneys. Urine deposits a white sediment. Kidney stones.
Limbs - Tearing pains in loins. Rheumatic pains in small joints, wrist, fingers, ankles toes. Swelling in
joints from slight fatigue. Wrist swollen, red, worse any motion. Paralytic weakness in the hands. Lame
feeling in arms. Pain in knee. Sudden lassitude after talking or eating.
Lungs - Short, irregular breathing at night, while lying. Great oppression. Shortness of breath on exposure
to fresh air. Difficult inspiration, stitches in the epigastrium.
Modalities - Worse from change of weather or temperature. Worse cold air. Worse night.Worseh
touch.Worses light exertion. Worse fatigue and mental exertion.
Mouth - Increased salivation. Fetid odor. Nose - Nose red at tip, fluent coryza.
Sleep - Obstinate insomnia, sleeplessness, unable to rest (Coff.).
Stomach - Tearing, darting pains in epigastric region with vomiting. Cramp-like pains in stomach and
epigastrium with
Actea spicata difficult breathing. Sudden lassitude after eating. Sour vomiting. Cancer of the stomach with
tearing, drawing pains.
Temperature - Shuddering after drinking. Shuddering followed by fever during which vomiting supervenes.
Belching during the chill.
Throat - Throat sore when speaking, when breathing cold air.
Vertigo - Dizziness, forehead feels empty when stooping. Vertigo with tearing headache, better in open air.
COMMENTS - Rheumatism, arthritis, osteoarthritis. Rheumatoid arthritis, arthritis of the small joints, wrists,
fingers and toes (Caul.). Rheumatism, weakness, trembling, spasmodic action of muscles. Epileptic and
hysterical convulsions. Sharp pains in various parts. Pains come on suddenly, pains like electric shocks.
Boericke said, “Rheumatic remedy of the small joints and specific for wrist rheumatism.” “Worse touch and
motion” and “oppression of the chest and shortness of breath.”
Grimmer wrote that it had been successfully used in cancer of the stomach. Sour vomiting after drinking with
tearing, darting pains in epigastric region. Increased salivation, fetid odor from mouth.
Vertigo - Vertigo, fear of death, especially when in bed at night. Furious delirium, also during fever, mental
anxiety. Bad effects from fatigue and fright.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cimic., Caul., Led. (2) Other Ranunculacee, Am., Bry. (3) Caul. - Rheumatism
of fingers. (4) Lyc., Rhus t., Ruta, Sal-ac., and Stict. - Small joints. Complementary: Caul., Coloc., Sabin.,
Stict., Viol-o.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Adamas
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - adam. Adamas. White Diamond. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Aphonia. Backache. Belching. Bladder, disorders. Bone, pains. Brain, tumors. Chilliness. Cold,
sores. Constipation. Coughs. Cramps. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Fever. Fever, blisters. Flatulence. Hair, loss.
Headaches. Heat. Hemorrhoids. Hyperactive. Insomnia. Itching. Leucorrhea. Moles. Nausea. Nightmares.
Nosebleed. Numbness. Palpitations. Photophobia. Pimples. Skin, dryness. Sprained joints. Stiffness. Tingling.
Tonsillitis. Varicose, veins. Vertigo. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Adamas has associations with the word “Adamantine” meaning unbreakable, impenetrable,
impregnable. The Greek word “adamas” means “unyielding, invincible.”
Chilliness. Feeling very cold and shivering inside, deep down in bones is freezing cold. Body temperature
unusually warm. Sensation of heat all over, all day.
Increased appetite and thirst. Loss of appetite. Craving for coffee, fruit, smoked salmon. Unrefreshing sleep.
Frightful dreams. Dryness of skin. Whole body is sensitive, bones aching, skin hurts.
MIND - Irritable and taciturn. Anger towards friends, loved ones. Irritated easily by words and gestures. Does
not like to work. Resentful towards others. Does not want to be seen. Aversion to company, talking. Desire to
be alone. Feelings of worthlessness. Loss of self confidence. Critical of others and self. Hard to be pleased.
Mind feels cloudy. Feels separated and detached. Indecision. Does not stick to one decision. Forgetful. Weak
memory. Poor concentration. Fumbles in speech with difficulty in getting at certain well-known words. Makes
mistakes in speaking. Spelling mistakes. Mixing up words. Mistakes in speech. Slurred speech. Lethargic in
morning.
 Anxiety about health. Anxiety felt in stomach. Fear of driving car, obsessed with
crashing and accidents and death, fear of breast cancer. Despair about their recovery. Delusion they have two
pairs of hands, two pairs of arms.
Impatient and intolerant. Hurried and impatient. Feels rushed, so much to do. Feels overwhelmed.
Hyperactive, since beginning of proving. Very excitable as if about to lose control. Sensitive to music. Tearful
and oversensitive.
Feels trapped and helpless. Sad and moody. Mood swings. Despair. Lack of joy. Depressed and body feels
heavy. Desire for order, everything needs to be in it's place. Fastidious. Feels disorganized. Obsessed with
trifles.
Abdomen - Bloated abdomen. Much smelly, nausea-inducing flatulence. Muscles aches, worse cough, worse
movement. Shooting pains in lower abdomen in the evening. Needle like cutting pains. Sharp pain, left
hypochondria upwards to left breast and inner left upper arm. Groin hurts when coughs.
Back - Back cold in bed. Chilliness down the back, waist, shoulder blades and spine. Backache, very painful,
better heat of bath. Feels better when lying down. Dull aching across back of shoulders, neck with pressure
downwards. Severe backache while walking. Pain aching across lumbar region. Low back pain. Sharp
shooting pains.
Bladder - Sharp bladder pain across pubic bone above penis. Very dark, orangey brown urine. Diminished
urination. Urine smells ketonic.
Breasts - Breasts feel enlarged. Fizzy feeling in right breast. Shooting pains through right breast, like needles.
Chest - Spot above left breast. Contracting feeling in chest. As chest if expanded, opened up. Heat rising from
chest to face. Pain in base of left ribs corresponding with pain of left vertex. Sharp pain under ribs. Tight chest
with cough.
Coughs - Racking, distressing cough. Incessant, exhausting, constant cough. Deep, barking cough. Coughing
up bloody mucus, felt cold and clammy. Suffocative cough, difficult to inspire.
Coughs - Cough with chill, shivering and heaviness in limbs, head and eyes. Loose cough with tight chest.
Coughing up bloody mucus. Cough with catarrh in nose and throat. Spasmodic cough, better from sips of cold
water. Cough, worse deep inspiration, worse morning, aggravated from cold air or drinks. Burning pain with
cough. Sharp pain on coughing. Explosive, wet, violent cough. Vomiting from coughing. Wet cough. Cough
from anger.
Dreams - Dreams of friends betraying him and felt disappointed. Dream of protection, violence, murder.
Dreams of betrayal, conspiracy, lies and deception. Dreams of traveling, water, babies. Dreams of cliffs and
chasr. s.
Ears - Sensation as if ears were filled with water. Buzzing in both ears. Hearing is very sensitive. Hearing
impaired.
Eyes - Sticky eyes on waking, eyes watery. Bloodshot. Heat and heavy sensations. Itching, eyes. Photophobia.
Twitching. Very tired with gritty eyes. Sensation as if something in the eyes.
Face - Redness of face with burning dry heat. Deep ache in right jaw. Numbness left side of face when in cold
air. Dark rings under the eyes. Blemishes on face like spots underneath the skin.
Female - Menses scanty. First day of period very painful. Uterus feels heavy, full aching. Uterus feels as if
hanging, suspended in space. Ovarian pain, cramping both sides. Stabbing, knifing pains through abdomen
and groin, as if knives were cutting up inside vagina and womb. Severe pulling, as if being dragged down
physically by pelvic bone. Pains worse during morning, and when eating. Eruption on right labia with white
head. Vagina and labia itching, hot and burning. Voluptuous itch in vagina. Leucorrhea, thick, white, bland
vaginal discharge. Heat in vagina with soreness at start of menses. Desire for sex diminished. Aversion to sex.
Food - Aversion to cream, fats, milk. Aversion to white wine. Desires alcohol, cheese, coffee. Desires fruit,
dried fruit, sparkling drinks. Desires seafood, fish, smoked salmon. Desires starchy food, potatoes. Desires
vegetables, green vegetables. Desires wine, red wine. Worse from alcohol. Cold drinks aggravate coughs.
Head - Headache and hunger. Dull and aching pains. Headaches with nausea. Headaches, worse exertion.
Hair falling out. Scalp itching and dry. Heat sensation in vertex. Pain over eyebrows. Sharp pains in head.
Head feels heavy and congested.
Heart - Heart palpitations. As if heart skips and jumps a beat. Palpitation with anxiety all through day.
Limbs - Cold arms. Chilliness. Hands hot and clammy. Burning pain in ankle. Sensation of heat on soles of
feet. Cramp in calves during sleep. Heavy feeling in my arms. Aching pain in wrists and elbows. Sharp pains
like pins in hand. Numbness. Sprained joints. Stiffness. Tingling in legs. Varicose veins. Wrists feel weak.
Lungs - Dyspnea. Difficulty breathing in. Burning in lungs on breathing in. Wheeze like a high-pitched whine
on breathing. Wheezing and struggling for breath like asthma. Gasping for air on inspiration, during and after
coughing fit. Sensitive bronchi.
 Male - Penis sore. Low sex drive.
Modalities - Better sunshine. Better fresh air. Worse cloudy days. Worse winter.
Mouth - Dry mouth and throat. Fever blisters. Cold sores. Lips very dry, sore and chafed. Bottom lip cracked
in middle, split open. Rawness of palate. Offensive breath better after glass of water. Increased salivation.
Neck - Sore neck, very stiff, aching, better lying down and stretching. Cricking of neck.
Nose - Nosebleed. Catarrh white, stringy, thick and glossy, worse evening. Postnasal catarrh. Sinuses feel full
and congested.
Perspiration - Body odor smells acidic. Perspiration smells garlicky. Hot sweats during day.
Rectum - Urgent desire to pass stool. In the morning has to rush for stool. While going to sleep sudden urging
for stool. Much flatulence. Constipated, dark, round balls. Skin around the anus is raw and sore. Hemorrhoids.
Hot itch in anus. Diarrhea, feel weak and drained afterwards. Diarrhea, preceded with gripping cramps. Loose,
watery stools. Stool extremely pale. Hard, small stools. Unfinished feeling with bowel movement.
Skin - Dryness of skin. Pale skin. Large, painful cold sores in left corner of upper lip. Moles. Pimples, very
sore, red and elevated. Dry, brownish-red eczema-like rash. Itching with redness, especially after a bath. Skin
very painful, feels prickling and cold. Itchy pimples on right arm. Bumps and spots on left side of face.
Sleep - Insomnia. Waking frequently. Sleep unrefreshing, awoke tired. Deep yawning. Restless, sleep.
Stomach - Belching. Burning sensation. Cold sensation in stomach. Nausea and distention with headache.
Nausea at thought of milk in tea since proving. Feel sick when eating or drinking, worse in morning. Feel
nauseous but hungry. Vomiting from coughing. Bruised soreness in epigastric region.
Teeth - Grinding teeth. Teeth feel sharp. Pains in back molar teeth. Bruised sore feeling above right upper
canine tooth, worse cold air, pain extends up into the jawbone.
Temperature - Chilliness down the back, waist, shoulder blades and spine. Icy cold body generally. Skin felt
icy, freezing. Shaking with cold when sitting still. Chill, unable to keep warm, must go to bed. Cold shivers all
over body. Fever, sudden onset. Fever with shaking, heat, sneezing and coughing.
Throat - Sore throat, better eating or drinking hot things. Sensation of needles pricking in throat. Adenoids and
tonsils sore from coughing. Tonsils red and inflamed. Aphonia.
Tongue - Burning sensation down the middle of tongue. Tongue feels swollen on the left side. Tongue is
coated, white.
Vertigo - Dizzy, worse sitting down, better eating. Sensation on closing the eyes, as if rotating clockwise.
Vertigo on closing eyes, floating feeling in head.
COMMENTS - Although extremely hard, diamond is very brittle, being able to tolerate great pressure, yet being
sensitive to violent jarring or shock. It will likely to be a remedy that aids recovery from psychological or physical
trauma, recent or past.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Plb-i.
REFERENCES - Sankaran. Sherr.

name: Adelheid Aqua
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - adel. Adelheid aqua. Mineral Springs at Heilbrunn. Adelheidsquelle. Contains among other
substances, Iodine, Bromine, Alumina, Natrum, etc. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Diarrhea. Glands, disorders. Goiter. Scrofulous, disorders.
HOMEOPATHIC -This waterhasbeen used for hundreds of years forgoiter, scrofulous troubles of various
kinds, enlarged glands, etc.
MIND - Mental confusion. Reading fatigues them (Nat-m., Ruta). Much trilling and tra-la- ling. which formerly
she never did.
Abdomen - Ache in upper abdomen wakes him. Lower abdomen became thick and protruding. Loud rumbling,
grumblings and noises in the lower part of the abdomen after every eating or drinking, especially after pears.
Chest - Chest is tired. The whole chest is painfully sensitive, as if inflamed.
Eyes - Eyes feel swollen, as after taking cold, without redness.
Face - Cheeks became full and the face red, was formerly thin and pale.
Food - Increased appetite. Appetite for potatoes and sour fruit. Aversion to meat and roasted articles. Unusual
thirst. After drinking water, the appetite increased and then became conversational and lively.
Head - Confusion of head, better in open air.
Limbs - Small, hard indurations in the palm of the hand, very near the last joint of the fourth finger, adherent
to the bone. After rising in the morning, cramp in left calf twice disappeared after going around.
Male - Testicles sensitive.
Mouth - Salivation, especially nights.
 Neck - Swollen thyroid gland, but not the cervical and inferior maxillary glands.
Nose - Nosebleed and much tossing about the bed at night (lod.). Nosebleed after beginning to take the waters
the second time.
Rectum - Diarrhea, watery, clear brown, then yellow and watery, four or five times a day with much offensive
flats, no pains.
Skin - Hard pimples with a red inflamed areola, itching somewhat with a yellow, pustular apex, somewhat
moist on scratching it off (like small boils), on neck, chest, fingers and toes (Sil.).
Stomach - Painful flatulent distention in pit of stomach.
RELATIONS - Spirit-nit-dulc., antidotes. Coffee drinking relieved the attacks, especially the rumblings. Nat-c.
relieved the diarrhea. Compare: (1) lod., Nat-c., Nat-m., Sil.
REFERENCES - Allen.

name: Adlumia Fungosa
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - adlu. Adlumia fungosa. Climbing fumitory. Fumaria fungosa. N.O. Papaveraceae.
CLINICAL - Bladder, disorders. Chilly. Constipation. Dyspnea. Flatulence. Headache. Impotence. Infertility.
Kidney, stones. Nail, disorders. Nausea. Nightmares. Me- teorism. Palpitations. Rash. Styes. Vertigo.
Weakness.
HERBAL - Fumaria species have long been valued as medicinal herbs for chronic skin rash and kidney stones,
in which its success was ascribed to its sweat-inducing capacity, as well as its blood-purifying effect by means
of the urinary organs.
French and German physicians prefer it to most other medicines as a purifier of the blood.
Sometimes the dried leaves are smoked in the manner of tobacco, for disorders of the head. The plant was
also believed to be useful in infertility.
HOMEOPATHIC - Sense of weakness, must lie down. Great weariness towards end of afternoon, must lie
down. Chilliness, yet better open air. Pain extends to left scapula or to left arm. Meteorismus from smoking.
Slow growth of nails.
MIND - Causeless sadness. Sadness and joyless for days. Difficult concentration. Mistakes in writing. Euphoria
when weariness subsides.
Abdomen - Flatuence. Distended sensation in abdomen and rumbling. Pressure in hepatic region. Pressing
pain in epigastrium after eating, better lying on abdomen. Sensation of weakness in abdomen at 11 p.m.
Chest - Oppression in left side of chest.
Eyes - Styes, lower lidofright eye. Swelling of lower lid of right eye.
Female - Sexual power diminished.
Food - Desires cold milk. Better cold food. Worse beer, fats, sausages. Intolerance to fatty food. Nausea from
sausage.
Head - Headache, worse 3 a.m. Headache better fresh evening air, better rainy weather. Headache and
nausea and vertigo. Congestion of head and face from flatulence pressing upward. Right-sided headache.
Heart - Palpitations of heart.
Limbs - Pain in finger joints.
Lungs - Dyspnea. Sensation of breathlessness.
Male - Sexual power diminished. Impotence. Too quick ejaculation.
Modalities - Better fresh evening air. Better lying on abdomen. Better pressure. Better coffee. Worse evening.
Worse after exposure to heat of sun. Worse 3 a.m. Worse afternoon, 2 p.m. to 5 p.m.
Mouth - Discoloration of tongue. Tongue coated white.
Rectum - Constipation, difficult discharge of soft stool. Ineffectual urging and straining. No stool for days.
Frequent urging in afternoon, but passes only yellow mucus. Flatulence and soft stool. Meteorism.
Frequent stools at 4 p.m. to 6 p.m. Hard, knotty stool. Soft, light-colored stool.
Sleep - Disturbed sleep. Wakes at 3 a.m., tosses about and finally falls asleep again. Restless sleep from
constipation during daytime. Falling asleep difficult from palpitations of heart. Sleepiness during daytime, worse
in afternoon, irresistible desire to lie down. Frequent waking with tormenting thoughts. Nightmares. Frightful
dreams, even during short afternoon naps.
Stomach - Pressing pain in stomach after meals. Nausea and pain in epigastrium extending to left scapula.
Nausea from smoking. Nausea from beer. Nausea better after eating.
Vertigo - Vertigo on slight exertion. Vertigo with headache and nausea.
REFERENCES - Bayr. Grieve.
 ***ADONIS AESTIVALIS
PHARMACY - adon-ae. Adonis aestivalis. N. O. Ranunculaceae. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL-Dyspnea. Heart, disorders. Heart, weakness. Pulse, rapid.
HOMEOPATHIC - This plant was examined by Italian doctors as to its therapeutic value and Albertoni reported
in its favor. His experiments were made on animals and sick and healthy people.
Neither of these species of Adonis has been proved in homeopathy. There were some attempts to prove
Adonis vernalis, but the results were very meager. It seems to cause irritation of the bladder, strangury, etc.,
but all cardiac medicines do that.
In cases of insufficiency of heart action, with feeble, irregular, rapid pulse, diminished arterial pressure,
dyspnea and diminished excretion of urine. The administration of the plant in substance produced, in a few
days, the return of normal pulse, increase of the pressure of the blood, and disappearance of the respiratory
oppression. The quantity of urine increased from eight hundred to three thousand cubic centimeters in a day.
COMMENTS - These good results were not obtained in cases in which the organs susceptible to the influence
of Adonis, such as the kidney epithelium, muscular fiber and the nerve apparatus of the heart, had already
retrograded to too great an extent.
The dose is 4 to 8 grains a day, given in substance or infusion. The effects manifest themselves about the
third day.
REFERENCES - Hale.

name: Adonis Vernalis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - adon. Adonis vernalis. Pheasant's eye. N. O. Ranunculacee. Infusion or tincture of fresh plant,
an extract, Adonidin. Historical dose: Tincture, five to ten drops of the tincmre. All potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Ascites. Dropsy. Dyspnea. Fatty, degeneration. Heart, disorders. Hydrothorax.
Myocarditis. Rheumatism. Tinnitus.
HERBAL - Adonis, like Cratageus and Conval- laria, is a popular herbal heart tonic. It is used as a heart
tonic after rheumatism, influenza or kidney infection. Adonis is not cumulative in action. Compensatory
hypertrophy of heart in cardiac stenosis and mitral regurgitation.
Adon, regulates the pulse increases the contracting power of the heart with increased urinary secretion. It is
valuable in cardiac dropsy, hydrothorax, ascites and anasarca.
HOMEOPATHIC - Adonis has not been proved, but the indications for its use have been defined from
experience. Indications include rapid and feeble action of the heart, dropsy, scanty urine with albumen and
casts. Valvular disease and cardiac asthma. There is no record of its uses in the potencies.
Adonis acts predominantly on the heart when it is affected after rheumatism, influenza or nephritis, where the
muscles of the heart are in the stage of fatty degeneration. Pains wander from place to place.
Regulates the pulse and increases the power of contractions of heart with more urinary secretions. Low vitality
with weak heart and slow, weak pulse. Most valuable in cardiac dropsy.
Hydrothorax, ascites or anasarca.
MIND - Anxiety about the heart. Apprehension.
Abdomen - Dropsy. Faint feeling in epigastric region with vertigo better out of doors. As if a heavy weight in
bowels. Sensation as if intestines would break on bending.
Back - Spine and neck stiff, aching pain with tired feeling. Stiffness of left cervical region and spine.
Ears - Tinnitus.
Eyes - Pupils dilated.
Food - Appetite, easy satiety after a few bites. Gnawing hunger. No thirst.
Head - Feels light headed. Aches across front of head. Pain from occiput around temples to eyes. Scalp
feels tight. Pain in occiput, extending to eyes, around temples.
Heart - Weakness of circulatory system and dropsy. Dropsy. Murmurs, valvular disease. Arrhythmia. Heart
failure. Mitral and aortic regurgitation. Chronic aortitis. Fatty heart pericarditis. Rheumatic Endocarditis (Kalm.).
Precordial pain, palpitations and dyspnea. Marked venous engorgement. Fatty heart. Myocarditis, irregular
heart action, constriction and vertigo. Weak, fatty, arrhythmic heart. Precordial pain, palpitations and dyspnea.
Trembling and palpitations. Pulse rapid, irregular.
Kidneys - Nephritis. Urging to urinate. Albuminuria, urine scanty, oily pellicle on urine.
Limbs - Aching in nape. Spine stiff and aching. Edema.
Lungs - Cardiac asthma (Queb.). Frequent desire to take a long breath. Feeling of weight on chest. Difficult
breathing, worse touching back. Dry tickling, cardiac cough.
Modalities - Better from exertion. Better walking open air. Worse from cold. Worse lying down.
 Mouth - Slimy. Tongue dirty, yellow, sore, feels burnt. Sensation as if tongue were scalded.
Skin - Vesicles on the skin.
Sleep - Dozing as soon as eyes are closed. Falling asleep and palpitations. Sleeplessness with rambling
thoughts or horrible dreams. Restless with horrible dreams.
Stomach - Heavy weight sensation. Gnawing hunger. Faint feeling in epigastrium. Better out of doors.
Vertigo - Faintness and vertigo, better open air. Vertigo, worse turning or moving head quickly. Vertigo on
lying down. Vertigo on rising. Vertigo with palpitations.
COMMENTS - Cash gave great relief to “a water-logged patient of seventy-four” with mitral regurgitation with
one-grain doses of Adonidin at eight-hour intervals after the failure of Ars. and Dig. Urinary secretion rose from
half a pint to 21/2 pints in 24 hours. Breathing was relieved, sleep returned.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Conv., Crat., Dig., Strop.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Adrenalinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - adren. Adrenalinum. Adrenal glands. Extract of adrenal glands. Sarcode. Tincture or trituration.
Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL -Addison's disease. Adrenahn neuralgias. Allergies. Angina pectoris. Asthma. Bronzed skin.
Debility. Hematuria. Hemorrhages. Hyperemia. Neuralgia. Palpitations. Tachycardia.
HOMEOPATHIC - Adrenaline or Epinephrine, the active principle of the medulla of the suprarenal gland, is
employed as a chemical messenger in the regulation of the activities of the body in fact. Its presence is
essential to the activity of the sympathetic nerves.
Adrenaline appears to possess a very powerful local action over dilated blood vessels. When injected into the
circulation, blood pressure rises, the arteries being contracted. The general muscular system is affected, a
slight stimulus producing prolonged contraction.
Adrenalin has been suggested in acute congestion of lungs. Asthma. Addison's diseases and Grave's
diseases, Arteriosclerosis, chronic aortitis, angina pectoris, hemophilia, chlorosis, hay fever, serum rashes,
acute urticaria, etc.
Adrenalin’s chief therapeutic use depends on its vaso-constriction action, therefore a most powerful and
prompt astringent and hemostatic and invaluable in checking capillary hemorrhages from all parts, where
local or direct application is feasible including the nose, ear, mouth, throat, larynx, stomach, rectum, uterus,
and bladder.
Clinically effective inallergies, neuralgia, bronzed skin, debility, hematuria, palpitations, tachycardia,
hyperemia, exceedingly rapid pulse, loss of strength, wasting. May well be needed in cancer patients with
adrenal disturbance. Prolonged contraction of the general muscular system. Great loss of strength, rapid
emaciation. Rapid pulse and irregular intermitting heartbeats. General marked anemia.
MIND - Despondent and nervous. Ailments from overwork and stress. Apathy. Lack of interest in anything.
No ambition. Disinclination for mental work. Absence of mental stamina and will power. Anxious and restless.
Distracted easily. Aversion to mental activity. Cannot concentrate thoughts.
Abdomen - Rumbling in the intestines, borborygmus.
Back - Pain especially on the left side, better by sitting up straight or lying straight.
Ears - Aching in the left ear accompanies the headache, sharp pain in both ears at
times. Itching and tickling in right ear, better by boring into ear with finger.
Eyes - Strained feeling as though he wanted to open them wide or press upon them. Pain in the right eye.
Pressure on the eyes. Hyperemia of the conjunctiva. Aching in eyeballs, better by pressure and rubbing.
Face - Feels flushed but is not red. Flushes of heat over face and head, flushed throughout evening.
Food - Appetite increased. Ravenous hunger. Less thirst than usual. Thirst at times for large quantities,
 increased in the evening.
Head - Hot headache in left side, extending to right. Headache, worse by reading and in the morning, with a
feeling as though the eyes were strained. Frontal headache with congested nose and eyes. Burning heat in
head. Headache extending all over head. Severe pain, better by pressure on the eyes. Headache with nausea
and heat in face without redness. Neuralgic headaches. Brain feels swollen as though it were too large for
skull. Flushes of heat in the evening over face and head.
Kidneys - Strong odor, hot and scalding, frequent, profuse, pale. Burning before and during urination. Sudden
urgent desire to urinate. Amount of urine decreased, solids increased. Crystals of sodium oxalate increased
while sodium urate appeared during the proving and was very prominent, no casts.
Limbs - Slight rheumatic pains coming and going down leg. Arms and legs go to sleep easily, numbness and
tingling from below upwards. Corns on the toes. Aching in limbs on waking in the morning, aching in the calves.
Rheumatic pains in left elbow and little finger on waking. Legs tired and ache, especially in the calves and
below the knees. Ankles feel weak and tired. Painful swelling on first finger of right hand, resulting in a felon.
Tired aching in arms and legs on waking. Dull pain in arms and legs.
Lungs - Cough from irritation in suprasternal fossa. Expectoration of gelatinous mucus, which is hard to
detach. Increase of respiratory movements, soon followed by suffocation and death from paralysis of medulla
and pneumogastric.
Male - Sexual desire increased without erections. Erections, lascivious dreams all night causing waking from
sleep. Emissions in early morning without any bad effects.
Mouth - Bad taste on waking. Mouth filled with dark brown mucus, which has nasty taste. Tongue coated
white, red edge and tip. Tongue clean anteriorly, mouth dry. Tongue coated white at times posteriorly.
Nose - Congested, full feeling in nose. Gelatinous mucus drops from the posterior sinuses, difficult to detach.
On going out into the cold air had a copious, watery nasal discharge. Slight stuffiness in the nose with full
feeling at the root of the nose.
Rectum - Passage of foul flatus. Stool loose, brown, semi-solid, passed quickly with fetid odor. Sudden
spluttering diarrhea, all over in a minute, followed with burning in anus.
Sleep - Great sleepiness and drowsiness. Sleepy in evening and after a good night's sleep. Dullness and
sleepiness from 3 p.m. to 6 p.m.
Stomach - Belching after meals. Sensation of nausea as though he would vomit. Pain in stomach passing
from right to left, coming and going suddenly. Nausea before meals, though appetite is good after beginning
to eat.
Throat - Much hawking to clear throat. Vocal cords inflamed, laryngeal catarrh, profuse secretion from the
pharyngeal glands of whitish gelatinous mucus which was difficult to loosen. Right side swollen and sore, red
and inflamed, worse by swallowing.
COMMENTS - Leading features include bronzing of the skin, loss of strength, wasting, and exceedingly rapid
pulse. It has cured a case of hematuria accompanied by pain in the adrenal region.
Adrenaline has cured a number of cases of Addison's disease and has arrested others. It has been used locally
in cases of hyperemia of the conjunctiva, dissipating it almost immediately and thus rendering operations
possible.
Dr. P. Jousset reports success in treating, homeopathically, cases of angina and aortitis, sub-acute and
chronic, when Adrenalin has been prescribed per os and in infinitesimal dose. The guiding symptom is a
sensation of thoracic constriction with anguish. This, with vertigo, nausea and vomiting have been produced
by the drug. Abdominal pain. Shock or heart failure during anesthesia.
Adrenaline causes very prompt rise of blood pressure by its action on nerve endings in the vessel wall.

author: Murphy
full:

Dropsy. Dysentery. Edema. Fever. Gonorrhea. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hemorrhages. Hemorrhoids.
Impotency. Indigestion. Influenza. Jaundice. Kidney stones. Leprosy. Liver, disorders. Phlegm. Pneumonia.
Rabies. Ringworm. Water brash.
HERBAL - In Bengal, the leaves of this plant are kept in the drinking pot of patients suffering from dropsy with
the belief that drinking this water will accelerate the cure.
The leaves of the Aegle-f. are used by the Sannyasi (monks and ascetics) of India to suppress sexual desires
and excitement (Agn.) as they have found it produces sexual impotency. For seminal weakness and
 impotency.
HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Pramada Prasanna Biswas of Padna, Bengal, made a short proving of this drug using
a preparation from the leaves.
This remedy destroys phlegm, and is useful for fevers associated with catarrhal symptoms. Generally useful
for bowel complaints. Diarrhea and dysentery. Alternating diarrhea and constipation, it acts as a mild stimulant
to the intestinal mucus membrane. It can act as a laxative for existing constipation. Intestinal colic.
Dropsy, particularly when due to heart disease. Continued fever associated with dropsy, especially of children.
Dropsy in certain parts or throughout entire body. Bruised pains. Diminished appetite. Sensation of heat worse
movement, better rest. Weakness.
Leprosy. Bites from venomous animals such as snake, rabid dog and scorpion. Coughs, asthma, gonorrhea.
Jaundice, ascites associated with liver disorders. Bleeding piles. Hemorrhages. Anemia. Kidney stones.
Diseases of heart and hemicrania.
MIND - Mistakes in spelling. Anxiety with heat and bruised feeling. Lack of concentration while studying.
Abdomen - Pain, griping in the lower abdomen, worse after eating. Gripping pain in abdomen, worse
sitting, better from walking.
Back - Eruptions in scapular regions of back, red, small pimples, painful with thick white pus, itching worse
covering, rubbing. better open air.Pain, lumbarregion. Bruised pain, worse sitting, walking.
Chest - Sharp pain, worse during cough.
Eyes - Pain, soreness in the right eye, worse deep inspiration, sunlight, pressure. Sensation, as if sand in the
eye. Watery discharge, left eye, better closing eyes. Agglutination of eyelids, worse morning.
Face - Jaw, aching with soreness in throat worse chewing. Jaw, right soreness and tenderness with enlarged

Food - Appetite diminished with bad taste in mouth. Appetite diminished during fever. Appetite, increased with
increased thirst and sleepiness. Thirst for large quantity of water at short intervals. Desires rice, meat, milk.

Heaviness with soreness in right eye. Heaviness, with throat pain. Heaviness with thirst. Pain in frontal region
better open air, better pressure. Bursting pain, in forehead. Pressing pain in the right frontal region, with

Kidneys - Kidney stones. Urine yellow.
Limbs - Bruised pain, shoulders, hips, knee joints with sleepiness worse motion, better pressure. Aching pain
in the right hand worse movement of hand, holding anything by hand, better pressure. Pain in the knee joints
worse motion. Eruptions, both hands, pimples like, painful worse touch, pressure, better cold bathing.
Eruptions, lower limbs with itching, worse covering, warmth, better open air, undressing.
Lungs - Dyspnea, worse inspiration.
Mouth - Bitter taste in mouth. Salivation, profuse. Taste, bad with diminished appetite. Taste, bitter. Thick
yellow coating on the tongue during fever. Tongue flabby with imprints of teeth on edges. Tongue thick, moist

Nose - Watery discharge bland, white, worse bathing, change in temperature, better hot inhalation. Coryza,
bland white or watery discharge. Sneezing with heaviness of head, malaise, chilliness. Sneezing worse

profuse salivation, disturbed sleep.
Perspiration - Profuse sweat, all over the body, followed by weakness. Profuse, offensive sweat.
Skin - Pimple-like eruptions. Eruptions, papular, dark red, painful. Urticaria with itching. Urticaria with
redness and swelling with restlessness. Itching, worse warmth, covering, better cold bathing, undressing.
Sleep - Sleepiness day and night with uneasiness. Sleepiness with increased appetite and thirst.
Stomach - Nausea, vomiting with weakness. Nausea at the sight of food. Vomiting of watery fluid containing
food particles, sour smelling.
Stools - Semi-solid stool with diminished appetite and bad taste in mouth.
Temperature - Fever with weakness, diminishedappetite. Heat worse at midnight with bursting pain in
forehead. Fever without chill worse at night. Fever with thirst for large quantities of cold water.
Throat - Pain, bruised, amel. hot drinks. Pain, stitching with dry cough worse during deglutition, amel. hot
drinks. Soreness, worse swallowing. Soreness with aching in jaw worse chewing.
Vertigo - Vertigo worse lying down.
Vertigo worse physical exertion, better lying down. Vertigo worse on walking and standing. Vertigo with
darkness before eyes.
COMMENTS - An anti-psoric remedy, historically used for skin diseases such as itches and ringworm. An anti-
bilious and febrifuge remedy.
 Headache due to congestion. Headache between 4 a.m. and 8 p.m. (Lyc.). Heat in the vertex appears in the
evening, relieved by eating something. In the afternoon and evening, flushes of heat come out from the eyes
and face, and in the ear. All these symptoms disappear after eating.
Irregularity or disorder of the stomach, abdomen is distended and flatus passes with a loud sound, worse in
the afternoon. Water brash. Accumulation of wind in the lower abdomen. Constipation with flatus (Lyc.).
Indigestion, abdominal colic, piles and constipation (Nux-v.). Chronic gastrointestinal catarrh with flatulent
colicky pains. Decreased quantity of urine.
Slight pain in the back and lumbar region that is worse in the afternoon. All pains in the limbs are aggravated
after four p.m. Beriberi, with a full, strong and regular pulse (Dig., with irregular or intermittent pulse). Swollen
upper eyelids. Anasarca, ascites and edema of all sorts. Full, strong and regular pulse (Bell.).
Chronic fevers associated with hepatic and splenic disorders, with swollen feet, burning in the eye, face, hands,
and feet, no appetite, diminished urine, and cough. Continual fever. Fever with swelling in the hands, legs and
face. Catarrhal fevers in children. Fever with dropsy and diarrhea. Influenza, with fever and swollen face and
eyelids. Bronchitis and pneumonia.
Lt. Col. R. N. Chopra asserted that none of the preparations appear to possess any specific therapeutic
properties to cure either amoebic or bacillary dysentery, but its efficacy is certain in chronic cases with the
keynote symptoms.
Ghose noted the case of Babu Sarat Chandra Jana, aged 28, who had sudden swellings of his legs and feet
on March 2, 1932. His urine was examined, but there was no albumen present. The urine became scanty and
high-colored. Pain over the hepatic region. Giddiness of head and heart palpitations.
Ghose prescribed Boerhaavia Diffusa in drop doses to be taken thrice daily. The medicine was continued for
six days and the patient got rid of the swelling and other complaints within ten days.
Ghose had a second case, Babu Santiram Roy, aged 28, who had an epidemic dropsy on May 30,1932. He
was treated by several well-known allopaths of Calcutta, but nothing could lessen the swelling. Ghose was
called in on June 14.
The patient complained of a terrible headache, principally on the right side. Preexisting liver derangement, at
the time it was congested and painful to touch or pressure. Swollen hands, feet and abdomen. Scanty, high-
colored urine.
Cough with thick, white mucus expectoration. Throbbing pain in the cardiac region felt off and on. Ghose
prescribed Boerhaavia in 2-drop doses thrice daily. He was cured within a month.
Ghose cured more than 30 cases of epidemic dropsy with the help of this new drug.
Aegle marmelos contains almost all the identical therapeutic properties ascribed to Aegle folia.

name: Aegle Marmelos
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aegle. Aegle marmelos. Bel fruit. Bael fruit. Bael tree. N. O. Rutaceae. Historical dose: Tincture
and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Allergies. Asthma. Backache. Bronchitis. Coccygodynia. Conjunctivitis. Constipation. Coryza.
Dermatitis. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Dysentery. Dysmenorrhea. Eczema. Headaches. Hoarseness. Infertility.
Intermittent fever. Laryngitis. Lumbago. Migraines. Palpitations. Polyps, nasal. Rheumatism. Rhinitis.
Ringworm. Scabies. Spring catarrh. Stomatitis. Styes. Vertigo.
HERBAL - The aegle marmelos tree is indigenous to India and is found wild all over the Sub-Himalayan forests,
in Bengali, in Central and South India, and in Burma. It is also cultivated to a great extent.
Different parts of the bel tree are used in Ayurvedic medicine. The root bark is used in the form of a decoction
as a remedy in hypochondriasis, melancholia, intermittent fever and palpitation of the heart.
It constitutes an ingredient in the “Dasam- ul” or ten roots used by the Ayurvedic physicians. The leaves are
made into a poultice and applied to inflamed parts. The fresh juice is bitter and pungent, and when mixed with
water is praised as a remedy in catarrh and feverishness.
The fruit, both green and ripe, is used against diarrhea and intestinal conditions. For diarrhea and dysentery
the roasted or sun-dried unripe fruit cut in slices is general used. The astringent rind of the ripe fruit is employed
in dying and tanning and it is also used medicinally.
Ayurvedic physicians note that the ripe fruit is nutritious, delicious, aromatic, alternative and a laxative. It is
given with sugar candy to prevent the growth of piles and to remove habitual constipation.
When taken in excess it often causes flatulence. Syrup of ripe fruits is used in dyspepsia. The root bark is a
refrigerant, and is given in fevers and asthma, with palpitations of the heart.
In native practice, a poultice of the leaves is applied to the chest in acute bronchitis.
 The decoction of the Aegle leaves is given in asthma, a marmalade of bel fruit is a household remedy for
diarrhea and dysentery.
HOMEOPATHIC - A proving of Aegle marmelos was done by the Central Council for Research in
Homoeopathy of the Ministry of health and family welfare. Government of India, giving a good array of
symptoms. It showed a marked affinity for the gastrointestinal tract, skin and upper respiratory tract though it
has also evoked symptoms from head, eyes, genitalia, back and extremities.
A study to clinically confirm the symptoms elicited during provings is in progress and the data obtained so far
show its positive application in vertigo, styes, rhinitis, stomatitisanddermatitis. Nocturnal seminal emission
with amorous dreams.
Backache and cramps in calf muscles. Lachrymation and burning in eyes, better closing eyes. Allergic
conjunctivitis. Styes, especially when accompanied with stitching pain and sensation of dust particles in eyes
with lachrymation (Sulph., Staph.). Aphthae with difficulty in eating.
MIND - Disinclination to talk. Disinclination to work, with sadness. Irritability. Hypochondriasis. Melancholy.
Abdomen - Pain in abdomen around umbilicus. Rumbling in abdomen with diarrhea and increased thirst.
Back - Backache, better lying down worse, turning in bed. Pain in right lumbar region, worse walking, stooping.
Pain in coccyx, worse getting up, better walking, lying down.
Chest - Burning sensation in chest. Eruptions, small round patches on chest itching, burning, worse from
bathing, sun, and friction of clothes.
Eyes - Redness of eyes, worse from straining. Stitching pain in eyes. Swelling of both upper eyelids. Sensation
