and disinclination to talk. Blurred vision in left eye.
Face - Small eruptions on forehead and cheek. Black, raised eruption on chin.
Female - Dysmenorrhea with pain in the back and legs, worse sitting. Menses dark, blackish.
Food - Thirst increased. Appetite increased, with pain in abdomen.
Head - Bursting pain, better from tea, sleep. Pain as if beaten by hammer, with anger and disinclination to talk,
worse after sleep. Hammering pain, left side, worse looking at an object or after sleep, better from closing eyes
and in the afternoon.
Limbs - Pain in knee and ankle joints, with sadness and disinclination to work, better pressure, bathing, and
sitting, worse walking. Sensation as if legs were being cut. Pain and weakness in left leg, cramping pain worse
flexing knee, sitting. Pain in left leg worse walking, feels as if stretched. Pain in calf muscles. Itching on both
lower limbs.
Male - Nocturnal seminal emissions.
Mouth - Pain in teeth. Itching over tongue with aching. Aphthae.
Nose - Coryza with sensation of heat in whole body and thirstlessness. Coryza with achiness. Sneezing with
itching in nostrils, watery discharge. Thick, white nasal discharge. Burning in right nostril with raw and red
surface.
Rectum - Constipation. Loose stool. Profuse, yellowish semi-solid stool. Odorless stool with pain and rumbling
in abdomen, increased thirst.
Stomach - Sinking sensation in stomach, not relieved by eating.
Throat - Pain, constricting with difficult speech. Voice heavy and hoarseness, worse from talking. Pain in throat
and in the right ear, worse morning, evening. Stitching pain, worse swallowing, drinking and eating.
Vertigo - Vertigo with tendency to fall forward. Vertigo with constipation. Vertigo better lying down. Vertigo
worse walking, sitting and standing.
COMMENTS - R. N. Khory, in the Materia Medica of India, noted many traditional uses for Aegle. Aegle
marmelos is held sacred by the Hindus, and its leaves are presented to
Shiva as an offering by the devotees. It is often planted near the temples. The Hindus consider it an emblem
of fertility and a very auspicious plant.
No herbal remedy has been longer and better known or appreciated by the inhabitants of India than the bel
fruit. Two kinds of fruit are available in the market: a small, wild variety and a cultivated variety. The full-grown
fruit of either variety, when it just begins to ripen, is best for medicinal purposes.
The unripe or half-ripe fruit is regarded as an astringent, digestive, stomachic and is said to be an excellent
remedy for diarrhea owing to the presence of tannins or mucilaginous substances. It is said to be particularly
useful in chronic diarrhea. It is sometimes used in combination with opium by ayurvedic practitioners.
The fruit is also sliced and a configure made from it. which is commonly used by Hindu physicians in the
treatment of diarrheas and dysentery.
The ripe fruit is sweet, aromatic and cooling. When taken fresh, it possesses laxative properties. The dried
pulp is pale orange or flesh colored, and when mixed with water, yields a pleasant orange-colored food which
 has mild astringent properties.

The white rootstock is pungent and aromatic, but the flavor of the leaves is strong and disagreeable. Diuretic

Breasts - Burning pain in nipples, nipples very sensitive to touch.

Female - Burning pain in ovaries at time of ovulation. Sexual desire increased.

 Skin - Dry skin and desquamating. Itching.

Throat - Scraping in throat.

Vertigo better sitting.

name: Aesculus Hippocastanum
author: Murphy
full:

Hippocastanaceae. Northern India and North America. Tincture of ripe kernel, trituration of dry kernel. Tincture

HERBAL - In some districts it is a popular custom to carry a chestnut in the pocket as a preventive for
hemorrhoids..
HOMEOPATHIC - The action of this remedy is most marked on the lower bowels, producing engorged
hemorrhoidal veins with the characteristic backache and absence of constipation. Hemorrhoids, with much
pain but little bleeding. Venous stasis in general. Varicose veins of a purple color.
Many of the symptoms which Aesc. produces are due to a deranged liver or reflex from hemorrhoids.
Everything is slowed down, digestion, heart, bowels, etc. Torpor and congestion of the liver and portal system
with constipation. Fullness in various parts, dry, swollen mucus membranes.
This remedy has great affinity for the pelvis, hips, the sacro-iliac joint and sacrum problems. Sacro-iliac
 problems since an injury or a fall. Degenerative hip disease. Arthritis of the hip. Aching pains in hips and
pelvis. Sore muscles, mornings on waking and on motion.
Glandular swellings. Aesculus produces sensation of heat, dryness, stiffness and roughness in throat,
nose, anus, etc. Throat symptoms with hemorrhoid conditions. Mucus membranes dry, swollen, burn and
feel raw.
Joints weak. The back aches and gives out. Backache, lumbo-sacral region aches. Walking greatly
aggravates all symptoms. When walking feet turn under. Soles feels sore, tired and swell. Hands and feet
swell and become red after washing, feel full.
MIND - Aesc. patients are despondent, gloomy and irritable. Irritable, unable to fix his attention. Depressed
and irritable. Extremely irritable. Loses tempereasily. Feels miserably cross. Gloomy and despondent.
Malaise. Dullness of head and mind, fullness at root of nose. Dullness, sluggishness on waking in morning,
on waking at night. Mistakes in localities. Wakes up with confusion of mind, bewildered, especially the
children. Doesn't know where she is nor whence came the objects around her.
Abdomen - It has a marked action on the veins of the lower bowels and pelvic organs causing engorged
hemorrhoids. Pain at umbilicus. Jaundice, throbbing in hypogastrium and pelvis. Throbbing in abdomen,
especially hypogastrium. The most intense action is on the lower bowel and pelvic organs. Veins of portal
system are also engorged producing soreness and fullness of the liver and abdomen.
Back - There is a characteristic backache which unfits the patient for business. Backache of sacrum and
hips, worse walking or stooping. Pains are sticking or flying all over, hot like lightning. Lameness in neck,
aching between shoulder blades. Back region of spine feels weak, back and legs give out. Pain as if back will
break. Has to make repeated efforts at rising, worse walking and stooping. Aching in lumbar
and sacral regions with stiffness in the back, almost impossible to walk.
Chest - Feels constricted. Heart's action full and heavy, can feel pulsations all over. Laryngitis, coughs
depending on liver disorders, hot feeling in chest, pain around heart in hemorrhoid subjects. Feels
constricted, hot feeling in chest.
Constitutions - Bilious temperament. Anal troubles. Menopausal years. Varicose veins. For persons with
hemorrhoidal tendencies who suffer with gastric, bilious or catarrhal troubles.
Eyes - Eyeballs feel heavy, dull, hot and sore with lachrymation with enlarged blood vessels.
Female - Constant throbbing behind symphysispubis. Leucorrhea with lameness of back across the
sacro-iliac articulation, dark, yellow, sticky corroding, worse after menses.
Food - Loss of appetite. Considerable thirst. Nausea from tea.
Head - Headache dull, confused, aching as from a cold. Pressure in forehead with nausea, followed by stitches
in right hypochondrium. Pain from occiput to frontal region with bruised sensation of the scalp, worse in the
morning. Neuralgic stitches from right to left through forehead, followed by flying pains in epigastrium. Bruised
pain in occiput to the frontal region with flushes of heat over occiput, neck and shoulders.
Heart - Pain around heart in hemorrhoid subjects. Audible palpitations, when pulsation extends to limbs.
Kidneys - Frequent, scant, dark, muddy, hot urine. Pain in kidneys, especially left and ureter.
Limbs - Degenerative hip disease. Arthri ti s of the hip. Aching pains in hips and pelvis. Bruised pain affecting
sacrum and hips. Takes repeated efforts at rising from seat, worse walking and stooping. Aching and
soreness in limbs, in left acromion process with pain shooting down arms, fingertips numb. Weak feeling in
sacro-iliac joints, as if legs would gave way. Paralytic heaviness of arms, spine, feet.
Limbs - Hands and feet swell and become red after washing. Spine feels weak.
Liver - Tenderness and fullness in region of liver. Soreness and fullness in liver region, the abdomen is sore
to touch. Jaundice with bileless stools. Dull aching in liver and epigastrium.
Male - Discharge of prostatic fluid at every stool and urination. Testes as if sore. Testes itch. Drawing pain in
left testes. Dull and heavy shooting pain through penis. Shooting pain in right testes. Seminal emissions with
amorous dreams.
Modalities - Hemorrhoids better from bleeding. Better in summer. Better in cool, open air. Better bathing.
Better continued exertion. Better kneeling. Worse from winter, cold air, cold seasons. Worse after washing.
Worse morning. Worse on waking. Worse afternoon. Worse after eating. Worse after stool, urinating. Worse
motion. Worse standing. Worse lying. Worse stooping. Worse walking, which aggravates all symptoms.
Mouth - Thickly coated tongue, tongue and mouth feel as if scalded. Cannot control the tongue so as to form
words rightly. Toothache, lower molar, worse warm drinks, better holding cold water in mouth. Salivation. Taste
sweet, bitter, metallic. Teeth as if covered with oil.
Nose - Dry inspired air feels cold, nasal passages sensitive to it. causes burning, rawness and fluent coryza
and sneezing. Pressure at root of nose. Membrane over the turbinate bones distended and boggy. Obstruction
of nose due to hepatic disorders. Congestive catarrh.
 Rectum - Anus raw, sore. Burning in anus with chills up and down the back. As if a bug crawling from
anus. Constipation, hard, dry, knotty, white stools. Pains long after stools. Feels full of small sticks. Much
pain after stool with prolapse. Hemorrhoids with sharp shooting pains up the back. Hemorrhoids blind and
bleeding, purple, painful. Hemorrhoids external, worse standing and walking, worse during menopause.
Irritation caused by ascarides and aids their expulsion.
Sleep - Disposition to stretch and yawn. Drowsy, falls asleep easily. On awaking, knows not where she is.
Awakened by burning pain in stomach. Sore and tired in morning on awaking. Sleepless from thoughts
continually crowding on mind.
Stomach - Heartburn and gulping up of food after eating. Weight of a stone with gnawing, aching pain, most
manifest about three hours after meals. Pressure as from . a stone with gnawing, aching pain, about three
hours after meals. Desire to vomit with constant distress and burning.
Stool - Large, hard, dry stools. Stools first part hard and black, then white and soft.
Temperature - Chill at 4 p.m. Chilliness up and down back. Evening fever, 7 to 12 p.m., skin hot and dry.
Sweat profuse and hot with the fever.
Throat - Hot, dry, raw, stitching pain into ears when swallowing. Swollen glands. Follicular pharyngitis
connected with hepatic congestion. Veins in pharynx distended and tortuous. Throat sensitive to inspired
air, feels excoriated and constricted, burns like fire on swallowing in afternoon. Feeling of roughness, dryness,
stitching or burning like fire on swallowing. Neuralgic pains in the fauces. Hawking of ropy mucus of sweetish
taste.
Vertigo - Vertigo when sitting and walking. Slight vertigo while sitting, worse rising from seat. Vertigo with
sensation as if he had to balance the head.
COMMENTS - Disordered liver. Soreness and fullness in the liver region, the abdomen is sore to the touch.
Jaundice with bileless stools. Throbbing in abdomen, especially hypogastrium. The most intense action is on
the lower bowel and pelvic organs. Malaise, dullness of head and mind, fullness at root of nose. Follicular
pharyngitis with dryness, burning, roughness, contraction in throat.
Keynote use for hemorrhoids, blind or bleeding, relieved by bleeding. Large, swollen hemorrhoids, like a bunch
of grapes. Feeling of dryness in rectum as if little sticks or splinters were pricking the folds of the mucus
membrane with weak feeling in sacroiliac joints, as if legs would gave way.
Constipation, large, hard stools, followed by feeling of prolapse of rectum. Boericke noted fullness in the
rectum, pain in the anus as if sticks stuck up the rectum.
General aching in lumbar and sacral regions with stiffness in the back, almost impossible to walk. Tearing pain
in the small of the back and hips. Great affinity for the hips, the sacroiliac joint, for sacrum problems.
“Hip joint disease,” “dislocates easily.” May palliate for hip dysplasia. Degenerative hip disease, arthritis of the
hip, bursitis. Deep, sore, aching pains. Characteristic worse from rising from a seat. Paralytic feeling in the hip
and sacrum, feels weak, lame, and stiff. Ankylosing spondylitis, rigid back that aches and is sore.
For the back giving out during pregnancy, with a white leucorrhea. Ruptured disks, herniated disks, prolapsed
disks, with radiating pains. Sacroiliac and lumbosacral problems with aching down both thighs, the backs of
the thighs, and strong aching in the back.
Varicose veins (Ham.). “Venous stasis,” the veins in the body are weak, producing hemorrhoids and varicose
veins. Veins have lost tone and swell up with blood.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aesc-g., Aloe, Coll., Merc., Nux-v., Podo., Sulph. (2) Phyt. - throat dry, more
often in acute cases. (3) Aloe, Collinsonia. Nux-v. Sulph., Puls. (4) Arg-n. has also pain in sacroiliac joints and
sensation as if the bones were loose. (5) Ne- gundium americanum. (6) Kali-bi. - throat, but Aesc. h. has not
the stringy mucus. (7) Phyt. - follicularpharyngitis. Complementary: Carb-v., Lach., Mur-ac. Nux-v. antidotes
the hemorrhoidal symptoms. Follows well: Coll., Nux-v., Sulph.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Aether
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY -aether. Aether. Ether. Etherum. Ethyl oxide. Ethylic ether. Sulfuric ether. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Bronchitis. Catalepsy. Convulsions. Cough. Delirium tremens. Hiccough. Mania. Meningitis.
Nausea. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Ether is the well-known anesthetic and the effects are those observed in patients under the
action of its vapor, administered for the purpose of operation in habitual ether drinkers and on some who have
voluntarily experimented with the drug upon themselves.
Ether is closely allied to alcohol, it possesses very similar intoxicating properties, produces visions, frequently
 pleasurable, hallucination and in some instances a persistent maniacal condition.
Convulsions, spasms and a cataleptic state. Chilliness. Bronchitis is a common after result of ether anesthesia
and Belladonna has been observed to be the best antidote for this.
Macerator reported the cure of a woman of 60, who had been confined to bed for weeks with severe neuralgia
of the head, raised welts on the scalp like ridges accompanying the pain. Ether 200c cured quickly.
MIND - Exhilaration, furious excitement, flushed face. Pleasant dreams of rapid flight through the air, gorgeous
visions and unearthly music. Frightful dreams, fancied he heard the ringing of his own funeral bell. Low-spirited,
fearful of some disease, desponding. Loss of consciousness.
Chest - Extreme coldness of the chest, wants it covered. Tightness, irritation and pain.
Ears - Sounds indistinct, seem far off, yet resound violently in the ears.
Eyes - Eyes suffused, lids closed, conjunctive injected. Pupils dilated. Dim vision as if mist or thin cloud before
eyes.
Face - Face flushed.
Head - Meningitis. Temporal arteries enlarged, beat violently. Head drops to one side or is thrown back. Severe
neuralgia of head with raised welts on scalp.
Heart - Excitement and invigoration of heart's action. Pulse full and bounding.
Limbs - Paralysis of lower limbs.
Lungs - Violent cough from stinging or heat in bronchia. Expectoration of blood. Breathing is quickened,
stertorous. Congestion of lungs and brain.
Mouth - Mouth often open. Salivation, slight frothing at mouth. Pronunciation difficult and indistinct.
Stomach - Hiccough persistent. Nausea. Vomiting.
Vertigo - Dizziness, headache with partial blindness follow ether anesthesia.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Aethiops Antimonalis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aethi-a. Aethiops antimonialis. Hydrargyrum stibiato sulfuratum. Aethi-a. is made by triturating
two parts of sulphuret of antimony with one of quicksilver. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Corneal, ulcers. Otorrhea. Scrofula.
HOMEOPATHIC - Aethiops antimonialis is often more effective than Aethiops mercurialus in scrofulous
glandular swellings, eruptions, otorrhea and eye affections, corneal ulcers.
REFERENCES - Boericke.

name: Aethiops Mercurialis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aethi-m. Aethiops mercurialis. Blacksulphide of mercury. Aethiops mineralis. Mercurius
sulphuratus niger. Hydrargyrum sulfuratum nigrum. Mercurius cumkah sulph. Trituration. Made by triturating
two parts of sulfuret of antimony with one of quicksilver. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Ophthalmia. Otorrhea. Scrofula. Skin disorders. Syphilis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Clarke has confirmed its utility in many aggravated skin disorders. Aethiops Mercurialus
has not been proved, but it has been used with success in scrofulous,
herpetic, eczematous eruptions and discharges. Favus-like eruptions.
Eruptions from fright. Painful, irritating, scabby eruptions of face. Scrofulous disorders. Scrofulous
ophthalmia and otorrhea offensive. Hereditary syphilis. It seems to combine the powers of its various
components.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Calc., Sil., Psor. (2) Aethiops Antimonalis.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Aethusa Cynapium
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aeth. Aethusacynapium. Fool's parsley. N. O. Umbelliferae. Europe. Tincture of whole flowering
plant. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Attention deficit. Anasarca. Brain, weakness. Cholera infantum. Colic. Coma. Convulsions.
Cough. Delirium. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Ear, discharge. Ecchymosis. Emaciation. Epilepsy. Eye, disorders.
Gland disorders. Headaches. Herpes. Hiccoughs. Idiocy. Infantile, paralysis. Insomnia. Malnutrition.
Marasmus. Mental, retardation. Mental, retardation. Milk, allergy. Pyloric, stenosis. Stomach disorders.
Trismus. Vomiting, projectile.
HOMEOPATHIC-Aethusacynapium affects the brain and nervous system, connected with gastrointestinal
 disturbances. Keynote violent action. Violent vomiting, violent convulsions, violent pains, violent delirium. In
epileptiform spasms, the thumbs are clenched, face becomes red, eyes turned downwards, pupils dilate and
staring, foams at mouth. There is great weakness of mind or body.
Inability to digest milk (Nat-c.). Diarrhea, with marked aggravation from drinking milk and poor circulation.
Improperly fed babies (Calc-p.). Patient cannot stand, sit up or hold the head up. Children who lack the power
to hold their heads up with no particular ailment, sometimes they can't even stand or bear any weight on their
limbs. Want of power to stand up. Sharp pains. Parts feel screwed together.
Weak, nervous and prostrated from overwork. Prostration with somnolence. Profound prostration and stupor
and lack of reaction, even speechless. Anguish, crying and expression of uneasiness and discontent. Useful
forchildren's summer complaints and diseases during dentition.
MIND - Mind and body become weak. Brain fatigue from over study. Inability to think, to fix the attention.
Awkwardness. Mental, retardation. Attention deficit. Idiotic children. Idiocy may alternate with furor and irritabil-
ity. Weepy, worse as disease progresses. Stupefaction during vertigo.
Fear before sleep to close eyes lest he should never wake. Examination failure from sense of incapacity.
Unable to read after overexertion of mental faculties. Restlessness, anxious and crying. Irritability, especially
in open air. Irritability during headache.
Feels different from other people. Reserved people with inwardly strong emotions. Feels unconnected to other
people. Loners. Great sadness when alone. Lives in his own sentimental world. Loves animals, talks to
animals, looks after them with unnatural passion.
Delirium, better perspiration. Unconscious, delirious. Fancies herself lost on waking. Hallucinations. Delusions
of animals. Delirium, sees cats, dogs and rats. Wants to jump out of bed or out of the window.
Abdomen - Cold internal and external with aching pain in bowels. Colic, exhaustion and drowsiness. Colic,
followed by vomiting, vertigo and weakness. Black bluish swelling, coldness of abdomen, subjective and
objective with coldness of legs with aching in bowels better warm application. Bubbling sensation around navel.
Back - Small of back as if in vice, aching. Want of power to stand to hold up head. Swelling of glands around
neck like string of beads. A feeling as if pain in back could be better by straightening out and bending stiffly
backwards.
Chest - Crampy constriction in chest. Stitches in left side of chest.
Constitutions - Suited to infants, teething children and cholera disorders of children and the elderly.
Ears - Feel blocked, better by inserting the fingers and drawing the parts apart. Sense of something hot from
ears, as if something hot steaming out. Hissing sound.
Eyes - Eyes drawn downward, squinting, pupils dilated. Brilliant and protruding. Cornea sunken. Objects
seem larger or double. Photophobia, chronic. Swelling of meibomian glands. Rolling of eyes on falling
asleep.
Face - Sunken, pale, puffed, red-spotted, collapsed. Expression anxious, full of pain. Linea nasalis marked
blue white pallor about the lips, puffed, spotted, red.
Female - Sharp pains in sexual organs. Pimples on external parts, itching on getting warm. Menses watery.
Swelling of breasts with sharp pains.
Food - Burning thirst with total loss of appetite. Desires wine, but aggravated from it. Intolerance of milk.
Nibbling appetite. Regurgitation of food long after eating. Digestion affected from brain exhaustion.
Glands - Lymphatic glands swollen like strings of beads.
Head - Head feels confused. Head or brain feels as if bound up or in avise. Occipital pain extending down
spine, better lying down and by pressure. Head symptoms relieved by expelling flatus (Sang.), and by stool.
Cannot raise head. Hair feels pulled. Squeezing headache with vertigo worse walking and looking upward.
Dizzy and drowsy.
Heart - Violent palpitations with vertigo, headache and restlessness. Pulse rapid, hard and small, not
rhythmical.
Kidneys - Cutting pain in bladder with frequent urging. Pain in kidneys.
Limbs - Want of power to stand up or hold head up. Weakness of lower limbs. Fingers and thumbs bent
inwards or clenched. Numbness of hands and feet. Violent spasms. Sensation as if arms had become much
shorter. Heaviness, weakness, contraction of fingers. Excoriation of thighs on walking.
Lungs - Difficult, oppressed, anxious respiration, crampy constriction. Short breath interrupted by hiccough.
Suffering renders the patient speechless. Cough causes pain in head.
Male - Right testicle drawn up with pain in kidney.
Modalities - Better in open air. Better from walking in open air. Better by conversation and company. Worse
from milk. Worse coffee. Worse wine, drunkenness. Worse frequent over eating. Worse from 3 a.m. to 4 a.m.
Worse evenings. Worse warmth. Worse summer. Worse warmth of bed. Worse cold water. Worse over
 exertion. Heat causes all eruptions to itch intolerably.
Mouth - Dryness. Aphthae in the mouth. Tongue seems too long. Burning and pustules in the throat with
difficult swallowing. Speech slow, embarrassed. Speechless. Bitter taste, of onions, cheese, sweetish in
morning.
Nose - Nose stopped up with much thick mucus. Herpetic eruption on tip of nose. Frequent ineffectual desire
to sneeze. Alae nasi drawn in.
Rectum - Cholera infantum, child cold, clammy, stupid with staring eyes and dilated pupils. Cholera disorders
in old age. Undigested, thin, greenish stools. preceded by colic with tenesmus followed by exhaustion and
drowsiness. Yellow, green, slimy diarrhea. Obstinate constipation, feels as if all bowel action is lost.
Skin - Excoriation of thighs when walking. Easy perspiration, surface of body covered with clammy sweat.
Lymphatic glands swollen. Itching eruption around joints better from heat. Skin of hands dry and
shrunken. Ecchymosis. Anasarca. Whole body may be blue, black.
Sleep - Disturbed by violent startings or cold perspiration. Dozing after vomiting or stool. Child is so
exhausted, it falls asleep at once. Rolling of the eyes or slight convulsion on falling asleep. Limpness and
deep sleep after vomiting, with a deathly nausea.
Stomach - Intolerance of milk, vomiting as soon as swallowed or in large curds.
Hungry after vomiting. Regurgitation, about an half hour after eating. Nausea at sight of food. Painful
contraction of stomach. Violent vomiting of a white frothy matter. Projectile vomiting. Vomiting of frothy
matter white as milk or yellow fluid. Pyloric stenosis. Retching. Vomiting vnthsweatandgreatweakness,
accompanied by anguish and distress, followed by sleepiness. Stomach feels turned upside down with burning
feeling up to the chest. Tearing pains in the stomach extending to esophagus.
Temperature - Great heat, no thirst. Profuse, cold sweat. Must be covered during sweat. Sweating, on
slightest physical effort.
Throat - Sensation of constriction, preventing swallowing. Stinging in the throat. Soft palate red, swollen.
Pungent heat in mouth and throat.
Vertigo - Vertigo, with sleepiness, can't raise the head. Vertigo with drowsiness with palpitation, head hot
after vertigo ceases.
COMMENTS - Ingesting Aethusa plant matter causes severe projectile vomiting. There is also gripping with
diarrhea, vomiting, crying. Guernsey said Aeth. is invaluable for adults who complain of regurgitation of food
an hour after it has been taken.
Copious vomiting in adults with a great feeling of distress, can't tell what the distress is about, but it still exists.
A peculiar expression of great anxiety and pain. Linea nasalis, a surface of pearly whiteness on upper lip
bounded by distinct lines from wings of nose to angles of mouth.
Inability to hold down any food. Severe spasmodic vomiting. Malassimilation. Also for vomiting during
pregnancy that's very spasmodic andprojectile. Goodforprojectile vomiting, pyloric stenosis, failure to thrive in
children.
Keynote intolerance to milk in any form. Milk allergies in children with vomiting and spasm (Nat-c., has gas,
bloating and diarrhea). Vomiting of everything taken, especially milk, which is ejected in yellowish or greenish
curds. Great weakness and exhaustion after vomiting, the child is so
exhausted they fall asleep at once. Wakes hungry, eats and vomits again. “Hungry after vomiting.”
Epilepsy in children with emaciation, mal- assimilation and failure to thrive. Epileptic spasms (Cup.), the thumbs
are clenched, the head is drawn back and the eyes go down. Epilepsy with foaming, pupils fixed and dilated.
Prostration and sleepiness after attacks. Convulsions with cold limbs.
Sensation of swelling in the head and face on entering a room, sunken cornea, and eyeballs convulsed and
directed downwards. Sensation of swelling in hands after walking. Lancinating pains. Swelling of breast or
axillary glands with sharp pains. Prostration, stupid.
Tetanus. Alcoholism, with tremors, shaking, malassimilation and emaciation. Late learning to walk. Backward
children with muscle weakness, stumbling, falling, late speech. Poor mental and brain development and
coordination.
Characteristic inability to think or fix the attention. Stupor, in some cases alternating with a furor. Hallucinations.
Delirium, sees cats and dogs. Wants to jump out of bed or out of the window. Irritability, especially in open air.
Somnolence.
Clarke sent single doses of Aeth., at rare intervals with great rehef, to a little child in an orphan home who
suffered from severe headaches and inability to fix his attention on his lessons. The little boy asked for the
remedy himself subsequently on a return of the old symptoms.
Clarke gave it to an undergraduate preparing for an examination with complete success. He had been
compelled to give up his studies, but was able to resume them and passed a brilliant examination.
 Guernsey said “The mental symptoms peculiar to children and frequently of adults, are, great anguish and
crying. As the disease progresses the patient becomes more and more retired in his disposition and more
inclined to weep.”
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ant-c., Calc., Ars., Cic. (2) Athamantha - confused head, vertigo better lying
down, bitter taste and saliva. Hands and feet icy cold. (3) Cic., Con., Oena., Ant-c. and Calc. - vomiting of milk.
(4) Are., Asar., Cupr., Ip., Op. Complementary: Calc., Sil. It antidotes: Opium, and is antidoted by vegetable
acids. Teste places Aeth. in the Sulphur group with Cic., Con., Aster., Bov., Lob., Merc., Kreos.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Agaricinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - Agarin. Agaricinum. Agaric acid. It is obtained from the fungus Boletus laricis (White Agaric)
and is a white crystalline powder. Triturations and dilutions. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL-Cataracts.Chorea. Emphysema. Erythema. Heart, weakness. Neuralgias. Neuritis. Tic
douloureux.
HOMEOPATHIC - This remedy is employed in severe cases of chorea. Useful for the sweats of tuberculosis,
it should be given before retiring. The dose may be repeated once or twice during the night.
Heart dilation, when complicated with emphysema. Fatty degeneration. Weakened heart action from acute
diseases and old age, when attended with profuse perspiration and erythema.
Agaricin should be studied when the symptoms are crossed over the body. Chorea. There is marked twitching
of the eyelids, spasmodic movements from simple involuntary motions and jerks of single muscles to a dancing
of the whole body.
Trembling of the limbs, soreness of the spine and redness of the eyes. Involuntary movements cease during
sleep, symptoms are worse during a thunderstorm.
Neuritis. The parts are red, hot and swollen. There are burning, itching and cramps of the hands and feet.
There is twitching of the muscles of the hands and feet. The sleep is restless and disturbed.
COMMENTS - Royal reported that the 3x of Agarin. given three times daily cured a most violent case of Tic
douloureux of the left side of face after Ars., Mag-p. and Bell, had failed. A slight touch would cause the
paroxysms to recur.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Agar.
REFERENCES - Blackwood.
keynote:
PHARMACY - Agarin. Agaricinum. Agaric acid. It is obtained from the fungus Boletus laricis (White Agaric)
and is a white crystalline powder. Triturations and dilutions. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL-Cataracts.Chorea. Emphysema. Erythema. Heart, weakness. Neuralgias. Neuritis. Tic
douloureux.
HOMEOPATHIC - This remedy is employed in severe cases of chorea. Useful for the sweats of tuberculosis,
it should be given before retiring. The dose may be repeated once or twice during the night.

name: Agaricus Blazeimurill
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - agar-b-m. Agaricus blazei murill. Brazil mushroom. Tincture of fresh fungus. Also used as a
powder and food. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Allergies. Angina pectoris. Asthma. Athlete's, foot. Atopic, dermatitis. Breast cancer. Bronchitis.
Cancer. Colds. Constipation. Cystitis. Dermatitis. Eczema. Hay fever. Heart, disorders. Hemorrhoids.
Immune, weakness. Infections. Influenza. Insomnia. Kidney, disorders. Leukemia. Lymphoma. Psoriasis.
Prostate, enlargement. Raynaud's disease. Rhinitis. Septicemia. Skin, cancer.
HERBAL - An agaricus mushroom found in the highlands of Piedade, Brazil. The inhabitants in Piedade enjoy
long and good health with very few degenerative disease. The people there rarely suffer from cancer, heart
disease, stroke, diabetes, arthritis, allergies, asthma, eczema, ulcers, etc.
In the 1960s, a Japanese descendant living in Brazil visited Piedade and made the observation that the people
there eat a special kind of mushroom which is not found anywhere else. He sent samples of the mushroom to
Japan for study and cultivation.
About the same time, two scientists from America also visited Piedade and made a similar observation. They
proceeded to analyze the nutritional content of the Brazilian mushroom and published the results in scientific
journals in 1965.
Experiments showed that not only the Agaricus mushroom is an effective cancer fighter, but also that it is the
best cancer fighter among all the medicinal mushrooms known. The mushrooms fight cancer by
enhancing the body's own immune system rather than directly trying to kill off the cancer cells. It is therefore
as safe as any food substance can be.
Subsequent studies showed that the Agaricus mushroom has a powerful normalizing effect of all body
physiological functions.
That is why that clinically it has been effective against many health problems afflicting mankind.
Blood - Raynaud's disease. Septicemia.
 Cancer - Breast cancer. Hodgkin's lymphoma. Leukemia. Lymphatic cancer. Ovarian cancer. Skin cancer.
Heart - Angina pectoris. Heart tonic. High blood pressure, and low blood pressure. Hardening of the arteries.
Kidneys - Kidney infection. Kidney failure.
Lungs - Chronic bronchitis. Hay fever, allergic rhinitis, and asthma.
Rectum - Constipation and hemorrhoids.
Skin - Athlete foot. Eczema. Atopic dermatitis. Psoriasis. Skin cancer.
Sleep - Insomnia.
COMMENTS - Dr. Alexander Yuan of Hong Kong reported on this agaricus mushroom noting its usefulness
for blood purification, cold hands and feet, frozen shoulder, hangovers. Neck and shoulder pain and low back
pain.
Chronic debility. Collagen disease. German measles. Frequent colds and influenza, lack of energy. Insomnia,
weak concentration. Pale, sallow complexion. Hyperactivity and improved athletic performance, among other
benefits.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Care.
REFERENCES - Murphy. Yuan.

name: Agaricus Campanulatus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-agar-epn. - Agaricus campanu- latus. Agaricus ovalis. A rare species, found in England on dung.
N. O. Fungi. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Asthenopia. Backaches. Belching. Constipation. Delirium. Diarrhea. Flatulence. Hemorrhoids.
Jaundice. Neuralgias. Palpitations. Spasms. Toothache. Trembling. Twitching. Vertigo. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Poisonous doses produce violent vomiting and diarrhea with numerous nervous
phenomena, tonic contractions of smooth muscle fiber, increased glandular and mucus secretions, and
persistent anemia of nerve centers from spasm of arterioles.
Chorea-like spasms. Vertigo and general intolerance of the sun. Heavy weight in occiput. A very irritable and
sensitive spine. Asthenopia with flickerings. Twitching of eyes and lids.
Gastro-enteric inflammation, with excessive, inodorous flatulence. Irritable bladder. A host of neuralgic pains
everywhere, mostly splinter-like, burning and shooting. Particularly valuable in burning of the skin as from a
frostbite, especially on the ears and feet.
Chorea-like twitchings of various fibrillae and even groups of muscles. Tremblings, external and internal. Flesh
feels bruised, or as if frostbitten, sensitive to touch and to cold air.
General aggravation from walking in the open air. ameliorated when warm in bed. Pains in the limbs may
disappear on motion, and return during rest. Symptoms often appear crosswise, as in right arm and left leg,
etc. Shooting, splinter-like pains everywhere.
MIND - Delirium, attempts to escape. Incoherent talking. Aversion to mental work. Confusion and vertigo,
aggravated by heat of sun.
Abdomen - Flatulent distention, rumblings, cutting, griping, stitches, and tension.
Back - Stiffness and soreness of nape. Backaches. Bruised and strained feelings. Deep stitches, burning,
itching along spine and limbs. Spine sore to the touch and on stooping. Extreme pain and soreness in lower
dorsal regions, becoming a pulsating on motion. Severe pains in the spine, boring, stitching, drawing, and
soreness, mostly in lower dorsal region. Back pains, aggravated by walking in open air.
Bladder - Irritable bladder. Sharp pains. Burning on urinating. Not profuse urine. Lemon-colored urine,
discharge of sticky mucus.
Chest - Numerous pains, tearing, pinching, tensive, stinging, burning. Constriction, oppression, heaviness.
Rawness.
Ears - External ear burns and itches, as if it had been frozen. Twitchings of the auricular muscles. Numerous
ringing and other noises within the ear.
Eyes - Twitching of lids and eyeballs. Margins of lids red, agglutinating. Vision dim on attempting to use the
eyes. Flickering, type wavers, with itching and burning.
Face - Pale. Twitching of the muscles. Pains lancinating, tearing in the cheek.
Female - Violent pressing, tearing pains in back and abdomen with the menses. Pruritus pudendi.
Head - Drawing in bones of forehead, to the root of the nose. Shooting pains, mostly in the sides of the head
or in small spots. Feeling of icy coldness on the head.
Heart - Palpitations. Tumultuous action. Irregular, intermittent pulse, ameliorated by coffee.
Limbs - Limbs weary and heavy. Trembling. Twitching. Shooting pains, shifting. Pains often ameliorated by
motion.
Male - Sexual desire without erections.
 Modalites - Better by motion. Better by coffee. Worse by walking in open air. Worse from heat of the sun.
Mouth - Dryness on salivation. Sweet taste. Toothache, neuralgic, aggravated by open air. Splinter-like pains
in the tongue. Splinter-like pains through the jaws. Upper lip chapped, smarting, dry, with burning vesicles.
Lips twitch.
Nose - Clear water runs from the nose, without inflammatory symptoms.
Perspiration - Profuse inodorous sweat, often localized to the chest. Oily sweat.
Rectum - Burning. Hemorrhoids.
Respiratory - Convulsive paroxysms of cough, sudden, ends with repeated sneezing. Expectoration of balls
of mucus. Difficult respiration as if chest were full. Deep breathing and sighing. Noisy respiration at night.
Skin - Jaundice. Redness, stinging, burning as if frostbitten. Itching. White nodular elevations, with intense
itching and burning.
Sleep - General sleepiness, especially after eating.
Stomach - Unnatural hunger, in evenings. Belching, empty. Numerous sensations with spasmodic
contractions, irritable spine. Pains, gnawings, boring, cramps, and fullness.
Stool - Emission of much inodorous gas. Watery diarrhea. Constipation.
Temperature - Chilliness on motion, in the air, or on lifting the clothes. Burning heat on different spots, mostly
local.
Throat - Constriction of larynx. Sharp pain extends through right eustachian tube to ear. General dryness.
Contractions. Feels swollen externally, hands feel tight.
Vertigo - Vertigo, aggravated by heat of sun.
RELATIONS - Compare: Agar. Agar-cps., Agar-em., Agar-ph., Agar-st., Amanita vemus.
REFERENCES - Allen.

name: Agaricus Campestris
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - agar-cps. Agaricus campestris. Common mushroom. Psalloita campestris. N. O. Fungi.
Historical dose: All potehcies.
CLINICAL - Abdominal pain. Abscesses. Boils. Cold. Colic. Cramps. Delirium. Dyspnea. Fever. Gangrene.
Inflammatory, swellings. Nausea. Pulse, weak. Quinsies. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Agaricus campestris is the common mushroom. This mushroom, common in the North
America and in Europe, is esculent, stem only two to three inches high.
COMMENTS - Poisoning symptoms. Slight delirium. Eyes sunken, with livid circles. Face humid, hippocratic.
Tongue red and parched. Skin cold, covered with cold sweat. Greenness of the skin. Formation of abscesses,
which discharge a thin, ill-conditioned pus, and pass rapidly into suppuration and gangrene.
Abdomen retracted. Great abdominal pain at intervals. Severe colic. Nausea. Purging and vomiting of liquid
matter.
Pulse hard, weak, rapid, irregular. Pulse feeble. Respiration irregular. Severe cramps. Kind of tertian fever.
Somnolency.
RELATIONS - Compare: Agar. Agar-cpn., Agar-em., Agar-ph., Agar-st., Amanita vemus.
REFERENCES - Allen.

name: Agaricus Emeticus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - agar-em. Agaricus emeticus. Russula emetica. N. O. Fungi. A small acrid species, foundin
woods in Europe. Tincture of fresh fungus. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Anxiety. Belchings. Cold sweat. Diarrhea. Gastritis. Heartbum. Vertigo. Vomiting. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of Agar-em. resemble those of the other Agarics, but while cold water
aggravates the symptoms of Agaricus muscarius it speedily and permanently relieves those of Agar-em.
Violent burning pains in the stomach.
There is a sudden and violent craving for ice-cold water during the worst attacks of anxiety, which gives
gradual relief. All symptoms better from cold water. Violent vomiting with anxious sensation, as if the
stomach hung on threads which would be momentarily tom in two with ice-cold sweat of face. Gastritis with
cold sweat and a vomiting sensation.
Sudden great weakness. Severe vertigo, one must be carried to bed, is not able to sit or stand. Faintness
worse by moving head. Faintness worse by smelling vinegar, which is unbearable.
MIND - Attacks of anxiety. Anxiety in stomach.
Abdomen - Distended abdomen. Constantly increasing pain in abdomen.
Eyes - Lachrymation from odors. Lasting weakness of eyes.
 Food - Sudden, violent desire for ice-cold water, during the worst attacks of anxiety, which gives gradual
relief. Dislike for wine and meat, relieve by cold water.
Modalities - Better from cold water. Worse from odors. Worse by smelling vinegar.
Mouth - Nauseous taste in mouth. Sharp burning in mouth.
Nose - Sneezing from smells.
Pulse - Pulse rapid, exceedingly weak.
Stomach - Violent vomiting with anxious sensation, with ice-cold sweat of face. Violent burning pain in
stomach. Painful pressure in stomach, followed by frequent belchings, repeated attempts to vomit. Constantly
increasing anxiety in stomach. Stomach so sensitive that one could not touch it, nor cough.
Vertigo - Vertigo, so severe that one must be carried to bed is not able to sit or stand.
RELATIONS - Compare: Agar. Agar-cpn., Agar-cps., Agar-pa., Agar-ph., Agar-st., Amanita vemus.
REFERENCES - Allen. Boericke. Clarke.

name: Agaricus Muscarius
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - agar. Agaricus muscarius. Fly agaric. Amanita muscaria. Bug agaric. Champignon fou. N. O.
Fungi. Grows in Europe, Asia and America in dry places, especially in dry pine woods. Trituration of the
carefully dried-up cap. Tincture of the fresh fungus. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne rosacea. Alcoholism. Blepharospasm. Brain, softening. Bunion. Chilblains. Chorea.
Coldness. Cough. Cramps. Delirium tremens. Epilepsy. Fever, enteric. Frostbite. Gangrene. Headaches.
Hyperpyrexia. Hypothermia. Itching. Jaundice. Lachrymal, fistula. Lichen. Lumbago. Menses, painful.
Meningitis. Myopia. Neuralgias. Nosebleeds. Numbness. Nystagmus. Paralysis. Rheumatism. Sacrum, pains.
Sebaceous tumors. Sexual excess, effects. Spinal, Irritation. Spleen, disorders. Tics. Toothaches. Tremors.
Tuberculosis. Twitching. Typhoid fever. Typhus.
HOMEOPATHIC - Agaricus contains several toxic compounds, the best known of which is muscarin. The
symptoms of poisoning do not develop at once, usually twelve to fourteen hours elapse before the initial attack.
Agaricus acts as an intoxicant to the brain, producing more vertigo and delirium than alcohol, followed by
profound sleep with lowered reflexes.
Agaricus is used in many parts of the world for making an intoxicating drink. We find in alcoholism a sphere
for its action and also in all states of delirium, mania and even idiocy. Cerebral excitement, as found in delirium
of fevers, alcoholism, etc. The delirium is to make verses and prophesy, also silly merriness and incoherent
talk with mania, kisses companions.
Frostbite and chilblains, itching, redness and burning. Bunions. Sensations if pierced by needles of ice.
Sensitive to pressure and cold air. Violent bearing down pains. Symptoms appear diagonally as right arm
and left leg. Pains are accompanied by sensation of cold, numbness and tingling.
General paralysis. Jerking, twitching, trembling and itching are strong indications. Epilepsy with great exertion
of strength. Chorea, twitching ceases during sleep. Various forms of neuralgia and spasmodic disorders
and neurotic skin troubles are pictured in the symptomatology of this remedy.
Agar, is a spleen medicine, causing stitch in the side and it has cured stitch in runners, enabling them to run
further. Anemia. Incipient tuberculosis is related to the tubercular diathesis. Offensive breath, belchings and
stools. Sweat may be oily, but is not offensive.
MIND - Mental depression, languor, indifference. Disinclination to work, confusion. Indisposed to perform any
kind of work especially mental. Cannot do anything new, cannot do routine work, or does the opposite. Slow
in learning to walk and talk. Awkward and clumsy.
Morose, self-willed, stubborn. Selfish behavior. Alcoholism. Dull and dizzy as if drunk. Delirium tremens.
Reveals secrets. Pressure on spine causes involuntary laughter. Aversion to being touched.
Hyperactive, clumsy children without any fear or idea about danger. Fearlessness, recklessness and
thoughtlessness. Convulsions after being scolded (Ign.).
Makes many revengeful plans. Confusion of mind on waking in morning, better after eating. Knows no one,
throws things.
Hysteria after sexual excesses. Memory active, in evening.
Fears to be left alone lest he injure himself inafrenzy. Fear of cancer. Preoccupied with death, dying,
graveyards. Fear of ghosts. Fear after going to bed. Pities herself.
Delirium of fevers. Delirium characterized by makes verses, singing, shouting and muttering, rhymes and
prophesies. Increased cheerfulness, courage, loquacity, exalted fancy. Hilarious. Embraces and kisses
hands.
Delirium with much twitching. Fearlessness. Sings, talks incoherently, but does not answer. Loquacity,
 changes rapidly from subject to subject, but does not answer.
Great mental excitement and incoherent talking, immoderate gaiety alternates with melancholy. Perception of
relative size of objects is lost. Physical strength is increased, can lift heavy loads. Delirium begins with
paroxysm of yawning.
Sings, talks incoherently, changes rapidly from subject to subject, but doesn't answer. Full of ecstasy. Furious
or raging delirium. Screaming, raving, wants to injure himself.
Abdomen - Burning in abdomen. Flatulent distention of abdomen. Sharp pains in spleen (Cean.), and
abdomen. Sharp pain in the splenic region in runners. Colic. Cutting, griping pains in bowels. Rumbling and
fermenting in bowels. Profuse, inodorous, hot flatus. Sensation of writhing. Abdomen as if empty, hollow or
cold.
Back - Painful weakness and soreness. Shooting, burning pains along spine. Pain with sensitiveness of
spine to touch, worse in dorsal region. Aching in back after dinner. Burning pains along the spinal cord. Pain
as if hot and cold needles stabbed into spine. Painfulness along spinal cord when stooping. Painful
pulsation in spinal canal. Lumbago, worse in open air. Crick in back and neck. Twitching of cervical muscles.
Spine seems short. Muscles of back feel tight, as if they would break on bending. As if cold air were spreading
along back. As if cold water were running down back. Spinal irritation, due to
Agaricus muscarius sexual excesses. Sacrum as if beaten or dislocated. Swelling of cervical glands.
Breasts - Metastases from suppressed milk to the brain, abdominal troubles etc. Nipples, itch and burn, look
red during pregnancy.
Causations - Blood poisoning. Frostbite. Mental exertion or excitement, over-exertion. Fright. Alcoholism,
sexual excess, subjective symptoms arising after sex.
Chest - Anxiety in chest. Stitches under short ribs, left side. Sharp pain behind sternum most at end of
expiration. Sharp pain in right lung while walking. Severe burning in chest. Chest as if too narrow. Chest as if
too full of blood. Chest as if sprained, worse deep breathing. Burning, biting pimples on chest.
Constitutions - Light hair, skin and muscles lax. Old people with indolent circulation. Venous weakness.
Diarrhea. Alcoholics, especially with headaches. Mushrooms are forbidden by Grauvogl to persons with the
hydrogenoid constitution. The patients are exceedingly sensitive to cold and damp.
Cough - Cough with rattling of mucus, without expectoration. Dry cough after dinner. Cough ends in a sneeze.
Spasmodic coughing at night after falling asleep. Cough with expectoration of little balls of mucus. Has to
sit up in bed, or cough takes his breath. Has to sit down when cough comes. Violent attacks of coughing that
can be suppressed by effort of will, worse eating, pain in head while cough lasts. Convulsive, hacking cough,
with anxious sweat.
Ears - Itching in the ears with redness and burning pain, as if they had been frozen. Twitching of the muscles
about the ears with noises. Rattling, fluttering in tympanic cavity. Sharp pains in left mastoid process. Excessive
secretion of wax. Very acute hearing. Feels worse from hearing people talk. Dull hearing.
Eyes - Eyes as if weak, without having exerted them. Asthenopia from prolonged strain. Spasms of
accommodation. Twitching of eyelids and eyeballs (Cod.). Oscillating eyeballs. Heat in eyes. Lids heavy,
as if stuck together. Eyelids thick, dry, burning red, itch and agglutinate. Inner angles very red. Gum in canthi.
Narrowing of space between eyelids. Nystagmus, squint. Swellingofteargland. Vesicles or ulcers on cornea.
Lachrymation from smells or coughing. Sensitive to light, even candlelight. Pupils dilated.
Face - Face, blue and puffed. Grimaces. Idiotic expression. Facial twitching. Muscles feel stiff. Face itches
and burns. Lancinating, tearing pain in cheeks, as of splinters. Neuralgia, as if cold needles ran through
nerves or sharp ice touched them. Pricking in chin, as from needles. Herpetic eruptions. Pimples changing to
vesicles filled with yellow serum. Burning and smarting on lips. Faceache with toothache. Jaws clenched.
Eruption about mouth in growing children given to licking of lips.
Female - Spasmodic dysmenorrhea. Laborlike cramps, must lie down. Menses too profuse, earlier. Menses
with titillation in genital organs and desire for sex. Tearing, pressive pain in genitals and back, with itching.
Severe bearing-down pains, especially after menopause. Bearing down pains on lifting. Leucorrhea, dark,
bloody, excoriating, patient is unable to walk. Leucorrhea, with much itching, with sexual desire. Complaints
following childbirth and sex. Itching, with sexual desire. Sexual excitement.
Food - Loss of appetite after sex. Thirsty all the time. Much hunger, but no relish for food. Better from coffee.
Better for an hour after eating while he is so exhausted, but great sleepiness remains. Alcoholism. Craving
for alcohol. Worse after tobacco. Worse tea and coffee. Wine causes indisposition to work. Coffee accelerates
pulse. Meat causes heartburn. Prunes causes pressure in stomach. Smelling vinegar causes faintness. Smell
of vinegar unbearable. Drinking cold water aggravates.
Head - Head in constant motion. Headache must move head to and fro. Falling backward, as if a weight in
occiput. Lateral headache, as if from a nail (Coff., Ign'). Dull headache from prolonged deskwork.
 Headache, must move the head to and fro. Headache with nosebleed. Headache with thick mucus discharge.
Headache better after stool or urination. Headaches of alcoholics. Aching in vertex. Head drawn towards
shoulders. Pain in small spots. Cold spots on head. Icy coldness like icy needles or splinters. Sharp,
tearing, aching and boring pain in occiput. Neuralgia with icy cold head. Desire to cover head warmly (Sil.).
Twitching and stitches, more on left side. Scalp tender, sensitive. Itching nettle-rash on scalp.
Heart - Anxious sensation of pressure in heart. Irritable heart of tea and coffee drinkers, and tobacco smokers.
Irregular, tumultuous palpations after tobacco. Heart region oppressed, as if thorax were narrowed.
Oppression on bending body down. Palpitations with redness of face. Palpitations during sex and depressed
afterwards in both the sexes. Pulse intermittent and irregular.
Kidneys - Lameness in left kidney, sore to touch. Stitches in urethra. Stitches and burning while urinating.
Sudden and violent urging to urinate. Frequent urination. Viscid, glutinous, mucus from urethra. Urine, flows
slowly or in drops, has to press for passing urine. Urine, cold, profuse, colorless, clear, lemon colored. As if a
cold drop of urine were passing. Urine scanty and dark.
Limbs - Stiff all over. Pain over hips. Rheumatism better motion. Weakness in loins. Uncertain gait. Frostbite.
Hands and feet very sensitive to cold. Itching of toes and feet as if frozen. Cramps in hands and feet. Cramp
in soles of feet. Joints feel as if dislocated. Pain in shin. Neuralgia in locomotor ataxia. Muscular soreness.
Paralysis of lower limbs with spasmodic condition of arms. Trembling and twitching. Numbness of legs on
crossing them. Paralytic pain in left arm followed by palpitations. Tearing painful contractions in the calves.
Rheumatism better motion.
Liver - Sharp pains in liver. Cirrhosis. Liver weakness from alcohol.
Lungs - Dyspnea while walking, has to stand still to get breath. Suffocative fits with anxiety and fainting.
Labored, oppressed breathing. Difficult, noisy breathing. Frequent deep sighing. Dyspnea with rapid beating
of heart. Impeded breathing at night, from closure of nose by thick mucus. Rapid breathing, with heat all over
and sweat, most in face. Easy expectoration offloculi or balls of mucus. Large brown lumps. Mucus, worse
mornings.
Male - Burning in urethra during sex, worse ejaculation. Sexual desire increased. After sex, great debility,
profuse sweat, burning and itching of the skin, tension and pressure under ribs. Hot seminal discharge.
Premature ejaculation. Testes painfully retracted. Old gleet. Complaints after sexual debauches.
Modalities - Better from moving about slowly. Worse from open air. Worse cold orfreezing air. Worse cold
weather. Worse before a thunderstorm. Worse sun. Worse morning. Worse after eating. Worse after sex.
Worse from touch. Worse debauchery, alcohol. Worse mental exhaustion. Worse fright. Worse during
menses. Worse pressure on dorsal spine.
Mouth - Aphthae on roof of mouth. Herpes on lips. Burning and smarting on lips. Offensive breath. Froth at
mouth. Swelling and bleeding gums with pain. Angles of mouth droop from paralysis, saliva runs out. Twitching.
Sweet, bitter taste. Taste sweet, sharp and bitter. Increased flow of acrid saliva. Salivation during menses.
Thirsty all the time. Indistinct, jerky speech.
Nose - Redness of nose. Nervous nasal disturbances. Hay fever, itching of nasopharynx and ears. Itching
internally and externally. Spasmodic sneezing after coughing, sensitiveness, watery discharge. Inner angles
very red. Fetid, dark, bloody discharge. Nosebleeds in elderly people. Frequent sneezing without coryza.
Flow of clear water without coryza. Redness. Obstruction on stooping. Sensation of soreness in nose and
mouth.
Perspiration - Cold sweat on face, neck, chest. Sweats easily. Sweats on alternate sides. Night sweats.
Copious sweat when walking, or from least exertion. Greasy sweat, but not offensive. Sweats from anxious
palpitations of heart. Sweats during stool.
Rectum - Crampy colic, with passing wind. Sharp itching in rectum. Itching,prickling in rectum and anus,
as from worms. Biting in rectum after emission of flatus. Flatus hot. Emission of much inodorous gas.
Constipation with rumbling in bowels duringpregnancy. Hemorrhoids. Writhing in rectum. Burning in anus.
Warm feeling in anus. Anus as if completely closed. Dysentery.
Skin - Miliary eruptions with severe itching and burning. Burning, itching, redness and swelling, as if
frozen. Pimples, hard like small fleabites. Chilblains. Angioneurotic edema, rosacea. Swollen veins with cold
skin. Circumscribed erythematous, papular and pustular and edematous lesions. Itching changing place on
scratching. Itching over affected part. Skin pains, when cold. Miliary eruptions with intolerable itching and
burning. Slight blow causes ecchymosis.
Sleep - Sleeplessness from rush of ideas. Restless from violent itching and burning. On falling asleep, starts,
twitches and awakens often. Drowsy in daytime. Unpleasant dreams awaking from sleep. Paroxysms of
yawning. Frequent yawning before pains or spasms as a concomitant. Yawning followed by involuntary laugh-
ter. Vivid dreams. Anxiety as if suffocating in dreams. Nightmares of dead people and graveyards.
 Stomach - Empty belchings, tasting of apples. Flatulent distention of stomach. Profuse inodorous belchings.
Eructation, empty, tasting of apples or of rotten eggs. Belchings and hiccoughs. Eructations alternating with
hiccough. Burning in stomach about three hours after a meal, changing into a dull pressure. Gastric
disturbance with sharp pains in liver region. Nervous disturbances with spasmodic contractions, hiccough.
As if a
lump in epigastrium. Vomiting, bitter with prostration with stitches in rectum and groin.
Stools - Fetid stools. Pappy stools with cutting in abdomen and passing of wind. Very hard stools, at first hard
and knotty, then soft, finally diarrheic. Diarrhea with much fetid, garlicky odor flatus. Diarrhea of children with
grass green, bilious stools. Diarrhea, morning after rising.
Teeth - Teeth sensitive to touch, pressure, or while chewing. Teeth as if too long. Tearing pain, pulsating,
worse cold air. Shooting pain from right upper teeth up to right side of head. Teeth worse, when abdomen gets
better. Toothache at beginning of menses and during. Swelling and bleeding gums, with pain.
Temperature - Chills or sweats easily. Chills with warm face, hands and feet. Very sensitive to cool air.
Chilliness in open air, strikes through whole body. Shiverings over body, running from above downward.
Goosebumps. Violent attacks of fever in evening. Burning spots.
Throat - Stitches along eustachian tube to ear. Feels contracted. Small solid balls of phlegm thrown up.
Dryness of pharynx, swallowing difficult. Scratching in throat, cannot sing a note. Burning, cooling feeling.
Pressure as from a foreign body sticking in throat, not better swallowing. Dryness and constriction of pharynx.
Induration of tonsils and other glands.
Tongue-Tremulous tongue (Lach.). Tongue coated white. Tongue dry, one side numb with vertigo. Tongue as
if dry and contracted, as after an astringent. Splinter like pains in tongue with salivation. Sharp pain, soreness
or burning at tip of tongue. Bad taste at root of tongue. Tip of tongue studded with small dirty yellow aphthae.
Vertigo - Vertigo in morning. Vertigo from sunlight. Vertigo from heat of sun. Vertigo with palpitations. Vertigo
on walking. Vertigo reeling as if drunk. Vertigo with tendency to fall forward. Vertigo with stupefaction and
burning in vertex. Vertigo after menses. Vertigo from yawning.
Vision - Double vision (Gels.). Dim and flickering vision. Flickering vision while
writing. Shortsighted. Reading difficult, as type seems to move to swim. Focal distance changes while
reading. Dim vision as from a mist. Vibrating specters. Muscae volitantes, brown. Yellow, brown or black spots
before left eye.
COMMENTS - Mushrooms are among the articles of diet forbidden to persons of the hydrogenoid constitution,
in which the patients are exceedingly sensitive to cold and damp. Agreeing with this, in the provings of Agaricus
is a great sensitiveness to cold air. In skin disorders and brain exhaustions, give the lower potencies. A left-
sided remedy.
Talcott considered Agar, the most similar to general paralysis of all the remedies, with exalted notions of
grandeur and power, hilarity and excitement followed by depression, confusion, imbecility.
Ludicrous behavior, poor perception. Causes delirium, mania and idiocy. Very talkative and loquacious, and
tend to be alcoholics (Lach.). Creative, tendency to poetry, prophesy. Incoherent speech. Silly, may have a
confused mind, can't think. States of ecstasy and trance. Wants to kiss and embrace everyone (Hyos.).
Mania with great displays of strength. Confusion in the brain as if semi-intoxicated. Tendency to use alcohol
or drugs, spaced out, low energy. Disintegrated personality. Severe mood changes, irritability. May alternate
between two states, one of being silly, foolish and manic and the other being depressed, sad and indifferent
and the states may alternate.
Worse in the morning and during the daytime. Spacey, awkward. Dull, stupid, poor memory. Can’t function
during the day, relieved at night. Energy in the evening, they become more fluent, increased intellect. Worse
mental exertion in general.
Marked and persistent vertigo with constant impulse to fall backward. Very sleepy after meals. Twitching about
eyes and face, redness without heat, puffy and distorted. Visual defects along with twitches, may have blurring
vision or twitching in the left eye.
Facial twitches, trigeminal neuralgias, tic douloureux.
Spasmodic twitchings throughout body, followed by tremulousness, finally relaxation and exhaustion. Don't
twitch during sleep. Drops things. Hands fly open uncontrollably. Arm may snap or twitch without their knowing
it (Nux-v.).
Muscular jerking and twitching, good for chorea. Spinal problems associated with twitching or brain problems
associated with a retarded mind. Spasms and twitches due to spinal disease, arthritis or injury to the spine.
Twitchings are especially marked in the eyes, eyelids and facial muscles. Blepharospasm and tic convulsif.
Awkward people. Ankylosing spondylitis. Spine is as stiff as a board, as if spine would break (Tub., Rhus-t.,
Nat-m.). Severe arthritis of the spine. Shooting, burning pains in the spinal cord, as if the whole spine is on
 fire. Tingling deep in the spine. As if hot or cold needles are being stuck in the spine. For cold spots along the
spine or very tender places that cannot be touched.
Numbness of the extremities from some spinal problems. Pain in the sacrum followed by general paralysis
symptoms, numbness in the limbs. Burning up and down the spine (Phos.). Back and neck feel dislocated, or
for slipped discs with severe pain (Bry., Rhus-t.). Formication of the skin as if bugs are crawling under the skin
(Cocain.).
Symptoms in extremities are as if the blood was cut off to the feet or hands, severe numbness, tingling, biting,
burning of the extremities, as if they are on fire. Spasms and then burning pain and numbness in their legs,
intermittent claudication. Better moving, worse rest. Burning cold, numb, twitching. Awkward walk.
Feet feel so cold as if they are frozen, like blocks of ice. Frostbite. Ailments since frostbite or sensation as if
frozen. Poor circulation where the hands and feet turn blue, then burn as if on fire. Chilblains, loss of blood to
the extremities. Spasms in the arteries and cuts off the blood. Chilblains, worse heat. Creeping, crawling
sensations, formication, itching.
Peripheral vascular disease when the blood vessels in the extremities have deteriorated to the threat of
gangrene.
Compromised blood flow. Typhoid states. Epilepsy. Brain disorders and fever with rolling of the head.
Pain as if touched or pierced by needles of ice is very characteristic.
Diagonal symptoms, right side and left forearm (Lac-c.). Electric-like shocks with jerking, spasms and twitching,
painful. For bone aches as if they would break.
Peculiar headaches, “throbbing headache with sensation of stiffness of muscles of face. Dull, drawing
headache in the morning, extending into root of nose with nosebleed or thick mucus discharge. Pain as from
a nail in right side of head.” Face feels stiff with the headache.
Chilly remedy, worse cold weather, cold air, drinking cold water. They can also have sun headaches (Nat-m.).
Worse from storms. Better in the evening, better warmth and better motion.
Ravenous appetite with bolting of food. Desire for eggs, sweets and salt. Used for sudden, morning diarrhea
that smells like sulphur (Aloe, Sulph., Rumx.). For diarrhea in children that is grass green (Cham.).
Worse after sex (Ph-ac., Sil.), may have more pains and twitches. Sexual desire enormous and enthusiastic
with relaxed penis and impotence.
Bearing down pains in the pelvis as if everything will come with acrid, vaginal discharge with itching of the
vagina. Also for spasmodic chronic hiccups (Nux-v.) and herpes on the lips that burn and smart. The nervous
patients requiring Agar, pass little urine (opp. Ign.), though the bladder may be irritable.
Clinical for alcoholism, intoxication, hangovers, DTs, the shakes. Worse alcoholic or for “old drunks”, spasms,
twitches or convulsions, frothing at the mouth with arching of the back (Nux-v.). Muscle quivers and delirium
tremors. Disordered speech in alcoholics. Lost continuity of speech.
Children with retarded development. Late learning to walk and talk. For children who have slow minds or
mental retardation. Fainting and twitching of children.
Or twitches and spasms ever since puberty or a shock. Excitement brings on twitches and spasms.
Uncoordinated children, they stumble, fall, and drop things. It's hard for them to learn.
Very anxious about their health. Fear of cancer (Ars. Nit-ac., Phos. Kali-ar.). Preoccupation with spookiness,
fear of ghosts. Talk and dream about the dead, are obsessed with coffins.
RELATIONS - Agar, stands between Stram. and Lach. Antidote: Absin., Coff., Camph. Compare: (1) Agar-
cpn., Agar-cps., Agar- em., Agar-pa., Agar-ph., Agar-st., Amanita vemus. (2) Muscarine, Atropiaexactly
opposes Muscarine, resembles Pilocarpine in action. (3) Tamus - chillblains and freckles. (4) Cimic., Cann-i.,
Hyos.,Tarant-h. (5) Bov., Stict, Act-r., Cann-i., Op., Stram. - alcoholism, chorea. (6) Coff. - ecstasy. (7) Cic. -
spasm of eyes. (8) Cod. - spasm of the eyelids. Mygal., Tarent., Verat. - icy-cold feeling in head. (9) Ars. - hot
needles, Agar, ice-cold needles.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.
keynote:

Fungi. Grows in Europe, Asia and America in dry places, especially in dry pine woods. Trituration of the
carefully dried-up cap. Tincture of the fresh fungus. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne rosacea. Alcoholism. Blepharospasm. Brain, softening. Bunion. Chilblains. Chorea.
Coldness. Cough. Cramps. Delirium tremens. Epilepsy. Fever, enteric. Frostbite. Gangrene. Headaches.
Hyperpyre

name: Agaricus Pantherinus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - agar-pa. Agaricus pantherinus. Spotted amanita. N. O. Fungi. Historicaldose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Coma. Convulsion. Delirium. Diarrhea. Fatigue. Mania. Spasms. Trembling. Twitchings. Vertigo.
HOMEOPATHIC - Agaricus pantherinus is a brownish species (not reddish, like Agaricus muscarius), found
in woods or pastures in England and in the United States, not considered poisonous.
General overpowering sense of fatigue. Extreme lassitude and torpor. Problems coordinating muscular
movements. Convulsive movements. Loss of power. Monosyllabic answers, with annoyance. Vertigo. Loss of
consciousness. Violent general spasms. Violent convulsive twitchings of the muscles of the face and limbs.
 Restless tossing about. MIND - Delirium. Maniacal disposition to rave.
State of consciousness resembling coma. Loss of memory.
Eyes - Eyes partly open. Conjunctiva injected. Red eyes.
Face - Face congested.
Food - Some loss of appetite.
Head - Great heaviness of the head. Heat in the head.
Limbs - Trembling of the hands.
Lungs - Respiration stertorous and irregular. After a few deep inspirations the respirations became weaker
and weaker, until at last they ceased entirely for about a quarter of a minute, then there were again deep
inspirations.
Mouth - Lips tremble.
Rectum - Slight diarrhea.
Sleep - Invincible drowsiness. Stupor. During sleep, respiration embarrassed, face congested and of a livid
hue, pulse rather slow.
Throat - Difficult swallowing.
RELATIONS - Compare: Agar. Agar-cpn., Agar-cps., Agar-em., Agar-ph., Agar-st., Amanita vernus.
REFERENCES - Allen.

***AGARICUS PHALLOÏDES
(Amanita Bulbosa)
PHARMACY - agar-ph. Agaricus phalloides. Amanita bulbosa. Agaricus bulbosa. Amanita phalloides. N. O.
Fungi. Europe and North America. Tincture of fresh fungus. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Chills. Cholera. Chorea. Cold. Collapse. Coma. Cramps. Convulsions. Delirium. Diarrhea.
Gastritis. Malaise. Trismus. Urine, suppression. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Agaricus phalloides is a small stinking fungus common in Europe and North America. The
poison is a toxalbumin, resembling the poison in the rattlesnake and the poison excreted by the cholera and
diphtheria germs. It acts on the red blood corpuscles, dissolving them so that blood escapes into the alimentary
canal and the whole system is drained.
The amount of this toxic principle is small, even handling specimens and breathing the spores affects some
people unpleasantly.
The poison is slow in development, even twelve to twenty hours after taking it the patient feels all right.
Symptoms generally begin with vertigo, followed by violent choleraic symptoms with rapid loss of strength, with
death preceded by stupor and spasms on the second or third day. Symptoms observed in poisoning cases
give a complete picture. Extreme prostration and chilliness, the sweat is cold, marked hippocratic face, the
tongue is cold and there is violent thirst.
Debility, prostration. Malaise. Staggers as if intoxicated and with odd gestures, labors to express his sufferings
but cannot articulate a syllable. Violent convulsions. Slight convulsive motions in the legs and arms, which
generally extend to the muscles of the trunk and cause irregular distortions of the whole body. Constant
restlessness.
Very frequent bilious vomiting. Incessant cramps in stomach. Hard, tense abdomen. Frequent whitish watery
stools or bilious, bloody stools.
The urine is suppressed, the voice is hoarse. Pulse small intermittent, hardly perceptible. The limbs are cold
and there are violent cramps in legs, feet and calves.
Fatty degeneration of liver, heart and kidneys, hemorrhages in lungs, pleura and skin. Lethargic but mentally
clear. Sudden changes from rapid to slow and from slow to rapid breathing. Intense thirst for cold water, dry
skin.
Extreme collapse. Cholera, cramps in stomach, cold limbs, urine suppressed. Vomiting and purging.
Continuous urging to stool, but no gastric, abdominal or rectal pain.
MIND - Mental excitement for three days after taking them. Delirium with faint indistinct dreams. Very averse
to lying down.
Restlessness and impatience lead him to make frequent attempts to walk about, but without any fixed object
or design. Complete consciousness until death. Stupor. Coma and rattling respiration before death.
Abdomen - Violent pains in epigastrium, which spread rapidly over the whole abdomen, greatly worse by
pressure. Abdomen tense, swollen, painful. Unendurable pain in hypogastrium and lumbar region.
Eyes - Eyes sunken, weak and lusterless. Pupils much dilated.
Face - Deathlike pallor, face sunken, cyanotic. Nose and mouth dry. Anxious countenance, hippocratic. Tetanic
closure of jaws with at times grating of the teeth.
 Head - Frightful pains in head.
Kidneys - Suppression of urine.
Limbs - Cold limbs. Skin of limbs lost its elasticity. Upper limbs swell and become livid, fingertips livid. Cramps
of the legs of the calves of the feet with drawing back of the limbs.
Lungs - Respirations short.
Modalities - Worse from pressure.
Mouth - Teeth and gums black. Cold tongue.
Breath cold. Trismus. Speech slow, difficult. Stammering.
Perspiration - Sweat cold.
Pulse - Small and intermittent, hardly perceptible, slow and somewhat irregular, hard and frequent. Pulse full
and rapid (later action).
Rectum - Anus inflamed. Frequent, bilious, whitish stools as in Asiatic cholera. Frequent, watery, bloody
stools.
Skin - Body covered with livid spots.
Sleep - Somnolence.
Stomach - Violent pain in epigastrium, worse pressure. Violent thirst, nausea, vomiting, then diarrhea. Pains
in stomach and hypogastrium followed by anxiety and vomiting. Incessant cramps of stomach. Very frequent
mucus and bilious vomiting. Vomiting of an offensive greenish-colored fluid of blood.
Temperature - Marked chilliness. Skin cool, afterwards hot.
Throat - Dry throat. Constant burning sensation in the pharynx after vomiting. Voice hoarse.
Vertigo - Vertigo always on rising up without loss of consciousness.
COMMENTS - General cholera symptoms are developed, as with Agar, muscarius. At times, the development
of choleraic symptoms saves the patient. Chilliness predominates.
Prominent convulsions. Mental excitement, which has in some cases lasted for three days. Sometimes there
is stupor, at . other times consciousness remains until death.
The effects do not come on until ten or twelve hours after taking the drug (Colch.).
RELATIONS - Compare: Agar. Agar-cpn., Agar-cps., Agar-em., Agar-pa., Agar-st., Amanita vemus.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Agaricus Stercoranius
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - agar-st. Agaricus stercoranius. N. O. Fungi. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Coma. Convulsions. Delirium. Headache. Twitching. Vertigo. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Thomas Stevenson M. D., writes in Guy's Hosp. Reports, vol. xix, p. 418: R. M., age thirty-
nine years, ate food with Agar-st. in it. In half an hour he complained of nausea, some oppression in his
breathing, and of severe pain across the forehead, with giddiness.
His wife then noticed a strangeness in his appearance, and that in attempting to walk he kept his eyes fixed
on the ground and guided himself with difficulty. He was, however, quite conscious of everything, and opened
a book to see if he could read, but found that he was unable to make out any of the letters.
When outdoors he continued to suffer severely from the pain across the forehead, with giddiness, and in
addition experienced a feeling as if something was continually over his head, or as if passing “through an
arcade.” He staggered much.
About 11 p.m. after more than three hours, Mr. Hicks was called to see him. Hicks found him sitting down in a
semi-state of stupor, with pupils dilated and inactive, and the pulse slow and feeble, from 55 to 60. On being
roused and made to get up he looked completely bewildered, staggered as if tipsy, and said he could not
recognize the things in the room, nor the room itself as that which he usually occupied.
He now become more restless, threw his arms about, and seemed anxious to be continually moving from place
to place. He also appeared to be somewhat convulsed, with twitching of the muscles of the face, and
complained of pickings in his hands, and of a feeling as if they were swelling. He suddenly became more
excited, and rushed wildly out of the house into the street. He was found in a neighbor's house, considerably
prostrated after his exertions, and in a very lethargic state.
Twenty grains of Zinc sulphate were now administered, and in a short time vomiting ensued, much dark fluid
with numerous pieces of fungi being brought up. For a short time afterwards he expressed himself as feeling
better, and was allowed to be taken to the door of the cottage.
Almost immediately afterwards, as if moved by a sudden impulse, he again rushed wildly out, but after going
a short distance stopped suddenly, as if bewildered. Emetics were again administered and the stomach pump
used, and in the course of a few hours he gradually recovered, though feeling much prostrated.
He said that during the whole time he was quite conscious of what was being done, but that at times he felt
 drowsy and inclined to sleep. When the convulsive paroxysms came on he felt wild and excited, with ah
irresistible desire to move about and to run. He had no pain in the stomach or bowels at any time, nor did the
feeling of oppression of his breathing continue after the first symptoms.
RELATIONS - Compare: Agar. Agar-cpn., Agar-cps., Agar-em., Agar-pa., Agar-ph., Amanita vemus.
REFERENCES - Stevenson.
