name: Agathis Australis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - agath-a. Agathis australis. Kauri tree. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Asthma. Backache. Bulimia. Catarrh. Colic. Coryza. Coughs. Diarrhea. Flatulence. Hay fever.
Headaches. Heat, flushes. Hysteria. Lachrymation. Lassitude. Leucorrhea. Monomania. Numbness. Photo-
phobia. Salivation. Sneezing. Tooth, decay. Toothache. Twitching.
HOMEOPATHIC - Breathing deep ameliorates. Becomes cold easily. Heat flushes with numbness, waves of
heat. Sensation of heat on surface of the body, of energy moving up the body. Heaviness sensation. Lassitude,
in the afternoon, walking in open air ameliorates.
Waves of numbness. Usually painful complaints are painless. Prickling sensation. Sluggishness. Worse
exposure to the sun. Tingling, trickling sensation, like drops. Twitching. Desires to walk. Wavelike sensation.
Pins and needles sensations. Muscular weakness. Weariness in the afternoon.
MIND - Mental power increased. Memory active for past events. Yearning for things long past. Abundant ideas.
Restlessness. Irritable. Monomania. Tranquility, serenity, calmness. Spaced-out feeling. Stupefaction with
sleepiness. Vague thoughts.
Clearness of mind alternating with dullness, with sleeplessness. Dullness, as if drunk, in the afternoon. As if
mind enveloped in a fog. Mental exhaustion, brain fag. Confused memory. Memory loss. Weakness of memory.
Forgets what was about to do or say. Memory weakness foreveryday things, words. Mistakes about left and
right sides, in speaking, writing. Transposes words and uses wrong letters, figures. Studying and reading
difficult. Erroneous thoughts. Mental confusion. Confusion as to his identity, sense of duality.
Anxiety for the world. Anxiety in chest and heart region. Cares, full of worries. Desires death. Thoughts of
death. Despair of recovery. Discontented with himself. Disgust.
Fear of being alone. Fear of poverty. Forsaken feeling. Feels friendless. Aversion to company. Indifference,
apathy. Self-loathing, contempt. Remorse. Helpless feelings. Detached. Discouraged. Insecurity. Hatred.
Yearning, longing for things lost.
Moods are changeable. Weeping and tearful mood. Weeping and laughing at same time. Loquacity. Cheerful,
exuberant and talkative. Ceaseless, childish, hysterical laughing, excessive. Laughs easily, everything seems
ludicrous.
As if intoxicated. Gay delirium, exhilaration. Impulsive. High-spirited. Excitement. Audacity. Childish behavior.
Makes strange faces. Curses.
Bulimia. Lascivious, lustful. Tendency to lie. Oversensitive. Sensitive to noise. Sensation of being old.
Quarrelsome with her family. Quiet disposition. Resignation. Sadness from a dream. Heaviness, sensation
alternating with clearness of mind. Dancing ameliorates mental symptoms.
Abdomen - Sensation of something alive, movements. Bubbling sensation. Painful distension. Flatulence.
Fluttering sensation. Gurgling in the evening. Heaviness as from a load. Aching, dull pain. Pain as if clutching
with nails. Clawing, cramping, griping pain. Pains extending downward. Sharp pain in the sides, in the evening.
Rumbling in daytime, evening, as if diarrhea would come on. Stopped sensation. Twitching and jerking in sides.
Colic during diarrhea.
Back - Backache. Aching pains in dorsal region, scapulae, spine, lumbar region, sacrum. Boring pain,
extending to right shoulder, in dorsal region, scapulae. Burning pain in dorsal region, right scapulae, between
scapulae. Cutting pain as if stabbed. Stabbing pain in vertebrae. Digging pain on right side. Lancinating pain
in dorsal region. Pain as if someone is poking. Painful stiffness, in sacral region. Tension in dorsal region,
scapulae. Twitching. Backpains extending to arms, elbow, lower limbs, shoulder, thighs, wrist.
Bladder - Constant urging to urinate, with thirst. Long, copious, increased urination, brown, dark brown,
brown-yellowish, dark, yellow-dark, straw yellow.
Breasts - Pain in breasts, worse evening, night. Cutting, stitching pain, at night.
Chest - Anxiety in chest and heart region. Constriction, tightness, dryness, oppression. Pains evening in bed,
at night. Pain from pressure on chest. Pains on sides, left. Burning pain in the sternum, pressure aggravates.
Pressing pain in sternum. Cramping pains, under ribs, sides. Cutting, stitching pain, in ribs, sides, evening and
night, extending downward. Sore, bruised pain, particularly ribs. Tearing pain and tension in lower ribs.
Cough - Dry, tickling cough, from irritation in larynx. Persistent cough.
 Ears - Coldness as from a draft. Formication. Noises in ears like bell of a clock. Ringing in ears. Boring,
lancinating, stitching pains. Stopped sensation, afternoon. Heat on one side, left ear very hot.
Eyes - Filmy. Pain in right eye. Itching in the corners of eyes. Itching canthi, eyelids. Photophobia, during
headache. Involuntary desire to close the eyes. Heaviness, pressure sensation. Lachrymation. Burning,
cutting, sore, stinging pains. Sensation as from a foreign body.
Face - Sensation of collapse. Pale, flushes easily. Stupid expression. Red face. Sensation of forehead
wrinkled. Herpetic eruptions about lips, nose. White pimples. Itching, scratching ameliorates, particularly of
cheeks. Aching pain, pressing, pulling sensation.
Female - Menses black, inky, pitch-like. Menses too early, and frequent, every two weeks. Menses too short.
Clutching and relaxing sensation of uterus. Offensive leucorrhea, like ammonia, old cheese. Leucorrhea yeast-
like, thin, watery, transparent. Vagina pain. Burning pain in ovaries. Cramping, grasping pain in uterus. Drawing
pain. Lancinating pain, vagina. Piercing pain in pubic bone. Sore pains. Sore vagina. Sharp pain in labia,
uterus, vagina. Sexual desire diminished, wanting or increased, insatiable. Swollen before and during menses.
Food - Appetite increased, with menses. Appetite ravenous, canine hunger. De-
Agathis australis sires bread, meat, fried food, juicy fruits, chocolate, sweets, cold drink and water, and beer
in the morning. Aversion to vegetables. Thirst, at night, on waking. Extreme thirst for large quantities.
Head - Tension headaches. Photophobia during headache. Sensation of a current of air passing through head.
Boiling sensation on forehead. Congestion, constriction, tension. Empty, hollow sensation. Headaches in the
morning, ceases toward evening.
Limbs - Awkwardness. Coldness at night in bed. Cold hands, knee, leg. Cramps in forearm and hand.
Heaviness sensation of thigh. Itching on hands, fingers, thighs, knees, ankles. Sensation of lightness. Lumps
in elbows, ankles. Numbness in forearm, wrist, ankle. Pain in right shoulder, forearm, and wrist. Aching pain
in upper limbs, elbow, legs, wrist, heat ameliorates. Knee aches in evening. Burning pain in forearm. Drawing,
pressing pain in shoulder, extending to nape of neck. Shooting pain in upper limbs, shoulder, elbow, wrist.
Sore, bruised pain. Wrist as if sprained. Swelling of ankle. Tingling in the forearm, thigh, knee. Tingling in the
foot, extending upwards. Twitching in the knee.
Lungs - Anxious, asthmatic breathing. Periodical dyspnea, dyspnea after vexation. Breathing irregular, slow,
stertorous. Difficult breathing, as from dust, in the evening, night, worse mental exertion.
Modalities - Worse exposure to the sun. Worse mental exertion.
Mouth - Itching. Salivation, morning in bed. Herpetic ulcers, on lips, around mouth. Painful, sore, smarting
ulcers. Dental caries, decayed, hollow teeth. Toothache, pain in roots. Sensation of lips swelling.
Neck - Itching. Stiffness in neck, region. Swelling in nape of neck. Tension in cervical region.
Nose - Hay fever with asthmatic breathing. Hay asthma, with sneezing. Catarrh. Coryza, Sneezing, constant,
frequent, paroxysmal. Sneezing in sunshine. One sided nasal discharge, at night. Bloody discharge in the
morning. Dripping discharge. Gummy discharge. Agglutination of nostrils in the morning. Cracks in nostrils.
Dryness inside nose, night, painful. Itching. Nasal obstruction, one sided, in morning and night. Pain in root.
Tip of nose swelling, in morning and evening. Tingling inside on blowing the nose. Acute smell.
Perspiration - Profuse. Sweetish odor.
Rectum - Diarrhea in afternoon, evening, night. Itching. Rectal pain with diarrhea. Stinging pain with stool.
Stools mushy, soft, thin liquid.
Skin - Herpetic eruptions, itching. Heat sensation. Itching, prickling. Herpetic ulcers. Itching, painful, swollen
ulcers.
Sleep - Unrefreshing sleep. Bad sleep, disturbed easily by dreams, thoughts. Frequent waking from dreams.
Restless from dreams. Semi-conscious. Sleepiness in forenoon, afternoon. Sleepiness with detached
sensation and vagueness.
Stomach - Disordered stomach. Belching, gurgling, nausea. Heaviness after eating. Clawing, prickling pains.
Throat - Choking sensation as if grasped. Dryness of throat, worse morning. Dryness after expectoration.
Sensation of a foreign body in esophagus. Esophagitis. Sore pain on swallowing. Sensation of swelling. Thick
sensation
Tongue - Sensation as if tongue enlarged. Tip numb, swollen.
Vertigo - Floaty feeling. Tendency to fall forward.
Vision - Acute, clear, bright and lucid vision. Blurred and foggy. Blindness.
REFERENCES - Gray. Norland.

name: Agave Americana
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - agav-a. Agave americana. Century plant. American aloe. N. O. Ama- ryllidaceae. Agavaceae.
 Tincture of freshchopped leaves. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Gonorrhea. Hydrophobia. Scurvy. Stomach, pain. Strangury.
HERBAL - The fermentedjuice of Agave americana is the Mexican intoxicating beverage “Pulque. ’’ The plant
has a local reputation as a remedy for hydrophobia. Indicated in stomach ache and painful erections in
gonorrhea.
HOMEOPATHIC - Agav-a. is an unproved remedy. According to Hansen, Agav-a. is indicated in scurvy,
stomachache and gonorrhea. Hydrophobia. Scurvy, pale countenance, swollen and bleeding gums. Strangury.
The legs covered with dark purple blotches, swollen, painful and hard. Appetite poor, bowels constipated.
MIND - Quarrelsomeness, excitement, fright inability to swallow, great anxiety.
COMMENTS - A striking case is quoted by the Homeopathic Recorderfrom El Siglo Medico. A boy developed
the classical symptoms of hydrophobia four and a half months after being bitten. He showed quarrelsomeness,
excitement, fright, inability to swallow, small frequent pulse, and great anxiety.
Finally swallowing was impossible, restraint had to be used to prevent him from biting his nurses in the hospital.
As a last resource, a piece of Agave was offered to the boy by the doctor in attendance, cut from a hedge of
the plant with which the hospital grounds were fenced.
To the astonishment of all, the boy reached for it and ate it greedily, almost without chewing. By evening a
decrease in the violence of the nervous attacks was manifest, though they remained as frequent as before.
The improvement was slow but steady.
On the fourth day he took some nourishment. but also continued chewing Agave and swallowing the juice. On
the fifth day he recovered consciousness but still demanded Agave. On the eighth day he said he did not want
any more as “it tasted too bitter and caused a burning in the mouth.” He had no further symptoms of the
disease.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Anhalonium, Lyss., Lach.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Agave Tequilana
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - agav-t. Agave tequilana. Agave rígida. N. O. Amaryllidaceae. Agavaceae. Pulque and Tequila
are drinks made from the plant. Tincture of whole plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL-Alcoholism. Anorexia. Cancerous conditions. Chronic invalid syndrome. Drug addictions.
Emphysema. Hypopituitarism. Laryngitis. Memory, lost. Migraine. Silicosis. Tubercular conditions.
HERBAL - The agaves belong to the Amarylli- daceaefamily.Their appearance isreminiscent of aloes. The
plant is used in the preparation of a popular drink, “pulque.” which is obtained by the fermentation of the plant
and a liqueur, ‘Tequila,” obtained by distillation. Roughly 170 varieties of agave are in existence and, for the
most part, they originate from Northern and Central America.
HOMEOPATHIC - General fatigue, weakness and muscles pains. Anorexia. Insomnia. Erratic rheumatic pains.
Impotence. Ovarian pain. Alcoholism and alcoholic polyneuritis with mental troubles. Desire for alcoholic
drinks. Migraine, notably alcoholic. Hypopituitarism, impotence or amenorrhea with genital and mammary
atrophy. Laryngitis and bronchitis. Tuberculosis. Emphysema. Silicosis.
MIND - Sadness and pessimism. Desire for the unattainable. Unsatisfied, unrealistic desires. Alcoholism with
mental troubles. Voluble state, excitable. Jokes, asks questions is humorous.
State of nervous irritation, stammers, shouts, becomes violent, even aggressive. Hypomania, a state of
exaltation, exaggerated over-activity, followed often by a period of depression. Temporary amnesia following
the excited state. Dazed state.
Back - Rheumatic pain in the lumbar region and lower limbs.
Ears - Itching of the auditory canal with the urge to scratch with the first object that comes to hand. Buzzing in
both ears. Diminution of auditory acuity. Eczema of the auditory canal. Deafness.
Eyes - Conjunctival congestion and itching of the eyelids. Diplopia and impeded vision, more intense in one
eye than the other. Burning sensation in the eyes, resulting in rubbing. Blepharitis. Dacryocystitis. Choroiditis.
Face - Feeling of heat about the face, even though he is pale.
Female - Ovarian inflammation and pain. Acute bilateral pain in the ovaries. Weak, painful menstrual flow.
Menstrual stomachache relieved by drinking alcohol. Painful Menstruation.
Food - Total lack of appetite. Desire for alcoholic drinks.
Head - Headache when turning the head from one side to the other. Heaviness and slight headache, eased
by pressing the head between the hands.
Limbs - Leg cramps, especially when lying down. Rheumatic pains in different places, aggravated by
movement. Short, frequent bouts of arthritis and periarthritis often accompanied by nodules both intradermal
and beneath the skin.
 Liver - Cirrhosis, alcoholic or atrophic.
Lungs - Dilatation of the bronchi. Cough with sticky, yellow-green sputum. Profusion of glairy secretion, which
makes breathing difficult. Forcing the subject to sleep almost upright in bed. Laryngitis with tracheitis.
Male - Intermittent pain in the testicles, as if result of contusion. Incomplete erection, but ejaculation in spite of
the flaccidity of the penis. Low sexual desire. Impotence. Epididymitis with orchitis, tubercular or sycotic. Cyst,
epididymis.
Modalities - Worse from movement. Worse alcoholic drinks.
Nose - Dryness of the nasal mucus membrane. Formation of sticky nasal scabs which block and are difficult
to expel and which make breathing painful. Difficulty in wiping the nose, the scabs come off, causing great
pain. Nose blocked at night, alternating from one side to the other. Ozaena. Sinusitis.
Sleep - Insomnia becomes worse after drinking alcohol. Disturbed dreams, having a bearing on the day's
events and of an obsessive nature.
Stomach - Heartburn, hyperacidity of the stomach. Acid dyspepsia. Diffuse hypertrophic cirrhosis from the
alcoholic causes. Feeling of emptiness in the stomach, compulsion to eat, but no hunger.
Throat - Dry throat. Difficulty in swallowing as a result of constriction in the neck. Hoarse voice.
Vertigo - Slight vertigo and troubled vision.
COMMENTS - The Homeopathic proving was directed by De Legarreta using 3x, 15 drops three times a day.
In his first proving, he used the mother tincture, prepared from the plant itself. In the second proving, the
remedy was prepared from Tequila liqueur.
The symptomatological table was the same in both cases. De Legarreta recommends 15 drops of 3x in the
morning, fasting as a preventive treatment foralcoholism, causing aversion to alcoholic drinks.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Bryonia - Dryness of the mucus membranes, severe biting pains, better by
pressure and rest, aggravated by the slightest movement. (2) Lachesis - Sad, melancholic in the morning, the
sleep disturbed, cannot bear any constriction. Extreme loquacity, especially in the evening. Antidote against
the bad effects of alcohol. (3) Ran-b. - Antidote against the bad effects of alcohol. Stinging pain in the eyes.
Vesicular eruptions which resemble herpes.
REFERENCES Julian.

name: Agnus Castus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - agn. Agnus castus. Chaste tree. Vitex agnus castus. Verbena verticillata. N. O. Verbenacae.
Found on the shores of Mediterranean, Provence and Greece. Tincture of ripe berries. Historical dose:
Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Abuse, sexual. Agalactia. Anus, excoriation. Ascites. Breast-milk. Chronic fatigue. Debility.
Depression. Dislocations. Fatigue. Gonorrhea. Gouty, joints. Gums, ulcerated. Hormonal, disorders.
Impotency. Infertility. Knees, coldness. Leucorrhea. Masturbation. Memory, weak. Mouth, ulcers. Neurotic.
Photophobia. Premature, aging. Rheumatism. Spleen, swelling, induration. Sexual, melancholy. Sexual,
weakness. Sprains. Strains. Tachycardia. Testicles, disorders. Toothache. Weakness.
HERBAL - The Vitex Agnus Castus of the Alchemists, the “chaste berry” from this tree is taken as a herbal
tonic for the sexual organs and hormones. Agnus castus is for low sexual vitality with corresponding mental
depression and loss of nervous energy.
The Chaste Tree was used in ancient times by both men and women to suppress their sexual desire. It was
used by the Greek monks centuries ago to lower their sex drive.
HOMEOPATHIC - Agnus produces its chief effect on sexual organs of both the sexes. General debility and
depression of vital power are marked. Impotence and infertility in both sexes, but more pronounced in men.
History of repeated gonorrhea or masturbation. Impotency and premature old age from loss of sexual power.
Nervous debility in unmarried persons.
Weakness from masturbation habit. Gnawing itching in all parts, especially eyes. Tachycardia caused by
tobacco in neurotic young men. A remedy for sprains and strains.
MIND - Absent-minded, and forgetful. Distraction of mind. Inability to fix attention when reading. Bad memory.
Unable to recollect things has to read a sentence twice before he can comprehend. Forgetful of purchases,
goes off and leaves them.
Depression. Nervous depression and mental forebodings. Fear of death. Great sadness with a fixed idea of
approaching death (Aeon.). Sad and despairing, repeats that he will soon die. Desires death. Doubts if
anything had existence.
Changeable, moods. Indifference to everything, alternating with cheerfulness. Lack of courage.
Discouragement alternating with haughtiness. Lethargy alternating with frenzy. Exhilaration alternating with
 sadness.
Neurotic. Peevish. Inclined to get angry. Premature old age with apathy and melancholy. Mental ailments
from sexual excesses, masturbation. Sexual melancholy. Self-contempt from sexual abuse (Staph.).
Aversion to sex. Sexual thrill absent from excessive masturbation. Illusion of smell, herring, musk. Starting
during sleep.
Abdomen - Ascites. Abdomen distended after meals. Incarcerated flatus. Abdomen sensitive to pressure.
Rumbling in abdomen during sleep. Violent contracting pain coming suddenly in morning. Spleen swollen,
sore. Swelling and induration of spleen, often with soreness, after intermittent fever. Nausea with sensation
as if intestines were pressed downwards. Bowels as if sinking down, wants to support bowels with hands.
Flatus smells like urine, remaining long on clothes.
Back - Creaking noise in vertebrae. Pain in sacrum, from flatus. Sharp, deep pain on and near coccyx. Sharp
pain near sacrum.
Breasts - Agalactia. Breast-milk absent, with sadness. Milk scanty or entirely suppressed. Deficient secretion
of milk in lying-in women (Calc-p.).
Chest - Sensation of dryness in chest. Hard pressure in the region of the sternum, especially during a deep
inspiration. Pressure in xiphoid cartilage. Hard pressure in right axilla and upper arm, worse touch or motion.
Constitutions - It corresponds to lymphatic, sycotic constitutions. Premature old age with apathy and
melancholy. Nervous debility in unmarried persons. Impotence and gleet in old offenders.
Cough - Coughs during the evening. Coughs in bed, before going to sleep. Coughs with raising of blood,
followed by copious mucus. Coughs in paroxysms. Coughs with palpitations and epistaxis. Coughs when
inhaling cold air.
Ears - Roaring in the ears. Hardness of hearing.
Eyes - Gnawing itching in eyes. Corrosive itching over and on eyebrows and lids, and below eyes. Sensation
as if one had received a blow on eye. Burning pain when reading in evening. Pupils dilated (Bell.).
Photophobia. Dim vision before menses.
Face - Corrosive itching on the cheeks. Formication in cheeks. Tearing under right lower jaw. Long sharp pain
followed by fine pricking itching. Rending, tearing pain under alveoli of right lower jaw. Erysipelas on left cheek,
spreading from nose over face and head.
Female - Menses are suppressed with abdominal pains. Bearing down pains. Suppressed menses. Scanty
menses. Infertility with suppressions of menses and no sexual desire (Sep.). Swelling of uterus. Leucorrhea
staining yellow, transparent. Relaxation of genitals with leucorrhea. Transparent vaginal discharge passes
imperceptibly from the very relaxed genital. Retained placenta. Ailments due to masturbation, sexual
excesses. Sexual thrill absent from excessive masturbation. Aversion to sex.
Food - Appetite lessened. Food makes him feel uneasy and replete. Only the most simple food agrees.
Relishes food, but it doesn't agree with him. Warm food and drink cause teeth to ache. Thirst during heat.
Thirstlessness, and aversion to all drink.
Head - Headache before menses. Tearing pain with pressure in the temples and forehead, worse during
motion. Pain in the temple, as from a blow. Heaviness in the head and pressure, as if the head would fall
forward. Pain in the vertex. Tension and chilliness in the scalp, which is warm to the touch. Biting-itching on
scalp, worse evenings and when falling asleep.
Heart - Hysterical palpitations with nosebleed in women. Tachycardia caused by tobacco in neurotic young
men. Slow and weak pulse, often imperceptible. Palpitations during cough.
Kidneys - Passes more urine, frequently. Pain in bladder. When urinating, pain in kidneys. Red, turbid urine
with burning and pressure in urethra. Gets up twice at night and even once during siesta to urinate.
Limbs - Inflammatory, rheumatic swelling of joints. Sprains and strains. Gouty nodosities. Hard pressure in
right axilla and upper arm, worse from touch and motion. Strains from lifting a little too much. Swelling of
the finger joints, with arthritic, tearing pains. Heaviness of right foot, as from a weight. Joints as if dislocated.
Feels bruised all over. Cold hands, cold knees, even in bed. Joints easily twisted. Feet easily turn under when
walking on stone pavement. Rheumatic and gouty nodosities on joints.
Liver - Aching in region of liver worse touch.
Lungs - Dyspnea worse evening. Dyspnea on going up stairs. Tough, hanging mucus like a rag in fauces.
Male - Itching of genitals. Testicles, cold, swollen, hard and painful. Penis small, flaccid. Drawing pain along
spermatic cords. Loss of prostatic fluid on straining. Gleety discharge. Yellow discharge from urethra.
Aversion to sex. Impotence with genitals cold and relaxed. Impotence, after frequent attacks of gonorrhea,
syphilis. No erections. Penis so relaxed that voluptuous fancies excite no erection. Feeble erections without
sexual desire. Impotence, with morning erections only. Spermatorrhea with impotence. Ailments
Agnus castus due to masturbation, sexual excesses. Sexual desire almost lost. Sexual desire gone (Sei.,
 Con., Sabal.). Scanty emission without ejaculation.
Modalities - Better scratching. Better pressure. Worse from over lifting, sprains. Worse from sexual excess.
Worse from seminal losses. Worse from masturbation.
Mouth - Mouth very dry. Saliva viscid and tough, drawing out in strings. Ulcers in the mouth and on the gums.
Metallic, coppery, bitter taste. Boils. Tongue coated white.
Nose - Hard ache on dorsum of nose, better pressure. Soreness and pain in left side of nose. Illusion of smell,
herring, musk.
Perspiration - Sweats, almost only on the hands, when walking in the open air. Sweats easily. Pungent smell,
causes dullness and headache. Sweats followed by vomiting and trembling.
Rectum - Anus excoriated. Deep fissures of the anus, often giving pain when walking. Flatus smells like urine,
remaining long on clothes. Sensation as of subcutaneous ulceration near the anus, only while walking.
Difficulty of passing soft stools. When pressing at stool, discharge of prostatic fluid. Corrosive itching of the
perineum. Sensation as if diarrhea would set in, when standing.
Skin - Corrosive itching on different parts of the body, better by scratching, but soon returns. Itching around
the ulcers, in4he evening. Yellow tint of skin.
Sleep - Sleeplessness. Awaking often, as if alarmed, starting. Anxious dreams. Amorous dreams.
Stomach - Only the most simple food agrees. Belchings, smell like urine. Pinching pain when sitting bent over.
Nausea in pit of stomach after eating. Nausea in pit when standing. Nausea as from eating fat food.
Stools - Stools soft, recede, difficult. Diarrhea of children. Chronic diarrhea of adults.
Teeth - Teeth are painful when touched by warm food or drink. Throbbing, tearing pain in left eyetooth. Small
boil near tooth, very painful to touch.
Temperature - Chilliness, internal with -trembling, the external skin is warm. Chill alternating with heat. Chilly
all over, but only hands feel cold to touch. Much chilliness, with cold hands. Flushes of burning heat, principally
in the face, with cold knees in the evening in bed.
Throat - Corrosive itching in pit of throat. Voice as if passing through wool. Voice has no timbre.
Vertigo - Vertigo before menses. Vertigo from loss of vital fluids.
COMMENTS - Great sadness with a fixed idea of approaching death, especially after confinement when milk
fails to appear. Deficiency of milk with despair of recovery. Absent-minded. Drowsiness.
Illusion of smell, like herrings or musk. Ulcers in mouth and on gums. Tearing pain in lower jaw. Toothache
from hot food or drink. Swelling and induration of spleen. Rumbling of flatus during sleep.
Discharge of prostatic fluid while straining at stool. Suppressed menses with abdominal pain. Leucorrhea
staining yellow. Infertility. Pain as if dislocated in joints. Joints easily twisted. Rheumatic and gouty nodosities
on joints.
Hahnemann became interested in this remedy when he read that the Chaste tree was used by the Greek
monks centuries ago to stop their sex drive. They would take tincture doses and they took so much that their
testicles and genitals would atrophy.
In Boericke there are descriptions of shrinking and atrophying, “Testicles, cold, swollen, hard, and painful,”
“lower sexual vitality,” and “corresponding depression.”
Useful for people who have over exerted themselves sexually, a promiscuous period, and since have lost sex
drive, very apathetic. Emaciated, pale, blue circles around their eyes with dilated pupils. Sexual neurasthenia.
Sexual melancholy, depression about not having a lover, gloom, moroseness. All sexual desire is gone.
Impotence. History of repeated gonorrhea or promiscuity. The genitals are cold and relaxed, can get no
erection.
History of cures of chronic spermatorrhea, chronic dribbling of semen and prostatic fluid because of the
weakness in the whole area. Women's abhorrence or aversion to sexual intercourse and infertility (Nat-m., Ph-
ac., Sep.).
RELATIONS - Agnus is the only proved member of the Verbena family, though the Labiate or Mint family are
closely allied. Teste groups it with Mur-ac. and Hyos.Antidotedby: Camphor, Nat-m. - headache, strong
solutions of table-salt. Compare: (1) Sei., Con., Nat-m., Sep., Sabal., Ph-ac., Camph, Lyc. Olnd. (2)
Leucorrhea staining yellow, Nux-v., Chel., Carb-an., Kseos. Followed well by: Ars.,Bry.. Ign„ Lyc., Puls.,
Sulph., Sei.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

name: Agraphis Nutans
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-agra. Agraphisnutans.Bluebell. Wild hyacinth. Endymion nutans. Scilla nutans. N. O. Liliaceae.
Hyacinthaceae. Tincture of fresh plant and growing shoots. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
 CLINICAL - Adenoids. Catarrh. Chill. Deafness. Diarrhea. Glands, enlarged. Tonsillitis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Agraphis is one of the remedies introduced by Dr. Cooper. The plant grows in sheltered
places, and Dr. Cooper gave “better from shelter” as a leading indication. It partakes of the characters of the
lilies and corresponds to catarrhal conditions.
Clarke regarded it as one of the leading remedies in cases of adenoids. Dr. Cooper noted “Adenoids with
enlarged tonsils, frequently accompanying dentition.” He cured with it mucus diarrhea following a
suppressed cold. Obstruction of the nostrils, especially from adenoids and throat deafness. Enlarged tonsils,
adenoids, throat deafness. The action of it is felt towards the root of the nose. Catarrhal conditions.
Patient is prone to take cold on exposure to cold winds (Aeon.). Mutism of childhood unconnected with
deafness. Chill from cold winds (Sil.). Mucus diarrhea from cold. Throat and ear troubles with tendency to
free discharge from mucus membranes.
Rectum - Mucus diarrhea following a suppressed cold.
Throat - Adenoids with enlarged tonsils. Throat deafness.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Hydr., All-c, Calc-p., Sul-i., Calc-i. (2) All-s., Squil.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Agrimony
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - agr-b. Agrimony. Agrimonia eupatoria. The flowering stalks are floated in a bowl of water and
left in the sun for several hours. The water imbued with healing power is used as medicine. Historical dose:
Take two drops from the stock bottle into a one ounce dropper bottle (add brandy, or some other alcohol, if
this bottle will be used for days or weeks). This is the dosage bottle, take a few drops straight into the mouth
or as needed in a little water.
HOMEOPATHIC - Agrimony, along with Centaury, Walnut and Holly, belongs to the group of "Over sensitivity
to Influences and Ideas," as classified by Bach. These fourremedies help those who are distressed or overly
influenced by disturbing factors, powerful impressions in their environment.
Agrimony has been used as an herbal remedy for liver troubles. Li ver disturbances may exist. Craving for
stimulants is a frequent indication. Restlessness in mind and body. Anxieties and worries. Internal disquiet,
nervousness and hurried. Agrimony will greatly ease pain in a patient who is smiling despite pain and internal
torture.
Suppression, over-compliance and denial of emotions.
MIND - Desire to not let others down and burden them with their personal problems. Intend to spread cheer
and uplift others. Tendency not to express strong emotions which could bring disharmony or strife to oneself
or others. Resentment and antagonism nonetheless build up within and may find release unexpectedly in
spiteful remarks or in masked, aggressive behavior.
Unsettled and restless mind, prone to be distracted. Inner cares and worries. Anxieties build up, restlessness
and a sense of dissatisfaction. Grief or other forms of disappointment. Resentment or guilt which are not being
worked through. Unresolved conflicts or trauma. Inner restlessness, a sense of boredom. Often finds some
relief in drugs, entertainment, or other forms of diversion. Quarrels distress and bring unhappiness.
REFERENCES - Bach.

name: Agrostema Githago
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - agro. Agrostema githago. Corn cockle. Lychnis githago. N. O. Caryatides. Caryophyllaceae.
Trituration of the seeds, which are poisonous and contain Saponin. Preparations of an active principle
Githargin. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Gastritis. Paralysis. Tenesmus. HOMEOPATHIC - Knowledge of this plant is derived almost
entirely from cases of poisoning in persons who have eaten bread containing the seeds.
Agrostema's active constituent is Saponin. Agrostema causes violent sneezing and sharp burning taste,
burning in stomach, which extends to esophagus, neck and breast. Sensations of burning. Vertigo, headache
and coma. Impaired locomotion, difficulty remaining erect.
Back - Tearing along spine.
Head - Headache. Sensation of heat and burning rises into vertex from left lower jaw, almost makes her crazy.
Vertigo.
Mouth - Dry and hot. Palate has ared margin. Burning on palate in a short time.
Rectum - Constipation with tenesmus. Diarrhea with tenesmus. Burning in bowels and rectum.
Stomach - Nausea and vomiting. Burning from stomach along esophagus to throat and in chest. Knife-like
 pains in stomach at times.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lath., Sec.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Aids Nosode
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aids. AIDS nosode. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - AIDS. Bites. Breast, tumors. Chills. Coryza. Cystitis. Emaciation. Fevers. Headaches. Heartburn.
Hypertension. Memory, weakness. Nosebleeds. Ovaries, pain. Palpitations. Sinusitis. Toothaches.
Trembling. Wounds.
HOMEOPATHIC - Sluggishness of the body. Coldness of affected parts, lack of vital heat. Heat sensation.
Hypertension. Intoxication, after. Stitching pain. Relaxation of connective tissue. Restlessness. Stiffness.
Trembling, quivering, tremulous weakness. Wavelike sensations. Bites and wounds.
Headaches with nausea. Ovaries aching pain, worse evening, on the right. Cystitis. Low or diminished sexual
desire. Palpitations with anxiety. Weakness during menses. Weakness with nausea. Rheumatic pain.
MIND - Awkward. Mentaldullness. Slowness of mind. Forgetful, weak memory. Prostration of mind.
Concentration is difficult, worse afternoon, studying. Mental confusion. Confusion as to his identity. Mistakes
at work, when writing. Awkward. Timidity. Bashful, want of self-confidence. Pathetic, helpless feelings, self
pity. Insecure. Weak character. Introspective.
Anxiety. Fear of authority, death, failure, high places, of infection, of closed places, poverty. Aversion to
company, yet fear of being alone. Desire for solitude alternating with desire for company. Consolation
ameliorates. Discontented.
Irritability alternating with cheerfulness, with discouragement. Irritability from difficult concentration. Offended
easily, sensitive to reprimands. Ailments from anger. Anger towards husband. Desire to kill everyone he sees.
Least provocation would enrage him. Indifference, apathy, particularly in the afternoon, evening. Indifference
to loved ones. Want of sensitiveness. Hardhearted, inexorable. Suspicious.
Stupefaction, as if intoxicated. Persistent thoughts. Pertinacity. Vanishing of thoughts. Calmness alternating
with sadness.
Seriousness. Wants to be quiet. Mildness. Laziness.
Alternating moods. Crying, from many causes. Forsaken feeling. Sensation of isolation. Feels unloved,
estranged from loved ones. Sympathetic. Causeless sadness. Dwells on the past. Exalted love for humanity.
Lovesick.
Excitement. Exhilaration. Optimistic. Extravagance. Desires activity. Playful, frivolous. Mischievous.
Shameless. Loquacity. Wants to be naked, because it is natural. Industrious, mania for work. Restlessness.
Hurry, haste.
Automatic conduct. Unconsciousness. Time appears shorter or longer, passes too quickly or too slowly.
Everything is strange, as if in a dream. Delusions that she has lost her shell and protection. Delusions of
floating in air. All, barriers between him and others are removed. Beautiful delusions of youth, beauty, love
and peace. Sees bubbles popping, rising to the surface. As if brain was moving, wavering, oras if a heavy
lump in the left side of brain.
Abdomen - Pain, distension, heat. Abdomen pain after anger. Cramping, griping pain. Lancinating pain. Sore
pain on motion, pressure aggravates. Contraction left side. Lancinating pain in inguinal region. Sore pain, near
inguinal region. Pain in the hypogastrium, iliac region. Pain, left side extending to right. Stitching pain, in
evening, morning, in left iliac region. Tension in inguinal region. Offensive, yellow discharge from umbilicus.
Passing flatus with distension. Cramping, griping pain, before stool.
Back - Boils in dorsal region, scapulae. Pain lumbo-sacral region, in the morning, on stooping. Aching pain,
dorsal region, left scapulae. Sore pain. Stitching pain after kneeling. Tension in dorsal region, scapulae.
Bladder - Cystitis. Painful, frequent urging to urinate. Ineffectual urging to urinate. Urging to urinate, night,
midnight. Cutting pain when not urinating. Urethral pain after urination. Copious, brown-reddish urine.
Breasts - Breast tumors. Breast pain during cough. Breast cancer, left. Sensitive nodules.
Chest - Constriction on left side. Asthmatic constriction. Fullness of chest. Painful oppression. Cutting pain
ribs, left side. Pain as if sternum was punched. Perspiration, axilla, evening.
Dreams - Dreams followed by fear. Amorous dreams, having sex with several people. Dreams of animals,
dead, injured, suffering, wild. Dreams of old friends, boyfriend, childhood home. Beautiful, big, ornate, palatial
buildings, churches. Buildings are neglected outside but beautiful inside. Being buried alive with explosives.
Dreams of infections, AIDS. Dreams about children, babies, looking after or rescuing children. Trapped inside
acrystal. Teeth falling out. Being bitten by dogs, snakes or toads. Dreams of people on fire. Hair falling out or
turning white. Dreams of jewels, rings, diamonds, knives, magical gifts, music. Dreams of danger, storms, war.
 Dreams of difficulties on journeys. Horrible dreams, robbers, shooting, police, violence. Dreams of being
pursued, rape. Nakedness. Crowds of people. Flying an airplane. Dreams of tunnels, train, foreign country,
stairs, banisters
Ears - Aching pain. Fetid, offensive, yellow discharges. Itching external ear. Noises in ear. Buzzing, ringing,
night. Soreness ear, meatus, left ear. Pain on yawning, right ear.
Eyes - Discharges, morning, watery, yellow. Aching pain, left. Discoloration, red inner canthi. Dryness.
Itching, left eye, inner canthi, eyelids. Lachrymation left eye. Sore pain with itching, left. Stitching pain about
the eyes, left. Eye pain, touch aggravates. Eyes sensitive to touch. Swelling, left inner canthi, on waking.
Face - Acne on lower lip. Red eruptions on cheeks, nose. Herpes about the lips. Red, white pimples. Rash on
the chin, warmth aggravates.
Female - Bland, bloody, watery, thin, yellow leucorrhea. Bright red menses, mingled with dark clots. Menses
copious, at night. Menses too late, too short. Menses painful
on waking. Ovaries pain, worse evening, right. Aching pain in right ovaries. Low or diminished sexual desire.
Food - Thirst for small quantities and often. Thirst from drinking cold water. Thirstless. Appetite diminished.
Appetite increased. evening, night, before midnight, morning on waking. Insatiable appetite. Desires bitter
drinks, chocolate, fish, ice cream, milk, peaches, sweets. Aggravated from alcoholic drinks, easily intoxicated.
Worse from beer, coffee, bread.
Head - Feeling of cotton wool in head, with slight vertigo. Constriction sensation. Enlarged sensation, head
feels inflated. Formication, vertex. Heaviness sensation, smoking aggravates. Perspiration of scalp, forehead.
Pulsating, temples, right, vertex, morningon waking. Swollen feeling, vertex.
Headaches - Bursting pain, morning on waking. Cutting pain, above left eyes. Headaches with nausea.
Forehead pain extending to occiput, neck, nose or teeth, in morning. Pain behind the eyes. Pain extending to
neck region. Pain forenoon, morning on waking. Headaches preceded by disagreeable dreams. Pulsating pain.
Stitching pain, forehead over left eye, sides, in morning on waking. Feels well especially before the headache
attack.
Heart - Palpitations at night. Palpitations with anxiety.
Kidneys - Cutting pain extending to back. Larynx - Voice hoarseness.
Limbs - Eruptions, rash, red patches or blotches on leg, calf. Pustules, rash. Heat in limbs. Heat in right hand,
left knee, at night after going to bed. One hand cold the other hot. Coldness, right foot. Perspiration at night
and on waking, on feet and hands. Itching, as of insect bites, on legs, toes. Rheumatic pain. Sciatica,
particularly on the left side, better from warmth and slow motion. Crushed, cutting, dislocated pain, particularly
in joints. Cramping in legs, calves, especially when sitting. Limbs, shoulder is stiff in the morning, tension in
the limbs, better from motion. Aching pain in lower joints, sore, bruised pain. Stitching pain in lower limbs
after kneeling. Painextends to groin, inner side of thigh. Pain in wrist when grasping. Stitching pain in toes.
Tingling in upper limps, worse left, at night. Heavy sensation in lower limbs. Numbness on feet and hands,
in the morning. Lameness of the forearm. Joint pain, particularly hips and knees, worse motion. Trembling in
left knee, weakness as if knees would knock together. Relaxed joints.
Lungs - Respiration difficult, after exertion, during palpitations. Wheezing. Tickling cough at night.
Male - Sexual desire diminished. Erections, wanting, morning. Eruptions, pimples, pustules on the penis.
Cutting pain in penis after urination.
Modalities - Better after stool or urination. Betterlying. Worse in the afternoon. Worse on waking in the
morning. Worse after sleep. Worse during menses.
Mouth - Numbness about mouth. Sore pain, gums. Sore pain, palate. Ulcers, mouth, ulcers. Jaw pain. left.
Sore, bruised lower jaws. Stitching pain, jaws. Convulsions, spasms of jaws.
Neck - Constriction. Eruptions, pustules. Sensitive to slightest touch. Sensation of rope around neck. Cannot
bear anything tight around neck and waist, clothing aggravates. Swelling of cervical glands. Pain neck during
menses. Perspiration. Prickling sensation. Tension cervical region on waking.
Nose - Bleeding eruptions on nose when touched. Coryza, from change of temperature. Clear discharge.
Crusts, scabs, inside nose. Discharge thick, viscid, tough, in evening. Nosebleeds, bright red blood, clotted,
coagulated. Nosebleeds, left side, morning, in bed, on waking, periodic and profuse. Nose itching.
Obstruction, morning on waking. Burning, smarting pain. Sore pain, worse touch. Painful sneezing, with
nosebleed, from dust. Tingling inside nose.
Rectum - Constipation. Flatus. Frequent, ineffectual urging and straining. Sudden diarrhea, in afternoon,
evening. Involuntary stool. Dry or watery stool. Soreness, pain during and after stool. Rectal fissure.
Hemorrhage from anus after difficult stool. Itching, in the evening.
Sleep - Unrefreshing sleep. Anxious, restless sleep, from activity of thoughts. Heavy sleep. Sleeps on
back, with arm over head. Sleeps curled up like a dog, with lower limbs stretched out, or with one leg one
 stretched out the other drawn up. Waking difficult, too early, too late. Weeping on waking. Prolonged sleep.
Sleepy in the afternoon, morning.
Skin - Itching and burning, at night. Insect stings.
Stomach - Fullness, heaviness after eating little, in the morning. Soreness, pain, in the epigastrium, in the
morning. Heartburn. Cramping before stool.
Teeth - Toothache, worse left, in incisors, upper teeth. Aching pain, extending to eyes, forehead, nose, left
side. Sensitive teeth, tender to cold water. Sensation of loose teeth.
Throat - Dryness, painful on waking. Disposition to hawk from dryness. Sensation ofalump, on swallowing.
Watery mucus, at night, on waking. Rawness, sore pain. Sore throat, in the morning, worse at night, on the
left, better warm drinks. Difficult swallowing. Tickling in throat.
Vertigo - Vertigo accompanied by heaviness in the eye, in head. Sensation of ascending, as if floating, as if
intoxicated. Vertigo looking at revolving objects, as if everything were turning in a circle. Vertigo on rising,
while sitting up in bed, lying, walking, after looking into mirror. Vertigo in morning.
Vision - Colors before the eyes, black stripes, blue squares, blue stripes, blue spots, green-yellow, in the
morning.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ars., Care. Syph. (2) Echi., Nit-ac., (3) Bapt., Bry., Gels., Hyos., Lach.
REFERENCES - Norland.

name: Ailanthus Glandulosa
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ail. Ailanthus glandulosa. Tree of Heaven. Ailanthus altissima. Chinese Sumach. N. O.
Simarubacae. Eastern Asia. Cultivated as a shade-tree in North America. Tincture from flowers beginning to
open. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne. Chancre. Coryza. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dysentery. Headaches. Meningitis. Mumps. Post-
partum fever. Rash. Rheumatic fever. Raynaud's disease. Sepsis. Scarlatina. Streptococcus, infections.
Syphilis. Tonsillitis. Typhoid fever. Typhus fever.
HOMEOPATHIC - Ailanthus acts upon blood disorganizing it and producing conditions like low fevers, low
types of eruptive diseases and hemorrhagic diathesis. Mucus membranes become hemorrhagic and ulcerative
(Lach., Ars. ). Rapid prostration. Malignant and suppressed scarlatina. General stupor with sighing. Sepsis.
Low types of eruptive diseases, diphtheria. Raynaud's disease.
Lividity, stupor, fetor and malignancy. Thin, acrid discharges. The skin appears livid or purplish, face
dark as mahogany. Hot, sordes, throat swollen, purple, livid. Purpled appearance of the skin. Rash coming out
in patches. Eruptions which are slow in appearing. Rashes often return annually.
Follicular tonsillitis, streptococcus infection. Hemorrhagic diathesis. Low adynamic forms of disease with
extreme prostration torpor, vomiting. Prostration at the outset of a disease. The patient is stupid, dull, delirious,
weak. Semi-conscious, delirious, weak pulse, general torpor and prostration. Diarrhea, dysentery and great
weakness.
MIND - Confused mind, mental depression. Stupor or stoic indifference, with sighing. Dullness, must read a
subject several times or figures over and over again. All the antecedents are forgotten. Constant muttering
delirium with sleeplessness and restlessness. Raging delirium with brilliant eyes.
Abdomen - Tenderness over liver region.
Burning in the stomach and bowels. Tympanites.
Back - Neck tender, and very much swollen. Constant sharp pains through small of back and hips.
Chest - Stitching and aching in chest. Burning in right lung, contracted feeling in left. Chest feels strapped, or
as if air-cells stuck together.
Constitutions - Suited to nervous, sensitive persons. Bilious temperament. Stout and robust. Hemorrhagic
diathesis.
Ears - Pain in ear when swallowing. Parotid glands tender and enlarged.
Eyes - Conjunctivitis, smarting, aching, lachrymation, purulent discharge. Suffused and congested, startled
look when aroused. Photophobia. Pupils dilated and sluggish.
Face - Mahogany colored, dark and swollen. Chronic speckled spotted face, a kind of acne. Face sallow,
jaundiced, blue circles around eyes. Face red and hot, covered with a rash. Purplish face. Lips are swollen,
cracked, ulcers near commissures.
Female - Malignant puerperal fever. Vomiting of pregnancy.
Food - No appetite, everything tastes insipid, sight of food makes her worse, disgust for food. Hunger and
distressing sense of general emptiness during chill. Thirst for cold drinks, brandy.
Head - Frontal headache with drowsiness, dizziness and red-hot face, cannot sit up. Faint on rising up or
 vertigo worse lying. Passive congestion headaches. Suffused, dilated eyes, photophobia. Face dusky. Thin,
copious, ichorous, bloody nasal discharge.
Heart - Rapid, small pulse, weak, frequent, and irregular. Dull pain and contracted feeling in region of base of
heart and through center of left lung.
Kidneys - Urine scanty, suppressed, passed unconsciously.
Lungs - Breathing hurried, irregular, heavy. Dry, hacking cough. Lungs sore and tired. Deep, exhausting
cough, with violent fits until sputum is raised. Sputa is blood- mixed, yellow, bitter, worse morning. Aphonia.
Croupy choking.
Male - Sore on prepuce, looking like incipient chancre.
Modalities - Better from hot drinks. Better when lying on right side. Worse from suppressions. Worse raising
up or sitting up. Worse walking, motion. Worse sight of food.
Mouth - Tongue dry and brown, parched and cracked. Tongue moist, furred white, tip and edges livid.
Neck - The neck is tender and swollen.
Nose - Nostrils congested. Nose dry, secretion suppressed. Coryza, with rawness in nostrils, sneezing. Loss
of smell. Thin copious bloody ichorous nasal discharge. Itching and uneasy feeling around the nose.
Pulse - Rapid, small, weak.
Rectum - Diarrhea, dysentery with great weakness. Thin, watery, offensive stools. Passing of involuntary
stools with urine. Tapeworms. Sense of insecurity with stool or urine.
Skin - The skin appears livid or purplish. Miliary, livid rash, returns annually. Large blisters filled with dark
serum. Irregular, patchy, livid eruptions, disappearing on pressure. Cold skin. Eruptions in dark, sparse
patches, appear slowly, disappear on pressure, but return slowly. Scarlatina maligna. Petechae. Skin mottled.
Crawling all over the body.
Sleep - Drowsy, restless. Heavy, disturbed, unrefreshing.
Stomach - Vomits food speedily during the chill, suddenly and violently when sitting up, with stupor. Peculiar
feeling of emptiness in stomach.
Teeth - Tearing in teeth. The teeth are covered with sordes.
Temperature - Adynamic fever with weak heart. Cold sweat.
Throat - Diphtheria and tonsillitis. Streptococcus infections. Inflamed, edematous, dusky red. Throat dark and
swollen. Tonsils studded with many deep ulcers (worse left), with loose pultaceous discharge. Much swelling
internal and external. Dry, rough, scraping, choking feeling. Hoarse, croupy voice. Pain in swallowing
extends to the ears. Dry, foul fauces. Irritation and itching of posterior pharynx.
Vertigo - Dizzy when rising up.
COMMENTS - With the low fever of Ail. there is stupor orindifference with sighing. Constant frontal headache
of a neuralgic character. Paroxysmal headache with drowsiness during the day, confused mind, depression.
A feeling of fullness everywhere. A sensation of electric current passing from head into limbs was prominent
in the provings. The head is burning hot with piercing pains. The parotid glands are sensitive and enlarged.
The attacks are characterized by fullness of head with heat, pains burning, darting in temples and occiput,
vertigo and nausea.
The throat is severely affected: thick, edematous, dry, choky feeling. Dry, rough, scrapy, worse morning. Livid,
swollen with ulcers oozing a fetid discharge. The symptoms are better lying on right side (bronchial affections).
Sitting up causes vomiting, dizziness. Motion causes staggering. Toothache is better walking.
RELATIONS-Antidoted by: Alcohol, Rhus-t., Nux-v. Compare: (1) Ptel., Xanthoxylae. (2) Am-c., Am., Arum-
t. (3) Aloe, - dull frontal headache. Bapt., Bry., Gels., Hyos., Lac-c. Lach., Nit-ac., Nux-v., Phyt., Hydr-ac.,
Rhus-t., Stram., Echi.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Alabaster
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - alab. Alabaster. White gypsum. Hydrous calcium sulphate. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Backache. Belching. Colds. Colic. Conjunctivitis. Constipation. Cough. Cramps. Eczema.
Headache. Hoarseness. Insomnia. Leucorrhea. Moles. Nausea. Sciatica. Sinus, congestion. Sneezing. Tin-
nitus. Toothache. Vaginitis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Plaster of Paris is so named because of the prevalence of gypsum in the Paris basin where
it was originally produced. Plaster of Paris is generally the hemihydrate of Calcium Sulphate - CaSO4- 2H2O.
Alabaster is a fine-grained, massive, opaque or translucent variety of gypsum. It tends to be white in coUr but
can be
streaked or tinted with brown, red, yellow, green, etc.
 Chemically, alabaster is hydrous Calcium Sulphate manifesting as a monoclinic crystal structure. Gypsum is
formed by the evaporation of bedded deposits that are precipitated mainly from evaporating saline water.
It has been used for centuries for making statues, carvings, ornaments and for decorations. The pyramids near
Cairo were originally faced in alabaster, but it is now completely weathered away.
Plaster of Paris (and gypsum plaster) is made by the partial (or complete) dehydration of gypsum by heating
or burning. When mixed with water, it gives a plastic paste which can be cast or molded. It eventually sets and
hardens due to the chemical recombination of the gypsum with water.
MIND - Rocks violently. Muddled mind. Memory poor. Forgetful. Low self confidence. Indecisive. Feeling very
impatient and irritable. Tired physically, bright mentally. Feels depleted. Want to be held, feels vulnerable.
Anxious, fretful, worrying. Anxious on waking. Anxious about future. Anxiety about getting breast cancer. Panic
attack, anxious and unable to breath. Fear of death. Fear of life. Fear of the dark. Fear of madness.
Restless, but mind doesn't feel as though it wants to think about anything in particular. Hard to relax, feels
vulnerable, stupid. Sensation as if smiling. Tired and restless having to do lots of things. Thinking about
travelling.
Depressed and hopeless. Sad, melancholic, blue. Very moody and impatient. Woke feeling very low. Sensation
as if, too much to do, feel sorry for myself, teary. Craves some peace and quiet. Don't like crowds.
Discontented. Intolerant, irritable. Ennui. Panicky and weepy. Irritable and angry with people at work. Anger
towards former work colleagues. Feels irritable in the morning. Abdomen - Colic. Griping pain in both sides of
lower abdomen. Sudden pains in right abdomen, extending to rectum and extending upwards. Abdominal pain
.after eating. Achey and bloated feeling.
Abdomen bloated and tender. Solar plexus feels heavy. Sharp stabbing pain, left side of abdomen. Nausea
and pain abdomen after eating.
Back - Neck very stiff. Neck aching. Back aching down spine with pain shooting from lower back down to both
ankles. Stiffness down spine. Desire to twist spine for relief. Tingling base of neck at the back. Skin dry and
itchy. Pain in upper back, especially right side. Pain sore, nagging, stitching, tender, compressing. Lower back
pain. Coldness middle of back. Backache in middle of back, piercing pain. Backache, worse moving around
worse sitting.
Bladder - Bladder discomfort. Burning pain. Not passing urine as often as usual.
Breasts - Breast tenderness, worse before menses. Eruptions on outer side of both breasts. Mastitis. Pain in
right breast.
Chests - Sides of chest itch. Chest feels tight. Chest and solar plexus feels heavy. Sore pain.
Cough - Weak cough while eating. Cough from a tickle in the throat. Cough with yellow-brown mucus. Tickling
cough. Woke in night with coughing and cramping pain right lower leg.
Ears - Very itchy in ear canal. Popping sound in right ear. Right ear burns and feels warm. Achey and sore.
Pain deep in right ear. Shooting sensation below right ear extending to nose and eye. Boring sensation in both
ears, better rubbing finger in ear. Left ear, shooting pain, at end of conversation. Sensitive hearing to ticking
clock. Tinnitus. Ringing in ears. Sounds more acute on left side. Buzzing noise. Hissing noise.
Eyes - Burning sensation outer corner of right eye. Right eye watering. Heavy and aching pain better closed
eyes. Eyes sore, as if tired. Aching pain in left eye. As if, conjunctivitis in right eye. Hard to open eyes, scratchy
discomfort and watering. Eyes feel very tired, wants to close them. Woke with watering eyes and blocked nose.
Sharp pain in right eye on rubbing it in morning. Woke with eyes discharging and gluey, crusted. Eye irritation
and puffiness, worse perfumes.
Face - Upper lip hot and burning. Skin very itchy, especially around right eye and cheek. Numbness of upper
lip. Skin on face very sensitive. Cheeks warm, especially right side. Bags under eyes after heavy sleep. Face
looked pale. Pins and needles sensations in face. Rash on face and neck, red, sore, itchy. Stinging red rash
on forehead and right side face.
Female - Cramping in uterus just before period. Bloating and nausea before menses. Menses profuse with
clots. Menses scanty. Leucorrhea with fishy discharge. Thrush symptoms, itching and white discharge.
Vaginitis. Vagina red and sore. Vaginal irritation better cold water. Discharge, mucus, cream, pale yellow color.
Discharge pink again and specks of blood.
Food - No appetite. More thirsty. Craved hot chocolate drink.
Head - Head feels hot. Pressure at back of head in a band running from ear to ear. Headache, back of neck
very stiff. Dull ache in occiput extending to temples, worse bending forwards. Temples pounding. Headache
all day not better for fresh air or drinking cold water. Head feels full, heavy. Woke with a headache. Pain in
head, left side. Headache across forehead and temples. Frontal headache. Light headedness worse moving
quickly. Pain in forehead, behind eyes, a nauseating pain. Pain as if brain being squeezed.
Heart - Heart feels as if it's beating faster. Dull, bruised pain in heart.
 Limbs - Leg area sensitve. Feels like electric shocks, during menses, running from bottom to ankles. Pain in
legs like sciatica, worse bending forward, worse sitting. Sciatica pain worse running. Shooting pains down legs.
Hands sensitive to washing. Red blotchy rash on back of hands. Eczema elbows. Twinges of rheumatic pain,
left hip. Restless legs. Twitching of legs. Legs feel very tired and heavy. Left knee aches. Pin-prick sensation
in right knee. Skin on buttocks dry and flakey, not itchy. Legs felt weak when went upstairs. Tingling in hand.
Cramps in limbs. Feet very cold. Legs ache. Aching limbs. Ankles cold.
Lungs - Feels breathless. Wheezy. Yellow, brown expectoration.
Male - Burning pain in the root of the penis and lower urinary tract.
Mouth - Metallic taste. Bitter, taste in mouth.Very dry mouth. Roof of mouth feels a bit greasy. Mouth ulcer in
right cheek. Tingling in middle of lower lip. Gums puffy round tooth. Gums bleeding, when brushed teeth. Itchy
palate.
Nose - Very itchy inside nose. Colds. Sneezing and runny nose. Nose blocked both sides. Nose tender, feels
bashed. Feels broken across bridge of nose. Sensitive to house dust while cleaning. Constant sneezing. Nasal
catarrh and sneezing. Lots of mucus in back of throat, nose blocked. More sensitive to smells. Sinus conges-
tion. Tickle on end of nose.
Perspiration - More sweaty than usual, sticky armpits. Less sweaty at night.
Rectum - Rectum feels full, doesn't feel empty even after passing a stool. Windy and loose stools,
accompanying right sided (hypochondria) pain. Constipation. Smelly stools. Loose stool, a bit explosive.
Skin - Skin is dry and itchy. Skin feels hot. Red rash, sore, itchy, worse cold weather, better being outside.
Stinging red rash on forehead and right side face. Moles, bleeding. Mole with slight prickling, scabbed over.
Itchy skin after alcohol, especially legs, worse left.
Sleep - Heavy sleep. Panic attack before going to sleep, fearful not sure of what. Sleeplessness. Restless
night. Waking up a lot. Woke with restless legs. Woke very fearful. Woke during the night feeling really
depressed and hopeless. Anxious dreams. Dreams of dead people. Nostalgic dreams. Dreams of water.
Dreams of work. Lots of different, active dreams. Vivid, intense dreams.
Stomach - Belching. Queasy feeling before breakfast. Rumbling and gurgling. Nausea and pain abdomen
after eating. Nauseous and sick feeling. Nauseous at thought of food.
Teeth - Slightly clenching teeth. Pain in left upper molars. Toothache, dull pain. Right
upper tooth socket bleeds.
Temperature-Cold and clammy. Feels quite warm. Mild fever. Felt hot.
Throat - Voice hoarse but painless. Voice sounded husky and broken. Laryngitis. Mucus, need to keep clearing
throat. Mucus, back of throat. Sore throat. Swollen painful throat, hurts to swallow. Throat sore, both sides, dry
and stinging. Woke with painful throat. Dry, burning, raw, difficult to swallow. Feeling something stuck in throat.
Throat felt constricted. Mucus running down back of throat. Slight nausea in throat. Tickly feeling at back of
throat, extends to left ear, sinuses.
Vertigo - Slight dizziness.
RELATIONS - Compare: Chemically related remedies would be Calc-sulph. (Calcium Sulphate - CaSO4) and
Hepar-sulph. (impure Calcium Sulphide - CaS).
REFERENCES - Wilkinson.

name: Albizia Julibrissin
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-alb-j. Albiziajulibrissindurazz. Mimosa tree. Silk tree. Powderpuff tree. Silky acacia. Pink sins. N.
O. Fabaceae. Asia. Tincture from flowers, leaves and stems. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Abscess. Anxiety. Boils. Bruises. Cancer, lung. Carbuncles. Depression. Fractures. Grief. Heart,
disease. Hemorrhoids. Insomnia. Pains. Sarcoma. Sores. Sprains. Stress. Swellings. Worms. Wounds.
HERBAL - The Mimosa tree, Albiziajulibrissin, was introduced to the United States in 1745 for use as an
ornamental plant because of its unusual, attractive and fragrant pom-like flowers and interesting fem-like
foliage. This deciduous tree is attractive to bees, butterflies, and birds.
This is a traditional herb used for depression and irritability. The flower heads are carminative, digestive aid,
sedative and tonic.
Mimosa flowers are used internally in the treatment of insomnia, irritability, breathlessness and poor memory.
The stem bark is anodyne, anthelmintic, carminative, discutient, diuretic, oxytocic, sedative, stimulant, tonic,
vermifuge and vulnerary. It is used internally in the treatment of insomnia, irritability, boils and carbuncles.
Externally, it is applied to injuries and swellings. A gummy extract obtained from the plant is used as a plaster
for abscesses, boils, etc., and also as a retentive in fractures and sprains.
The flower of the mimosa invigorates blood, calms the spirit. It's used for acute and chronic depression,
 insomnia, poormemory, and irritability. Problems due to constrained emotions, especially when accompanied
by poor memory, epigastric pain and feelings of tightness and pressure in the chest.
MIND - Depression. Anxiety. Poor memory. Feelings of grief and loss.
Skin - Abscesses. Boils.
Sleep - Insomnia.
COMMENTS - Called the “tree of collective happiness” by the Chinese, mimosa flowers are specifically used
for individuals who are experiencing deep feelings of grief and loss.
Micheal Tierra stated that he has used mimosa or albizia flower and bark extract alone or in formula for large
numbers of people who might otherwise be given pharmaceutical anti-depressants.
All experienced complete or significant benefit even after a day's use. He recommend taking one half to one
teaspoon, three or four times daily. While its flavor leaves something to be desired, it has shown itself to be
completely safe and after experiencing its positive effects, one quickly grows used to the flavor.
REFERENCES - Buttimer. Murphy. Tierra.

name: Alchemilla Vulgaris
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - alch-v. AlchemiUa vulgaris. Lady's Mantle. Mary's Cape. Lionsfoot. N. O. Rosaceae. Europe.
Tincture from leaves and stems. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Bruises. Cuts. Gastritis. Indigestion. Leucorrhea. Menopause. Menstrual, disorders.
HERBAL - AlchemiUa means “Hail to the Alchemists.” The leaves of AlchemiUa fold in such a way as to catch
the morning dewdrops likejewels. In Iceland this plant is sacred to the V irgin, called Mariastakker, which gives
quiet sleep if placed under the pillow at night.
HOMEOPATHIC - AlchemiUa has been used for healing wounds and for women's problems. It is mildly
astringent, diuretic and anti-inflammatory. Helps regulate the menses and eases the menopause. Gastritis and
enteritis. Used as a douche for leucorrhea.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Alcoholus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aleo. Alcoholus. Ethyl alcohol. Aethanolum. Spirits of wine. Remedy made from commercial
spirits of wine, by re-distillation. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Alcoholism. Coma. Delirium. Dementia. Double vision. Hallucinations. Imbecility. Insanity. Mania.
Stupidity.
HOMEOPATHIC - Amid the pleasures of the cup the soldier no longer complains of the campaign, the sailor
forgets the dangers of the storm. The weak one grows strong and the despondent bold. The despairing lover
leaves his solitude and forgets the indifference of his mistress. From acute alcohol intoxication all weaknesses
are exposed and all secrets divulged without reserve, all hypocrisy ceases. Intoxicated persons beget
alcoholics.
General excitement of all the senses. Moral and physical exaltation.
Transition from delirium tremens into permanent mania with hectic fever or dropsy.
A feeling of vague and unaccountable dread. Sadness often constant through the whole disease (delirium
tremens). Staggering, uncertain gait. Coma, that changes to paralysis of the brain in persons of an apoplectic
habit.
Sexual powers at first increased, then diminished. Impotence, want of sexual power. Irregular menstruation.
Abortion in the first months. The children of alcoholics may grow up dull, indolent, stupid and become
intemperate. Inclination to obesity. Diminished perspiration.
MIND - Mind disturbed, difficulty fixing the attention. General intellectual enfeeblement. Impaired memory.
Absence of the senses and of reason. Restlessness and anxiousness, tries to disguise. Solitude and repose
in bed increase the anxiety.
Mania with excessive irritability, excited by slightest causes. Mania with disposition to commit murder or start
 a fire. Impatience of contradiction. Unreasonable inclination to quarrel. Exhilaration. Increased self-esteem and
importance. Feels insulted and abused by one's friends. Melancholy, weeping. Depression. Inclination to
commit suicide.
Delirium. Rapid and incoherent talk. Thinks himself pursued. Screaming, singing and immoderate merriment.
Feeling unusually strong and rich. Various hallucinations of sight, hearing, smell and sensation. Abdomen -
Sense of pressure in both hypochondria. Swelling of spleen. Recti muscles of abdomen become rigid and
prominent. Ascites. Rumbling and growling in intestines. Inflammation of the intestines and stomach.
Flatulence. Colic pains. Intestinal hemorrhage.
Back - Veins of neck swollen. Temporal and throat arteries throb, jugular veins turgescent or protruding.
Weakness, finally in muscles of back, cannot even sit erect.
Chest - Hydrothorax. Emphysema. Congestion of lungs. Sensation of warmth in chest. Tension of chest.
Burning sensation back of the sternum.
Constitutions - A sanguine, choleric temperament, sentimental and passionate. Weak-nerved person shows
blunted senses and childish. The phlegmatic temperament remains passive and rather falls from his chair
before giving loud evidences of his intoxication.
Ears - Dryness in external meatus. Acute sense on hearing. Hearing blunted, perception of sound lessened.
Confusion on sounds. Roaring in ears, especially after spasms or with vertigo. Ringing, buzzing or rushing
sound in the ears, frequently accompanied with dull, diffused headache. Illusions of hearing. Imaginary voices
and sounds.
Eyes - Eyes injected. Red and excited, watery eyes. Eyes fiery, brilliant, fixed and wild. Rigid, gleaming look.
Bright and animated or suffused and soft. Spots in the eye and dimness of vision. Catarrhal inflammation of
the eyes. Roughness of the margins of the lids. Contraction of the pupils, drooping lids and coma. Effusion
and swelling below the eyes. Conjunctiva more or less jaundiced. Y ellow tinge of the sclerotica. Dilated and
almost insensible pupils. Vision weak, cannot use eyes, objects flicker and become dim. Cannot read or write.
Aversion to light. Black before eyes. Flashes of light before eyes. Muscae volitantes in clouds, before the eyes.
Double vision. Visual hallucinations.
Face - Distorted face. Face bloated, without expression, stupid, silly. Redness of the cheeks and nose. Face
red and swollen. Tetter in the face. Eruption in the face, bluish-red or white vesicles and pimples.
Food - Mania for alcoholic drinks, pepper and other heating things. Longing for spirituous liquors and, if not
speedily gratified, becomes raving or has convulsions. At first no desire to eat, afterwards, ravenous hunger.
Loss of appetite. Aversion to food and alcoholic drinks. Thirst before breakfast and through the day, often
excessive.
Head - Head dull, clouded and hazy. Effusion of water into the membranes and ventricles of the brain.
Softening of the brain. Pressing headache, causing stupidity. Drawing in the head. Dull, diffused headache
with a buzzing or rushing sound in the ears. Sensation of fullness at the crown and back of the head or at the
temples.
Heart - Valvular insufficiency. Organic difficulties of the heart and the large vessels. Hypertrophy of the left
side of the heart. Increased activity of the heart and arteries. Pulsation of the heart and arteries violently
increased, hard and full. Increased heat and rapidity of action in the heart. Very excited action, violent throbbing
of the heart. Palpitations of the heart. Pulse nearly always accelerated, sometimes small and empty,
sometimes full and even rather hard.
Kidneys - Sensitiveness, aching and pain in the region of the kidneys.
Limbs - Sudden startings of the limbs, as from electrical shocks. Trembling of limbs. Increased warmth, then
coldness. Creeping sensation (formication) under the skin of the hands and feet. Weakness and relaxation of
the muscles of locomotion, first in fingers and hands, especially in thumb and index-finger, extending all over
both limbs. Limbs numb, as if paralyzed and extremely sensitive to touch and motion.
Liver - Heat, weight and soreness in the region of the liver. Inflammation of the liver. Cirrhosis.
Lungs - Sensation of heat in the larynx. Catarrhal bronchitis. Accumulation of mucus in the air-passages.
Disposition to clear the throat. Hoarseness. Sobbing. Hacking, dry cough. Coughing blood. Accelerated
breathing. There was a sense of impediment to respiration. Heavy, labored breathing. Snoring respiration.
Asthma. Asphyxia.
Modalities - Worse when lying down. Worse when quiet at night.
Mouth - Grinding the teeth. Tongue fissured from middle to the edges, furred or sometimes denuded of
epithelium. Papillae at tip of tongue enlarged and red. Sore and dry condition of the tip of the tongue. Dry, red,
glazed tongue. Tongue covered with yellow slime in the middle,
the margins clean. Tongue smooth and red with tendency to stick to the teeth or roof of the mouth. Tongue
moved with difficulty. Convulsive motions of the tongue with stammering and inarticulate speech. Dry state of
 the mouth. Offensive smell from the mouth. Froth in mouth. Sour, salty or bitter taste in the mouth in the
morning. Bitter taste in the mouth. Illusions of the sense of taste. Stammering speech.
Nose - Redness of the nose and cheeks. Redness of the nose, especially at the tip. Vessels of the skin
congested. Swelling and inflammation. Red pimples or tubercles. Lining membrane of the sinuses inflamed
and ulcerated. Bleeding of the nose. Illusions of the sense of smell.
Rectum - Hemorrhoids and varicose veins. Bleeding hemorrhoids. Paralysis of anus. Feces compact, knotty,
black or light gray. Stool black, bilious, slimy and bloody, thin and clay colored. Diarrhea mucus or mealy.
Diarrhea often alternating with constipation. Involuntary excretion of stool and urine.
Skin - Skin smutty or yellowish-gray. Jaundice. Skin soft and flabby. Skin becomes dry and hard. Sense of
dryness, heat and evident fullness of swelling of the exposed parts of the skin, as the hands and face with
general sensation of heat. Tormenting eruption, exceedingly itching, rough, scaly patches. Eczema and
prurigo. Acne rosacea. Skin does not heal readily. Large indolent, blue-looking boils orcarbuncles. Varicose
ulcers.
Sleep - Irresistible sleep. Deep sleep, frequently accompanied by rattling breath. Lethargic with snoring
respiration, intermittent pulsation of the heart. Restless sleep. Starts from his sleep with anxiety and
restlessness. Insomnia, the patient tosses from side to side during nearly the whole night, getting only broken
snatches of sleep and often with frightful dreams.
Stomach - Belchings, sour or foul. Belchings of water. Eructation like rotten eggs. Nausea and vomiting mucus
and water. Vomiting of sour and offensive smelling matters. Hematemesis. Fullness and distention after eating.
Burning heat in
stomach. Pressure in the stomach. Sense of oppression and weight. Weakness of the stomach. Constriction,
uncomfortable tension and pressure in epigastrium.
Temperature - Great inclination to sweat. Sweat easy at first. Sweat profuse, cool, sticky, sour smelling,
sometimes warm. Increased perspiration moderates intoxication. Sensation of cold with paleness of the body.
Fevers. Evening exacerbations. An agreeable warmth spreads over the body. General sensation of heat with
increased action of the heart and dryness of the skin.
Throat - Throat red and feels stiff. Granulations on the posterior wall of the throat, also on the base of the
tongue. Engorged appearance of the veins of the fauces. Redness, dryness and heat. Aphthous ulcers in the
throat. Gangrenous ulcers. Throat full of tough mucus, difficult to hawk up. Paralysis of pharyngeal muscles.
Paralysis of the muscles of swallowing. Sensation as if something lodged in the esophagus. Strong efforts to
clear the throat or belch or vomit, bring up blood or bloody mucus. Painful swallowing.
Urine - Frequent need to urinate, finally incontinence. Involuntary excretion of urine and stool. Increased
quantity of urine. Lessened secretion of urine. Retention of urine. Urine scanty at first, yellowish or deep red,
then more copious with sediment. High-colored urine. Albuminous urine. Urine acid, contains serum and bile.
Bloody urine.
Vertigo - Attacks of vertigo with sudden faintness and reeling or falling down, but no twitchings. Violent vertigo,
nearly changing to a stroke. He staggers while walking and standing. Momentary attacks of vertigo.
COMMENTS - Frenzy, accompanied by violent convulsions. Drunkenness with various manias. Much
inconsiderate, confused talking. Talkativeness, by which confessions are drawn from him. Ashamed of his
intoxication. Sweet outpourings of friendship and tender confessions. Shamelessness. Moral degradation.
Stubbornness. Quarrelsomeness.
Grudges long since forgotten are renewed. Forgetfulness.
All desires and inclinations become uncontrollable. Indescribable serenity of mind with cheerfulness, which the
face expresses. Lively imagination. Rapid flow of thought, but he cannot keep his attention fixed continuously
on one subject. Immoderate bursts of laughter. Cheerfulness.
Mental inquietude. Dread arising from actual delusions. Believes he is falling, even when on solid ground.
Apprehension of nearby evil. Religious ravings, they address confidential and irreverent discourses to the
Deity. Absurd fancies. Confuses one person with another.
Dancing, convulsive gestures, like chorea. Convulsions with a feeling as if something in the head is twisted
and turned. Convulsions begin in one extremity, can be confined to one side, head can draw back, teeth clench,
eyes distorted. Hysterical paroxysms. Epileptic attacks, generally coming on while standing. Epilepsy returns
after every excess in drinking. Convulsive-like epileptic attacks.
The w hole body trembles, commonly after exertion. Tottering and shaking. Trembling of the whole body.
Twitchings or jerk- ings in muscles on sitting or lying, not in standing, especially on changing position.
Persistent muscular tremor, first developed in the limbs.
Muscular inquietude inability to keep the limbs or the body still without a special effort of attention. Drawings
in muscles like electric shocks. Trembling and paralysis as usual consequences of a stroke. General paralysis
 after delirium tremens. Marked sensory paralysis.
Power of directing and coordinating the muscles lessened. Musculartone and power greatly lessened. The
body loses its mobility and becomes more and more destitute of muscular power. Emaciation, want of strength
with continued want of appetite. Prostration of the whole body.
Premature old age, face becomes pale and wrinkled, features relaxed, eyes dim, lips pale, the hands and the
rest of the limbs tremble, gait unsteady. Indolence of body and mind. Frequent swoons. Hyperesthesia.
This numbness is usually superficial, sensitive to deep pressure, sometimes sensitiveness of the whole body
is blunted.
Pain and neuralgic tearings, cuttings. Very marked, continuous buzzing or thrilling, passing from above
downwards and through the whole system. Sensitiveness to the fresh air, shudder and frost.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Hyos., Lach., Agar.
REFERENCES - Allen.
