name: Alcoholus Sulphuris
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - alco-s. Alcoholus sulphuris. Liquor lampadii. Carburet of sulphur. Historical dose: All
potencies.
HOMEOPATHIC - Homoeopathic Provings by James W. Metcalf, M. D. It may prove useful in some forms of
sick headache, especially when the pain commences in the forehead, and extends to one or the other temples.
Scrofulous affections of the eyes and lids. Twitching of the eyes and lids, such as occurs in scrofulous, nervous,
and verminous children. Some rheumatic and neuralgic affections of the face.
Chronic rheumatism, prurigo, and impetigo. Chronic pharyngitis. Irritation of the pharynx, with much hawking
and spitting. Gagging cough from the irritation of an elongated uvula, especially when these symptoms occur
in bilious and dyspeptic subjects.
Chronic irritation of the pharynx and larynx, with constant desire to hawk and spit, with hoarseness and short
cough. May prove helpful in the first stage of tubercular disease of the lungs. It may prevent the tendency to
irritation and congestion of the upper parts of the lungs which to readily lead to the fresh deposit of tubercles
in consumptive patients.
Pyrosis, heartburn, and various dyspeptic and bilious derangements. Flatulence, bilious and flatulent colic, and
congestion of the liver. It is one of the few drugs which seem to exert a specific action upon the cecum. Cured
a case of chronic diarrhea, appearing every four or six weeks, attended with colic, the evacuations were liquid,
frothy, yellowish, sour, and attended with tenesmus.
Abdomen - Great inflation of the abdomen, with rumbling of wind and tearing colic. Colic pains after eating.
Slight wind-colic from time to time, with desire to urinate. Colic pains with loose stool and flatulence. Paroxysm
of disagreeable pain in the left lobe of the liver. Soft stool, preceded by pain in the left lobe of the liver, and
followed by pains in the cecal region.
Chest - Sensation of heat in the chest, congestion in the upper part of the lungs. Oppression, fullness in the
chest. Slight stitches and pains about the chest.
Ears - Pain in the ears as if some one were striking upon the tympanum with a dull instrument.
Eyes - Burning and itching of the lids. Pustules on the lids, lasting four days. Dilatation of the pupils, with
quickness of the pulse. Abundant secretion of whitish yellow mucus in the eyes. Lachrymation of the eyes.
Twitching and trembling of the muscles of the eyes and lids.
Face - Redness and puffiness of the face, heat of the face andhands. Lancinating and tearing pains in the
cheeks, extending up to the temples and lasting two months.
Fever - Great internal heat, with coldness of the hands and feet. General heat, headache, quick pulse, cramps
in the calves of the legs and toes, without much thirst, and no perspiration.
Head - Pain in the forehead, which draws towards the left temple and remains there for two hours. Pressive
frontal headache, lasting almost all day, and accompanied with transient pains in the temple. Drawing and
tearing pain, stretching from the forehead to the temples, lasting all day, more severe in the room and during
rest, relieved by walking in the open air. Dull pain in the frontal region, with nausea and heaviness’of the whole
head. Thumping pain in both temples. Violent pressive pain in the right temple, with malaise, desire to vomit,
and rumbling of wind in the bowels.
Larynx - Heat and irritation of the larynx, hoarseness and irritation of the larynx. with continual desire to hawk.
Cough provoked by a tickling at the bifurcation of the bronchi. Slight dry cough.
Limbs - Pains in and eruption upon the arms and legs.
Mouth - Dryness of the lips and mouth, irritation of the cavity and isthmus of the pharynx, followed by a
sensation of contraction in the larynx, with gagging cough and quick breathing. Gum boils. Pasty, disagreeable
 taste in the mouth, with foul taste of the pharyngeal mucus. Bitter sharp taste in the mouth, or very repulsive
acrid taste, or sweetish putrid taste. Great accumulation of saliva, with sweetish taste. Very frequent spitting.
Pale red swelling of the uvula and vellum Burning and scraping in the pharynx and esophagus.
Skin - Sharp itching and stinging in different part of the skin, as if from nettles. Itching in various part of the
skin, much aggravated by scratching. Bleeding and burning of eruptions when scratched (prurigo). Eruptions
of impetigo on the back of the hands, the pustules are seated on the inflamed red base, contain a yellowish
cloudy serum, and form thick yellowish scabs.
Sleep - Sleep. Sleeplessness from headache, dryness of the skin and general unpleasant heat, so that he is
obliged to rise and bathe himself.
Stomach - Stomach. Very abundant eructation, sour burning, acrid regurgitations (pyrosis) occurring one or
two hours after eating. Continual acid regurgitations. Regurgitations of air with nausea, discharge of flatulence
upwards and downwards. Burning in the stomach and hepatic region. Heat in the epigastric region, which
ascends and occupies the whole chest. Violent heat, ascending from the stomach to the head. Fullness in the
stomach, with eructations, yawning, desire to vomit, and dizziness.
Stool - Liquid stools. Slimy, watery diarrhea, with violent pain in epigastrium. Sudden diarrhea, after having
dined with good appetite. Violent diarrhea, with tenesmus and sour evacuations.
COMMENTS - Lampadius, in 1796, while distilling a mixture of pyrites and charcoal, procured a clear liquid in
the receiver, which he named Alcoholus sulphuris, or the Alcohol of Sulphur. It consists of one equivalent of
Carbon and two of Sulphur.
REFERENCES - Jahr. Marcy.

name: Aletris Farinosa
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - alet. Aletris farinosa. Star grass. Blazing grass. Colic root. Unicom root. N. O. Hemodoracae.
Melanthiaceae. North America. Tincture of root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Abortion. Anemia. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions. Debility. Dysmenorrhea. Dysuria. Emaciation.
Endometritis. Fainting. Fatigue. Fever. Hemorrhoids. Hysteric colic. Indigestion. Labor-like, pains. Leucorrhea.
Menorrhagia. Miscarriage. Muscle, pain. Pregnancy, vomiting. Infertility. Uterus, pain, prolapse.
HOMEOPATHIC - Star grass is said to be the most bitter of all plants. Aletris farinosa particularly affects the
female organs. Produces an anemic, relaxed condition, especially of the female organs. Useful for chlorotic
girls and pregnant women.
Many symptoms appear in the uterine sphere including uterine atony. Sensation of weight in uterine region
and tendency to prolapse. Hemorrhages. Menorrhagia, black clots, fullness and weight. Menses are profuse
and premature with labor-like pains or amenorrhea, debility from loss of fluids, protracted illness. Leucorrhea
with debility. Obstinate vomiting of pregnancy. Habitual tendency to miscarriage. Infertility.
Characterized by weariness of body and mind. The patient is fatigued and tired all the time, suffers from
prolapse, leucorrhea, rectal distress, etc. Marked anemia. Fainting attacks with vertigo. Sensation of weight in
occiput as if it would draw the head back. Parts feel heavy. Lack of appetite, in connection with uterine
disorders. Disgust for food, nausea, constipation. The least food distends the stomach. Marked emaciation.
MIND - Mental power and energy weakened. Cannot concentrate mind. Confused feelings. Fainting with
vertigo.
Abdomen - Colic settling in lower colon, better passing flatus. Scanty, diarrheic stools. Pain, better bending
backwards.
Back - Sensation as if back would break just above waist. Backache with dragging in sacral region, with stringy,
colorless leucorrhea.
Constitutions - Suited to chlorotic girls and pregnant women. Weak, emaciated people.
Ears - Feel as if open through from one to the other.
Female - Premature and profuse menses with labor-like pains (Bell., Cham., Kali- c., Plat.).
Menorrhagiaprofuse, black with clots. Retarded and scanty flow (Senec.). Copious menses followed by
copious, watery oozing between periods. Leucorrhea white, stringy, due to weakness and anemia. Uterus
seems heavy. Prolapse uterus with pain in right inguinal region. Habitual tendency to miscarriage. Mus-
cular pains during pregnancy.
Food - Want of appetite with weakness.
Head - Weight in occiput, as if it would draw the head backwards. Vertigo with fainting, sleepiness, vomiting
or purging.
Kidneys - Involuntary urination on walking fast or sneezing.
Limbs - Chronic rheumatism. Dropsy. Leg (right) feels paralyzed below knee, numb, could not bear weight on
 it.
Lungs - Cough before menses.
Modalities - Better from passing flatus. Better bending backwards. Worse from loss of fluids.
Mouth - Much frothy saliva.
Rectum - Loads up with feces-paretic condition. Large, hard, difficult stool, with great pain. Fearful pain during
passing stools, as if forcing a passage. Constipation, as from rectal atony.
Stomach - Want of appetite, disgust for food. Least food causes distress. Flatulent colic. Nervous dyspepsia.
Obstinate vomiting of pregnancy. Nausea better by coffee, by dinner with pressure in forehead.
malnutrition, including neurasthenia, syphilis, insomnia, or nervous digestion. Anorexia nervosa. Cancer with
emaciation.
Failure to thrive in children. Deficient breast-milk, it increases the quality and quantity of milk in nursing
mothers. If a baby has failure to thrive, give Alfalfa to the mother and child, the breast milk improves, the mother
gets stronger and the baby gains weight.
Pronounced urinary action. Diabetes insipidus and phosphaturia. Useful to allay the bladder irritability of
prostatic hypertrophy. Rheumatic diathesis.
Weakness, enervation, exhaustion, prostration, infirmity. Muscle weakness. Convulsive movements. Desires
sweets. Sympathicotonia. Worse in the evening, from 6 to 9 p.m.
A concentrated Alfalfa tincture should exercise an influence similarto that of Avena sativa. An herbal infusion
used in three cases produced the same results as the alcoholic preparations.
MIND - Alfalfa induces a mental exhilaration of buoyancy. Cheerfulness. Vivaciousness. A general feeling of
well being, feels clear and bright, so that all blues are dissipated. Exhilaration. Mirth, hilarity, liveliness.
Clearness of thoughts.
Morose, sulky, cross, fretful, ill humored, peevish. Sadness, despondency, melancholy. Depression from
disappointed love. Hypochondriasis. Aversion to mental work. Bad dreams from emotional causes. Bulimia.
Prostration of mind, mental exhaustion, brain fag. Dull, drowsy, stupid (Gels.), gloomy and irritable, worse
during evening. Slowness. Mental dullness, sluggishness. Difficulty thinking and comprehending.
Abdomen - Distension. Flatulence with distention. Pain from passing flatus. Shifting, flatulent pain along colon
several hours after meals. Frequent loose, yellow, painful stools with burning flatulence. Colitis. Chronic
appendicitis. Inflammation, peritonitis, enteritis. Dropsy, ascites, with scanty urination. Cramping, griping pain.
Passing flatus aggravates.
Back - Backache.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Chin., Hydr., Sabin., Senec., Sep. Tril. (2) Helon. - False Unicorn, not to be
confounded with Alet. (3) Dios. - colic worse bending forward. (4) Caust., Puls., Ferr., - discharge of urine
during cough. (5) Alum. - constipation, grasps the seat tightly, despairs of having a stool. During stool terrible
pains as if a passage were being forced, Alet.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
keynote:
PHARMACY - alet. Aletris farinosa. Star grass. Blazing grass. Colic root. Unicom root. N. O. Hemodoracae.
Melanthiaceae. North America. Tincture of root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Abortion. Anemia. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions. Debility. Dysmenorrhea. Dysuria. Emaciation.
Endometritis. Fainting. Fatigue. Fever. Hemorrhoids. Hysteric colic. Indigestion. Labor-like, pains. Leucorrhea.
Menorrhagia. Miscarriage. Muscle, pain. Pregnancy, vomiting. Infertility. Uterus

name: Alfalfa
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - alf. Alfalfa. Medicago sativa. California clover. Lucerne. N. O. Papilionoi- deae. Historical dose:
Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Anorexia. Appendicitis. Appetite, loss. Ascites. Breast-feeding. Bulimia. Cachexia. Cancer.
Chemotherapy, effects. Colitis. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Emaciation. Exhaustion. Fatigue. Flatulence.
Hypoglycemia. Insomnia. Malnutrition. Marasmus. Neurasthenia. Nutritional, disorders. Polyuria.
Prostate, hypertrophy. Radiation, effects. Rheumatic, diathesis. Syphilis. Weakness. Weight, loss.
HERBAL - This is a leguminous plant, cultivated from ancient times and highly prized as a pasture and forage
plant. Those who have observed its influence when employed as a forage for stock must have been impressed
with the favorable results.
All of the provers, except one, noted three things in particular: an increased appetite so they could not wait for
their regular meals, an increased amount of urine and urea, and a general sense of well-being. Causes mental
exhilaration, increases energy and stamina.
Alfalfa favorably influences nutrition, evidenced in "toning up" the appetite and digestion. Acts as a fat
producer, corrects tissue waste. Improves appetite and digestion, mental and physical vigor returns with weight
gain.
HOMEOPATHIC - Metabolic regulator. Lack of appetite or aversion to all food. Emaciation. Disorders
characterized by
Bladder - Bladder irritability. Urging to urinate, morbid desire. Frequent urging to urinate.
 Breasts - Breast milk, absent or disappearing.
Constitutions - Anorexic, emaciated, broken down constitutions. Cancer diathesis.
Ears - Stuffed feeling in Eustachian tube (Kali-m.) at night, clear in morning.
Eyes - Aching in and above the eyes.
Face - Flushed.
Female - Increased desire. Menses coming earlier than usual.
Food - Increased thirst. Appetite wanting with weight loss. Sensation of hunger at all times. Appetite is
increased. Malnutrition. Desire for sweets. Sometimes ravenous appetite. Hypoglycemia, must stop and
have something to eat in the middle of the morning. Hungry in forenoon (Sulph.).
Head - Dull, heavy feeling in occiput in and above the eyes, worse toward evening. Violent headache. Pain in
the left side of the head. Dull heavy feeling comes on about 2 p.m. and gradually increases until 6 p.m., starts
at the occiput and becomes severe.
Kidneys - Kidneys are weak, frequent urging to urinate. Polyuria (Ph-ac.). Increased elimination of urea
indican and phosphates. Inactivity. Suppression of urine, anuria.
Male - Enlarged prostate gland. Prostatic hypertrophy.
Rectum - Painless, yellow diarrhea, accompanied with flatus and attended with burning. Stools loose and
more frequent than usual. Stools two or three times daily. Pasty, papescent stools.
Sleep - Slept better than usual, especially in early morning, it induces quiet, reposeful and refreshing sleep.
Insomnia. Sleeplessness during convalescence.
Stomach - Emptiness, weak feeling, faintness, goneness. Hungry feeling not ameliorated by eating. Nervous
indigestion.
Urine - Profuse urine, increased. Scanty. Sediment, increased indican, phosphates. Sugar in urine.
COMMENTS - Dr. Houts gathered the fresh Alfalfa leaves, but obtained good results from the use of dried
leaves which still retain a green color. Using these, he made an infusion which he gave to patients suffering
from backaches.
He found it especially indicated if they were passing small quantities of water while suffering from rheumatic
symptoms or backache with muscular aching, with an excessive quantity of uric acid and urates secreted.
Dr. Fearn of Oakland wrote that its action was very soothing upon the kidneys and urinary apparatus. He
believed that it could be prepared for human food to as good, if not better, advantage than for animal food.
Dr. Ben Bradley of Hamlet, Ohio, believed that alfalfa is one of our upcoming remedies. He reported a case
where a woman had seven children born apparently strong and well, but when they reached the age of
eighteen years they wasted away and died.
When the last girl was taken with the symptoms of which the others had died. Dr. Bradley made a saturated
tincture of Alfalfa seed concentrated, fully saturated and gave her ten drops four or five times a day. This is
reported to have increased her weight from 99 to 133 pounds. She recovered good health.
Mr. D. aged 41, a chief clerk in the general offices of one of our railroad companies, had complained for several
months of losing flesh. His appetite was poor, he did not relish his food. There was present an abnormal thirst,
a loss of flesh and polyuria.
The quantity of urine for twenty-four hours was eighty ounces, specific gravity 1008. Nothing abnormal apart
from an excess of indican. The prostate was enlarged and sensitive to pressure. He complained of some
irritation upon urination.
Five drops of the tincture was prescribed four times a day. After two weeks he sent a message for a supply
stating it had greatly benefited him. He called at the end of two months having gained ten pounds, the urine at
this time was practically normal in quantity. The appetite was fine and he considered himself in a normal
condition.
Mr. G, aged 29, complained of a loss of weight and appetite, excessive thirst, polyuria and mental depression.
This syndrome had been gradually developing for the past year.
Physical examination showed a man of medium size, emaciated. Heart action weakened. Prostatic portion of
urethra hypersensitive. The urine was greatly increased in quantity and of low specific gravity, free from casts
and albumin, phosphates were increased.
Five drops of the tincture before each meal and on retiring gradually relieved the condition so that in three
months he considered himself well.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Avena Sat., Hydr.. Dipodium punct. (2) Ars., Gels., Kali- p., Ph-ac., Zinc.
REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke. Murphy

name: Allantoin
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - alian. Allantoin. Glyoxyldiureide (C4H6N4O3). Allantoin is a white, odorless, crystalline powder
(when isolated). Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne. Burns. Canker, sores. Diaper rash. Fever blisters. Rashes. Skin, disorders. Stretch, marks.
Sunburn. Ulcers. Wounds.
HOMEOPATHIC - Allantoin is a botanical extract of the Comfrey plant and is used for its healing, soothing,
and anti-irritating properties. Allantoin helps to heal wounds and skin irritations and stimulate growth of healthy
tissue. This extract can be found in anti-acne products, sun care products, and clarifying lotions because of its
ability to help heal minor wounds and promote healthy skin.
Abate stretch marks naturally. Promotes wound healing, speeds up cell regeneration, and has a keratolytic
(skin-softening) effect. Allantoin has been termed a cell proliferant, an epithelization stimulant, and a chemical
debrider.
It is said to clean away necrotic tissue,
hastening the growth of new healthy tissue. Since Allantoin stimulates new and healthy tissue growth, healing
epithelization may take place.
Allantoin has been also termed a counter irritant that helps alleviate the untoward skin-irritation effects of
certain cosmetic ingredients such as soap and detergent surfactants, oils, and acidic or alkaline materials.
It produces its desirable effects by promoting and speeding up the healthy, natural processes of the body. It
helps the skin to help itself.
It has long been known to enhance the efficacy and desirability of cosmetic creams and lotions by its action
as a skin protectant.
Allantoin has also been incorporated into shampoos, lipsticks, shaving creams, suntan products, bath foams,
hair gels, baby powders and various aerosol preparations. Most recently, Allantoin has been used in various
dental preparations such as toothpaste and mouthwash.
For the temporary protection of minor cuts, scrapes, burns and sunburn. Helps prevent and temporarily
protects chafed, chapped, cracked, or wind-burned skin and lips.
Relieves dryness and softens cold sores and fever blisters. Helps treat and prevent diaper rash. Protects
chafed skin. Minor skin irritation associated with diaper rash and helps protect from and seal out wetness.
REFERENCES - Murphy.

name: Allium Cepa
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - all-c. Allium cepa. Red onion. N. O. Liliaceae. Alliaceae. Tincture of the onion. Tincture of whole
fresh plant gathered from July to August. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL -Allergies. Anus, fissure. Ascites. Catarrh. Colds. Coryza. Coughs. Diarrhea. Earache. Facial
paralysis. Feet, easily galled. Hay fever. Hernia. Influenza. Itching. Laryngitis. Neuritis. Neuroma. Otitis.
Panaritium. Pneumonia. Sinusitis. Sneezing. Traumatic, neuritis. Whitlow. Whooping cough. Worms. Yellow
fever.
HOMEOPATHIC - Allium cepa covers more symptoms of common colds and hay fever than any other
remedy. Anyone who has cut up raw onions for cooking knows the irritation upon the eyes and nose. Onions
cause active sneezing andlachrymation. If the homeopathic principle of cure is true, it ought to be a good
remedy for coryza, and it is.
All-c. affects the mucus membranes of nose, eyes, larynx and bowels, causing increased secretions. Hay
fever and coryza with acrid nasal discharges and laryngeal symptoms. Burning of the eyelids, nose, mouth,
throat, bladder, skin. Acute colds from damp cold weather. Coughs, colds or headache, worse in warm room,
better in open air, worse again on returning to warm room. Eye discharges may be bland.
Cough caused by tickling in larynx, constant inclination to hack in order to relieve it. It has cured violent
catarrhal laryngitis, hoarse cough with feeling as if it would split and tear the larynx, causing watering of eyes.
Cough from inhaling cold air. Nasal secretion is acrid, secretion from eye is bland.
Traumatic neuritis. Neuralgic pains like a fine thread, following amputations or injuries to nerves. Thread-
like pains in the face. Left-side facial paralysis. Wounds do not heal. Singer's coryza. Neuroma. Senile
gangrene. Sensation of glowing heat in different parts of the body. Symptoms go from left to right. The feet are
aggravated by walking.
The toothache is better by cold air or cold washing. Picking or sucking teeth improves the toothache. Sensation
of glowing heat on different parts of the body. Desires raw onions. Strangulated hernia has been known to
follow the eating abundantly of cooked onions. A raw onion eaten just before going to bed is a popular remedy
for sleeplessness.
MIND - Anxious about their health. Despair of recovery. Fear that pain will become unbearable. Melancholy.
 Indefinable anxiety. Indolence in morning. Confusion of mind, after coffee, wine.
Abdomen - Rumbling offensive flatus. Pains in left hypogastrium. Colic sitting, moving about. Very offensive
flatus. Belching with rumbling and puffing up
of the abdomen. Violent cutting pain in the left lower abdomen, with frequent desire to urinate. Pains in liver
region. Abdomen distended, rumbling, urging, and finally diarrhea.
Back - Intense pain in ñapé of neck. Pain under right shoulder blade. Chills run down the back with frequent
urination, followed by heat and thirst.
Causations - Damp cold wind, weather causes colds and toothache. Colds of spring, hay fever of August,
epidemics of spasmodic cough in autumn. Wet feet. Eating spoiled fish, cucumbers, salads. Injuries. Shooting
pains after surgical operations.
Constitutions - Especially adapted to phlegmatic patients. Psoric and allergic constitutions.
Ears - Earache, shooting pain in Eustachian tube. Aching extending to throat. Itching in ears from allergies.
Otitis media. Discharge of pus from the ear. Hardness of hearing.
Eyes - Itching, biting, burning in the eyes. Eyes red, sensitive to touch. Flow of tears. Much burning and
smarting lachrymation. Sensitive to light. Eyes suffused and watery, profuse, bland lachrymation, better in
open air. Burning in eyelids, worse coughing, wants to rub them. Sensation as if eye were hanging by a string
or torn. Nearobjects seem distant, while yawning. Letters appear smaller. Swelling around the eyes.
Face - Thread-like pains in face. Paralysis of left half of face, also in limbs of same side. Facial neuritis.
Food - Thirst. Canine hunger. Appetite, increased or diminished. Strong craving for raw onions, cannot take
any other nourishment.
Head - Dull headache, with coryza. Catarrhal headache, in forehead, worse in warm room, towards evening.
Headache ceases during menses, returns when flow disappears. Aching in forehead, extending to eyes and
face, better free running coryza. Electric shock passes through head. Skull bones numb. Pain in occiput and
down the neck.
Kidneys - Sensation of weakness in bladder and urethra. Frequent and copious urination. Increased secretion
of urine with coryza. Strangury after wet feet. Dribbling of urine in elderly people. Urine red, with much urging
and burning in urethra.
Limbs - Joints feel lame. Panaritium. Painful disorders of the fingers about the nails, red streaks running up
the arm. Limbs, especially arms feel sore and tired. Neuralgia of stump. Bad effects from getting feet wet.
Ulcers when skin is rubbed off by the shoes especially on the heels. Sore feet from long walking.
Lungs - Hacking cough on inhaling cold air. Acute bronchitis. Oppressed breathing from pressure in
middle of chest. Constricted feeling in region of epiglottis. Violent catarrhal laryngitis, the hoarse cough seemed
to split and tear the larynx. Much sneezing and coughing.
Modalities - Better in open air. Better cold room. Better bathing. Better motion. Worse in a warm room.
Worse damp weather. Worse spring. Worse wet feet. Worse afternoon and evening. Worse lying down. Worse
singing. Rest aggravates, feels better from motion.
Mouth - Bad odor from the mouth and throat.
Nose - Fluent coryza with headache, cough and hoarseness. Way/ever (Euphr., Sabad., Psor.). Allergies every
August. Spring coryza. Nose drips. Acrid discharge, when singing. Sneezing, especially when entering a
warm room. Constant sneezing with profuse acrid coryza. Burning and smarting in the nose. Burning pain in
edges of nose and lips. Profuse watery discharge with sneezing. Acrid burning discharge. Nasal discharge
excoriating the nose and upper lip. Feeling of a lump at root of nose. Coryza, headache, cough and
hoarseness. Copious acrid watery discharge from nose, with bland watering of eyes. Polyps. Nosebleed.
Sinusitis. Sensitive to odors of flowers and the skin of peaches. Nose stopped, nasal voice. Common colds
becomes laryngitis.
Rectum - Diarrhea after midnight and in the morning. Flatus very offensive. Hemor
rhoids, tearing, jerking pains in anus. Stitches in the rectum. Cracks at the anus. Itching at the anus. Worms.
Skin - Redness, nettle rash, measles, scarlatina, when the complaints are characterized by the coryza
symptoms. Prickling as from pins. Sensation of glowing heat on different parts of the body. Red streaks running
up arm. Felon after childbirth.
Sleep - Yawning in deep sleep or with headache and drowsiness and cramp in stomach. Wakes at 2 a.m.
Gaping in deep sleep. Dreams of being near water, of battles, precipices, deep wells, of storms, high waves,
Annoying dreams in convalescents.
Stomach - Sour belching. Nausea, coming from stomach up the throat into the fauces. Weak, empty feeling
in stomach. Pressure in stomach. Pain in region of pylorus.
Temperature - Fever with rumbling in the abdomen, coryza, and thirst. Flitting heat over whole body, and
thirst. Coldness alternates with heat during catarrh. Sweats easily and copiously.
 Throat - Hoarseness. Sensation as of a lump in the throat. Tickling in larynx. Expectoration of a lumpy
mucus through the posterior sinuses. Sensation as if larynx is split and torn. Pain in throat extending to the
ear.
COMMENTS - Coryza with frequent sneezing and profuse acrid discharge, corroding upper lip and nose.
Lachrymation, also profuse, but bland (Euphr. is the reverse). The action of All-c. seems to be primarily in the
nose (Euphr., in the eyes).
Allium Cepa is irritating discharge with burning and itching, from a cold, flu, allergies and hay fever. The nose,
the back of the throat, the palate and the throat are itching and burning.
A keynote is that the upper lip is red and irritated. Frequent sneezing (Ars.), with discharge. Strong symptoms
from the nose, profuse sneezing (Nat-m.). Another keynote is itching in the back of the throat that drips into
the larynx and causes hoarseness and change of voice. Burning in the larynx and voice box.
Allergic asthma. A hay fever that was suppressed with antihistamines that went into the lungs (Ars., lod.).
Nash found it particularly useful in children when the profuse coryza or cold extended to the bronchial s with
much mucus coughing and rattling of mucus.
RELATIONS-Antidotedby: Am. - toothache. Cham. - abdominal pains. Roasted coffee will remove onion
breath. Compare: (1) Euphr., Wye., Sabad., Arundo, All-s. (2) Aeon., Puls., Gels. (3) Nux-v. - coryza recurring
in August. (4) Verat. - colic with despondency. (5) Thuj. - offensive breath and diarrhea after eating on. ions.
(6) Lach. - left to right. (7) Calen.. Hyper.neuritis, amputation pain. Complementary: Phos., Puls., Sars., Ther.,
Thuj. Incompatible: All-s., Aloe, Scilla. Followed by: Calc, and Sil. in polyps.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Nash. Murphy.

CLINICAL -Allergies. Anus, fissure. Ascites. Catarrh. Colds. Coryza. Coughs. Diarrhea. Earache. Facial

name: Allium Sativum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - all-s. Allium sativum. Garlic. N. O. Liliaceae. Alliaceae. Tincture of fresh bulb. Historical dose:
Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Alopecia. Asthma, periodical. Bronchiectasis. Bronchitis. Catarrhs. Chest, complaints. Colic.
Colitis. Constipation. Coughs. Coxalgia. Dandruff. Deafness. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dyspepsia. Fevers.
Hams. Headaches. Hemoptysis. Hemorrhoids. High blood pressure. Hoarseness. Mensfrual. Menorrhagia.
Ophthalmia. Prolapsed anus. Retained, placenta. Rheumatism. Ringworm. Salivation. Scurvy. Skin, disorders.
Sprains. Tuberculosis. Vertigo. Whitlow. Worms.
HERBAL - Garlic has been used as a condiment from ancient times and also as a remedy against worms and
fevers. It has a reputation of lowering the blood pressure.
HOMEOPATHIC - All-s., though closely related to All-c., is incompatible with it and not very like it in action. It
produces headache in connection with digestive troubles and menstruation. Heavy headache, can hardly open
eyes, better onset of menses, worse after.
Teste cured with it chronic dyspepsia in old, fleshy persons, whose bowels were deranged by the least
irregularity of diet. He also greatly relieved cases of diabetes mellitus with it. Periodical asthma, a case of
permanent dyspnea, rheumatism of hip, swelling of breasts after weaning.
Characteristic respiratory symptoms include a cough, giving rise to fetid breath (Caps.). Bronchial catarrh with
profuse, gelatinous, difficult mucus expectoration. Cough when smoking.
All-s. has vaso-dilatory properties. It acts directly on intestinal mucus membrane increasing peristalsis. Colitis
with pathological flora. Adapted to fleshy subjects with dyspepsia and catarrhal disorders. High livers.
Patients who eat a great deal more, especially meat, than they drink. The digestion in disordered by slightest
irregularities in diet. Pressure in epigastrium and transverse colon, better by pressure and sitting bent. Pain in
hip, psoas and illiac muscles.
Stings and bites. Dropsy after protracted intermittent in marshy districts. The child is drowsy, lifeless, extremely
pale, bowels torpid, will not walk and the legs do not grow as rapidly as rest of the body.
Breasts swollen and painful to touch. Profuse menses. During menses there is soreness of vulva and thighs.
Pulmonary tuberculosis. Hemoptysis. Cough and expectoration diminishes, temperature becomes normal,
weight is gained and sleep becomes regular.
MIND - Anxiety and impatience. Sensitive. Fears he won't recover, that he won't able to bear any medicine.
Fear of being poisoned. Fear he will never get well. Impulse to run away. Wants many things, pleased with
nothing. Weak memory. Sadness when alone. Weeping during sleep.
Abdomen - Pressure in upper abdomen, better by sitting bent and pressing with both hands. Colic from flatus,
twisting and pinchings around navel. Emission of fetid flatus. Everything seemed to drag downward. Weight in
hypogastrium, immediately after a meal.
Back - Red spots like ringworm on the back. Itching between shoulders. Tearing, cutting pain in sacrum, in
 morning. Simple pain in coccyx.
Breasts - Breasts swollen and tender during menses. Swelling of breast after weaning. Dull stitches in right
breast. Breasts sensitive to touch. Eruption of red blotches between the breasts and around the nipples.
Causations - Drinking bad water, gluttony, meat eating.
Chest - Darting pain in the chest which prevents sleep. Pain in left chest with dark urine. Chest complaints
worse after eating.
Constitutions - Rather a gourmand than a glutton. Suited to persons who are disposed to excesses at the
table, have strong constitutions, dark complexions, firm flesh, though occasionally disposed to obesity.
Persons who eat a great deal more than they drink. Suited to fleshy people and those used to high living.
Ears - Catarrhal deafness. Hardened earwax and crusts (Thuj.).
Eyes - Catarrhal ophthalmia at night, smarting, burning and lachrymation, agglutination, returns every night
when he tries to read. Tarsi sore with irritation.
Face - Spots on face. Lips are dry. Sharp pain on one side of the face.
Female - Eruption in vagina, on breasts and vulva during menses. Menses profuse, too early. Headache and
dizziness lessen as the flow becomes established. Soreness of vulva and thighs during menses. Suppurating
pimples on vulva. During menses extensive excoriations of skin of internal portions of thighs. Retained
placenta.
Food - Voracious appetite. Thirst. Hunger and emptiness in stomach without appetite. Desire for butter.
Digestion is disordered by slightest error in diet. Complaints from bad water, gluttony.
Head - Heavy, pulsation in temples. Headaches before menses, ceases during, worse after menses.
Heaviness in forehead. Dull pain in occiput in morning, while lying on the back. Headache with mucus in the
throat in dyspeptic subjects. Dandruff.
Heart - Leaping beats of the heart. High blood pressure.
Kidneys - Urine increased. Whitish very abundant urine, becoming cloudy from nitric acid. A kind of diabetes.
Dark brown with copious sediment.
Limbs - Rheumatism of hip. Tearing pain in hip. Pain in psoas and iliacus muscles, worse crossing legs.
Painful contraction in arm. Pain in forearm, seems as if paralyzed. Burning, then moisture in palms. Skin peels
off the hands. Tearing pains in fingers extending below the nails. Weakness in lower limbs, painful weariness
in the thighs. Pain as from a sprain in ankle joint, in toe joints. Tingling in feet, burning in soles, stiffness in
feet.
Lungs - Difficult breathing as if sternum compressed. Periodic asthma. Constant rattling of mucus in
bronchials. Cough in the morning after leaving bedroom with mucus expectoration. Coughing when smoking.
Sensitive to the cold air. Painful irritation of windpipe when coughing. Cough seeming to come from stomach.
Dry cough after eating. Bronchiectasis with fetid expectoration. Great difficulty in expectorating a glutinous
mucus. Expectoration of thin, yellowish, purulent-looking blood-streaked mucus of putrid odor.
Modalities - Better from sitting bent. Worse from change of temperature. Worse pressure. Worse drinking bad
water. Worse gluttony. Walking aggravates pains in limbs. Every step causes excruciating pain in intestines.
Worse in evening and night. Worse in morning on waking.
Mouth - Much sweetish saliva after meals and at night. Tickling sensation in the lower teeth. Swelling of lower
gums. Dryness of palate. Hot taste in mouth, from throat, strongly reminding him of garlic.
Nose - Coryza rather dry than fluent, with pressive pain from above the root of the nose. Smarting at junction
of ale nasi and face. Blowing blood from the nose in the night.
Rectum - Constipation with constant dull pains in bowels. Expels flatus. Stool first fecal, then watery and hot.
Involuntary stools. Diarrhea with cuttings in abdomen and loins. Hemorrhoids. Prolapsed anus. Worms.
Skin - Loose, dry, wilted skin. Skin sensitive. Swelling with itching and burning. Red spots, on hands, on chest,
on back. Herpetic itching burning, red or whitish spots on a swollen surface.
Sleep - Drowsiness after a meal. Muscles twitch on falling asleep. Sleep prevented by stitches on chest, weight
on stomach, or thirst. Coldness felt in sleep and awakening him frequently. Dreams of water and storms.
Anxious dreams, continuing after waking.
Stomach - Burning belchings. Slightest error in diet disturbs the stomach. Sensations of cold and or hot
ascending esophagus. Burning in stomach, very sensitive to the least pressure. Weight in stomach which
prevents sleep. Pressure inward as from a stone in epigastrium.
Temperature - Chilliness on one side only. Shivering before midday and in evening. During coldness, redness
of face. Vomiting during the fever. Sweat in afternoon. Sweat acrid, causing itching, fetid.
Throat - Sticky feeling in throat with dryness, tickling, heat, and raw feeling in larynx. Sensation as of something
cold rising in throat. Sensation as of a hot and smarting vapor rising in the throat. Mucus accumulations in the
throat in the morning.
 Tongue - Tongue pale red papillae. Sensation of a hair on tongue or throat.
Vertigo - Vertigo while reading. Vertigo on looking steadily at anything for a long time. Short-lasting vertigo,
and only on rising from a chair.
COMMENTS - Pain, pressi ve from within outward (Bry.), stinging or stinging and burning or stinging with
paralytic weakness ortearing and crampy. Sometimes they increase gradually to a high point and then
decrease gradually (Sulph., Stann.). “Hair” sensation on tongue, worse reading. Copious sweetish saliva. The
hip is the seat of many rheumatic pains.
Tearing in hip. Pain in psoas and iliac muscles worse least movement, though he can lift the limb with the
hands. Aggravation from reading (Cina.).
Vertigo, brought on by looking long and steadily at anything. This is probably, in essence, the same modality
as worse by reading. Catarrhal ophthalmia returning every night on trying to read. Coryza, moist, dry, thin,
fluent with pressive pains above root of nose. Scurvy gums, sore mouth.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: All-c., Lyc. Compare: (1) Ars., Senega, Kali-n. All-c. (2) Ornithogalum
umbellatum - stomach disorders. (3) Bry., Caps., (fetid breath with cough). (4) Coloc. - colic, hip-pain, Ign.,
Kali-bi. (ropy expectoration, hairon tongue). (5) Rhus-t. and Hyos. (fear of being poisoned), Lyc., Nux-v.,
Seneg. Complementary: Ars. Incompatible: Aloe., All-c., Scilla.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

CLINICAL - Alopecia. Asthma, periodical. Bronchiectasis. Bronchitis. Catarrhs. Chest, complaints. Colic.

Hams. Headaches. Hemoptysis. Hemorrhoids. High blood pressure. Hoarseness. Mensfrual. Menorrhagia.

name: Alloxanum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - allox. Alloxanum. Meoxalylurea. Allopathic drug. It takes the form of rhomboid crystals soluble
in alcohol and insoluble in water. The anhydrous crystals are dark yellow in color, the hydrogenized crystals
are colorless. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Aerophagy. Alcoholism. Aphthae. Arthritis. Bedwetting. Blood, disorders. Cardiac neurosis.
Catarrh. Conjunctivitis. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Dyspepsia. Dysuria. Ecchymosis. Eczema. Glossitis.
Glycosuria. Headaches. Hypogycemia. Insomnia. Laryngitis. Leucorrhea. Myopia. Narcolepsy. Nausea.
Neuralgia. Neurasthenia. Nightmares. Numbness. Osteoporosis. Pancreas, disorders. Pharyngitis. Pimples.
Poly-neuritis. Purpura. Rheumatism. Toothache. Toxemia. Toxic diabetes. Vaginitis. Varicose veins.
HOMEOPATHIC - Alloxan was discovered accidentally by Dum and his collaborators in 1943. The toxicological
action can be seen at the level of the pancreas, the kidneys, the liver, the lungs and in the blood. In animals,
diabetes mellitus is provoked or, in other words,
alloxanic diabetes. There would be a rapid degeneration if the islet Beta cells responsible for the production of
insulin.
The homeopathic proving of Alloxan was undertaken by Templeton on two occasions, in 1949 on six provers,
when the potencies 6c and 30c were tried out, and in 1951 on nine provers and seven controls.
Lack of heat and vital reaction. Disturbed sleep with nightmares. General indifference. Need for solitude.
Dryness of digestive mucus membranes. Diabetes mellitus. Excessive thirst and frequent urination. Joint
pains in the lumbar, sacral and ileocecal regions. Neuralgia of the tongue. Toothache.
Acrid dyspepsia. Spontaneous ecchymosis and eruption of itching pimples. Sensation of body being dispersed
into different parts. Osteoporosis and muscular weakness. Decrease of phosphoremia and increase of
phosphates in the blood. Glycosuria without hyperglycemia.
MIND - Great forgetfulness. Forgets places, names, things just done, just heard. Loss of short-term memory.
Spelling mistakes. Words don't register. Mistakes in spelling. Dyslexia. Silly mistakes in writing simple words.
Silly sort of attitude to serious things.
Alcoholic poly-neuritis with mental troubles. Paranoia. Sadness and tearfulness improved by solitude. Need
for solitude and uneasiness about the future. Weeping better when alone.
Indifference towards the surrounding environment. Indifference to conversation. Indifference to loved ones.
Indifference to work.
Irritable with people, talking, loud voices. Irritability from noise. Fits of anger. Hurried. Dogmatic. Dictatorial.
Impatient, taps foot with impatience. Quarrelsome. Hurried, others move too slow. Wants to dash about, wants
to do everything quickly.
Confusion as to his identity, as if head was being lifted off. Delusion, as if head were separated from body
(Psor.). People talking seemed miles away. Voices seemed far away. Keeps washing hands.
Abdomen - Abdominal distention with profuse rumbling. Toxic diabetes. Ileocecal pain, aggravated by
bending forwards and by movement. Sensation of a band around abdomen.
Back - Stiffness better stretching. Pain and cervical stiffness, aggravated in bed, ameliorated by stretching.
Cramping pain in the shoulder blade, cutting pain, aggravated by drinking. Lumbar rheumatism. Arthritis of the
 spine, preventing movement. Pain in the lower lumbar region, worse in bed, in kneeling position and by
standing, better by hot weather. Pain in lumbar region worse cold weather. Pain in lumbo-sacral region
extending down legs.
Bladder - Feeling of fullness in the bladder. Coldness in bladder, worse draft of air. Sensation as if bladder is
swollen. Incontinence on hurrying to get up, on sneezing. Bedwetting.
Blood - Reduction in the number of phosphates in the blood plasma, normal presence of glucose in the blood,
azotemia. Reduction of sedimentation rate.
Chest - Feeling of a heavy weight on the chest. Heaviness better menses. Stitching pain better menses.
Constitutions - The subjects are often phosphoric and very weak. Subjects nervous, uneasy, anxious.
Ears - Deep, drumming pain inside. Itching of the auditory canal. Eczema of the outer ear.
Eyes - Conjunctivitis. Eyelids red, burning and itching. Eyes painful, especially as a result of light and after
reading, ameliorated by closing the lids. Sight dim with patches and bright spots. Myopia. Dim vision and
twitching of eyelids, on waking (Cycl.). Sparks like fragments of fire.
Female - Inflammation of the vulva and vagina. Feeling of swelling in the vagina, especially after standing for
a long time. White leucorrhea, non-irritating, but increasing with the approach of menses. Sensation as if vagina
were swollen, worse standing.
Food - Feeling of hunger, quickly sated. Hypogycemia. Aversion to salt. Desire for cold dritiks, refreshing
things. Excessive thirst and feeling of dryness. Worse cold drinks, warm drinks. Better warm drinks.
Head - Feeling of constriction and heat in the head, which is cold to the touch. Heaviness of head on waking
with sensation of the hair being pulled. Headache better ascending steps, better closing eyes, worse couching,
worse hot room. Headache from hunger, but eating does not relieve. Headache worse laughing, better talking,
better travelling.
Heart - Pain as of a punch in the precordial region. Shooting pain in the heart, worse when walking. Retro-
sternal cramping pain. Cardiac neurosis.
Kidneys - Kidney pain on the left side on urination. Dysuria. Glycosuria. Frothy urine, burning as it passes
down the urethra. Frequent urination by day. Waking from urging to urinate, morbid desire. Sudden urging,
can't hold urine for long.
Limbs - Cramp in the calves and toes in bed. Aching with shivering in the arms, legs, ameliorated by stretching
out, aggravated by the cold and by standing. Chronic joint problems. Chronic rheumatism of the hip. Heaviness
and prominent veins in the legs. Varicose veins. Varicose hemorrhage. Itching of leg followed by ecchymoses.
Numbness of arms when raising them. Numbness of legs when crossing them.
Liver - Pain in liver on breathing, after eating, better eating, better pressure. Pulsating in liver. Bubbling in
region of liver.
Lungs - Breathing difficult after meals.
Modalities - Better from climbing stairs.
Better closing eyes. Better eating, but if hungry, there is no improvement. Worse by dust, smells. Worse heat.
Worse coughing. Worse laughter. Worse physical or mental exertion. Worse noise. Worse left side. Worse
between 4 p.m. and 5 p.m.
Mouth - Breath smells like apples. Salty taste on lips. Sweetish taste on lips. Corners of lips cracked. Dry,
chapped lips. Lowerjaw painful. Toothache, aggravated by sweet things. Tip of tongue painful.
Small, superficial ulcers on the mouth and palate. Bitter, acrid taste, sweet taste on the lips. Mouth dry.
Nose - Acute catarrh of the nasal mucus membrane with streaming, sometimes from the right side, sometimes
from the left. Aggravated by dust, smells and heat. Catarrh from dust. Sensation of heat in nose on inspiration.
Smell in nose as of musty books.
Rectum - Diarrhea, worse between 6 a.m. and 9 a.m., leaving a burning excoriation in the anus. Feeling of
insufficient evacuation. Stools clammy and sticky, blood-streaked. Fullness after stool.
Skin - Dry, cracking eczema. Ecchymosis. Rheumatoid purpura. Purpura without fever, beginning suddenly
with large, benign ecchymoses. Hands dry, chapped. Spontaneous bruising of the fingers and legs. Skin dirty,
with eruption of itching pimples.
Sleep - Troubled sleep with dreams, nightmares. Sleepwalking, somnambulism. Insomnia until 2 a.m. Sleep
disturbed by dreams. Dreams of accidents. Dreams being chased by a horse. Dreams of resurrection. Dreams
of death of a friend. Dreams of bandits, robbers. Dreams of rats, toads, frogs in the bed. Dreams of being
followed or falling. Dreams killing with a knife. Dreams being imprisoned. Dreams of sermons.
Stomach - Nausea before meals and heavy, aching feeling after. Nausea when travelling.
Throat - Acute and chronic laryngitis and pharyngitis. Dry, painful on the left side with burning, grating pain.
Swallowing painful, improved with a hot drink. Throat pain better drinking, better expectoration, worse singing,
when talking.
 RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Uranium nit. - Excessive thirst, morbid hunger, emaciation. Polyuria. (2) Ph-ac.
- Apathy, indifference towards everything, weakness, headaches, diarrhea, abundant urine, seminal discharge,
weakness of vertebral column. (3) Arg-n. - Apprehension. Sadness. Weakness of legs. Feeling of a splinter of
wood sticking in the pharynx. Urinary incontinence by day and
by night, desire for sweet things to eat.
REFERENCES - Julian.

name: Alnus Rubra
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aln. Alnus rubra. Red alder. Alnus serrulata. Alnus glutinosa. Black alder. Tag alder. Common
alder of Europe. N. O. Cupuliferae. Betulaceae. Tincture of the bark. Tincture of the young shoots. Historical
dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Glands, enlarged. Gleet, hemorrhage. Herpes. Impetigo. Leucorrhea. Psoriasis.
Rheumatism. Scrofula. Syphilis.
HERBAL - The bark-tincture of Aln. is used by herbalists as an ‘ ‘alterative’ ’in scrofulous conditions in chronic
skin affections, rheumatism, syphilis, gravel and gleet.
Aln. has some reputation as a remedy for skin affections, glandular enlargements and indigestion from
imperfect secretion of gastric juice. It stimulates nutrition and thus acts favorably upon strumous disorders,
enlarged glands, etc.
HOMEOPATHIC - Among its indications are leucorrhea with erosions which bleed easily, amenorrhea with
burning pains from back to pubis and hematuria. Ulcerated mucus membranes of mouth and throat. Fingers
covered by crust caused by pustules, disagreeable odor. Indigestion from imperfect secretion of gastric juice.
Female - Leucorrhea with erosions of cervix, bleeding easily. Amenorrhea with burning pains from back to
pubis.
Skin - Chronic herpes. Enlarged submaxillary glands. Eczema, prurigo. Purpura hemorrhagica. Poison oak,
used topically.
COMMENTS - The plant grows in swamps and marshes. Not to be confused with certain of the Rhamnacae,
which are also popularly called Alders.
Cooper, who used a fresh plant tincture of Alnus glutinosa, noted the “Pain in rectum after stool.” and
“heaviness in head as after being drunk the night before.”
Hale gave, as particularly indicating it, “Eruptions on the skin alternating with diseased conditions of mucus
membrane.”
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Cooper.

name: Aloe Socotrina
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aloe. Aloe socotrina. Common aloes. Aloe ferox. Aloe succotrina. N. O. Liliaceae. Aloaceae.
Trituration or solution in spirit of the gum oftheleaves. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Abdomen, plethora. Alopecia. Anal, weakness. Backache. Bronchitis. Cholera. Colic. Colitis.
Constipation. Coryza. Cough Diarrhea Dysentery. Earache. Flatu- ence. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Headaches.
Hemorrhoids. Hysteria. Incontinence. Insomnia. Jaundice. Lumbago. Nausea. Nosebleed. Onanism.
Pimples. Proctitis. Prostate, disorders. Sacrum, pain. Skin, disorders. Tenesmus. Tuberculosis. Uterus,
prolapsed. Varicose veins. Vertigo. Vomiting.
HERBAL - Aloe socotrina is one of the oldest and most famous remedies. It is in worldwide use as a purgative
and forms a leading ingredient in a large number of patent medicines for regulating the bowels and menstrual
functions.
HOMEOPATHIC - Aloe has the anti-psoric property of throwing out internal complaints to the skin. It causes
congestion of various parts, especially abdomen, pelvic organs and head. Especially suitable to lymphatic and
hypochondriacal patients. Bad effects from sedentary life or habits. Dissatisfied and angry about himself,
alternating with lumbago.
Aloe affects abdominal veins, causing congestion, relaxation in rectum, liver, colon and pelvis. The rectal
symptoms are usually very strong. Prolapse rectum. Burning in rectum. Heat internally and externally.
Pulsation in rectum after eating.
Portal congestion. Hemorrhoids like a bunch of grapes, better cold bathing. Burning and stitching in anus
and rectum from hemorrhoids, preventing sleep. Hot rtool and flatus.
The child goes around the house, dropping little hard, round, marble-like stools. Diarrhea, after eating oysters
in the hot season, or of beer drinkers. A lot of mucus is passed with pain in rectum, after lumpy, watery stools.
 Rumbling, gurgling in bowels, sudden urging, sense of insecurity then hurriedly passes a gushing watery
stool. Uncertain whether gas or stool will come. Diarrhea with pain in the rectum after stool. Lienteric stools.
Ana/ weakness, oozes mucus. Stools escape with flatus or when urinating. Stools, mushy, lumpy, watery,
gelatinous, bloody, solid stools passed involuntarily, urging to stools with passing flatus only.
Aloe has a diarrhea that is worse in the early morning (Sulph). Diarrhea worse immediately after eating, worse
from walking (Aesc., Thuj.), or standing (Sulph.). Feeling of insecurity of bowels on passing gas or before stool
(Phos.).
Periodic headaches which alternate with lumbago. Sensation of fullness in the parts. Heavy, dragging, as of
a load. Drawing, downward sensation. Discharges, gelatinous, post nasal, stools, etc. General weakness and
weariness. Heat external and internal.
Aloe has been used successfully in the treatment of tuberculosis by giving the pure juice. Carroll Dunham
cured a heavy frontal incapacitating headache in an old man occurring in winter and alternating with a diarrhea
which occurred in summer when he was free from headache. Dunham also cured incontinence of urine in an
old man with enlarged prostate with the diarrhea.
MIND - Ill humor, especially in cloudy weather or with constipation. Taciturn after eating. Sense of insecurity.
Discontented, better evening. Dissatisfied and angry about himself. Sadness in morning, betterevening.
Hates people, repels everyone. Thinks that she would die in a week.
Fright at slight noises. Restlessness and fear. Fear of men. Exhaustion alternating with activity. Disinclination
to mental labor. Life is a burden. Aversion to labor. Lassitude alternating with great mental activity.
Children, with much emotions, chat and laugh.
Hysteria. Extremely excited during pain. Easily excited, angry, revengeful. Wants to destroy object of wrath,
better tea or mild stimulants. Trembling from musical sounds and other noises. Imagines that persons are
stepping hard or quickly. Time passes too slowly.
Abdomen - Heaviness in hypogastrium. Colic before and during stool. Abdominal pains better from passing
burning, offensive flatus. Colitis. Dragging down in abdomen. Abdomen feels full, heavy, hot, bloated.
Weak feeling, as if diarrhea would come on. Great accumulation of flatus, pressing downwards, causing dis-
tress in lower bowels. Sensation as if plug between symphysis pubis and coccyx with urging to stool.
Twisting, griping pains, must sit bent forward. Soreness in sides. Rumbling, gurgling in bowels, sudden
urging. Pain around navel, worse pressure. Pain from navel to rectum. Bloated abdomen, more on left side,
or along colon and worse after eating. Pulsating pain around navel. Pelvis as if filled with hot water.
Back - Backache. Pain in lumbar region, worse moving. Sharp pain through sacrum, extending to loins.
Lumbago alternating with a headache and hemorrhoids. Pain in sacrum, worse while sitting, better moving
about. Creeping sensation beginning in sacrum, until it was a creeping in bones over whole body. Heaviness
and pressure in sacrum worse sitting, better moving about.
Causations - Sedentary habits, poor diet.
Chest - Congestion to the chest. Breathing impeded by stitches in the left side of the chest. Front of chest
feels sore on deep inspiration. Weakness of chest.
Constitutions - Adapted to weary people, the aged and phlegmatic, old beerdrinkers. Suited to old people, to
women of relaxed phlegmatic habit, to persons of lymphatic or hypochondriac temperament. Allen said it's
adapted to weary people with very broken down constitutions and elderly people. Menopausal years.
Coughs - Cough in winter, with itching. Coughs when she would sit down. Cough when standing, or stand up.
Cough after sitting, with lachrymation. Dry, irritative, hacking cough with metallic taste in mouth. Cough with
scratching in throat. Cough with sharp pain right side of larynx.
Ears - Cracking when chewing when mov-._ r ingjaw. Sudden explosion and clashing in left ear. Tinkling as
of some thin, shivered, metallic globe in head. Sticking in left ear, later in right. Earache during menses. Internal
and external heat.
Eyes - Lachrymation. Congestion of eyes. Pressure in orbits. Compelled to make small during pain in forehead.
Pain deep in orbits. Flickering before eyes. Redness of eyes with yellow vision. Closes eyes partially from
pain in forehead. Pain as if in muscles, worse right side.
Face - Lips dry, cracked, swollen, pustular, sore at corners. Lips markedly red, bleed- ■ ing. Pain while yawning
or chewing. Heat of the face when excited, or during headache. Face pale during cloudy weather. Lips moist,
white, scaly.
Female - Menses too early, last too long and too profuse. Menstrual flow increased, dark and clotted. Prolapse
uterus. Bearing down in rectum, worse standing and during menses. Uterus feels heavy, cannot walk much
on that account. Labor-like pains in loins, extend down legs. Menopausal hemorrhage. Heavy congested
uterus with labor-like pains, felt in groins and hips worse standing and during menses. Leucorrhea of bloody
mucus, preceded by colic. Dysentery after childbirth.
 Food - No appetite. Hungry during diarrhea. Hungry after stools. Thirst with dryness of mouth, awakens at
night. Aversion to meat. Desires juicy things, fruits. Desires apples. Desires salty food. Beer causes
diarrhea. Beer relieves pains in anus. Diarrhea after eating oysters. Diarrhea from vinegar. Vinegar relieves
colic. Sour food doesn't agree.
Head - Dull, pressive pain, worse heat. Headache alternates with lumbago. Headache alternates with intestinal
and uterine
disorders. Headaches are above forehead with heaviness in eyes, must partially close them. Headache
better closing eyes. Headache after stool. Headache with heaviness of eyes and nausea. Headaches worse
heat, better cold applications. Heavy pressure on vertex. Clinking in head as from some thin-slivered glass,
extending to ears. Headaches with gastrointestinal irritation and coldness of lower limbs. Congestion to head,
compelling one to sit up. Congestion to head and face during stool. Sensitiveness of scalp in spots. Alopecia
with chronic headaches. Dryness of hair.
Heart - Strong beat of heart occasionally. Pulse accelerated. Pulse weak, suppressed after vomiting. Pulse
slow in afternoon.
Kidneys - Incontinence in aged, bearing- down sensation and enlarged prostate.
Every time on passing urine, feeling as if thin stool would escape with it. Burning pain when urinating. Frequent
urging, worse at night or in afternoon. Urging so quick he can scarcely retain urine. Scanty, hot and high
colored urine. Urine with much mealy sediment or slimy. Urine copious, pale, after stool. Urine saffronyellow,
becoming cloudy.
Limbs - Lameness in all limbs. Drawing pains in joints. Sensation of weakness in the joints of the hands and
feet. Sensation as if joints, bruised or dislocated. Pricking, dull twitching in joints. Paralytic drawing in muscles.
Soles are painful when walking on the pavement. Cold hands with warm feet. Heaviness of right arm.
Weakness of wrist-joints. Weakness of ankle-joint. Varicose veins.
Liver - Fullness in region of liver, pain under right ribs. Tension in the region of the liver. Uneasiness, heat,
pressure, and tension in the region of the liver. Pain in the liver, worse on standing, so that he bends forward.
Sharp pains in the liver, when drawing a long breath. Chronic types of jaundice with bilious states, the tongue
is coated, breath foul, and a sensation of fullness and heaviness in hepatic region.
Lungs - Difficult respiration with sharp pains from liver to chest. Whistling in throat, as if something had fallen
into trachea. Yellow, tenacious mucus. Spits up blood.
Male - Offensive sweat on genitals. Epididymis sensitive, to touch or while walking. Penis shrunk and testicles
cold. Scrotum relaxed. Prostate enlarged. Involuntary emissions during siesta. Itching of prepuce. Erections
after urinating. Premature ejaculation. Sexual irritability after eating, after waking (in children). Increased sexual
desire with erections.
Modalities - Better from cool open air. Better cold applications. Better passing flatus. Better closing eyes.
Better taking tea or stimulants. Worse in early morning. Worse evenings. Worse summer. Worse heat. Worse
hot damp weather or hot dry weather. Worse after eating or drinking. Worse after dysentery. Worse yawning
or chewing. Worse stepping hard. Worse evening. Worse standing or walking.
Mouth - Dry mouth, with increased thirst and greater redness of the lips. Lips dry, peeling off, cracked,
bleeding. Metallic, bitter or sour taste. Bitter, nauseous taste. Taste like ink or iron. Yellow spots in mouth.
Accumulation of saliva in mouth. Sickening smell from mouth. Increased salivation. Inflamed sore spots in
mouth and inside of cheeks. Palate swollen. Concave edges of teeth seem sharp and hurt tongue.
Nose - Coldness of tip. Nosebleed in morning on awakening. Full of crusts. Nosebleed from nose after waking.
Cory za with burning and pain in nose. Sneezing causes stitches in umbilical region. Redness of nose in open
cold air. Dryness of nose in morning, in bed.
Perspiration - Cold sweat after stool. Sweat smells strong. Offensive sweat on genitals. Sweats at night.
Sweats after drinking.
Rectum - Every morning, on rising, has a hasty desire for stool. Must run from bed to toilet. Diarrhea,
drives him out of bed. Diarrhea from cold, damp room. Diarrhea in hot, damp weather. Diarrhea when walking
or standing. Diarrhea after
Aloe socotrina chagrin. Hospital diarrhea. Colic and diarrhea. Cholera. Rumbling, gurgling in rectum,
sudden urging. Sensation of weakness and loss of power of anal sphincter. Sense of insecurity in rectum,
when passing flatus. Uncertain whether gas or stool will come. Urging to stool as soon as he eats, or
immediately after eating and drinking. Constant bearing down in rectum, bleeding, sore and hot, relieved
by cold water. Hemorrhoids protrude like grapes. Hemorrhoids bleed often and profusely. Hemorrhoids
very sore and tender, better cold-water application. Hemorrhoids with soreness and constant bearing down in
rectum. Burning and sharp pains in anus and rectum, from hemorrhoids, preventing sleep. Burning in anus
and rectum. Burning, copious flatus. Constipation with heavy pressure in lower part of abdomen. Pulsation
 in rectum and sexual irritation. Dysentery, after childbirth. Fistula in anus.
Skin - Itching, especially of legs. Spots which, when scratched, pain and become sensitive. Itch appears each
year, as winter approaches. Golden colored skin. Furuncles with disordered liver. Ointments aggravates
burning (Sulph.). Pimples on abdomen. Spots which, when scratched, become sensitive.
Sleep - Drowsy, dozing in morning. Spasmodic jerks when falling asleep. Sleeplessness from itching and
burning in anus. Insomnia, cannot get to sleep for a long time, thoughts crowd upon him and keep him awake.
Awakened by thirst. Awakened by urgency to urinate. Dreams of soiling himself. Oppressive dreams. Dreams
of danger, could not cry out.
Stomach - Bitter, acrid or sour eructations. Tasteless belchings with oppressions in stomach. After eating,
flatulence and nausea with a headache. Pain in pit when making false step. Sensations as if vomiting were
coming on, from rising of flatulence toward throat. Fullness in stomach, followed by distension. Nausea with
headache. Nausea with empty feeling in stomach. Nausea with pain at umbilicus. Vomiting of blood.
Stools - Feces and urine escape together, can't pass one without the other. Child goes around house, dropping
little hard round marble-like stools. Stool passes without effort, almost unnoticed. Lumpy, watery stool. Jelly-
like stools with soreness in rectum after stool. A lot of mucus with pain in rectum after stool. Stool escapes
with flatus or when urinating. Stools mushy, lumpy, watery, gelatinous. Stools bloody. Stools small, brownish,
slimy, half fluid. Stools bright yellow.
Temperature - Chill with coryza, in the cold open air. Chill at stool. Shivering. Cold hands, warm feet. Internal
heat. Heat in spots, on scalp or face. Heat flushes with anxiety and restlessness.
Throat - Thick lumps of tough mucus. Varicose condition of veins in pharynx. Dry, scrapy feeling. Hawking of
thick lumps of jelly-like mucus. Raw and swollen feeling in throat. Fauces raw, hot, as if burned. Scraping in
larynx. Voice husky, hawking.
Tongue - Dry tongue. Yellow ulcers on the tongue. Severe fine stitches in under part of tongue when moving
it. Tongue coated yellowish-white. Tongue stiff, dry, red. Inflamed sore spots on tongue.
Vertigo - Vertigo with sense of insecurity. Vertigo on moving. Vertigo as if everything whirled with her, worse
going up stairs or turning quickly. Vertigo with anxiety when moving.
Vision - Flickering vision with heat of face. Flickering vision during headache. Yellow vision. Sees yellow rings
moving before eyes, with redness of eyes. Dim vision while writing.
COMMENTS - This is Aloe socotrina, not Aloe vera. Keynote incontinent stool, and an early morning sudden
urge to diarrhea or stool. Colitis, irritable bowel, and dysentery.
Uneasiness and pains in the liver region. Fullness, heaviness, heat and inflammation. The whole abdomen is
painfully sensitive to touch. Rumbling. Feeling as of a plug wedged in between pelvis and coccyx. Abdominal
colic. Burning gas, heaviness in the rectum. Strong relationship to Sulphur.
Sudden and continued desire to go to stool. Tenesmus, weak rectum with forceful stool. Desire for stool after
each meal (Ars., Chin., Lyc., Podo., Trom., and Ferr. when it's while still eating).
Rumbling and cramping in abdomen before and during stool. The hard stool falls out without being noticed,
urging to stool while passing water, every time on passing water feeling as if stool would pass. A hard stool
may be passed involuntarily. “Stool passes unnoticed.”
Nash noted the case of a child, constipated from birth, who screamed all the time he as being held to stool,
could not pass it even after an enema. Yet when not trying, he passed solid pieces in bed without knowing.
Cured with Aloe 200c.
Involuntary soft stool while passing wind. With the diarrhea, flatulency, pinching in abdomen, pain in back and
rectum and chilliness. Flatus offensive, burning, copious, much flatus with small stool. Burning in anus with
passing of flatus.
Lack of confidence of the sphincter ani (Cimic.). Stools like mush, bright yellow, gray, hot, undigested. Mucus
and blood in feces. Profuse withjelly-like lumps. Watery stools, worse standing or walking. Watery stool
containing lumps “like frog spawn.”
Bilious, yellow fecal, bright yellow diarrhea, great rumblings in bowels and escape of much wind. Worse
morning and evening in damp weather, from overheating after cold taken in damp room, after chagrin.
Diarrhea driving one out of bed very early in morning (Sulph). Diarrhea with sense of insecurity (Phos.).
Faintness after stool with cold sweat. Griping may (Nux-v.), or may not (Merc.), cease after stool. Heaviness,
heat, pressing, burning in rectum. Itching, burning, pulsating as from fissures at anus.
After stool there is a cutting, feeling as if more would come, protruding hemorrhoids. Hemorrhoids that protrude
like a bunch of grapes, constant bearing-down in rectum, bleeding, sore, tender, hot, better by cold water.
Periodic headache which alternates with lumbago. Darting pains in left temple worse every step. A peculiar
dull, heavy, pressing pain in forehead. Worse all exertion, especially mental. Pressure in vertex and forehead
as from a weight. Heaviness in the eyes (All-s.). Compelled to make the eyes small during pain in forehead.
 In females, pain in hypogastrium as if menses coming on. Labor-like pains drawing into legs. Menses too early
and too profuse. During menstruation there is a headache, better by application of cold water, earache, pain
in small of back, and pressing down in rectum. Fullness in pelvis. Leucorrhea of bloody mucus preceded by
colic. Pain in small of back, worse sitting or awaking at night, better moving about. Lumbago alternating with
headache.
RELATIONS - Aloe is related to All-c., All-s., Agave., Scilla, Colch. Antidoted by: Sulph., Mustard, Camph.
relieves for a while, Lyc., and Nux-v. relieve the earache. Compare: (1) Sulph. similiar in many symptoms,
and is of equal importance with Sulph. in chronic diseases with abdominal plethora. (2) Kali-bi., Lyc., All-s. (3)
Ail. - dull, frontal headache. (4) Gamb. - diarrhea. (5) Am-m. - abdominal and diarrheic symptoms. (6) Nux-v. -
gastric abdominal and uterine troubles: bad effects of sedentary habits. (7) Aesc. - hemorrhoids. (8) Merc., -
dysentery. (9) Podo. - alterations between head symptoms and abdominal symptoms. Complementary:
Sulphur.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Alstonia Constricta
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - alst-c. Alstoniaconstricta. Bitter bark. Native quinine bark. N. O. Apocynaceae. Australia.
Tincture of the bark.Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Anemia. Breast-feeding, disorders. Breast-milk, excessive. Debility. Diarrhea. Dysentery.
Fevers. Indigestion. Intermittent fever. Leucorrhea. Lienteria. Malaria. Nausea. Palpitations. Pregnancy,
vomiting. Rheumatic pains. Ulcers. Uterus, debility. Weakness.
HERBAL - Alstonia constricta is an exceedingly bitter herb. It grows in India and the one from Malabar are
probably similar in effects to Alstonia scholaris. It has been used as a tonic after exhausting fevers. Locally,
it has been for ulcers and rheumatic pains.
HOMEOPATHIC - Alstonia was proved by Dr. Cathcart of Australia, who found it produce great debility and
prostration or low fever often with diarrhea. Characteristic gone sensation in stomach and sinking in abdomen
with debility. Malarial disease with diarrhea, dysentery, anemia, and feeble digestion.
Dr. Dietz gave the following as leading indications: debility from lack of digestive power in the stomach or
general assimilative power. Tongue generally has a dirty white coat, especially at base, though it may be clean.
Nausea, worse morning, before breakfast or at irregular times, when depending on reflex irritation from pelvic
organs.
Food seems to remain in stomach a long time undigested. Diarrhea of undigested food immediately after
eating, has to leave table before finishing a meal. This symptom
was cured by Alst. c. lx in a patient who had taken a great deal of iron.
Violent purging and cramps in bowels. Heat and irritation in lower bowels. Camp diarrhea, bloody
stool.Dysentery. Diarrhea from bad water and malaria. Painless watery stools (Phos-ac.). Diarrhea
immediately after eating.
Leucorrhea and bearing-down worse by walking. Swollen feeling in right ovarian region. Sharp shooting pain
from left side of stomach through to back (spleen).
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Similar in action to Alstonia scholaris, the Dita bark of India aand Malabar. (2)
Ars., Chin. - similar in diarrhea, chronic dyspepsia and debility. (3) Hydr., Ferr-cit., Chin.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
