name: Alumen Crudum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - alumn. Alumen crudum. Potash alum. Potassic-Aluminic Sulphate. Trituration of the crystallized
double sulphate of Aluminium and Kalium. Trituration of the pure crystals. Historicaldose: Trituration and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Alcohol, effects. Alopecia. Anus disorders. Asthma. Backaches. Breast, cancer. Bronchitis.
Catarrh. Cancer. Chilblains. Colic. Constipation. Coughs. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Eczema.
Emaciation. Epithelioma. Esophagus, stricture. Eye, disorders. Eyes, surgery. Fungus. Glands, indurated.
Gleet. Gonorrhea. Hemorrhages. Hoarseness. Indurations. Itching, skin. Lead, colic. Leucorrhea. Locomotor
ataxia. Nausea. Noma. Otorrhea. Palpitations. Paralysis.Paralytic, weakness. Polyps. Scurvy. Skin, rough.
Strabismus. Teeth, operations. Throat, disorders. Typhoid. Ulcers. Uterus, disorders. Uvula. Vaginismus.
Vertigo. Vomiting. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - The well-known astringent action of Alum, gives a leading indication for its use in practice.
On the other hand, it is equally available for the states of relaxation, which corresponds with its secondary
action.
Stools as hard as stones. No desire for stool for days. Aggravated constipation and hemorrhage from bowels
during the course of typhoid. Cancer of uterus and rectum with the most obstinate constipation.
Constrictions and contractions of sphincters and various parts.
Tendency to induration of glands and other tissues. Tongue, rectum, uterus etc., are hardened, ulcers with
Indurated base. Indurations following inflammation. Lupus or cancer of nose. Scirrhus of the tongue.
Paralytic weakness of all the muscles of the body with typhoid. Relaxation of muscles.
Prolapsed uterus and rectum, excruciating pains. Sensation of dryness and constriction. Mental paresis,
dysphagia especially to liquids.
Sluggish action of muscles, hemorrhages of various kinds, large clots in typhoid, relaxed mucus membranes,
relaxed uvula, hoarseness and bronchial affections, diarrhea. Sensitive to cold, exposure to air causes
roughness and chaps in the skin. Yellow bland discharges.
Useful after operations on the eyes and teeth. Hemorrhages from leech bites, extracting teeth, etc.
Parenchymatous bleeding from mouth, gums, nose, uterus. Hemorrhages of dark blood. Mucus membrane
dry in nose, on tongue in mouth, larynx. Emaciation. Joints of arms, hands and feet feel bruised.
MIND - Nervous tremors from bad news. Doubting people. Lectophobia. Desires to remain in bed. Fear of
falling. Spells of rage, attacks people.
Thinking about disease causes palpitations. Anxiety at night. Anxiety at night with nausea and headache.
Sadness in morning. Weeping in morning.
Abdomen - Colic worse by walking, with fullness and heaviness. Potter's colic, lead colic. Abdomen retracted,
better from pressure. Contractive sensation deep in pelvis with complaints of rectum and bladder.
Back - Sensation as if cold water were poured down back, with headache. Backache in evening on both sides
of spine, with every deep inhalation. Weakness of spine in evening.
Bladder - Irritable bladder alternating with pain in vertex. Catarrh of bladder, mostly with the aged. Discharge
of mucus from urethra. Itching of orifice of urethra.
Breasts - Sore, inflamed nipples. Induration of cervix and breasts (Carb-an., Con.). Breast cancer.
Causations - Bad news. Operations on eyes, on teeth.
 Constitutions - Adapted to elderly people, especially bronchial catarrhs. Disease of bladder. Children with
profuse bronchial catarrh.
Coughs - Cough in morning before breakfast, better after. Dry cough, in evening after lying down. Chronic
morning cough of elderly people. Cough from tickling in larynx caused by talking.
Ears - Heat in both ears and left side of face at night. Purulent otorrhea. Hears every noise in sleep.
Eyes - Wild look with spells of rage. Bruised feeling on pressure or by moving eyelids. Spots on cornea.
Prolapse of iris after cataract operation. Right eye squints towards the nose. Varicosities of conjunctiva.
Purulent ophthalmia of infants. Itching burning on border of lower lids. Dilated pupils. Diplopia by candlelight.
Sees double by candlelight.
Female - Induration of cervix. Left ovary affected. Menses scanty, watery. Hands weak, drops things during
menses. Chronic gonorrhea, yellow with little lumps along urethra. Weight and prolapse of uterus. Affections
of left ovary with troublesome constipation. Chronic yellow vaginal discharge. Leucorrhea and emaciation
with yellow complexion. Vagina very sensitive, and narrowed by swellings of various size. Vaginismus. Itching.
Aphthous patches in vagina (Caul.). Bleeding after childbirth.
Food - Appetite increased, even with fullness in stomach. Loathes food. Emaciation. Thirst, throat dry and
increased appetite with heat in stomach, better by drinking cold water, intense with fever. Mouth dry, but no
increase of thirst.
Head - Alopecia. Rush of blood to head. Headache, better drinking cold water. Burning pain and weight on
vertex, better ice-cold cloths pressed on the part. Headache shooting through temples with nausea, better
drinking cold water. Jerking pain in left forehead, evening. Pains coming and going, from place to place.
Headache in morning on awaking.
Heart - Palpitations worse from thinking of her disease. Palpitationsfrom lying down on right side.
Palpitation from mental excitement. Pain from heart to lower part of right leg. Dilatation of heart. Strong
pulsation through whole body.
Kidneys - Frequent and painful urging with painful passing of small quantities of urine. Must urinate every hour
or two, night and day. Diabetes mellitus. Urine passed with difficulty. Oily iridescent film on urine. Urine falls
down perpendicularly (Hep.). Urine scanty, clear flow, containing lumps of blood. Urine sediment slimy,
tough or membraneous. Scanty, reddish urine in colic.
Limbs - Bruised pain in joints of arms, hands and feet. Weakness of all muscles, especially arms and legs.
Constricted feeling around limbs. Cold hands and feet during pain in stomach. Chilblains.
Lungs - Asthma. Croup and bronchitis. Catarrh of chest. Hemoptysis. Great weakness of chest. Difficult to
expel mucus. Copious ropy, expectoration in morning in elderly persons. Ropy sputa. Atonic hemoptysis.
Male - Eczema on the back of penis and scrotum. Erections while at dinner. Frequent emissions. Gonorrhea,
gleet. Shooting pain from middle line of belly, as along a thread, down into penis. Cutting pain in left side of
penis.
Modalities - Worse from cold, except headache, which is relieved by cold. Worse during sleep. Worse lying
on right side. Worse bad news.
Mouth - Mouth dry, without thirst. Dryness of mouth, tongue and throat. Taste bitter, sourish, astringent.
Taste sweetish. Disgusting after-taste. Spreading ulcers in mouth. Noma. Profuse salivation, mercurial in origin
or not.
Nose - Nasal polyps, left side with rough skin all over the face and body. Lupus or cancer on nose. Dryness
of nostrils and choanae. Nosebleed.
Rectum - Constipation of the most aggravated kind, as in cancer of uterus and rectum. No desire to stool
for days. Violent ineffectual urging to stool. No ability to expel stool. Marble-like masses pass, but rectum
still feels full. Itching after stool. Itching in anus. Long lasting pain and smarting in rectum after stool, also
hemorrhoids. Yellow like an infant's, ft'emorrfiage from howe/s. Wematemesis
of hard drinkers. Passes large clots.
Sensations - Sensation of dryness. Sensation of constriction, as if a cord or band around limbs in paralytic
states. ;
Skin - Skin roughens and chaps after exposure to cold air. Skin dry. Eczema. Proud flesh, chilblains, indolent
ulcers. Ulcers with indurated base. Indolent ulcers. Scorbutic ulcers. Indurations resulting from chronic
inflammations. Glands inflame and harden. Furuncles on body, on thighs. Fungus granulations. Alopecia.
Epithelioma. Veins become varicose and bleed.
Sleep - Many complaints come on during sleep, like nightmares. Light sleep, hears every little noise. Can't get
to sleep on account of orgasm of blood. Sleeplessness from fever. Disturbed by nightmare, at 4 a.m.
Stomach - Burning heat, better by drinking cold water. Sinking sensation, better by eating. The pain is better
by pressing on stomach. Nausea with faintness and weakness. Attacks of nausea in morning before
 breakfast. Vomits large quantities of glairy mucus or tough, colorless slime. Vomiting of everything he eats.
Vomits blood. Habitual vomiting in alcoholics.
Teeth - Teeth loose. Teeth and gums scorbutic. Gums swollen, inflamed, spongy. Profuse bleeding after
extraction of tooth.
Temperature - Chill during nausea. Coldness followed by headache. Coldness of skin followed by heat and
tingling. Coldness during pain in stomach, followed by heat with rush of blood to head, can hardly hold it up.
Furious delirium. Fever with intense thirst, nausea, etc. Internal heat throughout body. Heat in forehead.
Warmth creeps over abdomen.
Throat - Tendency to throat colds. Burning and severe pains. Hoarseness worse from talking. Aphonia.
Enlarged and indurated tonsils from frequent colds. Every cold settles in throat. Mucus membrane red and
swollen. Throat relaxed. Throat sore and dry when swallowing fluids. Uvula inflamed and enlarged. Uvula
elongated, relaxed. Scraping in throat with cough.
Tickling in throat. Burning pain down the esophagus. Constriction, spasms of esophagus, liquids can scarcely
be swallowed.
Tongue - Dryness of tongue. Tongue dry, black. Tongue burning in evening. Tongue sour feeling, stitches
worse at tip. Tongue clean, except a slight coating of slime on back part. Scirrhus of tongue.
Vertigo - Vertigo with weakness in the pit of stomach, better opening eyes, turning on right side. Vertigo when
lying on his back.
COMMENTS - The Alumn. patient is very sensitive to cold, exposure to air roughens and chaps the skin. Slight
scratches bleed. Bleeding after tooth extraction. Catarrhal conditions prevail throughout.
Sensations of dryness and contraction. Contractive sensation in abdomen and pelvis and retraction of
abdomen as in lead colic. Paralytic states with the sensation as if bound with a tight band.
Tendency to indurations whenever inflammations occur. Scirrhus indurations, indurated glands. Pains are
insupportable. Attacks come and go suddenly, periodically.
Many complaints come on during sleep, like nightmares. Turning on right side improves the vertigo. Lying on
right side brings on palpitations. There is sensitiveness to all sorts of weather changes and especially to cold.
W. P. Wesselheft cured bronchitis characterized by scraping from upper sternum to throat with free
expectoration of thick, yellow mucus, paroxysmal cough, morning cough with gagging.
Aching in chest and in the lower part of the back in region of lower ribs. Profuse expectoration with a scraping
pain, for scraping coughs are usually dry. All-c. had helped the preliminary sneezing and coryza.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Cham. - cramps in abdomen. Nux-v., Ip. - nausea and vomiting. Sulph. Antidote
to: Lead poisoning, calomel and other mercurials, Aloe - vomiting blood. Compare: ( 1 ) Alumina, Alum, Aloe.
- rectum. (2) Caps. - long uvula. (3) Ferr. - relaxed abdominal walls, prolapsed uterus. (4) Kali-bi. - stringy
discharges. (5) Merc. - prolapsed uterus, vagina, rectum, tenesmus. (6) Merc-c., Mur-ac., Nit-ac„ Nux-v., Op.,
Plat. - lead poisoning. (7) Plb., Rat., Stann., Sulph., Sul- ac., Zinc - eyes.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer.

name: Aluminum Oxydata
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - alum. Aluminum oxydata. Aluminum oxide. Argilla. Pure clay. Oxide of Alum.
Trituration.//ivtorica/rfo.se.'Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL- Aluminum, poisoning. Alzheimer's Disease. Anus disorders. Boils. Brain, weakness. Bubo.
Catarrh. Chlorosis. Colds. Colic. Constipation. Cough. Cracks. Debility. Dehydration. Dementia.
Disappointment. Dryness. Dysentery. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Emaciated. Eyes disorders. Fatigue. Fissures.
Fistulas. Headaches. Hernia. Lead, poisoning. Leucorrhea. Locomotor ataxia. Memory, loss. Muscles,
weak. Nails, disorders. Otorrhea. Ozaena. Paraesthesia. Paralysis. Pregnancy, disorders. Prostatorrhea.
Ptosis. Scrofula. Senility. Strabismus. Taste, disordered. Tetters. Throat, disorders. Trismus. Typhus.
HOMEOPATHIC - Alumina causes dryness of skin and mucus membranes, eyes, throat, rectum etc.
Irritability and relaxation. It affects the cerebro spinal axis causing disturbances in coordination and tendency
 to paretic muscular states.
Alumina paralyzes the bowels in the same way as lead poisoning to which it is an antidote. Constipation with
dry stool. Obstinate constipation. Lack of urge. Must strain in order to pass a stool. Small and soft stools are
passed with great difficulty. Straining to pass even a soft stool, can only evacuate bowels when standing.
Strains as if abdomen and rectum were paralyzed. Painful evacuations with spasms of the colon. Must strain
at stool in order to urinate. Urine is slow in passing.
Painter's colic. Pregnant women and children with constipation. Constipation from artificial baby foods.
Elderly people with constipation, lack of vital heat or prematurely old with debility. Sluggish functions,
heaviness, numbness and staggering. Functions become sluggish, actions are delayed, sensory impressions
reach the consciousness slowly.
Alumina produces irritation of mucus membranes with dryness or extreme secretion and paralysis of
involuntary muscles, like its relative Alumen. It affects the rectum, the nervous and muscular systems
generally.
Degeneration of spinal cord. Paraesthesia. Paralysis of the internal rectus muscle of the eye, causing squint.
Also ptosis. Drawing, pains appear in the limbs, a sensation of constriction in several organs. Locomotor ataxia.
Boenninghausen cured a case of ataxia with Alum.
Craves dry rice and dry food. Worse from starch, especially potatoes, salt, wine, vinegar, and spirits. Patient
is thin, inactive, wants to lie down, but it increases the fatigue. Exhaustion after talking, after menses. Dis-
position to colds in the head and belchings in spare, dry. thin subjects. Tendency to induration. Vertigo on
closing eyes.
MIND - Senility and dementia. Absentminded. Memory weak or loss. Forgets things, loses their way.
Alzheimer’s disease. The consciousness of reality andjudgment is disturbed. Timid. Makes mistakes in speak-
ing and writing. Inability to think coherently. Slowness in answering questions and vague replies. Cloudiness
and drunken feeling alternating with pain in kidneys.
Alternating moods. Always groaning, moaning, worrying, fretting. Sneers at everything. Contrary. Grumbles.
Obstinate. Peevish. Hasty, hurried. A feeling of hurry follows, things do not move fast enough. Hasty, but slow
of execution, hence makes mistakes in speaking and writing. Contemptuous laughing. Laughs and talks
between paroxysms of spasms.
Depressive mental states. Low-spirited. Everything is viewed in sad light. Ill effects of disappointments.
Ailments from anger. Sad, apprehensive, wants to get away. Mental symptoms mostly come on in the morning
on waking. Depressed on awakening. Involuntary weeping.
Great stupor with fear of falling forward. Fears loss of reason (Med., Calc.). Anxiety of conscience, as if
guilty of a crime. Impulses. Fears his own impulses. Desire to kill at the sight of a knife or a gun. Suicidal
tendency or impulses when seeing a knife or blood.
Confusion as to personal identity. When he sees or states something, he has the feeling, as though
another person had said or seen it, or as though he was placed in another person and could see only them.
Things seem unreal. Time passes slowly. Illusions of being larger, numb, smooth, heavy. Sensation as if he
would fall forwards, which he greatly fears.
Abdomen - Abdomen as if hanging down heavily, when walking, worse afternoon. Left-sided abdominal
complaints. Colic whenever the body is exposed to a chill. Cutting pain better warmth. Lead colic. Colic in
morning. Painter's colic (Plb.). Protrusion and incarceration of inguinal hernia. Pressing in both groins toward
sexual organs. Sticking pain from below upward. Sharp pains in region of inguinal ring. Shooting pain in region
of spleen. Big-belliedchildren. Flatulence. Reaching too high strains abdominal muscles.
Back - Backache as if bruised. Pain along spinal cord with paralytic weakness. Gnawing pain. Sensation as
if hot irons were thrust through lower spine. Violent sharp pain in middle of back. Back feels bandaged by
a cord.
Back - Shooting in right side of neck. Throbbing in lumbar region during stool. Sudden sharp pain, like a stab
in lower part of back, with feeling as if she could not straighten spine. Swelling of glands of left side of neck.
Itching in nape and of throat. Cervical muscles drew head back during sleep.
Breasts - Nipples itch, burn, look irritated and inflamed during pregnancy.
Causations - Anger, disappointments. Bodily exertion, lifting.
Chest - Congestion of blood to chest and head, with redness of face. Chest feels constricted, worse sitting
bent or stooping.
. Violent oppressive pain, worse at night. Chilliness in chest. Soreness of chest on talking, on lifting. Chest as
if too large.
Constitutions - Psoric persons. Infants, constipation, especially when artificial food is used. Big-bellied
children. Suited to persons of sedentary habits who suffer from chronic ailments to constitutions with
 diminished animal heat. Spare habit, dry, thin subjects. Elderly people, hypochondriacal or suffering from
chronic diseases, especially catarrhs. Puberty, chlorosis with longing for indigestible substances. Elderly
people with lack of vital heat or premature old age with debility.
Coughs - Coughs soon after waking in morning. Coughs on talking or singing, in morning. Constant, dry,
hacking cough, interrupts breathing. Cough on talking or singing. Morning cough. Coughs with sneezing.
Coughs from elongated uvula. Dry hacking cough from tickling in throat or irritability in larynx, worse morning,
worse using voice. Coughs at times with dyspnea, vomiting or even involuntary escape of urine. Continued
dry, hacking cough with vomiting and arrest of breathing. Dry cough at night, with dryness of throat.
Coughs with much expectoration. Cough causes pain in right temple and vertex.
Ears - Sharp pain in ears, evening or night. Eustachian tube feels plugged (Kali-m.). Heat and redness of one
ear. Purulent discharge. Humming, roaring. Crackling noises and buzzing in ears when, chewing
Aluminum oxydata or swallowing. Sound as of large bells. Sensation as if something lay before ear. Buzzing
as if outside ear.
Eyes - Burning pain on waking with photophobia. Chronic conjunctivitis. Eyes are inflamed, burning,
agglutination at night, lachrymation during day. Hot or acrid tears. Eyes feel cold. Granular lids or chronic
blepharitis. Itching in canthi and lids. Photophobia in morning. Ptosis. Strabismus. Eyelids are weak, falling.
Upper lids difficult to raise as if powerless. Eyelids thickened, dry, burning, smarting. Double squint, worse
teething. Inclination to stare. Eyes better from being bathed. Eyelashes fall out.
Face - Gloomy, pale, or red alternating with pale. Old look, dusky, wrinkled. Coppery cheeks. Feels as if
albuminous substance had dried on it. Sensation as if white of egg or a cobweb on face. Rush of blood to face
after eating. Tearing and lancinating in malar bone. Twitching of lower jaw. Involuntary spasmodic twitchings
of the lower jaw. Maxillary joints feel tight, while chewing or opening mouth. Lips dry, chapped. Blood-boils
and pimples. Nodules or boils on face and nose. Rubs face all the time.
Female - Menses preceded by headache, colic. Menses too early, short. Menses scanty, pale, followed by
great exhaustion (Carb-an., Cocc.). Girls, dried up and wrinkled, at puberty. It takes a woman all her time to
recuperate from one menstrual period to the next. Leucorrhea acrid, profuse, transparent, ropy. Acrid,
corrosive leucorrhea, with burning in genitals. Leucorrhea with burning, runs to feet. Leucorrhea, worse during
daytime and after menses. Leucorrhea relieved by washing with cold water. Intolerable bearing down pain.
Severe painful swelling in ovaries, very sensitive to touch. Painful throbbing in left side of vagina. Tickling and
itching in genitals with strong sexual desire. Sexual desire decreased.
Food - Irregular appetite. No desire to eat. No appetite, food has no taste. Thirst all day. Meat has no taste.
Aversion to meat (Graph., Arn., Puls.). Aversion to beer.
Aversion to potatoes. Abnormal cravings for coarse food, indigestible things. Desire for starchy foods.
Cravings for chalk, charcoal, dry food, clean white rags, tea or coffee grounds. Desires fruits, vegetables, dry
rice. Desires cloves, acids. Desire for coffee. Worse from potatoes. Potatoes causes bitter eructations.
Onions causes soreness of throat. Hypoglycemia. Worse when hungry causes trembling and weakness.
Worse tobacco smoke.
Head - Headache better by lying quiet in bed. Chronic catarrh of head. Sharp, burning pain in head with
vertigo, worse in morning, but relieved by food. Throbbing headache with constipation. Pressure in forehead
as from a tight hat. Vertex painful to touch. Inability to walk except with eyes open. Violent sharp pains in the
brain with nausea. Increased pulsation of temporal arteries. Headache, as if one were dragged by the hair.
Falling of hair. Scalp itches and is numb. Itching of scalp with dry, white scales. Dry hair.
Heart - Palpitations and shocks at heart. Wakes at 4 a.m. to 5 a.m. with anxiety at heart, better after rising.
Palpitations irregular, large and small beats alternate.
Kidneys - Muscles of bladder paretic, must strain at stool in order to urinate. Pain in kidneys with mental
confusion, worse dancing. Frequent desire to urinate in old people with slow flow. Difficult starting. Fears he
will wet the bed. Retention with dribbling. Smarting while urinating. Feeling of weakness in bladder and genitals.
Limbs - Pain in arms and fingers, as if hot iron penetrated. Arms feel heavy, as if paralyzed, short, go to sleep.
Legs feel asleep, Especially when sitting with legs crossed. Locomotor ataxia. Staggers on walking. Legs
feel numb, especially when sitting cross-legged. Heels feel numb when stepping. Soles tender, on stepping,
feel soft and swollen. Pain in shoulder and upper arm. Gnawing beneath fingernails. Brittle nails. Gnawing
under nails. Spinal degeneration and paralysis of lower limbs. Festination. Inability to walk except when eyes
are open or in daytime. Totters if eyes were closed. Soles are painful on
Aluminum oxydata stepping on them, as if they were too soft and on walking. Cramps when crossing legs.
Bones feel squeezed.
Liver - Soreness over liver, on stooping. Tearing pain from liver to hip. Painful sensibility of the liver on
stooping, followed sometimes by shooting pains.
 Lungs - Arrested breathing by copious, thick, tenacious, saltish mucus. Rattling, asthmatic breathing, worse
coughing. Wheezing, with tough mucus in larynx. Sneezing interrupts breathing, worse after waking in the
morning. Dyspnea, with spasmodic pains in stomach and hypochondria. Dyspnea when lying on back, better
when turning on side. Getting tired from exerting voice aggravates. Hoarse, aphonia, tickling in larynx,
wheezing, rattling respiration. Sudden loss of voice on taking cold.
Male - Prostatic discharge. Voluptuous itching or tickling in genitals. Pains in the perineum during sex and
while erection continues. Left testicle hard and very painful. Light yellow pus from urethra, causes itching of
glans penis. Priapism at night. Sensation of weakness in penis. Increased sexual desire, followed by loss of
power. Involuntary emissions when straining at stool.
Modalities - Better evenings. Better open air. Better moderate exertion and temperature. Better damp weather.
Better cold. Better washing. Better as day advances. Worse periodically. Worse on alternate days. Worse dry
weather. Worse full and new moon. Worse in afternoon. Worse from warmth of room orbed. Worse from
artificial food. Worse potatoes, starch, salt. Worse tobacco smoke. Worse from speaking. Worse when waking.
Worse sitting. Worse after menses, sex. Worse lifting, exertion.
Mouth - Dry and sore. Musty bad odor from mouth. Gums sore, bleeding. Tensive pain in articulation of jaw
when opening mouth or chewing. Mouth feels dry with increased saliva. Tingling, itching on tongue.
Nose - Disposition to head colds. Nasal catarrh with scanty secretion and obstructed nostrils. Discharge of
thick yellow mucus. Pain at root of nose. Sense of smell diminished. Fluent coryza with frequent sneezing.
Redness of nose. Point of nose cracked, red. Nostrils sore, worse touch. Nosebleed with pressure in
forehead and congestion to eyes. Scabs with thick yellow mucus. Tettery redness. Ozaena atrophica
sicca. Membranes distended and boggy. Septum of nose swollen, red, and painful to touch.
Perspiration - Inability to perspire. Sweats at night, toward morning most profuse in face. Sweats frequently
only on right side of face.
Rectum - Inactive rectum and bladder. Severe, obstinate constipation. Constipation of infants (Coll., Psor.,
Paraf.) and elderly people. Constipation in women of very sedentary habit. Rectum sore, dry inflamed,
bleeding. Itching and burning at anus. Pulsating pain in anus. Even a soft stool is passed with difficulty.
Great straining. Pains from rectum to ankle. Can only pass stool when standing. Evacuation preceded by
painful urging long before stool and then straining at stool. Pressure and sense of excoriation in rectum
after a small, hard stool. Hemorrhoids worse evening, better after night's rest. Diarrhea on urinating. Diarrhea,
worse on alternate days. Corroding diarrhea during menses. Stools of small balls, hard knots. Stools with bright
clots of blood. Hard, dry, knotty stools with no desire. Stool like sheep dung. Stools covered with mucus.
Sensations - Sensation of constriction. Pulsations are felt in various parts and pains go upwards.
Skin - Dry, tettery, itching eruptions, worse winter. Eczema. Dry, rough, cracked skin. Chapped and dry
tettery. Itching, burning, over seat of pain. Intolerable itching when getting warm in bed. Must scratch, until
it bleeds. Intolerable itching with constipation. Brittle nails. Brittle skin on fingers. Veins distended. Itching and
formication with flatulence, dry stools or diarrhea. Ulcerated surface secretes
yellow-brown, badly smelling pus. Slightest injuries of the skin smart and become inflamed. Skin symptoms,
worse winter, full and new moon.
Sleep - Sleepy in morning. Frequent waking. Sleeplessness forepart of night. Restless sleep, turns frequently,
feels too warm, lies uncovered in unrefreshing slumber. Anxious, restless with confused dreams. Dreams
about thieves, ghosts. Dreams of boats foundering. Nightmares. Many dreams before menses, on awaking
face hot, headache and palpitation.
Stomach - Belchings, sour and acrid. Heartburn, stomach feels constricted. Chronic eructations for years,
worse evening. Heartburn with profuse salivation. Distension of stomach. Potatoes disagree. No desire to
eat. Can swallow but small morsels at a time. Feels food, whole length of esophagus. Constriction of
esophagus. Pain lasting 3 hours after meals. Nausea, with faintness. Frequent nausea and inclination to vomit.
Pain, as from excoriation, in the pit of the stomach. Vomiting with hacking cough. Vomiting of food, mucus or
bile.
Teeth - The teeth covered with sordes. Teeth feel long, pain extends to other parts down larynx, neck,
shoulders.
Temperature - Chill with great thirst. Chilliness, better open air. Shivering, even when near a fire. Chill at night,
in bed, not able to warm oneself. Chill all over during stool. During the day chill, fever during the night. Heat
with itching. Fever towards the evening with chilliness. Fever at night with anxiety and sweat.
Throat - Irritable and relaxed throat. Looks parched and glazed. Clergyman's sore throat in thin subjects. Dry
and sore throat. Food cannot pass, esophagus contracted. Feels as if splinter or plug were in throat. Thick,
tenacious mucus drops from posterior sinuses. Great dryness which induces frequent clearing of throat
in evening. Dry, feels full of sticks or constricted, food cannot pass. Constant inclination to clear the throat.
 Tightness from pharynx down to stomach as if food could not pass, can swallow but small morsels. Swallowing
painful, worse solids. Better from empty swallowing, warm drinks. Elongated uvula from condiments creating
irritating things, talking or singing. Throat sore from eating onions. Uvula hangs down.
Vertigo - Vertigo in elderly people with atheromata or earthy deposits on the cerebral or cardiac arteries.
Vertigo with nausea, better after breakfast. Worse talking, on closing or opening eyes, before breakfast. Vertigo
with white stars before the eyes. Eyes suddenly went out of focus, one has to wait for normal vision, better
wiping eyes.
Vision - Objects look yellow. White stars before eyes, with vertigo. Dim vision obliged to wipe eyes constantly,
with sensation as if lids would adhere in corners. Fiery spots. Farsighted. Dim vision as if through mist or as if
feathers before eyes. Glittering vision after blowing nose.
COMMENTS - Alum, and Plb. (Lead) antidote each other in homeopathy. They're very similar in their
pathologies, but Plb. is more severe and painful. The action of Alum, is slow in developing and the remedy
must not be changed quickly. Teste grouped Alum, with Sep. and Cop. He considered it the chronic of Sep.
as Sil. is of Puls.
A remedy for the elderly and feeble, especially in senile dementia. Pathological memory loss, confusion over
their own identity, slowness of mind. A lot of fears, confusion. Great general fatigue, even after a short walk,
but chiefly after speaking. Frequent stretching while sitting. The buttocks go to sleep while sitting. Drags the
legs, especially the left one.
Sensations are slow in being transmitted to the centers. Keynote delayed nervous reaction. Spinal diseases,
local motor ataxias. Slow onset of nerve degeneration, paralysis of the lower limbs with emaciation, wrinkled
face and dry skin. Incoordination of the limbs, loss of control of limbs. Tottering gait.
Several painful symptoms appear after the midday meal and continue until evening, when they disappear or
are replaced by others which begin only then.
On the other hand, the pains which appear in the morning or in the evening are abated after eating.
Trembling, convulsive movements of the limbs and head, spasms with tears and laughter alternately. There is
exaltation of the whole nervous system. Trembling of the whole body with a desire to lie down.
Catarrh with dryness of mucus membranes, The throat looks parched and glazed. The nose is stopped, feels
dry and the point of it is cracked. Alum, has the fish-bone sensation in the throat on swallowing. There is
profuse leucorrhea running down to the heels, sometimes excoriating.
Itching eruptions, worse from warmth of bed. Eruptions of all indurations, ulcers. Granular eyelids. Hairs fall
out all over body. The skin of the face feels as if covered with dried white of egg or as if a cobweb was on it.
Fissures.
Severe dryness of the skin and face where the face is wrinkled, symptoms in children where the children's skin
wrinkles, ages and dries out. Alum, in physical doses is a drying agent. The first symptom is that the hair dries
and flakes, the skin dries. It affects the fluid balances in the body.
Burning pains in the back are common, especially a sensation as if a hot iron were forced through the lower
vertebrae. There are pulsations in various parts. The pains go upward. Upper left, lower right affected (opposite
of Lyc.). The symptoms are worse on alternate days, periodically. Keynote as if a hot poker is stuck in the
spine.
Another keynote is potatoes and starch disagree, especially affects constipation. Constipation of nursing
children from being fed artificial food and bottle-fed babies. Aggravated by hot, dry weather, and the moon
phases. Worse heat of the bed, worse after menses. Dryness without eruptions. Desires indigestibles like
chalk, sand, dirt (Calc., Tarant.).
RELATIONS-Antidote to: Lead.Antidotedby: Bry., Nat-m., Cham., Ip., Camph. Compare: (1) Bry. Plb. (2)
Aluminum chloridum. Pains of loco-motor ataxia. Lower trits in water. (3) Slag Silico, Sulphocalcite of Alumina
3x - anal itching, hemorrhoids, constipation, flatulent distention. (4) Sec., Lath., Aluminum acetate solution. (5)
Alumen, Arg-n. (clergyman's sore throat, paralysis), (6) Bar-c. - hypochondriasis of elderly, constipation, Bry.,
Calc., (7) Con. (old people, squint), (8) Ferr. - chlorosis, relaxed abdomen, disgust for meat, etc. (9) Ferr-i. -
profuse transparent leucorrhea. (10) Graph. - chlorosis, skin rough, chapped, itching, nails, blepharitis, etc.
(11) Lach. - sad on waking, menopause.( 12) Ruta - loss of power of internal recti. (13) Sepia - irritable, tearful,
ozaena, scanty menses, puberty, prolapsus uteri, inactive rectum, weakness in urinary organs, etc. (14) Sil.,
Sulph., Zinc. - inner canthus, granular lids, worse from wine. Complementary: Bry. Plb. Follows well: Bry.,
Lach., Sulph.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

CLINICAL- Aluminum, poisoning. Alzheimer's Disease. Anus disorders. Boils. Brain, weakness. Bubo.
Catarrh. Chlorosis. Colds. Colic. Constipation. Cough. Cracks. Debility. Dehydration. Dementia.

name: Aluminum Phosphorica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - alum-p. Aluminum phos- phorica. Aluminum phosphate. Solution. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Asthma. Boils. Bronchitis. Constipation. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Hair, loss. Headaches.
Hemorrhages. Hyperventilation. Ingrowing, toenails. Leucorrhea. Lung, disorders. Mental, prostration.
Migraines. Osteoporosis. Paralysis. Petechia. Rickets. Shocks. Somnambulism. Strokes. Tuberculosis.
Vertigo. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Burning pains. Feeling of numbness and cobwebs. Constriction. Discharges watery, scanty,
acrid. Dryness. Hemorrhages of bright red blood. Cerebral hemorrhage. Paralysis, ascending. Onesided
paralysis from hemiplegia. Shocks.
Weakness and nervousness. Diabetes. Strong desire for the open air which relieves. Sensitive to cold which
aggravates. Sensitive to thunderstorms. Bruised, burning, pressing pains, worse morning and night.
Electric shocks, worse after sleep. Boils on nates and thighs. Ingrowing toenails. Standing is extremely
tiresome. Extreme thirst, except during fever.
MIND - Mental prostration. Confusion of mind. Apathetic. Extreme weariness. Irritable. Suited to mental
breakdown after overwork or overstudy. Mental exertion aggravates. Chronic effects of grief. Nervous and
anxious. Worse from thinking of their symptoms.
Easily frightened. Fear of being alone. Fearofdark. Fear of thunderstorms. Fearof twilight. Fear of future,
disease. Fear of death of family and friends. Fear of knives, blood. Fearof insanity. Fearof own impulses. Fears
comes and goes suddenly.
Ailments from mental work. Anxiety and perspiration. Nervous, restless. Hurried. Discontented. Timid, yielding.
Complaining, moaning and groaning. Slow to act and answer. Apathetic and depressed. Mental confusion.
Lamenting over imaginary misfortune. Suicidal.
Alternating moods. Excitement alternates with dullness. Abundant ideas, clearness of mind, alternates with
deficiency of ideas. Indifference alternates with excitement. Ailments from sexual excesses. Weeping in
morning on waking (Alum.). Frequent crying.
Bladder - Ineffectual, fruitless, urging at night. Frequent urination at night.
Chest - Pain after herpes zoster. Palpitations of heart after menses.
Ears - Ears hot and red. Sensation of flapping in ears.
Face - Face sickly, bluish red. Sensation of white of egg dried on it.
Female - Excoriating leucorrhea. Menses too early, short. Menses profuse. Menses pale blood. Tiredness
after menses.
Food - Extreme thirst. Aversion to warm food. Aversion to meat, fish, oysters. Aversion to beer, salt. Aversion
to cold drinks, cold food. Aversion to milk, potatoes, tobacco. Desires dry food, rice, starch. Desires coffee,
spices. Desires fish, salt. Desires fruit, sour foods. Better warm drinks. Worse from potatoes, milk. Worse from
artificial food. Worse warm
food, warm drinks. Worse cold drinks, cold food. Worse from tobacco. Worse alcohol.
Head - Pain in sidesofhead. Migraines. Loss of hair. Headache after sleep. Headache, worse warm room. Pain
in occiput. Pain in sides. One sided headaches. Pressing pain, worse pressure. Pressing pain in occiput at
night (Sulph.). Pressing pain in temples at night.
Limbs - Bone problems. Growing pains. Rickets. Osteoporosis. Tingling fingertips. Weakness of thighs.
Weakness of knees.
Lungs - Lung disorders. Hyperventilation. Bronchitis. Asthma. Tuberculosis.
Modalities - Better from open air. Better pressure. Better lying on left side. Better damp weather. Worse from
cold. Worse motion. Worse from jar, walking, stepping. Worse from lying. Worse standing. Worse from sexual
excess. Worse from mental exertion. Worse from thinking of symptoms. Worse dry weather. Worse 9 a.m. and
9 p.m. Worse winter.
Mouth - Mouth dry. Breath offensive, even putrid.
Nose - Nasal discharge, green. Pain, worse pressure. Lost of smell.
Perspiration - Perspiration little or none.
Rectum - Diarrhea. Constipation, dry, hard stools, no urging or great urging. Stool has to be removed by
artificial means. Green stools. Hard, tough and greasy stools (Caust.). Knotty stool.
Skin - Itching eruptions worse warm room (Sep.). Dry, peeling skin. Rough skin with cracks. Itching, scratching
until it bleeds. Petechia. Loss of hair.
Sleep - Sleeping on right side, amel. Short sleep. Somnambulism. Worse on waking. Dreams of death. Dreams
of falling. Dreams of robbers.
Stomach - Vomiting worse drinking.
Vertigo - Vertigo in morning, on closing eyes. Vertigo, falling, worse closing eyes. Vertigo tendency to fall
 forwards.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Alum., Sil., Alum-sil.
REFERENCES - Boericke.

name: Aluminum Silicata
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - alum-sil. Aluminum silicata. Alumina silicate. Kaolin. Chinese clay. Porcelain clay. Bolus alba.
Andalusite rock. Alumina 63, Silica 37 parts. Kaolin is disintegrated Fei spar. Trituration. Historical dose:
Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Brain, disorders. Chest, soreness. Convulsions. Croup. Diphtheria. Lead poisoning. Nose,
soreness. Spinal disorders.
HOMEOPATHIC - According to J. Landes- mann, Alum-sil. is a remedy for croup and bronchitis. Aegidi was
the first to use Alum-sil. in cases of croup. In old-school practice it was used “as a completely inert powder"
in the same way as fuller's earth and also as a basis for making pills.
Alum-sil. is a deep acting remedy for chronic complaints of brain, spinal cord and nerves. Weakness, especially
spinal. Aching and burning in spine. Formication, numbness, pain in all limbs.
Constriction, of orifices. Aching and burning in spine. Formication, numbness and pain in all limbs.
Epileptiform convulsions. Coldness during pains. Venous distention.
Croup in the lower portion of the larynx or upper part of the trachea, which may be recognized by the much
more laboring and sawing respiration.
Chest - Excessive soreness along trachea and chest. Soreness, cannot stand percussion. Catarrh of chest,
pain, raw feeling. Feeling of great weakness in chest. Stitching pains.
Head - Congestion of brain. Constriction of scalp. Pain in head, better heat, perspires. Pain in forehead. Pain
in eyes, flickering. Frequent coryza. Swelling and ulceration of nose.
Limbs - Heaviness, jerking, numbness, aching and pains.
Lungs - Spasmodic cough with purulent viscid expectoration. Gray sputa. Capillary bronchitis. Larynx and
chest sore. Membranous croup, extends down trachea. Husky voice, metallic, rasping breathing and
suffocative cough.
Lungs - Croup dipping down into trachea, heavy, labored, sawing respiration.
Modalities - Better warmth. Better fasting. Better resting in bed. Worse cold air. Worse after eating. Worse
standing. Worse towards evening. Worse in the night.
Nose - Itching and burning. Yellow discharge. Sore, scabby, stopped up. Nostrils feel sore, scabs form in
nose, scanty and blood-streaked secretion.
Skin - Dryness of skin. Formication along course of nerves, veins feel full and distended. Sore to touch and
pressure.
Throat - Membranous covering of left side of throat of right side.
COMMENTS - Landesmann confirmed its efficacy and related a case as an example. After Aeon., Hep.,
Spong., Bor.. Phos. and lod. had failed to relieve, Alum-sil. 6c, four or five globules every half-hour, rapidly
removed the laboring, sawing respiration and the child was out of danger.
According to Farrington, a leading indication is internal soreness along trachea and the upper part of the chest,
the child will not be touched. The use appears to be from the clinical side entirely. Alum-sil. 30c relieved
symptoms of lead poisoning in a case of Clarke's.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Alum., Sil., Kali-bi., Spong., lod.. Hep., Aeon. (2) Fuller's Earth.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Amber
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - succ. Amber. Fossil resin. Succinum purum. Amber oil. (A mineralized fossil resin not to be
confused with Ambergris, Ambra). Trituration. Solution of the non-recti- fied oil prepared by dry distillation of
Amber. Solution of Succinic acid. Historical dose: All potencies. Drop doses of the oil.
CLINICAL - Asthma. Fears. Globus. Hayfever. Hiccough. Hysteria. Leucocythemia splenica. Spleen disorders.
HOMEOPATHIC - The fossil resin known as Amber has been used in folk medicine by many cultures.
Dr. Morris Weiner tested Amber, which he prepared himself from Amber, by dry distillation. The fumes of the
crude acid, he said, are inflammable and produce asthma, cough, sneezing, weeping, dropping of watery
mucus from nostrils, pain in chest and headache.
On this indication he treated thirty persons suffering from hay fever, and cured them all, saving them the
necessity of making an annual exodus. He gave one or two grains of the 3x trituration of Amber diluted in
 twelve teaspoonfuls of water, a teaspoonful every two hours.
Burnett wrote in Diseases of Spleen, that the Amber non-rectified oil is used as an organ remedy in spleen
affections, especially when accompanied by nervous and hysterical phenomena. Burnett noted it for hysterical
convulsions in women.
The crude oil is a thick, brown liquid having a strong empyreumatic odor. It is a powerful local irritant and has
been used with success as such in lumbago, rheumatism and sciatica.
Amber produces many nervous and hysterical symptoms. Asthma. Fear of trains and closed places. Affections
of spleen. Symptoms of collapse, the patient aborted, but recovered.
Heaviness externally. Lassitude. Lie down, desire to. Pulse slow. Trembling externally. Twitching. Weakness,
daytime afternoon. Weakness after walking.
MIND- Absorbed mentally. Dullness of mind. Stupefaction. Concentration difficult. Forgetful. Feels constantly
as if he had forgotten, something. Memory, weakness. Mistakes in time, confounds the present with past.
Disoriented. Abstraction of mind.
Confusion of mind. Confusion as to sexual identity. Confusion, knows not where he is. Confusion of past and
present. Confusion, as if in a dream. Speech slow. Expressing oneself difficult.
Mood, alternating. Anger. Offended easily. Averse to being disturbed. Aversion to company, yet fear of being
alone. Irritability from conversation. Irritability from noise. Dictatorial. Contemptuous. Hatred of men. Wants to
fight. Censorious. Attempts to escape. Suspicious. Fastidious. Sadness after midnight, amel. Desires to attack
others.
Loathing, of life. Grief. Unfortunate, feels. Sadness from disappointed love. Lovesick. Sentimental.
Homesickness. Forsaken feeling. Helplessness. Estranged feelings. Sensation of being isolated. Despair of
life. Weary of life. Suicidal thoughts.
Pities herself. Weeping easily. Weeping from menopause. Weeping during menses, during regrets. Weeping
from sickness. Weeping when telling of her. Answers in monosyllable. Aversion to answering. Indisposed to
talk others.
Anxiety in daytime, morning. Panic attacks with feelings of electricity. Starting startled. Frightened easily. Fear
of conscience. Fear of color black. Fear of everything. Fear of dark. Fear of death. Fear from flying in airplane.
Fear in insanity. Fear of narrow places. Fear of trains and closed places. Fear of shadows.
Want of self-confidence. Excitement, excitable. Restlessness. Conviction of death. Desires death, Sensation
as if dying. Aversion to the color black. Charmed by orange purple. Contented with himself.
Impressionable. Senses acute. Sensitive to all mental impressions. Sensitive to external impressions.
Sensitive to music. Sensitive to noise. Sensitive to reprimands and criticism. Sensitive to reproaches. Sensitive
to rudeness.
Desire to frighten others. Gossiping. Haughty. Desire to hide. Reproaches himself. Hysteria. Impatience.
Indifference. Sensation as if she could easily injure herself. Intolerance. Introspection. Jesting. Desire for
sunlight.
Full of cares. Cautious. Remorse. Childish behavior. Coquettish. Aversion to men. Aversion to conversation.
Thinking of complaints aggravates. Aversion to certain persons. Aversion to being touched. Aversion to
washing.
Serious. Ardent. Religious affections. Thoughts intrude of the past. Tormented thoughts. Time, appears slower.
Clairvoyance. Affectionate. Amorous disposition. Veneration for the sun. Singing. Shuns the foolishness of
men.
Delusions, she is beautiful. Delusions, things look beautiful. Delusions, has lost affection of friends. Delusions,
impression of division, between himself and others. Delusions, put him into a fury, rage. Delusions sees black
objects. Delusions, everything seems unreal.
Delusions, surrounded by enemies. Delusions, as if just waking from adream. Wrong, everything seems.
Coma, unconsciousness. Delusions, she would fall if she did not hold onto something. Delusions, has
neglected his duty.
Abdomen - Flatulence. Gurgling. Rumbling. Cramping pain, must bend double. Cramping pain before menses.
Hypochondria. dragging, bearing down pain. Eruptions, itching. Trembling.
Back - Itching. Backache, motion amel., stretching amel. Backache, turning head agg. Aching pain in cervical
region. Lumbar region sore and bruised. Stiffness. Neck pain, sides. Neck stiffness. Back weakness after
walking.
Bladder - Frequent urination at night. Urine burning.
Chest - Pains in chest. Constriction in chest.
Pain in sternum during cough. Sore bruised pain in ribs, left side.
Cough - Dry cough. Hard cough. Tight cough. Cough, worse, from smoke, tobacco.
 Dreams - Nightmares. Frightful dreams. Dreams of monsters. Amorous dreams. Animal dreams. Awake while
dreaming. Dreams of old friends. Dreams of being late. Dreams of being pursued. Dreams of being lost.
Dreams of death and decay.
Ears - Sensation of fullness. Heat, flushes.
Itching. Pain, behind the ear, touch aggravates. Inside sore. Stopped up. Hearing. Acute.
Eyes - Unable to keep the eyes fixed steadily. Granular. Heaviness sensation. Itching from cats, with
lachrymation. Lachrymation, daytime. Lachrymation in cold air. Lachrymation when laughing. Opening the
eyelids difficult. Burning pain when looking at the fire. Pressing pain left eye. Stinging pain. Sharp pain, left
eye. Photophobia. Pupils, contracted. Desire to rub eyes. Styes. Swollen, lids. Twitching, around eyebrows
left. Weak eyes.
Face - Discoloration, red. Expression, old looking. Itching. Numbness. Pain, jaw left pulsating, jaw left. Tension,
jaw left. Twitching eyes, below. Twitching corners of mouth. Wrinkled skin.
Female - Menses copious. Menopause, during lying amel. Frequent late menses. Menses painful protracted.
Metrorrhagia during menopause. Aphthae, vagina. Heat, flushes during menopause. Sexual desire, increased.
Weakness during menses.
Food - Appetite, diminished easy satiety. Appetite, wanting with headache. Desires fruits. Desires sweets.
Head - Headaches. Congestion of head. Constriction, forehead vertex. Formication, vertex. Heat in occiput,
temples. Heaviness sensation of forehead. Numbness. Headache, better after eating. Headaches from fasting.
Headache above the eyes. Headaches from cold air. Pulsating in temples. Headaches, worse light. Headaches
better lying, pressure. Itching.
Limbs - Awkwardness, lower limbs. Coldness. Electrical current sensation. Formication of legs. Heaviness
sensation. Itching of shoulder hand, back of legs, feet. Jerking. Numbness. Pain, Wandering, shifting pains in
left shoulder, while walking. Aching pain. Cramping pain in shoulder. Sore bruised pains. Stiffness of joints,
shoulders, arms, hands. Tension in shoulders. Trembling of limbs. Twitching. Weakness, limbs.
Lungs - Asthma. Asthmatic from contact with cats. Congestion of lungs. Deep desire to breathe. Difficult
breathing in daytime, morning. Difficult breathing, lying amel. Difficult breathing, after walking. Chronic
bronchitis. Incipient tuberculosis. Whoop-
ing cough.
Male - Formication of genitalia. Masturbation, disposition. Aching pain in testes. Sexual desire, increased in
morning.
Modalities - Better open air. Desire for open air. Aversion to bathing. Worse air, draft. Worse food, alcohol.
Worse fats. Worse spices. Worsesweets.Worsecloudy weather. Mental symptoms, worse before or during
menses.
Mouth - Bleeding, gums when cleaning them. Dryness in mouth. Neuralgic pain in gums. Salivation. Taste,
acrid.
Nose - Coryza. Nasal congestion. Discharge, copious watery. Dryness. Itching, inside. Own body odor
agreeable. Nasal obstruction. Pressing, rawness pain. Sinusitis. Tingling, tip of nose. Sneezing, dropping of
watery mucus from nostrils.
Rectum - Diarrhea, daytime. Diarrhea after eating. Painless diarrhea. Brown stools, like chocolate. Light
colored stools. Mushy stools. Orange stools. Thin stools. Watery stools.
Skin - Formication. Itching. Sensitive.
Sleep - Disturbed. Sleepiness daytime lying, inclination to lying down. Sleeplessness, midnight, after. Waking
night, midnight after, 4 a.m. Anxiety, as from early frequent.
Stomach - Cramping pain, eating amel. Dull pain. Persistent hiccough. Belching. Fullness after eating, ever
so little hunger, during. Heartburn after sugar. Indigestion. Fasting, amel. Lying down, amel. Nausea on
waking. Nausea on eating. Nausea, daytime, morning. Nausea after eating. Nausea after amel. Violent
vomiting.
Teeth - Pain left side. Filled tooth, in a. Upper teeth, right molar. Left molar. Wisdom teeth. Neuralgic pain, left
side. Pulsating. Sore.
Temperature - Chilly. Lack of vital heat. Coldness of neck.
Throat - Choking sensation. Burning pain, rawness sore, left side. Globus.
Vertigo - Vertigo in morning on rising. Vertigo on closing, eyes. Vertigo, tendency to fall. Vertigo, as if
intoxicated. Vertigo, lying down, necessary. Vertigo, with nausea. Vertigo, on rising from seat.
Vertigo from stooping. Vertigo as if rocking. Vertigo with swaying. Vertigo turning in bed. Vertigo on washing
hair.
Vision - Dim vision, alternating with bright. Blurred vision. Bright vision. Flickering vision, around outside range
of vision. Foggy vision. Weak vision.
 COMMENTS - Amber enters into the composition of “Roche's Embrocation,” and “Haarlem Oil,” and has a
popular reputation as a remedy for whooping cough when rubbed into the spine night and morning. A
tablespoonful dose, said Murrell, caused persistent vomiting, diarrhea and symptoms of collapse and the
patient aborted.
These observations are of value in relation to Burnett's experience. He added half a scruple of Amber oil to six
ounces of Acornwater. They do not mix chemically, but by shaking each time a dose is taken the required
division and potency is attained.
Burnett's keynote is “painful spleen disorders where there are convulsive attacks ■ such as the hysterical and
hypochondriacal often have.”
Burnett related in his book a most remarkable case of “chronic enlargement of the spleen with hyperesthesia,
head pain, Dyspnea orthopnea, convulsions” in a young lady “towards the end of her teens.”
After years of treatment, Burnett concluded from Rademacher's account of Amber oil. that it might provide the
remedy. Amber oil was given in five-drop doses three times a day. In forty-eight hours the convulsive attacks
ceased for good and all the phenomena slowly leucocythemia.
A keynote of Burnett's is “Fear of trains and close places.” His dose is five drops of Amber oil three times a
day.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Succinic acid. - Hay fever. Paroxysmal sneezing, dropping of watery mucus from
nostrils, asthma. Inflammation through respiratory tract, causing asthma, chest pains, etc., itching of eyelids
and canthi and nose worse drafts. (2) Ars-i., Arundo, Wye., Sabad, Sinapis.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Ambra Grisea
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ambr. Ambra grísea. Ambergris. Morbid secretion of the whale. Trimration and tincture. Most
probably a morbid product found in the Sperm Whale or floating in the sea. Not to be confounded with Amber
Suc- cinum. Historical dose: Trimration, Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Anus, irritation. Asthma. Bashfulness. Brain, softening. Cardiac asthma. Convulsions. Coughs.
Deafness. Emaciation. Face, pimples. Forgetful. Hearing, impaired. Hypertension. Hysteria. Jaundice.
Melancholy. Menstrual, irregularity. Music, intolerance. Nervousness. Nosebleed. Nymphomania. Prurims
vulvae. Puerperal convulsions. Ranula. Reaction defective. Spleen, pain. Tympanites. Vertigo. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Ambr. produces faintness (Mosch.), nervousness, jerks and twitches. Reflex action is
increased. In old age, helpful for asthma and colds.
Ambr. affects the nerves, causing nervousness, twitches and jerks. A great remedy for the elderly people with
impairment of all functions. Weakness, coldness and numbness, usually of single parts, fingers, arms, etc.
Also for patients weakened by age or overwork, who are anemic and sleepless. Emaciation. Weakness of
upper parts of the body with trembling of lower part.
There is defective reaction in nervous patients. Sensation of icy coldness in abdomen. Extreme nervous
hypertension. Patients are worn out, yet over-impressionable. Music aggravates symptoms. External
numbness of whole body in the morning and weakness.
Symptoms suddenly change places. Onesided complaints call for it. Numbness and torpor of the whole body
especially in the morning. Coldness of the body with twitching. Tearing in muscles and joints often on one side.
Adapted to hysterical subjectsorthose suffering from spinal irritation with convulsive cough, belching, etc.
Coughs are worse when many people are present.
Slight or unusual things aggravates the breathing and the heart, start the menses etc.
MIND - The patient has an embarrassed feelings. Bashful state is very characteristic. Intensely shy, blushes
easily. Cannot do anything in presence of others. Embarrassed in company, cannot have others present
during urination and stool (Nat-m.).
The memory is impaired, slow comprehension. Forgetful. Awkward. Dread of people and desire to be alone.
Dwells upon unpleasant things. Melancholy, sits for days weeping. Dreamy. Time passes slowly. Thinking
difficult in the morning with old people. Cannot understand what one reads.
Music causes weeping and trembling. Sad. Despair, loathing of life. Fantastic illusions. Bashful, blushes
easily. Loss of love of life. Restless, excited, very loquacious. Hearing others talk or talking himself affects him.
Aversion to laughter. As if in a dream.
Flitting, flighty talker, modem society girls. Jumping from one subject to another, never waiting to have first
question answered. Fixed disagreeable fancies. Imagines diabolic faces, sights.
Abdomen - Flatulence. Incarcerated flatus.
Tension and inflation of the abdomen, principally after eating and drinking. Sensation of coldness in the
 abdomen. Sweat on abdomen and thighs. Pressive pain in the epigastrium. Heaviness in the belly. Cutting
pains with diarrhea. Pain in the spleen, as if something were tom off. Flatulent colic in the night.
Back - Pressive, drawing pain in the neck and back. Heaviness in the back, with pain in the belly, as if the
intestines were compressed. Shooting pain in the loins. Stiffness in the loins after sitting long.
Causations - Shock due to business failure or due to the deaths, one after another, in the family. Effects of
domestic shock, business worry. Loss of near relatives. Imaginations.
Chest - Oppression felt in the chest and between the scapulae. Sensation of rawness in the chest. Itching in
the chest and in the thyroid gland. Rheumatic pain, as from a bmise in the chest.
Constitutions - Suited to excitable, nervous children. Young, modem society girls. Nervous persons. Lean
persons. Elderly people with a nervous and bilious temperament. “Dried-up” nervous persons. “Thin,
scrawny women.” Hysterical subjects who are weakened by age and overwork to the elderly with impairment
of all functions.
Ears - Hardness of hearing with cold sensation in abdomen. Deaf in one, roaring and whistling in the other.
Eyes - Stitching in the eyelids as if a stye were being formed. Eyelids, heavy, cannot open them though awake.
Spots float before the eyes after sewing.
Face - Twitching of the facial muscles. Cramps in lips, lips hot. Left cheek red. Flushes of the face, jaundiced
color. Embarrassed look. Tetanus, lockjaw in newborn.
Female - The sexual desire is increased. Nymphomania. Itching of pudendum with soreness and swelling.
Menses too early and too profuse. Itching in labia. Profuse, bluish leucorrhea, worse at night. Discharge of
blood between periods, at every little incident, worse after hard stools, walking a little longer etc. Lying
down aggravates uterine symptoms.
Food - Thirstlessness. Want of appetite.
Head - Pressure on front part of head with mental depression. Tearing pain in upper half of brain. Brain,
feels loose, falls to side lain on. Softening of brain. Rush of blood to head, when listening to music. Hearing
impaired. Profuse bleeding from teeth. Hair falls out. Confusion in occiput, also sprained feeling in. Headache
worse blowing nose.
Heart - Palpitation with pressure in chest as if from a lump lodged there or as if the chest were
obstructed. Conscious of the pulse. Palpations in open air with pale face. Anxiety in heart.
Kidneys - Cannot pass urine in presence of others. Pain in bladder and rectum at the same time. Burning in
orifice of urethra and anus. Feeling in urethra as if a few two drops passed out. Burning
and itching in urethra while urinating. Urine turbid, even during emission, forming a brown sediment.
Urinates more than drinks. Urine sour during whooping cough. Burning, smarting, itching in vulva during
urination.
Limbs - Cramps in hands and fingers, worse grasping anything. Arms, numbness. Left leg becomes quite
blue during menses. Twitching of limbs with coldness of body during sleep. Cramps in legs and calves. Limbs
go to sleep easily. Finger nails brittle. Drops what one is carrying. Coldness of hand (left) with headache. Sore
and raw between thighs.
Liver - Aching in small spot in the region of the liver, better pressure. Liver pains, pressive.
Lungs - Asthma of elderly people and of children. Asthma with eructation of gas. Asthma when attempting
sex. Wheezing in the chest. Nervous spasmodic cough with hoarseness and eructation, on waking in
morning. Worse in presence of people. Hollow, spasmodic and barking cough, coming from deep in chest,
then eructation. Tickling in throat, larynx and trachea, chest oppressed, gets out of breath when coughing.
Choking when hawking up phlegm. Bluish, white expectoration. Cough worse music, talking, reading aloud,
lifting weight. Loss of breath from cough. Cough with emaciation.
Male - Voluptuous excitement of and itching in genitals. Voluptuous itching of scrotum. Parts externally numb,
burn internally. Violent erections without voluptuous sensations. Impotence.
Modalities - Better slow motion. Better in open air. Better lying on painful parts. Better cold drinks. Worse
music. Worse presence of others. Worse from any unusual thing. Worse embarrassment, agitation, worry.
Worse thinking of problems. Worse in morning. Worse from over lifting. Worse warmth, warm room, warm milk.
Mouth - Profuse bleeding from the gums, offensive breath. Insipid or rancid taste. Sour mouth, worse after
milk. Salivation with cough. Small growths under tongue. Ranula.
Nose - Nosebleed, while washing face in the morning, during menses. Stoppage mostly at night, must breathe
through the mouth, with chronic coryza.
Rectum - Flatulence, cannot have others present during urination and stool, worse during pregnancy.
Constipation during pregnancy and after delivery. Frequent ineffectual urging for stool. Large flow of blood with
stools.
Sensations - Sensation of coldness, numbness in spots or of single parts, fingers, arms etc. with twitching.
 Itching with trembling and flushing. General pulsation.
Skin - Itching and soreness, especially around genitals. Numbness of skin.
Sleep - Retires tired, wakeful as soon as touches the pillow. Cannot sleep from worry, must get up. Anxious
dreams. Coldness of body and twitching of limbs during sleep.
Stomach - Distention of stomach and abdomen after midnight. Sensation of coldness in abdomen. After
eating, cough and gasping, and a feeling as if food did not go down into the stomach. Belching with a violent,
convulsive cough. Acid belching like heartburn. Heartburn from drinking milk.
Temperature - Frequent flushes of heat at short intervals. Sweat on slightest exertion especially on abdomen
and thighs.
Throat - Sensation as if a plug in throat with difficulty swallowing. Sore, raw from exposure to air, worse motion
of tongue.
Vertigo - Senile vertigo with weakness in head and stomach. Senile dizziness.
COMMENTS - The pelvic organs are painfully influenced. There is voluptuous itching on the scrotum and some
rawness below the thighs in the male. In the female, there is a discharge of blood between the periods at every
little accident, as straining at stool or extra work. Severe itching on pudenda. During urination, itching, tickling,
burning of vulva and urethra.Nymphomania with discharge of bluish white mucus. After childbirth, obstinate
constipation and tenesmus with bashfulness, cannot make the attempt to stool if any one is present, even the
nurse.
There is a tickling, spasmodic cough. Cough excited by speaking. Night cough. Cough followed by copious
belching. Itching in chest. The limbs go to sleep easily. Fingernails are brittle. Sweat on slightest exertion.
Sleepless from worry, retires tired, wakeful as soon as touches pillows.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Camph., Coff., Nux-v., Puls., Staph. Antidote to: Staph. - especially the
voluptuous itching of scrotum, Nux-v. Follows well: Moschus frequently follows advantageously. Compare: (
1 ) Ol-suc. - hiccough. (2) Sumb., Cast., Asaf., Croc., Lil- t. (3) Moschus (faintness, hysteric asthma), (4)
Castor., Asaf., Psor. and Valer, (defective reaction), (5) Coca (bashfulness), (6) Kali- br.. Nux-v. (increased
reflexes), (7) Nux-v. (thin, nervous persons), (8) Ars. - Asthma, Phos. - asthma, nervous excitability, “irritable
weakness,’" slender build, (9) Bov. - flow of blood between the periods. (10) Lach, and Sep. - worse from over
lifting. (11) Coff., Chin., Ign., Sulph., Puls., Staph., (12) Sec. - scrawny women. Related remedies: Bar-c, Ign.
Do not confound with Amber succinum.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Ambrosia Artemisiefolia
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-ambro. Ambrosiaartemisiaefo- lia. Ragweed. Roman wormwood. Hog-weed. N. O. Composite.
America. Tincture of fresh flower heads and young shoots. Historical dose: Trituration. Tincture and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Allergies. Colds. Coryza. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Hay fever. Itching. Lachrymation. Nasal,
congestion. Nosebleed. Sinus, congestion. Whooping cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - Ambrosia is a remedy for lachrymation, hay fever and intolerable itching of the eyelids
(Euphr.). Nosebleeds. Stuffed feeling in nose and head. Some forms of whooping cough. The respiratory tract
in its entire length stopped up.
Hay fever with itching, watery eyes. Sneezing to the point of nosebleeds. Hay fever with a tickling cough,
can go into asthma. Allergic asthma. Severe allergies to ragweed. Reactions to allergy shots or drops for
ragweed allergy. Also as a preventative, given before ragweed season, if person has a strong history.
Good for children with nondescript stuffy noses and no symptoms or modalities (Aeon.). Manyforms of
diarrhea, especially during summer months, also dysentery. Loose stool (Ars.).
Eyes - Redness. Smart and burn. Hay fever with itching, watery eyes. Lachrymation. Intolerable itching of
eyelids.
Lungs - Respiratory tract is congested. Irritation of trachea and bronchial tubes with asthmatic attacks (Aral.,
Eucal.). Wheezy cough. Whooping cough.
Nose - Nasal, congestion. Allergies. Coryza. Watery coryza, sneezing, watery discharge. Hay fever. Sinus,
congestion. Nosebleed. Stuffed up feeling of nose and head.
Rectum - Loose stool (Ars.). Many forms of diarrhea. Summer diarrhea. Dysentery.
COMMENTS - The fresh leaves and flowers are pounded to a pulp and macerated with two parts by weight of
alcohol. In the 1889 Homeopathic Recorder, Dr. C. F. Millspaugh, wrote “Of late years much attention has
been called to the species of the genus Ambrosia (the Rag Weeds) as being, through the agency of their
pollen, the cause of hay fever.”
 Dr. E. T. Marsh and another experimenter suffered severely from symptoms of coryza and hay» fever while
working with the pollen of this plant. Ambrosia should therefore be of service in similar disorders.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) In hay fever: All-c., Euphr., Sabad. (2) Wye., Succ-ac.. Ars-i., Arund.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

name: Amethyst
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ameth. Amethyst. Gemstone. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL-Amblyopia. Ataxia. Backaches. Headaches. Insomnia. Migraines. Tinnitus. Trembling.
HOMEOPATHIC - Affects the nervous and endocrine systems, useful in states of nervous tension where the
five senses (especially hearing) are overtaxed. Helpful when the hormonal system is affected by excessive
adrenalin, creating mood swings and nervous excitation followed by exhaustion.
Profoundly affects sleep patterns, can soothe troubled sleep or induce somnolence in the insomniac. Has been
found effective in easing mental disorders where there is too much excitement of the senses.
Nervous tension with an inability to relax. For damaged nerves in the spinal column, especially where the
neural pathways are interrupted causing difficulties in relaying sensations or when nerve pains become all
consuming, causing the patient to be unable to function normally.
Internal trembling, especially felt in the legs. When exhaustion has set in and nerves no longer respond as
efficiently as they should. In low potency, follows well after Mag. Carb. For those who feel the need of
stimulants to revive them or to “steady their nerves,” bringing them to the point of addictiveness. Addiction
rooted in nervous tension and psychic fears. Fear of addiction.
Deeply syphilitic. Nervous diseases such as motor neuron disease, MS and ataxia. Likely to make an
improvement on the quality of life in patients suffering these conditions. Arthritic conditions.
MIND - Anxiety and tension. Fear of not being able to achieve all that one sets out to do. Lack of confidence
in ability to complete allotted tasks, especially true in those who feel called to a spiritual or caring profession.
Sense of thwarted mission where the difficulties seem to be self generated and self perpetuated. Sense of
having “done all this before and now I'm getting it wrong again!” Too tired to be able to finish tasks or fulfill role
properly due to excessive tension (Oak.).
Negative outlook. Becomes withdrawn and intense when anxious or displeased. Apprehensive of his own
position in a general state of difficulty where others are involved. Wonders what will become of him. Tries but
finds it difficult not to betray his inner sense of preoccupation and unease. Deeply affected by sad news.
Inexplicable fearfulness, held in the solar plexus. Fears of being overburdened, of becoming too anxious and
fixated on one thing to the exclusion of everything else, and of the past and what may come back to influence
the present. Deep sense of longing, particularly in connection with places which make one feel spiritually “at
home.” In cases where one would expect to find despair but instead there is deep pathology.
Difficulty relaxing. Tense and miserable from lack of sleep, nervous tics or tremors from night watching.
Indecisive, forgetful, cannot hold many ideas in the mind at the same time so becomes limited to routine
functioning. Feels cut off from the real world, floats off into a state of dreaminess. Reluctant to face reality,
especially after great tension.
Abdomen - Trembling in the abdomen.
Back - Backaches. Pains in cervical area which extend down the spine, worse emotional turmoil. Tension in
the lumbar region with sciatic type pains in either leg. Feels the top half of the spine (or body) is unconnected
with the bottom half. Persistent symptoms after manipulative treatment on the spine. Patient enjoys massage
and goes for a lot of it but it never holds for long.
Bladder - Tendency to frequent urination. Has to get up at night to pass water, especially worse 3 a.m. to 4
a.m. Cannot drink late at night without having to rise. Must hurry to pass water once the urging is there. Needs
to be advised to drink more water as this will ease the tension in the bladder and slow the frequency of urging.

name: Ammoniacum Gummi
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ammc. Ammoniacum gummi. Gum ammoniac. N. O. Umbelliferae. Gum- ammoniac is obtained
from Dorema Ammoniacum. Trituration of the gum. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Appendicitis. Asthenopia. Asthma. Bronchitis.Eyes, disorders. Dyspnea. Glands, disorders.
Heart, disorders. Hemorrhages. Hydrocele. Panaritium.
HOMEOPATHIC - The heartbeats too strong, worse lying on left side. Great accumulations of mucus. There
are many rheumatic pains in the limbs and loins. Marked sensitiveness to cold, worse in cold weather.
Stitches were prominent in the provings. Stitches in the cecum at 7 p.m., alternating with pains elsewhere.
 Appendicitis. Diminished secretions from the mucus membranes, then increased. A remedy for the elderly
and feeble, especially in chronic bronchitis.
Stars and fiery points before the sight. Sees smoke in circles. Dim sight from a blow on the head, from
excessive reading. Sensation of burning and scratching in neck and esophagus. Hydrocele.
Hemorrhages that causes abundant serous discharges. Dropsical complaints.
Gout not developing tn usual form of attacks, but disturbing general health. Scrofulous tumors or enlarged
joints.
MIND - Ill humor.
Constitutions - Suited to bronchial disorders in old people brought on by cold weather.
Eyes - Dim sight. Stars and fiery points float before eyes. Easily fatigued from reading.
Food - Want of appetite.
Head - Catarrhal headache due to closure of frontal sinuses.
Heart - Heartbeats stronger, extends to pit of stomach.
Lungs - Coarse rattling of chest in elderly people. Difficult breathing. Chronic bronchial catarrh. Large
accumulation of pus and feeble expectoration, worse from cold weather. Mucus tough and hard.
Throat - Throat dry, worse inhaling fresh air. Full feeling, burning and scraping sensation. Immediately after
eating, sensation as if something stuck in esophagus, causing swallowing.
RELATIONS-Antidotes: Bry., Am. Compare: (1) Senega., Ant-t., Bals-p.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Ammonium Aceticum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY- am-acet. Ammonium aceticum. Ammonia acetate. Spiritus Mindereri. Aqueous solution.
Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Diabetes. Fever. Sweat.
HOMEOPATHIC - This is a very old medicine in great use in old-school practice for “fever mixtures. ”
Ammonium aceticum has been experimented with by Wibmer, who experienced the following symptoms:
“Scraping in throat. Increased warmth in abdomen in the skin, especially of face. Heaviness in the head.”
“Bathed in sweat” is a leading indication. It causes profuse flow of urine, said to contain sugar.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Ammonium Benzoicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - am-be. Ammonium benzoicum. Ammonia benzoate. Solution in distilled water. Historical dose:
Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Dropsy. Gout. Indigestion. Ranula. Rheumatism.
HOMEOPATHIC - One of the remedies for albuminuria, especially in the gouty. The chief symptoms are that
the head feels heavy, dull and stupid. Scanty, smoky urine. Right kidney sensitive to pressure. Gout with fluid
in great toe joint or with deposits in the joints.
Back - Pain across sacrum with urgency to stool. Soreness in region of right kidney.
Face - Bloated, swollen eyelids. Swelling under tongue like granula.
Head - Heavy, stupid feeling.
Kidneys-Urineis smoky, scanty.Albuminuria. Albuminous urine and thick deposits. Urinary incontinence in
the aged.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ter., Benz-ac., Ammonia salts, Caust. (2) In albuminuria - Kalm., Helon, Merc-
c., Berb., Canth.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Ammonium Bromatum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - am-br. Ammonium bromatum. Ammonia bromide. Ammonium hydrobro- micum. Solution in
distilled water. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Ciliary neuralgia. Coryza. Cough. Epilepsy. Kidney, pains. Larynx, catarrh. Nails, biting. Obesity.
Ophthalmia, scrofulous. Ovaries, disorders. Pharyngitis. Pterygium. Whooping cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - This salt has been well proved by A. M. Cushing. Nervous constitutions. Markedly affects
the eyes and ovaries. In the morning, the eyes are red and sore with mucus in comers (worse left eye). Dull
pain in left ovary, with hard swelling. Obesity.
 Indicated in laryngeal and pharyngeal catarrh. Chronic laryngeal catarrh of speakers. Sudden strangling,
suffocating, cough. Suffocating sensation before epilepsy. Irritable feeling in fingernails, better by biting it.
Constrictive pain in head, chest, legs.
Eyes - Edges of lids red and swollen, also Meibomian glands. Eyeballs feel large. Pain around eyes into head.
Head - Cerebral congestion. Feeling of a band above ears. Sneezing, thick nasal discharge.
Lungs - Sudden, short cough, strangling. Tickling in trachea and bronchial tubes. Wakes at 3 a.m. with cough.
Feels suffocated, continuous cough, when lying down at night, sharp pain in lungs. Whooping cough. Dry,
spasmodic cough on lying down.
Modalities - Better from warmth and warm drinks. Worse in open air. Worse cold air. Many symptoms occur
on waking. Worse 3 a.m.
Throat - Smarting in mouth. Tickling in throat with inclination to dry, spasmodic cough, especially at night.
Burning in fauces. White, sticky mucus. Chronic speakers' catarrh.
COMMENTS - The mucus of Am-br. is apt to be stringy. A sudden desire to cough, so sudden it causes
strangling. Sudden, short cough when rising in morning from accumulation of mucus in throat. Cough at 3 a.m.
Indicated in epilepsy when the aura begins with a fainting or suffocating sensation at epigastrium, rising up
both sides of sternum to throat.
There is an irritable feeling under fingernails, better only by biting them. Must walk about for fear of suffocation.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Hyos., Con., Arg-n., Kali-bi.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
