name: Anacardium Orientale
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - anac. Anacardium orientale. Marking nut. Malacca bean. Semecarpus anacardium. N. O.
Anacardiacae. East Indies. Trituration of layer between shell and kernel of heart shaped nut. Historical dose:
All potencies.
CLINICAL - Abuse, effects. Alcoholism. Al- zheimer'sdisease. Amnesia. Anxiety. Bipolar. Brain, disorders.
Brain, weakness. Constipation. Coughs. Debility .Delusions. Dementia. Dermatitis. Dysmenorrhea.
Dyspepsia. Eczema. Elephantiasis. Fears. Hallucinations. Headache. Hearing, disorders. Heart disorders.
Hemorrhoids. Humiliation. Hypochondriasis. Hypoglycemia. Hysteria. Insanity. Lichen planus. Manic
depression. Memory, loss. Mental, disorders. Mental, weakness. Multiple,personalities. Neuralgia.
Neurasthenia. Nervous. Palpitations. Paralysis. Pemphigus. Phobias. Poison, ivy. Religious, mania.
Rheumatism./Wins, poisoning. Self-abuse. Senile, dementia. Schizophrenia. Skin, diseases. Smell,
illusions. Spinal, disorders. Stiff neck. Strokes. Tendonititis. Urticaria. Vesicular eruptions. Vomiting,
pregnancy. Whooping cough. Warts. Writer's cramp.
HERBAL - The nut is heart-shaped, hence its name Anacardium orientale, and perhaps this may be taken as
the “signature ”of its courage impartingproperties. Found in Asia, native of East Indies and found in
mountainous dry
Anacardium orientale forests. Juice in the external rind of nut is used. Excellent ink made from this nut.
 Indians after depriving the nut of its external rind and juice roast and eat it with much relish. The juice which is
in cells under the rind is of such acridity that it is used by natives to burn off warts, condylomata and other
excrescences and keep down excessive granulation in ulcers.
Ancient writers recommended it chiefly in mental diseases - loss of memory, nervous disorders. Abuse of this
drug is harmful leading to madness. Poisonous, acrid, vesicant, purgative and narcotic properties prevail in
varying degree throughout the order.
Anacardium has many features in common with its botanical relatives, the different species of Rhus, especially
in its action on the skin, muscles, and joints, but it has also very distinct features of its own.
HOMEOPATHIC - Anacardium acts on the mind, nerves, muscles and joints. Its skin symptoms are similar to
Rhus-t. and it has proved a valuable antidote to poison oak and ivy. Syphilitic patients often suffer with these
conditions.
It is used for neurasthenics, such have a type of nervous dyspepsia, relieved by food. Physical and mental
lack of power. Special senses are weakened. Sensation of a plug in various parts-eyes, rectum, bladder,
etc., also of a band. Empty feeling in stomach. Intermittent symptoms.
Gnawing hunger, desire to nibble, hypoglycemia. Great emptiness in the stomach with weakness and
irritability. Worse from fasting or missing a meal. Better after eating. Indigestion, pain is worse when
digestion is complete, lasts until the next meal, then better for some time (Nux-v.). Eating temporarily relieves
all discomfort. Dypepsia. Constipation.
Headache worse by mental exertion, better by eating. Stiffness of neck, worse beginning to move. The
senses are either too weak or too acute and there are sense illusions, a light has a halo, optical illusions in
dark colors, illusions of hearing, illusions of smell: burning tinder, pigeon's dung.
Trembling, on slight exertion, worse knees or arms. Emaciation. Paresis of muscles subject to volition. Paralytic
condition. Diseases of spinal cord. Heaviness and fullness of the whole body after piano playing. Cramp like
pains in muscles. Contraction of joints. Injured or strained tendons.
MIND - Anacardium has won for itself a reputation for the “fear of examinations” and allied conditions. Mental
disorders. There is physical and mental lack of power. Brain fatigue. Aversion to work, wants to lie or sit
continually. Nervous exhaustion from overstudy. Special senses are weakened, sight, hearing touch etc.
Cowardly. Lack of confidence in himself or others. Lack of self-esteem.
Absent-minded. Senile dementia. Bad memory. Impaired memory. Loss of memory from fright or
mortification. Forgetfulness makes her low-spirited. Suddenly forgets names of those around her. Forgets
what she has seen. Vanishing of thoughts, deficiency of ideas andloss of subject without knowing it.
Alzheimer's disease.
Phobias. Apprehends trouble from everything. Fear of impending misfortune. Anxiety about every trifle.
Hypochondriasis. Anxiety when walking, as if pursued. Fear of examinations in students. Fear of the future.
Fear of paralysis. Refuses to eat for fear of being poisoned. Fastidious, can't rest when things are not in proper
place.
Extremely irritable, passionate and contradictory. Angry and depressed. Very easily offended. Excessive
anger at slight offence, breaking out in violent behaviour. Irresistible desire to swear and curse. Tendency to
use foul, violent language. Malicious, seems bent on wickedness. Great propensity to curse, swear and
blaspheme in persons not usually known to curse. Hard hearted, cruel. Unsociable. Absence of all moral
restraint.
Profound depression and hypochondriasis, with tendency to use violent language. Manic depression.
Forsaken feeling. Estrangement from individuals and society. Shuns people. Victims of verbal, physical and
sexual abuse. Despairs of getting well. Feeling of helplessness. Ailments from humiliation,
punishments. Mental dullness and gloom after sexual indulgence. There is a tendency to suicide by shooting
(Ant-c.).
Schizophrenia (Lach.). Alcoholism. Suspicious andjealous (Hyos., Lach.). Religious mania. Senseless talk.
Internal conflicts. Contradictory impulses. Conflicted over sexual desire, intense desire or aversion to sex.
Sexual perversions. Clairaudient. Hears voices, of persons far away, spirits or dead people. Hears voices
behind her. Hears voices saying he is going to die.
Fixed ideas and delusions of various kinds. There is no reality in anything, all appears as in a dream.
Hallucinations. Delusion he is under superhuman control. Delusion that a demon and an angel sit on his
shoulders telling him offensive or good things. Delusion that he is double. Seems to have two wills, one
good, one bad. Feels as if he had two wills, one commanding him to do what the otherforbids. Delusion
that her husband is not her husband, her child is not hers. Delusion that the mind and body are separated.
Sees everybody's face in mirror except his own.
Abdomen - Abdomen full and distended.
 Colic. Pain as if dull plug were pressed into intestines. Rumbling, pinching and griping, especially with
flatulent colic. Pain as if a dull plug were pressed into intestine. Hardness of abdomen.
Back - Lumbago with painful stiffness. Dull pressure in the shoulders, as from a weight. Stiffness at nape of
neck, down back and pain worse motion. As of a heavy weight on sides of neck and back. Tearing pain
between scapulae.
Causations - Abuse, verbal, physical and sexual. Checked eruptions. Examinations. Fright. Humiliation.
Chest - Anxiety in region of sternum. Pressure in chest, as from a dull plug. Oppression of chest with internal
heat and anxiety, driving him into open air. Rawness and scraping in chest. As if contracted, while walking,
during headache. Itching on chest. Violent eczema on chest and throat. Redness of skin, with little vesicles
itching intolerably.
Constitutions - Anae, is suited to neurasthenic patients. Suited to manic-depressives. Ill-natured children.
Elderly senile people. Frequently indicated in depressed, nervous and paranoid people. Hypochondriacs.
Women during pregnancy, gastric and nervous disorders.
Cough - Cough excited by talking in children after fit of temper. Cough after eating with vomiting of food and
pain in occiput. Cough then yawns and sleeps. Paroxysms of coughing every three or four hours. Cough more
violent every other or every third day. Violent cough with loss of smell and taste.
Ears - Pressing in the ears as from a plug. Otorrhea. Itching in ears. Painful swelling of external ear. Catarrh
of eustachian tubes. Hard of hearing. Imagines whispers in the ears. Humming. Roaring.
Eyes - Eyes as if swollen, but without pain. Pressing pain like a plug on upper orbit. Lachrymation during
coryza. Lids so swollen he can hardly see. Great sensitiveness to light. Dim vision as if looking through mist.
Objects appear too far off. Optical illusions in dark colors. Threads and black spots before the eyes.
Shortsighted. Pupils first contracted, then dilated.
Face - Redness of face, in mania. Blue rings around eyes. Face pale with sunken eyes. Expressionless, wild,
childish. Eczema of face and neck. Violent burning pain. Tetters around mouth. Rough, scaly skin. White, scaly
herpes. Twitching of mouth in sleep.
Female - Frequent but scanty menses with spasmodic pain in abdomen. Pressing pain in uterus, with pain in
abdomen. Vaginitis. Leucorrhea with itching and excoriation of the parts. Leucorrhea with soreness and itching.
Much loss of blood after miscarriage. Melancholy after childbirth. Morning sickness. Nausea during pregnancy
better eating.
Food - Loss of appetite with fever and skin symptoms. Loss of appetite, alternating with violent hunger.
Refuses to eat for fear of being poisoned. Food tastes flat and offensive. Bitter taste in mouth after
smoking tobacco. Everything tastes like herring-brine. Thirst for milk with sweat all over. Thirst during fever.
Constant thirst, yet drinking takes breath away.
Head - Gastric and nervous headaches. Hot head, with icy-cold hands and feet. Headache worse by mental
exertion, better by eating. Headache from strong smells. Pressing pain, asfromaplug, in forehead, occiput,
temples or vertex. Pressing pain worse coughing, deep breathing after mental exertion. Headaches, better
after a meal. Headaches, better falling asleep. Vertex as if constricted. Violent pressure in right or left temple.
Throbbing in occiput. Tearing pain during hard labor. Baldness. Itching and little boils on scalp.
Heart - Restless feeling at heart. Double stitch at the heart, passing into lumbar region. Beating in
bloodvessels. Palpitations with coryza in the aged. Sharp pains in heart during inspiration, at night. Rheumatic
pericarditis with double stitches.
Kidneys - Constant desire to urinate. Frequent urging with but small discharge. Frequent urination at night.
Frequent discharge of clear watery urine, deposits, turbid, clay colored sediment.
Limbs - Tired feeling. Paralytic weakness. Knees feel paralyzed or bandaged. Pressure as from a plug in the
glutei. Pain in ankle, as if sprained worse stepping. Painful thumping on the middle upper arm (left). Cramps
in the calves worse walking or rising from a seat. Cramps from toe to instep from heel up calf. Dry hands.
Fingers swollen with vesicular eruption. Writer's cramp. Neuralgia in thumb. Warts on palms and hands.
Lungs - Asthma, hysterical, ends in flow of tears. Breath stops, on coughing or swallowing. Dyspnea in children
who have an uncontrollable temper. Attacks of suffocation. Sweetish, flat tasting mucus. Purulent, tenacious
mucus. Greyish-yellow mucus. Expectoration only during day.
Male - Sensation of burning in the penis during and after urination. Cutting pain along penis. Prostatic
discharge during the stool. Voluptuous itching of scrotum, exciting sexual desire. Seminal emissions without
dreams. Enjoyment absent during sex. Sexual excesses and perversions.
Modalities - Symptoms disappear during dinner, but begin anew after two hours. Better from eating. Better
lying on side. Better from rubbing. Better heat, hot bath. Better being in the sun. Worse from mental exertion.
Worse emotions, anger, fright, care. Worse from abuse and mortification. Worse on application of hot water.
Worse stepping hard. Worse motion. Worse drafts, open air. Worse cold. Worse hours after eating. Worse
 rubbing, scratching. Worse from talking. Worse morning. Worse evening to midnight. Worse from checked
eruptions. Worse strong smells.
Mouth - Bad breath and taste. Taste lost. Flat offensive taste. Painful vesicles, fetid odor. Tongue feels swollen
and stiff, impeding speech and motion with saliva in mouth. Tongue white, and rough like a grater. Ulcers in
mouth. Burning around lips as from pepper. Painful vesicles.
Nose - Chronic coryza, with loss of smell and discharge of purulent mucus. Frequent sneezing, followed by
coryza and lachrymation. Violent coryza with palpitation especially in the aged. Soreness in nostrils. Red
pustule in right nostril on septum. Sense of smell perverted. Smell lost or acute. Illusory smell of burning
tinder.
Perspiration - Sweats better while eating. Clammy sweat on palms especially left. Sweats in evening, on
head, abdomen and back, even when sitting quiet. Cold sweat with internal heat.
Rectum - Rectum seems powerless. Bowels inactive. Soft stool passes with difficulty. Ineffectual desire.
Rectum as if plugged up. Spasmodic constriction of anal sphincter. Itching of anus. Painful hemorrhoids.
Moisture from rectum. Hemorrhage during stool. Stools of very pale color. Stools mushy, bloody, brown,
liver-like. Painless stools.
Sensations - Sensation of a plug in various parts. Sensation as if a dull pressure, is repeated from time to
time. Sensations of a band or hoop.
Skin - Itching worse scratching. Intense itching. Eczema with mental irritability. Neurotic eczema. Skin
insensible. Dermatitis. Lichen planus. Ulcer on forearm. Urticaria. Promotes expulsion of splinters. Eruption
like that of poison-oak (Xero., Grind., Croto-t.). Weals, exuding a viscid, yellowish fluid. Vesicular eruption,
swelling. Yellow vesicles. Blisters discharging a yellowish transparent liquid. White herpetic spots. Smallpox
like eruptions. Warts on palms and hands.
Sleep - Spells of sleeplessness lasting for several nights. Sleeplessness from restlessness, itching. Vivid
dreams. Anxious dreams. Dreams of fire. Dreams of dead bodies, tombs.
Stomach - Gastric pain, better by eating, but worse again after 2 to 3 hours. Empty feeling in stomach.
Spasmodic pain. Hiccough. Weak digestion with fullness and distention. Eating relieves dyspepsia. Rumbling
and fermentation. Heartburn after eating soup. Swallows food and drinks hastily. Eructations, nausea,
vomiting. Nausea in morning with empty feeling in stomach. Morning sickness. Nausea with retching. Vomiting
of food during pregnancy, better eating. Better from vomiting.
Teeth - Toothache on taking something warm in mouth. Tearing pain in lower incisor, worse contact with
tongue and in open air. Teeth of lower jaw seem most affected. Bleeding of gums upon slight rubbing. Swelling
of gums.
Temperature - Easily chilled, better sunshine. Chills even in a warm room. Chilliness internal with external
heat. Chills over back, as if cold water were poured over it, with heat of face. Internal chills with hot breath.
Heat from 4 p.m. until evening, passing off after supper. Heat of upper body with cold feet. Internal shiverings
and hot breath. Heat of left side.
Throat - Apt to Choke when eating or drinking. Firm tough mucus in fauces.
Suppuration of tonsils. Sensation as if blunt plugs in throat. Sensation of scraping in throat. Sensation of
rawness, during cough. Pressure pain oraching near larynx. Voice hoarse and deep. Rattling in trachea when
lying on side.
Vertigo - Vertigo worse walking, stooping and rising from stooping. Vertigo objects seem too distant. Vertigo
as if turning in a circle. Vertigo with blackness before eyes. Vertigo as if surroundings or self were tottering.
COMMENTS - Characteristic pressing or penetrating pain as from a plug, which may occur in any locality in
connection with neuralgias, ear disorders and hemorrhoids.
Alzheimer’s disease (Staph., Hyos.), may be accompanied with personality changes. Brain fatigue. Marked
loss of memory. Deafness with loss of memory. Fear of exams and failure.
Cough better by eating. Whooping cough with a gasping and drowsiness after the cough. Morning sickness,
better by eating, but returns soon after. Symptoms generally better by eating, recur two hours after. Intermittent
symptoms.
“The attacks ceased for one or two days and then continued again for a couple of days.” Guided by this
indication alone, Custis cured a case of sleeplessness in a pregnant woman with Anacardium 200c. “Spells of
sleeplessness lasting for several nights.”
Disorders of the palms of the hands. There are warts even on the palms. Skin eruptions in general (Rhus-t.).
Bayes' indications are “brain fatigue before examination,” “nerve-exhaustion from over-study.” “nervous
prostration from seminal emissions,” or sexual excess. Conflicted over sexual desire, intense desire or
aversion to sex.
Paralyzed feeling in knees. Sensation as if knees were bandaged. Sensation of a hoop or band around the
 body or about any part is a leading symptom. Sensation of a blunt object anywhere.
It has been used with success in diseases of the spinal cord with this sensation and the feeling of a plug in the
spine, worse by any
motion which causes a pain as if the plug were sticking still further in. Kent noted it for tendonititis.
Paranoid schizophrenia, multiple personalities (Plat.), manic depression (Lach.), symptoms of Lyc. and Nux-
v. combined and intensified. Keynote separation of the will, “delusion” that there's an angel on the right
shoulder and a devil on the left shoulder.
The moral consciousness becomes polarized. Keynote that they can hear voices telling them to do evil. Moral
struggle to fight impulses to hurt people. Rubrics are “lack of moral feeling,” “godlessness,” not lack of religious
feeling, but a feeling that they can’t be punished. Impulses so strong they shake and tremble. Misanthropy.
Deep, suppressed anger and humiliation. History of hard-tempered and low confidence. Inner antagonism.
Delusions of sight and smell, fears of spirits, demons, paranoia, hallucinations. Hears voices, keynote.
Irresistible desire to curse and swear, can be used for Tourette's syndrome (close to Plat., but Plat, talks about
sex.).
Religious mania (Verat., Lach.). Feels that he is possessed. Become frightened of their anger, of their own
hardness and uncompassionate nature, moral conflicts, turn to religion to restrain themselves. Fear of losing
control. Dramatic alteration of moods, deep guilt and torment about their soul and salvation alternating with a
mania, maliciousness and impulsiveness.
Clarke cured with it a man who had a smell of burning wood in his nose, remaining after influenza.
RELATIONS - Antidotes: Grind., Coffea, Jug-c., Rhus-t, Eucalyptus. Compare: (1) Anae, occidentale, Rhus-
t., Cypr., Chel., Xero. (2) Cereus serpentina - swearing. (3) Com., Rhus-t., Rhus-v. (4) Ant-t„ Apis, Cori-r.,
Ferr., lod., Jug-c.,Lyc.,Nit-ac., Nux-v., Ph-ac.,Plat., Urt-u., Puls., Nat-m., Caust. (5) Thuj. - fixed
ideas.Relatedremedies: Ign.. Lyc, Plat, Rhus-t. Platina follows well. It is an antidote to Rhus-t. if there are
gastric symptoms, or symptoms going from right to left.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

CLINICAL - Abuse, effects. Alcoholism. Al- zheimer'sdisease. Amnesia. Anxiety. Bipolar. Brain, disorders.

name: Anagallis Arvensis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - anag. Anagallis arvensis. Scarlet pimpernel. Weather-glass. Red'chickweed. N. O. Primulacae.
Tincture of whole fresh plant. The fresh plant of the scarlet-flowered variety, gathered before the development
of the flowers is pounded to a pulp and subjected to pressure. The expressed juice is mingled with an equal
part by weight of alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Active mind. Amblyopia. Cataract. Constipation. Convulsions. Dropsy. Epilepsy. Gonorrhea. Gout,
hemorrhoids. Headache. Hypochondriasis. Hysteria. Itching. Mania. Neuralgia. Nosebleed. Rheumatism.
Ringworm. Skin, unhealthy. Snakebites. Syphilis. Tetters. Ulcers. Wounds.
HERBAL - The Greek name of the plant means to laugh out loud. It produces great exhilaration andoveractivity
of mind. Great hilarity. An ancient medicine for hydrophobia and dropsy. It is a vulnerary of some importance.
Like the Primula obconca, Anagallis has a marked action on the skin, characterized by great itching and tingling
everywhere. Possesses power of softening flesh and destroying warts. Ill-conditioned ulcers. It favors
expulsion of splinters. Anagallis has been used for snakebites and ulcers.
HOMEOPATHIC - Skin itches all over, becomes dry and rough. Tetters. Vesicles in groups. Ulcers and
swellings on joints. Bran-like, ring-shaped tetters on face. Eruption on chest. Skin of hands dry, stick and dirty-
looking.
Soreness on chest with pain. Pains in joints going from place to place. Rheumatic and gouty pains. Dropsy.
Tensive drawing ascending from left shoulder to nape of neck (Eup-per.). Pain and tightness in bend of left
knee.
Tickling and itching in left ear. Dull pains in gums accompanied by very hard stools. Sensation on tongue as if
something cold were placed on it. Dryness and scraping in throat. Scraping, scratching of larynx and trachea
with hoarseness, worse after eating. Syphilis with nosebleed, deranged mind, pain in small of back and itching
skin. Tickling prickling along urethra orifice agglutinated. Tearing in spermatic cord.
MIND - Great hilarity, exhilarated feeling. Cannot collect his thoughts while listening on account of jovial
feelings. Mind very active. Despondency. Great prostration after mental exertion.
Abdomen - Distended with wind, weak feeling in abdomen.
Causations - Mental work causes great prostration (Pic-ac.).
Constitutions - Psoric, allergic constitutions.
Eyes - Pain in right eyeball, worse from touching lids.
Head - Headache over supra-orbital ridges with rumbling in bowels and belchings, better from coffee. Sick
 headache. Pain in facial muscles.
Kidneys - More or less irritation in urethra inclining to sex. Burning pain on urinating with agglutination of
orifice. Urine passes in several streams, must press before it passes. Urine is dark, straw-colored, urine
escapes in divided stream (Thuj.).
Limbs - Rheumatic and gouty pains. Pain in shoulder and arm. Cramp in ball of thumbs and fingers.
Modalities - Better from coffee, relieves headache. Burning in urethra before and during erection, ceases
during sex. Worse by touch. Worse after eating.
Mouth - Viscid saliva in mouth, raised by coughing, water in mouth with tearing pains in molars.
Neck - Tensive drawing, ascending from left shoulder to nape of neck, worse from raising and extending arm.
Nose - Nosebleed. Violent sneezing, expelling lumps of yellow phlegm. Running water from nose. Copious
secretion of yellow phlegm.
Pelvis - Violent pain in sacrum when lifting a slight load.
Skin - Itching, dry, bran-like eruption, especially on hands and fingers. Palms especially affected. Ulcers
and swellings on joints. Rough, dry, bran-like tetters in rings. Groups of small vesicles, smarting and itching,
oozing a yellowish-brown
lymph, which soon turns into a scurf, new vesicles appearing beneath. Promotes expulsion of splinters (Hep.).
Stools - Hemorrhoids. Offensive flatus. Stools soft and pappy, watery diarrhea. Stools hard like stone, knotty.
Teeth - Pain as from cold.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Primula obcon. Anagallis contains Saponin. (2) Similarto Cof- fea - joyous,
excited. (3) Picric acid - prostration after mental exertion. (4) Cyclamen - sneezing. (5) Lith. - cough skin,
ringworm. Sep., Tell. (6) Puls. - chilliness, catarrhs.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Anantherum Muricatum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - anan. Anantherum muricatum. Cuscus grass. Andropogon muricatus. Andro- pogon
squarrosus. Vetiver. Viti-vayr. N. O. Gràmineae. India. Tincture of root. Historical dose: Tincture and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Abscesses. Aphonia. Boils. Cancer. Chancre-like sores. Colic. Erysipelas. Glandular
inflammation. Hair, loss. Herpes. Hydrophobia. Sycosis. Syphilis. Tic convulsive. Tic douloureux. Tumors.
Ulcers.
HOMEOPATHIC - A medicinal grass cultivated in the Markarentas Islands, East India. Anantherum has
produced a state of drunkenness and intoxication. Farrington noted if for “Erysipelas with much swelling of
arms and legs, darkred or bluish eruptions with tendency to suppurate.”
Anantherum is a skin remedy of high order. Abscesses, boils. Abscesses, ulcers and fissures on arms and
hands. Tumors of breast, ulcerated indurated.
Herpes and ulcers or scabs on scalp. Tumors, wart-like growths on eyebrows. Falling off of eyebrows and
beard. Chancre-like ulcers on penis. Eruptions like itch or lichen. Ulcers at labial commissures. Pustules like
smallpox on vulva. Syphilis.
Severe neuralgic headache, as if bells moved about in head, as of steel arrows from forehead to nape. Pains
in facial bones as if crushed or ulcerated. Convulsive tic. Plugged sensation. Glandular swellings
especially of sub-maxillary and cervical glands. Swelling of tonsils, constriction of throat, inability to swallow.
Painful swelling of various parts extending to suppuration.
MIND - Sadness and restlessness with fear of death and the future. Sheds tears easily. Dread of society.
Seeks solitude and obscurity. Apathetic. Anger with desire to strike and destroy. Quarrelsome, but after being
angry he often regrets what he has done. Jealousy. Foolish joy and absurd complacency.
Changes in his mood and turn of thought. Ardent desire to travel. Blunted intellect and loss of memory. Haste
in all his actions. Persistent fear of death during all his suffering. Monomania, as for rowing about in a boat,
dressing or walking out in a grotesque manner, always frequenting the same places and doing the same things.
Abdomen - Cramps, lancination and digging in the region of the spleen with loss of respiration. Spleen as if
ulcerated and hypertrophied. Burning in the whole abdomen, as if he had erysipelas. Inflammation and swelling
of the abdomen, very painful. Abdomen inflated, tense and hard, with tympanitic sound on percussion. Colic,
cramps and tearing pains in the abdomen, sensation as if there were a red-hot iron in it.
Breasts - Breasts swollen indurated, nipples excoriated. The breasts are atrophied and become soft. Heat
and pain in the breasts, as if they had been gashed with a penknife. Inflammation and swelling. Congestions
of the breasts as from accumulation of milk. Lancinating, pulsating and pressive pains. Excoriation of the
nipples.
 Constitutions - Psoric and allergic constitutions.
Ears - Very copious secretion of cerumen. Heat and smarting in the lobes of the ears. Fissures in the lobes of
the ears. Noises, murmurs and hissing in the ears.
Eyes - Heat and burning in the eyes. Pressure and painful stitches in the eyes. Photophobia. The eyelids are
inverted and as if scarified. Abundant secretion of mucus and considerable lachrymation, especially in the
open air. Trembling of the lids.
Eyes - Swelling and ulceration of the lachrymal glands. Weakness of the eyes.
Face - Face yellowish or red, enlarged inflamed and congested. Face pale, transparent and white as wax.
Face gray, cold and frozen looking and paralyzed. Face emaciated, bluish, cyanotic, contracted, shrunken with
hollow eyes.
Female - Scirrhus-like swelling of cervix. Prolapsed uterus. Sterility, as from atrophy of the ovaries. Swelling
of the uterus. Menstruation very painful and copious, the blood generally bright or light-colored. Menstruation
retarded, the blood dark, thick, followed by fetid leucorrhea. Suppression of menses. Menstruation frequent
and painful. Great itching and burning in the vulva. Whitish and reddish eruptions on the vulva. Leucorrhea
watery, clear or milky and of very bad odor. Thick, purulent, yellow or green leucorrhea.
Food - Morbid hunger, wakes up in night to eat, as if he had a tapeworm. Burning, unquenchable thirst. Longing
for aromatic drinks.
Head - Pains pierce brain like pointed arrows, worse in afternoon. Herpes, ulcers and tumors on scalp. Wart-
like growth on eyebrows. Boils and tumors on tip of nose.
Heart - Burning and sensation of weight in the heart with sadness, anguish and fear of death. Stitches and
formication in the heart with great anxiety.
Kidneys - Turbid, thick urine, full of mucus. Bladder cannot hold smallest quantity. Involuntary. Cystitis.
Constant urging to urinate with stitches and crushing pains in the kidneys. Frequent emission of urine, which
is turbid or soon becomes so. Sensation of a numbness and obstruction in the kidneys and bladder were
always full and swollen.
Liver - Sensation of heat and of congestion of the liver. Cramps in the hepatic region with sensation as if it
were full of painful tuberosities.
Male - Excoriations on the prepuce and urethral meatus. Secretion of a thick substance of very strong odor,
between the glans and prepuce, which are swollen.
Burning, stitching and pinching in the penis. Syphilitic-looking pimples on the penis with intense pains,
traversing from one part of another.
Modalities - Coffee at first worse, then better. Wine and coffee aggravates the toothache.
Mouth - Tongue fissured, as if cut on edges, copious salivation. Constant inclination to clench the teeth.
Sensation of cold in the teeth with heat in the gums and the whole mouth. Burning in the teeth, gums and lips,
as if they were burned. Gum-boils. Very painful pimples on the tongue with itching and burning.
Rectum - Very long-lasting constipation, followed by dry, brown, bulky stools, then diarrhea. Obstinate
constipation with fever, heat, thirst, sweat and debility. Stools difficult, large and hard, knotty like sheep-dung,
passed with difficulty, even after the use of injections.
Sleep - Restless sleep with cries, starting up, movements of the limbs and anxious dreams. Comatose sleep
with disturbing dreams and snoring. Prolonged sleep in the morning with inclination to lie abed late. Sleep with
frequent dreams, alternate coldness and heat and burning of the whole body, intense thirst and fright.
Stomach - Obstinate, convulsive hiccough. Burning in the stomach, as if it were on fire. Excessive and almost
continual secretion of phlegm. Vomiting of the food and of bile, with hunger even after eating. Vomiting of food
and often of blood after meals. Vomiting of acrid, burning matter, followed by bile and blood. Pains in the
stomach with cold sweats on the face and back.
Skin - Itching. Offensive foot sweat. Diseased and deformed nails. Herpes. Abscesses, boils and ulcers.
Erysipelas. Chancre-like sores.
COMMENTS - Burning and stitches. Thirsty, but cannot drink. Burning heat alternating with icy coldness in
gullet, as of something alive in gullet. Involuntary urination when walking and during sleep.
Formication as from ants. Ulcers yellowish, violet, swollen, everted, syphilitic.
Discharges from ulcers are foul, foul breath and belchings. Sexual desire increased by every attempt to satisfy
it until driven to onanism and madness.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Staph., Merc., Thuj.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Andersonia Rohitika
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ander. Andersonia rohitika. Plihaghati. N. O. Mediaceae. Stem and root bark. Historical dose:
Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Biliousness. Debility. Fever. Glands, enlarged. Gonorrhea. Heat, flushes. Jaundice. Leucorrhea.
Liver, enlarged. Malaria. Nausea. Spleen, disorders. Spleen, enlarged. Vomiting.
HERBAL - Rohitaka is a large tree and is generally found in many districts of Bengal. It also grows in Assam,
Sylhet and Cachar and also in Western India. Burma, Malacca and some other places this plant can be found.
Rohitaka has been named by Ayurvedic physicians as Plihaghati meaning thereby that it does away with all
splenic disorders.
The Ayurvedic physicians have found it to be alternative, astringent and tonic. They prize it as an excellent
remedy in the enlargement of liver and spleen, in corpulence and enlarged glands and also in general debility.
They have also recommended it in gonorrhea.
Chakradatta. Charaka and other ayurvedic authorities have recommended it in the splenic affections, mucus
gonorrhea, and leucorrhea. they have also found it efficacious in hepatic affections and derangements as well.
They have recommended it for jaundice, dropsical swellings, chronic fevers and some other diseases.
HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Pramada Prasanna Biswas of Padna, Bengal, personally proved this drug. The following
symptoms set in while it was proved:
MIND - Easily angered. Mistakes in spelling take place. Memory become dull and disordered. Cannot fix mind
on any subject or matter.
Abdomen - Heat is felt in the lower abdomen. Pains are felt in the right and left hypochondrium. Enlargement
of both liver and spleen and burning sensation is felt here.
Eyes - Eyes, burn.
Face - Face, eyes, burn. Flushes of heat come out of the face.
Head - Heat in the head, especially on the vertex. Giddiness of head. Feeling of warmth or heat in the head,
specially on the frontal region. Sensation of pain in the temples associated with heat which is relieved by cold
breeze or cold application. Burning sensation is felt in the eyes and face.
Limbs - Hands and feet burn. Burning sensation is felt there. The patient feels great relief if body coverings
are thrown off.
Modalities - Open air, cold breeze or cold application generally mitigates or relieves all pains, specially burning
of the body.
Mouth - Heat comes out of the mouth. Insipid taste in the mouth. In the morning taste becomes bad and bitter.
Stomach - Burning sensation is felt in the stomach with urging for vomiting. Sensation of heat is felt in the
stomach and spasmodic colic due to indigestion ensues. Nausea and vomiting. Also an attempt at vomiting.
Water comes out of the mouth.
Temperature - There is feverishness with headache with frontal pains. During fever aching pains are felt. Body
becomes hot. Face, eyes hands and feet burn.
COMMENTS - It is alternative, astringent, and tonic, given in enlarged gland, as liver and spleen, in corpulence
and in general debility. (R. N. Khory, Materia Medica of India, vol. II, p. 118)
R. N. Chopra in his Indigenous Drugs of India, p. 461, says: “It is an aperient usedin enlarged glands, liver and
spleen diseases and corpulence.”
It is a splendid remedy in all disorders of the spleen, either enlarged or painful.
It is also an excellent medicine in all hepatic derangement.
In chronic slow malarial fevers associated with the enlargement of the spleen and liver its action is supreme.
It is particularly useful for patients with bilious temperament.
Fever with headache and burning temperature. Fever with headache and burning sensation of eyes, face,
hands and feet, they desire to have cold breeze or cold application which ameliorates all burning sensations
experienced by them.
There is constipation which is a characteristic symptom of the drug. There is no desire for food. Taste of the
mouth is insipid or bitter. The patient feels laziness while getting out of the bed in the morning.
REFERENCES - Ghose.

name: Androctonos Amurreuxi
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - androc. Androctonos amurreuxi hebraeus. Scorpio europaeus. N. O. Scorpionida. Arachnida.
A scorpion of West Asia. Tincture of animals. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Apathy. Backache. Constipated. Fatigue. Headache. Hemorrhoids. Memory, weak. Nausea.
Nightmares. Salivation. Strabismus. Tetanus.
HOMEOPATHIC - The scorpion was a major remedy in ancient Egyptian medicine. A proving of scorpion is
 written in the medical papyruses, which give a vivid description of Isis allowing herself to be stung to determine
the effects of the medicine.
A proving on a middle eastern scorpion was conducted by Jeremy Sherr. Most provers were between age 25
to 40 years old. The symptoms are from the provings and effects of the stings.
Pain and swelling of the injured part are first experienced followed by sleepiness, prostration and possibly
tetanus. Strabismus has been observed in some cases and the pupils are dilated.
The bitten part is very swollen with violent pains lasting from one to three days. Heat and pain at bitten spot,
sleepiness, sneezing, rest
lessness, later, abundant saliva, meteorism, later, trismus or tetanus. Complete prostration. Always acute
pains in and diminished temperature of the part bitten. Scorpion stings are attended with a certain amount of
danger, especially for children.
MIND - Forgetful. Absent-minded. Mind dull and foggy, better while moving and walking. Difficulty applying
self. Lack of concentration with daydreaming and difficulty in mental exertion. Mind blank when concentrating.
Unable to think of more than one thing at a time. Mistakes in writing and spelling. Speech slurred, answered
with difficulty. Conversation difficult.
Weariness. Tired and apathetic. Felt detached, very interested in little things. Dreamy and staring. Felt
disconnected from the human race, as if everyone were another species. Depressed and destructive. Aversion
to things she usually enjoyed. Averse to work.
Very changeable moods, one moment extremely friendly, nice and amiable, then irritable. Incredible upsurge
of energy, felt very high, then low, then high again. Great swings of mood, better from eating. Clumsy. Accident-
prone. As if drunk, with increased sexual desire. Desire to be out in the country.
Hurried, restless. Impatient watching others. Time seems to go slowly. Irritable, snappy, oversensitive to noise
and bright lights, can't bear music. Argumentative, critical. Feels resentful and abused. Great hostility to those
around him. Assertive, impatient, aggressive. Angry with her children and family. Terrible uncontrollable
temper. Wanted to kill her husband and children.
Panic-stricken. Fear, as if something terrible would happen. Overwhelmed by terror, panic and fear. Terrified
of dogs, fearful while driving. Anguish and worry, anxiety for no reason. Anxiety about health. Anxiety for self,
friends and the world, with continual sighing.
Despairing, tearful mood, could see no way out. Sadness and confusion. Feels sorry for herself, better crying.
Sympathetic, took on otherpeople's problems. Desires company and sympathy. Indisposed to talk and averse
to company. Disappointed with people.
Abdomen - Short, sharp, strong, stabbing cramps below ribs. Clinching feeling of panic in abdomen, as if
nearly had °1 an accident. Ache in lower abdomen.
Pains in intestines feel bruised and sore.

HERBAL - Common in India, specially in Bengal. It is an annual plant, 1 to 3 feet high, common in hedgerows
throughout the plains of India from Lucknow to Assam. It is also cultivated in gardens in some parts of India.
The shrub is well-known under the name of Kalmegh and forms the principal ingredient of household medicine
called alui which is extensively used in Bengali.
The macerated leaves and juice together with certain spices are made into little globules, which are prescribed
for infants to relieve griping, irregular stools and loss of appetite.
The roots and leaves have also reputation of being a febrifuge, tonic, alternative and anthelmintic.
In general debility, dysentery and certain forms of dyspepsia associated with gaseous distension of the bowels,
the decoction or infusion of the leaves have been used with satisfactory results.
Ayurvedic physicians used it with success singly or as a principal ingredient with other medicines in worms of
children, vomiting Of children. Infantile liver, enlargement of
liver and spleen. Fever with the enlargement of liver and spleen. Fever with constipation. Fever in malaria.
Fever in infantile liver. Fever in kala-azar of children, and also in boils, abscesses and septic wounds.
The people of India prize it to be a highly efficacious remedy in all sorts of liver complaints from very early
times.
The Ayurvedic physicians of India use it in enlarged liver or any derangement of liver, especially in children
wjth jaundiced skin or without it, in the first stage of cough and cold, in the general debility and in convalescence
after a long - continued fever. They also employ it in cutaneous ailments.
In intermittent fevers, the fever comes on daily between 8 and 9. a.m. or between 10 a.m. and 12 noon. During
fever there is slight thirst. Loose stools, catarrh, cough and pain in the hepatic region are the
accompanying symptoms. There may be constipation in place of diarrhea.
Burning sensation in eyes, face hands andfeet, especially in the palms are keynote symptoms for its
administration. During fever the patient is disinclined to move, desire to keep quiet, during fever there is
intermingling of chilliness and burning sensation.
Sometimes the patient likes cold applications. Sometimes he dislikes them, in this wáy contradictory and
conflicting symptoms manifest themselves.
 It is generally used in an attack of remittent or intermittent fever where there is double accession of the seizure
associated with predominance of bilious symptoms and headache. In some cases, headache may be absent.
In show fevers of children with derangement or enlargement of liver, it is very useful. In infantile jaundice where
eyes and urine have become yellow, it is used with efficacy. It is excellent remedy in chronic fever associated
with the enlargement of liver and spleen along with burning of hands, feet, eyes and face, and headache. Its
efficacy is found also in kala-azar of infants. The following are the principal guiding symptoms of Kalmegh:
Sensation of heat and burning in hands and feet, mental depression and despondency, bad taste in the mouth,
bitter and putrid taste over the tongue, constipation, scantiness of stools, changeableness of symptoms,
heaviness of the whole body for which the patient walks slowly.
The patient wants to wash the hands and the feet with cold water in order to be relieved of the burning sensation
felt over the parts, he feels considerable relief from cold, he does not desire to move. .
Kalmegh is a domestic medicine for flatulence and diarrhea of children and it is also used for worm symptoms
as it is considered to be anthelmintic. It is used in torpidity of liver, neuralgia, dyspepsia, in general debility, in
convalescence after fevers and in the fully developed stage of dysentery. In short, Kalmegh is a sovereign
remedy for the above mentioned ailments.

Angelica sinensis aches, lumbar aching, chest and abdominal diseases.
Constipation and expulsion of pus. Toning action on the organs. Effective for cases of hematuria and melaena.
Weight changes, regular loss of weight in obese hypothyroid types. Tendency to plumpness. Reduction in
libido. Menses scanty with fainting feeling, breast congestion, diarrhea and occasional vomiting. Joint pains,
predominantly on the left side, especially in the hip and pelvis. Spontaneous hematomata. Vesicular eruption.
Formation of hard nodular patches.
MIND - Difficulty in concentrating. Reading difficult, because he needs to move, to walk about. General
restlessness. Lacks courage, while being restless. State of euphoria, which is mixed with a state of indifference.
Feels well, calm, a little tired. Feels more dynamic but more nervous.
Abdomen - Pain in the solar plexus with pulsations in the abdominal aorta. Flatulence. Attacks of colitis and
prurigo.
Back - Pains in the scapula and left arm, causing him to wake at night. Pain under the left scapula, in the left
shoulder. Lumbar pains. Lumbago as after exertion. Spontaneous hematomata in series, stretching all along
the vertebral column and waist.
Breasts - Benign breast tumors, cysts on the breasts. Disappearance of a nodule in left-sided mastitis.
Chest - Pain in the middle of the sternum, sometimes spontaneous. Sternum painful, almost impossible to
touch it.
Constitutions - Hydrogenoid, neuro-lym- phatic type.
Female - Amenorrhea. Long intervals between menses. Premenstrual syndrome Premenstrual swelling,
breast congestioi and legs heavy. Menses scanty. Meno pansai complaints. Discomfort, feelinj sensation durii^'
menses with vomitinj and frequent stools. Hot flushes and dis comfort and night. Profuse leucorrhea milky,
irritating discharge. Intercours uncomfortable, sometimes painful. Libid very irregular. Pain and congestion in
th left ovary.
Food - Loss of appetite, worse after eating sweets, pastries or sugar. •
Head - Headache after meals, at the nape of the neck. -
Heart - Palpitations, limbs cold, legs heavy.
Kidneys - Urination not very frequent. Urine very dark in color. Has to get up during the night to urinate once
or twice.
Limbs - Acrocyanosis of the hands, legs, cheeks, and inside of the arms. Joint pains in the left shoulder and
left hip. Strumous edema of the legs, worse in cold weather.
Lungs - Stifled sensation with need for air. Feeling of heat, respiration difficult,'need for fresh air. Grasps for
breath. Dyspnea with no apparent cause.
Male - Irregular libido with loss of sexual appetite. Sexually indifferent.
 Modalities - Better in fresh air, a need for ri;, fresh air. Worse from movement. Worse contact. Worse in the
late afternoon.
Mouth - PainTul swelling of the gum where there is a bridge. Tongue covered with a white or yellow coating
at the back and on the edges. •
Neck - Cannot bear the collar of his shirt to be fastened.
Pelvis - Pain in the hip and left sacroiliac _( joint, appearing especially in the late afternoon. Pain in all the
joints of the pelvis, ri Feeling of stretching of the pelvic joints as after giving birth.
Rectum - Diarrhea, worse after eating sweets, pastries, sugar. Diarrhea after . any meals. Tendency to periods
of constipation, alternating with soft stools, diarrhea.
Skin - Vesicular, itching eruptions, located on the right knee. Itching patches on the , left hip, stretching to the
waist, back and ,, slightly on the right hip. Hardening below the skin on the left hip. Small hard patches on the
outer side of the right forearm. Loss }      ofhair with scaly, scabby formations on the
scalp. Erysipelas. Acrocyanosis. Strumous edema. Knotted erythema.
Sleep - Sleep after meals. Sleep not very good, irregular with Sensation of heat, persistently disturbed. Sleep
lasts only a short
while. Agitated dreams, dreams of death, funerals, falling into deep, black pit.
Temperature - Perspiration appears fairly quickly and chill disappears, takes off woolen clothes. Perspires
easily. Varying chilliness, at times cold, then with hot flushes.
Throat - Tension in the thyroid region with blocked, stifled sensation.
COMMENTS - “Case (1) Francine D„ 28, came for a consultation on 28/10/74, for a hormonal problem. She
began menstruation at 17 and since then has always had irregular periods, up to 5 or 6 days late. Menses are
weak, scanty with bright red or brown blood and painful. Between menses, yellowish- green leucorrhea. .
“She has been receiving allopathic hormone treatment for 5 years after an examination which revealed the
right ovary to be large, smooth and white. Feels tired on waking up, tendency to be constipated, dreams a
great deal, complains of dorsal pains.
“Anxious, legs heavy. She has scoliosis, small breasts, gastric ptosis, slight acrocyanosis and infiltrated ankles.
She says she has not been receiving hormone treatment for several months.
“Prescription of 25 drops of Radix-An- gelicae-Sinensis in 3x on waking up. 15 drops of Radix-Angelicae-
Sinensis in 7c on going to bed. Condition generally improved, feels better. Stools regular sleep better and
fewer dreams, no tiredness ôn waking, lost a little weight, which pleased her, 52 kilos, arterial tension 14/8.
“As for menses, she had one period on 8th December 1974, but it was still a little painful. Then on 22nd January
1975, normal, copious and, above all, painless. .We maintained the original prescription.
“Case (2). D. St., age 24,' came on 9th September 1974. Began menses at 9, always had painful, scanty
menses with black, clotted blood. Operated on in January 1972 for a right sided hydrosalpinx and menstrual
cycle did not improve afterwards. While, milky leucorrhea, feels swollen intercourse painful.
“Prescription Radix-Angelicae-Sinensis, 3x in the morning, 7c in the evening. The menstrual cycle was restored
and she had periods on 27th September, 25th October, 20th November, 21s> December 1974 and then
22ndJanuary 1975,18th February and 22nd March 1975. No more leucorrhea, regular, painless intercourse,
no more swelling, regular stools.
“Case (3). Myriane F..., 26, came on 13th July 1974 with obesity and rare, irregular menses. Here is a pattern
of her periods when taking Radix-Angelicae-Sinensis, 3x and 7c: 18th July, 30th August, 3rd September, 4th
October, 14th November, 19th December, 24th January. She was 1.67m tall, weighing 65 kilos at 13/7/74 and
59 kilos at 24/2/75.
“She is now very well. In fact, these three cases are only given as indications. A closer clinical and biological
study is necessary in order to demonstrate its value. We must also point out tha^a greater posage of 25 to 50
drops, two to Three times a day, can be given in cases of benign breast tumors or secondary amenorrhea,
especially after cessation of taking the birth control pill.”
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Aranea Diadema - Hydrogenoid tendency, faintness, menses with pains in the
lumbar and sacral regions, periodicity and feeling of increase in size and weight of the upper limbs. (2)
Aristolochia Clematitis -Affinity forthefemale genital organs. Menses scanty, irregularjoint pains, strumous
edema. (3) Histamine hydrochlor. - Thyroid type with pain in the left ovary, burning, cramping pains in the
scrotum, joints and muscles, burning, itching, red papules on small areas of the skin. (4) Mandragora Radix -
Euphoria, alternating with depression, libido disturbed, menses early or late, leucorrhea and lumbar pains,
herpestype vesicles on the face.
REFERENCES - Julian.

 (Red Gum)

Dysentery. 1
HERBAL - This herb resembles eucalyptus in appearance. It was proved by F. Kopp, producing bearing-down

Pains and tenesmus only better by lying down flat on the face. Obstinate constipation, then nausea, sickness
and diarrhea with vertigo and debility.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Ip.
REFERENCES Clarke.

name: Angusturavera
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ang. Angustura vera. Cusparía febrífuga. Galipea cusparía. Galipea officinalis. Bonplandia
trifoliata. N. O. Rutacae. Bonplandia trifoliata from Angustura, South America. Trituration and tincture of the
bark. Historical dose: Trituration, Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Anxiety. Belching. Bone, pains. Chills. Coffee, addiction. Decay, tissues. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia.
Headache. Hemorrhoids. Injuries. Intermittent, fevers. Knee, pain. Myopia. Palpitations. Paralysis. Rheuma-
tism. Spavin in horses. Tetanus. Toothache. Trismus, neonatorum Ulcers. Varicóse veins. Vertigo. Whooping
cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - Thi effects of Ang. are closely allied to those of Nux-v., Ruta and Merc. Clarke has verified
the power of Ang. over long bones in a case of acutè periostitis of the tibia in a scrofulous boy. The 5x trituration
speedily arrested inflammation after the failure of Merc. Decay of bones, particularly
if patient has longing for coffee and has a very touchy, sensitive mind.
Principal action is on spinal motor nerves and mucus membranes. Over-sensitive and excitable. The
slightest offense, a mere trifle, irritates (Nux-v.). Timidity and weakness (Sil.). Characteristic strong craving
for coffee.
Decay of tissue. Decay with crumbling off of pieces of bone. Decay of long bones. Ulcers very painful,
penetrate to marrow. Tearing in the bones, worse at rest, better cold applications, better extension, worse
exertion and pressure. Exostosis of lower jaw. Rheumatic and paralytic complaints with great difficulty in
walking. Crackling in all joints. Drawing, tension, stiffness of muscles and joints, bruised, sore feeling as after
a blow.
Constricting sensation in varicose veins. Spinal marrow and extensor muscles are principally affected.
Paralysis. Tetanus. Drawing of head of right side, later to left. Heat in forehead at night.YJear-sighted.
MIND - Greatly excited and extravagant spirits. Oversensitive, Sudden attacks of anxiety at night. Anxiety
while lying in bed. Anxiety as if she never would get awake again. Easily frightened and starts. Pusillanimity.
He has not confidence enough in himself to undertake and perform voluntary motions.
Marked ill humor, everything vexes her. Lachrymose and irritable. Great gloom. Dis- fl heartened. Offended
easily. Prone to anger, every trifle irritates. Filled with bitterness, will stand no joking, irritation at least of- Hi
fence. Absence of mind, wants now this, then that thing.
Abdomen - Pain from navel into sternum.
Loud rumbling in the abdomen. Emission of stinking flatulence.
Back - Itching along back. Twitching and jerking along back. Pain in cervical ,(, vertebrae. Drawing in the neck.
Cutting pain from point of right scapula to breast, near nipple (Chel.). Pain in spine, at nape of neck and
sacrum, worse on pressure. Bends backwards. ,
Constitutions - Syphilitic constitutions.
Ears - Heat of the ears and both cheeks.
Pinching in the external ear. Heat in the lobes. Sensation as if something were before the ear and as if
something were inserted in it. Throbbing pain behind the ears, on the side of the neck, as if the carotid were
beating.
Eyes - The eyes are red and burn, agglutinated in the morning. Violent burning in the inner half of the eyes.
Pressure in both eyes, as if a bright light were irritating them and they became weary. A few stitches over the
eyes. Eyes feel as if there was sand in them.
Food - Aversion to solid food, desires nothing but warm drink. Thirst without desire to drink. Irresistible desire
 to drink coffee. Aversion to meat, especially pork. Thirst for cold water, could not drink enough during evening.
Wants now one thing, now another, which are refused when offered. He cannot get satisfied without having
much appetite.
Head - Oversensitive. Headache with heat of face. Acute pain in cheeks. Drawing in facial muscles. Pain in
temporal muscles, worse when opening the jaws. Pain in articulation of jaw in masseter muscles, as if fatigued
by chewing too much. Cramppain on the zygomatic arch.
Limbs - Stiffness and tension of muscles and joints. Pain in limbs on walking. Arms tired and heavy. Decay of
long bones. Coldness of fingers. Knee pain. Cracking in joints.
Lungs - Cough, as if something weighed on his lungs. Frequent short cough, followed by one hiccough.
Expectoration of sour, salty water. '
Modalities - Toothache is better application of cold fingers. Palpitations, worse sitting bent and better sitting
up. Pain in cervical vertebrae worse moving arms. Loose cough is worse 3 p.m. Worse from exertion. Worse
stooping. Worse moving or lifting arms. Worse drinking warm milk. Worse cold application. Worse extension.
Worse lying on left side.
Mouth - Great dryness of mouth and lips without any thirst. Much saliva flows from the mouth. Bitter taste in
the mouth after the usual’smoking.
Nose - Sensation of a corrosive soreness deep in the nose.
Rectum - Diarrhea and colic. Tenesmus with «vij soft stool. Chronic diarrhea with debility 5, : and loss of flesh.
Burning in anus. Frequent urging in the rectum, as if diarrhea would come on immediately.
Rectum - Hemorrhoids remain protruded, , even during the night.
Skin - Decay, very painful ulcers which affect the bone.
Sleep - Restlessness at night. Uneasy sleep, i wakes without cause ani cannot get to _ L sleep again. Vivid
dreams, partly disagree- g, able, partly anxious. Anxious, distressing , dreams, causing her to weep much.
Stomach - Belchings of water. Many empty ri.. belchings after a meal. Bilious belchings. gp Belching with
cough (Ambr.). Frequent p^ hiccough. Sense of nausea in the stom- j,F ach. Nausea with water brash. Nausea,
especially during a meal. Empty feeling in stomach. Cutting, tearing in the pit increased by moving the trunk
after dinner.
Cramp like, pinching pain below the pit , of the stomach. Atonic dyspepsia.
Temperature - Chills all over with nausea.
At 3 p. m., shivering with goose flesh, abating in the open air without thirst, for . several days in succession.
Throat - Frequent roughness in the throat, he must hack without being able to expectorate anything.
Roughness and dryness in the back part of the palate and fauces without any thirst. -
Vertigo - Periodical vertigo. Vertigo in the open air. Vertigo from the occiput when sitting, throbbing in right
temple.
COMMENTS - Trismus neonatorum, where much mercury had been given. Drawing in upper right molar tooth
better application of cold finger. Thirst, constant desire to drink. Irresistible desire to drink coffee.
Hiccough after cough. Belching with cough (Ambr.). Dry, hacking cough from scratching in throat or irritation
behind sternum. Irritation behind sternum through to back. Every evacuation followed by shivering, crawling
sensation over face. Tenesmus with soft stool. Hemorrhoids protrude with hard, knotty stool. Seminal
emissions. Itch-ing of tip of glans penis (when walking in open air). Violent itching on scrotum.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Coffea, (not Camph.). Bry. - Bellyache after milk, Chef - sharp, cutting pain from
just beneath right scapula to chest. Ang. is like Ruta in its action on bones and as an antidote to Mercury, also
like False Angustura. Compare: (1) Nux-v., Ruta, Merc. (2) Brucea Bark or Angustura falsa. (3) Bell. - worse
3 p.m. (4) All-c., Cham., Coff. - toothache better by cold. (5) Cic., Ign., Nux-v. - tetanus. (6) Merc., Phos., Sil. -
decay of jaw. (7) Aesc., Aloe. - hemorrhoids and backache. (8) Hyper. Led. - punctured wounds. (9) Ran-b. -
pain in pectoral muscles.
REFERENCES - Allen. Boericke. Clarke.

name: Anhalonium Lewinii
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - anh. Anhalonium lewinii. Peyote. Peyotl. Lophophora williamsii. Mescal buttons. N. O.
Cactaceae. Mexico, Rio Grande. Tinctures, extracts or infusions. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Audio-visual, hallucinations.
Brain-fag. Delirium. Delusions. Depersonalization. Depression. Goiter. Headaches. Hearing, disorders.
Hysteria. Insomnia. Intoxication. Megrim. Mental, weakness. Neuralgia. Paraplegia. Senses, disordered.
Ptosis. Pupils, dilated. Schizophrenia. Suicidal, tendencies. Vision, disorders.
HERBAL - The Anhalonium plant from which the mescal buttons are obtained grows in barren and rocky soil
 in the valley of the Rio Grande. It is used by some Native American tribes in their religious ceremonies. In the
ceremonies the constant beating of tom-toms is an essential feature.
HOMEOPATHIC - Anhalonium has been recently tested and a notable proving was made by Dr. Wier Mitchell.
It is a cardiac tonic and respiratory stimulant. It weakens the heart and produces insanity.
The chief feature of the drug's action is the production of colorful visions of overpowering brilliancy, associated
with moving shapes of fantastic design, the motion being regulated somewhat in time by music.
It makes “each note upon- the piano a center of melody which seems to be surrounded by a halo of color
pulsating to the rhythm of the music.’’’Hyperesthesia of all the senses. Acute sensitivity to changes of the
weather.
Feeling of cold over the body. General increase in muscular tone. Hypersecretion of the thyroid gland. Hysteria.
Allergic persons with hypersensitivity. Loss of sex drive (Sep.). Insomnia. Anxiety and neurosis. Melancholy.
Chronic hallucinatory state. Schizophrenia. Impression that the self is double. Suicidal tendencies. Basedow's
disease (Goiter).
MIND - Anhalonium is a remedy for brainweakness, audio-visual hallucinations with colored brilliant visions.
It causes a form of intoxication accompanied by wonderful visions, remarkably beautiful and varied
kaleidoscopic changes and a sensation of increased physical ability. V isions of monsters and various
gtuesome forms. "Delirium.
Loss of contact with the outside world and escape into a fantasy world. Loss of conception of time. Distrust
and resentment. Lazy contentment. Gloomy, sad, dull. Irrational, sudden changes of mood. Egocentric
introversion. Noises and touch are perceived through colored vision.
Depersonalization, does not know his identity. Diminution of willpower, apathy and slow reactions. Passive
state. Existential anguish. Impression that objects and his whole body are transparent, sees his own internal
organs. Memories exalted.
Ears - Exaggerated reverberation of ordinary sounds. Impressions of sound and visions heightened by any
marked stimulation of skin.
Eyes - Pupils dilated. Ptosis. Accommodation impaired. Troubled vision, accommodation and perception.
Visions in all colors. Fantastic visions of surpassing brilliance, moving in designs. Moving scenes, dances,
affected by beating time. Natural objects seem more brilliant, shadows deepened, flickering of lights greatly
exaggerated?
Face - Disinclined to make the slightest movement, eyelids droop, they scarcely
move the lips and jaws in articulating. Head - Headaches with disturbed vision.
Frontal headache with visual zigzags. Occipital headache, with disturbed vision. Persistent ache and tired
feeling in occipital region.
Limbs - Burning sensation of the limbs. A fine tremor in lower limbs.
Lungs - Breathing shallow.
Modalities - Better lying down. Worse on closing eyes. The nausea and faintness were worse on movement.
There is great disinclination to move.
Mouth - Great difficulty in talking, partly from paralysis of the tongue, partly from slowness of thought.
Nerves - Motor incoordination. Extreme muscular depression increased patellar reflex. Paraplegia. Neuralgias,
trigeminal of the ophthalmic nerve, the maxillary nerve, frontal nerve and naso-ciliary nerve.
Nose - The air seemed filled with vague perfume. Smell blunted, could not tell whether or not tincture of
asafetida was a perfume.
Sleep - Insomnia and hysteria. Drowsiness, followed by consciousness of unusual energy.
Stomach - Nausea, worse on movement, entirely better on lying down.
Vertigo - Faintness. Vertigo, brain tired.
COMMENTS - One prover, Havelock Ellis said “I first cut up the Peyote buttons into small fragments and
poured on boiling water twice, a single infusion is inactive.” He noted a distinct slowing of the pulse, slight
faintness and shallow breathing, but there were none of the terrible heart symptoms of the other Cacti.
Other symptoms are loss of conception of time, occipital headache, tired feeling in head, nausea. Tremor of
muscles increased knee-jerk and loss of power of coordination. Extreme muscular depression, don't want to
stir, whole body feels relaxed. Lazy contentment. Fine tremor in lower limbs before the visions, unable to walk
without assistance, can with difficulty sit up.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cann-i. - time sense disordered, fantastic visions. (2) Gels. - paralysisof
accommodation. (3) Bell., Stram.,
Op., Pic-ac., Pip-m., Coff., Coca. (4) Plat. - objects seem small and distant. (5) Psor. - better lying down. (6)
Agave. (7) The intoxication of Anhalonium is similar to that of Cannabis Ind. and Oenanthe.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
 ***ANILINUM
(Amidobenzene)
PHARMACY - anil. Anilinum. Amidobenzene. Amidobenzol. A secondary product of coal tar obtained by
reduction of nitrobenzene. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Anemia. Anorexia. Cancer. Cholera. Cyanosis. Eczema, rubrum. Tumors.
HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of Anil, have been observed on working people poisoned by inhalation of
the fumes and on persons who have worn an aniline-dyed article next the skin.
The symptoms are in1 many respects like those of Arsenicum. There is vomiting, purging, bursting headache,
and epileptiform attacks. Face has a purple hue. Marked cyanosis, swelling and irritation of the skin.
Profound anemia with discoloration of the skin, blue lips, anorexia, gastric disturbances. Painin penis and
scrotum with swelling. Cancerous growths. Tumors of urinary passages. Giddiness and pain in head.
COMMENTS - In old-school practice, injections of aniline blue have been used with some success to destroy
cancerous, growths, aniline having a marked affinity for cell nuclei, hence its use in staining microscopic
specimens.
In Anil, poisoning cases, évacuants, the inhalation of oxygen, and the free use of stimulants, including brandy,
ammonia, chloric ether, cold infusions to the head, and mustard plasters on legs and thighs, have been used
with success.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Glon., Ars., Pyrog., Phenacetinum. Antifebrinum.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. ,

name: Anise Stellatum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - anis. Anise stellatum. Star anise. Chinese anise. Illicium stellatum. Illicium verum. N. O.
Magnoliacee. Illecebraceae. Tincture of seeds. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Asthma. Catarrh. Colic. Convulsions. Cough. Dyspnea. Hemoptysis. Lungs disorders. Stomach,
catarrh. Rheumatism. Thigh, pain. Vomiting.
HERBAL - Illicium is a genus of Magnoliaceous shrubs or low trees with smooth entire leaves, exhaling when
bruised a strong odor of aniseed, owing to the volatile oil contained in minute pellucid dots, which may be seen
by the aid of a lens. The star anise fruit is used throughout China, Japan and India as a condiment and is
chewed in small quantities after a meal to sweeten the breath.
Anis, has a local repute as a stomachic and carminative and should be remembered in the treatment of flatulent
conditions. It has been used for the so-called three months colic, especially if it recurs at regular hours, with
much rumbling in abdomen. Colic of babies.
HOMEOPATHIC - The Anis, provings were made by Franz and Mure. Both showed the action of the drug on
the nose, mouth and stomach. Franz had many symptoms on the face, especially lips, skin and limbs.
Characteristic pain in region of third rib. about an inch or two from the sternum, generally on right side, but
occasionally on left. Frequent cough with this pain. Purulent tracheal and gastric catarrh of old alcoholics. Old
asthmatics. Vomiting, epileptiform convulsions with biting of tongue.
Abdomen - Three months colic, especially if it recurs at regular hours, bowels disturbed. Violent wind colic.
Rumbling in abdomen. Pain in spleen region.
Back - Pain in back and chest. Cramp-like drawing, as from a cold in left side of dorsal vertebra.
Chest - Pain in region of third rib, about one or two inches from sternum, generally on right side, but
occasionally left. Pain
about junction of third rib with cartilages, hemorrhage, coughs, congestion and enlarged liver.
Ears - Buzzing in ears. Ringing in ears followed by sleep. Itching over left ear, going off when touching the
place.
Face - Stinging sensation in upper lip, as if blood would press out, better from touch. Dryness of upper lip,
which is drawn closer to teeth. Burning in inner surface of lower lip with sensation as if it had gone to sleep.
Food - All food, except rye brea’d. tastes too salty or bitter, yet appetite is good. Rye bread tastes good, its
odor is refreshing. Satiety after eating but little.
Head - Pains in head, better evenings, worse mornings.
Heart - Palpitations with aphthae and weakness.
Limbs - Jerking and têaring in bend of left elbow and at same time in palm, a feeling as if an arter^had been
injured by a blow. Pressure back °f right hand, between the two middle metacarpal bones, as though something
fiard lying between them, worse pressing hand against anything hard, not by touch. Left thigh feels as if broken
in the middle while sitting, it disappears on standing.
 Lungs - Dyspnea in old asthmatics. Feeling of emptiness after coughing. Frequent cough with pain. Spitting
blood in small quantities and with pus-like phlegm, pain in right chest. Whitish expectoration. Tough and
viscous phlegm with old alcoholics. Dyspnea. Pain near third intercostal cartilage. Cough with pus-like phlegm.
Palpitation with aphthae. Hemoptysis.
Modalities - The pain in thigh is worse sitting, better rising. Pains in the head are worse in morning, better in
evening.
Mouth - Tongue covered with aphthae, most on edges. Edges of tongue folded like little bags.
Nose - Acute catarrh. Water discharge from nostrils. Warm, smarting sensation in nose, succeeded by
sneezing. Sharp stitches in tip of nose, beneath lip. Acute catarrh. Burning and numbness of inner lower lip.
Rectum - Stools bilious, compact and dark-colored.
Skin - Stitches as with pins in left palm, between first and second fingers, better by scratching, but afterwards
return with burning. Dull, painful stitches in skin of lower forearm. Crawling, itching stitches in right palm. Itching
in front and above left ear, better by touch.
Sleep - Sleepless at nightfall. Disturbed sleep.
Stomach - Nausea in stomach, extends to chest, then ceases. Nausea with gagging and inclination to vomit.
Bloating of stomach, acidity.
Temperature - Heat from abdomen to stomach and chest, running over different places and abating during
day.
Throat - Touch, viscid phlegm from stomach with old alcoholics.

Asked why, he replied: “Whenever I sit down my limb feels as if broken off right here,” pointing to the middle

arm and severe “sore pain” in his back. Anis. 30x cured all the symptoms.
Mure's Anis, symptoms were noted on head, abdomen, chest and back. Tough white expectoration appears
to be a characteristic and there is pain in region of third rib. about one or two inches from sternum (junction of
rib with its cartilage), generally on right side, but occasionally on the left.

author: Murphy
full:

Kidneys - Bladder feels distended. Frequent urination.
Liver - Aching in region of liver.
Lungs - Coryza with much lachrymation, sneezing and discharge of clear water from the nose. Symptoms
worse indoors. Constriction and rawness of throat. Tickling cough, worse in a warm room.
Male - Pain along spermatic cord, which feels full, as if has varicose veins.
Rectum - Itching of anus with white puttylike stools.
Skin - Itching of the soles, as if from chilblains. Gooseflesh.
