name: Anthracinum
author: Murphy
full:
(Anthrax Nosode) .
PHARMACY - anthr. Anthracinum. Anthrax nosode. Air alcoholic extract of the anthrax poison prepared from
the spleens of affected sheep. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Abscesses. Acne. Anthrax. Bites. Boils. Blisters. Bubo. Cancer, pains. Carbuncles. Cellulitis.
Chills. Coma. Delirium. Depression. Ecchymosis. Edema. Erysipelas. Gangrene. Gangrenous, ulcers.
Glands, swollen. Fevers. Hemophilia. Hemorrhages. Hydrophobia. Injuries. Malignant, pustules. Parotiditis,
gangrene. Phlegmonous, inflammation. Prostration. Pustules. Quinsy. Septic, fevers. Septicemia. Smallpox.
Splenic, fever. Sycosis, barbae. Ulceration. Ulcers. Weakness. Whitlow. Wounds. Zymotic fevers.
HOMEOPATHIC - Anthracinum was introduced into homeopathic practice by Lux, a veterinarian, long before
the experiments of Pasteur. The potential anthrax nosode is the best remedy for the disease from which it is
obtained, “splenic fever” in animals and “malignantpustule” in human beings. Epidemic spleen diseases
of domestic animals and in septic inflammation, carbuncles and malignant ulcers.
This nosode is a very valuable remedy in malignant or septic inflammation of connective or cellular tissue. It
produces boils or boil-like eruptions, carbuncles, malignant ulcers, abscesses, bubo, where there is purulent
focus. For boils and boillike eruptions, acne. Succession of boils or carbuncles. Suppurating, burning
abscesses, fetid pus. Recurrent abscesses.
Abscess of nasal septum. Quinsy. Gangrene, dissecting wounds. Offensive gangrenous ulcers. Parotiditis.
Foul secretions. Ulceration, sloughing andintolerable burning. Hard, stony swelling in region of right lower
jaw and submaxillary gland. Anthrax quinsy. Whitlow and sloughing. Glands painfully swollen. Black or blue
blisters. Foul erysipelas and gangrenous erysipelas, cellulitis.
Septicemia. Hemorrhages are thick, black tar-like from any orifice. Glands swollen, cellular tissue edematous
and indurated. Terrible burning with great .prostration. Black and blue Wisters. Insect stings. Bad effects
from inhaling foul odors.
Induration,, cellular tissue, glands, muscles. Lymphangitis. Inflammation after surgery. Injuries, blows, falls and
bruises. Injuries to bones, fractures. Compound fracture. Pain in cancerous affections. Burning pain, external.
Pyemia. Swelling of glands. Trembling, paroxysmal. Benign tumors. Angioma. Fungus hematodes.
Hemangioma. Atheroma. Steatoma.
Disorganization of blood. Congestion of blood. Convulsions, spasms, particularly in alcoholics. Clonic spasms.
External dropsy. Weakness, enervation, exhaustion, prostration, infirmity. Weakness during fever. Weakness
from perspiration. Wounds. Bites of dogs, poisonous animals. Snakes bites. Ailments from inhaling foul
odors. Poisoning with sewer gas.
In the treatment of carbuncles, remember the prescription of the prophet Isaiah for King Hezekiah's carbuncle
i.e., the pulp of a fig placed on a poultice and applied.
MIND-Anxiety, withfever. Confusion of mind. Disinclined to work, aversion to mental work. Depression, with
debility and chill. Silent grief. Irritability, restlessness, ner
vousness, at night. Sadness, despondency, depression, melancholy.
Delirium and excitement during fever. Oversensitive. Presentiment of death. Thinks she feels death
approaching. Hydrophobia. Makes animals howls, bite, run about, become greatly excited, followed by
paralytic symptoms. Collapse, unconsciousness, coma.
Abdomen - Distension. Swelling of the abdomen. Colicky pains. Bellyache with chill. Rumbling noises.
Abdominal soreness, in epigastrium with vomiting, cold limbs, dull head. Intestinal anthrax. Mesenteric glands
enlarged, size of a walnut. Dark red carbuncle in the omentum. Bubo. Burning, smarting pain.
Back - Axillary glands swollen. Eruptions. Carbuncles. Opisthotonos.
Blood - Septicemia, blood poisoning. Tendency to hemorrhage. Blood does not coagulate, hemophilia.
Bleeding from orifices. Bleeding, clots, dark, ropy, tenacious. Rapidly decomposing blood.
 Chest - Sensation as if diaphragm were pushed forward. Sensation of anxiety and constriction, in the
précordia. Swelling of axillary lymphatic tissue.
Ears - Ringing in ears. Swelling of ears.
Eyes - Dilatation of pupils. Pale yellowish or greenish swelling. Pale redness above the brows along the
forehead.
Face - Acne, boils and pustules. Parotiditis gangrenosa, after scarlatina. Abscess, lips.
I Cancer. Gland under chin painfully swol- ! len. Tearing pain. Earthy discoloration. I Red face and nose.
Swelling, face glands, lymphatic tissue. Erysipelas. Indurations. Sycosis barbae.
Food - Appetite wanting. Diminished appetite with fever. Loss of appetite with chills and gastralgia. Aversion
to eggs, odor of eggs. Excessive thirst, but can hardly swallow. Thirst with fever.
Head - Dullness in head ak from narcotics. Headache, as if a smoke With a heating pain was passing through
the head. Headache with chill. Carbuncles on head, near the ears or temples. Swelling of head. Cerebral
hemorrhage. Erysipelas. Swelling of dura mater.
Heart - Heartbeats frequent but weak. Soft, scarcely frequent pulse. Blood does not coagulate.
Jaws - Tearing pain in tower jaws. Lockjaw, trismus. Stiffness in jaws. Stony swelling around lower jaw.
Kidneys - Kidneys swollen with edema. Suppression of urine, anuria. Swelling.
Limbs - Burning pains. Coldness of lower limbs. Cramps. Severe pains in limbs and joints with the fever.
Convulsions, spasms. Tetanic spasms of upper limbs.
1, Cracked skin. Arms and hands covered with a crusty eruption, full of cracks. Felon with sloughing, severe
torturing pain and great prostration. Boils, blisters, and vesicles. Pustules. Whitlow. Gangrene from burns
or scalds. Gangrenous ulcers. Ulcers with black base on lower limbs. Swelling of limbs. (
Liver - Liver engorged. Congestion, liver. Lungs - Cyanosis.- Breathing frequent, laborious and spasmodic.-
Male - Erections, troublesome. Erections, continued, priapism.
Mouth - Flabby taste. Dark red, bloody ecchymoses of mouth. Hemorrhage, oozing of blood. Abscess, lips.
Pustules, lips. Black, lips. Erysipelas, lips. Offensive odor from mouth. Mouth could not be opened. Induration
of salivary, submaxillary glands. Inflammation of parotid gland. Saliva increased. Cancer of glands, salivary,
submandibular. Swelling of salivary, submaxillary glands.
Nerves - Epileptiform convulsions. Paroxysms of trembling. Clonic spasms, trismus or opisthotonos. Tetanic
spasms in upper limbs. Debility and depression, with pain in the limbs.
Nose - Eruptions, inside nose, boils, furuncles. Nose swollen and red, fetid smell from it. Bloody mucus
membranes of nose. Red discoloration of nose extending to cheek. Coryza. Discharge, offensive, fetid.
Smells putrid odors, imaginary and real. Swelling, nose.
Perspiration - Sweat all over with debility. Night sweats. Cold sweats. Debilitating, exhausting sweats. Sticky,
viscid sweats. Perspiration, suppressed.
Rectum - Vomiting followed by a painless, often bloody diarrhea. Diarrhea with fever. Diarrhea painless.
Cholera-like collapse. Diarrhea with bellyache. Retarded stool. Stools, white. Mucus, slimy stools. Odor, putrid.
Pasty, papescent stools. Sputtering stools.
Skin - Itching with dry skin. Dryness. Ec- chymosis. Boils, painful. Blood boils. Carbuncles, burning. Edema,
ulcers, gangrene, sloughing whitlows. Blackish eruptions. Black or blue blisters. Crusty oozing eruption.
Sloughing ulcers. Smallpox. Bluish spots, with burning. Red spots. Erysipelas. Pustules and vesicles.
Gangrene from bums’or scalds. Gangrenous ulcers. Ulcers, cancerous. Ulcers with offensive discharges.
Sleep - Sleeplessness because of the pain. Sleepless, restless and irritated at night. Delirium with sleepiness.
Sleep short, not refreshing, more like a stupor. Comatose. Unrefreshing sleep.
Spleen - Spleen, complaints of. Enlarged spleen. Epidemic spleen diseases of cattle or horses.
Stomach - Belching with nausea, and inclination to vomit. Nausea and vomiting with chill. Vomiting of bilious
and slimy masses. Vomiting followed by diarrhea. Pressure and burning in the region of the stomach. Burning
pains. Vomiting of bile, mucus.
Temperature - Creeping' chills. Debility with chills. Chills, alternating with heat. Great weakness with fever.
Fever with diarrhea. Continued fever, typhus fever. Typhoid fever, with rapidly sinking pulse, loss of strength,
fainting, delirium. Puerperal fever. Septic fevers. Zymotic fevers.
Throat - Right tonsil painful. Anthrax quinsy. Malignant sore throat. Swallowing difficult. Bleeding, oozing,
tonsils. Sore throat. Tonsillitis. Swelling, edematous.
Tongue - Tongue ofteirfurred, with a thick brown coat, dry.
Urine - Pale urine. Profuse, increased urine. Scanty urine. Watery, clear as water.
Vertigo - Dizziness with headaches. Vertigo with loss of consciousness.
COMMENTS - Great restlessness. Debility and depression with pains in limbs and general sense of malaise,
followed by disturbance of the intestines. Restlessness. Clonic and tetanic spasms. Exhaustion and collapse.
 Terrible burning pains.
Malignant boils. Severe boils that are very painful, with a tendency toward gangrene or cancer, or that refuse
to heal (Tarant., Sil., Hep., and Bell.). Boils that come in crops all over the body. Keynote severe burning pains
(Canth.). Ulcers with terrible burning. Induration of tissues. Hypersensitivity to the least touch, so they can't
wear any clothes.               .
Completely exhausted, think they feel death. Collapse, with difficulty of breathing, loss of consciousness,
death. Cyanosis, asphyxia and the most extreme collapse, followed by death in all cases of bleeding.
Hemorrhage of dark blood (Croc.), keynote black, stringy hemorrhages.
RELATIONS»- Antidoted by: Camph., Ars., Rhus-t., Sil.? Lach., Carb-v., Puls., Kreos., Carb-ac., Sal-ac.,
Apis. Similarto: Ars., which it often follows. Tarent-c. Compare: ( 1) Ars., Tarent-c., Carb-v., Pyrog., Lach.,
Crot-h., Hippozaen, Echi. Follows well: Ars. - burning and ulceration, Ph-ac. Followed well by: Aur-m-n. -
periosteal swelling of lower jaw, Sil. - cellulitis. •

name: Antimonium Arsenicosum

full:

CLINICAL - Asthma. Catarrhal pneumonia. Dyspnea. Edema. Emphysema. Heart weakness. Influenza. Low,
appetite. Lung, disorders. Myocarditis. Ophthalmia. Pericarditis. Pleurisy. Pneumonia. Sciatica. Tuberculosis.

affect preferably upper left lung. Emphysema with excessive dyspneaandcough, much mucus secretion.
Dyspnea, worse on eating and lying down. Sense of weakness..
 Catarrhal pneumonia associated with influenza. Mattes said it is equally effective in right-side^ases in old
pneumonias and catarrhal pneumonias in children in old pleuritic effusions and in pericardial exudations. Loss
of appetite. General sick feeling.
The cough is worse by eating and on lying down. Pleurisy especially of left side with exudation and pericarditis
with effusion. Rush of blood to head. Inflammation of the eyes and edema of the face. Wandering pains in
sciatic nerves. Myocarditis and cardiac weakness.
COMMENTS - Boericke said “emphysema with excessive dyspnea,” difficulty in breathing, cough with a lot of
mucus. Catarrhal pneumonia associated with influenza. Other lung disorders, tuberculosis. Worse on eating
and lying down, low appetite. Sense of weakness. Pleurisy, especially of left side, with exudation and
pericarditis with effusion.

name: Antimonium Crudum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ant-c. Antimonium crudum. Native Sulphide of Antimony. Antimonium sulphuratum nigrum.
Stibium sulfuratum nigrum crudum. Historical doye: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne. Alcoholism. Amenorrhea. Anus, irritation. Arthritis. Backache. Belching. Blepharitis.
Boils. Bunions. Callosities. Catarrh. Chills. Chotea. Constipation. Corns. Deafness. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia.
Eczema. Emaciation. Feet, sore. Fever. Food, allergies. Freckles. Gastrointestinal, disorders. Gout. Grief.
Gum rash. Headaches. Heartburn. Heatstroke. Hemorrhoids. Hoarseness. Horny, growths. Hysteria.
Indigestion. Leucorrhea. Marasmus. Nails,fungus. Nails, split nausea. Nettle rash. Nosebleed. Nym-
phomania. Obesity. Otorrhea. Premenstrual, syndrome. Proctitis. Prolapsed,rectum. Red gum. Remittent,
fever. Rheumatism. Skin, disorders. Stomach, disorders. Suicidal. Sunstroke. Tendons, inflamed. Tongue,
coated. Toothache. Urticaria. Vertigo. Voice, low. Vomiting. Warts. Whooping cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - Ant-c. is pre-eminently a stomach and skin remedy. It corresponding to constitutions with
tendency to growths and rough scaling skin with horny patches. These homy patches are very tender, the
patient can hardly bear to walk on therfi. Fungus under nails. Nails tend to grow in splits. Warts.
Boericke said, “thickly coated white tongue are. true guiding symptoms.” Fis-' sures on comer of the
mouth that split and crack (Petr.). Lips are dry and cracked, usually at comers. Thickly coated tongue, white,
milky-white or like whitewash evenly laid. The edges may be red and sore. Sore, cracked and erusty nostrils
and comers of mouth.
Chronic indigestidh. Patient can have a big appetite, eats beyond the capacity of his digestion or without
discrimination, the mental and skin symptoms can be due to this disturbance. Exceedingly weak condition of
the body.
Abnormal hunger, not relieved by eating, emptiness of epigastrium and want of animal heat. Gastric
derangements, with z tongue coated thickly white, with different complaints. Disgust for all foods.
Nursing iv children throw up a little sour milk as soon to as they take the breast or bottle, then refuses to nurse
again (Aeth. after vomiting the child tr sleeps and wakes hungry).
rri Heartburn, gas. Food allergies, especially
tjto sour wines and vinegar. Intolerance to il s wine. In one case it produced *a feeling of h. intoxication like
that of alcohol, so that the patient refused to take any more of it.
Chronic complaints that are traceable to suppression of eruptions or ulcers. Effects of suppressed eruptions.
Worse by heat (Apis, b Puls,, Cham., Sec., Camph.). Worse from s cold washing, cold water and cold food.
Cannot bear heat of sbn.
bh- 'An absence of pain, where it Would be expected. Rheumatism and gout if parts are inflamed o» swollen.
Gout with stomach symptoms. Acute gout having left deposits with gastric symptoms. Inveterate chronic gout
without fever. Dark hemorrhages. Dropsical swelling of whole body.
Mucus membranes generally affected. Swelling pain and redness of glands. Exter- 1® nal parts turn black, dry
gangrene. Obesity n of young people. Tendency to grow fat. MArasmus of children. Emaciation. Glandular
obstructions. Scrofula. Fungus articularis. Metastasis of gout and rheumatism causing gastric catarrh.
Anasarca.
MIND - Excessive irritability and fretfulness, with a thickly-coated white tongue. Fretful cross and peevish.
Adults are sulky, do not wish to speak with anyone. Angry at every little attention. Homesickness. Weeping
and impressionable.
Nervous hysterical girls and women, who are overcome by mellow light from stained- glass windows.
Sentimentalmoodby moonlight. Dreamy, sentimental. Amativeness. Ill effects of disappointed love, grief.
 Ecstasy and exalted love. Love sick, with sulkiness. Sulky, doesn't want te speak with anyone. Either
sentimental or cross and touchy during; diarrhea and before menses.
The child is cross, but will scream at every little attention (Cham, wants to be carried). Child cannot bear to
be touched or looked at (Nat-m.). Can’t bear to be washed or touched. Anger when touched. Peevishness,
worse touch orconsolation. Very sentimental, easily moved, more so in the adult. Nymphomania during
suppressed menses. Disposition to start, even at slight noises.
v. Excitability. Anxious reflections in relation to one’s present and future. Can be anxious about their fate,
health and future. Cross and contradictive, whatever is done fails to give satisfaction. Sleepy and weary. Talks
in rhymes or verses, taciturn. So - busy with oneself one forgets to urinate or defecate, eats only when asked.
Loathing of food, bathing etc.
Great sadness and woeful mood. Sorrowful, irritable humor. Distrustful. Suicidal depression. Inclination to
shoot himself, at night he is obliged to get out of bed because he can’t free himself of the idea. Loathing,
disgust for life. Abject despair, wants to commit suicide by drowning. Mental symptoms are worse from
suppressed eruptions (Mez.). Suicidal thoughts drive him out of bed.
Abdomen - Inflation of the abdomen with a sensation of fullness, chiefly after a meal. Abdomen very much
distended, with much rumbling. Colic with loss of appetite, hard stool, red urine. Sensation of emptiness in
the abdomen, as after violent diarrhea. Sensation of swelling and of hardness in the inguinal region, on its
being pressed. Incarcerated flatus. Flatus in the abdomen with rumbling and bor- borygmi. Cutting in
bowels with watery diarrhea. Violent cutting pains, sometimes with want of appetite, red urine and hard ' I
stools. Pinching pain and sensation as if diarrhea would come on.
Back - Itching and pain of neck and back. Violent pain in small of back when rising, better when walling. Coccyx
heavy. Swelling of cervical glands. Spasmodic drawing, in muscles of nape, reaching to scapulae. Backache
evening after lying down and in morning. Backache worse stooping, exerting arms and turning head to left.
Spasmodic stitches in right scapula when sitting.
Causations - Ill effects of disappointed love, grief and suppressed eruptions. Hot weather or sun. Getting over-
heated, Overeating.
Chest - Stifling oppression and paralytic orthopnea. Shootings in the chest, when -c1' drawing breath and at
other times. Itch- 5o ing of chest with oppression. Pain, as if contusion in the pectoralis major, on raissing
the arm and on pressure. Sharp pain under left breast. Burning pain in the chest oP with heat. Pains during
fever. Oppression and pressive pains, more right side. Sharp pains in chest when exhaling. Burning and
sticking pains. Severe itching upon chest continuing all day.
Constitutions - Suited to infants and chilis dren with coated, moist, white tongues and in the elderly.
Hydrogenoid constitutions.
Tendency to grow fát. Constitutions with tendency to rough scaling skin with horny zu patches. A scrofulous
medicine.
Cough - Cough in paroxysms, as if-arising from abdomen, first paroxysm always most severe, subsequent
ones weaker and weaker, until the last one only resembles a hacking cough. Burning with dry cough and
dyspnea. Burning at every cough. Cough in hot sun. Cough with hot breath. Cough shaking whole body, with
involun- Lt tary escape of copious urine. Cough on coming into warm room. Cough from cold air. Cough
with burning sensation inchest, -w itching of chest, oppression. Looking into os: fire aggravates cough. Cough
after rising in morning.
Ears - Redness and swelling, pain in eusta- h chian tube. Ringing and deafness. Moist eruption around ear.
Otorrhea. Deafness, J i. as if bandaged or a leaf lying on ear.
Eyes - Dull, sunken, red, itch inflamed, agglutinated. Canthi are raw, fissured and cracked, red and moist,
Itching in canthi, Chronic blepharitis. Pustules on cornea and on the margins of the lids. Looking into the fire
causés cough. Inflammation of lachrymal glands and ducts. Chronic sore eyes of children. Photophobia. Dried
mucus in corners. Eyes worse glare of snow.
Face - Acne worse near fire. Dry lips. Eczema about mouth. Pimples, pustules and boils on face. Eruption like
nettlerash. Freckles. Yellow crusted eruption on cheeks and chin. Sallow, haggard or sad. Cracks in the
comers of the mouth. Comers of lips and nostrils cracked and sore. Burning, stinging on chin, as from a hot
spark. Small, sore, honey colored granules on chin. Sharp pain in left cheek when exhaling. Twitching of facial
muscles. Heat and itching on cheeks. Submaxillary glands swollen.
Female - Menses too early and profuse. Premenstrual syndrome. Toothache before menses. Amenorrhea.
Menses suppressed from cold bathing. Menses suppressed with feeling of tenderness of the ovaries,
pressure in womb as if something would come out during menses. Painful ovaries in love sick girls. Leucorrhea
watery, acrid, lumpy. Nymphomania from checked menses. Excited, genitals itch. Nausea, vomiting with
diarrhea, all during pregnancy. Hemorrhoidal affections during pregnancy. Tenderness of ovarian region, with
 nausea, vomiting and white tongue. Irritable, painful ovaries of hysterical girls who are dreamers, who suffer
from unrequited affections. Watery vaginal discharge causes smarting down thighs.
Food -Loss of appetite with disgust for food. Great desire to eat, but gets no strength. Appetite does not
return after severe illness. Food leaves an aftertaste or causes constant belching. Good appetite with burning
at pit of stomach. Diminished appetite in summer owing to heat. Loathing of food with a bitter taste. Long-
lasting loss of appetite with disgust for all food. Hunger early on waking without appetite, eating does not
better it. Desire for acids, sour pickles. Desit^ for cucumbers, sour, wine, vinegar. Desire for beer with chill.
Intense thirst with dryness of lips, more at night. Patient is a gross feeder, a glutton, he eats beyond the
capacity of his digestion or without discrimination.
Head - Headaches, worse in vertex, on ni ascending. Headaches from disordered stomach. Headache
worse candy or acid wines, fruits, fats, ascending stairs. Headache from alcoholic drinks. Suppressed
eruptions. Heaviness in forehead with vertigo, nausea and nosebleed. Headaches from bathing in cold
water. Headache after stopped coryza. Headache with great loss of hair. Itching of the head with falling of
hair. Tendency to take cold about sfrii n head. Heaviness in forehead with vertigo, nausea and nosebleed.
Lentil-sized, flat tubercles here and there on scalp, painful to pressure, crawling sensation around them. Rush
of blood to head, followed by nosebleed.
Heart - Violent palpitations. Pulse extremely irregular, now accelerated and again slow. Pulse changing every
few biu. beats. Slow pulsation during fine prick- on ii.- ing headache. •
Kidneys-Urine is turbqi and has a foul odor, ah Cutting iiTurethra while urinating. Tenesmus of bladder rouses
him from sleep at night Urination is frequent, profuse with burning and backache. Involuntary urination, on
coughing. Gritty sediment. Suit Frequent urination with much mucus, intense burning in urethra and backache
during emission.
Larynx - Heat in larynx in open air. Voice harsh and badly pitched. Voice, lacks control, harsh, badly pitched
better using it. Aphonia from overheating. Laryngitis, Rough voice from over use. Hoarseness after cold water
bath. Great weaknes or entire loss of the voice, chiefly on becoming warm. Sensation of a foreign substance
in the larynx with inability to expectorate. Violent spasm in the larynx with sensation of excoriation.
Limbs - Lassitude, tremulous fatigue and heaviness of all limbs. Twitching of muscles. Jerks in arms. Limbs
weak during headache. Arthritic pain in joints of fingers. Horny or split nails. Nails brittle, grow out of
shape. Horny growth under the nails. Skin beneath nails painfully nom. sensitive. Discolored nails. Horny
warts on hands and soles. Weakness and shakinof hands in writing followed by offensive flatulence. Painful
stiffness of knee. Pustules on thighs. Inflamed corns. Pain in heels. Painful inflammation of the tendon of
elbows with great redness and curvature of the arms. Shiny elbows. Callosities on soles. Skinon solesis
withered on account of foot sweat. Feet very tender, covered with large horny places. Rheumatic pain,
in legs. Numbness of legs during rest and while sitting. Weakness and shaking of hands in writing, followed by
offensive flatus. Crippled feet.
Lungs - Deep, sighing, as from fullness of chest, afternoon and after eating. Unequal breathing, during sleep.
Oppression coming from stomach. Constriction almost to suffocation. Spells of sighing. Difficult breathing, with
raised shoulders. Respiration deep with sighing. Expectoration of large quantities of mucus, exhausts the
patient.
Male - Eruption on scrotum and about . genitals. Impotence.. Atrophy of penis and testicles. Biting, itching of
scrotum with eruptions. Excited sexual desire with uneasiness of the whole body. Nightly pollutions with or
without voluptuous dreams. Itching of penis, of tip of glans. Erections when getting warm in bed, with
sleeplessness.
Modalities - Better in open air. Better moist warmth. Better during rest. Better lying down. Worse in evening.
Worse at night. Worse moonlight. Worse water, wet poultices. Worse cold bathing, cold water (on head).
Worse dampness. Worse radiated heat. Worse heat from sun. Worse from acids, vinegar. Worse sweets,
wine, pork. Worse overeating, debauches. Worse after getting drunk. Worse rising up. Worse ascending
stairs. Worse touch.
Mouth - Aphthae. Dryness of mouth. Gums bleed easily. Taste bitter. Pappy taste. Salivation, taste sklty.
Tongue coated thick white, as if whitewashed. Canker sores. Sore feeling and redness on border of tongue.
Much slimy mucus. Pimples around the mouth. Rawness of palate, with expectoration of much mucus.
Nose - Fluent or dry coryza. Nostrils •2u‘t chapped and covered with crusts. Stuffed nose in a heated room.
Eczema of nostrils, sore, cracked and scurfy. Nosebleed and headache. Nosebleed, evenings with rush
of blood to head. Feeling of coldness on in- tow halation. Nose painful when breathing.
Perpiration - Hot sweat. Perspires at same mi hour every other day. Sweats in morning but when awaking,
causes shrivelling of to - fingertips. Sweat soon disappears and followed by dry heat. Cold, clammy sweat from
motion. Sweats during rheumatic to pains. Sweats during headache.
 Rectum - Anal itching. Burning, itching and fissures in the anus. Diarrhea alternating with constipation. Acrid
diarrhea. Diar- Ito^d rhea in summer. Diarrhea, worse during headache. Diarrhea with much belching.
Hemorrhoids, bliijd and running with burning and tingling. Mucus hemorrhoids, prickling and burning with
continuous tuo< mucus discharge from anus, staining yellow. Catarfhal proctitis. Flow of black blood from
the anus. Abuse of laxatives. Constipation in heat of summer, in bed Soreness in rectum as if an ulcer has
been torn open, during stool. Expansive pressure in the rectum during stool as if an ulcer had been torn open.
Burning furunculus in the perineum. Rectal hemorrhage with solid stools, hemorrhoids. Boils on perineum,
burning around them.
Skin - Freckles become numerous. Eczema with gastric derangements. Pimples, vesicles and pustules,
pimples and vesicles as from stings of insects. Pustules here and there with brown scurf. Eruptions worse heat
of stove, etc. Sensitive to cold bathing. Thick, hard, honey-colored scabs. Urticaria. Urticaria, white with red
areola, itching fearfully. Itching when warm in bed. Itching of skin, feels sore when scratched. Skin diseases
during pregnancy. Measles-like eruptions. Dry gangrene. Scaly, pustular eruption with burning and itching,
worse at night. Callosities from slight pressure, ulcers become fistulous. Deep, spongy ulcers. Smooth warts.
Warts (Thuj., Sabin., Caust.).
Sleep - Great sleepiness during day. Deep unrefreshing sleep, can hardly rise in morning, so tired. Sleepy and
weary. Drowsiness in elderly people. Strong inclination to sleep during the day, chiefly in the evening or
morning. Waking with fright during the night. Frequent waking from itching here and there. Sleeplessness with
shivering over left side. Dreams, anxious, horrible, voluptuous or painful. Dreams full of quarreling. Anxious
dreams, as if he were to be hurt. Horrible dreams, about mutilation of men. Coma with, delirium.
Stomach - Digestion disordered easily. Heartburn, nausea, vomiting. Burning, spasmodic pains, driving to
despair. Gastric derangements, with tongue coated thickly white, with different complaints. After
nursing, the child vomits its milk in curds and refuses to nurse afterwards and is very cross. Great desire to
eat, but no strength to do it. Eructation tasting of the ingesta. Gastrointestinal complaints from bread and
pastry, acids, sour wine, pork, cold bathing, overheating, hot weather. Constant belching. Gouty moves to
stomach and intestines. Indigestion, c chronic. Sweetish water brash. Bloating after eating. Sensation of
emptiness in stomach. Stomach seems to be always overloaded. Stomach is painful to pressure. Nausea with
diarrhea. Loathing nausea, and desire to vomit. Vomiting, worse eating or drinking, without nausea or relief.
Nausea ceases, vomiting continues. Vomiting, fearful with convulsions, which nothing can stop. Vomiting of
slimy mucus and bile.
Stool - Stools composed entirely of mucus. Hard and loose stools, with nausea. Stools watery, containing
undigested food. Diarrhea after acids, sour wine, baths, overeating. Diarrhea alternates with constipation,
especially in elderly ' people. Diarrhea, watery with cutting pains. Urgent inclination to go to stool. Stools
composed entirely of mucus, pappy. Constant secretion of yellowish-white ' ' mucus by the anus. Difficult
evacuation of hard stools, the feces are too large in size. Stools of hard lumps mixed with « watery
discharge. Diarrhea during summer after nursing.
Teeth - Gums detach from teeth, bleed easily. Grinding of teeth, when sleeping in sitting position. Pains in
hollow teeth. Toothache worse touching tooth with rrtongue, better walking in open air. Teeth noi! so sore it
seems one can hardly bear the dental operation. Toothache in hollow teeth, worse night, touching tooth with
tongue causes pain as if nerve were torn.Sharp pains in tooth when’inspiring air. Toothache before menses.
Temperature - Chill predominating during day. Violent chill, shaking, toward noon, with thirst. Chill over back,
feet cold as ice, with sweat on rest of body. Chill at every motion, with cough. Chill after vomiting. Chill before
menses. Chilly even in warm room. Disturbances of stomach during apyrexia in intermittent fevers. Intermittent
fever with disgust, nausea, vomiting, ¿ belchings, ¿oated tongue, diarrhea. Hot sweat. Great heat from little
exercise, especially in the sun. Heat and thirst after sweat. Fever at night. Body hot, limbs cold, during cough.
Fever with desire to sleep and want of thirst.
Throat - Much thick yellowish mucus from posterior sinuses. Hawking in open air. Great heat in the throat
while moving in the open air. Sensation as if a foreign body had lodged with constant desire to 1B' swallow.
Vertigo - Confusion of head, as after long labor in the cold. A feeling of intoxication.
Vertigo with nausea and nosebleed. Ver- ' ,l; tigo with nausea and confused feeling, as if drunk. Vertigo during
headache. Vertigo from deranged stomach.
COMMENTS - Restlessness and jerking of muscles. Slight noises startle. Nosebleed with vertigo after
headache after rush of blood to head. Gastric and remittent fevers and fevers of children with great thirst and
the characteristic white tongue. The fever runs higher at night. Tendency to take cold about head. .,
Scrofulous ophthalmia, canthi especially affected (Graph, the whole margin).
Otorrhea. Moist eruption behind ears (Graph.). Itching of the scalp and hair falling out.
Fungus infections or deformity of the nails, calluses from pressure, corns, painful bunions, painful warts and
 horny warts (excrescences). Good for warts that grow next to the nail and bleed and irritate. Thickened skin,
spots on the nails, nails that split, “crippled nails.” Arthritis and deformative arthritis of the fingers and toes.
Constipation and other intestinal disorders. Severe gastric flu with a white tongue. Chronic indigestion.
Diarrhea which alternates with constipation, often found in old people, “stomach weak, digestion easily
disturbed in old people.” Anal fissures (Graph., Sil.). Continuously oozing hemorrhoids, staining linen.
General symptoms are worse heat of sun, sun gives headache, worse bathing or change of weather.
Intoxicated easily from wine (Zinc., Chin., Caps.), face flushes after a couple sips. May cough if they look at a
fire or will be aggravated by radiant heat. Worse from heat, but great sensitiveness to cold. Suitable to the
hydrogenoid constitutions. Tendency toward obesity.
A student, 17, had twenty-three warts on right hand and thirty-four warts on the left hand. Mainly on backs and
fingers, but a few on interior surface of fingers. In addition, inflammation of eyelids. Ant-c. 200x cured her of
warts in 7 weeks.
Dr. M. Jousset has recorded a severe case of chorea which resisted all the usual remedies and was cured
with Ant-c. prescribed on the digestive symptoms, particularly the characteristic white tongue. Ant-c.
corresponds in a sense to the swine, as Ars. does to horses and Puls, to sheep.
RELATIONS - Antidote to: Stings of insects. Antidoted by: Calc., Hep., Merc. Bry. Compare: (1) Nat-m„
Ant-t., Antimonium Chlo- ridum. (2) Kermes mineral - Stibiat sulph. rub. - Bronchitis. (3) Also Puls, Ip., Sulph.
(4) Aethi-a., Am-m., Apis, Bry., Graph., Ran-b., Rhus-t., Vario., Cham., Chin, and Hep., Rhus-t,
Sep. and Spig. (5) Sulph. - Averse to be washed, digestive condition, loaded tongue and worse from warmth
in summer complaints. (6)Stram. - averse to be looked at. Complementary: Squil., Sulph. Follows well: Puls.,
Ip. Followed by: Puls., Merc., Sulph.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

author: Murphy
full:

HOMEOPATHIC - Recommended by Hale in cases of uterine hyperplasia, also in cases of humid asthma,
bronchitis and other pulmonary disorders. Inability'to raise the sputum, especially in the aged and weak
patients. Pneumonia. Stage of resolution of pneumonia slow and delayed.
In sub-acute and chronic colds in chest which have extended downwards from head and into the bronchial
tubes in the form of hard, croupy cough with a decided wheeze.
Indicated by frequent spells of coughing with expectoration of frothy, white or thick ;i yellowish mucus. Loss of
appetite and strength. Moderate febrile action. Coated tongue. Yellowish discoloration of skin and conjunctive,
sweaty. Dull and drowsy.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

pupils, sunken, lusterless eyes. Nausea and vomiting, burning pains in throat and stomach, frequent abortive

becomes black. Abrasions. Great prostration of strength.
MIND - Stupor, but from which he could be aroused by questions. Stupor with cold feet. Insensibility.

name: Antimonium Oxydatum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-ant-o. Antimonium oxydatum.
 Antimonious oxide. Antimony sesquiôxide. Fumes from antimony works. Trituration. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL-Bloody urine. Cough. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Headache. Impotence. Intermittent, fever.
HOMEOPATHIC - Great relaxation of the whole organism.
Abdomen - Distended by incarcerated gases.
Back - Sharp pains in the sacro-lumbar region.
Bladder - Pains and urging at neck of bladder, and burning in the urethra during urination. Discharge of a few
drops of mucus from the urethra. Gonorrhealike discharge from the urethra. Urine of a deep orange-yellow
color, almost red. Deep-red and bloody urine, causing burning in the urethra, from which exuded a whitish
mucus after cessation of the bloody urine. |
Chest - Very great constriction of the chest, with stitches. Sharp stitches through the chest, towards the
shoulders and back. Violent stitches in chest, with dry cough.
Head - Lightning-like stitches through the . head backward, which suddenly disappear, while the headache in
the forehead - > remains. Slight headache increases to an r.p intolerable degree.
Lungs - Cough violent, shattering, dry, with stitches in chest. Cough dry, painful, lt. finally ends in a difficult
expectoration of tenacious mucus. Respiration difficult, with mucus and sibilant rales over the chest.
Male - Penis flaccid. Complete impotence, no ejaculation of semen, âhd even no erections. Atrophy of testicles
and penis. Pains in the testicles.
Mouth - Tongue coated white.
Rectum - Diarrhea, with griping pains in abdomen. Stools troublesome, frequent, consisting of food evacuated
soon after eating.
Skin - Pustular eruption on lower abdomen, neck, body. Eruption thickest on genitals, in the bends of the limbs,
on nates, and especially OQ thighs ancfscrotum. Pustular elevations, like pocks, on the scrotum.
Temperature - Very profuse and debilitating sweats during sleep. Very tormenting, pouring sweat, every time
after sleeping, followed by great exhaustion. Complaints assume the form of intermittent fever.
REFERENCES - Murphy.

name: Antimonium Sulphuratum Auratum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ant-s. Antimonium sulphuratum auratum. Gold sulphuret of antimony. Trituration. Historical
dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne. Amaurosis. Bronchial, catarrh. Catarrh. Constipation. Corneal spots. Diarrhea.
Indigestion. Iris, protruding. Itching. Lung, congestion. Nasal, catarrh. Nosebleed. Pneumonia.
HOMEOPATHIC - In its provings, the most notable effects were produced in the eye and chest As with the
other Antinomies, there is disordered digestion, g^sty mouth and taste in morning.
Chronic nasal and bronchial catarrh. Increase of tough mucus in larynx and bronchi, respiration difficult.
Dry, hard cough with passive congestion of upper lobe of left lung. Nosebleed on washing. Itching on hands
and feet.
Burning in head with eye complaints. Amaurosis (commencing). Spots on cornea and hypopion. Acne.
Abdomen - Pressure, tension and fullness in abdomen. Umbilical region sensitive. Violent colic and rumbling
around navel.
Eyes - Amaurosis, commencing. Spots on cornea. Iris protruding through cornea.
Face -Pustular acne.
Food - Loss of appetite, almost a loathing of food.
Head - Pfessive pains. Burning pain in head, with eye complaints. Reddish swelling behind right ear, leaving
a redness and scurfiness.
Kidneys - Urine increased, dark red.
Limbs - Itching on hands and feet. Arms heavy in morning. Boring and tearing pain in arms and hand-joints.
Swelling of fingers..
Lungs - Accumulation of tough mucus in bronchi andlarynx. Tiçklingin larynx./n- creasedmucus with fullness
in bronchials. Respiration difficult, pressure in bronchi with constriction. Dry, hard cough, no expectoration.
Congestion of upper lobe of left lung. Winter coughs, patient is sore all over. Pneumonia, when hepatization
occurred and resolution failed to take place. Increased mucus sputum, mixed with blood of a sweetish taste.
Passive congestion of upper lobe left lung with hard, dry cough.
Male - Pustular eruption on scrotum with much itching. .
Mouth - Metallic taste. Pasty mouth and taste in morning.
Nose - Nosebleed on washing the face. Increased secretion in nose and throat. Loss of smell. I
 Rectum - Passage of much flatus with sud- ¿I, den urging, followed by a solid stool at 3^ first, then bright
yellow and pasty stool.
Constipation. Feces hard and passed with difficulty. .      .        ,>t
Skin - Acne, pustular variety. Itching on hands and feet.
Sleep - Deep sleep. Wakes after midnight with dull headache. Wakes with restless- e ness and sexual desire.
Awoke suddenly with heavy, confused head, pressure in stomach, difficult breathing. Sleep dreamy.
Stomach - Pressure and fullness in stomach and abdomen, umbilical region sensitive.
Stool - Passage of much flatus with sudden urging, followed by a stool, solid at first then bright yellow and
pasty, afterwards violent colic and rumbling around navel. Constipation, feces hard and passed with difficulty.
Throat - Increased secretion in nose and throat. Rough and scrapy feeling. Metallic styptic taste. Burning or
heat in fauces. Mucus from throat becomes offensive to smell. Pressure in throat as if a plug stuck in it.
Scratching, rough feeling in throat in jporning. Tickling in larynx. Accumulation of tough mucus in larynx and
bronchi.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Other Ahtimo- nies. (2) Aur. - chest, Ars., Ferr., Merc-sulph., Sulph. (3) Am-c. -

name: Antimonium Tartaricum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ant-t. Antimonium tartaricum. Tartaremetic.TartrateofAntimony and potash. Trituration and
solutions. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Alcoholism. Aphthae. Asphyxia. Asthma. Bilharziasis. Bilious disorders. Bronchitis.
Catarrh. Chickenpox. Chills. Cholera. Cholera morbus. Colic. Coughs. Croup. Delirium. Delirium, Tremens.
Dyspepsia. Emphysema. Eruptions. Eyes, inflamed. Gasping. Gastric, disorders. Headache. Hematuria.
Hydrocephalus. Impetigo. Intermittent fever. Laryngitis. Leucorrhea. Vnrcbago.Lungs,disorders.
Lungs,paralysis. Muscle pain. Nausea. Parkinson's disease. Plica polonica. Pneumonia. Psoriasis. Pustules.
Rheumatism. Ringworm. Smallpox.
Stiff-neck. Sycosis. Synovitis. Taste, altered. Thirst Tongue, coated. Tremors. Vomiting. Warts. Weakness.
Whooping cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - Tartar emetic of the Alchemists. Ant-t. resembles closely Ant-c. and the other Antimonies
in its action, though the modalities differ. Ant-t. was the favorite emetic historically, and consequently it is one
of our best remedies in states of nausea. The nausea is as intense as that of Ip., but less persistent and is
better by vomiting.
A correspondent related the case of an apprentice who had been employed for a week making up “cough-
balls” and diuretic balls for horses, both containing powdered antimony. He had been cautioned not to inhale
the powder, but his employer believes he did. At the end of the week he was seized with an illness due, his
employer thinks and no doubt correctly, to the antimony.
Affects the mucus membranes especially of the bronchials and lungs. Ant-t. has many symptoms in common
with Ant-c., but also many peculiar to itself. Cyanosis, depression of vital power.
Rattling of mucus with little expectoration. Great accumulation of mucus with coarse rattling, impeded
respiration and labored heart action, defective oxygenation in the circulation of blood.
Complaints arising in digestive sphere. Gastric disorders of alcoholics and gouty subjects. Cholera morbus.
Patient becomes increasingly weak, sweats, become drowsy and relaxed with lack of reaction.
Prostrated in mind and body. Sensation of coldness in blood vessels. Bilharziasis. Ant-t. acts indirectly on the
parasites by stimulating the oxidizing action of the protective substance. Lumbago. Chills and contractures
with pain in muscles.
Chronic trembling of head and hands, as in Parkinson's disease. Trembling of whole body, great prostration
and faintness. Warts on glans penis. Convulsive twitching. Convulsions when eruptions fail to appear. Ant-t. is
homeopathic to dysuria, strangury, hematuria, albuminuria, catarrh of bladder and urethra, burning in rectum,
bloody mucus stools, etc.
Nursing infants let go the nipple and cry out as if out of breath. Child continuously wishes to be carried
erect, unwilling to be looked at or touched. Children have convulsions if attention is thrust upon them. Clings
to attendants.
MIND - Great despondency. Fearofbeing alone. Fretfulness, whining and crying, before the attack of sickness.
Bad mood. Frightened, at trifles. Muttering, delirium and stupor. Stupid on awakening.
Melancholic, complains of numerous suffering. Despairs of his recovery. Anxious, despairing. Anxiety during
nausea. Peevish, whining and moaning. Child will nof be touched without whining. Can't bear to be looked
 at. Child clings to those around, calls for help in a hoarse voice, with cough. Restlessness in children, better
being carried about. Dreads being left alone, lest he should be very nervous. Contradiction between mind and
will. Pitiful whining before and during attacks. Hopeless and despairing when awake. Clings to attendants.
Apathy or easily annoyed, wants to be let Jl alone Furious delirium. Talking to himself. Boldness. Desire to bite.
Wild gaiety, •'‘towards evening. Consciousness wanes oh closing eyes.
Abdomen - Burning pain in abdomen. Feels •“ as if full of stones. Painless rumbling. Flat- -'(H ulence, with
rumbling in bowels. Violent -^ colic with drowsiness. Colic, as if bowels would be cut to pieces. Spasmodic
cough, much flatus. Sharp, cutting colic before n« stool. Colic around umbilicus, better after stool. Pressure in
abdomen, especially on i stooping forward. Pain in the groins and ht' cold creeps before menses.
Back - Lumbago. Violent pain in sacrolumbar region. Slightest effort to move may cause retching and cold,
clammy sweat. Worse lifting. Sensation as if a heavy load was hanging on end of coccyx, dragging
downwards all time. Twitching of muscles, limbs tremulous. Vertebrae seem to rub against each other. Cramp
in gi muscles of neck. Burning in back.
Causations - Effects df anger (cough) or vexation. Ill effects of vaccination when Thuj. fails and Sil. is not
indicated.
Chest - Rattling of mucus in the chest when breathing. Velvety feeling in chest. Burning sensation in chest,
which ascends to throat. Paralysis of the lungs. Anxious oppression of the chest, with a sensation of heat,
which ascends to the heart. Rheumatic pain in the left side of the chest. Miliary eruption.
Constitutions - Suited to old people and children. Gouty subjects and alcoholics with gastric disorders.
Hydrogenoid type constitutions. Torpid and phlegmatic constitutions. Worn-out constitutions.
Coughs - Gasping for air, before every attack of cough. Coarse, loose, rattling cough. Cough followed by
vomiting or sleep worse anger. Lungs seems full of mucus yet less and less is raised. Must sit up to
breathe or cough. Coughs and yawns alternately. Coughing and gasping. Cough excited by eating with pain
in chest and larynx. Cough and dyspnea better lying on right side (opposite Bad.). Child bends backwards with
cough.
Ears - Roaring. Fluttering before left ear, as from a large bird. Warmth of left ear. Tearing pain. Twitching in
right ear.
Eyes - Eyes sunken, surrounded by dark circles. Eyes bloodshot. Weak, tired eyes. Eyeballs as if bruised.
Dim, swimming eyes. Burning and smarting pain. Tearing pain in eyes. Collection of mucus in margins of lids
(in pneumonia). Conjunctivitis with much lachrymation. Pustular eruptions on the conjunctiva. Lachrymation
when yawning. Flickering, sparks before the eyes. Eyes staring. One eye closed. Strabismus. Rheumatic
ophthalmia.
Face - Anxious, despairing expression. Face pale and sunken. Pale, bluish or twitching with cough. Pale face,
covered with cold sweat. Sickly, sunken. Burning heat of face. Burning pain as from hot coal, on right side
of chin. Incessant quivering of chin and lower jaw (Gel^.). Tearing pains. Pustules, leaving ugly blue-red
scars.
Female - Menses of watery blood. Menses too early, weak and only for two days. Leucorrhea of watery blood,
worse sitting. Severe bearing down pain in vagina.
Female - Chronic metritis with feeling of weight tugging at coccyx. Eruption of ¿b- pimples on the genital
organs. Pustules '"' on external genitals. Itching of pudenda.
Puerperal convulsions, better after the child is born.
Food - Appetite diminished. Loss of appetite, anorexia. Disgust for food during pregnancy. Food seems
tasteless, tobacco has no taste. Aversion to milk. Aversion to all kind of nourishment. Desires apples, Í fruits
and acids, which disagree. Desire for cooling things after vomiting. Great disgust for whiskey. Worse sour
things St* and milk. Thirstlessness. Thirst fir cold water, little and often. Difficult swallow- V ing of liquids.
” Head - Confusion in head in morning, b. Numbness of head, with stupefaction -’’ and drowsiness. Band-like
feeling over f' forehead. Headache as from a band compressing (Nit-ac.). Hydrocephalus.
Trembling of head, wfliile coughing. As of a lump in forehead. Head better in open air, washing with cold water
and motion. Head bent back. Headache with vomiting.
Wave-like increase and decrease of pain H ' in forehead. Head hot and sweaty. Scalp .sa - very sensitive.
Child will not be touched S' without whining.
i Heart - Great precordial anxiety with vom- i iting of mucus and bile. Palpitation with H uncomfortable hot
feeling. Palpitations -e with loose stools. Paralytic depression tv of heart. Weak quick pulse. Sensation of w .
coldness in blood vessels. Sensation as if ,1» heart were strained. Rheumatic dilatationof heart. Pulse rapid,
weak, trembling. Pulse full and slow, or contracted and s. hardly perceptible.
Kidneys - Sharp pains in region of kidneys !• on moving arms. Burning in urethra during n< and after urinating.
 Last drops bloody with V ■ pain in bladder. Urging increased. Catarrh ofbladder and urethra. Stricture. Involun-
tary emission of urine. Red urine, which forms blood-red filaments after standing. Deep-brown, acrid, turbid
urine.
Limbs - Acute 'articular rheumatism. Rheumatic and bruised pains. Twitching of muscles. Trembling of the
hands. Fin
gertips icy cold or dead, numb, dry and hard. Restless arms. Feet go to sleep on sitting. Dropsy of synovial
membranes. ' * Dropsy of the legs and knee joint (left).
Calves as if sore. Tension in hamstring when walking. Synovitis. Joints swollen. Jerking up of limbs during
sleep with loose stools. Weakness of all limbs. Constant inclination to stretch.
Liver - Liver region sensitive to touch.
Lungs - Asphyxia from drowning. Asphyxia neonatorum, child breathless and pale when born. Gasping
inspirations, v expirations long and slow. Edema and impending paralysis of lungs. Unequal breathing,
abdominal breathing. Suffoca- , tive shortness of breath, before cough or alternating with cough.
Hoarseness. Great rattling of mucus, but very little is expectorated. “Death rattle.” Rapid, short, difficult
breathing. Feels as if he wouldsuffocate, mustsit up. Emphysema of the aged. Capillary bronchitis, pneu-
monia, pleuro-pneumonia. Bronchitis. Bronchial tubes overloaded with mucus. Severe pneumonia, last
stages. Gastric or bilious pneumonia. Complete hepatization. Expectoration copious, thick, white. Velvety
feeling in chest. Dyspnea relieved by eructation. As if a leaflet seems to close the trachea. Lungs seems full
of mucus yet less andless is raised. Atelectasis. Hydrothorax. Percussion sound tympanitic.
Male - Pain in testicles after checked gonorrhea. Orchitis. Warts on glans penis. Excitation of sexual system.
Pustules on genitals-and thighs. Syphilis.
Modalities - Better cold open air. Better from sitting erect. Better lying on right side. Better vomiting. Better
belching and expectoration. Better motion. Worse from warmth. Worse warmroom. Worse wraps. Worse
warm weather. Worse overheating. Worse cold dampness. Worse from anger. Worse lying, sitting down.
Worse rising from a seat. Worse motion. Worse morning. Worse sour things and milk.
Mouth - Aphthae around mouth. Itching vesicles on lips. Upper lip drawn up. Lips dry and scurfy, or cracked.
Spits all the time. Copious accumulation of saliva in the mouth. Copious salivation during *’ pregnancy,
nausea. Mouth and lips swollen and excoriated. Mouth remains open ii! after yawning. Bitter, flat taste. Mouth
}6 so sore, can scarcely swallow, morning jf after rising.

Nose - Nostrils widely dilated. Alae nasi flapping. Stoppage of nose alternating 1 ■ ' with fluent coryza. Violent
fluent coryza with frequent sneezing. Ulcerated nostrils. Loss of smell and of taste. Uncontrollable nosebleed
with spongy gum^ Nosebleed followed by fluent coryza with sneezing. Nose dry and pointed.
Perspiration - Copious cold clammy ' ■ sweat with great faintness. Affected parts sweat most profusely.
Sticky sweat. Very copious sweat without relief. Sweats with influenza.
Rectum - Sharp pain in rectum. Burning at anus after loose stool. Constipation, alternating with diarrhea.
Desire for stool ineffectual though bowpls- seem full and pressing. Diarrhea and vomiting. Diarrhea in
pneumonia, smallpox, and other erup- >' tive diseases, especially if the eruption has been suppressed.
Involuntary evacuations. Palpitations during stools. Cholera morbus. Cholera when vomiting is copious and
there is coldness, and threadlike or trembling pulse.
Sensations - Sensation of weight or heaviness in many parts, head, occiput, coccyx, limbs. Sensation of
coldness in blood vessels.
Skin - Delay ed or receding eruptions. Eruption fails to appear and convulsions set in. Vesicular eruptions over
whole body. Itching in the skin. Itching pimples, and miliary eruption. Itching around ulcers. Pustular eruption,
leaving a bluish-red mark. Rash mixed with small vesicles and pustules. Rash after vaccination. Smallpox.
Thick eruptions like pocks. Eruptions like scabies. Barber's itch. Chickenpox. Smallpox. Impetigo., Blue
eruptions. Warts.
Sleep - Sleepiness during sweat. Irresistible inclination to sleep with nearly all complaints. Great drowsiness
with all complaints. Drowsiness from warmth.
Yawning with many complaints. Electriclike shocks on falling asleep. Cries during sleep with fixed eyes and
trembling. Lies on back with left hand passed under head. Trembling during sleep. Heavy, anxious dreams.
Dreams, clearly remembered in morning on waking.
Stomach - Great sensitivity' of stomach. Throbbing and pressure. Belchings like bad eggs. Eructations empty,
acid, bitter, salty. Violent hiccough. Dryness of esophagus. Cramps in stomach. Sinking at stomach. Fullness
and heaviness. Nausea produces fear with pressure in precordial region. Nausea, retching and vomiting.
Nausea with deathly faintness and prostration.. Nausea comes in waves. Nausea with weakness and cold
sweat. Vomiting forcible, then exhaustion and sleep. Frequent vomiting of bitter, sour substances. Violent
retching. Vomits with great effort. Vomiting better lying on right side.
 Stool - Mucus stools, grass green. Bloody feces. Diarrhea in eruptive diseases. Watery, slimy, bloody diarrhea.
Diarrhea with vomiting. Diarrhea with flatulence. Diarrhea of alcoholics. Very offensive diarrheic stools. Stools
yellowish-brown. Stools thin, bilious. Stools with heat at anus. Stools slimy, like yeast. Stools of cadaverous
smell.
Teeth - Violent toothache in morning. Rheumatic pain of intermittent type. Gums bleed. Gums spongy, with
nosebleed. Teeth covered with mucus. Dentition with catarrhal hyperemia.
Temperature - Coldness, trembling and chilliness. Cold creeping chills before menses. Chills as if cold water
was poured over one. Chills from within outward. Chills with trembling, worse going into open air. Chill
alternating with heat, during day. Intense heat. Intermittent fever with fatigue. Burning sensation. Heat coming
from heart.           |
Throat - Aphonia. Voice weak and changed in evening. Hoarseness in morning, worse talking. Rattling of
mucus when coughing or breathing. Much mucus in throat with short breathing. Swallowing painful or
impossible.
Throat - Roughness in throat with sensation as if a small leaf obstructed trachea on hawking. Throat, mouth
and tongue as if tense. Sharp pain in throat. Burning in fauces. Rapidswellingoftonsilsandcervi- cal glands.
Child grasps at larynx during cough. Larynx painful to touch.
Tongue - Difficult, even painful, to move tongue. Tongue flaccid, dry. Imprints of teeth on border of the tongue.
Tongue red, dry in middle, red in streaks. Çoated, pasty, thick white with red edges. Tongue moist, t clean,
or loaded with a brown coating.
Tongue moist and yellow in middle.
Vertigo - Dizziness with cough. Vertigo with dullness and confusion. Vertigo L alternates with drowsiness.
Vertigo from lifting head from pillow. Fits of vertigo ^with sparking before the eyes. Vertigo
must lie down. Vertigo with dimness of vision and pressing headache. Vertigo with violenbchills. , •
COMMENTS -Tiering said that Antimonium Tartaricum was the invention of the Alchemists. Tartar emetic. It
has been used.as a poison, similarto Arsenic, usually someone would be dead in 12 to 24 hours. It has a very
strong affinity for the lungs and stimulating the secretions of the mucus membranes.
Chest disorders with a great accumulation of mucus with coarse rattling and inability to raise it. “Lies with head
back.” “A child coughs when angry.” Heath cured a case of whooping cough in a child who was very fretful
before the cough. The mother said that if the child got angry she immediately had a fit of coughing. “Cough at
4 a.m.” is another indication.
Last stages of pneumonia, severe rattling in the lungs, and white, thick mucus. Asthma with white, thick mucus,
wet asthma (Puls.). Chronic bronchitis in the elderly with a rattling cough and white, thick mucus that’s hard to
expectorate. Drowning victims, pulmonary edema, Infantile pneumonia.
For children who get colds often and it goes to the chest with a great accumulation of mucus.
Sometimes'indicated after gas poisonings, if the gas caused irritation to the mucus membranes and mucus
comes
up (Carb-v., Bry., Ant-t.). For emphysema when caused by an irritant causing loss of lung space (Sil.).
Respiratory distress due to constriction and mucus in the lungs. There is a great accumulation of mucus in the
lungs. The sputum is thick and ropy but it is white and more sticky like glue. No expulsive power. Noisy
breathing with severe wet cough. Weakness of the bronchioles where they can't expectorate, can be used
chronically. The nostrils flare because they can't breathe. Suffocating, choking because-of the mucus.
Gastric and bilious complaints. Constant nausea..Nausea felt in chest (Puls.). Nash found Ant-t. the nearest
thing to a specific in cholera morbus, the indications being “nausea, vomiting, loose stools, prostration, cold
sweat, stupor or drowsiness.”
Deathly nausea (Ip., Puls.). Difficulty vomiting, just like expectoration. They strain, a lack of explosive power.
Vomits whatever is eaten. Vomits thick, white, ropy mucus, may have blood or slime in it. Also produces ulcers,
ulceration of the mucus membranes. Ulcers that bleed and then they vomit blood.
The tongue has a thick, white, pasty coat with red papillae showing through. Intense nausea and vomiting with
great effort with perspiration on forehead. -FullneSs and sensation of stones in abdomen, especially when
sitting bent forward. Anxiety felt in the stomach, apprehension in the stomach. Sensations of a weight or
heaviness in the abdomen or various parts of the body. The abdomen is distended, severe cramps or cutting
pains.
There is heat about heart and warmth rising up from it. Coldness in the blood vessels. Generally cold hands
and feet. The face is pale or cyanotic .and the breathing stertorous. Severe weakness from lack of oxygen,
tired from coughing. Oppression of the chest.
Great drowsiness or sleepiness with cough and congestion in the lungs (Op., more of a stupor). Can palliate
or bring them back if it's possible.
 Drowning victims and newborns who are not breathing, or for any severe respiratory problems going into
respiratory failure (Carb-v.). Coma. -
Arthritis in the smaller joints. Sensation of weight or heaviness in many parts, head, occiput, coccyx, limbs.
Pulsations in all the blood vessels. Chronic trembling of head of head and hands (as in Parkinson's disease).
“Sycotic” skin. Clarke verified a symptom given in Hering, “warts at.the back of the glans penis.” Leprosy,
chickenpox, smallpox and impetigo, worse after smallpox vaccination. It has been used instead of vaccines for
preventive purposes and a prophylactic power has been claimed for it (Vario.). The terrible backache of
smallpox is paralleled by the back-pains of Ant-t., which Clarke found to correspond to more cases of lumbago
than any other remedy.
Worse by warmth, but not the excessive sensitiveness to heat and sun of Ant-c. and some of tlfe rheumatic
symptoms are better by warmth. Cough worse from warm drink, lying in bed, especially bçcoming warm there.
Suffocates in a warm room, want fresh air (Puls.). Greatly aggravated by the sun. Cough is worse anger and
worse after eating.
Thirstlessness, lost any desire for fluids (Puls., Ip.). May vomit water if they try to drink it. As if they have
enough fluid already (Apis.). Crave apples- and acid fruits, but may be aggravated by sour food or wine,
causing severe diarrhea. Great aversion to milk or are aggravated by milk. Loathing of food.
Peevishness, whining and crying (Cham.). Restless, apprehension and agitation. Dullness and bewilderment
of head as if benumbed. Irritable, don’t want to be looked at or talked to or touched. The whole body feels
tender. Children may want to be carried and cling to their mother or may scream on being touched, keynote
that they do not want to be bothered. Coughing fits at 4 a.m.
The child looks pale, sunken eyes and have dark rings arOund the eyes and they have periodic cold sweats.
The child cries and may jerk during sleep.
Difficulty nursing and breathing at the same time. Better when held upright and hit on back to break up the
mucus.
Children are very anxious and timid, especially in the evening, as if they are anticipating the night because it
is so bad for them. They lay down and get congestion and coughingfits. They have apprehension about the
future, but it's more the upcoming night. Elderly may feel despair of recovery.
Etiology can be cold, damp weather that seems to bring out the mucus.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Asaf., Chin., Cocc., Con. (pustules on genitals), Ip., Laur., Opium in large doses
is the best antidote in poisoning, Puls., Sep. Antidotes: Bar-c., Bry. (dyspepsia),Camph.,Caust.
(dyspepsia),Puls., Sepia. Ant-t. differs from Merc, in producing a purely local action on the mouth similar to its
action on the skin. The action of Merc, on the mouth is indirect. Compare: (1) Aeon. - croup, Aeth. and Ip. -
expression of nausea, Am-c. (2) Ars. - asthma, heart symptoms, gastric catarrh, Bry. - pneumonia, worse left,
Ant-t. worserighthas nostrils dilated. (3) Verat. - colic, vomiting, coldness, craving for acids. Ant-t. has more
jerks, drowsiness, urging to urinate, Verat. more cold sweat and fainting. (4) Op. - cough with drowsiness and
yawning, Sang. - pneumonia, face livid. (5) Ip. - Ant-t has more drowsiness and.tendency of lungs to collapse.
(6) Thuj. - effects of vaccination when Thuj. fails and Sil. is not indicated. Ant-t. develops smallpox pustule,
Thuj. dries it up. Compatible: Phos. inhydrocephalus, worn-out constitutions, laryngitis, pneumonia. Follows
well: Sil. in dyspnea from foreign substances in larynx, Puls, (nausea in chest gonorrheal suppressions), Ter.
(symptoms from damp cellars), Variolinum.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

***ANTIPYRINUM 1
(Phenazone)
PHARMACY - antip. Antipyrinum. Phenazone. Antipyrine. Phenyl-dimethyl-pyrazolon. A product of coal tar
through Toulon. Solution and trituration. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Bedwetting. Cheyne-stokes, breathing. Dysmenorrhea. Eczema. Edema. Epilepsy. Erythema.
German measles. Hallucinations.Headache. Heart paralysis. Lachrymation. Menses, suppressed. Mind,
deranged. Nausea. Nosebleed. Pemphigus. Scarlatina. Throat, sore-. Tinnitus. Toothache. Urticaria.
Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Antipyrine is known from the poisonous effects it produced in old-school practice. Many
fatal cases were recorded and there can be little doubt that its injudicious use determined a fatal issue in many
cases that have remained unrecorded.
Antipyrines action is very like that of Acetan, in producing collapse, but it has more effect on the skin, causing
scarlpt rash and edema. It is one of the drugs that induce leucocytosis, similar to ergotine, salicylates and
tuberculin.
Antipyrine acts especially on the vasomotor centers, causing dilation of the capillaries of the skin and
 circumscribed patches of hyperemia and swelling. In large doses, it causes profuse perspiration, dizziness,
cyanosis, somnolence, albumen and blood in urine. Acute erythema multiform.
MIND - Fear of going insane. Hallucinations of sight and hearing. Nervous anxiety, Ears - Pains and
buzzing. Tinnitus.
Eyes - Puffiness of lids. Conjunctiva red and edematous with lachrymation. Red spots (Apis).
Face - Edema and puffiness. Red and swollen.
Female - Itching and burning in vagina. Dysmenorrhea. Menses suppressed. Watery leucorrhea.
Head - Throbbing headache. Headache under ears with earache. Sensation of constriction. Flashes of
heat.
Heart - Faintness with sensation of stoppage of heart. Throbbing throughout the body. Rapid, weak, irregular
pulse.
Kidneys - Diminished. Penis black.
Lungs - Cheyne-Stokes respiration. Aphonia. Oppression and dyspnea.
Mouth - Swelling of lips, tongue Burning of mouth and gums. Ulceration of lips and tongue, vesicles and bullae.
Small lump in cheek. Bloody saliva. Toothache along lower jaw.
bierves-Generalprostration. Epileptiform seizures. Contractures. Trembling and cramps. Crawling and
numbness. _
Nose - Fluent coryza. Nasal mucus membrane swollen. Dull pains in frontal sinus.
Skin - Erythema, eczema, pemphigus. Intense itching, urticaria, appearing and disappearing suddenly with
internal coldness. Angioneurotic edema. Dark blotches on skin of penis, sometimes with edema.
Stomach - Nausea and vomiting, burning and pain.
Throat - Painful when swallowing. Expectoration of fetid pus. Abscess, white false membrane. Sensation of
burning.
COMMENTS - A young female patient who took Antipyrine on her own account whenever she thought she
might be going to have a headache, developed intense dysmenorrhea (to which she was not subject) with
depression.
This was only removed after she had discontinued the drug. Later, she took Phenacetin with result that an
eruption of erythema appeared on both cheeks, which peeled after a few days and recurred persistently.
It would seem that the drug is homeopathic to some forms of neuralgia. One patient had Cheyne-Stokes
respiration. Erythema appears first on face and arms, last on legs.
Hansen mentioned its use in bedwetting and nosebleed. Better from hot drinks.
RELATIONS - Antidotad by: Bell. The symptoms are much intensified in persons addicted to coffee in excess.
Compare: ( 1 ) Anilinum - skin symptoms. (2) Aeon. - numbness, rapidity of attack. (3) Acetan., Ars., Chloral.
REFERENCES: Boericke. Clarke.

name: Aphis Chenopodii Glauci
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aphis. Aphis chenopodü glauci. Aphids. Chenopodü glauci aphis. N. O. Insecta. A tincture is
made of the aphids grown on the Chenopodium glaucum. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Chills. Colic. Coryza. Cough. Diarrhea. Headache. Rheumatic, pains. Sneezing. Tenesmus.
Toothache.
HOMEOPATHIC - The msect partakes of the properties of the plant it lives on. Chenopodium glaucum being
a popular colic remedy and allied to the Polygonacae, Rheum and Rumex. Aphis is peculiar in being the only
remedy which has toothache better by sweat, though Cham, has general better by sweat.
Coryza with burning and biting on margins of nostrils, especially of septum. Increase of violent toothaches in
bed, only relieved from a general warth sweat breaking out.
Cutting in atxiomen and rumbling of flatus. Ineffectual urging in bladder and rectum. In the morning urging after
rising, several mush-like stools with pinching, burning in anus with urging. Flatus accompanies stool. Thin
stools with slime and spots of dark blood.
Abdomen - Rumblings of flatus in the abdomen. Emission of gas. Frequent pinching pains in the abdomen.
Cutting and pinching pains with borbory gmi. Congestion of blood towards the abdominal viscera.
Back - Pain in the left shoulder blade.
Ears - Tearing pains, sometimes in one ear, and sometimes in the other.
Eyes - Burning heat in the eyelids during several evenings.
Face - Color pale, yellowish, heat in the face, with head confused as by coryza, at night. Dry lips, sometimes
especially in the morning.
Food - No appetite for meat and wheat bread, with chilliness. Increased thirst from sensation of dryness in
 throat. Much thirst in evening, second week.
Head - Head confused in the evening with transient heat in the face. Pressure and tightening in the forehead
or occiput,
increased by motion. Tearing shooting in the head.
Kidneys - Tearing shooting in the bladder. Irritation in the urethra, compelling frequent urination. Frequent
secretion of a frothy urine, deep yellow. Urine red, brownish, frothy, depositing during the night a thick,
yellowish sediment. Burning in the urethra, especially at the orifice, while urinating.
Limbs - Rheumatic pains. Bruise-like pain of the limbs. Tearing shootings in the shoulders and the upper part
of the arms. Pulling and tearing above the knee in the morning. Weariness in the legs. Coldness of the feet,
extending to the knees. Burning lancinations in corns.
Lungs - Expectoration of mucus. Voice frequently rough and smothered, removed by hawking. Frequent
irritation in the larynx, which compels coughing. Dry cough, provoked by irritation in the throat.
Male - Voluptuous excitation of the glans penis.
Mouth - Painful vesicles at the end of the tongue. Dryness of the mouth and of the throat. Increase in the
secretion of saliva. Scraping sensation in the palate.
Nose - Pain of excoriation in the nostrils. Violent sneezing. Coryza, with burning and smarting at the edges of
the nostrils and at the septum. Fluent coryza.
Rectum - Loose evacuations of the consis- '          tency of liquid pap. Flatulency before and
after a stool. Liquid, mucus-like stools in the morning, with spots of blood. Tearing shooting in-the rectum.
Sleep - Sleeplessness at night, without much pain. Lascivious dreams with pol- 1 lutions. , -         -
Teeth - Toothache with tearing shootings, i Nocturnal tearing pains in the teeth, with tearing shootings above
the face towards morning.          >„       ., A -
Temperature - Frequent chills on the whole surface of the body, chiefly of the z back. Burning in the palms of
the hands. ' Tendency to perspire in the morning. Hot I .^ sweat or general perspiration. . Uir,w ! SWtilq HUA ’
ruíüi: ! - iAWvim»»» «WW. I noi Cito Ht; >< rroijcivmsfirri zaMsbotq )i ’■
Throat - Secretion of frothy- mucus in the mouth and throat. Scraping and burning, as from acrid substances.
Sensation of dryness and increase of mucus secretion.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Aeth. - stool after rising, pinching, cutting before, urging after. (2) Nat-s. - stool
after rising with discharge of wind. (3) Nux-v. - frequent urging in rectum and bladder. (4) Gels. - chills up and

author: Murphy
full:
(Honey Bee) .
PHARMACY-apis. Apismellifica. Honeybee. N. O. Insecta. Hymenoptera. Apium virus is honey-bee venom.

feeling at pit of 1S, stomach laSting for hours and partially relieved by eating.

rest, mostly left-sided.

author: Murphy

,(Spreading Dogbane)
PHARMACY - apoc-a. Apocynum androsae- mifolium. Spreading dogbane. N. O. Apocyna- ceae. Tincture
from the root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Diarrhea. Dropsy. Nausea. Neuralgia of face. Rheumatic pains. Vomiting. Wandering
rheumatism^ Worms.
HOMEOPATHIC - Acute rheumatism with great stiffness. General rheumatic pains. Flying pains in different
parts. Its pains are of a wandering nature with much stiffness and drawing. The pains go from above downward,
are worse when breathing and on turning to left side.
Itching of body and face. Profuse sweat of whole body. Swollen sensations. Trembling and prostration. Worms.
Everything smells or tastes like honey.
It has been proved in large doses, its most prominent symptoms included “Heaviness with great desire to
sleep. Trembling of 'the body. Prostration and trembling. Swollen sensations of face and body. Swelling of
hands and feet, showing its relation to dropsical states like Apoc. can. and Stroph.” Face - Twitching in face.
Violent pain in left zygoma.
Female - Profuse menstruation lasting eight days with violent, pressing pain.
Head - Pains and stiffness in back of head and neck.
Kidneys - Profuse flow of clear urine.
Limbs - Violent pains in all the joints. Much pain in knee and right shoulder. Pain in toes and soles. Tingling
pain in toes. Cramps in soles. Profuse sweat with violent heat in soles (Sulph.). Swelling of hands and feet.
Mouth - Pains in all teeth of left lower jaw. Delightful taste in the mouth.
Nose - Everything smells like honey.
Stomach - Vomiting and purging, better from copious evacuation.
COMMENTS’- Hale cured with it rheumatic gout, “Acute pains in the joints attended with cramps, bilious stools
and flying pains in the teeth. The tincture in drop-doses has been known to expel ascarides and other worms.”
It has been used, for expelling kidney stones and gravel.
