name: Argentum Nitricum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - arg-n. Argentum nitricum. Silver nitrate. Lunar caustic. Trituration and solution. Historical dose:
Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Acidity. Addison's disease. Anemia. Anticipation. Anxiety, attacks. Chancre. Chemosis.
Dyspepsia. Epilepsy. Belchings. Erysipelas. Eyes disorders. Flatulence. Fears. Fright. Gastric ulcer.
Gonorrhea. Hands, swelling. Headache. Heartburn. Herpes zoster. Impetigo. Incoordination. Locomotor
ataxia. Melancholy. Neuralgia. Ophthalmia, neonatorum. Panic, attacks. Paralysis. Prostate, enlargement.
Scarlatina. Smallpox. Spinal irritation. Syphilis. Taste, altered. Throat disorders. Tongue ulcerated.
'Trembling. Warts.
HOMEOPATHIC - It was the use of Argentum nitricum in ancient times in the treatment of epilepsy which led
to the production of the lamentable cases of lead-colored pigmentation of the skin called Argyria.
Arg-n. has irresistible desir e for sugar, which at the same time aggravates. Kent related a case illustrating
this. A nursing infant had a grass-green diarrhea which failed to yield to Merc., Ars., and Cham. At last Kent
discovered that the mother ate a pound of candy a day.
Arg-n. was given and the candy stopped and the child soon got well.
Grimmer used it for Addison's disease, lead-colored pigmentation of the skin. Mental symptoms are important
indications for the use of the remedy, nervous fears and restlessness with trembling hands, skin cancers.
In Arg-n. the neurotic effects are very marked, many brain and spinal symptoms presenting themselves which
give certain indications forits homeopathic employment. Symptoms of incoordination, loss ofcontrol and
want of balance everywhere, mentally and physically, trembling in affected parts. Emaciation is progressive.
Paraplegia. Ascending paralysis. Parts seem enlarged or bound up. Pains increase and decrease gradually.
The cases of epilepsy calling for this drug are those caused by fright or occurring at the menstrual period. For
days or hours before the attack the pupils are dilated and after the attack the patient is very restless and has
trembling of the hands.
Impulse to walk very fast (Lil-t.). Suitable to businessmen, students. Very characteristic is the great desire for
sweets, the splinter-like pains and free muco-purulent discharge in inflamed and ulcerated mucus membranes.
Sensation as if a part were expanding and other errors of perception are characteristic. Pains increase and
decrease gradually.
Muco-purulent discharges and splinter like pains. Faint and tremulous. Flatulent state and prematurely aged
look. Explosive belching, especially in neurotics. Upper abdominal disorders brought on by undue mental
exertion. Paraplegia, myelitis .and disseminated sclerosis of brain and cord. Intolerance of heat. Sensation
 of a sudden pinch (Dudgeon). Destroys red blood corpuscles, producing anemia.
MIND - Nervous impulsive and hurried, yet timid and anxious. Panic and anxiety attacks. Dreads ordeals.
Anticipation, apprehension and fear, when ready to go to doctor, dentist, church, etc. Diarrhea from
anticipating upcoming events. Performance, anxiety. Examinations, fear of taking tests. Thinks that all his
undertakings will and must fail.
Fears, phobias and anxieties. Fears projecting corners of buildings and high buildings. Fear of heights.
Fearsome. Fear °f flying in airplanes. Fear of impending evil. Fear of crowds. Fear of dark. Claustrophobia.
Fear of fainting. Fear of being too late. Fear of failing. Fear of having a panic attack. Fear of losing self-
control.
Peculiar mental impulses. Impulse to jump when crossing a bridge or from a window. Impulsive, wants to
do things in a hurry (Lil-t.). Walks rapidly from anxiety.
Fear of passing a certain point of high buildings. Imagines he cannot pass a certain point (Kali-br.). The sight
of high buildings makes him giddy and causes him to stagger, it seems as if houses on both sides of street
would approach and crush him.
Tormented by strange ideas and emotions. Irrational, does strange things and comes to strange
conclusions, does foolish things. Hidden irrational motives for actions. Delusion he is despised. Thinks about
killing himself.
Obstinate, against whatever was proposed, he had the queerest objection. Errors ofperception. Time passes
slowly (Cann-i.). Time seems short, wants to do things in a hurry, must walk fast, etc. Brain fag. Memory weak.
Perversion of senses. Indifference while in company. Loss of ambition.
Melancholic, apprehensive of serious disease. Fear of some incurable disease. Forsaken feeling. Sensation
of isolation. Desire to talk. Hesitates, falters in speech in gait, etc. Childish talk. Talks about his sufferings.
Talks of one subject. Believes that all his undertakings will fail. Weeps, says he is lost beyond hope.
Abdomen - Rumbling, gurgling. Flatulence causing distention and bursting of abdomen. Loud, explosive
belchings discharged upwards and downwards. Shivering through bowels, extending up the back. Colic with
much gas and distention. Constriction in bowels, as if tightly tied with a band. Sharp ulcerative pain on left
side, below short ribs. Cutting pain with loud rumbling. Spasms of diaphragm.
Back - Much pain. Spine sensitive with nocturnal pains (Ox-ac.). Paraplegia. Posterior spinal sclerosis. Pain
in the small of the back worse rising from sitting better standing or walking. Throbbing in spine or weak spine.
Glands of the neck indurated. Weakness in sacro-iliac symphysis as if bones were loose. Heaviness in
sacrum, as before menses. Glands of neck indurated.
Breasts - Sore nipples from nursing.
Causations - Anticipation. Apprehension, fear or fright. Eating ices. Mental strain and worry. Masturbation
and sexual excesses. Intemperate habits. Sugar. Tobacco.
Chest - Angina pectoris with nightly aggravation. Intense spasm of chest muscles. Feels as if a bar were
around chest. Painful spots in chest. Pain in the chest on putting boots. As if weight of stone in middle of the
sternum.
Constitutions - Withered up and dried constitutions, especially when associated with unusual or long
continued mental exertion. It corresponds to Grauvogl's carbo-nitrogenoid constitution (Sulph., Cupr.) in higher
to the hydrogenoid or sycotic constitution. Hysteric nervous persons, headaches from mental causes
characterized by dullness of head. Women with menstrual disturbances. Cachetic state. Scrawny, feeble,
dried-up-looking women. Guernsey put it, “withered and dried up by disease. A child looks like a withered old
man.”
Cough - Cough is worse laughing, stooping, smoking, ascending stairs before menses. High notes causes
cough. Suffocative cough, at noon. Cough when angered.
Ears - Tearing pain in ears. Sharp pain from right to left ear, with congestion to head. Buzzing in ears with
vertigo. Ringing with deafness. Whizzing in left ear, with feeling of obstruction and hard hearing. Fullness and
ringing.
Eyes -Acute conjunctivitis. Great swelling of conjunctiva, discharge abundant and purulent. Eyestrain
from sewing, worse in warm room. Aching, tired feeling in eyes, better closing or pressing upon them. Useful
in restoring power to the
weakened ciliary muscles. Inner canthi swollen and red. Photophobia in warm room. Ophthalmia
neonatorum. Painful purulent ophthalmia. Chronic ulceration of margin of lids, sore, thick, swollen. Unable
to keep eyes fixed steadily. Opacity of cornea. Ulcer in cornea. Pterygium of pink color. Blepharitis, thick crusts
on eyelids. Pupils dilated. Chemosis. Eye symptoms worse with abdominal symptoms.
Face - Sunken, old, pale and bluish. Face yellow, dirty looking. Old man's look, tight drawing of skin over
bones. Sickly, sunken, grayish of muddy color. Infraorbital neuralgia, left side. Prosopalgia, almost taking away
 eyesight. Drops of sweat on face.
Female - Pain in stomach and spasmodic contraction in chest before menses. Menses scanty with dyspnea.
Menses, irregular too soon too late or last one day only. Menses with headache. Metrorrhagia with nervous
weakness at menopause, also of young widows and childless women. Leucorrhea profuse with erosion of
cervix, bleeding easily. Leucorrhea mucus, bloody, corroding, yellow and profuse. Prolapsed uterus. Uterine
hemorrhage, two weeks after menses, painful disorders of left ovary. Ovaries painful with pains radiating to
sacrum and thighs. Itching of skin and flushes of heat during menopause. Disposition to miscarriage. Infertility.
Puerperal convulsions. Orgasms at night. Sex painful, followed by bleeding.
Food - Desire for cheese and salt. Loss of appetite. Appetite good, but every kind of food disagrees.
Hypoglycemia. Eating relives nausea but aggravates stomach pain. Better after warm drinks. Better
sourthings, smoking. Better after alcohol. Great craving for sweets. Craves sugar, which disagrees.
Desires for cheese and salt. Desires ice cream, fat and sweets. Craves plum sauce. Worse from coffee. Worse
cold drinks
Head - Excessive congestion to head, with throbbing carotids. Migraine followed by debility. Emotional upsets
causes appearance of migraine attacks. Migraine, head feels much enlarged.
Head - Nervous headache with coldness and trembling. Headaches, worse mental exertion, dancing, better
tight bandaging. Head as if in a vise. Sensation of expansion. Brain fatigue with general debility and
trembling. Aching in frontal eminence with enlarged feeling in corresponding eye. Boring pain, better on
tight bandaging and pressure. Itching of scalp. Hemicrania, bones of head feel as if separated. As if skull
bones were separated. Headache ends in vomiting. Headaches of hysterical young women, delicate literary
persons. Itching, crawling sensation on the scalp.
Heart - Angina pectoris. Organic heart troubles of business men, students and brain workers. Burning feeling
in region of heart. Anxiety with palpitations and throbbing throughout the whole body. Palpitations with
nausea. Palpitations, worse lying on right side (Alumn.). Palpitations, worse riding in car, better pressing
by hand. Unpleasant sensation of fullness about the heart better fresh open air. Sensation as if heart would
stop beating, when sitting quietly. Pulse is irregular intermittent.
Kidneys - Violent pain from kidney to bladder, worse touch, motion and deep inspiration. Touching region of
kidneys increases pain. Urethra inflamed with pain, burning, itching, pain as from a splinter. Emission of a few
drops after having finished. Urethritis with pain, increased gonorrhea, priapism, dysuria, bloody urine
andfever. Early stage of gonorrhea, profuse discharge and terrible cutting pains, bloody urine. Urging to
urinate, urine passes less easily and freely. Retention of urine. Sugar in urine. Divided stream. Urine passes
unconsciously, day and night. Yellow bloody urine. Urine is highly colored, dark red with albumin. Urine scanty
and dark.
Limbs - Lassitude and weariness of forearm and legs with trembling. Cannot walk with eyes closed. Trembling
with general debility. Trembling of hands, cannot write. Numbness of arms. Numbness of fingertips, ring and
little fingers. Fingers half
Argentum nitricum clenched, cannot be separated. Paralysis with mental and abdominal symptoms.
Weakness, rigidity or twisting in calves. Walks and stands unsteadily, especially when unobserved. Post-
diphtheria paralysis (Gels.). Chorea-like convulsions, with the legs drawn up, arms jerked outwards and
upwards. Peripheral neuralgias. Edema of legs. Legs feel as if made of wood or padded. Paraplegia after
debilitating causes. As if a weight hanging to coccyx.
Lungs - Asthma, worse summer, cold weather or taking cold. Asthmatic attacks from going up stairs or bodily
exertion. Suffocative cough, as if from a hair in throat. Dyspnea. Craves fresh air. Many people in a room
seem to take away his breath. Panting, quick, sibilant breathing. Rawness, soreness, high up in trachea worse
coughing. Crowded rooms takes away his breath. Desire to take deep breath which aggravates the dyspnea.
Craves fresh air. Asthma, worse in summer in cold weather or taking cold.
Male - Chancre like ulcers, on the prepuce. Testes drawn up high. Genitals shrivel. Desire waning. Cutting in
urethra with painful erection. Sex painful, urethra as if put on stretch or sensitive at orifice. Impotency. Erection
fails when sex is attempted. Cancer-like ulcers. Ulcers on prepuce.
Modalities - Better from open air, fresh air. Better cool air, cold, cold bath. Better from hard pressure. Better
motion. Better belching. Better from bending double, pressure. Worse from emotions. Worse anxiety,
apprehension. Worse fear or fright. Worse from suspense. Worse from mental strain and worry. Worse
warmth in any form. Worse at night. Worse from cold food, cold drinks. Worse ice cream. Worse sugar,
sweets. Worse after eating. Worse leftside. Worse in aroom in closed, small places. Worse lying on right
side. Worse looking down. Worse from drinking, crowds. Worse from warmth in any form. Worse before and
during menses. Worse from riding. Worse thinking intently.
Mouth - Fetor from mouth. Taste coppery like ink. Canker sores. Stringent, sour or bitter-sour taste. Food
 escapes from mouth during chewing. Cannot talk, spasms of muscles of tongue and throat. Stammers. Tough
mucus in mouth. Ptyalism. Lips dry and viscid, without thirst. Lips tremble while speaking. Lips blue.
Nose - Nasal bones painful as if bruised. Nasal discharge like boiled starch. Discharge of whitish pus, with
clots of blood. Nosebleed during menopause. Loss of smell. Violent itching. Coryza with chilliness,
lachrymation andheadache. Violent itching, rubs it. Ulcers in septum.
Perspiration - Sweats in morning or at night. Profuse sweat on the face in beads. Sweat and chilliness as
soon as he gets warm in bed.
Rectum - Diarrhea from emotions, worse immediately after eating and drinking. Diarrhea from anticipation.
Diarrhea after any emotion with flatulence. Nervous diarrhea after sugar candy. Diarrhea of children after
weaning. Fluids go right through him after sweets. Constipation, alternates with diarrhea. Hemorrhoidal pain
in morning. Itching of anus. Tenia or threadworms.
Skin - Brown, tense and hard. Drawing in skin, as from a spider-web or dried albuminous substance withered
and dried up. Irregular blotches. Ulcers, angry, deep with hard edges. Warty granulations. Adherent crusts.
Bedsores. Bluish-black eruption. Scarlet fever.
Sleep - Drowsy stupor. Sleepless from fancies before his imagination. Ailments from long, wearisome,
fatiguing night watching. Restless sleep, awakes almost every hour, disturbed with many dreams. Horrible
dreams of snakes, wakes in fright. Dreams he is hungry. Dreams of sexual gratification.
Stomach - Alcoholic gastritis. Belching with most gastric ailments. Ineffectual effort at eructation.
Gastroenteritis. Flatulence, painful swelling of stomach. Enormous distension. Painful spot over stomach
that radiates to all parts of the abdomen. Gnawing ulcerating pain.
burning and constriction. Trembling and throbbing in stomach. Enormous distention. Ulcerative pain in left side
under ribs. Ulceration with radiating pain. Deathly nausea during headache, not better after vomiting.
Nausea, retching, vomiting of glairy mucus. Astringent sour or bitter vomiting. Vomiting with diarrhea and
violent colicky pains.
Stool - Stools, shreddy, mucus, turning green like chopped spinach. Watery, noisy, flatulent stools. Stools,
green like chopped spinach with shreddy mucus and enormous distention of abdomen, very offensive.
Teeth - Gums tender and bleed easily. Pain in healthy teeth. Teeth pain worse chewing, cold things, sour
things.
Temperature - Chills with nausea. Chilly- when uncovered, yet feels smothered if wrapped up. Chilly with
many complaints. Chills with cold hands and feet. Constant chilliness up back and over shoulders. Intermittent
fever, with hemorrhage from lungs. Fever with no thirst.
Throat - Burning and dryness in fauces and pharynx. Much thick mucus in throat and mouth causes hawking.
Raw, rough and sore. Uvula and fauces dark red. Sensation as if a splinter in throat, when swallowing,
breathing or moving the neck better cool drinks. Dark redness of throat catarrh of smokers with tickling as of
hair in throat. Strangulated feeling. Swallowing difficult. Chronic induration of tonsils. Food lodges in pharynx.
Smoker's catarrh with sensation as of a hair in throat. Loss of voice. Chronic laryngitis of singers. Raising the
voice causes cough, high notes cause cough. Chronic hoarseness.
Tongue - Red streak down middle of tongue. Tongue has prominent papilla. Tongue tip is red and painful.
Tongue furred with clean edges. Aphthae on edges of the tongue. Tongue coated white.
,Vertigo - Vertigo with buzzing in ears and with nervous disorders. Vertigo before epilepsy. Vertigo looking
down from heights. Vertigo with transient blindness. Vertigo worse closing eyes. Vertigo with cerebral
congestion.
Vertigo - Vertigo at sight of high buildings.
Vision - Spots before the vision. Blurred vision. Distorted vision. Misty vision. Diplopia, from rush of blood to
head. Sight worse by candlelight, than by daylight. Black motes, before right eye. Dim vision on thinking
intently, with headache. Grey spots and serpent-like bodies moving before eyes. Vanishing vision must
constantly wipe away mucus. Farsighted. Paralysis of accommodation from errors of refraction.
COMMENTS - Among the key symptoms of Arg-n. are great tremor, nervous feeling, and sensation as if being
squeezed in a vice. Feeling of constriction in various parts as if a band of iron around chest or waist.
A feeling as if the body or some part of the body was expanding. Migraine with feeling as if head were
enormously enlarged, better tightly bound. Defective coordination. Paralysis of motion and sensation, a
peculiar numbness accompanied with hyperesthesia. Sensation of a splinter sticking in various parts. Burning
sensations.
In allopathic practice the dyspepsia for which it is given is worse before food, when the stomach is empty. The
opposite condition is the leading indication in homeopathic practice. Gowers recorded a case in which the use
of Arg-n. for stomach trouble caused (like lead), drop-wrist, gout and albuminuria.
E. P. Brewer recorded a proving in which the prover, a young man, took on three consecutive days one grain
 a day of Arg-n. triturated with sugar of milk. A number of motor and sensory symptoms were elicited, reminding
Brewer of locomotor ataxia for which it has been used with success by old- school practitioners.
This use also has led to many cases of ar- gyria. Among the symptoms of this proving were “Mental operations
sluggish, continued thought required special effort, but exertion of mind did not aggravate the heaviness and
fullness of head. Lower limbs fatigued, as if they would suddenly fail him. Loss of ambition. Building air castles
by day: monstrous dreams by night.”
Other symptoms were sore throat with white patches, rheumatic pains in (left) wrist and finger joints with
external tenderness of bony prominences, pain on rising in right sacroiliac notch. Sore muscles of neck and
back. Urticaria spots in various parts.
In poisoning cases complete loss of consciousness insensibility and convulsions have occurred. Some of the
notable digestive symptoms are: “Irresistible desire for sugar. Fluids go right through him.” Belching ac-
companies most gastric disorders.
Green stools are remarkable. Green mucus like chopped spinach in flakes. Stool turning green after remaining
on diaper. Stool expelled with much spluttering. Stool shreddy, red, green muco-lymph orepithelial substance.
There is a pain in the small of the back, better on standing or walking, but severe when rising from a seat
(Sulph., Caust.). Mucus membranes affected, purulent and bloody discharges, membranous diarrhea with
agonizing pains. Epithelium affected (cancers). Intestinal catarrh with shreddy membranous discharges is often
cured by Arg-n.
Most symptoms are worse night, very nervous at night. Worse at night or in morning on rising (epileptic
attacks). Day half more cough, night half more diarrhea. Worse on awaking. At 11 a.m. nervous attacks better
by stimulants. Chill down back every day at noon. A large number of symptoms appear on the left side.
Grimmer notes that it's used along with Natrum Mur to antidote the effects of silver nitrate cauterization. For
example, of the nose, and sometimes they do the uterus, the cervix, to stop bleeding, any place. Parkinson's
paralysis, or disorders after stroke, loss of motor control, especially on left.
Good for multiple sclerosis. Addison's disease, lead-colored pigmentation of the skin. Mental symptoms are
important indications for the use of the remedy, nervous fears anirestlessness with trembling hands, skin
cancers. Severe blood sugar problems, acute or chronic sugar poisoning, hypoglycemia, diabetes.
Consider Arg-n., a left-sided Lycopodium. Voracious, canine desire for sweets. Bingeing on sweets. Can
become angry or irritable after sugar. Also craves salt. Another keynote is gas and bloating, then low blood
sugar. They can have a splinter-like sensation in the throat.
It's specific for laryngitis. Hoarseness, sore throat. Epilepsy from frights. Diarrhea from anxiety. Headache from
over studying, eye strain. Conjunctivitis, looks like raw meat, pus green and yellow in color.
Majorphobiaremedy. Panic attacks when low blood sugar. They have a lot of fears of fainting, fears of having
a fit in public, fears of epilepsy, the general idea is fears of losing control.
Fear of something bad happening, “impending doom.” Superstitions, rituals, conspiracy paranoia. “Fear of
being poisoned,” anxiety over health. Fear of death, may predict their own death (Agn.). In late stages, fear of
their own thoughts. Tormenting thoughts and impulses, repeating thoughts.
Over-active mental plane, anticipation leading to worry. For anticipation, stage fright to the point here they get
diarrhea (Gels., Aeon.). Gastrointestinal symptoms with anxiety. Vertigo due to anxiety.
Concentration problems, brain degeneration, early senility with strong imaginations. Symptoms worse at night.
Hasty walk, keynote, they walk so fast that the upper body is leaned forward. Neurological deficiencies and
incoordination of walking, staggering gaits.
Keynote craving of sugar, which aggravates. The aggravation of the sugar is as strong as their craving. Sugar
causes headaches, anxiety, irritability, and low blood sugar. Severe gas and bloating. Craves salt and strong
cheese (Puls, Ign, Rhus-t.). Worse heat, skin may be cool, but they think they are hot (Sec.).
Desires company, open, forward with a lot of vitality. Strong emotional nature. Impulsive, instinctive expression
of emotions. Happy, easy-going high sexual power. High sex drive, loss of erection or premature ejaculation
due to overexcitement and
anticipation.
RELATIONS-Antidoted by: Am-caust., effects of tobacco. Nat-m., Ars.. Milk. Antidotes to: Puls., Calc., Sep.,
next in importance, Lyc., Sil., Rhus-t., Phos., Sulph. Compare: (1) Ars., Merc., Phos., Puls. (2) Arg-cy. - angina
pectoris, asthma, spasm of esophagus. (3) Argent, iodat. - throat disorders, hoarseness, gland affected. (4)
Argent, phos. - an excellent diuretic in dropsy. (5) Arg-oxyd. - chlorosis with menorrhagia and diarrhea. (6)
Arg-m. - acts on cartilages, Arg-n. more on mucus membranes, skin, bone and periosteum and is suited to
herpetic patients. (7) to Aur., Cupr., Kali-bi„ Lach., Merc., Merc-c., Merc-i., Nairn., Nit-ac..Thuj. (8) In complaints
from pressure of clothes like Calc.. Bry., Caust., Lyc., Sars., Stann. (9) In congestive headaches like Glon. and
other Nit-ac„ Hep., worse by cold, Arg-n. worse in warm room. (10) Puls, is its nearest analog. Inimical: Coff.
 ( it increases the nervous headache). Follows well: Bry., Spig. (dyspepsia). Spongia (goiter), Caust. (urethral
affections), Verat-a. (flatus). Is followed well by: Lyc. (flatus).
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Aristolochia Clematitis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - arist-cl. Aristolochiaclematitis. Common biithwort. Aristolochia infesta. N. O. Aristolochiaceae.
Europe, South America, Asia. Tincture of the root. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - After-pains. Amenorrhea. Anorexia. Arthritis. Bedwetting. Bronchitis. Chills. Colic. Cystic mastitis.
Cystitis. Depression. Dysmenorrhea. Eczema. Enteritis. Hormonal, imbalances. Insomnia. Laryngitis. Mastitis.
Menopause. Metritis. Nephritis. Premenstrual syndrome. Rheumatism. Spasmodic colitis. Sinusitis. Vaginitis.
Varicose veins. Vertigo.
HERBAL - Aristolochia Clematitis, of the Aristolochiaceae family, grows in Southern Europe and South
America. Its active principle is clematine, which is identical to the Aristolochia or the Serpentarin as well as to
non-purified Aristolochic acid. Aristolochic acid causes menorrhagia, tends towards miscarriage, and has a
toxic action on the kidneys
and liver parenchyma as well as intestinal mucus membranes.
“Aristos” means better, “locheia” means giving birth. Used in popular medicine to induce birth or stimulant the
menses. Also as a diuretic, and against rheumatism. In high doses it is an emetic and cathartic. In South
America, some Aristolochia are used for blindness.
HOMEOPATHIC - The proving by Mezger made use of the spring rhizome. The experiment was carried out
by eighteen provers, of whom thirteen were women. The potencies 5x, 2x, 12x and the mother tincture were
used in the proving. The experiment lasted for twelve weeks.
It produced excess of estrogen hormones. Marked affect on the urinary passages, kidneys, venous system,
skin. Irregular menses. Premenstrual insomnia with agitation and congestion of the pelvis. Joint pains improved
by movement. State of fatigue, or the opposite. Worn out with vertigo, chilliness, slightly improved by heat.
Hunger pangs and need to eat despite feeling nausea. Tendency to plumpness.
MIND - Sensation of solitude. Fearforthe future. Rejects company. Psychosomatic complaints tending towards
depression, especially in women who are going through the menopause (Sep.). Depression, ameliorated by
fresh air and menses. Mental condition aggravated before and after periods, clearly ameliorated during
menstrual flow.
Abdomen - Colic. Spasmodic colitis.
Enteritis. Abdomen distended, painful, before and during menses.
Breasts - Pain and feeling of hardening of the left breast. Pain in the breast. Cystic mastitis.
Chest - Chest feels hard, like a breastplate.
Constitutions - Hormonal imbalances. Subjects of a nervous constitution, with extreme sensitivity, and who
cry easily. Tubercular conditions of the “worn-out” type.
Eyes - Watering aggravated by light, reading. Burning and itching.
Female - Brown discharge, watery flow. Eczema of the vulva. Sensual itching, aggravated before menses,
ameliorated during menses, aggravated after menses. Menses absent, late or short, Blood black, withclotting.
Varicocele. Dysmenorrhea. Infrequent menses. Amenorrhea. Metritis. After-pains with laryngitis. Vaginitis.
Food - Anorexia, nausea with vertigo and cold sensations.
Head - Diffuse headaches, improved in the fresh air and by cold, damp compresses. Congestive headache
(Bell.).
Kidneys - Pain in the kidneys and bladder with a frequent urination. Bedwetting, especially in older women.
Incontinence and compelling need to urinate. Pyelitis. Cystitis. Albuminuria with white discharge.
Limbs - Arthritis in women, with menopause. Rheumatism of the knee. Limbs cold, with chilblains, skin
discolored or red. Legs heavy before menses. Joint pains improved by movement, aggravated in the sitting
position. Fingers and toes swollen before menses. Swollen, distended varicosities before menses. Varicose
veins.
Lungs - Bronchitis. Angina, laryngitis with hoarseness. Morning cough, thorax painful on left side.
Modalities - Better during menses. Better from elimination of secretion. Worse from suppression. Worse
before and after menses.
Mouth - Mouth painful, with cracked corners of the lips. Teeth painful, aggravated by cold food, ameliorated
by hot food.
Nose - Sinusitis. Coryza in the morning, improved by getting up, by fresh air. Watery flow, improved between
8 a.m. and 9 a.m.
 Rectum - Rectum prolapsed after eating. Rectal weakness. Mucus diarrhea, hemorrhoid bleeding between
stools, which contain mucus.
Skin - Varicose eczema. Acrocyanosis in young girls. Burns, also for external use in compresses of liquid
extract at 15%, diluted 1:50 in water.
Stomach - Acrid dyspepsia.
Temperature - Chilliness.
Throat - Throat discolored, yellow, dry.
Tonsils inflamed, swallowing painful. Laryngitis.
Vertigo - Vertigo with headache in the morning, worse when learning forwards.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Puls. - close therapeutic relationship, acting on the same type of patient. (2)
Calen. - which is also an excellent healing plant. (3) Rhus-t. - also shows amelioration from movement.
REFERENCES - Julian.

***ARISTOLOCHIA MILHOMENS (Brazilian Snake-Root)
PHARMACY - arist-m. Aristolochia mil- homens. Brazilian snake-root. Aristolochia cymbifera. Aristolochia
glandifera. N. O. Aris- tolochiacae. Tincture of the ttowers. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Achilles tendon. Diabetes. Extravasations. Heart, pain.
HOMEOPATHIC - In a proving by Mure, prominent among the key symptoms were sharp and pricking pains
in various parts. Pain at apex of heart stopping breath. Excoriations of lips and gums. Cramp-like pains in left
Achilles tendon.
Stitching pains in various parts. Pain in heels, burning in anus and frequent irritation. The whole leg is covered
with large irregular patches formed by extravasated blood. Pain in back and limbs. Stiffness of legs. Itching
and swelling around the malleoli.
The mouth is pasty in the morning. Anorexia. Flatulence in stomach and abdomen. Colic followed by diarrhea.
Burning at anus. Disturbed rest. Disgusting dreams. Head burning hot. Great thirst and bitter mouth, makes
water more frequently than usual.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aristolochia Serpentaria.
REFERENCES Clarke.

name: Aristolochia Serpentaria
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - arist-s. Aristolochia serpentaria. Virginia snake-root. Serpentary. N. O. Aris-
tolochiacae.Triturationofdried roots. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Colic. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Flatulence. Poison oak.
HOMEOPATHIC - Aristolochia serpentaria was proved by Jorg's provers and others. Chief effects were noticed
in the gastro-enteric organs, nausea, vomiting, abdominal distention, flatulence and urging to stool. Increased,
and afterwards lost, appetite. Symptoms of intestinal tract, diarrhea, meteorism. Flatulent dyspepsia. Distention
and cutting pains in abdomen.
Irritation of the urinary and genital organs with frequent desire to urinate. Disturbed rest, also heat of the head
(Arist-m.). Brain congestion. Symptoms like those of poison oak.
MIND - Peevish mood. Disinclination for work.
Abdomen - Colic in umbilical region. Distention, rumbling, uneasiness, cutting pains, with emission of flatus,
belchings which relieve. •
Back - Pressive pain in nape of neck.
Head - Sticking in forehead extending to base of brain. Increased warmth of head.
Kidneys - General irritation of urinary and genital organs. Violent desire to urinate with great increase in
quantity of urine. Frequent desire but only a little brownish urine passed.
Mouth - Copious salivation with frequent spitting.
Stomach - Increased appetite, yet able to eat little, since the first morsels satisfy. Loss of appetite. Nausea
and vomiting, vomiting did not cease until the stomach was entirely emptied. Distended feeling as if too full.
Heaviness better by emission of much flatus.
Stool - Distressing itching about anus. Frequent desire with evacuation of more gas than feces. Frequent
desire for stool with evacuation of scanty, hard, tenacious feces with much flatulence.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Arnica Montana
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - am. Arnica montana. Leopard's bane. Brusiewort. Fallkraut. Fall herb. N. O. Composite.
Tincture of whole fresh plant. Tmctureofroot.Historicaldose: All potencies. Arnica should not be used
externally where there is broken skin. For tom and lacerated wounds, Calendula can be used locally.
CLINICAL - Abscess. Aching, pains. Back, pains. Baldness. Bedsores. Black eye. Blows. Boils. Brain
disorders. Breath, fetid. Bronchitis. Bruises. Carbuncle. Chest, disorders. Chorea. Concussions.
Contusions. Coms. Cramp. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Ec- chymosis. Exhaustion. Eyes, disorders.
Falls. Fatigue. Gout. Head, injury. Hematemesis, Hematoma. Hematuria. Headaches. Heart, disorders.
Impotence. Influenza. Injuries. Labor, pains. Lumbago. Mastitis. Meningitis. Mental shock. Miscarriage. Over-
lifting. Over-working. Paralysis. Pleurodynia. Purpura. Pyemia. Rheumatism. Shock. Spleen, pain. Sore,
pains. Sprains. Stings. Strains. Strokes. Suppuration. Swellings. Taste, disorders. Thirst. Trauma.
Traumatic, fever. Tumors. Typhoid. Voicedisorders. Whooping cough. Wounds. Yawning.
HERBAL - Growing on the mountains, Arnica may be said to possess a native affinity to the effects of falls. As
its German name. Fallkraut, attests, its value as a vulnerary has been known from remote times. It may be
said to be the traumatic par excellence.
Ussher noted that the local use of Arnica produced an extraordinary growth of hair on a limb. This suggested
the use of an oil mixed with Am. lx in a case of baldness, which was followed with marked success.
Clarke once ran a piece of wire into the tip of one of his fingers, causing paralyzing pain. He applied Am., 1 x
at once and the pain was better instantly seeming to be wiped out from the point of injury up the arm.
HOMEOPATHIC - Trauma and its effects, recent or remote is met by Arnica as by no other single dmg and
the provings bring out the appropriateness of the remedy in the symptoms it causes. Tumors in many parts,
following injury, have been cured by Arnica including scirrhus tumors of the breast. Nervous disorders as
chorea after falls.
Trauma in all its forms, and the recent or remote effects injuries are covered by this remedy. It produces
conditions upon the system quite similar to those resulting from injuries, falls, blows, contusions. Compound
fractures. Mental or physical shocks.
After traumatic injuries, overuse of any organ, strains. Tinnitus aurium. It affects blood, causing putrid and
septic conditions. Putrid phenomena. Septic conditions, prophylactic of pus infection. Strokes with a red, full
face. It is especially suited to cases when any injury, however remote, seems to have caused the present
trouble. Trauma of grief, remorse or sudden realization of financial loss.
Arnica is disposed to cerebral congestion. Marked effect on the blood. Acts best in plethoric, feebly in
debilitated with impoverished blood, cardiac dropsy with dyspnea. A muscular tonic. Thrombosis. Hematocele.
Influenza with sore bruised muscles. Limbs and body ache as if beaten, joints as if sprained. Bed feels too
hard or full of lumps.
Great prostration, with a tired feeling. Discharges are foul, breath, taste, flatus, stools etc. Tendency to tissue
degeneration, low septic conditions. Abscesses that do not mature. Typhoid, septic fevers. Recurring boils.
Thrombosis. Sore, lame, bruisedfeeling. Rheumatism of muscles and tendons, especially of back and
shoulders. Aversion to tobacco. Vaginitis in females and impotence in males from excessive sexual
indulgence.
MIND - Arnica is used after severe mental stress orshock.Mentaloremotionalshocks.Never well since a
trauma, fright or grief. History of severe physical trauma with chronic men-
tal or emotional effects. Accident, trauma victims. Nervous, can't bear pain, whole body oversensitive.
Fear of being touched or injured. Feels like a wounded animal. Fear of the approach of anyone. Fear of
sickness. Fear of instant death with heart distress. Fear at night. Fear on awakening. Agoraphobia. Fear of
open spaces. Fear of crowds, public places.
Violent attacks of anguish, anxiety with angina pectoris (Aeon.). Easily frightened, unexpected trifles cause
him to start. Hypochondriacal anxiety. Fear remains at night after fright (Op.). A sudden fear that rouses one
from sleep at night especially after an accident (Op.).
Head injury or strokes that effect mental functions. Morose, repentant mood. Overworked and exhausted.
Indifference to work. Depression from injuries to the head (Nat-s.). Forgetful, what he reads quickly escapes
his mind. Absent-minded. Forgets the word he is about to say. Unconscious. When spoken to answers
correctly, but relapses. Coma. Muttering delirium. Delirium tremens.
Morose, delirious. Nervous and mental shock. Sits as if in thought. Says there is nothing the matter with
him. Feels well in serious cases, because of shock. Sends the doctor home. Wants to be left alone. Prays
quietly for her soul. Stupor, with involuntary discharge of feces, typhoid. Stupefaction, loss of sight and hearing,
from concussion of brain.
Abdomen - Colic, with retention of urine. Colic, resembling dysentery. Cramps from epigastrium down over
the bowels, then foul stools. Tympanitic distension. Distended with offensive flatus. Flatus smelling of rotten
 eggs. Bruised pain, in sides of abdomen. Sharp pains from side to side. Sharp thrusts through abdomen. Sharp
pain in region of spleen, taking away breath. Swashing in abdomen as from water.
Back - Backache from muscle strain, overuse. Great soreness and pain in back, as if bruised or beaten.
Back sore and aches, worse overlifting. Agonizing pain in back and hips before urination.
Bruises on back from injuries, blows. Violent pain, in spine, as after sudden rising up after long stooping.
Cervical vertebrae tender. Muscles of neck weak, head falls backwards or any side. Sacrum as if beaten.
Bladder - Retention of urine in bladder from over exertion after labor. Urine retained, with aching and pressing
in bladder. Bladderaffections after mechanical injuries. Bladder tenesmus with very painful urination.
Tenesmus of bladder with diarrhea. Bladder feels full and sore, the pressure of urine hurts him. Cutting pain
in orifice of urethra at end of urination. Infants scream from pain in bladder. Constant dribbling of urine after
labor.
Breasts - Sore nipples. Mastitis from injury. Tumors of breast from injury (Bell-p., Con.). Violent after-pains,
worse nursing.
Causations - Mechanical injuries. Fright, financial loss, anger. Overuse of any organ. Surgical operations.
Insect stings. Splinters.
Chest - Burning or rawness in chest. Sharp pains under false ribs. Bruised, aching sensation in chest on
walking. Sensation as if all ribs were bruised, when coughing. Bones and cartilages of chest are painful, worse
motion, breathing or coughing. Heavy sensation lower chest. Sharp pains in chest, taking the breath away,
better pressure. Pain in intercostal muscles. Pleurodynia (Ran-b.. Bry., Cimic.).
Constitutions - Adapted to sanguine, plethoric persons, disposed to cerebral congestion. Persons easily
made train-sick or seasick. It is suited to persons who are sensitive to mechanical injuries and who feel the
effects of them long after. Teste noted it for plethoric red-faced persons.
Cough - Cough produced by weeping and lamenting. Dry cough from tickling low down in trachea. Cough
causes bloodshot eyes or nosebleed. Violent, spasmodic cough with facial herpes. Cardiac cough,
paroxysmal, at night during sleep, worse exercise. Whooping cough, child cries before coughing. Cough
after measles. Cough in sleep without waking.
Ears - Shooting in and around ears. Blood from ears. Suppurating otitis with stupor. Cartilages of ears as if
bruised. Bruised pain in external ears. Sensitive to shrill noise. Sensitivity to loud sounds. Hearing impaired
from injury to the head. Dull hearing, after concussion. Hardness of hearing. Deafness after typhus. Noises
in ear caused by rush of blood to the head. Humming.
Eyes - Bloodshot. Eyes sunken. Black eye from injury. Traumatic ulceration with much hemorrhage into
anterior chamber. Expedites absorption of clots, in retinal hemorrhage. Bruised iris after cataract operations.
Bruised, sore feeling in eyes after close work. Eyesfeel tired and weary after sightseeing, moving pictures.
Lachrymationburning. Photophobia. Righteye protrudes, looks larger than left. Must keep eyes open, dizzy on
closing them. Photophobia. Pupils contracted, dilated.
Face - Face hot and red, with cold legs. Sunken, very red, pale. Acne sore and painful. Bruised pains.
Chilliness during headache. Herpes in face. Ruddy, congested, bluish red in strokes, fevers. Lower jaw hangs
down, paralysis. Redness and burning of one cheek. Cheeks puffed, red. Swelling of parotid gland during
measles. Throbbing and stinging pain, in swollen cheeks.
Female - Menses, early, hot, profuse. Uterine hemorrhage from mechanical injury after sex. Hemorrhages
bright red or mixed with clots. Bloody discharge between menses. Ulcers of uterus with a tendency to bleed.
Labia painfully swollen. Prolapsus caused by concussion. Ovarian region feels as if sprained, obliging her to
walk bent. Threatened miscarriage from falls etc. Soreness of the whole body during pregnancy. Feeling as if
fetus were lying crosswise. Cannot bear fetal movements, cause nausea and vomiting. Labor pains, weak
orceasing. Bruised parts after labor. Soreness and lameness of parts after delivery. Puerperal fever. Violent
after-pains, worse breast-feeding.
Food - Loss of appetite. Loathing very sight of food. Canine hunger. Loss of appetite
and sourness of stomach of brandy drinkers, creates a disgust for brandy. Aversion to milk and meat. Aversion
to broth, smoking tobacco. Longing for vinegar. Desires sour, alcoholic drinks. Constant desire to drink, but
knows not what for, as all drinks are offensive. Thirst with dry mouth.
Head - Hematoma. Head injury. Headaches from injury to head. Meningitis from injury to head. Periodical
attacks of migraine. Hot head with a cold body. Brain feels tired. Burning in brain. Confused, sensitivity of
brain with sharp, pinching pains. Stroke victims, with loss of consciousness, involuntary evacuations from
bowels and bladder, paralysis. Head as if too large. Headache as from a nail. Headaches from strong emotions.
Cold spot on the forehead. Burning or hot spots on vertex. Head throws backwards while walking. Baldness.
Recurring boils on scalp. Scalp feels contracted.
Heart - Sudden pain as if heart is squeezed or had got a shock. Strain of heart from violent running.
 Weakened heart muscles. Palpitations after any exertion. Palpitations after any shock or injury. Palpitations
shake the whole body. Angina pectoris, with severe pain in elbow of left arm. Sharp pain in heart. Heart pains,
left to right. Horror of constant death with cardiac distress at night. Cardiac dropsy with distressing dyspnea.
Fatty heart and hypertrophy. Pulse feeble and irregular. Weak fluttering of pulse. Pulse hurried. Pulse quicker
than beat of heart.
Kidneys - Cutting pain in kidneys. Piercing pain, as from knives plunged into kidneys, with chilliness and
inclination to vomit. Involuntary dribbling with constant urging. Has to wait a long time for urine to pass. Urine
has dark brick-red sediment. Bloody urine from mechanical causes. Urine in small quantity, staining napkin
yellow-brown. Red urine in liver complaint. Scanty, red urine, very offensive. Brown clear urine which
immediately becomes whitish and turbid.
Limbs - Sore and bruised limbs. Soreness after overexertion. Sprained and dislo-
cated feeling. Lame feeling. Great fear of being touched or approached. Pain in back and limbs, as if bruised
or beaten. Limbs ache as if beaten. Everything on which he lies seems too hard. Bed feels too hard.
Heaviness in all limbs. Deathly coldness of forearm. Joint, muscle pain from injury. Cannot walk erect, on
account of bruised pain in pelvic region. Sore, aching muscles with influenza. Gout. Rheumatism begins
low down and works up (Led.). Rheumatism, from exposure to dampness, cold. Rheumatism from excessive
muscular strain. Cramps in the fingers, writer's cramp. Pain in arms better hanging down. Want of strength in
the hands on grasping. Veins of hands distended. Knee joints suddenly bend when standing. Feet numb.
Liver - Sharp pain in region of liver; painful when turning in bed. Pressure in region of liver. Pain from liver
through left chest and down left arm.
Lungs - Asthma with inclination to move about. Asthma with sleeplessness before midnight. Asphyxia
neonatorum. Dyspnea with hemoptysis. Short, panting breathing. Children lose their breath when angry. Raw,
sore feeling in morning. Pneumonia, approaching paralysis. Can't expectorate, but must swallow whatever is
loosened by coughing. Bloody expectoration. Hemorrhage after mechanical injuries. Offensive, green,
purulent, blood-streaked expectoration. Spitting up of black, thick, viscid blood, or bright red, frothy blood,
mixed with mucus and coagula. Pneumothorax from external injuries. Pleurisy after mechanical injuries.
Pleurodynia (Bry., Ran-b., Cimic.).
Male - Genitals bruised and much swollen. Swelling of penis and scrotum, bluish-red. Hot swelling of scrotum
after injury. Spermatic cords painfully swollen. Relaxed testicles. Hematocele. Phimosis from friction.
Hydrocele caused by a bruise. Violent continued erections often waking. Seminal emission during caress.
Impotence from sexual excess or abuse. Erysipelas of scrotum.
Modalities - Better from lying down. Better lying outstretched. Better with head low. Better motion. Better
clear, cold, stimulating weather. Worse evening and night. Worse from injuries. Worse from falls, blows,
bruises, shock. Worse jarring, noise. Worse after labor, over-exertion, sprains. Worse least touch. Worse
motion. Worse rest. Worse alcohol, wine. Worse damp cold. Worse after sleep. Worse coal gas. Worse lying
on left side.
Mouth - Soreness of gums after teeth extraction (Sep.). Dry and thirsty. Bitter taste (Coloc.). Taste as from
bad eggs. Fetid breath. Taste disgusting, putrid, slimy. Bad taste after operation. Empyema of maxillary sinus.
Bright red, puffy fauces. Saliva diminished. Swallowing is prevented by sort of nausea as if food would not go
down. Heat in lips. Lips burn, swollen and cracked. Lower lip trembles, while eating.
Nose - Bruised, from above downward. Swelling of nose. Nosebleeds after injury. Nosebleeds after every fit
of coughing after washing face, dark fluid blood. Nose feels sore, cold. Violent sneezing from overlifting. Nose
feels sore, cold. Post-nasal drip. Catarrh of antrum. Burning pain in typhoid fever. Nosebleeds during typhoid
fever. Ulcerated nostrils. Empyema of maxillary sinus.
Perspiration - Sour sweat at night. Sour or offensive sweat, sometimes cold. Several transitory sweats all
over at night, with anguish. Worse when sweating. Sweat partial on front of body. Sweat followed by faintness.
Rectum - Flatus smelling of rotten eggs. Sensation of rumbling in rectum, without stools. Obstinate
constipation after a blow on epigastrium. Straining of tenesmus in diarrhea. Dysentery with dysuria, in
summer and autumn. Diarrhea at night, with cutting in intestines. Diarrhea of tuberculosis, worse lying on left
side. Prolapsed anus, worse after walking for few minutes only better washing the whole body. Cramps in
rectum, while standing. Anus as if bruised. Burning along perineum during urination.
Skin - Ecchymosis. Bruises from injury.
Every little injury makes bruises. Black and blue spots. Eruptions after trauma. Red, hot, edematous. Hot,
hard, shining swelling, from insect stings. Dusky, mottled. Acne indurata, characterized by symmetry in
distribution. Very sore acne. Itching, burning, eruption of small pimples. After scratching, itching begins
somewhere else. Tingling and itching which moves from pk"e to place. Crops of small boils (Ichthy., Sil.).
Carbuncles. Bedsores. Petechiae. Erysipelas. Scarlet fever when the eruption doesn't come out. Erythema
 nodosum. Corns. Varicose ulcers.
Sleep - Unrefreshing sleep. Involuntary stools during sleep. Sleepless and restless when overtired. Can't
fall asleep, fantastical illusions while lying awake. Frequent yawning in evening, without sleepiness. Yawning
before chill. Comatose drowsiness, awakens with hot head, drops to sleep as he answers. Nightmares.
Horrors in the night. When dreaming sees black forms of spectres, ghosts, spirits. Dreams of death. Dreams
of being buried alive, suffocation. Dreams of mutilated bodies. Anxious and terrible dreams, awakes in terror,
then sleepless. Awful dreams, of robbers and murderers.
Stomach - Belchings, tasting of bad eggs after coughing. Eructations of bitter mucus. Oppressive gases pass
upward and downward. Stomach distended with wind. Pain in stomach during eating. Pinching, spasmodic
griping pain in stomach. Pressure as from a stone. Feeling as if stomach were pressing against spine. As
if a lump in stomach. Hiccough. Motion sickness. Nausea with burning and scratching in throat. Retching at
night. Fetid vomiting. Vomiting of dark, red coagulated blood. Vomiting of blood after injuries. V omiting of
food, mixed with blood.
Stools - Dysenteric stools with muscular pains. Brown or white diarrhea. Offensive, brown, bloody,putrid
involuntary stools. Stools look like brown yeast. Must lie down after every stool. Stools are bloody, foamy,
purulent, acrid involuntary during
sleep. Ribbon-like stools, from enlarged prostrate or retroverted uterus. Stools consisting of bloody, slimy
mucus, with urging and violent bellyache. Undigested stools.
Teeth - Swollenjaw after dental work. Pains after dental work, injuries. Soreness of gums after teeth
extraction (Sep.). Gums sore, swollen during dentition. Sore and aching after trauma. Beating and tingling
in gums, during toothache. Throbbing, toothache. Excruciating, cutting, tearing, in teeth.
Temperature - Chilly with heat and redness of one cheek. Coldness of part lain on. Thirst during chill. Must
uncover but it chills him. Shivering over whole body. Shivering, as if dashed with cold water. Internal chills
with external heat. Heat and redness of head with coolness of rest of body. Internal heat, feet and hands cold.
Head or face alone hot, body cold. Heat flushes, with thirst. Influenza fever. Intermittent fever. Typhoid fever.
Septic and traumatic fevers.
Throat - Acute tonsillitis, swelling of soft palate and uvula. Bright red, puffy fauces. Burning, when swallowing.
Stinging in back of throat. Raw, sore feeling. Crackling in trachea, when lying down. Hoarseness from
overuse of voice. Hoarseness, worse exertion, colds or getting wet. Hoarseness early in morning. Voice deep
or low, muttering.
Tongue - Tongue dry, almost black. Biting, burning and scraping at root of tongue. Tongue, dry, almost black.
Red stripe down centre of tongue. Tongue coated white. Tongue coated yellow. Tongue dry with brown streak
down middle.
Vertigo - Chronic vertigo, objects whirl about especially when walking. Vertigo of the elderly. Vertigo with
nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. Vertigo worse walking, sitting erect, closing eyes. Vertigo worse, head injury.
Vertigo during headache. Vertigo on rising and on moving.
Vision - Diplopia from trauma, muscular paralysis, retinal hemorrhage. Diplopia, with vertigo, on looking
downward. High objects appear to lean forward and about
to fall. Flickering, worse reading or writing, with headache. Lost vision, after a violent blow. On reading, print
seems to dance in a fog and vanish, must rub eyes. Muscae volitantes. Obscured, lost vision, during headache.
COMMENTS - Arnica is allied to wounds and cures hemorrhages of many kinds including strokes, dilatation
and rupture of small bloodvessels. Vomiting, coughing, purging, accompanied by streaks of blood in vomit.
Extravasation of blood into the conjunctiva as in whooping cough. Hemorrhages into the tissues of internal
organs or the skin.
An odd symptom of Arnica is “coldness of the nose.” A case of facial (left) neuralgia, face swollen, dark red,
very painful to touch, was cured with Arnica (radix), the guiding symptom being “cold nose.” Patient had bitter
taste, was very excitable and worse at night.
Effects of violent cough or sneezing, the child cries before cough comes on (or with the cough) in whooping
cough. Chronic bronchitis when patients have bruised, weak aching in the chest or great sensitiveness of the
chest on exertion or walking.
Arn. affects the left upper extremity and the right chest. Putrid excretions (Bapt.), putrid breath, fetid sweat.
Incessant passing of stool and urine in putrid states.
Nash gave “Stupor with involuntary discharge of feces and urine.” “Fears being touched or struck by those
coming near him.” “Putrid smell from mouth.” “Bruised, sore feeling in uterine region, cannot walk erect.” “While
answering falls into a deep stupor before finishing.” “Head alone or face alone, hot, rest of body cool.”
“Many small boils, painful, one after another, extremely sore.” “Suddenness” is a feature of Arn. pains and
action. P. P. Wells related a cure of double pleuro-pneumonia in a child with sudden stabbing pains on both
 sides of the chest almost preventing breathing. Arnica instantly caused a violent aggravation, the next instant
relief was perfect and the child fell asleep breathing naturally.
Keynote sore, bruised feeling. Bluish discoloration, bruising, better cold applications. The bed feels too hard.
Fatigue, “fear of being approached,” an animal-like fear of guarding a wounded area. Can believe nothing is
wrong when severely injured, sign of shock (Op.). Patient may be irritable and want to be left alone. Can have
amnesia, or nightmares after injury or loss of confidence since injury. Intermittent fear of death.
A major goutremedy, afraid of joints being touched. Good for flus and mono when there is a sore, achy feeling
all over. Also acute muscle fatigue in athletes. Superficial tissue trauma. Boils that feel sore and bruised.
Comas from trauma and injury. Any fever with a sore, bruised feeling. For chronic weak joints after repeated
injuries. Shock due to trauma or shock from the injury itself. For grief and financial shock.
Good for overexertion. It's also used for trauma from blows from blunt instruments, sprains. For post-stroke
victims, for injuries and hematomas. For heart attacks from overexertion. For internal bleeding. Achi- ness and
weakness from the weight of the baby in pregnant women. For people who have a tendency to bruise easily.
Vertigo, worse head injuries and strokes. Also for severe illness when the patient goes into the stupor stage.
Good after dental work. For vomiting of blood after injury to the abdominal region or injury to the uterus.
Sensitive to cold damp weather, and hot sun. Worse from touch. Alcohol will aggravate the condition, but may
crave alcohol to relieve pain. Also worse tobacco. Sensation worse after an adjustment to spine (Ruta., Rhus-
t.).
RELATIONS - Antidotes: Camph. Vitex trifolia. Compare: ( 1 ) Aeon., Bapt., Bell-p., Ham., Led., Rhus-t..
Hyper., Symph.. (2) Abrot., Absin., Calen., Cham., Cina, Gnaph. (3 ) other Composites. (4) Am-c., Crot-t. -
swashing in abdomen. (5) Ars., Bapt. - typhoid states, Bapt. “feels ill,” Arn. “feels well.”Bry.,Rhod.,Ruta., Sul-
ac. Complementary: Aeon., Ip. Follows well: Aeon., Ip., Verat., Apis. Followed well by: Aeon., Ars., Bry.,
Ip., Rhus-t. Antidote to: Am-c., Chin., Cie., Ferr., Ign., Ip., Seneg. Antidoted by: Camph., Ip. (to massive
doses),
Coffee (headache), Aeon., Ars., Chin., Ign., Ip. (to potencies).
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
keynote:
PHARMACY - am. Arnica montana. Leopard's bane. Brusiewort. Fallkraut. Fall herb. N. O. Composite.
Tincture of whole fresh plant. Tmctureofroot.Historicaldose: All potencies. Arnica should not be used
externally where there is broken skin. For tom and lacerated wounds, Calendula can be used locally.
CLINICAL - Abscess. Aching, pains. Back, pains. Baldness. Bedsores. Black eye. Blows. Boils. Brain
disorders. Breath, fetid. Bronchitis. Bruises. Carbuncle. Chest, disorders. Chorea. Concussions.
Cont

name: Arsenicum Album
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ars. Arsenicum album. White oxide of arsenic. Arsenic trioxide. Solution and trituration.
Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Abscess. Acne rosacea. Albuminuria. Alcoholism. Allergies. Amenorrhea. Anemia. Angina
pectoris. Anorexia. Antrax. Anxiety. Aphonia. Aphthae. Ascites. Asthma. Atrophy. Bronchitis. Burning,
pains. Cachexia. Cancer. Cancrum, oris. Carbuncle. Cecum, disorders. Chills. Cholera asiatica. Colds.
Colitis. Coryza. Coughs. Croup. Cyanosis. Dandruff. Delirium tremens. Despair. Diabetes. Diarrhea.
Diphtheria. Dropsy. Dysentery. Dyspepsia. Ears disorders. Eczema. Emaciation. Endometritis. Enteric fever.
Epithelioma. Erysipelas. Eye, disorders. Face, eruptions. Fainting. Fatigue. Fears. Fevers. Food, poisoning.
Gangrene. Gastric, ulcers. Gastritis. Gastroenteritis. Glandular, swellings. Gout. Hay asthma. Hay fever.
Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hepatitis. Herpes zoster. Hodgkin's disease. Hydrothorax. Ichthyosis.
Influenza. Intermittent fever. Jaundice. Kala- azar. Kidney, diseases. Leucorrhea. Leukemia. Lichen. Lips,
epithelioma. Locomotor ataxia. Lung disorders. Lupus. Malaria. Malignant, pustules. Measles. Menstruation,
disorders. Miliary, eruptions. Myelitis. Nausea. Nettle rash. Nephritis. Nervousness. Neuralgias. Numbness.
Paralysis. Peritonitis. Pityriasis. Plethora. Pleurisy. Pleurodynia. Pneumonia. Prostration. Psoriasis. Purpura.
Remittent, fever. Restlessness. Rheumatism. Rickets. Ringworm. Scarlatina. Sciatica. Scrofulous, disorders.
Sea-bathing. Seasickness. Septic, fever. Sneezing. Stomach, disorders. Strains. Suppuration. Throat, sore.
Tobacco habit. Tongue, disorders. Traumatic, fever. Typhlitis. Typhus. Ulcers. Uremia. Vomiting. Weakness.
Whooping cough. Worms. Wounds. Yellow fever.
HOMEOPATHIC - Grimmer stated that Ars. helped cancer, epithelioma, lupus, pernicious anemia have
yielded to the power of this potent medicine. Typhus and pernicious types of malaria present a fair picture of
the range and character of the sickness this remedy has cured.
Arsenicum album is a very deep acting remedy, affecting every organ and tissue. Ars. acts on the nerves
producing inveterate neuralgias and multiple neuritis better heat. All-prevailing anxiety, exhaustion and
restlessness with nightly aggravation, are most important. Great exhaustion after the slightest exertion.
Burning pains. Burning relieved by heat. Seaside complaints (Nat-m., Aq-mar.). Pains are maddening,
burning likefire, hot needles or wires, better warmth. Acute and chronic bums. Sudden intense effects.
Sudden great weakness from trivial causes. Very restless, restless even in affected part, even stupor is
interrupted by fits of restlessness with anxious moaning.
 Fear, fright and worry. Dying patients, Ars. gives quiet and ease to the last moments of life when given in
high potency. Cancer pains. The prostration seems to be out of proportion to the rest of his illness. Anemia
and chlorosis. Low vitality. Putrid cadaveric odors. Emaciation. Gradual loss of weight.
Asthma, worse after getting colds in midsummer. Asthma, worse around midnight. Unable to lie down, fears
suffocation. Anxious, must sit up, worse from odors, laughing, ascending, turning in bedorreced- ing
eruptions, better coffee or sweet water. Hay fever. Air-passages constricted from allergies. Shortness of
breath. Suffocative catarrh. Whistling, wheezing breathing.
Ars. should be thought of in ailments from alcoholism, Ptomaine poisoning, stings, dissecting wounds, chewing
tobacco. Food poisoning. Ill effects from decayed food or animal matter, odor of discharges is putrid in
complaints that return annually. Injurious effects of fruits, especially more watery ones.
Discharges of mucus membranes are acrid, thin and scanty, coryza, saliva,
sweat etc. Weakness and emaciation is rapid. Degenerative changes. Gradual loss of weight from impaired
nutrition. Reduces the refractive index of blood serum (also Chin, and Ferr-p.). Malarial cachexia. Septic
infections and low vitality. Green discharges. Unquenchable thirst. Infantile Kala-azar.
Infections. Alcoholism. Frequent fainting. Destructive process, carbuncles, gangrene, cancer, malignancy.
Dropsy, pale, baggy, swellings. Restlessness, then becomes drowsy. Eruptions undeveloped or sup-
pressed.
MIND-Clinging, anxious and desperate. Begs for help. Extremely nervous and anxious. Deep insecurities
and fears. Desires company, fears to be left alone. Restlessness, changes place continually. Inclined to
complain and whine to those about her. Indecisive. Weeps and whines, but speaks little.
Full of worries about trifles. Anxiety about the future. Anxiety about health. Anxiety about others. Anguish
and restlessness. Anxiety on waking from frightful dreams. Anxiety during headache. Anxiety, better motion.
Anxiety about trifles.
Fear of death, yet tired of living, worse night. Fear of starvation. Fear of financial loss, poverty. Fear of
diseases. Fear of getting cancer. Fear of catching an infection. Fear of germs, viruses. Fear of being poisoned.
Fear of being left alone (Phos., Puls.). Fear of violence. Great fear with cold sweats. Fears something may
have happened to relatives.
Children are capricious, want to be carried, want to go from father to mother to nurse (Cham.). Lacks courage.
Frighten easily. Desires to be carried fast. Desires company, fears to be left alone. Clings to parents.
Obsessive compulsive disorder. Fastidious, upset about disorder, dirt, germs. Obsessed with order and
tidiness. Sensitive to disorder and confusion. Suspicious. Miserly. Selfish and her desires exceeds her needs.
Inclined to malice and satire.
Clinging to a doctor, needing reassurance. Exaggerating symptoms to assure attention. Domineering and
demanding.
Angry with himself and others. Faultfinding and reproaches others. Irritability alternating with despondency.
Irritability and restlessness during headache.
Melancholy. Despair of recovery. Despair drives him from place to place. Thinks it useless to take medicine.
Consolation aggravates. Moaning and groaning, walks about wringing hands. Groans, moans and weeps
during menses.
Insanity. Delirium tremens, cursing and raving, vicious. Mania, wants to be held. Fixed ideas. Tormenting
thoughts. Suicidal impulses, mania, determined to commit suicide, he suffers so. Fear of being left alone, lest
he do himself bodily harm (Nat-s.). Has no rest anywhere, rolls about on floor and despairs for his life.
Hallucinations of smell and sight. Delusions, body will putrefy. Sees ghosts day and night. Sees vermin, throws
away bugs by handfuls. Carphologia. Imagines house full of thieves, jumps and hides. Fears he has murdered
somebody. Self-torture, pulls her hair, bites her nails, tears at own body. Abdomen - Peritonitis. Ascites and
ana
sarca. Gastroenteritis. Coldness and chilliness in abdomen. Abdomen swollen and painful. Rumbling in
bowels. Periodical colic. Burning pains. Crampy pains in bowels. Cutting pains. Violent pains in abdomen
with anguish. Violent squeezing and constricting, in umbilical region. Intussusception with pain in abdomen.
Liver and spleen enlarged and painful. Spleen is enlarged in malarial fever, kala- azar. Pain as from a wound
in abdomen on coughing. Gnawing, burning pains like coals of fire, relieved by heat. Epigastrium sore, tender.
Ulcer above navel. Peritonitis. Swelling of inguinal glands.
Back - Burning pains in back (Ox-ac.). Weakness in lumbar region. Bruised pain in small of back. Cold, chill
creeps up back. As if warm air streaming up spine to the head. Drawing in of shoulders. Stiffness of the back
ascends from coccyx to nape. Neck stiff, as if bruised or sprained. Sacrum as if broken. Small of back as if
broken, with hemorrhoids.
Back - Cervical glands enlarged, felt like a series of hard nodules under skin. Ulceration of sacrum after
 typhoid.
Bladder - Acute cystitis, with violent burning pains. Dysuria. Burning in urethra during urination. Burning
at commencement of urinating. Bladder as if paralyzed. Atony of bladder in old persons. Retention of urine.
Retention of urine after confinement. Great desire, but passes no urine. Bedwetting, nocturnal.
Blood - Leukemia, especially in children. Blood is disorganized causing pernicious type of anemia and severe
septic conditions. Hemorrhages, of black offensive blood.
Breasts - Burning in breasts, better motion. Mastitis.
Causations - Ill effects of food poisoning, eating ices, poor diet, watery fruits tobacco, quinine, sea bathing
and traveling, mountain climbing. Care, grief, fright, ptomaine poisoning, financial loss, poverty. dissecting
wounds.

quantities.
COMMENTS - Anshutz's best successes were in obstinate cases of syphilis, in the first stages of tabes
dorsalis, in the reconvalescence from exhausting acute diseases, in gastric suppurations inactivity of bowels,
tardy digestion, constipation.
In those cases where Chin-s. failed in intermittent fevers, he prescribed Ars-br. twice daily, four drops, each
time in a full glass of water. Gradually diminishing it to
one daily dose and in four weeks.
Even the most obstinate cases yielded to this treatment. The patient felt encouraged by his increasing vigor,
the fever-cakes disappear, the bowels moved regularly and appetite left nothing to be desired. Those mean
obstinate cases of intermittent fevers often appearing in the form of unbearable neuralgias, yielded more
rapidly to it than to the Quinine.
Anshutz noted the case of “S. T., age 46 years old, contracted syphilis some years ago and was relieved of it
by mercurial treatment and by Zittman's decoction. About six years ago he felt out of sorts and a papular
eruption appeared on forehead, temples and especially at the root of the nose. Though treatment was
immediately instituted, still in a few weeks the face of the patient was covered by ugly, foul-smelling crust.
“Cod liver oil was now taken internally and applied externally until the scurfs fell off and the eruption
concentrated on three points. For six months that treatment was kept up, but after being omitted for a few
weeks, the eruption spread again to its former extent. Every treatment was tried in rotation without the least
benefit.
“In the spring 1856 he entered my clinic. In the center of the forehead, at the root of the nose, on both eyebrows
on the temples and right cheek there are moist herpetic eruptions covered with crusts, exuding on least
pressure an acrid, burning discharge, with easily bleeding.
“Around these eruptions the skin is injected, reddened interspersed with a large network of veins. Cough and
expectoration hint to a beginning of tuberculosis, an heirloom in the family. Little appetite, disturbed digestion,
tardy defecation and evening fever.
“He is ordered Solutio Ars-br. twice a day, four drops in a glass of water and already after two weeks the
eruption begins to dry up, appetite returns and bowels are regular.
“After two months two crusts fall off and the skin under them is soft, shining, somewhat red. About July all
eruption had gone and the cough greatly improved.”
He continued by noting that “Ars-br. is also a powerful remedy in diabetes mellitus and insipidus, cured cases
where the patient had already been reduced from 138 pounds to 98 and where the urine could be condensed,
 by boiling into syrupy consistency.
“A diabetic patient needs fresh pure air if he wishes to get well, confinement in a room or in the office prevents
the action of any treatment, for it needs ozone to reduce the sugar of the blood into carbonic acid and water.
“Let the patient take three drops thrice daily in a glass of water and after a week the insatiable burning thirst
will be quenched and these doses must be continued until the quantity of sugar in the urine is reduced, when
the remedy might be taken twice a day and continued for a long time.” REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke.
Clarke.

name: Arsenicum Hydrogenisatum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ars-h. Arsenicum hydrogenisatum. Arseniurettedhydrogen. Arsenic hydrogen. Solution in
distilled water. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Collapse. Hematuria. Hemorrhages. Hiccough. Menses, suppressed. Prostration. Sneezing.
Urine, suppressed. Vertigo. Vomiting. Yellow fever.
HOMEOPATHIC - Ars-h. was used by Drysdale as a substitute for Arsenic in the collapse stage of cholera.
The symptoms set in suddenly but developed slowly. In poisoning cases, death often took place in the second
week and one person, who recovered, suffered seven weeks.
Though like Ars. in general symptoms, the gas has symptoms of its own. The general action is the same, but
more accentuated. A striking case of sudden suppression of menses was cured with Ars-h. after failure of Ars.
Anemia. Anxiety, despair. Hematuria with general blood disorganization. Hemorrhages from mucus
membranes. Urine suppressed, followed by vomiting. The prepuce and glans of penis are covered with
pustules and round superficial ulcers.
Collapse. Coldness, prostration. Sudden weakness and nausea. Skin becomes dark brown.
MIND - Mental activity much impaired. Indifference on hearing most important news. Discouraged. Impeded
in talking, answers very slowly. Answers abruptly, shortly. Changeable. Starting during sleep. Thinking of water
irritates, as if he would have to vomit, nauseates him.
Anxiety, restlessness with great prostration of strength. Anxious feeling before chill. Full of care and fear about
complaints when getting awake at night. Fear of death when alone. Excitable, wants to talk constantly.
Impatience. Loud complaining about unbearable pains in spine.
Abdomen - Distension of abdomen during chill. Gurgling noise, Incarcerated flatus. Sensation as from a stone
lying in abdomen. Glowing heat in abdomen with cold limbs. Violent cutting pain in region of navel, paroxysmal.
Colic with vomiting, before midnight. Burning pain through whole alimentary canal. Softening of spleen. Pain
in loins during vomiting.
Back - Sensation as if something were sticking below right scapula. Glow in back after chilliness. Backache
causing loud lamentations. Tearing pain in neck during chill. Pressure between shoulders. Crawling over
shoulders and back. Shuddering over single parts of back. Violent pain in lumbar region. Violent pain in sacrum.
Stiffness of neck and between scapulae.
Chest - Constriction of chest, during chill. As if whole thorax were laced tightly, with rapid breathing. Sore, raw,
over whole chest. Crawling, as if warm drops running over chest. Glowing sensation in chest after chilly feeling.
Pain in middle of sternum, worse walking about. Pressure over whole chest with great anxiety.
Eyes - Eyes sunken, broad, blue circles around. Eyes lustreless. Conjunctiva reddened during chill.
Heavinesss of lids, have to be lifted up with fingers. Blue light before right eye when falling asleep. Dim vision.
Face - Expression of extreme anxiety. Painfully distorted features. Face looks old and bears an expression of
pain. Face copper-colored, or dark red. Chilly feeling in face, followed by a glow. Yellowish face at beginning
of chill. Pain in maxillary joints, when first opening mouth. Heat in face. Face edematous, worse evening. Face
greatly changed. Very painful twitching. Lips colorless. Upper lip sore with chill.
Food - Less appetite, eats without relish. Loss of appetite. Violent thirst and a dry tongue. Much thirst. Sensitive
to tobacco. Sweet things taste too sweet.
Head - Head dull and benumbed. Pressure in forehead. Heaviness. Pressing, stupefying sensation at night.
Headache above forehead. Pressure in right frontal sinus. Pressure above eyebrows with numbness. Violent
pressive frontal headache, worse at night. Head worse warmth. Pain in upper and back part of head when
coughing. Pain in forehead during chill.
Heart - Knocking, thumping, in heart, deep in chest. Pulse frequent. Pulse quite imperceptible. Pulse intermits
when awaking at night, with anxiety and thoughts of death.
Kidneys - Heat and burning over kidney region. Unpleasant sensation of pressure in region of kidneys. Urging
to urinate. Urine dark red and a thick clot of pure blood is formed. Pressure in kidneys with desire to urinate.
Large quantities of pale urine. Scanty, foaming urine in morning. Inky urine. Urine very dark, orange-colored.
 Limbs - Coldness of limbs.
Liver - Liver painful to pressure.
Lungs - Frequent, with pain in perineum. Talking worse. Coming from front upper part of chest. Coughing
causes sweating.
Male - Sensation of numbness. Unbearable pain in both groins. Pain in symphysis pubis, sensitive to touch.
Pain in left side of penis. Sexual irritation on glans penis. Whole foreskin and glans covered with little blisters
containing pus. Small round flat ulcers.
Modalities - Worse dampness. Worse before thunderstorm. Worse from motion.
Mouth - Mouth hot and dry, little thirst. Bitter taste, with great prostration. Contracting. Sensation of numbness,
like a cold feeling. Increased salivation. Ammoniacal odour of breath.
Nose - Unpleasant crawling in nose causes sneezing. Nose as if deadened. Nose feels as if dried up. Violent
sneezing. Nose cold, must be wrapped up in warm cloths. Tickling up in nose, causes sneezing. Bloody mucus
from nose. Nose and lips somewhat excoriated.
Perspiration - Sweats in large drops on face and whole head. General, warm sweat, after midnight. Attacks
of night sweat. Sweats on falling asleep.
Rectum - Urging as to diarrhea. Copious passage of wind and looseness. Frequent bilious stools. Constipation
with feeling of heaviness and stiffness, like a weight. Stool with vertigo, weakness and crawling. Weak
sensation, as if relaxed. Sensation as if diarrhea would fall out, evening. Thumping, knocking, in region of
perineum, near anus. Tearing pain in perineum. Tearing pain upward in anterior wall of rectum.
Skin - Dark brown skin all over.
Sleep - Can’t get to sleep for a long while, feels as if he had to move about. Total sleeplessness. So drowsy
that he can hardly open his eyes. Sopor between attacks of vomiting. Moaning in sleep. Sleep interrupted by
headache. Sleep interrupted by slightest noise. Sleep disturbed by wind colic towards morning. Frequent
starting while falling asleep. Very pleasant, poetical dreams. Dreams he was praying. Dreams of people going
and arriving.
Stomach - Irritability of stomach. Burning pain. Weary feeling in stomach with pressure in temples. Belching
with taste of food eaten. Spasmodic eructations of tasteless gas. Violent cutting pain in stomach. Pressure in
epigastric region during chill. Pressure of hand causes dull pain in pit. Hiccough following eructations.
Tormenting hiccough. Incessant retching and vomiting.
Stomach - Vomiting with pain in loins. Vomiting liquid, first bilious and afterwards coffee-colored. Vomiting of
green, bitter mucus during colic. Vomits large masses.
Temperature - Chills while walking. Chilly and weak while attempting to rise. Glowing heat in abdomen and
cold limbs all night. Much heat and burning in different parts of body.
Throat - Burning and constriction in throat, followed by irritability of stomach. Squeaking voice. Whispering
voice. Voice has lost its timbre, sounds as if broken, but not hoarse.
Tongue - Tongue enlarged. Tongue deep, irregular ulcer. Tongue nodular swelling. Sensation of numbness
in the tongue. Pricking on tip of tongue. Tongue slimy. Tongue yellow. Yellowish furred tongue during chill.
Back part of tongue greyish- white.
Vertigo - Swimming sensation in head and whole body. Violent vertigo, on going up stairs. Vertigo, staggers
against sides of stairs. Vertigo with general weakness. Vertigo, with nausea and vomiting. Vertigo, with
pressure in frontal sinuses.
RELATIONS -Antidotedby: Am-a. Compare: ( 1 ) Ars. (2) Sinapis - breathing. (3) Nux-v. - fever, drinks
containing sulfuretted hydrogen.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
