name: Asclepias Tuberosa
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - asc-t. Asclepias tuberosa. Pleurisy root. Butterfly-weed. N. O. Asclepiadacae. North America.
Tincture of fresh root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Alopecia. Asthma. Bilious fever. Bronchitis. Catarrh. Chancre. Colic. Coughs. Diarrhea. Dyspnea.
Dysentery. Flatulence. Headaches. Heart disorders.Influenza. Marsh, fever. Ophthalmia. Pericarditis.
Pleurisy. Pleurodynia. Pleuro-pneumonia. Pneumonia. Rheumatism. Scrofula. Syphilis.
HERBAL - Asc-t. is said to be diaphoretic and expectorant, without being stimulant. In large doses, it is often
a cathartic. It is thought, by the herbal doctors, to act prominently on the cutaneous system, stimulating the
capillary circulation, promoting diaphoresis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Asclepias tuberosa has been used for bronchitis andpleurisy. Marked action on the chest
muscles, which has been verified. Also effective in autumn dysentery with painful diarrhea, griping and
tenesmus.
Increases the secretions of skin, serous and mucus membranes. Catarrhal states from cold and damp weather.
Bronchitis and pleurisy. Pains in lungs better bending forward. Stitches in left side shooting over to right and
up to left shoulder. Profuse perspiration in pneumonia and pleuropneumonia.
A general eliminative remedy, acting specially on the sweat glands. Influenza with pleuritic pains. Cutting pain
behind sternum intercostal spaces near sternum tender to pressure. Catarrhal complaints from cold and
damp weather. Bilious marsh fever on rice plantations. High fever with hot sweat.
Sick headache with flatulence in stomach and bowels. Dyspepsia. Sensitive to tobacco. Unfit for business
because of pain in bowels and frequent stools. Irritation of larynx with huskiness, grip with pleuritic pain.
Diarrhea or rheumatic conditions. Muscular and joint rheumatism with stitching pains, dark red urine and hot,
perspiring skin.
MIND - Dullness of mind with difficult thinking. Languid and dull all day both in body and mind. Memory weak.
Mood changes, without any cause.Cheerful mood. Excessive dejection. Fretful and peevish.
Abdomen - Flatulence after meals. Colic pains from flatulence. Colic on going upstairs. Rumbling in the bowels
with uneasiness, or sharp, cutting pains and soreness. Burning borborygmi. Dull pain in bowels on pressure.
 Emission of fetid flatulence.
Back - Stiff-neck on waking. Sharp pains in back and between the shoulders. Pains shooting from left chest
into left shoulder. Sharp pain in loins near sacrum, lumbago.
Breasts - Sharp pains shooting from left nipple downward, with stiffness of left side of neck. Pain beneath left
nipple with palpitations.
Chest - Warm feeling in chest. Pleurisy. Pleurodynia. Acute pleuritic pain in right side, with dry, hacking cough,
and scanty mucus expectoration. Chest pains better bending forward, worse lying, breathing. Pains worse 4
a.m. and 4 p.m. Spaces between ribs close to sternum tender. Pain in lower chest, diaphragm.
Constitutions - Hydrogenoid type, which corresponds to catarrhal complaints, worse from cold and damp
weather.
Eyes - Eyes look dull, fatigued, and heavy, as after a long illness. Ophthalmia, with itching and pain in eyes.
Feeling of sand in the eyes. Vision disturbed, large spots before the eyes.
Face - Hippocratic face after violent diarrhea. Yellow complexion. Vesicles on lips. Itching of lips.
Female - Profuse menses. Menorrhagia with violent bearing down pain.
Food - Loss of appetite, especially in morning. Insatiable hunger. Sensitive to tobacco.
Head - Headache better after footbath. Headache in the morning on rising. Headache pressing deeply on the
base of the skull. Pain in the forehead from coughing. Alopecia.
Heart - Pericardial effusion. Constrictive pain in the heart. Tenderness to pressure over heart. Sharp pains,
like pricking of a needle in region of heart. Pulse slightly accelerated.
Kidneys - Sharp pain in urethra, excoriation of glans penis in several places with bloody and purulent
secretion. Urine very red, looks as if blood were in it.
Limbs - Rheumatic pain in all the joints. Rheumatic pains that affect the body diagonally, or left upper and
right lower or the opposite. Pains near wrists. Joints give sensations as if adhesions being broken up on
bending. Itching of thighs and buttocks but no eruption. Pain in right hip. Corns painful.
Lungs - Short of breath and weak on walking. Bronchitis and pleurisy. Dry cough, throat constricted, causes
pain in head and abdomen.
Lungs - Breathing painful, at base of left lung. Humid asthma, worse after eating, worse after smoking a
little. Oppression and difficulty of breathing, in paroxysms, like asthma. Catarrh with frontal headache and
sticky yellow discharge.
Male - Flabbiness, perspiration, and insipid smell of genitals. Excoriation of glans penis in several places with
a bloody discharge, better by bathing with urine. Chancre. Weakness, erection without desire.
Modalities - Worse in morning. Worse on rising. Worse by motion. Worse by coughing. Worse from tobacco.
Worse from motion. Worse deep breathing. Worse lying down. Worse rising up. Worse coughing.
Mouth - Breath smells like pepper. Tough yellow coating on tongue. Taste, putrid of blood. Teeth yellow-
coated. Bleeding of the gums. Tongue covered with a tough yellow coating.
Nose - Sticky yellow nasal discharge, Snuffles of children. Fluent coryza with much sneezing. Blowing of blood
from left nostril. Itching of the nose. Snuffles of children.
Rectum - Autumnal dysentery. Tenesmus. Catarrhal dysentery with rheumatic
pains. Diarrhea is a worse in winter. Stools with a feeling as stream of fire passing through abdomen. Soft and
fetid stool. Early morning diarrhea. Winter diarrhea. Stools like white of eggs, yellow, green, clammy,
enveloped in froth, like moss. Stools smell like rotten eggs or burn like fire. Constipation after diarrhea.
Skin - Vesicles, pimples, and pustules all over the body, especially on arms, legs, and face, itching.
Sleep - Drowsy. Uneasy, restless sleep. Troublesome dreams.
Stomach - Fullness, pressure, weight. Belchings. Nausea, and efforts to vomit, in the morning when rising.
Stomach pains, burning, disagreeable weight. In evening, violent stomach pain after supper. Cramps.
Temperature - Chill towards noon, with cold feet though room is warm. Feverish afternoon. High fever with
hot sweat. Rheumatic, catarrhal, bilious marsh fevers of rice plantations.
Throat - Slight constriction of throat, and pricking in larynx.
Vertigo - Feeling of drunkenness with weakness of sight after smoking a very little. Swimming of the head with
dullness behind forehead.
COMMENTS - Sharp, stitching, pricking pains, worse by motion. Sensitive to tobacco. Pain in forehead and
abdomen from coughing. Griping and sharp peritoneal pains, worse by pressure. Excessive weakness, walking
seems impossible.
Dyspnea. Hard cough, dry or hoarse, croupy with tight breathing and constriction of larynx and acute pleuritic
pains. Warm feeling in chest. Pain like pricking of a needle in region of heart. Contracting pain in heart. Sharp
pains, starting from left nipple downward with stiffness of left side of neck.
Increased secretions of skin, serous and mucus membranes. Catarrhal states from cold and damp weather.
 Bronchitis and pleurisy (often will follow Bry. in pleurisy cases), coughing and pain in the chest and pain on
breathing. Pains in lungs, better bending forward.
Stitches in left side shooting over to right and up to left shoulder. Profuse perspiration in pleuro-pneumonia.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Ant-t. (2) Asclepias Incamata. Periplocagreca - Cardiac tonic, acts on circulation
and respiratory center, accelerating the respiration in a ratio disproportionate to pulse. (3) Agar., diagonal
pains. (4) Bry., Verat. Relieved pains with stool at night. (5) Dulc. - worse cold and damp.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

All potencies.

HOMEOPATHIC - Asclepias vincetoxicum is a gastro-intestinal irritant. Producing vomiting and purgation. Asc-

REFERENCES - Boericke.

name: Asimina Triloba
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - asim. Asimina triloba. American papaw. Anona triloba. Paw Paw. Custard Apple. N. O.
Anonaceae. Tincture of ripe and unripe fruit, green leaves, bark and root. Historical dose: Tincture and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne. Aphthae. Carbuncle. Cramp. Diarrhea. Fever. Glands, enlarged. Hoarseness. Scarlatina.
Throat, sore. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - The Anonaceae, to which Asimina belongs, are allied to the Magnolia family. From eating
the unripe fruit, five children developed high fever, sore throat and a scarlet eruption with diarrhea, one of them
eventually having a carbuncle.
Asimina produces a series of symptoms much like scarlet fever, sore throat, fever, vomiting, scarlet eruption.
Tonsils and submaxillary glands enlarged with diarrhea. Fauces are red and swollen. Face swollen.
In provings, the mouth, throat and stomach are irritated. Drinks much, desire
for ice cold things and worse after eating. Hoarseness talks with difficulty. Languid, drowsy irritable.
Acne. Itching in evening on undressing. Thick, yellow nasal discharge in morning. Hard, flaky, dark grey and
often offensive nasal discharge. Cramps in chest.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Caps., Bell., Ill. (Colic).
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Asparagus Officinalis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aspar. Asparagus officinalis. Garden asparagus. N. O. Liliaceae. Tincture of young sprouts.
Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Coryza. Coughs. Cystitis. Diabetes. Dropsy. Gravel. Heart disorders. Hydrothorax. Kidney,
disorders. Kidney, stones. Migraine. Nasal catarrh. Palpitations. Polyuria. Pulse, weak. Rheumatic, pains.
Urinary disorders.
HERBAL - Asparagus has a marked and immediate action on the urinary secretion. Like other liliaceous plants
it acts on the kidneys, heart and dropsical effusions.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cystitis. Frequent urination with fine stinging in the meatus, followed by stitches out of the
urethra. After urinating, burning in urethra with sensation as if some were still passing. Increased urine, beer-
brown without sediment. Urine is strong smelling, odor peculiar, deposits greasy sediment on sides of vessel,
gravel.
Severe coryza and nasal catarrh with profuse secretion of thin, whitish fluid from left nostril, afterwards right.
Frequent violent sneezing. Copious discharge of tenacious mucus from the throat, not easily loosened, but
brought up by hawking or paroxysms of cough.
Weakness and cardiac depression with dropsy. Rheumatic pains, especially about left shoulder and heart.
Fullness in chest, hydrothorax. Visible violent palpitations, while sitting, with anxious restlessness increased
by motion or ascending with oppression of chest.
Pulse weak, slow, irregular. Pain at left acromion process, under clavicle and down left arm. Constant desire
to be carried about in the arms.
 MIND - Constant anxiety and apprehension. Anxiety with palpitations of the heart and ill humor. Calmness of
the mind. Fretful and peevish. Disturbed by trifles.
Abdomen - Sensation of fullness in the abdomen, pinching in the umbilical region, at night with painful
sensibility to the touch. Inflation of the abdomen, frequent emission of wind.
Back - Pain near the shoulders on touching the part, rheumatic pain between the shoulders. Sensation, as if
something passed through kidneys and penetrated to the abdominal vertebrae, on the patient sitting down.
Shootings pains, especially below the left shoulder blade. Pains in the region of the false vertebrae.
Chest - Oppression of the chest, especially when writing. Dyspnea brought on by motion, on going upstairs.
Pressure on the chest. Emptiness within, with weight on the chest. Severe shooting pain across the right side
when sitting down. Hydrothorax.
Eyes - Darting and tingling in the eyes, sight more piercing.
Face - Paleness of the face. Increase of heat in the face, cheeks burning.
Female - Menses continue a day beyond the usual time.
Food - Thirst increased. Feeble appetite. Fullness and oppression after eating and drinking. V omiting of food
taken evening before. Palpitations after eating.
Head - Aching in forehead and root of nose. Morning migraine headaches with scotoma. Aching pain in the
temples, aggravated by pressure, weight in the forehead.
Heart - Irregular beating of the heart, rapid, redoubled. Heartbeat almost imperceptible. Palpitations with
oppression of chest. Palpitations, which are visible and audible even during very gentle movements with
agitation and anxiety. Palpitations from
Asparagus officinalis motion and on ascending the stairs, worse when seated. Shooting pains in the region
of the heart after a meal. Pulse slightly accelerated, feeble, intermits, weak.
Kidneys - Frequent urination with fine stitches in orifice of urethra, burning of peculiar odor. Kidney
stones. Cystitis with pus, mucus and tenesmus. Urgent inclination to urinate. Frequent and scanty emission
of urine, preceded by a sensation as if a foreign body were in the urethra. Diminished secretion of urine,
burning in the urethra.
Limbs - Rheumatic pain in back, especially near shoulder and limbs. Pain at acromion process of left scapula
under clavicle and down arm with feeble pulse. Pain, as of dislocation in the right hip joint, which causes
lameness. Shootings in the knees, at night afterwards under the left patella, on being seated. Bruise-like pains.
Severe drawing pains in the calf of the right leg, in the morning, on waking and on extending the limb, cramps
in both calves.
Lungs - Great oppression in breathing. Frequent sneezing, hawking with irresistible inclination to cough, but
without any power to detach mucus, paroxysms of coughing, which compel the patient to rise from his seat,
abating after breakfast, violent cough, attended by oppression of the chest and copious expectoration of
mucus. Violent cough inducing retching.
Male - Excitation of sexual appetite, dartings in the glans penis.
Mouth - Taste insipid, sweetish (as of copper), softness of the saliva, as if it were mixed with blood.
Nose - Coryza with profuse, thin fluid.
Rectum - Bilious diarrhea with pain as of excoriation in the anus, colic and dragging in the groins.
Stomach - Belchings, flatulency in the stomach, nausea in the morning, on waking. Vomiting of food, mixed
with bile and slimy matter afterwards diarrhea of bile and of fecal matter.
Throat - Throat feels rough with hawking copious, tenacious mucus from throat. Abundant secretion of mucus
in the throat, a constant rattling of mucus in the chest
with roughness in the throat.
Urine - Urine loaded with phosphates and the urate of ammonia in kidney dropsy. Gravel passes in small
quantities with the urine. Straw colored urine, scanty, soon becomes turbid with little white specks. White flaky
sediment, the urine deposits a fatty sediment on the sides of the vessel. Urine brown or clear with a fetid smell,
a peculiar smell from the urine.
Vertigo - Vertigo in forehead, head confused, as during an attack of vertigo, dizziness in the forehead, followed
by aching in the temples.
COMMENTS - Aspar, is a prostate and kidney remedy. The old homeopaths used to give it in tincture for the
tendency to form kidney stones or history of kidney stones. Sediment in the urine, urine is gritty and painful.
Boericke noted it for cystitis and lithiasis, the predisposition to kidney stones. Diabetes. Dropsy. Heart
disorders. Urinary disorders.

name: Aspen
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - asp-b. Aspen. Populus trémula. Small twigs with leaf buds and clusters of flowers, which are
the catkins, are boiled for half an hour. Both the male catkins, which are gray with tinges of red anthers or
yellow pollen, and the smaller, gray female catkins are selected. The water is subsequently strained and used
as medicine. Historical dose: Take two drops from the stock bottle into a one ounce dropper bottle (add
brandy or another alcohol if this bottle will be used for days or weeks). This is the dosage bottle, take a few
drops straight into the mouth or as needed in a little water or juice.
HOMEOPATHIC - The remedy Aspen belongs to the group of “For Those who have Fear,” as determined
by Bach. The other fear remedies are Rock Rose, Mimulus, Cherry Plum and Red Chestnut.
Aspen can greatly benefit those unable to fall asleep due to their fears of letting go. Sleeping disorders and
insomnia due to nightmares of an eerie, haunting kind.
Foreboding and anxious disquiet in mind and body. In panic disorders, when no apparent reason can be given
for the attacks (Cher-p-b, Rock Rose). Anxiety attacks marked by the typical, vague fears with shaking and
trembling. Anxiety about death. Mental and emotional withdrawal. Dejected or haunted in appearance.
MIND - In the Aspen state, the mind is overly receptiveand too easily impressed. Primordial fears and feelings
of doom. Delusions, superstitions, omens, fateful encounters, prophesies and ghost stories.
Some people develop personal rituals to establish a sense of protection.
Forebodings are vague and may be solely imaginary. Intuitive, spiritual or psychic paths of personal
development may lead people into the Aspen state. Aspen is indicated in states of fearful delusions and
paranoia when fears are based on imaginary content with haunting features.
REFERENCES Bach.

name: Astacus Fluviatilis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - astac. Astacus fluviatilis. Crawfish. Cancer astacus. Cancer fluviatilis. River crab. N. O.
Crustacea. Europe. Tincture from whole animal. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

exemplifi ed in Astacus more than all other varieties. The lacquer workers of the East have discovered that the

The liver is markedly affected and a great characteristic is “nettle-rash with liver complaint.” Pain and

 Skin - Itching in various parts. Nettle rash over whole body. Crusta lactea with enlarged, lymphatic glands.

author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aster. Asterias rubens. Red starfish. N. O. Radiata, Echinodermata. Tincture of fish. Historical
dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne. Axillary, tumor. Breast, cancer. Cancer. Chorea. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions.
Epilepsy. Gland, disorders. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hemorrhoids. Herpes zoster. Hysteria. Insomnia.
Neuralgia. Psoriasis. Salivation. Scabies. Strokes. Sycosis. Tetters. Tongue, paralysis, swelling. Ulcers.
Uterus, disorders. Vertigo.
HOMEOPATHIC - The starfish was used by Hippocrates in uterine diseases. This shows its pathogenic
relationship to Sep. and Murx. It is also an ancient remedy for epilepsy and stroke.
Aster, has been successful in curing breast cancers with nightly sharp pains. Drawn back feeling in eyes.
Nipples feel drawn in. Breast cancer. Increased sexual desire, sexual excitement.
Powerfully affects the brain and the head, causing severe congestion with red face, strokes.
This remedy produces disturbances of the circulation with pulsations and congestion in head, womb, chest.
Sexual desire increased, sexual excitement. A pushing-out sensation in womb, impeding walking (Sep.).
Petroz used Asterias rubens successfully in old skin affections, old ulcers and in cancers. He found that it only
acted on the latter when on the left side. H. C. Allen mentions it as a remedy for acne having small puncta with
black tips and small red bases.
Nervous disorders include neuralgia, chorea, hysteria and epilepsy. Epilepsy is preceded by twitching over
whole body. Chorea, quiet only when the hands are in the pockets. Left-sided symptoms. Symptoms are worse
at night, by motion and in cold, damp weather. Tears ameliorate the mental state.
MIND - Easily excited by any emotion. Weeps from least emotion. Sense of impending misfortune. Fears bad
news. Fear of apoplexy at night, with feeling as if head would burst. Fear of fainting with sensation of fullness
in chest.
Melancholy alternating with cerebral excitement. Cannot bear contradiction. Indifference. Unwilling to think or
work. Clearness of mind when headache disappears.
Irritability, necessity of quarrelling with somebody. Irritability before convulsion. Impatience in house. Sadness,
desire to weep.
Anxiety during sleep after menses. Feeling of extreme anxiety from noon to 3 p.m. Nervous agitation with erotic
thoughts and sexual desire.
Insanity during menopause. Delusion he is under control of strangers .Hallucinations of hearing voices, away
from, among strangers. Loss of consciousness in epilepsy.
Abdomen - Shocks of dull pain in the right side of abdomen and near umbilicus. Incarcerated wind. Violent
colic, with shuddering, alternating with flushes of heat in the face. Alternate swelling and sinking of the
abdomen during the twenty- four hours. Sensation of pressure on lower abdominal organs. Tearing, drawing
pain
in abdominal walls.
Back - Scrofulous ulcer left neck. Pulling, drawing in the back and sacrum.
Breasts - Breast cancer even in ulcerative stage. Neuralgia of left breast and arm (Brom.). Acute,
lancinating, or smarting pains in breast tumor, entirely depriving her of rest at night. Nodes and induration
of breast gland. Dull aching, neuralgic pain in breast region (Con.'). Nipples retracted. Breasts swell and
painful, worse left. Left breast feels as if pulled inward. Pain from breasts extends over inner arm to end of
little finger. Slight eruption between breasts. Axillary glands swollen hard and knotted. Rash or furfuraceous
eruption between breasts.
Chest - Enlarged axillary glands, worse at night and in damp weather. Axillary glands swollen hard and
knotted. Ulceration with sharp pains, piercing to scapulae. Pain under sternum and in muscles of precordial
region. Full feeling in chest with fear of fainting. Violent itching spot upon chest. Itching in right axilla. Pain
under sternum. Lancinating pain.
Constitutions - A remedy for the sycotic diathesis, flabby with red face. Flabby lymphatic constitution.
 Ears - Lightning-like stitches in the meatus auditorius. Violent reports in the ears. Noise in the ears as from
waves. Noise of rushing water. Dullness of hearing in the right ear.
Eyes - Drawn backwards. Winking of eyelids. Heat and redness in the eyes, weary look. Difficulty of bearing
the light. Eyes are drawn backwards. Edges of eyelids reddened. Photophobia. Light fatigues eyes. Twitching
of lids.
Face - Red, flushed face. Redness of face, precursor of apoplexy. Acne. Pimples on side of nose, chin and
mouth. Disposition to pimples atadolescence. Pimples, black tips with small red bases. Neuralgia. Livid
discoloration of face, during epileptic attack with falling.
Female - Jerking or distress in uterus. Colic and other sufferings cease with appearance of flow. As if
something were passing out of uterus. As if something
protruded behind uterus. Pushing sensation in uterus. Twitching of uterus. V agina moist with feeling of ease.
Violent and constant sexual desire, not better by sex, with nervous agitation with disposition to weep. Sexual
desire increased, worse mornings in bed.
Food - Loss of appetite. Uncertain appetite. Dullness of taste. Aversion to meat. Desires cold drinks. Desires
highly seasoned food, strong cheese. Desires liquors, tea. Great desire for cold drinks. Worse from coffee.
Head - Face red, with throbbing carotids. Rushes of blood to head with throbbing. Sensation as if head would
burst, precursor to stroke. Sensation as if head would split. Shocks in brain, throbbing. Heat in head, as if
surrounded by hotair. Bones of skull and scalp sore. Pain in occiput, right side. Emptiness in the head.
Severe pressure in forehead. Boring pain, above left eye. Burning pains in head. Soreness of whole scalp
during severe headache.
Heart - Palpitations, pulse hard and frequent. Strong and frequent beating of the heart, jerking palpitations. As
if heart had ceased to beat, with dull, prolonged heartbeats. Anxiety at the heart. Violent beating in right carotid
artery. Pulse hard, full, frequent.
Kidneys - Heat in the urethra while the urinating. Frequent urination with copious, clear urine. Thick, viscid
urine. Urine profuse. Urine thick and slimy.
Limbs - Gait unsteady muscles refuse to obey the will. Numbness of hand and fingers of left side. Numbness
of hands, with coldness of the arm. Lassitude and great weakness of the lower limbs. Pain in the left hip. Pain
in the joints of the . foot. Feeling in all limbs as if beaten, most in arms, when walking in open air. Restlessness
in limbs worse covered or in warm room.
Lungs - Short breath with pain in chest when inhaling. Cough with expectoration, morning in bed. Easy
hawking of greyish- black mucus during forenoon.
Male - Sexual desire increased, erotic thoughts. Frequent erections during sleep or in the morning.
Modalities - Better appearance of menses. Worse from coffee. Worse at night. Worse cold damp weather.
Worse left side. Worse from heat, motion. Worse during menses. Worse from contradiction. Malaise is worse
heat.
Mouth - Acute and pressing stitches in the upper teeth. Swelling of the tongue. Pulling pains in the tongue.
Heaviness of speech. Profuse flow of saliva. Dry, hard, exceedingly painful pimples on lower lip. Loss of taste.
Shooting pain in tongue. Difficulty to move tongue, aversion to speak. Talking difficult with profuse salivation.
Nerves - Gait unsteady, muscles refuse to obey the will. Epilepsy, preceded by twitching over whole body.
Nose - Nosebleed, sneezing and coryza in the morning on waking. Sneezing and coryza in morning on
awaking. Pimples on sides of nose and chin.
Rectum - Severe constipation. Ineffectual urging. Obstinate constipation. Stool like olives. Stool hard, round

Sleep - Sleeplessnes from nightly, pains. Insomnia. Disposition to sleep after reading a moment. Late falling
asleep and late getting up. Agitated sleep, tossing about. Sleep quiet but not refreshing. Many dreams. Dreams
about persons and events. Dreams, images vivid and lifelike. Dreams, sees and hears people as if she was
awake.
Skin - Acne with black tipped puncta, small red base. Dry, harsh skin, earthy appearance. Destitute of pliability
and elasticity. Itching spots. Psoriasis and herpes zoster worse left arm and chest. Eruption on thighs and
insteps of small itching vesicles which tear easily and form superficial ulcers. Ulcers with sensitive edges, fetid
discharge. Scabies. Tetters.
Stomach - Frequent belchings. Dull or constrictive pain at the precordial region.
Frequent forcible eructations in morning. Nausea. Distress in pit, with great debility.
Temperature - Shivering with sleepiness, followed by hot skin and restless night. Fever followed by coldness.
Violent heat, in head, then over whole body. Increased general heat. Heat alternating with cold.
Throat - Dryness and heat in throat. Sore throat with constriction in morning on awaking. Pressing irritation of
 the throat. Dull pain apparently all along the esophagus.
Throat - Rough sensation in larynx causes cough.
Vertigo - Vertigo, transient, when walking. Vertigo with insensibility of lower limbs. Sudden attacks, like shocks
in head. Vertigo, precursor of apoplexy.
COMMENTS - Asterias powerfully affects the mind and head, producing symptoms strongly suggesting a
stroke.
The face is red and there is strong congestion to the head, which is hot and feels as if surrounded by hot air.
Certain forms of cerebral congestion with obstinate constipation. Electric shocks in the head. Nightly sharp
pains in the breasts have led to its successful use in cases of breast cancer.
Teste noted that the malaise is worse by heat. Great desire for cold drinks. Coffee worsens all the symptoms
and excites them anew several days after they have disappeared.
Breast cancer in the upper-left quadrant, which is the most frequent place to get breast cancer. Cancer of the
left breast that has metastasized to the axillary glands of the armpit. Tumors of the nipple.
Characteristic severe lancinating pains which are worse at night. Sharp, darting pains. Bearing down pains.
May complain of a sensation of the breast being drawn inward. Sharp pains that extend to the scapula. Severe,
dull, aching pains in the breast. Pains can be related to hormones, can be worse premenstrually. Substernal
pains.
Cancer pains, inflamed and swollen glands (Con.). Axillary glands are swollen, indurated and knotted.
Knotted in the left side of the neck. Pain extends down the left arm. Swollen breast, can have ulcerations.
The affected breast may develop a red spot that suppurates premenstrually. At times it will become inflamed
and discharge with an offensive odor coming out.
For stroke patients, or threatened stroke or epilepsy (Bell., Glon.). They get a red, congested face and are
excitable, apprehensive with fears.
Weeping ameliorates the mental state. Worse at night, cold, and motion. Desire cold drinks. Aggravated by
coffee. They are very excitable, weepy, and fear something bad will happen, fear of getting bad ne ws or
misfortune (common symptoms of cancer patients).

Cund., Murex. Sep., Astac., Homarus, Eryth., Crot., Grat., Gamb., Jatr., Thuj., Bell..Lil-t./’b/fows we//:
Bell..Carb-an.. Con., Sil., Suiph.'Caic.Incompatible: Coffee, Nux-v. (Ip. relieved afterNux-v. aggravated.)
Teste includes Aster, in the Sulphur group of anti-psorics.

with a short stem and downy leaves. When mature, it has an oval fruit.
HOMEOPATHIC - There is no homeopathic symptomatology for this remedy. The symptoms which follow are
from O. A. Julian's toxicology and clinical experimentation.
Alternation of mental and pulmonary complaints. Dyspnea and respiratory spasm. Falls easily and has tension
disorders of the organs. Giddiness. Pressing pains in the temples, in the maxillary sinuses. Shoot-
ing pains above the right eyebrow. Painful sensation of fullness in the left temporal and maxillary regions.
General paralysis. Cerebral softening. Paretic weakness of the lower limbs. Incoordination of movements,
walking difficult of an ataxic type. Paretic walk and pressing temple and maxillary pains. Neuritis of syphilitic
type. Tertiary syphilis.
MIND - Unstable moods, excites quickly and loses his dash and assurances easily. Mental confusion in
nervous subjects. Psychological state, sees as through a fog. Bewilderment, worse in the morning.
Chest - Weakness of the chest.
Constitutions - Psoric and allergic constitutions. Tubercular types. Nervous, uneasy types with depressive or
obsessive tendencies.
Food - Anorexia. Emaciation.
Limbs - Sensation of formication on the right foot from the heel towards the toes. Icy coldness in the left calf.
Tumors on the maxillary bones and jaw. Juvenile dystrophy and the bones. Multiple myelomata of the bones.
Raynaud's syndrome. Arteritis.
Lungs - Difficulty in breathing, choking sensation, groping for breath. Asthma. Emphysema. Slow, difficult
respiration and small or thick plugs of sputum. Rhon- chi and bronchial wheezing.
 Nose - Permanent head cold with watery, abundant flow, sometimes burning and excoriating. Sinusitis.
Stomach - Burning all along the esophagus. Empty feeling in the stomach with failing and debility. Crises of
gastric tabes. Hiatus hernia.

Tuberculinum - Gradual emaciation, headache as though restricted by a headband, nasal and pharyngeal
congestion, cough with thick, yellow sputum, sweating. (4) Syphilium - Obsessions, loss of memory, nightly
aggravation, especially of the pains in the bones, coughing.

Papilionoideae. Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.

HOMEOPATHIC - Purple Loco-Weed causes irregularities in gait, paralytic disorders. Loss of muscular

Affects animals like the effects of alcohol, tobacco, and morphine in man. After acquiring a taste for the plant,
the animals refuse every other kind of food. In the first stage, a period of hallucination or mania with defective

name: Atrax Robustus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - atra-r. Atrax robustus. Sidney Funnelweb Spider. Australia. Arachnida. Historical dose:
Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Earaches. Exophthalmic goiter. Glaucoma. Headaches. Insomnia. Mental exhaustion. Neuralgias.
Tubercular states. Worms.
HOMEOPATHIC - Atra-r. is a venomous spider, a spinner mygale from Australia. Its bite produces a serious
toxic syndrome, atraxism, which is characterized by a phase of excitement followed by a period of stupor and
sleepiness with hypothermia. Death comes after a phase of intense agitation with salivary and lachrymal
secretions.
Sankaran undertook the proving in 1969, at the suggestion of D. W. Everitt of London. There were four pro
vers, of whom one acted as control. The potency used was 30c, at the rate of one daily dose for a month.
Gets up in the morning with a feeling of fatigue which then gradually disappears. Feeling of general exhaustion.
Sensation of protrusion of the throat and eyes. Asthenia of the body. Drawing pain in the ears. Weakness of
the lower limbs, predominantly on the left.
MIND - Mental exhaustion in the evening. Incapable of doing the least physical or intellectual exercise.
Abdomen - Pain around the umbilical region, starting in the morning. Pain worse after breakfast, from leaning
backwards, walking, standing, improving with pressure, lying on the stomach or leaning forwards.
Ears - Drawing sensation in the outer ear as if pulled by a string. Impression of tugging behind the ears,
passing from left to right.
Eyes - Eyelids stuck together in the morning. Pain below the left orbit when lying down. Heavy, yellowish-white
secretion during the night. Eyeballs painful with feeling of protrusion, especially on the left side.
Face - Neuralgia of the face and under the orbits.
Kidneys - Urine slightly irritating. Frequent urination at night. Feeling in the bladder of not being empty after
urination. Last drop hot and irritating.
Limbs - Sudden sensation of weakness in the limbs, especially the legs. Need to lie down and condition
improved by continual pressure. Joint pains in the knees.
Lungs - Cough with thick, greenish sputum which comes up easily.
Modalities - Better from pressure, lying on the stomach. Worse from walking. Worse standing still. Worse
leaning backwards.
 Nose - Nasal discharge of thick, yellowish liquid, sometimes black and sticky.
Sleep - Insomnia until 1 a.m.
Throat - Feeling of obstruction in the throat, worse when lying on the back. Throat red, dry, painful, especially
on the left side and when swallowing. Dryness of the throat not improved by drinking water, worse from drinking
cold drinks. Feeling of protrusion of the thyroid cartilage.
Vertigo - Feeling of vertigo, lasting only a short while in the evening, around 7 p.m.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Aranea Di adema - Exhaustion with strong desire to go to bed. Icy cold feeling
in the bones. Drilling pains in the heels. (2) Spigelia - Pains in the eyeballs, as if the eyes were too big forthe
sockets. Neuralgic pain starting at the back of the head, spreading to the frontal region and ending above the
eye, especially the left side.
REFERENCES Julian.

name: Atropinum Purum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - atro. Atropinum purum aut sulphuricum. Atropine. N. O. Solanaceae. Atropine is an alkaloid of
Belladonna. Theeffects of the Sulphate of Atropine, the preparation most in use, are included. Solution.
Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Bedwetting. Blepharospasm. Convulsions. Epilepsy. Eyes, disorders. Gastric ulcer. Locomotor
ataxia. Mania. Neuralgias. Pancreatitis. Peritonitis. Spinal irritation.
Stammering. Tetanus. Vision, disorders. Torticollis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Atropine, as the most active principle in Belladonna, produces most of the characteristic
effects of that drug, but at the same time the two are not identical. Atropine has shown an affinity for the
pancreas, which relates it to lod., Kali-i. and Iris. It can produce a hypersensitivity of the sensory nerves.
Numerous eye symptoms. AU kinds of illusions of vision. Motes seen over every thing. All kinds of illusions of
sight. Everything appears large (Plat, opposite). On reading, words run together, double vision, all objects
seem to be elongated.
Clarke once cured with Atro. a woman who had an appearance of shadows passing over whatever she looked
at.
Difficulty of speech. Frequent stuttering. especially at difficult to pronounce words. Indistinct articulation, rapid
and chattering.
Great dryness of throat, almost impossible to swallow. Chronic stomach disorders with great pain and vomiting
of all food. Peritonitis. Hypochlorhydria, heartburn. Eustachian tube and tympanic congestion. Affinity for the
pancreas. Hyperacidity of stomach. Paroxysm of gastric pain, ovarian neuralgia.
Mind - Sad and morose, prefering solitude and a dark room to society of friends. Fear of her condition being
observed. Meddlesome. Mistakes in localities, in time. Rambling speech. Speech embarrassed, loud, slow,
unintelligible in sleep. Wandering thoughts. Mirthful.
Frightful delirium. Delusions, sees frightful images. Delusions sees people in room at bedside. Delusions
familiar things seem strange. Answers to imaginary questions. Refuses obstinately to swallow anything or to
answer questions in any way than by a grunt.
Back - Constant burning in back. Large portion of spine so sensitive that she cried out on pressure. Painful
affections from spinal irritation.
Chest - Burning under sternum.
Ears - Morbid sensitiveness to sounds and objects.
Eyes - Sharp neuralgic pains in and about eyes. Neuralgic pain. Eyelids heavy and difficult to keep open.
Corneal ulcers with spasmodic winking. Irritability of eye. Conjunctivitis with lachrymation. Dim vision with
dilated pupils. Vertical diplopia, apparent object below real one.
Face - Deep red distorted face. Deathly pallor.
Female - Severe cutting or drawing pains, in left ovary, extorting screams, must bend double. Left ovary
swollen and tender during menses. Puerperal convulsions.
Food - Appetite often considerable, sometimes absent. Thirst after vomiting.
Head - Periodical headache, coming on suddenly, increasing rapidly, until intensely severe. Dull pain in
temples. Sticking pain in back of skull and over eyes, worse every motion, stepping. Severe headache
beginning in occiput, passing over right side, locating over eyes. Headache with flushing of face and head.
Headache with rush of blood to head. Sensation as if head were screwed up. Headache of epileptics.
Headache with great weakness.
Kidneys - Congestive states of kidneys. Chronic albuminuria. Involuntary urination, but scanty discharge of
urine.
 Limbs - Throwing about limbs. Spasms worse when disturbed. Gouty affection of right wrist, with stiffness.
Clenching of thumbs. Involuntary movements of hands towards head. Locomotor ataxia. Edema of legs.
Mouth - Pappy taste. Dryness of mouth and throat. Unability to speak from dryness of mouth, tongue nearly
adherent to roof of mouth. Dryness of mouth after two hours suddenly gave way to a viscid, acrid secretion,
very highly offensive odor.
Rectum - Diarrhea with constipation. During stool, felt badly weak, terribly nervous, with general sweat.
Sleep - Drowsiness with tendency to quiet dreams and delirium. Somnolence with nervous startings.
Prolonged yawning. Restless sleep, sleeps only towards morning. Sleep much disturbed by gastric
pains. Starting as if frightened on falling asleep.
Stomach - Constant burning under stomach. Constant retching and empty eructations, immediately after
eating. Nausea with pressure at stomach. Vomiting of food. Fluttering in stomach. Vomiting seldom with
nausea. Vomiting at times extremely violent. Stomach very sensitive to pressure.
Teeth - Grinding of teeth.
Throat - Burning from coughing. Dark red, husky hue. Difficult swallowing from great dryness. Voice husky.
Dryness of larynx causes dry cough and difficult swallowing.
Tongue - Tongue seems partially paralyzed, speech indistinct, rapid and chattering. Tongue hard, parched
and cracked. Tongue coated white.
Vertigo - Vertigo on rising in morning. Vertigo on turning head suddenly.
RELATIONS - It antidotes: Muscarine and Op. It is Antidoted by: Op. and Phys. Compare: Like Bell., it is a
right-side medicine.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarice.

Food - Increase of appetite. Aversion to food and meat. Desire for alcoholic stimulants. Desire cold drinks and

Head - Chronic syphilitic headaches.
Lungs - Dyspnea, desire for open air. Tuberculosis.

Mouth - Breath offensive and putrid. Grinding of teeth at night.
Stomach - Bitter eructations.

author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aur-br. Aurum bromatum. Gold bromide. Trituration. This is an unproved salt of gold. Historical

CLINICAL - Epilepsy. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Migraine. Neurasthenia. Night terrors. Sleepwalking.
HOMEOPATHIC - Aurum bromatum was recommended by Dr. E. M. Hale as being superior to other
preparations of gold, especially in certain nervous disorders of an epileptiform character, such as migraine,
night terrors, sleepwalking.
 Valvular diseases of the heart and hypertrophy, attacks of faintness with coldness and feeble pulse alternating
with attacks of congestion and red face with palpitations. In headaches with neurasthenia, megrim, night
terrors, valvular diseases.
COMMENTS - Hale writes: “In the physiological hypertrophies of young persons at puberty, of pregnant
women, and at the climacteric period, I prefer the bromide of gold in the 6x trituration.
It will prevent the pathological hypertrophy which often threatens.”
“Besides the class of disorders enumerated, this preparation of gold is very useful in reflex mental affections
from uterine or ovarian irritation. I do not consider the suicidal despondency a necessary symptom. It is often
indicated in just the opposite state when there is exalted sensitiveness, great mental exhilaration and unnatural
gaiety.”
REFERENCES - Clarke. Hale.

name: Aurum Metallicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aur. Aurum metallicum. Gold metal. Aurum foliatum. Foliatum colloidale. Gold, (Au, At. Wt.
1968). Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration, Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL-Alcoholism. Amenorrhea. Angina pectoris. Anthropophobia. Arteriosclerosis. Ascites. Asthma.
Bone, disorders. Breath, offensive. Colic. Depression. Double, vision. Dropsy. Dyspnea. Ears, disorders.
Erysipelas. Exostosis. Eye, disorders. Fatigue. Flatus. Fevers. Glaucoma. Gonorrhea. Grief. Headaches.
Heart, disease. Hemorrhages. Hemorrhoids. Hemiopia. Hepatitis. Hopelessness. Hydrocele. Hypertension.
Infertility. Inguinal, hernia. Insomnia. Jaundice. Leucorrhea. Lipoma. Locomotor ataxia. Melanosis. Mercurial
poisoning. Miscarriages. Nasopharyngeal catarrh. Night terrors. Obesity. Orchitis. Otorrhea. Ozaena.
Palpitations. Paralysis. Photophobia. Pining, boys. Pustules. Scrofula. Smell, disordered. Suicidal,
depression. Syphilis. Testicles, affections. Tongue, nodules. Tuberculosis. Tumors. Uterus, disorders.
Vaginismus. Vertigo. Vision, disordered. Warts. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Sol of the Alchemists. This use of gold as an anti-venereal and anti- scrofulous remedy is
very ancient, but has been forgotten until rediscovered by homeopathy.
Gold profoundly affects the entire organism, exercising a solvent action on the tissues, producing ulcerations
and the disappearances of new growths. It is one of the best antidotes to mercurial over-dosing and especially
in cases of syphilis. Scrofula and bone decay. Produces rushes of blood and hemorrhages. “Worse from
sunset to sunrise.”
Ulcers which attack the bones. Warts, scrofulous, syphilitic, mercurial. Exostosis, decay, nightly bone pains,
especially cranial, nasal and palatine. Glands swollen in scrofulous subjects. Palpitations and congestions.
Frequently indicated in secondary syphilis and for the effects of mercury.
Ascites often in conjunction with heart disorders. Ozaena. Sexual hypersensitivity. Arteriosclerosis. High
blood pressure. Nightly paroxysms of pain behind sternum. Sclerosis of liver, arterial system, brain.
Shelton has recorded effects on girls working with gold leaf, including the occurrence of a “thick leucorrheal
discharge, not offensive, white or yellowish, occasionally profuse invariably worse by walking.”
MIND - Mental states of great depression. No remedy produces more acute mental depression than Aurum
met. There is a condition of melancholy, hopelessness and profound depression. Acute depression. Future
looks dark. Hopelessness with heart disease. Want of self-confidence and thinks others have none which
makes her unhappy.
 Complaints after grief, fright, anger, disappointed love, contradiction, reserved displeasure. Ailments from
unusual responsibilities. Duty-bound. Workaholic, industrious, always busy and working, never finished. Grief
and depression. Financial loss. Hopelessness. Aggravation from strong emotions. Forsaken feeling.
Sadness when alone. Homesickness.
Despondent and great desire to commit suicide. Profound despondency, with increased blood pressure.
Loss of love of life. Disgust of life and thoughts ofsuicide. Despair from pain, wants to jump out of window.
Talks of committing suicide. Every opportunity is sought for self-destruction. Tendency to suicide and
longing for death.
Mental derangements. Weak memory. Melancholy, imagines he is unfit for this world, never can succeed. She
does everything wrong. Thinks had neglected something, her friends, her duty. Pining boys, low spirited,
lifeless, weak memory. Self-reproach, self-criticism. Feeling of selfcondemnation and utter worthlessness.
Peevish and vehement at least contradiction. ateful and quarrelsome. Dictatorial. Grumbling. Boredom.
Indisposed to talk. Vexed mood. Enraged by least contradiction. Oversensitive to contradiction, resulting in
explosive fits of anger and violence. Anger at absent persons. Hatred of persons who had offended. Trembling
when he can't
Aurum metallicum satisfy his anger.
Changing moods. Brooding melancholy, alternating with irritability and moroseness. Excitement and confusion.
Hysteria, laughs and cries alternately. Weeping when meeting people. Weeping, because he imagines he has
lost the affection of his friends.
Anthrophobia. Great fear of death. Fears the least noise. Fear of persons intruding. Frightened easily on falling
asleep.
Oversensitive to pain, to smell, taste, hearing and touch. Hypersensitive to noise, causes excitement,
confusion. Excitement about absent persons during pain. Loquacity. Constant rapid questioning without
waiting for reply. Rapid questioning without waiting for a reply. Speaks continually in questions. Cannot do
things fast enough.
Delirium with exaltation of strength. Religious mania, imagines herself irretrievably lost. Violent hysteria, with
desperate actions, thrashes oneself about. Weeping, praying and self-reproaching. Delusion has neglected
his duty and deserves réproach. Imagines to see obstacles in his way everywhere. Wrings the hands.
Abdomen - Ascites with heart disorders.
Colic, with sensation of great uneasiness and inclination to evacuate. Incarcerated flatus. Abdomen inflated.
Grumbling and rumbling. Right hypochondrium hot and painful. Swelling and suppuration of inguinal glands.
Inguinal hernia of children. Tendency of hernia to protrude. Swelling and suppuration of the inguinal glands.
Frequent gas, very fetid wind.
Back - Stinging pains in small of back. As if lower spine bulged backwards. Lumbar muscles painfully stiff,
thigh cannot be raised. Swollen cervical glands like knotted cord. Tension in neck as if muscles too short, even
at rest, worse stooping. Pains, drawing and acute, in the back and sometimes so violent as to prevent any
motion of the limbs.
Bones - Destruction of bones like secondary syphilis. Pain in bones of head, lumps under scalp, exostosis
with nightly pains in bones. Decay of nasal, palatine and mastoid bones. Soreness of affected bones, better in
open air, worse at night.
Causations - Ill effects of grief, fright, anger, disappointed love, contradiction, reserved displeasure. Prolonged
anxiety, unusual responsibility. Loss of property.
Chest - Aching in left side of the chest. Crushing weight under sternum, worse ascending. Stitches in the
sternum. Constrictive oppression of the chest. Pain, as if there were a plug placed under the ribs. Much
congestion in the chest. Oppression of chest with faceache. Inflammatory swelling of axillary glands.
Constitutions - Suited to sanguine people with black hair and dark eyes, olive-brown complexion. Syphilitic
and mercurial patients. When syphilis is implanted on the scrofulous constitution.
Constitutions - It is adapted to nervous, hysterical women, girls at puberty. Also light-haired scrofulous
persons. Pining boys and old age. Old people with heart disease. Persons who are low-spirited, lifeless, weak
memory, yet sensitive to pain, which drives them to despair.
Cough - Cough from want of breath at night. Cough with tough yellow sputum on awaking in morning. Dry,
nervous spasmodic cough, peculiar to women from sunset to sunrise. Cough from want of breath, at night.
Ears - Congestion to ears. Burning, prickling, itching. Decay of the mastoid process. Obstinate fetid ottorrhea
after scarlatina. Flow of fetid pus from the ears. External meatus bathed in pus. Labyrinthine disease due to
syphilis. Menière's disease. Nerve deafness with embarrassed speech. Oversensitive to noise, but better
music. Hardness of hearing with embarrassed speech. Humming, buzzing and rushing in the ears. Roaring in
the ears.
 Eyes - Orbits feel sore. Feels tense. Violent pains in bones around eye (Asaf.). Intestinal keratitis. Vascular
cornea. Pains from without inward. Sticking pains inward. Trachoma with pannus. Glaucoma. Extreme
photophobia. Constant lachrymation. Styes. Eyes better moonlight and after active muscular exercise.
Face - Anxious expression. Inflammation of the bones of the face. Congested, bluish-
red. Face puffed, and shining as if from sweat. Tearing in zygoma. Mastoid and other facial bones inflamed.
Red eruption, which peels off, on the forehead and on the nose. Painful swelling of the submaxillary glands.
Parotids swollen, painful to touch. Swelling of the cheeks.
Female - Amenorrhea with great sadness. Delayed menarche. Menses too late, and scanty or absent. Before
menses, swelling of axillary glands. Uterine troubles worse reaching high with arms. Uterus enlarged and
prolapsed. Induration and ulceration of the womb from repeated miscarriages. Uterine disorders with
depression. Prolapsus uterus with heaviness in abdomen. Prolapsus uterus, with backache, worse during
menses. Vaginismus. Great sensitiveness of vagina. Burning-smarting of vulva. Labia majora red, swollen.
Leucorrhea profuse and corroding. Leu- corrhea yellow, thick white, not offensive. Leucorrhea, worse walking.
Infertility, also of those women who are mentally depressed on account of their barrenness. Depression during
pregnancy. Despair from labor pains. Labor pains make her desperate. Suppressed breast-milk.
Food - Loathing of food. Bulimia. Loss of appetite in pining boys. Appetite and thirst increased with
qualmishness. Excessive hunger and thirst. Aversion to meat. Craves nothing but sour things. Desire for milk
and coffee. Desire for alcohol, wine. Desire bread, delicacies such as pastries. Water tastes foul. Worse after
drinking. Worse after wine.
Head - Rush of blood to head. Violent pain in head, worse during the night, outward pressure, causing
confusion. Roaring in head. Vertigo. Tearing through brain to forehead. Pain in bones extending to face.
Congestion to head. Head hot, full. Headache of students with precordial anxiety and flushes of heat to the
head. As if air passed over the brain. Exostosis with boring pain. Lumps under scalp. Baldness from syphilis.
Boils on scalp.
Heart - Angina Pectoris. Oppression at the heart. High blood pressure. Carotids and temporal arteries throb
visibly. Valvular
lesions of arteriosclerosis. Heart feels loose on walking. Palpitations compels him to stop. Violent palpitation,
at puberty. Sensation as if heart stopped beating for two or three seconds, immediately followed by
tumultuous rebound with sinking at the epigastrium. Palpitations with rush of blood to chest. Heart bruised,
sore worse suppressed foot sweat. Aortic disease. Fatty degeneration of heart. Hypertrophy. Endocarditis.
Carotids and temporal arteries throb visibly. Pulse rapid, feeble, irregular. Pulse small but accelerated.
Kidneys - Nephritis with cardiac and hepatic diseases. Painful retention of urine with urgent inclination to
urinate. Pressure on the bladder. Constant urging. Urine turbid, like buttermilk. Urine scanty, greenish- brown.
Urine with thick mucus-like sediment. Frequent emission of watery urine. Hematuria. Urine increased, pale.
Limbs - Holds the left arm during attack of palpitations. Nightly leg pains. All the blood seems to rush from
head to lower limbs. Dropsy of lower limbs. Orgasm, as if blood were boiling in all veins. Paralytic, tearing
pains in joints. Knees weak. Pains in both the knees as if tightly bandaged. Paralytic feeling in legs. Nails turn
blue. Trembling feet. Hot bruised soles, at night. Cold foul foot sweat.
Liver - Liver region hot and painful. Hepatitis. Liver with heart symptoms. Jaundice of pregnancy.
Lungs - Asthma, from congestion to chest. Cardiac asthma with weak pulse, mental depression and great
debility. Asthma worse open air. Suffocative attacks, with spasmodic constriction of chest. Dyspnea worse
laughing, at night. Always takes a deep breath and cannot get enough air. Frequent, deep breathing, stitches
in sternum. Accumulation of mucus in the trachea, which is expectorated with difficulty. Tough yellow mucus,
on awaking in morning.
Male - Pain and swelling of testicles. Chronic induration of testicles. Atrophy of testicles in boys.
Undeveloped testes. Itching of scrotum. Hydrocele of children.
Orchitis. Chronic induration of testicles. Epididymitis. Sarcocele. Flow of prostatic fluid, with flaccidity of the
penis. Bubo. Chancre. Condylomata around corona glandis. Violent erections. Sexual desire greatly increased.
Nocturnal erections and pollutions. Ulcers on scrotum.
Modalities - Better from cool, open air. Better cold bathing. Better becoming warm. Bettermusic. Better
walking. Better moonlight. Worse from emotions, depressing affections. Worse mental exertion. Worse in cold
weather. Worse when getting cold. Worse cloudy weather, winter. Worse at night. Worse sunset to sunrise.
Worse mercury, alcohol, iodide.
Mouth - Aphthae on mouth. Copious saliva. Saliva sweetish. Fetid smell of the mouth, like rotten cheese. Foul
breath in girls at puberty. Taste putrid or bitter. Metallic taste. Milky or sweetish taste, foul even to water.
Ulceration of gums. Ulcers on palate. Inside of mouth blistered. Gums swollen, dark red, bleeding. ■
Nose - Nose red and swollen. Inflammation of nose. Decay with fetid discharge, purulent, bloody. Red, knobby
 tip of nose. Ozaena. Snubbed. Ulcerated, painful, swollen, obstructed. Boring pains in nose, worse at night.
Horrible odor from nose and mouth. Putrid smell from nose. Fetid discharge, purulent, bloody. Complaints
from strong odors. Sensitive smell (Carb-ac.).
Perspiration - Cold sweat and damp all over. Sweat about genitals. Copious general perspiration. Early
morning sweats, mostly about genitals. Profuse sweat in endocarditis.
Rectum - Fetid flatus. Constipation, stool very large in size, or very hard and knotty. Constipation better during
menses. Copious stool. Offensive stool during pregnancy. Stools offensive, painful, greyish, ashy. Diarrhea
alternating with constipation. Nightly diarrhea with burning in the rectum. Hemorrhoids with rectal catarrh.
Hemorrhoids bleed during stool. Prolapse of rectum during menses. Warts around the anus.
Skin - Acne. Large red pimples. Lipoma.
Violent itching. Indurations under the skin, like wheals. Pustules in the face and on the neck and chest.
Formication, here and there, over the body. Transient but intense itching of the abdomen, hips, knees, arms
and wrists. Fine papular eruption on face. Deep ulcers. Warts.
Sleep - Weary, but cannot rest or sleep. Sleeplessness after midnight. Chronic insomnia with depression.
Nocturnal mumbling in the form of questions. Sobs aloud in sleep. Moaning and crying out in sleep. Sobs
aloud in sleep. Disturbed by sexual excitement. Drowsiness after meals. Awakened by bone pains with
despair. Unrefreshing sleep.
Sleep - Fatigue and weakness in the morning on waking. Vivid, frightful dreams. Frightful dreams. Restless
sleep, with anxious dreams. Dreams of thieves. Dreams of dead, death and corpses. Dreams towards morning.
Stomach - Swelling of epigastrium. Burning at stomach and hot belchings. Burning, drawing, and cutting pain,
pressure. Pain in the stomach, as if from hunger. Uneasiness in the epigastrium. Stinging pain when touching
stomach. Nausea from mental labor. Sour eructations.
Teeth - Decay of teeth. Toothache, with heat and congestion in the head. Looseness of the teeth. Sensation
as if too long. Ulcers in the gums, with swelling of the cheeks. Toothache worse at night, worse drawing cold
air into mouth. Gums swollen, dark red, bleeding.
Temperature - Painfully sensitive to cold, shivering in bed. Febrile chills over the whole body, while in bed in
the evening. Coldness of the entire body, with bluish color of the nails, nauseous taste, with inclination to vomit.
Heat of the face, with cold in the hands and feet.
Throat - Voice nasal. Stitches when swallowing, pain in glands. Decay of the palate. Drinks come through
nose. Stinging in throat when swallowing. Tonsils swollen and ulcerated. Red and swollen tonsils.
Tongue - Aphthae on tongue. Tongue swollen, with scirrhus-like hardness. Flabby taste with clean tongue.
Tongue trembling
and dry. Tongue leathery, hard. Tongue dry and coated. Tongue coated at back. Ulcers on tongue. Warts on
tongue.
Vertigo - Stupefaction during vertigo. Vertigo when stooping. Vertigo as if turning in a circle, better on rising.
Vertigo as if drunk when walking in open air, feels as if he would fall to left, must lie down.
Vision - Double vision. Hemiopia, upper half of objects invisible. Hemiopia from straining eyes. Yellow
crescent bodies floating obliquely upward. Sees fiery objects. Sees fog or smoke before eyes. Everything looks
blue. Black spots, flames, sparks before the eyes. Irregular pupils. Optical illusions in bright colors.
COMMENTS - Boring pains and burning stitches predominate. The head is giddy, full, hot. Rush of blood to
the head. Vertigo as if turning in a circle when stooping, goes away on rising. As if drunk when walking in the
open air. Sensation as if a current of air were rushing through the head if not kept warm. Bones of skull painful,
especially lying down.
Vertical half-sight. Fiery sparks. Decay of mastoid process of bones of nose. Ozaena. In the abdominal region
there is swelling of liver, jaundice (Merc.). Hernia inguinal or umbilical and in children. Onanism.
The sexual organs are markedly affected. Induration of testes. Undeveloped testicles in puny boys. Swelling
or neuralgia of testicle. Uterus prolapsed and indurated, the weight of it causes prolapses. The chloride of gold
and sodium acts more powerfully in these conditions.
Suffocative attacks with oppression of chest. Anxious palpitations from congestion to the chest. Palpitation
with anguish and tremulous fearfulness. Pain in heart region extending down left arm to fingers. Boring pains
in bones, worse at night.
Hysterical spasms with laughing and crying alternately. Hypersensitive to all pains. Great ebullitions with
congestion to the head and chest and palpitation of the heart.
Frightful dreams, sobs aloud when asleep. Chilliness predominates, shivering in open air, coldness of hands
and feet, sometimes lasting all night. Heat, only in the face.
Perspiration in the morning hours, mostly on and around the genitals. Paralytic drawing in the limbs in the
morning when awaking and on getting cold.
 Severe heart disease, arteriosclerosis, cerebral arteriosclerosis, high blood pressure, with depression.
Sensation of the heart not beating or getting heart pains or that it is beating too fast. Fear of heart disease.
Also for arthritis or for the ill effects of gold shots. Tennis elbow. Sinus infections, breaking down in nasal
septum. Late stage syphilis. Chronic, severe, unrelenting insomnia that no medication can help. Hair falls out.
Suicidal depression or severe depression with no hope of recovery. Giving Aurum is giving a ray of hope back,
that the actual remedy is like potentized light, because in their life there’s no light or hope.
May have history of attempted suicide from financial loss, from the loss of money and property, loss of love.
Manic depression. Suicidal tendencies from pain. Kent describes losing the will to live as the deepest illness
one can have
Religious mania with deep guilt (Nairn.). Depression after death of a loved one. Over investment,
possessiveness followed by loss. Over responsible, strong sense of duty and loyalty.
Keynote insomnia, drives a person crazy, particularly in the elderly. Geriatric remedy for people who feel
they've lost their purpose or value in life, but act stoic. “Hippocratic countenance,” as if their face was chiseled
out of stone. Flat tone to voice, can have lack of emotion but with a happy façade.
Pathologically independent and can have difficulty expressing themselves. Resigned to depression.
Introverted. Kent gave the etiologies as prolonged anxiety, grief, and unusual responsibilities that were heaped
on someone and they failed. Financial loss, abuse of mercury as a medicine, or a history of suppressed
syphilis.
Craves sunshine, finds dull, cloudy days unbearable. Depressed, dejected, tired of life, discontented.
Depression worse at night. Deep self-con
demnation, guilt complex, easily frightened, feels worthless. Restless, hurried, fidgety.
Quarrelsome, may have wild outbursts of rage followed by remorse, worse contradiction. Sensitive to pain and
cold. Chilly, likes to be wrapped up but may still like fresh air. Worse from sunset to sunrise. May have a history
of syphilis, especially if there is bone pain. Worse grief or emotional stress.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Bell., Chin., Cocc., Coff., Cupr., Merc., Puls., Spig., Soln. Antidote to: Merc.,
Spig., Chronic effects of alcohol, Kah-i. Compare: (1) Aur-ars. (2) Aur-mur-kali. - in uterine induration and
hemorrhage. (3) Aur-sulph. (4) Also, Asaf. - in decay of bones of ears and nose. (5) Syphilis, Kali-i„ Hep.,
Merc.,Mez., Nit-ac., Phos., Syph. (5) Bell., Caps. - Caries of mastoid, corpulency. (6) Calc. - night terrors,
leuco-phlegmatic. (7) Dig., Ferr., Glon. - hyperemia of lung from heart. (8) Kali-br. - anguish at heart and desire
to move about. (9) Lach., Lyc., Merc., Nit-ac., (10) Nux-v., - hernia, prolapsed uterus. (11) Tarent. - Heart as if
turned around.
REFERENCES - Boèricke. Clarke. Murphy.

name: Aurum Muriaticum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aur-m. Aurum muriaticum. Gold chloride. Historical dose: Trituration, Tincture and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Amaurosis. Angina pectoris. Anus, fistula. Asthma. Brachial neuritis. Bubo. Cancer.
Decay. Condylomata. Dropsy. Eczema. Fistula. Gland, disorders. Gonorrhea. Hair, loss. Heart, disorders.
Hemorrhage. Hemorrhoids Indurations. Infertility. Leucorrhea. Liver, disorders. Morvan's disease. Multiple
sclerosis. Ophthalmia. Ozaena. Periostitis. Pudenda, over-sensitiveness. Spinal, sclerosis. Spleen, enlarged.
Syphilis. Tuberculosis. Uterus, tumors, Uterus, hemorrhage. Vaginitis. Voice,, hoarse. Warts.
HOMEOPATHIC - Gold salts, like mercury salts, dissolve organic tissues, they stimulate the heart more, but
act on fluid tissues less powerfully than mercury. This salt has been proved.
The symptoms are mostly identical with ’hose of the metal, but some are peculiar
or more pronounced in the one than in the other. The Muriatic element is seen in the heart symptoms, violent
palpitations, sore aching, heaviness and sensation of rigidity in heart, hyperemia from heart disease.
Aurum muriaticum is a sycotic remedy, causing suppressed discharges to reappear. Marked catarrhal and
glandular disorders. Burning, yellow, acrid leucorrhea. Heart symptoms, glandular affection. Warts appear on
various parts on tongue, genitals. Sclerotic and exudative degeneration of the nervous system.
Indescribable weariness in whole body. Sclerotic and exudative degenerations of nervous system. Hypertrophy
of all the fingers. Drawing pains in various parts, especially the limbs.
Multiple sclerosis, pains and tremors, it will often help in sclerotic and exudative degenerations. Valuable in
menopausal hemorrhages from the womb. Diseases of frontal sinus. Stitching pain in left side of forehead.
Weariness, aversion to all work. Drawing feeling in stomach.
MIND - Great depression of mind. Suicidal disposition, with frequent weeping. Tired of life. Everything is
disagreeable, dreary, even nature around. Sadness, as when homesick. Sad, as if a great misfortune
 impended. Aversion to weeping. Ailments after mortification. Laziness, aversion to all work. Desires company.
Irritable without cause.
Great restlessness, changes his position every moment. Restlessness, nervousness better open air. Great
anxiety with palpitations. Full of whims and notions. Delusion that he has every disease. If left alone thinks of
nothing but of one's ailments and becomes more out of humor. Anger when thinking of his ailments. Starting
from sleep, on waking as if suffocated.
Abdomen - Distension of abdomen. Redness, heat, itching and biting at umbilicus. Spleen enlarged. Abdomen
sensitive to touch. Swollen abdomen. Ascites. Stiffness in region of groins. Swelling of inguinal glands.
Back - Tension in dorsal vertebrae. Dull drawing pain in neck while sitting. Burning, pricking, cutting pains and
stiffness
in back. Very severe backache.
Causations - Ill effects of chagrin, fright, vexation.
Chest - Anxious contraction of chest. Pressure under sternum. Pleuritic pains left side of chest, changing
place.
Constitutions - In this remedy the sycotic miasm unites with the syphilitic and psoric miasms to produce
constitutions that are feeble and prone to degenerative diseases. Suited to the lymphatic, scrofulous con-
stitutions.
Cough - Short, dry cough, in paroxysms. Frequent hard cough, with white sputa mingled with threads of blood.
Frequent, loud sounding cough. Loose, with thick yellow sputum.
Ears - Burning and itching behind ears worse night. Tinkling sound in ears followed by deafness, as if interior
of ears were large and empty. Buzzing in left ear and sensitivity. Ringing and roaring in ears. Music relieves.
Redness of ears. Scurf behind ears.
Eyes - Sudden blindness after childbirth. Neuralgic pains in left eye. Scrofulous phlyctenular ophthalmia.
Chronic inflammation of margins of lids. Fistula lach- rymalis. Burning, pricking, itching and tickling in eyes and
lids. Red sclerotics. Burning heat and prickling. Lachrymation. Difficulty in keeping eyes shut. Lids agglutinated
in morning. Chronic inflammation of edges of eyelids.
Face - Acne rosacea. Red face. Pale face with red spots. Hair falling out of eyebrows and head. Exostosis of
right cheekbone. Induration of lips. Burning like pepper on lips. Cancerous ulcers on lips. Painful swelling of
maxillary glands.
Female - Amenorrhea. Suppressed menses. Menses too early and profuse, blood acrid, excoriating. Painful
induration of os uteri. Metritis. Gonorrheal discharge with swelling of both groins. Hemorrhage from the
uterus at menopausal. Constant discharges from vulva. Burning stitching of vulva. Heat and itching in vagina.
Leucorrhea, light yellow, especially mornings. Vaginitis. Leucorrhea and red pustules on labia before menses.
Leucorrhea acrid.
excoriating thighs with itching of genitals. Gonorrheal discharge with swellings in each groin.
Food - Slow digestion. Appetite increased or lost. Thirst. Disgust for sweetened coffee. Coffee, tea, wine
aggravates.
Head - Head hot, limbs cool .Cold sensation on vertex. Dullness in head. Drawing pain in forehead. Constant
burning in whole head. Burning in forehead. Throbbing pains in left temple. Tearing pain in bones of skull.
Head feels insensible. Pressure on brain, along sagittal suture. Congestion increasing to delirium. Tickling
itching on forehead. Falling out of hair, eyebrows and beard.
Heart-Anginapectoris. Sharp pains above the heart. Palpitations with anxiety, worse emotions. Palpitation
when thinking about his diseases. Heartbeats increased, too strong. Rheumatic endocarditis. Irregular
heartbeats with severe constriction of chest.
Kidneys - Burning on urinating. Urine feels as if too hot. Incontinence of urine. Tenesmus of bladder. Kidney
pain with pale, clear urine. Burning, tickling and heat in urethra. Scanty urine. Turbid urine with brick-red
sediment.
Limbs - Morvan's disease, hypertrophy of fingers. Swelling of the wrists with tension on reversing the hand
and lancinations in grasping an object, tearing pains in middle finger after meals. Legs swollen and very tender
along inside of tibia. Exostosis. Periostitis after typhoid.
Liver - Induration of liver with dropsy.
Lungs - Loud cough with thick yellow expectoration. Asthma worse at night. Impeded breathing, from pressure
on chest. Difficult breathing, from stagnation of blood. Suffocation at night.
Male - Diminished virility. Increased desire. Exhausting erections. Violent itching of glans penis wakes him at
night. Drawing along spermatic cord. Painful drawing in left testis extends towards inguinal ring, recurring by
paroxysms. Chancres. Condylomata. Syphilitic gonorrhea. Excrescences from glans up to sacrum. Warts on
prepuce.
 Modalities - Better from cold washing, weather. Better gentle motion. Worse from ascending stairs. Worse
from warmth, throws off bed-covers.
Mouth - Dryness of mouth. Increased saliva, frequent desire to swallow. Metallic taste. Mouth filled with
aphthae. Flat, bad taste. Taste entirely lost. Burning itching and biting in mouth.
Nose - Offensive, watery discharge, irritating upper lip. Pressing pain in nose. Ozaena scrofulosa. Tirigling,
burning and itching in nose. Redness and inflammation with itching. Red swelling with ulcerated nostrils. Dry
yellow crusts. Sensation of stoppage. Deep crack in alae nasi. Sudden running of pus from nose. Blowing of
blood from nose. Snuffles. Nostrils stuffed up with hard crusts.
Perspiration - Copious sweats, offensive smell. Copious sweats, cold. Promotes - sweat in smallpox.
Rectum - Obstinate constipation. Hemorrhoids, bleeding during stool. Condylomata at anus. Excoriation at
anus and between thighs. Fistula. Diarrhea after eating. Diarrhea, worse night after eating with pain in bowels.
Frequent fluid stools. Stools, greyish-white, yellow, watery.
Sleep - Yawning aftereating. Sleepy by day, even at work. Comatose sleep. Sleeplessness from excitement.
Sleeplessness from palpitations. Frequent starting. Dreams with sadness. Tormenting dreams.
Stomach - Gastritis. Putrid eructations and nausea. Hot feeling in stomach. Cramps. Burning, cutting, stitching
in stomach, cramps. Nausea, distension. Fullness of stomach, after eating. Nausea, worse fasting, better after
breakfast. Painful drawing in pit worse eating, drinking. Vomiting of a green fluid.
Temperature - Violent chill and fever. Hectic fever, with dropsy, after scarlatina.
Teeth - Looseness of teeth. Front teeth sensitive. Dental fistula. Toothache with thrilling pains. Great
tenderness of gums with salivation. Gums inflamed or white, bluish.
Throat - Scraping and pricking in throat. Hoarseness, speaking difficult. Dyspnea,
sensation in larynx as if closed. Laryngeal disorders in syphilis and mercurio-syphi- lis. Frequent desire to
swallow, feeling of a plug in throat. Suppurating ulcer on tonsil.
Tongue - Redness, dryness and excoriation of tongue. Cancer of the tongue. Tongue hard as leather, hardly
movable. Indurated tongue, warts, cancer, ulcers. Induration after glossitis. Yellow coaud tongue. Warts on
tongue.
Vertigo - Vertigo as if walking in air.
Vision - Slow accommodation for near or far objects. Sudden blindness in childbed. Sudden blindness after
scarlatina. Pupils don't react to light. Letters disappear in evening when reading at candlelight. Paper seems
white, as if not printed upon.
COMMENTS - Grimmer said that the patient needing this medicine is sensitive to heat and relieved in wet
weather, he is as restless as Arsenicum and as depressed as Aurum. Cancerous warts on the tongue and
genitals have been cured with this medicine.
Aur-m. is particularly valuable in hemorrhages from the womb at menopausal and after, which are frequently
of sycotic origin. Violent chill and fever. Hectic fever. Sensitive to heat and relieved in wet weather, restless
(Ars.).
Depressed (Aur.), with suicidal conflict. Will discuss and plan suicide, but fear of it. Both “desires death” and
“loathing of life.” Boericke noted this conflict, similar to Nat-s., but with Nat-s. they are constantly trying to
restrain themselves. For Aur-m„ the plans content them, a wonderful secret that they can rely on.
Catarrhal and glandular disorders are marked. Warts appear in various parts, on the tongue, on the genitals.
Digestion is slow. Diarrhea after eating.
A sycotic remedy, causing suppressed discharges to reappear.
Halbert gave Aur-m. 2x with much success in cases of sclerotic and exudative degeneration of the nervous
system. He narrated a case of disseminated sclerosis, the result of a fall, one of exudative localized meningitis
and one of Morvan's disease greatly improved under its use.
This patient, a male cook, had hypertrophy of all the fingers. In some of them this had progressed until the
painless whitlows appeared.
Analgesia and anesthesia were present and some atrophy of the muscles of the hand and arm. Brachial
neuritis appeared to be the causative factor in the case. Remarkable improvement occurred under Aur-m. 2x.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Bell., Cann-i., Merc. Sulphur springs are incompatible. Compare: (1) Aeon.,
Am-c., Arg-m., Arg-n., Ars., Aurum met. Bell., Cann-i., Ferr., Glon., Hecla., Lyc., Merc., Nit-ac., Phos., Plat.,
Sil., Sulph.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Murphy.
