name: Aurum Mur. Natronatum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aur-m-n. Aurum muriaticum natronatum. Sodium chloroaurate. Double Chloride of Gold and
Sodium. Historicaldose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amaurosis. Amenorrhea. Arteriosclerosis. Ascites. Bright's disease. Bubo. Cancer. Cervicitis.
Chancres. Cirrhosis. Dyspepsia. Erysipelas. Gastroenteritis. Fibroids. Hemorrhoids. Hair, loss. Headaches.
Hectic fever. Hypertension. Indurations. Infertility. Jaundice. Leucorrhea. Miscarriage. Nephritis. Ovarian,
tumors. Prolapsed, uterus. Psoriasis, syphilitica. Rhinoscleroma.
Scrofula. Sycosis. Syphilis. Syphilitic, ataxia. Tongue, disorders. Tuberculosis. Tumors. Ulcers.
Uterus,indurations. Uterus, tumors. Warts.
HOMEOPATHIC - This double salt of na- trum and chloride of gold shows more of the syphilitic miasm present,
carcinoma on a syphilitic base. Burnett stated that Aur-m-n. has more power over uterine tumors than any
other remedy.
Anshutz wrote, “Never have I observed gold so startling in its action as in the following case: The patient is a
type of the scrofulous habit, reddish hair, pasty complexion, thick nose, coarse features.
“About thirty years of age. He has had the misfortune of being infected by syphilis and the still greater ill-luck
of being treated by mercury and iodine to excess. All these circumstances conjoined helped to produce a
complication of morbid conditions which would put medical art to a severe test.”
A case of rhinoscleroma was reported cured by Aur-m-n. in 5x by Kranz-Busch. Old cases of rheumatism or
gouty pains. Scrofula. Burnett considered it to have more power over uterine tumors than any other gold
preparation. Aur-m-n. has been proved, but it has been chiefly used on general Aurum indications.
Aur-m-n. has induration of one part, softening of another. This remedy has a pronounced effect on the female
organs. Fibroids of uterus. Enormous induration of an ovary. Cancer of breast and uterus. Cancerous warts
on tongue. Corrosive leucorrhea, pustules on genitals.
Arteriosclerosis. High blood pressure due to disturbed functions of the nervous system. Warts on tongue. White
stools with jaundice. Swelling of testicle. Bright's disease. Old cases of rheumatism and gouty pains. Hepatic
cirrhosis. Interstitial nephritis.
Affections of the bones and glands. Boring pains are very marked in the pathogenesis of this salt, over left
eye, skull, chest, tibia and bones generally. Periosteal swelling on lower jaw. Psoriasis syphilitica. Chancres,
ulcers, warts. Bubo. Syphilitic ataxia.
MIND - Depression and anger. Ailments from anger. Hysteria. Mental activities are disordered. Feeling of
unrest and impatience. Reproaches, himself. Yielding. Anxiety of consciousness. Remorse. Ailments after
reproaches.
Ailments from grief. Fear of failure and rejection. Cautiousness. Fear of undertaking anything new. Fear of
strangers. Compulsive disorders. Sarcastic. Self pity. Tendency to daydream.
Abdomen - Coldness in abdomen. Dropsy. Gastroenteritis. Pressure in the right hypochondrium. Dropsy
without fever but threatening suffocation.
Back - Cracking in cervical vertebrae on bending head. Burning and drawing, tension and pressure in muscles
to left of nape extending to shoulder, worse bending head to right, at times unbearable during rest. Pustular
eruption on back.
Causations - Vexation (jaundice).
Constitutions - Suited to Carbo-nitrogenoid and mercurio-syphilitic constitutions.
Eyes - Amaurosis. Ophthalmia, scrofulous, cancerous, at the same time, nose scurfy.
Face - Ulcers in cavities of upper jaw. Pallor of face. Ulcer in right corner of mouth.
Female - Indurated cervix. Chronic metritis and prolapsed uterus. Uterus fills up whole pelvis. Leucorrhea
with spasmodic contraction of vagina. Leucorrhea, corroding the parts. Ovaries indurated. Ovarian dropsy.
Enlargement of ovary. Sub-involution. Ossified uterus. Fibroids of uterus. Uterus, tumors. Scirrhus cancer
of uterus. Carcinoma of breast and uterus. Pustules on genitals. Miscarriage from uterine indurations.
Ulceration of neck of womb and vagina. Ulcers with induration of uterus.
Fever - Remarkable coldness of back. Remarkable heat in skin. Sweats only on right side, left (affected) side
 of head remains dry. Excessive perspiration.
Food - No appetite in jaundice.
Head - Hair falls out. Every morning pressure over eyes, pains in forehead, dullness in head, lasting until
afternoon, better in evening, nasal discharge bloody, fetid.
¡chorus. Continual humming in head with beating of carotids. Violent headache, in left side of head, mostly
over eye.
Heart - Palpitations of young girls. Irregular heartbeats with anxiety and short breath, while sleeping. Severe
violent beats of the heart with sensation of pressure while standing.
Kidneys - Dark urine in jaundice. Turbid urine.
Limbs - Rheumatism or gouty pains. Burning in skin of right axilla. Pressure in right deltoid. Boring and
pressing pains in arms and elbow-joints. Boring pain in bones. Painful stitching in fingertips. Boring pains in
thighs, knees, tibia (first right then left). Boring in both sides right Achilles tendon when sitting. Stitches in tips
of toes in bunion.
Liver - Hepatic cirrhosis. Pressure in liver region. Jaundice after vexation.
Male - Ulcers on foreskin, warts around them. Ulcers on glans eating deeply. Chancre on internal surface of
prepuce. Bubo in fold of groin.
Modalities - Worse in cold, wet weather. Worse from October to spring (headache). Worse by rest.
Mouth - Redness and swelling of palate behind upper incisors. Salivation. Bitter taste. Fetid odor from mouth.
Neck - Burning pain in skin of nape. Heat in nape rising into head and cheeks.
Nose - Ulcers, caries. Ozaena. Nose swollen, hard, shining (scrofulous), if he takes cold, erysipelas sets in.
Destruction of nasal bones. Scurfy, oozing tetter on nose.
Perspiration - Sweats only on right side. Excessive sweats. Suppressed sweats.
Rectum - Clay-like feces. Hemorrhoid which protrudes and is painful. Stools hard. Feces like whitish clay.
Skin - Intolerable itching all over body, sores followed by an eruption of little lumps, several covered with dark-
looking scabs. Jaundice. Deep-spreading syphilitic ulcers on skin.
Teeth - Teeth get loose, look dirty, gums recede.
Throat - Swelling and inflammation of fauces. Small blisters on fauces.
Tongue - Burning, stitches and induration. Burning on tip of tongue. Tongue coated white in jaundice. Warts
on tongue.
COMMENTS - Hale considered this the most active of all the preparations of gold. In toxic doses itcauses
“violent gastroenteritis” accompanied by cramps, convulsive trembling insomnia, priapism and insensibility.
In pathogenetic doses it causes epigastric pain, nausea, loss of appetite and constipation. The constipation is
like that of Hydr., being accompanied with catarrh.
Hale used it with success in nervous dyspepsia with a tendency to diarrhea after eating in gastric and duodenal
catarrh with or without jaundice.
He stated that the primary effect of the salt is to cause congestion, irritation of the uterus and ovaries, sub-
acute metritis, ovaritis, profuse and premature menses, habitual abortion, nymphomania, ulceration of uterus,
cervicitis. For these, the potencies are suitable.
The secondary effects are “Atonic amenorrhea, scanty and delaying menses, deficient sexual desire, infertility
from ovarian torpor, ovarian dropsy,” for these, Hale recommended the lowest triturations.
He suggested its use in puerperal mania with sexual excitement, ovaritis, gastrointestinal irritation and suicidal
impulses. Also in corresponding states in men.
Aur-m-n. is a specific for asymptomatic ovarian tumors and asymptomatic fibroids.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Arg-n., Ars., Bad., Bry., Crot., Con. (2) Graph., Hep., lod., Kali-bi., Kali-i. (3) Lyc.,
Merc., Nit-ac., Phos., Sulph., Thuj.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Murphy.

name: Aurum Sulphuratum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aur-s. Aurum sulphuratum. Gold sulphide. Auric sulphide. Historical dose: Trituration and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Bedwetting. Goiter. Head, nodding. Impotence. Jaundice. Breasts disorders. Nightmare. Nose,
swelling. Parkinson's disease. Pruritus vulvae. Staggering.
HOMEOPATHIC - This valuable gold preparation has been used with success in Aurum met. cases with some
Sulphur indications.
Aur-s. has been proved and the most striking symptoms include constant nodding of head. Lancinations in
occiput. Redness and swelling of nose, crusts, dry coryza, great sensitiveness to least contact.
 Sensitiveness to touch was observed in other parts. Inclined to vomit after eating. Bedwetting. Impotence.
Lancinations in penis. Heaviness in genitals. Heat, lancinations and itching of vulva.
Swelling of the breasts, painful to touch. Cracked nipples, sharp pain in point of nipples. Thick yellowish
leucorrhea, especially in morning. Staggering gait. Weariness. Frightful dreams.
Indurations, ulcerations around nose, lips and genitals with intense itching of skin. Parkinson's disease,
constant nodding of the head. Affections of the breasts, swelling pain, cracked nipples with sharp pains.
MIND - Desire for solitude. Disgust for life.
Breasts - Swelling of breasts, painful to touch. Cracks on nipples.
Eyes - Redness of eyelids. Morning agglutination. Stye near outer canthus. Photophobia.
Face - Cracked lips.
Female - Thick, yellowish leucorrhea, especially in the morning. Irregular menstruation. Sensitiveness of
uterus to touch.
Head - Constant nodding of head. Continual rush of blood to had. Lancinations in occiput. Itching of scalp,
worse night. Burning and smarting of scalp. Falling out of hair. ,
Heart - Palpitation when ascending a height.
Kidneys - Nocturnal bedwetting. Thick, yellow, red and sandy urine.
Lungs - Nightly paroxysms of loud cough. Hard cough with scanty expectoration of pure blood. Suffocating
attacks at night.
Male - Frequent erections with desire for embrace, but ceasing immediately. Impotence.
Mouth - Redness, swelling and bleeding of gums. Aphthae.
Nose - Redness and swelling of nose. Crusts on nose. Sensitiveness to least contact.
Sleep - Troublesome frightful dreams of thieves of assassins.
Stomach - Great thirst. Watery belchings tasting of ingesta. Frequent hiccough. Very slow digestion.
Throat - Swelling of thyroid.
REFERENCES - Clarke. Grimmer.

name: Avena Sativa
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aven. Avena sativa. Oatstraw. Common Oat. N. O. Gramineae. Tincture of fresh plant in flower.
The fresh green plant, gathered in August is pounded to a pulp and macerated with two parts by weight of
alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL -Addictions. Alcoholism. Amenorrhea. Brain, fatigue. Cholera. Chorea. Coffee. Colds. Coryza.
Debility. Delirium, tremens. Drug, abuse. Dysmenorrhea. Endocarditis. Epilepsy. Headaches. Heroin.
Impotency. Insomnia. Influenza. Masturbation. Nervous, disorders. Neurasthenia. Opium, morphine,
addiction. Palpitations. Sexual, weakness. Sleeplessness. Spermatorrhea. Tobacco. Tuberculosis.
Weakness.
HERBAL - Aven, improves the nutrition ofbrain and nervous system. One of the best tonics for debility after
exhausting diseases. Valuable in enabling a patient to overcome the morphine or heroin habit.
Aven, has been used in substantial doses of 5 to 15 drops of the tincture in a large number of cases of nerve
weakness. The only symptom that has been observed to be caused by it is a pain at the base of the brain from
20-drop doses.
BANISTERIOPSIS CAAPI
(Ayahuasca)
PHARMACY - bani-c. Banisteriopsis caapi. Ayahuasca. Spirit Vine. Yagé. Psycho- tria viridis. N. O.
Malpighiaceae. South America. Amazon. Historical dose: Ail potencies.
CLINICAL - AIDS. Allergies. Asthma. Autism. Cancer. Chronic, fatigue. Clairvoyance. Delusions. Digestive,
problems. Drug, abuse. Emphysema. Hallucinations. Insomnia. Kyphosis. Malnutrition. Nausea. Numbness.
Parkinson's, disease. Scoliosis. Sexual, abuse. Vomiting. Worms.
HERBAL - Ayahuasca, commonly called yagé, or yajé in Colombia. Ayahuasca in Ecuador and Peru. Inca
“vine of the dead, vine of the souls,” aya means in Quechua “spirit,” “ancestor,” “dead person,” while huasca
means “vine,” “rope,” and caapi in Brazil. Ayahuasca brew is prepared from segments of a species of the vine
Banisteriopsis, a genus belonging to the Malpighiaceae.
HOMEOPATHIC - Tiredness, exhaustion, debility. Unable to move from tiredness. Shakiness and
disorientation. Unable to recover one's energy with rest. Feelings of detachment, poor memory and vagueness
with the exhaustion. Rushes of energy which are associated with raised heartbeat and that cause some
anxiety. Heightened sensitivity of all senses, mostly vision and hearing.
Muscular soreness and weakness from tiredness. Limbs go to sleep, pins and needles sensations. Tightness,
 tingling, aching, and drawing in the spine. Numbness and general malaise. Anesthesia. Muscle wastage.
Tissue necrosis. Easy dislocation of joints. Crumbling of bone tissue.
Digestive tract malfunction. Poor assimilation and metabolism. Imbalance of bowel flora causing
psychological symptoms such as depression. Pains can be sharp, sudden on appearance and quick to go,
tend to be worse night. Autism. Ailments from injuries, worse spine or the head. AIDS. Cancer. Chronic fatigue.
Parkinson's disease. Strong history of drug abuse. Multiple allergy syndrome.
MIND - Confusion of mind. Cannot think straight. Difficult concentration, compre
hension. Dullness, sluggishness. Mistakes about time. Memory weakness. Forgetfulness. Thoughts intrude
and crowd around each other. Tormenting, persisting thoughts. Amorous thoughts.
Clear-sighted, increased precision of mind. Sensitive to all external impressions. Senses are acute.
Oversensitive to light, noise, shrill sounds, sad stories. Charmed by colors, especially red. Easily startled.
Moods are changeable, variable, swings between extremes of rage and well being. Impulsive. Restless,
nervous. Impatient, hurried, everybody moves too slow.
Stressed mentally and emotionally. Full of worries, forebodings. Insecure. Anxious, desperate. Anxiety from
palpitations, on waking. Anxiety about salvation. Overpowering panic attacks. Prolonged anguish and fear
which has heightened every sense.
Irritability from any disturbance, when questioned. Fastidious. Obstinate, headstrong. Rage, fury. Impulse to
kill. Anger during meetings. Jealousy associated with sexual excitement. Suspicious, mistrustful.
Weeping, causeless. Pessimistic. Dwells on past disagreeable events. Homesick, nostalgic. Sadness,
depression, crying difficult. Ailments from grief, sorrow. Grief of the deepest kind. Forsaken feeling. Worse
from consolation, company. Aversion to company. Indifference, apathy towards friends. Despair of life.
Unmitigated misery. Suicidal thoughts. Loquacity alternating with sadness. Loss of self-control.
Feelings of being disconnected, worse fatigue, stress, anxiety or fear. Inability to feel connected to the mother.
Desire for sympathy. Inability to remember childhood. Loss of purpose. Sense of uselessness and frustration
at not being able to find one'spath. Sense of having been derailed. Work fatigues easily. Sympathetic,
compassionate.
Fear that something bad will happen. Fear of insanity, of losing self-control. Fear of crossing a bridge, of
falling. Fear of ghosts, evil. Fear of impending death, feels as if soul were escaping from body. Fear of terrible
dreams.
For acute coryza, take 20 drop doses in hot water hourly for a few doses.
HOMEOPATHIC - Selective action on brain and nervous system, favorably influencing their nutritive function.
Leading indications are nervous exhaustion, sexual debility, and general weakness. Sleeplessness with
nervous exhaustion and weakness. Chronic insomnia. Delirium tremens.
Drug addictions. Bad effects of morphine or heroin addiction. Addicted to cocaine, marijuana, nervines,
tranquilizers or sedatives. Alcoholism. Insomnia due to drugs or alcohol. Post-diphtheria paralysis.
Rheumatism of heart.
Colds and coryza. Nervous palpitations. It is useful in nervous exhaustion, sexual debility, debility after
exhausting diseases. Weakness of the mind when due to masturbation or sexual irregularities.
Nervous states of the female and male sexual systems. Nervous tremors of the aged. Parkinson's disease,
chorea and epilepsy.
MIND - Prostration of mind, mental exhaustion, brain fag, with sleeplessness. Symptoms from mental or
physical overwork. Mental exertion aggravates. Dullness, sluggishness. Difficulty of thinking and
comprehending. Inability to keep mind on any one subject.
Nervous exhaustion in brain workers, or from worry and anxiety. Difficult concentration from masturbation.
Brain fatigue with sleeplessness. Morphine or heroin addiction. Alcoholism, dipsomania to help withdrawal.
Hypochondriasis.
Constitutions - Nervous constitution.
Female - Amenorrhea. Dysmenorrhea with weak circulation.
Head - Nervous headache at menstrual period with burning at top of head. Occipital headache with phosphatic
urine. Aching deep in brain. Vertex headache during menses.
Heart - Inflammation of heart, carditis. Endocarditis. Rheumatic heart. Palpitations.
Limbs - Numbness, as if paralyzed. Weakness, twitching, trembling of hands. Strength of hand diminished.
Numbness, insensibility. Paralytic weakness. Rheumatic pains.
Male - Disposition to masturbation.
Troublesome erections, wanting. Seminal emissions aggravates. Seminal emissions without erection.
Spermatorrhea. Impo- tency after sexual excesses. Diminished sexual desire.
Nose - Coryza. Acute colds. Watery discharge. Rhinitis.
 Rectum - Cholera. Diarrhea.
Sleep - Chronic insomnia, worse during convalescence. Sleeplessness after worry, mental exertion, after
influenza, from weakness. Insomnia, aggravated by exhaustion, alcohol. Sleeplessness in alcoholics, with
delirium tremens.
Urine - Sediment, phosphates increased.
COMMENTS - Aven, is pre-eminently an anti-neurotic, quieting the nervous system to a remarkable degree.
Its special sphere of action seems to be upon the male sexual organs, regulating the functional irregularities
of these parts perhaps as much as any remedy can.
Aven, is indicated in the sleeplessness of the weak and elderly. Also for children who are nervous and weak.
It is a most useful remedy in all cases of nervous exhaustion, general debility, nervous palpitation of the heart
insomnia inability to keep the mind fixed upon any one subject. More especially when any or all of these
troubles is apparently due to nocturnal emissions, masturbation, or sexual over activity.
This is a specific remedy for drug addiction, mainly heroin and morphine, but also tobacco, cocaine, marijuana
and valium. Boericke noted it for alcohol addiction.
It is one of the most valuable means for overcoming morphine addiction. In most cases in which the habit has
not used more than four grains daily the opiate may be abruptly discontinued and even substituted without any
serious results.
If a larger quantity than this amount has been taken for some time, it is better to gradually reduce the daily
dose of morphine in the usual manner, simply prescribing the Avena in addition. The latter should be given in
the same dose, as a rule, regardless of the amount of morphine taken.
In other words, it is not necessary to increase the Avena as the opiate is withdrawn. When the quantity of
morphine has not exceeded four grains daily it should be stopped at once, as stated above and Avena given
in its stead in fifteen-drop doses, four times a day in wine glassful of hot water.
By this method the disagreeable aftereffects will be much less than though the dose of morphine is gradually
reduced and the patient will find life quite bearable, as a rule, at the end of a week.
Avena sativa should always be given in appreciable doses of the tincture. Fifteen drops three or four times a
day, well diluted, will usually meet the case. It may be given in doses of from five to sixty drops in rare instances.
It should, however, never be given in larger quantities than twenty minims unless the patient is thoroughly
accustomed to the remedy and has found the usual dose insufficient.
Otherwise, there is danger of getting the physiological effect of the drug, which is pain at the base of the brain.
When this symptom makes its appearance the medicine should be discontinued for a day or two and then
given in reduced doses.
There seems to be no danger whatever of forming the habit of taking this remedy, as it can be suddenly
abandoned at any time without evil consequences, even when given in large quantities. In one case it was
prescribed in sixty drop doses, night and morning, for one year and then abruptly stopped. Nothing was
substituted, without bad effects.
Whenever a quick action is desired and in all cases where Avena is given to overcome the morphine habit, it
should be prepared in hot water. It is also a good plan to prescribe it in this fashion wherever indigestion
complicates the case.
Anshutz employed this drug in his private practice for a number of years with the most gratifying results. He
has very rarely found it to fail when indicated and on account of his high opinioii of the remedy he has taken
great pleasure in thus bringing it prominently to the attention of the medical profession.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Alfalfa - general tonic similar to Avena sativa. Alfalfa, also for scanty and
suppressed urine. (2) Passiflora, Valerian.
REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

name: Azadirachta Indica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - aza. Azadirachta indica. Neem bark. Margosa bark. Nim. Melia azadirachta indica. Antelaea
azadirachta. N. O. Meliacae, Tribe, Meliee. India and Burma. Tincture of the bark. The fresh bark is pounded
to a pulp and macerated in two parts by weight of alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Acroparesthesia. Amnesia. Boils. Constipation. Depression. Diarrhea. Eczema. Gonorrhea.
Hypochondria. Intermittent, fever. Leprosy. Leucorrhea. Malaria. Miscarriages. Quinine, effects.
Rheumatism, acute. Senile dementia. Spleen, congested. Typhoid fever. Vomiting. Worms.
HERBAL - Azadirachta Indica is a large tree. The leaves, bark, wood, roots, fruits and every part of this tree,
are intensely bitter. The vast range of its action is chiefly due to azaserine, margocine and catechin, the three
active principles found in this tree.
 This is an Indian remedy from very ancient times. The bark, known as Margosa bark, is the best-known
medicinal portion. The tincture for the provings were made from the bark by Dr. P. C. Majumdar of Calcutta,
India.
Majumdar contributed a synopsis of Aza. According to Ayurveda, the different parts of this tree possess
different medicinal properties. Sanskrit authors agree that Azadirachta Indica bark, though very disagreeable
in taste, is generally used with success.
The Neem tree is used for treatment of bacterial, viral, fungal infections and for the treatment and prevention
of malaria. Its action on fevers is well-known in India, the native physicians use Neem as the principal
substance in their febrifuge medicines. It is especially useful in cases previously maltreated with quinine.
In Kenya the tincture of Neem in the 2x dilution has been used as a treatment for three weeks to neutralize the
malaria organism from the body. A decoction of fresh leaves is used as a favorite wash to cure old ulcers of
long standing.
It remo ves within a short time the sloughs and promotes the healing. The fruit is purgative, demulcent and is
used in some forms of skin disorders.
A kind of oil is produced from the seed of ripe fruits and this oil is said to cure leprosy, eczema and some other
obstinate skin diseases. Neem is also praised by some of the allopathic physicians for its tonic, anti-septic,
astringent and anti-periodic properties.
HOMEOPATHIC - Aza. has been used in cases of lassitude, thirst, cough, fever. Loss of appetite,
helminthiasis, boils, bilious derangements. Catarrh, vomiting, skin diseases, hiccough, gonorrhea. Its leaves
are used in some forms of ophthalmic diseases, parasites, worms and disorders brought on by deranged bile
or from the use of poisonous things.
Aza. is used in a variety of complaints, especially of the eyes, digestive derangements and skin disorders. An
afternoon fever and rheumatic pains in various parts are caused by this remedy. Pain in sternum and ribs in
back and shoulders and limbs.
Giddy on rising, headaches, scalp sensitive, eyes burn, pain in right eyeball. Heat, pricking and aching in
hands. Loss of memory. Thirsty for large quanti ties of water at long intervals. Tendency to miscarriage.
Copious leucorrhea.
MIND - Mind, weak and dull, full of anxiety inactive. No desire to go out of walk out. Depressed. Mistakes in
writing and spelling words. Senile dementia. Hypochondriasis. Amnesia. Loss of memory. Forgetful. Abdomen
- Great uneasiness in the abdomen, with flatulent rumbling in the bowels, twisting pain in the epigastric region,
no tenderness in the abdomen, clutching pain in the umbilical region, obliging to bend forwards, which affords
some relief. Abdomen a little distended, passing of
offensive flatus. Painful tension in the hypochondria region.
Back - Itching of the body, especially the back, worse in the open air and in the afternoon. Pain and aching at
the nape of the neck.
Chest - Pain in sternum and ribs. Aching in the lower part of the right chest below the nipple. Stitches in the
chest. Crampy pains in the lower part of chest. Transitory stitches in the chest, especially in the right side.
Cramping pains at the base of the lungs.
Constitutions - Nervous or rheumatic constitutions.
Ears - Buzzing in the ears. A peculiar cracking sound is heard in the ear like tickling with a feather, which is
increased on opening the mouth.
Eyes - Burning, dull and heavy. Pain in the eye, from slightest pressure. Red, sunken, congested, with slight
coryza. Sense of pressure in the right eye.
Face - Flushing and heat in the face. Pale. Alternating heat and pallor of the face.
Female - Copious leucorrhea. Metritis of the cervix. Metrorrhagia. Recuning miscarriages.
Fever - Fever commences with very slight chill or without chill at 4:30 p.m. and abates at 7:30 p.m. Afternoon
fever. Glowing heat and burning, especially in the face, eyes, palms of the hands and soles of the feet, in open
air.
Food - Thirsty for large quantities of water at long intervals. Keen appetite. Desires cold drinks and sweets.
Head - Right-sided headache with throbbing of the temporal artery and pain in the right eyeball, worse in the
open air. Scalp and hair painful and sensitive to the touch.
Heart - Pulse rapid and strong, or rapid and weak. Pulse is quick and hard, feeble.
Kidneys - Urine purple in color. Urine scanty and high colored and scalding, urine white, clear and copious,
urine of strong odor.
Limbs - Numbness of the limbs, as if the limbs are paralyzed. Rheumatic pains in the lower limbs. Gnawing
in the legs. Strength of the hand diminished. Burning of the hands and soles of the feet. Numbness of the
hands only, especially the right hand.
 Lungs - Sighing, breathing at intervals. Hot breath, rapid respiration. Short dry cough in the afternoon. Violent
cough with thick, white, jelly-like sputum, which is difficult to expel. Cough after bathing. Cough with grayish
expectoration, thick sputa. Cough with tasteless white sputa.
Male - Great excitement of sexual organs. Sexual desire a little diminished.
Modalities - Worse in the open air. Worse in the afternoon.
Mouth - No thirst, but mouth is clammy, water has relish, good taste. Mouth is bitter. A painful burning
sensation, as if scalded, is felt on the sides and surface of the tongue, papillae seem to be enlarged and
prominent. Putrid taste in the mouth. Saliva coming out which tastes salty. Slight difficulty in deglutition,
especially water and meat.
Neck - Pain and debility in the nape of the neck.
Nose - Running of watery fluid from the nose.
Perspiration - Copious sweat, especially on the forehead, neck and upper part of the body. Sweating
commences on the forehead, gradually extending towards the trunk, no sweat in lower part of the body.
Rectum - Diarrhea, no satisfaction after stool. Feeling after stool, that the rectum is not empty. Constipation
with ball-like stools which are hard and small, alternating with diarrhea. Insufficient, constipated, stools hard,
small and knotty, stools hard. Copious, soft, semi-solid stools.
Skin - Itching of various parts of the body without the appearance of any eruption. Sudamina on the back.
Sleep - Insomnia and agitation in bed. Wakes frequently. Dreams of fights and quarrels in the second half of
the night. Sleeplessness and tossing in the bed, dreamy and interrupted sleep at night.
Stomach - No thirst, appetite very acute and keen. Very great thirst for large quantity of cold water, at long
intervals. Heartburn and water brash. Uneasy sensation in the thorax.
Throat - Bitter taste in the throat. Slight hoarseness. Left-sided sore throat.
Vertigo - Sensation of drunkenness, especially on lifting the head and around 10 a.m.
COMMENTS - The most peculiarfeature of the proving is the fever, which commences with a very slight chill
or none at all, at about 3 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. and abates around 7:30 p.m.
Glowing heat and burning, especially in face, eyes, palms of hands and soles of feet in open air.
Sweat copious, commencing on forehead, gradually extending towards trunk, no sweat on lower part of body.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cedrón, Chin., Ars., Nat-m. (2) Guarea. (3) Ars. - Prostration, anxiety,
restlessness. Cadaverous odor of secretions. Aggravation from 1 a.m. to 3 a.m. (4) Chin. - General weakness
from loss of liquid. Thirst for large quantities of water. Hemorrhaging from the mucus membranes. Sensitive
scalp. (5) Sulph. - Quarrelsome with grandiose ideas. Burning pains, weakness in the morning. Need for fresh
air and fear of water. Morbid alternations. (6) Med.- Forgets names and recent events. Restlessness,
precipitation, desire fordrinks. Irritating leucorrhea. Breasts cold. Heels sensitive. Sleeps in knee-chest
position.
REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke.
keynote:
PHARMACY - aza. Azadirachta indica. Neem bark. Margosa bark. Nim. Melia azadirachta indica. Antelaea
azadirachta. N. O. Meliacae, Tribe, Meliee. India and Burma. Tincture of the bark. The fresh bark is pounded
to a pulp and macerated in two parts by weight of alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

name: Bacillinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-bac. Bacillinum. Tuberculosis nosode. A nosode prepared from human tuberculous sputum.
Nosodes. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Addison's disease. Alopecia. Asthma. Bronchitis. Colds. Coughs. Dyspnea. Eczema. Growth,
defective. Headache. Hydrocephalus. Idiocy. Infections. Insanity. Joints, disorders. Lung, disorders.
Meningitis. Melancholy. Night-sweats. Phlegm. Pityriasis. Pyorrhea. Quinsy. Ringworm. Scrofulous, glands.
Teeth, defective. Tabes, mesenterica. Throat, sore. Tonsillitis. Tuberculosis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Bacillinum is a nosode of tuberculosis named and first described by Dr. Burnett, for whom
it was prepared from tuberculosis sputum by Dr. Heath. As this preparation has been experimented with
separately, its symptoms are given apart from the other nosodes of tuberculosis. Useful as an intercurrent
remedy.
Bacillinum has been used for the treatment of tuberculosis, generally causing the sputum to decrease and less
become less purulent. Tubercular meningitis. It has a disposition to catch colds and sore throats.
Respiratory and lung weakness. Chronic reoccurring sore throats and coughs. Glands of the neck are
enlarged and tender. Night-sweats.
Bacillinum is indicated for the weak lungs of elderly people and for children with chronic catarrhal conditions
and attacks of suffocation at night with difficult cough. Suffocative catarrh. The patient expectorates very
little. Chronic catarrhal conditions of the lungs when bronchial mucus and dyspnea are present. Tubercular
meningitis. Ringworm.
Dr. Burnett has shown that ringworm of the scalp and pityriasis versicolor on the body are indications of
 tubercular diathesis and they respond to this remedy. He cured a case of insanity and ringworm.
Tuberculosis patients are better in dry sunny climates in mountains areas and in the pine forests. Sunlight
helps to prevent tuberculosis, also there has been many cures of tuberculosis via sunbathing and the milk diet,
which these patients crave.
Dr. Cartier has found it particularly useful in cases where there was excessive mucopurulent bronchial
secretion threatening to occlude the lungs. It should be compared with Bacillinum testium, Tuber. Bovinum,
Tuber. Aviaire and Tuber. Koch.
MIND - Taciturn, sulky, snappish, and irritable. Does not want to be disturbed. Fretful ailing, whines and
complains. Great weakness. Morose. Depressed and melancholic, even to insanity. Tendency to be frightened,
fear of dogs.
Abdomen - Abdominal pains, enlarged glands in groin. Tabes mesenterica, grinds teeth, indurated and
swollen glands. Spleen region bulging out. Inguinal glands indurated and visible, excessive sweats, chronic
diarrhea.
Back - Glands of neck enlarged and tender. Sensation of damp clothes on spine. Very sharp pain in left
scapula, worse lying down in bed at night, better by warmth.
Chest - Sharp pain in precordial region arresting breathing.
Constitutions - Tubercular constitutions. For cases stemming from a tubercular inheritance with extreme
soreness of affected parts, patients of rheumatic tendencies with syphilitic taints in the bloodstream, general
muscular soreness.
Ears - Otitis after sore throats.
Eyes - Eczema of the eyelids.
Face - Indolent, pimple on left cheek, breaking out from time to time and persisting for many weeks.
Food - Poor appetite.
Head - Severe headache, deep in, recurring from time to time, worse shaking head. Terrible pain in the head
as if he had a tight hoop of iron around it. Meningitis. Ringworm. Alopecia areata.
Kidneys - Increased quantity of urine, pale with white sediment. Rises several times in the night to urinate.
Limbs - Trembling of hands. Hands blue. Pain in left knee while walking. Tubercular inflammation of knee.
Lungs - Weak lungs. Humid asthma. Colds with sore throats. Hacking cough. Hard cough, shaking patient.
Coughing, more during sleep, but it did not waken him. Catarrhal dyspnea. Muco-purulent expectoration of
bronchitis. Congestion of the lung. Tuberculosis. Bubbling rales and muco-purulent expectoration.
Coughing, that wakes him in night, easy expectoration. Expectoration of non-vis- cid easily detached, thick
phlegm from air passages.
Modalities - Worse night and early morning. Worse from cold air.
Nose - Nasal congestion. Coryza.
Perspiration - Night-sweats.
Rectum - Sudden diarrhea before breakfast, with nausea. Obstinate constipation with offensive flatus. Severe
hemorrhages from bowels. Stitching pain through hemorrhoids. Passes much ill-smelling flatus.
Skin - Ringworm. Pityriasis. Eczema. Glands enlarged and tender.
Sleep - Absolute sleeplessness. Talks in sleep. Drowsy during day, restless at night. Many dreams.
Stomach - Windy dyspepsia, with pinching pains under ribs of right side in breast line.
Teeth - Pyorrhea. Aching in teeth, especially lower incisors, very sensitive to air. Grinds teeth in sleep.
Imperfectly developed teeth. Favors falling off of tartar of teeth.
Temperature - Flush of heat, some perspiration, severe headache. Fever, with emaciation, abdominal pains
and discomfort. Restless at night, glands of both groins enlarged and indurated, cries out in sleep, strawberry
tongue.
Throat - Tickling in fauces, compelling cough. Pricking in larynx with sudden cough.
COMMENTS - In the provings, a constant symptom was a severe headache, deep in, worse by motion. Also
a slight cough with easy expectoration of phlegm. Tends to do better in chronic cases of tuberculosis, as
compared to acute cases.
There are leading indications for it when present in combination with other disorders. An inter-current course
of Bacillinum will often make a wonderful change in patients who have a personal or family history of chest
disorders. Bacillinum is an acute miasm remedy for Phosphorus and Calcarea constitutions in particular.
Grimmer used it for cases stemming from a tubercular inheritance with extreme soreness of affected parts,
patients of rheumatic tendencies with syphilitic taints in the bloodstream, general muscular soreness.
Dr. Young recorded the cure of several cases of cretinism. A case of insanity with pityriasis yielded rapidly to
the remedy. Pityriasis has been cured by it when all attempts to kill the body lice by chemicals were useless.
Clarke has found an eczematous condition of the margins of the eyelids a strong indication for it.
 Bacillinum is made from tuberculosis bacilli, and Tuberculinum is from bovine tuberculosis. Tuberculinum is a
deeper and more chronic remedy. Bacillinum tends to be more for acutes, but there's a lot of overlap. If a
Bacillinum case keeps relapsing, follow with Tuberculinum. Miasmatic remedy, history of tuberculosis in family.
Good for children or adults with a tendency to get colds and sore throats frequently, particularly if they react
well to acute remedies, but keep coming back. For children who get a cold at every change in the weather.
Often swollen glands in the throat. Weight on the chest (Phos.). Mucus in the lungs, bronchitis. Good for the
elderly with a tendency to colds and bronchitis. Lingering colds. The majority of the symptoms are gone, but a
lingering cough or sore throat. Nondescript coughs.
Ringworm (Sep., Thuj., Tell.), and the tendency to ringworm. Diarrhea, especially with a cold, sore throat (Ars.).
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Phos., Dros., Mercury. Its effects seem to be identical to that of Koch's
Tuberculinum. Both are useful in the tubercular diathesis before tuberculosis has developed. In the early
stages of tubercular disease of glands, joints, skin and bones. (2)
Psor. (3) Bac-t. (4) Ant-t., lod., Lach., Ars-i., Myosotis. Complementary: Kali-c., Calc-p., Lach., goes with this
remedy very well. Follows well: Levico, 5-10 drops, follows as an intercurrent where much debility is present
(Burnett).
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Mur-

name: Bacillium Testium
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bac-ts. Bacillinum testium. Nosode prepared from human tuberculous testicle. Histarical dose:
All potencies.
CLINICAL - Bedwetting. Inguinal glands, disease. Leucorrhea. Lipomas. Mesenteric glands, disease.
Pneumonia. Testicles, tubercles. Tuberculosis. Tumors.
HOMEOPATHIC - This preparation has been used by Burnett; it has a more direct relation to the lower half of
the body than the pulmonary Bac., but it is not an exclusive distinction.
Tuberculosis. Pneumonia. Inguinal glands and mesenteric glands are affected. Eruptions in inguinal region.
Abscesses with suppurations. Benign tumors or lipomas. Bedwetting with a weak bladder. Frequent urination.
Excoriating leucorrhea, smells like fish brine. Testicles have tubercles. Picking in the nose with fingers.
Abdomen - Cracks on surface of abdomen and groin. Eruptions in inguinal region. Pain in gallbladder.
Back - Soreness and pain in coccyx. Fatty tumors on neck.
Constitutions - Tubercular constitutions.
Chest - Pneumonia. Perspiration of axilla.
Tumors, lipoma.
Female - Itching, acrid discharges. Leucorrhea is excoriating, greenish offensive like fish brine. Menses are
painful, dysmenorrhea.
Food - Appetite wanting, worse mornings. Aversion to bread, eggs, tea, tomatoes. Desires chocolate, fried
fish, sweets. Nausea and vomiting.
Head - Forehead pain.
Kidneys - Urination, frequent. Carbuncle, vascular bleeding, tumor of urethra.
Limbs - Eruption in the bends of joints.
Eczema. Felon, panaritium. Flat, pointed
warts on hands. Rheumatic pains in thighs and knees.
Lungs - Asthmatic breathing. Morning cough.
Modalities - Worse at the seaside. Worse during the summer months.
Mouth - Odor offensive. Cracked, middle of lower lips (Nat-m.).
Nose - Picking the nose. Boring in nose with fingers. Catarrh.
Rectum - Diarrhea. Itching.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Bac., Cina, Tub.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Bacillus Seven
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY -ba-sv. Bacillus seven. Bacillus asiaticus. Bacillus cloacae. Bacillus freundi. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Asthma. Arthritis. Backache. Bronchitis. Cardiac arrest. Constipation. Deafness. Exhaustion.
Fatigue. Fibrositis. Flatulence. Hemorrhoids. Mental fatigue. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Myocardial,
weakness. Osteo-arthritis. Osteoporosis. Quinsy. Rheumatoid, arthritis. Rheumatism. Senility. Tonsillitis.
HOMEOPATHIC - This remedy is so named as it was the seventh non-lactose fermenting type of bacillus
 observed in the laboratory. As it did not confirm to any of the previously known groups, it was given the number
“Seven.”
Extreme mental and physical fatigue. Its site of action is the neuro-muscularjunction. Unfit for mental
exertion, leading to extreme physical exhaustion. Asthma, catarrh, sticky mucous. Low blood pressure and
myocardial weakness.
Flatulence, fullness after food. Feeble urinary flow, loss of sexual function, premature senility. Rheumatic
nodules. Backache, cannot stand long. Faints easily. Sensitive to cold. All the symptoms can be related to
general lack of nerve and muscle tone.
MIND - The outstanding symptom is mental fatigue, a feeling of unfitness for any mental effort, which produces
a sense of extreme physical exhaustion. Tense and tired. The
thought of doing anything is sufficient to exhaust him.
Abdomen - Flatulence. A sense of fullness after food, flatulence and distention of the stomach. Flabby
abdomen. Pain in liver region.
Back - Backache, cannot stand long without feeling of faintness. Fibrous rheumatism of neck and back,
abdominal muscles, shoulders and arms. Spinal osteo-ar- thritis.
Chest - Some pain.
Constitutions - More suitable for the elderly and the debauch.
Ears - Catarrhal deafness.
Eyes - Thrombosis central retinal vein. Eyes closed, lasted one week.
Face - Dark, pale, puffy. Angio-neurotic edema.
Female - Pain in vulvae, no leucorrhea. Menorrhagia and metrorrhagia.
Food - Averse to fat.
Head - Dull headaches.
Heart - Myocardial weakness. Sudden cardiac arrest. Slow pulse rate, often with lowered blood pressure.
Kidneys - Feeble urinary flow.
Limbs - Poor muscle tone. Joints swollen and painful. Fibrositis. Fibrous rheumatism thighs. Limbs stiff.
Osteo-arthritis of the knees. Left hip fixed, arthritis. Rheumatoid arthritis, knees and ankles. Stabbing pain in
hip. Pain shoots up and down leg. Cramps in leg at night. Pes planus. Feet painful. Gout in left toe. Wrists and
ankles immobile. Rheumatism of the wrists. Ganglion right hand. Fingers swell. Blood vessels burst in
fingers.
Lungs - Asthma. Bronchitis. Bronchial catarrh, tough sticky mucus, difficult to raise. Worse at 2 a.m. (Kali-c.).
Male - Loss of sexual function. Premature senility.
Modalities - Sensitive to cold to drafts and cold, damp air. Backache, better heat and rest. Worse damp and
cold. Worse on commencing to move.
Neck - Stiff neck ’’cracks like a nut.” Fibrositis of neck and shoulders.
Nose - Nasal catarrh.
Perspiration - Excessive perspiration.
Rectum - Constipation. Hemorrhoids. Skin - Cracks in knuckles, fingertips, palms.
Circinate eruption hands, palms, hot, nippy and scaly. Paronychia fingers.
Sleep - Light sleeper. Wakes 2 or 3 a.m. Takes hours to fall off to sleep.
Stomach - Belching.
Throat - Tonsillitis. Quinsy.
Vertigo - Tendency to syncope after sudden exertion. Faintness on standing long and after sudden exertion.
COMMENTS - Rheumatoid arthritis shoulders, elbow, wrists. Relaxed fibrous tissue with tendency to the
formation of “rheumatic nodules”.
RELATIONS - This bacillus has a closer relationship to the two halogens, Bromine and Iodine often in
combination with Potassium. Compare: ( 1 ) Bromine, Iodine and particularly the Kali salts, especially Kali-c.
(2) Among remedies related to this nosode are many iodides. (3) Calc-f.
REFERENCES – Paterson

observed in the laboratory. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Allergy. Asthma.' Anorexia. Cough. Dermatitis. Headache. Itching. Leucorrhea. Nasal catarrh.
Paronychia. Pruritus, ani. Pruritis, vulvae. Rheumatism. Ringworm. Vomiting. "Warts.
HOMEOPATHIC - Allergy to drugs given for asthma.
MIND - Anxious. Overactive mind. Irritable and depressed.
 Abdomen - Pain in gallbladder.
Back - Pain in left iliac fossa and right iliac fossa.
Chest - Panniculitis, chest wall. Lipoma, lower ribs
Food - Anorexia. Averse to egg, bread, tomato, tea and to breakfast. Aggravated by eggs and fat. Craves
sweets, chocolates, fried fish.
Female-Pruritis vulvae. Leucorrhea, fishy odor, greenish, corrosive. Groin skin is raw, dry and cracked.
Urethral caruncle.
Head - Headache in forehead, left eye.
Kidneys - Frequent urination.
Limbs - Tenderness coccyx. Rheumatism of thigh. Rheumatoid arthritis left knee. Paronychia.
Lungs -Asthma. Cough, worse in the morning, sputum difficult.
Mouth - Spongy gums. Offensive breath.
Neck - Fatty cyst.
Nose - Nasal catarrh.
Rectum - Bowel motion first thing in the morning. Sluggish bowel motion. Pruritus ani.
Skin - Warts on hands, numerous flat or pointed (after working with pickled hams). Dermatitis of skin flexures.
Ringworm. Perspiration in axilla.
Stomach - Nausea, vomiting.

name: Bacopa Monnieri
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - baco. Bacopa monnieri. Brahmi. Water Hyssop. Thyme-leafed gratiola. Moneywort. Herpestris
monnieria. Moniera euneifolia. Lysimachia monnieri. N. O. Plantaginaceae. Historical dose: Tincture and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Anemia. Ascites. Biliousness. Blood, disorders. Diarrhea. Epilepsy. Fevers. Indigestion. Leprosy.
Leucoderma. Memory, disorders. Scabies. Spleen. Syphilis. Tumors. Ulcers.
HERBAL - Bacopa monnieri is a perennial, creeping herb whose habitat includes wetlands and muddy shores.
It commonly grows in marshy areas throughout India.
Bacopa monnieri is an herb used in India for memory, epilepsy, and as a mild sedative. It has been used for
centuries to treat epilepsy, improve memory capacity, increase concentration, and reduce stress- induced
anxiety.
Traditionally, it was used as a brain tonic to enhance memory development, learning, and concentration, and
to provide relief to patients with anxiety or epileptic disorders.
Patients taking Bacopa say that they can better handle difficult mental tasks and
stress. It improves the memory. Increased learning abilites. Protects the brain from the effects of aging.
Alleviate anxiety. Mental and brain fatigue. Attention-deficit disorders.
The plant has also been used in India and Pakistan as a cardiac tonic. Digestive aid. Improves respiratory
function in cases of broncho-constriction.
According to Unani medicine, it is bitter, aphrodisiac, good in scabies, leucoderma, syphilis etc. It is a blood
purifier and useful in diarrhea and fevers.
Bacopa is bitter, pungent, heating, emetic, laxative and useful in bad ulcers. Also used to treat anemia, ascites,
enlargement of spleen, biliousness, indigestion, inflammations, leprosy, tumors, etc.
COMMENTS - In India, this herb has also been used traditionally to consecrate new born babies in the belief
that it will stimulate the intelligence. Studies suggest bacopamay improve intellectual activity in children.
Recent research has focused primarily on Bacopa's cognitive-enhancing effects, specifically memory, learning,
and concentration, and results support the traditional Ayurvedic herbal claims.
Also, research on anxiety, epilepsy, bronchitis and asthma, irritable bowel syndrome, and gastric ulcers also
supports the traditional uses of Bacopa.
RELATIONS - Compare: Ginko, Kali-p. Gotu kola.
REFERENCES - Murphy.

name: Badiaga
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bad. Badiaga. Freshwater sponge. Spongilla fluviatilis. Trituration of the dried sponge gathered
in autumn. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL- Basedow'sdisease. Breast, cancer. Bruises. Buboes. Catarrh. Chilblains. Cracks. Coryza.
 Coughing. Dandruff. Edema. Eyes, pains. Glands disorders. Hay fever. Headache. Hemorrhoids. Heart
disorders. Indurations. Influenza. Metrorrhagia. Ophthalmia. Neuralgia. Palpitations. Paresis. Rheumatism.
Roseola. Scrofula. Soreness. Syphilitic, buboes. Syphilis. Tibia, pain. Thyroid, disorders. Tonsillitis. Whooping
cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - Badiaga is the Russian name for the river sponge, which is a popular Russian remedy.
Among the peculiar symptoms and indications are headache with aching in backs of eyeballs, 2 p.m. to 7 p.m.,
worse motion. Severe headache in vertex better night, returning severely after breakfast. Headache with
inflamed eyes. Pains in eyeballs extending to head.
General soreness of muscles and tissues, feeling as if beaten, worse motion and friction of clothes with
sensitiveness to cold. Soreness of anterior muscles of legs, toes bend while walking as if extensors were
paralyzed. Leftcheekand mal ar bone sore to touch. Sharp pains in stomach, liver, below scapulae, urethra,
chest.
Swollen glands. General paresis. Influenza. Basedow's disease. Syphilis, bubo, roseola. Buboes. Infantile
syphilis. Chronic rheumatism, worse by cold, especially in cold air. Chancres suppressed by cauterizations.
Breast cancer.
Cough, causes sneezing, profuse coryza, coming from nostril with a gush. Occasional severe fit of coughing
ejecting viscid mucus, flying out of mouth. Cough caused by tickling in larynx as if a particle of sugar was
dissolving in throat, better in warm room. Pleuritic stitches in chest, neck and back.
Tremulous palpitations, worse lying right side. Palpitations afterpleasurable emotions. Edema. It has lessened
a hard, cellular swelling of both legs. Sharp stinging in back of right heel, worse least pressure.
MIND - Mind generally clear, active in spite of headache. Palpitations after pleasurable emotions. Desire for
mental work.
Abdomen - Sharp pain with a bounding movement in region of liver. Indurated inguinal glands. Syphilitic
buboes.
Back - Stitches in nape of neck, scapula. Pain in small of back, hips and lower limbs. Very stiff neck. Muscles
and skin sore, as if beaten.
Breasts - Indurations. Breast cancer (Aster., Care., Con., Carb-an., Plum-i.).
Ears - Slight sounds are very accentuated.
Eyes - Eyeballs tender, aching in eyeballs. Twitching of left upper lid. Intermittent sore pain in eyeball,
coming on at 3 p.m. Neuralgia of eyeballs extending to temple.
Face - Blue color under the eyes.
Female - Metrorrhagia, worse at night with feeling of enlargement of head (Arg-n.).
Food - Much thirst.
Head - Headache, better at night after sleep. Dull, dizzy feeling in head. Sensation of enlargement and fullness.
Pain in forehead and temple, extending to eyeballs, worse in afternoon. Headache with inflammation of eyes.
Dandruff. Scalp sore, tetter-like.
Heart - Tremulous palpitations. Heartbeats are felt from chest to neck, worse lying on right side. Indescribable
bad feeling about the heart with soreness and pain, flying stitches all over.
Lungs - Cough, worse in afternoon, better in warm room. Cough excited by sweets, candies etc. Ths mucus
flies out of mouth and nostrils. Whooping cough with thick yellow expectoration, flies out. Hay fever with
asthmatic breathing.
Male - Syphilis of infants. Chancres. Buboes.
Modalities - Better by heat, warm room. Worse from cold air. Worse stormy weather. Worse afternoon. Worse
pressure and touch.
Mouth - Hot. Breath hot.
Nose - Coryza, sneezing, watery discharge with asthmatic breathing and suffocative cough.
Skin - Sore to touch. Freckles. Cracks. Raised and discolored scars.
Stomach - Sharp pain in pit of stomach, extending to vertebra and scapula.
Throat - Tonsils inflamed, swollen, worse swallowing solids.
COMMENTS - J. A. Biegler cured a case in which a woman had, off and on for months, a severe pain in
herright eyeball, which extended to her forehead over the eye, then to her temple, always worse in the
afternoon. Scalp sore, dry, itching, scurf, tetters.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Merc, similar but opposite generals. (2) Hydr., Phyt., Con. (3) Seneg. - cough
caused by sneezing, opposite of Bad. (4) Grind. - respiration ceases on falling asleep. (5) Spong. - cough with
much sneezing. Kali-c. - phlegm flies from mouth. (6) Calc-s. - indurations, Carb-an. - indurations, buboes. (7)
Cist. - scrofula. (8) Clem., Hep., lod., Kali-i., Lach., Merc., Merc-i., Nit-ac., Sil., Sulph. Complementary: lod.,
Merc., Sulph. Followed well by: Lach.
 REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Balsamum Peruvianum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-bals-p. Balsamum peruvianum. Balsam of Peru. Myroxylon Pereire. Myroxy- lon peruvianum.
Peruvianum, balsamum. N. O. Leguminose. Caesalpinioideae. Tincture of the balsam that flows from the
stems. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Bronchitis. Catarrh. Cracks. Diarrhea. Hectic,fevers. Nosebleed. Scabies. Tuberculosis. Ulcers.
Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Peruvian Balsam has been proved by Lembke. It has been chiefly used empirically in
catarrhal tuberculosis or bronchial catarrh with copious purulent expectoration. Sputa thick, creamy, yellowish
white, loud rales, night sweats, hectic.
Bals-p. is useful in bronchial catarrh with copious, purulent expectoration. Debility and hectic fever. Cracks
of nipples and fingers.
Chest - Cough, mucus and purulent expectoration. Tuberculosis of mucus type, vomit in lungs. Loud rales in
chest (Kali-s., Ant-t.).
Kidneys - Scanty urine, with much mucus sediment. Urination more frequent and copious. Catarrh of bladder
(Chim.). Sticking and cutting in urethra.
Limbs - Oppressive pain in right wrist. Severe pain in left tibia. Boring in right tibia.
Lungs - Bronchitis and tuberculosis with muco-purulent, thick, creamy expectoration. Tuberculosis of
mucus type, vomit in lungs. Very loose cough, mucus and purulent expectoration.
Nose - Profuse, thick discharge. Chronic, fetid, nasal catarrh. Bleeding from right nostril. Ozaena with
ulceration. Eczema with ulceration.
Perspiration - Night-sweats.
Stomach - Vomiting of food and mucus. Catarrh of stomach.
Stool - Mucus diarrhea. Copious liquid stool, painless. Passage of blood with normal stool.
Temperature - Hectic fever and nightsweats with irritating, short cough and scanty expectoration.
Throat - Scraping in larynx in forenoon, dry cough. Continued scraping of fauces.
COMMENTS - Hale used it with success in “chronic, purulent, fetid anterior or posterior nasal catarrh with or
without ulceration.” He said that a cerate of the Balsam is the best application next to Glycerol of Aloes for
indolent ulcers, cracked nipples, cracks in fingers and palmar surfaces of hands or fissured and chapped lips.
Bals-p. is used locally as a stimulant to raw surfaces in indolent ulcers, scabies, cracked nipples. Promotes
granulation, removes the fetid odor. A one percent solution in alcohol or ether may be used with the atomizer
in respiratory disorders.
Internally, it is used as an expectorant in chronic bronchitis. Used externally for killing scabies. All parts affected
are gently rubbed with it at night and a bath taken in the morning. A single application is sufficient.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Balsamum Tolutanum. (2) Oleum Caryophyllum - oil of cloves in profuse
expectoration, 3 to 5 minims in milk or capsules.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Bambusa Arundinacea
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-bamb-a. Bambusaarundinacea. Barpboo. N. O. Gramineae. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne. Ankylosing spondylitis. Arthritis. Backache. Belching. Colds. Constipation. Cystitis.
Depression. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Gingivitis. Headaches. Heartbum. Indigestion. Influenza. Insomnia. Joint,
pains. Leucorrhea. Motion sickness. Nausea. Neck, pain. Neuralgic, pains. Nightmares. Post-partum,
depression. Rheumatism. Ringworm. Sciatica. Spinal, injuries. Stiffness. Tendonitis. Torticollis.
Tuberculosis. Vertigo. Vomiting.
HERBAL - In folk medicine, the leaves have been used to treat blood diseases and inflammation. The
hardened material inside bamboo has been used for tuberculosis, asthma and leprosy. The shoots are said to
 be an appetite stimulant and digestion aid.
The root has been used for ringworm. The juice from the flowers has been used for earache and deafness.
Some modem studies confirm its anti-inflammatory and anti-tumor effects and its action on the utems.
HOMEOPATHIC -Arthritis and rheumatism. Back pain and sciatica. Spinal injuries. Tension and stiffness
ofjoints, worse from damp, cold weather. Clumsiness and awkwardness. Radiating pains. Wandering and
wave-like pains. Numbness and tingling. Post-partum depression (Sep.). Generally chilly, better from warmth
and worse cold and damp.
MIND - Everything seems uncertain. Emotionally sensitive, vulnerable. Yielding disposition. Sadness with
weeping. Crying over trivial things. Conscientious about trifles. Capricious. Restless, tosses about in bed.
Startled as from a fright.
Cannot handle things anymore, overwhelmed by stress. Mental exhaustion, brain fag. Anxiety, felt in chest.
Anxiety during vertigo. Anxiety of conscious. Bites nails. Anxiety about the future, finances. Worries about
money. Depression with a strong fear of poverty.
Overpowering panic attacks. Fear of losing self-control, of misfortune, of failure. Fear during pregnancy. Fear
of impending disease. Fear of something wrong in her head. Fear of brain tumor, epileptic convulsions. Fear
of lumps in breast. Fear of something wrong in head, Fear of being observed. Fear of saying something
wrong. Fear of vertigo. Hypochondriasis.
Moods changeable, variable. Jealous. Brooding. Domineering. Morose, sulky, cross, fretful, ill-humor, peevish.
Anger from noises. Cursing, swearing. Quarrelsome, scolding. Averse to being disturbed. Irritable towards
husband, children, better in the evening. Irritable, when spoken to. Easily offended. Sensitive to reprimands,
criticism.
Post-partum depression. Depression with a feeling that they would never get well again. General feeling of
betrayal and desertion. Forsaken feeling. New mother feels stressed, drained, overwhelmed, and trapped.
Feelings of helplessness. Pities herself. Feels inferior, poor self confidence. Timidity about appearing in public.
Discontented, dissatisfied with himself, everything. Desire for change. Ennui, boredom. Feels cut off from
life. Indifference, apathy to everything. Sadness alternating with indifference. Depression before menses, in
morning on waking, afternoon, worse 4 pm. Desire for solitude.
Mental dullness, sluggishness. Difficulty thinking and comprehending. Concentration difficult while driving,
studying, reading, writing.
Confusion of mind in morning, as if in a dream. Mistakes about time. Confounds the days of the week.
Mistakes in writing, omitting letters. Absent-mindedness. Memory weakness, from mental exertion. Forgetful.
Delusions, imagines that she is alone in the world. Blames her partner for her bad mood. Imagines he is
deceived, deserted, forsaken. Delusions everything will fail. Imagines he has ruined his health. Delusions,
that left and right side are not the same.
Delusions that body parts are distorted. Foolish behavior. Attempts to escape.
Abdomen - Gas and bloating. Obstructed flatulence. Rumbling noises. Bilious complaints. Tenderness in the
gallbladder region.
Back - Backaches. Spinal injuries. Ankylosing spondylitis. Burning along the spine. Stiffness and tension.
Cramping, aching and dragging pains. A knotted feeling in the back. Heat waves, flushes. Numbness and
tingling. Sacroiliac pains. Coccyx pain, after injuries, stiffness. Stiffness, shoulders. Neuralgic and rheumatic
pains, shoulders.
Bladder - Cystitis, from taking cold. Dragging pains. Pain comes in waves.
Causations - Ailments from anger, vexation, suppressed anger, anticipation, foreboding, excitement,
wounded pride, honor.
Chest - Sensation of a lump near sternum. Ears - Hissing noises in ear. Stopped sensation. Pulsation during
headache.
Eyes - Blinking. Itching, swelling of eyelids.
Face - Acne. Painful pimples. Numbness. Pain in facial bones.
Female - Dysmenorrhea. Profuse menses. Suppressed menses. Offensive leucorrhea. Post-partum
depression, accompanied by a stiff neck, back pain or sciatica (Cimic.). Prolonged lochia. Menstrual problems
after childbirth. Excoriation of cervix. Tearing pain in ovaries.
Fever - Influenza (Rhus-t.).
Food - Strong aversion to fat and to beer. Desires wine, cheese spicy foods. Desires stimulants, like coffee.
Worse from fats, beer and wine.
Head - Headaches are worse from physical exertion, cold wind, and bending the head forward. Pressing pain.
Heart - Stitching, burning pain and stiffness. Dragging sensation in heart region.
Limbs - Rheumatic pains. Stiffness, worse from damp, cold weather. Sciatica, as if painful electric currents
 running down the sciatic nerve to the hollow of the knee. Sharp, stitching pains. Numbness and tingling.
Twitching of limbs. Radiating pains. Wandering and wave-like pains. Icy cold hands and feet. Weakness and
heaviness. Swelling of the ankles.
Limbs - Weak ankles. Burning in the soles of the feet. Icy cold feet. Weakness of the hand, difficulty in writing.
Contractions and spasms.
Liver - Pressing pain.
Male - Atrophy, shriveled genitals. Troublesome erections. Priapism.
Modalities - Pains are better from rest, heat, hot drinks. Worse in the morning on waking, Worse from cold
and damp.
Mouth - Profuse salivation. Gingivitis.
Neck - Stiffness, worse from damp, cold weather. Tension in neck. Very difficult to turn the neck. Torticollis.
Nose - Colds. Nasal congestion. Dryness and numb. Sensitive to odors.
Perspiration - Profuse night-sweats. Odor of sweat, like fresh coffee. Offensive, sweetish sweats. Sticky,
viscid sweats.
Rectum - Anal, itching. Constipation, with soft stool. Diarrhea, like gushing water. Greasy and fatty stools.
Involuntary stool.
Skin - Excoriation. Itching during sleep. Painful scars. Sensitive to hot water. Stings, from insects.
Sleep - Insomnia. Sleeplessness, from an overactive mind. Constantly turning ideas over in the mind. Wakes
3:30 a.m. to 4:30 a.m. Confused dreams. Nightmares. Dreams of accidents, misfortune, disease, deaths.
Dreams of animals, water. Dreams children, old friends. Dreams of teeth falling out. Amorous dreams.
Stomach - Belching. Heartburn, worse from excitement, beer. Indigestion. Dyspepsia. Empty, weak, hungry
feeling. Nausea from
odors. Nausea with headaches. Motion sickness. Lump sensation. Vomiting after nuts. Vomiting, evening.
Teeth - Toothaches, pain worse from sweets.
Temperature - Alternating fever and chills. Chilliness, worse at night. Shaking, shivering with chills.
Throat - Sore throat. Tonsillitis. Tonsils, suppuration. Coldness sensation. Redness. Lump, plug sensation.
Mucus, tenacious, difficult to hawk up. Difficult swallowing. Hoarseness. Roughness sensation. Ulcerative pain.
Tongue - Burning, raw pains. As if tongue was burnt. Formication. Tingling and prickling sensations. Metallic,
offensive, sour, putrid taste.
Urine - Dark color, frothy, foamy urine. Profuse, increases amounts urine. Scanty urine. Strong, putrid odor,
like rotten eggs, sulphur.
Vertigo - Vertigo with staggering. As if intoxicated. Worse from looking downward. Motion sickness.
Vision - Double vision. Foggy, dim vision.
Blurred vision with lachrymation.
COMMENTS - Bernd Schuster related several cases of his experiences with Bamb-a. The first concerned
Karen, a 29-year-old mother, who could not look after her 12-week-old baby because of severe headaches.
The baby was delivered by caesarian and her headaches started shortly afterwards.
Initially, the pain was felt only when she shook her head or cleaned her teeth, but by the time the baby was
three weeks old she could only lie down. She could not bear the sound of her child crying. Pain was better if
she lay down or supported her head. There was a feeling of heaviness or enlargement of her head.
Menstruated immediately after childbirth.
Irritable. She said she wished her little boy would get lost. Then she laughed and said she didn't mean it and
then cried and said, I feel guilty enough about not looking after him properly. After being given Bamb-a., her
head and neck pain did not return and her mood improved markedly
The second case concerned Lisa, a 35-
year-old new mother, who reported “The stress of the birth completely changed me. It was difficult. I am
nervous and a wreck. Breastfeeding makes me feel weaker while nursing I have a terrible feeling. My mood is
the same as when my mother died. I always weep when I am nursing. I feel empty, miserable, depressed,
drained of all my energy.”
She was completely stressed and almost felt persecuted by her crying baby. She lay in bed all day. She was
afraid to be solely responsible for the child. “I imagined the relationship with the child to be closer, but I need
someone to help me I need more support.”
After being given Bamb-a., Lisa was more at ease with her baby; the weakness, emptiness and depression
have gone and she had more energy. She found it easier to tell friends how she really felt and to accept help.
The third case concerned Judy, a 38- year-old mother of two, who suffered from headaches, backaches,
sciatica and a feeling of stiffness in the morning, all of which were worse for three days before her period. She
had been diagnosed with postnatal depression in the past. She described it as “feeling down.”
 “My children are not babies any more, but still everything to do with them depends very much on me. My
husband is never there. My parents have now moved here and they are always wanting something. And I have
to do a lot of jobs physically which women don't usually do. They all come to me when they want something
but no one ever asks if they can help me. It bothers me for the future if I get ill, no one will be there for me.”
She has had other homeopathic remedies and chiropractic, which both worked well, but it was not until she
was given Bamb-a. that her mood improved profoundly, she changed the dynamics in her relationships and
her pain and stiffness disappeared.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Sep., Puls., Placenta. (2) Rhus-t., Dulc., Cimic., Eup-per.
REFERENCES - Schuster.

name: Banisteriopsis Caapi
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bani-c. Banisteriopsis caapi. Ayahuasca. Spirit Vine. Yagé. Psycho- tria viridis. N. O.
Malpighiaceae. South America. Amazon. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - AIDS. Allergies. Asthma. Autism. Cancer. Chronic, fatigue. Clairvoyance. Delusions. Digestive,
problems. Drug, abuse. Emphysema. Hallucinations. Insomnia. Kyphosis. Malnutrition. Nausea. Numbness.
Parkinson's, disease. Scoliosis. Sexual, abuse. Vomiting. Worms.
HERBAL - Ayahuasca, commonly called yagé, or yajé in Colombia. Ayahuasca in Ecuador and Peru. Inca
“vine of the dead, vine of the souls,” aya means in Quechua “spirit,” “ancestor,” “dead person,” while huasca
means “vine,” “rope,” and caapi in Brazil. Ayahuasca brew is prepared from segments of a species of the vine
Banisteriopsis, a genus belonging to the Malpighiaceae.
HOMEOPATHIC - Tiredness, exhaustion, debility. Unable to move from tiredness. Shakiness and
disorientation. Unable to recover one's energy with rest. Feelings of detachment, poor memory and vagueness
with the exhaustion. Rushes of energy which are associated with raised heartbeat and that cause some
anxiety. Heightened sensitivity of all senses, mostly vision and hearing.
Muscular soreness and weakness from tiredness. Limbs go to sleep, pins and needles sensations. Tightness,
tingling, aching, and drawing in the spine. Numbness and general malaise. Anesthesia. Muscle wastage.
Tissue necrosis. Easy dislocation of joints. Crumbling of bone tissue.
Digestive tract malfunction. Poor assimilation and metabolism. Imbalance of bowel flora causing
psychological symptoms such as depression. Pains can be sharp, sudden on appearance and quick to go,
tend to be worse night. Autism. Ailments from injuries, worse spine or the head. AIDS. Cancer. Chronic fatigue.
Parkinson's disease. Strong history of drug abuse. Multiple allergy syndrome.
MIND - Confusion of mind. Cannot think straight. Difficult concentration, compre
hension. Dullness, sluggishness. Mistakes about time. Memory weakness. Forgetfulness. Thoughts intrude
and crowd around each other. Tormenting, persisting thoughts. Amorous thoughts.
Clear-sighted, increased precision of mind. Sensitive to all external impressions. Senses are acute.
Oversensitive to light, noise, shrill sounds, sad stories. Charmedby colors, especially red. Easily startled.
Moods are changeable, variable, swings between extremes of rage and well being. Impulsive. Restless,
nervous. Impatient, hurried, everybody moves too slow.
Stressed mentally and emotionally. Full of worries, forebodings. Insecure. Anxious, desperate. Anxiety from
palpitations, on waking. Anxiety about salvation. Overpowering panic attacks. Prolonged anguish and fear
which has heightened every sense.
Irritability from any disturbance, when questioned. Fastidious. Obstinate, headstrong. Rage, fury. Impulse to
kill. Anger during meetings. Jealousy associated with sexual excitement. Suspicious, mistrustful.
Weeping, causeless. Pessimistic. Dwells on past disagreeable events. Homesick, nostalgic. Sadness,
depression, crying difficult. Ailments from grief, sorrow. Grief of the deepest kind. Forsaken feeling. Worse
from consolation, company. Aversion to company. Indifference, apathy towards friends. Despair of life.
Unmitigated misery. Suicidal thoughts. Loquacity alternating with sadness. Loss of self-control.
Feelings of being disconnected, worse fatigue, stress, anxiety or fear. Inability to feel connected to the mother.
Desire for sympathy. Inability to remember childhood. Loss of purpose. Sense of uselessness and frustration
at not being able to find one's path. Sense of having been derailed. Work fatigues easily. Sympathetic,
compassionate.
Fear that something bad will happen. Fear of insanity, of losing self-control. Fear of crossing a bridge, of
falling. Fear of ghosts, evil. Fear of impending death, feels as if soul were escaping from body. Fear of terrible
dreams.
Disoriented. Sense of unreality. Feels as if intoxicated, drugged. Blissful. Cheerfulness. Euphoria. Tranquility,
serenity, calmness. Thoughtless. Out-of-body states. Feeling of lightness. Fearlessness. No conception of
 time. Incorrect judge of sizes.
Trance. Clairvoyant and clairaudient. Telepathic phenomena. Psychic abilities that may be illusory. Hears
voices or receives psychic messages. False messages. Pride about psychic abilities, may be deluding
themselves.
Delusions, visions and hallucinations on closing eyes. Floating in air, that he is a bird, of flying, that he has
no weight.
Delusions that body parts are immaterial, that the head is separated from body, that the mind and body are
separated.
Religious delusions, that he lost his salvation, of gods, goddesses, angels, devils, ghosts, spirits. Frightful
images, phantoms. Delusions of dangerous animals, crocodiles, tigers. Delusions of leopards, reptiles,
snakes. Delusions of seeing monsters.
Visions of suffering, cruelty, torture, of being at war. Delusions of danger, of being surrounded by the enemy,
of being watched, that another person is in the room. Delusions
-of events long past. Delusions that death is approaching, about the death of others.
Abdomen - Flatuence. Malabsorption and malnutrition from defective gut.
Back - Injuries to the spine and coccyx. Tension in the neck. Scoliosis and kyphosis.
Dreams - Exhausting, frightful or joyful dreams. Unremembered dreams. Dreams of animals, reptiles.
Dreams of crossing bridges, flying, musical instruments, music, food. Amorous, lewd, lascivious, sexual
dreams. Dreams of previous events, old friends, people not seen for years. Dreams of anger of cruelty,
enemies, death, dying, war, being taken prisoner, strife, being wounded.
Ears - Hears acutely. Hears as if from a distance.
Eyes - Acute vision or blurred. Sees images superimposed on whatever is being looked at. Doubts what is
seen, has to look again.
Female - Total loss of libido after use of hallucinatory drugs. Heightened libido, which can lead to excessive
masturbation. Excessive libido in those who enjoy it as if it were only a spiritual experience. Sex with detached
feelings. Sexual abuse followed by a crippled sex-life. Difficult, prolonged or late periods.
Food - Craves alcohol, stimulants such as coffee and tea. No appetite, would prefer to do without food.
Head - Sensation of being stuffed up with cotton wool. Heat in the vertex or cold as ice.
Heart - Congenital heart disease. Real or phantom pains. Raised heart rate. Palpitations.
Kidneys - Weak kidneys. Frequent urinary infections or pains in the kidneys.
Limbs- Muscle wasting. Poor extension and abduction of limbs due to inelasticity of tendons and ligaments.
Poor circulation, coldness and numbness of extremities. Possible remedy for gangrenous states.
Lungs - Restricted breathing from emotional disturbances. Emphysema. Asthma, chronic constricted airways.
Male - Prostate trouble relating to impo- tency. Total loss of libido after use of hallucinatory drugs. Heightened
libido, which can lead to excessive masturbation. Excessive libido as if it were a spiritual experience. Sexual
abuse followed by a crippled sex-life.
Perspiration - Offensive, strong, sweetish odor.
Rectum - Constipation, ineffectual urging and straining.
Sleep - Sleeps as if dead. Full of dreams. Many and varied dreams. Dreams seem more real than life. Desire
to go back into the dream to continue it. Insomnia, from drug abuse or from over-use of sleeping pills.
Stomach - Sensitive stomach, reacts to many foods. Nausea and vomiting after stimulant food and drink.
Feels relieved from vomiting. Nausea and vomiting with anxiety and dread.
COMMENTS - Ayahuasca has been noted to produce lethargy, immobility, a desire
to close the eyes and a sense of withdrawal from the environment. Visions or dreams, most commonly of
snakes which portend either good or evil: they appear either with an open mouth that threatens to swallow, or
in motion. Results are different among non-native users.
Extreme spiritual fear, often followed by giddiness, nervousness, nausea and sometimes vomiting
accompanied by profuse sweating.
Flashes of light, which can be followed by a bluish haze on closing the eyes.
General lassitude and a heightened aware- . ness and appreciation of colors. Deep and dream filled sleep. On
waking there is a common urgency to pass diarrhea. The net result of the whole experience is one of peace
of mind and a physical purging.
Sleep-like trance, in which the person would want to keep the eyes closed, but in which there would be a sense
of alertness with greatly increased intensity of awareness and insight into metaphysics or into personal
problems of the moment.
Users described various themes, including the separation of sour and body separate, often with a sense of
flight, sometimes at high speed. Visions of jungle animals. Mystical visions of angels, Christ or the Devil.
 Clairvoyance, vision of a future event. Visual experience of an event from the past that in some way illuminates
the present.
RELATIONS - Compare: Anae., Ahal. Op.
REFERENCES - Murphy. Wansbrough.

Malpighiaceae. South America. Amazon. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - AIDS. Allergies. Asthma. Autism. Cancer. Chronic, fatigue. Clairvoyance. Delusions. Digestive,
problems. Drug, abuse. Emphysema. Hallucinations. Insomnia. Kyphosis. Malnutrition. Nausea. Numbness.
Parkinson's, disease. Scoliosis. Sexual, abuse. Vomiting. Worms.
HERBAL - Ayahuasca, commonly called yagé, or yajé in Colom

name: Baptisia Confusa Acetica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bapt-c. Baptisia confusa acética. Australian baptisia. N. O. Leguminosae. Papilionoideae.
Acetum of stem and leaves. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL-Dyspnea. Headaches. Oppression. Spleen pain. Typhoid. Vision, weak.
HOMEOPATHIC - Pain in the right jaw and oppression in left hypochondrium, producing dyspnea and a
necessity to assume an erect position.
COMMENTS - J. Meredith notedhisexperience
with this shrub. He showed symptoms including congestion of the forepart of head. Weak vision. Hectic flush
after tea. Right molar felt too long, worse by pressure intermittent, right jaw (later both jaws) stiff and painful at
joint. Sciatica left side. Appetite increased, more energy for mental work. Improved sleep.
He was also relieved of a distressing symptom, that has troubled him for many months, and for which the
ordinary Bapt. tincture in any preparation had failed to relieve. He described it as “areally distressing left
hypochondrium oppression, fullness and actual dyspnea, impelling me to assume an erect position."
This oppression would continue half the night. The distress was located either in the spleen or splenic curve
of the colon. It was uninfluenced by eating. Bapt-c. seemed to relieve the symptom very rapidly, causing
something to move to the left and downwards, after which he went to sleep.
A case simulating typhoid was rapidly relieved by the remedy, showing its relation to Bapt. tinct.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
