name: Baptisia Tinctoria
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bapt. Baptisia tinctoria. Wild indigo. N. O. Leguminosae. N. O. Papilionoideae. North America.
Tincture of fresh root and its bark. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Appendicitis. Biliousness. Blood, poisoning. Brain, softening. Cancer. Delirium. Delusions.
Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dysentery. Epidemic, influenza. Enteric fever. Esophagus, stricture. Eye disorders.
Fevers. Gallbladder, disorders. Gastric, fever. Headaches, bilious. Hectic, fever.High, fever. Hysteria.
Infections. Influenza. Intestinal toxemia. Mumps. Miscarriage, threatened. Plague. Prostration. Putrid,
discharges. Relapsing, fever. Septic, fever. Septicemia. Sewer gas, poisoning. Shivering. Stomatitis.
Strokes. Tabes mesenterica. Tinea capitis. Tongue, ulcerated. Toxemia. Tuberculosis. Typhoidfever.
Typhus. Vaccinations. Variola. Worms.
HOMEOPATHIC - Baptisia, the wild indigo of America, has its reputation as a remedy for typhoid fever. In
low potency it increases the resistant power of the body against typhoid.
In one case, that of an old man, food could be swallowed and retained some days, but not on others. He had
always liked very hot food. The esophagus was red and granular. Bapt. 12c cured.
Hale considered it specific in threatened miscarriage from mental depression, shock of bad news, watching,
fasting or low septic fevers. Patients in these conditions often complain of “dreadful sinking at the stomach,”
fetid breath and other symptoms of Baptisia.
Many cases of tuberculosis are relieved by this remedy when the symptoms and type of fever correspond. It
has cured hysteria with prostration, numbness and fear of paralysis, wanting to die, rubbing hands continually,
restlessness.
Baptisia tinctoria has the ill effects of anti-typhoid serum vaccinations. It affects the blood, causing septic
conditions, like low fevers and malaria poisoning. The symptoms of this remedy are of an asthenic type,
simulating low fevers, septicemia conditions of the blood, malarial poisoning and extreme prostration.
Restlessness, does not sleep quietly, wants to be on the move. Indescribable sickfeeling all over. Tired,
bruised, sick feeling in all parts of the body. Great languor, wants to lie down. Weak and tremulous, as if
recovering from a severe illness. Prostration with disposition of fluids to decompose. Great muscular
soreness and putrid states are present. All the secretions are offensive, breath, stool, urine, sweat, etc.
It has proved specific in a large number of cases is epidemic influenza. Besotted look, bleary eyes, aching
head, sore throat, pains and soreness all over the body and profound prostration.
Chronic intestinal toxemia of children with fetid stools and belchings. Foul odor of the body, breath of
excretions, stools, sweat, urine etc. Brown, sordes, stools, menses.
 Discharges, stools, hemorrhages etc. are dark in color, fetid. Dark spots appear upon the body. Mucus
membranes that become dark. Ulceration of the mucus membranes, especially of the mouth, with tendency to
putrescence.
Feeling of soreness, heaviness and aching of muscles. Prostration is rapid, bed feels too hard on account
of soreness of muscles, yet he feels too weak to move.
Lifeless body but restless mind. Restless, always rubs the hands, hysterical. Insensitive to pain. Parts feel
numb or too large. Bed sores. Intermittent pulse, especially in the elderly. Numbness, prickling and paralytic
feeling over the whole body, especially left side.
MIND - Dull and confused mind. Inability to think. Mind wanders as soon as eyes are closed. Confusion, as
if intoxicated. Ideas confused. Aversion- to mental and bodily exertion. Hopeless of recovery and certain of
death. Melancholia with stupor. Indifference, doesn't care to do anything. Aversion to hear conversation about
sickness or injuries. Falls asleep while answering or does not complete his sentence.
Delirium, wandering, muttering. Wild, wandering feeling. Bewildered. Sense of duality. Illusion of divided
personality. Thinks he is broken or double and tosses about the bed trying to get pieces together.
Imagines his limbs are talking to each other. Sensation as if some person touched him gently while dozing.
Parts feel separated. Worse when thinking of pains in various parts of body.
Abdomen - Distended and rumbling. Fullness and distention of the abdomen. Severe colic in umbilical and
hypogastric region. Intestinal toxemia. Soreness of abdomen in region of liver. Right side markedly affected.
Right, iliac region sensitive. Pain in region of spleen. Abdominal muscles sore on pressure. Sharp, rheumatic
pains in groins, worse from walking. Glands of left groin swollen, painful on walking.
Back - Back and hips very stiff, ache severely, worse walking. Symptoms radiate from small of back. Back
sore and bruised. Feels as if lying on board. Neck tired, cannot hold it easy in any position. Dull pain in sacrum.
Pain in sacrum around hips and legs. Bedsores. Stiffness and lameness of neck muscles, worse on moving
head. Rheumatic pains in muscles of back, followed by burning.
Breasts - Dull stitches in left nipple.
Chest - Constriction and oppression of the chest. Weakness of chest. Sharp pains in center of sternum. Weight
and oppression in precordial region, with a feeling of unsatisfied breathing, afternoon.
Ears - Ears feel hot and burn, yet cold to touch. Soreness in right ear, running down neck. Roaring in ear, with
mental confusion. Dull hearing. Early deafness in typhoid conditions. Delirium with almost complete deafness.
Eyes - Blood vessels congested, eyes look red, inflamed. Eyes feel swollen. Eyelids heavy. Half closed.
Cannot bear light. Feeling as if eyes would be pressed into head. Eyeballs feel sore with great confusion of
sight. Visually, everything appears to move. Severe pains in eyes on reading, compelling to stop. Partial
paralysis of lids. Photophobia, eyes burn, but don't water. Chronic ophthalmia.
Face - Anxious, frightened look. Dusky, stupid. Besotted look. Dark red. Heat and redness of face. Sweats
on face and forehead. Face and whole head feel numb. Pain at root of nose. Burning, prickling of left side of
face and head. Cheeks burn. Muscles of jaw rigid. Cracked, bleeding lips. Pain in left parotid gland. Lower jaw
drops.
Female - Menses too early and too profuse. Threatened miscarriage from mental depression, shock, night-
watching, low fevers. Lochia acrid, fetid. Puerperal fever. Stomatitis of nursing mothers.
Food - No appetite. Constant desire for water. Great thirst. Loss of appetite. Averse to nourishment and
stimulants. Child can drink nothing but milk. All symptoms worse from beer (Kali-bi.).
Head - Congestive headache. Headache, as if intoxicated. Dull, bruised feeling in occiput. Headache, fever
and delirium. Frontal headache, with pressure at root of nose. Headache, with stupor and confusion.
Excitement of brain, with delirium at night. Feels too large. Heavy, numb feeling in head. Brain feels sore. As
if a blow or heavy pain on occiput. Vertex feels as if would fly off. Brain feels sore. Skin of forehead feels tight,
seems drawn to back of head.
Heart - Heartbeats seem to fill the chest. Feeling of greatly increased frequency of heart's pulsations, seem to
fill chest. Audible palpitations. Pulse first accelerated, then slow and faint.
Kidneys - Sharp pain in region of right kidney. Shooting pain in left kidney. Burning when urinating. Increased
secretion of urine at night. Urine is scanty, dark red, alkaline and fetid. Light-green urine. Uremia.
Limbs - Muscles ache, sore and bruised pains. Feels as if lying on a board, changes position often. Bed
feels too hard, worse in region of sacrum. Great weakness, especially in lower limbs. Stiffness and pain,
aching and drawing in arms and legs. Wandering pains in all the limbs with dizziness. Bedsores.
Liver - Soreness over region of gallbladder with diarrhea. Pain in liver, from right lateral ligament to gallbladder,
can scarcely walk. Constant pain in stomach and liver, worse walking, hot sensation, heavy aching in liver.
Pain in liver region on going upstairs.
Lungs - Asthmatic oppression of chest, with frequent yawning. Bronchial asthma. Craves air. Afraid to go to
 sleep on account of sense of suffocation and nightmares. Snoring. Awakes with great difficulty of breathing.
Lungs feel tight and compressed. Breathing difficult from weakness of chest, worse on waking, better
standing. Cough from tickling in throat.
Male - Dull pain in right groin and testicle. Orchitis. Pressing pain in testes as if squeezed.
Modalities - Better drinking liquids. Better open air. Better motion. Worse from open air, cold wind. Worse
autumn. Worse hot weather, humid heat. Worse fog. Worse indoors. Worse from pressure. Worse on waking,
walking. Worse mental exertion. Worse swallowing solids. Worse during sleep.
Mouth - Mouth and tongue very dry in fevers. Filthy taste with flow of saliva. Flat, bitter taste. Foul or bitter
nauseous taste. Putrid, offensive breath. Breath fetid. Can swallow liquids only, least solid food gags.
Lower jaw drops. Sore mouth of nursing child. Thick speech. Soft palate swollen. Putrid ulcers with salivation.
Saliva viscid. Ulcers in the mouth. Sordes on lips. Dark red, tumid mouth and throat.
Nose - Dull pain at root of nose. Nosebleed of dark blood. Sensation of fullness, edema. Sneezing and feeling
as after a severe cold. Thick mucus from nose. Right nostril stopped up. Illusion of smell of burnt feathers.
Perspiration - Fetid sweat. Beginning of typhus when the nervous symptoms predominate, causes sweat to
break out and relieve. Typhus with sweat on forehead and face.
Rectum - Intestinal toxemia of children with fetid stools and belchings. Constipation with fullness of abdomen.
Offensive diarrhea day and night. Diarrhea sudden, horribly foul, mushy, painless, dark or bloody stools.
Aphthous diarrhea. Very fetid exhausting diarrhea. Dysentery of the elderly people with pain in limbs, small of
back and rigors. Painless dysentery with fever. Stricture from hemorrhoids. Stools very offensive, thin, dark,
bloody. Stool like sheep dung, dry and crumbling. Stool papescent, with large quantities of mucus.
Sensations - As if bruised or beaten all over the body. Bed feels too hard, makes him feel sore and bruised.
Feels as if lying on a board, changes position.
Skin - Livid spots all over body and limbs. Burning and heat in skin (Ars.), worse in face. Eruption like measles
or urticaria. Confluent smallpox, tardy eruption. Foul,
Baptisia tinctoria gangrenous, eating syphilitic sores. Putrid ulcers with stupor, low delirium and prostration.
Sleep - Fears going to sleep on account of nightmare and sense of suffocation. Drowsy, stupid and languid,
slides down in bed. Drowsiness, can only keep awake by great effort. Falls asleep when answering a
question. Lies curled up like a dog on one side. Sleepless and restlessness. Sleeplessness with wandering
of mind. Weary, as if he had not slept enough. Cannot get herself together, feel s scattered about bed. Troubled
with dreams, but inability to remember them. Nightmares and frightful dreams.
Stomach - Gastric fever. Can swallow only liquids. Cramp in stomach, evening. Constriction at cardiac
orifice. Cardiac orifice contracted convulsively. Ulcerative inflammation of stomach and bowels. Dreadful
sinkingfeeling in the stomach. Pain in epigastric region. Feeling of hard substance (Abies-n.). Nausea with
eructations, followed by painful vomiting. Easy vomiting. Sudden attacks of vomiting and diarrhea, with fever.
Vomiting due to spasm of esophagus.
Teeth - Sordes on the teeth and lips. Teeth and gums sore, ulcerated. Gums oozing of large quantities of
blood on pressure with finger.
Temperature - Chill with rheumatic pains and soreness all over body. Chilly with soreness of body. High fever,
sudden onset. Sweat relieves. Gastric influenza. Typhoid and cerebral forms of fever. Shipboard fever. Heat
all over with occasional chills. Septic fevers. The whole surface hot and dry with occasional chills, mostly up
and down the back. Typhoid fever. Hashes of heat, feeling as if sweat would break out. Uncomfortable burning
all over surface, especially face.
Throat - Aphonia. Larynx sore to touch, painful swallowing or speaking. Septic sore throat. Fauces red, dark,
putrid ulcers. Painless sore throat and offensive discharge. Numb inside but sensitive outside. Mucus
rattles in throat. Can swallow liquids only, least solid food
gags. Spasms of gullet. Constriction at cardiac orifice of esophagus. Constrictive feeling in throat causing
frequent efforts at swallowing. Dark redness of tonsils and soft palate. Tonsils and soft palate dark red and
swollen. Sharp pain in right tonsil. Ragged ulcers in the throat.
Tongue - Burning at root of tongue. Tongue feels burned. Tongue feels thick. Brown down the center,
cracked, sore, ulcerated. Tongue is dry, glistening edges. Yellow- brown coating in center, edges dark-red and
shining. Tongue cracked, bleeds, heavily coated. Numb, pricking sensation in tongue. Root of tongue feels
numb.
Vertigo - Confused, swimming feeling in head. Vertigo, with paralysis of eyelids. Vertigo, with severe nausea.
Vertigo with a weak feeling, especially of lower limbs and knees. Vertigo as if intoxicated, worse walking.
Vertigo, pressure at root of nose.
COMMENTS - Stupor, falls asleep while being spoken to, confused as if drunk. Cannot keep his mind together,
a wild wandering feeling. This scattered feeling is further exemplified by the illusion that the body is double,
 limbs separated and conversing with each other. Can't sleep because body seems scattered about and cannot
collect pieces. Indifferent and apathetic.
There is a dull, heavy sensation in the head with drowsiness and heavy eyelids. The head feels large with a
numb feeling of head and face. Bruised headache, as if soreness in brain, bruised feeling in occiput, heavy
feeling at base of brain with drawing in of cervical muscles. Frontal headache with pressure at root of nose.
The neck is tired, cannot hold head easy in any position. The jaw drops, prostration.
The eyes cannot bear light, burn, are weak, painful on reading. Weight on eyes, eyeballs sore, feels lame on
moving eyes. Blear-eyed. Lids partially paralyzed. An illusion of smell “as of burnt feathers” has been caused
and cured by it. Pain in left parotid gland.
Flat, bitter taste. Tongue swollen, feels numb, speech difficult. Whitish yellow coating and feels burnt or
scalded. Dry, parched, brown center, cracked and ulcerated. Canker
sores in mouth. Ropy saliva. Sore mouth in nursing children. Thirsty. Sore throat with abscessed tonsils and
pus (Merc.). Painlessness is a feature in the sore throat, putrid, painless, dark ulcers.
Esophagus feels constricted down to stomach, can only swallow liquids, cases of convulsive contraction of
esophagus and cardiac orifice with regurgitation of food have been cured by it. Nausea, retching and vomiting.
For food poisoning from bad water.
Gastric flus with nausea, loss of appetite and diarrhea (Nux-v., Ars.). Sinking, gone feeling.
Pain in liver and gallbladder. Pain in spleen, in right iliac region, in groin, swollen glands. Soreness of
abdominal muscles in right iliac region. Fetid, exhausting diarrhea, dysentery in autumn or hot weather.
Bleeding from the colon, dark, offensive blood. Worms.
The urine is high-colored, scanty, alkaline, and fetid. Orchitis, squeezed pain in testes.
Lumbar backache. Feels as if lying on a board, bed feels hard. Pain in sacrum. Weakness of lower limbs. Much
prickling and numbness in left foot. Numbness and soreness. Excessive drowsiness. Bedsores with offensive
discharge (Hyper., Led.). Offensive, putrid discharges, like something is decomposing. The sweat is putrid,
cadaver-like odor.
Threatened miscarriage (Pyrog., Caul.), from overexertion, excitement, emotional stress, morning sickness, or
lifting.
Sudden onset septic fevers. Overall feeling of toxicity. Drugged look, “besotted appearance,” “dusky
appearance.” Septic infection from blood poisoning from an infected wound, or after childbirth or surgery. Good
for toxic flu.
On a spectrum, Gelsemium is the mild toxic flu. then Baptisia, then Pyrogen for the most toxic. The first keynote
is a bad taste in the mouth, foul mucus in the back of the throat.
Used in the past as the primary remedy for typhoid, contemporary interest for AIDS, as they share many
symptoms. Possible remedy for toxic fever with an AIDS case, with diarrhea, emaciation, and chronic recurring
fever.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Echinacea angus- tifolia is perhaps its nearest analog. (2) Gels., Am., Ars.,
Pyrog., Bry. or Ars. may be needed to complete the favorable reaction. (3) Ailan- thus differs, being more
painful. Bapt. more painless. (4) Rhus-t., Mur-ac., Hyos., Kali-m., Lach., Mur-ac. and Nit-ac.. Follows well:
Ars. Followedwellby: Ter., Nit-ac. Ham., in typhoid Nux-v., Op., Rhus-t. Sil. has like Bapt., ability to swallow
only liquids like milk, but unlike Bapt., Sil. has aversion to milk.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Mutphy. Phatak.
keynote:
PHARMACY - bapt. Baptisia tinctoria. Wild indigo. N. O. Leguminosae. N. O. Papilionoideae. North America.
Tincture of fresh root and its bark. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Appendicitis. Biliousness. Blood, poisoning. Brain, softening. Cancer. Delirium. Delusions.
Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dysentery. Epidemic, influenza. Enteric fever. Esophagus, stricture. Eye disorders.
Fevers. Gallbladder, disorders. Gastric, fever. Headaches, bilious. Hectic, fever.High, fever. Hysteria

name: Barosma Crenulatum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - baros. Barosma crenulatum. Buchu. Barosma betulina. Barosma sanatifolia. N. O. Rutacae,
genus, Diosmee. South Africa. Tincture of dried leaves. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Bladder disorders. Calculus. Catarrh. Gravel. Leucorrhea. Prostate, disorders.
HERBAL - The leaves of several species of Barosma contain in vitae a volatile oil, having a warm camphor-
like taste and an odor something like mint.
HOMEOPATHIC - Buchu has a markedly specific effect on mucus membranes and especially on the genito-
urinary system, closely resembling that of Sabal, Populus, Copaiva and Thuja. There are no provings of the
remedy and the only uses made of it have been with the tincture.
Muco-purulentdischarges. Hale gave as indications chronic disorders of genito-urinary organs with muco-
purulent discharges, abundance of epithelium mixed with pus and mucus corpuscles.
Irritable bladder with catarrh or gravel with spasmodic stricture. Prostatic disorders. Vaginal leucorrhea. Undue
secretions from
mucus follicles of urethra, seminal vesicles or prostate produced by excessive sex or masturbation.
 RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Cop., Thuj., Pop., Chim. (2) Diosm.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Baryta Acetica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bar-acet. Baryta acética. Barium acetate. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all
potencies, second and third trituration.
CLINICAL - Forgetful. Paralysis. Rheumatic pain.
HOMEOPATHIC - Hering and Hahnemann combined the two, Baryta acética and Baryta carbonate. Hering
said there is hardly any difference between the two and certainly none in the symptoms cured. Bar-a. produces
paralysis beginning at the limbs and spreading upward (Con.). Pruritus of aged.
MIND - Absent-minded. Forgetful. Foggy mind. Childish and stupid. Lack of self confidence. Wavering long
between opposite decisions. Weak mind.
Back - Lumbago. Fine stitches in neck. Suppurating pimples. Spinal disease with tinea capitis.
Eyes - Immovable pupils.
Face - Feeling of cobweb in face. Cadaverous pallor. Pale face. Drawn features, eyebrows rather drooping.
Dark redness of cheeks. Mouth arawn to one side.
Head - Tinea capitis. Very disagreeable formication and pricking under skin of head and face.
Heart - Dull, deep sounds of heart. Pulse very small and frequent.
Kidneys - Frequent urination. When appetite improved and thirst lessened, urinary secretions became very
considerable. Clear and abundant urine. Incontinence of urine and feces.
Limbs - Crawiing pain with burning stitches. Paralysis of limbs. Rheumatic pain in muscles and joints.
Drawing pain down whole left leg.
Liver - Sensation as of a ball in liver. Region of liver as if swollen and cold.
Rectum - Involuntary stools. Rumbling in bowels. Diarrhea. Semi-liquid stool followed by constipation.
Lungs - Breathing gradually more and more embarrassed. Imperfect and very frequent respiration. Respiratory
sound almost inaudible. Inability tocough, to expectorate. Inability to articulate words.
Skin - Skin cool and rather moist. Skin covered with profuse sweat.
Sleep - Wants to sleep all the time. Restless sleep. Moaning and muttering during sleep.
Stomach - Retching. Nausea followed by sudden and very copious vomiting of bile. Severe attacks of very
copious vomiting. Vomiting almost regularly every hour for twenty-four hours.
Tongue - Cold tongue, somewhat black. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Bar-c., Bar-m. REFERENCES -
Boericke.

MIND - Absent-minded

name: Baryta Carbonica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bar-c. Barytacarbonica. Barium carbonate. Bar-c. with which are included symptoms of Baryta
acética. Trituration of carbonate. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Aneurysm. Arteriosclerosis. Asthma. Atheroma. Atrophy. Baldness. Brain
disorders. Bronchitis. Down's, syndrome. Dwarfish, children. Colds. Cysts. Dyspepsia. Emaciation.
Esophagus, spasms. Fatty tumors. Foot sweats. Glandular, swellings. Hemorrhoids. Heart, disorders. High
blood pressure. Impotency. Leucorrhea. Lipomas. Marasmus. Memory, defective. Mental, retardation.
Ophthalmia. Palpitations. Paralysis. Parotiditis. Photophobia. Prostate, enlarged. Quinsy. Sarcoma. Senile,
dementia. Strokes. Throat, sore. Tonsillitis. Tonsils, enlarged. Tumors. Warts. Vertigo. Waterbrash. Wens.
HOMEOPATHIC - Bar-c. is especially indicated in infancy and old age. Dwarfish children and childish old
people. Elderly people who are overweight. It has cured a case of fetid foot sweat with spells of despondency,
seeking solitude, sobbing
and crying.
Bar-c. has cured tumors of several kinds. Induration in the breasts. Sarcoma in neck with burning. Fatty tumors,
especially about the neck. Swelling and induration of glands.
Has cured baldness in young people, tinea, wens. The scalp is very sensitive to touch. Enlarged glands in
occiput and neck. It has proved curative in the habitual colic of children who do not thrive, enlarged mesenteric
glands. Hungry, but refuses food, painful swallowing.
It's a cardio-vascular poison acting on the muscular coats of heart and vessels. Arterial fibrosis. Blood vessels
soften and degenerate, become distended and aneurysms, ruptures and apoplexies result.
Affects glandular structures and useful in general degenerative changes, especially in coats of arteries and
senility. Many cases of aneurysm have been cured with Bar-c. It corresponds to the atheromatous condition.
 For those liable to take cold easily, sore throat from cold, glandular disorders. There is a tendency to
enlargement of the glands with indurations especially tonsils, cervical and prostate. Takes cold easily and
then always have swollen tonsils. Catarrh of posterior sinuses with frequent nosebleeds.
This remedy brings aid to scrofulous children, if they are backward mentally and physically. Dull, and apathetic.
Down's,syndrome, delayed development. Marasmus. Dwarfish, they do not grow and develop. Scrofulous
ophthalmia with a swollen abdomen. Persons subject to quinsy, which is prone to suppurate, gums bleed
easily.
Diseases of old men when degenerative changes begin in cardiac and cerebral vascular. Old men who have
enlarged prostate or indurated testes. Offensive foot sweats. Very sensitive to cold. Very weak and weary,
must sit or lie down or lean on something. Averse to meeting strangers.
Often useful in the dyspepsia of the young who have masturbated and who suffer from semina’ emissions
together with cardiac irritability and palpitations. Cysts. Sarcoma with burning. Vascular softening and dila-
tion, aneurysm, ruptures, strokes. Lipomas, fatty tumors. Emaciation of persons who were well nourished.
Prostration, weariness, constant inclination to lie down, sit or lean on something. Upper half of the body feels
stiff and numb. Too tired even to eat. Paralytic effects.
MIND - Increasing mental weakness. Beclouded mind. Difficult concentration. Irresolution. Confusion. Idiocy.
Senile dementia. Slow mental grasp. Loss of memory tries to recollect past events. Forgets her errand or
word in her mouth. Slow, inept and backward. Thinking of ailments worse. Mental dullness. Irresolute. Lost
confidence in himself. Mental functions loss after a stroke.
Bashful. Timid. Cowardly. Shy of strangers. Aversion to strangers, shuns, avoids strangers and unfamiliar
faces. Dread of strangers. Mistrustful. Hides behind the furniture and keeps the hands over the face, peeping
through the fingers. Easily frightened and afraid of strangers. Childish and thoughtless behavior, worse since
a stroke.
Idiocy. Whining mood. Silly, absurd. Mental retardation. Children cannot remember to learn. Slow in learning
to talk. Difficult concentration in children. Talking mania during menses in young girls. Child does not want
to play but sits in the corner doing nothing. Excessively busy, without any aim.
Anxiety about future. Anxiety about domestic affairs. Censorious, critical. Conscientious about trifles. Grief
over trifles. Suspicious that people are talking about her. Imagines being criticised and laughed at. Thinks one
is being laughed at and made fun of. Homesickness. Oversensitiveness of all senses. Heedless. Loquacity
during menses. Sadness about trifles. Exaltation of fancies at night.
Abdomen - Habitual colic of children who do not thrive and though apparently hungry refuse food. Children
with large abdomen. Hard and tense, tender, distended with emaciation of body. Colicky pains. Pain in
abdomen swallowing food. Colic with hunger, but food is refused. As if
intestines fell from one side to other on turning in bed. Mesenteric glands hard and swollen.
Back - Burning in back. Glands swollen in nape and occiput. Weakness of spine. Pulsation in back after
emotions. Bruised pain between scapulae. Indurated cervical glands, like knotted cords. Stiffness in
sacrum. Throbbing in back after emotions. Fatty tumors upon the neck. Chronic torticollis. Itching on lumbar
region. Cramp in neck.
Causations - Ill effects of checked foot sweat. Vaccinations.
Chest - Sharp pain in chest, worse inspiration. Pains in the chest, mitigated partly by belching and by external
heat. Sensation of soreness in the chest. Fullness and pressive heaviness, especially when ascending. Chest
as if sore when coughing. Pain in axillary glands, which are swollen. Chest sensitive to pressure. Itching and
burning stinging in moist, pustular eruption on chest.
Constitutions - Marked influence on the growth especially of children and old people, who become childish.
In children the growth is retarded, they become dwarfish mentally and physically. Children are late coming into
maturity to take on their responsibilities and do their work. It is a remedy for early senility and when
degenerative changes in old men begin in heart, brain and vascular system.
Cough - Dry suffocative cough in old people, full of mucus but lacking strength to expectorate. Cough after
getting feet wet, or least exposure to cold air. Cough is worse every change of weather (Seneg.). Cough
worse in the presence of strangers, eating warm food. Chronic cough, in scrofulous children, with swollen
glands and enlarged tonsils.
Ears - Hardness of hearing. Crackling noise, worse swallowing, walking. Glands around ears painful and
swollen. Itching in ears. Eruptions on lobes of ears. Eruption on and behind ears. Suppuration of middle ear.
Reverberation on blowing nose. Roaring in right ear. Buzzing and jingling.
Eyes - Burning and pressure in eyes after exerting vision. Feeling of sand in eyes. Redness of conjunctiva,
with swollen lids. Itching in eyes. Photophobia. Pressure deep in eyes, better looking downward. Light dazzles
and hurts eyes. Opaque cornea. Agglutination of lids. Eyelids are granular, thickened. Pupils dilate and
 contract quickly. Cataracts (Calc-p., Phos., Sil.).
Face - Expression stupid and vacant, always whining. Tension as from a cobweb (Alum.). Sensation as if white
of egg had dried on face. Parotitis after scarlatina. Face deep red with purple lips and great congestion of the
blood. Prosopalgia. Eruption on the face. Lips dry and cracked. Swelling of upper lip, with burning pain. Lips
pendulous. Acute pain in the joint on closing the jaws. Swelling of the submaxillary glands, with induration.
Female - Amenorrhea. Menses scanty, last only one day. Before menses, pain in stomach and lumbar back.
Menses of long duration. Tearing pain in vulva. Leucorrhea, immediately before menses. Genitals feel numb.
Atrophy of ovaries and breasts.
Food - Loss of appetite, though food has natural taste. Food has a sour taste. Hungry, but refuses food.
Sudden disgust while eating. Aversion to sweet things, fruits especially plums. Desire for sweets. Worse after
warm food. Better from cold diet. Weakness of digestion. Thirst during chill.
Head - Head sensitive to cold, disposed to catch cold when washing head. Brain feels loose, better cold air.
Heavy pressure over eyes. Stitching pain when standing in sun. Pulsation in temples. Crawling over scalp, as
from ants, in spots. Wens on scalp. Dry eruptions or moist crusts on the scalp. Tension as if skin were too
tight. Hair falls out. Baldness of vertex. Premature baldness, even in very young men.
Heart - Arteriosclerosis. High blood pressure. Aneurysm. Cardiac symptoms after suppressed foot sweat or
after masturbation. Heart feels bruised, sore. Palpitations and distress in region of heart. Palpitations
Baryta carbónica when lying on left side, when thinking of it. Palpitation felt in head. Violent, long- lasting
palpitations. Pulse full and hard. Pulse, slow, small.
Kidneys - Burning in urethra on urinating. Every time patient urinates, his hemorrhoids come down. Urging to
urinate, cannotretain the urine. Renewed straining after urination, with dribbling of urine. Frequent urination.
Passes much urine at night. Urine is dark brown, scanty.
Limbs - Pain in axillary glands. Pain in deltoid on raising arms. Limbs feel numb. Numbness from knees to
scrotum, better when sitting. Fingers numb. Pain in joints, burning pains in lower limbs. Trembling of feet and
hands while writing. Cold, foul foot sweat. Pain in the knees, while kneeling. Cold, clammy feet (Calc.).
Fetidfoot sweats. Toes and soles sore, soles painful when walking. Soles feel hot or bruised at night during
sleep.
Lungs - Asthma of old people, worse wet, warm air. Chronic bronchitis. Oppressed, breathing with anguish.
Paralytic aphonia. Larynx feels as if smoke were inhaled. Lungs feel full of smoke. Paralysis of lungs in elderly
people.
Male - Enlarged prostate gland. Flabby genitals. Genitals feel numb. Indurated testicles. Small retracted
testicles. Impo- tency. Premature emissions. Diminished desire. Erections when riding. Erections only in
morning before rising. Falling asleep during sex. Painful nodes in breast in old fat men. Moisture and soreness
between scrotum and thighs. Sweats about scrotum.
Modalities - Better walking in open air. Better cold food. Better warm wraps, warm atmosphere. Better when
alone, standing. Worse while thinking of symptoms. Worse company. Worse mental exertion, emotions.
Worse raising arms. Worse sitting. Worse lying on painful side. Worse left side. Worse from cold air, cold
damp. Worse cold exposure to feet and head. Worse washing. Worse odors. Worse warm food and after
eating. Worse supressed foot sweat. Headache is worse from heat of sun or being near a warm stove.
Mouth - Mouth feels numb. Sour, bitter taste. Whole mouth filled with vesicles, especially inside the cheek.
Saliva runs put, while asleep. Dribbling of saliva at dawn. Fetor oris, unnoticed by himself. Awakes with dry
mouth. Sudden accumulation of water in mouth.Much tough mucus in mouth.
Nose - Dry, sneezing, worse blowing it. Coryza with swelling of upper lip and nose. Coryza worse mornings.
Tip and edges of nose are painful. Sensation of smoke in nose. Discharge of thick, yellow mucus. Frequent
nosebleeds. Nosebleeds before menses. Scabs around wings of nose. Smell sensitive.
Perspiration - Sweats on single parts, one hand, one foot, Sweats on one side of body, face. Fetid foot
sweats. Stinking sweat of feet. Worse supressedfoot sweat. Debilitating at night.
Rectum - Burning in anus and rectum during stool. Crawling in rectum. Ascarides. Hemorrhoids protrude while
urinating. Shooting pain in hemorrhoids. Constipation with hard, knotty stools. Diarrhea with lumbar ache.
Diarrhea, with bloody mucus. Anus sore and moist. Oozing at anus. Anus as if excoriated.
Skin - Acne. Lipomas. Cysts. Whitlows. Intolerable itching and tingling over the whole body at night. Sensation
like the pricks of burning needles, itching and crawling sensations. Burning sarcoma. Excoriation and oozing
in several parts of the skin. Injuries in the skin heal with difficulty. Swelling and induration of the glands. Warts.
Sleep - Sleepy and can't sleep. Sleepiness in the daytime. Sleepiness and weariness on slightest exertion.
Talking in sleep, awakens frequently, feels too hot. Twitching during sleep. Sleep, agitated. Frequent waking
and anxious dreams. Almost constant dreaming, causes anxiety at night.
Stomach - Sensitivity of stomach. Spasms of esophagus as soon as food enters esophagus, causes gagging
 and choking (Merc-c., Graph.). Pain and weight immediately after a meal with epigastric
Baryta carbónica tenderness (Kali-c.). Pain while fasting and after eating. Sore spot in stomach. Weak
digestion of old people with possible malignancy, better cold food. Dyspepsia of young masturbators or with
seminal emissions. Long-lasting nausea. Morning sickness and vomiting. Vomiting fluid, water and chalk,
followed by prostration. Waterbrash, hiccough and eructation, which relieves pressure as of a stone.
Teeth - Rapid decay of teeth. Gums bleed and retract. Gums hurt when touched. Toothache with swelling of
gums. Toothache, worse before menses. Involuntary chattering of teeth. Fistula dentalis. Abscesses at roots.
Temperature - Strong disposition to chilliness. Chilliness relieved by external heat. Flushes of heat, more at
night.
Throat - Submaxillary glands and tonsils swollen. Takes cold easily with stitches and smarting pain.
Tonsils inflamed with swollen veins. Suppurating tonsils from every cold. Enlarged tonsils. Quinsy.
Smarting pain when swallowing, worse empty swallowing. Feeling of a plug in pharynx. Tendency to
tonsillitis. Can swallow liquids only. Sudden waterbrash. Sore throat with salivation. Throat troubles from over
use of voice. Stinging pain in tonsils, pharynx or larynx. Submaxillary gland swollen. Much burning in throat.
Chronic torticollis.
Tongue - Tongue, weak, hard, cannot speak. Paralysis of tongue. Smarting, burning, in tip of tongue. Burning
soreness or vesicles on tip or under the tongue. Tongue as if swollen, with dryness, early in morning. Tip of
tongue cracked and sore. As if blisters were on side of tongue.
Vertigo - Vertigo with confusion, in morning. Vertigo when standing in the sun, sharp pain extending through
head. Vertigo of elderly people. Vertigo with nausea, worse stooping. Vertigo when lifting arms up.
Vision - Amblyopia. Gauze before eyes. Fiery sparks before eyes in dark. Sparks before eyes in dark. Diplopia.
Weakness of sight caused by old age. Flying webs and black spots. Optical illusions, gener-
ally in bright colors. Sees everything as in a fog when closing eyes and pressing balls. Sees a cloud before left
eye. Weak vision, worse during day, evening. Weak vision in candlelight
COMMENTS - A paralytic condition runs throughout the pathogenesis. There is paralysis of mind and body.
Mistrust, lack of self-confidence, aversion to strangers. The child does not want to play.
Deficient memory. Children cannot remember and learn. Sensation as if the brain is loose.
Vertigo with nausea from stooping, or when lifting arms up in old people. Pressure and sticking in brain at
vertex, on waking.
Rough, dry and herpetic eruptions on the face. Dark redness. Tension of whole face as if egg white had dried
on it, as if a cobweb (Bar-acet.), over face, temples and scalp. Painful swelling of parotid and of submaxillary
glands. The sense of smell is very acute, may have an illusion of the smell of pine smoke. Nosebleed before
menses. The tongue is paralyzed. Salivation, saliva runs out during sleep.
The digestion is weak after eating. Pressing in the stomach, pain in hard, swollen abdomen. Stomach feels
sore while eating, it feels as if the food had to force its way through some raw place.
The anus is sore and humid. Hemorrhoids protrude with urination as well as stool. Constipation with hard,
knotty stools, hemorrhoids, burning and soreness. The paralytic condition appears in the sexual organs.
Soreness and moistening between scrotum and thighs. Impotence. Enlarged prostate.
Paralytic condition of the respiratory organs. Feeling in the larynx as if inspiring smoke or pitch. Hoarseness
and loss of voice from cough, mucus in larynx and trachea. Suffocating catarrh and paralysis of lungs in old
people. Sensation as if lungs are full of smoke.
There is a spasmodic cough, like whooping cough, from roughness and tickling in the throat and the pit of
stomach. Cough is worse evening until midnight. Worse after
getting feet cold, exercise, lying left side, cold air, thinking of it.
Palpitations with soreness of heart, worse lying on left side, worse thinking of it. Violent, long-lasting palpitation
felt in head. Palpitations worse on exertion. Slightest exertion makes him feel tired and sleepy. Aneurysm and
atheroma.
Marked pulsation in the back. Stiffness and tension in small of back in the evening, especially while sitting,
allowing one to neither rise nor bend backwards. Painfulness of arms and swelling of axillary glands. Cold feet.
Fetid perspiration of feet. Corns with burning and stinging. Burning and drawing pains are frequent in
lowerlimbs. Tearing in limbs with chilliness. Tension and shortening of muscles
Intolerable irritation all over like prickings and tingling, waking him at night. Itching, sore and humid skins.
Warts. General soreness and sensitiveness. Small wounds ulcerate and get very sore. Offensive sweat of one
side (mostly the left). Cold, clammy feet (Calc.). Chilliness predominates. Left side much affected. After eating,
so weak cannot raise his hands. Too weak to masticate.
Down's syndrome, delayed development. Slow learning, slow speech, slow walking and coordination,
delayed dentition. Difficulty making connections between words and objects, communication problems. Weak
 long-term memory, forgetfulness, poor attention span. Simian fold, a straight line across the palms.
Retarded development of growth, or of a specific organ. Stimulates the growth hormone (Pituin. 6x) if child is
still growing. Also for pituitary tumors. Growth could be stopped by trauma, vaccination, or shock. Delayed
development of the genitalia, especially the ovaries and the testicles. Undescended testicles (Aur., Clem.).
Very shy, gentle, and docile. They have very poor self-confidence. Inability to make decisions. The Bar-c
constitution has floppy hands and feet, and giggling, spacey eyes. Simple mindedness. Symptoms of autism,
dreamy. Never leave childish state, dependent.
Dumbfounded look on their face, clumsy, dull. Can have night terrors (Calc.).
Post-apoplectic in the elderly, when they revert to a childhood-like states. They become very shy and sensitive
and can't make decisions. Also from epilepsy or head injury. Elderly have poor memory and indecision, some
of the symptoms of Alzheimer's. Premature senility. Can have high blood pressure, swollen glands. Hormonal
problems which age them quickly. Both the elderly and children need a specific routine, structure, to be happy.
Children can have recurring tonsillitis (Bar-m.). Tendencies to colds, with swollen glands. A lot of adenoid
problems. Can have skin problems. Chilly. Can get emaciation easily, especially after infections. Lymphatic
problems with a history of glandular problems. They have an enlarged abdomen (Sil., Calc., Sanie.). Offensive
foot sweats (Sil., Nit-ac., Graph., Calc.).
Clarke cured an advanced case of thoracic aneurysm with the 3x. A case has been recorded in which Bar-c.
removed from an old man a pain that came suddenly in the hollow of the knee and ran down the back of the
leg like a thin stream of hot fluid or molten metal running down under the skin.
RELATIONS - Antidote for poisonous doses: Epsom salts. Antidoted by: Ant-t„ Bell., Camph., Dulc., Merc.,
Zinc. Compare: (1) Dig., Rad-br.. Arag., Oxyt., Astrag. Alum. (2) Ant-t. - paralysis of lungs. (3) Bell., Calc. -
scrofulosis, coryza, etc. Calc-i. - large tonsils, Caust. - paralysis, Cham., Chin. (4) Con. - old people, Dulc. -
catching cold, Fl-ac. - old people, lod. - glands, Lach., Lyc. (tonsils). (5) Mag-c., Merc, -colds, glands, diarrhea,
Nat-c., Phos., Puls., Sep. (tinea), (6) Sil. - glands, fetid foot sweat, but Bar-c. lacks the head-sweat of Sil. and
Sil. has self-will instead of the weak-mindedness of Bar-c. (7) Sulph., Tell. Compatible: after Scilla. Ars. Before
and after Sulph. Complementary: Dulc., Silica, Psor. Incompatible: Calc.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Mur- phy-

name: Baryta Iodata
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bar-i. Baryta iodata. Baric iodide. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Breast, cancer. Cancer. Glands, enlargement. Indurated, glands. Leucocytosis. Ophthalmia.
Quinsy. Tumors.
HOMEOPATHIC - Bar-i. has been used empirically, especially in cases of glandular enlargement and new
growths. The indications are suggested by its two elements. This remedy is used clinically for enlarged and
indurated glands especially the tonsils and breasts.
Bar-i. has been used in breast cancer, breast tumors, breast cancer after trauma (Arn., Bell-p., Calen., Con.).
Tumors and cancers following blows or other injuries (Con.), cuts, punctured wounds, or abrasions.
Acts on the lymphatic system, increased leucocytosis. Quinsy. Strumous ophthalmia with tumefaction of
cervical glands and stunted growth.
Modalities - Better from cold open air. Worse from walking.
COMMENTS - Grimmer noted that Bar-i. has been used for breast cancer, breast tumors and
eniargedglands.Breastcancersaftertrauma. Tumors and cancers following blows or other injuries, cuts
punctured wounds, abrasions. Indications are from the provings of the two remedies making up the compound.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Aeon, lycotonum - swelling of cervical, axillary and breast glands. (2) Lapis,
Con. Merc., lod., Carb-an.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Grimmer.

name: Baryta Muriatica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bar-m. Baryta muriatica. Barium chloride. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL -Aneurysm. Anus, abscess. Arteriosclerosis. Asthma. Bronchial, disorders. Convulsions.
Deafness. Dyspepsia. Fistula. Glandular, swellings. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Headache. Hypertension. Idiocy.
Influenza. Leucorrhea. Mania Mumps. Multiple sclerosis. Nymphomania. Otorrhea. Pancreas, induration.
Pancreatitis. Paralysis. Paresis. Quinsy. Scrofula. Infertility. Testicles, disorders. Tinea capitis. Tinnitus.
Tonsillitis. Tumors. Vertigo.
HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of Bar-m. are like those of the other Barium salts, but it
 hasadistinctcharacterofitsown. Convulsions are more marked in the muriate. Many cases of aneurysm have
been benefited by Bar-m. Both elements have a strong action on the heart and arteries. It has cured whizzing
and buzzing in ears, noises on chewing and swallowing.
In one poisoning case, that of a girl, the instant she swallowed the solution she exclaimed that she was on fire;
vomitings, convulsions, pain in the head and complete deafness supervened and death in an hour.
Bar-m. causes vascular degeneration, causing hypertension when high systolic pressure with a comparatively
low diastolic is present with cerebral and cardiac symptoms. Arteriosclerosis (Aur., Sec.), and cerebral
disorders due to this condition. Increased tension of pulse. Vertigo, due to cerebral anemia and noises in ears.
Acts on the lower digestive tract, especially rectum, on muscles and joints, giving stiffness and weakness as
from walking too much. Indurated and narrowing of the cardiac orifice with pain, immediately after eating,
and epigastric tenderness.
Multiple sclerosis of brain and cord. Voluntary muscular power gone but perfectly sensible. Paresis after
influenza and diphtheria. Icy coldness of body with paralysis.
Convulsions. Convulsive attacks occur periodically with starting and excessive tossing about. Electric shocks
with convulsions.
General feeling of lassitude in the morning, especially weakness of the legs with muscular stiffness. Great
weakness, wants to lie down. Enlargement of the glands and induration tonsils, pancreas. Chronic hypertrophy
of the tonsils.
Nymphomania and satyriasis. In every form of mania when the sexual desire is increased. Children who go
around with their mouth open and who talk through the nose. Child lies on the abdomen all the time to shun
the light. Stupid appearing, hard of hearing. Headaches, but without acute crisis, occurring in old people,
heaviness rather than pain.
MIND - Answers confusedly as if thinking of something else. Anxiety in evening. Irresolution. Sense of
oppressive anxiety. Sadness in morning. Dejection and dread of men. Suspicious. Talking in sleep. Sexual
mania in every form when sexual desire is increased.
Dullness of mind. Stupid appearance. Idiocy. Startles easily. Children are inattentive when studying, sit in
corners and give confused answers. Indisposition to play in children.
Abdomen - Distressing throbbing in abdomen (Sei.). Induration of pancreas. Abdominal aneurysm. Inguinal
glands swollen.
Back - Enlargement and induration of cervical glands. Pains in the back. Eruption at the nape of the neck.
Chest - Catarrh with heat. Heat in the upper part of the chest. Oppression.
Constitutions - Useful in old age and childhood, when mental and physical dwarfishness is present (Bar-c.).
Acts on parotid glands and pancreas. Suited to scrofulous children. Attacks of tonsillitis occurring in spring and
autumn.
Ears - Earache, better sipping cold water. Offensive otorrhea. Inflates middle ear on blowing nose. Hard of
hearing. Noises on chewing and swallowing or sneezing. Whizzing and buzzing.
Eyes - Eyes fixed and immovable. Pupils
dilated and insensible, with fixed look. Blennorrheal of the eyes, of the ears, and of the nose. Shuns light, child
lies all the time on its face.
Face - Pulling pains in the muscles of the face. Painful nodosity at the point of the nose with slight pricking.
Parotids swollen.
Female - Induration of ovaries. Tumor or atrophy of ovaries. Infertility. Menses too early. Pains as from a
bruise, in the pelvis. Leucorrhea. Nymphomania.
Food - Loss of appetite. Thirst.
Head - Headache with vomiting. Heaviness of head in elderly people. Very purulent eruptions on the scalp.
Scabby eruptions on the head and neck.
Heart - Throbbing of the heart accelerated. Palpitation of the heart. Irregular heartbeats, pulse scarcely
perceptible.
Kidneys - Great increase in uric acid, diminution of chlorides. Frequent, involuntary, and painful urine. Very
offensive urine, yellowish, with whitish sediment.
Limbs - Toes cramp up, better drawing up the limbs. Fatigue of legs as from long walk with stiffness of joints.
Lungs - Weak voice. Dry cough. Great accumulation and rattling of mucus with difficult expectoration.
Facilitates expectoration. Senile asthma. Bronchial disorders of elderly people with cardiac dilation.
Chronic cough of scrofulous children.
Male - Frequent emission of semen. Swelling of the testes. Buboes after suppressed gonorrhea.
Mouth - Swelling of the salivary glands and palate. Tongue loaded. Tongue and mouth dry. Fetor of the mouth,
as if from mercury. Putrid taste in the mouth, also of food.
 Nose - Coryza. Sneezing in sleep without waking.
Perspiration - Increased perspiration. Cold sweat.
Rectum - Spasmodic pain in rectum. Feces slimy, jelly-like with blood. Stools white, hard as stones. Easy
evacuation. Chronic, painless diarrhea or diarrhea with violent colic.
Skin - Burning and pricking in excoriated places. Small, itchy eruptions on the head, nape of the neck,
abdomen, and thighs. Glands are inflamed and ulcerated. Hemorrhage.
Stomach - Burning pain in the stomach. Sensation of heat, ascending from the stomach to the chest and head.
Gone feeling at epigastrium. Retching and vomiting. Vomiting in the morning, with anxiety. Vomiting of a
small quantity of water, with nausea.
Temperature - General dry heat, night and day. Redness and heat of the face. Pulse frequent and full. Tertian
fever.
Throat - Suppuration of tonsils after every cold. Swallowing difficult. Tonsillitis. Tonsils enlarged and
infected. Uvula elongated. Paresis of pharynx and Eustachian tubes with sneezing and noises. Throat feels
too wide open. Varicose veins of throat.
Vertigo - Vertigo due to cerebral anemia and noises in the ears. Vertigo, swimming before the eyes, things
turnaround. Head confused and heavy.
COMMENTS - Periodical attacks of convulsions with excessive excitement of the limbs. Idiocy. Mania with
increase of sexual desire, “in every form of mania as soon as the sexual desire is increased.” Offensive
otorrhea. Parotid glands hard and swollen, especially right. Earache is better by sipping cold water. Deafness.
Great salivation and odor from mouth as from mercurialization. Swelling of salivary glands. Disposition to
tonsillitis. Great indigestion. A hardness below the stomach to left, from which paroxysms of dyspnea come.
Induration of pancreas. Distressing throbbing in abdomen with abdominal aneurysm.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) In sclerotic degenerations, especially of spinal cord, liver and heart. Plb. met.
and Plb-i. (2) Aur-m. (3) Con. - indurations of abdominal glands. (4) lod., Kali-i. and Iris (pancreas). Sei. (pulsa-
tions in abdomen). (5) Useful after Ars. in extravasations of blood. (6) The vomiting is antidoted by Absinthe.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Baryta Sulphurica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bar-s. Baryta sulphurica. Barium sulphide. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Arteriosclerosis. Cancer. Dementia. Emaciation. Glands, swelling. Growth, disorders. Headaches.
Hemorrhoids. Leucorrhea. Tonsilitis. Varicose veins. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Arteriosclerosis. Pressing pains. Weakness. Emaciation. Dwarf growth. Swelling of glands.
Cancer of the glands. Tonsils swollen and inflamed. Pain in heart, radiating to throat. Varicose veins.
MIND - Dementia. Idiocy. Retarded development. Very anxious, especially duringfever. Suspicious. Timidity,
bashful. Anxiety. Fear of people. Cowardice. Anthropophobia. Always in a hurry. Loss of willpower. Marked
irritability.
Ears - Roaring in ears. Hearing impaired.
Eyes - Eyes worse light. Vision dim on exertion of eyes.
Female - Leucorrhea copious, smarting.
Food - Cannot bear hunger. Craving for salt, sour, pickles. Desires sweets and chocolate.
Head - Itching of scalp. Headaches. Pain in sides of head. Throbbing in the occiput or in whole head.
Limbs - Corns sore, sting, burning, painful. Small warts, stinging pain.
Modalities - Desire for and better open air. Better walking in open air. Worse morning. Worse forenoon, night.
Worse hearty meals. Worse bathing. Worse before and during menses. Worse lying on left side.
Nose - Nose dry, internally.
Rectum - External hemorrhoids. Constant moisture at anus.
Sleep - Restlessness sleep.
Stomach - Pressing in stomach after eating.
REFERENCES - Murphy.

name: B.C.G.
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - beg. B.C.G. Myobacterium tuberculosis vaccine. Tuberculosis bovine vaccine. Nosodes.
Vaccinations. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Abscess. Adenitis. Anorexia. Asthma. Blepharitis. Bronchitis. Catarrh. Chilliness. Colds.
Conjunctivitis. Cystitis. Dysthyroidism. Dysuria. Eczema. Emaciation. Eosinophilia. Erythema, nodosum.
 Fatigue. Gland, disorders. Granulomas. Hematuria. Hypersensitive. Hyperthyroid. Hypochondriasis.
Hypotension. Ichthyosis. Incontinence. Insomnia. Keratitis. Leukocytosis. Lung, disorders. Lupus, vulgaris.
Lymphadenitis. Lymphogranulomatosis. Malaise. Melancholy. Nausea. Nocturia. Osteomyelitis. Peritonitis.
Pleuritis. Pleurodynia. Pneumonia. Pulmonary, granulomas. Sore, throat. Tonsillitis. Tuberculosis. Tumors,
benign. Urticaria. Vaccinations. Vertigo. Vomiting. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - BCG, or Bacille Calmette-Guérin, is a vaccine for tuberculosis. BCG is used in many
countries with a high prevalence of TB to prevent childhood tuberculous meningitis and miliary disease.
However, BCG is not generally recommended for use in some countries because of the low risk of infection
with Mycobacterium tuberculosis, the variable effectiveness of the vaccine against adult pulmonary TB, and
the vaccine's potential interference with tuberculin skin test reactivity.
Leukocytosis. Eosinophilia. Lymphadenitis. Lymphogranulomatosis. Inflammation of glands, adenitis.
Tuberculosis of glands. Dysthyroidism with tendency to hyperthyroidism. Benign tumors. Hypotension.
Malaise. Emaciation. Lack of vital heat. Weakness and exhaustion. Tendency to take colds. Intoxication.
Tobacco, aversion to .smoking his accustomed cigar. Ill effects after vaccinations.
MIND - Mental excitability. Exaggerated caresand worries. Sensitive, oversensitive. Restlessness and
nervousness. Prostration of mind, mental exhaustion, brain fag. Dull-
ness, sluggishness, difficulty of thinking and comprehending. Memory weakness. Loss of memory.
Easily irritated, angered, depressed. Any noise annoys him. Hypochondriasis. Anxiety, vertigo, feeling that
death is imminent. Presentiment of death. Depressive psychoneurosis. Sadness, despondency. Melancholy.
Abdomen - Abdominal pain. Peritonitis, enteritis. Colitis. Cramping, griping pain. Stitching, sticking, pains.
Back - Backache.
Bladder - Cystitis. Dysuria. Hematuria.
Paralysis of the bladder. Incontinence. Nocturia.
Chest - Pleurodynia. Chest pains. Oppression of the chest, sternum.
Constitution - Constitutional emaciation, especially in tubercular types. Phosphoric or carbo-phosphoric
types. Hypersensitive, nervous, uneasy, restless.
Coughs - Dry cough. Exhausting cough.
Hacking cough. Hoarse cough. Whooping cough.
Ears - Stitching pains, worse left.
Eyes - Catarrh. Blepharitis. Conjunctivitis.
Interstitial keratitis. Swelling, eczema on the eyelids.
Face - Discoloration pale. Dry lips. Pain in left cheekbones, worse chewing.
Female - Diminished sexual desire.
Food - Anorexia. Wanting appetite. Appetite increased, hunger in general.
Head - Brain feels dull. Headache in school children, students, and over-worked intellectuals. Headaches with
disturbed sleep. Sensitive scalp. Heaviness sensation.
Heart - Oppression of heart. Palpitations.
Limbs - Joint pains, worse in small joints.
Cramps in toes, lower limbs.
Liver - Stitching, sticking pains, worse lying down.
Lungs - Asthma in children. Bronchitis. Pneumonia. Pleuritis. Pulmonary granulomas. Pulmonary infections.
Male - Diminished sexual desire.
Modalities - Better from cold application.
Better lying down. Better after eating. Worse from physical or mental exertion. Worse evening. Worse 6 p.m.
to 9 p.m.
Worse 9 p.m. to 5 a.m.
Mouth - Cracks in corners of mouth. Bitter, pasty taste.
Neck - Inflammation of lymphatic tissue. Neck pain, bettermotion. Pain in cervical region on turning head to
right.
Nose - Icy coldness. Dryness inside. Sneezing. Prolonged, chronic coryza. Chronic rhinitis. Nasal obstruction,
better open air, worse in a room. Polyps.
Rectum - Constipation. Rectal, anal fissures.
Skin - Dry skin, with fissures. Scaly skin, ichthyosis. Abscess with recurrent discharge. Granulomas. Lupus
vulgaris. Histiocytoma. Hidradenoma. Urticaria. Erythema nodosum. Erythema multiforme. Red papules.
Sleep - Sleeplessness after midnight. Insomnia in school children. Sleep di sturbed by dreams. Restless
sleep.
Stomach - Slow digestion. Stomach distension. Nausea, worse in the morning, on and after rising, better after
 eating. Retching, gagging with distention. Vomiting.
Temperature - Chills. Fever. Flu-like symptoms.
Throat - Sore throat. Tonsillitis. Pain in tonsils on swallowing, worse right. Scraping.
Tongue - Coated, discolored yellow, white tongue. Bitter, pasty taste.
Vertigo - Vertigo, feeling that death is imminent. Dizziness.
COMMENTS - Made from a stock of Myobacterium tuberculosis of the bovine variety. The vaccinating mother-
stock suspension of the homeopathic attenuations is made from a film of this bacillus, cultivated on a
background of Santon fluid.
A Hahnemannian Proving was conducted by O. A. Julian in 1960-61 on six provers, using the 5c, 7c, and 9c
(1977). Symptoms included extreme fatigue, persistent asthenia, and a heavy head, with diffuse pain in the
occipital region. Head dull, face pale. Dry skin, with fissures.
Dry, tiring cough. Pleurodynia. Frequent head colds, eyes red, earache. Glandular infections. Extreme
chilliness. Chilly, cannot bear noise, headaches, with disturbed sleep.
Rare fever, lasting only a short time.
Anorexia, persistent nausea. Tubercular conditions in thin types, always tired, and with chronic constipation.
Asthenic, thin, hypersensitive, constipated type. Aversion to cigarettes.
Julian noted “in clinical practice, B.C.G. is shown to be a polycrest, and has a definite value in all para-
tubercular and psychosomatic cases. It is worthy of replacing the nosode Marmoreck.”
RELATIONS - Compare: Tub., Bac., Phos.
REFERENCES - Julian. Murphy.
keynote:
PHARMACY - beg. B.C.G. Myobacterium tuberculosis vaccine. Tuberculosis bovine vaccine. Nosodes.
Vaccinations. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Abscess. Adenitis. Anorexia. Asthma. Blepharitis. Bronchitis. Catarrh. Chilliness. Colds.
Conjunctivitis. Cystitis. Dysthyroidism. Dysuria. Eczema. Emaciation. Eosinophilia. Erythema, nodosum.
 Fatigue. Gland, disorders. Granulomas. Hematuria. Hypersensitive. Hyperthyroid. Hypochondriasis.
Hypotension. Ichthyosis. Incontinence. Insomnia. Keratit

name: Beech
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - beech-b. Beech. Fagus syl- vatica. The remedy is prepared by the boiling method. Small twigs
and male and female flowers, they are found on the same tree, are boiled for half an hour. The boiled water is
strained and used as medicine. Historical dose: Take two drops from the stock bottle into a one ounce dropper
bottle, (add brandy or alcohol, if this bottle will be used for days or weeks). This is the dosage bottle, take a
few drops straight into the mouth or as needed in a little water or juice.
HOMEOPATHIC - Together with the remedies Rock Water, Vine, Vervain and Chicory, this remedy belongs
to Bach's group of Over-care for Others' Welfare. These five remedies deal with attitudes of control and over-
care towards others.
People in need of Beech may appear haughty and rigid in body posture, in some cases, frequently raised
eyebrows can be observed. Faultfinding, criticism and intolerance are predominant traits. The attitude may
also be less condescending, more nagging and dissatisfied.
In the treatment of persecutory delusions or paranoid personality disorders, Beech lessens the tendency to
overly criticize others and fit them into a specific image with threatening features (Holly-b., Will-b.).
MIND - Bach described the indications for the remedy, “The mind is narrowed in perception, tolerance andj
udgment, although one believes
oneself to have the right attitude and capacity for assessment. This results in self-deception. The ego raises
itself above others with the selfappointed right to assume critical judgment on another's expression of life. It is
a state of arrogance, an attempt to impress upon others one's own standards of assessment considered
special or perfect.
“Judging others creates superiority and those criticized are held low, condescended against. Oftentimes, one
actually does not want them.to measure up to one's own perfect style, so that one may continue to consider
oneself special. The mind does not want others to move up in standard and it gives more personal satisfaction
to keep them in their place.
“There is often an underlying sadness, a personal loss of a more perfect reality that is mourned. To have
personal perfect standards and finding reality wanting implies a loss, a sense of being let down. In many cases,
if grief was not allowed to be fully worked through there may develop a Beech state. The event or person is
criticized or rejected, instead of mourned.”
REFERENCES Bach.
