name: Belladonna
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bell. Belladonna. Deadly Nightshade. Atropa belladonna. N. O. Solanaceae. Europe. Greece,
Italy, Britain. Tincture of whole plant when beginning to flower. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Abscess, Acne. Airsickness. Amaurosis. Bladder weakness. Boils. Brain disorders. Bronchial
 glands, disease. Carbuncle. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions. Cough. Croup. Delirium. Dehisions. Diarrhea.
Diplopia. Dysentery. Ear, disorders. Epilepsy. Erysipelas. Eye, disorders. Exophthalmic, goiter. Fevers.
Glandular, swellings. Goiter. Gout. Hallucinations. Hemorrhoids. Headaches. Heart, disorders. High, fevers.
Hydrocephalus. Hydrophobia. Hyperemia. Infections. Influenza. Intestinal fever. Kidney disorders. Lung,
disorders. Mania. Mastitis. Measles. Meningitis. Menses. Mumps. Otitis media. Neuralgia. Nymphomania.
Paralysis.
Peritonitis. Phlegmasia alba dolens. Photophobia. Pleurisy. Pneumonia. Pregnancy, disorders. Puerperal
mania. Rabies. Rheumatism. Rheumatic, fever. Roseola. Scarlet fever. Sleep, disorders. Strangury.
Strokes. Throbbing, pains. Throat, sore. Tongue disorders. Tonsillitis. Tuberculosis. .Ulcers. Uterine
disorders. Vaccinations. Vertigo.
Whooping cough. Worm fever.
HOMEOPATHIC - Bell, acts upon brain and nerve centers, producing twitching, convulsions and pain.
Produces an active congestion, furious excitement, perverted special senses. Glands swollen, tender, red.
Marked action on the vascular system, skin and glands.
Hot, red face, semi-stupor, every little while starting or jumping in sleep as if it might go into convulsions.
Excited mental state, hyperesthesia of all senses, delirium, restless sleep. Spasms, shocks, jerks and
twitching. Constrictions occur in parts of the body like throat, vagina etc. or in ^ whole body.
Fullness, congestion especially to head, and swelling. Pains are throbbing, sharp, cutting, shooting or
clawing of maddening severity, coming and going in repeated attacks. Severe neuralgic pain, that come and
go suddenly (Oxyt.).
Violent attacks and sudden of onset. Complaints come suddenly. Hot, red skin, flushed face, dilated
pupils, throbbing carotids. Marked burning heat, bright redness and dryness. Red streaks. Hot body,
part, etc. Discharges are hot and scanty. Hot hemorrhages.
Convulsive movements. Epileptic attacks are followed by nausea and vomiting. Spasms are followed by
prolonged unconsciousness. Throws the body forwards and backwards, chorea. Convulsions commence in
the arm.
Scarlet fever, also as a prophylactic. Exophthalmic goiter with extreme thyroid toxemia. Sensitive to light,
noise, jarring. Dry mouth and throat with aversion to water. No thirst. Hydrophobia.
Right sided symptoms. Good for children (Cham.).
MIND - Acuteness of all senses. Overactive mind. Changeable moods. Quarrelsome. Constant moaning.
Disinclined to talk. Memory impaired. Forgets in a moment what he was about to do. Mental confusion, worse
motion. Mind disordered so that speech didn't correspond to thought. Mistrustful. Hides things.
Anxious and confused. Fears she is about to die. Fear of imaginary animals. Fright, with weeping. Starts in
fright at approach of others. . Fear of dogs. Anxiety during menses. Anxiety during sleep.
Stupefaction with congestion to head and dilated pupils. Hypochondriac depression. Consolation aggravates.
Sadness, with indifference. Suicidal disposition while walking in open air. Weary of life, with desire to drown
herself. Rather desires death than fears it. Weeping and screaming, worse consolation. Loss of consciousness.
Wildly delirious. Delirium, furious, rages, bites, strikes. Rage, doesn't know his relatives. Delirium wants to
escape or hide himself. Delirium, better after sleep. Rage during headache. Restlessness during headache.
Delirium with quick movements. Delirium with springing out of bed.
Violent delirium with livid face, injected and protruding eyes, dilated pupils, strong pulsation in carotids, full,
hard, frequent pulse and inability to swallow. Imagines himself dreaming when awake. Carpholo- gia, picking
at bedclothes as if looking for something lost, with confused muttering. Hands constantly in motion, tries to
catch things in air.
Desire to escape or hide himself. Mania, rages, bites, strikes. Very restless. Spits on faces of other people.
Tendency to dance, laugh, sing, whistle. Plays antics. Excitable, easily weeps. Disposed to tear things to
pieces. Hydrophobia. Abhorrence of liquids. Liquid poured out makes her furious.
Delirium, sees frightful images. Fear of imaginary things, wants to run away from them. Delusions,
hallucinations, sees monsters, hideous faces. Imagines he sees ghosts, hideous faces and various insects.
Horrible visions in the dark.
Visions of fire. Sees black animals, dogs, wolves, etc. Sees faces on closing eyes. Praying. Rage leading to
violent deeds. Insanity with increased strength.
Abdomen - Flatulent colic. Distended, hot abdomen. Extren-- sensitiveness to touch, bedclothes, etc.
(Lach.). Cramps and colic, as if a hand has clutched some parts. Colic pains, comes quickly and goes
quickly. Bearing down in abdomen as if all the viscera would protrude through genitals. Tender, swollen
abdomen. Transverse colon distends and protrudes during abdominal colic. Colic from gall-stones. Cutting
pain in epigastrium, better bending backwards. Cutting pain across, stitches in left side of abdomen, when
 coughing, sneezing or touching it. Clawing pain around the navel. Incarcerated hernia. Itching on abdomen.
Pain in splenic region, worse sneezing, coughing, touch.
Back - Back feels broken. As if lumbar region would break. Pressure on dorsal region, most painful. Lumbago
with pain in hips and thighs. Curvature of lumbar vertebrae. Hyperemia of spine, with difficulty in walking. Pain
in sacrum. Swelling of glands of neck. Sour smelling sweat only on neck. Stiff neck and shoulder (right).
Pain in nape, as if it would break.
Bladder - Cystitis. Retention of urine with paralysis of bladder. Postpartum retention of urine. Sensation of
motion in bladder as of a worm. Bladder region is sensitive. Dull pressing pain in bladder during night. Shooting
pain in bladder when moving. Incontinence, continuous dripping.
Breasts - Breasts feel heavy, hard and red. Mastitis with throbbing, redness. Red streaks radiate from
nipple. Tumors of breast, pain worse lying down. Discharge of milk from women not pregnant. Erysipelatous
inflammation of breasts, worse from weaning.
Causations - Ill effects of hair cutting, head getting wet. Sausages. Sunstroke. Walking in the wind -or a draft.
Chest - Burning pain in right chest. Pressi ve pains in chest. Sharp pain in chest when coughing. Constrictio i
across chest, as if pressed inwards from both sides. Heat
in sternum. Corroding, gnawing, beneath cartilages of last ribs, right side. Swelling of axillary glands. Eruption
of scarlatina begins on throat and chest.
Constitutions - Suited to plethoric persons with red face and to conditions where there is local plethora,
inflammatory states with pain, throbbing, shiny redness as in acute gout. Suited to the bilious, lymphatic tem-
perament. Light hair and complexion, blue eyes. It grows in dry limestone soils and is the acute correlative of
Calc. Its influence is felt more in intelligent and plethoric persons who are jovial and entertaining when well,
but violent when sick, therefore a great children's remedy.
Cough - Barking cough, whooping cough with pain in stomach before attack, with expectoration of blood.
Tickling, short, dry cough, worse at night. Cough, worse fine dust in air, yawning. Cough with pain in left
hip. Stitches in chest when coughing. Child cries before cough. Cough with stiffening of body. Tickling, short,
dry, worse night. Dry, barking cough, sometimes spasmodic, caused by scraping or pain in larynx. Violent
cough in sleep, with grinding of teeth.
Ears - Otitis media. Otorrhoea. Hematoma auris. Inflammatory swelling of ears. Hot, sensitive and painful
ears. Bulging and red eardrums. Child cries out in sleep, throbbing and beating pain deep in ear,
synchronous with heartbeat. Tearing pain in middle and external ear. Pain causes delirium. Earache worse
least noise. Parotid gland swollen. Acute conditions of eustachian tube. Noises in ears. Humming, roaring,
ringing noises. Hearing very acute. Intolerance of noises. Autophony, hearing one's voice in the ear. Impaired
hearing from taking cold. Deafness, as if a skin were drawn over ears.
Eyes - Pupils dilated. Throbbing deep in eyes on lying down. Eyes feel swollen and protruding. Staring,
brilliant, conjunctiva red, dry. Burning, shooting pain in eyes. Photophobia, worse artificial light.
Conjunctivitis, with great inflammation. Sensation as if eyes were half closed. Eyelids swollen, congested,
feel
sore. Squinting, spasms of lids. Everted lids. Fundus congested. Exophthalmus. Lachrymation like brine.
Ciliary neuralgia appearing and disappearing suddenly, with photophobia and congestion. Sudden ophthalmia.
Eyeballs in constant motion. Mydriasis, resulting from nervous headache. Inflammation of optic nerve and
retina. Strabismus. Yellow sclera. Ulcers or spots on cornea. Thickening of cornea.
Face - Becomes pale and red alternately. Red, hot, swollen and shining face. Face mottled, bluish red.
Swelling of upper lip. Facial neuralgia with twitching muscles and flushed face. Spasmodic distortion of mouth
(risus sardonicus). Convulsive motions of muscles of face. Lowerjaw, as if drawn backwards. Cutting, tearing
pain, worse right side. Parotid glands swollen. Pustules on face. Sweats only in face.
Female - Amenorrhea, with congestion to head. Menses bright red, too early, too profuse. Menses gushing.
Menses and lochia very offensive and hot. Ovarian pain with appearance of menses. Flow of blood between
periods. Dragging around loins. Painful menstrual cramps with bright red flow. Cutting pain from hip to hip.
Badly smelling hemorrhages. Hot gushes of blood. Metritis. Violent bearing down towards genitals, as if
everything would fall out, better standing and sitting erect, worse lying down. Spasmodic contractions of uterus.
Ovaritis. Leucorrhea, white mucus with colic. Bearing down pain with leucorrhea. Dryness and heat of vagina.
Rigidity of the cs. Labor pains come and go suddenly or ceasing. Diminished lochia. Afterpains, confinement.
Retained placenta. Hemorrhage after confinement or after miscarriage. Menopause with sudden hot flushes.
Food - Loss of appetite. Distaste for acids, coffee, beer. Aversion to meat and milk. Desire for lemonade or
lemons (which agree). Desire sour food, vegetables, sweets. Craving for undigestible things. Craving for snuff.
Beer causes internal heat. Desire for lemonade during headache. Headache from abuse of coffee.
Shortness of breath after drinking coffee. Bread tastes sour. Wine aggravates dyspnea. Great thirst for cold
 water. Dread of drinking, abhorrence of liquids. Drinks in sips. Thirst for water changed into thirst for beer.
Head - Rush of blood to head, pulsation of cerebral arteries, throbbing in brain. Congestive headaches with
a red face. Meningitis. Sunstroke. Vascular headaches. Throbbing, hammering headache, worse temples,
motion. Headache better letting hair down, laying the hand on head, bending head backwards. Much throbbing
and heat. Pain, fullness, especially in forehead, occiput and temples. Headache from suppressed catarrhal
flow. Sensitive to least contact. Sudden outcries. Headache, worse light, noise, jar, lying down and in
afternoon, better by pressure and sitting in a semi-erect posture. Headache worse on right side and when
lying down. Headache worse from having hair cut. Hydrocephalus with boring of head in the pillows, head
drawn backward and rolls from side to side. Head sensitive to drafts and cold or washing hair. Feeling in
the brain like swashing of water, rises and falls in waves. Cold sensation in head at the middle of the forehead.
Sinusitis, maxillary or frontal. Pulls her hair. Hair splits, is dry and comes out. Hematoma.
Heart - Heart seemed too large. Throbbing in carotid and temporal arteries. Throbbing all through body.
Bubbling at the region of the heart. Violent palpitations, reverberating in head with labored breathing.
Palpitations from least exertion. Gurgling at heart, when going up stairs. Pressure in cardiac region, arresting
breath and causing anxiety. Dichrotism. Rapid but weakened pulse. Pulse full, hard, tense. Pulse slow,
thready, irregular.
Kidneys - Stinging, burning pain from region of kidneys to bladder. Acute urinary infections. Involuntary
urination, on lying down or when standing or at night, when sleepy during day. Frequent and profuse
urination. Hematuria where no pathological condition can be found. Spasmodic, crampy pains along ureter,
during pas-
sage of kidney stones. Urine scanty with tenesmus. Urine dark and turbid. Urine loaded with phosphates.
Fiery red urine. Urine deep red, with white sediment. Urine turbid like yeast, with reddish sediment. Urine
copious, pale and watery.
Limbs - Joints swollen, red, shining with radiating red streaks. Jerks, spasms, or trembling in limbs. Cramping
pains of limbs. Spasms. Heaviness and paralytic feeling in limbs. Shifting rheumatic pains. Shooting pains
along limbs. Phlegmasia alba dolens. Cold limbs. Lies or sits with feet crossed, cannot uncross them.
Weakness and tottering gait. Involuntary limping. Violent convulsions, distortions of all muscles.
Liver - Acute pain in liver region, extending to shoulder and neck, worse lying on it. Gallstone colic. Jaundice
with stones in gall bladder.
Lungs - Asthma in hot, damp weather. Asthmatic attacks with sensation of dust in lungs. Difficult, short,
quickrespiration. Respiration oppressed, unequal. Cheyne- Stokes respiration (Cocain., Op.). Moaning at
every breath. Oppressed, quick, unequal breaths. Heavy and stertorous breathing. Dyspnea after rising in
morning, better open air. Bloody mucus, in morning, with bloody taste in mouth.
Male - Testicles hard, drawn up, inflamed. Weakness and relaxation of genitals. Nocturnal emissions with
relaxation of penis. Nocturnal sweat of genitals. Flow
• • of prostatic fluid. Prostatitis. Hypertrophy of prostate. Soft, painless tumor on glans. Drawing pain in
spermatic cord during urination. Increased sexual desire, with great inclination to masturbation. Diminished
desire.
Modalities - Better from light covering. Better wrapped up well in a warm room. Better bending backward,
semi-erect. Betterrestin bed. Better standing. Better from leaning head against something. Better bending or
turning the affected part. Worse from heat of sun. Worse if heated. Worse drafts on head. Worse getting hair
cut. Worse washing head. Worse after taking cold. Worse from light, noise. Worse jar
ring. Worse checked sweat. Worse touch. Worse company. Worse pressure. Worse motion. Worse from
hanging down affected part. Worse afternoon. Worse lying down. Worse looking at shining objects. Worse
running water. Worse morning, afternoon. Worse 3 p.m., 11 p.m. Worse after midnight. Worse night.
Mouth - Dry and hot. Mouth feels scalded. Hot breath. Taste salty, sour, bitter, pappy, offensive. Chewing or
sucking motions of the mouth. Scraping in mouth and throat. Mouth as if constricted. Soft palate bright red and
swollen. Thick whitish mucus in mouth and throat, with constant inclination to hawk and swallow. Lockjaw.
Stammering speech. Hemorrhage from mouth and nose. Salivation worse lying down. Increased flow of saliva.
Nose - Drying in nose, fauces, larynx and trachea. Red and swollen. Tip of nose, shining red and burning.
Tingling in tip of nose. Nosebleeds with red face. Coryza, mucus mixed with blood. Fluent coryza from one
nostril only. Frequent sneezing with tickling in nostrils. Imaginary odors. Offensive smell in nose as from herring
brine or sour beer. Odor of tobacco intolerable. Nostrils and corners of lips ulcerated.
Perspiration - Hot sweat. Sweats on covered parts. Perspiration, dry only on head. All over, dry only on head.
Perspiration of chest at night, during menses. Cold sweat on limbs.
Rectum - Stinging pain in rectum. Spasmodic stricture. Straining and urging to stool, with scanty evacuations.
Hemorrhoids with back pain as if breaking. Hemorrhoids more sensitive with backache. Violent itching with
 constrictive sensation in anus. Prolapsed anus (Ign., Podo.). Shuddering during stool. Mucus membrane of
anus seems swollen and pressed out. Diarrhea with bearing down pain in uterus. Diarrhea worse motion
(Rheum and Crot-t.). Escape of faeces when passing flatus.
Skin - Skin hot, moist alternating with dry. Dry and hot skin. Skin imparts a burning sensation to the examining
hand. Swollen, sensitive, scarlet, smooth skin.
Intense dermatitis. Bright, red, glossy. Redness of whole body, with quick pulse. Erythema, pustules on face.
Erythema, very sensitive. Alternate redness and paleness of the skin. Indurations following inflammations.
Acne rosacea. Scarletfever. Intense erysipelatous fever, with inflamed swellings, passing even into gangrene.
Urticaria during profuse menses. Eruptions resembling measles. Boils, returning every spring. Red scaly
eruptions. Suppurative wounds.
Sleep - Sleep prevented by fever, anxiety. Sleeplessness with drowsiness. Kept awake by pulsation of blood
vessels. Moans and tosses about in sleep. Jerks during sleep. Kicks in sleep. Restless, crying out, gritting of
teeth. Screams out in sleep. Staring when closing the eyes during sleep. Sleeps with hands under the head
(Ars., Plat.). Heavy sleep with hot skin. Restless, crying out, grinding of teeth. Kept awake by pulsation of
bloodvessels. Screams out in sleep. Sees frightful visions on closing eyes, dreams of quarrels, fire, robbers,
assassins. Frequent yawning. Waking at night full of fear. Woken constantly by fearful dreams and twitching.
Frightful dreams. Dreams of quarrels. Dreams of fire, robbers, assassins. Dreams of falling. Vivid dreams,
but can't remember them. Dreams of swimming.
Stomach - Burning pain in stomach. Pain in stomach extending to shoulder and throat worse pressure.
Constriction, pain runs to spine. Cramps in stomach. Spasms of stomach. Spasmodic pain in epigastrium.
Painless throbbing and beating at pit. Violent hiccoughs. Spasmodic hiccough with sweat and convulsions.
Esophagus is dry, feels contracted. Nausea and vomiting. Empty retching. Uncontrollable vomiting. Vomits
everything with paleness and weakness. Vomiting of mucus. Vomiting of bile and mucus. Vomiting of
undigested food. Hematemesis with ringing in ears, red cheeks.
Stool - Dysenteric stool in lumps like chalk. Retarded stools. Involuntary stools. Stools are thin, green,
dysenteric or contain
chalky lumps. Stools thin, green mucus. Stool sometimes bloody. Diarrhea of green mucus and blood after a
haircut. Stools clay-colored, chalky white. Stools with granular, slimy mucus, smell sour.
Teeth - Throbbing pain in teeth. Pain becomes intolerable. Toothache, better biting. Toothache with red, hot
face and throbbing in head. Teeth feel on edge. Teeth feel elongated. Toothache with earache. Gums as if
ulcerated. Grinding of teeth. Heat and redness of gums during dentition. Painful swelling of gums. Gumboils.
Bleeding of gums.
Temperature - Chill alternating with heat. Chill without thirst. Feet icy cold. Shuddering during stool. Shivering
chills running down back. Burning, pungent, steaming, heat. Distended blood vessels. Skin hot, but moist
and dry alternately. High fever without thirst. Hot head with cold limbs. Burning, pungent, steaming heat
with internal coldness. Delirium and fever. Internal heat, with anxiety and restlessness. Fever with redness
and puffiness of face.
Throat - Dry. red, hot throat. Dry throat, as if glazed, angry-looking congestion (Gins.). Throat feels
constricted.Redness, worse on right side. Tonsils enlarged. Spasms in throat. Tonsillitis worse right side.
Chokes easily, things go down wrong way. Swallowing difficult, worse liquids. Sore, bright red throat with
fever. Muscles of swallowing very sensitive. Must take a drink to swallow solid food. When swallowing, bends
head forward and lifts up knees. Sensation of a lump. Larynx feels sore, very painful. Larynx feels as if a
foreign body were in it with cough. Laryngitis. Painless hoarseness, voice loss. High piping voice. Spasms
in throat. Urging to swallow with choking. Scraping sensation. Hypertrophy of mucus membrane. Clutches at
throat during epilepsy. Aversion to tight collars.
Tongue - Tongue is red. hot, swollen and painful. Strawberry tongue. Edges of tongue red. Red streak in
middle of tongue, wider at tip. Tongue hangs out of the mouth in children. Forepart of the tongue cold
and dry. Tongue hot, dry, red, cracked. Tongue white centre with red edges. Tongue difficult to movç,
scalded feeling. Papillae of tongue of deep red color. Tongue covered with white clammy fur. Trembling of
tongue .when protruded.
Vertigo - Vertigo with falling to left side or backwards. Vertigo, worse stooping and rising from stooping. Vertigo
with vanishing of sight and flickering before eyes. Vertigo with rush of blood to head, roaring in ears, dim vision,
etc. Vertigo on motion, on turning over in bed.
Vision - Diminished vision from doing fine work. Lost vision after severe congestive headache. Attacks of
blindness, then yellow vision. Clouded vision before menses. Diplopia. Triplopia. Squinting, spasms of eyelids.
Moonlight blindness. Lines appear crooked when reading. Objects ap- pearupside down. Objects appear
double, and seem to revolve and run backwards. Sees red flashes before vision. Flickering, sparks. Bright
 sparks. Farsightedness. Amblyopia.
COMMENTS - Cases of Belladonna poisoning have frequently been mistaken for cases of scarlatina. Can
control and act as a prophylactic for cases presenting a smooth, even, red surface. When such an epidemic is
about, those who may be exposed to infection may obtain almost certain immunity by taking Belladonna two
or three times a day.
A striking picture of Bell, is sometimes seen in cases of worm-fever. Lutze reported a case of a pale, feeble
child, aged 3, who awoke, or at least sat up, at night in bed screaming, could not be pacified. Wet the bed at
night, passed worms now and then. Cheeks and ear-tips were brilliant scarlet, other parts of the face, especially
around the mouth, were white as snow.
Eyes brilliant, staring, pupils dilated. Skin dry and hot like fire. On being spoken to, flew into a violent rage.
Cina 200c ameliorated. Bell. 100,000c cured permanently.
Corresponds to the symptoms of “airsickness" in aviators. Can be given as a preventive. Has cured a very
severe headache in a nervous man that occurred whenever he
was exposed to tobacco smoke.
An enormous number of the symptoms of Bell, are developed in and from the head and sensorium. The pains
of Bell, run downwards, away from the head (Sil. and Gels, have a pain running up the back). Characteristic
heat, redness and burning.
All the symptoms come and go quickly. Predominantly a right-side medicine. Worse lying down. May want
something bitter or sour with their fever. They like lemons and are thirsty in general for cold water. Generally
aggravated at 3 p.m. and 9 p.m.
Great general sensitiveness and also sensitiveness of the special senses. Sensitive to light, to slightest noise,
to motion or jar as when someone touches the bed. Photophobia. Mania, rage, disposition to bite, scratch and
tear things. Fantastic illusions when closing eyes. Dull and sleepy, half asleep and half awake. Delirium with
fevers, especially with kidney infections. Hallucinations.
Chilly. Sensitive to changes from warm to cold, to drought of air, to damp weather, to chilling from having the
head uncovered or having the hair cut. Better from being wrapped up warmly in a room.
Remarkable quickness of sensation or of motion, the eyes snap and move quickly. The pains come and go
suddenly no matter how long they may last. Pains are throbbing, burning and stabbing, “stabbing from one
temple to the other." Throbbing pains anywhere in the body.
Head pains, headache. Headache with flushed face and brilliant eyes, dilated pupils. Feeling in brain like
swashing of water. Throbbing, pulsating headache with beating arteries and violent palpitation of the heart.
Congestion of blood to the head. Migraine headaches, vascular headaches, where all the blood rushes to the
head. Palpitations, feels as if head would burst. Headache from sudden exposure to cold air or the sun (Aeon.).
Sun headache.
Blood congestion. The blood rushes to one part of the body and becomes hot and throbbing. Congestion,
inflammation, throbbing blood vessels. Hemorrhaging, nosebleeds, uterine bleeding. The blood may feel hot.
Vertigo, mostly at night on turning over in bed or when getting up in the morning, also when walking and on
every change of position. Starting, twitching or jumping in sleep. “Sleepy, but cannot sleep.” Moaning in sleep.
Marked spasms and twitchings. Neuralgias and cramps. Convulsions. Epilepsy. Spasms from congestion or
heat. Meningitis with sudden onset, high fever, dilated glassy eyes, rolling their head back.
The face is purple, red and hot, or yellow. Redness and pallor alternate. Skin is “uniform, smooth, shining,
scarlet redness, so hot that it imparts a burning sensation to the hand of one who feels it. Sweat on covered
parts only.” Burning rashes, smooth and shiny. Scarlet fever.
Acute sinusitis, especially with nasal discharge that dries up (Kali-bi.) and throbbing. Bronchitis. Strep throat,
ear infections. Earaches that come on fast with a high fever. Photophobic with earache.
Tonsillitis, throat and tonsils are red (Ars.). The mouth is exceedingly dry without thirst. Stinging in esophagus,
worse swallowing or talking. Esophagus feels contracted. Affinity for sore throats, especially forchildren. May
have swollen glands, high fever.
Vision disorders. Child has glassy eyes. Eye injuries (Aeon., Calen.) with inflammation, pain and photophobia.
Pupils are dilated and the eye gets red and hot. Very sensitive to light. Sparks before eyes.
Cough short, dry, tickling (Rumx. and Phos.). Whooping cough with crying or pains before the attack, flushed
face, nosebleed and bloody expectoration.
Paralysis of lungs and heart (vagus nerve). Violent palpitation of heart. Stitches in chest. Swellings of breast
with bright red streaks radiating from center of inflammation. Rheumatism worse by motion. Sweat on covered
parts only.
“Tenderness of abdomen, worse by least jar. Pressing downward as if contents of abdomen would issue
through vulva, worse mornings often associated with pain in back as if it would break.”
 Lumpy stool, like chalk. Spasmodic contraction of anus, obstinate constipation. Involuntary stool and urine.
Bladder infections with congestion. Cramps and spasms on trying to urinate. Bleeding hemorrhoids, back pains
as if breaking. Sensation of a hand clutching intestines. Stitches in spleen. Appendicitis, acute pancreatitis,
gallstone colic.
The menstrual flow is hot, light color or bad smell. Ovarian cysts, especially on the right. Bearing down
symptoms, stabbing pains (Sep.). Pelvic inflammatory disease with severe cramps and high fever.
Can be used prophylactically or to treat rabies, or bad reaction to rabies shot (Lyss., Hydrophoninum).
Appropriate in hydrophobia.
The almost absolute deafness in cases is noteworthy in connection with Dr. Cooper's cure of a very chronic
case of deafness with single drop doses of Bell.
RELATIONS - Calc, is often required after Bell. Antidotes to Belladonna: Camph, Coff., Op„ Aeon. Compare:
(1) Glon., Hyos., Stram. (2) Sanguisorba officinalis - Profuse, long-lasting menses, especially in nervous
patients with congestive symptoms to head and limbs. Passive hemorrhages at menopausal. Chronic metritis.
Hemorrhage from lungs. Varicose veins and ulcers. (3) Mandragora - A narcotic of the ancients. Restless
excitability and bodily weakness. Desire for sleep. Anti-periodic properties like Chin, and Aranea. Useful in
epilepsy and hydrophobia, also Cetonia. (4) Hyos. - less fever, more agitation, Stram. - more sensorial
excitement, frenzy. (5) Hoitzia - A Mexican drug, similar in action to Bell. It useful in fever, scarlatinal eruption,
measles, urticaria, etc. High fever with eruptive fevers. Dry mouth and throat, red face injected eyes, delirium.
Complementary: Bor., Hep., Merc., Nat-m. Calc. Especially in semi-chronic and constitutional diseases.
Incompatible: Acet-ac.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Mur- phy.

name: Bellis Perennis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bell-p. Bellis perennis. English daisy. N. O. Composite Tincture of whole fresh flowering plant.
Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne. Aching, pains. Arteriosclerosis. Artery diseases. Boils. Blows. Brain, softening. Breast,
tumors. Bruises. Cancer. Carpal tunnel syndrome. Conjunctivitis. Debility. Ecchymosis. Exudations. Falls.
Fatigue. Giddiness. Gout. Headaches. Hematoma. Hemorrhages. Hemoptysis. Herpes.
• Indigestion. Injuries. Joint, pains. Lameness. Masturbation. Miscarriages. Menopause. Muscle, pains.
Mydriasis. Neuragias. Neuritis. Organ, injury. Over-work. Pregnancy, complaints. Psoriasis. Railway spine.
Repetitive strain. Rheumatism. Sleeplessness. Spleen, disorders. Sprains. Sore,pains. Stasis. Stomatitis.
Strains. Strokes. Swelling. Tendonitis. Trauma. Tumors. Uterus, fatigued. Uterus prolapsed. Varicose,
veins. Venous, stasis.
HERBAL - The old name of “Wound-wort" or “Bruise-wort, ” shows one of the main spheres of the action
of Bellis and allies it in action with its fellow composites. Arnica and Calendula. The daisy is a flower that is
repeatedly trodden upon and always comes up smiling afterwards. Being the “day's eye ” may be the sign of
its propensities for waking too early.
Burnett said “It is a princely remedy for old laborers, especially gardeners.” Overworked old laborers and
workmen, head sufferings of elderly working gardeners, commercial travelers, railway spine. Burnett generally
gave it in the mother tincture.
HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Burnett is the chief authority for its homeopathic uses. “It acts very much like Arnica,
even to the production of erysipelas.” He has cured with its aid several cases of tumors originating in a blow.
“Stasis” and “fatigue” are the principal notes of the action. Exudations and swellings of many kinds. Fagged
womb. Varicose veins. The giddiness of elderly people (cerebral stasis).
Bell-p. acts upon the muscular fibers of the blood vessels. Lameness of joints, as if sprained. Debility of limbs
after gout. Venous congestion due to mechanical causes. Arteriosclerosis. Vascular cerebral sclerosis.
Venous stasis, swelling, varicose veins. Hemorrhages.
Injuries to the deeper tissues. Septic wounds to the internal organs, after major surgical work (Calen.).
Sprains and bruises (Arn.). Near and remote effects of blows, falls, accidents.
Soreness, swelling due to injuries. Injuries to the nerves with intense soreness, better by cold bathing.
Feeling of bruising of the whole body, especially the back. Tumors or cysts from injury. Exhaustion with
need to move, which eases the pain. Muscular and joint pains. Pain in the right deltoid muscle.
Rheumatic symptoms. Pains are hard, aching, squeezing or throbbing. Unbearable pain that drives to
distraction, worse heat better cold. Patients feel tired and exhausted, desire to lie down. Trigeminal neuralgia.
Development of chronic conditions that may become cancerous.
Trauma of the pelvic organs from kicks, blows and surgery. Sore, bruised feeling in the pelvic region, worse
 since childbirth. It removes the ill effects of excess of masturbation.
Externally in nevi. Acne. Boils all over. Acrid pus, destroying hair. Belchings.
MIND - Impulse to move. Ideas slow, difficult. Very excitable, makes himself noticed by those around him.
Insomnia between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m. Dreams of anger.
Abdomen - Abdominal muscles lame. Soreness of abdominal walls. Soreness of abdomen in pregnancy.
Fullness about the spleen. Sharp pain in spleen. Spleen sore, enlarged. Bloated, rumbling in bowels. Injuries,
blows to abdominal organs. Post-operative pain and ecchymosis. Sharp pain in the right iliac cavity. Polyps
of the buccal and intestinal mucus membranes. Pain in the appendix. Chronic appendicitis.
Back - Sore, aching pains. Backache from overlifting and strain. Sprains with great soreness. Backache or
strain during pregnancy. Lumbago form physical labor. Falls on coccyx. Railway spine. Itching on back and
flexor surface of thighs.
Breasts - Breasts and uterus engorged. Breast tumor or cancer after injury.
Causations - Ill effects of cold drinks. exposure to wet or getting chilled when overheated. Affections due to
cold wind. Blows, falls, injury, accidents, surgical operations. Childbirth. Overexertion, overwork.
Chest - Angina pectoris.
Constitutions - Suited to old gardeners, farmers, laborers and commercial travelers. Carbo-fluorica types with
tendency to visceral ptosis, laxity of the ligaments and hemorrhages.
Eyes - Eye injury or strain. Catarrhal conjunctivitis. Conjunctivitis with excoriation and irritating discharge.
Female - Painful menses. Injury to female organs. Uterus prolapsed. Prolapse of the bladder and vagina.
Uterus tumors. Pelvic cramping pain, spreading to the back. Uterus feels sore, as if squeezed. Tendency to
hemorrhage. Viscous, irritating leucorrhea. Injuries, blows to pelvic organs. Feeling of downward pressure
in the uterus. Soreness of uterus. Metrorrhagia. Metritis. Cervicitis. Varicose veins with pregnancy. Uterine
strain, soreness from prolonged standing or pregnancy. Inability to walk during pregnancy. Sore, aching
pains after childbirth.
Food - Insatiable hunger. Desire for exotic food. Effects of cold or iced drinks when heated.
Head - Headache from occiput to top of vertex. Forehead feels contracted. Bruised soreness. Shooting pain.
Head heavy on waking with feeling of blood in the head. Attack of migraine with pain in the eyes and watery
nasal secretion. Drawing pains in the head and around the trigeminal region. Headache better by holding the
head tightly. Itching around scalp and over back, worse from hot bath and bed.
Heart - Enlargement of heart. Rhythmic anomalies. Irregular pulse. Extra systole. Palpitations. Spasms and
precordial pain, spreading to the right shoulder. Coronary thrombosis. Angina pectoris. Non-inflam- matory
lesion of the myocardium. Cardiac neurosis.
Limbs - Injuries, blows, strains to limbs. Muscular and joint rheumatism. Sprains with great soreness.
Joints sore, muscular soreness. Hematoma. Tendonitis. Bruised, aching, sore pains from injury or strain.
Post-traumatic and rheumatic myalgic pains. Rheumatism in old laborers. Swellings from injuries. Pain
down anterior of thigh. Wrist feels contracted as from elastic band around joint. Carpal tunnel syndrome.
Repetitive strain. Hip pains, worse exertion. Itching on back and flexor surfaces of thighs. Varicose veins
with bruised sore feeling.
Liver - Tingling in the hepatic region. Chronic inflammation of the gallbladder.
Lungs - Acute bronchitis. Hemoptysis. Pulmonary atelectasis.
Modalities - Better from continued motion. Better pressure. Better cold applications. Better heat and food.
Worse from injuries, blows, sprains. Worse exertion, lifting. Worse surgical operations. Worse left side.
Worse immobility. Worse touch. Worse hot bath. Worse warmth of bed. Worse becoming chilled when hot.
Worse before storms. Worse cold wind. Worse cold baths, cold drinks.
Mouth - Stomatitis. Angina. Pain in the tongue and mucus membranes of the mouth. Small ulcerations and
cracks and chapping of the lips. Lip herpes. Burning sensation on the tip of the tongue and edges of the tongue
are red. Improved by drinking cold water. Toothache improved by heat. Impression that the teeth are too long.
Dental neuralgia.
Nose - Watery, irritating secretion. Loss of sense of smell. Nosebleeds. Sinusitis. Rhinitis.
Rectum - Diarrhea and large amounts of gas. Yellow, painless diarrhea, foul odor, worse at night.
Skin - Ecchymosis, swelling, very sensitive to touch. Bruises and swellings. Venous congestion due to
mechanical causes. Hematoma. Acne. Herpes. Red papules and blisters. Boils with itching and burning
sensation. Skin dry, cracked. Itching, aggravated by heat in bed and in a hot bath, improved by the cold.
Exudations and swellings. Anthrax. Seeping eczema. Nevus.
Sleep - Sleeplessness due to sore, aching pains. Wakes early in morning andcannot get to sleep again.
Dreams of anger.
Stomach - Indigestion or stomach ache. Acrid dyspepsia. Aerophagy. Heavy feeling, vomiting, acrid belching.
 Cannot bear the weight of clothing on the stomach. Worse cold drinks. Worse when overheated, touch. Pain
improved by eating and by pressure. Vomiting, or regurgitation.
Temperature - Fever with shivering.
Throat - Pain on swallowing, feeling of itching in the throat. Huskiness. Feeling of rawness of the mucus
membranes, heavy cough. When coughing, feels a sharp pain the thorax. Acute and chronic laryngitis.
Vertigo - Vertigo in elderly persons with cerebral stasis. Headaches with vertigo, improved by fresh air and by
leaning over.
COMMENTS - Marked action on the female sexual organs, especially on engorged uterus and breasts. It
relieves troubles of pregnancy including the inability to walk, varicose veins, weakness of bladder, constipation,
hemorrhoids, prolapses. Given after childbirth, it will relieve pain and bleeding, help the sore, bruised
tenderness of uterine area.
Bearing down pains, sense of weight or a ball in the uterus of rectum, weak bladder or uterus since childbirth
(Sep.). Mechanical symptoms, the “heavy, tired womb.” For toning the uterus after many births. For profuse
bleeding or weakness in the uterus since pregnancy, miscarriage or abortion, with muscle soreness and
bruised feeling. Sensation of being kicked, deep soreness (Arn.).
Near and remote effects of blows, falls, accidents (trauma). Tumors or cysts from trauma. For sports injuries
with chronic aches and pains, orarthritis in the joints from overexertion and bending. Tennis elbow, sprains.
Aches and pains in the elderly and laborers are worse with weather changes.
Stasis and stagnation. Loss of tone after injury or trauma, especially to soft tissue. Sleeplessness from
overwork. Fatigue from masturbation. Tired feeling with desire to lie down. Can cause sleeplessness. Waking
at 3 a.m. “Waking up too early in the morning and cannot get to sleep again.”
Stitches in spleen. For severe injury to spleen, sore and enlarged, knife-like pain, area becomes congested
and bluish. It has produced acne, boils, rheumatic pains, giddiness. Headache from occiput to front, contracted
feeling in front brain. A pain in inner side of right arm as if a boil were developing.
Ill-effects of sudden, wet chill to heated stomach or body surface (Rhus-t.). Keynote “effects of cold or iced
drinks when heated,” dyspepsia, amenorrhea, skin disorders, rheumatism from this cause. Pre-eminently left-
side medicine.
Burnett had a case of a tumor in the abdomen after injury to a rib. It became inoperable, he gave Bellis tincture,
and seventeen days later the tumor was gone. He also gave it as a remedy for debility following acute attacks
of gout, classing it with Vanadium of which it is a complement in degenerative states, as brain softening and
atheroma of arteries.
Bell-p. has been observed to cause dilatation of the pupil when used locally.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Compare with Am. - aggravation from the slightest touch and from movement.
(2) Calen., Hyper., Con., Ars., Ham., Staph. (3) In effects of brain fag, Pic-ac. Vanad. - degenerative states.
(4) Ign. - Unstable, nervous, weeping easily. (5) Sepia - Affects of childbirth. After pains.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Julian. Murphy.

name: Benzoicum Acidum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - benz-ac. Benzoicum acidum. Benzoic acid. It is obtained by sublimation from Gum benzoin or
from several aromatic hydrocarbons. Tincture or trituration. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Asthma. Bedwetting. Bladder, disorders. Bunions. Cracks. Diarrhea. Eye, tumors. Ganglion.
Gonorrhea. Gout. Joints, disorders. Kidney, disorders. Knee, pain. Rheumatism. Sycosis. Throat, sore.
Tongue, sore. Tonsils, enlarged. Ulcers. Uric, acid Urine, offensive. Wens.
HOMEOPATHIC - The leading keynote is the occurrence, as a concomitant of any morbid condition, of strong
smelling urine, generally also dark. It produces and cures symptoms of a uric acid diathesis with highly
colored and very offensive urine and gouty symptoms. Patient gives out a very strong urine-like odor.
Symptoms fluctuate according to the fluctuation of urine. Urination profuse and scanty alternately.
Gouty and asthmatic. Painful gouty nodes. Kidney insufficiency. Joints crack when moving. Hygroma,
bunions. Meniere's disease. Marked action on the metabolism.
Pains suddenly change their locality but are mostly felt in the region of the heart or they alternate with urinary
symptoms. Pains alternate with heart symptoms. Chilly, symptoms are worse in open air, by uncovering, better
by heat. Symptoms appear left side first, then right. Child wants to be nursed in the arms, will not be laid down.
MIND - Activity of mind while at work, followed by anxiety. Fear following hurry. Anxiety while sitting. Anxiety
while sweating. Omits words in writing. Child cross, wants to be nursed in arms, will not be laid down.
Depression. Prone to dwell on unpleasant things in the past. Shudders if he sees anyone deformed. Delusion
 hears confused voices, worse swallowing or walking in open air. Abdomen - Cutting about navel, better stool.
Back - Pressure on spinal column. Coldness in sacrum. Dull pain in region of kidneys, worse wine. Trembling
in lumbar region.
Chest - Chest very tender. Cannot tolerate pressure of clothes on chest. Pain in region of heart.
Constitutions - Gouty constitutions.
Ears - Noise, as of confused voices in ears, worse swallowing or walking in open air.
Face - Copper-colored spots. Red with little blisters. Circumscribed redness of cheeks.
Female - Prolapse of uterus with foul urine.
Head - Headaches when urine becomes scanty. Throbbing in temporal arteries, causes puffing around ears.
Noises when swallowing. Ulceration of tongue. Swelling behind ears (Caps.). Cold sweat on the forehead.
Pricking, puckered constriction of mouth, bluish and bleeding gums. Wens.
Heart - Pains change places, but are most constant about the heart. Awakes after midnight with violent
pulsation or burning at heart.
Kidneys - Urine is hot, dark brown, strong foul odor of horse urine, ammoniacal. Excess of uric acid.
Cystitis. Kidney insufficiency. Kidney gravel, stones. Dribbling of urine. Retention of urine in infants.
Bedwetting, the sheets are stained brown. Offensive urine of old men. Bladder catarrh from suppressed
gonorrhea.
Limbs - Gouty deposits. Joints crack on motion. Rheumatic gout, nodes very painful. Tearing with stitches.
Cracking, pain and swelling in knees. Pain in Achilles tendon at the os calcis with pain in heart, when stepping
on foot. Ganglion, swelling of the wrist. Bunion of great toe. Tearing pain in great toe.
Liver - Stitching in liver region.
Lungs - Hoarse in morning. Asthma with rheumatic complaints. Asthmatic cough, worse night, lying on right
side. Hard, dry cough, followed by expectoration of green mucus.
Modalities - Better from heat. Better profuse urination. Worse from open air, Worse cold. Worse changing
weather. Worse by uncovering. Motion aggravates most symptoms, but headache is worse at rest and
toothache is worse lying down.
Mouth - Involuntary biting of lower lip, while eating. Tongue, spongy on surface with deep cracks and spreading
ulcers. Mouth and throat symptoms are better eating. Toothache worse lying down.
Nose - Itching of septum. Pain in nasal bones. Seems to smell cabbage, dust or something stinking.
Perspiration - Profuse sweat without relief. Night sweats. Sweat with aromatic odor.
Rectum - Frothy offensive, liquid, lightcolored like soapsuds, bowel movements mostly windy. Stitches and
constricted feeling. Puckering constriction of rectum. Itching and watery elevations around anus. Copious
grayish stools like soap suds of a pungent urine-like odor, very foul, white.
Skin - Red spots. Itching with agreeable sensation on being scratched, but leaving a burning.
Stomach - Sweat while eating, pressure in stomach, sensation of a lump. Vomiting of salty or bitter substance.
Temperature - Hands, feet, back, knees cold, as from a cold wind. Chilliness, cold sweat. Internal heat on
awakening.
Throat - Sensation as of a lump, swelling and constriction better eating.
Vertigo - Vertigo inclination to fall sideways.
COMMENTS - Ganglion of wrist and bunion of great toe have been frequently cured with Benz-ac. In these
cases, an ointment of the 3x is a useful external adjunct. Asthma has been cured by it, especially in rheumatic
persons. “Most of the symptoms appear on the left side, but may subsequently come on the right.” Inclination
to dwell on unpleasant subjects and shuddering on seeing anyone deformed.
Inflammation of bronchi and lungs with great tenderness of chest, cough worse night, lying on right side.
Long-continued, dry cough after suppressed gonorrhea. Sensation of lump (as of food) in pit of throat of
swelling and constriction. Throat symptoms are better by eating. Tongue is spongy on the surface with deep
cracks and spreading ulcers.
Watery, light, very offensive stools (in children), stools like soapsuds with usually strong-smelling urine.
Shivering before stool. Bedwetting at night, urine dark, strong-smelling, heavy, hot, smelling like horse's urine.
Gout (Colch.), kidney infections, with strong-smelling and offensive urine (Nit- ac.). Joints are red and swollen,
sensitive to the touch, gout can migrate. Tearing and stitches in great toe, especially right (gout). Swelling and
pain of right knee. Gouty concretions. Kidney stones or gravel in the urine, or for the tendency to form gravel.
Uric acid diathesis (Colch., or Urt-u. in tincture).
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Copaiva. Compare: (1) Nit-ac. - urine smelling like horse's. (2) Calc., Am-c.
benz., Sabina, Tropeleum, Garden Nasturtium, (fetid urine). (3) Cop., Ferr., Zinc., Tropeolum. (4) Useful in
gout after Colch. after abuse of Copaiva. (5) In suppression of gonorrhea in bedwetting after failure of Nitrum.
Incompatible: Wine, which aggravates pains in kidneys, drawing in knees, etc. Useful after Colch. fails in gout
 after Copaiva in gonorrhea.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy-

full:

Empty sensation at the stomach and lower part of bowels. Wakes from sleep with a sick feeling in stomach

MIND - Unpleasant, fearful feeling.
Head - Hair oily.
Limbs - Hips feel crushed. Pains in knees.
Feet and legs cold up to knees, remained cold in bed.
Modalities - Worse after sleep. Worse on lying down. Head swims with sinking sensation, which makes lying

name: Benzolum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - benz. Benzolum. Benzol. Ben- zinum. Benzene. Coal naphtha. Benzoline. A product of
distillation from coal tar. Tincture with alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Coma. Dysentery. Fever. Headache. Insomnia. Myeloid, leukemia. Photophobia. Sweat. Typhoid
fever. Vision disorders.
HOMEOPATHIC - Our knowledge of this medicine is derived from observations on a worker in a rubber factory,
who for weeks had his hands and arms daily bathed in benzine and drank water impregnated with it.
Benz, affects the blood. In the provers it resulted in ^decrease of the red and increase of white cells. It may
to be of use in acute myeloid leukemia. Patients are tired and nervous. Pain travels from below upwards.
Striking eye symptoms. Sense of falling through bed and floor. Hallucinations, epileptiform attacks, coma and
anesthesia.
MIND - Hallucination as of a great white hand appeared to him in darkness.
Eyes - Illusion of vision with wide-open eyes. Twitching of lids. Photophobia, objects blurred. Aching in eyes
and lids. Marked dilation of pupils. Failure to react to light, particularly daylight.
Head - Sense of falling through bed and floor. Dizzy. Tired and nervous. Pains from below upward. Pressing
feeling in head. Frontal headache to root of nose. Right-sided headache.
Limbs - Heavy limbs and cold legs, exaggerated knee-jerk. Pains from below upward.
Male - Swelling of right testicle. Severe pain in testicles. Itching of scrotum. Profuse urination.
Modalities - Worse at night, right side.
Nose - Profuse fluent coryza, especially in afternoon. Violent sneezing.
Skin - Eruption like measles. Perspiration on side not lain upon. Itching all over back. COMMENTS - Benz,
caused a profound disturbance of mind and body, weeping at trifles, irritability, pain darting upwards in occiput.
Could not turn eyes upward without severe aching and throbbing.
A sort of clairvoyant state in which a great white hand appeared to him in the darkness, coming outspread
towards his face, causing him in terror to scream for the watcher. A sense of falling through the bed and floor.
Insomnia and visual illusions. Pains travel from below upward (headache, pain in anus), chills.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) T. N. T. (2) Benzin. - Petroleum ether, not as pure a compound as Benzene,
(Benzol). It is the same, but with a mixture of various hydrocarbons. Oxyhe- moglobinemia. It seems to exercise
a special influence on the nervous system and the blood. Physical weakness, cramps, exaggeration of
kneejerks, nausea, vomiting, dizziness. Heaviness and coldness of limbs. Tremor of eyelids and tongue. (3)
Benzin, dinitricum.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
 ***BENZOLUM DINITRICUM
PHARMACY - benz-d. Benzolum dinitricum. Di-Nitrobenzol. A crystalline substance obtained from the further
action of Nitric Acid on Nitrobenzol at higher temperatures. Solution in alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and
all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amblyopia. Anemia. Color-blindness. Impotence. Peripheral, neuritis. Retinitis. Scotoma.
Spastic paralysis, Urine, black.
HOMEOPATHIC - Benz-d. is used in the manufacture of the higher explosives. The effects on workers were
recorded by Simeon Snell in the British Medical Journal of March 3, 1894. The symptoms observed strongly
resemble those of Benz-n.
The most obvious results of poisoning by skin absorption are changes in the red blood corpuscles and liver
degeneration. Anemia with a murmur in the pulmonary artery. Headaches, giddiness, staggering, with
numbness and paralytic sensations. Impotence in men. Distaste for tobacco. Dyspnea was marked in all,
accounting partly for the inability to smoke.
Amblyopia, color-blindness, retinitis, “a small central scotoma for red and green.” Field of vision contracted.
The retinal veins were found much engorged, probably part of the general venous engorgement and cyanosis.
The blood is altered and turned black, and the urine is black without containing blood.
MIND - Delirious, complaining of great pain in head. Raving behavior and unconscious from 5 p.m. to 10 p.m.,
the doctor gave him up, but he recovered.
Eyes - Blindness. Color-blindness, central scotoma for red and green. Disc pale, grayish, edges defined,
retinal vessels full, especially the veins. Retinal hyperesthesia. Veins much larger than the arteries.
Conjunctive jaundiced.
Face - Face pale, lips blue. Face bluish, asphyxiated look.
Head - Giddiness, compelling to sit down. Reels as if drunk, even fell off a stool when sitting, stumbled getting
into a train. Could not walk many yards without fall
ing. Occipital headache, unable to work on account of headache. Frontal headache with delirium. Color of hair
altered from golden to a sort of red.
Heart - Engorgement of venous system. Bruit in pulmonary artery. Pulse very frequent (115), small and
compressible. Anemia. Blood black.
Kidneys - Urine dark like ink.
Limbs - Want of sensation in arms and legs, prickly feeling. Legs numbs to knees and arms to elbows. Stiffness
about hands and feet, especially the fingers. Hands and feet cold, feet numb and sore. Fingertips feel cold to
the touch, though she herself is not aware of it.
Lungs - Breath very short, rendering smoking very difficult. Short breath with giddiness. Asphyxia.
Male - Sexual desire lost, power diminished (restored when taking liquid strychnine after leaving off the work).
Stomach - Intolerance of alcohol, ‘‘it made him fell so bad. '' Occasional nausea and vomiting.
RELATIONS-Antidotedby: Strychnine. Compare: (1) Benz., Benz-n., Hydr-ac., Ars.
REFERENCES Clarke.
keynote:
PHARMACY - benz. Benzolum. Benzol. Ben- zinum. Benzene. Coal naphtha. Benzoline. A product of
distillation from coal tar. Tincture with alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Coma. Dysentery. Fever. Headache. Insomnia. Myeloid, leukemia. Photophobia. Sweat. Typhoid
fever. Vision disorders.
HOMEOPATHIC - Our knowledge of this medicine is derived from observations on a worker in a rubber factory,
who for weeks had his hands and arms daily bathed in benzine and drank water

name: Benzolum Nitricum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - benz-n. Benzolum nitricum. Nitro-benzene. Essence of Morbane. Artificial Oil of Bitter Almonds.
Prepared by heating Benzol with Nitric Acid, the oily fluid formed is washed and rectified, it is miscible with
alcohol and has an odor of bitter almonds. Solution in alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amaurosis. Convulsions. Cyanosis. Diuresis. Epilepsy. Nystagmus. Respiration, slow.
Strabismus. Tetanus. Trismus.
HOMEOPATHIC - Nitro-benzene is a very poisonous substance and our knowledge of its action is due to
numerous cases of poisoning that have occurred. Slows the respiration until death occurs.
Rolling of eyeballs in their vertical axis, pupils dilated. Nystagmus. Blue lips, tongue, skin, face,
conjunctive and fingernails.
Flapping of nasal alae. Burning taste in mouth. Burning in throat and stomach. Sweat on forehead and face.
Whole body covered with profuse cold sweat. Secretions smell strongly of bitter almonds. Nausea, vomiting of
food eaten. Pains in abdomen. Involuntary evacuations.
Paralysis of all limbs. Faintness, sinking, convulsions, twitchings, stupor. Head drawn backward and to the left
side in spasms. Punctiform ecchymoses. Dark, black blood, thatcoagulates with difficulty. Venous blood,
hyperemia of the brain and general venous engorgement. Respiration very slow, difficult, sighing. Cold skin,
pulse small, weak, breathing slow and irregular, unconsciousness, symptoms of apoplectic coma.
 MIND - Loquacity, following drowsiness, soon passing into stupor. Extreme mental excitement, soon became
unconscious with inarticulate, confused speech.
Ears - Violent roaring in ears and sounds.
Eyes - Eyes staring. Rolling of the eyeballs in their vertical axis. Constant turning of the eyeballs, inward and
outward in a slow, regular motion with the visual axes perfectly parallel. Constant slow movement of eyeballs
from left to right under . closed lids. Nystagmus. Great injection of conjunctiva of bulbs. Eyeballs seemed
enlarged. Strabismus. Pupils dilated, insensible to light. Distorted vision and flashes of strange light and colors.
Head - Head drawn backwards and to the left in spasms.
Kidneys - Diuresis, urine brownish red, odor of bitter almonds. Urine and feces passed involuntarily.
Limbs - Paralysis of all limbs. Twitchings in hands and feet. Arms spasmodically flexed, sometimes extended
afterwards relaxed.
Lungs - Dyspnea. Snoring. Sighing, frequently interrupted. Breathing, slow, difficult.
Mouth - Tongue white and swollen, thick and soft. Burning taste, followed by numbness and tingling of tongue
and lips. Tenacious saliva. Stammering speech.
Neck - Stiff-neck, trismus and twitchings in masseter muscles.
Pulse - Pulse rapid, weak, irregular, scarcely perceptible. Pulse full and slow.
Rectum - Involuntary evacuation.
Skin - Skin cold and livid, bluish-gray. Punctiform ecchymosis. Bruised spots, bluish-black, beneath scalp and
on gluteal muscles.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Benzin., Amyg. am., Camph. Hydr-ac.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Berberis Aquifolium
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - berb-a. Berberis aquifolium. Oregon grape. Mahonia. Mountain grape. N. O. Berberidacae. The
fresh root and stem is pounded to a pulp and macerated in two parts by weight of alcohol. Fluid extract or
tincture of root. Historical dose: Tincmre and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Biliousness. Bladder, stones. Blisters. Bronchitis. Eczema. Face, roughness. Headache. Herpes.
Kidney, stones. Leucorrhea. Nausea. Pimples. Pityriasis. Psoriasis. Pustules. Scald, head. Spleen disorders.
Stomatitis. Syphilis. Typhoid. Voice disorders.
HERBAL - Berberis aquifolium belongs to the Mahonia group of the Barberry family. It has been used by
eclectics in chronic syphilis, chronic skin diseases in scrofulous cachexia and for removing pimples from the
faces of girls.
A tea made of the leaves of Berb-a. Mahonia has a local reputation in the mountain typhoid of the Rockies
and the provings of Berb-a. show febrile symptoms and a marked action on the spleen. It has a reputation for
making “a new man of an old one. "
Hale reported a case of very advanced secondary syphilis cured with it and some characteristic cases of
psoriasis. In all these conditions Berb-a. tincture has been given in 5 to 10 drops doses.
HOMEOPATHIC - Keynotes include an intense, pulsating headache in the forehead. Nausea, vomiting. Pains
in the bladder. Rheumatic pains in the joints of the hands and in the lumbar and sacral regions, worse at night.
Pruritus and psoriasis-type eruptions. The skin becomes dry, rough, scaly, pimply. Clears the complexion.
Eruptions on scalp extending to face and neck. Acne. Psoriasis. Dry eczema.
For chronic catarrhal affections, secondary syphilis. Hepatic torpor, lassitude and other evidences of
incomplete metabolism. Stimulates all glands and improves nutrition. Heavy feeling in the stomach, liver and
bladder. Pains in the region of the bladder. Rapid peristalsis.
MIND - Unhappiness and depression, sometimes coming on suddenly. Hysterical crying at frequent intervals.
Nervous, restless. Disinclined to move or do anything, dullness, stupidity.
Abdomen - Uneasy feeling without desire for stool. Pain in the hypogastrium. Biliousness and waxy, jaundiced
hue. Intense burning in spleen and feeling as if pounded. Distressing soreness in spleen.
Back - Pain in the dorsal vertebrae. Pain in the sacrum.
Breasts - Breast tumor with pain.
Chest - Oppression and weakness of upper part of chest. Burning heat in lower left lung.
Constitutions - Psoric and the sycotic constitution. Biliary types and allergic reactions. Types with a
predominance of allergies with chronic mesenchymal poisoning.
Eyes - Feeling that the eye is falling from the socket. Conjunctiva injected. Sensation of film before eyes. Eyes
look hollow and weak, as if tired, burning feeling and aching as from strain.
Face - Acne. Blotches and pimples. Clears the complexion. Waxy, yellowish white skin. Flashes of heat to
 cheeks. Pinched expression.
Female - Slight burning in vagina, bearing-down pains and aching as if menses about to come on.
Food - Anorexia, aversion to food. Hunger, even soon after eating, without desire for food. Sudden nausea
after eating.
Head - Sensation of a band just above ears. Bilious headache. Scald head. Scaly eczema. Cramping pains
located in the
Berberís aquifolium forehead, spreading towards the occiput. Sensation that the hair is stiff. Pulsating
vascular pains.
Kidneys - Stitching, crampy pains, thick mucus and bright-red, mealy sediment. Frequent need to urinate in
small quantities. Pain in the region of the kidneys, worse when seated, with frequent need to urinate and
burning pain in the bladder. Urine increased or decreased in quantity.
Limbs - Rheumatic pain in the joints of the hands and fingers with slight swelling of the joints between the
phalanges. Sense of numbness and feeling as if there was no strength of will to lift the part. Pain severe as
after a heavy blow. Peculiar prickling as from electricity on back of hand and outside forearm. Rheumatic
tensions and stiffness of legs.
Lungs - Bilious colds, expectoration yellow and then greenish. Dry, irritating cough. Scanty, tenacious, blood-
streaked expectoration.
Male - Drawing and pressure in testicles.
Modalities - Better from cold water. Worse in the evening and at night. Aggravation from rest at night, but also
from prolonged movement.
Mouth - Fetid breath. Blisters on the edge of the tongue. Tongue thickly coated, yellowish-brown, pasty white,
feels blistered. Bilious taste after eating. Soreness in lower teeth and salivary glands.
Nose - Stuffy feeling, with discharge of greenish-yellow mucus. Itching within nose with desire to sneeze.
Rectum - Large, dark stools. Hot, bilious diarrhea. After loose stools, light-colored, constipated stools. Stools
too large, expelled with difficulty.
Skin - Acne. Pimples with a dry, rough, scaly skin. Dry eczema. Eruption on scalp extending to face and
neck. Psoriasis. Glandular induration. Pruritus, at first in localized places, then spreading over the whole
surface of the skin. Appearance of rashes, blisters, pustules, papules, urticaria. Amelioration from washing in
cold water.
Sleep - Drowsy in daytime.
Stomach - Heartburn. Burning in stomach.
Nausea and severe straining to vomit. Nausea and hunger after eating.
Temperature - Diurnal rise of temperature and pulse. Flashes of heat and burning of palms. Flashes of heat
to cheeks.
Throat - Dry throat. Throat choked with mucus. Voice rough and somewhat hoarse. Voice seemed cut off, as
if a damper had closed. Lack of timbre in voice.
Vertigo - Dizzy sensation, worse sleeping or moving.
COMMENTS - J. D. W. C. in the Recorder, 1896, detailed his personal experiences with does of 10 to 15 drops
a day. On the third day he felt nausea and dull-headed. Later, there was straining to vomit without vomiting.
Then came a peculiar headache, strong compression, as if a band of iron two inches wide passed entirely
around head just above ears. It kept growing tighter and tighter.
Strong black coffee relieved this after a time, but left him tremulous in nerves and unsteady in gait. Even after
that, a single drop of Berb-a. on the tongue was sufficient to avert an attackof biliousness when threatening,
and saved him much trouble of the kind to which he had formerly been liable.
Clarke verified its usefulness in second- ary syphilis.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Sulph. - Principal remedy for allergy with burning pains, need for cool air, but
aggravation from washing or bathing. Pain in the lumbar and sacral regions with stiffness. Dry, scaly, itching
rashes. (2) Psor. - This is a principal nosode remedy for allergic conditions. Chilliness, itching, sometimes fetid
eruptions. Subject aggravated by the cold, but the eruption is aggravated by the heat in bed. Occipital and
frontal migraine improved by eating. (3) Ars. - Burning pains improved by heat. Nightly aggravation between 1
a.m. and 3 a.m. Scaly, burning, itching rashes, improved by hot, damp compresses. (4) Carb-ac., Euonym.,
Berb., Hydr.
REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke. Julian.
