name: Berberis Vulgaris
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - berb. Berberis vulgaris. Barberry. N. O. Berberidacae. Britain. Tincture of the bark of the root.
 Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Aphthae. Arthritis. Bilious attack. Bladder, disorders. Chills. Colic. Coryza. Cystitis. Diarrhea.
Duodenum, catarrh. Dysmenorrhea. Dysuria. Eczema. Fevers. Fistula. Gallstone, colic. Gallstones. Gravel.
Heartbum. Hematuria. Hemorrhoids. Her- pes,. Itching. Jaundice. Joint, disorders. Kidney, colic. Kidney,
disorders. Kidney, stones. Knee, pain. Leucorrhea. Liver, disorders. Lumbago. Menstrual complaints.
Nausea. Nephritis. Neuralgias. Ophthalmia. Oxaluria. Polyps. Prostate, enlarged. Rheumatism. Sacrum,
pain. Side pain. Spermatic cords, neuralgia. Spleen, disorders. Tonsillitis. Tumors. Urinary, disorders.
Vaginismus. Venous, stasis. Vertigo .
HERBAL - The usual preparations of Berberis vulgaris are made from the root bark. Affections of liver and
kidneys are strongly marked, but Berb. is a medicine of wide range.
HOMEOPATHIC - Berb. is often useful in arthritic and hepatic disorders with urinary, hemorrhoidal or
menstrual complaints. Venous stasis occurs in the pelvic region, causing hemorrhoids. It acts upon the urinary
organs, when there is tendency to the formation of kidney stones.
Berb. causes inflammation of the kidneys with hematuria. Marked pain in the region of the kidneys, hence
its use in kidney and bladder troubles. Severe pains from kidney stones. Gallstones and bladder catarrh.
Sharp or tearing, bubbling pains in region of kidneys, worse stooping and rising again, sitting or lying, better
standing.
Violent sticking pains in bladder, extending from kidneys into urethra with urging to urinate. The emission of
urine is frequently accompanied by pains in thighs and loins. During urination burning in urethra or bladder,
pressure in bladder, cutting, burning or stitches in urethra.
Dragging or sharp pains in spermatic cord, extending into testes.
Affects the liver markedly, promotes the flow of bile. Useful for fleshy persons with good livers, but with little
endurance. Gallstone colic, followed by jaundice. Sticking pain in region of liver and gallbladder shooting up
to left shoulder, worse by pressure.
Pains rapidly change their locality and character. Pains are radiating from one point, shooting outward or all
over, sticking, burning, smarting, soreness. Pains may be felt all over body, emanating from small of back.
Spinal irritation. Cold feeling in prepuce, glans, testes and scrotum.
Movement aggravates complaints (Bry.). Sharp pains are frequent and a bubbling sensation. Bubbling and
sharp pains are characteristic. A bubbling feeling as if water were coming up through the skin. Tearing, burning
pains or bubbling sensation in joints.
Rapid changes of symptoms. Thirst alternates with thirstless, hunger and loss of appetite. Chills and fever.
Coldness of body with hot face, commencing 11 a.m., burning heat in afternoon, worse during night.
MIND - The mental condition of Berb. is one of indifference, apathy. Aversion to the darkness. Melancholy,
inclination to weep. Fretful humor with weariness of life.
Patient is mentally and physically tired, not inclined to do anything. Mental work requiring close thinking is very
difficult, the least interruption breaks the chain of thought. Vanishing of thoughts when interrupted. Objects
seem twice as large as natural.
Apathetic. Indifference and pensiveness, with disinclination to speak. Anxiety before sleep in evening. Anxiety
while sitting, standing or moving. Sees terrifying apparitions in twilight, especially children. Desires death
during menses.
Abdomen - Burning in or under skin of abdomen. Rumbling in bowels. Colic pains from gallbladder to
abdomen, worse pressure. Torn loose feeling in the epigastrium. Sharp pains in front of kidneys extending to
liver, spleen, stomach,
Berberís vulgaris groins. Cramplike contraction in splenic region. Sticking deep in ileum. Pressure and
tension in groins, as if a hernia would develop. Sharp pain in region of umbilicus. Severe pain in inguinal region.
Varicose veins near right inguinal ring.
Back - Back as if beaten, disabled or stiff. Bubbling sensation in back. Tearing, sticking with stiffness, which
making rising difficult. Numbness, bruised sensation. Lumbago (Ant-t., Rhus-t.). Post-operative pain in lumbar
region. Soreness with sharp pains, with frequent urination. Stitches in the spine. Constant pulsating, sharp
pains in sacrum. Sharp pains in neck and back, worse respiration. Pustules. Pimples on scapulae.
Inflammation of the glands of the neck.
Bladder - Cystitis. Burning pains in bladder region. Dysuria, frequent urination. Urethra burns when not
urinating. Pain in the thighs and loins on urinating. Cutting and burning in urethra during and after urinating.
Sensation as if some urine remained after urinating. Crampy, contractive, or aching pains in bladder, when
bladder is full or empty. Burning in urethra during menopause. Constant urging, with pain in neck of bladder,
mostly burning and scanty discharge.
Breasts - Pressure in breasts, especially at nipple. Sensation as if breasts were swollen, after menses.
 Pressure behind left nipple.
Chest - Oppression of the chest, especially at night, with violent flowing of the coryza. Painful shootings in the
left side of the chest. Sensation of excoriation in the chest. Tearing, sharp pains in chest and region of
heart. Stinging, pulsating, pressing or tensive pains in muscles of chest. Pimples on chest and scapulae.
Itching, smarting and burning in axillae. Itching returns after scratching, with smarting stitches or burning.
Constitutions - Acts well in fleshy persons with good livers, but with little endurance. Prematurely old and
worn out men and women. Old gouty constitutions. Suited to bilious diathesis. Cases where kidney or bladder
symptoms are prominent.
Ears - Itching with small pustules on the outer parts of the ears. Heat alternating with coldness of external ear.
Sensation of coldness or bubbling in ears. Stopped up feeling with pressure. Beating or fluttering noise in
ear. Nodes on auricle. Throbbing and roaring. Acute and shooting pains in the interior of the ear and in other
parts. Sharp pains in the ear. Small tumor, size of hazelnut, under and behind ear, enlarged gland.
Eyes - Conjunctivitis, with inflamed lachrymal caruncle. Dryness of eyes with burning and redness of
conjunctiva. Aching and sensation of burning in the eyes. Eyes sunken with dark-bluish circles around. Burning
and dryness in the eyes, which are dull. As if sand between the lids and eyes. Eyes feel cold as from a cool
wind with lachrymation on closing the eyes. Shootings in the eyes. Itching in the canthi, eyebrows, and eyelids.
Ophthalmia. Painful eyes on reading by candlelight. Sensitive to the sunlight. Shuns light.
Face - Face hot and red. Sunken cheeks and eyes with bluish circles. Dirty gray, pale, sickly. Bilious. Greenish
face, with blue rings and pink eyes. Sensation as if cold drops were spurted into the face when going into the
open air. Dryness of the lips. Sensation of tingling on the lips. Burning in lips. Suppurating acne.
Female - Menses, consisting of gray mucus or brown blood. Menses, with pain in kidneys and chilliness,
pain down thighs. Scanty menses, of black drops of filthy slime. Menses, watery blood or brown. Gray mucus
replaces menses. Dysmenorrhea with blood looking like gray serum. Dysmenorrhea, with pains radiating
in every direction. Leucorrhea. grayish mucus with painful urinary symptoms. Acrid leucorrhea, very
prostrating. Neuralgia of ovaries and vagina. Pain changes sides. Vagina sensitive. Vaginismus. Vulvaitch- ing
and burning. Pinching constriction in mons veneris, contraction and tenderness of vagina. Burning and
soreness in vagina. Urinary symptoms with menses and leucorrhea. Cutting pain during sex. Enjoyment absent
during sex. Prostration
Berberís vulgaris after sex. Desire diminished. Suppressed sexual desire with long delayed orgasm.
Food - Appetite either increased or decreased. Excessive appetite, almost like bulimia. Very slow digestion.
Acid, bitter taste, especially after a meal. Want of appetite, with bitter, bilious taste. Food appears insipid.
Alcoholic drinks aggravates. Thirst and dryness of the mouth.
Head - Dullness of head, as from coryza. Confusion and heaviness of the head. Frontal headache. Cold
sensation in right temple. Cold temples. Chilliness in back and occiput. Heat in head from exertion. Skin of
head and face as if numb. Headache, worse by movement, better in open air. Headache with hepatic or
rheumatic arthritic complaints. Headache with affections of urinary organs. Darting and shooting pains in
the head after changing the locality. Sensation as if the head were becoming larger. Sensation of a tight cap
pressing upon the whole scalp. Tearing pain in auricle and gouty concretions. Pustules in the tissues of the
head and in the face.
Heart - Squeezing with shooting pains in the region of the heart. Frequent palpitations. Sharp pains about the
heart. Very painful contracting, shooting pain in region of heart. Pulse becomes very slow. Pulse slow and
weak. Pulse full, hard and rapid.
Kidneys - Radiating, shooting pains from kidneys into bladder. Kidney colic from kidney stones. Pain
from kidney, extending along ureter or to liver, stomach, spleen, arresting breathing. Bubbling sensation in
region of kidneys. Kidney stones. Burning, soreness in kidney region. Stinging, burning, gnawing, on small
spot near kidneys, worse hard pressure. Sensitiveness in region of kidneys so great that any jarring motion,
riding in a wagon, jumping from it, was intolerable. Clear discharge from meatus before urinating. Urine with
thick mucus and bright-red. Urine turbid, yellow. Urine red, mealy, sandy or slimy sediment. Passes small
calculi. Urine smells like coffee. Urine blood-red.
Limbs - Bruised feeling in limbs. Rheumatic paralytic pain in shoulders, arms, hands and fingers, legs and
feet. Swelling of joints. Neuralgia under fingernails with swelling of the finger joints. Sensation of cold on
outside of thighs. Heels pain, as if ulcerated. Sharp pains between metatarsal bones as from a nail when
standing. Pain in balls of feet on stepping. Intense weariness and lameness of legs after walking a short
distance.
Liver - Liver troubles with stickingpains in region of gall bladder. Shooting, aching pains in the hepatic
region, increased by pressure. Pressure in the liver. Gallstones. Sharp pain in region of gallbladder, worse
pressure, extending to stomach. Gallstone attack with severe pains. Violent stabbing, in region of liver,
 taking breath, must bend over. Catarrh of the gallbladder with constipation and yellow complexion.
Lungs - Increased deep breathing, with dry cough. Shortness of breath when going up stairs. Obstruction of
breath when raising arms. Gallbladder or kidney colic arresting breathing. Short, dry cough with sharp
pains in chest. Expectoration of a quantity of thick, yellow, jelly-like mucus.
Male - Genitals cold and sweaty. Neuralgia ofspermatic cord and testicles. Constrict- ing pain in testicles.
Testicles drawn up. Smarting, burning, stitching in testicles in prepuce and scrotum. Itching on scrotum. Pain
changes sides. Prostate gland enlarged, with pressure in perineum. Prepuce and glans cold and numb. Penis
hard and contracted, bends upwards. Suppressed sexual desire. Straining during and after ejaculation of
semen.
Modalities - Better after urination. Better open air. Worse from motion. Worse jarring. Worse stepping hard.
Worse rising from sitting, Worse fatigue. Worse urinating. Worse twilight. Worse standing, it brings on, or
increases, urinary complaints. Worse deep pressure.
Mouth - Aphthae. Burning and acrid taste in the mouth. Bitter taste. Offensive metallic odor from mouth. Sticky,
viscid, foamy, saliva like cotton (Nux-m.). White, sticky tongue, viscid salivaresembling soapsuds.
Diminished saliva. Ugly bluish-red spots in mouth. Gums dirty gray. Small white nodes in the gums. Teeth feel
as if too long or too large.
Nose - Dryness in the nose. Crawling and itching in nostrils. Pricking pain in tip of nose. Coryza with the
yellowish serum discharge, afterwards of purulent. Obstinate catarrh of left nostril. Catarrh whitish, yellowish,
or greenish mucus, especially in the morning. Titillating irritation to sneeze. Drops of blood from left nostril.
Perspiration - Everything excites sweat.
Rectum - Constant urging to stool. Diarrhea painless, clay-colored. Burning and smarting in anus and
perineum. Bearing down pain in anus and in sacrum. Changingstools. Scanty, thin-formed stool, hard or soft.
Hard stools, like sheep dung, with burning in the anus. Stools are dirty gray, smarting tough, watery with
jaundice. Tearing pain around anus. Fistula in anus, itching with chest complaints. Copious hemorrhage from
anus after increased exercise. Hemorrhoids. Herpes around anus.
Skin - Itching, burning and smarting, worse scratching, better cold applications. Small pustules over whole
body. Eczema of anus and hands. Eruptions leave a brown stain. Circumscribed pigmentation following
eczematous inflammation. Red marbled spots changing into brown spots. Boils, hastens suppuration and
prevents return. Flat warts.
Sleep - Sleepiness during the day. Restless sleep, disturbed by burning itching of the skin or by anxious
dreams. Frequent waking, and fatigue, as from want of sleep. Sleep greatly prolonged. Unrefreshing sleep.
Difficult awaking in morning, followed by headache, exhaustion, and want of recollection. Anxious dreams.
Stomach - Bitter eructations. Heartburn. Eructations, without bad taste or smell. Bilious risings. Frequent
eructations alternating with yawning. Nausea before breakfast, better after. Pains from stomach to back, or
the reverse. Shiverings in the epigastrium. Burning, shooting pains in the stomach. Sticking or whirling pain
in gastric region.
Teeth - Teeth as if too long or too large. Pain as if gums were torn, or teeth pulled out. Scraping, gnawing
pains. Tearing pain in left upper molar. Piercing pain in hollow tooth of lower jaw. Sharp pains. Gums dirty
grey. Small white nodes in gums. Dingy red edges of gums. Gums bleed easily. Sore gums during dentition.
Temperature - Chilly. Cold sensation in various parts, as if spattered with cold water. Cold single parts. Chills
as if in bones, with warmth of skin. Chills before dinner, with ice-cold feet. Chills in region of kidneys. Warmth
in lower part of back, hips and thighs. Heat in the hands and head in the afternoon, continuing for several days.
Typhoid and putrid fevers.
Throat - Inflammation of the tonsils and pharynx, with swelling and fiery redness. Hoarseness with soreness.
Sensation of plug in the side of the throat with dryness. Scratching and burning as from sand in throat.
Tonsillitis. Pain in tonsils, when speaking or swallowing. Polyps of larynx.
Tongue - Tongue feels scalded. Vesicles on tongue. Painful pimple on tip. Tongue smarts when touched.
Slimy furred tongue.
Vertigo - Vertigo, with sensation of fainting and great weakness. Vertigo on stooping and on making use of
the arms. Feeling of intoxication and giddiness.
Vision - Dim vision, all objects looking dark, as if through a veil, or running together. Dim vision with itching
around eyes and in face, preceded by incipient catarrh, succeeded by itching on legs.
COMMENTS - There is great weakness like fainting after a walk, with perspiration and heat on the upper part
of the body, cold, pale, sunken face and oppression of breathing. Great relaxation with disinclination to do
anything. Great sleepiness during day and after dinner. Vertigo and heaviness.
Heat of head after dinner or in afternoon. Puffy feeling in head, as if it were becoming larger. Scalp tense. The
face is pale with a dingy gray tinge, sunken cheeks. Deep-set eyes, surrounded with bluish and black-gray
 border. Mouth dry and sticky, painful white blisters on tip of tongue.
Darting and shooting pains often changing their localities, worse movement, better open air. Changeable pains.
Dry mucus membranes. Discharges or skin is dirty gray. Cold feeling in the bones, eyes, ears etc. Numbness
insensible to extreme heat and cold. Metatarsus and metacarpus feel sprained. Neuralgia under fingernails.
Lumbago, pains extend from back, around body, down leg, with red sediment in urine. Many old troubles in
the back. Sufferings worse by fatigue. Aching in small of back, worse sitting or lying in the morning on
awakening.
Chest affected after operations, hemorrhoids, fistula, etc. The pit of the stomach is puffed up. Gnawing pain in
right hypochondrium, shooting up to left scapula. Pains shoot down from tenth rib to navel. Burning in either
inguinal region (especially right).
Constipation, stool like sheep-dung. Diarrhea. Hemorrhoids with itching or burning, particularly after stool,
which is frequently hard and covered with blood. Anal fistula with painful pressure in perineum, extending deep
into pelvis (left side).
Nephritis, acute kidney infections, kidney pain from passing a stone, kidney colic from polyhephritis.
Numbness, stiffness and lameness in kidney region. Great sense of weakness in kidney region, after exertion.
Kidneys are worse walking, especially down stairs, worse jar, bubbling sensation.
Bladder infections with achy kidneys, burning on urination, worse motion (Bry.). Cramping pain while urinating
with urinary infection. Profuse amount of urine alternating with little urine.
Frequent urging to urinate. Urine is dark yellow and red, becoming turbid, copious, mucus sediment or
transparent, jelly-like or reddish, bran-like sediment. Urine slimy when passed, depositing copious foamy
yellowish sediment. Greenish urine depositing mucus.
A liver remedy and gallstone colic with the same pain as passing a stone from the gallbladder, sharp pain that
radiates.
Gallstone colic with jaundice. Absence of pleasurable sensation during sex, in women. Uterine symptoms and
leucorrhea associated with painful urinary symptoms. Dysmenorrhea, pains radiating in all directions down
thighs, etc. Vagina intensely painful, reddened. Violent pain in back with menses, which are too scanty.
Guernsey admirably summed up Berb. “Affects particularly the lumbar region, kidneys, uterus. The patient is
sometimes unable to tell the exact locality, but the pain is somewhere in the back and shoots up the back or
into the spermatic cord or testes, bladder, buttocks or legs.
“The pain may shoot up or down or both ways. Pains may be felt all over the body, emanating from the back,
the pains are of a sticking, pricking, sharp or jerking character, flying about now here and there. There is often
a bubbling sensation in the region of the kidneys.”
On the indication “tumors and sessile growths,” Ozanam cured a case of polyps of the vocal cords, red with a
sessile base. Thuja had failed. Berb. 200c was given at first with good effect, the potency being gradually
reduced with increasingly good effect until the growth disappeared entirely under the lx.
B. Simmons verified a symptom of Berb. A gentleman of 52 complained of rheumatic pains in his legs and loss
of walking power. After he had walked a short distance, he was compelled to stop from a feeling of intense
weariness, heaviness, lameness and stiffness of the legs, which felt sore as if bruised. A single dose affected
a complete cure, improvement commencing on the fourth day.
Stuart Close recorded the cure with Berb. 200c of a woman who had cutting, burning pains in the balls of the
feet on stepping. On standing with most of the weight on the heels, she had no pain. On rising in morning,
there was a sensation in soles as if stepping on needles.

and pricking pains in anus. Lyc., Thuj. (6) In duodenal catarrh: Chin., Lyc., Hydr., Podo., Ric., Merc. (6) In

Podo., Caul., Berb-a. Complementary: Mag-m. Follows well: Bry., Kali-bi„ Rhus-t, Sulph.

name: Beryllium Metallicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - beryl. Beryllium metallicum. Glucinium metallicum. Historical dose: Trituration and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Allergic conditions. Cancerous conditions. Chronic fatigue. Dermatitis. Eczema. Emphysema.
Erythema nosodum. Gingivitis. Kidney stones. Lichen planus. Lipomas. Myocarditis. Sarcoidosis. Stomatitis.
Tubercular conditions. Tumors.
 HOMEOPATHIC - Beryllium, a light metal closely resembling Aluminium, was isolated in 1828 by Bussy, thirty-
one years after Vauquelin's discovery of the oxide which he named glucinium, because of the sweet taste of
its salts. Beryl exists in America, especially in Columbia; Madagascar; Russia and France.
The homeopathic symptomatology was undertaken by Templeton in 1951-52 on seven provers, using the 3x,
6x, 7x, 12x, and 30c. Some symptoms can be attributed to the fluorine if it is a question of impure beryllium
containing beryllium fluoride.
The usefulness of the remedy should be noted for kidney stones with hyper-production. It is especially a
remedy for respiratory deficiency with audible heartbeat.
Slight fever with gradual weight loss. Gradual emaciation and sub-febrile state. Anorexia. Faintness with
weakness of the legs. Asthenia. Sleepiness, desire to eat, general weakness, rapid pulse.
Throbbing headache and pain going from the left to right mastoid.
Dyspnea, dry cough, painful with bloodstained sputum, difficult to expectorate. Dorsal and lumbar pains, as if
produced by needles. Disorders of the bones of the limbs. The skin is weeping, burning with an itching eruption.
Acrid, abrasive coryza. Tendency to skin tumors.
Abdomen - Diaphragmatic hernia. Chronic pancreatitis. Fibrocystic disease of the pancreas.
Back - Lumbar osteoarthritis. Pain in the back, aggravated by bending head forwards and lying down. Stitching
pain and cold feeling in the dorsal and lumbar region.
Blood - Hyperchromie anemia. Increase of leucocytes. Elevation of calcium. Elevation of total protein.
Elevation of the sedimentation rate. Albumin-Globulin ratio inverted.
Chest - Angina pectoris. Burning pain behind the sternum.
Eyes - Conjunctivitis with photophobia. Catarrhal conjunctivitis. Follicular conjunctivitis.
Face - Facial neuralgia.
Food - Capricious appetite. Anorexia, followed by keen appetite, which improves the condition. Aggravation
from the sight or smell of food from riding in a bus. Aversion to sweets.
Head - Beating or bursting headache, improved by fresh air, lying on the painful side and aggravated by the
least movement. Occipital pain extending to the mastoid. Pain from one mastoid to the other, from left to right.
Heart - Rhythmic anomaly. Rheumatic myocarditis. Sclerous myocarditis. Cardiac palpitations and feeling of
thoracic constriction.
Kidneys - Porphyrins increased in urine.
Limbs - Rheumatism. Pain in the arms as if bruised. Buttocks cold. Clubbed fingers. Blue discoloration of the
hands. Sarcoidosis of the bones. Deposits around the inter-phalangeal joints.
Liver - Liver weakness and deficiency. Acute inflammation of the gallbladder and bile ducts. Chronic
cholecystitis with or without stones.
Lungs - Respiration painful, aggravated by movement. Deep, dry, painful cough, aggravated by bending
backwards, from smoke, better in a very warm room. Sputum streaked with blood. Cyanosis, cough
accelerating the respiratory rhythm. Spasmodic cough with pain behind the sternum. Appearance similar to
tuberculosis or sarcoidosis. Pulmonary sarcoidosis. Pulmonary tuberculosis, early stage. Emphysema.
Tracheitis and bronchitis. Capillary bronchitis. Dilation of the bronchi. Pneumoconiosis.
Modalities - Better from the cold and fresh air. Worse from physical exercise. Worse heat. Worse movement.
Mouth - Lips dry, cracking. Small ulcerations on lips and tip of tongue. Ulcers of the mouth and tongue. Glazed
appearance of the palate. Stomatitis, gingivitis. Lichen planus of the mouth.
Nose - Acute and chronic rhinitis. Seasonal rhinitis, hay fever. Acrid, excoriating coryza, improved in the open
air, aggravated in a warm room. Bruised pain inside the nose.
Rectum - Painful, explosive stool, worse by breathing in.
Skin - Nodules and papules, itching and burning. Development of granulomata and papillomata. Hypodermic
sarcoids. Lichen planus. Eczema. Dermatitis. Erythema nosodum. Tumors, syphilitic, tubercular or parasitic.
Cysts and lipomas.
Stomach - Capricious appetite, nausea at the sight or smell of food and from traveling in a bus.
Temperature - Feverish, goose flesh, shivering, aggravated by the slightest movements.
Throat - Shiny, painful, burning, pain going from left to right mastoid. Constant need to swallow. Stridulous
laryngitis. Chronic non-specific laryngitis. Tubercular laryngitis. Polyps and papilloma of the larynx.
COMMENTS - The extraction of the metal is made from the iron ore, beryl, which is ground and roasted,
usually with sodium fluoro-silicate. The double fluoride of Be and Na thus obtained is transformed into
beryllium oxyfluoride. The metal is isolated by electrolysis in the presence of barium.
Oxidized beryllium can also be treated with sulfuric acid and transformed into Be sulphate from which glucinium
is extracted, the latter can be used directly in the manufacture of alloys or to pure Be after treatment by
ammonium fluoride.
 Workers are exposed at different stages of preparation to the inhalation of fine particles of dust and noxious
fumes, formed particularly by fluoride derivatives as well as derivatives of glucinium.
Beryllium is used in, among other things, the manufacture of light bulbs, radio and TV sets' incandescent
casings, glass making and ceramics and synthetic precious stones.
Accidental poisoning can occur during the crushing process or the thermal treatment necessary to produce
the powders. Chronic berylliosis is essentially caused by its insoluble compounds, especially beryllium, zinc
manganese silicate.
These compounds are dangerous because of their fumes and particularly the dust particles, even at a rate
lower than half a milligram per cubic meter.
The finer dust particles, are particularly noxious. These form veritable aerosols, which spread over a distance
(which explains cases near factories) and which impregnate worker's clothes easily (this explains cases in the
family, resulting from brushing the clothes).
The element causes proliferation in the mesenchyme, which ends in the formation of alveolar granuloma. This
in turn causes difficulty in the diffusion of oxygen through the alveolar walls with subsequent anoxaemia.
The fixation is above all made in the ethmoid bones and is permanent. It is of the same nature and rapidity in
the liver and kidneys, but less prolonged. Elimination is brought about through the urine, at first rapid and
profuse, then slow and sparse.
In a subject who died from berylliosis, Martland showed spectrographically that beryllium was present,
especially in the kidneys and skeleton.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Bry. - Aggravated by movement with a dry, painful cough. (2) Lach. - Failing
from cardiac weakness, suffocation, dry, rending cough.
REFERENCES - Julian.

name: Bismuthum Subnitricum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bism. Bismuthum subnitri- cum. Magistrate of Bismuth. Bismuthum oxidum. Precipitated Sub-
Nitrate of Bismuth. The oxidum of Hahnemann and Kent. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Abdominal surgery, vomiting after. Anemia. Angina pectoris. Cancer. Cholera. Colds. Coughs.
Cystitis. Delirium tremens. Diaphragm, inflamed. Flatulence. Gangrene. Gastralgia. Gastritis. Headaches.
Hemorrhages. Nausea. Nosebleeds. Phlegmasia alba dolens. Stomach, cancer. Stomach, cancer.
Stomach, disorders. Stomatitis. Toothache. Ulcers. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Bismuth, including the sub-nitrate, was used by alchemists to prepare the “Magistrate of
Bismuth. ” According to Teste, Bism. corresponds to slow digestion with fetid belchings. It is hardly ever
indicated where belchings are not odorous or sour.
Bism. exerts its chief action on stomach and alimentary canal, causing irritation and catarrhal inflammation of
the digestive tract.
Gastric disorders with vomiting, purging and prostration. The surface of the patient is generally warm. In
summer complaints of children there is cadaverous smell of flatus or stool. Desires company, child holds on to
its mother's hand.
Gastralgia, not associated with catarrh (Nux-v.). Stomach pain is accompanied by habitual constipation without
vomiting or with vomiting of insipid, ropy mucus. The stools are preceded by crampy, pinching pains in the
stomach.
Cancer of the stomach, nausea after every meal relieved by cold drinks. Water is vomited as soon as it
reaches the stomach, violent belching with aputrid smell. Violent retching and vomiting of bile and brownish
fluid with extreme pain. Burning, griping, sharp with dull pain in back or spasmodic vomiting.
Oppressive anxiety, with a small pulse, vertigo and prostration. Hemorrhage of dark blood. Prostration. Pains
 are tearing, pinching, burning, and screwing. Sensation of heaviness in internal parts. Ailments after abdominal
surgery.
MIND - Apathetic. Fickle minded, begins this, then that, holds but a short time to any one thing. Anguish,
never long in one place or position. Restlessness.
Discontented and dissatisfied. Complains about his condition. Irritability in daytime, better evening. Fear of
being alone on waking. Solitude is unbearable. Desire for company. Children hold on to mother's hand.
Abdomen - Flatulence. Distended abdomen. Abdomen bloated in ridges. Rumbling along colon. Pinching
pain in lower abdomen with rumbling.
Back - Boring and burning pains. Tensive pressure on right side of neck near cervical vertebrae. Pain in left
side of back, as after stooping too long. Pressure in spine better bending backward.
Chest - Angina pectoris, pain around heart, left arm to fingers. Burning and piercing in the chest and back.
Flushes of heat in chest and head. Aching in right half of chest, near sternum. Pressure and squeezing across
the chest. Hot, burning, constriction of the chest.
Ears - Pressure and drawing pains in left external meatus.
Eyes - Aching of the eyeballs. Thickened mucus in both canthi. Secretion of mucus in the corner of the eyes.
Stupor, with mist before the eyes. Foggy, dim vision, during vertigo.
Face - Earthy, blue around the eyes. Aching pain in cheekbones, better running about and holding cold water
in mouth. Face pale and cold. Face pain alternating with gastric pain.
Female - Menstrual blood dark, pitchy.
Food - Intolerable thirst. Craves cold drinks, which are vomited.
Head - Headache alternates with stomach pain. Neuralgic pain, as if torn by pincers involves face and teeth,
worse eating, better cold. Cutting or pressure above right orbit extending to occiput. Headache extending to
the root of nose. Pressure in occiput, worse motion with heaviness. Headaches return in winter. Cutting pain
in brain.
Heart - Angina pectoris, pain around heart, left arm to fingers. Violent heartbeat.
Kidneys - Urine, frequent, watery, copious and pale. Emission of urine entirely suppressed.
Limbs - Cramps in hands and feet. Tearing in wrist. Paralytic weakness, especially in right arm. Tearing in
fingertips under nails (Berb.). Itching erosion near tibia and back of feet near joints. Dry palms and soles. Limbs
cold. Blue color of forearm and thigh.
Lungs - Dyspnea, from burning, constriction in chest. Cough, day and night with copious expectoration.
Pinching in middle of diaphragm, extending transversely through chest. Dark, bloody or blood- streaked.
Male - Aching pains in the testes. Gonorrhea. Nocturnal pollutions without dreams. Pressing, aching in the
(right) testicle. Seminal emissions with lascivious dreams.
Modalities - Better from cold drinks. Better cold applications. Better bending backwards. Worse motion. Worse
from eating, over eating. Worse when alone.
Worse summer, winter.
Mouth - Metallic, sweetish, sour taste on back part of tongue. Taste bitter. Inflammation of mouth, with whitish
excoriations and fissures. Gums swollen. Profuse salivation, teeth loose. Constant secretion of a brownish,
thick saliva. Tongue coated white, swollen. Black, gangrenous looking wedges on dorsum and sides of tongue.
Nose - Nosebleeds, with dark blood. Heaviness at the root of the nose.
Perspiration - Surface covered with warm sweat.
Rectum - Painless discharge of blood from rectum. Cholera infantum, when the body remains warm. Cholera
morbus and summer complaint, when vomiting predominates. Watery diarrhea with a putrid smell.
Painless diarrhea with great thirst and frequent urination and vomiting. Stools papescent, foul, watery, smell
cadaverous. Prostration after stool.
Skin - Burning, smarting in the skin. Ulcers, gangrenous black, bluish. Dry gangrene, parchment-like.
Sleep - Frequent waking, as if in a fright. Sleepy in morning, a few hours after eating. Restless on account of
voluptuous dreams, with or without emissions. Drowsy while working. Starts in sleep, thinks that he is falling,
awakes in a fright. Unrefreshing sleep. Lascivious, vivid dreams, sometimes without, frequently with seminal
emissions.
Stomach - Eructation after drinking. Burning, feeling of a load. Will eat for several days, then vomit. Bilious
vomiting after eating. Slow digestion with fetid belch- ings. Pain from stomach through to spine. Gastritis,
better from cold drinks, but vomiting when stomach becomes full. Stomach pains, better bending backwards.
Pressure as from a load in one spot, alternating with burning, crampy pain and heartburn. Atrophy of stomach.
Stomach hangs down, hard lumps are felt below navel. Nausea after eating or nursing. Nausea and pressure
in stomach after eating, during headache. Stomach cancer, vomiting brownish water. Vomits with convulsive
gagging and pain. Water is
 vomited as soon as it reaches the stomach. Vomits all fluids. Vomiting with vertigo and prostration. Bilious
vomiting, after eating. Vomiting and purging, with great prostration, flatulence, white tongue and cadaverous
stools.
Teeth - Gums swollen, with pain like excoriation. Pressive, pains. Toothache, better from cold water in the
mouth, worse when it becomes warm (Coff.).
Temperature - Chill with deathly coldness of whole body. Chilliness intermittent, periodical. Coldness of the
whole body, externally. Great heat. Flushes of heat, especially on head and chest. Intermittent fever, small
pulse.
Throat - Inflammation of the throat. Burning pain in the throat, sometimes insupportable. Difficult swallowing
of fluids, which return through nose. Sore throat, awaking at night and paining very much, with short cough
and retching. Ulceration of uvula with burning and tearing.
Vertigo - Giddiness in the morning. Vertigo from violent exercise. Vertigo as if the brain were turning in a circle.
Violent vertigo with pressing pain in forehead.
COMMENTS - Grimmer wrote that it's good for stomach cancer, nausea after every meal relieved by cold
drinks, water is vomited as soon as it reaches the stomach. Great affinity for disorders of the right upper limb
or forehead. The patient is restless, moving about, anxiety. Desires company (Phos.).
Violent risings of a putrid smell with violent retching and vomiting of bile and brownish fluid with extreme pain.
Pressing heaviness with stomach pains. Headache alternating with gastralgia.
The pains are chiefly piercing, tearing, burning, cramping and screwing. There are tearing pressing pains in
the bones of the hands and feet, spasmodic disorders Of the muscles of face and limbs.
Sensation of heaviness in inner parts. Oppressive anxiety, small pulse, vertigo and prostration. Hemorrhage,
with dark, pitchy blood. Anemia, with an itch-like eruption. Corrosive itching on side of tibia. Gangrene and
gangrenous ulcers, bluish or dried, parchment-like.
Craves cold drinks, which ameliorate symptoms, but aggravates after it warms up. Cold drinks and cold bathing
improve the headache and toothache. Summer complaints. Headache returning in winter. Motion relieves most
symptoms, but aggravates some headaches. Pressure in spine is better bending backward.
O. W. Smith verified “Pain in stomach, better bending backward and eructation, tasting of food eaten twenty-
four hours before.”
Teste cured with the oxide a wearing, nightly cough in a hysteric woman and a case of sub-acute cystitis with
irregular paroxysms of crampy pains in the bladder, also a case of phlegmasia alba dolens (left). Petroz cured
another such case.
RELATIONS - Antidotes: Nux, Caps., Calc. Bismuth is Antidoted by: Calc., Caps., Coff., Nux-v. Is
isomorphic with: Ant-c., Ars., Phos. Useful after: Euonymus (headache). Compare: (1) Phos. - vomiting, Bism.
vomits immediately, Phos. vomits water as soon as it becomes warm in stomach. (2) Ant-c. - vomiting, white
tongue, gastritis. (3) Ars. - anxiety, gastritis, cancer, gangrene, vomiting. (4) Bell. - gastralgia, cancer, flatus in
ridges. (5) Bry. - toothache, gastritis. (6) Calc., Caps., Chin., Ign., Kali-c., Kreos. (7) Lach. - sore throat, sleep,
ulcers. (8) Lyc., Merc. (9) Nux-v. - gastralgia, urging to stool. (10) Plb. - abdomen in ridges, gastralgia, better
bending backward, heart disease. (11) Puls., Rhus-t. - better by motion. (12) Sep., Sil., Staph.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - blatta-a. Blatta americana. American Cockroach. Periplaneta americana. Kakerlac insignis. N.
O. Orthoptera. Trituration of insect with milk sugar. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Asthma. Dropsy. Jaundice.
HOMEOPATHIC - Mure, who proved Blatta-a., noted that it developed symptoms of jaundice, yellow sclerotics

Blatta-a. has been used as a remedy for dropsy and has a popular reputation in jaundice. Pain shifting from
back to shoulder blade. Acute pain in chest with want of breath (Blatta.). Heat in urethra when urinating

name: Blatta Orientalis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - blatta. Blatta orientalis. Indian Cockroach. Periplaneta orientalis. N. O. Orthoptera. Trituration
of whole insect with milk sugar. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Asthma. Bronchitis. Colds. Coughs. Dyspnea. Emaciation. Obesity. Lockjaw. Lung, disorders.
Lung, weakness. Mucus. Pneumonia. Suffocation. Tuberculosis. Unconsciousness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Blattaorientalis was found accidentally to relieve asthma in a patient who took tea in which
a cockroach had been infused. More effective in low potencies for acute attacks, the higher potencies being
given in the more chronic stages.
Asthma, especially when associated with bronchitis (after Ars., when it is insufficient). Acts best in stout and
corpulent patients. Much pus-like yellow mucus. Threatened suffocation threatened by great accumulation
of mucus.
Asthmatic fits at night, coughs during the day with slight expectoration and hurried breathing.
Bronchitis and tuberculosis, with short- nessofbreath. Cough withdyspnea in bronchitis and tuberculosis.
Chronic bronchitis. Colds that bring on bronchitis with fever, may develop into asthma. Emaciation.
MIND - Anxiety about health.
Chest - Chronic inflammation of bronchial tubes.
Constitutions - Obesity, suited to corpulent people. Malarial cases and cases worse in rainy weather.
Asthmatic constitutions.
Limbs - Weakness in hollow of knee.
Lungs - Severe chronic asthma. Shortness of breath. Difficult breathing, better from expectoration.
Suffocation from great accumulation of mucus. Purulent tough, viscid, yellow mucus. Cough with
dyspnea. Pneumonia. Bronchitis and tuberculosis. Spasmodic cough at short intervals with slight
expectoration.
Modalities - Worse from dust. Worse during the rain. Worse winter
COMMENTS - Asthma with a lot of mucus and rattling, yellow brown phlegm (Nat-s.). Bronchitis with yellow
mucus, difficulty breathing. Keynote worse dust (Sil.), sensitivity to dust (Poth.), especially in dry climates.
Great oppression of the chest, “as if a weight or a heaviness on the chest,” with asthma. “Feeble lungs,” totally
inability to expectorate the thick, yellow mucus (Hydr.).
Easier breathing with head bend forward or supporting head with elbows while sitting. Must sit up in bed. Loud,
coarse wheezing, like a saw through pinewood. Spasmodic, debilitatingcoughs.Greatfearof suffocation and
dying. Lack of ambition to live, great weariness in this remedy.
Clammy, cold sweat. General swelling of the body. Tends to stooped shoulders, barrel-chest. Bronchial
spasms. Locked jaws. Unconsciousness.
Used in tuberculosis epidemics, especially the last stages. Characteristic lung weakness, the doctor would
have to put their ear next to the person's mouth to hear the case (Stann.).
Aggravated at 9:00 p.m. (Cham., Bell.).
Dr. Ray recorded a case, one of the first for this remedy, in which a man had a 25-year history of severe
asthma cured with Blatta. He was emaciated, had nightly attacks, troublesome cough and very frothy mucus.
Worse lying down. Stooped shoulders and a stiff neck. Despaired, feeble, could not expectorate, speechless,
so weak he could not talk (Stann.).
Anshutz recorded 4 cases concerning the use of Blatta. The first, “A young man, aged thirty-four, had been
suffering from asthma for some years. He was invariably worse during the rains and the winter and chronic
bronchitis was almost a constant accompaniment. He tried allopathic and lots of patent drugs with only
temporary amelioration of the trouble. At last in November, 1888, he came to my office.
“On examination of his chest I found there was a chronic bronchitis. He said that slight difficulty of breathing
with hacking cough used to trouble him every night, besides a cold would be followed by a severe attack of
asthma, so its periodicity of recurrence was irregular. 1 treated him with Ipecac, Arsenicum alb., etc. The first-
named medicine did him the most good, but he never got entirely well.
“In July, 1889 I put him under tincture Blatta orientalis 3x, drop doses, three or four times daily. Under its use
he began to improve steadily and had only two or three attacks of asthmatic fits since he used this drug, which
were promptly relieved by the same drug in lx potency.
“Euphrasia off. was prescribed for his cold whenever he had it. He is free from all trouble for the last year and
 a half. His general condition is so much changed that there is no apprehension of the recurrence of his former
illness.”
The second case, “A shoemaker, aged forty-two, robust constitution, has been suffering with asthma for three
or four years. He came to my office on the 6th of November, 1890. He had been getting asthmatic fits almost
every night since October last. During the day a troublesome cough comes with slight expectoration and
hurried breathing,
made him unable to attend his business.
“Tincture Blatta orientalis lx, one drop doses, six times daily, was given. The very first day he perceived the
good effect of the medicine and continued the same for a month, when he got well and discontinued the
medicine. He has been keeping well ever since.”
Anshutz's third case concerned “A gentleman, the keeper of a common shop, aged forty-four, belonging to a
village, had been suffering from asthma for the last eight years and had always been under treatment of native
kabiraj (medical men). In June, he came to the city and I was called to see him on the 14th of June to treat him
for his asthma. The day previous he had an attack, for which he took no medicine. Each of his attacks usually
lasted four or five days.
“I gave him Blatta orientalis 1 x trituration., one grain every two hours and left him six such powders to be taken
during the day. He took them and felt better the next day. He stayed here two or three days more and when
well he wanted to proceed home, which was some couple of hundred miles.
“He took with him two drachm phials of Blatta orientalis, one of lx and the other of 3x trituration. He continued
the 3x, one grain doses, two or three times daily, for a month and discontinued afterward. He had no more
asthmatic fits.
“In January last, 1891,1 had a letter from him, thanking me for his recovery and asking for some of the same
medicine for a friend of his, who had been suffering from asthma. The friend of his who used the same drug,
Blatta orientalis, was equally benefited.”
The fourth case, “Mrs. Datta, a thin lady, aged thirty-eight, mother of several children, had been exposed to
cold, which brought on an attack of bronchitis with fever. This in the course of a fortnight, developed into a
regular fit of asthma.
“She was all this time treated by an old school physician, but when the husband of the lady saw that she was
daily getting worse and a new disease crept in, he made up his mind to change the treatment, I was called to
see her in the morning of the 8th of June, 1890.
“She became very much emaciated, could not take any food, had fever with acute bronchitis, hurried
respiration, difficulty of breathing, this she was complaining of bitterly, owing to which she could not lie down
in bed, but had to sit up day and night. There was a prolonged fit of spasmodic cough at short intervals with
slight expectoration, but these coughing fits would make her almost breathless.
“This was the first time I prescribed Blatta orientalis lx in a case of asthma with fever and acute bronchitis. It
answered my purpose well. She had only ten powders during the day and passed a comparatively better night.
“Next morning when I saw her she was better except the coughing fits, which were continuing as before. The
same medicine was repeated. On the 10th of June she had no asthmatic trouble at night, but there was not
much improvement in her cough, Ant-t. and Bry. were needed to complete the cure.”
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ars., Hydr. (2) Puls., Sil., Kali-s.
REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

name: Boletus Laricis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bol. Boletus laricis. White agaric. Boletus purgans. Agaricus laricis. Larch agaric. Polyporus
 officinale. N. O. Fungi. Trituration. Tincture of the dried mushroom. Historical dose: Trituration and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Chills. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Faintness. Fever. Gallbladder, disorders. Headaches. Intermittent
fever. Liver disorders.
HOMEOPATHIC - Burt proved the crude substance and the third trituration. The gastroenteric irritation
common to the fungus was very well marked. Motion will aggravate the headache. Disposition to yawn and
stretch when chilly. Great resdessness after midnight. Faintness after stool. Aching distress in all joints.
MIND - Very gloomy and despondent. Irritated at the least trifle. Absent-minded.
Abdomen - Aching in liver and umbilicus. Severe cutting pains in abdomen every few minutes. Dull, aching
distress in umbilicus and loud rumbling in bowels all night. Severe, aching pain just below stomach, causing
great faintness.
Back - Chilliness along spine with frequent hot flashes of fever. Dull, aching distress in back and legs.
Eyes - Agglutination of eyelids morning with dull, aching pains in eyeballs.
Face - Hot and flushed with severe frontal headache. Hands hot and dry.
Head - Head feeling very light and hollow with deep frontal headache and great faintness.
Liver - Heavy dragging pains in liver, more in right lobe. Dull, burning distress, drawing, aching in right lobe of
liver with frontal headache. Sharp cutting pains in right lobe of liver and whole dorsal region on full inspiration.
Sharp cutting pains near gallbladder. Burning distress in region of gallbladder all afternoon with sharp pains in
stomach and heavy aching in liver.
Mouth - Teeth and gums very sore.
Perspiration - Profuse perspiration at night with hectic chills and fever. Sweat is light and without relief.
Night-sweat in tuberculosis.
Rectum - Thin, yellow pasty stool, mixed with something looking like oil in large and small drops. Black, lumpy,
dry stools mixed with bile, blood and mucus, with high fever. Lienteric. Straining after stool.
Skin - Hot and dry, especially in palms. Itching more between scapulae and on forearms.
Stomach - Constant nausea and vomiting. Feeling in fauces as if would vomit. Great faintness at epigastrium.
Severe cutting pains in stomach.
Temperature - Quotidian intermittent fever. Chilliness along spine with frequent, hot flashes. Y awns and
stretches when chilly. Severe aching in shoulders andjoints and small of back. Waking at midnight in a profuse
perspiration.
Tongue - White coat, thick yellow coat showing marks of teeth. Taste is flat, coppery, unnatural of all food,
lost.
COMMENTS - Anshutz noted two cases. The first consisted of a case of fever. “Intermittent fever: Type
Quotidian Duplex. In a large lymphatic woman, weight about 180 lbs., aged thirty-nine. November 4th. For the
last five weeks has had the ague. At first it was simple quotidian. Took quinine, which broke it for four days,
when it returned took quinine in massive doses, which checked it for one week.
“It returned two weeks since in the form of a double quotidian. The chill comes on every day at 10 a.m. and 5
p.m. The chill lasts from one to two hours each time, hands and feet get icy cold, chills run up and down the
spine with severe pains in the head, back and limbs, followed by high fever for three hours and then profuse
sweat.
“Tongue furred whitish yellow with large fissures in the tongue, flat, bitter taste, has had no appetite for five
weeks, craves cold water all the time, bowels rather costive, has nausea during every chill, but no vomiting,
very weak, can only sit up about one hour in the morning.
Great depression, cried during the whole examination, face very much jaundiced.
“Treatment: Ars. 2c, every two hours, for three days. It produced constant nausea and lessened the chills, but
aggravated the fever. I then determined to try the Boletus 1c, two grains every two hours .Took two doses
when the chills came on, she then ceased to take the medicine until 5 p.m.
Took three doses and then fell asleep. 8th. She says she is feeling a little Better continued treatment, 10 a.m.,
commenced to have a severe diarrhea, an effect of the medicine, discontinued the powders until 5 p.m.
“The fever did not come on until 3 p.m., had no chill, fever lasted three hours, perspired profusely all night,
slept well for the first time in a number of weeks. 9th. Feeling much better. Fever came on at 4 p.m., had no
chill, fever lasted four hours, nausea all the evening, sweat all night. 10th. Feeling quiet well. Had no more
fever, but had night sweats for a week after. Convalescence was very slow, she had no more fever it was three
weeks before she felt perfectly well.
“This case demonstrated the fact to us that the Boletus is superior to our greatest remedial agents in the case
of intermittent fevers. I believe if I had not been acquainted with the therapeutic properties of the Boletus I
would have been compelled to treat this lady every few weeks for two or three months with our usual remedies.”
 His second case, “Intermittent fever: Type quotidian. November first, Mrs. B., aged fifty-six. Temperament
nervous. Three weeks since had an abscess in left ear, which made her quite sick for a week.
“Since then has had fever every afternoon and night. Feels chilly whenever she moves. Walking produces
nausea. Does not perspire any. Tongue coated white. Loss of appetite, bowels loose. Very restless at night,
cannot sleep any, getting very weak, keeps to her bed most of the time. Gave Boletus laricis. She had the
fever but one day after.”
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Boletus luridus. Boletus satanus. Cocc. (head hollow). (2) Agaricin, active
constituent of Polyporus officinale - tubercular and other enervating
night-sweats 1-4 to 1-2 grains doses, also in chorea in dilatation of heart with pulmonary emphysema, fatty
degeneration, profuse perspiration and erythema.
REFERENCES - Anshutz. Clarke.

name: Boletus Satanus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bol-s. Boletus satanas. N. O. Fungi. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Cramps. Debility. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Faintness. Vomiting. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - There are two fragmentary provings of this fungus and observations on six persons
poisoned. It produces gastro-intestinal disturbances very similar to its two relatives.
Dysentery, vomiting, great debility. Faintness while vomiting. Cold sweat over whole body. Cold limbs, spasm
of limbs and face. Sudden sensation through all his limbs as if he would be attacked with a stroke. Violent and
extremely painful cramps in the muscles of the limbs and face.
MIND - Fear and restlessness.
Abdomen - Obstinate tension of abdomen. Sunken and frightfully painful abdomen.
Eyes - Sparks before eyes, alternating with obscure vision.
Mouth - Troublesome dryness in mouth and throat.
Rectum - A profuse diarrhea of blood and of the mucus lining of the intestines. Watery evacuations.
Stomach - Unquenchable thirst. Sudden desire to vomit, no nausea between attacks. Vomited twenty times
in three hours. Frightful pain in stomach.
Throat - Violent burning and scraping in throat.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Bombyx Processionea
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bomb-pr. Bombyx processionea. Procession Moth. Thaumetopoea processionnea. N. O.
Lepidoptera. Tincture of caterpillars. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Delirium. Fever. Itching. Tubercles. Urticaria.
HOMEOPATHIC - Contact with the caterpillars or the emanations from a nest of them causes intense irritation.
Large, hard tubercles with a red areola formed, so thick as to leave hardly any space between. Sometimes
they are formed in a linear manner, most marked near joints.
In one case, that of a boy who shook a large number of the caterpillars from a tree onto his naked breast, it
caused an itching so severe that the boy had to run home for assistance, then fever, somnolence, delirium and
finally death ensued.
Burning heat of skin. Sensation as if a foreign body were under the skin. Itching of whole body. Itching, in
evenings, not relieved by anything. In one victim it caused frequent waking at night and dreams that his arms
were being cauterized and arrows thrust into the muscles.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Apis, Astac. fl., Rhus-t.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Borax Veneta
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bor. Borax veneta. Sodium biborate. Natrum biboracicum. Trituration and solution. Historical
dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Aphthae. Aphthous, ulcers. Chilblains. Colic. Collapse. Coms. Coryza. Cystitis.
Dentition. Diarrhea. Dysmenorrhea. Ear, discharge. Emaciation. Entropion.Erysipelas. Ey es, disorders.
Finger, joints. Finger, ulcers. Galactorrhea. Headache. Hematuria. Herpes, simplex. Herpes zoster. Infertility.
Leucorrhea. Marasmus. Menstruation, painful. Nephritis. Nipples, sore. Nose, disorders. Pleurisy. Pleurodynia.
Plica, polonica. Psoriasis. Screaming. Seasickness. Sore, throat. Taste, disordered. Thrush. Trichinosis.
Ulcers. Urine, offensive. Vertigo.
HOMEOPATHIC - The nervous symptoms are very characteristic and have frequently been verified, especially
in the therapeutics of children. Useful in epilepsy. Sensitiveness to sudden noises, as a distant shot, which
causes violent starting. Gastro-intestinal irritation. Eructation, when painful parts are pressed.
Dread of downward motion in nearly all complaints. Symptoms are worse going down stairs. Seasickness
when the downward motion is felt most: “Every time the ship goes down, everything in me comes up.” Child
screams when nurse puts it into cot or when she rocks it.
Aphthous mouth ulcers of the mucus membranes. Thrush. Herpes of the mouth. Salivation, nausea,
vomiting. Aphthae, mouth of child feels hot to mother's nipple, child lets go nipple and cries with pain and
vexation, or else refuses breast altogether.
Painful nursing, pain after nursing, empty feeling in breasts, they ache because they are empty, keynote better
by pressure. Mother's milk is thick and tastes badly. Poorly nourished, soft and flabby, children. General
emaciation. Marasmus.
Skin and mucus membranes shriveled. Child screams before urinating from inflam-
mation of mucus membrane. Colic, diarrhea, collapse, albuminuria, casts and bladder spasms. Diarrhea with
pain or soft yellow stools accompanying aphthae. Hematuria.
Discharges are thick, hot, biting. Clear, copious, albuminous, unnaturally hot leu- corrhea. Favors easy
conception. Infants cyanotic from birth.
Heat in single parts, mouth, vagina, palms etc. Sticking or drawing pains internal intercostal, soles etc. Skin
eruptions. Parts which are usually red turn white. Sensation of cobweb, on hands, face. Restlessness in
afternoon. Delirium, visual changes.
MIND - Great anxiety and sleepiness. Dread of downward motion, causes anxiety. Afraid of
falling.Excessively nervous, easily frightened. Fear of thunder. Fear of being infected by some contagious
disease. Fear of falling.
Sensitive to sudden noises. Startles from hearing bad news or from excitement. Easily frightened and
startled with least noise. Frightened easily at sneezing. Starting at hawking, at sneezing. Oversensitive to
noise during labor. Violent fright from sound of a gun, even at a distance.
Fretful, ill-humored, ipdolent and discontented. Irritability. Fault finding. Changes from one business to another
from one room to another. Confusion, better after stool. Disposition to be angry, with ill humor and passion.
Becomes vehement and swears. Does not wish to do anything. Dread of labor.
Fidgety, fickle. Irritable before stool, cheerful and happy after. Babies cry and scream, when nursing or before
passing stool or urine. Children awake, suddenly, scream, hold the sides of cradle without any apparent cause.
All the mental symptoms are better at 11 p.m. Laughing alternating with weeping.
Abdomen - Colic with tendency to diarrhea after smoking tobacco. Accumulation of flatus in the abdomen,
and frequent escape of wind. After every meal inflation of the abdomen with diarrhea and colic. Belly soft,
flabby, sunken. Distention after eating, vomiting. Pain as if diarrhea would set in. Pulling from spleen to chest.
Catch in
groin on coughing. Stitching pains in the groins before or during menses.
Back - Pain in back, inability to stoop. Sharp and drawing pains between the shoulder blades. Furunculus in
the armpit. Itching and crawling, aching or burning in the sacrum, when seated or stooping.
Breasts - Galactorrhea, flow of milk, which curdles speedily (Calc., Con.. Bell.). When nursing, pain in
opposite breast. Empty feeling in breasts after child nurses with stitches better compressing. Mother’s milk is
thick and tastes badly. Aphthae so tender they prevent child nursing.
Chest - Pain in chest, better lying on back, washing with cold water, or pressure. Sharp pains in chest with
inspiration and cough. Pleurodynia, worse upper part of right chest. Sticking pain in chest (intercostal), worse
coughing, inspiration, yawning or any physical exertion. Sneezing with violent shootings in right side of the
chest.
Constitutions - Suited to the period of dentition, to persons with light hair, lax skin and muscles, wrinkled skin,
consequences of getting cold in cold and wet weather, riding, or eating fruit.
 Ears - Inflammation and swelling of the ears. Shootings in the ears, with pain as of excoriation. Very sensitive
to slightest noise, not so much disturbed by louder ones. Buzzing and murmuring in the ears. As if ear opened
and closed.
Eyes - Itching in the eyes. Redness about eyes. Pressure on the eyes. Eyelashes turn inward. Entropion.
Gummy, crusty, sticky eyelids. Granular eyelids. Eyelids inflamed, lids cut against eyeball. Visions of bright
waves. Sparkling before the eyes when writing. Sensitivity to candlelight.
Face - Erysipelas in face. Pale, earthy with suffering expression. Swollen with pimples on nose and lips. Puffy
face, bluish in infants. Cobweb sensation. As of a bug crawling over lip. Anxious during downward motion.
Female - Labor pains with frequent belch- ings. Leucorrhea, like egg whites, with sensation as if warm water
was flowing. Menses too soon, profuse, with gripping.
nausea and pain in stomach extending into the small of back. Membranous dysmenorrhea. Itching of vulva
and eczema. Sensation of distention in clitoris with sticking. Indifference to sex. Infertility. Easy conception.
Food - Appetite moderate, especially at supper. Loss of taste. Thirst in the morning. Desire for acid drinks,
sour things.
Head - Headache, with shootings in the ears. Headache with nausea and trembling of the whole body. Fullness
in the head, and pressure above the eyes. Hot head in babies. Hair tangled, cannot be separated, as in plica
polonica (Vine.).
Heart - Violent palpitations. Feels as if on right side and being squeezed. Infants cyanotic from birth.
Kidneys - Nephritis. Cystitis. Urgent inclination to urinate. Frequent emission of urine even in the night.
Ineffectual urge to urinate. Hot acrid, smarting urine of pungent smell. Child afraid to urinate, screams before
urinating (Sars.). Small red particles on diaper.
Limbs - Want of strength, especially in joints. Limbs tremble at 10 a. m. As if warm water running down thighs.
Weakness in calves. Sharp pains in sole. Pain in heel. Burning pain in great toe, inflammation of balls of toes.
Eczema of toes and fingers with loss of nails. Feeling as of cobwebs on hands. Palms hot. Itching on back of
finger joints and hands. Throbbing pain in tip of thumb.
Lungs - Shortness of breath, worse ascending stairs, stitches on speaking. Arrest of breathing when lying, is
obliged to jump and catch breath, which causes pain in right side. Dry, hectic cough, caused by a tickling and
scraping in the throat. Hacking and violent cough. Expectoration, blood streaked or moldy taste and smell.
Male - Indifference to sex, low sexual desire. Erections, with painful tension, on waking in the morning.
Gonorrhea. Chancres studding prepuce. Sticking, sore pain, worse when touched.
Modalities - Better at 11 p.m., evening, cold weather, pressure. Worse from downward or upward motion,
rocking,
being dangled up and down. Worse from cold, wet. Worse least uncovering. Worse warm weather. Worse fruit.
Worse smoking. Worse after menses.
Mouth - Mouth hot and tender. Aphthous ulcers in the mouth and on the tongue, which bleed easily. Aphthous
after taking sour or salty food. Oral thrush. White fungus-like growth. Dry cracked or puffy indented tongue.
Bitter taste in the mouth on eating or on swallowing the saliva (Bry., Puls., Cupr.). Palate, hard and wrinkled,
as if burnt, pains when chewing, while nursing in children.
Nose - Itching in the nose with tingling. Acrid coryza. Nostrils ulcerated. Dry scabs in the nose. Sneezing.
Stoppage of nostrils alternately with lachrymation. Red nose of young women (Nat-c.). Red and shining
swelling with throbbing and tensive sensation. Tip swollen and ulcerated. Blood follows on blowing the nose.
Accumulation of thick and greenish mucus in the nose.
Perspiration - Perspiration during the morning sleep.
Rectum - Burning in rectum during stool. Pain as if diarrhea would result. Stools, turning green or persistently
green like boiled starch. Mucus diarrhea, then weakness. Loose, pasty, offensive stools in children. Stools
slender. Diarrhea offensive, preceded by colic, mucus stools with aphthous sore mouth.
Skin - Unhealthy skin, slight injuries suppurate. Wilted, wrinkled skin. Skin, dry, festers easily, won't heal.
Psoriasis. Eruptions on fingers and hands, itching and stinging eczema. Whitish pimples with areola.
Ulcerations on feet from rubbing of shoe or boots. Herpes (Nat-m., Rhus-t.). Erysipelatous inflammation with
swelling and tension. Chilblains relieved in open air.
Sleep - Anxious cries of children during sleep with convulsive movements of the hands. Child cries out in
sleep, as if frightened (Bell.). Voluptuous dreams, dreams of sex. Cannot sleep on account of heat, especially
in head. Starts from deep as if to fall. Sleepiness during the
day and sleeplessness at night.
Stomach - Fullness and pressure in the stomach after having eaten fruit, pears and apples. Gastralgia, reflex
from uterine troubles. Belchings, on pressing painful part. Nausea, when thinking hard with trembling of body
and weakness of knees. Vomiting of sour mucus after drinking. Pain in the region of stomach after heavy lifting.
 Stitching, extending to small of back. Sweat on stomach.
Teeth - Toothache, worse wet weather, better by smoking. Shooting pains in decayed teeth. Pressive tingling
in the teeth, immediately after supper or breakfast. Ulcers in the gums with swelling of the cheek. Bleeding
gums. Painful gumboil.
Temperature - Flushes of heat. Shivering, shuddering or cold with trembling. Chilliness especially during
sleep. Thirst before or during the cold, or else after the sweat. Heat in the evening in bed, with shivering on
being the least uncovered.
Throat - Dryness in the throat. Hoarseness in the throat with drawing shootings on coughing and sneezing.
Tenacious mucus in the throat with difficult expectoration.
Vertigo - Fits of vertigo with fainting. Vertigo, with fullness in the head. Vertigo, worse from ascending stairs
or any elevation.
COMMENTS - A piece of borax, the size of a pea, dissolved in the mouth, acts magically in restoring the voice
in cases of sudden hoarseness brought on by cold and frequently for an hour or so, it renders the voice silvery
and clear. It has even cured “shot-shyness ’’ in sporting dogs.
Herpetic eruptions, pleuritic symptoms (upper right chest) and cough with expectoration of a mushy, moldy
odor. Parts usually red turn white. White fungus-like growths. Stitching pains predominate. Starts with pain.
Cobweb sensations. Restlessness with ebullitions, especially after talking with nausea.
Sore muco-cutaneous surfaces. Ingrown eyelashes. Otorrhea and inflammation of auricle, “starts with the
pains.” Nostrils ulcerated, soreness, pain and swelling of
tip of nose. For oral thrush, oral candida. Aphthous ulcers, round and white, like canker sores. Thrush in AIDS
cases, with or without aphthous ulcers.
Dysmenorrhea with excessive pain during flow. Leucorrhea preceding and following menses, albuminous,
acrid (Graph.).
For infected or cracked nipples while nursing. For babies with sores from nursing (Nat-m., and Sul-ac.), hot
and burning. Diaper rash, ulcers and sores around the rectum, candida rashes of the anus. Diarrhea, offensive
stools, excoriating. Child screams out in sleep, wakes frightened and clinging.
Laughter alternating with weeping. Idles through the afternoon, does not really get to work, changes from one
business to another from one room to another. Fretful, ill humored, indolent and discontented before easy stool
in the afternoon, after it, lively, contented and cheerful. Excessively nervous, a slight noise arouses. Patients
tend to pale, earthy, fleshy and flabby.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Cham., Coffea. Compare: (1) Calc., Bry., Nux-v., Bry., Lyc., Merc., Puls., Rhus-
t, All-c., Sil., Sanícula, Sulph., Sulphuric acid. (2) Ars., Bell., Graph., Ign., Kali-bi., Phos. (3) Am-c. and Mag-
m. - right nostril stopped. (4) Calc. - inclination to breathe deeply. (5) Kali-bi. - tough mucus. (6) Aur. and Puls.
- laughter alternately with weeping. (7) Sars., Lyc. (8) Benz-ac. - strong urine, crying before urination, but these
three have gravel: with Borax it is from inflammation of mucus membrane. (9) Arum-t. - sore mouth, Graph. -
trichiasis. (10) Bell. - hot leucorrhea. (11) Sep. - small ulcers about joints. (12) Bar-c. - cobweb-sensation. (13)
Nat-s. - cheerful after stool. Incompatible: Acet-ac., Vinegar, Wine.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Boric Acidum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bor-ac. Boricum acidum. Boric acid. Solution of crystals in alcohol. Historical dose: Trituration
and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Antiseptic. Colds. Conjunctivitis. Dermatitis. Diabetes. Dermatitis. Edema. Erythema. Eyes,
disorders. Headache. Impetigo. Edema. Menopausal, flushings. Kidney colic. Vomiting. Whitlow. Wounds.
HOMEOPATHIC - Bor-ac. has been largely used as an antiseptic dressing for wounds, as a lotion for the eyes
and whitlow, and as a wash in catarrh of the bladder. Arrests fermentation and putrefaction. It is much less
irritating than Carbolic acid, but it has also produced skin eruptions.
Bor-ac. affects the skin causing an extensive exfoliative dermatitis.
Pain along ureters with frequent urination. Edema around the eyes. Diabetes. Tongue dry, red and cracked.
Coldness (Helo.). Cold saliva. Vagina cold as if packed with ice. Useful in menopausal flushing.
Eyes - Conjunctivitis. Edema of tissues around eyes.
Female - Menopausal flushings (Lach., Amyl-n.). Vaginal coldness, as if packed with ice.
Kidneys - Frequent urination with burning and tenesmus.
Modalities - Better from walking in open air.
Skin - Exfoliating dermatitis. Multiform erythema of trunk and upper limbs.
COMMENTS - Poisonings and provings with Bor-ac. have caused headache, vertigo, noises in the ears,
 prostration, cold saliva, vomiting of tough, greenish stuff, uncontrollable vomiting, hiccough, pasty stool, pain
in region of ureters or increased urine and increased call to urinate, albuminuria, and an erythematous eruption
on face, body and thighs followed by pearly vesicles on face and neck.
Three cases of poisoning have been reported from packing the vagina with the dry acid, kept in by tampons
until liquefaction took place. Symptoms included formication
of hands and feet, later of face.
Sad spirits, great nervous depression. Burning skin, became swollen and charred and all motions were painful.
One case went into collapse, temperature subnormal, sighing and weeping by turns. Prominent coldness,
vagina felt “cold as if packed with ice.”
In the 3x potency. Cooper found it give great relief in menopausal flushings.
One woman took 30 grains of boric acid per day for a month, when there appeared a multiform erythema of
trunk extending to upper limbs, at the same time there appeared a painful swelling of upper lids with
conjunctivitis and photophobia.
Finally the edema was so intense as to close the eyes and give the appearance of sclerosed tissue. The
symptoms began to abate when the Bor-ac. was discontinued and disappeared in a week.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Bor., Carb-ac. (2) Kali-bi. - tough mucus.
REFERENCES - Boericke.

name: Boron Metallicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bor-met. Boron metallicum. Boron metal. Historicaldose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Anemia. Aphthae. Arthritis. Bronchitis. Conjunctivitis. Constipation. Cystitis. Diarrhea. Ear,
infections. Eczema. Epilepsy. Gastritis. Herpes. Joint pains. Leucorrhea. Mastitis. Motion sickness. Nausea.
Osteoporosis. Parkinson's disease. Sterility. Vertigo. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Retarded development, late walking, late talking, late being toilet trained. Growth disorders.
Hair tangled. Nails drop off. Anemia.
Dizziness with feeling of falling backwards or sliding down, as if in a lift. Parkinson's disease. Epilepsy. Watery,
sometimes green discharges.
MIND - Mentally confused. Slow mind. Disoriented. Lack of concentration. Forgetful. Dementia. Confusion of
identity. Sympathetic. Obsessive behavior. Psychosis caused by stress. Delirium.
Nervous, and restless. Timid, unsure of themselves. Indecisive. Low self confidence. Fear of failing. Doubts
oneself. Easily discouraged. Desire support from others. Listless and apathetic. Gloomy disposition. Suicidal.
Startled easily from sudden noises. Vague fears. Fear of the unknown. Fear of diseases, infections, germs.
Fear of death. Fear of going down stairs. Delusions voices that tell them who they are and what they should
do.
Bladder - Cystitis. Inflammations of bladder. Bladder spasms.
Breasts - Mastitis. Inflammation of breasts, pain on the opposite side from the one the baby is suckling from.
Late birth, child prefers the right breast.
Chest - Sharp pains in chest.
Ears - Ear infections. Sensitive to noises.
Eyes - Conjunctivitis. Inverted eyelids.
Face - Face pale, tip of nose red.
Female - Menses frequent, profuse, with stomach andback pains. Sterility. Clitoris painful and swollen,
eczema. Leucorrhea white, sticky and stringy. Leucorrhea like egg-white. Sexually immature. Low estrogen
levels.
Food - Aversion to lettuce, fruit, meat, vegetables. Desires apples, pears, potatoes, sweet, cheese, bread.
Worse from fruit, pears, bananas, wine, coffee, sour, salt, coffee. Worse fats.
Kidneys - Crying before urination. Urine contains blood and protein.
Limbs - Osteoporosis. Joint pains. Pain at tip of thumb, soles and ball of feet.
Lungs - Bronchitis. Hard cough. Sharp pains in lungs. Lungs feel as if pressed in.
Male - Atrophy of testes. Sexually immature. Low testosterone levels.
Modalities - Better after stools and urination. Better crying. Worse loud noises. Worse 8 am. Worse downward
motion. Worse going down stairs. Worse elevators. Worse chlorine. Worse cold weather. Worse damp
weather. Worse thunder.
Mouth - Infections in mouth, aphthae, thrush. Herpes on lips. Salivation aggravates. Taste and smell of fungus.
Fissured tongue, red and bleeding. Fungus taste.
Rectum - Constipation. Diarrhea. Stools soft with mucus.
Skin - Cobweb sensation on skin. Eczema around mouth, on cheeks, fingers and toes.
 Sleep - Sleeps a long time. Talking during sleep.
Stomach - Gastritis. Inflammations of the stomach. Stomach acidity. Nauseaon exertion. Vomiting. Motion
sickness.
Vertigo - Dizziness with feeling of falling backwards or sliding down, as if in a lift.
REFERENCES - Scholten.

name: Bothrops Lanceolatus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - both-1. Bothrops lanceolatus. Yellow viper. Lachesis lanceolatus. Vipera jaune. Fer-de-lance.
N. O. Crotalide. Martinique Island. Solution of the poison in glycerin. Potencies in rectified spirit. Historical
dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL-Abscesses. Amaurosis. Anthrax. Aphasia. Blindness. Blood, clots. Bones, necrosis. Day-
blindness. Edema. Emaciation. Erysipelas. Gangrene. Hematemesis. Hemiplegia. Hemorrhages. Lockjaw.
Lungs, congestion. Lymphangitis. Nervous, trembling. Paralysis. Phlebitis. Pulmonary, congestion. Septic,
fever. Septicemia. Snake, bites. Thrombosis. Trembling. Tongue, paralysis. Wounds.
HOMEOPATHIC - The venom of the yellow viper is a coagulant, therefore it is expected to be useful in
thrombosis and thrombotic disorders.
After being bitten in the little finger of one hand, paralysis began in the fingertips of the other hand and extended
over the whole of that side. Intolerable pain in right great toe (patient bitten in left thumb). Marked diagonal
course of symptoms.
Ozanam noted some peculiar symptoms, including amaurosis. Day blindness, can scarcely see her way after
sunrise. Deep gangrene, dissecting, bones laid bare and necrotic.
Bothrops lanceolatus
Hemorrhages from every orifice of the body. Black spots. Blindness from hemorrhage into retina.
Pulmonary congestion, oppressed breathing and bloody expectoration. more or less profuse. Hemorrhages
from the wounds.
Great lassitude and sluggishness. Nervous trembling. Syncope. Sudden or rapid debility and emaciation. Slight
shivering, followed by profuse sweat. Aphasia, inability to articulate, without any tongue problems. Hemiplegia,
with aphasia. Paralysis of one arm or one leg only.
MIND - Persistent hypochondriasis. Mental symptoms after having a stroke. Behaves as if he had a stroke.
Aphasia, inability to articulate. Forgetful of words while speaking. Mistakes, using wrong words. Stupefaction,
as if intoxicated. Anguish. Stupor, syncope. Unconsciousness, coma.
Abdomen - Tympanitis.
Back - Opisthotonos.
Blood - Septicemia. Hemorrhages from every orifice of the body. Blood being fluid and black.
Lymphangitis. Dissecting gangrene. Blood clots. Thrombosis.
Constitutions - Broken-down and hemorrhagic constitutions, septic states.
Eyes - Conjunctival hemorrhage. Blindness from hemorrhage into retina. Day- blindness. Amaurosis without
any notable pupillary dilatation.
Face - Swollen and puffy. Besotted expression. Swollen, injected, cyanotic. Lockjaw.
Head - Hemicrania, stupor, vertigo. Migraine headaches. One-sided headaches.
Heart - Heart pains. Precordial pains, syncope. Frequent, tight pulse.
Kidneys - Hematuria.
Limbs - Abscess, leg. Edema. Heaviness, lower limbs. Paralysis of the right leg. Paralysis of the right arm.
Muscular tissues are filled with black blood. Numbness. Phlebitis. Consecutive necrosis. Suppuration, leg.
Varicose veins. Leg is badly infected after surgery for varicose veins. Swollen veins. Gangrene, toes, legs.
Gangrenous ulcers.
Lungs - Bloody expectoration, pneumonia. Pulmonary congestion, oppressed breathing and bloody
expectoration, more or less profuse. Spitting of blood.
Modalities - Worse on right side.
Mouth - Trismus. Aphasia, inability to articulate words, while the tongue retains all its functions.
Nerves - Hemiplegia. Nervous, trembling.
Perspiration - Clammy sweats. Profuse sweats. Chills with abundant sweats. Abundant cold sweats at the
beginning and end of the malady.
Rectum - Tympanitis and bloody stools.
Skin - Formication and itching. Burning pains. Skin bluish, as from deep and extensive contusion. Skin yellow,
as in yellow fever. Blackish skin. Swollen, livid skin, cold with hemorrhagic infiltration. Anthrax. Gangrene.
 Lymphatics swollen. Malignant erysipelas. Septic wounds and ulcers. Scars, bleeding and break open.
Wounds heal slowly.
Sleep - Tendency to sleep, somnolence; coma, deeper and deeper until death.
Stomach - Intense hematemesis. Epigastric distress. Nausea and vomiting. Black vomiting. Gastric mucosa
is red and dotted.
Temperature - Septic fever. Coldness. General heat. Chills with abundant sweats.
Throat - Red, dry, constricted, swallowing difficult, cannot pass liquids.
COMMENTS - The main idea of Bothrops is thrombosis and phlebitis. Tendency to form blood clots (Lach.).
Eizayaga used this remedy for clots in the legs, specifically for clots that form in the veins in the legs, and then
go somewhere else. Also for “milk leg,” phlebitis in nursing women.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Other snake poisons, notably Lachesis. (2) Bell, has nightblindness. (3)
Toxicophis. Trachinus.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Mur- phy-
