name: Botulinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - botul. Botulinum. Bacillus botulinum. Toxin of Bacillus botulinum. Nosodes. Historical dose:
Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Aphonia. Bulbar paresis. Coma. Constipation. Convulsions. Diphtheria. Diplopia.
Dizziness. Dysphagia. Dyspnea. Eye, disorders. Food, poisoning. Hydrophobia. Muscular, weakness. My-
driasis. Paralysis. Ptosis. Vision, disorders. Strabismus. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Botulism is classified under the heading of meat poisoning. Meat infected by it has no putrid
odor, though a characteristic rancid smell is described. Fish, as well as any sort of preserved meat, may form
a suitable medium for its growth.
The symptoms of poisoning set in 24 to 36 hours after taking the infected material. Vomiting is usually the first
symptom, but the gastro-intestinal tract is little affected in patients attacked by the bacillus botulinus and its
toxin.
There is generally constipation rather than diarrhea. Following the first vomiting a train of nerve symptoms
develope. Eye symptoms, ptosis, double vision, blurred vision, mydriasis, strabismus, paralysis of
accommodation.
Botulism poisoning produced a clinical picture of bulbar paresis. Repeated suffocative attacks have been often
observed and after large doses convulsions. General muscular weakness, successive dryness and
hypersecretion of the buccal and pharyngeal mucus membranes.
Aphonia, and retention of urine. Difficulty in swallowing and breathing, choking sensation. Weakness and
uncertainty in walking, blind staggers, dizziness. Thickening of speech. Cramping pain in stomach. Masklike
expression of face, due to weakness of facial muscles. Severe constipation.
COMMENTS - The therapeutic applications spring from the recorded symptoms. The drug is to be thought of
in hydrophobia, bulbar paralysis and allied affections, diphtheritic paralyses, and the dyspnea attacks
and coma of diabetes.
Paroxysmal dyspneas occurring in various diseases, in so far as they are central in origin, should be aided by
Botulinum , and it is interesting to note that it is precisely repeated attacks of dyspnea that Dr. Schepens has
found himself able to cure with the drug.
His first recorded case is that of a lady of 70, with arteriosclerosis, slight albuminuria, and a small pleural
effusion, who suffered from nocturnal dyspnea attacks of an alarming kind. Phos., Ars., Lach., Spong., and
Hyos. all did little or nothing. After fifteen days Botul. 30c was given, one dose.
Short aggravation followed by amelioration ensued. The dose was repeated in two days' time, and the same
phenomena occurred, but the improvement was more marked. In another two days another dose, and no
more, was required. Nine days from the first dose the effusion had disappeared, and albuminuria and attacks
of dyspnea followed suit.
The second patient was a man of over 50. An erysipelatous eruption of the right leg disappeared under Apis,
lod., and Kali-i., but when the patient returned to work he was at once attacked by paroxysms of dyspnea,
preventing him from lying down and causing great distress. Traces of albumen were found in the urine. Rhus-
t. and Lach, did little.
Botul. 50c, two doses within an interval of two days, caused amelioration, after two days more, Botul. 30c, one
dose. The next day the albumen had disappeared. One more dose after four days was all that was required,
and the patient returned to work restored fully to health.
RELATIONS-Compare: Bell., Bry., Rhus-t., Sulph., Agar., Hydr-ac., Lach., Ant-t. Ars., Phos., and Tab.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Wheeler.
 ***BOVISTA LYCOPERDON
(Puff-Ball)
PHARMACY - bov. Bovista lycoperdon. Puff ball. Bovista gigantea. Warted puff-ball. Lycoperdon bovista. N.
O. Fungi. Trituration. Tincture of the spores of the mushroom. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Absent minded. Acne. Asphyxia. Boils. Chills. Coccyx, itching. Colic. Constipation. Corns. Cough.
Cysts. Diabetes mellitus. Diarrhea. Ear, eczema. Eczema. Fever. Flatulence. Ganglion. Gleet. Headache.
Hemorrhages. Heart, disorders. Herpes. Hiccough. Jaundice. Joints, disorders. Leucorrhea. Menstruation,
disordered. Metrorrhagia. Morning sickness. Nausea. Neuritis. Nosebleed. Ovarian,cysts. Ovaries, disorders.
Palpitations. Pellagra. Rheumatic, disorders. Scurvy. Stammering. Tetters. Tongue, ulcers. Tumors.
Urticaria. Vertigo. Vomiting. Warts. Whitlow. Wounds.
HOMEOPATHIC - Clarke stated “This globular fungus, which, according to report is eaten in Italy before it is
ripe, becomes filled, while ripening with a black dust that breaks the husk which contains it with a slight noise.”
Corresponding to this signature, “bloated, puffy condition of body surface,” and a sense of “enlargement,”
leading features of the Bov. pathogenesis include flatulent distention and noisy passage of flatus. Guernsey
added “We may always think of Bov. when we see a very ‘tettery' person, one who has tetters here and there,
all over the body. These tetters may be either moist or dry.”
The puffball exerts its influence on the circulation, causing relaxation of the capillary system, thereby
ptoducinghemorrhagic diathesis. There is a general puffiness, bloated condition of body surface, which
produces easy indentations with a blunt instrument (scissors etc.). Eczema-like eruption. Herpes. Marked
languor and lassitude.
Laxity, especially felt in joints, which seem loose. Great weakness of the joints (has cured where Rhus-t.
seemed indicated and failed). Nervous joints. Enlarged or swollen
feeling in head, heart, etc.
Stage of numbness and tingling in multiple neuritis. Asphyxia due to charcoal fumes. Effects of over-exertion
and application of tar locally.
MIND - Awkward in speech and action, drops things. Everything falls from hands. Absentminded. Weak
memory. Inattentive. Slowness of understanding and comprehension. Dullness, with restlessness.
Alternating moods. Laughs and cries alternately. Sensitive, takes offense at everything. Ill-humor, aversion
to all things. Quarrelsome. Wants to fight. Fear of insanity on waking from a dream. Irritable, takes everything
amiss.
Confusion on waking. Confusion while standing. Confusion when stooping. Enlarged sensation (Arg-n.).
Stares vacantly into space. Sad when alone. Cheerful in company. Mental symptoms from sexual excesses.
Abdomen - Bloatedness of abdomen. Cannot bear tight clothing around the waist. Flatulence or rumbling with
constipation. Pain around umbilicus. Abdominal colic, with bright red urine. Flatulent colic. Colic relieved by
eating and bending double. Offensive flatus. Sharp pain through perineum towards rectum and genitals.
Coldness sensation moving about in abdomen. Ulceration in bowels.
Back - Pain in the back with heaviness after stooping. Tip of coccyx itches intolerably. Pain and stiffness of
back after stooping. Stiffness of neck in morning. Shooting pains between the shoulders are better from
bending, straightening up. Sharp pains in neck.
Causations - Antidotes effects of charcoal fumes.
Chest - Oppression of chest, as from constriction, with desire to loosen clothes. Sharp pains in various parts
of chest. Sweat in axilla, onion smell. Burning in outer chest.
Constitutions - Hemorrhagic diathesis. Adapted to old maids with palpitations and stammering children.
Ears - Boil in right ear with pain, worse swallowing. Discharge of fetid pus. Indistinct hearing, misunderstands
much
Bovista lycoperdon that is spoken.
Eyes - Eyes look weak and dim. Inflammation of eyelids, with nightly agglutination. Pressure in orbits. Vertical
half-sight. Objects seem to be nearer than they really are. Stares at one point. Loss of vision from paralysis of
optic nerve.
Face - Frequent violent alternations of color. Acne, worse in summer, due to use of cosmetics. Cheeks and
lips swollen. Crusts about corners of mouth. Twitching of muscles, before asthma. Pale swelling of cheek after
toothache.
Female - Burning pain in genitals. Menses too early. Menses too profuse, worse at night. Menses every
two weeks, much dark and clotted blood. Soreness of pubes during menses. Traces of menses between
menstruation. Leucorrhea a few days before or a few days after menses. Leucorrhea like white of egg, when
walking. Leucorrhoea acrid, thick, tough, greenish, leaving green spots on linen worse while walking after
 menses. Metrorrhagia. Cannot bear tight clothing around waist (Lach.). Ovarian cysts. Voluptuous
sensation.
Food - Excessive hunger, even after meals. No appetite for cooked food, desire for bread only. Desire for
brandy, wine, milk. Hot food relieves. Worse spirituous liquors, wine, cold food. Confusion from spirituous
liquors, after wine. Thirst for cold drinks. Thirst during chill and heat.
Head - Dull, bruised pain in brain. Confusion on waking. Staggering, confusion and numbness in head after
sex. Tension headaches, worse early morning, open air, lying. Stupefying headache in forehead and vertex.
Sensation as if head were enlarging, especially of occiput. As if wedge is pressed in occiput. Scalp itches,
worse warmth, sensitive, must scratch until sore. Falling out of hair. Scalp tender to touch.
Heart - Heart feels enormously large. Palpitations as if heart working in water. Palpitations with tremor of
hands, worse bathing, excitement. Palpitations worse after eating. Palpitations with restlessness, nausea and
headache. Palpitations
Bovista lycoperdon during menses. Visible palpitations of the heart.
Kidneys - Frequent desire to urinate, even immediately after urination. Diabetes mellitus. Stinging, itching,
burning in urethra. Bright red urine. Urine bright yellow. Urine with slowly forming cloud, turbid. Urine like loam
water. Urine with violet sediment.
Limbs - Great weakness of all joints, clumsiness with her hands, drops things from hands. Weariness of hands
and feet. Moist eczema on back of hand. Weak hands. Heavy, painful legs. Itching of feet and legs. Tip of
coccyx itches intolerably. Edematous swelling of (right) foot even years after a sprain. Edema of joints after
fracture.
Lungs - Asthma preceded by twitching of facial muscles. Shortness of breath on moving the arms. Viscid
expectoration. Spasmodic laughing and crying with asthma. Dry cough, caused by tickling in throat and chest.
Cough after coming into room from cold air. Loose cough in evening, dry in morning.
Male - Increased sexual desire. Reeling and confusion in head after sex.
Modalities - Better from bending double. Better eating, hot food. Worse before and during menses. Worse
hot weather, getting warm. Worse full moon. Worse from cold food, coffee, and wine. Worse at night. Worse
after eating. Worse when blowing nose. Easily intoxicated, worse wine.
Mouth - Putrid taste. Stammering when reading with inability to pronounce several words rapidly. Stammering
(Stram., Merc.). Mouth dry, as if sand were in it. Numbness. Increased saliva. Offensive odor from mouth.
Gums bleed easily on sucking them. Bleeding after tooth extraction. Lips chapped, cracked, crusty. Pale
swelling of upper lip. Scurf and crusts about nostrils and corners of mouth. Corners of mouth sore.
Nose - Nose stopped up, cannot breathe, worse lying down. Scurf and crusts about nostrils and corners of
mouth. Discharge from nose, stringy, tough. Watery coryza
with dizziness. Bleeding of nose and gums. Nosebleed with menstrual irregularity, or from trauma. Bleeding
early in the morning (during sleep), a few drops escape on sneezing.
Perspiration - Sweat in axilla, onion smell. Sweats in morning, most profuse on chest.
Rectum - Offensive flatus. Flatulence or rumbling with constipation. Constipation. Fruitless urging to stool.
Sharp pains through perineum towards rectum and genitals. First portion of stool is hard, latter part thin
and watery. Diarrhea worse before and during menses. Chronic diarrhea of elderly people, worse at night
and early morning. Diarrhea, better after breakfast. Itching in rectum, as from worms.
Skin - Eczema, red, burns, itches, disturbs sleep. Eczema, moist formation of thick crusts. Jaundice of
newborns. Pellagra. Itching on getting warm. Itching eruptions, oozing, forming thick crusts or scabs with pus
beneath. Urticaria on excitement with rheumatic lameness, palpitations and diarrhea (Dulc.). Urticaria
covering whole body with diarrhea or metrorrha; gia. Urticaria on waking in the morning, worse from bathing.
Pimples cover the entire body. Scurvy. Herpetic eruptions. Shooting pain in corns and warts. Blunt instruments
leave deep impression on the skin. Tetter, moist or dry, red, scabby eruptions.
Sleep - Spasmodic yawning before asthma, morning sweat in bed. Night Great drowsiness in afternoon and
early evening and after eating, rest disturbed by burning and itching of nettle-rash. Restless sleep with many
anxious, frightful dreams.
Stomach - Empty eructations. Intolerant of tight clothing around waist. Hiccough before and after dinner.
Sensation as if a lump of ice in stomach. Pressure and fulness in pit. Nausea better breakfast. Nausea with
chilliness, whole forenbon. Morning sickness, vomits only water. Vomits watery fluid.
Temperature - Chills with pain. Chills after going to bed at night. Chill predominating, even near a warm stove.
Chills all
night: Shivering in evening, spreading from back. Shuddering alternating with flying heat. Fever with thirst,
anxiety and restlessness. Fever heat during sleep.
Throat - Burning pain in throat. Sharp pain in throat before asthma. Sore throat with scratching and burning in
 esophagus. Scratching sensation in larynx with viscid mucus. Rawness in larynx, mornings, with catarrhal
speech. Hoarseness in morning, with scraping in throat.
Tongue - Soreness or ulcers on edges of tongue. Burning in tip of tongue early in morning on waking. Cutting
pain in tongue, before asthma. Numbness of posterior portion of tongue early in morning on waking. Tongue
feels almost like wood.
Vertigo - V ertigo with feeling of stupidity in head on rising. Vertigo and confusion of head after sex. Vertigo,
falls over, momentarily unconscious in morning. Sudden attacks of vertigo while standing.
COMMENTS - Relaxation of entire capillary system. The heart feels enormously large. Hemorrhagic diathesis.
Hemorrhage from menstrual irregularities, from trauma. Hemorrhage between the periods. Menstrual flow
occurring only or chiefly at night. Ovarian cysts.
Puffy condition of the body, surface instruments (e.g., scissors) indent the fingers in an unusual degree. Sweat
of axilla, smells like onions. Early morning sweat, worse on chest. Many symptoms are worse in early morning,
including the diarrhea. Sensitive to touch, cannot bear clothing. Sensitive to drafts, chilliness predominates.
Warts and corns with shooting pains. Ebullitions with great thirst. “Itching at top of coccyx.” The corners of the
mouth are broken out. Numb, pithy feeling in mouth. There is stuttering and stammering speech.
Awkwardness, misapplies words in speaking and writing.
Colic, causing the patient to bend double (Coloc.), better by eating, sometimes accompanied by voiding of red
urine.
M. L. Sircar recorded a striking cure of such a case with Bov. 3x, the pain being griping-twisting intermittent,
starting be-
low umbilicus and diffusing itself towards epigastrium, some constipation, urine scanty and reddish. Nothing
gave relief except eating.
Teste observed psoric eruptions appear on the hands and feet of a patient to whom he gave Bov. for a
headache. He cured with it “red, crusty eruptions on thighs and bends of knees of eighteen years' duration.” It
disappeared for weeks, reappearing in hot weather and at the full moon.
W. S. Gee recorded a case concerning a widow, 55. She had an eruption, which she thought to be erysipelas,
on her right foot. . Some years before, she had an eruption on her left foot, which discharged much water and
was “cured" by the use of a salve. A few months later, the left knee became affected and the limb was
amputated above the joint.
The current eruption was fiery red, covered with yellowish-brown scales, thick as an old-fashioned wafer. There
were also rheumatic pains in the leg. After Rhus-t. had been given without benefit, she was cured with Bov.
4c.
Dr. Gee elicited additional symptoms including “Occasional spells of short breathing, especially from working
with the hands. Frequent desire to urinate, even immediately after urinating. Sleep disturbed by burning and
itching and also by anxious, frightful dreams, headache when waking from sleep.”
Lilienthal noted “moist vesicular eruptions with formation of thick crusts”; Bov. was given with steady
improvement and eventual cure.
A case of cyst in the broad ligament was cured. It was accompanied by metrorrhagia, flow at night or early
morning, easily provoked from slight over-exertion during menses. Could bear nothing tight around body.
Menses were preceded and followed by diarrhea. Acrid, corrosive leucorrhea, flowing at night only, follows
menses.
RELATIONS - It antidotes: Effects of Tar ap- plied locally. Compare: ( 1 ) Calc., Cic., Rhus-t., Sep., Phos.,
Puls., Staph., Sulph., Verat., Bell., Bry., Carb-v., Caust., Kali-c., Lyc., Merc., Nat-
m., Sil., Spig., Stront., Valer. Aur., Puls., Lyc. (2) Stram. - laughter alternately with weeping. (3) Ars., Lyc.,
Sulph. - sinking immediately after eating. (4) Bufo - sensation as if heart in water. (5) Zinc. - worse from wine.
(6) Coloc. - colic better bending double. (7) Am-c. - poisoning by charcoal fumes. (8) Stram. - stammering. (9)
Ambra - hemorrhage between periods. (10) Sec., Ust. Followed well by: Alum., Calc., Rhus-t., Sep. Teste
puts Bov. in his Sulphur group. Antidoted by: Camph. Bov. antidotes coal tar applications. Suffocation from
gas. After Rhus-t. in chronic urticaria.

name: Brachyglottis Repens
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - brach. Brachyglottis repens. Puka puka. N. O. Eupatoriacae. New Zealand. Compositae.
Tincture of green leaves and flowers. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL- Albuminuria. Back, pain. Bright's disease. Cystitis. Dysmenorrhea. Nephritis. Writer's cramp.
HERBAL - The Maoris use the leaves to apply to old sores and ulcers. Horses eating young shrubs lose all
 power over their hind legs and spine.
HOMEOPATHIC - Brachyglottis was proved byC. L. Fischer. A large number of symptoms were produced in
all regions of the body, but few have been tested clinically.
Kidney and bladder symptoms predominate. Bright's disease. Produces symptoms of albuminuria. Urgency
in passing urine, pain in neck of bladder. Pain in bladder after urinating. Pain in urethra and stinging in penis.
A large quantity of pale-colored urine voided of low specific gravity and containing albumen.
Causes lassitude, weakness, and flesh loss. Fluttering sensation (Calad.). Throbbing pains. Pains in back
and limbs. Oppression of chest. Writer's cramp. Chilliness predominates. Itching in ears and nostrils.
Dysmenorrhea with fluttering in abdomen, right ovary has been cured with it.
Abdomen - Isolated throbbing in left groin. Fluttering sensation in abdomen. Feeling as if something rolling
about.
Back - First dorsal vertebra sore to touch. Cutting under left shoulder. Aching in lumbar region. Isolated
throbbing in right side of back. Feeling as if whole back would contract backward and muscles of neck were
affected.
Bladder - Cystitis. Sense of swashing in bladder. Pressure in neck of bladder, urging to urinate. Soreness in
urethra, feeling as if urine could not be retained.
Chest - Pains flying about chest and precordial region. Throbbing in sternum.
Ears - Tingling, itching, pricking in ears. Throbbing about right ear, from ear to eyes, and throat to neck.
Eyes - Soreness around eyes, as if bruised. Dim sight during pressure in forehead.
Face - Twitching in left side of face (evening). Soreness right zygomatic process. Flushed face. Face ache left
side, submaxillary glands affected.
Female - Fluttering in region of ovary. Dysmenorrhea with fluttering in abdomen and right ovary.
Head - Cold sensation and tightness about scalp. Throbbing in left temple. Headache over left or right eye.
Headache and faceache become very severe and prevent sleep during night.
Kidneys - Bright’s disease. Nephritis. Urine contains mucous, cells, albumen and casts. Passing urine
preceded by pains in bowels. Urine abundant, contains mucus and albumen.
Limbs - Great weakness in limbs, weariness and prostration. Cramp in fingers, thumb and wrist when writing,
soreness extending along flexor carpi ulnaris.
Lungs - Oppression of breathing, better by sighing.
Male - Throbbing in penis and desire to pass urine, pressure in bladder.
Mouth - Pain, numbness, pricking, soreness of tongue. Heat in mouth. Toothache right side.
Nose - Nostrils, sore, itching. Irritation in nose.
Rectum - Ineffectual urging for stool. Diarrheic stools in evening. Tendency to diarrhea. Constipation.
Evacuation of dry feces with sore, constrictive pain in anus. Feces like balls and knotty. Dry stool, like balls,
evacuated with sore, constrictive pain in anus, evening.
Sleep - Great sleepiness during day with constant yawning. Restless and sleepless nights. Talking in sleep.
Sleeplessness after waking. Confused dreams. Full of dreams.
Stomach - Nausea in stomach. Fluttering. Soreness in evening. Throbbing in stomach. right side.
Temerature - Chilliness and shivering. Coldness of hands and feet. Nervous chills.
Throat - Soreness, rawness, scraping in throat, worse by swallowing.
Vertigo - Vertigo with flushed face. Vertigo with pain in forehead.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Helon., Merc-c., Plb. (2) Apis - soreness, stinging in urethra, Am. - bruised, sore
feeling. (3) Bov. albuminuria, Helonias, Merc-c. - albuminuria, urging to urinate and defecate. (4) Nux-v. -
urging to urinate and defecate. (5) Op. - constipation, Plb. - feces like balls, painful urination, albuminuria. (6)
Eupatoriacae.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Brandy
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bran. Brandy. Spirit of wine. Aqua vitae. Tincture. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Bums. Colds. Indigestion. Insomnia. Shock. Toothaches. Wounds.
HOMEOPATHIC - Brandy is distilled wine - wine with most of the water removed - which changes the taste
and makes the alcohol content higher.
“Brandy” is derived from brandywijn, a word of Dutch origin for “burnt”. Created in a still to leave the water and
remove the alcoholic vapor which condenses back into liquid form as it cools. In other languages
too, it is the burning that is the essential feature.
Concentrated spirits of wine were used in ancient Greece and Rome, both as an antiseptic and as a primitive
 anesthetic.
From the 12th to the 14th centuries alchemists in Europe began experimenting with the distillation of many
items, but medicines were still mostly given as infusions or decoctions of single herbs. Arabic writings and
universities in Spain began to influence Christian schools of medicine in Italy and France.
Two contemporary 13th century Spanish alchemists, Arnold de Villanova and Raymond Lully, introduced wine
spirits, which they called aqua vitae (water of life), as a solvent into European medicine.
This later became known as brandy, shortened from the Dutch term for “burnt wine.” In the 14th century during
the Black Death brandy began to be used as a medicine by itself. It was thought of as a polycrest, a remedy
of many virtues.
Brandy is a stimulant, tonic and has restorative powers. Teaspoon doses of brandy were given to patients with
low fevers, typhus. Sleep aid, helps prevent and treat colds. Warms the body and improves the circulation.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aleo., Vitis.
REFERENCES - Murphy.

name: Brassica Napus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - brass. Brassica napus. Rape seed. Cole seed. Wild com. Wild kale. N. O. Cruciferae. Tincture
of whole fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL-Amenorrhea. Arthritis. Bulimia. Carpal tunnel. Contractures, joints. Cough. Cramps. Dropsy.
Dysphagia. Edema. Gangrene. Insomnia. Jaundice. Liver, enlargement. Myalgia. Nails, shedding. Numbness.
Pes, equinnus. Raynauds disease. Scleroderma. Scurvy. Ulcers. Wasting, muscles. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Our knowledge of the toxic effects of Brassica napus is derived from the experience of the
Irish famine during which people ate it freely.
Brass, has all the symptoms of impoverished blood, such as growth of downy, colorless hair. Dropsical
swellings, scorbutic mouth, voracious appetite.
Tympanitic abdomen. Skin blotches like bums. Dropping off of nails and gangrene. Weariness, strength loss.
Wasting, extremé weight loss. Jaundice.
MIND - Irritability. Anxiety. Depression. Distress. Memory disorders
Abdomen - Enlargement of liver. Tympanitic abdomen. Enlargement of spleen. Liver disease.
Back - Pitting edema.
Chest - Pulmonary edema. Chest wall restricted from motion. Pain. Pulmonary hypertension.
Cough - Non-productive cough.
Eyes - Sicca syndrome, reduced or no lachrymation with consequent dryness and inflammation of conjunctiva.
Face - Edema. Scleroderma. Swollen to an enormous extent, the distended state of eyelids and upper lip
producing great deformity. Bum-1 ike blotches on nose and forehead (also hands and feet), varying from
discoloration to ulceration.
Female - Transient amenorrhea.
Food - Appetite increased, sometimes voracious.
Head - Alopecia. Very distressing frontal headache and tension.
Kidneys - Urine deficient and irritating.
Limbs - Chronic pain. Hands and feet dry and shrunken, with blotches of a deep red, like bums, on backs of
hands and dorsa of feet, the fingers and toes being frequently cold and livid, ulceration, loss of nails. Myalgia.
Contractures, joints. Claw-hand. Hands, feet. Genu-flexum. Pes Equinnus. Raynauds disease. Cramps,
muscles. Wasting, muscles. Arthritis. Arthralgia. Loss of reflex. Weakness. Numbness. Carpal Tunnel
Syndrome. Tenderness.
Lungs - Pneumonia. Dyspnea, worse exertion. Respiratory failure.
Mouth - Mucus membrane of mouth and throat inflamed, ulcerated in parts, gums spongy.
Rectum - Bowels torpid.
Skin - Sallow and muddy-looking, covered with downy hair. Edema. Pitting edema. Tenderness. Itching.
Blotches, deep red, like bums, on backs of hands, feet, nose and forehead, varying from simple discoloration
to most troublesome ulceration. Destruction of cuticle and dropping off of nails. Gangrene. Skin rash. Maculo-
papular rash. Jaundice. Scleroderma. Hyperaesthesia. Hypoaesthesia. Atrophy. Hyperpigmentation.
Sleep - Sleep disturbances. Insomnia.
Throat - Dysphagia. Mucus membrane of mouth and throat inflamed, ulcerated in parts, gums spongy.
Vision - Xeropthalmia.
COMMENTS - Allen gives this account of Brass, poisoning: They all exhibited indications of deteriorated
health, the hue of the skin being uniformly sallow and muddy-looking, totally different from the brown
 discoloration caused by exposure to the sun, the surface was always covered with that colorless downy hair,
so characteristic of what the country people here call “impoverished blood."
An edematous state prevailed generally of the whole body, but a always of the face and lower extremities, the
former sometimes being swollen to an enormous extent, the distended state of the eyelids and upper lip
especially producing remarkable deformity
The abdomen was tympanitic. The bowels torpid. The mucous membrane of the mouth and pharynx was
inflamed, and in some parts ulcerated, and the gums spongy. The appetite was usually greater than natural in
some cases voracious. The urinary secretion was deficient and irritating, and that of the skin suspended.
Very distressing frontal headache and tension was also complained of, but the most curious symptom, next to
the edematous appearance of the patient, was the state of the hands and feet, which were dry and shrunken,
with blotches of a deep red, re
sembling burns, on the backs of the hands and dorsum of the feet, the fingers and toes being frequently cold
and livid.
Similar blotches existed on the nose and forehead, and these varied in their consequence from simple
discoloration to ulceration of a most troublesome description, terminating in loss of the cuticle, and dropping
off of the nails, with a marked disposition in the aggravated cases to gangrene.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Raph., Armora- cea, Sinapis, Sec.
REFERENCES - Allen. Clarke. Murphy. Sherr.

name: Bromium
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - brom. Bromium. Bromine. (Br, At. Wt. 799). Halogens. Must be prepared fresh, as it is predi
sposed to rapid deterioration. Solution in distilled water. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Aphthae. Asthma. Breast, cancer. Bronchitis. Cancer. Coughs. Croup. Diphtheria.
Dysmenorrhea. Emaciation. Emphysema. Encysted, tumors. Fainting. Feet. pain. Fistula lachrymalis. Glands,
enlargement. Goiter. Heart, diseases. Headache. Laryngismus. Migraine. Mwmps. Nosebleeds. Palpitations.
Parotid gland. Parotid, induration. Respiration, disorders. Scrofula. Seaside, effects. Strokes. Testicles,
induration. Throat, sore. Tonsils, enlarged. Tonsils, inflamed. Trachea irritation. Tuberculosis. Tumors, breast.
Ulcers. Uterus, air in. Vagina, air in. Vertigo. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Bromine forms a leading constituent in the mineral waters of Kreutzach and Wood hall.
Bromine is useful in scrofulous children with enlarged glands, which are swollen and indurated, but seldom
suppurate. Like the other Halogens, Bromine is a strong antiscorbutic.
Marked effects on the respiratory tract, especially larynx and trachea. Constriction and membranous formation
occur in larynx, spreading upwards. A sense of suffocation. Cough, worse entering warm room Nosebleed,
accompanies many problems especially those pertaining to chest and
respiratory tract.          s'
Excoriating discharges. Profuse sweats and great weakness. Weak and easily overheated, then sweaty and
sensitive to drafts. Fainting. Tremulous all over. Tendency to spasmodic attacks. Emaciation. Headache worse
from drinking milk or from stooping.
Boring pains in bones. Cancer. Breast cancer. Enlarged and indurated glands. Glands which become hard,
but seldom suppurate. Left-sided mumps. Complaints from being over-heated. Complaints are worse at
seaside, sailors coming ashore suffer from asthma, which is relieved when they go to sea again.
MIND - Much anxiety of the mind. Fears a stroke. Fear of ghosts. Quarrelsome. Very bad humor. Takes no
interest in the household duties. Loss of ideas. Forgetfulness. Aversion to any kind of work, even reading.
Sad. Indifferent. Low spirited, inconsolable. Does not feel normal, but cannot tell why. Sits alone in her room
without doing anything. Looks constantly in one direction without saying anything.
Desires to be carried. Crying and lamentations, with hoarse voice. Cheerful mood, desire for mental labor.
Visions when in the dark. Expects to see something jump around the floor. Delusion that strange persons are
looking over patient's shoulder and that she would see someone on turning.
Abdomen - Tympanitic abdomen, bloated.
Enlargement and induration of spleen. Passage of much wind.
Back - Neck stiff. Goiter. Glands of neck much swollen. Encysted tumors on sides of the neck. Aching at
inner border left scapula. Boring in spinous processes of different vertebrae. Glands of neck enlarged. Cystic
tumors on both sides of neck.
Breasts - Tumors in breasts with sharp pains, worse left. Sharp pains from breast to axilla. Sharp, shooting
pains in left breast, worse pressure. Suppression of menses in scirrhus breasts. Hard, uneven tumor in right
breast.
 Chest - Violent cramping of chest. Chest pains run upward. Cold sensation when inspiring.
Constitutions - Suited to scrofulous children with enlarged glands. Blue-eyed, fair people, especially children
with thin, pale, delicate skins and very light hair and eyebrows to scrofulous constitutions. Blondes.
Ears - Hard swelling of the parotid gland, warm to touch after eruptive fevers. Noise in ears.
Eyes - Lachrymation with swelling of tear glands. Pupils dilated. Protruding eyes. Flashes before eyes. Darting
through the left eye.
Face - Ashy gray. Pale, red, alternating. Swelling and hardness of parotid gland, feeling warm to the touch.
Suppuration of left parotid, swelling remaining hard and unyielding. Sensation of cobweb. Seems drawn to a
point at nose.
Female - Menses, bright red blood. Menses flow passive with much exhaustion. Dysmenorrhea. Depressed
before menses. Queer ill feeling a few days before menses. Menses too early, too profuse, with membranous
shreds. Violent contractive spasms before or during menses. Chronic ovaritis. Dull, constant pain, in left ovary.
Swelling of ovaries. Itching in vagina. Flatus from vagina, noisy. Vagina as if sore. Suppression of menses in
scirrhus breasts. Prolapsed uterus, with mental derangement.
Food - Desire for acids, which aggravate and cause diarrhea. Water tastes salty.
Head - Head congested, fears a stroke. Headache worse drinking milk, stooping. Headache in sun, passes off
in shade. Headaches, deep in the vertex with palpitations. Megrim of left side, worse stooping, especially after
drinking milk. Headache, worse heat of sun and from rapid motion. Sharp pain through eyes.
Heart - Hypertrophy from gymnastics with palpitations. Cutting pain running upwards, with heart disease.
Violent palpitation worse lying on left side. Nervous palpitations with nausea with headache.
Kidneys - Constant desire to urinate with tickling sensation in tip of urethra. Dribbling of urine with burning,
after urinating. Urine scanty and dark. Urine turbid, deposits a whitish sediment adhering to vessel. Urine
leaves a red coating on vessel. Urine contains large flakes of white mucus. High colored urine with eczema.
Limbs - Icy cold forearms or hands. Boring pain in one or both tibiae. Left arm, lame in cardiac affections.
Lungs - Whooping cough. Dry cough with hoarseness and burning pain behind sternum. Suffocative fits,
choked, croupy or wheezing cough, with palpitations. Spasmodic cough with rattling of mucus in the larynx,
suffocative. Thick white expectoration. Spasms of glottis. Croup after febrile symptoms have subsided.
Fibrinous bronchitis. Bronchial tubes feel filled with smoke. Wants to take a deep breath, but it excites cough.
Lungs feel coated with down. Every inspiration provokes cough. Colds start in larynx, go upward and
downward. Deep hoarseness if heated. Difficult and painful breathing. Larynx is cold. Laryngeal diphtheria,
membrane begins in larynx and spreads upward. Dyspnea with great swelling. Asthma, difficulty in getting
air into lung (Chlor, in expelling air). Asthma of sailors going ashore. Better at sea.
Male - Swelling and induration of testes, worse slight jar. Sharp pain in glans and sides of penis. Swelling of
left testicle, with sore pain, or sensation of coldness. Increased sexual desire. Nightly emissions.
Modalities - Better from any motion. Better exercise. Better riding on horseback. Better at sea. Better from
nosebleed, shaving. Worse from warmth. Worse damp warm. Worse Worse overheating. Worse from
evening, until midnight. Worse when sitting. Worse in warm room. Worse heat of sun. Worse chilled when hot.
Worse cold and damp weather and cold air. Worse water or diet. Worse from sea bathing. Worse dust. Worse
draft. Worse lying on left side.
Mouth - Dry, parched. Aphthae with affection of eyes. Water tastes salty.
Nose - Tickling, smarting, asfrom cobwebs. Fan-like motion of ale (Lyc.). Nosebleed, relieving the chest.
Stoppage of right nostril. Long continued, obstinate coryza. Acrid, burning coryza, with violent sneezing and
soreness of the nose. Pressure at root of nose.
Perspiration - Sweats from least exertion or exercise. Sweats on palms. Viscous sweat, with cool skin.
Rectum - Painful hemorrhoids with black stool. Hemorrhoids, bleed, intensely painful, worse application of
cold or warm water. Diarrhea after eating oysters and sour things.
Skin - Acne, pimples and pustules. Boils on arms and face. Glands stony, hard, especially on lower jaw
and throat. Hard goiter (Spong.). Gangrene.
Sleep - Great drowsiness when reading. Continued yawning in respiratory troubles, with drowsiness. Full of
dreams and anguish, jerking and starting during sleep, full of fantasy and illusions, difficult to go to sleep at
night, cannot sleep enough in morning, trembling and weak on awaking.
Stomach - Sharp burning from tongue to stomach. Pressure like from a stone. Stomach pain, better eating.
Sour things disagree. Vomiting like coffee grounds, bloody mucus. Aversion to customary tobacco smoking.
Temperature - Chills with yawning and stretching, repeated every other day, as a chilliness, and cold feet.
Chills on alternate days, with cold feet. Internal burning heat, as if between skin and flesh.
Throat - Tonsils, swollen, deep red, with network of dilated blood vessels. Pain, worse swallowing fluids than
solids. Feels raw, evening with hoarseness. Tickling in trachea during inspiration. Hoarseness coming on from
 being overheated. Even a small goiter oppresses. Stony hard, swollen glands. Diphtheria.
Vertigo - Dizzy when crossing a stream of water. Vertigo worse on bridge. Vertigo at the sight of running water.
Vertigo with nosebleed. Vertigo with a tendency to fall backward.
COMMENTS - Migraine, chiefly on left side, worse from stooping, especially after drinking milk. Sensation
deep in the brain as if vertigo would come on. Vertigo with a tendency to fall backward, worse at the sight of
running water or if he put his foot on a bridge, worse in damp weather. Vertigo with nosebleed.
The glands (thyroid, testes, maxillary, parotid) are swollen and indurated. Tubercu- losis, especially of right
lung. Hypertrophy of the heart and palpitations. Pain in heart going up to axilla. Exertion causes oppression at
heart.
Soreness and crusts inside nose. Nosebleed accompanies many affections, especially of chest. There is a
peculiar headache with coryza. Loud emissions of air from the vagina.
Particularly affects the internal head, left side. Predominantly a left-side medicine. Better at the seaside
(opposite Nat-m.), but worse in sailors when coming ashore.
Guernsey noted that cases of diphtheria begin in the larynx and run up. In croup with all the croupy sound,
there is a loose rattling in the larynx with the breathing and coughing, but no choking in the cough, as there is
in Hepar sulph.
RELATIONS -Antidotes: Am-c., Camph. Salt inhibits the action of Brom. Antidoted by: Camph.. Am. c., Mag-
c., Op. Useful after: lod., Phos.. Spong. Compare: (1) lod. - but lod. has worse morning, dark hair and eyes.
(2)Chlorum, Lach., Spong., Fl-ac., Hep., Apis, Arg-n., Chin., Con., Coff., Cina., Cupr., Lyc., Merc., Phos. (3)
Rhus-t. - cardiac hypertrophy, also Spong., Am. from over-exertion. (4) Sep., Sulph., Ant-t. (5) Puls. - blondes.
Fear of ghosts or visions, also, Aeon., Ars., Carb-v., Phos., Sulph. (6) Con., Aster., Hydrobromic acid.
Compatible: Arg-n. - generally after Brom. Kali-c. - emphysema.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

sposed to rapid deterioration. Solution in distilled water. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Aphthae. Asthma. Breast, cancer. Bronchitis. Cancer. Coughs. Croup. Diphtheria.

name: Brucea Antidysenterica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bruc. Brucea antidysenterica. Angustura spuria. Angustura falsa. Nux vomica cortex. N. O.
Loganiacae. Bark of Nux vomica or angustura falsa. Tincture or trituration. Historieal dose: Trituration and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Abdomen, throbbing. Belches. Borborygmi. Headaches. Hypochondriasis. Pain. Tetanus.
HOMEOPATHIC - Although the Brucea symptoms are similar to the pathogenesis of Nux-v., the bark has been
experimented with independently. The homeopathic preparation of Nux-v. is prepared from the seed. Bmcea
contains strychnine, and the symptoms are included in the pathogenesis of Stry. and Nux-v..
Paralyzed lower limbs, worse least touch, cries for fear of being touched. Tetanic spasms with undisturbed
consciousness, worse from noise or liquids. Painful jerking of legs, cramp-like pain in knees, rigid and lame
limbs of paralytics.
Disposition to stretch the limbs and to yawn. Great weariness when walking. In the evening, nervous
excitement, trembling and tottering when walking. Painful sensation of fatigue in the limbs. Pinching in several
parts of the limbs. In the evening, stiffness in the joints and acute drawing pains in the limbs with shootings in
the head in the ears and in the chest. “Headache with extreme drowsiness, disappearing in evening.”
“Sensation of throbbing in pit of stomach and in entire abdomen.” For the pain in the passing of kidney stones
or gallstones.
MIND - Irritability, augmented in the evening. Dejection, with want of sleep. Taciturnity and hypochondriasis.
Gloomy, melancholy humor with indolence and lassitude. Sad and gloomy on waking in the morning.
Abdomen - Throbbing felt in the abdomen. Painful pinching in the abdomen. Squeezing, as from claws in the
abdomen J followed by frequent, small, slimy evacuations. Borborygmi in the abdomen. The pains in the
abdomen cease after the first
evacuation. Shootings in the umbilicus after the evacuations. Loose evacuations, followed by fainting, which
enforces lying down.
Back - Sensation of squeezing in the back.
Chest - On breathing, sensation of great weight on the whole chest. Oppression of the chest with chilly
disposition and great sensibility in the open air. In the morning, pain as from a bruise on the outside of the
chest, with tight pains on breathing deeply. Pains like excoriation in the interior of the chest, especially in bed
at night, which are most violent when lying on the side.
Eyes - Dull and swollen eyes. Eyes red in the corners, in the evening. Eyes red and burning in the morning.
Itching in the eyelids. Painful sensation in the eyes, as from sand, rendering it necessary to rub them.
Face - Mealy, itching tetters on the face, followed by peeling off of the skin. Paleness in the face. Slight
 convulsive, rapid movements in the lips.
Fever - Sweats on walking, with shiverings, which appear chiefly during rest. Chilly disposition and aversion
to the open air. Shivering and excessive coldness.
Food - Weak appetite, food at dinner and breakfast appears insipid. After a meal, violent beating of the heart,
aggravation of headache, fermentation in the intestines and inclination to evacuate.
Head - Headache, aggravated by sitting, as well as after eating. Shootings in the head, aggravated by walking,
especially in the sun. Heaviness and confusion in the head with sleepiness, disappearing in the evening.
Digging, crawling in the top of the head. Headache in the evening after having walked a while in the sunshine.
Headaches behind the eyebrows, which seem to be swollen.
Limbs - Pains, as of fatigue, in the thighs and loins. Cramp-like pain in the back of the hand. Miliary eruption,
red, raised and itching on the back of the hand and on the body. In the evening, sensation of paralysis in tl{e
thigh. Weariness in the
knees. Curvature of the joint of the foot, so that one walks almost on the anklebone. Sensation of burning in
corns.
Mouth - Acute pains in the teeth and gums, especially on drinking cold water. Accumulation of saliva in the
mouth, forcing one to spit continually. Dryness and burning pain in the gullet, as if from rancid fat.
Rectum - Evacuations too soft, in too small quantity, and of too light a color. Strong disposition to loose
evacuations with colic and flatulency. Loose evacuations in the morning and in the evening. Itching in the anus
in the evening.
Sleep - Sleepiness during the entire day, especially when seated, in the morning, early in the evening, and
particularly in the afternoon. Sleepiness alternately with want of appetite. Sleep full of dreams, with ebullition
of the blood. Sleep troubled with confused or frightful dreams.
Stomach - Clammy taste. Empty belches. Sensation in the stomach, as if nothing had been eaten for a long
time. Sensation of burning, heat in the pit of the stomach. Sensation of throbbing in the pit of the stomach and
in the entire abdomen. Pressure in the stomach, immediately after eating or drinking. In the evening, attack of
nausea with cramp-like pains in the abdomen, vomiting of food and loose evacuations with great prostration.
Vertigo - Vertigo, which occasions falling in the evening.
COMMENTS - Underthe name of Brucea antidysenterica, a quantity of Nux-v. bark got upon the drug market
and was at first supposed to be Angusturabark. Many poisonings ensued before the mistake was discovered
and the bark received the name Angustura falsa in contradistinction to the true Angustura.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) The following also have drowsiness with headache: Gins., Hera., Nux-m., Nat-
s., Sulph. (2) Gels. - difficult to keep the eyes open.
REFERENCES Clarke.

name: Brucella Melitensis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - brucel. Brucella melitensis. Brucella nosode. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Anorexia. Backaches. Brucellosis. Chills. Cirrhosis. Coma. Constipation. Depression. Emaciation.
Epilepsy. Faintness. Fatigue. Fever. Glands, swollen. Headaches. Hemochromatosis. Insomnia. Intermittent,
fever. Joint, pains. Muscle, pain. Perspiration, excessive. Undulant, fever. Vertigo. Weakness. Weight, loss.
HOMEOPATHIC - Brucellosis, also known as undulant fever or Mediterranean fever, is caused by the
bacterium Brucella. Undulant fever derives its name from the undulating, or up-and-down, temperature.
Brucella bacteria infect cattle, goats, camels, dogs, and pigs. Transmission of the disease to humans occurs
by contact with infected meat, the placenta of infected animals, or ingestion of unpasteurized milk or cheese.
The illness may be chronic and persist for years.
Acute brucellosis may begin with mild flu-like symptoms with fever, chills, sweating, muscle aches, joint aches
and malaise. Fever spikes occur every afternoon to levels around 104° Fahrenheit.
Common symptoms include fever and chills, excessive sweating, weakness, weight loss and fatigue. Loss of
appetite. Anorexia, emaciation. Febrile state with profuse sweat, at night, from the least effort. Headache.
Insomnia. Vertigo. Faintness.
Muscular and joint pains, especially of the lower limbs. Back pain. Joint and muscle pain. Swollen glands and
lymph nodes. Vesicular eruptions. Abdominal pain. Enlarged liver. Constipation, dry and hard stools.
Weariness in the morning with strong desire to sleep. Pricking pains everywhere. Wandering diffuse pains
particularly in lumbar region, in thighs, hips, better by mo-' tion. Alternation of symptoms, for example the joint
pains disappear and cough appears. Periodical complaints, worse in winter, spring, summer, every 2 to 4
weeks.
MIND - Changes mood and behavior. Emotional instability. Irritability and nervousness. Apathy and
 indifference. Depression. Coma.
Abdomen - Abdominal pain.
Back - Feeling of coldness with shivers in the back. Back pain. Pains in lumbar region, better by motion.
Glands - Swollen glands and lymph nodes.
Limbs - Muscular and joint pains, especially of the lower limbs.
Liver - Cirrhosis. Enlarged liver.
Modalities - Better by occupation. Better in company. Better motion. Better heat, particularly of the sun. Worse
from prolonged exercise. Worse when rising from sitting. Worse when motionless. Worse after alcohol, eating.
Worse from changes of temperature or weather. Worse warm room. Worse hot summer. Worse damp, wet.
Worse storms. Worse in morning.
* Worse from sea, wind.
Perspiration - Excessive sweating.
Rectum - Constipation, dry and hard stools.
Skin - Blotches and rashes. Vesicular eruptions.
Temperature - Fever and chills. Chills with shivers. Fever, with profuse sweat, depression.
Vertigo - Vertigo with loss of sight and feeling of coldness.
COMMENTS - Roger Schmidt recorded two cases, published in Annales Hom. Fr., No. 2. 1959. The first case
concerned M. W. R., a butcher who was 43 years old. He called on Schmidt on the 18th October, 1948, for a
fever of 103.4 F in the evening which he's had for three days. Profuse sweat on the upper part of the body,
preceded by shivering, which jerks him from head to foot. Restless during the fever, hungry, and has the desire
to drink cold water.
While telling Schmidt his history, he noted having been treated for acute brucellosis in 1935, and that half of
the workers of the same firm were affected. At that time, M. W. R. stopped his work for a year. The fever, he
said caused his hair to fall out, but it, fortunately, grew back.
In 1940 and 1941, he had two new attacks that were treated by serum. In 1949, he relapsed again, complicated
with anemia, and was treated by penicillin and vaccines. He told Schmidt that since that time he has always
felt weak.
Gels. 6c ameliorated the fever in 24 hours. The temperature did not rise above 99.5° F. One week later, the
patient had diarrhea with profuse sweats, rapidly ameliorated by Chin. 6c.
During the next month, he gained 8 pounds and was feeling better. Schmidt's intention was to complete the
cure by the nosode, but he did not get the chance because, in order to resume his work, M. W. R. was forced
to see the doctors who treated him before.
Schmidt's second case concerned Mrs. H. B. of San Diego, married, age 69. She came to see Schmidt in
September 1950, complaining of some gastric troubles, which she had for several months. She was also
suffering from gas, vomiting, regurgitations, and a stubborn constipation.
She was constantly depressed and weak, nervous, restless and had shiverings. She felt sudden weakness,
had vertigo by the least movement. While she was young she suffered from a perforated appendix. Physical
examination was negative, except for a distended abdomen.
After her return to San Diego she asked Schmidt to prescribe by mail. Ars., Sulph., Nux-v., Carb-v., Kali-p.,
andCarbo-s. all did her some good, but the variety of remedies showed that the case was jumbled when it was
difficult to get a simillium.
Finally in July, 1951, Schmidt had the idea that this may be a case of Brucel. The sudden attack of fever and
sweats, weight loss (seven pounds), and the persistence of some symptoms indicated the diagnosis.
Schmidt gave her Brucel. 10m. Without any delay, the patient informed Schmidt that this was the first remedy
that gave her almost instantaneous result. She soon took up weight, but after six weeks she complained anew
of serious vertigo and the stubborn constipation. She was given
Brucel. 30c, and for 3 months her condition was satisfactory.
On December 6th, 1951, her fever returned with profuse sweat and abdominal pains. Schmidt gave her Brucel.
10m, which caused a moderate aggravation but clearly ameliorated during the next two weeks, with a
maximum temperature of 100° F during the day, which ended in a long period of amelioration lasting for 3
years.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Nat-m. - Emaciation with anemia, cachexia, depression, headaches,
constipation, sensitiveness to cold, desire for salt, mapped tongue. (2) Gels. - General weakness with
tremblings; headache with heaviness; weakness of limbs, slow pulse. (3) Ferr-p - Febrile states with full, rapid
and soft pulse, thirst and sweats that does not ameliorate.
REFERENCES - Julian. Murphy.

(Brucine)
PHARMACY - brucin. Brucinum. Brucine. An alkaloid obtained from the bark and seeds of Strychnos nux
vomica. N. O. Loganiacae. Tincture or trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Headaches. Paralysis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Lepelletier noted that Brucin. caused sudden jerking, especially of the lower limbs,
spreading generally, but not accompanied by trismus or tetanus, and not extending to the esophagus and
pharynx as with Strychnia. Twitching in the paralyzed as well as healthy muscles. A fever of short duration
ends the attacks, after which deep sleep comes on.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Stry., Nux-v., Brucea antidys.

name: Bryonia Alba
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bry. Bryonia alba. Wild hops. Bryonia dioica. White Bryony. N. O. Cucur- bitaceae. Tincture of
root procured before flowering. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Alcoholism. Amenorrhea. Anger, effects. Angina pectoris. Ankle, injuries. Appendicitis. Aphthae.
Arthritis. Asthma. Backache. Bilious attack. Bones, broken. Brain disorders. Breast-feeding, disorders.
Breast inflamed. Bronchitis. Cancer. Chills. Chlorosis. Constipation. Coryza. Coughs. Dehydration. Dentition.
Diaphragm, rheumatism. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Edema. Enteric fever. Gastroenteritis.
Glaucoma. Hemorrhages. Hands, swollen. Headaches. Heart, pain. Hernias. Hiccoughs. Hydrocele. Hy-
drocephalus. Influenza. Injuries. Intermittent fevers. Jaundice. Joints,pain. Knee, injuries. Liver, disorders.
Lumbago. Lymphangitis. Mastitis. Measles. Meningitis. Menstruation, vicarious. Migraine. Milk fever. Muscle
pain. Nephritis. Nosebleeds. Ovaritis. Peritonitis. Phlegmasia alba dolens. Pleurodynia. Pleurisy.
Pneumonia. Pregnancy. Puerperal fever. Pyuria. Relapsing fever. Remittent fever. Rheumatism. Scarlatina.
Sciatica. Spina bifida. Stiff-neck. Strokes. Suppressed, eruptions. Tongue, coated. Toothache. Trachea, pain.
Tuberculosis. Vertigo. Waterbrash. Whooping cough. Yellow fever.
HERBAL - The commonBryony of England is the Bryonia dioica, which has been substituted for the Bryonia
alba and has probably identical properties, but the alba alone has been proved, and consequently this should
always be dispensed. Bryonia dioica is a popular remedy for “black-eye” as a local application.
HOMEOPATHIC - Bry. is one of the polycrest remedies of the homeopathic Materia Medica. Less rapid in its
action than Aeon., but it goes deeper in its effects and often takes up the work where Aeon, leaves off. It not
only disorders the circulation, but alters the blood itself. Vicarious bleeding. Corresponds to fevers of almost
all kinds, especially rheumatic, typhoid, bilious and
remitting.
Affects on all serous membranes and the viscera they contain, causing inflammation and exudation. Mucus
membranes are all dry. Discharges are scanty and adherent. Dryness everywhere, of mouth, throat etc. Dry
hacking painful coughs in pleurisy, pneumonia. Streaks of red in lymphangitis. Dry, parched lips and
mouth. Excessive thirst, bitter taste in the mouth.
Rheumatic pains and swellings, dropsical effusions into synovial and serous membranes. Aching in joints and
muscles. Injury of the joints (when Arn. fails). Every spot in the body is painful to pressure. Pains are
bursting, stitching or heavy sore, going backwards, tearing, worse by motion, better rest. Stitching pains
in the chest. Muscles become hard after neuralgia.
Pressure headaches. Severe headaches. Bursting, splitting headaches. Vertigo from raising the head.
Physical weakness, on slightest exertion. Dropsical swellings gradually increase as the day progresses and
disappear during the night. Sensitive epigastrium and feeling of a stone in the stomach. Stools large, dry, hard.
Complaints develop slowly but forcibly. Aggravation from motion, movement of all kinds. Avoids even the
movement of the eyes, raising head from pillow causes faintness, nausea and vomiting. Betterfrom pressure,
from lying on painful side. Rightsided effects. Tendency to great irritability and bad temper.
Children dislike to be carried or raised. Persons who over-eat or eat excessively of meat, and have strong
constitutions.
MIND - Effects of anger, fright, chagrin or pain. Exceedingly irritable, everything puts him out of humor. Very
morose, ill-humored. Ugly in behavior. Easily angered, with biliousness, headache, dyspepsia. Quarrelsome.
Worse from arguments, which will give them a headache and pain.
Capricious, hard to please and satisfy. Desire for things that are rejected when offered (Cham., Calc-p.).
Desire for things that can't be had. Weeping mood, with headache and other complaints. Hasty disposition.
Easily startled, during headache. Restlessness, wants change.
 Determined. Taciturn. Aversion to being disturbed. Intolerance of contradiction. Contradiction causes anger.
Irritability during menses. Wants to be let alone. Aversion to company. Desire to be independent, difficulty
asking for help. Aversion to being touched.
Fright, fear and vexation. Apprehension anddreadforfuture. Talks of business. Worried about money and the
future. Fearful of poverty. Fear of thunderstorm. Insecure. Despair of being cured with fear of death. Worry
about their health. Despair of recovery. Anxiety better open air.
Mental state, better from cool temperature, wants windows open. Oversensitiveness of senses to external
impressions. Child dislikes to be carried or to be touched. Dullness of mind. Weakness of mind, so that his
ideas disappear. Delirium, wants to go home, thinking he is not there.
Abdomen - Distension of abdomen with colic after eating. Abdomen very sore to touch, with constipation.
Appendicitis. Peritonitis. Gastroenteritis. Abdominal wall very tender. Griping, pinching colic. Burning, sharp
pain, worse from pressure, coughing, breathing. Movements, loud rumbling or a gurgling and soreness
and dragging downward. Pain from movement of flatus. Epigastrium, tender, throbbing. Groin sore before
menses.
Back - Complaints from over lifting, concussion. Backache from over lifting. Severe painful back injuries,
worse any motion. Scapular numbness or pain going to epigastrium or from left scapula to heart. Slipped
disks with sharp pains. Lumbago, worse stooping. Sharp pains and stiffness in lumbar region. Pain in
the small of back worse walking or turning. Sharp pain in lumbar region during cough. Backache from sudden
changes of weather. Vertebrae out of place causing much pain and immobility. Joints and muscles of
lumbar region stiff and tender, preventing motion and stooping, worse standing or sitting, better lying. Brachial
neuragia.
Back - Painful stiffness of neck, worse motion. Drawing and stiffness in muscles of right side of neck.
Cervical glands sore to touch. Spina bifida.
Breasts - Pain in breasts at menstrual period. Mastitis, stony hard breasts. Breasts hot and painful, hard.
Abscess of breasts. Milk fever. Swollen breasts.
Causations - Ill effects of anger, fright, chagrin. Complaints from taking cold drinks in hot weather. Alcohol.
Gluttony. Suppressed eruptions and discharges. Constipation. Broken bones, joint injury, wounds. Cold winds.
Chest - Angina pectoris. Holds chest or presses the sternum when coughing. Sharp pains in chest, worse
motion, deep breathing and coughing. Sticking pain, in chest, better pressure or lying upon painful side.
Sticking pain in sternum when pressing upon it. Heaviness beneath the sternum extending towards the right
shoulder. Internal heat in chest. Sharp pains in cardiac region. Sharp pain from left to right side of chest, during
inspiration. Rheumatism of muscles of chest. Ribs sore, as if beaten.
Constitutions - Suited to a robust, firm fiber and dark complexion with tendency to leanness and irritability.
Gastro-bilious- rheumatic constitutions. Choleric, bilious tendency with firm fleshy fiber. Adapted to nervous,
dry, slender people.
Cough - Dry, hacking cough from irritation in upper trachea. Cough, dry, hard, very painful, at night as if
from stomach. Cough with sneezing. Coming into warm room excites cough (Nat-c.). Cough with feeling as
if head and chest would fly to pieces. Very painful coughs must hold the chest. Nausea excites cough, and
coughing often excites vomiting. Coughs with gagging, without nausea. Cough with sharp pains in sides of
chest. Cough compels patientto spring up in bed involuntary and immediately. Whooping cough. Coughs,
worse motion, talking and laughing. Painful coughs with bronchitis, pleurisy, pneumonia.
Ears - As if stopped-up. Otorrhea following inflammation. Boil in front of ear.
Vicarious bleeding from ears. Intolerance of noise. Aural vertigo. Roaring, buzzing, ringing, humming in ears.
Chirping, as from locusts. Humming in left ear. resembling pouring of water over a dam.
Eyes - Eyeballs sore. Burning in eyes, inflammation, worse warmth. Pains behind the eyeballs. Glaucoma.
Pressing, crushing, aching pains. Aching and pulsation in left orbit. Lachrymation during day, especially in the
sun. Lids swollen and puffed. Sore to touch. Sore when moving eyes. Sharp pain like a needle going through
eye. Itching and burning of margins of lids. Sensation as if sand in eyes. Gout shifting to eyes. Aversion to
light, especially sunlight.
Face - Dark red, hot, bloated. Yellowish paleness. Heat of face with redness and thirst. Redness of face after
getting angry. Face bluish-red, during difficult respiration. Lips, dry, as if burnt, parched, cracked, wants to
moisten them. Picking of lips. Burning of lower lip in old smokers. Chewing motions in brain disorders of
children. Twitching in corners of mouth. Small nodules and induration. Tetters in face.
Female - Menstrual irregularities with gastric symptoms. Menses, dark, foul. Menses too early, too profuse,
worse from motion, with tearing pains in legs. Menses suppressed with vicarious discharge or splitting
headache. Frequent bleeding of nose at appearance of menses. Ovaritis. Inter-menstrual pain with a great
abdominal and pelvic soreness (Ham.). Pain in right ovary as if torn, extending to thigh (Lil-t., Croc.). Sharp
 pains in ovaries on taking a deep inspiration, very sensitive to touch.
Food - Craves what he cannot relish. Loathing for food. Canine hunger after nausea. Irritability after eating.
Aversion to greasy food. Aversion to milk, but when he takes it he relishes it. Great desire for coffee, wine
and acid drinks. Desire for meat, oysters, sweets. Desire for warm drink, and better by it. Worse bread.
Cabbage causes diarrhea. Sauerkraut, cabbage, potatoes and other vegetables, disagree.
Worse w#rm drinks, which are vomited. Gastric derangement after old sausages, old cheese, cabbage,
sauerkraut, fruit, turnips, salads, milk, etc. Drinks hastily and eagerly. Thirst, for large quantity of cold water,
also for warm drinks, which ameliorate.
Head - Gastric, rheumatic, congestive, bilious headaches. Migraine headaches, worse on any motion, even
that of the eyeballs, better from closing eyes. Pressure in head, as if brain were too full, worse sitting. Bursting,
splitting headache, as if everything would be pressed out. Bursting pain, with dry, parched lips. As if hit by
a hammer from within, worse from motion, stooping, opening eyes. Pain over left eye, pressive, going to
occiput, then spreading over whole body. Severe sharp pains in head, worse motion. Headache in occiput.
Headache from ironing. Headache when constipated. Frontal headache, frontal sinuses involved. Bones
drawing in towards zygoma. Vertex as if bruised. Headaches better from tying up head. Mental exertion
aggravates head pains. Rheumatic pains, in cold, damp, wet seasons. Scalp very sensitive, can't bear even a
soft brush, every hair pains. Dandruff, rough and uneven. Hair very greasy. Cold sweat on head.
Heart - Angina pectoris. Sharp pain in cardiac region, worse motion. Sharp pain, cramp in region of heart,
worse walking, motion or slightest exertion. Heart beats violently and rapidly. Palpitations with dyspnea.
Fluttering and palpitations on going up stairs. Burning in veins. Endocarditis. Pulse frequent at night, slower
during day. Pulse tense and hard. Pulse full and quick. Intermittent pulse with strong orgasm of blood.
Kidneys - Pain in region of kidneys. Involuntary urination during exertion. Involuntary discharge of urine from
cough. Burning and cutting pain before urination. Burning in urethra, when not urinating. Urination frequent,
but scanty. Obliged to rise at night to urinate. Urine, red, brown, like beer, scanty, hot. Urine whitish, turbid.
Limbs - Joints with sharp and tearing pains, worse on least movement. Sprained, injured and painful joints,
worse motion. Severe pain from broken bones. Joints red, swollen, hot. Swelling of elbow. Painful stiffness
of limbs. Pains in joints and limbs better warmth. Every spot is painful on pressure. Constant motion of left
arm and leg with sighing (Hell.). Sciatica, better lying quietly and on painful side. Knees stiff and painful. Ankle
or knee injury, swollen, painful and worse motion. Knees totter and bend under him when walking. Hot
swelling of feet. Pins and needles in soles, preventing walking. Ulcers on fingers and toes. Weariness and
heaviness in all limbs.
Liver - Liver heavy, swollen, sore, tensive, better lying on it. Jaundice. Symptoms of inflammation of liver.
Burning and sharp pain in hepatic region.
Lungs - Bronchitis. Asthma. Paroxysms of asthma, at night. Pleurisy with sharp pains, worse motion.
Difficult, quick respiration, worse every movement, caused by sharp pains in chest. Croup and pleuro-
pneumonia. Dyspnea, must sit up, worse after eating or drinking, with sharp pain in chest. Dyspnea
painful, so that he could not talk. Sighing and sobbing. Dyspnea with rapid breathing. Wants to take deep
breath, but cannot or it excites cough. Pneumonia with painful cough. Rusty, tenacious sputum. Brick
colored, blood-streaked sputum. Sputum like lumps of jelly. Tough mucus in trachea, loosened only with much
hawking. Yellowish mucus. Dry, friction sound.
Male - Sharp pains in right testicle and spermatic cord. Sharp pains in testicles when sitting. Red, itching
eruption on glans penis. Increased sexual desire.
Modalities - Better from lying on painful side. Better from pressure. Better bandaging. Better rest, being
quiet. Better drawing knees up. Better sitting up, descending. Betterfrom cold things. Better cold food or
drink. Better cool open air. Better cloudy, damp days. Better heat to inflamed part. Better exhaling.
Modalities - Worse from least motion. Worse lying on the painless side. Worse raising up, stooping.
Worse coughing, deep breathing. Worse exertion, touch. Worse from dry cold or heat. Worse becoming
hot. Worse in room. Worse hot weather. Worse drinking while hot. Worse from eating, vegetables, acids.
Worse from anger, vexation. Worse calomel. Worse suppressions. Worse taking cold. Worse 3 a.m. to 4
a.m. Worse evening, 9 p.m. Worse in the early morning. Worse summer.
Mouth - Dryness of mouth, tongue and throat with excessive thirst. Offensive smell from mouth, with
hawking of offensive, tough mucus. Taste bitter, cannot swallow food, better cold drinks. Soapy, frothy saliva.
Burning in lower lip in old smokers. Lips parched, dry, cracked. Sore mouth in infants, child does not want
to take hold of breast, but after mouth becomes moist it nurses well.
Nose - Fluent coryza, watery or greenish. Headache following checked coryza. Descending colds. Dry nasal
catarrh. Coryza with shooting and aching in the forehead. Vicarious nosebleeds, when menses should
appear. Nosebleeds in pregnancy. Nosebleeds in the morning relieving the headache. Swelling of tip of nose,
 feels as if it would ulcerate when touched. Inflamed and ulcerated nostrils. Boils. Sneezing between coughs.
Loss of smell.
Perspiration - Sweat, sour or oily after slight exertion. Easy, profuse perspiration. Profuse sweat at night and

Skin - Dry skin. Skin, yellow, pale swollen, dropsical. Slow development or sudden receding of rash in eruptive

Sleep - Drowsy, starting when falling asleep. Sleepiness during and after stool. Frequent yawning the whole
day. Somnambulism. Restless sleep before midnight. Sleeplessness on account of heat and thirst.

Stomach - Dyspeptic ailments during summer heat. Burning pain in stomach. Tasteless eructations. Stomach

Stools - Stools, large dry, very hard. Stools, as if burnt. Stools, brown, thick, bloody. Stools, loose, painless,
undigested. Stools, worse in morning, worse from moving, worse after being heated from cold drinks, worse
every spell of hot weather.
Involuntary stool during sleep. Yellow, mushy stools. Lumps of tough mucus after stools. Gushing diarrhea,

Teeth - Gums pain as if sore and raw, with painful loose teeth. Aching of gums with teething children (Dol.).

tooth was in pain from cold air.
Temperature - Chilliness predominates. Chill with external coldness, dry cough, stitches. Chill with hot head
and red face, worse warm room. Chill after anger. Coldness and rigors during stool. Dry burning heat, with
worsening of all symptoms. Blood seems hot. Fever with desire to uncover. Rheumatic fever and typhoid fever
marked by gastro-hepatic complications. Painful continued fevers.
Throat - Hoarseness, worse in open air. Dryness, sticking on swallowing, scraped and constricted (Bell.).
Hawks brown lumps with effort. Dryness and rawness of throat worse in warm room. Back of throat seems
swollen. Aphthous patches, recurring. Sharp pain when swallowing. Pressive pain in right tonsil. Pain, pres-
sure and soreness in trachea, pain worse talking and smoking. Soreness in larynx and trachea. Tough mucus
in larynx and trachea, loosened only after much hawking, worsecoming intowarmroom. Voice nasal or raised.
Tongue - Dryness of tongue. Dry, white, filthy tongue. Aphthae on tip of tongue. Tongue coated yellowish,
dark brown. Tongue coated heavily white in gastric derangement. Tongue coated along centre, red at base.
Trembling of tongue. Tongue thinly coated yellow, with longitudinal fissure. White tongue with red edges.
Vertigo - Aural vertigo (Aur., Nat-sal., Sil., Chin.). Vertigo, nausea, confusion. Vertigo, dizzy or faint on rising
up. Vertigo felt in occiput. Vertigo, as though
all objects are whirling. Vertigo worse on least motion. Vertigo, as if sinking deep down in the bed, better
cold. Vertigo, as if brain were turning around. Vertigo on turning head or on stooping.
Vision - Dim vision. Every object appears covered with rainbow colors, followed by photophobia. Letters run
together when reading. Bluish haze.
COMMENTS - Primary distinguishing symptoms are a slow onset of a disease, dryness of the mouth and skin
and a thirst for cold drinks. Any complaint is worse motion, patient will immobilize affected area, frozen with
pain.
 Intermitting fever, chill mixed with heat. During chill, head hot, cheeks deep red, decided thirst, generally for
large quantities at long intervals, sweat worse by least motion, sour or oily. Fever with a stupid, drowsy
condition or mild delirium in which the patient has the delusion that he is somewhere else and “wants to go
home.” Chilliness predominates.
Dry, burning heat as if blood burning in veins. Sweat profuse at night and morning, sour or oily.
Headache or neuralgia in (left) side of head and face, better from hard pressure and cold applications, worse
moving. Dull headache, frontal or bursting, splitting. Headache is worse by any motion or by the concussion
of cough, and it goes from the front to back of head. The headache of alcoholics, of over-feeding or
constipation. Nausea and faintness when rising up, better when lying still.
Migraines with splitting, sharp pain, throbbing nausea and vomiting. They want to go into a dark room and be
left alone. Sensation of hammers hitting their head (Nat-m.). Better hard pressure, can be worse light touch.
Worse motion, light, sound, any stimulation. Headache with bursting pain, as if their head will explode. Eye
movement can cause severe pain, occipital pain is sharp. With sinus headache, sinuses become dry.
Dry mucus membranes, especially those of the mouth and stomach, deficient secretion. Serous membranes
are inflamed, the seat of sharp, stitching pains, worse from motion.
later on there is exudation.
Muscles are inflamed and sore. Flu with soreness and aching in the joints, pain, worse motion.
The respiratory organs and heart are profoundly affected. Lungs are dry, good for dry, hacking cough that goes
into the chest in pneumonia and bronchitis. Respiration becomes worse with deep breathing, try to breath as
little as possible. Cough, worse morning. “Frequent desire to take a long breath, must expand the lungs” Want
open, fresh air, felt better in cold air.
Hemorrhages. Nosebleeds, especially in the night, 3 to 4 a.m., which is characteristic. This may or may not be
preceded by a sense of fullness in the head. Nosebleeds consequent on suppression of the menses is
characteristic.
Mouth very dry, tongue coated white down the middle, the edges may be quite clean, later it becomes yellow
with bitter taste. Lips are dry and cracked.
Toothache, better by pressing head into pillow, by cold applications. Tendency to chew lips, pick nose or
cracked lips, or grind teeth. Brain disorders with a constant motion of the mouth as if chewing. Dirty wash-
leather, foul tongue, congested eyes, bitter nausea.
Food lies at the epigastrium like a stone, better bringing up wind. The digestion is worse in summer. Symptoms
worse after a meal. A coarse feeder. Bry. is a gourmand (Nux-v., an epicure). There is intolerance of vegetable
food. Everything tastes bitter. Gastric derangement “absolutely requires water as a dissolvent.” Thirst for large
quantities. Burning thirst, for cold drinks, worse from beer. Dehydration in the GI, causing constipation, and
joint, causing arthritis.
“Belchings of tasteless gas.” Sour stomach. Constipation, atony of the bowels. Stool large, dry, hard, brown or
black, as if burnt or charred, crumbling (Plat, has sticky, tenacious stool, sticks to rectum). Stools smell of old
cheese. Can have no desire to stool. Diarrhea worse in the morning.
The liver is tender and inflamed. The kidneys also are inflamed, the urine being dark red without deposit (from
excess of coloring matter). Appendicitis with nausea, vomiting, fever and rebound tenderness (Bell.). Mastitis,
hard, tender. Left ovarian pain, better lying on painful side.
Dropsical swellings, swellings of the legs, sensitive to touch. “Joints red, swollen, stiff with stitching pain from
slightest motion.” Synovial swellings. Symptoms are worse with stiffness.
Ankle injuries, the slightest movement causes severe pain. Trauma injuries. Low back problems, slipped disks.
Whiplash where the neck is frozen with pain and they don't want to be touched, will immobilize neck as
movement causes great pain.
Fixation due to pain worse from motion. Worse with any effort, they move only because there is pain. Will cling
to support. Lying on the painful part keeps the part at rest. There is also an intense headache, dull throbbing
or sharp stabbing pains, sharp pain in or over eyes. Head greasy, scalp tender, eyeballs tender. All their
symptoms become worse at 9 p.m. and 3 a.m.
Irritable. Constantly finding dissatisfaction. Hasty speech. Dreams of the occupations of the day. The child
kicks the covers off. Often of a dark complexion and hair, choleric, bilious tendency with firm fleshy fiber,
tendency to great irritability and bad temper.
Clarke cured a case of congenital hydrocele with Bry.
Van den Berghe found Bry. singularly curative in chlorosis, with diarrhea and constipation. Diarrhea occurs in
the morning “as soon as he moves” from cold drinks in warm weather, on every spell of hot weather.
Teste took Bryonia as the type of a group which includes All-s., Lyc., Dig., Nux-v., Coloc. and Ign. All these act
with much more power on carnivorous than on herbivorous animals. They are thus appropriate to persons who
 over-eat or eat excessively of meat and have strong constitutions, “persons accustomed to rich living with rich
blood, firm resisting flesh.” Teste regarded the digestive canal, and more particularly the stomach, as
the principal seat of the action of Bry.
A case of facial eczema was cured with it in an infant five months old, presenting the additional symptoms of
constipation, peevish, fretful, thirsty, face and lips are cracked and sore. The child scratched continually. The
mother had a similar eruption for some years and it disappeared suddenly at the sixth month of her pregnancy.
RELATIONS-Antidotes: Aeon., Cham., Nux- v.. Bryonia is Antidoted by: Aeon., Alum., Camph., Cham.,
Chel., Clem., Ign., Mur-ac., Nux-v., Puls., Rhus-t., Seneg. Teste found by accident, Ferr-m. the best antidote
in his experience. It antidotes: Alum., Chlorum, Chin., Frag., Merc., Rhus-t. Compare: (1) Asc-t., Kali-m.,
Ptelia. (2) The Cucurbitaceae - all have belching with unaltered taste of food. (3) Aeon. - pallor on rising up.
Aeon, has more restlessness and tossing about is full of fears, Bry. must keep still. (4) Amm., Ant-c. (nausea,
vomiting and diarrhea, aversion to milk), Am. (hemorrhages, wounds, soreness all over, also Bapt.), Ars.
(unlike Bry. drinks often and little and eats seldom but much), Asc-t. (pleurisy). (5) Bell, (delirium, hasty speech,
hasty drinking. Bell, has headache worse lying down, Bry. must lie down, Bell, has worse lying on painful side,
Bry. better lying on painful side. (6) Bell, has "chewing motion of jaws’’ but without the dry, cracked lips of
Bry.). (7) Calc, like Bry., Chin, and Bell., has “as soon as he closes his eyes sees all sorts of objects ",
Carb-v. (miliaria), Caust., Cham., Ign., Ip. (miliaria). (8) Kali-c., chest affections, sharp pains in right
hypochondrium shooting up into chest, sharp pain coming from lower lobe right lung, but Kali-c. has not
necessarily worse by motion. (9) Kreos., Lach., Lyc., Merc., Nat-s. (morning diarrhea), (10) Nat-m. - headache
in morning, oily, sour sweat on face, Bry. on head generally, cracked lips, Bry. and Nat-m. gowelltogetherand
are often complementary. Complementary: Alum., Rhus-t. Alum, is the “chronic" of Bry. and Kali-c. and Nat-
m., hold a similar but less pronounced relation to it. Complementary: Upas when Bryonia fails. Rhus-t.,
Alumina.
