name: Bufo Rana
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bufo. Bufo rana. Toad poison. Bufo satytiensis. Bufo vulgaris. N. O. Bufonide, Batrachide.
Europe, Asia, Japan. Solution of the poison expressed from the cutaneous glands on the back. Historical
dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Brain, softening. Brain, tumors. Breast, cancer. Buboes. Cancer. Carbuncles. Convulsions.
Decay. Dropsy. Chorea. Convulsions. Dropsy. Epilepsy. Gout. Heart disorders. Imbecility. Impotency.
Intermittent fever. Leucorrhea. Lumbago. Lymphangitis. Malignant pustules. Masturbation, effects.
Meningitis. Nosebleed. Panaritium. Paralysis. Parkinson's disease. Pemphigus. Phlegmasia alba dolens.
Plague. Sciatica. Self-abuse. Septic, lymphangitis. Skin disorders. Spasms. Stammering. Suppuration.
Whitlow.
HOMEOPATHIC - Mureprovedthecommon variety, Bufo rana and the Brazilian toad, Bufo Satytiensis.
Shakespeare was correct in speaking of the toad as having “sweltered venom. ”
The poison is excreted by glands in the skin of the back. “Quintessence of toads ” figured largely in the
therapy of Salmon's Doron Medicon (1583), where it is commended as a “Specific in the Dropsy. ”
Homeopathic provings and poisonings have shown that this reputation is founded on fact.
The chief laurels of Bufo have been won in the treatment of epilepsy. Bojanus cured many cases, and no
medicine has served better in the treatment of this disease.
Few people who have witnessed a characteristic epileptic seizure can have failed to notice the curiously toad-
like aspect assumed by the subject.
The epileptic seizure and the status epileptic give the clearest correspondence to the Bufo range of action.
Epilepsy is often found among the effects of self-abuse in the young.
Remarkable action on nervous system and sexual organs.
Epileptic symptoms. Epileptic seizures occur during night, connected with sexual sphere. Variety of
symptoms occur before epileptic spasms. Seizures at the time of menses in women when sexual desire is
excited in young men due to onanism or during sex. Falls down unconscious with a blood-curdling scream.
Bufo is indicated in epilepsy when the attacks occur during sleep at night. The patient may or may not be
awakened by the attack, if not, when he does awaken he will have violent headache. Epileptic symptoms worse
warm room.
Symptoms of Parkinson's disease. Convulsions from suppurative conditions. Fetid discharges and exhalations.
Injuries to fingers, pain runs in streaks up the arms. Septic lymphangitis, due to injuries, when pain runs up
in streaks. Striking rheumatic symptoms. As if a peg in joint.
 Marked periodicity, quartan fever. Dropsy. Paralysis. Carbuncle. Buboes. Causes low grades of inflammatory
action, fetid exhalations and discharges. Cancer. Severe late cancer conditions. Clarke has removed the fetor
in hopeless cases of cancer with this remedy.
Affects circulation, causing heat flushings, burning in different parts. Anesthetic spots on skin. Marked uterine
symptoms. Spasms in children after nursing, angry or frightened mother. Causes a desire for intoxicating
drink and produces impotence. Extremely sensitive to light and noise, the latter is intolerable.
MIND - Confusion and loss of memory, bordering on imbecility. Prematurely senile. Great weakness of
memory, idiotic. The mind remains childish, only the body grows. Of use in feeble-minded children. Feeble-
minded. Idiocy, silly, tittering. Talks nonsense, then angry if not understood.
Anxious about health. Fears animals, strangers. Fear of mirrors in room. Biting nails. Nervousness and
trembling worse open air. Music is unbearable. Lamenting alternating with crying. Easily laughs or cries. Cries
much with epilepsy. Easily startled.
Sad, restless. Sadness on waking. Dullness better evening. Walks the floor and wrings the hands. Ill-humour
after menses. Irritability in morning on waking. Irritability at night after retiring. Irritability after menses.
Delirium or apathy, with hot head. Stupor and inability to speak. Deceitfulness. Rage while alone. Propensity
to bite. Howling, impatient, nervous, imbecility. Longs for solitude, yet dreads being alone.
Anger before convulsions. Stupefaction between convulsions. Unconsciousness after convulsions.
Moral depravity. Derangements of the sexual sphere. Depravities due to bad inheritance. Desire for solitude
to practice masturbation. It arouses lowest passions, patient is not only low minded but develops low type
of disease also.
Abdomen - Colicky pain after drinking milk, and after smoking. Violent colic with convulsive movements
of jaws and limbs. Sensation as if cold balls running through bowels. Buboes in groins. Convulsive
movements in abdomen after spasms. Spasms end by convulsive movements in abdomen. Epileptic attacks
originate in abdomen.
Back - Jerks in nape of neck, epileptic attacks. Lumbago, worse rising up or least motion. Swelling of bone,
size of a fist. Decay of dorsal vertebrae. Stiff neck after sleep.
Breasts - Mastitis. Bloody oozing from nipples. Bloody milk. Breasts cancer. Induration in breast glands.
Violent pain in breasts, worse at night. Palliative in cancer of breasts. Offensive bloody discharge from breast.
Chest - Sensation as if chest and heart were constricted. Burning like fire in chest. Rapid motion of diaphragm.
Constitutions - Feeble-minded children. Prematurely senile.
Cough - Suffocative. [11] From any emotion. From burning or stitches in larynx. At night, provoked towards 3
or 4 AM by tickling in larynx, which he feels only at this hour. In consequence of cold feet. Violent, with vomiting.
Dry, with sharp pain or burning in chest.
Ears - Music is intolerable (Ambr.). Every little noise distresses. Purulent otorrhea, ulceration and bleeding of
external ears. Heartbeats reverberate in ears, in meningitis. Pains worse cold washing. Swelling of ears and
parotids.
Eyes - Eyes red, injected. Itching, swollen, painful. Eyes sunken during epileptic attack. Burning, itching and
ulceration of lids. Left eyelid paralyzed. Little blisters form on eye. Right eye open, left nearly closed. Eyeballs
rolled upward and to left before attack. Strabismus. Aversion to the sight of brilliant objects. Pupils dilated.
Face - Face greyish. Burning and redness of swollen face. Lips black. Face bloated and distorted, mouth and
eyes convulsed. Bathed in sweat during spasms. Sweat runs down face. Momentary hot flushes of face.
Phlegmonous erysipelas, which leaves face deformed. Cold water causes pricking of face.
Female - Menses too early, too copious. Epilepsy with menses. Menses with headache. Menstrual pains run
into legs. After menses, ill-humored. Offensive, bloody discharge, clots. Watery leucorrhea. Offensive purulent
leucorrhea. Burning and swelling in ovaries and uterus. Burning heat and sharp pain in ovaries. Hydatids in
ovaries. Ulceration of cervix, with burning pains. Tumors and polyps of the womb. Milk-leg. Veins swollen.
Cord like swelling from groin to knee, milk leg. Sexual excitement with epileptic attacks. Cancer of uterus.
Veins swollen. Swelling and great sensitiveness of ovarian region.
Food - Desire for sweet drinks. Desire for sugar-water. Longing forbrandy, delights in getting drunk. Aversion
to food and drink.
Head - Face bathed in sweat. Congestive headaches with flushed face. Pillow hurts occiput. Pressure like two
iron hands holding temples. Headaches after breakfast. One-sided headaches, worse by light and noise.
Numbness of brain before epileptic attack. Headache with epilepsy. Head at first drawn to one side, then
backwards before an attack. Lancinating pain in occiput, inclining head
to fall backward, in meningitis. Violent orgasm in head. Profuse sweat on head. Hair falls out. Sensation as if
hot vapor rose to top of head.
Heart - Feels too large. Heaviness about heart. Rapid heart action in exophthalmos. Palpitations with
 headache during menses. Constriction about heart. Palpitations after eating. Palpitations with nausea. Palpita-
tions on awaking. Heart seems to float in water or air. Sticking pain about apex of heart. Palpitations and
oppression from walking fast. Paralysis of heart. Pulse more rapid and threadlike as epileptic attacks multiplied.
Kidneys - Burning pain in kidneys, with oppressed breathing and faintness. Involuntary urination. Hematuria
in childbed. Frequent discharge of pale urine. Suppression of urine. Urine brown, offensive.
Limbs - Trembling of limbs. Limbs become stiff, numb. Cramps in limbs worse cold air. Bruised pains,
trembling, cramps, arthritic swellings. Arms go to sleep easily. Swelling of hands and arms, burning pains.
Lymphangitis, red streaks under skin. Staggering gait. Feeling as if a peg were driven in joint. Panaritium,
swelling blue-black around nail, pain in streaks up arm. Sciatica. Contusive pains in arms, legs and loins,
during motion. Arthritic pains, worse after sleep. Swelling of bones. Epileptic attacks preceded by restless
movements of limbs and body.
Liver - Enlargement of liver. Pulsating, pain in liver like an abscess, with vomiting of bile.
Lungs - Burning like fire in lungs. Suffocative cough. Asthma. Difficult breathing from compression of larynx,
trachea and heaviness of chest, must sit up or bend forward. Anxious, difficult, gets shorter and shorter, during
fever. Dyspnea, pants like a dog. Mucus or bloody expectoration, or pure blood, raised most in morning and
evening, with sensation of cold in chest.
Male - Buboes. Disposition to fondle organ (Hyos., Zinc.). Disposition to masturbation. Effects of onanism.
Involuntary emissions. Impotence, ejaculation too quick. Spasms during sex.
Male - Semen is discharged too quickly, without pleasurable sensation, sometimes with cramps or painful
heaviness in limbs.
Modalities - Better from cold bathing. Better putting feet in hot water. Better cool air. Better bleeding. Worse
from warm room. Worse sexual excitement. Worse from masturbation. Worse least motion and injuries. Worse
on waking. Worse with a full moon.
Mouth - Burning in mouth, as from acid, worse cold water. Bloody saliva. Constant licking of lips. Fetid odor
from mouth. Stuttering and stammering, angry when not understood. Falling out of teeth. Convulsions after
extracting teeth. Mouth wide open before epileptic attack. Ejection of frothy, bloody saliva from mouth during
epileptic attack.
Nose - Nosebleed with flushed faced and pain in forehead. Better after nosebleed. Nosebleed almost
producing faintness. Sneezing in evening, when going to bed. Coryza, pimples on upper lip. Discharge of
greenish-yellow, putrid mucus, worse evening. Mucus descends into posterior nares. Ulcerated, burning
nostrils. Loss of smell.
Perspiration - Profuse sweat, oily, on head and face. Profuse sweat with weakness. Sweats during spasms.
Sweats during sleep, towards morning. Cold sweat. Copious, clammy sweat, on hands and arms. Sweats
during epilepsy.
Rectum - Dysentery with delirium, headache and sleeplessness. Bowels torpid. Ascarides. Hemorrhoids,
discharging bright red blood. Stools white. Difficult, hard stool, with cold body and hot head.
Skin - Itching and burning. Lymphangitis, red streaks under skin. Patches of skin lose sensation. Pustules,
suppuration from every slight injury. Pustules, tetters and eruption of small nodules. Pemphigus. Yellow
bullae, yellowish, corrosive fluid oozes out. Blisters on hands occurring annually. Blisters on palms and soles.
Large yellow blisters. Epidemic, infectious carbuncles. Carbuncles. Goose bumps. Ulcers with burning pain.
Anthrax.
Chilblains. Yellowness of skin.
Sleep - Irresistible sleepiness after eating. Drowsy, but can't sleep, from agitation, constantly turning in bed.
Sleepiness after smoking in forenoon. Comatose after spasms. Sleepy after meals. Sleepiness after having
been in open air. Constant yawning, can't keep lids open. Starting in sleep, awakens as if frightened. All
symptoms worse on waking.
Stomach - Burning pain in stomach. Weak, faint feeling in stomach. Eructations, as from rotten eggs. Nausea
and vomiting from nervous excitement. Vomiting after drinking. Yellow fluid in vomit. Vomiting of blood and
bile.
Temperature - Coldness and shivering, with moist skin, nervousness and trembling, worse going into open
air. Fever with apathy or delirium, and cold feet. Burning heat in various parts. Limbs burning hot during fever.
Throat - Convulsive and constrictive motion in throat, with sensation like a stone there. Dryness in throat,
impeding swallowing, in morning. Difficult swallowing, can hardly swallow saliva. Burning, excoriation in larynx.
Bleeding fissures, causes quick, jerking cough.
Tongue - Tongue is cracked, bluish black. Lapping of or playing with tongue. Paralysis of tongue, lapping
motion before the attacks. Bites tongue. Dry tongue.
Vertigo - Vertigo, as if house was turned upside down. Vertigo with heaviness of head. Vertigo, as if floating
 or swimming in water or air. Dizzy, drunken feeling after dinner.
Vision - Dim vision, with itching in eyes. Can't bear sight of brilliant objects. Objects appear crooked. Objects
appear as if seen through a veil.
COMMENTS - Bufo provokes the tendency to the practice, or even causes impotence. The Indian women of
Brazil are aware of this last property and administer the venom to their husbands in food or drink when they
wish to free themselves from their marital attentions.
L. Guthrie told a story of an Italian peasant, apparently dying of dropsy, whose wife, weary of the interminable
length of his illness, thought to hasten his end by putting a toad into his wine. The man was completely cured.
According to Lippe, Bufo is especially indicated in epilepsy when the attacks occur during sleep at night. The
patient may or may not be awakened by the attack, if not, when he does awaken he will have a violent
headache.
Epileptic symptoms are worse in warm room, but there is also great sensitiveness to cold air and wind. Epilepsy
that's worse with a full moon. For epilepsy in children with delayed development (Bar-c.). Keynote masturbation
in children or with epilepsy.
Lymphangitis. Swollen glands, buboes, particularly in groin and armpits. May go systemic, pus and
suppuration. Infection leading to swollen glands and fever (Carban.). “Low state,” decomposition, breakdown
in tissues with pus and septic states. Difficult to heal. Cancers with deterioration (Kreos.) in the late stages.
Greasy skin, foul discharges and odors. Carbuncles, boils, large water-filled vesicles (bullae). Marked
periodicity, quartan fevers. Hemorrhages. Boericke noted a “desire for solitude” in order to masturbate.
Guernsey commended it in panaritium where the pain runs in streaks, all the way up the arm. Also when the
fingers have been injured and look black, with pains running in streaks up the arm.
E. E. Case reported a cure with Bufo cinereus of “nosebleed daily for several weeks with flushed face, heat
and pain in forehead better by the bleeding, there was also easy, perspiration in general, apt to be offensive,
especially on the feet.”
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Lach., Seneg. Compare: (1) Bar-c., Aster., Salamand. (Epilepsy and softening
of brain). (2) Cubeb, in convulsions from low grades of suppuration.
(3) Ars., Canth., Lach, and Tarent, in epilepsy aura starting in solar plexus. (4) Art-v., Calc., Nux-v., Sil., (5)
aura starting in arm, Lach., Sulph. (6) in chorea, patient cannot walk, must
run or jump, Kali-br., Nat-m., as if heart in water, Bov., (7) in masturbation, impotence, etc., Hyos., Merc.,
Sulph., (8) in malignant pustule, Anthrax., Ant. c., Lach. (9) in bullae, panaritium, etc.. Hep., Lach., Ph-ac., Sil.,
Dios. (10) Head drawn to either side, Camph. Complementary: Salamandra. Helo., Am- phisbena is
complementary in epilepsy and brain-softening (Hering).

Decay. Dropsy. Chorea. Convulsions. Dropsy. Epilepsy. Gout. Heart disorders. Imbecility. Impotency.
Intermittent fever. Leucorrhea. Lumbago. Lymphangitis. Mali

name: Bunias Orientalis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-buni-o. Bunias orientalis. N. O. Cruciferae. Tincture of the seeds. Historical dose: Tincture and
all potencies.
CLINICAL - Adenitis. Allergies. Amaurosis. Arthritis. Asthma. Brachial neuralgia. Cancer. Coccydynia.
Congenital malformations. Dyspnea. Eczema. Emaciation. Fever. Headaches. Hoarseness. Hodgkin's
disease. Intermittent fever. Leucorrhea. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Nausea. Neuralgia. Neuritis. Proteinuria.
Scars. Syphilitic, adenitis. Tubercular, adenitis. Vertigo.
HERBAL - Buniasis abiennial plant, measuring up to 120 cm. It flowers in May and June, and grows near
lucerne fields and along the roads all over Europe.
Prinzing used the seeds of the Norwegian stock of the plant in homeopathic potencies. His attention was drawn
towards this plant after learning that a doctor in the North was using Bunias to treat cancerous subjects with
interesting results.
HOMEOPATHIC-The homeopathic clinical proving involved one hundred and three patients during a period of
two years, and a series of forty patients observed for ten years. The remedy as found to be suitable for
tubercular and sycotic types with arthritic neurotic tendencies, for women with syphilitic afflictions, and
especially for cancerous subjects.
Allergic, psoric or syphilitic conditions, pre-cancerous conditions. Hodgkin's disease. Intermittent attacks of
fever, beginning with a fit of shivering at around 11 p.m. chattering teeth, heat and ending in the morning.
Brachial neuralgia. Pains go around in circles, quickly change place, burning, stinging or cramping. Diffuse
nerve pains, behind the mastoid process, the top of the radius top of the fibula the end of the 12th rib. Neuralgia
of the left sciatic nerve.
The sudden appearance and disappearance of all symptoms. Rapid emaciation of no apparent reason, (pre-
cancerous condition). Tiredness, weakness, loss of vitality. Every difficult previously overcome with ease is
 now arduous and faced with gritting of the teeth. Need to lie down after a few hours work. Cannot stay awake
in the evening.
Sensory complaints decreased vision and hearing. Feeling of stabbing the chest. Sensation that the head is
increased in size of swelling in the upper part of the body in the hand. Feeling of coldness in the head, stomach,
fingers and back. Sensation of lightness and of hovering in the air, then of falling violently into a bottomless
pit.
Itching eruption followed by adenitis. Subacute infections of rheumatic or of the female genital organs. Neuritis
and neuralgia.
Irregular menses, nauseating leucorrhea. Abnormal pregnancy. Children weak puny, premature, syphilitic
types. Babies born with congenital malformations.
Profuse bleeding after birth with large placenta. Scars. Bloodstained lochia continuing for three to four months.
Vulvar varicosity during pregnancy. Metrorrhagia during menopause.
MIND - Neurotic condition with anguish and unrest. Irrational anxiety, can lead to suicide. Depressive
psychosis in the pre-cancerous subject. Psychological exhaustion. Depressed. Depressive psychosis, which
can end in suicide.
Abdomen - Copies flatulence during the day.
Constitutions - Psoric and allergic constitutions. Cancerous, syphilitic conditions.
Ears - Tinnitus-like bells ringing, or water boiling.
Eyes - Visual complaints. Sees clouds or black circles before the eye. Temporary amaurosis.
Female - Menses painful, irregular, abundant or scanty flow with purplish blood and
clotting. Infrequent menses. Headaches and dyspnea before menses. Vulvar congestion with red-brown
coloring. Vulvar eczema. Irritating leucorrhea, yellow or brownish, foul-smelling, nauseating. Menorrhagia in
young girls. Pre-menopausal menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia through premature placenta or hematoma behind the
placenta. Abnormal pregnancy.
Kidneys - Urine irritating of a strong odor, albuminous or streaked with blood. Proteinuria. Indol in urine.
Bacteria in urine.
Limbs - Bouts of rheumatoid arthritis with swollen joints. Localized edema, coming and disappearing suddenly,
on the back of the hand, collarbones and axillae. Coccydynia.
Lungs - Sharp, sudden hoarseness. Dyspnea. Asthma, appearing suddenly at the age of 40. Wheezy
respiration, dyspnea, sensation of restriction in the chest, pain on the left side of the sternum.
Modalities - Better from walking. Better changing position. Better open air. Worse at night. Worse on the side
of the body compressed for a long time. Worse on left side. Worse from over-exertion. Worse from heavy, fatty
foods.
Rectum - Stools suddenly turn to diarrhea in attacks lasting 2-3 days, then reverting to normal. Attacks of
constipation with hard stools, difficult with nausea. Tendency to sudden appearance of hemorrhoids.
Skin - Eruption of red spots or vesicles, redbrick or pale purple in color, located on the nose, cheeks, palms,
forearms, thighs, legs. Vesicles on the tip of the tongue, the periphery of the mouth and around the anus.
Itching eruption, aggravated by scratching. Pruritus premonitory to malignant adenitis.
Sleep - Sleep light, disturbed, frequently woken. Tosses and turns constantly from one side to the other to fall
asleep exhausted when the morning comes.
Temperature - Fever every 21 days in short attacks, coming between 11 p.m. and 12 p.m. with shivering,
thoracic pains on the left side, weakness and vomiting. Two to four hours after the shivering comes
sweating, which soothes.
Vertigo - Vertigo with a feeling of uncertainty, coming suddenly, lasting only a short while in the early morning.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1 ) Bapt. - Considerable nervous depression, face red, bewildered, extreme
agitation, putrid-smelling breath, fetid diarrhea, lived marks on the body and limbs. (2) Syph. - Pains in the
bones, at night, appearing and disappearing slowly. Breath fetidand painless constipation or diarrhea in the
morning. Profuse, acrid, yellowish leucorrhea. (3) Syph. - Changing moods, difficulty in assembling thoughts,
loss of memory, especially forproper nouns. (4) Ars. - Rapid prostration, anxiety, agitation, cadaverous odor of
the secretions, aggravation at night between 1 a.m. and 3 a.m. (5) Sec. - Post-partum hemorrhage.
Hemorrhage of black blood in exhausted women.
REFERENCES Julian.

name: Buthus Australis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - buth-aust. Buthus australis. Scorpion venom. Buthus prionuris. Androc- tonos funestus. Buthus
occitanus. Algerian scorpion. Common yellow scorpion. N. O. Arachnida. Tincture is prepared from the
 scorpion venom. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Chills. Fever. Headaches. Hypotension. Prostration. Salivation.
HOMEOPATHIC - Buthus Australis is a scorpion belonging to the arthropod order of the arachnid class.
The scorpions are insects distinguished by the division of their bodies into three sections: the head and thorax,
the pre-abdomen (seven segments) of the same form as the head and thorax, and the post-abdomen (six
segments), mistakenly called the tail, which is very mobile and ends with a venomous, curved sting.
The chelicerae have three joints, the last sections forming the pincers. The leg-jaws are very long and end in
fat pincers. These animals are viviparous, carnivorous, feed on insects and spiders, which they catch with their
pincers and have a defense organ.
Azam first carried out a proving on himself by taking one drop of pure venom orally. A second proving was
undertaken by Azam and carried out with the help of eight pro vers (three women and five men), using the 6x
potency for thirty days. Only four provers continued to the end of the thirty days.
Symptoms included an inhibition of will power and reduced activity. Head heavy, frontal headache. Vertigo on
walking. Excessive salivation. Attacks of fever with shivering. Limbs are cold with burning pain in the skin.
Upset by climatic changes with mental depression and shivering.
Anguish, thoracic constriction. Sensation of a piece of wood nailed between the heart and lungs. Hypotension
in infectious conditions. Infectious conditions with fever, shivering, prostration, aggravated at night. Respiratory
difficulty during pulmonary or cardiac illnesses.
MIND - Intellectual work arduous or trying. Alternating moods, at times loquacious, at times taciturn, sometimes
prostrate, sometimes restless. Irresistible need to speak. Anguish. Indecision and worry. Weepy. Fear of the
future, especially after 7 p.m. Sensation of being in a dream.
Abdomen - Pain and chill.
Back - Cervical muscular pains and stiffness of the nape of the neck.
Eyes - Red, weeping with photophobia. Eyeballs sunken. Strabismus.
Head - Throbbing headaches, wandering, very intense.
Heart - Feeling of heat in heart of a piece of wood nailed between heart and lungs.
Limbs - Trembling of the limbs. Hands cold, especially during shivering. Walking painful, and the legs seem
to want to move backwards instead of forwards.
Lungs - Difficult respiration, palpitations. Male - Erection not achieved.
Modalities - Better from eating, rest. Worse from effort, intellectual work. Worse in the late afternoon. Worse
when shivering. Periodicity is worse yearly.
Mouth - Profuse salivation. Difficult swallowing.
Nose - Sneezing.
Rectum - Diarrhea.
Skin - Red spots. Formication. Itching. Cold sweating, especially at night. Sensation of coldness, like icy
needles pricking the skin. /
Sleep - Strong feeling of fatigue, sleepiness and insensitivity.
Throat - Constriction in the throat.
Vertigo - Vertigo on walking.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lach. - Aggravated by lying down. Spontaneous hematoma. (2) Merc. -
Excessive salivation and tongue has a yellowish coating, which retains the imprint of the teeth. (3) Apis -
Sensation of being pierced by red hot needles, but with a predominance coldness at the limbs and sensation
of icy needles. (4) Verat. - Sensation of icy coldness. (5) Sil. - Throbbing headache, weeping, sneezing,
difficulty in swallowing, chilliness, shivering and sweating, but without the feeling of a piece of wood nailed
between the heart and lungs.
REFERENCES - Julian.

***BUTYRICUM ACIDUM (Butyric Acid)
PHARMACY - but-ac. Butyricum acidum. Butyric acid. A volatile acid obtained chiefly from butter, being found
there in the form of an ester, a triglyceride, and as such constitutes thechieffatofbutterandmilk. Historical
dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Ankylosing spondylitis. Anorexia. Belching. Cervicitis. Cramps. Dys- idrosis. Dysuria. Edema.
Flatulence. Foot sweat. Gingivitis. Headache. Leucorrhea. Onychomycosis. Palpitations.
HOMEOPATHIC - Butyric acid occurs in the animal organism undera variety of conditions. It constitutes the
chief fat of butter and milk. Butyric acid set free by fermentation causes a rancid taste and the odor of
contaminated butter.
When milk sours, milk sugar is converted into lactic acid by the lactic ferment of various bacteria. The lactic
 acid is then acted upon by butyric acid ferment contained in the air.
It may be present in the gastric contents under abnormal conditions, with a markedly diminished hydrochloric
acid secretion. In excessive fermentation in the enteric tract, butyric acid may be formed in significant amounts.
Abdominal flatulence. Tremendous formation of gas in the whole belly, much belching of gas, a great deal of
gas is passed at the call to stool, which in many cases fails to come.
Marked straining at stool. Stools are small like lumps. Intermittent belly cramps which are below the umbilicus.
Pain in the ileocecal region. Complete loss of appetite. Fetid leucorrhea. Offensive sweating of the soles of
feet.
MIND - Anxiety and fear. Worries over trifles. Constant fear and nervousness. Impulsive thoughts of suicide,
brooding.
Abdomen - Gastric and abdominal flatulence. Cramp in abdomen below umbilicus. Bowels irregular. Atony of
the liver and stomach. Epigastric and peri-umbilical pains, awaking at about 2 a.m. Pain in the ileocecal region
with feeling of cramp, relieved by expulsion of gas.
Back - Tired feeling and dull pain in small of back, worse walking. Pain in ankles and up back of leg. Pain low
down in back and limbs. Ankylosing spondylitis. Morbus coxae senilis.
Female - Foul-smelling leucorrhea, like horses urine. Purulent cervicitis. Dysuria.
Food - Anorexia. Poor appetite.
Head - Headache makes him apprehensive about trifles, worse going upstairs or rapid motion. Dull, hazy ache
of head.
Heart - Palpitations, aggravated by eating, with a feeling of abdominal plethora.
Kidneys - Urgent and pressing need to urinate, especially for women. Urine malodorous, smelling like
asparagus. Amorphous urate deposits.
Limbs - Dull aching of lumbar and sacral regions, worse standing, spreading towards the hip. Dull aching of
arms, legs and calves. Cold feet, with abundant, fetid perspiration. Edema of the feet during menses.
Modalities - Worse at night. Worse fast walking. Worse going upstairs. Worse during menses.
Mouth - Fetid odor in the mouth. Profuse salivation. Gingivitis. Gums tinged with blood. Gingival secretions,
which are offensive smelling and more profuse during menses. Painful gums, worse during menses.
Perspiration - Perspiration on slight exertion. Profuse, offensive foot sweat.
Rectum - Sudden nocturnal cramps with an urgent need to go to stool. Offensive smelling stools, chestnut
or light yellow in color. Feeling of heaviness in rectum with pain in the anus. Stool accompanied by pain and
straining.
Skin - The fingernails crumble away. Su- damina. Dysidrosis of the palms and soles. Onychomycosis.
Sleep - Sleep disturbed, owing to digestive complaints. Pronounced sleeplessness, dreams of serious nature
while asleep.
Stomach - Much gas in stomach and bowels. Cramps in pit of stomach, worse at night. Stomach feels heavy
and overloaded.
COMMENTS - The following provings were conducted at the Hahnemann Hospital of Philadelphia, upon
students at that institution. The students took the 3 c potency of the remedy every two hours; in all, the proving
was carried on for approximately seven weeks.
The remedy induces a peculiar effect on the superficial part of the body. Pronounced and awfully malodorous
foot sweat.
Students at the Hahnemann College often had to constantly change their socks, a thing quite foreign to the
provers under normal conditions.
Crumbling away of the fingernails. Aggravated backache.
All the symptoms are decidedly worse at night. Pronounced sleeplessness.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Bapt. - Putrid smelling breath. Fetid diarrhea and putrid stools. Mental confusion,
illusion that the body is double. (2) Verat. - Prostration intense delirium, feeling of chill running over the whole
body and cold sweating on forehead, hands and fee . Abdominal colic with copious diarrhea,
followed by extreme weakness. (3) Nux-m. - Dryness of the mucus membranes, thirst, gastric and abdominal
distention. Constipation with difficulty in expelling stools. Amenorrhea with leucorrhea.
REFERENCES - Anshutz.

name: Buxus Sempervirens
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - bux. Buxus sempervirens. Box tree. N. O. Euphorbiacae. Tincture of the young leaves and
twigs. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL-Abdomen, pains. Coldness. Convulsions. Diarrhea. Dizziness. Paintings. Nausea. Rheumatic pain.
 Sleepiness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Paintings. Strong forcing pains, like those of labor, in the lower part of the abdomen, which
varied greatly in intensity, and lasted from twenty or thirty seconds to a minute or longer.
Pretty frequent desire to urinate, but no increase in amount of urine emitted. Slight increase in frequency of
pulse. Slight degree of nausea on one or two occasions.
Senseless and unconscious, with ice-cold hands and feet, half-closed eyes, dilated pupils, respiration very
slow, almost imperceptible, action of the heart intermitting, scarcely perceptible, anus relaxed, wide open,
limbs relaxed. He fell to the ground unconscious, with loud cries and convulsions.
MIND - Mental and physical prostration. Emotional. At times, painful weeping, with grinding of the teeth.
Sadness. Wakes in bad humor. She seemed to have some consciousness, as was shown by the look of her
eye when her name was called aloud.
Abdomen - Labor like pains in lower abdomen.
Ears - Noise in the ears, extending to the occiput, like letting off steam.
Eyes - Dimness of sight. Optical illusions.
Food - Appetite when beginning breakfast, but it suddenly ceases after taking a little milk.
Head - Giddiness of the head. Weight in the head, especially the top of the forehead, at 4 p.m.
Kidneys - Sudden pain, with lancination, in the urethra, above the fossa navicularis, for two minutes.
Limbs - Rheumatic pain in the right thigh. Trembling of the knees and of all the limbs with violent emotion,
when hearing others talk about the disease he is afraid of having. Weakness of the knees when going upstairs.
Swelling of the ankles, less at night.
Mouth - Clammy mouth, with bad breath. Bitter mouth.
Perspiration - Profuse sweat during sleep, ceasing on waking. Very fetid sweat under the axilla and on the
scrotum.
Rectum - Tenesmus and pressure in the sphincter ani, with pricking, but ineffectual urging to stool. Diarrhea
in the morning. Unusually easy stools. Watery, greenish, fetid stools. Copious, light colored, watery, fetid
stools.
Sleep - Sleepiness. Drowsiness in daytime. Falls asleep late. Distressing dreams, about wanting to save an
asphyxiated child, whose parents will not let him treat it. Dreams about a conflagration, with small flames.
Stomach - Violent vomiting and purging. Heaviness in the stomach all night, relieved by applying the hands.
Borborygmi. Vague and transient, but very acute, pains in the stomach.
Temperature - Coldness and shrinking. The whole head, especially the nape of the neck, is cold. Face and
limbs cold. Icy coldness under the shoulder-blades, in bed, even when well covered up. Coldness even to the
marrow of the bone.
Vertigo - Dizziness. Paintings.
RELATIONS - Compare: Gels., Chin.
REFERENCES - Desai.

name: Cacao
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cac. Cacao. Cocoa. Theobroma cacao. N. O. Sterculiaceae. Tribe, Buettnerieae. Trituration of
the seeds. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Aneurism. Angina pectoris. Apoplexy. Atheroma. Asthma. Bladder, paralysis. Brain, congestion.
Bronchitis. Diaphragm, rheumatism. Dropsy. Exophthalmic goitre. Fistula. Hematuria. Hemoptysis.
Hemorrhage. Headaches. Heart, affections. Heart, hypertrophy. Intermittent fever. Lungs, hemorrhage.
Melancholy. Menstruation, painful. Malaria. Neuralgia. Otitis. Ovaries, inflammation. Ovaritis. Pneumonia.
Prostate, affections. Rheumatism. Sunstroke. Traumatic fever. Vaginismus.
HERBAL - Theobroma is Greek for “Food of the Gods”. Mayan Indian legend has it that the cocoa tree was a
gift from the gods. The Mayas believed the drink made from the cocoa seeds would nourish them after death.
The Aztecs believed cocoa would relieve their fatigue and stimulate their mental and psychic abilities.
The Spanish invaders were surprised to find that the cocoa beans were valued more than any other substance,
even more than gold. The Aztecs used a chocolate drink as a base in many of their medicinal formulas. The
Aztec nobility used the chocolate drink favored with vanilla and spices as a pleasurable drink.
HOMEOPATHIC - The main ingredients of chocolate are caffeine, phenylethylamine, theobromine and
theophylline. Feeding with waste Chocolate led to fatal poisoning in calves. The animals showed excitement,
stared about in all directions, walked with exaggerated strides and had convulsions. One calf died, possibly
from heart failure.
Allen noted, “In explaining the nutritive value of Cacao, we must take into account the presence in this
 substance of a special
alkaloid, theobromin, whose physiological effects are identical with those of caffeine and thein.
“Which, retarding the organic waste in the same way as the active principles of coffee and tea, place Cacao
high up among the preservative substances or those that check tissue-waste.”
“By placing ourselves under the influence of a decoction highly charged with aromatic principles and made
from powdered Cacao well roasted, we ascertained that this beverage produces an excitement of the nervous
system similar to that caused by a strong infusion of black coffee.
“Since these effects are insignificant if a decoction of the raw bean is employed. It is natural to attribute them
to the aromatic essences that are developed in the Cacao by the process of roasting. A still wider difference
is observed when we compare the effects on the circulation respectively produced by a decoction of powdered
Cacao roasted and one of the same substance in a crude state.
“The former case indicated an excitement of the circulation, as shown by an accelerated pulse, with an
increased fullness and diminished arterial pressure.
“When, on the other hand, an infusion of the raw bean is made use of, the action of the theobromin
predominates and an entirely different character of pulse is the result, as may be placed beyond doubt by
examining the results, obtained from a single individual.”
Causation - Damp. Disappointed love. Sun.
Sensations - Finger were enlarged on waking. Grain of sand under skin. Worm under skin which ran
away when touched.
COMMENTS - Allen stated “In order to ascertain the effect of the active ingredients, contained in Cacao,
(aromatic essences and theobromin) upon the nervous system. It was necessary to separate those ingredients,
as far as possible from the fatty substances (cacao butter) of which the beans are so largely composed. With
this view, we prepared a decoction of powdered Cacao in boiling water and conducted our experiments with
this liquid.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Chocolate, Coffea, Thea.
REFERENCES - Allen. Desai.

name: Cactus Grandiflorus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cact. Cactus grandiflorus. Night-blooming Cereus. Cereus grandiflorus. Cactus selenicereus.
N. O. Cactaceae. Mexico. West Indies. Tincture of youngest, tender stems and flowers collected in summer.
Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Aneurysm. Angina pectoris. Atheroma. Asthma. Bladder, paralysis. Brain, congestion.
Bronchitis. Colic. Diaphragmitis. Dropsy. Dysmenorrhea. Ear, inflammation. Exophthalmic, goiter. Fevers.
Fistulas. Goiter. Hematuria. Hemorrhages. Headache. Heart, attack. Heart, disorders. Indigestion.
Intermittent, fevers. Lungs, hemorrhage. Melancholy. Menstruation, painful. Malaria. Neuralgias. Otitis media.
Ovaritis. Pneumonia. Prostate, disorders. Rheumatism. Spasmodic, pains. Stroke. Sunstroke. Traumatic
fever. Vaginismus.
HERBAL - Given as a heart tonic, it will benefit a large number of cases of weakened and painful heart.
Atheromatous arteries and weak heart. General weakness and prostration. Irregular circulation, causing violent
congestion or localized pulsations. Congestion in the esophagus, bladder, etc. Used as an herbal tonic for
heart patients with a history of constricting pains.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cactus affects the entire organism powerfully. but its internal operation is on the heart and
circulation. In congestive violence it rivals Aeon., which is one of its antidotes. The pains are unendurable, they
extort screams. Sadness, apprehension, fearof death and a tendency to be easily frightened characterize the
mental state, as they do many conditions of heart disease.
Constriction, periodicity and spasmodic pains. “As if an iron band had prevented its normal movements,”
or “heart as if compressed, and as violently struggled to burst its bonds.” Whole body feels as if caged,
each wire being twisted tighter. It affects the circular muscles, thereby producing constricting pains in the
heart, throat, chest, bladder, rectum, vagina, and neck.
“Fluttering and palpitation of heart, worse when walking or lying on left side.” Pain and numbness in left arm
accompanying heart disease. “Heart disease with swelling of left hand only.” “Numbness of left arm.”
Hemorrhagic remedy, favors formation of clots speedily. Hemorrhages (nose, lungs, rectum, stomach).
Bloody congestions, which are in a way a counterpart of the constrictive sensations.
“Periodical attacks of suffocation with fainting, cold sweat on face and loss of pulse.” Pulseless, panting and
prostration. Low blood pressure from weakness of heart. Congestions, irregular distribution of blood.
Sharp pains in diaphragm and girdle pain around its attachment, with indigestion. Hot gushing into chest. Toxic
 goiter with cardiac symptoms. Dropsical disorders.
Weakness and coldness of limbs. Twitching of muscles and sensation of constriction produced by touching
the affected part. “Rheumatism of all joints, beginning in upper limbs.” The pains are very sharp, causing the
patient to cry out. “Heavy pain in vertex like a weight.”
Great periodicity, neuralgic pains occur periodically. Chill at same hour every day, 11 a.m. or 11 p.m. Many
symptoms are worse at night. Menses cease at night.
MIND - Melancholic, taciturn, sad, ill-humored. Sadness and melancholy. Cries, knows not why, worse from
consolation. Screams with pain. Love of solitude. Weeping, without knowing why, worse consolation.
Fear that something bad will happen. Easily frightened. Fear of death. Fear of heart disease. Screams with
pain. Anxiety on waking. Irresistible inclination to weep. Believes that his disease is incurable. Fears some
organic lesion of heart which will cause sudden death. Easily frightened on waking.
Wishes to be alone and not to speak to anyone. Slowness, always behind hand. Impulse to do strange things.
Irritability,
worse consolation. Sadness during menses. Sensitive to music, noise. Talk of others aggravates. Weeping
before menses. Difficulty in expressing ideas when writing.
Delirium at night, ceases on awaking, but returning in sleep. Feels she is dying and thinks she will not live till
morning, but has no fear of death. Unwilling to answer. Easily frightened, often awakes in a fright. Felt much
alarmed on waking, but could not tell cause of alarm.
Abdomen - Colic with loose stool. Intense burning in abdomen. Sharp pain, shooting through diaphragm and
up into chest. As if a cord was tied tighter and tighter around attachment of diaphragm, taking his breath away.
Pain and bearing-down in lower abdomen.
Back - Exophthalmic goiter. Cold in back and icy cold hands. Rheumatism of the shoulder. Pain under left
shoulder blade with palpitations. Lumbar muscles tender on pressure and stiff, especially on first moving after
repose.
Breasts - Inflammation of breasts. Mastitis. Breast tumor.
Causations - Ill effects of sun, dampness, disappointment in love, or grief.
Chest - Constriction, acute pains and stitches in chest. Constriction as if bound, hindering respiration.
Oppressed breathing as from a weight on chest. Angina pectoris with suffocation, cold sweat and an iron-band
feeling. Palpitation, pain shooting down left arm. Diaphragmitis with great difficulty of breathing. Continuous

feet, worse in rest and in motion, and in all positions. Left arm numb. Pain in left arm down to fingers. Fingers

Lungs - Difficulty breathing. Oppression of breathing, going up stairs. Periodical attacks of suffocation with

Male - Prostatic affections, weight in anus.
Modalities - Better from open air. Better pressure on vertex. Worse from lying down on left side, on occiput.

Nose - Profuse nosebleed, but soon ceases. Fluent coryza.
Pulse - Pulse, irritable intermittent, feeble. Irregular and intermittent action after forceps delivery.

Skin - Dry, scaly herpes on the outside of the elbow and on the right internal malleolus.
Sleep - Sleeplessness, on account of strong
pulsations in different places. Frightful dreams, lascivious, of falling. Awakes in fright.

Vertigo - Vertigo, worse deep breathing or exertion. Vertigo from blood congestions to head.

A case of angina pectoris was cured by the 30c with a sensation as though a swarm of hornets were going
from pectoral region to heart.
Choudhury reported a case cured, the characteristics included “Chill severe, 11 a.m., thirst, headache, body

Heat with thirst and short breath. At times there is entire absence of sweat.
Keynote constricting pain. The chest feels tight, and keeps getting tighter as their breath

Heart attack (Lat-m.). Tendency to a heart attack with high blood pressure, chest pain, shortness of breath,

Neuralgia around the ribs and heart, feels as if the rib cage or the heart is wrapped with wire and someone is

 Constriction anywhere in the body. Constriction in the ovaries. Uterine cramps where the uterus feels

Facial neuralgias where the face feels squeezed in together and painful, more often right (Spig., more often

author: Murphy
full:

Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Cancer. Diarrhea. Heartbum. Indigestion. Strokes. Throat pain. Tumors. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cadm-br. should be compared to Cadm-s. Three persons experimented with Cadm-br., it
produced a burning sensation in mouth, gullet and stomach. Goose flesh. Diarrhea.
Clinically Cadm-br. has been used for apoplexy, threatening stroke and predisposition for strokes. Cerebral
hemorrhage. Pulse, imperceptible. Throat pain. Sore throat, pain worse after swallowing.
Stomach pain after lifting. Burning pain in stomach. Burning pain as from an ulcer. Vomiting of blood. Bloody
vomit. Sudden vomiting. Cancer of the bowels. Tumors.
COMMENTS - Allen stated: “I found both ladies vomiting severely and complaining of extreme pain and burning
sensation in the stomach.
“Mrs. R. who also purging freely, though her daughter was not. The vomiting and
purging lasted fully five hours and during a part of the time the pulse was imperceptible in either patient. After
this period the symptoms ameliorated and they both fell asleep.
“For several days they were both confined to their beds and were obliged to be extremely careful as to what
they took into their stomachs. Mrs. R. has since suffered with some cerebral symptoms which betoken a
tendency to strokes. A severe burning sensation in the mouth, esophagus and stomach, which lasted perhaps
and hour.”
REFERENCES - Allen. Clarke.

name: Cadmium Flourata
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cadm-f. Cadmium flourata. Cadmium flouride. Cadmium fluoricum. Historical dose: Trituration
and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Adenoma. Bowel, cancer. Cancer. Prostate, cancer. Rectal, cancer. Tumors.
HOMEOPATHIC - Grimmer wrote: “Cadmium fluorata is a remedy that helped one case very much, a late
case of cancer of the prostate. There was no question about the diagnosis, which was made by an eminent
pathologist in Chicago. The patient was at the point of death.
“I sent my assistant out to see him and get a blood sample. Every test showed the presence of cancer. I never
saw this patient, so I didn't report the case, but the doctor informed me there was a big pulsating mass. He
could feel it through the patient's rectum and said it was undoubtedly cancer, very far advanced. He didn't think
the man would live more than a few days. Nevertheless, we gave him cadmium flour.
“This man lived for a year and part of the time the function of the bladder was restored. He gave up his catheter
 for quite a while and subsequently used it only occasionally. He left us because he was dissatisfied with his
progress. He was an old man and had been put in much more comfort. I lost track of him after a year, but at
the end of that year he was better in every way.”
REFERENCES - Grimmer. Murphy.

name: Cadmium Metallicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cadm-met. Cadmium metallicum. Cadmium metal (At. Wt. 48). Historical dose: Trituration and
all potencies.
CLINICAL - Aluminum, poisoning. Anemia. Bacillary, dysentery. Backache. Blood, poisoning. Cancers.
Chemotherapy, effects. Chlorosis. Colic. Colitis. Constipation. Coughs. Depression. Diaphragmatic, hernia.
Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Dysentery. Emaciation. Enterocolitis. Fatigue, chronic. Headaches. Hemorrhoids.
Indigestion. Influenza. Liver, weakness. Lupus, erythematous. Migraines. Nausea. Pharyngitis. Radiation,
poisoning. Tuberculosis. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cadmium met. comes between zinc and mercury with an atomic weight of 48. The
toxicology indicates vomiting, loss of appetite, emaciation. Sneezing and coughing with profuse secretion from
the respiratory and ocular mucus membranes.
Cadmium met. and other chemical combinations of cadmium have proved curative in many cases of stomach
and intestinal cancer.
Many of these cases were caused were caused by irritative actions of alumina toxin resulting from aluminum
cooking utensils. The water supply of many cities and towns has been treated with aluminum fluoride, exposing
the public to a potent carcinogenic agent that has the potential to activate the disease in all those with inherited
tendencies to it.
Cadm-met. and Cadm-o. are the most effective antidotes against the alumina toxins.
The blood changes, anemia and the gastrointestinal tracts are especially affected by the alumina poison. When
absorbed by the lungs and intestines, cadmium causes lesions on the pulmonary and digestive epithelium.
Fatigue, with lassitude like influenza, dull aching all over. State of indifference, desire to be alone, improved
by appearance of a skin eruption. Anemia. Nausea and vomiting.
Diarrhea with soft stools and the sensation of a foreign body in the rectum. Sneezing, coughing, muco-purulent
sputum. Sneezing with influenza and tickling at the back of the throat. Influenza-type rhino-pharyngitis.
MIND - Hypersensitive. Nervous and restlessness. Irritable. Impulsive irritability, on the verge of insanity in its
violence, alternating with deep depression.
Depressive psychosis with fear of cancer (Care.). Loathing of life. Despair. Hopeless and apathetic, all joy is
 gone. Averse to people. Averse to certain kinds of music. Averse to noise.
Concentration difficult. Mental exertion aggravates. Mistakes, saying and doing the wrong things. Makes
simple mistakes. Weak memory. Indifference, does not want to see anyone. Apathy after influenza.
Indifference to work.
Abdomen - Diaphragmatic hernia. Colitis and enterocolitis. Bacillary dysentery. Abdominal distention with pain
in the region of the umbilicus and epigastrium, betted by eating, bending double.
Back - Backache, pain in the scapula.
Blood - Acquired hemolytic jaundice. Anemia. Anemia and chlorosis in young girls. Infantile hereditary anemia.
Breasts - Breasts feel enlarged and sore.
Causations - Aluminum or radiation poisoning.
Chest - Constrictive pain behind the sternum, especially when coughing.
Constitutions - Pre-cancerous. Chronic infection of the reticuloendothelial system. State of psychosomatic,
post-influenza exhaustion.
Ears - Buzzing and painfully sensitive. Old ear discharge with pain.
Eyes - Sensitive to light. Eyelids painfully sensitive and burning, worse when reading and in a hot room.
Food - Insatiable hunger, with nausea aggravated by jarring. Loss of appetite.
Head - Extreme, neuralgic headaches with maddening pressing pains throughout the head, extending to eyes
and ears. Occipital headaches with vertigo, buzzing in ears, visual and psychosomatic complaints. Headaches,
the pains come and go sud-
denly. Headaches accompanied by nausea. Headache worse by shaking the head, movement. Headache
worse reading, sustained intellectual activity, and in the morning on waking. Headaches, better by cold
compresses, holding the head, and eating.
Heart - Intense squeezing pain in the region of the heart, with a sense of weakness.
Kidneys - Frequent urination.
Limbs - Numbness of the feet and hands when sitting. Paraesthesia at the limbs. Weakness. Heaviness of
the limbs. Trembling of the feet and hands. Feet burning, formication.
Lungs - Difficult respiration, especially with the slightest movement. Cough with muco-purulent, sometimes
blood-streaked sputum. Acute bronchial and pulmonary diseases.
Modalities - Better from eating. Better pressure. Better bending double. Better cold application, and with the
appearance of an eruption. Worse in the morning. Worse from waking. Worse left side. Worse movement.
Worse mental effort.
Mouth - Teeth yellow. Mouth dry, lips itching.
Nose - Sneezing.
Rectum - Constipation with hemorrhoids, aggravated by passing stool. Soft diarrhea with sensation of a foreign
body in the rectum. Diarrhea of black, musty stools with intestinal pains. Constipation with clay-colored stools.
Skin - Sensation of heat or burning in small areas of the skin. Localized itching. Erythema, dry eruption,
papules, vesicles. General fatigue, diminishes with the appearance of eruption on the skin. Lupus
erythematous. Tuberculosis with papules, nodules, vesicles and purpura. Sclerous lichen (isolated or grouped
papules, sclerodermic in appearance). Chronic pustular dermatitis, spreading away from the center.
Sleep - Dreams of sickness, causing worry after waking. Dreams of running without reaching anywhere.
Stomach - Acrid dyspepsia. Indigestion. Odors and other unpleasant stimuli induce nausea, even thinking of
them.
Temperature - Goose bumps. Shivering without fever. Cold even when near a fire. Glandular fever.
Mononucleosis.
Throat - Throat dry in the morning, improved by eating.
Vertigo - Vertigo while looking at moving pictures. Vertigo with a sensation of something taking the breath
away. Objects recede and return.
COMMENTS - The first proving was carried out by Burdach in 1827 with a half grain, and later by Petroz. The
proving was undertaken again at the instigation of the International League of Homeopathy in 1947 and a
report was created by Gutman in 1951. The proving was made on thirty-eight provers, using the 2c, 3c, 6x,
12x and 30c potencies.
In another connection, MacFarland made a proving on four female provers using the Skinner potencies, 10m
and 50m. Templeton experimented on nine provers with 2c, Pahud on sixteen provers with 2c, 3c, 6x, 12x and
30x.
Violent vomiting attack with headache, alternating of heat and coldness. Some pressing pains in the liver and
spleen. Vomiting of bile and acid. More frequent urination, discoloring the toilet bowl brownish or a deep lemon
color, very difficult to wash from the bowl.
 Hemorrhage of the bladder and rectum was cured many times by Dr. Grimmer, especially when dark-colored
blood with small clots was present. Bright red hemorrhages have also been observed.
Grimmer had a case: “Severe neuralgic pains in the face with plugged sinus, followed by facial paralysis, after
large doses of quinine and aspirin, cured with one dose of Cadm-met. 10,000c.”
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Cadm-s. (2) Bry. - Also aggravated by movement, constipated intensely thirsty.
(3) Ars. - Agitation with anxiety, burning ameliorated by heat.
REFERENCES - Grimmer. Julian. Murphy.

Indispensable and unequalled as an antidote to the alumina toxins which stem from the use of aluminum

COMMENTS - Grimmer noted a case in which the patient suffered from chronic asthma, despite having
excellent homeopathic treatment over a long period of time with only short acting palliation of the asthmatic
attacks, which gradually became more intense and wearing.
The patient was greatly reduced in weight and strength with an ever-increasing dyspnea, which made him very
depressed with despair of recovery. Then it was discovered that he was poisoned with chronic aluminum from
using aluminum cooking ware for a long time.
A dose of Cadm-o. 30c, and later a 200c, brought quick relief which was superseded by an attack of what
appeared to be the symptoms of a viral influenza.
In this condition a perfect picture of Hep. was presented. Chill, fever and copious sweat, must be covered in
all stages, no relief from sweat. Hep. 30c brought complete relief of the asthma for several weeks without a
break andthe patient rapidly regained weight and strength.

MIND - Dullness of mind, unconscious. Horror of solitude and work. Apprehension at the approach of anybody.
Excessive irritability. Anxiety, before stool. Effects of anxiety or fits of passion. Restlessness worse sunlight.
Fear of others approaching him. Smiling in sleep. Moaning during sleep. Nervousness during headache.
Anxiety. Vexation. Fits of passion aggravates symptoms in general. Unconsciousness between attacks of
cough.
Abdomen - Sore, tender, tympanitic. Pain in abdomen with vomiting. Coldness. Stretching in the sides.
Compressed feeling, pressure, bruised pain. Pulsation. Lancinations in the left hypochondria. Griping in the
lower bowels.
Back - Pain in muscles of neck. Back pain as from the efforts to vomit.
Breasts - Inflamed nipples. Erysipelas of the breasts.
Causations - Chemotherapy, radiation poisoning. Vaccinations. Lead or other toxic poisoning. Grief.
Chest - Chest contracted with asthma. Drawing. Feeling of dilatation or contraction. Feeling as if the lungs
adhered to the chest. Swelling of the external chest. Weakness of the chest. Rheumatic pain. Painful blows.
Tingling in the chest. Beating near the heart. Chest symptoms.
worse squatting.
Constitutions - Cancer miasm and toxic constitution. Broken down constitution from cancer, chemotherapy
or radiation treatments.
Ears - Pressure behind the ears. Lacerating pain. Lancinating pain in ears. Abnormal hearing, alternating with
abnormal vision. Sounds echo in the head. Clucking noises in the ears.
Eyes - Hollow eyes. Opacity of cornea from injuries or inflammation. Blue circle around eyes. Lachrymation,
hot ' tears. Blenorrhea. One pupil dilated the other contracted. Swelling of conjunctiva. Scrofulous inflammation
of eyes. Idiopathic chronic conjunctivitis. Night blindness. Cannot read small type.
Face - Gloomy countenance. Vexed look. Grayish complexion. Drawing pain in face. Facialparalysis, left
side, worse cold air, cannot close the eyes, difficult talking and swallowing, distortion of the mouth. Crawling
sensation in the face. Trembling of lower jaw. Spasmodic motion of the upper lip. Swelling of the lips. Yellow
spots on the cheeks and nose.
Food - Thirst, with heat in bed at night. Craves little drinks of cold water that are vomited at once. Nausea and
vomiting after eating.
Head - Inflammation of the brain. Strokes. Heat in head. Lancinations, hammering, digging pains. Drawing
pains in head. Tingling in head. Heat in head. Pulsation in the temples. Pain in the vertex. Congestion to head,
with pains cutting like knives. Rolling of head, with open eyes, in cholera infantum. Inflammation of brain.
Apoplexy. Herpes on temples.
Heart - Palpitation with constriction of chest.
Kidneys - Rawness and soreness in urethra. Urine mixed with pus and blood. Griping in the region of the
kidneys.
Limbs - Rheumatism. Boring and digging. Suppuration of the axillary glands. Stretching of the arms. Swelling
of the arm-bones. Tension in the forearm. Gnawing in the hands. Tearing pain in the metacarpal joints. Jerking
of the fingers.
Lancinations in the joints and in the toes. Numbness of the thighs. Trembling in the knee. Pressure in the knee.
Tearing pain in the legs. Cramp of the calf. Pain, as if sprained. Heaviness of the feet. Chilblains.
Liver - Region of liver sore.
Lungs - Suffocation on dropping to sleep. Cough with loss of consciousness. Cough with agitation, red face,
pain in the stomach or vomiting of bile. Interrupted breathing during sleep On waking, want of air.
Modalities - Better eating and rest. Worse fromraising up. Worse least motion. Worse carrying burdens. Worse
ascending stairs. Worse walking. Worse swallowing. Worse after sleep. Worse in morning. Worse from
stimulants. Worse after intoxication. Worse from vexation. Worse in sunshine. Worseopenair.
Worsecold,coldair. Worse itching of skin when cold.
Mouth - Difficult swallowing. Salty, pitchy taste. Salivation. Aphthae on the lips. Stringy and offensive exudation
 on mucus membrane. Tongue, dirty brown orblack. The symptoms of the mouth are aggravated during
deglutition. Salty belching.
Nose - Tightness at the root of the nose. Obstruction of the nose by swelling. Numbness of the nose. Ozaena.
Nosebleed. Polyps, boils. Caries of the nose. Lacerating pain in the nose. Nostrils ulcerated. Decay of nasal
bones. Ulcerative, cancerous smell.
Rectum - Clots of blood from bowels. Bloody, black and offensive stools, gelatinous, yellowish green, semi-
fluid with urinary suppression.
Skin - Blue, yellow, sallow, scaly, cracking. Chloasma, yellowish stains on nose and cheeks, worse exposure
to sun and wind. Itching when touched and during cold, ameliorated by scratching, which excites a voluptuous
feeling. Chilblains. Goose bumps after drinking, with hot hands, heartburn.
Sleep - Sleeps with open eyes. Somnolence with broken dreams. Moaning and smiling during sleep.
Nightmares. W'hile asleep, the feet are agitated by shocks. Stops breathing on going to sleep, wakes up
suffocating. Fears to go to sleep again.
Protracted sleeplessness (Care., Cocc.). Sleepiness in the forenoon. Drowsiness when sitting.
Stomach - Intense nausea with pain and cold. Burning and cutting pain with retching and gagging. Violent
nausea, retching. Black vomit, like coffee grounds. Vomiting of mucus, green slime, blood, with great
prostration and tenderness over the stomach. Least thing touching lips will excite nausea and vomiting.
Stomach symptoms worse carrying burden, better quiet. Stomach cancer, with persistent vomiting.
Temperature - Icy coldness (Camph., Verat., Helo.), Goose bumps after drinking or with hot hands.
Coldness, even when near the fire, with heat in the hands. Coldness after sleeping and after walking. Fever,
before midnight. Yellow fever (Crot-h., Carb-v.). Sweat in the axilla and the palms.
Throat - Chilliness and aching. Sore throat, constant tickling, gagging and nausea, worse from deep breathing.
Dysphagia. Esophagus is constricted (Bapt.).
Vertigo - Faintness on rising. Vertigo, room and bed seem to spin around.
COMMENTS - Cadmium sulphuratum is found in nature in intimate association with Zinc, which it resembles
in action, but it acts more powerfully. Cadm-s. is a cross between Bry. and Ars. It has the desire to keep quiet
of Bry. with the exhaustion and stomach irritability of Ars.
A major cancer remedy. Affinity for cancers of the GI tract, cancers of the esophagus, the stomach, the liver,
and the colon (Cadm-met. for bone cancers, Cadm-i. for glandular cancers). Nausea and vomiting in cancer
cases. For the ill effects of radiation and chemotherapy. Extreme prostration and fatigue after chemotherapy
or radiation, emaciation, sunken features, cachexia.
Nausea, intensified by motion. Vomiting of acid or yellow substances. Black vomit, occurs in severe zymotic
diseases. Vomit like coffee grounds. Vomiting during pregnancy, when other remedies fail. Pernicious forms
of vomiting, of black blood from chronic ulcers or cancer of the
Cadmium sulphuratum stomach. Nausea and vomiting with cold perspiration bathing the face and cutting
pains in the abdomen.
Ulceration of the stomach in alcoholics (Ars.). Beer aggravates the gastric complaints. Salivation, with bitter
burning in the mouth and throat, fetid breath, ulcers with dryness, and burning constriction of the throat.
Characteristic coldness, all complaints are made worse from becoming cold, or from cold changes in the
weather. Icy coldness even whennearafire. Goose bumps, with hot hands, or after drinking. Sweat in axilla.
Effect of a drought or cold air in checking sweat.
Weakness and tiredness, accompanied by a cachectic state that stimulates the cachexia of advanced cancer
cases or pernicious anemia. Increased irritability. Horror of solitude and of work.
Ozaena and polyps. Cutting, sharp pains, sense of constriction. Opacity of the cornea, loss of vision. Protracted
sleeplessness, insomnia. Sleeps with eyes open, stops breathing on going to sleep. Awakens suffocating after
sleep.
RELATIONS - Followed well by: Care., Bell. - rolling of head with open eyes in cholera infantum, Carb-v.,
Lob. inf. In cancer - Hydr., Ars. In yellow fever - Nit-ac. In nausea of pregnancy - Alet. Compare: (1) Cadm-
ox., Cadm-br. - pain and burning in stomach and vomiting. (2) Cadm-i. - Itching of anus and rectum felt during
the day only, constipation, frequent desire, tenesmus, abdomen bloated. (3) Zinc., Ars., Carb-v., Verat. (3)
Zinc, but in Zinc, the action is primarily on brain in Cadm. primarily on stomach. (4) in constriction across chest
with palpitations, Kali-chl. (5) weakness, nausea, vomit and burning, Ars. (6) black vomit, disorders of
alcoholism, Ars., Lach, in nausea and retching. Asar., Bry., Crot-t., Cupr., Nux-v„ Podo., Ant-t. in deathly
nausea, Ip., Tab., greenish gelatinous vomit.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Murphy.

name: Caesalpinia Bonducella
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - caesal. Caesalpinia bonducella. Nata. Fever nut. Bondue nut. N. O. Leguminosae. Historical
dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL-Asthma. Hemorrhage. Leprosy. Tuberculosis.
HERBAL - Nata'is a well-known wild shrub of India. It grows near the sea-coast in all hot countries, the
extensive distribution being due probably to the transport of the seeds by oceanic currents. It is pregnant with
climbing prickly points and the shrub is commonly found all over Bengali, Bombay and practically the whole of
southern India. The plant has been known for a long time to the Hindu and Mohammedan physicians to contain
excellent medicinal properties.
The seeds are considered in India and Persia to be “very hot and dry” and they are found to be very useful in
dispersing swellings, arresting hemorrhage and warding off infectious maladies. The seeds, roasted and
powdered, are employed for hydrocele internally and externally. They are also used internally in curing leprosy.
The powdered seeds mixed with black pepper are found to be febrifuge and anti- periodic and are used in
chronic fevers. The fixed oil expressed from the seeds is emollient and is employed as an embrocation for the
purpose of removing freckles from the face, also as a cosmetic and used also to arrest discharges from the
ear. A decoction of the roasted seeds is employed against consumption and asthma.
HOMEOPATHIC - Extreme weakness is felt after the remission of fever, so much so that the patient is averse
even to have any talk. There is no inclination to do any work. Always likes to sleep. Lies quit with closed eyes.
No desire to leave bed.
After the remission of fever the patient feels extreme weakness, is disinclined to do any work. There is no
desire to talk even. The patient likes to lie down quietly in bed with closed eyes.
The fever appears between 8 a.m. and 10 a.m. or between 2 p.m. and 4 p.m. In the afternoon fever there is
no thirst, but in the morning fever there is thirst in hot stage.
The above symptoms are generally observed in intermittent fevers, but in remittent fevers of malarial origin it
is also used with benefit.
MIND - Mental depression. Lack of enthusiasm.
Abdomen - there is gurgling in the lower abdomen, sometimes liquid, slimy stools are passed by the patient.
Back - Drawing pains are felt in the back after cold bath.
Eyes - Before the appearance of fever and during its invasion terrible pains are felt in the eyes as if they are
burnt; they are relieved by the application of cold water; eyes are sunken and bloodless.
Fever - It is very irregular in appearance. It may come on any time; fever appears with chilliness and shivering
one day and again on another day it appears in the afternoon with slight chilliness. The character of fever is
changeable. It's is generally felt with chilliness and shivering. Thirst is generally felt in the stage of heat; the
stage of sweat lasts for a short time only, sweat breaks out over face, chest, neck, shoulder, the fever does
not last more than 6 hours.
Food - Desire to take boiled rice and other hard substance and meat. Aversion to take any liquid food. No
desire to take bath.
Head - During fever terrible pains are felt over both the temples of head, relieved by wrapping them up or by
pressure.
Liver - The lower lobe is enlarged; before fever sometimes uneasiness in the hepatic region is felt or
sometimes slight pain is felt there.
Mouth - During hot stage of the fever thirst is felt; thirst for cold water; face is flushed during fever.
Nose - Hot breath; during fever frequent and hurried respiration takes place.
Skin - Dry, dirty, blackish coloured. Small eruptions like mosquito bite appear on the skin, which disappear
generally.
Spleen - Enlargement and hardness of spleen exist and it is painful to touch.
Stool - Hard, saffron colored stools. Stools are sometimes liquid and yellow coloured.
Tongue - Slight white coating on the tongue appears; bloodless white tongue; tongue is moist, but there is
thirst.
REFERENCES - Ghose.

name: Caffeine
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY -caffe. Caffeine. AlkaloidofiCof- fee arabica. Coffine. Trituration of the alkaloid and also of the
Citrate of caffeine. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Anxiety. Brachialgia. Diuresis. Dizziness. Headaches. Insomnia. Nervousness. Neuralgias.
Polyuria. Pulmonary edema. Restlessness. Trembling.
 HOMEOPATHIC - A crystalline alkaloid, it is a direct heart stimulant and diuretic. One of the best stimulants
of the vaso-motor centers. Dropsy depending on cardiac insufficiency. Cardiac insufficiency in pneumonia and
other infectious diseases. Myocardial degeneration.
Caffeine raises the blood pressure, increases pulse rate and stimulates the heart muscle, hence a support in
extreme feebleness or threatened failure. Stimulates the respiratory center, nerve centers and increases
diuresis. Acute pulmonary edema. Brachialgia and other neuralgias characterized by nightly aggravations.
COMMENTS - A proving has been made with this alkaloid, but has brought out no symptoms not included in
the pathogenesis of Coff. Marked pulsation of the arteries on the head and temples. Sparks before eyes,
roaring in the ears. Vomiting with relief of all symptoms.
The Citrate of caffeine, which is used in allopathic practice, has occasioned dangerous poisonous symptoms
in a number of cases. The most characteristic include restlessness and dizziness, inability to keep erect.
Palpitations. Violent precordial anxiety. Very rapid pulse.
Abdominal pulsation. Violenttremblingof all the limbs. Grating of the teeth. Features expressive of great
anxiety. Constriction of the neck and throat, recurring periodically every fifteen minutes.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aeon., Cham., Coffea, Nux-v, Cypr. (2) Caffeine and plants containing it, as
Cacao, Kola, Thea, etc.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Cainca Racemosa
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cahin. Cainca racemosa. Brazilian chiococca. Chiococca densifolia. Chiococca racemosa. N.
O. Rubiacae. Brazil. Tincture of dried root bark. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Ascites. Bright's disease. Cough. Dropsy. Dyspnea. Fatigue. Kidney, pain. Nephritis.
Ophthalmia. Polyuria. Spleen, pain. Traveling, effects. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cainca is related botani- cally to Chin., Ip., andCoff. Clinically, it is very like Apoc. Marked
urinary symptoms. It has been given with success in dropsies, especially when associated with dry skin.
General fatigue and weakness. It removes fatigue from riding on horseback too long. Much weakness after
dinner, so as to make him lie down. Abdomen sensitive to the touch. Albuminuria with dyspnea on lying down
at night. Ascites and anasarca with dry skin. Polyuria while traveling. Slight uneasiness.
MIND - Feeling of anxiety with increased warmth of the lower abdomen.
Abdomen - Stitches in and through the ; spleen. Warmth about the umbilicus. Fullness, inflation and
uncomfortable feeling in the abdomen. After eating, perceptible pulsation of abdominal aorta during rest.
Gurgling and rumbling in the abdomen and bowels. Slight colic with borboryg- mus. Cutting pains in abdomen
before evacuation of the bowels. Pain under the umbilicus with desire to go to stool.
Back - Pain in region of kidneys, better lying bent backward.
Chest - Constriction and pressure on chest. Peculiar shooting and beating pain over the trunk. Dartings in the
right side of thorax. Piercing pain in the middle part of the right side of the chest. Pricking pain in the lower
third of the right side of the chest, with feeling of weight.
Ears - Intolerable hissing in the ears. Roaring and buzzing, as if from a swarm of insects in the air.
Eyes - Burning in the eyes. Increased sensibility of the eyes. Photophobia. Edema of left upper or right lower
eyelid. Pressure in the eyeballs from above downwards and from below upwards. Sensation as if the eyeballs
were pressed upwards, with troubled vision for five minutes, returning after half an hour.
Face - Heat of the face.
Food - Appetite good in the evening. Absence of appetite. Less appetite than usual for dinner. Thirst.
Head - Very violent headache. Severe headache, particularly in the occiput, forbidding reading and every
intellectual exertion. Heaviness of the head. Heaviness, pressure and uneasiness of front of head. Piercing
pain in right temple. Pressure in the sinciput. Darting pains in right half of sinciput. Feeling of weight and
pressure in occiput.
Kidneys - Constant desire to urinate. Polyuria while traveling. Urine fiery. Burning pain in urethra, especially
glandular portion.
Limbs - Pricking pain in left hand. Stretching of lower limbs. Heaviness of the lower limbs. Feeling of lassitude
in soles of feet. Constant pressure in the lower third of the under part of right foot. Acute pricking under nail of
great toe.
Lungs - Tickling cough with tough, greenish-gray expectoration, waking him at 3 a.m.
Male - Drawing in of testicles and spermatic cord. Pain worse during passage of pungent-smelling urine.
Horridly excited sexual impulses. Fearful, lascivious dreams with erections, restlessness, awakened by an
emission.
 Modalities - Better in evening. Better rest. Better after diarrhea. Worse frommotion. Worse ascending stairs.
Worse from waking. Worse in the morning. Worse siesta. Worse from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m.
Mouth - Offensive smelling breath. Considerable salivation, or saliva no longer seemed to be secreted.
Perverted taste, the whole mouth bitter. Mucous, insipid taste. Drug tasted like apple-wine, first sweetish, then
bitter and burning. In the evening, tearing pains in the teeth of the upper jaw.
Nose - Violent catarrh of thin mucus, excoriating the nose, especially in the daytime.
Rectum - Frequent calls to stool with escape of nothing but air. Burning at the anus. Tickling in the anus,
obliging him to scratch frequently.
Sleep - Yawning with stretching of limbs. Sleepiness in morning. Desire to sleep. Sleepless during the whole
night. Restless sleep, with lascivious dreams. Somnolence.
Stomach - Dryness of the throat, trembling of the hands. Belchings, as after small doses of tartar emetic. Much
tasteless belching. Nausea and vomiting. Violent vomiting from three spoonfuls. Vomiting and slight shivering,
for half an hour. Feeling of cold in the epigastric region.
Temperature - Heightened temperature of the body. Warmth all over. Moist skin, sweating even when at rest.
Perspiring more easily than usual, particularly in the evening.
Throat - Voice hoarse and hollow. Ulcers in the throat to the Eustachian tube. Distressing dryness in throat.
Obliged to hawk often from irritation of the throat. Burning and grating pain in throat. Scraping in throat, forcing
him to cough. Rawness of throat, with taste like that of pepper. Dry, burning heat in the pharynx, at first with
sensation as if from pepper. Feeling of itchiness and scraping. Dysphagia. Cold feeling down the esophagus.
Tongue -Tongue coated with mucus. Tongue exceedingly dry with a white and very dark coating. Tongue
furred white.
Vertigo - Symptoms of giddiness and sickness. Giddiness, with vomiting, or on going up stairs.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Colch., Rhus- t. (gastralgia), Verat. Cainca follows well: Ars. Compare: (1)
Apocynum, Ars., Bry. (2) Similar to Coffea in relieving effects of fatigue, also Am.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
