name: Camphora
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - camph. Camphora. Camphor. Laurus camphora. N. O. Lauracae. A gum obtained from Laurus
camphora. Solution in rectified spirit. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies, tincture in drop doses,
repeated frequently or smelling of Spirits of Camphor.
CLINICAL - Angina, pectoris. Anxiety. Asphyxia, neonatorum. Bedsores. Chills. Cholera. Colds. Colic.
 Collapse. Congestion. Convulsions. Coughs. Cramps. Delirium. Diarrhea. Epilepsy. Eruptions. Erysipelas.
Fevers. Gonorrhea. Heart, disorders. Hematuria. High, fever. Influenza. Measles. Memory, loss. Nausea.
Priapism. Rheumatism. Sexual, mania. Shiverings. Sleeplessness. Snakebites. Spasms. Strangury. Taste,
disordered. Tetanus. Tobacco, habit. Twitching. Urethra, stricture. Urine, suppression. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Marked coldness, cramps and convulsions with mental anguish. Affects the digestive tract
and cerebro-spinal nerves, urinary organs and nose. For colds and chills. Scrofulous, weakly, irritable children
are especially affected.
Shock. State of collapse. Sudden collapse from over-powering influences acting on nervous centers.
Sunstroke with ebbing vitality, fainting spells, cold sweat and icy cold body.
First stages of a cold with chilliness and sneezing. Very sensitive to cold and to touch. Great sensitiveness
to cold and cold air, which worse pains, takes cold easily. Icy coldness of the whole body, sudden sinking of
strength, pulse small and weak. Low blood pressure after operations, if temperature is subnormal.
Patient will not be covered, notwithstanding the icy coldness of the body, or wants them off and then on
alternately with internal burning heat and anxiousness. Limbs cold with cramps.
Camph. has a direct relationship to muscles and fascia. Local rheumatic disorders in cold climates.
Awkwardness. Trembling and extreme restlessness.
Pain better while thinking of it. Cracking of joints. Distention of veins.
Convulsions with blue lips, froth at mouth and lock-jaw. Epileptiform convulsions. After effects of measles.
Violent convulsions with wandering and hysterical excitement. Tetanic spasms.
Camph. achieved classical fame in cholera epidemics. In some epidemics, Camph. given early has cured a
majority of the cases treated, whether it was given as drop doses of the tincture or in the 30c.
In the collapse of cholera it corresponds rather to the initial chill before either vomiting or diarrhea. The tongue
is cold. If he can speak, the voice is either high pitched or husky. Coldness (Verat.), with marked nausea and
vomiting, upper lip drawn up.
Acts on the genito-urinary sphere (similar to and antidotes Canth.). Strangury and priapism.
MIND - Afraid of his own thoughts, wants to be diverted from thoughts of himself. Fears to be left alone. Does
not like any one near him. Memory lost. Most pains are felt during ahalf-conscious condition and disappear
when thinking of them. Worse from inattention.
Insensibility, vanishing of all senses or anxiety. Awkwardness. Nothing satisfies. Delirium. Mania, religious,
puerperal. Wants to jump out of bed or window. Excited, talks constantly, scolds in indecent language.
Feeling that she is going to die, relieved, when she finds herself alive. Attacks of anguish at night. State of
frenzy, hysterical, scratches, spits, bites, tears her clothes. Screams and calls for help. Closes her eyes and
answers no questions.
Abdomen - Cramps in the abdomen.
Cutting colic at night. Bellyache as if diarrhea would follow. Drawing pain, as from a bruise. Sensation of
fullness in the abdomen. Cold or of burning heat in the epigastrium and in the abdomen.
Back - Tension and stiffness of the neck. Drawing stitches between shoulder blades. Pressure in small of
back. Sensation as if cool air was blowing on back.
Causations - Ill effects of shock from injury, operations, sunstroke, snakebites. Vexation.
Chest - A cold feeling in chest followed by cold breath. Dry feeling at bifurcation of trachea. Cramps in the
chest. Shootings in the chest.
Ears - Heat and redness of the ears, especially in the lobes. Abscess in the meatus with deep redness and
pressive shooting pain.
Eyes - Fixed, starinfe, turned upwards or outwards, pupils dilated. Sensation as if all objects were too bright
and glittering. Objects appear too bright or move to one side with ajerk. Eyes protrude with mania. Eyes deeply
sunken.
Face - Pale, haggard, anxious, distorted, bluish, cold. Cold sweat. Pale and red by turns. Distorted. Grimaces.
Upper lip retracted. Lockjaw. Froth or foam at the mouth.
Female - Menses too profuse, or absent. Sexual desire increased. Hot flushes with coldness of abdomen and
limbs, at menopause. Labor-like pains. Weakness of sexual system.
Food - Bitter taste of food, especially of meat. Dislike and repugnance to tobacco smoke. Excessive thirst.
Head - Influenza, headache with catarrhal symptoms, sneezing, etc. Cold sweat. Head sore. Feels knotted up.
Beating pain in cerebellum. Occipital throbbing, synchronous with the pulse, better standing, when
deprived of sexual intercourse. Fleeting stitches in temporal region and orbits. Head is drawn to one side
(in spasms). Pains run from head to fingertips.
Heart - Anxiety at heart. Spasmodic stitches in region of heart. Precordial distress. Palpitations, after eating.
Pulse, weak, not perceptible, frequent, small.
 Kidneys - Burning and strangury with tenesmus of the neck of the bladder. Retention with full bladder.
Hematuria.
Limbs - Rheumatic pain between the shoulders. Difficult motion. Numbness, tingling and coldness. Cramps
in calves. Cracking in joints. Feet cold, pains as if
sprained. Icy cold feet, ache as if sprained. Fingers stiff, open, distorted. Thumbs drawn backwards.
Lungs - Asphyxia neonatorum. Asthma, worse from bodily exertion. Breath cold. Breathing anxious,
oppressed, sighing, quiet, deep and slow, snoring. Cutting, cold feeling deep in windpipe, causes a slight
cough. Hoarse, squeaking voice. Suspended respiration. Violent attacks of dry cough. Suffocative dyspnea.
Male - Sexual excitement. Chordee. Priapism, during dreams Nightly emissions. Satyriasis. Impotence.
Modalities - Better from free discharges, sweat. Better warmth. Better thinking of it. Better drinking cold water.
Worse motion. Worse contact. Worse mental exertion, shock. Worse night. Worse when half asleep. Worse
from cold air, drafts. Worse suppressions.
Mouth - Breath fetid in the morning. Cold breath. Foam at the mouth. Abundant accumulation of a viscid and
slimy saliva. Tongue cold, flabby, trembling, bluish. Speech, broken, feeble, hoarse. Boiling hot tea seems
cold.
Nose - Cold and pinched. Inhaled air seems cold. Persistent nosebleed with goose bumps. Stopped up,
sneezing. Fluent coryza on sudden change of weather. Coryza in old age.
Rectum - Black stools, involuntary. Rice water stools. Asiatic cholera with cramps in calves, coldness of
body, anguish, great weakness, collapse, tongue and mouth cold.
Skin - Dryness of the skin. Skin, bluish and cold, with coldness of the body. Old looking, pale, blue, livid.
Cannot bear to be covered (Sec.). Erysipelas. Sequelae of measles. Skin sensitive, even to the slightest touch.
Sleep - Comatose sleep. Insomnia with cold limbs. Trembling and extreme restlessness.
Stomach - Pressive pain in pit of stomach. Coldness, followed by burning. Burning in stomach, in abdomen.
Little vomiting or purging with dry collapse. Vomiting of bile or blood. Sour, bilious vomiting
in the morning. Strong pressure in the epigastrium.
Teeth - Toothache, as if from swelling of the sub-maxillary glands. Toothache better beer. Sensation of
lengthening of the teeth. Acute shocks in the roots of the incisors. Painful looseness of the teeth.
Temperature - Pulse small, weak, slow. Cold perspiration. Icy coldness of the whole body. Shaking chill
with cold skin, wants covers during the hot stage only. Congestive chill. Tongue cold, flabby, trembling.
Sudden inflammatory fevers with rapid alternation of heat and cold, followed by rapid prostration. Heat or
sweat, better covers. Sweats when covered, body becomes cold when uncovered. Chilly, below scapula,
before colds.
Throat - Soreness in the throat on swallowing. Dry, scraping sensation of the palate. Burning heat in the throat.
Constriction of larynx, feeling as if throat tied.
Vertigo - Vertigo, with a tendency to unconsciousness, feeling as if he would die.
COMMENTS -Camphor has a special place in homeopathy because it's the major antidote of the remedies
along with coffee. Camph. corrects spoiled cases and antidotes most of the medicines, especially from the
vegetable kingdom.
Useful as a heart stimulant for emergency use. Give drop doses on sugar as often as every five minutes.
Hahnemann gave it as a remedy for cholera along with Cupr. and Verat. (Cupr. has spasms and cramps,
Verat. has voracious thirst), and used it prophylactically. Useful for dehydration. Rice-water stools. Collapse
and coldness (Carb-v.).
Internal heat and external coldness. Great coldness of surface with sudden and complete prostration of the
vital forces. Feeling as if a cold wind were blowing over body. For all kinds of sudden internal pains arising
from chill or other causes.
Tetanic spasms, with drawing up the corners of the mouth, showing the teeth (like NUXT-V. andPhyt.), and
coldness. Spasmodic movement of head, head drawn to right side, rest of body relaxed, unconscious.
Spasmodic drawing of head laterally or backwards with deathly coldness.
Erysipelas spreading to central membranes. Eruptions. Soft parts drawn in. Skin painfully sensitive.
Salzer said the cases calling for it are those in which “arterial spasm,” with difficult breathing (spasm of
pulmonary arteries), coldness and lividity are the leading features.
In the form of the ordinary Camph. pilules, Clarke found it an excellent remedy for sleeplessness. In this, as in
its effect on colds, it resembles Aeon.
RELATIONS - Antidotes: Opium, Nit-s-d., Phos. Camph. has very important antidotal relations.
Camphorantidotesormodifies the action of nearly every vegetable medicine-tobacco, opium, worm medicines,
etc. It is Antidoted by: Op., Nit-s-d., Dulc. and Phos. It antidotes: Am-c., Canth., Carb-v., Cupr., Lyc., Squil.,
Nat-m., so-called worm-medicines tobacco, bitter almonds and other fruits containing prussic acid. Also the
 secondary disorders remaining after poisoning with acids, salts, metals, poisonous mushrooms, etc. Compare:
( 1) Cupr., Ars., Verat., Aloe. (2) Carb-v. - coldness from undeveloped exanthema, collapse, nosebleed, dark,
persistent, low hemorrhages generally. (3) Canth., Dulc. (4) Sec. - skin cold with desire to uncover. (5) Lyc. -
head drawn to one side, Lyc. to left, Plb. and Stram. to right, Bufo to either. (6) Op. - narcotism, heart disorders.
(7) Phos. - anguish and burning in cholera. (8) Nit-s-d., Squil., Verat. (9) Teste puts Camph. in his Belladonna
group with Agar., Lach., Cedr., Stram., Tab. and others. Complementary: Canth. Incompatible: Kalin.
Nitrum. Tea, coffee and lemonade, as a rule, do not interfere, but sometimes coffee worse.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

name: Camphora Bromata
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - camph-br. Camphora bromata. Camphor monobromide. Monobromata. A compound in which
one atom of hydrogen of the camphor has been replaced by one of bromine. Trituration. Historicaldose:
Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Cholera infantum. Chordee. Convulsions. Delirium tremens. Eczema. Gastric, catarrh. Hysteria.
Impotence. Influenza. Irritation, skin. Nervous, excitability. Neuralgia. Parkinson's disease. Sleep, disorders.
Spermatorrhea.
HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Cooper found Camph- br. of wide utility in all cases where nervous excitability is present.
He has given it chiefly in single doses of 3x trituration. Hale noted it for hysteria, weeping and laughter
alternately.
Nervous excitability. Headache in women and young girls due toe to mental excitement and excessive study.
Delirium tremens. Parkinson's disease. Cholera infantum and infantile convulsions.
Chordee. Neuralgia of testes and prostate. Impotence. Spermatorrhea. Nightly emissions. Painful erections.
Suppression of breast milk. Intensifies the action of Quinine and renders it more permanent.
MIND - Sense of direction is lost. Directions appear reversed, i.e., north seems south and east seems west.
Nervous excitability. Mental excitement and excessive study. Hysteria, weeping and laughing alternately.
Trance-like state.
COMMENTS - In a case reported by Dr. E. M. Beard, a young man suffered from gastric catarrh in paroxysms
which were induced by the sight of physical deformity, the touch of a cold, clammy hand and the mention of
odors, the actual presence of which did not affect him.
Complete relief was afforded by 3 gram doses of Camph-br. every 3 or 4 hours.
The drug, however, set up some singular symptoms including: directions appeared to be reversed, north
seemed south and east seemed west, innumerable black flies
Camphora bromata seemed to be flitting over the field of vision, he was sleepless and when he did sleep it
was restless and vexed with ghastly dreams. The reversal of directions lasted many days and the strain on the
faculty of attention was so torturing that he became prostrate in mind and body.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Canchalagua
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - canch. Canchalagua. Centaury. Erythraea chironioides. Erythraea chilensis. Centaurium
chironioides. Venusta centaury. N. O. Gentianacae. Chile, Peru. Tincture of whole plant when in flower. Must
be made from the fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Chills. Constipation. Influenza. Intermittents. Nausea. Sleeplessness.
HERBAL - Canch. has been used extensively as a fever remedy and bitter tonic (Gent-b.), anti-malarial and
anti-septic.
HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Richter proved Canch., experiencing symptoms including a congested feeling in the
heard, scalp tight, felt as if drawn together by India rubber. Stitches, pain, buzzing and roaring in ears.
Indicated in severe intermittents of hot countries, and influenza. General sore, bruised feeling, nausea and
retching. The skin becomes wrinkled like a washer woman's.
Sensation of drops falling from and upon different spots. Constipation, hard, knotty stools. Chills repeatedly
down back worse in bed, at night. Sleeplessness. After the proving, a cold wind could be borne better than
before.
Head - Congested. Scalp feels tight, head feels as if bound, burning in eyes, buzzing in ears.
Skin - Wrinkled like a washerwoman's. Sca/p feels tight, as if drawn together by India-rubber.
Temperature - Chill all over, worse in bed at night. Sensitive to cold, trade-winds. General sore and bruised
feeling, nausea and retching.
 RELATIONS - Compare: (1) The Gentians, Chin., Ip.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Candida Parapsilosis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-cand-p.          Candida      parapsilosis.   N.      O.     Fungi,    Ascomycetes,    Endomycetidae.
Saccharomycetaceae. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Candidiasis. Flatulence. Headache. Indigestion. Itching. Leucorrhea. Thrush. Vaginitis. Vertigo.
HOMEOPATHIC - Candida parapsilosis is a common yeast-like organism that has been implicated in human
infection. It has been recovered from respiratory secretions, urine, gastric washings, blood, vagina,
oropharynx, skin, transtracheal aspiration, stool, pleural fluid, ear, and nails.
It is implicated in the following human infections: Endopthalmitis, endocarditis, vaginitis, mycotic keratitis,
external otomycosis, paronychia, and fungemia. In the vagina, it is found less frequently than Candida albicans
and Torulopsis glabrata and is only rarely associated with vulvovaginal candidiasis as it is a less adherent
organism.
The people most infected with Candida are those with natural defences depressed by excessive use of
antibiotics and steroids or by certain diseases or operative procedures. Oral candidiasis is called thrush.
MIND - Very tired and scatter-brained. Total ‘loss of mind': seeing red lights and thinking they were green.
Spacey and poor concentration. Unusually irritable. Explosive anger at minor incidents - as though their rights
were being infringed upon. Mind races and words come out in wrong order or mispronounced. Abdomen -
Bloating, fullness, cramping of abdomen. Bloating with flatulence.
Female - Egg-white leucorrhea. Dripping discharge.
Food - Increased appetite. Great thirst. Desires salt, garlic, pickles.
Head - Wakes with a headache. Banging sensation. Frontal constriction. Lightheaded feeling. Itching of scalp,
dry, flaking, reddening spot along hairline. Eczema-like patches on hairline. Red, scaly and itching.
Heart - Sensation of arrhythmias with light-headed feeling. Prominent, quick heartbeat which reverberates
through the chest.
Modalities - Better open air. Worse direct sunlight.
Nose - Stuffiness of nose.
Skin - Eczema-like patches. Red, scaly and itching.
Stomach - Bloating, fullness, cramping of stomach.
Vertigo - Vertigo and hot flushes.
RELATIONS - Compare: Cand-a.. Carbo-v, Chin., Lyc., Sul-ac.
REFERENCES - Brown. Lange. Murphy.

name: Cannabis Indica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cann-i. Cannabis indica. Indian marijuana. Hashish. Bhang. Ganja. N. O. Cannabinacae. East
India. Tincture of young leaves and twigs. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL-Absent-minded. Anxiety. Backache. Catalepsy. Chordee. Clairvoyance Delirium, tremens.
Delusions. Diabetes. Dysmenorrhea. Epilepsy. Flatulence. Fears. Gonorrhea. Headache. Infertility. Insomnia.
Intoxication. Kidney, disorders. Mania. Memory, weak. Menorrhagia. Miscarriage. Nervousness. Paralysis.
Paranoia. Prostatitis. Satyriasis. Stammering. Uremia. Urinary, disorders.
HERBAL - The use of Cann-i. in the East as an intoxicant gives the leading note of its sphere of action.
Cannabis sativa and Cannabis indica are botanical ly identical, the difference in their properties is solely due
 to the difference of soil and climate in which they are grown.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cann-i. produces a state of exaltation with sublime visions, delusions and hallucinations
in great variety. Time seems too long, space illimitable. Paranoid. Apprehensive of approaching death. Fixed
ideas. Fear of becoming insane or losing control. Horror of darkness.
Great desire to lie down in the daytime. Thoroughly exhausted after a short walk. Felt so weak that he could
scarcely speak and soon fell into a deep sleep.
Soothing influence in many nervous disorders like epilepsy, mania, dementia and irritable reflexes. Catalepsy.
Delirium tremens, trembling. Hallucinations. Tendency to become furious. Nausea, unquenchable thirst. Feels
weak and all gone to nothing. Diabetes. Exophthalmic goiter.
MIND - Remarkable hallucinations and imaginations. Exaggeration of the duration of time and extent of
space. Misperceptions of time and space. Time seems too long, seconds seem ages. A few miles an
immense distance. Heat and cold sensations of the body. Loss of identity. Clairvoyance. Imagines himself in
a room of which the
walls gradually close in upon him. Double consciousness, subconscious or dual nature state.
Absent-minded. Poor short-term memory. Poor concentration and foggy mind. Sudden loss of memory.
Inability to fix his thoughts on one subject. Forgets what he intends to write or speak. Sudden loss of speech,
begins a sentence but cannot finish it. Lazy but restless. Chronic insomnia due to over activity of the mind.
Drug-induced spaciness, pathologically happy state. Full of fun, mischief and laughs. Uncontrollable
laughter. Extremely happy and contented, nothing troubles.
Emotional excitement, rapid change of moods. Exaltation of spirits with excessive loquacity. Stammering
and stuttering. Constantly theorizing. Fixed ideas. Ideas crowd upon each other. Lost in thoughts.
Great agitation, anxiety and nervousness. Mania, must constantly move. Panic attacks, paranoia. Anguish,
better in the open air. Constant fear of becoming insane. Horror of darkness. Fear of approaching death.
Depression, constant fear of becoming insane. Abdomen - Throbbing here and there.
Rumbling in bowels at night. Flatulence, on rising in morning, with headache. The abdomen feels swollen,
better by belching. Sensation of extreme tension in abdominal vessels feel distended to bursting. Sensation
as if something alive in abdomen (Thuj.).
Back - Backache, worse during menses, which occur every two weeks and are scanty. Warmth in spine
extending to head. Torticollis, chin drawn to the sternum. Pain across shoulders and spine, must stoop,
cannot walk erect.
Breasts - Stitches extending from both nipples through chest.
Chest - Oppression of chest with deep, labored breathing. Feels suffocated, has to be fanned.
Ears - Aching, throbbing and fullness in both ears. Extreme sensitiveness to noise, very acute hearing. Noise
like boiling water, buzzing and ringing. Periodical singing in the ears during a dreamy spell, ceasing when he
came to himself.
Eyes - Eyes bright and shiny. Injection of vessels of conjunctiva of both eyes. Glaucoma. Jerking in corner of
the eye and eyelids. Fixed gaze. Weak vision. Twinkling, trembling and glimmering before the eyes. Letters
run together when reading. Sees objects outside of visual field. Visual clairvoyance.
Face - Dejected, careworn, wearied, exhausted appearance. Drowsy, stupid look. Skin of face, especially of
forehead and chin, feels as if drawn tight.
Female - Menses with violent uterine colic with dysuria. Menses profuse, dark, painful, without clots.
Backache during menses. Spasmodic uterine pains returning like labor pains, great agitation and
sleeplessness. Sexual desire increased in infertile women or with dysmenorrhea. Infertility (Bor., Sep.).
Threatened miscarriage in eighth month, burning on urination with purulent discharge.
Food - Increased appetite. Ravenous hunger. Craves sweets. Very thirsty for cold drinks.
Head - Violent headaches and hallucinations. Vertex seems to open and shut, worse noise. Head seems
separated from the body. Feels as if top of head were opening and shutting. Shocks through brain (Aloe.,
Coca.). Involuntary shaking of head. Uremic headache. Headache with flatulence. Migraine attack preceded
by unusual excitement with loquacity. Pain in the whole right side of the head. Throbbing and weight at occiput.
Heavy pressure on the brain, forcing him to stoop. Dull, heavy, throbbing pain with sensation as from a blow,
on back of head and neck.
Heart - Palpitations, awaking from sleep. Piercing pain with great oppression. Pulse very slow (Dig., Kalm.,
Apoc.). Pressing pain in the heart with dyspnea the whole night. Sensation as if drops were falling from the
heart. Stitches in the heart, accompanied by great oppression, the latter relieved by deep breathing.
Kidneys - Dull pain in region of right kidney. Pain in the kidneys when laughing. Bunting, aching or sharp
stitches in the
kidneys. Urging to urinate, but cannot pass a drop. Must wait some time before the urine flows, strain. The
 urine dribbles out after the stream ceases. Must force out the last few drops with the hand. Profuse, colorless
urine, can have mucus. A white glairy mucus may be squeezed from the urethra. Burning and scalding or
stinging pain in the urethra before, during, and after urination.
Limbs - Weariness in limbs and stiffness and aching in knees, almost paralysis. Thrilling through arms and
hands, and from knees down. Entire paralysis of the lower limbs. Pain in soles and calves, sharp pains in
knees and ankles, very exhausted after a short walk. Paralysis of the right arm. Coldness of right hand with
stiffness and numbness of right thumb. On attempting to walk, intensely violent pain as if treading on spikes,
which penetrated the soles and ran upward through the limbs. Shooting pains in the joints of the toes of the
left foot, worse in great toe, aching and stitching pain in ball of left great toe.
Lungs - Humid asthma. Chest oppressed with deep, labored breathing. Rough cough with scraping
immediately under the sternum. Great effort to take a deep inspiration.
Male - Sexual desire increased. Satyriasis, priapism. Prolonged thrill. Erections not caused by amorous
thoughts. Violent painful erections. Backache after sexual intercourse. Oozing of white, glairy mucus from
glans. Chordee. Sensation of swelling in perineum or near anus, as if sitting on a ball. Penis relaxed and
shrunken. Itching in the glans penis. Sharp pricking like needles in urethra, so severe as to send a thrill to
cheeks and hands. Gonorrhea without pain with a very profuse yellowish-white discharge. Feeling as if
discharge in urethra.
Modalities - Better from walking about outdoors. Better fresh air. Better cold water. Better rest. Worse from
coffee, liquor and tobacco. Worse lying on right side. Worse mornings.
Mouth - Gritting and grinding of teeth while sleeping. Tongue is white, thick, frothy and sticky saliva.
Dryness of the mouth and lips. Lips feel as if glued together. Every article of food is extremely palatable.
Stammering and stuttering speech.
Rectum - Sensation in anus as if sitting on a ball. Painless, yellow diarrhea.
Sleep - Sleepy but cannot sleep. Chronic insomnia. Excessive sleepiness, sound sleep with melancholy
dreams. Jerking of the limbs while sleeping, causing him to awake. Talks during sleeps. Gritting teeth during
sleep. Catalepsy. Nightmares every night as soon as he falls asleep. Dreams are prophetic, of dead bodies,
danger and perils to be encountered. Erotic dreams with erection and profuse seminal emission.
Stomach - Pain in the cardiac orifice, relieved by pressure. Suffocative feeling while eating. Distention. Pyloric
spasm.
Temperature - Loss of vital heat. General chilliness. Coldness of the face, nose and hands after dinner.
Profuse sticky sweat, standing out in drops on his forehead.
Throat - Throat is parched, accompanied by intense thirst for cold water.
Vertigo - Chronic vertigo, as of floating off the ground. Worse on rising with stunning pain in back part of head.
Sensation as if the room were falling in pieces about her. COMMENTS - Cann-i. inhibits the higher faculties
and stimulates the imagination to a remarkable degree. A major remedy for drug flashbacks, fears, phobias or
panic attacks since a drug overdose. DTs. Clairvoyance and clairaudience.
A condition of intense exaltation in which all perceptions and conceptions, all sensations and emotions are
exaggerated to the utmost degree. Hypersensitivity of all the senses. Extreme sensitivity to noise, can hear a
whisper in adjoining room and is irritated from it. Startles easily. Fear of loss of control.
Sensation of levitation. Sensation as if in a dream. Vertigo on rising with stunning pain in back part of head.
Cann-i. removed a vertigo in which the patient felt as if the house were falling in ruins about her.
Starting, talking, nightmares, during sleep. Grinds teeth while asleep. Wants to sleep but cannot (Gels.).
Palpitations, awakens from sleep. Stitches in heart with oppression, better deep breathing.
Dryness of the mouth. Stammering and stuttering. Thirst for cold water, worse warm, stuffy rooms. Craves
sweets. Useful when treating hypoglycemia related to smoking marijuana.
Affects the urinary and generative organs. History of kidney problems, cystitis, or gonorrhea. Constant dull
pain in region of right kidney. Pains in kidneys when laughing. Sensation in anus as if sitting on a ball, as if
anus and part of urethra were filled by a hard, round body.
Frequent urination with burning pain in evening. Urging and straining, but cannot pass a drop. Burning, scalding
or stinging in urethra before during and after urination. Dribbling of urine (Thuj., Sabah, Sep.). Urine loaded
with slimy mucus after exposure to damp and cold.
Backache worse during menses, which occur every two weeks and are scanty. Very profuse, painful, dark
menstruation, but without clots. Tendency to get vaginitis.
Catalepsy. Tingling of paralyzed parts. Paralysis of lower limbs and right arm. Muscle cramps and weak knees.
Headache with flatulence, lasts until flatus can be passed up or down, throbbing of occiput. Scalp sore feeling,
crawling on vertex, sensation as though skin tightly stretched over bones of face. Weight at occiput from which
pains start up sides of head to temples and vertex. Warmth of spine extending to head.
 Sensation as of brain boiling over and lifting cranial arch like a lid, opening and shutting sensation. Shocks
through brain on regaining consciousness. Guided by this symptom, Clarke removed a “noise like a crash or
explosion during sleep.”
Nash related the case of a woman suffering from cardiac dropsy, who, when relieved of the latter, suddenly
lost the power of speech. In answer to a question she could begin a
sentence, but could not finish it as she could not remember what she wished to say. She was very impatient
about it, would cry, but could not finish the sentence, though she could signify assent if any one did finish it for
her. Cann-i. cured rapidly.
In one case of overdose the observer experienced a modification of this: absolute forgetfulness of the thought,
speech or acts of the previous moment, startled by hearing the echo of the last words of a sentence he has
just spoken. Having suggested a walk to a companion and meeting him at the street door, wondered why they
were there. Afterwards, he could remember everything. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cann-s., Bell., Hyos.,
Stram., Lach., Agar. (2) Anhalon. - time sense disordered, time periods enormously overestimated, thus,
minutes seem hours. (3) Cann-s. - in extreme sensitiveness to noise. (4) Nit-ac. - to jarring and rumbling of
wagon in street. (5) Coff. - to all sounds. Borax - slightest noise, fall of door latch, rumpling of paper, rustling
of silk. (6) Asar. - to scratching of linen or silk or even the thought of it. (7) Levitation -Asar., Calc., Cocc., Ph-
ac., Sil., Stict., Sulph., Thuj. (8) Asif in adream - Ambr., Anae., Calc., Con., Cupr., Med., Rheum., Stram.,
Valer., Verat., Zinc. (9) Horror of darkness - Am-m., Bar-c., Calc., Carb-an., Phos., Stram., Stroph., Valer. (10)
Noise like a crash or explosion in head - Aloe.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

name: Cannabis Sativa
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cann-s. Cannabis sativa. Marijuana. Hemp. Europeanhemp. American hemp. N. O.
Cannabinacae. Tincture of male and female flowering tops. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Ascites. Asthma. Cataract. Choking. Cystitis. Fatigue. Forgetful. Glaucoma. Gonorrhea.
Headache. Hysteria. Infertility. Impotence. Leucorrhea. Memory, weak. Miscarriages. Nausea. Nephritis.
Nosebleeds. Opacity, cornea. Ophthalmia. Palpitations. Paralysis. Phimosis. Pleurisy. Pneumonia. Post-
partum hemorrhage. Polyuria. Priapism. Sexual, disorders. Stammering. Teranus.
Trachea, mucus. Urethral discharges, caruncle. Vaginitis. Vomiting.
HERBAL - Cann-s. and Cann-i. are similar, the difference in their properties is solely due to the difference of
soil and climate in which they are grown. Cann-s. has less pronounced mental symptoms and head symptoms
and the eye and genito-urinary symptoms are more so than Cann-i.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cann-s. seems to affect especially the urinary and sexual organs. Acute and chronic
gonorrhea, especially when the patient walks with the legs apart. Sexual excitement in both the sexes.
Threatened miscarriage from too frequent sexual intercourse or complicated with gonorrhea. Vaginitis.
Characteristic sensations as of dropping water. Choking in swallowing, things go down the wrong way. Great
fatigue from having spoken or written. Feels exhausted after a short walk. Feet feel heavy on going upstairs.
Acute drawing and contractive, pressive pains with sensation of paralysis. Drawing pains in regions of kidneys
extending into inguinal glands with anxious sensation of nausea at epigastrium.
Tetanus, chiefly in the upper limbs and in the trunk. Paralysis with tingling of the affected part. Unendurable
fine stitching over whole body, as from a thousand needle points, at night, when sweating from warm covering,
better uncovering.
MIND - Confusion of thought and speech. Stuttering and stammering. Embarrassed speech, at one time
words are wanting, at another the voicefails. Veryforgetful cannot finish the sentence. Vanishing of
thoughts, want of words. Wavering speech, hasty, incoherent. Speech stops with anxiety and agony on
account of pain in the back. Many errors in writing.
Ideas seem to stand still, he stares in front of him is absorbed in higher thoughts, but in unconscious of them.
Time seems too long. Thinks everything is unreal, as if in a dream. Voices including her own, seem to come
from a distance, her own voice s-^ ems strange, as if it were somebody else
speaking. Clairvoyance.
Loquacity. Laughs immoderately, at mere trifles. Laughs and weeps. Ecstatic, heavenly. Fixed ideas. Mania,
sometimes happy, sometimes serious or furious. Sadness and indifference. Irresolution and uncertainty.
Moaning and crying. Disposition to be easily frightened or irritated. Fear of going to bed. Abdomen - Pain as
from a bruise in the intestines. Hard and painful swelling of the liver region. Cramp-like pains in the epigastrium.
Sensation of soreness. Shuddering sensation, as if cold water were running through abdomen. Painful jerks.
Shaking of the intestines, as if they were detached, when the arms are moved. Shocks and pressure towards
 the outside in the regions of the groins. Pulsation of abdomen from within outward.
Back - Pains in the back, which impede speech and suspend respiration. Shooting pains between the shoulder
blades. Pressure towards the outside in the sacral region and coccyx.
Chest - Weight on chest, rattling wheezing breathing. Shootings in the bottom of the chest, especially on
breathing, speaking or during movement.
Ears - Throbbing and pressure in the ears, that disappears when one is stooping and reappearing when raising
the head again. Hears voices, bells, music. Buzzing in the ears and sensation as if a skin were before them.
Eyes - Glaucoma. Pressure from back of eyes, forward. Eyeballs ache. Cataract from nervous disturbances,
abuse of alcohol and tobacco, patient feels deeply approaching blindness. Gonorrheal ophthalmia. Opacity
of cornea. Scrofulous eye troubles (Sulph., Calc.). Cramp-like pulling in the eyes. Misty sight. Weakness and
confusion of sight, on viewing objects either distant or near. Appearance of a circle of whitish flames before
the eyes.
Face - Paleness of the face. Heat of the face and redness of the cheeks. Tingling, itching and smarting in the
face, as if from salt. Twitching of the muscles of the face.
Female - Acute gonorrhea. Threatened abortion, complicated with gonorrhea or on account of frequent
sexual intercourse. Leucorrhea. Infantile leucorrhea. Amenorrhea, also with constipation. Profuse
menstruation. Miscarriage with convulsions. Great sexual excitement with infertility.
Food - Desires sweets and cold drinks. Every article of food is extremely palatable. Aversion to meat, of
which she was fond.
Head - Headache, as if there were a stone pressing upon it. Sensation of a heavy weight on the vertex.
Pressure and tension on the temples. Pressure on root of nose. Congestion in the head, throbbings in the
brain, cheeks red and hot with pulsation. Sensation at the scalp, as if something were creeping on it and as if
drops of cold water were falling on the head.
Heart - Great anxiety of heart. Painful tension in the heart with palpitations of the heart and anxiety. Beatings
of the heart, which are felt lower than their ordinary place. Pulse weak, slow and scarcely perceptible.
Pericarditis. Inflammation of the heart. Sensation as if drops were falling from the heart.
Kidneys - Inflamed sensation with soreness to touch. Acute gonorrhea, urethra sensitive, walks with the
legs apart. Kidney colic and pains. Pain in kidney, while laughing. Painful urging. Must strain to urinate, has to
wait for some time before the urine flows, dribbles after flow ceases. Scanty burning urine passed drop by
drop. Urination in split stream. Burning while urinating, extending to bladder. Urine scalding with
spasmodic closure of sphincter. Stitches, zigzag pain along urethra. Urethral caruncle (Eucal.), phimosis.
Stoppage of urethra by mucus and pus. Discharge of yellow, watery mucus from the urethra (gonorrhea).Urine,
turbid, white or reddish and as if mixed with blood and pus. Incontinence of urine. Ejection of a kidney stone
on urinating. Retained urine with constipation.
Limbs - Pain in the limbs, worse deep breathing. Pain, as from a bruise in the shoulder and forearm during
movement. Entire paralysis of lower limbs. Cramps in the thighs, the calves of the legs and the hams.
Weakness, staggering and pains of the knees. Displacement of the patella on going up the stairs. Pulsation
and stretching pain in the feet and in the joints of the foot, as after a long walk. Spasmodic contraction of the
Achilles tendon with violent pains. Cramps in the hands and the fingers. Sudden paralytic weakness of the
hand with trembling on laying hold of an object and inability to hold it firmly.
Lungs - Suffocative attacks. Humid asthma. Difficulty in breathing and palpitations, then must stand up. As
if there were a weight on the chest, with wheezing and rattling in the bronchials. Difficulty of respiration with
uneasiness in the throat, worse lying down. Rattling breathing. Inflammation of the lungs, with greenish
vomiting and delirium. Cough with green viscid, bloody, expectoration. Cough, violent and dry.
Male - Sexual desire increased. Priapism. Strong sexual desire or aversion to sex. Erections without amorous
thoughts. Erections with tensive pains. Acute gonorrhea. Itching and inflammatory swelling of the prepuce,
glans and penis with deep redness and phimosis. The penis feels sore and burnt when walking, walks with
legs apart. Cold genitals. Dragging, aching in the testes and tension in the spermatic cord, when standing
upright. Swelling of the prostate gland.
Modalities - Better from fresh air. Better cold water. Better rest. Worse from urinating. Worse after a meal.
Worse coffee, liquorortobacco. Worse darkness. Worse at night. Worse after midnight. Worse open air, and
heat. Worse from exercise, exertion. Worse talking. Worse walking. Worse going upstairs. Worse touch. Worse
lying down.
Mouth - Grinding of teeth in sleep. Dryness of the mouth with viscid saliva and absence of thirst. Saliva,
white, thick,
frothy. Eruption on the border of the lips.
Nose - Swelling of the nose with copper- like redness. Stupefying pressure on the root of the nose. Heat and
 dryness of the nose. Nosebleed, preceded by a sensation of burning in the nose.
Rectum - Diarrhea, accompanied by cramplike pains in the abdomen. Pressure in the rectum towards the
outside. Sensation as of cold water running from the anus. Constipation and hard feces.
Sensations - As if hot water were poured over him. As if drops of cold water were falling on the head,
from anus, or from heart. As if pinched with pincers in back. Pressure as with a sharp point in coccyx.
Skin - At night, pricking and sensation of burning over the whole skin, as if from boiling water.
Sleep - Sleepy, but cannot sleep. Frightful or erotic dreams. Dreams of the dead. Sensation of greater fatigue
on waking in the morning, then when going to bed in the evening. Sleepy during the day.
Stomach - Empty risings. Regurgitation of acrid substances of a bitter sourness. Attack of violent cramps in
the stomach. Nausea with inclination for food. Vomiting with sensation of strangulation from the epigastrium to
the throat. Vomiting of green bile. Pain in the stomach, on being touched, as if it were ulcerated, better by
eating. Aching, pinchings and cuttings in the epigastrium and in the upper part of the stomach.
Temperature - Typhoid fevers, where strangury exists. Shuddering, shivering with thirst. Uneasiness and
external cold. Coldness of the body with heat in the face. Heat only in the face. Burning heat over the whole
body at night.
Throat - Cannot control voice. Loss of voice. Accumulation of tenacious mucus in the larynx with scraping and
difficulty of breathing.
Vertigo - Vertigo, sensation of dropping water on head. Attacks of vertigo on walking or when standing for
some time to such an extent as to cause falling. Sensation as if intoxicated.
COMMENTS - In Cann-i., the drug state is often the etiology, but Cann-s stands on its own. Closely related to
Med. And Thuj., will often follow Med. Boericke said that lemon juice antidotes Cann-s.
Strong affinity for the genital area and infections. High sex drive (Med.). Acute gonorrhea remedy, with
spaciness and a history of drug use. Yellow-green discharges.
Urethral symptoms with burning and smarting (Canth. has more tenesmus). Mucus in urine, burning on
urination. The bladder feels full. Non-specific urethritis. Pain in right kidney. Cramps of any kind. The urethra
is very sensitive to touch and pressure, the patient cannot bear the legs close together. Urethral caruncle.
Phimosis.
Dry mouth, craves sweets, thirst for cold water. Hypoglycemia. Sensitive to stimulants. Limbs feel weak and
heavy. Glaucoma. Cataract and opacities of the cornea, gonorrhea of the eyes. Eyeballs aches, pressure in
back of the eyes.
Sudden changes from agitation to restless to calm. Distortion in perception, spacey, bad memory. Better with
fresh, open air and cold water on their face.
RELATIONS - Antidotes: Camph., Lemon juice. Antidotes of large doses: lemon juice, Strychnia, Camph.,
Merc. Compare: ( 1 ) Cann- i., Thuj. Med., Canth., Petros. (2) Sars. - worse going up stairs. (3) In phimosis -
Merc., Sulph., Nit-ac., Sep., Thuj. Rhus-t.. Sabin. (4) as if something alive in abdomen - Croc., Thuj. (5) Apis,
Cop., Cimic., Kali-n. (6) Hedysa- rum - gonorrhea and inflammation of penis. Compatible: Bell., Hyos., Lyc.,
Nux-v., Op., Puls., Rhus-t., Verat.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.
keynote:
PHARMACY - cann-s. Cannabis sativa. Marijuana. Hemp. Europeanhemp. American hemp. N. O.
Cannabinacae. Tincture of male and female flowering tops. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Ascites. Asthma. Cataract. Choking. Cystitis. Fatigue. Forgetful. Glaucoma. Gonorrhea.
Headache. Hysteria. Infertility. Impotence. Leucorrhea. Memory, weak. Miscarriages. Nausea. Nephritis.
Nosebleeds. Opacity, cornea. Ophthalmia. Palpitations. Paralysis. Phimosis. Pleurisy. Pneumonia. Post-

name: Cantharis Vesicatoria
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - canth. Cantharis vesicatoria. Spanish Fly. Lytta vesicator. Meloe vesica- torius. N. O. Insecta,
Coleóptera. Tincture or trituration of whole insect. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Bladder, infections. Blisters. Burns. Chordee. Cystitis. Diphtheria. Dysentery. Eczema.
Emissions. Erysipelas. Eyes inflammation. Gastritis. Gonorrhea. Herpes zoster. Hydrophobia. Kidneys,
disorders. Mania. Neuralgia. Nymphomania. Ovaries, disorders. Peritonitis. Pleurisy. Pregnancy, disorders.
Retained, placenta. Satyriasis. Scarlatina. Sexual, mania. Spermatorrhea. Strangury. Sunburn. Thirst.
Throat, sore. Tongue inflammation. Urine, abnormal. Vesicles.
HOMEOPATHIC - Commonly known as Span- ish fly, Canth. belongs to the animal kingdom and finds its most
prominent sphere of action in exciting the animal passions. There is anger in a very acute degree amounting
to paroxysms of rage and a corresponding condition of the bodily tissues.
Rapid and intense action. Characteristic irritation. Hypersensitiveness of all parts. Burns and scalds.
Vesication. Erysipelas, blisters. Burning, stitches, shooting pains and exudation are the indications. Pains are
cutting, smarting or burning, biting or as if raw, causing mental excitement. Raw, burning pains.
Inflammations are violently acute or rapidly destructive in the mucus and serous membranes. Violent
inflammation of the whole gastro-intestinal canal, especially lower bowel. Puerperal convulsions. Inflam-
mations are often associated with bladder irritation.
 In any condition when the urine is scanty, cutting and burning. Intolerable, constant urging to urinate.
Dysuria with any other complaints. Painful urination, as a concomitant in any diseased condition. Acute
nephritis.
Gastric, hepatic and abdominal complaints, aggravated by drinking coffee. Gastric derangements of
pregnancy.
Inñameásexualorgans, causing frenzied delirium. Amorous frenzy, unbounded sexual desire. Sexual
weakness and excitability. Sexual excitement during pains. Expels dead fetus, placenta, promotes fecundity.
Discharges are bloody, acrid, watery, tenacious. Hemorrhages. Serous effusions. Sudden attacks of
weakness that takes the voice away. Hemiplegia of (right) side with aphasia. Convulsions with dysuria and
hydrophobic symptoms. Moles.
MIND - Great restlessness, obliging him to move constantly. Anxious restlessness, ending in rage.
Paroxysms of rage with crying, barking, biting and worse by bright objects, by touching the larynx, drinking
cold water. Despondent and low-spirited, says she must die. Weeping aggra,vates.
Furious delirium. Delirium, with dread. Acute mania after erysipelas. Wildness. Excessive sexual desire, not
better by sex. Acute mania, generally of a sexual type, amorous frenzy, fiery sexual desire. Sings lewd songs.
Striking at imaginary objects about him.
Fear of mirrors in room. Constantly attempts to do something but accomplishes nothing. Insolent, contradictory
mood. Disposition to contradict. Irritable, dissatisfied with every one and everything. Whining and complaining,
with anxious restlessness, worse motion, better lying quiet.
Exceedingly sensitive to all impressions. Uneasiness day and night, with hot head. Strange ideas crowd on
him against his will. Prattles about genitals, urine, feces. Delusion bed were raised. Insanity with increased
strength. Sudden loss of consciousness with red face.
Abdomen - Pain in loins with incessant desire to urinate. Violent burning pain through the whole intestinal
tract, with painful sensitiveness to touch.
Back - Emprosthotonos and opisthotonos. Pain in loins with frequent desire to urinate.
Bladder - Acute severe cystitis. Constant desire to urinate. Urging to urinate from smallest quantity of
urine in bladder. Intolerable tenesmus. Burning, cutting pains before, during and after urination. Severe
burning pains in bladder. Intense burningpain in urethra, worse motion, better lying on back. Violent
burning, cutting pains in neck of bladder. Atony of bladder from long retention of urine. Griping in bladder.
Heaviness in bladder, feels sore on slightest motion. Terrible pains from being catheterized. Bladder pains,
worse drinking, even small quantities of water. Burning pains when urinating and when not. Must double herself
and scream from fearful cutting pains in urethra.
Breasts - Breasts painful, with dysuria.
Chest - Chest pains better belchings. Burning pains in chest. Stitches in chest, at sternum (Bry., Kali-c., Squil.).
Pleurisy, as soon as effusion has taken place.
Ears - Sensation as if wind were coming from ear or hot air. Bones about ear painful (Caps.).
Eyes - Objects look yellow. Yellow vision (Sant.). Fiery, sparkling, staring look. Burning in eyes.
Face - Pale and wretched, death-like appearance. Expression of extreme suffering, terror or despair. Hot and
red. Jaws tightly closed, acute mania. Itching vesicles on face, burning when touched. Erysipelas of face with
burning, biting heat with urinary symptoms.
Female - Retained placenta (Sep.), with painful urination. Expels dead fetuses, membranes, etc.
Nymphomania (Plat.). Pruritus with strong sexual desire, at menopause. Leucorrhea with sexual excitement,
causing severe itching and masturbation. Puerperal metritis with inflammation of bladder. Menses too early
and too profuse, black. Swelling of vulva with irritation. Constant discharge from uterus, worse false step.
Cutting burning in ovaries, ovaritis. Sharp, tearing pain in os coccyx.
Food - Disgust for everything, drink, food, tobacco. Thirst unquenchable. Burning thirst, but aversion to all
fluids. Aversion to water. Aggravation from drinking coffee. drinking the smallest quantity increases pain in
bladder and is vomited.
Head - Burning in brain. Sensation as if boiling water in brain. Head heavy, aches from bathing or washing.
Hair falls when combing.
Heart - Palpitation, pulse feeble, irregular, tendency to syncope. Pericarditis with effusion.
Kidneys - Acute nephritis. Nephritis with bloody urine. Diabetes insipidus. Bright's disease. Kidney colic.
Kidney region very sensitive. Kidney pains and urging to urinate, steadily increasing in severity. Dropsy. Urine,
burning, scalding with cutting pains and intolerable urging. Strangury. Violent paroxysms of cutting and
burning in whole renal region, with painful urging to urinate. Urine is passed drop by drop, dribbling. Bloody
urine. Membranous scales looking like bran in water. Urinejelly-like, shreddy. Paroxysmal cutting and burning,
in both kidneys, the region very sensitive to slightest touch.
 Limbs - Knees totter when ascending steps. Ulcerative pain in soles, cannot step. Tearing in limbs.
Lungs - Voice low, weak feeling. Tenacious mucus in air passages. Pleurisy with exudation. Dyspnea,
palpitation, frequent, dry cough. Tendency to syncope. Short, hacking cough, blood-streaked, tenacious
mucus.
Male - Painful swelling of genitals. Priapism. Pulls at penis. Sexual desire increased not better by sex. Bloody
semen. Pollutions. Burning in urethra after sex. Strong desire, painful erection. Pain in glans. Gonorrhea with
priapism.
Modalities - Better from rubbing. Better warm applications. Better warmth. Better rest. Worse during or after
urination. Worse drinking cold water or coffee. Worse sound of water. Worse bright objects. Worse touch,
especially the larynx.
Mouth - Tongue covered with vesicles, deeply furred, edges red. Swollen tremulous tongue, edges raw.
Burning in mouth, pharynx and throat. Vesicles in mouth. Grinding of the teeth with lockjaw. Saliva
disgustingly sweet.
Rectum - Dysentery, mucus stools like scrapings of intestines. Shreddy burning stools with tenesmus of
rectum and bladder, with shuddering after stools. Bloody with burning, tenesmus and shuddering after
stool. Dysentery or diarrhea with dysuria. Constipation with retention of urine. Desire for stool while urinating.
Cutting in rectum partially better by flatus, entirely by stools.
Skin - Burns and scalds with rawness and smarting, relieved by cold applications, followed by undue
inflammation. Severe sunburns. Eruptions burn when touched. Dermatitis with bleb formation. Eruption with
mealy scales. Vesicular eruptions, turning black with burning and itching. Erysipelas, vesicular type with
great restlessness. Secondary eczema about scrotum and genitals, following excessive perspiration.
Tendency to gangrene. Burning in soles of feet at night.
Stomach - Burning sensation of esophagus and stomach (Carb.). Very sensitive, vio- lentburning. Vomiting
of blood-streaked membrane. Violent retching and vomiting. Sensitiveness over stomach, slightest pressure
produces convulsions.
Temperature - Chilly, as if cold water poured over him during stool. Cold hands and feet, cold sweat. Urinous
sweat, on genitals. Soles burn.
Throat - Burnt after taking hot food. As if on fire. Burning in mouth, pharynx and throat. Scalding feeling. Great
difficulty when swallowing liquids. Painfully constricted, aphthous ulceration. Full of blisters. Very
tenacious mucus (Kali-bi.). Violent spasms reproduced by touching larynx.
Vertigo - Vertigo, worse in open air.
COMMENTS - In Canth., the pains are burning and sharp, sharp along the course of a nerve. Tyler wrote that
it was “Another vehement drug of storm and stress, tamed by Hahnemann.” Burns and blisters. Severe pain
from burns. The part may be treated with a lotion containing a few drops or pills of the Canth. 30c or 200c to
the ounce of water, a dilution given internally.
An ointment made with the 3x is a good application for herpes zoster.
Useful forbladder infections (Staph.), with a constant, severe, painful urging, cutting in the urethra (Sars.).
Hematuria, blood in the urine, with a severe bladder infection. Pus in the urine. Can pass only a few drops like
molten lead. Strangury. Cutting, burning pains from the kidney down to urethra. Irritation of all grades. Worse
from a catheter.
The pains are burning and sharp, sharp along the course of a nerve. Neuralgia of head and face from taking
cold with loud screams and jerking of muscles. The slightest touch or approach aggravates the mental
symptoms. Violent spasms reproduced by touching larynx.
It acts on the brain, producing inflammation of the tissues. Irritation on the skin and serous membranes.
Pleurisy with effusion. Diphtheria, inflammation of throat, severe burning, constriction, thirst with aversion to
drinking.
The face is generally pale or yellowish with an expression of deep-seated suffering. Erysipelas commencing
in nose. The eyes are bright, pupils widely dilated. Conjunctivitis where the eye has burning pains, clawing at
the eye (Euphr.).
Pain in abdomen, colic-like, doubling the patient up, cutting, burning, lancinating. Dysenteric stools with
tenesmus. Violent dysentery, painful dysentery, with burning on passing the stool with blood and mucus.
Extreme superficial sensitiveness in hypogastrium (especially when the bladder is full), attended with
unbearable tenesmus of bladder. Inflamed stomach. The sexual appetite is aroused to the point of mania.
H. N. Guernsey observed that Canth. is almost always the remedy for whatever other sufferings there may be,
when there is as well frequent urination with burning, cutting pain or if cutting burning pain attends the flow,
even when urination is not very frequent.
Guernsey noted that “Canth. expels moles, dead fetus, placenta, promotes fecundity.” He also pointed out that
 Canth. should be studied in treating disorders of the airpassages when the mucus is tenacious.
Guernsey gave as the special indications in rabies and hydrophobia as “moaning and violent cries interspersed
with barking.” Glassy eyes, dilated pupil, flushed face, and the person is in a violent frenzy. Worse from
dazzling objects and by water, completing the hydrophobia picture.
Nash recorded a case in which this observation led him to make a cure. Kali-bi. had completely failed to relieve
a woman who had long suffered from bronchitis. The mucus was profuse, tenacious and ropy. One day the
patient mentioned that she had great cutting and burning on urinating, which she was obliged to do very
frequently. Canth. made a rapid cure.
Canth. has cured a case of malarial cachexia in which the symptoms were always worse when the urine was
scanty.
RELATIONS-Antidotes: Aeon., Puls. Camph. antidotes the strangury and retention of urine of Canth., Apis
the cystitis, Kali-n. the kidney symptoms. For its throat symptoms it is nearest to Capsicum. Canth. is Antidote
to: Camph., V inegar, Alcohol. Compare: ( 1 ) Apis, Staph., Ars., Merc-c., Bell. (2) Cann-s. - more burning and
smarting, Canth. more tenesmus. (3) Petros. - sudden urging, Caps, Puls. - retained placenta, Ars. - delayed
urination after childbirth. (4) Erections, those of Canth. prevent urination, those of Thuj do not. (5) Merc. -
semen mixed with blood, Sars. (urine bums like fire, shreddy particles and blood in it). Arum, Am., Rhus-t.,
Ran-s. (6) Teste classes Canth. with Senega and Ph-ac. in his Conium group. (7) Cantharidin - Glomerular
nephritis. (8) Vesicaria - urinary and kidney remedy. Smarting, burning sensation along urethra and in bladder
with frequent desire to void urine often with strangury. Cystitis irritable bladder. (9) Fuschina - Nephritis with
albuminuria. Redness of ears, mouth, swollen gums, deep, red urine, red, profuse diarrhea with severe ab-
dominal pains. ( 10) Androsace lactea - urinary troubles, diuretic, dropsy. Compatible with: Bell., Merc., Phos.,
Puls., Sep. Complementary: Camph. Incompatible: Coffea.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

name: Capsicum Annuum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - caps. Capsicum annuum. Cayenne pepper. N. O. Solanaceae. South America. West Indies.
Tincture of the dried pods. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amaurosis. Asthma. Brain, irritation. Delirium tremens. Cough. Delirium tremens. Diarrhea.
Diphtheria. Dysentery. Ear disorders. Esophagus, stricture. Colic. Gland, disorders. Hemorrhoid. Headache.
Heartbum. Hernia. Homesickness. Intermittents. Lungs, disorders. Mastoiditis. Measles. Mouth, ulcers.
Neuralgia. Nose, disorders. Obesity. Paralysis. Pleuro-pneumonia. Pregnancy, disorders. Rectum, diseases.
Rheumatic gout. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Scrofula. Seasickness. Stomatitis. Throat, sore. Tongue, paralysis.
Trachea, tickling. Urine, disorders. Whooping cough. Yellow fever.
HERBAL - Capsicum should be studied in connection with the other great members of the Solanum family,
Bell., Stram., Hyos., Dulc., Solan, carolin., Solan, nig., Solan, tub. (Potato) and Lycoper. (Tomato).
HOMEOPATHIC-The well-known burning effects of red pepper is a leading indication for its use. Burning
pains, wherever they occur, demand that Caps, should have consideration, if there are no other determining
symptoms in favor of another remedy. Burning, worse from cold water.
Pains are burning, smarting, pungent or strangling, threadlike, worse by cold water. Burning and pungent
pains, worse by application of cold water. Burning, pungent sensation in face worse by slightest draft of cold
air. Burning pains and general chilliness.
Burning in throat. Burning blisters in roof of mouth (diphtheria or gangrene). Constriction of throat, spasmodic
closure. Throat pain when not swallowing. Burning in rectum, tenesmus. Burning in bladder. Burning on
urination.
Fever. Redness of the skin, scarlet eruption (Bell.). Mucus membranes become dark, red, spongy or ooze
bloody mucus. Mucus
Capsicum annuum membranes have a sensation of constriction.
Disorders of bones. Pains in bones of face. Inflammation of petrous bone. Mastoiditis. Marked tendency to
suppuration in every inflammatory process. Deep abscesses. Discharges are very foul.
Violent pains in various places, now here now there. Muscle pain, aching and jerking of muscles. Neuralgias.
Sensation of soreness and constriction. Sensation as if cayenne pepper were sprinkled on parts. Sensation
as if parts go to sleep. Shuddering during pain or drinking.
Lack of reaction, particularly in persons of lax tissue. Sluggish circulation. Hemorrhages. Bodily irritability. Parts
pinched remain in raised position for a long time.
Extreme sensitiveness to cold and damp (Dulc.), aggravates most symptoms. Shuns open air, dreads
uncovering, dreads air. especially a draft. Better from heat. Patients who cannot get to sleep without a hot
 bottle at their back. Spirits become lower as body becomes cooler. Symptoms generally appear on left side. A
general uncleanliness of body.
Thirsty, but drinking causes shuddering. Absence of thirst during heat. Prostration and feeble digestion of
alcoholics. Abstainers from accustomed alcohol.
MIND - Capricious and changeable mood. If she wants a certain thing, she will oppose, if proposed by someone
else. Homesickness with red cheeks and sleeplessness with hot feeling in fauces. Homesickness with
sleeplessness and disposition to suicide. Sentimental, nostalgic moods.
Peevish, irritable, angry, easily offended. Irritability during chill. Confusion during chill. Peppery disposition.
Always on the lookout for insults. Obstinacy. Refractory, especially children. Wants to be left alone. Red cheeks
after emotions, fever.
Alternating states, laughs and weeps by turns is now jocose and sings, but becomes angry from slightest
cause. Clumsy. Awkward, runs 'Moeverything.Delirium tremens. Alcoholism. Dreads any kind of exercise.
Anxiety and fear, as though he was going to die. Fearfulness. Fear of slightest draft.
Fear of being censured. Frightened easily on waking. Awakens with fright, screams, and remains full of fear.
Sensitive to noise. Abdomen - Flatulent colic. Colic about umbilicus with mucus stools. Violent pulsations of
arteries in abdomen.
Back - Lumbar pain after stools. Pain in sacrum with hemorrhoids and dysentery. Pain in the back while
drinking water. Sensation as if cold water dropping down back.
Causations - Homesickness.
Chest - Constriction of chest, arrests breathing.
Constitutions - Suited to those of lax tissues, weak, lazy indolent, fat, red, clumsy, awkward and of unclean
habits. Such persons are opposed to physical exertion, averse to go outside of their routine and get homesick
easily. Old people who have exhausted their vitality, especially by mental work and poor living. Persons react
poorly and are afraid of cold. Abstainers from accustomed alcohol.
Ears - Swelling and pain behind ears, inflammation of mastoid. Mastoiditis. Otorrhea and mastoid
disease before suppuration. Tenderness over the petrous bone, extremely sore and tender to touch (Onos.).
Hot ears. Burning and stinging in ears. Otalgia, then deafness. Tympanum perforated. Sub-acute inflammation
of Eustachian tube with great pain. Ear affections during pregnancy.
Eyes - Objects appear black. Eyes prominent, with burning and lachrymation during cough.
Face - Red, but cold, or pale and red alternately. Pain in fine line coursing along the nerve. Lips, swollen,
cracked, burning.
Female - Menopausal disturbances with burning of tip of tongue. Pushing or sticking sensation in ovarian (left)
region with disorders of menses. Uterine hemorrhage near the menopause, with nausea. Sticking sensation
in left ovarian region.
Food - Craves stimulating, pungent things, wants a bracer. Much thirst, but drinking causes shuddering.
Desire for coffee, but it nauseates. Vegetables cause flatulence.
Head - Bursting headache, worse coughing, better heat, movement, lying with head high. Hot face. Red
cheeks. Face red, though cold (Asaf.).
Kidneys - Strangury, frequent, almost ineffectual urging. Burning in orifice. Comes first in drops, then in
spurts, neck of bladder spasmodically contracted. Thick, white creamy discharge from urethra, with gonorrhea.
Drinking excites urination and stool. Meatus everted.
Limbs - Joints crack, stiff, painful on beginning to move, pain as if paralyzed. Sciatica, worse bending
backwards and coughing. Leg (left) atrophied with violent pain. Staggers when walking. Pain from hips to feet,
worse coughing. Tensive pain in the knee.
Lungs - Pain at apex of heart or in rib region, worse touch. Dry, hacking cough, expelling an offensive breath
from lungs. Dyspnea. Explosive cough. Feels as if chest and head would fly to pieces. Ribs seem dislocated.
Pain in distant parts on coughing, bladder, legs, ears, etc. Wants to take deep breath, thinking that it would
relieve all her symptoms. Too weak to cough out expectoration. Asthma with redness of face, worse ascending.
Hoarsenessin singers and preachers. Threatening gangrene of lung.
Male - Coldness of the scrotum, with im- potency, with softening and dwindling. Atrophy, softening of testes
with loss of sensibility, spermatic cord shriveled. Prepuce swollen. Cramps in testes after emission. Trembling
of the whole body during amorous caresses. Gonorrhea with chordee, excessive burning, pain in prostate.
Modalities - Better from continued motion. Better heat. Better while eating. Worse from slight draft, even
warm. Worse cold air. Worse cold water. Worse uncovering. Worse dampness. Worse bathing. Worse touch.
Worse from empty swallowing. Worse drinking. After eating, the throat or excited urination is worse, in
alcoholics. Rest aggravates some forms of headache and improves others. Motion causes headache as if skull
would split, as if bruised,
 asthma, chilliness, stiff joints to crack. Ascending causes asthma.
Mouth - Stomatitis. Tongue greenish at base. Burning in tip of tongue. Vesicles or flat painful aphthae.
Gums, hot, spongy, retracted. Saliva increased. Taste, foul like putrid water, sour to food. Fetid odorfrom
mouth. Herpes of lips (apply one drop of the mother tincture.).
Nose - Red but cold, tip very hot. Nosebleed in the morning in bed.
Rectum - Dysentery. Mucus diarrhea. Bloody mucus with burning and tenesmus, drawing pain in back
after stool. Small, hot, burning stools. Thirsty after stool with shivering, worse drinking. Stinging pain during
stool. Burning, bleeding from hemorrhoids with soreness of anus.
Skin - Burning. Bloated, flabby.
Sleep - Sleeplessness from emotions, homesickness or cough. Sleepy after meals. Yawning by day. As if
falling from a height during sleep.
Stomach - Much flatulence, especially in debilitated subjects. Vomiting, sinking at pit of stomach. Water brash.
Acid dyspepsia, burning or trembling in stomach or icy coldness or as if cold water.
Temperature - Coldness with ill-humor. Chilly with the pains. Thirst before chill. Shivering after drinking.
Chill begins in back with violent thirst, but shivers from every drink with excruciating backache. Chill alternating
with heat, mounting to head, then sweat. Coldness of affected part. Sweats easily. Cold sweat on thighs.
Fevers afteremotions with homesickness. Must have something hot to back.
Throat - Burning, smarting in throat. Hot feeling in fauces. Constriction of throat with urging to swallow.
Inflamed uvula and palate, swollen, elongated and relaxed, feeling as if it were pressing on something hard.
Pain and dryness in throat extending to the ears. Sore throat of smokers and drinkers. Paralytic
dysphagia. Hot, pungent air comes up from the throat, tasting foul when coughing. Pains when coughing.
COMMENTS - A case of poisoning in a worker in a capsicum-plaster factory brought out a severe chill with
shaking and it ended in an intense coryza.
Mastoiditis. Glossitis. Cystitis. Dysentery (Canth.). Bloody mucus. Hemorrhage, helps stop blood flow. Ulcers
and burning. Herpes, where there is a smarting, burning sensation on the sores. Characteristic cough with
fetid breath or bad taste. Cough causing splitting pain in head. Chill at 10:30 a.m., beginning between shoulders
and running down back.
Homesickness (Calc-p., Ign., Nat-m.). Weight loss, insomnia, loss of appetite, depression. “Pining.” A lot of
sighing, respiration-
Clarke cured completely with a few doses of Caps., an Australian girl of florid complexion, who had come to
London to study and who was quite incapacitated by homesickness.
Delirium. Successful in delirium tremens, mostly in drachm doses of the tincture, given in milk or tincture of
orange peel. Equal parts of tincture of Caps, and glycerin make a liniment for external use in many cases of
chronic rheumatism and neuralgia.
Caps. 30c brought speedy relief in a case of tympanites following laparotomy, the concomitant symptoms
included cold nose and limbs and cyanosis.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Calad., Camph., Cina, Chin., Sul-ac. or vapor of burning sulphur. It antidotes:
Effects of Alcohol, Coffee, Opium or Quinine. Compare: (1) Am., Bell., Bry. - headache from cough, Canth. -
burning pains, throat symptoms, dysentery, urinary symptoms. (2) Psor. - lack of reaction, despair of recovery,
Caps, in persons of lax tissue. (3) Lach - thirst before chill, continues into chill, drinking Worse also Elaps. (4)
Nat-m., Carb-v. and Meny. (5) intermittents, Nat-m. is the “chronic" of Caps. (6) Carb-an. and Nit-ac. -
inflammation behind ears, Aur. and Nit-ac. preferable in abscess, Sil. in chronic suppuration. (7) Ph-ac. -
homesickness, Caps, has red face. (8) Ars., Alum., Carb-v., Lyc. have burning pains better by heat. (9) Merc.,
Nit-ac., Sulph. have passage of blood from bowels. (10) Crot-t. after drinking urging to
stool. (11) Hell. - colic with spasm of bladder. (12) Plat. - burning, pungent pain in face, worse slightest drought
of air, warm or cold. (13) Puls., Lyc., Bell. (14) Centaurea - surging of blood, homesickness intermittent fever.
Compatible: Bell., Lyc., Puls., Sil.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

name: Carbo Animalis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - carb-an. Carbo animalis. Animal charcoal. Made from charred ox-hide. Contains Calc-p.
Trituration. Historicaldose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne, rosacea. Aneurysm. As- phyxiation. Appetite, disordered. Belchings. Breast, cancer.
Breast-feeding. Bronchitis. Bubo. Cancer. Cataract Constipation. Coccyx, pain. Cough. Empyema. Face,
eruption. Gangrene. Glandular, indurations. Hemorrhoids. Headaches. Homesickness. Hookworm.
Hypertrophy. Legs, pain. Leucorrhea. Lumbago. Nose, disorders. Otorrhea. Pancreas, indurated. Perspiration,
 altered. Pleurisy. Pneumonia. Polyps. Scrofula. Strabismus. Syphilis. Tonguedisorders. Trachea, disorders.
Ulceration. Uterus, cancer. Vision, disorders.
HOMEOPATHIC - Carb-an., or animal charcoal, is made from charred ox hide, it contains Calc-p. in small
quantity. The Carbon group all have putriddischargesandexhalations. All act on the skin, causing interrigo and
excoriations and Carb-tcl. is said to cause fatty liver (Phos., Kreos., Chlf.).
Carb-an. is often indicated in the last stage of cancer, pneumonia, bronchitis, tuberculosis. Breast cancer
with burning, drawing pains through breast. Right chest is most affected. Uterine cancer, burning pains down
thigh. Tendency to malignancy.
Glands enlarge slowly and painfully, burning. Glandular enlargements with catarrhal states, flatulency and
asphyxiation. Painful swelling, lancinating, cutting and burning (Con., Merc-i-f.). Glands are indurated, veins
distended, skin blue. Glands are stony hard. Neglected buboes.
Marked tendency to induration of glands and tissues. Indurations after inflammations.
Ulceration and decomposition. Hemorrhages. Gangrene. Offensive secretions. Discharges are acrid and
foul. Slow, hard, painful processes. Sensations of looseness, crawling as of bugs.
Stitch remaining after pleurisy (Bry.). Venous stasis, blue skin. Local congestions without heat. Copper-
colored eruptions. Constitutional syphilis. Gummae.
Paralysis of muscles of feet and hands. Patients are susceptible to colds and easy sprains. Easily strained
from lifting. Hookworm disease (Thymol.).
Especially adapted to scrofulous and venous constitutions. Suited to weak, broken- down constitutions and to
the infirmities of old age or those prematurely aged. After debilitating disease with feeble circulation and
lowered vitality. Weakness of nursing women, they weep while eating, unable to walk even across the room.
MIND - Alternations of mood and overexcitability, alternating with fretful sadness. Sadness in morning.
Aversion to company. Desire to be alone, sad and reflective. Avoids conversation. Weeps during meals.
Whining.
Cheerfulness alternating with sadness. Homesickness, longing for the past. Homesickness in morning.
Forsaken feeling in morning. Anger about former vexations, about past events.
Easily frightened. Fear of the dark, worse on closing eyes. Anxiety at night with orgasm of blood.
Fearofsuffocation on closing eyes. Frightful images before sleep. Starting on falling asleep.
Stupefaction, with vertigo, has to close eyes, when rising after stool. Confusion better epistaxis. Confusion in
morning, did not know whether he had been asleep or awake. Difficulty in expressing ideas when writing.
Hastiness. Irritability in morning, with heavy and dull head.
Abdomen - Great distention after a operation. As of a hard body in groin (left) worse sitting, better pressure
and passing flatus. Feeling of coldness rising into the throat. Induration of pancreas. Neglected bubo.
Back - Coccyx feels bruised, burns when touched, worse sitting or lying. Coldness and aching in lumbar region
with cough.
Breasts - Weakness of nursing women. Darting in breast, painful indurations in breast, especially right, while
nursing, arresting breathing. Hard painful nodes in breast. Last stages of breast cancer.
Causations - Ill effects of eating spoiled fish or decayed vegetables. They are over affected by small vital
losses. Sprains.
Constitutions - Constitutional syphilis. Suited to old persons, greatly debilitated, especially when there is
venous plethora and blueness of skin. Persons whose vitality becomes low on account of some serious or
deep seated diseased condition or loss of fluids.
Ears - Parotid gland swollen. Otorrhea with swelling of mastoid. Sharp pain. Hearing confused, cannot tell
direction of sound. Ringing in ears, when blowing the nose.
Eyes - Pains down through (right) eyeball. Sensation as if something lay above eyes, so that she could not
look up. As if eyeball were loose in the socket. Objects seem to be far off. Dimness of vision when reading.
better rubbing eyes. Senile cataract.
Face - Bluish cheeks and lips. Copper colored eruptions. Acne, large number of pimples.
Female - Menses too early, frequent, long lasting, dark, clotted, putrid, followed by great exhaustion. So
weak can hardly speak (Cocc.). Flow only in the morning (Bor., Sep.). Leucorrhea, watery, burning, biting.
Worse walking or standing, stains linen yellow. Nausea of pregnancy, worse at night. Offensive lochia (Kreos.,
Rhus-t., Sec.), thin, long lasting, with numb limbs. Right ovary seems a heavy ball. Burning in vagina and labia.
Indurated os with burning. Uterine hemorrhage with disorders of glands. Cancer of uterus, burning pain down
thighs, pelvic bones pain on sitting.
Head - Rush of blood with confusion. Headache, As if skull had been split or blown to pieces, must press it
with both hands, better eating. Brain feels loose,
worse motion and coughing. Throbbing headache after menses. Sensation as if something lay above eyes so
 that she could not look up.
Heart - Palpitations when hearing singing in church or in public places. Coldness in precordial region with
goose bumps.
Limbs - Axillary glands, swollen, indurated. Night sweat fetid and profuse. Wrist pain. Hands numb with chest
disorders. Joints weak, easy dislocation. Ankles turn easily. Pain in hip joints at night. Pain in coccyx, burns
when touched. Straining and over-lifting produces a great debility Easy discoloration.
Lungs - Nervous dyspnea. Suffocation or closing eyes. Pleurisy, typhoid character with remaining stitch.
Ulceration of lung: with feeling of coldness in lungs. Cougl with discharge of greenish pus. Sputum dark, brown
tough, syrup-like.
Male - Syphilis. Bubo.
Modalities - Better in warm room. Bette from laying hand on affected part. Worsi from slight causes. Worse
losses of vita fluids. Worse after or during menses Worse from sprains. Worse lifting. Wors, touch. Worse
taking cold. Worse dry, coli air. Worse after shaving. Worse while eat ing. Cough is worse lying on right side
Throbbing headache worse in open ait Weakness worse during menses.
Mouth - Salty or sour water runs from th mouth. Knotty indurations in the tongue Bites cheeks while eating.
Teeth loose worse chewing and least cold. Toothach better eating salty things.
Nose - Hard, red, swollen, hot with itchin pimples and desquamation. Brown strip across the nose. Nose
swollen, tip bluisl small tumor on it. Fluent coryza with los of smell with yawning and sneezing.
Rectum - Anus sore. Moisture, oozing froi anus and on perineum.
Skin - Unsightly scars from eruption Spongy ulcers, copper-colored erut tion. Acne rosacea. Chilblains, worse
i evening in bed and from cold. Warts c hands and face of elderly people, wil bluish color of limbs. Burning,
rawne: and fissures, moisture. Bubo.
Carbo animalis
Sleep - Full of vivid fancies. Talks, groans, sheds tears in sleep. Talking and weeping in sleep.
Stomach - All food distresses the stomach. Repugnance to fat food. Eating tires patient. Weak, empty feeling
in stomach. Burning and griping. Weak digestion, flatulence. Heartburn. Retching, vomiting, hiccough with
stomach cancer. Sensation of coldness around the stomach better rubbing and pressure. Nausea from
smoking, whichcauses aversion to tobacco. Nausea, worse at night, of pregnancy. Faint gone feeling in
stomach not better by eating in nursing women. Ptomaine poisoning.
Temperature - Hot flushes. Sweat, foul, exhausting, at night, staining yellow.
Throat - Raw feeling like heartburn, better eating.
Vertigo - Vertigo after shaving, better reeling. Vertigo followed by nosebleed.
COMMENTS - Carb-an. is animal charcoal (Carb-v. is plant ash) and has similar affects as Bufo. Swollen
glands with suppuration. Glands become indurated, have bluish color. Often used in the last stages of cancer
with decomposition of tissue and sloughing off of tissue. Swollen inguinal glands that suppurate. Inflamed
axillary glands. Buboes.
Affections from loss of animal fluids, especially nursing women. Weakness of nursing women, can hardly walk
across the room. “Gone” feeling from loss of fluids. Too weak to eat. Weeps when eating.
Aversion to dark. Aversion to cold (Carb- v. to heat). Sensations of coldness, particularly in chest, about
stomach. Coldness of the stomach, better pressure from hand.
Nausea at night. Hunger in early morning. Emptiness, not better by eating (Carb-v. bettereating). Constipation
where patient thinks bowels will be moved but only wind passes.
Discharges are ichorous, but the discharge from hemorrhoids is odorless. Secretions stain yellow, particularly
sweat and leucorrhea.
Ichorous otorrhea and swelling of the periosteum over the mastoid bone. Hearing is confused, cannot tell the
direction from
which sounds come. Carb-an. 3x trituration has been used for ear polyps.
Hoarse, suffocating cough producing a shaking of the brain as if it were loose. Expectoration is greenish,
purulent offensive (Carb-v. yellow, more fetid). Tip of nose red or blue. Disagreeable smoothness of the teeth.
Smothering feeling on closing eyes. Feeling of looseness of eyes in sockets, on motion or coughing. Far-
sighted (Carb-v. is near-sighted). Objects seem farther apart and brighter.
Neuralgia of the bone. Injured coccyx, with a dragging, bruised pain, burning when touched. Gnawing pains in
tibia (during the night), such as usually followed cold feet. Lumbago when walking, standing and lying, feels
as if the back were broken.
A. W. K. Choudhury reports a case of cough of two years' duration in an unhealthy boy of twelve, cured by
Carb-an. The symptoms were: “Cough evening and morning or after lying down, especially at night, thick or
frothy whitish or yellowish sputa, sweetish when thick, worse lying on right side, worse from exposure to air to
 which he is very sensitive. Great tendency to catch cold.”
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Ars., Camph., Nux-v. Vinegar. Antidote to: Effects of Quinine. Compare: (1)
Thymol., Badiaga, Sep., Sulph., Plb. iod. (2) Calc-p. - nearest analog, Carb-an. contains Calc-p. (3) in
indurations, suppurations etc., Bad., Brom. (4) loss of fluids. Chin. (5 ) Graph., nostrils adhere to sepmm. (6)
Phos., gone feeling, loss of fluids induration of cervix, pressure on back, groins and thighs during menses. (6)
Cocc. has similar weakness and prostration as Carb-an. (7) Puls., Sil. (8) in vertigo with nosebleed. Sulph. (9)
aversion to darkness, Am-m., Bar-c. Calc., Stroph., Stram. (10) hunger in early morning, Ant-c„ Asar., Calc..
Sabad. (11) swelling behind ear, Caps., Aur. (12) burning pains, Caps. (13) weakness of nursing women, Olnd.
Complementary: Calc-p.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.
