name: Castor Equi
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cast-eq. Castor equi. Rudimentary thumbnail of the horse. Triturations are made from the scales
of rudimentary thumbnail of the horse. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Breasts, swollen. Coccyx, pain. Fainting. Epilepsy. Nails, disorders. Nipples, cracked. Nipples,
ulcerated. Psoriasis. Skin, disorders. Warts.
HOMEOPATHIC - This is a very ancient remedy and was proved and introduced into homeopathy by Hering.
The clinical experience of Hering and his fellow-provers has shown this to be highly useful remedy in cracked
and ulcerated nipples.
Cast-eq. especially acts on the nipples, the nails and bones, causing pains in right tibia and coccyx. General
action on thickening of the skin and epithelium.
Nails become brittle and fall off. Chapped hands.
Affects principally female organs, especially the nipples. Cracked and ulcerated nipples of nursing women,
excessively tender, cannot bear the touch of clothing. Warts on forehead, breasts. Psoriasis of the tongue.
Bones, especially tibia and coccyx are painful. Fainting. Epilepsy. Desire to smoke tobacco.
MIND - Unusual laughter about things not funny.
Abdomen - Colic with urging wakes him in the morning, followed by a very thin, watery, somewhat burning
stool, with passage of offensive flatus. Pain in left inguinal region.
Back - Weakness of spine. Pain in coccyx, worse every evening, while sitting.
Breasts - Breasts swollen, sensitive, worse descending stairs. Nipples almost hanging. Cracked, sore
nipples in nursing women, excessively tender, cannot bear touch of clothing, even in neglected cases,
ragged. Swelling of breasts. Violent itching in breasts. Reddened areola.
Chest - Burning pains on chest.
Ears - Sensation of dryness in left ear, compelling to scratch. Twitching, internally in left ear.
Eyes - Frequent twitching in right eyelid. Itching in canthi.
Face - Sensation as if trismus. Transitory, burning, prickling pain in face and also on body. Prickling and heat
on both cheeks. Dry lips with thirst in evening.
Food - Sense of hunger, even after eating, during coryza. Lack of appetite during headache. Desire to smoke
tobacco. Great accumulation of saliva, immediately after eating. Soon after pains in teeth, loud rumbling in
abdomen.
Head - Sensation as if occiput had gone to sleep. Scalp goes to sleep, numb. As if something crawling in hair.
Pressure in forehead. Pressive pain in temples. Deep pressure in occiput. Headache with vertigo and nausea,
sour stomach and lack of appetite.
Heart - Peculiar sensation about heart as of something alive struggling.
Limbs - Repeated pain in right tibia. Arms and legs sore as if beaten. Pain in left elbow and right knee. Right
wrist-joint as if sprained. Very brittle nails. Crumbling of fingernails from slightest knock against them.
Mouth - Burning, on front of tongue. Psoriasis of the tongue. Pain in hollow teeth of left side, must pick them.
Nose - Pressive pain in nasal bones. Coryza, fluent, with constant sensation of hunger, even after eating
Rectum - Urgent stool, preceded by colic and passage of flatus.
Skin - General action on thickening of the skin and epithelium. Warts. Psoriasis. Nails drop off. Brittle nails.
Sleep - Restless sleep with numbness of right arm. Sleepiness in early evening. Stretches arms up over head
and cracks fingers during sleep. Restless sleep, with many dreams. In winter dreams of fresh fruit hanging on
trees.
Stomach - Repeated empty eructations.
Throat - Disagreeable, sick feeling in larynx.
Vertigo - Vertigo, headache and nausea in mornings, sour stomach and lack of appetite.
COMMENTS - General action on thickening of the skin and epithelium. Principally affects the female organs.
Cracked and ulcerated nipples (Sars., Sil., Petr., Calen.), especially of nursing women. Nipples excessively
tender, cannot bear touch of clothing.
Chapped hands. Fainting. Epilepsy. Desire to smoke tobacco. Psoriasis of tongue. Warts on forehead and
breasts. Burnett cured with it a case of wart on forehead.
RELATIONS - Compare: (I) Calc-ox., Hipp., Cast., Mosch. Graph. (2) Hep. relieves the sore nipples. (3) Thuj.
has removed warts caused by Cast-eq.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak. Murphy.
 ***CASTOREUM CANADENSE
(Beaver Secretion)
PHARMACY - cast. Castoreum canadense. Beaver secretion. N. O. Rodentia. Tincture of secretion, found in
preputial sacs of beaver. Castoreum when fresh is yellow and of the consistence of syrup, when dry it is dark
red or brown and of the consistence of hard wax. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Chorea. Colic. Convulsions. Day-blindness. Digestion, disordered. Dysmenorrhea.
Eclampsia. Epilepsy. Flatulence. Hernia.Hysteria. Ileus. Menstrual colic. Paralysis. Pregnancy, vomiting.
Prostration. Reaction, deficient. Sexual, disorders. Sycosis. Tetanus. Typhoid. Typhus. Warts.
Yawning.
HOMEOPATHIC - Caspari proved Russian Cast., Nenning, that of Southern Europe. Teste remarked that
Cast, has been regarded as a resinous substance and he observed, moreover, that the beaver feeds almost
entirely on the resinous bark of pine trees. In Siberia, beavers feed on the bark of the birch, which may make
a difference in the effects of Cast, from different countries.
Cast, is a great remedy for hysteria. Weakness and lack of reaction. Marked prostration. Nervous
palpitations. Nervous women who do not recover fully, but are continually irritable and suffer from debilitating
sweats. Constant yawning. Restless sleep with frightful dreams and starts.
Day blindness, cannot endure the light. Spasmodic disorders after debilitating diseases. Creeping, tingling
sensation, worse sleep. Chorea. Epilepsy. Fibrillar twitch- ings. Heaviness of the whole body. Pains are
better by pressure, rubbing. Reflex uterine effects, are nervous and spasmodic. Menstrual colic with pallor
and cold sweat. Feeling of fullness in the stomach as if too much had been eaten.
MIND - Irritability. Easily sheds tears. Melancholic and full of anxious longings.
Abdomen - Colic or other abdominal complaints, accompanied with yawning. Colic with weakness, better
pressure.
Back - Pain as from excoriation, in the sacral region and back. Drawing pains in nape of the neck.
Chest - Stitches in chest, heat as if fire were burning in it.
Constitutions - Suited to nervous women with pains, cramps, and weakness after severe illness. Hysterical
individuals. Abdominal soreness. Nervous attacks when the aura starts from abdomen.
Ears - Acute dragging in the ears. Tinkling, buzzing, and gurgling in the ears, dispersed by boring the ear with
the finger.
Eyes - Day blindness. Cannot endure the light.
Female - Pain commences in middle of thighs. Violent, cutting dysmenorrheal colic with a few drops of blood,
then cold sweat. Amenorrhea with a painful
tympanites.
Food - Repugnance to food and constant nausea. Violent thirst, could not drink enough.
Kidneys - Frequent emission of urine, with burning thirst, day and night. After the emission of urine, desire to
vomit with disgust.
Limbs - Nocturnal dragging in shoulders and arms. Spasms of hands and feet. Hands hot with swelling of
veins. Weakness of the lower limbs.
Lungs - Breathing is short, difficult. Short breath when ascending. Slow, deep inspiration with short expiration.
Male - Seminal emissions with great excitability.
Modalities - Better from pressure. Worse from emotions. Worse cold. Worse during menses. Worse
debilitating diseases.
Mouth - Tongue, swollen, twitching. Round pea-like elevation in center of tongue with redness around. Tongue
sensitive to touch or food, with drawing pain towards hyoid bone.
Nose - Obstruction of the nose. Flow of aqueous, acrid, corrosive mucus from the nose.
Rectum - Summer diarrhea with green, mucus stools.
Sleep - Constant yawning as accompanied symptom. Yawns in sleep. Restless sleep with frightful dreams
and starts.
Stomach - Regurgitation of a bitter acidity. Vomiting of white, bitter mucus. Sensation of contraction and pain
of ulceration.
Teeth - Toothache when eating, provoked by cold and mitigated by hot things. Toothache with acute drawing
pains. Swelling of the gums at night, with acute pulling in the temples.
Temperature - Predominant chilliness. Chilliness with icy coldness in back. Exhausting sweats after fevers.
Throat - Hoarseness, with disposition to clear throat. Dryness of esophagus. Burning pain in the throat, as
from heartburn.
COMMENTS - Cast, resembles Ambr., Mosch., Ign. and Valer. Teste placed Cast, in the Thuj. group with Plat,
 and Bism. Teste concluded from analogy that Cast, would be an anti- sycotic, and he proved his point by
initiating with it the cure of a case of pedunculated vegetations around the anus in a hysterical young woman.
Thuj. completed the cure.
Teste quoted from Trousseau and Pi- deux the following indications, which he confirmed:
( 1 ) Amenorrhea, accompanied with painful and tympanitic swelling of the abdomen. We mean the cases
where only a few drops of blood escape from the uterus with a sort of uterine tenesmus.
(2)      The cases of colic to which Castoreum seems to be principally adapted are of the nervous kind, that
seem to be particularly seated in the small intestine. They are accompanied with paleness and cold sweats, a
sudden sinking of strength, as if the very principle of life had been struck down.
They are without any alvine evacuations, come suddenly after lively emotions, a cold on the bowels or by the
feet, as after long exposure to a cold rain.
Cast, causes jerking in small groups of muscular tissues, a sensation of heaviness of whole body, trembling
of limbs.
RELATIONS -Antidote: Colch. Compare: (Ï) Ambra, Mosch., Mur-ac., Valer.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Caulophyllum Thalictroides
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - caul. Caulophyllum thalic- troides. Blue cohosh. Squaw root. Leontice thalictroides. N. O.
Berberidacae. Tincture or trituration of mol. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - After-pains. Amenorrhea. Aphthae. Bearing-down, pains. Breast, pains. Chloasma. Cholera,
morbus. Chorea. Dysmenorrhea. False, labor. Feet, disorders. Gonorrhea. Hands, disorders. Infertility.
Labor, pains. Leucorrhea. Menopause. Menorrhagia. Menstruation, disorders. Miscarriages. Ovarian,
neuralgia. Paraplegia. Pityriasis. Pregnancy,
Caulophyllum thalictroides disorders. Premature, labor. Rheumatic, gout. Rheumatism. Thrush.
Trembling. Uterine, spasm. Uterine atony. Weakness.
HERBAL - Caul., the Blue Cohosh, is closely related in action to Cimic., the Black Cohosh, though they belong
to different families of plants.
HOMEOPATHIC - Caul, has only had one proving, by Dr. Burt, the majority of the indications were derived
from tradition and clinical experience.
Caul, acts most markedly on the female generative organs and on rheumatic states. Lack of tone of the
uterus. Left ovarian and left infra-breast pains. Leucorrhea in young girls or during pregnancy. Complaints due
to uterine disorders.
Bearing-down pains. Uterine spasms (Sep.). False labor pains. During labor, when the pains are deficient
and the patient is exhausted and fretful. Labor pains are weak or irregular, they cease from exhaustion or
they are too painful.
Internal trembling with weakness. Exhaustion and general debility. Reflex symptoms having a uterine origin,
like headaches, hoarseness, rheumatism, vomiting, cramps and spasms. Hysterical or epileptiform spasms at
puberty, during dysmenorrhea. Chorea at puberty.
A rheumatic remedy, especially acting on small joints. Erratic pains flying about from place to place, drawing,
cramping, shooting, rheumatic in character, ending in neck which gets stiff. Thrush, locally and internally.
Paraplegia from disorders of the uterus. Paraplegia after childbirth.
MIND - Nervous. Excitable. Fretful, irritable and apprehensive. Easily displeased.
Abdomen - Drawing pains in the right side over the liver. Severe colic. Pain in the umbilicus.
Back - Rheumatic stiffness of neck. Severe drawing in sternocleidomastoid, drawing head to left. Dull pains in
lumbar region.
Causations - Childbirth. Miscarriages. Constitutions - Rheumatic constitutions.
Eyes - Drawing pains over the left eye.
Eyes aching, with a feeling of something
under the lids. Profuse secretion of tears. Face - Moth spots on forehead, with leucor- rhea. Heavy upper lid,
has to raise them with fingers, with leucorrhea.
Female - Habitual or threaten miscarriage from uterine atony (Helon., Puls., Sep.). False labor pains.
Labor pains are weak or irregular, they cease from exhaustion or they are too painful. Revives labor pains
and furthers progress of labor. Spasmodic and severe pains, which fly in all directions, shivering without prog-
ress. Extraordinary rigidity of os (Bell., Gels., Verat-v.). After-pains. Profuse and prolonged lochia.
Menorrhagia after hasty labor, flow very profuse. Profuse menses, late. Violent, intermittent cramping pains
with little flow. Dysmenorrhea. Uterus retroverted. Irritable vagina, spasmodic intense pains. Leucorrhea with
 moth-spots on forehead. Profuse acrid leucorrhea, often in little girls. Needle-like pains in cervix. Placenta is
retained.
Head - Headaches from uterine or spinal troubles. Headaches over left eye, pressure behind eye, severe by
spells, worse stooping, from light, from noon until night.
Limbs -Rheumatism of small joints. Severe drawing, erratic pain and stiffness in small joints, fingers, toes,
ankles, etc. Aching in wrists. Sore nodes on finger joints. Cutting pain in fingers joints on closing hands. Erratic
pains, changing place every few minutes. Aching, sore lower limbs, before menses. Paraplegia after childbirth.
Lungs - Hoarseness and loss of voice. Panting breathing.
Male - Sharp, stinging pains in glans penis. Modalities - Worse from pregnancy. Worse suppressed menses.
Worse open air. Worse coffee.
Mouth - Aphthae. Thrush. Tongue coated white. Teeth feel sore and elongated.
Neck - Stiff, with head drawn to left. Nose - Drawing pains in the nose.
Rectum - Stool, soft white. Watery stools, great quantity.
Skin - Chloasma, on neck. Discoloration of skin in women with menstrual and uterine disorder. Hot and dry
skin.
Stomach - Cardialgía, spasms of the stomach. Dyspepsia with spasmodic symptoms. Frequent gulping of
sour, bitter fluid, with vertigo. Vomiting of uterine origin.
Temperature - As if too full of blood. High fever.
Throat - Pain in the fauces. Frequent inclination to swallow.
COMMENTS - Threatened miscarriage due to uterine atony, with a history of habitual abortion or miscarriage.
Weak, atonic uterus (Sep.). Inertia of the uterus. False conception or pregnancy. Sterility with a history of
uterine atony or a prolapsed or weak uterus.
Can be used for tendency to miscarriage, long ineffectual labor, weakness after childbirth, postpartum
depression, but not in general during pregnancy because it can stimulate labor.
Labor with a full feeling, bearing down with a rigid os, severe labor pains accompanied by severe exhaustion.
Exhausting labor, weak pains. Ineffectual labor (Puls.), false labor, premature labor. Rigid os, will not dilate
further during labor, with thirst (Gels, is not thirsty, Bell., Verat-v.).
1
  Lack of expulsive power where the placenta is retained, internal trembling. White, milk-like vaginal discharge
after childbirth that persists for weeks with exhaustion. Postpartum hemorrhage with passive oozing coupled
with exhaustion, venous hemorrhage.
Cervical erosion with a milky white discharge and chorine fatigue. Cervicitis (yellow-green discharge. Thuj.),
indurated cervix (Con.). Extreme fatigue and uterine weakness (Helon., keynote is they have a consciousness
of the womb). Antispasmodic.
Menstrual cramps with severe fatigue and exhaustion, labor-like pains. Drawing pain in the thigh, feels heavy
and tired. Vaginitis with bearing down pains in the uterus, acrid and burning leucorrhea. Exhausted with
vaginitis, thirsty. Menopause and hot flashes with weakness (Sep.).
Chorea at puberty. Problems at puberty, including weakness, menstrual cramps that come since first menses
(Puls.). Was given, with some success, for chloasma and pityriasis versicolor, curing dysmenorrhea at the
same time.
Great nervous excitement, tremulous weakness over whole body. Sleepless and restless, but exhausted. Can
scarcely speak. Sleepless, restless, nervous, recalling the effects of coffee, which is incompatible with it.
Generally chilly and wants warm clothing.
Arthritis in the smalljoints, fingers, wrists, toes and ankles, especially if since childbirth or menopause, or since
some problem with the uterus. Painful, swollen joints during pregnancy. Drawing pains in the joints with the
menstrual cramps, as though the tendons had contracted.
Rheumatic disorders of the small joints and muscles. Pains are intermittent and paroxysmal and fly about from
place to place, generally worse at night. Erratic, wandering pains from joint to joint, stiffness in the fingers.
Joints are swollen and painful. Stiff neck.
Nash regarded “internal trembling” as a strong characteristic when associated with the weakness, he cured
long-continued passive hemorrhage associated with these symptoms.
Nash prescribed Caul. 3c for a woman of forty, seven months pregnant, who was attacked with severe pain
and swelling of all the finger joints, wrapping them in mustard was the only thing that relieved her sufficiently
to allow her to get sleep.
Caul, relieved the finger pains, but caused such severe labor-like pains that it had to be discontinued for fear
of causing miscarriage. The bearing-down then ceased and the finger pains returned and continued until
delivery, when they ceased for a few days.
Then the lochia increased to a flooding, a passive, dark, liquid with great weakness and internal trembling.
 Now the terrible finger pains returned. Afraid to give Caul., other remedies were tried, but in vain. At last Nash
gave Caul. 200c, which rapidly cleared up the whole case.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Viol-o. - rheumatic carpal and metacarpal joints. (2) Cimic., Sep. (3) Gels, in
dysmenorrhea, it is like Gels, and follows it well. (4) Puls, in labor-pains, but the mental condition is opposite,
Cimic. (5) Bell, in intermittent and paroxysmal pains, Calc. - leucorrhea in little girls. (6) Lil-t., Lach., Sulph.,
Ust. and Vib-od. in left ovarian and infrabreast pains. (7) Mag-m. in uterine spasms, Bry. in rheumatism. (8)
Sec., Sep., Goss. Incompatible: Coffea.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.
keynote:
PHARMACY - caul. Caulophyllum thalic- troides. Blue cohosh. Squaw root. Leontice thalictroides. N. O.
Berberidacae. Tincture or trituration of mol. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - After-pains. Amenorrhea. Aphthae. Bearing-down, pains. Breast, pains. Chloasma. Cholera,
morbus. Chorea. Dysmenorrhea. False, labor. Feet, disorders. Gonorrhea. Hands, disorders. Infertility.
Labor, pains. Leucorrhea. Menopause. Menorrhagia. Menstruation, disorders. Miscarriages. Ov

name: Causticum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - caust. Causticum. Caustic potash. Causticum Hahnemanni. Hahnemann's tincture of acris sine
kali. Potassium hydrate. Obtained by distilling a mixture of slaked lime and a solution of potassium sulphate.
Tincture with spirit. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne rosacea. Amaurosis. Arthritis. Bell's palsy. Bedwetting. Bladder, disorders. Bronchitis.
Bums. Cataract. Chorea. Coccyx, pain. Constipation. Convulsions. Cough. Deafness. Dentition. Diphtheria.
Ears, otorrhea. Emaciation. Epilepsy. Eye, disorders. Facial, paralysis. Fistula. Goiter. Hemorrhoids.
Headaches. Heart, disorders. Heel, blistered. Herpes, zoster. Hip, disease. Impotence. Influenza. Intermittent,
fever. Intertrigo. Laryngitis. Lead, poisoning. Leucorrhea. Locomotor, ataxia. Meniere's, disease.
Menstruation, disorders. Muscle,pains. Nails, crippled. Neuralgias. Paralysis. Pemphigus. Pregnancy.
Prostatitis. Ptosis. Rheumatism. Scabies. Scrofula. Skin, eruptions. Smallpox. Stammering. Strokes.
Syphilis. Tendons, contracted. Throat disorders. Tongue, paralysis. Ulcers. Urethritis. Urine, disordered.
Varicose, veins. Voice, lost. Warts. Whooping cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - Caust. is one of the great polycrest medicines for chronic diseases. The chemical
composition is still uncertain though it is considered to be potassium hydrate or caustic potash.
Caust. acts upon the nerves, motor and sensory and on muscles voluntary and involuntary of bladder, larynx
and limbs.
Chronic rheumatic, arthritic and paralytic disorders. Characteristic burning, rawness and soreness. Indicated
in tearing, drawing pains in the muscular and fibrous tissues with deformities about the joints.
Chronic rheumatic disorders cause contraction of tendons and deformities about the joints. Stiff joints.
Restlessness at night with tearing pains in joints and bones and faint-like sinking of strength.
Progressive loss of muscular strength, tendinous contractures. Weakness, loss of muscular strength,
causing increasing uncertainty of control over the muscles, finally ending in paralysis of single organs or
parts. Local paralysis, vocal cords, muscles of swallowing of tongue, eyelids, face, bladder and limbs.
Paralysis from exposure to cold. Post-diphtheria paralysis. Paralysis from lead poisoning. Cold water tones
the paralysis.
Trembling. Convulsions. Chorea in nervous girls, worse during menses. Cramps here and there. Epilepsy,
runs in circle, then falls down, at puberty. Restlessness at night, especially the legs are constantly on the go.
Catarrhal disorders of the air passages. Seems to prefer dark-complexioned and rigid-fibered persons. The
skin is of a dirty white sallow with warts, especially on the face. Fissures from least provocation, about wings
of nose, lips, anus etc.
Emaciation, due to disease, fright, worry, grief and of long lasting illness. Children are slow in learning to talk
and walk. Awkward at talking, chewing, walking. Broken down seniles. Patient is susceptible to both cold and
heat.
MIND - Timid, nervous, anxious. Reticent. Anxiety of conscience as if she had committed a crime. Night
watching, nursing loved ones, keeping late hours and missing sleep from taking care of someone (Phos.
and Cocc.). Over sympathetic. Lacks control, balance.
Melancholy. Sadness. Taciturn and distrustful inclined to fits of anger with scolding. Hopeless, despondent,
wants to die. Whining mood. Looks on the dark side. Suspicious,
mistrustful. Weeps. Laughs before, with or after spasms. Convulsions from suppressed eruptions.
Grief, feels betrayed (Ign.). Bitter, emotionally caustic. Holds grudges. Weakness, ailments from long-lasting
grief, sudden emotions.
Foreboding. Fear of impending doom, that something bad is going to happen (Calc.). Full of fearful fancies,
worse at twilight. Sees fearful images when closing eyes. Fear of the dark and fear of being alone (Phos.).
Vexed with business worries.
Cannot tolerate to seeing injustice (Staph.). Affected by bad news, makes them angry and motivated.
Obsessive motivation for a cause, politics and injustice. Idealistic, more focused than Nat-m. Disappointed
 easily and argumentative (Ign.). Ambitionless.
Absent-minded. Memory fails. Confounds letters and syllables. Mental fatigue and paralysis. Mental exertion
causes symptoms, such as stitches in temples, tension in head and scalp, especially forehead to temples.
Thinking of complaints aggravates them, especially hemorrhoids.
Children are overly concerned about other people and oversensitive. Inquisitive and intelligent. Can get
frustrated and feel powerless. Child does not want to go to bed alone, least thing makes him cry.
Insanity with mental confusion. Very sensitive to light and noises, also better cold drinks (Phos.).
Abdomen - Enlarged abdomen in children.
Colic, spasmodic. Pain radiates to back and chest, better bending double, worse least food. Painful swelling
of the navel. Back - Back pain goes forwards or to the thighs. Pain in spine, worse swallowing. Stiffness
between shoulders. Pain in hips, worse coughing. Bruised, darting pains around coccyx. Cramps in lumbar
region and buttock. Dull pain in nape of neck. Stiffness of neck or back on rising from a chair, could scarcely
move the head. Torticollis.
Breasts - Disappearance of milk from fatigue, night-watching or anxiety. Nipples, sore, cracked, surrounded
with herpes.
Sticking pain below left breasts, dysmenorrhea. Violent itching about breasts in nursing women.
Causations - Ill effects of burns and scalds, fright, grief, worry, sorrow, night watching.
Chest - Chest tight sore, vest seems tight. Mucus under sternum, which he cannot reach. Pain in chest with
palpitations.
Constitutions - Anti-psoric, anti-sycotic and anti-syphilitic. It is one of Grauvogl's hydrogenoid remedies,
hence is a chilly medicine. Suited to dark-haired persons with rigid tissue, delicate skins. Adapted to broken
down, worn out senile persons. Lymphatic torpid temperament.
Ears - Ringing, roaring, pulsating, with deafness. Meniere's disease. Words and steps re-echo. Chronic
middle-ear catarrh and great accumulation of earwax. Thick gluey purulent discharge. Burning in ears, they
become red.
Eyes - Paralysis of ocular muscles after exposure to cold. Paralysis of one eyelid (right). Heavy drooping
eyelids. Ptosis (Gels.). Weakness of recti muscles. Diplopia, better looking to right. Continuous eye pain with
inclination to touch and rub the eyes, which seems to relieve the pressure in it. Profuse acrid tears. Vision
obscured as from gauze, on blowing nose. Sparks and dark spots before the eyes. Objects look large. Cataract
with motor disturbances. Rolling of eyes, epilepsy. Eyes remain open without winking, paralysis. Eyelids quiver.
Inflammation of eyelids, ulceration. Warts on eyebrows. Fissures in canthi.
Face - Face yellow, sickly looking. Feels furry. Eruptions. Warts. Cramps in lips. Pain in facial bones. Pain in
jaws with difficulty in opening mouth. Prosopalgia better cold water. Facial paralysis (right) worse opening
mouth. Dental fistula.
Female - Menses cease at night, flow only during day (Cycl., Puls.). Menses late and profuse. Anxiety, sadness
and weakness during menses. Dreams during menses. Dysmenorrhea with tearing pains in back and thighs.
Leucorrhea, smelling like menses. Leucorrhea. profuse, flow during
night with great weakness. Aversion to sex. Uterine inertia during labor. Smarting in the pudendum after
urination.
Food - Feels hunger, but appetite vanishes at the sight of food, or with thought or smell during pregnancy.
Aversion to sweets. Worse after eating fresh meat, smoked meat agrees.
Head - Painless commotion in the whole head. Pain in right frontal eminence. Sensation as of an empty space
between the forehead and brain, better hot application. To and fro or nodding motions or turning to right. Tight
scalp. Stitches in temples on mental exertion. Nausea and vomiting or blindness during headache, then
paralysis. Small, soft, round nodes on scalp or glabella.
Heart - Palpitation with pain in chest, burning and languor.
Kidneys - Paralysis of bladder from long retention of urine and consequent incontinence. Retention of urine
after labor after surgical operations. Involuntary passage of urine, on coughing, walking, blowing nose,
sneezing. Involuntary during first sleep at night, or from slightest excitement. Insensibility of urethra while
passing urine. Burning in urethra when urinating, worse after sex. Urine dribbles or passes slowly. Urine is
passed better sitting. Urine, black, cloudy, white. Itching of meatus.
Limbs - Twisting and jerking in limbs, chorea. Paralysis of single parts. Paralysis of deltoid, cannot raise
hand to head. Paralytic feeling in the right hand with paralysis of tongue. Heaviness and weakness. Dull,
tearing pain in hands and arms. Unsteadiness of muscles of forearm and hand. Numbness of hands. Trembling
of hands. Contracted tendons. Cracking and tension in knees, stiffness in hollow oiknee. Burning injoints.
Tearing joints. Arthritis deformans. Rheumatic tearing in limbs, better from the warmth, especially heat of bed.
 Disposition to stretch, bend or crack the joints. Cannot walk without suffering. Left-sided sciatica with numb-
ness. Unsteady walking and easily falling. Weak ankles. Restless legs at night. Pain
like electric shocks in legs. Itching on dorsum of feet. Cannot stand on heels. Cramps in calves, feet toes and
Achilles tendon. Writer's cramp. Whitlow of great toes. Slow learning to walk.
Lungs - Wandering chest pains, better pressure, worse sneezing. Oppressive breathing while talking and
walking. Tightness or scraping in chest. Cannot lie down at night. Purring in chest. Sore streak in larynx. Pain
in the larynx, worse blowing nose. Aphonia or hoarseness with pain in chest, worse morning, stooping, better
talking. Difficulty of voice of singers and public speakers (Royal). Short breath, before coughing. Cough,
hollow, hard, dry, incessant. Cough from tickling in throat pit of larynx. Cough at night, morning, worse stooping,
heat of bed, cold air, better sips of cold water. Cough during pregnancy. Cannot cough deep enough,
expectoration, slips back again, scanty, greasy, ropy like soapsuds, must be swallowed.
Male - Increase of smegma about the glans. Semen bloody during sex. Red spots on penis. Bruised soreness
in testes.
Modalities - Better from cold drinks (even chill). Better damp wet weather. Better washing. Better warmth
of bed. Better gentle motion. Worse in clear fine weather. Worse dry cold air. Worse winds, drafts. Worse
extremes of temperature. Worse change of weather. Worse 3 a.m. to 4 a.m. Worse evenings at 6 p.m. to 8
p.m. Worse twilight. Worse darkness. Worse exertion. Worse stooping. Worse motion of carriage. Worse taking
hold of anything. Worse bathing in the river in summer. Worse after stool. Worse from suppressed eruptions.
Worse coffee, fats, sour things.
Mouth - Bites inside of cheek fromchewing. Fatty taste. Recurrent abscess in gums, dental fistula. Teeth, feel
loose, elongated, ache, worse from cold or warmth. Swelling in side of cheek or induration. Swelling at root of
tongue. Paralysis of tongue with indistinct speech, words seem to jerk out. Tongue, red in middle, sides coated.
Painful vesicles on tip. Rheumatism of joint of lower jaw.
Nose - Coryza with hoarseness. Sneezing in the morning. Thick yellow or greenish- yellow discharge. Nostrils
ulcerated. Nosebleed during spasms. Pimples on tip of nose. Scaly nose. Old warts.
Rectum - Sore and burns. Small hard pustules around anus. Large hemorrhoids impeding the stools worse
walking, standing and when thinking of them. Fistula with pulsation and pain in perineum. Anus prolapses on
coughing. Itching in anus better cold water. Partial paralysis of rectum. Cramps in rectum on stooping, with
desire for urination. Rectum insensible to solid stool. Stools, hard tough, covered with mucous, shines like
grease, soft and small, size of goose quill (Phos.). Stool passes easily when standing. Constipation with
frequent ineffectual urging. Diarrhea from cold.
Skin - Old burns that do not get well. Ill effects from burns. Pain of burns. Cracks, ulcers. Soreness in folds of
skin, back of ears, between thighs. Skin prone to intertrigo during dentition. Warts, seedy, large, jagged,
bleeding easily, ulcerating, on fingertips, nose, lids, brows. Itching. Scars freshen up, old injuries reopen.
Sleep - Yawning, when listening or paying attention to others. Yawning and stretching. Very drowsy, can hardly
keep awake. Sleeplessness with dry heat. Frequent movements of arms and legs during sleep. Laughs and
cries during sleep. Wakes with slightest noise.
Stomach - Greasy, taste, belchings. Water brash, salty. Acid dyspepsia. Feels as if lime were burning in
stomach. Pain in stomach from ice water. Sensation of a ball rising in the throat. Sour vomiting followed by
sour belchings. Vomiting of blood at night. Fresh meat causes nausea, smoked meat agrees.
Temperature - Coldness, not better by warmth. Coldness, left sided of diseased part with pain. Flushes of
heat. Sweat about 4 a.m., profuse, on slight exertion, open air. Heat from 6 to 8 p.m.
Throat - Urging to swallow continuously as if the throat were too narrow. Swallows the wrong way or comes
through nose.
Difficulty in swallowing from paralysis of throat, unable to hawk out mucus, swallows it. Scraping, burning,
rawness in throat. Throat symptoms worse stooping.
Vertigo - Vertigo during sleep, at night in the morning, while lying down, on stooping, from looking up, during
menstruation.
COMMENTS - The weakening effect of potassium in allopathic overdosing is well known and was strongly
brought out in the Causticum provings.
Caust. is good for neurological problems with the neck, degeneration of the nerves, vertebrae, with brachial
neuralgia, stiffness, and muscle weakness in the neck. Bell's palsy. Facial paralysis. Parkinson's disease.
Weakness resulting from long standing grief or disease.
Paralytic weakness. Paralysis of single nerves or single parts. Paralysis of both the voluntary and involuntary
muscles. Ptosis, facial paralysis, paralysis of tongue of limbs of vocal cords of bladder of rectum, lead paralysis.
Facial paralysis from cold drought, neuralgia of right cheekbones to mastoid process, worse at night.
Convulsions, cramps, starting, restlessness, twitching. Contraction of flexor tendons. Trembling. Torticollis,
 spasm of the neck (Lachn.). Dupuytren’s contracture. Epilepsy, when fit occurs in sleep and urine escapes.
Chorea, the right side is more affected than left, words seem to be jerked out. Restless legs at night.
Arthritis with burning and stiffness. Jaw joints affected with rheumatism. Carpal tunnel syndrome. Rheumatism
tends to stiffen joints and contract limbs. Neuralgic and rheumatic affections, tearing, drawing pains. Tendons
can be indurated and thicken. Stiffness of the joints and neck (Rhus-t.) Keynote pains are raw, burning, sore,
and tender.
Headache that draws and tears through the body. Sensation as if there was an empty space between the bone
of the skull and the brain, better by warmth. Headache, cannot keep upper eyelids up. Ptosis of the eyelids.
Eyelids droop, weakness of the muscles (Gels., Sep.).
Vertigo, excitement of brain and spine incapable, tends to fall forward or sideways (locomotor ataxia) with
anxiety, weakness in head, sight as if through a fog, skin dry and hot, constipation.
Intermittent fevers, “sweat coming after the chill without intervening heat.” Marked periodicity. Periodic,
paroxysmal attacks, twice a day to every two, three or four weeks an attack, at new moon.
Sickly, sallow, low-spirited expression. Skin is dirty-white. Eruptions on scalp behind ears. Weakened and
emaciated appearance, especially about the face, the abdomen is large. Glandular indurations. Scrofulous
children. Scrofulous inflammations about eyes, ears and scalp.
Nails are crippled. Old, large inflamed and indurated warts, on hands, close to the fingernails, face, and
margins of eyelids. Burning itching on face, discharging acrid fluid which forms crusts. Burns due to caustic
chemicals, chemical burns (Canth., Urt-u.).
Eustachian tubes with tinnitus and reverberation. Sounds re-echo unpleasantly, an ordinary voice sounds loud.
Hoarseness with dry cough and redness of fauces, the result of weather or catching cold, worse in morning.
Dry, hollow cough with mucus on chest, patient cannot expectorate, must swallow the phlegm raised. Cannot
cough deep enough for relief. Accumulations of mucus in larynx and fauces, catarrh of throat.
Rawness and burning down throat and trachea. Laryngitis, hoarseness and speech problems, especially
stammering and stuttering in children (Nat-m.). Semi-paralysis of the tongue where the child stutters and
stammers and cannot talk right (Merc.). Aphonia, paralysis of vocal cords. Difficult swallowing of liquids.
Constant sensation as if lime was burning in stomach with water brash. Pressure and fullness in abdomen as
if it would burst, much worse by food. Griping, cutting, better by bending double, worse after least food or
tightening clothes, menstrual colic (Coloc.).
Spasm of rectum prevents walking. “Passes stool best standing.” Obstinate constipation (paralysis of rectum),
stools covered with shiny coating of mucus. Hemorrhoids, unbearable by walking, thinking of them, touch.
Well-marked aggravations of anal symptoms. Painful pustules near anus discharging pus, blood, serum.
Paralysis of bladder. Itching at orifice of urethra. Itching scrotum, cannot retain urine. Difficult, frequent
urination with spasm of bladder. Tendency for urine to escape during the day from any extra exertion, laughing,
walking. Bedwetting, especially during first sleep, worse winter, better in summer. Coughing expels urine.
Dribbling of the urine. Urine is irritating and burning (Canth.) Prostatitis and urethritis.
Blood with semen. Sexual appetite in women is abolished (Sep.). Constant indifference, except after the
period. Sadness during period. Menses too early, too abundant. After menses, a little blood passes oc-
casionally, smelling badly. Nursing women lose their milk after exertion or loss of sleep.
Slow learning to talk and walk and stumbling on attempting to walk.
Nash cured a severe case of prosopalgia with Caust. The patient was emaciated and debilitated by long
suffering, pains came in paroxysms and were of a drawing nature. She had suffered from eczema at times
before the neuralgia appeared. Sulph. had been given in vain. Caust. 200c rapidly cured.
Guernsey commended Caust. in the aftereffects of burns and scalds. Patients say, “I have never been well
since that burn.” Its caustic properties may be its “signature” here. Guernsey gave “sensation as if lime were
being slaked in the stomach.”
Macfarlan confirmed: “Sudden severe pains commence in the left hip joint, lasts a short time, feels as if it had
been injured, legs very sore or rather the lower limbs ache and feel tired.” “Forearms in front very sore to touch
and pressure, muscles of limbs sore generally.”
Kraft cured cases of incontinence following over-distention of the bladder owing to want of opportunity to attend
to the call to urinate at the time, such as occurs in shop
Causticum girls and schoolgirls, who cannot leave their tasks.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Asaf., Coff., Coloc., Dulc., Guai. - in rheumatic contractions, Nit-s-d., Nux-v.
Antidote to: Asaf., Chin., Coloc., Euphr., Plumb. (Lead poisoning), type-poisoning, abuse of Merc., and Sulph.
In scabies. Compare: ( 1) Rhus-t., Ars., Am-p. - facial paralysis. (2) Calc. - images on closing eyes. (3) Nat-
m. and Sep. - Spurting of urine with cough. (4) Rhus-t. - rheumatism from damp and cold, but with Rhus-t.
there is restlessness andbetterfrommotion. Caust. has restlessness at night only. (5) Eup-per. - hoarseness
 worse in morning, influenza with aching all over body, has more soreness on chest than, Caust. (6) Sal-ac.,
Chin., Carb-s. - Meniere's disease. (7) Staph., Coloc. - anger and colic. (8) Bar-c. - mental weakness, paralysis,
worse damp weather. (9) Sep. - Enuresis in first sleep, in deep sleep, Bell., Sulph. (10) Sars. - Urine, especially
in women, is passed without patient's knowledge. (11) Bell., Hyos., Ign., Lach., Lyc. and Phos. - difficult
swallowing of liquids. (12) Calc., Carb-an., Phos., Stroph. and Stram. - Fear of darkness. (13) Gels. - Ptosis,
paralysis, faint-like weakness and trembling, blindness. (14) Aeon. - paralysis from cold. (15) Kali-bi. -
blindness with headache, Kali- bi. has blindness better, as headache worse. Complementary: Carb-v., Staph.,
Coloc., Petros. Merc, assists the action of Caust. and vice versa in smallpox, (Teste).Incompatible: Acids,
Coff., Phos.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Ceanothus Americanus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cean. Ceanothus americanus. Red root. New Jersey Tea. N. O. Rhamnacae. Tincture of fresh
leaves. The fresh leaves are pounded to a pulp and macerated in two parts by weight of alcohol. Historical
dose: Tincture and all potencies. Locally as hair tonic.
CLINICAL - Anemia. Bronchitis. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Heart, disorders. Intermittent, fever. Jaundice.
Leucorrhea. Leukemia. Menses, suppressed. Metrorrhagia. Neuralgia. Side, pains. Spleen, disorders.
Splenitis.
HERBAL - This remedy has a special affinity to the spleen, which enlarges enormously.
HOMEOPATHIC - Enlargement of spleen and liver (Chin.). Deep-seated or cutting pains and fullness in
region of spleen. Painful inflammation, enlargement of spleen, either alone or with other disorders.
Low spirits with splenic affection. Headache on the right side with spleen pain. Pain in left hypochondrium with
dyspnea, diarrhea.
Ague cake of malaria. Marked blood pressure reducing powers. Active hemostatic, materially reducing the
time for blood clotting. Anemic patients where liver and spleen are at fault. Leukemia.
Periodical neuralgia. Chilliness, principally down back, shivering, rigors, must sit over fire, worse in cold
weather. Chronic bronchitis with profuse secretion. Weight loss. A left-sided remedy generally.
MIND - Apathy. Low-spirited, fears he will become unfit for work. Great nervous excitement with chilliness
and loss of appetite. Felt as if nerves were shaken, at dinner could scarcely hold knife and fork. Don't care
feeling all the time, cannot work.
Abdomen - Deep-seated pain in left hypochondrium. Unable to lie on left side. Pain in liver and back. Pain in
left side, with leucorrhea and chilliness. Sensitiveness in umbilical region with desire to relax abdominal
muscles. Whole abdomen moves with beat of heat. Bearing-down in abdomen, worse after eating.
Back - Carotids throbbing in neck. Pain under right scapula. Dull pain in lumbar region. Constant dull pain in
kidneys and up back. Chilliness down back. Weakness in small of back and legs.
Chest - Soreness behind the sternum. Constricted feeling in chest.
Constitutions - Sanguine constitutions.
Eyes - Eyes feel too large, lids swollen. Dry sensation of cornea, with a dull pain in orbital region.
Face - Cheeks and ears feel hot with cold fingers.
Female - Profuse, thick,yellow leucorrhea, with pain under left ribs. Weakening leucorrhea. Menses, ten days
too early and
very profuse. Menses every two weeks. Metrorrhagia with spleen pain.
Food - Loss of appetite. Craving for something sour. Cannot eat pastry. Thirst for water, but it made him sick.
Head - Headache, right side with pain in region of spleen. Head seems to move with every beat of the heart.
Head feels as if the brain were too large. Dull frontal headache, better lying down. Crackling sensation.
Heart - Palpitations and dyspnea with enlarged spleen. Pulse full and very strong, heart's pulsations visible
through the clothes. Heartbeat so hard it shook him all over. Chest feels too small for heart.
Kidneys - Sharp pain above pubes in region of bladder, before urination. Constant urging to urinate. Urine is
quite green, contains bile, strong odor, frothy. Urine is alkaline with increased phosphates, high specific gravity,
trace of sugar. After urinating, feeling as if all had not passed. Pain in back and irritation of urethra.
Limbs - Pains down forearms and fingers. Weakness of knees, must lie down. Dull pains in anterior part of
thighs.
Liver - Full feeling in region of liver. Pain in liver, worse lying on right side, beginning immediately after dinner.
Lungs - Congested feelings in lungs. Chest sore internally, worse deep inspiration. Violent dyspnea.
Male - Syphilitic complaints.
Modalities - Great weakness on walking or standing. Aversion to move, feels too weak. Worse from cold
 weather. Worse lying on left side. Worse motion.
Mouth - Aphthous disorders of mouth and fauces. Mouth dry. Tongue, white coat down center. Tongue looks
dirty. Food tasteless, unless highly seasoned.
Rectum - Continual bearing-down in rectum with constricting sensation, particularly with diarrhea. Dysentery.
Light brown stool with loud flatus.
Sleep - Awake all night. Sleeplessness. Dreamed of snakes, robbers.
Spleen - Chronic hypertrophy of spleen. Enormous enlargement of the spleen. Deep-seated or cutting
pains and full-
ness in region of spleen. Splenitis, pain all up the left side. Severe pain in region of spleen with low spirits.
Dull pain in region of spleen.
Stomach - Wanted to drink water, but it made him sick.
Temperature - Shivering, loss of appetite and nervous excitement. Rigors at frequent intervals. Intermittents
with splenic enlargements. Cheeks and ears hot with cold fingers. At 4 p.m., six chills in succession with
constant chilliness up and down back after chill very hot, fever, pulse 120, throbbing carotids.
Throat - Throat dry, raw sensation on swallowing.
Vertigo - Vertigo on turning in bed.
COMMENTS - Burnett, following Hale, is our chief authority for Cean. Great affinity for the spleen in tincture
or in potency. Good for trauma to the spleen, enlarged spleen, painful spleen in any blood disease or dying
patient. Stitching pains, sharp pains in the spleen. Large and painful spleen.
Diarrhea and dysentery (compare Cas-s. and other Rhamnee) have frequently been observed in patients
taking Cean. for spleen disorders. Leucorrhea, profuse, thick, yellow, with pain in left side.
Malaria, intermittent fevers and chills, and for severe cases where the spleen will swell. Peripheral edema with
swollen spleen. Leukemia with enlarged spleen. Blood diseases including anemia and platelet problems.
Pain generally on the left.
Cean. was proved by I. C. Fahnestock, but its place had already been made clear by clinical use and definite
clinical symptoms have been observed.
Fahnestock's two provers took repeated doses of the tincture and both had severe symptoms. One had malaria
five years before, treated with quinine. This prover suffered more acutely than the other and in the end had to
be treated. Nat-m. 30c soon put an end to his symptoms. The other prover had practically identical, but less
severe, symptoms.
Commonly used during the American Civil War. Dr. Hale, a homeopathic surgeon, gave Cean. in tincture and
potency for his
many cases of ruptured spleens from bayonet wounds and gunshots.
Dr. Hale said, “During the late Civil War I used this plant for splenitis, and was so well satisfied that I've been
using it for six years on every case. I do not remember using anything else for an enlarged spleen. I have used
it in the worst cases I ever saw from infancy to old age. I've yet to hear of its failure. However serious, it will
help the swollen, enlarged, infected spleen.”
P. C. Majumdar cured with Cean. 3x a case which had been diagnosed as heart disease, there were
palpitations and dyspnea on exertion. Majumdar found the spleen enormously large.
R. K. Ghosh cured many cases of suppression of menses and leucorrhea in patients from malarial districts.
Menses too profuse and too early with pain in left side. Cannot lie down for pain in left side.

pain in left side. (3) Case. - diarrhea, syphilis. (4)Tinosporacordifolia- a Hindu medicine for chronic cases of

name: Cedron
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY -cedr. Cedrón. Rattlesnake bean. Simaruba ferroginea. Simaba cedrón. N. O. Simarubacae.
Tincture of seeds. Tincture of pure bean scraped on wound. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

Glaucoma. Gout. Hydrophobia. Hysteria. Intermittent, fever.
Malaria. Neuralgias. Neuritis. Rheumatism. Snakebites. Stings. Toothaches.
 HERBAL - Cedr. is particularly useful in tropical or in damp, warm, marshy countries. Malarial disorders of
damp, warm, marshy countries. The seeds from Panama has accounts of antidoting snakebites when
chewed immediately after being bitten. It also heals snakebites and the stings of insects, with tincture of pure
bean being scraped on the wound.
HOMEOPATHIC - Petroz and Teste introduced Cedr. into homeopathic practice, because of its powers of
antidoting snakebites and also of its traditional reputation in intermittent fevers.
Clock-like periodicity is the most marked characteristic of this remedy. It has been found curative in malarial
affections, especially neuralgias. Neuralgias occurring at exact periodicity. Hysterical spasms regularly
night and morning. Chills in persons returned from tropical climates.
Mania. Complaints after sex, chorea ' in women, neuralgia in men. Trembling.
Numbness of the whole body. Convulsions during menses. Chorea after menses. Lec- tophobia. Bluish-red
face, forearm to elbow and hands and feet cold, sweat beneath axilla and on chest.
MIND - Nervous excitement, followed by depression. Restlessness, as driven from place to place. Lectophobia.
Body heavy, mind depressed. Mental symptoms are worse at night. Abdomen - Abdomen hard and distended.
Stitches in spleen and liver. Flatulence, colic and cramp. Borborygmi (left side).
Back - Stiff neck, pains all along spine. Pain in neck and loins on rising in morning. Pain under scapuli and in
pelvis.
Causations - Antidotes the effect of snakebites and stings of insects.
Chest - Oppression. Sharp, darting-cutting pains under floating ribs and scapula.
Constitutions - Adapted to persons of an excitable nervous temperament, especially to females.
Ears - Tinnitus. Hardness of hearing at night.
Eyes - Eyes red. Burn like fire. Shooting over left eye. Severe pain in eyeballs with radiating pains around the
eye, scalding lachrymation. Periodic supra-orbital neuralgia. Pain over the eye, worse sex. Iritis, choroiditis.
Objects appear red at night and yellow by day.
Face - Animated red face. Flying heat of face alternating with chills. Tumid face, pupils much dilated.
Prosopalgia (right). Wandering pains, spasmodic distortion of muscles. Lips cold, bluish, dry during menses.
Female - Many symptoms appear after sex and during the menses. Epilepsy during menses. Leucorrhea in
place of menses. Ptyalism and leucorrhea after menses. Genital excitement at daybreak with discharge like
leucorrhea and swollen breasts with pain. Puerperal eclampsia.
Food - Longing for cold drinks in some, for warm in others. Great thirst during menses. Loss of appetite.
Head - Orbital neuralgia. Roaring in ears produced by quinine. Stammers after sex. Crazy feeling from pain
across forehead, worse working on black. Pain from temple to temple across eyes. Whole body feels numb
during headache. Head feels as if swollen. Pain over whole right side of face, coming on about 9 a.m.
Heart - Palpitations and hurried breathing with headache. Irregular action. Pulse quick and full with animated,
red face. Pulse uncountable.
Kidneys - Pain in kidneys. Burning along ureter and in urethra. Feeling as if a drop of urine in urethra or a
constant dripping from it.
Limbs - Acute, sudden pain in ball of right thumb up arm to shoulder, same in right foot to knee, causing her
to drop to the floor. Dropsy of knee joint. Sharp pain in joints, worse feet and hands. Pain in ball of right foot,
extending to knee. Shingles with radiating pain.
Lungs - Difficult respiration with partial loss of voice, recurring at different intervals. Suffocative fits recurring
regularly every day 10 to 12 o'clock. Suffocating fits, worse after sex, sleep, better by eating.
Troublesome cough every morning at six, lasting two hours. Respiration much affected after sex. Breath cold.
Male - After sex, pain over left eye. Gonorrhea-like discharge, lasting three days. Gleet with formication over
whole body. Desire with firm erections, all night, on waking.
Modalities - Better from standing erect. Worse periodically. Worse at the same hour. Worse open air. Worse
before a storm. Worse lying down. Worse after sleep.
Mouth - Prickling itching of tongue. Painful pricking of tongue with sensation of heat. Feels paralyzed. Difficulty
of speech. Stammering after sex. Mouth and tongue dry, breath fetid during menses. Profuse ptyalism after
menses.
Nose - Point of nose cold with chilliness and yawning, 9 a.m. Profuse secretion. Glassy-looking mucus or thin,
clear, acrid.
Rectum - Involuntary stool during chorea attack. Ineffectual urging.
Sleep - Yawning and stretching. Drowsy, sometimes very profound sleep. Restless, frequent waking. Worse
after sleep. Dreamed of pleasant social interviews with female acquaintances. Dreamed of quarreling with a
dead sister and other dead friends, cried about it and awoke with sensation of a stone in the stomach.
Stomach - Nausea with distention of the stomach. Sensation as of a stone on stomach.
 Teeth - Toothache every night during menses with bleeding gums. Sudden toothache in left upper molars.
Sensation as if cold air touched the teeth on inspiration.
Temperature - Malaria. Quotidian or tertian fever with marked regularity. Regular paroxysms of fever,
coming at same hour, commencing every day 6 p.m. by chills in back and limbs or cold feet and hands.
Excitement before chill. Chill with congestion to head, hands, feet and nose remain icy cold. Shivering and
chill, followed by profuse perspiration every evening. During sweat, coldness and heat irregularly intermingle.
Hot stage, dryness, heaviness of head, redness
of face, burning heat in hands, pulse full and accelerated, thirst with desire for warm drinks.
Throat - Larynx constricted and tender. Intermittent laryngitis. Burning and constriction, difficult swallowing.
Prickling and tingling in throat and fauces, extending some way down esophagus. Pain on small spot next root
of tongue, as of a foreign body, worse from pressure.
COMMENTS - Characteristic clock-like periodicity in the recurrence of the symptoms. Rapidity of action (Bell.).
Fevers of low, marshy regions in warm seasons and tropical countries. Chills in persons returned from tropical
climates. Intermittent fever commencing the same hour every day or every other day. During the fever, there
is a red face in the hot stage, thirst with desire for warm drinks. Profuse perspiration. Excitement before chill.
General debility, languor and fainting. Malaise.
Predominance of nervous symptoms. Trembling. Accurately periodic neuralgias. Swollen sensations,
numbness of the whole body. Enlarged sensation. Sensation as if paralyzed. Strong sexual excitement.
Epileptiform convulsions during menses. Complaints after sex (chorea in women, neuralgia in men).
A large number of symptoms appear on left side, but right side of head, face, right elbow and right deltoid are
affected. Worse after sleep, lying down, night, open air, before a storm. Better standing erect. Objects appear
red at night, yellow by day.
Teste reported a case in which Hellert was bitten by a coral snake. “During the few seconds which it took him
to take the antidote out of the little bag which he wore suspended around his neck, he was seized with violent
pains at the heart and throat, but he had scarcely chewed and swallowed a small portion of Cedrón of the size
of a small bean, when the pain ceased as by magic. An oppression and general prostration remained.
“He chewed another portion of the same fruit and applied it to the wound externally and in another quarter of
an hour all he felt was a slight colic, which disappeared
Cedrón
after eating a little. This colic was followed immediately by a copious evacuation of a substance that looked
like curdled milk, white with a slightly yellowish tint.” Other cases were also reported.
Halbert related a case of malarial fever in a soldier. Chills and fever were clock-like in regularity of recurrence.
Liver and spleen were much enlarged.
Anemia was extreme and there was this additional peculiarity: intermittent stomach pain occurring with the
febrile crises.
In conjunction with these conditions there was a manifestation of chorea symptoms involving face and
shoulders mostly, the twitchings being troublesome in the inter febrile state. Often there were debilitating
hysterical spasms, the heart became irritable and sometimes irregular.
After other remedies had failed to make any impression, Cedr. cured in only three weeks, the improvement
setting in immediately.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Lach., Bell. Antidote to: Lach. Compare: (1) Ars., Aran., Bell., (2)Cedr.removes
roaringin ears of Chin. Bell, removes “Objects appear red at night, and yellowish by day” of Cedr., (3) Ars. and
Sabad. - complaints return same hour every day. (4) Aran. - ague when chills predominates.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Cement
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cem. Cement. Cement rock. The preparation for possible use is made by triturating a good
cement withsugarofmilkon the decimal scale. Historicaldose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Eczema. Cement maker's itch. Itching.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cement maker's itch is an occupational disease, entirely distinct from ordinary itch, being
neither parasitic nor contagious, but produced by the chemical or mechanical action of the cement upon the
skin.
Some physicians have attributed the corrosive action to calcium carbonate and to sulphuric acid. Fresh
cement, however, does not contain carbonate. It is questioned whether slaked lime or even partly slaked lime
will produce this effect. Masons working with lime mortar are seldom, if ever, attacked with cement maker's
itch. The quantity of sulphuric acid in cement is very small.
Cement maker's itch and ordinary itch have one symptom in common: intense itching, especially at night.
 The itching appears to be increased by the heat of the bed and also is more annoying in summer than in winter.
Scratching may produce infected wounds and swelling. It is likely to be followed by eczema and other
complications.
The managers of cement works should always require their workmen to wear cotton gloves and garments
tightly fastened at the neck and at the wrists. Cement workers on arches or ceilings should wear masks. Both
gloves and masks should frequently be washed.
REFERENCES - Anshutz.

PHARMACY - cench. Cenchris contortrix. Copperhead snake. American copperhead. Ancistrodon mokeson.
Ancistrodon contortrix. Agkistrodon piscivorus. N. O. Ophidians. Crotalida. North America. Solution of venom.
Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Amaurosis. Catarrh. Coma. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Eyes, swelling over. Headaches. Heart, disorders.
Lethargy. Leu- corrhea. Menorrhagia. Nightmare. Ovary, pain. Palpitations. Restlessness. Throat, disorders.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cenchris has the main features of all the serpent poisons. Cench. is a wonderful restorative
and deep acting remedy. Like Ars., it has a dyspnea, mental and physical restlessness, thirst for small
quantities of water. Needs clothing loose (Lach.).
Coma, semi-consciousness. Insensibility of cornea. Swelling of upper lip. General swelling, paralysis. Cold,
clammy sweat. Increased sexual desire in both sexes. Inef-
fectual attempts to recline. Right ovarian region painful.

wrong car without realizing where she was going. When riding in the car, rode past the place she intended to
get off at. Time passes too slowly. Lethargy.
Anxiety, feels she will die suddenly. Anxiety in evening in bed. Anxiety while lying. Presentiment of death. Fear
of apoplexy. Jealousy. Quarrelsome from jealousy.
Suspicious, thinks her husband is going to put her in an insane asylum, every day, 3 p.m. to 8 p.m., for ten
days, yet knew it was a delusion. Delusion of being in two places at the same time.
Abdomen - Intolerance of tight clothing.
Eyes - Swelling like bags over eyes and under brows. Redness of margins and twitching. Aching and itching
in eyes. Left eye waters from cough. Dim vision. Insensibility of cornea.
Face - Expression bloated, besotted. Face sallow. Burning face. Blue circles around eyes.
Female - Increased desire. Yellow leucor- rhea. Pain inright ovary. Herpetic eruption on labia. Menstrual flow
very profuse, light with dark clots.
Head - Aching pain in left frontal eminence and left side of teeth. Swelling around eyes, aching and itching in
eyes.
Heart - Feels as if heart were distended or swollen to fill the whole chest. Strongly conscious of heart.
Palpitations. Hard aching and sudden sharp stitching in heart. Throbbing or fluttering under left scapula. At 3
p.m., sensation of fluttering followed by feeling that heart fell down into abdomen. Then, pulse feeble with heat
lasting until after midnight.
Lungs - Hard, dry, tickling cough, worse 3 p.m., even causing escape of urine.
Male - Violent sexual desire.
Modalities - Worse on waking. Worse lying down. Worse pressure. Worse in the afternoon. Worse evening
and all night.
Nose - Catarrh, scabs, obstruction.
Sleep - Vivid, horrible and lascivious dreams, cannot be shaken off during waking hours.
Stomach - Nausea better by ice, worse by water, causes vomiting.
Stool - Diarrhea early in morning, on waking. Stool, gushing, frequent, watery, at first without pain, after several
hours, great pain before the motions.
Temperature - Chill or fever beginning in afternoon.
Throat - Accumulation of glossy, thick, tough mucus. Difficult empty swallowing, but easy swallowing of solids
and liquids. Warm drinks grateful.
COMMENTS - Marked alternation of moods. Dreamy absentmindedness. Swelling above eyes, below brow
like an over-hanging bag of water. Diarrhea with pain before stool, stool papescent, cold but not chilly. Yellow
leucorrhea. Pain in right ovary. Herpetic eruption on labia.
Hard, dry, tickling cough, worse 3 p.m. Restlessness and sense of suffocation, palpitation, sensation of dying.
Chokes, must lie with head drawn back. Tight clothing is unbearable.
 Chill or fever beginning in afternoon. Feeling as if whole body were enlarged to bursting, worse in region of
heart. “Awoke with throbbing in vulva and anus, followed by a dull aching in the sacral region, better by walking
about.”
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ars., Lach. (2) Clotho Arictans - Puff Adder - Should have a great sphere of
usefulness in many conditions where excessive swelling in leading feature.

PHARMACY - cent. Centaurea tagana. N. O. Compositae. Tincture of root. Historical dose: Tincture and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Coryza. Diarrhea. Eyes, inflammation. Fevers. Homesickness. Influenza. Intermittent, fever.
Vision, vanishing.
HERBAL - The Centaurea are allied to the thistles. Dr. Chagon, Duc de Sorentino, experimented with the root
of Cent.
HOMEOPATHIC - Marked symptoms of congestion. Blood surges painfully at every movement. The
symptoms are worse at night, in the morning on waking, by movement, during and after urinating. Better by
eating.
COMMENTS - Allen reported a case in which a bright servant-girl who took it seemed stupefied for several
days. The earliest symptoms appeared a quarter of an hour after taking the medicine, viz., those of the arms
together with dull pains in the hypogastrium, shiverings and general heat, especially on forehead, which was
covered with sweat.
These were followed by a stupefying pain in temples, frontal protuberances orbital arches and eyes. Next came
dimness of sight, appetite alternating with nausea, increase of salvia and vomiting, running of the nose,
lachrymation, belchings, rapid sinking of strength, general uneasiness, confusion of mind, weariness, dull
sunken eyes, spasmodic sweating, itching and pricking in the skin, drowsiness and thirst.
A state of reaction after four or six hours brought some quiet. Next day, in the forenoon or towards evening,
the above symptoms reappeared but with less violence and some of them assumed a periodic form.
Then ensued coryza, colic, diarrhea, fevers of various types, pains in the arms, dry cough, etc. The action
ended with the symptoms of catarrh of angina and of fever in the forenoon and with confusion and pain in the
forehead. This gives a general idea of the action of this remedy.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Bell., Cedr., Card-b., Card-m., Glon., Chin.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

In a mental illness, when excessive submissiveness and attempts to please others are part of the underlying

MIND - The mind is easily impressed with the needs and demands of others, to the point of wishing to do good
and be of service. The balance of perception is tilted in favor of others. Feelings of guilt and loyalty may further

Life may seem more drudgery than adventure. A mistake of the service-oriented person is to overlook growing
personal weakness and exhaustion. As needs of others seem predominant, one's own needs assume less
importance and one's health and strength may be undermined slowly. Serving others may be a refuge for
some, a binding up of one's identity with a positive attitude, a way to build self-esteem and find approval by
others.
Sadness due to unfulfilled potential or unanswered needs. Disappointment, resentment or frustration in the
 helpful person due to insensitivity and neglect.
Lacks the courage to make their needs known, or their ethical principles may prevent them from entertaining
resentful impulses. Can't assert their needs to others.

name: Cephalandra Indica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cephd. Cephalandra indica. Telakucha. Bimba. N. O. Cucurbitaceae. Historical dose: Tincture
and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Abscesses. Biliousness. Boils. Carbuncles. Cough. Diabetes. Dropsy. Dysentery. Fever. Glands,
enlarged. Glycosuria. Headache. Hemorrhage. Jaundice. Skin, diseases.
HERBAL - Telakucha is a perennial creeping herb with long tapering tuberous roots and deep green leaves.
It is found to grow abundantly in a wild state in Bengal and in other parts of India. It possesses a smooth green
fleshy fruit whose taste is very bitter.
When the fruit becomes ripe its color
becomes scarlet and its taste becomes sweet and it is sometimes eaten as a vegetable. It possesses the
reputation of being an excellent remedy in reducing the amount of sugar in the urine of patients suffering from
diabetes mellitus and mitigating their other sufferings.
According to Dhanvantariya Nirghanta, it is a good medicine for fever, dropsy, hemorrhage of the stomach.
Jaundice and flatulence. It suppresses urine.
According to Rajnirghanta, it is bitter, cures cough and vomiting, excellent remedy for blood poisoning, arrests
hemorrhage of the stomach.
The Ayurvedic physicians of India use the extracted juice of the leaves to allay the burning pains of poisonous
boils and carbuncles, and for general burning pains. It is also used by them in bloody dysentery and in
biliousness. They also use it in diabetes mellitus.
HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Sarat Chandra Ghose, introduced this remedy to homeopathy and he conducted the
first provings. He found Cephalandra indica an effective remedy for diabetes mellitus and insipidus.
Over-sensitivity to noise and external impressions. Biliousness, bilious complaints. Septic boils, abscesses,
and carbuncles. Burning pains all over the body, better cold applications. Profuse urination.
Giddiness. Dysentery with white and bloody stools. Headache from excessive exposure under sun’s rays.
Chronic fever associated with burning of eyes, face and other parts of body. Dropsy, jaundice, flatulence.
Hemorrhage from the stomach. Blood poisoning.
MIND - Moroseness. Fretfulness. Disinclination to do any work. Gloomy disposition. Could not remember all
events, memory partially gone.
Abdomen - Full of flatuence. Abdomen distended.
Eyes - Burning of eyes.
Face - Redness of face with burning.
Food - Loss of appetite.
Head - Headache from excessive exposure under sun’s rays.
Kidneys - Passage of copious quantity of urine at a time, clear urine, exhaustion and weakness after urination.
 Glycosuria. Presence of sugar in urine.
Modalites - Better by cold or cold applications. Worse after urination.
Mouth - Excessive dryness of mouth with great thirst for large quantities of water at a time, worse after
urination. Lips dry and parched.
Rectum - Greenish, mucus stools mixed or tinged with blood. Pain before and during stool. White and bloody
stools.
Sensations - Burning sensation exists all over the body, ameliorated by anything cold or cold applications.
Skin - Sickly, yellow skin was marked.
Throat - Dryness of throat.
Vertigo - Giddiness, worse after urination. COMMENTS - Dr. Ghose reports the following case: Babu Satish
Roy fell a victim of diabetes mellitus and suffered from this disease for two years.
November 12,1928. Ghose was called in to see the patient this day in the morning. The following symptoms
were present: Gloomy, morose and fretful. Lost weight steadily.
Passed large quantities of urine every now and then which exhausted him greatly. Urine was examined and
the tests show that there was sugar in the urine, quantity being 20 grains per ounce. Great thirst was present.
Burning sensation was present all over the body. Dryness of mouth and throat was present. Ghose prescribed
Cephalandra indica lx to be taken thrice daily.
Now 18, 1928. He saw the patient again this morning, and heard from him that he was faring much better than
before. Passed urine not so often as before, burning sensation and thirst were considerably less than before;
cheerfulness returned and he was feeling stronger than before.
Prescribed the same medicine in the same potency twice daily. Asked him to get his urine examined again.
Nov. 28,1928. Ghose saw him this morning, The urine examination report indicated that sugar had lessened,
quantity being 4
grains per ounce. Burning sensation and thirst practically disappeared. The same prescription was repeated.
Dec. 10,1928. The report of urine examination indicated that there was no sugar in the urine. In other respects
the patient was all right. Ghose advised him to take occasional doses of Cephalandra indica in 3x potency.
The patient made an eventful recovery and no sugar could be found in his urine later on.
RELATIONS - Compare: Uran-n., Phos.
REFERENCES - Ghose.

name: Cerato
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cer-b. Cerato. Ceratostigma willomottiana. Fresh flowers are put in a bowl of water and allowed
to sit in the sun for several hours. The water imbued with healing power is used as medicine. Historical dose:
Take two drops from the stock bottle into a one ounce dropper bottle, (add brandy or alcohol, if this bottle will
be used for days or weeks). This is the dosage bottle, take a few drops straight into the mouth or as needed
in a little water or juice.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cerato belongs to Bach's group of for those who suffer Uncertainty, along with Scler-
b., Gent-b„ Gors-b., Horn-b. and Wld-o-b. Lack of assertiveness may exist, the person is rather retreating and
allows others to lead. In regard to uncertain, unsteady gait or posture, especially if caused by reluctance and
inhibition, Cer-b. will give physical assurance. In diseases of the immune system, when it does not know how
to achieve health, Cer-b. may aid in reviving inner strength and help the organism decide on a strategy of
defense.
Internal agony, preoccupation with oneself, hampering self-observation and shyness are common (Mimul-b.,
Lar-b.). Speech problems arising from inner uncertainty. Useful during language development when inner
certainty needs to be improved.
Further, it could assist in developmental disorders by helping the mind gain in certainty and enhancing learning
potential (Ch-bd-b.). In other distortions of expres-
sion of personality, fixed ideas and irrational anxieties, inappropriate laughing and immature behavior.
In mental illness, this remedy can be of service in gender identity disorders, anxiety disorders, delusions,
elimination disorders and sexual disorders (Cher-p-b. for the last two), or whenever there is an underlying
uncertainty of consciousness expression.
MIND - Lack of self-esteem and easily stimulated feelings of inferiority. One is impressed by others' decisive
demeanor, wants to measure up, wishes for recognition and approval by others. Continued doubting,
uncertainty and lack of decisiveness and self-assurance.
Relies heavily on the advice of others, often admiring their decisive move through life and feeling less adequate
themselves. Overly impressed with outward shows and trends, people in charge of themselves and the
 situation, while they feel hampered within, often blaming themselves for this uncomfortable state.
Mistrust in one's capacity to judge correctly and make the appropriate decision. Dependent personality
disorder, addresses the excessive dependence on the approval and advice of others (Cent-b.).
Anxiety disorders. Delusions. For those lost in their own reality.
REFERENCES Bach.

name: Cereus Bonplandii
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cere-b. Cereus bonplandii. A variety of Cactus grandifloras. N. O. Cacta- ceae. Tincture of
stems. The fresh green stems are pounded to a pulp and macerated in two parts by weight of alcohol.
Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Eczema. Emaciation. Eyes, neuralgia. Heart, disorders. Insanity. Kidney, disorders. Neuralgia.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cereus bonplandii is a variety of Cactus grandifloras. The principal symptoms of Cere-b.
are in connection with the heart (Cact.).
Cere-b. was proved by John H. Fitch in substantial doses. The prover lost 7.5 pounds in weight. He felt weighed
down by an
incubus. When mental symptoms subsided, bodily symptoms increased and vice versa. Could not bear contact
of clothes, felt better on undressing.
Fitch who regarded Cere-b. as an “anti- psoric of remarkable powér” cured with it a case of eczema of both
hands extending up to elbows. Deposits in urine. Dropsy of cardiac and kidney origin. Left intercostal neuralgia.
Anterior crural neuralgia.
Fitch cured two cases of insanity, one in a young woman, gloomy, restless inclined to curse, swear and throw
things at persons, if resisted. The other case was in a married women who had spiritual delusions that she had
committed the unpardonable sin, etc. This came on originally after confinement.
Marked symptoms included a desire to be at work, doing something useful. Pains through globe of eyes and
orbit. Pain through heart in left great pectoral muscle, left side of chest. Expanding sensation in chest followed
by sudden collapse. The effect on the nervous system passed off in four or five days.
Pains have a tendency to spread to other parts. Most appear on left side. “Itching in right popliteal space”
lasted eight or nine years after the proving. “Itching with roughness of the skin like eczema above left knee
anteriorly.” “Itching with eruption like herpes below left scapula remained permanent.”
MIND - Gloomy and restless. Great desire to work and to be doing something useful. Inclination to curse and
swear (Anae., Nit- ac.). Inclination to throw things (Staph.) at persons if resisted. Loathing of life before menses.
Delusion is under a powerful influence. Mistakes in time. Praying.
Chest - Pain in chest through heart with pain running toward spleen. Pain in left pectoral muscle and cartilages
of left lower ribs. Difficult, sighing respiration, as from some compression of chest.
Head - Occipital headache and pain through the globe of the eyes and orbits (Cedr., Onos.). Pain across the
brain from left to right. Pain along right malar bone running to temple.
Heart - Convulsive pains at the heart, feels as if transfixed. Hypertrophy of heart. Sensation of a great weight
on heart and pricking pain.
Limbs - Pain in neck, back, shoulders, down arms, hands and fingers. Pain in knees and joints of lower limbs.
Modalities - Better undressing. Worse at night. Worse from pressure of clothing.
Skin - Itching of skin (Dolich., Sulph.).
COMMENTS - Symptoms from the proving including a miserable feeling on retiring. Throws himself on bed
without undressing. Great yawning fit. Feels not pleasant. Feels half sick. Very dull in the morning. Feels very
badly, has an ill-defined bad feeling in the evening and at night. Easily chilled in a room, better on disrobing
for bed.
Alternations of symptoms of mind and bodily pains. When pains of the body are noticed, symptoms affecting
the mind are suspended. The most prominent symptoms are the catarrhal and gastric ones, while those
affecting the chest, heart, eyes, brain and nerves are more slowly developed and are the ones that persist.
Remarkable anti-psoric. Some skin symptoms developed by it persisted off and on for year. Itching of the right
popliteal space. Itching with roughness of the skin like eczema, above the left knee anteriorly. Itching with an
eruption resembling herpes zoster below the left scapula. Sleeplessness.
The provings point in the direction of kidney troubles and deposits in the urine. Dropsy of heart and kidney
origin. Intercostal neuralgia, worse on left side. Anterior crural neuralgia. Rheumatism. Eczema of both hands,
extending to elbows. Albuminuria with great edema.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cact., Spig., Kalm. (2) Cere-s. - very irritable with tendency to swear, wild anger
and low morals. Disturbance in speech in writing leaves off the last syllable. Paralyzed feeling. Pains in heart
and dwindling of sexual organs. Emissions, followed by pain in testicles.
 REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke

Disturbance in speech, leaves off the last syllable. Mistakes in writing.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cact., Cere-b., Con. (2) Psor. - sensitiveness to cold. (3) Anae. - inclined to
swear.

name: Cerium Oxalicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cer-ox. Cerium oxalicum. Cerium oxalate. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Cough, reflex, Dysmenorrhea. Morning, sickness. Seasickness. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Originally introduced by Sir James Simpson as a remedy for the morning sickness of
pregnancy and chronic cases of vomiting, which he supposed to be due to some eruption on the mucus
membrane of the stomach, Cer-ox., has fairly maintained its reputation.
Hale found it of most use in cases of vomiting of half-digested food. It was mostly been given in lower
triturations by homeopaths and in five to ten grain doses by allopaths. In the latter doses, it has produced
decidedly narcotic effect in two cases.
Spasmodic coughs of nervous or reflex origin. Whooping cough with vomiting and
hemorrhage. Spasmodic reflex vomiting. Seasickness. Morning sickness. Vomiting of pregnancy and of
half-digested food. Dysmenorrhea in fleshy and robust women, scanty flow, pain coming before or at com-
mencement with feeling of tenesmus, better when the flow is established (Lach.).
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Ingluvin - made from gizzard of afowl. V omiting of pregnancy, gastric
neurasthenia. Infantile vomiting and diarrhea. 3 x trituration. (2) Amyg., Lac-ac., Ip.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Sleep - Drowsiness and yawning.

name: Cetraria Islandica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-cetr. Cetraria islándica. Iceland moss. Lichen islandicus. N. O. Lichenes. Iceland. Decoction and
tincture. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Atrophy. Catarrh. Diarrhea. Emaciation. Lungs, weak. Scrofulous. Scurvy. Tuberculosis. Ulcers.
Weakness.
HERBAL - The well-known Iceland Moss, growing in large quantities in Alaska, recommended to the Old
School since 1674 by Olaf Borrichins, Hiaren and others. Cetr. has been used in decoction and as a food and
has been found curative empirically. It is used as a decoction and boiled with milk as an expectorant and
nutrient in bronchorrhea, catarrh, etc.
HOMEOPATHIC - Indications include a bitter, slimy taste, full and satisfied feeling after eating a little, and
habitual vomiting. Weak lungs. Frequent catarrhs. Tickling and spasmodic feeling in windpipe on waking.
Copious expectoration. Fetid taste and smell causing nausea.
All kinds of bloody expectoration. Emaciated people. Chronic diarrhea with bloody expectoration. Chronic
diarrhea of tuberculosis patients. Scrofulous emaciation. Atrophy, depending on suppurative processes.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Stict., lod.
REFERENCES - Boericke.
