name: Cimicifuga Racemosa
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cimic. Cimicifuga racemosa. Black cohosh. Actea racemosa. Macrotys racemosa. Actea
monogynia. Cimicifuga serpentaria. Black snakeroot. Botroflus serpentaria. N. O. Ranunculacee. North
America. Tincture of the root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Abortion, tendency. Angina, pectoris. Appetite, disordered. Back, pains. Breast, disorders.
Cerebrospinal, meningitis. Chest, pains. Chorea. Colic. Cramps. Delirium, tremens. Diaphragm. Dyspepsia.
Epilepsy. Faintness. Fevers. Gout. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hot, flashes. Hysteria. Labor, pains.
Lumbago. Melancholy. Meningitis. Menopause. Menstruation, disorders. Miscarriage. Muscle, pain.
Neuralgia. Ovaries, disorders.
Perichondritis. Pleurodynia. Pregnancy, disorders. Puerperal, fever. Puerperal, mania. Rheumatism.
Sciatica, pains. Sleeplessness. Spinal irritation. Stiff-neck. Tinnitus. Tremors. Uterus, disorders. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Wide action upon the cerebrospinal and muscular system, as well as upon the uterus and
ovaries. The generative organs in the female are particularly affected. Uterine and ovarian pains are very
marked. Infra-breast pains. Tenderness of the uterine region. Pain across pelvis from hip to hip. Left ovarian
pains.
Leucorrhea with feeling of weight in uterus. Painful and irregular menses. Menses with backache,
nervousness, irregular in time and amount, more flow, more pain. Labor-like pains. Displaced labor pains to
hips, thighs or back.
Pains are violent, aching, shooting, wander here and there. Compressive pains. Pains like electric shocks,
with cries, faints etc.
Pains go upwards or side to side, up the neck, about the throat from ovary to ovary. Belly of the muscles feel
 bruised, sore, heavy aching. Muscular andcrampypains, primarily of neurotic origin, occurring in nearly every
part of the body. Sore and tender along the tract of pain.
Trembling, twitching in various organs or of part lain on. Alternating clonic and tonic spasms. Nervous
shuddering. Spasms of cerebro-spinal fever. Chorea, at puberty with delayed menses, cardiac. Hysterical and
epileptic convulsions at the time of menses.
Agitation. General sick feeling with exhaustion. Many of the symptoms are irregular, changeful or they alternate
in groups, alternation of physical and mental effects. Alternate mental and rheumatic symptoms. Symptoms
referable to the pelvic organs prominent.
Lumbago. Muscle pain. Useful in rheumatic, nervous subjects with ovarian irritation, uterine cramps and heavy
limbs. Children during dentition. Influenza. Cold air seems to penetrate the system, very sensitive to it.
Headache is better in open air, worse in warm room. Migraine.
MIND - Melanchol y. Depression with low spirits and exhaustion. Gloom and dejection, as if there was a
black cloud over everything. Forebodings of death, insanity, impending evil etc. Fear of death. Fear of riding
in a closed carriage. Fear that those in house will kill him. Fear of rats. Thinks she is going crazy. Vision of
rats, mice, various colors and forms.
Nervous, fidgety, excitable and jerky. Incessant talking, changing from one subject to another, as in delirium
tremens (Lach.). Desire to wander from place to place. Hysteria. Mania, before menses. Mania, alcoholic, tries
to injure himself. Puerperal mania, following disappearance of neuralgias.
Weak will. Indifferent. Suspicious. Oversensitive, especially for pain. Hypochondriasis. Sits and mopes in
great sadness, when questioned breaks into tears. Mental symptoms are better by diarrhea or menses, worse
after rheumatism.
Abdomen - Colic better bending double and after stools. Sharp pains across hy- pogastrium.
Back - Rheumatic pains in muscles of back and neck. Stiffness and contraction in neckandback. Stiff neck,
sensitive, worse pain or pressure, causes nausea and retching. Neck aches, throws the head back. Pain in
the angle of left scapula. Spine very sensitive, especially upper part. Pain in lumbar and sacral region, down
thighs and through hips. Crick in back.
Breasts - Burning in breasts. Infra-breast pains, worse left side. Presses breasts as though in pain.
Causations - Ill effects of anxiety, fright, disappointed love, overexertion, business failures, or childbirth.
Chest - Intercostal rheumatism. Sharp stitches in left chest, motion exhorting cries. Left-sided infra-breast
pain. Pleurodynia.
Constitutions - Suited to the menopausal period, to nervous persons, to children during dentition, diarrhea.
Nervousness from anxiety or overexertion. Rheumatic persons. Plump, delicate, sensitive, nervous, chilly
women who coinplain of aching pain in back, neck, here and there.
Many of the complaints are dependent upon uterine or ovarian irritation.
Ears - Tinnitus. Sensitive to least noise with spasmodic labor pains. Violent noises in ear with deafness.
Eyes - Eyes feel big, wild look. Asthenopia associated with pelvic trouble. Deep- seated throbbing and
shooting pains in eyes. Intense aching in eyeballs or behind them, better pressure, worse slightest motion.
Pain from eyes to vertex. Ciliary neuralgia. As if a needle were run into the eyeballs, worse closing eyes.
Photophobia from artificial light. Sees red flashes with dark borders.
Face - Pale, hot. Wild, fearful expression. Neuralgia affecting malar bones, better night, reappears the next
day. Facial blemishes in young women. Forehead feels cold.
Female - Menses are profuse, dark, coagulated, scanty with backache, nervousness, irregular in time and
amount, more flow, more pain. Menses suppressed from emotions, cold. Hysteric or epileptic spasms at the
time of menses. Great debility between menses. Amenorrhea. Leucorrhea with a sensation of weight in the
uterus. Pain across pelvis from hip to hip. Ovarian neuralgia, pain across pelvis from ovary to ovary or goes
upwards or downwards along the thighs. Uterine atony. Mania. Slow labor pains with nervous shivers.
Puerperal fever. After-pains with great sensitiveness and intolerance to pain. worse in groins. Lochia
suppressed by cold or emotions.
Food - No thirst, slight feeling of hunger in stomach, rumbling in abdomen. Great thirst. Appetite variable. No
appetite for dinner, wants to drink cold water, little at a time suffices.
Head - Waving or wild sensation in brain. Head retracted (meningitis). Opening and shutting sensation in
brain. Brain feels too large. Shooting, throbbing pains, headache after mental worry, over-study or from reflex
uterine disease, better open air. Pressing outward pain. Feeling as of a blow or as if a bolt has been driven
from occiput to vertex up to the eyes (left).
Heart - Heart's action ceases suddenly, impending suffocation. Sore, as if swollen or enlarged. Pulse weak,
irregular, trembling, drops every third or fourth beat. Tremulous action. Numbness of left arm. feels as if bound
to side. Needle-like pains at heart. Angina pectoris, pain spreads all over the chest to the back and down the
 left arm which feels numb and as if bound to the side. Cardiac neuralgia in childbirth.
Kidneys - Profuse clear urine, causing weakness, with yellow sand. Nervous urination.
Limbs - Alternation of rheumatic and mental symptoms. Uneasy and restless feeling in the limbs. Chorea
movements, accompanied by rheumatism. Rheumatism affecting the belly of muscles, especially large
muscles. Aching in limbs and muscular soreness. Jerking of limbs. Numbness of limbs. Cramps. Left arm
feels as if bound to the side, constant irregular motion of left arm (chorea). Hands tremble while writing. Cold
sweat on hands and feet. Soles itching. Cramps in calves. Stiffness and contracted Achilles tendon. Trembling
of legs, can scarcely walk.
Lungs - Tickling, short, dry, constant cough worse at night, speaking. Cough when secretion is scanty-
spasmodic, dry, with muscular soreness and nervous irritation. Nervous cough.
Modalities-Better from warm wraps. Better open air. Better continued motion. Better pressure. Better grasping
things. Better rest, and eating. Worse from damp, cold air. Worse change of weather. Worse heat and cold,
draft. Worse alcohol, especially wine. Worse from motion. Worse sitting. Worse puberty. Worse during menses,
labor, menopause. Worse emotions. Worse in the morning, and at night (malar neuralgia better at night). Pains
in arms and Achilles tendon worse as evening approaches.
Mouth - Saliva thick. Coppery taste. Hawks up viscid coppery tasting mucus. Thick mucus on teeth. Cannot
speak a word though she tries. Tongue and mouth feel warm. Tongue pointed and trembling, swollen.
Nose - Sensitive to cold air, every inhalation seems to bring the cold air in contact with the brain.
Rectum - Frequent thin, dark offensive stools. Alternate diarrhea and constipation. Morning diarrhea of
children.
Sensations - As of lifting up of skull, as if top of head would fly off, as of a bolt through from base of skull to
vertex. Inspired air seems to penetrate skull and into brain, causing a cold sensation. Intense pain in and
around the eyes (lancinating), worse moving head or eyes.
Skin - Locally and internally for ivy poisoning.
Sleep - Sleeplessness. Sleeps with arms overhead or yawning. Comatose, as if drunk. Brain irritation of
children during dentition.
Stomach - Sinking in the epigastrium (Sep., Sulph. ). Gnawing pain .Nausea and vomiting from pressure on
spine and cervical region, pregnancy, alcohol. Vomits green substance, groans, raves and presses the head
with both the hands for relief. Belch- ings with nausea, vomiting and headache.
Throat - Burning. Thyroid aches before menses.
COMMENTS - Frontal, vertical or occipital headache, accompanied by great pain in the eyeballs, better
pressure, worse slightest motion. Headache with a feeling as if going crazy. Headaches reflected from pelvic
organs. Depression as if a black cloud has settled over them.
Rheumatism affecting the vertebral joints and especially in the neck. Cerebrospinal meningitis, head and neck
retracted. Clarke found a pain at the nape of the neck very characteristic.
Sciatica with sharp, shooting pains down the limbs with back spasms. Hip and lum- . bosacral problems that
affect uterus and other organs (Aesc.). Back spasms from injury to the spine (Mag-p.). Arthritis that came on
with menopause, large joints (small joints, Caul.).
Pains in the joints and limbs. Pains like electric shocks, here and there, sharp in various parts, chest and
uterine pains shoot
Cimicifuga racemosa from side to side. A general bruised feeling all over as if sore, worse by touch.
Malar neuralgia, ceasing at night. Bad taste and breath. Coated tongue, sticky saliva, viscid mucus in throat.
Disordered digestion. Marked sinking at epigastrium.
Dry, teasing cough, worse at night and from every attempt to speak. Sharp pains in the heart and chest. Pains
down left arm, which is numb (Aeon., Puls., Rhus-t.), as if bound to the side. Palpitation from the least motion.
Heartbeat ceases suddenly.
Premenstrual syndrome with cramps. Backache with painful menses, muscle spasms in the back with the
period. Pain in the hip with menstrual cramps, hip can lock up. Symptoms worse during the period. Depression
with menses. Menopausal depression.
Painful prolapse of the uterus with cramps, spasms, backaches and hip aches, because pelvis is out of
alignment (Sep. has prolapse due to weakness and lack of tone).
Labor pains felt in the back or thighs. Muscle contractions in their thighs with labor pains, or they feel as if their
back will break (Kali-c., Cham.). Puerperal mania. According to Lippe a characteristic indication is: “The
recently delivered uterus becomes actually jammed in the pelvis with great pain.”
Cimic. should be given in daily doses in low lx potency two months before term, when indicated. It ensures
living births in women who have previously borne only dead children without any discoverable cause. If given
before the term, it renders labor easier, cures sickness of pregnancy, and prevents the after pains.
 In cases of tinnitus aurium it has proved curative in old-school practice in 15 to 30 drops of the tincture, whether
due to direct or reflex irritation.
Clarke greatly relieved an inveterate case of epilepsy in which the aura was a “waving sensation in the brain,”
which is a leading symptom of the remedy.
A patient who was taking 6-drop doses of the tincture complained of a feeling as if his heart had stopped.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Rham-cal. - muscular pains, lumbago, pleurodynia, acute rheumatism. (2) Derris
pinnata - neuralgic headachesof rheumatic origin. (3) Aristolochia milhom. - pain in achilles tendon, diabetes.
Caul., Puls., Lil-t., Agar. (4) Macrotin - especially for lumbago.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

PHARMACY - cimic. Cimicifuga racemosa. Black cohosh. Actea racemosa. Macrotys racemosa. Actea
monogynia. Cimicifuga serpentaria. Black snakeroot. Botroflus serpentaria. N. O. Ranunculacee. North
America. Tincture of the root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Abortion, tendency. Angina, pectoris. Appetite, disordered. Back, pains. Breast, disorders.
Cerebrospinal, meningitis. Chest, pains. Chorea. Colic. Cramps. Delirium, tremens. Diaphragm. Dyspepsia.
Epilepsy. Faintness.

name: Cina Maritima
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ciña. Cina maritima. Wormseed. Cinaartemisia. Artemisia maritima. Artemisia cintra. Semen
cine. Flores cine. Tartarian southernwood. N. O. Composite. Tincture. Cina is the source of the alkaloid
Santonin. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Abdomen, distended. Anemia. Anal, itching. Asthenopia. Asthma. Bedwetting. Bronchitis.
Borborygmi. Cachexia. Chorea. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions. Coughs. Dentition. Diarrhea. Emaciation.
Eyes, disorders. Grinding, teeth. Headaches. Hiccough. Hydrocephaloid. Hypoglycemia. Indigestion.
Intermittent, fever. Itching. Leucorrhea. Malassimilation. Nausea. Neuralgia. Nosebleed. Paraplegia.
Parasites. Pinworms. Remittent, fever. Roundworms. Scarlatina. Spasms. Strabismus. Threadworms.
Twitch- ings. Urine, milky. Vision, disorders. Vomiting. Whooping cough. Worms.
HERBAL - This remedy is a preparation of Artemisia cintra, Tartarian southernwood or wormseed. The
Artemisiae held a prominent place among the drugs of the ancient physicians from Hippocrates to Serapion.
They were recommended as febrifuge, stomachic and anthelmintic.
Cina is the source of the alkaloid Santonin which has a very strong anti-helminthic action. Cina is a powerful
remedy for the elimination of round worms.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cina is preeminently a worm remedy, as it causes all the symptoms which characterize
worm infestation, both mental, nervous and bodily. It corresponds more to the effects of lumbrici then to those
of other worms.
Reflex symptoms from abdominal irritation. Extreme sensitiveness of mind and body : offended by the
slightest thing, peevish and obstinate, aversion to be caressed. Child cannot bear to have hair combed or
brushed.
Irritation of the nose, causing constant desire to rub, prick or press into it. Grinding teeth during sleep.
Restless sleep, tossing all about the bed. Child lies on belly or on hands and knees during sleep. Nocturnal
bedwetting, urine white, turbid, at times fetid.
Over-sensitiveness of skin, cannot endure to be approached touched or pressed upon. Whole body is painfully
sore to motion and touch, bruised soreness. Hair is sensitive to touch.
Touch induces or aggravates spasms. Twitching, spasms. Convulsions with screams and violent jerkings of
the hands and feet. Convulsions with consciousness. Chorea. Unilateral. Children throw arms from side to side
during spasms. Paraplegia with unnatural hunger.
Variable appetite. Greater the hunger, greater the emaciation. Scrofulous. Sour smell of body especially
children. Children during dentition.
Pain comes in shocks. Jumps suddenly as though he felt pain. Trembling with shivering, when yawning.
Complaints concomitant to yawning, which comes on whenever someone yawns.
MIND - Extreme ill-humor and naughtiness in children. Wants to be carried, but carrying gives no relief. Wants
to be rocked. Irritability better rocking fast. Very touchy, irritable, petulant and dissatisfied. Child is very
cross, does not want to be touched or carried. WardZop/ease. Desires many things, but rejects everything
offered. Nervous.
Child can't be quieted. Irritability of temper. Irritability during dentition. Violent screaming attacks at night.
Child lying on the back and striking and kicking with hands and feet. Screaming, striking and biting. Nothing
pleases them for any length of time. Crying out as if in delirium.
Morose in daytime. Indisposition to play, in children. Convulsions in children when they are scolded or
punished.
Dislike of strangers (Bar-c.). Indifference to caresses. Worse if being looked at (Ant-t.). Unreal feeling of
having done something wrong, abnormal consciousness. Unconscious with frothing at mouth.
Sensitive, nervous women who get pain in head and eyes from sewing (Ruta). Irritability during menses.
Earnest and sensitive, offended at the slightest joke. Fear of evil while walking in open air, in evening. Throws
 things away. Causeless weeping.
Starting from sleep. Complaining on waking. Frightened easily on waking. Hallucinations of sight, smell and
taste. As if frightened, jumps out of bed, sees imaginary objects, screams, trembles, talks hurriedly, anxious
in evening and before midnight. Abdomen - Bloated and hard abdomen.
Abdomen as if empty. Twisting pain about the navel, better pressure (Spig.). Pressing outward in belly. Pain
on pressing upon navel. Colic with cutting, pinching pains from worms. Unpleasant, warm feeling. Pinching
or cramplike pressure transversely across epigastric region after a meal.
Back - Drawing, tearing pains down along whole spine. Tearing, jerking pain in middle of spine. Paralytic
feeling in nape. Bruised pain in lumbar region, not worse motion. Lancinating pain in upper part of spinal
column extendind to right scapula.
Causations - Ill effects of parasites, worms. Chest - Sternum as if lying too close to back. Cramplike,
contracted sensation. Constriction of right side, with difficult breathing. Chest as if pressed together from both
sides. As if chest was full of mucus. Sharp pain in left side. Burning and soreness in chest. Two dull piercing
pains in quick succession near sternum.
Constitutions - Generally hungry, cross, ugly and wants to be rocked. Children who are big, fat, rosy and
scrofulous, they stiffen out, when looked at, during cough or when they become cross.
Cough - Gagging cough in the morning. Whooping cough. Violent cough recurring paroxysms, as of down
in throat. Cough ends in spasm. Cough so violent
as to bring tears and sternum pains, feels as if something had been torn off. Child is afraid to speak of move
for fear of bringing on paroxysm of coughing. Periodic cough, returning spring and fall. Swallows after
coughing. After coughing, moaning, anxious, gasps for air and turns pale.
Ears - Cramplike jerking in external ear, like earache. Digging and scratching in ears. Dull stitches below
mastoid process. Hearing impaired.
Eyes - Dark rings around the eyes. Dilated pupils. Photophobia. Pulsation of ciliary muscle. Eyestrain,
especially when presbyopia sets in. Strabismus from abdominal irritation, from worms. Eyebrows twitch when
staring at any object. Drooping and heaviness of lids. Fatigue of eyes from sewing. Eyestrain with headache.
Pain in eyes when reading or staring. Sensations as if sand had got into eyes, worse when reading.
Lachrymation during cough. Spots on cornea. Itching of inner canthus.
Face - Face alternately pale and cold, or red and hot. Face puffy. Bluish white about the mouth. Pale with
dark rings around eyes. Pale with sickly look during cough. Pale streak down centre of face. Cold
perspiration. Grinds teeth during sleep. Chorea movements of face and hands. Tearing pain, in malar bones,
worse touch and pressure. One cheek red, the other pale. Twitching of muscles about eyes and face, with
disordered stomach and bowels.
Female - Child refuses breast. Aversion to mother's milk. Uterine hemorrhage before puberty. Menses too
early and profuse. Labor-like pains frequently recurring, as if menses would appear. Labor-like pains during
pregnancy. Spasmodic yawning in amenorrhea.
Food - Hunger voracious after eating. Gets hungry soon after a meal with feeling of emptiness. Indigestion.
Canine hunger. Hunger during or before intermittent fever. Aversion to mother's milk. Bread tastes bitter.
Desires many and different things. Craving for sweets, bread. Refuses ordinary food and desires dainties. Eats
alot but doesn't gain weight. Malassimilation. Children are hungry, the greater the hunger the greater the
emaciation. Hypoglycemia. Thirst for cold drinks. Difficult swallowing of liquids.
Head - Headache, alternating with pain in abdomen, relieved by stooping (Mez.). Headache from straining
eyes. Headache from sewing. Pain in head when reading or staring. Headache, before and after epileptic
attack. Turning the head from one side to other. Child leans his head sideways all the time. Women must let
hair down during headache. Children cannot tolerate to have their hair combed. Anemic headache, better
stooping, worse mental exertion. Weak, hollow, empty sensation in head with inclination to vomit. Stupefying
headache. Meningeal irritability, from worms.
Heart - Trembling beating of heart. Anguish about heart when working in open air. Pulse fast, 136 beats. Pulse
intermitting every seventeenth beat. Pulse small, but hard and accelerated.
Kidneys - Urine, turbid, white, milky. Urine, turns milky on standing. Involuntary at night. Bedwetting, worse
every full moon. Frequent urging with passage of much urine, all day. Involuntary urination. Urine becomes
turbid immediately.
Limbs - Child throws arms from side to side. Stretches out feet spasmodically, especially children. Twitching
and jerking distortion of limbs, trembling. Sudden inward jerking offingers of right hand. Left foot in
constant spasmodic motion. Sudden paraplegia, with unnatural hunger. Paralyzed shocks, patient will jump
suddenly, as though in pain. Nocturnal convulsions. Sensation of constriction around loins. Loins fatigued, as
if he had stood a long time.
 Lungs - Capillary bronchitis in children and loss of breath. Rattling in lungs and throat with excessive nervous
irritability. Suffocative attacks. Expectoration difficult. Gurgling from throat to stomach after coughing.
Catching and painful breathing. Short, interrupted breathing. Short breaths, with omission of some
inspirations. Breathing as from spasms in chest. V ery short breath, as if he had much mucus in chest, without
being obliged to cough. Difficult, loud breathing. Short breaths, moaning, with open mouth. Loud whistling
whoop in trachea while inspiring, not audible on expiration. Inhalation broken into two.
Male - Bad effects on masturbation, weakness of sight. Itching of genitals.
Modalities - Better from lying on abdomen. Better wiping eyes. Better motion, shaking head. Better from
rocking. Worse from worms. Worse vexation. Worse being looked at. Worse staring. Worse yawning. Worse
during sleep. Worse external pressure. Worse from touch. Worse open air, cold air, cold water. Worse sun,
summer. Worse full moon. Worse at night. Worse before midnight child wakes up frightened. Worse yawning.
Mouth - Sensitiveness of teeth to cold air and to cold drinks. Grinds teeth at night during sleep. Chews and
swallows in sleep. Much frothy saliva with rattling mucus on chest. Foul breath. Bitter taste before chill. Dryness
and rawness of mouth, palate. Clean tongue. Whitish sore place on margin of tongue, very painful to touch.
Tongue coated brownish-yellow.
Nose - Itching of nose all the time. Picks and bores at nose, until it bleeds. Wants to rub nose and pick at it.
Child picks its nose and cries out in sleep. Sneezing with whooping cough. Nostrils drawn in. Violent
sneezing with stitches in temples. Slimy discharge from nose. Bleeding from nose and mouth, with burning in
nose. Nosebleed, dark blood, with pain in forehead. Stoppage of nose in evening.
Perspiration - Cold sweat on forehead, nose and hands. Sour smell of body especially children. After the
sweat or before the chill, vomiting of food, with canine hunger at the same time.
Rectum - Worms (Naph., Sabad., Nat- p.). Itching of anus. Roundworms or threadworms. Stools white,
watery. Involuntary stools. Stools reddish mucus. Stools greenish slimy. Constipation. Stool r. ther hard and
black. White mucus like
MIND - Excitable nervous and sleepless. Talks rapidly and easily angered.
Abdomen - Sore throbbing in spleen. Mesenteric tuberculosis.
Chest - Veins stand out like whip-cord. Ears - Frying or sizzling in ears.
Heart - Angina pectoris.
Limbs - Habitually cold limbs.
Lungs - Acute pain in chest. Tuberculosis cough. Bleeding from the lungs. Asthma. Bronchitis.
Modalities - Worse from vital losses. Worse cold wind.
Rectum - Diarrhea of tuberculosis.
Skin - Exhausting night sweat (Merc.). Acne with pustules all over the body.
Sleep - Starts in sleep.
Stomach - Ravenous hunger, worse two hours after meals better when stomach is full. Loss of appetite.
COMMENTS - Has cured attacks of pain occurring two hours after meals, relieved by a cup of milk or light
food.
With the first trituration, Nash cured a boy of eight who had several abscesses in and around the knee joint.
The tibia was ulcerated and the ragged edge of the bone protruded through the surface. There was emaciation,
loss of appetite and he was as pale as a corpse. The appetite returned at once in great force.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Calc-p., Calc-i., Glon., Bar-c. (2) Kali-c. - excessive sweating, weakness, pallor,
Cact. - heart and arteries.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

author: Murphy
full:

HERBAL - This is an unproved drug, but it has been used with a good deal of success in cases of cataract
as an external application. The method adopted is to instill one drop four or five times a day into the affected
eye, for several months.
HOMEOPATHIC - Most effective in traumatic eye cases. Traumatic cataract and corneal opacities, as well
as senile cataract. No reports of cures by internal use of the remedy alone, but in some cases it was given
internally as well as used externally. Generally, the patients have received specific homeopathic treatment
internally at the same time.

name: Cinnabaris
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cinnb. Cinnabaris. Red mercuric sulphide. Mercuric sulphide. Mercurius sulphuratus ruber.
Hydrargyrum sulphuratum rubrum. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Bubo. Catarrh. Chancre. Cystitis. Dysentery. Eye, infections. Gleet. Gonorrhea.
Gout. Leucorrhea. Nose, sensitive. Priapism. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Scrofula. Sleep, abnormal. Sycosis.
Syphilis. Tapeworm. Ulcers. Warts.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cinnb. corresponds to sycosis as well as to syphilis and to combinations of the two. Warts
on the prepuce (Thuj.), especially for fan-shaped warts. General ner-
vous, uneasy sensation. Weariness, languor. Tired and prostrated, worse before eating, better when riding in
the open air.
General sensitiveness to touch, bones of skull, scalp, roots of hair, bridge of nose, warts bleed when touched.
Sensation on bridge of nose as if touched with metallic substance. Uneasy creeping and pressing sensation
about nasal bones as from wearing spectacles when not used to them. Headache with nosebleed.
Frequent jerkings and pullings. Certain forms of ciliary neuralgia and ulceration upon a syphilitic base. Cold
and chilly in warm room. Symptoms intermit in severity.
MIND - Indolence and indisposition to mental labor. Forgetful. Fretful, easily provoked. Sleepless during night.
Sensation of fullness in the head from mental application. Desire to be alone.
Abdomen - Flashes of heat confined to the abdomen with great flatulence, worse in the forenoon.
Back - Pain in back part of neck when head is thrown back, extending to occiput. Wrenching pains in the
vertebrae of the neck. The muscles of the neck seem as if contracted. Tearing in the side of the back. Aching
in the small of the back, as if bruised. Pain all over the back down to the loins.
Chest - Chest oppressed, feels contracted, relieved by stretching. Pain running over the ensiform cartilage
from the seventh rib on the right side diagonally through the chest. Pulsating and shooting pains in the chest,
especially when walking.
Constitutions - Anti-sycotic and antisyphilitic.
Ears - Roaring in the ears with swelling of the face, after eating. Scurfy eruption in right external ear. Itching
in right ear.
Eyes - Redness of whole eye. Eye infections.
Lids granulated, canthi and lids red. Severe shooting pain in bones of orbit, especially running from inner to
outer canthus in the bone. Pains from lachrymal duct around eye to temple from inner canthus across
brows to ear.
Face - Heat and swelling, mostly about the eyes.
Female - Leucorrhea, discharge with a feeling of pressure in vagina.
Head - Congestion to head, face purple red. Congestion of blood to the head, worse after eating. Violent and
frightful attack of headaches, better by compression of the head. Intense headache, he cannot raise his head
from the pillow, relieved by external pressure. Dull pain in the forehead, which is cold, relieved by heat.
Shooting pain in the left side of the head. Painful sensitiveness of the cranium and of the hair on being touched.
Stupefying buzzing in the head.
Heart - Heart flutters, then rushes of blood to the head.
Kidneys - Frequent and increasing emission of watery urine, also during the night. Pain, as if from a sore in
the urethra, when urinating, this pain wakes him up at night.
Limbs - Sensation of lameness in all the limbs. Pulling and shuddering in the arms and legs. Pain in long
bones when barometer lowers. Cold knees or joints. Left leg feels shorter than the right, while walking. Cramp
in calves after walking. Pain in Achilles tendon and os calcis when walking. Nodes on shin bones. Pain in
forearm from elbow down, including hands.
Lungs - Dyspnea with heat. Cough from tickling in the throat. Dry cough in single shocks, when lying down,
better by sitting up. Hoarseness in the evening.
Male - Jerking in penis during sleep. Foul acrid sweat between scrotum and thighs. Warts on prepuce, fan-
shaped and bleed easily. Small red pimples on glans. Itching of corona glandis. Redness and swelling of
prepuce, testicles enlarged, buboes, angry looking chancres. Syphilis, squamous and vesicular. Old hard
chancres.
Modalities - Better from rest. Better open air. Better sunshine. Better after dinner. Worse from light. Worse
summer. Worse dampness. Worse walking. Worse night. Worse touch. Worse lying on right side, feels as if
 contents of body were being dragged over to that side. Sweat worse at noon. Headache worse after sleep.
Mouth - Dry mouth and throat, wakes from
sleep, must rinse the mouth Both corners of the mouth are chapped. Tongue coated white with a putrid, bitter
taste in the morning. Burning, constrictive sensation in the palate. Salivation and increased flow of urine.
Nose - Nasal catarrh. Hawks stringy mucus from throat or lumpy mucus drops from the posterior sinuses.
Discharge from the nose is acrid, foul, burning, watery or dark lumps. Coryza with lumps of dirty, yellow mucus
are discharged from the posterior sinuses. Violent, fluent, burning coryza. Itching of the nose, with bleeding
after blowing it. Pain about root, extending into bones on each side (Aur.).
Rectum - Formication in the anus, as from a large worm. Little pimples around the anus with burning and
itching. Bloody dysentery. Tenesmus. Evacuations, soft and frequent. Thin, white stools. Green mucus
diarrhea, which stains the skin about anus and scrotum a copper color.
Sleep - Sleepiness in the daytime and sleeplessness at night, unconquerable desire to sleep after dinner, early
in the evening. Restlessness and sleeplessness at night from a constant flow of ideas changing from one thing
to another. Restless sleep with vivid dreams and much talking. Nightmares after midnight.
Skin - Red eruptions. Violent itching and pricking. Honeycombed ulcers. Very fiery-red looking ulcers.
Condyloma, easily bleeding. Buboes. Nodes on the shin bones. Sweat on nose.
Stomach - Soreness in the stomach, with dizziness and lightness in the head and tightness in the temples.
Nausea, alleviated by belchings. Nausea with water brash, in the evening.
Temperature - Pulse slower in the forepart of the day, accelerated in the evening. Coldness and chilliness in
the warm room. Heat of the body during the whole night. Profuse perspiration between the thighs. Perspiration
most at noon.
Throat - Stringy mucus passed through posterior sinuses into throat. Dryness of mouth and throat, must rinse
the mouth. Fiery-looking ulcers in mouth and throat.
Vertigo - Giddiness in the morning after rising, when stooping with nausea.
COMMENTS - The skin is much affected. Redness predominates (the color of the drug). Red spots. Heat,
redness and swelling of face, especially about eyes. Eruption on posterior cervical region, on inner and lower
part of thigh with itching.
Warts, pimples, pustules, ulcers, violent itching and pricking, especially about joints. Glands enlarged. The
back of the neck is affected. Pain extending to occiput when head is thrown back. Pain right side of neck on
turning head. Muscles seem contracted.
Leucorrhea, discharge causes a pressure in the vagina. Jerking in penis, occurring during sleep. Tearing
stitches in glans. Burning, stinging, itching of corona glandis. Frequent hemorrhages, nosebleed, bleeding
hemorrhoids.
Dysenteric symptoms. Obstinate constipation, stools hard and too large. Protrusion of anus during stool.
Formication as from a large worm. Little pimples around anus with burning and itching.
Berridge reported this symptom cured: “Left leg feels shorter than right while walking.”
. Guernsey said “We are led to use this for very red and very fiery-looking ulcers, which may occur in the throat
or on any other part of the body. Ulcers in the mouth, on the legs, particularly if there be nodes on the shin-
bones. In very angry looking chancres.” RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Hep., Nit-ac., Opium and Sulphur.
Compare: (1) Hep., Camph. (red spots), Lach., Merc., Nit-ac. (2) Thuj. - Cinnb. is better than Thuj in warts on
prepuce. (3) Sep. - warts on margin of prepuce, Ant-t. - warts at back of glans. (4) Seneg. has better bending
head backward, Clem, has headache worse from same, Clem, also has vertigo on lifting head up or moving
head, Cinnb. has pain in back of neck when head is thrown back.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Cinnamonum Ceylanicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cinnam. Cinnamonum ceylanicum. Cinnamon tree. Cinnamomum zeylanicum. Cinnamomum
cassia. N. O. Lauracae. Tincture. Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Ascites. Decay. Cancer. Chilliness. Constipation. Diarrhea. Exhaustion. Forgetfulness.
Hemorrhages. Headaches. Hoarseness. Hysteria. Leucorrhea. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Nausea. Post-
partum, hemorrhage. Vomiting.
HERBAL - Cinnam. has been used in large doses by the old school in cases of uterine cancer and some
success has been claimed for it. Cancer where pain and fetor are present.
For cancer, use a strong decoction, one-half pint a day. Oil of cinnamon in water solution is the best local
disinfectant. 3-4 drops in two quarts of water as a douche, wherever a germicide and disinfectant is needed.
Three drops on sugar for hiccough.
 HOMEOPATHIC - A leading feature of Cinnamon is hemorrhage, and has had abundant clinical verification.
Hemorrhage is bright red and clear, worse by any physical exertion. Nosebleeds.
Hemorrhage during the pregnancy, threatening miscarriage. A strain in loins or false step brings on a profuse
flow of bright blood. Post-partum hemorrhage. Hemorrhages from bowels, hemoptysis, etc.
Great weakness as after loss of fluids. Hysterical attacks, going off with belchings with nausea or vomiting.
Talking causes hysterical attacks. Feeble patients with languid circulation. Gastric disturbances. Flatulency
and diarrhea. Pains in bones and muscles.
Symptoms are worse while riding, exertion, talking, afternoon, and evening up to midnight.
MIND - Forgetfulness. Anxiety. Child screams and weeps until midnight. Delusion left side of body is
diminished, smaller. Hysteria. Great stupor in hysteria. Hysteria when
nothing brings on the attacks more surely than talking.
Abdomen - Much flatulence with colic and pain in uterus. Metastasis of gout to stomach and intestines.
Chest - Pain in chest. Anxiety and oppression in precordial region, causing constriction of chest.
Constitutions - Lymphatic, feeble, cachectic women with lax tissues and languid circulation. A women
advanced in years, hysterical convulsions.
Ears - Heat around left ear.
Eyes - Pain from left eye up to vertex in a line along the middle. Itching of the eyes. Improves weakness of
vision.
Face - Whole face turned red.
Female -Menses early, profuse, prolonged, bright red. Menorrhagia, with itching at nose, bright red blood,
worse after false step or strain. Bearing-down sensation. Uterine hemorrhages caused by overlifting. Repeated
small hemorrhages during pregnancy and puerperal state. Metrorrhagia. Sleepy. Fingers seem swollen. No
desire for anything. Worse on any exertion, lifting, straining, over-stretching arms, false step.
Food - Canine hunger with nausea and debility when passing the meal hour. Want of appetite with diarrhea
and acidity of stomach.
Heart - Great cardiac anxiety and loss of pulse with attacks. Heart weakness. Strengthens the heart. Hysteria.
Kidneys - Retention of urine.
Liver - Obstructions or induration of liver. Lungs - Oppressed breathing, with vertigo and weakness.
Male - Excessive irritability of sexual organs, causes erections. Impotence, sensation of weakness in legs.
Mouth - Toothache. Offensive taste in mouth. Ptyalism, particularly with pain in back.
Nose - Frequent attacks of nosebleed. Tough mucus from nose.
Sleep - Profound sleep with attacks.
Stomach - Tonic effect on stomach. Pressure and cramps in stomach. Hiccough jyjfh diarrhea, want of appetite
and acidity
Cinnamonum ceylanicum of stomach. Belching with colic. Nausea while riding with gagging and vomiting of
mucus. Nausea and retching every day at same hour for four days. Chronic vomiting. Paroxysms subside as
soon as vomiting sets in. Vomiting of pregnancy. Stool - Long continued constipation, stool in hard balls.
Diarrhea, worse after drinking with acidity. Hemorrhage from bowels, bright red and clear blood, occurring
especially after any physical exertion.
Temperature - Chilliness with trembling of limbs. Great fever in evening. Transient heat with sweat. Nervous
and typhoid fevers with great impairment of digestion, vomiting, diarrhea and exhaustion.
Throat - Sore throat. Hoarseness with cough. Clears the voice when muffled by secretions, scatters the phlegm
and is useful for tickling in larynx.
Vertigo - Vertigo with weakness and oppression of breathing. Fainting.
COMMENTS - Particularly useful for hemorrhage. Uterine hemorrhage, bleeding fibroids, any emergency
hemorrhage. Profuse diarrhea. Can be used easily as a home remedy, either in potency or as a tea in an
emergency.
Boericke said “a profuse flow of bright blood.” One case documented a woman who had a uterine hemorrhage
after childbirth and she craved cinnamon, Cinnam. helped.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Aeon. It antidotes: Opium. Compare: (1) Ip., Phos., Sil., Trill.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

name: Cipro
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cipr. Cipro. Ciprofloxacin. Cipro is a fluorinated quinolone, belonging to a class of fluorinated
antibiotics. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Abdominal pain. Acid, reflux. Acidosis. Allergies. Anemia. Anginapecto- ris. Agranulocytosis.
 Antrax. Ataxia. Blisters. Blood, clots. Convulsions. Diarrhea. Diplopia. Dyspnea. Edema. Headaches. Heart,
disorders. Heartburn. Hematuria.
Hepatitis. Hives. Hyperpigmentation. Insomnia. Itching. Jaundice. Ijver, disorders. Kidney, disorders. Kidney,
stones. Musculoskeletal, disorders. Nausea. Nephritis. Nightmares. Nosebleed. Palpitations.
Rhabdomyolysis. Sun, allergy. Sunburns. Swelling. Tendon, rupture. Tendonitis. Thrush. Tinnitus.
Tremors. Vaginitis. Vertigo. Vomiting. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cipro is a very toxic antibiotic drug used for the treatment of antrax and other infections. As
many as 20% of people taking Cipro have reported severe side effects. The most common side-effects
reported are gastrointestinal in nature such as nausea, diarrhea, vomiting, and abdominal pain.
Ciprofloxacin administration results in elevated serum fluoride levels. Cipro can cause musculo-skeletal
disorders such as rhabdomyolysis. Tendonitis and tendon rupture. Achilles tendon rupture was shown to
even after withdrawal of the drug.
Other fluoroquinolones are now withdrawn from the market because they had caused severe liver and kidney
damage and even deaths. Fatal liver failure associated with ciprofloxacin has been reported. Ciprofloxacin
has been implicated in several cases of acute kidney failure and dysfunc- - tion. Respiratory distress is a side-
effect of ciprofloxacin.
Photosensitivity can result when light interacts with chemical agents in the skin and eyes. This process can
produce undesirable clinical consequences, such as phototoxicity, exaggerated sunburn, sun allergy or
sun-carcinogenicity. People receiving Patients taking Cipro are warned not to expose themselves to direct
sunlight. Rashes develop on the areas exposed.
This medication may stimulate the central nervous system, which may lead to tremors, restlessness, light-
headedness, confusion, depression, and hallucinations. Other central nervous system reactions include
nervousness, agitation, insomnia, anxiety, nightmares, and paranoia.
Cipro can cause increased pressure within the brain. Convulsions have been reported in people receiving the
drug. Seizures. Slug
gishness. Tingling sensation. Vague feeling of illness. Weakness.
Swelling of the face, lips, neck, eyes, or hands. Agranulocytosis, potentially fatal condition where the white
blood cell count goes extremely low. Blood and albumin in the urine, elevated serum potassium, glucose, and
albumin. Elevation of triglycerides and cholesterol.
MIND - Abnormal dread or fear. Anxiety. Nervousness. Agitation and restlessness. Mental confusion.
Depersonalization. Loss of sense of identity. Depression. Irritability. Delirium. Hallucinations. Manic attacks.
Paranoia. Toxic psychosis.
Abdomen - Bleeding in the intestines.
Flatus. Intestinal inflammation. Intestinal perforation. Swelling of the pancreas.
Back - Back pain. Neck pain.
Blood - Acidosis. Anemia. Agranulocytosis.
Swelling of the blood vessels or lymph system.
Ears - Hearing loss. Ringing in the ears.
Eyes - Eye pain. Yellow eyes. Involuntary eye movement. Blurred vision. Double vision. Decreased vision.
Change in color perception. Sensitivity to light.
Face - Swelling of the face.
Female - Vaginal inflammation.
Food - Lack of appetite. Loss of appetite.
Head - Headache. Light-headedness. Blood clot to the brain.
Heart - Angina pectoris. Cardiopulmonary arrest. Irregular heartbeat. Palpitations. Pounding heartbeat. High
blood pressure. Heart attack. Heart flutters.
Kidneys - Inability to urinate. Kidney damage. Large volumes of urine. Kidney failure. Urinary retention.
Urethral bleeding. Acidosis. Nephritis. Increased urinary output. Kidney stones. Dark urine. Blood in urine.
Limbs - Achiness. Joint stiffness. Joint pain. Gout flare-up. Convulsions. Ataxia, lack of muscle coordination.
Tendon, rupture. Achilles tendon rupture. Tendonitis.
Liver - Hepatitis. Liver damage. Jaundice.
Liver failure.
Lungs - Dyspnea. Respiratory distress. Labored breathing. Blood clots in the lungs. Coughing up blood.
Difficult breathing.
Bronchial spasms.
Male - Burning in penis. Prostatitis.
Mouth - Mouth sores. Bad taste in mouth. Thrush. Oral fungal infection.
 Nose - Nosebleed. Loss of sense of smell.
Rectum - Diarrhea. Constipation. Pale or dark stools.
Skin - Blistering of skin. Burning sensations. Severe allergic reaction. Skin hypersensitivity. Cuticle
candidiasis (yeast). Skin peeling. Itching. Hives. Redness. Red bumps on skin. Skin sensitivity to sunlight.
Sunburns. Hyperpigmentation. Unusual darkening of the skin. Yellow skin.
Sleep - Drowsiness. Inability to fall or stay asleep. Insomnia. Nightmares.
Stomach - Acid, reflux. Heartburn. Indigestion. Bleeding in the stomach. Hiccoughs. Nausea and vomiting.
Temperature - Chills. Fever. Heat flushing. Throat - Difficulty in swallowing. Swelling of the throat. Speech
difficulties.
Vertigo - Dizziness. Light-headedness. Fainting.
RELATIONS - Compare: Calc-f., Fl-ac.
REFERENCES - Murphy.

name: Cistus Canadensis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cist. Cistus canadensis. Rock rose. Helianthemum canadense. Ice-plant. Frost-weed. N. O.
Cistacae. Tincture of whole flowering plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies. Locally as a wash to
arrest fetid discharges.
CLINICAL - Bone disorders. Breast, cancer. Cancer. Diarrhea. Erysipelas. Glandular swellings. Herpes
zoster. Hip joint disease. Hospital gangrene. Leucorrhea. Lupus. Mastitis. Ophthalmia. Panaritium. Parotiditis.
Pharyngitis. Pyorrhea. Scorbutus. Scrofula. Sore, throat. Ulcers.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cistus is a very ancient remedy for scrofulous disorders, in scorbutic states, and for
gangrenous ulcerations. The provings and homeopathic uses confirm its suitability in these respects and bring
out clearer indications.
Affects the glands, especially of nasopharynx, neck and breasts (left). Malignant disease of the glands of
the neck. Indurated glandular swelling of the neck and throat. Suppuration of the glands of the neck. Breast
cancer, hardness of the breasts.
Cancer of the lower lip. Scorbutic, swollen gums separating from the teeth, gums bleed easily, putrid,
disgusting. Cold tongue. Decay of the lower jaw. Desire for acid food and fruits. Saliva in throat. Belchings in
stomach.
Affinity for the naso-pharynx, aborts colds that center in posterior nose. Sniffling. Mucus discharges are thick,
yellow, foul, leave a painful rawness. Worse sweating, discharges. Scrofulous ophthalmia.
Herpetic eruptions, scorbutic states, chronic swellings and gangrenous ulcerations. Poisoned wounds, bites,
phagadenic ulcers. Suppurations. Lupus. Internal and external itching. Burnings. Formication through the
whole body with anxious, difficult breathing. Indurations. Callosities with cracks.
Extreme sensitivity to cold. Sensation of coldness in various parts. Inhaled air feels cool. Cold breath.
Grimmer said “This patient is extremely sensitive to cold and all complaints become worse after exposure to
cold.” All mental excitement aggravates.
MIND - Fear. Bad effects from vexation. All mental excitement aggravates (stitches in throat, cough).
Abdomen - Stitches in left hypochondrium.
Cool feeling in abdomen. Pain in groin coming from back.
Back - Hard, swollen glands in the neck. Neck is studded with tumors. Burning, bruised pain in the coccyx,
preventing sitting, touch.
Breasts - Induration of breasts, sensitive to cold air. Mastitis. Breast cancer.
Causations - Bad effects from anger, vexation.
Chest - Coldness in chest. Chest feels raw after expectoration. Trachea feels narrow. Hemorrhage from lungs.
Constitutions - Suited to scrofulous subjects who are very sensitive to cold air.
Ears - Watery discharge, fetid pus, after eruptive diseases. Discharge of water and bad-smelling pus. Tetter
on and around ears, extending to external meatus. Inner swelling of ears with discharge.
Eyes - Feeling as if something passing around the eye. Weight above eyes. Scrofulous inflammation. Canthi
cracked. Stitches in eyes.
Face - Decay of the lower jaw with suppurating glands on neck. Swelling of parotid glands. Open, bleeding,
cancer on lower lip. Lips cracked. Tip of nose painful. Itching, burning and crusts, on zygoma. Vesicular
erysipelas. Lupus.
Female - Sensitive to cold air. Bad smelling leucorrhea. Cancer.
Food - Desire for acid food and fruits, cheese, pungent things.
Head - Head drawn to one side by swelling in the neck. Forehead cold, and sensation of coolness inside
 forehead, in a very warm room. Pressive pain at root of nose with headache. Headache from missed meals,
better eating.
Limbs - Sprained pain in wrist. Cold feet. Cracked finger tips, sensitive to cold. Workmen develop hard place
on their hands with cracks. Tetter on hands. Syphilitic ulcers on lower limbs with hard swelling around. White
swelling.
Lungs - Asthmatic after lying down. Larynx and trachea feel cool on inhaling cold air. Trachea feels narrow
and breathing becomes difficult, preceded by formication. Expectoration of quantities of glairy, tenacious
mucus, on lying down. Chest feels raw after expectoration.
Male - Itching on scrotum.
Modalities - Better from eating. Better swallowing. Better expectoration. Great sensitiveness to touch. Worse
from touch. Worse slightest exposure to cold air. Worse drafts. Worse cold water. Worse evening, night,
morning. Worse mental exertion. Worse excitement. Worse touch. Worse motion. Diarrhea worse from drinking
coffee.
Mouth - Scorbutic, receding gums, easily bleeding, putrid. Pyorrhea (Merc-c., Caust., Staph., Kreos.). Mouth
feels cold.
putrid, impure breath. Tongue feels cold. Hurts to protrude the tongue. Breath cool. Saliva cold.
Nose - Cold feeling or burning in nose. Tip painful. Eczema of the nose. As of a lump in naso-pharynx. Pressing
pain at the root of the nose with headache. Chronic nasal catarrh, frequent violent sneezing.
Rectum - Chronic dysentery. Stool, thin, yellow, urgent, worse in morning. Diarrhea from coffee and fruit, with
goiter and nausea. Chronic diarrhea in wet weather in scrawny scrofulous children.
Skin - General itching which prevents sleep. Itching, crawling all over without eruptions. Small, painful pimples.
Skin of hands hard, thick, dry, fissured, deep cracks. Itching of swollen hands and arms. Mercurio-syphilitic
ulcers. Hemicrania. Lupus. Glands inflamed and indurated.
Sleep - Very restless at night. Sleepless from coldness or dryness in throat. Night sweats.
Stomach - Cool feeling in stomach before and after eating. Empty and cool belching. Frequent nausea with
diarrhea. Diarrhea after drinking coffee.
Temperature - Chilliness, followed by heat with trembling. Heat with thirst, causing to drink frequently. Sweats
easily. Night sweats.
Throat - Soft, spongy feeling, itching in the throat. Heat and itching in throat. Small, dry spot in throat, must
sip water frequently. Throat, very dry and becomes sore on inhaling least cold air. Breath, tongue, and
throat feel cold. Uvula and tonsils swollen. Glands swollen and suppurating. Goiter with frequent diarrhea.
Head drawn to one side by swellings in neck. Pains when coughing. Hawking of mucus.
COMMENTS - “Sensitive to cold air” and feelings of coldness. Cold feelings in larynx, in abdomen. “Inhaling
the slightest cold air causes sore-throat, which he has not when inhaling in a warm room.”
Indurated glandular swelling of the neck and throat. Trembling with the fever. Sensation as if ants were running
through the whole body (in evening with anxious,
difficult breathing). Prominent stitches. Characteristic soft or spongy feeling.
Clarke cured with Cist, a case of sore throat that had lasted for years under allopathic treatment with local
swabbings. There was an accumulation of thick yellow, leathery phlegm that had to be cleared away by a local
means. The patient complained of a “spongy” feeling in the throat and the led him to the remedy.
RELATIONS-Antidoted by: Rhus-t., Camph. and Sep. Compare: (1) Con., Calc., Arg-n., Bell., (2) Carb-v. -
cold breath. (3) Sulph. - morning diarrhea. Compatible: Magnesium - the plant grows on a magnesium soil.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer.

HOMEOPATHIC - All forms of dropsy and swellings are benefited with Citric acid and lemon juice,

name: Citrus Limonum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cit-1. Citrus limonum. Lemon. Citrus medica. N. O. Rutacae. Expressedjuice. Historical dose:
Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Cancer. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dysentery. Dyspnea. Eruptions.
Faintness. Headaches. Hemorrhages. Hetpes. Rheumatism. Scurvy. Splenitis. Sunstroke.
HERBAL - Lemon juice and citric acid are traditional remedies for and preventives of sea-scurvy. It can be
used as a local application (in one part of citric acid to eight of water).
HOMEOPATHIC - That their action is homeopathic has been proved by the occurrence of scurvy from the
excessive use of the acid when taken for other purposes.
Cit-1. has a powerful effect on the circulation and on the blood itself. Faintness, a weak pulse, hemorrhages
and swellings. Excessive menstruation.
Inflammation and painful enlargement of the spleen, dyspnea. Stiffness in the joints, particularly in the fingers,
bruised feeling, particularly in the feet. Herpetic eruptions. Cancer pains. Sore throats. Daily headache.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Aeon., Asarum, Datura, Euphorbia, Hep., Sepia. It antidotes: Aeon., Euphorb.,
Stram., snakebites and all animal poisons. It increases the curative effects of Bell. Compare: (1) It should be
compared with Acetic acid and the “bruisedpain in the joints” recalls the action of its congener, Ruta, Bell.,
Lach. (2) As an antidote against Stram. It has been employed with great success, the juice of the fruit being
administered by the teaspoonful.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Citrus Vulgaris
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cit-v. Citrus vulgaris. Bitter orange. Aurantium amara. Aurantii cortex. N. O. Rutacae. Tincture
of Seville orange peel. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Choking, sensation. Faintness. Headache. Metrorrhagia. Neuralgia. Palpitations. Pleurodynia.
Scarlatina. Throat, rising in.
HERBAL - The tincture of the orange peel is used as a pleasant bitter tonic in old-school practice. On sensitive
individuals, oranges in any form produce pathogenic effects. Boiled dried orange peel excites the intestine in
a manner similar to other forms of cellulose or agar.
There is an increased flow of bile which continues for hours. It unites both a chola- gogue action with a
mechanical stimulus to peristalsis. An orange eaten before breakfast is said to destroy the craving for alcohol
in alcoholics.
HOMEOPATHIC - One patient could never eat an orange without experiencing a fearful taste at the back of
the nose and throat. This lasted many days and caused choking sensations and faintness.
For diseases of the elderly with coldness and chilliness. Neuralgias and skin symptoms. Facial neuralgias,
mostly right-sided. Itching, redness and swelling of hands. Headache with nausea, vomiting and vertigo.
Frequent and irresistible yawning. Disturbed sleep. Great excitement, quick motions. Pains in kidneys and
bladder. Too copious menses. Pleurodynia. Palpitations. Thoracic oppression.
Face - Neuralgia of face, shooting, gnawing pains, in temples, especially right side.
Head - Right sided headache.
Skin - Itching, general or more often only in upper limbs, with redness and swelling of hands. Eruption and
other symptoms like scarlatina.
Teeth - Constant toothache. Teeth become decayed, wear off.
Throat - Something seems to rise in throat and choke. Fearful taste at back of nose and throat, lasting for
days and causing choking sensation and faintness.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Ruta, Angustura.
(2) Citrus limonum. (3) Citric acid. (4) Citrus decumana.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Clematis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - clem-b. Clematis. Clematis vitalba. Flowers are picked with the stalk, placed in a bowl of water
and allowed to sit in the sun for several hours. The water is strained and used as medicine. Historical dose:
 Take two drops from the stock bottle into a one ounce dropper bottle, (add brandy or alcohol, if this bottle will
be used for days or weeks). This is the dosage bottle, take a few drops straight into the mouth or as needed
in a little water or juice.
HOMEOPATHIC - This remedy belongs to the group of Not Sufficient Interest in Present Circumstances,
as classified by Bach. The additional remedies of this group are Honey- b., Wld-r-b., Oliv-b„ Wh-ch-b., Must-
b. and Ch-bd-b.. This group of remedies helps those not fully engaged in the here and now. Shocked by sudden
noise and startles easily when touched. Sleepiness, drowsiness, fainting and vertigo. In some comatose states,
Clem-b. may restore consciousness. The body may seem as if not “inhabited,” as the mind draws to future
dream castles or removes due to exhaustion or emotional hardship. Out-of-body experiences.
MIND - Hazy reality. Passive. Tendency to suddenly lose touch and become drowsy or sleepy. Lightheaded
or vacant feeling. Lack of concentration. Prevalent absent-mindedness, interrupted by spurts of interest.
Delusions with ecstatic content (Verv-b.), pleasant visions and reveries. Set on dreams of future fulfillment,
rather than seeing the present as promising and trying to find happiness therein. States from daydreaming
about future happiness, fatigue, strenuous or saddening daily routines. Hopeful.
Happy when dreaming, reality seems harsh, void of meaning, lonely or sad.
REFERENCES - Bach.

name: Clematis Erecta
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - clem. Clematis erecta. Virgin's bower. Upright virgin's bower. Flammula jovis. N. O.
Ranunculacee. Europe. Tincture of leaves and stems. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne. Arthritic, nodosities. Blepharitis. Cancer. Conjunctivitis. Eyes, disorders. Face, pimples.
Gonorrhea. Headaches. Homesickness. Nausea. Orchitis. Rheumatism. Skin, rashes. Testicles, infections.
Toothache. Urethra, stricture.
HOMEOPATHIC - Clematis, like other Ranunculi, is a direct irritant of the skin producing inflammation and
vesication. In the provings, the external head (left), eyes, teeth (left), skin, urinary and male sexual organs
show the greatest number of symptoms.
Acts especially on the skin, mucus membranes of eyes and urethra, glands, breasts, ovaries and genito-
urinary organs, especially the testicles. Glands become very hard and painfully swollen. Herpes, stricture of
the urethra, cancer of the breast and testes. Inflammation of eyes, worse left, smarting, burning, stitches,
redness, lachrymation, photophobia. Sensation as if fire were streaming from eyes.
Neuralgic pains in various parts. Pains relieved by perspiration. Burning, itching, stinging, crawling. Muscles
flaccid or twitch. Distant pulsation in whole body. Vibrating sensation through the body after lying down.
Strictures. Emaciation. Great sleepiness. Great debility from 3 p.m. to 5 p.m. Aversion to be washed.
MIND - Confused feeling, better in open air. Peevish, dissatisfied without any cause. Melancholy,
preoccupied with sad thoughts. General sadness and dread of misfortune. Sadness better after eating.
Cheerful alternating with sadness, followed by irritability and prostration.
Homesick (Caps.). Ailments from homesickness. Memory weak. Indifference. Aversion to talking. Indolence in
morning, better evening. Aversion to reading, desires to be read to. Irritable, taciturn, doesn't want to go out.
Low sex drive. Fear of being alone, but disinclined to meet even agreeable company. Sleepy, dreamy.
Abdomen - Pain from abdomen to chest, worse breathing and during urination. Swelling of inguinal glands
with jerking pains, with scirrhus or suppressed gonorrhea, rheumatism of joints.
Back - Itching pustules around the neck, with excoriation after scratching .Humid tetters from the nape of the
neck to the occiput. Eruption of pustules in the lumbar region.
Breasts - Breast and uterine cancer. Swelling and induration of breasts. Glandular induration and tumors of
breast.' Breast cancer with stitches in shoulders and uterus. Shooting pain in breast, worse urinating. Full,
heavy, sensitive breasts.
Causations - Homesickness.
Constitutions - Suited to light-haired people with torpid, cachectic conditions, swellings and indurations of the
glandular system. Syphilitic taint. Scrofulous, rheú- matic, gonorrheal and syphilitic patients.
Ears - Burning pain in exterior of the ear. Tinkling, ringing in the ear.
Eyes - Complaints from bright sunlight. Chronic conjunctivitis. Pustular conjunctivitis with tinea capitis, eyes
inflamed and protruding. Chronic blepharitis with sore and swollen meibomian glands. Iritis with great
sensitiveness to cold. Heat in eyes, sensitive to air, must close them. Burning, as if fire were streaming out
and smarting, worse closing eyes. Lachrymation. Flickering before eyes.
Face - White blisters on face and nose, as if sunburned. Pain in right side of face to eye, ear and temple, better
holding cold water in the mouth. Swelling of the submaxillary glands with hard tubercles, throbbing, aggravated
 on being touched. Lip cancer.
Female - Menses too early. Swelling and induration of the mammary glands. Breast and uterine cancer.
Food - Weakness, nausea and sleepiness after eating. Prolonged satiety, though the food continues pleasant
to the taste. Increased thirst, with desire for ice. Aversion to beer. Nausea on smoking tobacco, with weakness
of the legs.
Head - Confused feeling, better in open air. Hammering and strokes in the head. Boring pain in temples.
Headaches, worse bending head backward. Head feels full and heavy, hanging down. Eruption on occiput at
base of hair, moist, pustular sensitive. Itching on the hairy scalp.
Heart - Sharp stitches at heart, from within outwards.
Kidneys - Urethra feels constricted, like a large whip-cord painful on pressure. Stricture of urethra. Frequent,
scanty urination, burning at orifice. Burning in urethra during urination. Urine stops and starts, emitted drop
by drop. Must strain to pass a few drops, then full stream follows. Inability to pass all the urine, dribbling after
urinating. Last drops of urine cause violent burning. Tingling in urethra lasting some time after urinating. Pain
along the spermatic cord, worse at night.
Limbs - Arthritic nodosities in the joints of the fingers. Axillary glands swollen. Weakness in limbs after eating
or with nausea on smoking tobacco. Scaly tetters in the thigh.
Lungs - Breathing impaired, worse ascending the hill or walking over uneven road. Barking, dry cough with
stitches in chest. Expectoration of bloody saliva.
Male - Orchitis. Testes hang heavy or retracted. Testicles indurated with bruised feeling. Swelling of right
half of the scrotum. Ilio-scrotal neuralgia. Swelling of the spermatic cord with burning and soreness, extending
to abdomen. Violent erections with stitches in urethra. Burning in penis during seminal discharge during sex.
Aversion for sex.
Modalities - Better from sweating. Better open air. Worse from gonorrhea. Worse touch. Worse motion.
Worse moist poul
tices. Worse from heat of bed. Worse night. Worse cold washing or air, cold water. Worse during increasing
and new moon, better during the waning moon. Monthly aggravations. Headache and toothache are worse
lying down in evening.
Mouth - Breath offensive to others. Dryness of the tongue in the morning. Dull shootings and piercings in the
root of the tongue. Small blisters on the tongue and in the throat, which soon become ulcers.
Skin - Glands hot, painful, swollen, worse inguinal glands. Vesicles, pustules. Red, burning, scaly, scabby.
Corroding eruptions, ending in flat eating ulcers with thick crusts and eczema worse occiput and lower legs.
Varicose ulcers. Herpes zoster. Itches terribly, worse washing in cold water, worse face and hands and scalp
around occiput.
Sleep - Sleepiness. Restless, dreamy sleep with vibratory sensation throughout the body.
Stomach - Disagreeable sensation of coldness in the stomach. Weakness in all the limbs after eating with
pulsation in arteries. Nausea on smoking tobacco with weakness of legs.
Teeth - Toothache, worse at night andfrom tobacco, temporarily worse from heat of bed. Toothache in a
decayed molar tooth, much better by cold water. Shooting pains or successive pullings in the teeth. Sensation
as if the decayed tooth were too long. The least contact is exceedingly painful.
Temperature - Pulse accelerated. Quartan fever, characterized by shuddering, followed by sweat. Sweat on
waking, and sensitiveness of the skin, which the patient cannot bear to be uncovered. Dry heat, with sensation
of general heat.
Throat - Heat and burning in the mouth and throat. Sensation of roughness in the throat.
Vertigo - Giddiness if he lifts his head up, or when moving the head.
COMMENTS - Clematis was used by Stoerck before Hahnemann's time in cancerous and other foul ulcers,
inveterate skin eruptions, syphilis and rheumatism.
Affections of the urethra, penis in general, prepuce in particular. May have to wait a long time before he can
urinate with intense pain along fore part of urethra. Flow of urine by fits and starts. Mucus in the urine, but not
pus. Beginning of inflammatory stricture. Stricture of the urethra
Swelling of inguinal glands. Painful inflamed, swollen testicles. Great affinity for the testes. Useful for cases of
undescended testicles, painful, partially descended testicles, and hydroceles where the scrotum swells with
fluid (Con., Spong.). Indurated testicles. Testicular cancer. Gonorrhea that goes to the testes. Herpes. Breast
cancer.
Generally a right-sided remedy. Great debility, twitching of muscles, vibrating sensation through body.
Giddiness when lifting up head or when moving head.
Useful for poison ivy and poison oak. Vesicles and weeping of yellow, acrid fluid on body (Rhus-t.). Fluid stings,
worse bathing. Impetigo, fluid seeping from beneath the scabs.
 RELATIONS - It is antidoted by: Bry. (Toothache, urinary symptoms), Camph. Antidote to: Merc. Compare:
( 1 ) Clematis vitalba - varicose andotherulcers. (2) Sil., Staph., Petr., Oleand., Canth., Phos. acid. (3) Ars. -
skin, Clem, has more redness is worse from washing, has moist, alternating with dry scabs. (4) Puls. -
gonorrheal orchitis, testicle tender and hard as a stone. (5) Bell., Bry., Calc., Canth., Con., Caust., Dulc.
(syphilitic ulcerations), Graph., Merc, (iritis sensitive to cold), Petr, (impetigo on neck and occiput). (6) Sars. -
syphilitic ulcers. (7) In “aversion to be washed,” compare Ant-c., Hep., Phos., Sep., Spig., Sulph. (8) In bending
head back, Cinnb., Cobalt, has worse bending head forward. Compatible: Sil.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Cobaltum Metallicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cob. Cobaltum metallicum. Cobalt metal (Co. At. Wt. 58.6). Trituration. Historical dose:
Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Backaches. Constipation. Eye, disorders. Fatigue. Gonorrhea. Hemorrhages. Headaches.
Impotency. Liver, disorders. Lumbago. Masturbation, effects. Neurasthenia. Sexual, disorders.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cobaltum is useful for neurasthenic states of spinal origin with sexual disturbances. Affects
the spine, lumbarregion, genitals, kidneys and bones. Fatigue, agitation and bone pains, worse in morning.
Aching in bones. Soreness.
Characteristic very severe backache, worse sitting, better rising up, walking or lying down. Backache with
seminal emissions. Discharges frothy. Sourness of taste, stomach, foot, sweat etc. Fatigue.
MIND - Great exhilaration of spirits, vivacity and rapid flow of thoughts. All mental excitement increases
suffering. Constant interchange of mental moods. Sense of guilt. Thinks too little of himself. Delusion he is a
criminal and others know it. Confusion from motion. Reproaches himself. Desire for mental work.
Abdomen - Empty feeling at navel. Y ello w spots on abdomen. Sharp pains in the region of spleen, worse
taking deep breath.
Back - Backache in lumbar region and weak legs. Pain in back and sacrum, worse while sitting, better
walking or lying. Weakness in legs and backache after emissions. Aching pain in lumbar, worse sex, sitting,
better on rising, walking or lying down with weak knees, cannot straighten up. Pain along the spine and from
the sacrum down through the legs into the feet.
Eyes - Photophobia in spring. Darting pain in the eyes on coming into sunshine. Spring catarrh.
Face - Disposition to keep jaws tightly closed.
Head - Headache, worse stooping, jarring. Sensation as if the brain went up and down, on stepping. Headache,
worse bending head forward. Itching of hairy scalp and beard.
Kidneys - Smarting at the meatus at the end of urination. Albuminuria. Urine has a strong pungent smell.
Limbs - Trembling of limbs especially legs, aching when sitting. Flushes of heat along legs. Shooting into
thighs from liver. Sudden weakness in left hip, worse walking. Weak knees. Tingling, pricking in feet. Foot
sweat, mostly between the toes, smelling sour. Aching in wrist joints.
Liver - Shooting pains in the region of the liver. Shooting from liver region down into the thighs.
Lungs - Cough with copious, frothy, sweetish white mucus with lumps in it.
Male - Pain in end of urethra, greenish discharge, brown spots on genitals and abdomen. Pain in right testicle,
better urinating. Discharge of semen without erections. Frequent nocturnal emissions with lewd dreams,
headache and backache. Impotency. Yellow-brown spots on genitals.
Modalities - Better from hawking mucus. Better continued motion. Better walking. Worse from sexual losses.
Worse lying down. Worse rising from sitting. Worse sitting. Worse morning. Worse heatof bed or sun. Cold air
causes lachrymation and aggravates pain in teeth. Warmth of bed causes itching all over. Jarring aggravates
headache.
Mouth - Teeth feel too long. Tongue coated white (Ant-c.), with cracks across the middle. Sour taste.
Rectum - Desire for stool, while walking, worse on standing, followed by diarrhea. Constant dropping of blood
from the anus, no blood from the stools.
Skin - Pimples about buttocks, chin, hairy scalp. Itching all over whengetting warm in bed.
Sleep - Wakeful, can do with less sleep. Drowsy and can hardly get enough sleep. Unrefreshing. Disturbed
by lewd dreams.
Stomach - Sour or bitter water rises up with pain in stomach.
Vertigo - Vertigo with feeling as if head grows large, worse stools.
COMMENTS - Frequent nocturnal emissions with lewd dreams, with partial or no erections. Impotence.
Drowsiness, unrefreshing sleep. Headache worse bending head forward. Pimples on the head and elsewhere,
itching of the skin when warm in bed at night.
 Smarting and darting pains in eyes. Lachrymation in open air. Pain in hollow tooth, which feels too long and is
sensitive to touch. Tongue thickly coated white, cracks across middle. No appetite for supper. Urine has strong
pungent smell.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cann-i., Sep., Sei. (2) Zinc. - in pain in back worse sitting. (3) Agn. - impotency,
Nux-v. (4) effects of masturbation. Sei., Titan., Thallium. (5)Nitrate of Cobalt is a perfect antidote to Cyanide
of Potassium, the two forming an insoluble compound.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Cobaltum Nitricum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cob-n. Cobaltum nitricum. Cobalt nitrate. A chemically pure product. Trituration. Historical
dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL-Amenorrhea. Anemia. Arthritis. Blood, tumors. Chlorosis. Conjunctivitis. Deafness. Emaciation.
Encephalitis. Fatigue. Fibroids. Hemiplegia. Infertility. Meningitis. Metrorrhagia. Miscarriage. Neuritis. Orchitis.
Paralysis. Paraplegia. Pericarditis. Pleurodynia. Sterility. Syphilis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cobalt has been known since ancient times and it was introduced for used in the
manufacture of blue china, Dutch delftware, Moutier and Gien’s crockery and Sévre porcelain. A great deal of
research is carried out on it in industry and agriculture, including experiments concerning the toxicity of cobalt
and its salts.
In 1899, Pettini and Messina, by administering cobalt chloride in the food of dogs, cats and rabbits, noticed an
increase in the level of hemoglobin.
More recently, Polonowski, Sutter and Briska, showed an increase of red corpuscles due to cobalt. Canjolle
pointed to the complaints of pulmonary ventilation with a fall in arterial tension. According to Zarone, this
hypotension is linked to a toxic attack on the myocardium.
In occupational medicine, Desoille, Merk- len and Cotteril reported cases of poisoning of workers in which the
clinical symptoms noted respiratory complaints and an increase in the level of red corpuscles.
A lack of fertility and miscarriage due to bleeding under the placenta. Emaciation, bluish-red coloring of the
muscles and viscera, serous effusion. The thyroid gland is the location for pseudo-carcinomatous changes.
The homeopathic proving was re-evaluat- edby G. Maring in 1955 with fifteen provers, seven men and eight
women. He used the 3x, 6x, 12x, and 30x potencies.
Symptoms included general fatigue in the morning, immediately on waking, lasting through the day with the
feeling of being sleepy and heavy. General lassitude. Face pale, discolored. Frontal headache, vertigo.
Nervous.
General emaciation. Irregular appetite, diarrhea. Better during the afternoon. Trembling hands. Loss of libido.
Heaviness of the limbs. Pains in the bones. Pleurodynia on the left side. Cardiac pain. Metrorrhagia.
Syphilitic hemiplegia and paraplegia. Syphilitic radicular neuritis. Tabes. Diffuse meningitis and encephalitis or
general paralysis. Spasmodic dorsal tabes. Thyroid problems. Every morbid manifestation developing either
from hereditary or acquired syphilis. Hardening processes.
MIND - Anxiety. Excitability and over-activity, followed by inhibition and general depression. Depressive state
with difficulty in concentrating as a result of a persistent headache. Sullen. Sadness on waking. Memory poor
on first waking.
Abdomen - Chronic enteritis. Intestinal rumbling, ameliorated by belchings. Pressing abdominal pains, low,
spreading towards the back.
Back - Vertebral growth dystrophy in children. Dorsal pain accompanied by a sensation of heat and
headaches.
Blood - Chlorosis, anemia in young girls. Biermer's anemia. Increase of red blood corpuscles, hemoglobin.
Acceleration of the sedimentation rate.
Chest - Pain on the left side of the chest, aggravated by respiration.
Ears - Noise like roaring in the ears. Deafness. Edema of the ear.
Eyes - Purulent conjunctivitis. Interstitial keratitis. Iritis. Inflammation of the choroid and retina. Eyelids heavy,
swollen. Sensation of sand in the eyes. Boring pain around the left eye. Sensation of a veil over the eyes,
when writing. Vision complaints, cannot focus for close work.
Female - Metrorrhagia. Secondary amenorrhea. Kraurosis of the vulva. Stenosis and atresia of the neck of the
uterus. Hemorrhagic metritis. Uterine fibroids. Sclera-cystic inflammation of the ovary. Recurring miscarriage.
Sterility. Frigidity. Lack of libido. .,
Food - Appetite diminished.. Desire for fried potatoes and fluids.
Head - Frontal pressing headache with feeling of the skull sunken above the eyes. Itching of the scalp. Head
 numb, as though tied by a band. Sensation of heat in the head with icy cold feet.
Heart - Palpitations with sensation of rolling below the ribs. Pericardial effusion. Shivering in the evening,
exhausting fever and nightly perspiration. Cyanosis of the limbs of the hands and feet. Pericarditis. Aortitis
(syphilitic). Arteritis (syphilitic).
Kidneys - Pain in the kidneys. Bladder sensitive with urging and involuntary urination. Urine dark, odor of
garlic.
Limbs - Arthritis. Charcot's joints. Pseudo- tabes from arthritis of the vertebral joints. Legs heavy, painful,
especially in the morning. Limping with numbness of the legs as after walking or from exercise. Feet icy cold.
Lungs - Cortical pleurisy.
Male - Sexual asthenia. Impotence. Absence of spermatozoa in the semen. Orchitis and syphilitic orchi-
epidydimitis. Blood tumors.
Modalities - Better in the afternoon and evening. Better from eructation. Worse in the morning, on rising.
Mouth - Vesicles around the lips. Mouth and throat dry. Need to clear the throat. Difficult swallowing. Sensation
of swelling and inflammation of the gums. Pain in the gums and around the sockets of absent teeth.
Nose - Snuffling with frequent sneezing and tickling feeling in the nose. Purulent coryza. Sudden nosebleeds.
Rectum - Diarrhea in the morning with tenesmus. Stools soft, yellow and copious or hard in balls.
Skin - Vesicular eruption, palms of the hands. Urticarial eruptions, aggravated after midnight. Skin discolored.
Skin has cancerous tendency. Dryness ofthe palms. Sudamina. Vitiligo.
Sleep - Sleep deep, but unrefreshing. ’Troubled dreams of falling from a height or obscene or unpleasant.
Wakes tired with the need for more sleep.
Stomach - Nausea in the morning with eructation and headache. Sensation of acidity and emptiness in the
stomach after eating. Gastric pains.
Vertigo - Vertigoon rising, cannot stand up, aggravated by moving the head.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ferr. - Congestive headache, paleness of mucus membranes, pains in the bones,
amenorrhea with vicarious hemorrhage, nosebleeds, or hemoptysis. (2) Merc. - Slow thinking with bad memory
for names. Weakness with trembling hands. Alveolar pyorrhea. Menses profuse with blood and large clots.
Nightly pains in the bones. (3) Syph. - Memory complaints and difficulty in concentrating. Nightly lightning pains
in the bones. Hardening of the genital organs. Frequent need to wash the hands.
REFERENCES - Julian.
