name: Coffea Cruda
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - coff. Coffea erada. Unroasted coffee. Coffea arabica. N. O. Rubiacie. Tincture fromraw berries.
Tincture of dried seeds. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - After-pains. Anxiety. Asthma. Chills. Colic. Convulsions. Delirium tremens. Dentitions. Diarrhea.
Ear, neuralgia. Ecstasy. Excitement. Fainting. Fever. Flatulence. Fright. Headaches. Heart, disorders.
 Hernia. Hyperactivity. Hypertension. Hyperesthesia. Hysteria. Insomnia. Labor, pains. Leucorrhea.
Metrorrhagia. Neuralgias. Nymphomania. Over-sensitiveness. Pain, severe. Palpitations. Prosopalgia.
Sciatica. Shocks. Sleeplessness. Strokes. Toothaches. Unconsciousnes. Vertigo. Vomiting.
HERBAL - The effects of Coffea cruda have to be considered separately from those of Coffea tosta, since the
roasting converts much of the caffeine into caffeone or methylamine, which gives coffee its aroma. But the
effects are very similar.
HOMEOPATHIC - The provings of Coff. were made with the raw berries. Coff. belongs to the same family as
Chin, and Ip., and like these remedies has many symptoms like intermittent fever. It has been noticed that
coffee-drinkers with malaria are more difficult to cure than those who do not drink coffee.
Over excitable and over sensitive nerves, special senses become over acute. Hyperactivity of mind and
body. Sudden emotions, especially joy and pleasurable surprise, can produce dangerous symptoms.
Severe insomnia. Great nervous agitation and restlessness. Hysteria, screaming weeping. Convulsions of
teething children with grinding of the teeth and coldness of the limbs. Convulsions from excessive playing or
laughing in weakly children.
Skin hypersensitive. Touch, noise, odors, pain become intolerable. Neuralgia in various parts, always with
great nervous excitability. Intolerance of pain, driving to despair. Nervous palpitations.
Stimulates the functional activity of all organs increasing the nervous and vascular activity. Sensation of
warmth.
Coffee drinking is likely to increased production of uric acid, causing irritation of kidneys, muscle and joint
pains, and should be curtailed or careful watching in the elderly as they are more susceptible to the stimulating
action of coffee or tea.
Clarke noted that although it is believed that coffee antidotes almost all homeopathic medicines, it is doubtful
whether it could do so, especially when remedies are given in high potency. Experience shows that correctly
selected homeopathic remedies act in spite of taking coffee.
MIND - Clearness of mind in evening, at night. Unusual activity of mind and body. Full of ideas, quick to act.
Easy comprehension, irritability, excited, senses acute. Sentimental. Faints easily. Fright from sudden
pleasant surprise. Complaints from fright. Ailments from disappointed love. Ailments from excessive laughing
and playing. Trembles.
Clinging to persons or furniture. Confusion during paroxysm of pain. Tossing about
Coffea cruda in anguish (Aeon.). Throws things about. Pains seem intolerable, driving to despair with
weeping. Fear of death during labor or after-pains. Fear of death from pains. Fear of danger on falling asleep.
Fear of fresh air. Pangs of conscience. Weeps, laments and tosses about, over trifles.
Immoderate activity and vigour. Increased feeling of energy and health. Ecstasy. Buoyancy. Great loquacity,
brain feels clear and is active, he feels strong enough to do anything. Hasty eating and drinking. Hurried in
movements. Memory becomes very acute. Memory active until midnight. Wakeful, full of ideas. Lively
fancies, full of plans for the future. Theorizing. Weeping from delight.
Capriciousness. Cry and laugh easily. Now joyous now gloomy. Mental and physical exhaustion. Delirium
tremens, with trembling of hands. Thinks that he is not at home, restlessness. Annoyed by voices. Resents
sympathy. Weeping during headache, during menses.
All senses more acute, reads fine print easier. Hearing, smell, taste and touch acute. Excitement as if hurried.
Sensitive to noises, even if anyone walks across the floor. Fear of least noise. Impressionable to pleasurable
impressions. Unconsciousness, fainting after strong emotions. Unconsciousness during childbirth.
Abdomen - Flatulence. Intolerance of tight clothing. Clothes are oppressive. Abdominalpains with
despair.Tensionof epigastric region, with sensitivity to touch. Colic, which seems to be unendurable. Pains
as if abdomen would burst. Pressure in abdomen as from incarcerated flatus. Distended abdomen, extreme
emaciation. Incarcerated hernia.
Back - Small of back as if lame, while sitting or standing.
Breasts - Agalactia. Emaciation of breasts.
Breast cysts from coffee drinking.
Causations - Effects of sudden emotion, especially pleasurable ones. Ill effects of fear, fright, disappointed
love, over fatigue, excessive laughing, long journey. Wine. Slight passive movements are perceived as
enormous, children at times
cannot bear to be carried about.
Chest - Sharp pains in sides during cough.
Constitutions - Complaints during infancy and dentition. Suited to tall, lean, and stooping persons with dark
complexions. Sanguine choleric temperament.
Cough - Short, dry cough of measles in nervous, delicate children. Short, dry, hacking, constant, [5] as from
 constriction of larynx. [4] Cough and sleeplessness after measles. Feels exhausted after coughing. [5] Irritable,
nervous, at night, with anxiety and sleeplessness. [11] Irritation tocough, with coryza, worse open air. Single,
sudden shocks, quickly following each other. From irritation in throat, phlegm in back part of throat. When
falling asleep or soon after. Dry, hacking, like whooping cough, with this difference, that the spasms are
principally experienced during inspirations, not during expirations.
Ears - Sensitive hearing. Noise is painful, even footsteps. Sensitive to noise, music, voices. Hearing acute,
overhears distant sounds. Hardness of hearing with buzzing as of a swarm of bees. Noises and singing in
ears, with nervous people. Crackling noise in head, synchronous with pulse, worse mornings and in open air,
better indoors.
Eyes - Burning in eyes and throbbing in temples, during sick headache. Eyes half open during sleep, with
convulsive motion of eyes when awake. Eyes reddish and shining. Pupils dilated. Bright eyes. Can read fine
print more distinctly. Power of vision increased, esp. in open air. Scintillations. Dim vision during cough.
Face - Shining red face with much fever. Flushed face during sick headache. Transitory flushes in face. One
cheek hot and red, with constant shuddering. Dry heat with red cheeks. Acfiing, sharp, radiating pains.
Prosopalgia extending to molar teeth, ears, forehead and scalp. Sweat on face with internal chilliness.
Female - Menses too early and long lasting. Profuse menses with excessive sensitiveness of organs and
voluptuous itching. Dysmenorrhea, large clots of blackblood,
with extreme sensitiveness of genitals. Toothache during menses. Bearing down in genitals with frequent
urination. Metrorrhagia. Severe after pains or labor pains with fear of death. Voluptuous itching in the vulva.
Hypersensitive vulva and vagina. Vagina and vulva are too sensitive to rub or scratch, aversion to sex.
Leucorrhea like mucus, or milky, worse while urinating. Severe after-pains or labor pains, with fear of death.
Labor-pains ceasing, with loquacity. Irregular, ineffectual labor-pains. Puerperal fever from mental excitement.
Nymphomania.
Food - Diminished appetite. Hasty eating and drinking. Excessive hunger. Aversion to coffee. Bad effects from
wine and liquor. Bad effects from drinking too much wine. Thirst increased, esp. at night. Worse from
drinking too much coffee. Thirst during sweat. Headache from eating too much.
Head - Headaches from mental overexertion, thinking or talking. Sensation as if brain were torn to pieces. As
if a nail were driven into the head. Sensation as if brain is shattered or crushed. Headaches worse motion,
noise, music or light. Tight pain, worse from noise, smell, narcotics. Head feels too small. Feels and hears a
cracking in vertex. Coffee and caffeine headaches (Cham.). Temples throbbing with burning in eyes. Pains
driving to despair, patient runs wildly about room. Rush of blood to head, after exhausting joy. Threatening
apoplexy. Hyperemia of brain after abuse of Bell.
Heart - Violent irregular palpitations, especially after excessive joy or surprise. Nervous palpitation with
trembling of limbs, worse sun, heat. Hypertension. Sudden rise of blood pressure and urinary suppression.
Pulse full and frequent. Pulse intermitting. Pulse more frequent, but less vigorous, even small and weak.
Kidneys - Suppression of urine. Frequent, profuse urination of colorless urine. Pressure on bladder. Urine
passes off drop by drop.
Limbs - Trembling of hands, cannot hold the pen. Twitching of limbs. Crural neu-
ralgia, worse motion afternoon and night, better by pressure. Pain in limbs, worse noise. Coldness of limbs,
hands and feet. Sciatica, worse motion, afternoon and night with restlessness and sleeplessness at night.
Lungs - Short, dry cough of measles in nervous, delicate children. Asthmatic attacks in morning, wants to
move continually. Short inspiration, chest heaves visibly. Suffocative fits.
Male - Hypersensitiveness of sexual organs. Scrotum relaxed. Hot, itching genitals. Emissions at night,
followed by great languor and irritability of temper. Greatly excited sexual desire, with dry heat of body.
Modalities - Better warmth. Better from lying down, sleep. Better cold drinks. Better holding ice in mouth.
Worse excessive excitement. Worse strong emotions, joy. Worse mental exertion. Worse overeating.
Worse alcohol, wine, narcotics. Worse from strong odors, noise. Worse open air. Worse cold, wind. Worse
from touch, would like to rub the part but it is too sensitive. Worse at night, sleeps until 3 a.m. Warm drinks
aggravate toothache.
Mouth - Excessive dryness of mouth at night. Hot breath. Taste more acute. Delicate taste. Taste sweetish.
Loss of taste. Salivation during pregnancy. Hasty eating and drinking.
Nose - Acute, sensitive smell. Nosebleed with heaviness of head and ill humor during straining at stool.
Perspiration - Cold, clammy sweat, over whole body, but chiefly on palms of hands. Slight sweat, mostly in
face.
Rectum - Constant alternations of constipation and diarrhea. Constipation and hemorrhoids. Constipation in
sick headache. Diarrhea, watery, painless all day. Diarrhea in housewives from too much care about domestic
affairs. Diarrhea during dentition, after the use of chamomile tea. Hemorrhoidal conditions. Spasmodic
 contraction of sphincter, with burning and itching in anus. Fetid flatus. Liquid, fecal, offensive stools, from
sudden joy or taking cold in open air.
Sensations - As if head too small, as if something hard pressing on surface of brain, as if head would burst
and fly to pieces if she moved. As if intestines were being cut. As if body would burst. Tight pains and
sensations. Sensation of warmth.
Skin - Skin very sensitive, eruptions become extremely irritable. Painfully sensitive. Itching, scratches until it
bleeds. Itching of eruption changes into burning. Measly spots on the skin, with dry heat. Purple miliary
eruptions all over. Scarlet fever, may aid in bringing out the eruption in cases of extreme wakefulness and
nervous excitement. Scarlet rash with overwhelming pains and lamenting. Varicella, smallpox. Dryness of skin,
but not in febrile diseases. Stinging and smarting on skin.
Sleep - Restless sleep, frequent, sudden starting and waking. Nervous sleeplessness. Insomnia.
Sleeplessness, before or after midnight, from nursing the sick. Sleeps until 3 a.m., after which only dozing.
Sleeplessness from excessive use of coffee. Wakes with a start, sleep disturbed by dreams. Sleepless,
on account of mental activity, flow of ideas. Disturbed sleep from itching of anus. Sleeplessness after
pleasurable excitement. Sleepless with nervous excitability. Sleepless so long as any noise or light
continues, at night. Sleeplessness after acute diseases. Long and vivid dreams. Pleasant dreams, even merry.
Stomach - Intolerance of tight clothing. Bilious vomiting and restlessness at commencement of variola. Gastric
derangements of infants. Anguish and pressure in stomach pit. Burning in stomach during vertigo. Stomach
feels over loaded during colic. Burning, sour eructations. Hiccoughs. Eructation like rotten eggs. Violent
spasmodic eructations, with rising of the ingesta. Continual nausea during headache. Constant inclination to
vomit, felt in throat. Vomiting of mucus during violent attacks of megrim.
Teeth - Dentition of anemic, sensitive children. Convulsive grinding of teeth. Toothache during menses.
Toothache,
Coffea cruda
better holding ice water in mouth, worse as it warms. Severe toothache, intolerant of the pain with
restlessness, anxiety and weeping.
Temperature - Chilliness worse every movement. Internal chills with external heat of face and body. Chills
with heat of head and sweat of face. Chills running down back. Running all through limbs. Shivering, from least
exposure to cold air. Chills without thirst. Traumatic fever. Even with mild fever patient is very nervous and
sensitive. Ague, paroxysms every fourth day, two well days intervening. Intermittent fever. Feverish with pain
and always ready to weep.
Throat - Sore throat, worse cold air. Sore throat, parts very sensitive. Swelling and painfulness of throat, worse
swallowing. Pain as from a plug with constant desire to swallow. Uvula too long, swollen. Larynx as if covered
with dry mucus. Trachea as if raw. Roughness and hoarseness in larynx, in morning on waking. Spasm of
glottis, starts from sleep with short inhalation or gasping.
Vertigo - Dizziness and confusion in the head. Vertigo with blackness before eyes. Vertigo when stooping.
Vertigo during cough. Vertigo with whirling sensation in head, occasionally a general faint feeling, worse
thinking. Vertigo with burning in stomach. Vertigo during sick headache, worse change of position or from
moderate outdoor exercise.
COMMENTS - Teste grouped Coff. with Caust. He remarked that potentized Coff. prevents or neutralizes in
many persons the effects of roasted coffee. Teste noted that this quasi-isopathic action is by no means
confined to Coff., potentizations of many other drugs being antidotal to secondary effects of the crude
substances.
Hahnemann described the migraine of coffee-drinkers thus: “It comes in the morning after waking increasing
little by little. The pain becomes intolerable and sometimes burning integument of head very sensitive and
painful on slightest touch. Body and mind excessively sensitive. Patients look exhausted, retire to dark places,
close their
Coffea cruda eyes to avoid light of day, remain seated in an armchair or stretched on a bed.
“The least noise or motion excites the pain. They avoid talking, being talked to or hearing others talk. The body
is colder than usual though no chills are experienced, the hands and feet are especially cold.
“They loathe everything, especially food and drink, on account of a continual sickness at the stomach. If the
attack is very violent a vomiting of mucus takes place, which, however, does notrelieve the headache. There
are no alvine discharges. This kind of megrim scarcely ever leaves before evening.
“If the paroxysm is less violent, a little strong coffee which was the first cause of such a headache will produce
a temporary palliation of the pain, but the disposition to relapse becomes so much greater.
The attacks come irregularly, every fortnight or every few weeks without any apparent cause and quite
suddenly, so much so that the patient often does not feel a single unpleasant symptom the evening preceding
 the attack. Such a headache has never been seen by me except in real coffee-drinkers.”
More recently. Dr. Gilles de la Tourette (Lancet, July 20, 1895) has described the effects of coffee. In his
opinion they are very frequently mistaken for the effects of alcohol.
“Morning vomiting of glairy mucus, pain in the pit of the stomach, thickly-coated tongue, loss of appetite. The
disgust excited by even the idea of solid food is such that these patients eat nothing else but bread soaked in
their poison—coffee. There supervene then nausea, vomiting and painful acid belchings.”
The effects of coffee are less deep than those of alcohol and quickly disappear when the habit is discontinued.
Characteristic exaltation of the senses and sensibility in general (Aeon.). Sight is improved, fine print can be
read easily, hearing is more acute and noises are intolerable and are accompanied with fear of death. The
mental activities are exalted. Great sensitiveness to touch or contact.
Nervous energy, anxious, wide awake, and hypersensitive to all light and noise, any stimulus. Ailments due to
over-excitement (Arg-n., Phos.), pleasant surprises, joy. Happy excitement. Very sensitive to the cold and the
wind.
Over excitement from severe pain, hypersensitive to the pain. Frets over the pain. Cannot stand the pain, pain
out of proportion. Pain leads to sleeplessness and over excitability. An emergency remedy for amputation pain
and severe nerve pain with burning.
Tendency to be intellectual, very quick minded, clear thinkers with brilliant memories, but can't turn their
sensitivity off, an increased nervous system. Voracious mental appetite (Sulph.). Hyperactivity.
Severe insomnia from an overactive mind. Sleep is disturbed by terrifying dreams. Slowed pulse. Headaches
(Cham, for coffee headache). One-sided headaches with the sensation as if a nail was being pounded in (Ign.,
Thuja, Anae., Nux-v.), usually right over the eye. Sense of lightness of movement, the head feels light, full of
vigor.
Ringing in the ears or a roaring sensation in the head. For teething and toothache. Tendency to colic. Diarrhea
in housewives who have much care and trouble in managing their households. Labor pains.
RELATIONS - Antidotes: Nux-v., Coff., Tab. Strong black coffee, drunk as hot as possible is indispensable
as an antidote in a large number of poisons, especially narcotics. Hot coffee by rectum in cases of extreme
collapse. Compare: (1) Coff-t. (2) Cypr. - ecstasy. (3) Bry. and Cham. - toothache better by cold. (4) Aeon. -
predicts hour of death. Coca, Codeine. Complementary: Aeon. Incompatible: Camph., Cocc.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.
keynote:
PHARMACY - coff. Coffea erada. Unroasted coffee. Coffea arabica. N. O. Rubiacie. Tincture fromraw berries.
Tincture of dried seeds. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - After-pains. Anxiety. Asthma. Chills. Colic. Convulsions. Delirium tremens. Dentitions. Diarrhea.
Ear, neuralgia. Ecstasy. Excitement. Fainting. Fever. Flatulence. Fright. Headaches. Heart, disorders.
 Hernia. Hyperactivity. Hypertension. Hyperesthesia. Hysteria. Insomnia. Labor, pains. Leucorrhea.
Metrorrha

name: Coffea Tosta
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - coff-t. Coffea tosta. Roasted coffee berries. N. O. Rubiacae. Infusion of the well-roasted berries.
Historical dose: Tritura- tion and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Antidote, poisons. Chills. Cholera. Delirium tremens. Diarrhea. Fainting. Fever. Headaches.
Heart, disorders. Hemorrhoids. Hyperesthesia. Insomnia. Labor, pains. Migraine. Nervousness. Neuritis.
Pains. Palpitations. Seminal, emissions. Toothaches. Urinary, disorders. Vertigo. Vomiting.
HERBAL - The roasting of coffee develops certain vitamin-like substances. Pigeons which had developed
“deficiency” neuritis and paralysis on diet of polished rice lost their disabilities on the addition of 8 cc to a 5%
infusion of coffee to their food. Unroasted coffee was useless.
HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of Coff-t. have been principally obtained from sensitive persons on whom
strong coffee has acted injuriously and the clinical uses have been mainly based on these. But there is a
definite and extensive proving of Coff-t. given in Allen. While it is often given in the form of black coffee, it is
also available for use in the potencies.
Coff-t. is serviceable against both cold and heat. Beneficial to persons who live in the open air. Toothache,
better by cold (Coff.), “cold water better intense pain in sound teeth of right lowerjaw.” Clarke has several
times cured a toothache like this with Coff. 30c.
Heart disorders with troublesome palpitations from heart-irritability and in general nervous excitement. Tense
arteries. Periodic headaches in hysterical women. Nervous and gastric headaches.
Vomiting on least exertion. Diarrhea from overwork and too much care. Gout and rheumatism with tendency
to form chalkstone. Labor pains are intolerable. Useful in confinements to relieve the excess of suffering
which some women experience.
Body and mind excessively sensitive. Looks exhausted, retires to lonely and dark places and closes eyes in
order to avoid light. Least noise or motion excites pains. Avoids talking or being talked to or hearing others
talk. Body colder than usual, although no chills are experienced. Hands and feet very cold.
MIND - Increased intellectual activity and perception of sounds, motion. Great excitement. Full of apprehension
of terrible things happening. Depression and despair. Thinks she will die during labor. Begs that some one
 might end her life. Strange feeling in her head with palpitations, trembling and chilliness. Doesn't know where
she is. Delirium tremens.
Abdomen - Cramplike drawing pains in umbilical region with severe pains in lumbar region. Pains in abdomen
during labor.
Ears - Ringing and noises as if falling rain, during vertigo.
Eyes - Shining bright eyes during labor. Sees dazzling colors, principally blue and yellow, before eyes.
Face - Pale face during vertigo with fainting. Face hot and deeply flushed, during labor. Excruciating facial
neuralgia from decayed teeth.
Female - Very severe labor pains. Patient becoming greatly excited, constant tossing about with violent
movements of limbs, she complains of the severity of pains and is sure she will die. After rupture of bag of
waters, very severe pains in lumbar region.
Food - Loathes all food and drinks on account of continual nausea.
Head - Nervous and gastric headaches. Periodical headaches of hysterical women. Migraine coming on in
morning shortly after awaking. Pains increasing little by little. Pains become intolerable. Burning pains. Coffee
and caffeine headaches (Cham.). Scalp sensitive, hurts when touched ever so slightly. Headaches come on
irregularly, without premonitory symptoms. If headache attack is very violent, vomiting of mucus, which doesn't
diminish the pain. Headaches worse least
noise or motion.
Heart - Palpitations from irritable heart. Small and frequent pulse, during labor. Arteries tense.
Kidneys - Assists the passage of gravel and small urinary calculi, and impedes their further formation in
bladder. Catarrh of bladder, especially of old debauchees. Diabetes mellitus.
Limbs - Gout and rheumatism, where there is a disposition to the formation of chalk- stones in joints. Pains in
left shoulder-joint. Trembling of hands. Iliac pains. Pains in left foot and joint of big toe.
Lungs - Spasmodic asthma. Asthma thy- micum. Whooping cough.
Male - Seminal emission at 3 a.m. Seminal emission with voluptuous itching, followed by chill and cold, clammy
sweat.
Modalities - Worse least noise. Worse light. Worse motion.
Rectum - Diarrhea from overwork or too much worry. Obstinate diarrhea of elderly people occurring after an
attack of cholera. Chronic diarrhea. Hemorrhoidal complaints.
Sleep - Nervous andrestless sleep. Obstinate sleeplessness. Insomniafrom overactivity of the mind.
Sleepless from sensitivity to noise, light.
Stomach - Tight feeling in stomach after eating. Cramp of stomach. Vomits without least exertion. Epidemic
cholera, particularly against the weakening vomiting and tormenting thirst, and it was useful in subduing the
premonitory symptoms.
Teeth - Intense pain in sound teeth of right lower jaw nearly driving him crazy. No application relieves except
cold water in mouth. Toothache returns as water becomes warm. Premature decay of teeth in children.
Temperature - Feels chilly, without being cold, and trembles. Intermittent fever. Continued fever with
disposition to diarrhea. Inflammatory fever in children with excitability, starting and twitching in sleep,
restlessness and crying.
Vertigo - Vertigo comes in attacks. Vertigo with obscured vision, unable to distinguish surrounding objects.
Vertigo with ringing
in ears and noise as of falling rain. Vertigo, suddenly falls to the ground insensible. Vertigo with palpitation of
heart. Vertigo with easy vomiting and paleness of face during paroxysms.
COMMENTS - Its value is well known as an allopathic antidote to opium and its derivatives in poisonous doses.
Additionally, it counteracts the effects of Nux-v., Bell., Coloc., Valer., Cic., Cham., Phos, Ph-ac., lead. Salts of
Antimony, narcotic mushrooms, poisonous sumac, tobacco, bitter almonds, and prussic acid.
On account of its extensive antidotal properties coffee has largely been condemned by homeopathic
practitioners, but it should be remembered that it does not antidote all remedies.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Caps., Cham., Coff. Crud., Nux-v. Compare: (1 ) Coff. crud.. Caffeine. (2)
Cham., Nux-v., Valer.,
REFERENCES - Clarke. Murphy.

name: Colchicinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - colchin. Colchicinum. Colchicine. Alkaloid of Colchicum autumnale. Trituration. Historical
dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Arthritis. Convulsive, jerkings. Diarrhea. Exhaustion. Fevers. Gout. Intestinal, catarrh. Pleurisy.
 Prostration. Rheumatic, fever. Rheumatism. Sleeplessness. Spasms.
HOMEOPATHIC - This colchine alkaloid has been proved and the symptoms are sufficiently distinctive. The
symptoms point strongly to its use in that form of intestinal catarrh characterized by the appearance of shreddy
membranes.
Arthritis deformans in early stages. Intense pain of rheumatism. Rheumatic fever, gout. Convulsive jerkings
of right hand. Endocarditis and pericarditis. Pleurisy. Very great exhaustion increasing to feverish excitement.
Abdomen - Distention and sensitiveness. Frequent rumbling.
Eyes - Pupils widely dilated.
Face - Tearing pains in face.
Kidneys - Urine turbid, depositing a copious white sediment.
Limbs - Convulsive jerkings of right hand.
Mouth - Increased secretion of saliva.
Pulse - Pulse during the first two hours sank about eleven beats.
Rectum - Urging, causing him to leave the bed. Copious pasty evacuation. Stools with tenesmus and
consisting of a thin fluid with numerous flakes looking like cooked egg white in pieces from two to four inches
long. Stools thin, yellowish green, slimy, accompanied by pain. Liquid stools.
Sleep - Awakened from sleep soon after midnight by uneasy dreams. Somnolency and collapse.
Stomach - Pains and sensitiveness in epigastrium. On rising from bed, at night, nausea suddenly increased
and was followed by vomiting of undigested food, and afterwards of a bitter greenish fluid. Vomiting early in
the morning. Vomiting of blood for nine or ten days.
Temperature - Chill about noon on first day, followed by violent heat lasting several hours with increased thirst,
very rapid pulse, confusion of the head, uneasiness and sleeplessness.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ars., Caust., Colch.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Colchicum Autumnale
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - colch. Colchicum autumnale. Meadow saffron. N. O. Melanthacae of the Liliaceae.
Colchicaceae. Tincture of the bulb dug in spring. The flowers of the plant appear in autumn, the leaves not
until the following spring. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Appendicitis. Arthritis. Ascites. Asiatic, cholera. Asthma. Backache. Bright’s
disease. Cataracts. Cholera. Colic. Colitis. Coryza. Coughs. Cramps. Debility. Dehydration. Delirium.
Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dyspnea. Dysentery. Eye, disorders. Feet, painful. Flatulence. Gout.
Headache. Heart, disorders. Hydrothorax. Ileus. Intermittent, fever. Intestinal, catarrh.
Iritis. Joint, pains. Lumbago. Memory weak. Morning sickness. Muscle, pains. Nausea. Nephritis. Night-
watching. Nosebleed. Pericarditis. Pleurodynia. Proctalgia. Prostatitis. Prostration. Rectum, prolapsed.
Rheumatism. Smell, acute. Sneezing. Stiff- neck. Styes. Suppressed sweat. Tongue, sensation
lost.Torticollis. Typhlitis. Typhoid, fever. Uric aciddiathesis. Urticaria. Vertigo. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Colchicum is best known as a remedy for gout and rheumatism. It markedly affects
muscles, fibrous tissue, serous membranes, and joints, especially the small ones.
Colch. relieves gouty paroxysms. Red, hot and swollen parts. Tearing pain, worse in the evening, at night, and
from touch. Stubbing the toes hurts exceedingly.
Many joints are affected at the same time. Small, rapidly shifting areas of severe pain, but little swelling. Pains
are tearing, digging, drawing. Tingling, crawling. Stitching, jerking, drawing pains in muscles, periosteum and
joints. Pains worse from mental exertion, emotions, slightest touch and vibrations.
There is the irritability and aversion to touch so common in gout, pain in small joints and especially the great
toes. Affects the periosteum and synovial membranes of joints.
The stomach is acutely disordered, nausea and vomiting. Nausea at thought, sight or smell of food,
especially of cooking. Dysentery. Uric acid diathesis, pale yellow sediment like fine flour. Urine black as
ink. Urine loaded with albumen and casts.
Extreme relaxation of the muscular system, the head falls forward on the chest or falls back when the patient
is raised from the pillow, arms fall helpless by the side. Great prostration, internal coldness.
Tendency to collapse. Moist collapse, due to dehydration, as after repeated vomiting or purging. Cardiac and
arthritic disorders. Dropsy. Hydropericardium, hydrothorax, ascites, hydrometra. The patient must rest and lie
down. Cannot lie on left side.
Effects of night-watching and over study.
Shocks as from electricity through one half
 of body. Bad effects from suppressed sweat. Dreams of mice.
MIND - Mind befogged, but answers correctly. Intellect beclouded, though he gives correct answers. Mind
generally distracted. Can read, but cannot understand a short sentence. Memory weak. Weakness of memory
from fatigue. Deficiency of ideas. Disorders in comprehension and association of ideas. Lacks words to
express ideas. When writing, forgets syllables and entire words. Confounds objects.
Very irritable with the pains (Cham.). Pains worse mental exertion or by emotions. Intolerant of pain, his
suffering seem unendurable . Depressed, irritable and sensitive. Peevish, nothing satisfies him.
Discontented, not satisfied with anything. Misdeeds of others make him quite beside himself.
Extreme impressions such as bright light, strong odors, contact aggravate him. Sensitive to all external
impressions. Hatred of odors. Frequent starting and trembling are felt through body.
Delirium during headache. Starting during sleep. Delusions, sees mice, hears noises. Vision heightened, but
intellectual faculties dulled. Carphologia. Sardonic laughing. Indifference, doesn't complain unless questioned,
then says nothing of his condition. Absence of apprehension, no fear of death. Abdomen - Mucus colitis, after
dysentery.
Pain in transverse colon. Distention of abdomen. Distended cecum and ascending colon. Fullness and
continuous rumbling. Borborygmi. Colicky pains. Colic, worse eating, after flatulent food, with great
distension, better bending double. Icy coldness of abdomen with colic. Ascites with fold over the pubic
region. Surface of abdomen hotter than rest of body and extremely sensitive to touch. Pulsation in abdomen.
Pain over liver. Tearing pain about sigmoid flexure of colon, worse pressure and at night. Griping pains.
Back - Backache, better rest and pressure. Lumbago. Aching in lumbar and lumbosacral region. Ache better
pressure and rest. Tension in neck muscles felt even on swallowing. Violent pain in region of
kidneys, better lying on back only. Dull pain across loins. Spot on sacrum feels sore and bruised as if ulcerated,
very sensitive to touch. Stinging and tension between scapulae. Torticollis.
Breasts - Breast full, skin hot, pulse strong. Tearing, lancinating pain, deep in right breast, extending to back.
Nipples dark, brownish-red, protruding. Nipples, unbearable pain on slightest touch by child.
Causations - Bad effects of grief, nightwatching, over study. Misbehavior of others. Getting wet. Suppressed
sweat. Complaints from getting overheated.
Chest - Violent cutting pains, interruptirig breathing. Stinging and tearing pains in muscles of chest. Chest as
if squeezed by a tight band. Tensive feeling in chest. Sharp pain in chest on inspiration and coughing.
Lacerating, tearing pain in chest. Lancinating pain, as with a knife, in right side of chest. Dull stitches in
posterior part of thorax during expiration. Pleurodynia from catching cold or from living in damp dwellings.
Serous effusion in chest with rheumatic and gouty persons. Hydrothorax, with marked dyspnea and edema of
limbs. Spitting blood after chest injuries. Rheumatism of pectoral muscles.
Constitutions - Complaints of old people, asthmatic people. It corresponds to the gouty constitution. Leuco-
phlegmatic and melancholic, venous constitutions, uric acid diathesis.
Cough - Frequent, short, dry cough from tickling in larynx. Cough at night, compelling him to sit up, excited by
scraping in chest, with much expectoration. Cough at night, with involuntary spurting of urine. Slight cough
with coryza.
Ears - Itching, crawling in ears. Dryness of ears. Ears feel stopped up with roaring. Tingling of ears as after
being frosted. Sharp, shooting, below right tragus. Earache with lacerating pains. Earache with discharge.
Hearing very acute.
Eyes - Eyes sunken, staring, hollow, congested, protruding. Diffused inflammation and congestion. Pain in
and around the eyeball extending to occiput. Eyes half
open. Visible contraction in lower lid. Acrid tears, worse in open air. Violent tearing pain in eyes. Edges of lids
red and burning. Soft cataract. Kerato-iritis, with pus in anterior chamber of eye. Rheumatic iritis with great
soreness of eyeballs. Stye on left lower lids. Ulceration of meibomian glands. Pupils unequal, left pupil
contracted.
Face - Edematous swelling, cheeks red, hot, sweaty. Edema of lids and face. Pinched, sunken as in collapse.
Sickly, sad, suffering expression. Pain in facial muscles, moving about. Tingling and edematous swelling,
cheeks red, hot, sweaty. Pain behind angle of right lower jaw. Very irritable with the pains (Cham.). Tingling
in face as after being frozen. Cheeks, lips and eyelids purple. Risus sardonicus. Blotchy papular rash on face.
Female - Menses too early and scanty. Itching of genitals. Sensation of swelling in vulva and clitoris. Coldness
of thighs after menses. Feverish restlessness in last month of pregnancy. Intense boring or tensive pain in
ovary, must bend double, with great restlessness. Dropsy of uterus from suppression of menses. Hemorrhage
of uterus. Morning sickness with sensitivity to the smell of food (Sep.). Puerperal fever.
Food - Gags from mere mention of food. Craving for various things but averse to them when smelling them.
Loathes the smell or sight of food, better lying quietly. Nausea and anxiety from smell of cooking, or from
 fat food. Nausea from odor of fat meat, eggs, fish. Eggs disagree cause derangement of stomach.
Tastelessness of food. Thirst for effervescent, aerated waters, alcoholic beverages. No thirst.
Head - Difficulty in moving head. Creeping in forehead and over head. Pressive headache, better supper,
warmth, lying quiet. Headache chiefly frontal and temporal, but also occipital and in nape of neck, worse
afternoon and evening. Aching in occiput, worse mental effort. Neuralgic, tearing pain in scalp in small spots.
Headache over left eye, worse open air. Hemicrania, either of right or left side, changing about.
Very violent headache, coming in evening and lasting until morning. Hot forehead. Forehead covered
with cold sweat. Great falling off of hair.
Heart - Cardiac dyspnea. Heart disease, following rheumatism. Anxiety in region of heart. Violent palpitations
with oppression of chest. Pressure and oppression in the region of the heart, better walking. Cutting or
stinging at heart, weak heart. Trembling in precordial region, with sticking pains. Sound of heart becomes
weaker, pulse of low tension. Heart disease and rheumatism. Hydropericardium. Pericarditis, with severe
pain, oppression and dyspnea. Effusion into pericardium. Weak heart. Pulse not felt. Pulse is thready,
imperceptible.
Kidneys - Kidney failure with high uric acid. Uremia. Burning in urinary passages before urination. More
urging, more discharge of urine. Diabetes. Nephritis with extreme pain in region of kidneys. Burning in
urethra, as if urine were very warm. Tickling burning in urethra and discharge of a few drops, after urination.
Raw pain, in urethra during urination.
Limbs - Limbs, lame, weak, tingling, cold. Arthritic pain, patient screams with pain on touching a joint.
Joints stiff and hot, shifting rheumatism, pains worse at night. Rheumatic pain in joints of fingers, toes, wrists
and ankles. Painful gout in big toe, cannot bear to have it touched or moved. Pain worse in evening and
warm weather. Tearing in limbs during warm weather, stinging during cold. Sharp pain down left arm. Pins and
needles in hands and wrists, fingertips numb. Tingling in finger-nails. Finger joints distorted, fingers flexed
but in constant motion. Knees knock together, can hardly walk. Buttocks hot. Right plantar reflex abolished.
Edematous swelling and coldness of legs and feet. Bloating of hands andfeet with dysentery. Rheumatism in
spring.
Lungs - Chest seems squeezed by a hand. Night cough with involuntary spurting of urine. Great dyspnea.
Cardiac dyspnea. Dyspnea with palpitations of heart from 11 a.m. to 3 a.m. Lies in bed gasping for
breath, with pericarditis. Difficult breathing, better bending forward. Accelerated and audible breathing. Slow,
irregular breathing. Asthmatic breathing with moist sound. Asthma with hydrothorax or hydropericardium.
Asthma with dropsy of lower limbs. Hurried breathing with groans. Rapid and short, quick breathing.
Male - Edema of scrotum. Tearing in glands and left spermatic cord. Itching at prepuce and orifice of urethra.
Chordee after gonorrhea.
Modalities - Better from warmth. Better rest. Better doubling up. Better sitting. Better stooping. Better after
stools. Better lying quietly. Better open air. Oppression and colic better bending forward. Worse from motion
(Bry.). Can't lie on left side. Worse touch, vibrations. Worse stubbing toes. Worse bodily or mental exertion.
Worse from stretching. Worse checked sweat. Worse vomiting. Worse loss of sleep. Worsefrom smell of
food. Worse at night, evening. Worse sundown to sunrise. Worse from changing weather. Worse cold,
autumn. Symptoms generally worse cold damp, worse getting wet, bathing, living in damp dwellings,
changes to damp weather. Worse from rising up in bed.
Mouth - Sensation of warmth and dryness in mouth. Cracked lips. Thick, brownish coating on lips, teeth and
tongue. Taste, flat, bitter. Flow of saliva with a sense of dryness. Mouth hangs open. Heat in the mouth with
thirst. Profuse salivation with dryness of throat. Affection of salivary glands in Bright's disease. Cold breath.
Lossofspeech. Inflammation and redness of palate and fauces.
Nose - Nostrils dry and black. Smell morbidly acute. Odors of eggs, meat nauseate even to fainting.
Strong odors make him quite beside himself. Smell so acute that he smells odors others can't smell.
Obstinate coryza, discharge thin, tenacious, never watery. Sore pain in septum. Nosebleed, evenings.
Sneezing, with crawling sensation in nose.
Perspiration - Copious, cold sweat, without relief. Copious sour sweat suddenly coming and going with
rheumatism. Sweat
cold on face. Sour sweat, nightly. Clammy sweat on whole surface, with low temperature of skin, in acute
rheumatism. Acid reaction of sweat and urine. Suppressed sweat.
Rectum - Mucus colitis after dysentery. Autumn dysentery, when days are warm and nights are cold.
Hemorrhage from bowels in autumnal, cold, damp weather. Very offensive flatus, in evening. Diarrhea, then
gouty effects. Ineffectual pressing, feels feces in rectum, but cannot expel them. Pain, as if anus were torn
open with prolapse. Agonizing pains remain long after stool. Spasmodic constriction of sphincter, followed
by urging to stool. Unsatisfactory urging to stool, better passing flatus. Tingling, itching, burning and tearing in
 anus. Protrusion of rectum. Obstinate constipation in ileus.
Skin - Skin dry, sweat suppressed or profuse. Blotchy papular rash on face. Pink spots on back, chest and
abdomen. Urticaria. Stitches in skin. Tingling here and there, as after being frozen. Skin dry and pale, swollen,
parts cold and glistening. Dryness of skin. Itching as in nettle-rash, unchanged by scratching. Erysipelas,
smooth. Purple efflorescence on face, neck, and upper anterior part of thorax, inside of thighs, scrotum and
groins in patches.
Sleep - Falls asleep while reading. Lies prostrate on back. Sleeplessness from restlessness of limbs. At
night, disturbed sleep or driven away by pains. Irresistible sleepiness, drowsiness, when not in too much pain.
Drowsiness during day. Starting, jerking in sleep. Frightful dreams, awakening from sleep.
Stomach - Gastric affections before and during an attack of rheumatism. Burning pains. Eructations, with
burning in stomach. Icy coldness of stomach with colic. Pain in stomach and flatulence. Dry mouth, tongue
burns, gums and teeth pain. Profuse salivary secretion. Gouty gastralgia. Gastralgia from sudden suppressed
sweat. Stomach as if full and swollen, as if he had eaten too much. Nausea and retching. Nausea and
inclination to vomit, caused by swallowing saliva. Nausea from odor of
fat meat, eggs, fish. Vomiting of mucus, bile and food, worse any motion. Vomiting of the water he drank.
Vomiting and purging of rice-water stools, with thirst. Vomiting first food, then fluid.
Stools - Changeable stools, greenish, reddish, excoriating, slightly sour smelling, copious, frequent, watery
or bilious. Stools are painful, scanty, transparent, jelly-like mucus. Bloody stools. Stools scanty, discharged
only by hard straining, even if soft, with pain in lumbar region. Stools contain white shreddy particles in
large quantities. Stools frequently orange-yellow, slimy with bright-yellow flakes. Scanty stool with tenesmus,
salivation and copious urination. Stools pass insensibly, involuntary. Feces mixed with light blue matter.
Profuse watery stools in hot, damp weather.
Teeth - Gums and teeth painful. Teeth very sensitive when pressing them together. Grinding of teeth. Teeth
feel too long. Tearing pain in roots of teeth and gums. Toothache, worse cold and immediately after warm
things. Toothache, worse at night.
Temperature - Chilliness and coldness running through all limbs down back. Shuddering and creeping chills
in isolated parts. Chills even near warm stove, intermingled with short flushes of heat. Cold sensation of head
and limbs, in acute rheumatism. Dry heat at night with excessive thirst. Dry heat of whole body, constantly
increasing and palpitations, thirst. Body hot, limbs cold. Intermittent, fever.
Throat - Much greenish, thin mucus in the throat, comes involuntarily in the mouth. Voice hoarse, ordeeperthan
usual. Hoarseness in morning, with roughness of throat. Itching in larynx and trachea. Throat as if dry.
Constriction of esophagus. Tickling as if coryza were setting in, inducing cough and clearing throat. Tonsils
inflamed and swollen, spots covered with pus, swallowing difficult. Heat in pharynx and whole length of
esophagus.
Tongue - Glossitis. Tongue burns. Tongue, bright red, heavy, stiff and numb, protruded with difficulty. Brown
tongue.
Loss of sensibility in tongue. Tongue cold. Tearing, burning and sticking pain in tongue. Tongue coated white.
Urine - Urine, hot, highly colored, watery, black sediment. Albuminuria. Profuse secretion of urine. Urine of
sour smell and acid reaction. Dark, scanty or suppressed urine. Pale yellow, greenish urine. Urine turbid,
leaves an orange-colored ring in vessel. Bloody, brown, black, inky urine. Whitish sediment in urine.
Vertigo - Vertigo while sitting, after walking. Vertigo on rising.
Vision - Spots before eyes. Variations in visual acuity. Dim vision after reading. Lost vision, for a minute or
two on getting out of bed.
COMMENTS - Coldness in the abdomen, stomach, and limbs. Profuse cold sweat, marked chills with or without
periodicity. Burning in the cavities, especially the abdomen. Sensation of icy coldness or burning in stomach.
Bloated abdomen.
Diarrhea. Cholera. Dysentery with bloody stools and mucus. Autumn dysentery. Spring rheumatism. Dysentery
and rheumatism are exceedingly painful. Stools have jelly-like mucus, membranous shreds. Rice-water stool,
with hippocratic face, coldness, cramps, prostration. Stool accompanied by violent tenesmus. Protrusion of
rectum.
Affinity for the kidneys. Kidney failure with high uric acid. Effective for gout and joint conditions. In gouty
diabetes, the uric acid reappears as the sugar disappears. Rheumatism can appear on disappearance of uric
acid from urine.
Arthritis in the small joints. Stiffness that's better with motion (Rhus-t.). Arthritis, worse motion (Nux-v., Bry.).
Conditions worse in the autumn, damp weather and change of weather (Dulc., Rhus-t., Nat-s.). Cold and chilly,
dampness penetrates. Ailments from getting wet and chilled, changes to damp weather.
Oppression and anxiety in the heart, better by walking. Stitches about heart and loss of consciousness.
 Pericarditis on the disappearance of symptoms from limbs.
All functions, mental and bodily, are slow. Nutrition and digestion are at a stand and
Colchicum autumnale yet the patient does not emaciate rapidly.
Great prostration, debility from loss of sleep, the prostration of typhoid fever and typhoid states. Extreme
disinclination to move, worse from motion. Convulsions, cramps and restlessness. Pains are very acute and
unendurable.
Very sensitive and irritable. Cannot endure strong smells. Smell of food nauseates. Morning sickness with
sensitive to the smell of food (Sep.).
Nash recorded a striking cure by Colch. 200c. The patient was an old woman who was vomiting blood and
passing as many as sixteen bloody stools in the day. The doors of the room had to be mostcarefully kept
closed to prevent any smell of cooking reaching her as that immediately provoked nausea.
Guernsey noted that “after evacuation, as in dysenteric, there is generally relief but in typhus fever, sometimes
a terrific spasmodic pain of the anal sphincter comes on after stool. This may occur in diarrhea.”
The rice-water stool, hippocratic face, coldness, cramps, and prostration, led Salzer to use it for certain
epidemics of Asiatic cholera.
J. R. Simson of Tonawanda, N. Y., cured a very bad case of typhoid presenting symptoms including “his left
pupil was contracted so as to be almost imperceptible, while the right was dilated to the full extent.” This is
peculiar to Colch. and no remedy relieved the patient until he received this.
B. Simmons called attention to the powerlessness of the affected parts, especially when occurring in leuco-
phlegmatic subjects and when there is edematous swelling of the parts.
He cured a woman, 36, mother of two children, of leuco-phlegmatic temperament. who complained of
rheumatism of the hands, which were swollen, joints stiff and powerless, pain as if bruised, the arms being
affected but in less degree. “She was unable to brush her own hair, not so much from the pain as from the
extreme weakness and powerlessness of the parts affected. ”
T. F. Allen gave “Tingling in finger-nails” as characteristic of Colch., no other remedy
has it as strong.
RELATIONS - Antidotes: Thuj., Camph., Cocc., Nux-v., Puls. Compare: (1) Col- chicinum - intestinal catarrh
and shreddy membranes, convulsivejerkings of right hand, rheumatic fever, gout, endo and pericarditis,
pleurisy, arthritis deformans in early stages intense pain of rheumatism 3x trituration. (2) Carb-v., Am., Lil-t.,
Ars., Cocc., Kali-c., Verat.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.
keynote:
PHARMACY - colch. Colchicum autumnale. Meadow saffron. N. O. Melanthacae of the Liliaceae.
Colchicaceae. Tincture of the bulb dug in spring. The flowers of the plant appear in autumn, the leaves not
until the following spring. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Appendicitis. Arthritis. Ascites. Asiatic, cholera. Asthma. Backache. Bright’s
disease. Cataracts. Cholera. Colic. Colitis. Coryza. Coughs. Cramps. Debility. Dehydration. Delirium.
Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dyspnea.

name: Colibacillinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - coli. Colibacillinum. Escherichia coli. Historical dose: All potencies
CLINICAL - Anorexia. Backaches. Bradycardia. Chills. Colitis. Constipation. Cystitis.Dehydration. Diarrhea.
Dysentery. Epididymitis. Fever. Flatulence. Food poisoning. Gastroenteritis. Headaches. Hematuria.
Hepatitis. Hypotension. Indigestion. Insomnia. Leucorrhea. Menorrhea. Metritis. Nausea. Nephritis. Prostatitis.
Puerperal fever. Rheumatism. Salpingitis. Septic fever. Traveller's diarrhea. Typhoid fever. Vaginitis.
Vomiting. Weakness. Worms.
HOMEOPATHIC - The bacteria species, E. coli, occurs normally in the intestines of man and other vertebrates.
It is widely distributed in nature, and is a frequent cause of food poisoning and infections of the urogenital
tract and of diarrhea in infants.
In babies and young children, profuse weakening diarrhea with hypothermia, bradycardia, dehydration.
Hypotension, tendency to weakness, even collapse. Paleness, anxiety, vertigo, sweats, sound of the heart
become muffed, and lowering of the blood pressure.
General fatigue and depression which goes on aggravating with digestive and urinary troubles. Progressive
asthenia. Mental and physical weakness. Permanent worn out condition.
MIND - Mental weakness. Great timidity. Irresolution and lack of self-confidence. Always hesitating, cannot
decide on any
thing. Constant mental confusion because of the loss of memory. Forgets proper names. Loss of memory.
Amnesia of recent events. Weakness of memory with great difficulty to find out the right word. Uses very often
one word for another.
Depressive melancholia. Sadness and weariness. Obsessional neurosis. Confused deliriums. Schizophrenic
states, loss of contact with his environment and with his own reality. Catatonic condition with somnolence and
dreams.
Abdomen - Bloating after eating. Slow intestinal transit. Flatulence, intestinal spasms. Gastroenteritis.
 Heaviness and drawing in the intestines. Rumbling. Expulsion of putrid gas. Spasmodic colitis.
Back - Backaches. Lumbar pains.
Eyes - Swelling of the upper eyelids, sometimes left, sometimes right.
Female - Salpingitis, metritis, vaginitis. Vaginitis with burning pains. Leucorrhea. Heaviness of the lower
abdomen with ovarian pains. Menorrhea. Yellow leucorrhea, sightly irritating. Sexual relation becomes difficult,
with vulvo-vaginal burning sensation.
Food - Capricious appetite or anorexia. Food poisoning. Worse dairy products, milk. Worse eggs. Worse
from eating undercooked meat, fish.
Head - Empty feeling in the head. Frontal and suborditary headache, worse by humid coldness. Headaches
after contrariety and strong emotions.
Heart - Bradycardia. Hypotension. Sound of the heart become muffed.
Kidneys - Nephritis. Heat and burning after urination. Cystitis. Painful sensation in the region of kidney.
Frequent urination of little quantity. Painful urination with the sensation of burning at the end of the flow.
Sensation as if he must go again to pass urine immediately after urination. Urine smells bad. Hematuria.
Aggravation of urinary troubles in cold humid weather.
Limbs - Polyarticular pains. Swelling of small joints of legs and hands. Rheumatism. Chronic degenerative
rheumatism.
Liver - Hepatitis. Enlarged sensitive liver. Gall bladder, painful.
Male - Erection and ejaculation sometimes painful, with the sensation of burning in the urethra after sex.
Cystitis, prostatitis. Relapsing epididymitis.
Modalities - Better by heat. Better warmth. Worse by cold. Worse humid cold. Worse by the sea. Worse after
rest. Worse milk. Worse slightest mental or physical exertion. Worse cold, damp weather.
Rectum - Infants with diarrhea and dehydration. Diarrhea. Profuse weakening diarrhea. Constipation.
Traveller's diarrhea. Alternating diarrhea and constipation. Bloody, foul smelling stools. Worms.
Sleep - Deep and heavy sleep. Insomnia.
Stomach - Nausea and vomiting after eating spoiled foods. Very slow digestion with the sensation of the
stomach remaining heavy for a long time.
Temperature - Chilly, specially after eating. Nocturnal chill. Sensation of intense coldness with chill
immediately after meals. Fever with great weakness. Typhoid fever. Septic fever. Puerperal fever.
Tongue - Tongue, coated yellowish-white. Tongue with a red clear stripe down the center. White tongue.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Pyrog., Chin., Ars., Lyc., Sepia, Psor., Med., Thuj. (2) Bowel nosodes. (3)
Thymol., Folliculium. Cynodon dactylon.
REFERENCES - Julian.

name: Collinsonia Canadensis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - coll. Collinsonia canadensis. Stone-root. Horse balm. Richweed. N. O. Labiate. Tincture of fresh
root. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Atony. Catarrh. Colic. Constipation. Cough. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dysentery. Dysmenorrhea.
Dyspepsia. Hemorrhages. Heart, disorders. Hemorrhoids. Hoarseness. Labor. Pregnancy, disorders.
Proctitis. Pruritus, vulvae. Rheumatism.
HERBAL - Collinsonia is native to North America. It has a very tough, hard, knotted root. As a domestic
remedy, it is known for
chronic catarrhal conditions, especially of the stomach, bowels and bladder. Also of the nose, pharynx and
larynx and in tubular and capillary bronchitis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Congestion in pelvic organs, especially anus, rectum and uterus, resulting in hemorrhoids
and constipation, especially in females. Constipation of children from intestinal atony. It is said to be of
special value when given before operations, for rectal diseases.
Sense of weight and constriction. Venous engorgement. Depressed arterial tension, general atony of muscular
fiber. Chronic nasal, gastric andpharyngeal catarrh, due to portal obstruction. Pruritus in pregnancy with
hemorrhoids.
Irritation of cardiac nerves, palpitation, faintness, oppression. Dropsy from cardiac disease. Heart disorders
that alternate with suppressed bleeding hemorrhoids. Sensitiveness about the heart, fullness, oppressed
breathing, faintness.
MIND - Gloomy. Sullen. Excitable. Irresolution.
Abdomen - Distended abdomen. Colic with flatulence and nausea. Heavy, digging ache in pelvis. Sharp,
cutting pain in hypogastric region. Severe pain in lower part of abdomen. Congestion of portal system and of
 pelvic viscera. Flatulent rumbling in stomach and bowels.
Chest - Chest pains alternating with hemorrhoids. Fullness and oppression of chest.
Face - Yellow discoloration around the eyes.
Female - Genitals considerably swollen and inflamed. Amenorrhea from pelvic congestion. Dysmenorrhea,
swelling and dark redness of genitals, pain on sitting down. Membranous dysmenorrhea. Terrible
dysmenorrhea, with hemorrhoids, diarrhea and loss of appetite. Cold feeling in thighs after menses. Sensation
of swelling of labia and of clitoris. Lancinating pain in ovaries, worse right side. Prolapsed uterus, hemorrhoids
during pregnancy. Leucorrhea with pruritus. Itching of vulva with hemorrhoids during pregnancy.
Food - Loss of appetite. Excessive appetite with spasms of stomach and flatulence. Loss of appetite with
dysmenorrhea.
Head - Dull, frontal headache with constipation or hemorrhoids. Headache from suppressed hemorrhoidal
discharge. Headache with frequent flying pains in legs, tearing in knees.
Heart - Palpitations, rapid but weak. Dropsy after heart symptoms are relieved, hemorrhoids or menses return.
Palpitations in patients subject to hemorrhoids and indigestion. Rapid pulse. Heart's action rapid, regular or
irregular, slightest motion or excitement aggravates. Valvular heart disease, following a severe and prolonged
attack of acute rheumatism.
Kidneys - Chronic nephritis and cystitis. Catarrh of bladder. Urine increased.
Limbs - Sensation as if limbs were enlarged. Lower limbs seem not to belong to him. Tearing pain in arms,
hands and legs. Cold feeling in thighs after menses. Tearingpain in both knees, extending down inside of legs
to feet, while sitting.
Liver - Dull pain in liver region. Portal vein congestion.
Lungs - Difficult breathing and faintness. Severe attacks of dyspnea with great weakness. Oppression,
faintness and dyspnea (Acon-f.). Cough from excessive use of voice. Harassing, dry cough. Chest pains
alternate with hemorrhoids. Spitting of blood after suppression of hemorrhoids. Dark, tough coagula, enveloped
in viscid mucus. Hemorrhage from lungs.
Male - Varicocele with rectal symptoms. Spermatorrhea kept up by hemorrhoids and constipation.
Modalities - Better from heat. Better morning. Worse during hemorrhoids or from suppressed hemorrhoids.
Worse from the slightest emotion. Worse excitement. Worse during pregnancy. Worse at night. Worse from
cold.
Mouth - Tongue yellow with bitter taste (Coloc., Bry.).
Nose - Chronic catarrh. Sinus congestion.
Rectum - Sensation as if rectum is full of sharp sticks. Chronic hemorrhoids, alternating with heart, chest or
rheumatic
Collinsonia canadensis symptoms. Painful bleeding hemorrhoids. Vascular engorgement of rectum.
Sense of constriction. Rectum, aches, burns. Rectum seems dry and full of sand, with cardiac pain. Most
obstinate constipation with protruding hemorrhoids. Constipation during pregnancy with dysmenorrhea,
following labor. Alternate constipation and diarrhea and great flatulence. Prolapsed anus. Itching of anus
(Teucr., Rat.). Dysentery with tenesmus.
Sensations - Constriction and feeling of enlargement in various parts and organs of the body, limbs, vulva,
clitoris etc.
Sleep - Disposition to sleep during day. Sleep disturbed by hypogastric pains.
Stomach - Constant heaviness in stomach. Cramplike pains in stomach with nausea. Sharp, cutting pains in
stomach, every five minutes while sitting. Nausea with obstinate constipation, during pregnancy. V om- iting
with pain and heat in stomach.
Stools - Sluggish stool with distended abdomen. Chronic diarrhea of children. Diarrhea after delivery. Acrid
diarrhea. Light colored stools, lumpy with hard straining, mucus or black stools. Dry feces.
Temperature - Flushes of heat with oppressive breathing, with hemorrhoids.
Throat- Hoarseness. Speaker's sore throat, sharp pain in larynx.
Vertigo - Vertigo with gastric and hemorrhoidal troubles. Periodical spells of faintness.
COMMENTS - It has been proved twice, first by Burt and later by Dowla. The former took the tincture, the latter
the powder. Both experienced headache, the former in connection with abdominal and rectal disturbance. The
latter with flushing, sensation of heat, numbness, feeling of enlargement. The legs felt light, as if he could run
like a deer.
Nux-v. relieved the sensations, the symptoms passing off from above downwards. In Dr. Burt's case, the
symptoms generally passed from above downwards.
The greatest number of Dr. Burt's symptoms were experienced in the bowels and rectum, including pains in
umbilicus and hypogastrium, constipation with hard light
 stools, great straining, faintness, stools of mucus and blood.
These symptoms suggested the use of the remedy in cases of hemorrhoids, where it has proved most
efficacious. Hemorrhoids during the menses. Prolapse of the rectum with hemorrhoids. It reduces
complications when given before operations on rectal disease.
It is, according to Hammond, “a stimulant, a most valuable tonic, a positive diuretic and mild laxative.”
Hammond commended it in the palpitations of the menopause. Irritation of cardiac nerves, palpitation,
faintness, oppression.
F. S. Smith mentioned that it has adomes- tic reputation in rheumatism. He recorded a case (sub-acute) in a
woodsman of 30. It began in the foot and ankle and traveled over nearly every joint in the body. A few drops
of Coll, tincture was mixed in a tumbler of water and a teaspoonful given every two hours. Rapid cure resulted.
Dewey mentioned that it cured a case in which there was severe constrictive pain about the heart in a man
who habitually passed blood by stool, the heart symptoms coming on when the bleeding ceased and
disappearing when it was re-established. Coll, cured both.
Nash cured cases of the most obstinate constipation with Coll. In one there was severe colic, which had
recurred for several years, the concomitant symptoms being great flatulence and hemorrhoidal troubles.
He differentiated between Aesc. and Coll., in that Aesc. has a sense of fullness in the rectum, which Coll, does
not. and Aesc. hemorrhoids do not bleed as a rule, while those of Coll, bleed persistently.
Aesc. has pain, soreness and aching in the back. Coll, has more persistently constipation with colic on account
of it. Aesc. may have constipation or may not. Coll, has shown marked power of disturbing the circulation and
causing hemorrhages and also of disturbing cutaneous sensation.
Symptoms are worse in the evening and night, better in the morning. Worse by slightest emotion or excitement.
Inveterate cases of dyspepsia with a weight in epigastrium and hemorrhoids. Neuralgia and rheumatic pains
were experienced by the provers in many parts: upper jaw, arms, hands, knees, joints. Sensitiveness about
the heart, fullness, oppressed breathing, faintness. Heart disorders alternate with suppressed bleeding
hemorrhoids.
RELATIONS - Antidote: Nux-v. Compare: (1) Aesc.. Aloes, Ham., Lycopus, Negundo, Sulph., Nux-v.
REFERENCES - Clarke. Murphy.

name: Colocynthinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY -colocin. Colocynthinum. N. O. Cucurbitaceae. Colocin. is an active glucoside of Citrullus
colocynthis. Dilutions in alcohol. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Colic. Cough. Debility. Diarrhea. Feet, burning in. Genitals, congestion, pain. Headaches.
Neuralgia. Spinal pains. Traveling, effects.
HOMEOPATHIC - Having had a separate proving, Colocynthinum must be considered apart from Coloc., from
which it is derived, although the symptoms of the two bear a close resemblance.
Prominent neuralgic symptoms. Stitches and sensations of heat are found in many parts. Pulsation in the pit
ofthe stomach, with prickling stitches on back in neighborhood of middle thoracic vertebrae.
Diarrhea and colic, better bending forward. Congestion to male genital organs and pain in them. Burning pains
in soles of the feet.
Modalities - Better by bending over, black coffee. Worse by motion, better by rest, herein appears the
relationship of the glucoside to Bry., the botanical relative of Coloc. Worse evening. Worse riding in cars.
REFERENCES Clarke.
