name: Cubeba Officinalis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cub. Cubeba officinalis. Cubebs. Pipercubeba. N. O. Piperaceae. Tincture of dried unripe fruit.
Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Aphthae. Bedwetting. Catarrh. Croup. Cystitis. Diarrhea. Dysr entery. Gleet.
Gonorrhea. Hernia. Leucorrhea. Orchitis. Prostatitis. Rheumatism. Roseola. Urethritis. Urticaria.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cubeba is an old-world remedy for gonorrhea and gleet. It affects the mucus membrane of
the nose, air passages, intestines, and the uro-genital tract. It acts well in persons of bilious temperament with
tendency to constipation.
Burning, rawness is felt in the throat in stomach, abdomen, rectum, urethra, fossa navicularis. Catarrh.
Discharges are thick, acrid, yellow, pus like, green, offensive after violent inflammation. Frequent urination of
a nervous origin. Leucorrhea in young girls. MIND - Weakness of intellect. Frequent absence of mind. Loss of
memory. Is unable to accomplish anything. Waking reveries. All his ideas are confused and wandering. Cannot
find words to express himself. Exaltation of temper and mental faculties. Starting from noises. Uneasiness,
anxiety, can't remain in bed.
Madness, with sorts of beastly extravagances. Impatient, irritable, a mere trifle provokes him. Furious insanity,
with wickedness. Breaks everything within his reach, out of sheer malice. Mania, desire to strike and to kill.
Impulse to swear at people. Im-
Cubeba officinalis pulse to strike them and spit in their faces, even to bite them.
Proneness to debauchery and every species of excess. Shamelessly indecent in thoughts, words, and
gestures, especially towards evening. Delirium. Lascivious words and thoughts, with violent priapism. Lewd
talk. Incoherent speech during sleep.
Paroxysms of foolish gaiety, with great loquacity, or silent weeping, towards evening. Want of decision and
will-power. Fits of dejection, apathy, insensibility. Indifferent to everything.
Regards himself as more of an invalid than be really is. Delusion he is unfortunate. Disturbed about his health
and social position. Paroxysms of anxiety, suffocation and fainting. Excessive nervous excitement; he is very
easily frightened.
Abdomen - Distended and very sensitive. Burning in stomach and abdomen. Burning and pressure about
navel. Cutting pain in hypogastrium before stools. Sensation of weight, pressure and pain.
Constitutions - Suitable to persons of bilious constitution with tendency to constipation.
Cough - Cough seems totear bronchi. Cough in bronchitis. Incessant cough, bronchial. Barking and croupy
cough with feeling as of a foreign body in larynx. During and after cough cold sweat upon breast and back,
burning in abdomen. Cough with coryza and hoarseness.
Ears - Obstinate otorrhea. Offensive discharge.
Eyes - Rheumatic or gonorrheal ophthalmia. Fullness in eyes, turgid and watery.
Face - Fullness of face or red and pale by turns. Lips puffed, dry and shining. Twist of mouth to one side.
Female - Urethritis. Vaginitis, chronic with profuse discharge. Acrid leucorrhea in young girls. Leucorrhea,
profuse, acrid, offensive, yellow or green, with pruritus. Leucorrhea with erythema at inner surface of thighs.
Menses too soon, often preceded and followed by leucorrhea. Menses scanty, and consisting mostly of
leucorrhea.
Food - Increased appetite. Craving for oranges, onions, almonds and nuts. Desires delicacies, acid fruits.
Desires brandy, spirits, fresh bread. Mucus diarrhea worse fruit, acids. Unquenchable thirst with feeling of
dryness of mouth and burning in throat.
Head - Veins of the forehead and temples are distended. Contractive and pressive pains with drowsiness, but
without sleep. Deep-seated pains. The hairs becomes white. Falling off the hair, especially in the evening.
Pustules on the scalp, forming scabs like those of small-pox. Intolerable itching of the head, with burning ulcers.
Kidneys - Burning and itching in fossa navicularis. Hematuria. Cystitis. Urethritis with much mucus,
especially in women. Cramp, cutting, burning in urethra after urination, with constriction. Stringy gonorrhea.
Sensation as if bladder still contained water. Last drops of urine passed with pain. Urine frothy. Urine copious,
dark. Urine, odor of violets. Nocturnal enuresis.
Limbs - Sensation of heat in palms and soles. Numbness of fingers and toes. Wrists stiff and
thickeraboutjoints. Acute, deep-seated pains.
Lungs - Dyspnea. Catarrh of nose and throat with fetid odor and expectoration. Mucus trickles from posterior
sinuses. Rawness of throat and hoarseness. False membrane in larynx, danger of suffocation. Hurried and
noisy breathing. Impeded breathing with crepitant rales. Dyspnea and sense of suffocation.
Male - Pale, copious, slimy discharge from urethra after use of alcohol. Prostatitis with thick yellow discharge.
Pressure and heaviness in penis. Sexual excitement. Gonorrhea with profuse discharge and scalding pain
during urination. Pale, copious, slimy discharge, causing soiled linen to become stiff. Thick, yellowish- green
 discharge with frequent obstruction of urethra.
Modalities - Better from getting up and walking about. Worse from night, in bed.
Mouth - Aphthae of lips and gums. On attempting to smile or speak his mouth seems to twist to one side.
Mouth as if dry, though moistened with an oily saliva, great thirst. Tongue furred and moist or very white.
Nose - Post-nasal catarrh. Mucus trickles from nose into throat with rawness of throat and hoarseness. Nasal
catarrh, with fetid odor and catarrh of throat. Nasal catarrhwith greenish-yellow expectoration.
Rectum - Constipation with hemorrhoids and tenderness of perineum. Burning and itching of anus. Relief of
pains after stool. Loud flatus during stool. Long-continued tenesmus. Gelatinous stools of transparent mucus
mixed with whitish, shining particles like rice, worse night, in bed, better getting up and walking about. Diarrhea
with rumbling and cutting in abdomen and burning in rectum. Stools cold.
Skin - Eruption all over body like urticaria. Roseolous papules without fever or itching. Intense itching. Skin
diseases with kidney affections. Skin diseases with catarrh of bladder and urethra.
Stomach - Burning in stomach and abdomen. Uneasiness, heat at pit with fever. Sour eructations. Nausea
and vomiting.
Throat - Swallows saliva constantly to relieve burning and dryness of the throat. Catarrh.
Vertigo - Frequent giddiness, so that he is afraid of falling.
COMMENTS - Burning in throat with dryness, constant need to swallow saliva. Burning in stomach, abdomen,
rectum, urethra and fossa navicularis. Prickling in soles of feet. Sensation of downward weight and pressure
in region of femoral ring, worse on walking, riding or lifting.
Stools and colic are worse at night in bed, better getting up and walking about. Urine foaming. Albuminous,
bloody. Acrid leucorrhea in children. Skin diseases with kidney disorders.
Nash defined its place in gonorrhea as “After the inflammatory stage is passed under the usual remedies for
that stage, if there still remains burning in the urethra after
urination and the discharge remains thick, yellow or pus-like (with Puls, the discharge is bland with Merc, all
symptoms are Worse at night). Thin (gleety) discharge does not correspond to any of the three.”
RELATIONS - Cop. with which it is compatible. Compare: ( 1 ) Cucúrbitas. (2) Cop.. Santa. (3) Pipermethyst.
Pi per nigrum and Matico. Caps, Canth. (4) irritable bladder in females. Terebe., Cann-s. (5) lod. - membranous
croup.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Cucurbita Citrullus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cuc-c. Cucúrbita citrullus. Watermelon seeds. N. O. Cucurbitaceae. Cucúrbita. Historical dose:
Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Backache. Coryza. Diuresis. Dysuria. Rheumatism. Sneezing. Sinusitis.
HERBAL - Infusion of watermelon seeds for painful urination with a sense of constriction and backache.
HOMEOPATHIC - All those with hy- drogenoid constitution and suffering from rheumatic problems were found
to be affected most. Tendency to suppuration. Tendency to catching cold. Internal heat but external coldness.
Increased perspiration.
MIND - Irritable, on the slightest provocation or controversy. Irritable, esp. with children. Violent anger. Wants
to fight, but lacks the physical strength, so cannot. Depressed feeling in the morning. Desires death.
Abdomen - Fullness, bloated feeling. Pain in abdomen worse milk, worse coffee. Pain in left side of abdomen.
Abdomen pain, worse pressure. Abdomen pain, better lying on right side, passing flatus, warmth.
Face - Swelling of face in morning. Swelling of left cheek in morning.
Food - Increased appetite. Must eat, cannot remain hungry which she could before. Hungry at night and also
in the morning. Appetite increased after stools. Aversion to sweets. Desire for sweets decreased. Desires cold
drinks. Desires ice cream, spicy food. Worse coffee, milk. Better
Cucúrbita citrullus warm drinks.
Headache - Left-sided headache. Bursting pain. Heaviness. Headaches worse after 4 p.m., evening.
Headaches worse pressure, motion of head. Headaches worse sun, reading, lying down. Headaches better
warm bath, open air, rest, night, sitting.
Modalities - Worse left side. Worse Sun. Worse travelling.
Mouth - Salivation increased. Stringy saliva.
Nose - Sneezing. Coryza. Watery, acrid discharge, followed by sticky, greenish discharge. Sinusitis maxillaris.
Perspiration - Profuse perspiration at the nape of neck at night.
Rectum - Sudden urging for stool in early morning, worse 3 a.m. to 6 a.m.
Sleep - Drowsiness. Increased sleep with drowsiness.
 Stomach - Retching of stringy mucus.
Throat - Sore throat, with pain in spots mainly left side, worse Empty swallowing.
Vertigo - Faint feeling and vertigo. RELATIONS - Compare: Equisetum. REFERENCES - Boericke.

name: Cucurbita Pepo
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cuc-p. Cucúrbita pepo. Pumpkin seeds. Cucumis macrocarpus. N. O. Cucurbitaceae.
Cucúrbita. Tincture of fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies. Historical dose: Tincture and
all potencies, two ounces of seed, yielding one of pulp. May be mixed with cream and taken like porridge.
CLINICAL - Gonorrhea. Morning, sickness. Nausea. Roundworm. Seasickness. Tapeworm. Urinary,
disorders. Vomiting. Worms.
HERBAL - Cucúrbita pepo is of service in strangury and urinary affections, also in gastritis, enteritis, and febrile
diseases. A tincture of the vines and of the seeds has been prescribed with alleged benefit in vomiting of
pregnancy. It also has cured vomiting of food and salivation in non-pregnant women. Intense nausea
immediately after eating.
Cucúrbita pepo
Vomiting during pregnancy. Seasickness.
One of the most efficient and least harmful of vermifuges, which may be given safely to children. An infusion
of the seeds has also been found effectual in removing tapeworm. After a few hours, a purgative, like castor
oil, may be administered to aid in the expulsion of the worm. This is also effectual in removing the roundworm.
HOMEOPATHIC - Hansen mentioned that missionaries found the n.other tincture of great use in seasickness
and vomiting during pregnancy. Bonino recorded that Cuc-p. 3c cured salivation and vomiting in a woman in
whom the menses were absent and who was erroneously supposed to be pregnant.
Grist recorded a case in which a woman, four months pregnant, vomited almost from conception and for six
weeks had not retained a meal. “I am almost starved to death,” she said, was pale, haggard, tongue clean.
Soon after eating or drinking anything she became intensely nauseated.
The doctor got a fresh pumpkin stem, cut it into thin slices and covered them with alcohol. At the end of half
an hour he poured off a little and made a lx dilution and directed half a drachm to be put in half a tea cupful of
water, a teaspoonful every two hours. There was no further vomiting.
Dr. Griste's indication was “Intense nausea immediately after eating. ”
COMMENTS - For treatment, the seeds should be scalded, the softened outer skins peeled off as the green,
inner pulp is used. Use two ounces of the seeds, yielding an ounce of pulp, for each patient. The pulp should
be rubbed in a mortar or some other vessel to make a smooth mass.
The seed- may be mixed with milk or cream, and sweetened and taken like porridge. It should be taken in the
morning after a twelve to sixteen hour fast, and be followed in two hours by a castor-oil purge.
The infusion may be drank freely. The expressed oil of the pumpkin seeds, in doses of 6 to 12 drops, several
times a day, is said to be a most certain and efficient diuretic, giving quick relief in scalding of urine, spasmodic
affections of the urinary
Cucúrbita pepo passages, and has cured gonorrhea.
Half a fluid ounce of oil of pumpkin seeds, taken upon a fasting stomach, repeated in 2 hours, and in another
2 hours followed by a dose of castor oil containing 1/2 fluid ounce of the pumpkin-seed oil. has been effectual
in removing tapeworm.
Hale's method of using this remedy was to have the patient eat only a little of the lightest food all day, taking
no supper and, on going to bed, to eat one ounce of the peeled seeds, bruised with milk or cream.
In the morning on waking, he had them take a tablespoonful of castor oil, mixed with half a teaspoonful of pure
sulfuric ether. No breakfast was taken, only a cup of tea or coffee. In two or three hours the oil would operate,
expelling the worm.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Filix, Cina, Cuprum oxid. nig., Spig.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Culex Musca
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - culx. Culex musca. Mosquito. N. O. Culicide. Insecta. Tincture. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Cramps. Edema. Flatus. Vertigo.
HOMEOPATHIC - Kent wrote “When this remedy is needed your patient will present to you a picture of
something on fire, he burns like something he would like to mention and perhaps does mention the place, the
itching and burning are present every where in this remedy, he mbs and scratches wherever the eruptions
 appears.”
Edematous swelling. Sensation as of cold air blowing through a hole in clothes on the chest or back. Strange
feeling of having been poisoned. Menses stain indelibly. Generally a right-sided remedy.
Sharp, stinging pains all over the body like needles, lightning-like. Pain, itching, burning, worse in a warm room
and better in the open air. Pains darting here and there, aggravated by light pressure and ameliorated by hard
pressure. Griping pain down over hips, then into the womb.
Vertigo on blowing the nose. Tired and weak. Can scarcely move, cannot walk straight, with soreness and
aching all over the body. Nervous, finds it impossible to keep still, almost constant motion of the hands and
feet (Zinc.).
MINI) - Busy scratching to relieve the itching, and walking to relieve the restlessness, any interruption makes
him impatient and ready to quarrel. Anxiety and fear of death. Poor memory and a disinclination for all work.
Abdomen - Cramps in the abdomen during stool, with rumbling and the passing of much offensive flatus.
Colicky pairs come on about 10 a.m. and last from one to three hours. Blotcheson the abdomen the size of a
twenty-five cent piece. Itching, burning, with little pimples on the blotches.
Back - Dull pain in the right side in the region of the kidney, extending up the back to the occiput.
Chest - Cutting pains in the right pectoral muscles. Right side of the neck is swollen.
Ears - Swelling of the parotid glands and soreness on pressure, pain as if he were going to have mumps.
Sharp pains in both ears followed by sticky, watery discharge.
Eyes - Inflamed eyeballs. Stye-like ulceration. Rending pains in the eyeballs, could not keep his eyes open,
yet it pained to keep them shut. Eyes feel tired. Feeling of fullness in the right eye, extending to the parotid
gland, to the sub-lingual, and finally involves the right side of the face and head. Margins of the lids are sore
and crusted over. Inflammation of the lids, worse in the morning with a discharge of sticky fluid.
Face - Swollen sub-maxillary gland, tender on pressure. Eruption on the face and between the eyes, contains
a colorless fluid, with swelling and puffiness underthe eyes. Heat and redness of the right side of the face, with
a sore bruised feeling.
Female - Menses, too soon, with a profuse dark clotted flow. Violent pains in the uterus, compelling her to go
to bed. Itching and burning in vagina, so intense that she feels as if she could tear it to pieces, can
return at intervals for years.
Food - Ravenous appetite, feels faint if supper is late. Especially hungry and faint in the morning, cannot wait
for breakfast to be prepared.
Head - Dull, frontal headache, begins on waking at 5 a.m. and passes away after lying awake for a while.
Headache, worse from the least motion. Headache followed by intense vertigo in the afternoon, located in a
spot over the right eye. Head pains go from the cerebellum to the forehead or right temple. Boring pains in the
temples, several times a day. Pain comes and goes across the forehead just above the eyes. Rending pain in
back of the eyeballs. Itching and stinging of the scalp.
Limbs - Hands and fingers are hot and burning, as if frozen with severe pain. As if he must tear the flesh for
relief while the back of the hands felt cold and benumbed. Right hand is cold, left hand is warm. Lower limbs
feel heavy apd restless. Feet are tired all day. Soles tender while walking. Intense itching on the tops of the
feet.
Lungs - Oppression and anxiety in the chest. Apex of the right lung sore, aggravated by deep breathing or
raising the right arm. Deep sighing breathing, with constant desire for a deep breath. Constant desire to sneeze
and cough. On rising, hawking and coughing dark green scabs and strings of tough mucus tinged with dark
blood. Cough caused by burning in the chest. Whistling, strangling, choking cough, with red face and water
running from the eyes. Dry hacking cough with the feeling as if he would vomit. Small amount of yellowish
white expectoration.
Male - Burning of the glans penis. Strong smelling discharge from the glans. Itching of the scrotum from
swollen, burning spots, like bee stings. Rubbing aggravates itching, stinging, and burning.
Mouth - Dryness and burning. Constant wetting of the lips. Saliva leaves the lips sticky. Whitish saliva, leaves
a bad taste in the mouth in the morning. Sickish taste as if he had been drinking warm mineral water. Periodical
attacks of salivation, at night the pillow is wet and the daytime the
saliva accumulates and causes continued swallowing (Merc.). Foul breath, seemed as if he could smell it
himself.
Nose - Itching, stinging and tickling. Rubs and scratches because his nose itches inside and out, but rubbing
increased burning. Shining redness on top of nose. Nose is swollen. Eruptions contain a clear colorless fluid.
Nosebleed, morning and night on blowing the nose. Head feels stuffed. Ineffectual desire to sneeze. Watery
discharge with bloody scabs on the inside, dry or moist and bloody. Copious discharge, greenish or light-
colored.
 Rectum - Usual desire for morning stool is absent. Stool is scanty, lumpy and expelled with effort. First part of
the stool is hard and scratches the anus, followed by a soft stool. After stool, sensation that he has not finished
so he sits and strains until blood comes (Merc.). Itching and burning of the anus, scalding hot and raw as from
a bite.
Skin - Tormented by itching, burning, heat. Must scratch to relieve the constant itching, but aggravates. No
comfort in or out of bed.
Sleep - Restless, unrefreshing sleep, much tossing about. Dreams of quarrels, fights and of the dead. Heat of
the bed causes him to waken frequently, must rise early in the morning to move around for relief.
Stomach - Thirst for cold water which causes burning in the stomach with urging to stool, followed by loose,
dark brown, offensive stool, much tenesmus lasting several days and gradually subsiding into painless
diarrhea. Sickening pains and belching of much offensive gas. Nausea, day and night from even the thought
of food. Nausea with gagging and retching and inability to vomit.
Stomach - Increased appetite. Undigested food sours in the stomach.
Temperature - Hot flushes as if a chill would follow, followed by warm, sticky, strong smelling perspiration.
Throat - Burning and dryness of the throat. Soreness in throat and in the posterior sinuses on swallowing
solids or fluids. The right side of the throat is always sore.
Hoarseness, could scarcely speak a word, in the morning.
Tongue - Tongue is coated white, dry, swollen. thick on waking. Edge of the tongue is covered with a double
row of small, painful vesicles. Tongue numb, with ulceration at the tip following scarlet fever.
COMMENTS - Culex was proved by Kent, but the only verification Clarke found was of the symptom “vertigo
every time he blows his nose.”
W. P. Wesselheft cured a man, 40, stout, thick-set, light brunette, who had swelling on upper jaw over first
right tricuspid. Slight redness of cheek. Abscess threatened with paroxysmal throbbing, dull pain better by
warm applications. This came on after exposure to wet weather.
Merc, and Rhus-t. did no good. The patient then said that whenever he blew his nose he had vertigo with a
sense of fullness in the ears. Culx. promptly relieved the pain and in forty-eight hours the swelling had gone.
RELATIONS - Compare: Apis.
REFERENCES - Clarke. Kent.

name: Cundurango
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cund. Cundurango. Condor plant. Condurango. Gonolobus cundurango. Marsdenia
cundurango. N. O. Asclepiadacae. Ecuador. South America. Tincture and trituration of the dried bark of the
stem. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Anus, cracks. Breast, tumors. Cancer. Cracks. Eczema. Epithelioma. Fistula. Headaches.
Locomotor, ataxia. Lupus. Rodent, ulcer. Smallpox. Stomach, cancer. Stomach, disorders. Syphilis. Tumors.
Ulcers. Varicose, ulcers.
HOMEOPATHIC - The Condor plant was first introduced into medicine as a cancer remedy by Dr. Bliss of
Washington. Cundurango belongs to the Milk-weed family and is thus related to Asclepias Syriaca and
Tuberosa and also to Calotropis.
Cancer, especially for those originating in epithelial structures. Scirrhus cancers. Cancer of the breasts with
retraction of the
Cundurango nipples and sharp pains emanating from the tumor over the whole breast. Jagged ulcers of the
tongue. Tumors, strictures of the esophagus.
Cancer of the stomach with constant burning and vomiting, food seems to stick behind the sternum. Allays the
stomach pain accompanying cancer of stomach. Stimulates the digestive functions and thus improves the
general health. Modifies secretions of digestive glands. Chronic stomach catarrh.
Cutting, stinging, burning, tingling, constrictive and piercing pains. Cracks at muco-cutaneous orifices and
warty excrescences. Painful cracks in corner of mouth. Blotches. Eczema, pimples, pustules. Indolent
ulcers. Varicose ulcers. Lupus. Syphilitic affections.
The active principle (Condurangin) produces locomotor ataxia. This remedy is worth trying when other
seemingly indicated remedies fail to effect the disease.
MIND - Depressed, miserable. Irritable.
Abdomen - Pain in right hypochondrium.
Back - Dull, heavy, continuing pain in left scapula.
Breasts - Tumor of breast on either side. Cracked, painful, suppurating nipples. Retraction of the nipples.
Hard, painful swellings around nipple, ranging in size from pigeon's to hen's egg. Axillary glands swollen,
 emaciation.
Chest - Cancer-like ulcers on false ribs, as large as hand.
Constitutions - Cancerous diathesis. Broken-down constitution. In Burnett's opinion, it is anti-psoric.
Eyes - Flat epithelioma on lower eyelid. Appearance of objects before eyes.
Face - Deep crack in corner in corner of mouth, warty growths occupying edges. Ulcer on chin, right side
perforating to gums.
Head - Severe dull headache all day. Violent pain in left temple, cutting in left temple and through ball of left
eye. Sensation as if forehead were broad and high, as if left half were bigger than right. Left half feels heavy,
right half feels clear.
Cundurango
Heart - Constrictive pain. Sharp, distinct pain in heart on rising in morning, followed by passage of flatus.
Kidneys - Incontinence of urine. Urine scanty, high-colored, loaded with phosphates.
Limbs - Soreness all over body like rheumatism, worse through left shoulder and under left scapula (burning).
Cracks on hips and in bends of knees.
Mouth - Slight pain in left half of tongue. Small, painful pustule on right side of tip of tongue, on upper surface
towards edge. Cracks at angles of mouth. Tongue cancer.
Nose - Much glairy mucus from nose, alternating with unusual dryness. Stiffness in nose. Pressive full feeling
in bridge. Flat epithelioma left side of nose. Nasal sound to voice.
Rectum - Constipation. Cracks at anus, terrible pains when bowels are moved.
Skin - Fissures form about the muco-cutaneous outlets. Epithelioma of lips or anus. Ulcerative stage of
carcinoma when fissures form. Some small congenital warty excrescences enlarge and look fresh. Blotches,
pimples and boils.
Stomach - Anorexia. Painful disorders of the stomach, ulceration. Stomach cancer. Vomiting of food with
indurations and constant burning pain. Stricture of esophagus with burning pains behind sternum, where food
seems to stick.
Throat - Aching in throat, extending to stomach with great burning in stomach. Persistent sore throat, with
burning, aching and a husky feeling which causes a dry, hacking cough.
Vertigo - Great dizziness on stooping, or turning head.
COMMENTS - Burnett, who proved it and whose symptoms were of a severe nature, observed that it produced
“a painful crack in the right corner of the mouth.” These cracks were produced in several patients who were
taking the drug and Burnett cured similar cracks with it. He regarded them as a keynote indication and has
cured patients of tumors, some undoubtedly cancerous, who had that symptom as a concomitant.
Cundurango
Clotar Muller cured with Cund. several cases of old, obstinate, foul-smelling, ichorous ulcers. Carcinoma of
the lips, an unclean and sinus ulcer.
Dudgeon recorded a cure with Cund. first dilution of an undoubted case of cancer of left breast in a women of
sixty-nine. The nipple was so retracted as to be invisible.
A hard tumor the size of an egg on the outer side of the nipple was the center of sharp pains radiating from it,
the whole breast was very tender to touch. The tumor increased steadily under Hydr. and Phyt. and was only
checked temporarily by Con. Under Cund., it entirely disappeared.
Burnett considered it to have a strong affinity for the tongue. He cured a jagged ulcer of the tongue (doubtful
whether cancerous or syphilitic), where the tongue and lips were red.
One prover had a slight creeping pain along the periosteum of the right humerus and Clarke observed “a
creeping sensation up the back and headache in right temple” in a patient taking it in the lx tincture.
An old-school authority, Dr. Guyvenot, credits Condurango with causing a “veritable locomotor ataxia.” It
appears late and he thinks it is due to the formation of some toxic substance by the splitting up of the alkaloid
in the organism.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aster. Con., Hydr., Ars.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Cuphea Viscosissima
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cuph. Cuphea viscosissima. Flux-weed. Lythrum petiolatum. Waxweed. Red pennyroyal. N. O.
Lythraceae. Decoction or tincture of fresh plants collected in July or August. Historical dose: Tincture and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Acidity. Cholera infantum. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Fever. Sleeplessness. Tenesmus. Vomiting.
HERBAL - Cuphea viscosissima is a popular remedy in some parts of the U.S. for summer diarrhea and
 dysentery, as one of its names,
Cuphea viscosissima “Flux weed,” would imply. The entire plant has a clammy, sticky feel. It contains a
large percentage of tannic acid and seems to possess decidedly tonic properties, as children rally rapidly under
its use.
HOMEOPATHIC - Vomiting of undigested food. Cholera infantum, much acidity. Frequent green, watery,
acid stools. Tenesmus and great pain. Obstinate constipation. High fever, restlessness and sleeplessness.
COMMENTS - Cuphea viscosissima was first introduced to homeopathic practice by Dr. A. Roth of Frederick,
Maryland, who was induced to try it in his practice by a female patient. His experience was confirmed by S. G.
A. Brown.
Dr. Roth gave from 5 to 10-drop doses, according to age. He considered in to have “tonic” properties. Roth
found it to be highly successful in two chief forms, but useless in diarrhea from cold.
The first form consists of cases arising from acidity of milk or food. There is vomiting of undigested food or
curdled milk with frequent green, watery, acid stools, varying in number from five to thirty a day. Children are
fretful and feverish, can retain nothing on stomach, food seems to pass right through the child.
In the second form, stools are decidedly dysenteric, small frequent, bloody with tenesmus and great pain, high
fever, restlessness and sleeplessness.
Brown said “If you have a child that is fretful and feverish, vomits curdled milk from a hyperacidity of the
stomach, has frequent green, watery, acid stools or even if the stools are dysenteric with great tenesmus and
colic, high fever and restlessness, give Cuphea.”
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aeth. (2) Coto Bark - intestinal catarrh, chronic, copious, exhausting diarrhea
and dysentery, colliquitine sweats of tuberculosis and chronic diarrhea. (3) Typha latifolia, Cat-tail flag -
diarrhea, dysentery, summer complaint of children. Tincture and first potency.
REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke.

author: Murphy
full:

HOMEOPATHIC - Cupre-au. has had a proving, which, though not extensive, is sufficient to show the analog

name: Cupressus Lawsoniana
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY -cupre-1. Cupressus lawsoniana. N. O. Coniferae. Tincture of berries andleaves. Historical
dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Keloids. Lipoma. Tumors. Warts.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cupre-1. has been proved in a fragmentary way by Burnett, who had to relinquish the
proving on account of the “terrible pains it caused in the stomach.”
Burnett concluded from his experience that the action of Cupre-1. is like that of Thuj. He successfully used it
as a variant of that remedy and of Sabin, in the cure of tumors like cocks-comb growth in the mouth, lipoma of
the thigh, and keloids.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Cuprum Aceticum
author: Murphy
full:
(Copper Acetate) ’
PHARMACY - cupr-acet. Cuprum aceticum. Copper acetate. Verdigris. Solutions.Historical dose: Trituration
and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Brain disorders. Brow ague. Cerebrospinal meningitis. Cholera. Chorea. Croup.
Diarrhea. Eruptions. Erysipelas. Hallucinations. Hydrocephalus. Labor, pains. Leprosy. Mania. Measles.
Paralyzes. Psoriasis. Scarlatina. Smallpox. Strabismus. Stroke. Tapeworm. Uremia. Vertigo. Whooping cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - Burnett cured with Cupr-acet. a case of left-sided brow ague of many years' standing. He
used Rademacher's Tincture of Copper. The pain was described as boring, screwing and was spoken of by
the patient as “awful.”
Burnett was unable to say whether the cure was strictly homeopathic or whether the Cuprum acted on the
basis of the Paracelsus's Universalia, of which it is one.
Cupr-acet. produces the leading features of Cupr., including cramps, griping pains, spasms, paralytic disorders
 and convulsions. Attacks come on suddenly and periodically. Protracted labor.
Facial neuralgia in cheekbone, upper jaw and behind the ear better by chewing, pressure and hot applications.
Chorea, periodical with melancholy and dread of society. In epilepsy, aura begins in the knee and ascends to
hypogastrium.
Chronic psoriasis and leprous-like eruption over whole body in spots of various sizes without itching. It
corresponds to the results of repelled eruptions. Hay fever with burning excoriation. Paroxysmal cough with
tough, tenacious mucus and fear of suffocation. Constitutions - Suited to the carbo-nitrog- enous constitution.
Face - Collapsed, hippocratic. Facial neuralgiain cheekbone, upper jaw and behind right ear. Better by
chewing, pressure and external warmth.
Head - Neuralgia with heaviness of head, burning, stinging and stitching in temples and forehead. Violent
throbbing and sharp pains in forehead. Left-sided brow ague. Brain seems void. Inclined to gape and cry.
Loses consciousness, headreels when in large room. Constant protrusion and retraction of tongue (Lach.).
Lungs - Spasmodic constriction of the chest. Violent spasmodic cough. Short, difficult respiration. Dyspnea.
Attacks of angina pectoris coming on when excited.
Modalities - Better chewing. Better pressure. Better night. Better lying on affected side and warmth. Worse
from heat. Worse motion. Worse emotions. Worse touch.
Skin - Leprous-like eruption over whole
body in spots of various sizes, without itching.
Stomach - Violent spasmodic pains in stomach and abdomen. Vomiting. Violent tenesmus. Slimy brown
diarrhea. Cholera.
Vertigo - Head reels when in a high-ceilinged room.
COMMENTS - A man, 50, was cured with Cupr-acet. 5c trituration, of a tonic spasm of the toes of the right
foot, very painful, lasting for hours, brought on by friction, standing on cold floors, etc. There was no traceable
cause and no other derangement of health. Complete cure in five days after months of previous suffering.
Petroz recommended its use in smallpox and verified his induction in practice. As pointed outby General
Phelps, the “Crimson Cross Ointment” which was used successfully by Fielden in the Gloucester epidemic of
smallpox owes its virtue to the Cupr-acet. which it contains.
In epilepsy, the aura begins in the knees and ascends to hypogastrium, when patient becomes insensible. The
symptoms are worse by heat and motion. The patient frequently changes posture.
RELATIONS - Acts similarly to Cupr. but is more violent in action. In poisoning cases it is Antidoted by: sugar
or white of egg, given freely. Homeopathic antidotes: Bell., Chin., Con., Cic., Dulc., Hep., Ip., Merc., Nux-v.
Compare: (l)Calc., Gels, -overworked brain. (2) Cic. and Solanaceae - mental symptoms. (3) Zinc. -
hydrocephalus and convulsions from suppressed exanthems.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Paralyzes. Psoriasis. Scarlatina. Smallpox. Strabismus. Stroke. Tapeworm. Uremia. Vertigo. Whooping cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - Burnett cured with Cupr-ace

name: Cuprum Arsenicosum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cupr-ar. Cuprum arsenicosum. Copper arsenite. Scheeles green. Trituration. Historical dose:
Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Boils. Carbuncles. Cholera. Cholerine. Chorea. Convulsions. Cramps. Diabetes. Diarrhea.
Gangrene. Gastro-enteritis. Enteralgia. Headaches. Nephritis. Neuralgic, pains. Paralysis, left sided. Ulcers.
Uremia. Uterine, neuralgia. Vomiting.
Cuprum arsenicosum HOMEOPATHIC - Cupr-ar. combines the characters of its two metallic components.
J. N. Majumdar noted the great characteristic of Cupr-ar. in choleraic conditions after B. L. Bhaduri pointed it
out to him. Majumdar noted “icy-coldness of the whole body with cramps and an obstinate hiccough.”
Various intestinal affections. Cholera morbus and infantum. Rice water stools. Entero-colitis, diarrhea and
dysentery. Gastro-intestinal disturbances of influenza or typhoid. Inflammation of the digestive tract with violent
colic, vomiting, diarrhea and uremia, with obstinate hiccough and icy cold body.
Deficient kidney action. Urine of garlicky odor. Uremic convulsions, headache, vertigo and unconscious
conditions resulting from brain edema. Uremic convulsions preceded by gastro-intestinal symptoms. Nephritis
ofpregnancy.
Awful distress in epigastric region, burning along esophagus and in urethra. Numbness, creeping, itching and
chilly sensations. Intense neuralgic pains in abdomen. Visceral neuralgia, sharp shooting abdominal pains.
Painful neuroses, enteroptosis. Violent cramps in chest, fingers, calves toes etc. Delirium and tremor cordis.
Leg cramps, better pressing foot on the floor. Numb paralyzed feeling in the legs. Trembling of the whole body
when attempting to walk. Chorea after fright.
Bronchial asthma and with emphysema. Chlorosis. Weak heart. Purulent endocarditis (Royal). Cold, clammy
 intermittent sweat. Abdomen - Gastro-enteritis. Violent abdominal pain. Rumbling and sharp, cutting pain.
Back - Persistent lameness. Pain in lumbar region, lower left shoulder blade, chest tight.
Heart - Cardiac rhythm and force altered due to defective elimination.
Kidneys - Diabetes. Kidney inefficiency and uremia. Garlic odor of urine. Urine of high specific gravity
increased, acetones and diacetic acid.
Limbs - Cramps in calves of legs, worse after midnight, only relieved by getting
out of bed and standing. Gangrene ulcers. Male - Perspiration of scrotum is constantly damp and moist. Boils
on scrotum. Purulent discharge of a white color from urethra, tingling and burning in urethra. Pain in prostate,
pains in penis.
Modalities - Better rest and worse motion, but stiffness of back and tingling of hands are better from motion.
Damp weather causes neuralgia of abdomen.
Mouth - Tongue thickly coated, dirty brown, white, metallic taste, thirst. Dry mouth.
Rectum - Rice water stools. Cholera infantum, cholera (Verat., Camph.). Rumbling and sharp, cutting pain.
Dark liquid stools. Diarrhea in tuberculosis.
Skin - Icy cold sweat and skin even when dry. Cold, clammy perspiration of an intermittent nature. Acne,
pustules on face and in the genital region, ulcers look like chancre. Gangrene, carbuncles.
COMMENTS - Salzer showed that “cold, clammy perspiration of intermittent nature” is unique and
characteristic. He found it most valuable in the collapse stage of cholera, where intermittent cold, clammy
sweat was noted. The skin is very sensitive to touch and pressure worse all symptoms. Weakness and
restlessness. Periodicity in the symptoms.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ars. and Cupr. preparations (2) Aeon., Cimic. - angina pectoris, numbness of left
side of body, paresis of left arm. (3) Merc-c. - diarrhea and tenesmus. (3) Iris-v.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Cuprum Metallicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cupr. Cuprum metallicum. Copper metal, (Cu, At. Wt. 6). Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration
and all potencies.
CLINICAL - After-pains. Angina pectoris. Asthma. Asthma miller. Bronchitis. Cardialgía. Catarrh. Chlorosis.
Cholera. Chorea. Convulsions. Colic. Coughs. Cramps. Croup. Cyanosis. Dentition. Dyspnea. Emissions.
Epilepsy. Eruptions. Erysipelas. Fainting. Gout. Hematemesis. Herpes. Hyperesthesia. Hysteria. Larynx,
spasms. Mania. Measles. Meningitis. Neuralgias. Palpitations. Paralysis.
Pneumonia. Psoriasis. Ringworm. Sleeplessness. Spasms. Spinal irritation. Tapeworms. Ulcers. Whooping
cough. Worms. Yellow fever.
HOMEOPATHIC - Metallic copper is one of the most important remedies where the diseased conditions
“appear” on account of the non-appearance or suppressions of eruptions and the discharges.
Skin eruptions and foot-sweat. Effects of suppression of eruptions, exanthems and foot-sweat, whether these
effects are internal pains or spasms or oppression of the brain and mental disturbance.
Affects the nerves of the cerebro-spinal axis and muscles, causing spasmodic effects, convulsions and
cramps of violent form. Cramps in toes, fingers, calves where the muscles are knotted, better stretching.
Cramps beginning in fingers and toes, violent, contractive and intermitting pain.
Cramps may occur in the chest (angina pectoris), behind the sternum. Cramps in the limbs in elderly people,
particularly leg cramps (Calc., Mag-p., acutely). Cramps before sex, preventing sex, in the calves, soles and
feet.
Spasms with blue face and clenched thumbs. Jerking during sleep. Restless tossing all night. Stupor with
jerking of muscles. Paralysis of isolated muscles. Chorea from fright, periodical. Chorea from suppressed
eruptions.
Convulsions of children during dentition, children lie on abdomen and jerk the buttock up. Convulsions are
tonic or clonic. With convulsions, the eyes roll upward, out, or inward (Aeth.).
Convulsions start in the knees, toes, or fingers and radiate over the whole body with piercing ties. Twisting of
the head to one side. Trismus followed by headache. Spasmodic laughter. Shivering. Deathly exhaustion with
cold perspiration.
Epilepsy, at night, during menses. Violent epilepsy, legs may shoot out and lock in spasm. Epilepsy after
suppressed eruptions, especially on the head (Zinc). Epilepsy after fright.
In epilepsy, aura begins at knees, ascends to hypogastrium, then unconsciousness, foaming and falling. The
patient falls with a shriek, passes urine and feces. Headache follows after spasms or a group of symptoms.
Followed by the appearance as if the patient were dead or in a state of ecstasy.
 Pains like knife-thrusts, worse on least motion, that take away the breath. Patient thinks that he must die if
they last. The thrusts go through to the back from the umbilicus. Pains worse touch and motion. Pressive pains,
as from a blow being broken, racking darts through the whole body.
Cholera (Verat., Camph.). Gushing watery stools, with blue, cold extremities and jerking and cramping. Tape-
worms. Complaints from scarlet fever, including excessive vomiting, stupor, and convulsions. Nausea.
Meningitis. Chlorosis.
Hypersensitive, every drug overacts without curing. Easy relapses. Symptoms disposed to appear periodically
and in groups. Complaints begin in left side (Lach.).
MIND - Nervous. Uneasy. Fixed ideas, malicious and morose. Sullen, tricky, alternating yielding and head-
strong. Imitates, mimics. Speaks in a whisper because of pain. Uses words not intended. Sense of losing
consciousness.
Attacks of rage, wants to bite the bystanders. Mania, bites, beats, tears the things. Delirium, cold sweat.
Piercing shrieks. Weeps violently. Convulsive laughter. Fearful. Confusion, afraid of everybody who
approaches him. Loquacious, then melancholy with fear of death. Fear of society, shuns everybody. Abdomen
- Tense, hot and tender to touch. Neuralgia of abdominal viscera. Spasmodic movements of abdominal
muscles. Frightful colic with contraction of the abdomen. Better pressure, worse raising arms.
Intussusception, with fecal vomiting.
Back - Paralysis of all the muscles up to the neck. Sensation of heaviness in the axillary glands. Swelling of
the glands of the neck. Hyperesthesia of spinal column. Backache top of sacrum.
Causations - Ailments from emotions, anger, fright, suppressions, loss of sleep, mentally and bodily over-
work. Chorea from fright. Getting wet causes epileptic attacks.
Chest - Spasm and constriction of chest. Painful constriction of the chest (lower). Loud rattling in chest.
Round balls moving to and fro under the ribs, better tight clothing and lying quiet.
Constitutions - Suited to fair-haired people. Carbo-nitrogenoid constitution. Women who have borne many
children (after-pains).
Eyes - Aching over eyes. Fixed, staring, sunken, glistening, turned upwards. Eyeballs rotate quickly behind
closed lids or roll from side to side. Bruised pain in the orbits, worse moving the eyes. Lids spasmodically
closed, twitching of lids (left). Photophobia.
Face - Distorted,pale bluish, livid, sunken, pinched. Icy cold. Lips blue. Chewing motion of the lower jaw.
Lockjaw. Contraction of jaws with foam at mouth.
Female - Menses too late, protracted. Menses absent due to suppression of foot sweat. Violent cramps in
abdomen extending into the chest before or during menses, or from suppressions of the menses ,or from
suppressed foot sweats (Sil.). Convulsions before menses. Puerperal convulsions with open mouth and
opisthotonos. After- pains. especially in women who had borne many children. Ebullition of blood, and
palpitations. Chlorosis.
Food - Desire for cold drinks, which ameliorate. Milk causes belching. Food tastes sweetish, or metallic, acid,
or salt, watery. Desire for cold food in preference to hot.
Head - Meningitis, cannot hold head erect or bores into the pillow. Pulls her hair. Shakes the head from side
to side. Strange tingling, crawling in the vertex (suppressed menses). Headache after epilepsy. Sensation as
if water were poured over the head with headache. Empty feeling with pain. Purple, red swelling of head with
convulsions. Bruised pain in brain and eyes on turning them.
Heart - Palpitations, precordial anxiety and pain. Palpitations before menses. Fatty degeneration (Phos.).
Angina pectoris with asthmatic symptoms and cramps. Slow pulse or hard, full and quick.
Kidneys - Suppression of urine in cholera, uremia. Urgent desire to urinate with scanty emission. Frequent
emission of fetid, viscid urine. Passes clear, watery urine during or after spasms. B urning shootings in the
urethra, during and subsequent to the emission of urine. Bedwetting.
Limbs - Cramps in calves, soles, and palms. Jerking, twitching of muscles in hands and feet. Clonic spasms,
beginning in fingers and toes. Clenching of thumbs in palms. Joints contracted. Great weariness of limbs.
Knees double up involuntary when walking, bringing him down. Ankles painfully heavy. Ankylosis of shoulder
joint. Coldness of hands. Epilepsy, aura begins in knees, feel as if broken.
Liver - Cirrhosis of liver.
Lungs - Dyspnea with epigastric uneasiness. Dyspnea, cannot bear anything near the mouth, worse coughing,
laughing, bending backwards, before the menses. Hoarseness, worse breathing cold air. Cough in violent
paroxysms, coughs herself out of breath, better cold drinks, worse deep breathing, bending backwards with
cramps, lachrymation. Cough has a gurgling sound. Suffocative attacks, worse 3 a.m. (Am-c.). Trembling after
coughing. Whooping cough, better swallowing water with vomiting, spasms and purple face. Asthma, hiccough
before, alternating with spasmodic vomiting. Angina with asthmatic symptoms and cramps.
 Male - Cramps in calves prevents sex. especially in old or nervous young men.
Modalities - Better during perspiration. Better drinking cold water. Better being mesmerized. Better laying
hand on affected part. Better pressure over heart. Headache better wrapping head. Worse from emotions,
anger, fright. Worse loss of sleep. Worse suppression. Worse bodily and mental over work. Worse from motion.
Worse raising arms. Worse touch. Worse pressure. Worse before menses.
Worse evening and night. Worse cold air, cold wind. Worse hot weather. Worse at new moon.
Mouth - Strong metallic, slimy taste with flow of saliva. Froth from mouth. Grinds the teeth. Food tastes like
clear water. Stammering speech, loss of speech. Paralysis of tongue. Firmly closed or open with tongue darting
in and out like a snake in convulsions.
Nose - Stoppage of the nose. Sensation of violent congestion of blood to nose (Meli.). Violent, fluent coryza.
Rectum - Cholera with cramps in abdomen and calves. Cholera, summer diarrhea in children. Diarrhea,
profuse, spurting out of green water. Black, painful, bloody with tenesmus and weakness. Constipation with
great heat of body. Round, tapeworms or threadworms.
Skin - Bluish, marbled skin. Suppressed or undeveloped eruptions. Severe itching without eruptions. Chronic
psoriasis. Ulcers, itching spots and pimples at the folds of joints. Yellow scaly eruptions (bend of elbow).
Leprosy.
Sleep - Lethargic sleep. Profound sleep, with shocks in the body and starting in the limbs. Constant rumbling
in abdomen during sleep.
Stomach - Painful crampy pressure in epigastrium, worse touch and movement. Lies on stomach and jerks
the buttocks up (colic, convulsions). Whendrinking, thefluid descends with gurgling sound (Laur.). As if
something bitter were in stomach. Hiccough, before vomiting, convulsions, spasms or asthma. Pronounced
nausea. Periodical attacks of vomiting. Vomiting, violent tormenting with agonizing colic, diarrhea, shrieks or
convulsions, better cold drinks. Vomits always on waking up in morning, on least motion.
Temperature - Chilly. Icy coldness of skin. Sweat, cold, clammy, at night, sour smelling after convulsions.
Throat - Swelling of the glands of the neck. Spasms of throat. Unable to talk on account of spasms of throat.
Dryness of the throat, with thirst. Inflammation of the pharynx. Audible sound of drinking
(gurgling), while swallowing it. Intermittent aphonia in professional singers.
Vertigo - Giddiness accompanies many ailments, head falls forward on chest. Vertigo with internal tremors,
head sinks forwards on the chest, better stool, lying down, worse looking up.
COMMENTS - Metallic copper is an anti-psoric remedy, working from within outwards. It is one of the most
important remedies that relieve states arising from the “striking inward’’ of diseases or the failure of eruptions
or discharge to appear. Suppressed discharges that lead to spasms and convulsions.
Relieve internal spasms which renders it appropriate to the collapse stage of cholera (Sulph.). Aprophylactic
either when worn next the skin or when taken internally.
Maliciousness and a desire to injure. Screaming with cerebral or mental symptoms. Loquaciousness. Violent
head pains that are worse over the left eye. Brain seems paralyzed. Over-sensitiveness of the skin, especially
in the region of the stomach and fourth and fifth dorsal vertebrae.
Cramps, spasms, twitches, and convulsions. Twitches of little muscles spread into the major muscles and can
ultimately go into aconvulsion. Face will turn blue, fingers and toes cramp, thumb will go into the hand and
lock. B ack arches, neck goes back. Drawing in the fingers. Sudden and severe flexion and extension of the
limbs.
Cramps and convulsions in meningitis, cholera, whooping cough and spasmatic asthma. Spasms of the
stomach that lead to nausea and vomiting. Severe spasms after a vexation or a fright (Op.). Vomiting,
hiccoughs and spasms better by drinking cold water.
Whooping cough. Violent, spasmodic coughing, worse cold air (Rumx.). Wheezing and spasm. Spasmodic
breathing with rattling in the chest. Asthma with bluish lips and spasms and constriction of the chest.
Constriction pains with stress of asthma (Cact.). Constriction below the xiphoid process. Feels as if stuck with
the knife from the xiphoid to the back.
Cramps at puberty, better bathing in
Cuprum metallicum cold water. Convulsions during menses. Dysmenorrhea associated with cramps in the
fingers, severe cramps and spasms In the uterus. Labor pains are so severe they start convulsing. Or they
feel the labor pains and their hands and feet start cramping up or spasms outside the uterus. Sudden blindness
during labor.
Senile gangrene with the toes and fingers due to poor circulation, with cramps and spasms in the fingers and
toes (Ars., Sec., Agar.). Chlorosis from abuse of iron.
J. C. McLaren noted “Cramps or spasms beginning in hands and feet, extending to belly.”
Guernsey said that “a slimy metallic taste in the mouth” is one of the strongest indications for Cupr. (Rhus-t.).
 Paralysis of the tongue, stammering (Caust., Merc.). Grinds teeth at night. Thirst for cold drinks and
ameliorated by cold drinks. Worse inhaling cold air.
Mackechnie made a brilliant cure of psoriasis in a young girl with Cupr. The leading features of its
symptomatology are cramps, convulsions, violent spasms, coming on from disappearance of pains,
discharges, eruptions, mental derangement. Patient screams with suppression of menses. Tonic spasms of
thumbs. Eyeballs turn up. Opisthotonos. Tonic and clonic spasms.
Convulsions during pregnancy. Puerperal convulsions which begin in the fingers or toes and spread all over
the body. Can also have a great restlessness between the attacks, either filling up the entire interval or only a
part of the time.
Mossa regarded Cupr. as one of the remedies for the effects of fright, and relates the case of a girl who after
a fright was affected by involuntary motions of left arm and leg developing into pronounced general chorea.
Cupr. brought about slow but decided recovery.
Another girl, 12, who had recovered from whooping cough got a kind of chorea from repeated frights on seeing
an epileptic. To the muscular movements was added silly behavior including a heavy tongue, slow speech and
unwieldy gait. Frightened at night. Greediness in eating and drinking.
Ign., Stram., Sulph., did little good. She became ill-natured. Cupr. every four days cured completely in three
months.
Mackechnie reported the case of a boy who became epileptic after being locked up in school. Very great
improvementfollowed the administration of Cupr.
Schwencke cured a case of epilepsy of forty years' standing with Cupr. 6c after Bell, and Hyos. had done little
good. The patient was a man aged 45. The fits began suddenly towards morning with chewing motion of lower
jaw, gnashing of teeth, becomes upright and rigid in bed, shrieks, limbs convulsed. After giving way to violent
anger, attacks become more severe, arms and legs were thrown outwards and trunk arched upward.
Cupr. was given. For a time the attacks continued, but gradually improvement set in and in less than three
months they ceased altogether. The “anger” in this case and the “ill-humor” in Mossa's are noteworthy as
maliciousness is an indication for Cupr.
In a second case cured by Schwencke, that of a man, 38, epileptic seven years, a pressive headache preceded
the attacks, ascending from nape to forehead, then there was profuse salivation, head turned to left, eyes
closed tongue in active motion in open mouth, trunk arched upward, slight spasms of right arm outward. After
the attack, there was a dullness in the head and a feeling in the body as if beaten.
Cupr. first removed the fits and then the dullness of the head.
RELATIONS -Antidotes: Bell., Hep., Camph. Copper is found in Dulc., Staph., Con. and some other plants.
Also in the king-crab, Limulus. Compare: ( 1 ) Cupr-s. Cupr-cyan. - meningitis basilaris. (2) Cholas terrapina-
cramps in calves and feet, rheumatism with cramp-like pains, Plb.. Nux-v, Verat.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Cuprum Sulphuricum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cupr-s. Cuprum sulphuricum. Copper sulphate. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Alopecia. Conjunctivitis. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Eyes, granular lids. Scabies. Syphilis. Trachoma.
HOMEOPATHIC - Sulphate of Copper is a well-known emetic and caustic. It is a well- known application in
allopathic practice for stimulating flabby granulations and it has cured itching eruptions and manifestations of
syphilis. Pains better rest.
Cupr-s. causes forcible vomiting and much nausea. Burning at vertex. Paleness of face or jaundiced
appearance, pale skin generally. Tongue and lips bluish. Granular eyelids. Catarrhal and purulent conjuncti-
vitis. Incessant, spasmodic cough, worse at night. Diarrhea. Enlarged liver.
J. D. Tyrrell mentioned the case of a woman who could not use Cupr-s. for “stamping” fancy work because it
“made her face hurt and swell so she could scarcely see and her lips became everted, turned inside out, she
 said.” RELATIONS - Antidotedby: Milk, eggs, pure yellow prussiate of potash. Compare: ( 1 ) Kali- bi. - cough
and Merc.
REFERENCES Clarke.

name: Curare
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cur. Curare woorari. Arrow- poison. Curara. Woorara. Woorali. Hoorali. Oorari. N. O.
Loganiacae. Tincture. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Cancer. Catalepsy. Cirrhosis. Corns. Coughs. Debility. Diabetes. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspnea. Ear,
disorders. Eczema. Emphysema. Epilepsy. Facial, paralysis. Faintness. Headache. Leprosy. Liver, spots.
Locomotor, ataxia. Nervous, debility. Neuralgias. Otitis. Ozaena. Paralysis. Ptosis. Rabies. Reflexes, weak.
Scrofula, disorders. Tetanus. Tuberculosis. Ulcerations. Uterus, disorders. Vaginitis. Whooping cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - An arrow poison used by South American Indians, Curare affects the muscles and brain. It
is a muscular poison, causing paralysis of muscles without impairing the sensations and consciousness.
Muscular paralysis without impairing any sensation or consciousness. It causes death by paralysis of the
respiratory muscles. Reflex action is diminished or abolished. In many ways, its action is opposite that of
Nux-v.
Paralysis, facial, mouth, threatening respiration. Catalepsy. Trismus. Nervous debility. Sensation as if the brain
were full of fluid. As of a heavy weight hung to the limbs. Weakness, heaviness, numbness, numbness with
tingling. Piercing, sharp pains. Throbbing pains.
Debility of the aged (Bar-c.) and from loss of fluids. Glycosuria with motor paralysis. Diabetes mellitus.
Decreases the output of adrenalin. Vomiting of bile in cirrhosis of liver. Fetid discharges. Leprosy. Many
symptoms appear on right side.
MIND - Indecision, no longer wishes to think or act for herself. Inability to think or study, forgetful, stupid,
sleepy, indolent. Excited, hurried feeling. Depressed, desire to be alone. Abdomen - Weary ache from throat
to left hip. Neuralgic pain in hypogastrium with pressure in vagina. Pain in groin low down with heaviness in
limbs while walking. Bowels feel sore and bruised.
Back - Tired pain up and down spine. Stiffness in neck, head drawn back. Stiffness of muscles or right neck
and shoulder. Dull, tired ache in shoulders and across back, numb. Chills running up back and all over body.
Chest - Sore to pressure or touch.
Constitutions - Suited to scrofulous children, producing scrofulous eruptions on skin, eczema, especially of
face and behind ears, and yellow brown liver-spots.
Ears - Otitis interna, driving crazy. Noises, unbearable earache. Purulent discharge. Swelling of lobes of ear.
Sharp pains start from ears, extending down to legs.
Eyes - Sharp, stitching pains over right eye. Ptosis of right side. Heavy eyes, lids can hardly be kept open.
Eyes haggard, sunken. Feel as if full of sticks. Red, hot, sensitive to light. Black spots before vision, especially
worse from reading.
Face - Facial and mouth paralysis. Paralysis of muscles of expression. Aching right side of face. Tongue and
mouth drawn. Red face.
Female - Menses too early. During menses, colic, headache and kidney pain. Dysmenorrhea. Leucorrhea,
thick, purulent offensive, in clots. Bearing-down, dragging, tired, in all pelvic organs. Vaginitis. Griping in right
ovary. Ulcerations of os uteri, scirrhus. Aversion to sex.
Food - Thirst and great hunger with fever. Sudden hunger almost to faintness. Better after first mouthful of
food. Aversion to bread. Great thirst especially evening and night. Craves acids.
Head - Head drawn backward. Rush of blood to head. Brain feels full of fluid. Head confused, great weight in
vertex. Head beats like a hammer, with vomiting of bile. Nervous headache. Sharp pains all over head. Falling
out of hair.
Heart - Precordial pain, anguish with palpitations and stinging pains in heart.
Kidneys - Digging, crampy pain in kidneys, dry mouth, great thirst. Urine copious, urgent, bladder feels
distended. Clear and frequent urine. Sugar in urine, great emaciation (acute diabetes).
Limbs - Paralysis of limbs, burning with
heat and chills. Aching in all the limbs and body. Numbness and tingling. Debility, paralysis. Catalepsy.
Reflexes lessened or abolished. Arms weak, heavy. Cannot lift the fingers. Weakness of hands and fingers
in pianists. Legs tremble, give way in walking. Favors development of corns.
Lungs - Severe pains in lungs, especially left. Shortness of breath. Threatened paralysis of the respiration
on falling asleep. Very distressing dyspnea. Dyspnea, stitching pains right side. Dyspnea, worse ascending.
Short, dry, hacking cough, provokes vomiting, followed by fainting. Dry cough with soreness of chest walls.
 Cough, worse breathing cold air, laughing, moving, eating. Cough troublesome in morning.
Modalities - Worse from motion. Worse walking. Worse ascending, 2 a.m. and 2 p.m. to 3 p.m. Worse from
dampness. Worse cold weather, cold wind. Worse change of weather.
Mouth - Mouth dry. Tongue and mouth drawn to right. Tongue coated. On waking, tongue yellowish at base,
papillae raised, light pink anteriorly, yellow-white, bitter or bloody taste.
Nose - Nasal catarrh. Ozaena, fetid lumps of pus. Tubercles on nose.
Rectum - Extreme watery diarrhea. Diarrhea with constant urging, fetid, thin mush-like feces. Excessive pain
in hemorrhoids.
Skin - Leprosy. Dirty-looking skin. Itching, with hunger. Eczema. Liver-spots. Boils. Tubercles on nose. Blood
oozes through.
Sleep - Drowsy, cannot keep awake. Nights restless, always desiring to put feet out of bed, especially towards
morning.
Stomach - Empty, gone feeling in stomach. Sharp pain in pit of stomach, followed by nausea. Shooting in
stomach. Heartburn, pain and distention after eating ever so little. Chill after eating. Nausea in morning after
eating. Vomits green bile all night. Frequent and annoying hiccoughs.
Temperature - Chill, creeping up back without thirst. Body blue, and yet fever. Heat worse at night and in open
air. Sweat
with every exertion. Sweat, cold and bloody, especially at nights.
Throat - Burning heat in throat with sensation of distention.
Vertigo - Instant giddiness, falling in swoon while standing or walking. Dizzy when looking at near objects or
at water.
COMMENTS - Causes death by paralysis of the respiratory muscles. Reflex action is diminished or abolished
(opp. Nux-v.). Catalepsy, immobility with fixed gaze on waking. Indicated by debility short of paralysis, the
debility of the aged and nervous, and debility from the loss of fluids.
Fetid odor of secretions and discharges. It favors the formation of corns. Its relation to hydrophobia and tetanus
is probably antipathic. Used allopathically in tetanus treatments.
A cure of a pseudo-hypertrophic paralysis by the 200c was recorded. Two cases of diabetes in middle-aged
men have been cured by Burkhardt with Cur. 4c. Diabetes mellitus.
Grimmer noted that it is useful for cancer with weakness and a tendency to faint, extreme debility, difficult
breathing, vertigo with fainting. States of catalepsy, worse by exercise, walking, etc., worse in dampness. Cold
air, cold weather, worse 2 a.m. and 2 p.m. to 3 p.m.
RELATIONS - Antidote to: Strychnia and to the poison of rabies. In cases of poisoning artificial respiration
must be resorted to. Bromine and Chlorine antidote its effects. If the poisoning is due to a punctured wound,
rubbing in tobacco or salt will neutralize it. Compare: (1) Cystisin - motor paralysis. (2) Con., Caust., Crot-h.,
Nux-v. (3) Aran. - fever worse in damp weather. (4) Ferr. - hammering pains in head. (5) Crot-h. - blows in
region of cerebellum. (6) In yellow-brown spots on skin, Sep., Lyc., Nux-v., Sulph. Compatible: After Arn.
(paralysis from injury) after Bell, (paralysis after nosebleed). Follows well: in debility of the aged: Bar-c.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.
keynote:

Loganiacae. Tincture. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Cancer. Catalepsy. Cirrhosis. Corns. Coughs. Debility. Diabetes. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspnea. Ear,
disorders. Eczema. Emphysema. Epilepsy. Facial, paralysis. Faintness. Headache. Leprosy. Liver, spots.
Locomotor, ataxia. Nervous, debility. Neuralgias. Otitis. Ozaena. Paralysis. Ptosis. Rabies. Reflexes, weak.
Scrofula, disorders.

name: Curcuma Longa
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - cure. Curcuma longa. Turmeric. Curcuma rotunda. Southern Asia. N. 0. Zingiberaceae.
Rhizome. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Atherosclerosis. Cancer. Gastritis. Indigestion. Liver, problems. Osteoarthritis. Parasites. Skin,
diseases. Stomach, disorders. Uveitis. Worms. Wounds.
HERBAL - Turmeric (Curcuma longa), a flowering plant in the ginger family, is widely used as a food coloring
and is one of the principal ingredients in curry powder. Turmeric is fragrant and has a bitter, somewhat sharp
taste.
The aboveground and underground roots, or rhizomes, are used in medicinal and food preparations. These
are generally boiled and then dried, turning into the familiar yellow powder. Curcumin from turmeric, as well as
other substances in this herb, have antioxidant properties.
Turmeric has long been used in both Ayurvedic and Chinese medicine as an antiinflammatory, to treat digestive
disorders and liver problems, and for the treatment of skin diseases and wound healing.
Curcumin has been shown, to stimulate the production of bile and to facilitate the emptying of the gallbladder.
It has also demonstrated a protective effect on the liver, anti-tumor action, and ability to reduce inflammation
and fight certain infections.
Turmeric is for a variety of digestive disorders. Curcumin, for example, one of the active ingredients in turmeric,
 induces the flow of bile, which helps break down fats. Stomach upset, gas, abdominal cramps.
Extracts of turmeric root can reduced secretion of acid from the stomach and protected against injuries such
as inflammation along the stomach (gastritis) or intestinal walls and ulcers from certain medications, stress, or
alcohol.
Because of its ability to reduce inflammation, turmeric may help relieve the symptoms of osteoarthritis. Early
studies suggest that turmeric may prove helpful in preventing
the build up of atherosclerosis (blockage of arteries that can eventually cause a heart attack or stroke) in one
of two ways.
Turmeric may also prevent platelet build up along the walls of an injured blood vessel. Platelets collecting at
the site of a damaged blood vessel cause blood clots to form and blockage of the artery as well.
Curcumin has potential in the treatment of various forms of cancer, including prostate, breast, skin, and colon.
Roundworms and Intestinal worms. Turmeric, may reduce the destructive activity of parasites or roundworms.
Turmeric's volatile oil functions as an external antibiotic, preventing bacterial infection in wounds. Turmeric
applied to wounds hastens the healing process.
Inflammation of the uvea, and the retina. The uvea contains many of the blood vessels that nourish the eye.
Inflammation of this area, therefore, can affect the cornea, the retina, the sclera, and other important parts of
the eye.
REFERENCES - Potter.
