name: Dulcamara
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - dulc. Dulcamara. Woody nightshade. Bitter-sweet. Solanum dulcamara. N. O. Solanaceae. Not
to be confounded with “Deadly Nightshade,” Belladonna, nor with “Climbing Bitter-sweet,” Celastrus. Dulca-
mara tincture prepared from fresh green stems and leaves, gathered just before flowering. Historical dose:
Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Adenitis. Anasarca. Aphonia. Bladder, disorders. Blepharophthalmia. Catarrh. Cholera. Colds.
Crusta, lactea. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dysentery. Emaciation. Exostoses. Fevers. Glands, swollen. Hemorrhages.
Hay fever. Headaches. Hemorrhages. Hemorrhoids. Herpes. Influenza. Irritation. Lichen. Lumbago. Measles.
Meningitis. Mononucleosis. Muscle, pain. Myelitis. Nettle-rash. Neuralgias. Ophthalmia. Paralyzes. Pem-
phigus. Rheumatism. Scarlatina. Scrofula. Stammering. Sore, throat. Stiff-neck. Tibia, pains. Tongue,
disorders. Tonsillitis. Tumor. Typhoid.Urination,difficult.Urticaria. Warts. Whooping cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - The leading indication for Dulcamara is found in its modality, worse from cold and damp.
Effects of lying on damp ground (e.g., paralysis), conditions which are worse in cold, damp weather or from
changes from hot to cold weather.
Effects of damp weather, colds after exposure to wet, especially diarrhea. Results from sitting on cold, damp
ground. Hot days and cold nights toward the close of summer. Patients living or working in damp, cold
basements (Nat-s.).
Rheumatic troubles induced by damp cold are aggravated by every cold change, somewhat relieved by
moving about. Stiffness, numbness, aching and soreness of muscles on every exposure to cold especially of
back and loins.
Tearing pains. Dropsy, anasarca. Onesided spasms with speechlessness. Paralysis of single parts, vocal
cords, tongue, etc. Paralyzed parts icy cold. Congestive headache with neuralgia and dry nose.
Adenitis, glands, swollen and indurated. Enlarged glands. Exostoses. Hemorrhages, blood watery or bright
red. Eruptions on hands, arms or face around the menstrual period. Griping in bowels around the umbilicus in
testes.
MIND - Mental confusion, cannot concentrate. Difficult speech, cannot find the right word. Dullness and painful
stupefaction of head. Dullness of senses. Rejects the things asked for. Haughty. Domineering, strong-minded
and possessive. Scolds without being angry. Quarrelsome without anger.
Depression. Easily becomes delirious with pain. Restless and impatient. Weeping after hallucinations.
Delusions as if bed were sinking. Sees spectres on waking. Impatience in morning. Irritability during daytime.
Starting on falling asleep. Throws things away in morning.
Abdomen - Dropsy of abdomen. Eruptions or pain about the navel. Cutting pain at navel followed by painful,
green, slimy stools. Colic from cold. Cold feeling in bowels. Cutting pain about navel, followed by painful, green,
slimy stools. Swelling of inguinal glands (Merc.).
Back - Heat and burning in back. Pain in small of back, as after long stooping. Backache, worse damp cold
weather. Lumbar region and sacrum feel cold. Spinal meningitis during scarlatina or measles, eruption doesn't
develop. Myelitis after taking cold during menses. Hyperemia of spinal cord. Rheumatic affections of spinal
cord. Swelling of glands of neck. Stiffness and lameness across neck and shoulders after getting cold and
wet. Stiff neck.
Bladder - Cystitis. Catarrh of bladder from taking cold. Bladder wall thickened. Must urinate when getting
chilled. Frequent urination. Strangury, painful urination. Retention of urine from cold or cold drinks. Involuntary
urination from paralysis of bladder. Ischuria from wading with bare feet in cold water. Strangury, painful
urination.
Breasts - Breasts, engorged and sore, delicate, sensitive to cold. Sore nipples after weaning. Breasts, swollen
with absent menses or leucorrhea. Herpes on breasts in nursing women. Breasts, engorged, hard, sore, with
amenorrhea or leucorrhea. Eruptions on skin after weaning. Suppressed milk from taking cold.
Causations - Damp with cold, wading, washing. Injuries. Checked eruptions or perspiration. Complaints of
workers in ice factory. People who are exposed to a constant change of temperature, air conditioning.
Chest - Great oppression of the chest, especially when breathing. Pain in left chest as if lung moved in waves.
Dull shooting, as from blows in and upon the sides of the chest. Sharp pains, here and there in chest. Small
 pimples on chest and abdomen.
Constitutions - Suited to phlegmatic, torpid. scrofulous patients, who are restless and irritable and who take
cold on damp changes.
Coughs - Coughs in infants and elderly people. Whooping cough with excessive secretion of mucus. Panting
cough, like whooping cough, worse each deep inspiration. Cough after physical exertion.
Hoarse, spasmodic cough. Loose, rattling cough, worse cold, wet weather. Dry, teasing, winter coughs.
Cough, caused by tickling in the back of throat in prolonged fits with much loose easy expectoration. Must
cough a long time to expel phlegm. Copious mucus with loose cough. Barking cough, after a deep breath.
Ears - Child very susceptible to earache. Stitching earache with nausea, whole night, preventing sleep.
Buzzing in ears. Swelling of parotids after measles. Middle-ear catarrh (Merc-d„ Kali-m.). Earache with nausea.
Impaired hearing with humming in ears and dull pain.
Eyes - Every time he takes cold it settles in eyes. Aching pain when reading. Aching with dimness of sight.
Ophthalmia neonatorum. Chemosis of conjunctiva. Ophthalmia from catching cold. Hay fever with aprofuse,
watery discharge, worse in open air. Thick, yellow discharge, granular lids. Twitching of eyelids in cold air.
Jerking in muscles of eyes. Paralysis of upper lid. Pupils much dilated. Idiopathic iritis after exposure in damp
weather. Threatened amaurosis in scrofulous children. Dim vision. Sees as through a gauze. Sees sparks.
Face - Face bloated. Faceache and asthma, after disappearance of tetters in face. Facial neuralgia, worse
from the slightest exposure to cold. Tearing in cheek extending to ear orbit and jaw, preceded by coldness
of parts and attended by canine hunger. Twitching of lips in cold air. Humid eruptions on cheeks and face
generally. Thick, brown, yellow crusts on face. Swelling of parotids after measles. Pimples and little ulcers
around mouth. Warts. Herpes about lips. Cold sores on lips (Nat-m.).
Female - Rash appears on the skin before menses. Menses watery. Menses delayed and too short.
Dysmenorrhea with blotches all over. Menses, milk, suppressed by cold or dampness. Suppression of menses
from cold or dampness. Herpetic eruptions on vulva, worse every cold change of weather, or by exposure in
cold, damp situations. Lochia suppressed by cold or
damp. Threatened miscarriage induced by exposure in a damp, cold place. Pruritus with heat and sexual
desire.
Food - Hunger without appetite. Hunger after fever. Aversion to food. Aversion to coffee. Great thirst for cold
drinks.
Head - Congestion to head with buzzing in ears. Headache, relieved by conversation. Headache with great
uneasiness, depressed spirits. Occiput feels large, cold. Occipital pain ascending from nape of neck. Back part
of head chilled, heavy, aching during cold weather. Sensation as if a board were pressing against the forehead.
Sensation as if hair stood on end. Tinea capitis, crusta lactea and dandruff, worse change of weather. Scald
head, thick brown crusts, bleeding when scratched, causing hair to fall out. Ringworm of scalp.
Heart - Palpitations at night. Pulse hard, small and tense, worse at night. Pulse soft, full, slow, bounding. Pulse
slower than beat of heart. Pulse frequent at night, slow during day. Pulse collapsed.
Kidneys - Burning in meatus while urinating. Must urinate when getting chilled. Nephritisfrom cold. Ischuria
from wading with bare feet in cold water. Pain in region of kidneys, with dropsy and albumen in urine. Urine
increases with every little cold. Cloudy, slimy or foul urine. Urine with thick, mucus, purulent sediment. Urine
offensive, turbid when passed, and excoriating the skin.
Limbs - Rheumatic symptoms alternating with diarrhea or acute eruptions. Rheumatism after exposure to
wet. Paralyzed limbs. Feet icy cold. Cold feeling in bones. Sudden swelling of body and puffiness of limbs.
Swelling of calf of leg. Pain in shinbones. Exostosis on arms after suppressed scabies. Trembling of arm (right)
with urinary difficulty. Perspiration on palms of hands. Warts on hands and fingers.
Lungs - Asthma with dyspnea. Asthma with faceache after disappearance of tetters in face. Oppressed
breathing from a cold. Dyspnea with accumulation of mucus. Impending paralysis of lungs. Copious mucus.
Easy expectoration of taste
less mucus, often streaked with blood. Rheumatic pleuritis and pleuro-pneu- monia, with tough, difficult,
discoloured sputa. Hydrothorax, worse wet weather. Bronchitis with offensive smelling night sweat.
Tuberculosis, worse in changes from warm to cold. Tuberculosis, sputum tough, green.
Male - Enlarged testes with griping pain. Impotence. Herpes. Eruptions, brown, dry, humid or furfuraceous.
Eruptions, red, pale red. Eruptions with a red areola. Eruptions, round, scaly and small. Eruptions, suppurating,
yellow.
Modalities - Better lying on side. Better moving the affected part. Better external warmth. Better dry weather.
Worse from being chilled while hot, Worse hot days and cold nights. Worse sudden changes of temperature.
Worse cold wet, damp, rainy weather. Worse cellars. Worse getting wet. Worse using water. Worse autumn,
night. Worse from damp ground. Worse cold drinks, ice cream. Worse cold to feet, Worse suppressed
 discharges. Worse eruptions or sweat. Worse beds, and rest. Worse getting feet cold. Worse injuries. Worse
before storms.
Mouth - Mouth and tongue dry. Distorted, drawn to one side. Bitter taste. Saliva, tenacious. Saliva, ropy with
toothache. Cold sores on lips. Putrid sore mouth with salivation and swollen cervical glands. Mucus membrane
of mouth greatly swollen and very red. Holds cold water constantly in mouth, as pain and heat is better thereby.
Scurvy from cold.
Nose - Hayfever, profuse, watery discharge. worse open air. Hay fever, sensitive to newly mown grass. Hay
fever in August. Discharge suppressed from least contact with cold air. Complete stoppage of nose. Nose
stuffs up when there is a cold rain. Wants nose kept warm, least cold air stops the nose. Aching pain. Thick,
yellow mucus, bloody crusts. Severe coryza with hot, dry skin, limbs cold, stiff, numb and painful; general
offensive sweat. Dry or profuse coryza. Coryza of the newborn. Summer colds with diarrhea. Nosebleed in
place of menses. Nosebleed blood bright
red, and hot, with pressure above nose.
Perspiration - Foul sweat. Sweats with skin diseases. Sweats with copious limpid urine. Sweats at night, over
whole body, often offensive. Offensive sweat, night and morning. Sweats in axilla and palms. Suppressed
sweat. Conditions arising from sudden cooling of body whilst sweating.
Rectum - Itching of rectum. Burning in anus after stool. Biting pain in rectum as from salt. Constipation and
painful strangury. Cutting pain at navel followed by painful, green, slimy stools. Profuse thin stools in morning.
Diarrhea of green, sour, watery. Diarrhea slimy, bloody, mucus, worse at night. Diarrhea especially in the
summer. Diarrhea when the weather suddenly becomes cold. Diarrhea from damp, cold weather. Diarrhea
from repelled eruptions. Diarrhea after suppression of eczema. Watery, slimy, lienteric stool after eating.
Green, watery, slimy, bloody, mucus stools. Sour, watery stools, worse at night, summer, damp cold weather.
Yellow diarrhea, alternating with greenish.
Sensations - As of a board pressing against forehead, as if head were enlarged, as if hair stood on end. As if
fire were darting out of eyes. As if worms were crawling up and down in abdomen, biting in rectum as from
salt. As if lung moved in waves. As if arms were of wood, as of needles over whole body. Crawling, tickling
itching of various parts, tip of tongue.
Skin - Pruritus, worse in cold, wet weather. Herpes zoster, pemphigus. Eruptions, scaly, thick, crusty, moist,
bleeding or herpetic, worse before menses. Humid eruptions on face, genitals, hands etc. Urticaria, red spots,
brought on by exposure or sour stomach. Nettle-rash over whole body with violent itching. Thick, brown-yellow
crusts, bleeding when scratched. Sensitive bleeding ulcers. Little boils. Warts, large, smooth, on face and
palmar surface of hands. Small furuncles on places hurt. Eczema, rash of infants. Red spots, as from fleabites.
Ringworm in the hair in children. Anasarca. Impetigo, little boil-like eruptions that spread.
Skin callous.
Sleep - Uneasy, restless sleep, with confused dreams, frequent sweat, tossing from side to side. During sleep
mouth open, snoring. Falling asleep in evening, starting as if frightened. Sleep worse after 3 a.m. Fearfully
confused dreams.
Stomach - Indigestion with chilliness from every cold change of weather. Belchings with shuddering.
Heartburn. Nausea with desire for stool. Vomiting of white, tenacious mucus. Shivering, chilliness while
vomiting. Vomiting of mucus after cold drinks. Vomiting of greenish, yellow, slimy substances.
Teeth - Teeth thickly coated with tenacious, foul mucus. Teeth deeply imprinting cheeks and edges of tongue.
Toothache from cold with diarrhea. Toothache with confusion in head, profuse salivation. Teeth feel blunt, or
numb. Receding, spongy gums with salivation.
Temperature - Chill alternating with heat. Icy coldness with pains. Coldness in different parts, icy of paralyzed
parts. Chill starts in the back, not better by warmth, worse evening. Chill with urging in stool and urination.
Chilliness with thirst. Dry, burning heat all over.
Throat - Adenitis. Pressure as if uvula were too long. Tonsillitis from every change of weather. Much mucus
in fauces. Rough, hoarse voice. Continual hawking up of very tough saliva, with much rawness in fauces.
Constant titillation in larynx, with desire to cough. Trachea full of mucus, tough, greenish sputum with moderate
cough. Swelling and indurated glands from cold.
Tongue - Tongue, swollen, hindering speech, paralyzed inarticulate or difficult speech. Dry, rough tongue,
rough scraping in throat after taking cold in damp weather. Itching, crawling on tip of tongue. Tongue and jaw
become lame if cold air or water chills him.
Vertigo - Vertigo on waking in morning. Giddy and dizzy. Vertigo with trembling and weakness. Momentary
vertigo, when walking, with darkness before eyes.
COMMENTS - Sensitiveness to cold and damp runs through the Solanaceae. and is marked in Bell, and Caps.,
but it is supreme in Dulc. This feature among others renders them all good antidotes to Merc.
 Bar-c. is the complement of Dulc. in “worse from cold weather, especially in scrofulous children.” Every cold
settles in the eyes, throat or affects the bladder, respiration or bowels.
In poisoning cases, Dulc. produces hard, griping pains in the bowels, unconsciousness, tetanic spasms,
trismus, loud, rattling breathing, and death. One-sided spasms. Convulsions beginning in the face. Trembling,
especially of the right arm.
Paralysis, of the tongue, lungs, and heart (pneumogastric paralysis). Paralysis of the bladder. Rheumatic
paralyzes. Paralyzed part feels icy cold. “Paralysis of vocal cords (aphonia) from sleeping over a damp cellar.”
Scrofulous-looking eruptions. Moist or dry, red, tettery eruptions, especially on the face. Furfuraceous,
herpetic. Urticaria. Small furuncles appear on places hurt by concussion. Skin callous. Warts, fleshy or large,
smooth. Painless ulcers. Skin eruptions are sensitive to touch, pressure better.
Dropsical disorders. Catarrhal troubles. Dry mucus membranes. Offensive sweat, effects of sudden cooling
while sweating. Results of suppressed eruptions.
Diarrhea, vomiting with the stool. Bladder infections. Mucous-like sediment in the urine. Mucopurulent urine is
often associated with general one-sided sensitiveness, especially of the abdomen.
Dulc. 30c cured in two doses a rash like mosquito-stings appearing every month before the menses, worse
when warm, compelled to sit where it is cold.
Clarke gave Dulc. 30c with complete relief to the pain in a case of sarcoma of the bones at the base of the
skull in which there were stabbing pains in the front of the head and partial paralysis of the tongue. It was the
latter symptom that determined the choice of the remedy.
McLaren cured with a single dose the following case, which was the result of a wetting. Facial paralysis,
following neuralgia, the eye having remained unclosed for eight months. Red rash with itching worse in damp
weather. After a slight aggravation improvement began in two weeks and continued steadily.
RELATIONS -Antidoted by: Camph., Cupr., Ip., Kali-c., Merc. Follows well: Bry., Calc., Lyc.. Rhus-t., Sep., V
erat. Compare: ( 1 ) Aeon.. Ars.,Cham„ Hell., Nit-ac., Puls., Staph., Sulph. (2) In faintness during stool, Crot-
t., Verat. (3) Effects of cold, moist winds, Ars., Calc., Nux-v. m. (cold dry, winds, Aeon.. Bry.). (4) Effects of
exposure to wet and better by motion, Rhus-t. Rheumatic paralysis, Rhus-t., Caust. Hasty speech and actions,
Hep., Bell., Lach., Sulph. Paralysis of lungs, Solanum. (5) Pimpinello - Bibernell - respiratory mucus membrane
sensitive to drafts, pain and coldness in occiput and nape. Whole body weak, heavy head and drowsiness,
lumbago and stiff neck, pain from nape to shoulder, chilliness. (6) Rhus-t., Cimic., Calc., Puls., Bry., Nat-s.
Complementary: Baryta c. Incompatible: Bell., Lach.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.
keynote:
PHARMACY - dulc. Dulcamara. Woody nightshade. Bitter-sweet. Solanum dulcamara. N. O. Solanaceae. Not
to be confounded with “Deadly Nightshade,” Belladonna, nor with “Climbing Bitter-sweet,” Celastrus. Dulca-
mara tincture prepared from fresh green stems and leaves, gathered just before flowering. Historical dose:
Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Adenitis. Anasarca. Aphonia. Bladder, disorders. Blepharophthalmia. Catarrh. Cholera. Colds.
Crusta, lactea. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dysentery. Emaciati

name: Dysentery Bacillus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - dys-co. Dysentery bacillus. Dysentery co. Bacillus dy senteriae. Shigella dy senteriae. ABowel
nosode. Historicaldose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Anemia. Anxiety. Arthritis. Backache. Blepharitis, Bruises. Colitis. Diarrhea. Duodenal, ulcer.
Dysmenorrhea. Colitis. Fears. Fibrositis. Flatus. Headaches. Heartburn. Indigestion. Migraines .Nausea.
Osteoporosis. Otorrhea. Pharyngitis. Pleurodynia. Rheumatism. Spondylitis. Styes. Tachycardia.
Thyrotoxicosis. Tonsillitis. Ulcers. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - This is the nosode prepared from Bacillus dysenteriae. Dys-co. affects every tissue of the
body and is suitable for many slow and insidious chronic states. Dys-co., patients are typically the Arg-n. type.
Fearful and phobic, abdominal symptoms due to apprehension. “Anticipatory”nervous tension. Inhibition
and insecurity. Mental aberrations and nervous symptoms precede and are associated with myocardial and
circulatory disease.
Least excitement exhausts and aggravates symptoms. “Anxiety and excitement felt in the epigastrium,”
“nausea from excitement” and “diarrhea from excitement.” Excitement, anxiety or any agitation causes palpita-
tions, flushing, perspiration, breathlessness and even pain in the heart region.
Involuntary movements, tics or twitching (like chorea). Instability of the capillary circulation, causing blushing,
frontal headaches from excitement. Dry skin, scaly, with circinate lesions.
Dilation of stomach. Spasm in the pylorus. Retention of digested contents. Indigestion pain with distention
and discomfort. Heartburn. Cyclical vomiting in children. Diarrhea or indigestion from eating sweets and fat,
which they are fond of.
MIND - High strung and very sensitive to all impressions. Tense and nervous. Easily excited and flustered.
Forgetful, especially after interruptions. Full of worries about little things. Anticipating fear of difficulties that
might arise (Arg-n.). Full of fears. Claustrophobia. Shy, lacks confidence.
Abdomen - Distention and flatus. Colitis.
Pain and tenderness over gallbladder.
 Back - Fibrositis, rheumatism of neck and shoulders. Backache. Spondylitis.
Chest - Pleurodynia. Pain in chest on exertion. Tightness in lower ribs.
Constitutions - Tense facial expression, not fearful but alert and ready to react. Anxious, restless, fidgety,
timid and uneasy among strangers, easily upset by criticism.
Ears - Otorrhea. Sudden swelling of ears, blue, red, thin, scalding.
Eyes - Blepharitis, styes. Conjunctivitis with photophobia. Twitching of eyelids. Sensation of floating bodies,
woolly spots before eyes. Yellow color vision.
Face - Both children and adults show a marked anemia, watery, bluish pallor with puffiness of eyelids and
cheeks.
Veins frequently dilated and bluish lips that are apt to get dry and cracked. Neuralgia, supra and infra orbital.
Twitching of muscles of face.
Female - Menses irregular. Dysmenorrhea. Throbbing pelvis and perineum. Infantile masturbation.
Food - Fond of sweets, salt, milk and fat.
Head - Headache, frontal, over the eyes or in vertex, brought on by excitement. Blinding headaches with
looseness of bowel. Migraines, more headache than vomiting. Headaches often occur at regular time periods
of 7 to 14 day cycles. Fuzzy head. Scalp is painful to comb. Dry, scaly painful spots.
Heart - Tachycardia, palpitations, extra systoles. Palpitations before important events. Anticipatory discomfort
in the cardiac area. Heart rate is fast and may be irregular.
Limbs - Osteoporosis. Arthritis and periostitis. Pain in knees, ankles.
Lungs - Shortness of breath. Bronchial catarrh. Pertussis-like cough. Blood stained sputum.
Modalities - Worse from 3 a.m. to 6 a.m. Patients feel the cold, chilly and want warmth, yet are easily heated
up by the exertion and warm room. Feels cold, chilly and rapidly perspire from excitement and mental exertion.
Nausea and faintness in warm room, relieved by open air. Desires air and space.
Mouth - Bad taste .Tongue raw and burning. Lips are dry and cracked. Rheumatism of jaw.
Nose - Hay fever. Vasomotor rhinorrhea. Frequent coryza. Pain at the root of nose.
Rectum - Constipation and diarrhea. Weak expulsion of hard knotted stool with mucus. Loose morning
diarrhea, stools forcibly expelled and acrid, burning. Looseness, frequent motions 5 or 6 per day. Diarrhea on
excitement or worry. Throbbing rectum with sense of block or cork. Hemorrhoids and anal fissures. Hem-
orrhoids come down when walking.
Sleep - Insomnia, from crowding of thoughts, excitement, and palpitations. Sudden shocks through the body
on falling to sleep, awakening with fear, palpitation and breathlessness. Wakes at 2 or 3 a.m. with pain and
discomfort in epigastrium.
Stomach - Pain, worse from eating, better lying down. Ptosis stomach, dilation, splashing. Emptiness
between meals and sometimes nausea in the morning on awakening relieved by eating. Sinking emptiness
during day with relief from rest and food. Chronic indigestion. Eructation, heartburn, some hours after food.
Acrid vomiting burning up throat, bilious vomiting. Thirst and desire for cold drink, but worse afterwards. Mental
strain reacts on stomach and aggravates the stomach stasis.
Throat - Enlarged thyroid. Recurrent tonsillitis. Pharyngitis. Dry throat.
Urine - Urge to urination in tram or train. COMMENTS - Selective action on cardiac muscles. Cardiac disorder.
Function disturbance of heart action, associated with nerve tension. Affects the venous circulation. Walls of
veins get thin and veins dilated. Varicose veins. “Bruises very early and bleeds easily.” Stasis of abdominal
circulation.
Tendency to blush, with pallor. Flabbiness. Limbs, cold, bluish and perspiring. Rheumatism. “Growing pains,”
associated with valvular heart disease. Weak reaction.
Hypotonic stomach. Delayed digestion with pain, relieved by eating. Duodenal ulcer, with nervous tension felt
in stomach and heart area (Prot., has unperceived tension). Ulcers (Lyc., Nux-v.).
Dry skin. Ribbed brittle nails, dandruff and dry brittle hair. Cracked fingertips. The cracks and fissures are
deeper with an indurated base. Eruptions are dry and sluggish, come out slowly. Tendency to scale and crust,
gummy discharge (Graph.).
Herpes on face, neck, chest. Blisters between fingers. Scaly eruptions on flexures. Dermatitis of hands and
palms, dry, cracked and painful. Flat warts on hands. Psoriasis. Urticaria attacks.
Brain fatigue. Little power of concentration. “Loses train of ideas from interruption.” “Forgets what he was going
to say.” “Forgets what she went for.” Lack of initiative, easily deflected.
Hypersensitive, expressed as shyness or timidity. Unsociable. Aversion to meeting strangers. Tense around
strangers, alert. Fear of being alone. “I desire to be left to myself, but have a fear of being alone.”
Mental uneasiness, physical restlessness, fidgets, chorea movements of facial muscles or limbs. Nervous
tension, constant, triggered by anticipation. Impatience, hurry. Restless, desire to go from place to place (Tub.).
 Depression, from tiredness, constant tension. Anxiety. “Feels miserable from the fear that she can not
accomplish what she was to do.” Desire to be left alone, and indulge in tears. Consolation aggravates the
weeping and brings out irritability.
Burdened with over conscientiousness. Easily upset by criticism. Fear, in train, tram, bus and church, afraid in
theater, lift office etc. Fear of the future, dark, thunder and storms.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) There is close relationship between Dys-co., Arg-n. and Ars. (2) It is also related
to Kalm., Nux-v. and Lycopodium also follow it well in gastric disorders. (3) Proteus.
REFERENCES - Bach. Paterson.

name: Echinacea Angustifolia
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - echi. Echinacea angustifolia. Purple cone-flower. Echinacea rudbeckia. N. O. Composite, allied
to Rudbeckia. (Echinacea angustifolia, is the western species not to be confounded with Echinacea purpurea,
or Black Sampson, the eastern species.) Tincture of whole fresh plant. The whole plant including the root is
pounded to a pulp and macerated in two parts by weight of alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
Locally, as a cleansing and antiseptic wash.
CLINICAL - Abscess. Aphthae. Appendicitis. Auto-infection. Bites'. Blood, disorders. Blood, poisoning.
Boils. Canker sores. Carbuncles. Colds. Cramps. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Enteric, fever. Erysipelas. Fevers.
Gangrene. Goiter. Gonorrhea. Hemorrhoids. Hepatitis. Impetigo. Immune, disorders. Influenza. Leucor-
rhea. Lymphangitis. Meningitis. Ozaena. Poisoned, wounds. Post-partum infections. Pustules. Pyemia.
Rheumatism. Rhus, poisoning. Scarlatina. Septicemia. Snake, bites. Sore, throats. Struma. Syphilis.
Tonsilitis. Typhoid, fever. Ulcers. Vaccinations, effects. Wounds.
HERBAL - Echi. is a blood and immune tonic. This well-known drug came to notice as “Meyers's Blood
Purifier,” the proprietor did not know the name of the drug used and sent a whole plant to Professors King and
Lloyd of Cincinnati, who identified it as Echinacea angustifolia.
Echi. has long been used by herbalists in typhoid conditions, diphtheria, malignant scarlatina, carbuncles and
boils. Also as a septic remedy in snake, animal or insect bites.
Dr. H. W. Felled noted in the Eclectic Medical Journal, that “if any single statement were to be made concerning
the virtues of Echinacea it would read something like this: ‘A corrector of the depravation of the body fluids'
and even this does not sufficiently cover the ground.”
Antiseptic, anti-fermentative and antizymotic. Tissue alterations as are exhibited in boils, carbuncles,
abscesses or cellular glandular inflammations. Locally useful for cleansing and as an antiseptic wash for
wounds (Calen.).
Potency is not well proven, so it is used primarily in tincture to stimulate the immune system. Homeopaths
have generally followed the herbalists in using substantial doses of the tincture (5 to 40 drops), adjusted to the
particulars of the case.
HOMEOPATHIC-Bloodpoisoning or weak blood. Septicemia from a cut or wound, or after surgery (Pyrog.).
Acute auto-infection, septic conditions, bites of poisonous animals, lymphangitis. Tendency to ma-
lignancy in acute and sub-acute disorders. Gangrene (Rhus-t., Ars.).
Snakebites, insect bites and stings. Venomous infection. Lymphatic inflammation, after crushing injuries.
Foul discharges with emaciation and great debility. Cerebrospinal meningitis. Post-partum infections.
Infections at the site of a vaccination.
Ear infections. Fetid ozaena. Recurring strep throat. Beneficial in some cases of leucorrhea with bright yellow
discharge, as from a suppurating surface.
Boils, db not suppurate. Carbuncles, bluish-red color and intense pain. Erysipelas and foul ulcers. Goiter with
exophthalmic symptoms. Pustules. Hemorrhoids. Diarrhea in typhoid. Gonorrhea.
Asthenia, adynamia. Weak and tired, aching in muscles. Weakness felt more in stomach, bowels, heart, in
knees, with vertigo. Useful in the last stages of cancer to ease pain (Ars.).
MIND - Prostration of mind. Slowness in every action, speech, pace. Confused, cannot exert mind.
Depressed or cross. Brain fag and vertigo. Very nervous could not study. Aversion to thinking. Does not
wish to think or study. Dullness from headache, with cross, irritable feelings. Becomes angry when corrected,
does not wish to be contradicted.
Abdomen - Abdomen tender, sensitive and tympanitic. Pain in right hypochondrium. Appendicitis. Pain about
umbilicus, better
by bending double. Cramping pain better passing flatus. Sharp, cutting, pains coming and going suddenly.
Full feeling with borborygmus.
Back - Chills up the back. Pain in back of neck. Dull pain in small of back over kidneys. Pain in lumbar region,
 worse from stooping.
Chest - Pain as of a lump in chest and under sternum. Sharp, burning pain in sternum. Pain in pectoral
muscles, diaphragm, right lung. Full feeling in upper part of lungs. Sore feeling.
Constitutions - Broken-down and weak constitutions.
Ears - Shooting pain in right ear.
Eyes - Brows twitch. Feel hot on closing them. Lachrymation from cold air. Sharp pains in eyes and temples.
Pains back of right eye. Eyes pain on looking at an object and will fill with tears, better by closing them. Eyes
ache when reading. Sleepy sensation in eyes, but cannot sleep.
Face - Bluish. Face flushed. Red flushes from pain in head. Pale face with headache, vomiting. Fine eruptions
on forehead and cheeks. Neuralgic pain in left upper branch of fifth nerve. Numbness of lips.
Female - Discharges suppressed. Mucus from vagina in evening. Excoriating leucorrhea. Puerperal
septicemia. Pain in right iliac region, which seems deep, lasting but a short time.
Food - Loss of appetite. Nausea, could not eat. Desire cold drinks. Desire for cold water.
Head - Headaches with a peculiar, periodical flushing of the face, dizziness and profound prostration.
Enlarged sensation in brain. Sharp pain deep in brain, seems too large. Fullness in temples. Pain in
temples on motion. Pulsating headache. Throbbing through the temples. Hot burning forehead. Dullness in
head with cross, irritable feeling. Pain in forehead on sneezing (Nat-m.). Headache over eyes with sneezing.
Heart - Anxiety about the heart. Increasing but variable pulse. Rapid beating of heart. Slight pain over heart.
Stitching pain in left chest (apex of heart). Tongue, lipsand
Echinacea angustifolia fauces tingle with sense of fear about heart (Aeon.). Accelerated full pulse.
Kidneys - Desire for frequent urination. Involuntary urination. Albuminous, scanty, dark urine. Urine increased,
pale and copious. Sense of heat while passing urine. Pain and burning on urination.
Limbs - Rheumatic pain after tonsillitis. Aching in limbs and general lassitude, weakness. Pain between
shoulders, which extends to axilla and down the arms. Sharp pain in left elbow. Pain in wrists and fingers. Pain
in right thumb. Cold hands and feet. Hands are alternately numb or restless, on awakening. Chilliness in right
leg. Left hip and knee pains. Pain in right leg.
Liver - Hepatitis. As if a load in back part of liver.
Lungs - Pain as of a lump under the sternum. Burning under the left scapula.
Male - Seminal emissions. Soreness, pain in perineum. Perineum seems stretched. Pain in right spermatic
cord. Testicles drawn up and sore. Pain in meatus while urinating.
Modalities - Better from lying down. Better rest. Pains come and go suddenly and are better by bending
double. Worse after physical ormental exertion. Worse injury, operations. Worse cold air. Worse evening.
Worse after eating.
Mouth - Biting, tingling on lips. Corners of mouth and lips crack. Canker sores. Aphthae. Gums recede and
bleed easily. Dry sensation in back part of mouth. Metallic taste. Bad taste in the mouth in the morning. Burning,
peppery taste when taking remedy. Promotes the flow of saliva.
Nose - Stuffiness of nostrils with mucus in sinuses and pharynx. Foul smelling discharge, membranous
formations protruding. Post-nasal catarrh with ulceration and fetor. Nose feels stuffed up. Right nostril raw,
bleeding. Nostrils sore.
Perspiration - Sweat chiefly on upper part of body. Sweats on forehead.
Rectum - Griping pains folio wed by passing offensive flatus or a loose yellowish stool, producing great
exhaustion. Diarrhea following pain in stomach, going through
bowels. Blood flows after stools.
Skin - Dry skin. Intense itching and burning of skin on neck. Blackness of external parts. Little papules on
skin with redness, feeling like nettles. Small red pimples on neck and face. Recurring boils. Carbuncles.
Irritations from insect bites and poisonous plants. Dissecting wounds. Lymphatics enlarged. Gangrene. Old
tibial ulcers.
Sleep - Drowsy, could not read, with yawning. Sleepiness with confusion and weakness. Sleep disturbed,
wakes often. Sleepiness after eating. Dreams about difficulties, laborious or quarrelsome, about exciting
things, about dead relations.
Stomach - Sense of something large and hard in stomach. Dull pain in stomach. Distension, eructations do
not relieve (Chin.). Pain in stomach, going down through bowels, followed by diarrhea. Nausea with chilliness,
better lying down. Sour, bloody vomit like coffee grounds. Nausea with eructation of gas. Sour belching,
burning the throat, or tasteless. Heartburn.
Teeth - Teeth sensitive to draft of air. Darting pains in the teeth, worse on right side. Neuralgic pains in superior
and inferior maxilla. Dull aching of the teeth.
Temperature - Irregular, chills, rise of temperature and sweat. Chilliness with nausea. Cold flashes all over
 back. Chill in left occiput. Temperature raised adegree with flushed face and fullness of head. Malarial fever.
Throat - Sore throat, worse left side. Ulcerated sore throat. Mucus in throat with raw sensation. Constant
clearing of mucus from throat. Frothy mucus, hawks from throat. Tonsilitis. Tonsils purple or black, gray
exudation extending to posterior sinuses and air-passages. Irritation of larynx. Voice husky.
Tongue - Tongue dry and swollen, sores, dirty brownish. White coating of tongue with red edges. Tongue,
lips and fauces tingle with sense of fear about heart (Aeon.). Slight burning of tongue. Tongue, numb, with a
peppery taste.
Vertigo - Vertigo with weakness, dizziness
Echinacea angustifolia and profound prostration. Vertigo when changing position of head.
COMMENTS - J. C. Fahnestock extensively proved the remedy, and additional symptoms were contributed
by T. C. Duncan. With one exception the provers were males.
The first symptom noticed was a biting, tingling sensation on the tongue, lips and fauces (Aeon.), with a sense
of fear and pain about the heart. Febrile symptoms, full head, flushed face and accelerated pulse followed.
Languor was experienced by many provers, and neuralgic, sharp, darting, shifting pains. Marked drowsiness.
Catarrh of the digestive and respiratory tracts. Griping pains, offensive flatus and loose, yellowish stool.
In two pro vers there was found a diminution of red blood corpuscles after the proving. Chilliness (coldness of
right leg) and sensitiveness to cold, worse from exposure to cold air.
A remarkable case of vaccination poisoning is recorded in a man, 45, cured mainly by Echi. in 20-drop doses.
The symptoms included an ebbed vitality. He became so weak he could not sit up, his hair fell out. and an
eruption of psoriasis appeared on his limbs that extended to his body.
The disease advanced rapidly, the nails fell off. Left iritis supervened and then keratitis of the right eye. Under
Kali-i. and phosphoalbumen as a food, the hair ceased to fall out, but other symptoms became rapidly worse.
Echi. was now given, and slowly the disease was arrested, then gradual improvement and an ultimate cure
ensued. The report does not mention if the patient recovered sight in the left eye.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cench.. Both.. Ars., Lach., Bapt., Rhus-t., Cistus, Hepar. (2) the vulnerary
Composites, Arn., Calen, and Bell-p. (3) The closest analog is Bapt. (4) In snakebites it compares with Lobelia
purpura- scens. (5) in boils with Anthr. (6) Head feels enlarged, Arg-n., Bapt.. Bov., Glon., Nux-v. Mosch., Nux-
v. (7) Cases of Rhus-poisoning have been cured with Echin. a.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

name: Echinacea Purpurea
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - echi-p. Echinacea purpurea. Black Sampson. N. O. Composite. Eastern States of America.
Tincture of fresh root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Boils. Carbuncles. Diphtheria. Fatigue. Furuncles. Impetigo. Putrid fevers. Pyemia. Scarlatina.
Septicemia. Suppuration. Vaccination, effects. Wounds.
HERBAL - Echinacea purpurea is a popular remedy in the eastern states because it has been used in place
of Echi. Echi-p. has probably a very similar action and the root causes the same pungent sensation on lips and
tongue as the tincture of Echi.
HOMEOPATHIC - Echi-p. treats changes in the blood, simulating typhoid, pyemia, diphtheria, scarlatina,
septicemia, and the effects of vaccination (Thuj.). Tendency to suppuration. Offensive discharges (Arn., Bapt.).
Biting, tingling sensations.
Listless feeling, worse evening. High fever and flushed face (Bapt., Bell.). Marked chilliness. The black root
has been taken as a “signature” of the remedy in cases of low fevers where a black tongue was observed.
MIND - Mental confusion. Tired, drowsy. Fever - High fever, with fatigue. Typhoid fever. Low fevers where a
black tongue was observed.
Modalities - Better from rest in bed. Better pressure. Better bending double. Worse in the evening. Worse
stooping.
Skin - Infected wounds. Lacerated wounds. Impetigo. Dry skin. Boils, carbuncles and furuncles.
COMMENTS - George Royal wrote of his experiences with Echi-p. He used it for furuncles with a dry skin.
Small boils (“catboils”), very sensitive and seemed to come in crops, more about the neck and shoulders.
Carbuncles with profuse sanguino-purulent discharge, marked large sloughing, coming in crops mostly about
the neck, sometimes on perineum.
Royal would usually give such patients
Echinacea purpurea five drops of the 1st every three hours and apply a hot solution of 1 part of the tincture
to 9 of water; changing the application often. He noted that it could be used in a similar manner to treat bruised
or lacerated wounds.
 It cured a case of a strumous, young bricklayer whose hand and fingers were to be amputated because of
symptoms of sepsis (i. e., enlargement of the glands under the arms and temperature).
Echinacea 1c internally and tincture locally checked the sepsis and saved the fingers. In this case the skin and
muscles were brought as nearly as possible to normal position and the Echinacea applied and changed every
hour for 48 hours.
Royal used it successfully, only once, for suppurative appendicitis, i.e., after pus had formed and evacuated
into the intestines. Merc, and Hepar had both failed to heal but Echinacea 1c, five drops every night and
morning for three weeks, cured.
Used with success in recurring attacks of chronic inflammation about the cecum, and in a few cases of typhoid
when the tired feeling was the ranking symptom.
RELATIONS - Compare: Echi., Bapt., Pyrogen.
REFERENCES - Clarke. Royal.

name: Elaeis Guineensis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - elae. Elaeis guineensis. Palm oil. Aouara. Avoira. N. O. Palmaceae. Triturations of the fruit.
Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Diarrhea. Elephantiasis, arabum. Gastric, disorders. Headaches. Leprosy. Scleroderma. Sight,
defective. Skin, disorders. Sore, throat.
HOMEOPATHIC - Elae. was proved by Mure. Notable symptoms of leprosy and of scleroderma appear in the
provings including anesthesia, and swelling and hardening of the skin.
Aching, lancinations, burning, bruised and throbbing pains. Sensation as if a peg stuck in false ribs. Swelling
of parts.
The greatest number of symptoms appeared on the lower limbs and skin.
MIND - Merry mood. Disobedient.
Abdomen - Colic after a cold drink. Pain with bruised sensation in abdomen.
Chest - Pain in middle of chest as if pricked by needles. Lancinations every five minutes in right chest.
Eyes - Swelling of eyes. Unable to look steadily at an object. Sight weak, confused vision by candlelight. He
makes letters much too large.
Kidneys - White urine.
Limbs - Staggering gait. Weakness of legs. Swelling of right leg. Throbbing in calves. Hammering in tibia,
nape of neck and right foot. Soreness of soles of feet when walking and when touched. Swelling of left arm.
Beating in left arm. Insensibility of head to heat, but an hour after he feels it badly.
Lungs - Breathing embarrassed. Pricking in larynx on breathing. Cough with lancination in sides.
Modalities - Better from rest. Worse from cold drinks. Colic worse from descending stairs. Lancinations worse
from deep breathing.
Mouth - Burning in tongue, has to stop eating. Bad odor from mouth.
Neck - Constrictive pains around neck as if from tight string. Throbbing in nape.
Rectum - Frequent diarrhea. Black stools. Skin - Skin seems thicker. Swelling, roughness and itching of skin
on left leg. Small vesicles appear on swollen right leg and left arm and on other parts without swelling. Itching
all over, preventing sleep.
Stomach - Foul belchings. Vomiting of a cake immediately after eating it.
Throat - Lancinations in throat when swallowing, stinging when swallowing saliva.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Anae., Rhus-t. REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Elaps Corallinus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - elaps. Elaps corallinus. Brazilian coral snake. Micrurus frontalis. Micrurus corallinus. N. O.
Elapidae. Poison pressed from the venom-sac of the living snake and triturated with sugar of milk. Historical
dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Acidity. Amaurosis. Axilla, itching. Black, discharges. Cancer. Deafness. Ear disorders. Ear,
WM.Hemorrhages. Headache. Hemiplegia. Knee, pain in. Metrorrhagia. Nasal, catarrh. Naso-pharyngitis.
Nosebleed. Ozaena. Paralysis. Pneumonia. Throat, ulcerated. Tuberculosis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Like other snake poisons, the poison of the coral snake disorganizes the blood, producing
black discharges, especially hemorrhages. Characteristic pre-eminent blackness of its discharges and
hemorrhages. Sensation as if all the blood were collected in head. Black earwax.
Adynamic sepsis. Spasms, then paralysis. Oscillatory movements. Right-sided paralysis. The right side feels
 weak insensible or even paralyzed. Must have oscillatory motion. Sensation of internal coldness. Twisting
sensation. As of a heavy load or weight on the affected part.
Sudden pain in stomach. Cold feeling in stomach. Acidity of stomach with faint feeling. Spasm of esophagus,
pharynx constricted, food and liquids suddenly arrested and then fall heavily into stomach. Spasms followed
by paresis.
Cold things disagree. Fruit and cold drinks lie like ice on stomach and cause a cold feeling in chest. Desire
for sweetened buttermilk. Nausea and vomiting. The prostrating diarrhea of tuberculosis.
Ear, nose and throat symptoms. Sudden deafness at night with roaring and cracking in ear. Mucus membranes
wrinkled. Dreams of dead people. Shuddering from least contradiction, with pricking.
MIND - Depressed. Absorbed, buried in thoughts in daytime. Absent minded. Angry about one's self, does not
wish to be spoken to. Desire to strike. Shuddering from least contradiction. Can speak, but cannot understand
speech. Imagines he hears someone talking.
Fear as if something horrible might happen. Fear of the rain. Never feels happy in wet weather. Fear of having
a stroke. Fear of getting a fatal disease. Fear being left alone. Fear causes chattering of the teeth and
trembling.
Aversion to company. Avoids the sight of people, wants to get into the country away from people. Desire to
travel. Hysteria before menses. Taciturn during menses. Playful. Delusion he is being beaten. Delusion he
is falling forward. Delusion of being injured.
Abdomen - Colic with urging to stool. Bowels feel twisted together in a knot. Painful pressure in right side of
liver. Lancinating pain from both groins to symphysis pubis.
Back - Stiffness in the right side of neck. Lancinations in left side of neck. Lancinations in the whole Spinal
marrow from occiput to sacrum. Pressure between the shoulders. Coldness in back. Pain in the back with
chilliness, cold feet and strangury.
Chest - Oppression of chest on going upstairs. Feeling of a heavy load on chest. Coldness in chest after
drinking. Itching eruption in axilla. Rush of blood to chest in morning. Sharp pain and soreness to touch
across chest. Soreness from right to left axilla
Constitutions - Rheumatic constitutions.
Ears - Crusty eruption on ear. Earwax. black and hard with difficult hearing. Offensive, serous greenish
discharge. Intolerable itching in ear. Otorrhea. Watery, yellow oryellow-green discharge with deafness.
Sudden attack of nightly deafness with roaring and crackling in ears. Cracking in ears on swallowing. Buzzing
noise. Illusions of hearing.
Eyes - Eyes red and inflamed. Watery eyes. Eyes look glassy. Stye on left eye, with lancinating pain. Bloated
around the eyes
Elaps corallinus in the morning. Burning and dryness in both eyes on waking. Burning in lids. Eyeballs feel
sticky under lids. Violent itching in left eye. Aversion to light, desire to close eyes.
Face - Bloated around eyes in morning. Red spots on face. Red blotches on bloated face. Dull, yellowish color.
Crusty eruption on cheek. Redness and swelling of right cheek. Swelling of face.
Female - Itching of vulva and vagina. Dysmenorrhea with a flow of black blood. Discharge of black blood
between menses. Sensation as if something burst in the womb, then continuous stream of dark colored blood,
better when urinating. Itching of vulva and vagina. Weight at uterus and vagina after an hysterical attack.
Food - Canine hunger, yet unable to eat. Acidity after every mouthful. Aversion to meat. Aversion to bananas.
Desire for ice. Desires milk, whipping-cream. Desire for sweetened buttermilk. Desires sweets. Desires salads.
Cold drinks and fruit feel like ice in stomach, and cause coldness in chest. Worse fruits. Thirst during
fever.
Head - Congestion of blood to head on stooping. Violent headache, extending from forehead to occiput.
Headache pain in one eye, then the other. Fullness in head. Rushes of blood to the head. Pain in occiput,
worse mental exertion. Weight and pain in forehead. Lancinating pain, left then right side. Severe sharp
pain in forehead, with heaviness of head. Stinging pain with sleeplessness.
Heart - Sensation of laceration in region of heart. Palpitations with anxiety and trembling of hands.
Kidneys - Urine red. Discharge of mucus from urethra. Red urine with cloudy sediment. Thick urine with
red sediment. Suppression of urine. Strangury.
Limbs - Soreness of limbs worse at night. Arms weak. Arms and hands swollen bluish. Pricking under the
nails. Skin peeling off on palms and finger tips. Vesicular eruptions on feet. Icy cold feet. Knee joints feel
sprained.
Lungs - Air hunger. Pneumonia. Each inspiration causes a crackling sound in lungs. Cough with terrible
pain through lungs. Hemoptysis. Hemorrhage from lungs, black as ink and watery. Sharp pain in apex of
lungs, better walking. Stitches in apex of right lung. Sharp pain in left side of chest, worse breathing. Lungs
 feel forcibly separated. Worse right lung and expectoration of black blood.
Modalities - Better from rest. Better lying on abdomen. Walking relieves nosebleed, pain in abdomen and
chest. Worse cold drinks, food, air. Worse drafts, wind. Worse night. Worse wet weather. Worse dampness.
Worse approach of storms. Worse exertion. Worse touch. Worse warmth of bed. Cold things disagree.
Nose - Coryza from least draft of air. White and watery nasal discharge. Mucus membrane wrinkled. Chronic
nasal catarrh with fetid odor and greenish crusts. Ozaena with a yellowish-green discharge. Nostrils
plugged up with dry mucus. Nosebleeds, black like ink after a blow. Sudden, profuse nosebleed while
walking. Pain at root of nose. Pains from nose to ears on swallowing. Eruptions about nose. Sneezing at night.
Perspiration - Sweats on forehead and neck. Profuse sweat. Cold perspiration all over.
Rectum - Constipation. Constriction of sphincter after bloody stools. Cholera. Diarrhea, copious liquid stools,
watery, frothy. Diarrhea of an olive green color. Stools of black, frothy blood. Prolapsed anus. Formication at
anus as from worms.
Skin - Skin hot, dry. Glands and skin of axilla affected. Itching with tetters, eruptions. Yellow spots on hands
and fingers. Small blisters, on limbs. Fingertips peel off. Red pimples on fingertips. Little pimples, followed by
desquamation. Typhoid when ulcers have eaten into tissues and black blood is discharged.
Sleep - Drowsy all day, no sleep at night. Sleeplessness from sharp headache. Bites hand during sleep.
Dreams of business. Dreams of dead people.
Stomach - Stomach feels cold. Sensation as if food turned like corkscrew on swallowing. Burning in stomach.
Acidity after every mouthful. Sinking, faint feeling in stomach. Pain in stomach better lying on abdomen.
Paralysis of esophagus. Sensation of a sponge in esophagus. Spasmodic contractions of esophagus and
pharynx, food and liquids are suddenly arrested and then fall heavily into the stomach. Sour eructations.
Vomiting followed by diarrhea. Vomiting of mucus. Vomiting of green bile.
Temperature - Terrible coldness after drinking, as if ice water were rising and falling through left lung. Feels
cold, cold things disagree. Shivering after cold drinks. Coldness in back. Shaking chill, felt internally as if in
bones. Dry heat and burning redness of face. Skin hot, dry, but complains of feeling cold. Fever with thirst.
Heat alternating with chill. Heat flushes, in evening.
Throat - Tonsils swollen. Sides of throat sore to touch. Red blotches in throat. Painful, difficult swallowing of
solids and liquids. Pressure pain in throat. Thick, very offensive, dry, greenish-yellow crusts upon the posterior
pharyngeal wall and extremely foul breath. Ulceration of throat, worse left side.
Vertigo - Fainting caused by stooping. Vertigo with tendency to fall forward. Faints with vomiting or on
stooping.
Vision - Letters run together when reading. Veil before eyes. Large red fiery spots before eyes. Red bar before
eyes when opening them. Dirty red spot before eyes. Black rings before eyes (left).
COMMENTS - Rumbling in ears as of thunder. Sensation in brain as if shaken. Sensation as if food turned like
a corkscrew on swallowing, as if intestines were twisted by a cord and strung together in a knot. Fluids roll
audibly into stomach.
Marked pains in the lungs (especially right). Sensation within chest and at sternum as if pleura were pulled off
and the lungs violently drawn apart. Sensation as if a heavy load, iron bar or weight on parts. Mail ed periodicity.
Affects the glands and skin of axilla. Clarke cured with Elaps. 200c a very old- standing case of irritating rash
in axilla, (right) with recurrent suppuration of axillary glands.
E. V. Moffatt found Elaps 6c almost a specific in chronic naso-pharyngeal catarrh with greenish crusts and
subjective disagreeable odor.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Radiated heat, Alcohol, Ars. Compare: (1) Dr. Higgins used the gallbladder of
the coral snake, Fei Elapidis Corallini. (2) Ars., Carb-v.,Crot-h., Lach., Mur- ac., Nit-ac., Rhus-t. (3) red spot
before sight, Dub., (4) effects of cold, wet weather, Dulc. (5) Eucal. rostrata - offensive dark discharge from
right ear. (6) Crot-h., Alumn., Carb-v., Ars., Lach.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Elaterium Officinarum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - elat. Elaterium officinarum. Squirting cucumber. Ecballium elaterium. Momordica elaterium. N.
O. Cucurbitaceae. Tincture of unripe fruit. Trituration of Elat- erinum. Historical dose: Trituration and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Abscesses. Beriberi Bilious, fever. Bladder, disorders. Boils. Cholera. Colic. Cramps.Diarrhea.
Dropsy. Dysentery. Erysipelas. Intermittent, fever. Jaundice. Liver, disorders. Measles. Nettle rash.
Neuralgias. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Scurvy. Vomiting. Yawning.
HOMEOPATHIC - Characteristic explosion, as how the ripe fruit scatters its seeds. Profuse watery stools,
 coming out with a gush. Violent vomiting and purging with copious forceful watery, olive green, bilious or frothy
evacuations.
Dull, olive-green discharges and frothy stools. Cholera, cholerine and infantile diarrhea. Jaundice of newborns,
with bilious stools, urine staining the diaper.
Causes tissues to drain of their watery contents. Used in the absorption of dropsical fluids, minute doses will
often affect this. Promotes the opening of abscesses and boils.
Elaterium officinarum Urticaria, better rubbing.
Chilliness with much yawning and stretching. Gaping and yawning, with fever before the chill or before the chill
of cholera. Y awning throughout the chill. For the effects of damp weather or standing on damp ground, worse
by damp. Irresistible desire to wander from home to home.
MIND - Depression of spirits. Fear of some approaching disaster. Mental disorders com- ing on as a
consequence of suppressed malaria. Desire to leave home. Irresistible desire to wander from home at night.
Abdomen - Abdomen retracted. Feeling of stricture or oppression at the epigastrium. Dull pain in the
epigastrium. Dull pain in the right of hypochondrium. Cutting, griping pains in the bowels. Rumbling of flatus in
the course of the cecum and colon.
Back - Pains in the left sterno-mastoideus muscle, near its insertion into the sternum. Pains under the right
shoulder blade. Sticking pains in the lumbar region. Aching pain in the region of the left kidney.
Causations - Effects of damp weather.
Chest - Sharp pains at the lower part of the sternum, passing through to the spine.
Ears - Sticking pain near the rim of the cartilage of left ear.
Eyes - Sticking, as of a splinter, in the inner canthus of left eye.
Food - Loss of appetite.
Head - Confusion of the head, followed by headache. Violent headache with sensation of constriction of the
temples and forehead. Dull pain, pain in the temples.
Kidneys - Increased flow of limpid urine.
Limbs - Arthritic nodules. Pain in limbs, darting into fingers and toes. Pain extends down limbs, pain in hip
joints with diarrhea. Shooting, also dull aching pains in the course of left sciatic nerve to the instep and toes.
Sharp pains in fingers and thumbs, knees, toes and instep. Gouty pain in great toes.
Modalities - Worse from damp weather. Worse standing on damp ground.
Mouth - Tongue coated with a dirty-brown fur. Bitter taste in the mouth, with salivation. Unpleasant smell to
the breath.
Nose - Nosebleed.
Rectum - Bleeding hemorrhoids. Soreness of the anus. Discharges from the bowels of frothy water, coming
out with a gush. Stools are watery, copious, forceful. Squirting diarrhea, frothy, dull, olive green with cutting
in abdomen.
Sensations - As if a splinter in left eye. As if posterior sinuses and upper part of esophagus were enlarged.
Skin - Dropsical. Orange-colored skin. Smarts, stings and burns. Urticaria from suppressed intermittent.
Sleep - Incessant gaping. Much yawning and stretching.
Stomach - Pain in the pit of the stomach. Griping pains in bowels. Belching of gas. Nausea and vomiting with
great weakness. Vomiting a dark brown fluid mixed with food.
Temperature - Chill comes on with much yawning and stretching, lasting all through chill. Chills and fever
with spurting diarrhea. Perspiration relieves all the symptoms. If the intermittent fever is suppressed, urticaria
break out all over the body.
Throat - Pain in the back of the throat, as if scalded. Scraping in the throat. A feeling as if the choana and
upper part of the esophagus were enlarged.
COMMENTS - According to Cooper, Beriberi has been greatly helped by Elat. Used with good effect in scurvy
where gushing diarrhea is a marked symptom.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Crot-t., Gamb.
(2)   Bry. and Coloc. (sciatica). , Verat. (neuralgia), Colch., Crot-t., Verat. - choleraic affections, Sec. - olive
green diarrhea., Canth. - dysenteric diarrhea with painful urination.
(3)   Apis, Hep., Ign., Rhus-t. - urticaria during intermittent fever.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Electricitas
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - electr. Electricitas. Electricity. Potencies are made from sugar of milk saturated with the current.
Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
 CLINICAL - Chorea. Headaches. Hysteria. Paralysis. Rheumatism.
HOMEOPATHIC - While Caspari is the authority for the symptoms caused by electricity, the powerful effect
exercised on some by the approach of a thunderstorm and the influence of an electric current is well known.
In those who have been electrified, there is shaking of the whole body, commencing in the maxillary bones,
tingling in the parts electrified, and violent burning. Effects of atmospheric electricity and static electricity.
Dreads approach of thunderstorms.
General relaxation, sometimes with moral depression and headache. Anxiety, nervous tremors, restlessness,
palpitations. Relaxation of the nerves and muscles. Lassitude and stiffness of the limbs. Heaviness of limbs,
swelling of parts. Heat in the whole body.
Loss of the weight of the body, weakness of the parts shaken. Dragging sensations in all the limbs, as far as
the ends of the fingers and toes, nocturnal shootings in parts that are paralyzed. St. Vitus' dance. Epileptic fits
hastened and aggravated.
MIND - Intense nervous anxiety. Nervous tremors. Restlessness, anxiety and anguish. Fear on the approach
of a thunderstorm. Anxiety, restlessness with palpitations and headaches. Internal anguish. Violent agitation.
Timidity. Sighs and screams through nervous fear. Weeps in paroxysms.
General depression after a meal. Depression and weariness, sometimes with giddiness or drowsiness. Ill-
humor. Furor. Errors in the perception of time. Loss of memory. Involuntary laughter. Insensibility, foolish
actions. Loss of consciousness.
Abdomen - Spasmodic tension and contraction in the abdomen. Aching in the abdomen. Colic. Cutting pains,
on the approach of a storm, or with diarrhea. Darting
pains from left to right side. Shivering in the abdomen dr else burning, sometimes with tension. Inflation of the
abdomen, borborygmi in the abdomen, sometimes with fermentation.
Back - Difficulty in moving the neck. Tingling in a muscle shortened by suppuration. Tingling in the vertebral
column. Darting pains in an enlarged gland of the neck. Furunculi on the back and nape of the neck. Drawing
pains across the shoulder blades, as by a thread. Burning in the shoulder.
Chest - Constriction of the chest. Pains in the chest, sensation of coldness in the left side. Chest and shoulders
feel like marble.
Ears - Pains in the ear. Drawing pains from the jaws to the ears. Lancinations in right ear, proceeding from the
neck. Pulsations in the ear. Redness and heat of the ear. Swelling of the interior of the ear. Suppuration and
a small pustule in the auditory duct. Vesicles full of acrid serum behind the ear. Augmented secretion of wax.
Murmuring, sometimes with a sensation as if a flock of wool were before the ears.
Eyes - Haggard eyes. Wandering and haggard looks. Gnawing sensation in left eye or violent drawing pains,
extending to forehead. Sensation as if the eyes were much sunken. Sensation as if something were passing
out of the eye. Aching in the eyes, as from dryness. Redness of conjunctiva. Inflammation of the eyes. Swelling
of edges of eyelids, at the external angle. Lachrymation, especially of right eye. Contraction of pupils, which
were abnormally dilated.
Face - Bright red. Expression of terror. Increase of sweat on the face. Swelling of the face. Violent drawing
pain above left eyebrow. Contraction of the muscles of the face, especially of the mouth. Scabby eruption on
the face, on the arms and over the body. Eruption about the mouth and on the chin. Large blisters on the
cheeks. Lips cracked, the upper lip puffed out.
Female - Copious menses, sometimes with pressure in the rectum. Black and thick blood of the menses.
Appearance of the
menses (in the electric bath).
Food - Increased appetite, great inclination to eat between meals. Thirst during febrile shivering.
Head - Pains in the head, sometimes drawing. Bruise-like pain in occiput. Crushing pressure in forehead, as
from a stone. Shootings in right side of head or from vertex to the temple and right side of forehead. Tearings
in the occiput from the nape of the neck to the forehead. Painful cramps in the head. Violent pulsations
(beatings), or else heat throughout the head. Disagreeable shaking, most frequently from behind.
Heart - Palpitations, especially at the approach of a storm. Palpitations with fever, headache, or with
restlessness and vivid redness of the face. Disposition to fall in syncope. Painful and rapid, sharp pain
proceeding from the heart across the chest.
Kidneys - Sensations as though the bladder were going to burst. Augmented secretion of urine. Very frequent
emission of urine. Involuntary emission of urine. Orangeyellow urine in the morning; during the day, like water
in which meat has been washed. Urine thick, deep-colored, red like blood, abundantly charged with mucus.
White sediment. Discharge of blood with the urine. Leucorrhea, at first serous, afterwards thick in pieces of the
size of a hazelnut.
Limbs - Grievous pains in the limbs, pains in old wounds or in enfeebled bodies from a change of temperature.
 Stiffness of the limbs. Paralysis, especially of the inferior limbs. Trembling of the limbs, chiefly of those which
have been shaken, general trembling. Springing up of the tendons. Convulsions of the limbs.
Lungs - Respiration accelerated. Feeble and faint respiration. Respiration arrested. Dyspnea. Oppression of
the chest. Asthma, with palpitations and disposition to syncope. Cough, with much tickling in throat, or pressure
in forehead from within outwards. Short, irritable cough. Spitting of blood. Rough larynx.
Mouth - Great dryness of the mouth. Augmented secretion of saliva, foam at the mouth. Increased excoriation,
painful, in the interior of right cheek. On the palate, vesicles with desquamation of the epidermis. Dumbness,
inability to utter a sound.
Nose - Tingling or outward pressure in the nose. Sneezing. Augmented secretion of nasal mucus. Discharge,
on blowing the nose of a liquid like milk, aggravation of preexisting coryza. Nosebleed. Loss of smell.
Perspiration - Increased perspiration. Excessive nocturnal sweat, in gouty persons without mitigation, with
anxiety during a storm.
Rectum - Fruitless inclination. The stools are at first facilitated and afterwards restricted. Tenesmus and cutting
pains. Violent pressure in the rectum during the stools. Burning in the anus. Hemorrhoidal flux.
Skin - Itching or tingling over the whole body. Eruption of small nodosities on the spots touched by electrical
sparks, eruption like miliary or measles, white vesicles, itch-like eruption at the joints of carbuncles, which
proceed to suppuration. The skin becomes black, wheals on the skin. Violent pains and swelling of one of the
feet which had been frozen twelve years before.
Sleep - Great drowsiness. Yawning and stretching, sometimes with shuddering over the whole body. Profound
sleep. Sleeplessness, with tossing, for long periods. Confused and disquieting dreams.
Stomach - Fullness of the stomach after eating the least thing. Loathing. Abundant saliva. Sour taste.
Heartburn. Nausea, after a meal. Retching and vomiting with inflammation of throat and cough. Vomiting of
blood.
Stool - Diarrhea, with colic, or at the approach of a storm. Diarrhea with retraction of the testicles, constriction
in anus with dry stools after diarrhea. Frequent stools, liquid, hot, black, yellow and fetid.
Teeth - Tearing pains in upper teeth, proceeding from the head. Drawings in the gums, proceeding from right
ear. Quick, darting pain, as of subcutaneous ulceration, in places once occupied by molar teeth. Quick growth
of the teeth in children.
Throat - Constant tickling in the throat. Pressure on swallowing. Difficult deglutition. Inflammation of the gullet.
Tongue - Sensitiveness of the tongue, at the point, which is also red. Papillae very prominent. Dry tongue,
charged with a yellow coating. Swelling, thickness of the tongue. Vesicles on the tongue with excoriation pain.
Vertigo - Giddiness, especially on stooping. Confusion of head. Syncope and tendency to fall down.
Vision - Clouded vision. Objects all appear yellow to the sight. Everything appears pale. A dark room appears
to be illuminated. Little black spots before right eye. Blindness. Sight improved (curative symptom).
COMMENTS - Dr. Seward related a number of cases in which the injudicious use of electric baths brought on
tuberculosis. In another case, the chest and arms became stiff and paralyzed. A young married woman, who
had general and local (uterine) electric treatment, complained after it of feeling very heavy, as if she weighed
a ton.
One patient after a bath, said his chest and shoulders “felt like marble.” He became tubercular and died. The
paralysis caused by electricity was in several cases quickly relieved by Morph-acet., both in the solution and
in the potencies.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Morph-acet. Electr. antidotes Merc. Compare: (1) Phos. is the best antidote to
the effects of storms. (2) Rhod. is worse before a storm. (3) Galvanismus and Magnetismus.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Elm
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - elm-b. Elm. Ulmus procera. Boil twigs and blossoms for half an hour, strain the water and use
as medicine. Historical dose: Take two drops from the stock bottle into a one ounce dropper bottle, (add
brandy or alcohol, if this bottle will be used for days or weeks). This is the dosage bottle, take a few drops
straight into the mouth or as needed in a little water or juice.
HOMEOPATHIC - Elm belongs to Bach's group of Despondency and Despair, along with Crb-a-b., Oak-b.,
Will-b., Star-b-b., Sw-ch-b., Pine-b. and Lar-b. The group deals with states of oppressive, burdening hardship.
Tendency to exhaustion in mind, emotions and body. Listlessness and lethargy. Unresolved, overwhelming
conflicts or over work leading to the formation of chronic diseases (Wh-ch-b.).
MIND - High expectations for self. Strong sense of duty. Difficulty planning. Overwhelmed by duty. Feeling of
being lost in details, lack of progress. Anxiety over future challenges or duties. Dread, anxiety, intimidation.
 Internal exhaustion, feelings ofinadequacy. Disillusionment and despair. Sadness over unrealistic goals.
REFERENCES - Bach.

name: Embelia Ribes
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - emb. Embelia ribes. Krimighna. N. O. Myrsineae. The medicine was prepared from the seeds.
Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL-Constipation. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Flatulence. Indigestion. Rheumatism. Worms.
HERBAL - The pulp is purgative. The fresh juice is cooling, diuretic and laxative. The fruit is carminative,
anthelmintic, alternative and stimulant. It is employed in habitual constipation of children and in acute capillary
bronchitis. Asa carminative the fruit is given dyspepsia and flatulence. As an alternative in skin diseases and
rheumatism. If taken
for a long time, it is found to turn the urine acid and red. (R. N. Khory : Materia Medica of India, Vol. II, p. 426.).
Charaka states that it is a grand medicine to kill worms. It is also called Krimighna which literally means killer
of worms. Su- shruta says it is good for piles and worms. If it be regularly used in special seasons it will increase
longevity.
The seeds of this plant are used as an anthelmintic. Powdered seeds in doses of one to two drams are
administered with sugar or honey in an empty stomach to expel tape worms. (R. N. Chopra: Indigenous Drugs
of India, p. 577.)
Clinicaly it is very useful in diseases of children associated with or proceeding from worms. It is a grand
medicine in diarrhea, dyspepsia and flatulence owing to worms.
If Nux vomica, cina, santonine and other remedies for worms be ineffective, Embelia ribes will be found to be
a sovereign remedy in those complaints. In this new remedy, the urine becomes pungent and blood colored
and this is one of the characteristic symptoms for the administration of this remedy.
Other symptoms are fretfulness, moroseness and irritability of the patient. Grinding of the teeth. Patient always
picks his nose. Tongue is dry, nausea exists. The abdomen gets distended. Stools are undigested. Urine is
blood colored and pungent. Patient shrieks during sleep. Itching in the rectum, itching in the nose, and worms
come out with the stool.
HOMEOPATHIC - Name of the Prover - Babu sris Chandra Ghose, age 28, or robust physique and of excellent
health.
MIND - Became morose. The prover became fretful and irritable.
Nose - Itching sensation was felt in both the nostrils.
Rectum - Itching sensation was felt in the rectum. Large number of worms came out of the rectum and was
expelled with the stool. Passed three undigested stools in quick succession. Worms were expelled with the
stools.
Stomach - There was distension of the stomach.
Urine - Urine became red colored and strong smelling.
COMMENTS - Case 1 - The son of Babu srish Ch. Roy, B. A., was suffering from remittent fever continued
with unabated fury for six days without any remission.
I was called in to treat the son, aged 6 years, on the 6th March. 1931.1 continued to treat the boy with
Gelsemium and Bryonia for four days, but unfortunately no improvement took place.
10th March - 1 went to see the boy this morning and gathered the following symptoms:
The patient was morose and fretful. Patient always picked his nose. Tongue was dry. There was terrible
nausea. Abdomen was greatly distended. Passed undigested stools. Urine red colored and pungent. The boy
was found to shriek out during sleep. Fever in the morning it was found to be 101° and it generally rose up to
103° in the evening.
I gave Cina 20 and 200 for two days on account of the predominance of worm symptoms. Cina did no good.
At last I gave him Embelia ribes 1 x thrice on the 12th March. It acted very nicely to bring down the temperature
to 99° in the morning next day.
13th March - At 11 a.m. temperature rose, but again fell down to 99° at 4 a.m. on that day and complete
remission took place at eleven PM
14th March - There was no fever. Urine was clear, fretfulness was gone, there was no distension of abdomen,
no loose stools passed and the patient was cured within 3 days. All along these days he took 2 doses of the
new remedy. And since that time the patient did not suffer from worm troubles any more.
Case 2 - The daughter of Babu Ram Ratan Chatterjee, B. L., aged 4 years, suffered off and on from worm
troubles. Ordinary homeopathic remedies were given by a homeopath, but there was no perceptible
improvement. I was sent for on the 2nd November, 1932.
 I marked the following symptoms: The child was ill-humored and restless. There was great hunger soon after
a meal. Could not be quieted by any persuasion. The patient always bored her finger into the nose. The
abdomen was distended. Always disturbed sleep. Loose stool with undigested particles of food. Grinding of
teeth. Blood colored urine.
As the above were clear-cut symptoms of the presence of worms in the system, I prescribed Embelia ribes lx
twice daily. After using this remedy for a fortnight, the patient was perfectly cured.
I prescribed this new drug in 1 x potency in several cases suffering from worm troubles and I am glad to say
that all of those patients were radically cured.
REFERENCES - Ghose.

name: Emerald
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY -emer. Emerald. Gemstone. Triturations. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Allergies. Alzheimer's, disease. Amenorrhea. Asthma. Cancer. Cataract. Chronic, fatigue.
Dyslexia. Endometriosis. Epilepsy. Fainting. Glaucoma. Grief. Hemorrhages. Nursing, others. Senility.
Stammering. Sycosis. Tinnitus. Trauma. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Useful for conditions of exhaustion and debility due to an overtaxed nervous system.
Alzheimer’s disease, senility. Epilepsy. After strokes and brain injuries. Encourages regeneration of nervous
tissue.
Desire to sleep, to give up the struggle, for “all the problems to go away.” Useful in desperate cases when the
patient seems to be giving up. Feeling of being “not in the body,” when the body has been so injured that it is
no longer a wholly viable vehicle.
Chronic fatigue. Post traumatic stress, with disorientated. Weeps, especially at night, when alone. More
cheerful during the day. Inhibition and lack of confidence. Allergy to peanuts.
MIND - Arrogance and haughtiness. Negative, bitter thoughts. Frustration. Resentment and bitterness from
the past. Inability to forgive. Envy and jealousy. Hatred for those who have done well or better. Great negativity.
Wakes with vengeful feelings.
Easily manipulated, or becomes manipulative. Addictive personalities, do not see the threat of their addiction,
particularly in relationships. Fosters the strength to face deep issues that otherwise would lie buried.
Grief after sustained traumas or sadness. Rekindles imagination and intuition after emotional distress.
Distracted and hard to concentrate. Calms the mind and improves memory.
Fearful accepting their fate. Indecisive and changeable. Mistakes and misinterprets meanings. Poor moral
judgment. Encourages the id over the ego.
Back - Pain in the spine, especially after injuries. Tightness of the shoulders and cervical vertebrae. Lumbar
and sacral areas are painful, worse menstrual problems.
Ears - Tinnitus comes and goes. Hardness of hearing.
Eyes - Glaucoma and cataract. Watering eyes when sneezing and laughing. Long or short sight becomes
exaggerated.
Female - Uterine problems after grief or trauma. Endometriosis. Hemorrhages. Amenorrhea. Cancer of the
uterus or the ovaries. History of frequent miscarriages. Useful for anxiety, weakness and debility during
pregnancy. Useful for reducing the side effects upon ending hormone treatment.
Food - Poor assimilation of food.
Head - Headaches at night, worse left side. Light headed and dizzy. Stroke, affecting the left side of head and
body.
Intestines - Bowel cancer, especially if it is secondary to cancer of the generative organs or from suppressed
sycosis (i.e. polyps or warts).
Kidney - Kidney pains, worse right.
Limbs - Legs and feet very cold, but upper part and hands can be hot. Feels draft on the lower half of the
body. Stiffness of the joints, especially hands and wrists.
Lungs - Difficulty breathing, worse night. Pressure on the chest, mediastinal region. Left side of chest most
affected. Shallow breathing. Useful as a support or intercurrent remedy in asthma.
Heart - Sluggish circulation with cold extremities, especially the feet and lower legs, worse night. Can become
too hot in the daytime.
Nose - Frequent need to blow nose, but little mucous.
Skin - Dryness of complaints, hot, burning itching (Apis.). Recurrent abscesses.
Stomach - Throat, esophagus and stomach all feel connected in discomfort (Ign., Nux-v.). Indigestion with
painful trapped wind in the chest. Nausea, comes in waves. Better from limes and bitter fruit. Allergy to peanuts.
 Unable to lose weight in spite of dieting.
Throat - Dryness of throat and mouth. Sensations of constriction and of lump in the throat. Allergies that cause
swelling of the throat. Throat cancer.
COMMENTS - Sycotic, syphilitic and tubercular. Useful in treating pathology (Cars.), especially for cancer of
internal organs (given 30c or higher once a week). Cleanses the lymph system. Improves circulation.
Useful to support the action of heart remedies (Carb-v., Ars., Phos., and the snake poisons). Angina, where
indicated remedies do not work. For drainage in cancer and blood problems (in the x potencies).
x Radiation exposure. For emotional distress after general anesthetics. Mood or temperature swings.
Relates to the heart chakra. Encourages verbal expression of what would otherwise not be expressed due to
grief (Nat-m., Aur., Lach., Caust.). Useful for deep grief. Works well when given repetition.
REFERENCES - Murphy.

name: Emetinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - emetin. Emetinum. Emetine. It is the principal alkaloid of Ipecac. In physiological doses must
be carefully watched. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amebiasis. Colic. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Hematemesis. Hemorrhages. Pneumonia. Psoriasis.
Pyorrhea.
HOMEOPATHIC - Emetin. is a powerful amebicide, but is not a bactericide. Specific for amebiasis. Useful for
the treatment of amebic dysentery. Diarrhea with colic pains and nausea.
May produce hepatization of lungs, rapid heart action, and lobarpneumonia. Tendency to fall forward.
Pyorrhea. Psoriasis.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) In hematemesis and other hemorrhages, compare Gelin., which has a marked
effect on the coagulability of the blood. Hypodermically or if by mouth, a 10 per cent, jelly, about 4 oz., three
times a day.
REFERENCES - Boericke.
