name: Eupatorium Perfoliatum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - eup-per. Eupatorium perfolia- tum. Bone-set. Thoroughwort. N. O. Composite. Tincture of whole
plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Anus, herpes. Back. pain. Bilious, fevet.Bones,pains. Cachexia. Chills. Cough. Dengue, fever.
Diarrhea. Fractures. Fever. Gout. Headaches. Hiccoughs. Hoarseness. Indigestion. Influenza. Intermittent,
 fever. Jaundice. Liver, pain. Malaria. Measles. Mouth, cracks. Nausea. Ophthalmia. Relapsing, fever.
Remittent fever. Rheumatism. Ringworm. Spotted fever. Syphilitic pains. Thirst. Vomiting. Wounds.
HERBAL - Eupatorium perfoliatum is an herbal remedy recommended by Dioscorides for ill- conditioned
ulcers, dysentery, stings of reptiles, chronic fevers and obstructed livers.
It is known as “Boneset” from the prompt manner in which it relieves pain in limbs and muscles that
accompanies some forms of febrile disease like malaria and influenza. Eup-per. is a boon in miasmatic districts,
along rivers and marshes. Clarke found Eupper. most useful in epidemic influenza.
HOMEOPATHIC - Characteristic violent aching, bone-breaking pains. Bone pains, general soreness and
fevers. Distressing bone pains and muscle pains, with malarial fevers and influenza. Dengue fever. Colds.
Conditions where there is a great deal of bone pain. Muscles of chest, back and limbs feel bruised, sore aching.
Inability to lie on the left side. Sluggishness of all organs and functions. Weakness.
Acts upon the gastro-hepatic organs and bronchial mucus membrane. Bilious effects. Restless, chilly and
nauseated. Cachexia from old chronic, bilious intermittents. Useful in old broken down constitutions of
inebriate. Marked periodicity (Ars., Chin., Cedr.), changing periodicity, chill in the morning one day, in the
evening the next.
MIND - Feels at night as if going out of his mind. Anxiety, despondency. Very restless, cannot keep still, though
wishes to. Sadness during heat. Moaning during chill. Moans with aching pains.
Abdomen - Abdomen distension and tympanitic. Avoids tight clothing. Colicky pains in upper abdomen with
headache and other pains. Cramps. Griping pain worse after stool, with tenesmus. Tightness in left
hypochondrium.
Back - Backache before and during chill. Chill spreads from back. Pain in back of neck and between the
shoulders. Intense backache. Pain as if beaten, pain ascends. Aching pain in back. Beating pain in nape and
occiput, better after rising. Trembling in back during fever. Weakness in small of back. Deep-seated pains in
loins, with soreness from motion. Trembling in back during fever.
Breasts - Aching, under left breast, can't lie on left side. Pain through right nipple, when breathing.
Causations - Ill effects of the ice-house.
Chest - Great oppression of chest. Raw, hot, sore chest and bronchi. Muscles of chest are sore, worse from
inspiration. Soreness in chest, can't twist when standing, sitting or lying. Pain and soreness behind sternum.
Constitutions - Worn-out constitutions from inebriety.
Cough - Hoarseness and cough with soreness in chest, must support it. Cough after eruptive stage of
measles. Cough preceding or following measles. Cough with influenza. Chronic, loose cough,
chest sore, worse at night. Cough better getting on hands and knees. Cough lying on back. Loose cough,
at night. Cough from laryngeal tickling. Cough with soreness and heat in bronchi, flushed face, tearful eyes.
Hectic cough from suppressed intermittent fever. Cough worse from 2 a.m. to 4 a.m.
Ears - Buzzing in ears with heat on vertex. Could hear everything while seemingly in profound sleep, but
couldn't speak.
Eyes - Eyes glistened. Yellow eyes. Painful soreness of eyeballs, lids. Sore aching eyeballs with headache.
Great aversion to light. Intense, darting pain through eyes, as from needles. Increased lachrymation, during
cough. Redness of margins of lids. Glutinous secretion from meibomian glands.
Face - Sudden, severe contraction of muscles of right cheek. Yellow face. Sallow, sickly in intermittent fever.
Pale face, during catarrhs. Flushed face during cough or fever.
Female - Itching of the mons veneries. Herpes on thighs.
Food - Canine hunger during or before ague. Anorexia of alcoholics. Food has no taste. Thirst for cold water,
before and during chill. Great thirst for cold water, but after drinking shuddering and vomiting of bile. Craving
for ice cream. Desire for acid drinks.
Head - Head pains alternating with gouty pains. Occipital pain after lying down with sense of weight.
Headache with soreness internally. Throbbing, sore pain. Sensation as of a metal cap on head. Top and back
of head with painful. Headaches with soreness of eyeballs. Headaches better by vomiting of bile, by
conversation. Sick headaches every third and seventh day. Headaches with influenza. Lifts head with hands
during headache. Headache and nausea every other morning, when awaking. Violent headache, comes on
before the chill and lasts through all the stages, worse during the sweat.
Heart - Pressure as if heart is in too small a space. Pain, soreness in cardiac region, worse by least motion or
turning body around.
Kidneys - Dark-colored, clearurine. Watery urine, during intermittents. Urine profuse, pale, with gout. Urine
alternately profuse and scanty. Dark-brown, scanty urine, depositing a whitish, clay-like sediment.
Limbs -Boneaches with influenza. Swellings of limbs with the debility. Aching in bones with soreness of
flesh. Painful gouty nodes, associated with headache. Bone aches with fever and chills. Gouty soreness
 and inflamed nodosities of joints, associated with headache. Dropsy of legs, feet and ankles. Aching in arms
and wrists. Bruised pain in calves. Swelling of left great toe.
Liver - Liver problems on the use of alcoholic drinks. Soreness and sharp pains in region of liver on moving
or coughing.
Lungs - Dyspnea, must lie with head and shoulders high. Difficulty of breathing, with perspiration, anxious
countenance, sleeplessness. Sharp pain through right lung on deep inspiration, at night, disturbed breathing
frightens him.
Male - Itching of the groin. Herpes on scrotum and thighs.
Modalities - Better by conversation. Better by getting on hands and knees. Better vomiting bile. Better lying
on face. Better sweating. Worse from cold air. Worse night. Worse periodically. Worse every third or fourth
day. Worse lying on part. Worse morning. Worse at 7a.m. to 9 a.m. Worse coughing. Worse motion. Worse
smell or sight of food.
Mouth - Taste bitter. Breath smells moldy, sourish. Paleness of the mucus membrane of the mouth. Cracks in
corners of mouth. Soreness of the corners of the mouth. Tongue yellow, covered with white fur.
Nose - Coryza with sneezing, with aching in the bones. Sneezing with influenza. Nose very dry and stopped
up.
Perspiration - Coldness during night sweats. Sweat, relieves all the symptoms except the headache.
Sweat scanty. Skin bathed in sweat. Sweats at night, with
chilliness. Sweats from moving oruncov- ering. Profuse sweat at night in old cases of intermittent fever.
Copious sweats, in rheumatism.
Rectum - Cramps. Constipated with sore liver. Stools, frequent, whitish, green, watery. Constipation with
catarrh. Purging stools with smarting and heat in anus. Morning diarrhea.
Skin - Jaundice. Skin pale and sensitive during fever. Eruptions develop late, especially in measles.
Ringworm. Her- pectic eruptions.
Sleep - Stretching and yawning, before chill. Sleepiness with difficult breathing. Has to lie with head high.
Headache on awaking.
Stomach - Tight clothing is oppressive. Hiccoughs. Indigestion from alcohol of old people. Great thirst for
cold water, but after drinking shuddering and vomiting of bile. Distressing pain in the stomach not better until
all is vomited. Indigestion consequent on the use of alcoholic drinks. Nausea from smell or sight of food.
Nausea, vomiting of bile at close of chill or hot stage, throbbing headache. Vomits water or food that has
been taken. Vomiting and purging of bile of green liquid several quarts at a time. Vomiting preceded by thirst.
Temperature - Chill preceded by thirst, with great soreness and aching of bones. Pain all over, in the
bones as if broken, before the chill. Chill between 7 a.m. and 9 a.m. At the conclusion of the chill, vomiting of
bile or after every draft. Thirst continues during the chill and heat. Influenza with weak pulse, prostration,
bones sore. Influenza in inebriates and with old people. Great weakness and prostration during the fever.
Burning heat. Intermittent fever paroxysm generally commences in the morning.
Throat - Hoarseness, worse morning. Hoarseness and cough, with soreness in chest; must support it.
Soreness in trachea and bronchia. Fauces sore, dryness of throat. Throat dry, at times becomes hoarse and
loses her voice.
Vertigo - Vertigo, sensation of falling to left, worse lying on right side, better vomiting. Early in morning whirling
around in brain as if he had been whirled in cool screen: repeated after a short cessation.
COMMENTS - Characteristic soreness, painful aching in the bones. Bruised feeling, especially in old injuries.
Useful for residual bone pain, after the flu. Aching in limbs, throughout the body. Parietal protuberances, sore
with pain.
Pains come and go quickly (Bell., Coloc., Mag-p.). Pain and extreme tenderness of left glutei muscles. Aching
in the right scapula (similar to Chel.,Phos., Gels.). Aright-sided remedy, difficult to lie on the left side (Phos. ).
Swelling of the limbs.
Headaches with internal soreness. Migraine headaches, severe pain at the base of the brain. Congestive
headache (Bell.). Headache with nausea and vomiting. Sleepiness and yawning. Dizzy with a tendency to fall
to the left.
Influenza, periodic flus (Bry., Ip., Nux-v., Ars.). Winter colds, with sneezing in the back of the head. Bursting,
severe headaches and a thirst for cold water (Bry., Oscilloc. has the headache and bone pains). Eyeballs are
sore and achy. Dizziness (Gels.). Runny nose (All-c.). High fever, alternates with chills.
High fever with bone ache (Merc.. Aur.). Bilious fevers. Edema with intermittent fever or malaria. Yellow fever.
History of malaria. Periodic attacks of fever, colds, infection. High fever with increased aching, followed by
scanty or profuse sweat. All pains better with sweat except headaches, which are worse. Headache is better
rising up. Prostration.
 Chilliness predominates, wants to be covered, better in the house, worse in open air. Chills with a shudder
down the back. Chills begin in the small of the back with aching in the limbs as though every bone in the body
were being broken. Difficulty getting comfortable because of a bruised feeling, restless (Ars.).
Prominent catarrhal symptoms. Sore throat, hoarseness in the morning.
Hoarseness with aching soreness of the trachea. Hoarse, rough, dry, hacking cough with scraping in bronchia.
Desire for something cold to relieve the throat.
Sternal pains, especially when coughing. Bruised feeling with cough, desire to hold the chest (Bry.). Cough
with extreme soreness down trachea. Painful cough. Nocturnal, loose cough. Cough better by getting on hands
and knees, kneeling with face towards pillow, worse lying on back.
W. P. Defriez reported a case in which, every winter for several years, the patient had been annoyed by a dry,
hacking cough with paroxysms lasting some time, only relieved by getting on hands and knees. Eup-per. cured.
Cough arising from irritation of the liver. Bilious vomiting and diarrhea, bilious sick headaches. Liver pain,
soreness, may desire to rub the liver which is enlarged and tender. Hepatitis. Jaundice, clay-colored, white
stools. Bile in the urine, mahogany colored urine. Gout.
Bitter, bile taste in the mouth. Intense thirst, but drinking cold water causes shuddering and vomiting of bile.
Eating causes violent, distressing pains which are relieved only by vomiting. Can be disgusted by food, nausea
from smelling food (Colch.).
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Bry., Sep., Nairn., Chel. (2) Nyctanthes arbor-tristis - bilious fever insatiable thirst,
bitter vomiting at close of chill, also constipation of children.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Anus, herpes. Back. pain. Bilious, fevet.Bones,pains. Cachexia. Chills. Cough. Dengue, fever.
Diarrhea. Fractures. Fever. Gout. Headaches. Hiccoughs. Hoarseness. Indigestion. Influenza. Intermittent,

Remittent fever. Rheumatism. R

name: Eupatorium Purpureum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - eup-pur. Eupatorium purpureum. Gravel root. Queen of the meadow. Joe Pye weed. Trumpet
weed. N. O. Composite. Tincture of the root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Bedwetting. Bladder, irritable. Chills. Cystitis. Diabetes, insipidus. Dropsy.
Dyspnea. Dysuria. Enlarged, prostate. Fever. Gravel. Headache. Hematuria. Homesickness. Hysteria. Impo-
tence. Indigestion. Infertility. Intermittent
fever. Leucorrhea. Miscarriages. Kidney colic. Metritis. Nausea. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Stones. Strangury.
Throat, sore. Urine, retention. Vomiting.
HERBAL - The common name, “gravel root,” indicates the traditional use of the drug and in the hands of the
eclectics it has well in cases of irritable bladder, diabetes insipidus, incontinence of urine, and kidney stones.
Hale mentioned that impotency has been cured in the male and infertility and uterine atony in the female. It is
similar in action to Cimic. and Helon. here.
HOMEOPATHIC - Eup-pur. was well proved by a Mrs. Dresser; she experienced a feeling of homesickness
even when living in her own house. Distressing dyspnea from dropsy.
Kidney dropsy. Albuminuria, diabetes, strangury, irritable bladder. Cystitis in pregnant women from riding
over rough roads. Enlarged prostate. Impotency and infertility.
Bone pains, nausea and vomiting accompany fever. Sweat is slight. Restless tossing, moaning, unable to lie
down. General soreness (Eup-pur.). Chills and pains run upwards, beginning in the back, with shaking and
comparatively little coldness.
MIND - Homesick, even though at home and among family. Sighing. Depressed and sleepy. Hysterical, low-
spirited state. Great fear of sickness. Talkative, exclamations.
Stupid, dull mind. Delusions of sight and hearing. Delusion that heels were crowding through boots. Delusion
so marked that she felt compelled to look and see if it was really the case.
Abdomen - Pain and soreness of abdomen, much worse left side. Hypogastric region swollen and hot.
Rumbling, rolling and twisting pain in bowels. Severe colic after voiding urine.
Back - Weight and heaviness in back and Joins. Cutting pain in neck running from left shoulder to occiput.
Between shoulder-blades chilly feeling. Pains running upward from sacrum into kidneys from left side of back
and hip. Distressing pain in lumbar region before chill.
Bladder - Cystitis in pregnant women on riding on rough roads. Bladder irritability in women. Strangury.
Burning in bladder and urethra on urinating. Constant desire, even after frequent urination, the bladder feels
full. Soreness and pain in bladder. Smarting and burning pain very intense in bladder and urethra. Cutting,
aching pain in bladder, with constant desire to urinate.
Chest - Grating sensation in chest at every deep inspiration.
Cough - Hacking cough in evening. Cough with soreness and heat in bronchia. Dry, hacking cough in spells.
Cough before attack of intermittent fever. Cough continuing throughout paroxysm.
 Ears - Ears feel full. Illusions of hearing. Crackling, worse on swallowing.
Eyes - Staring. Red and swollen, with headache. Lachrymation.
Face - Face flushed. Lips blue.
Female - Profuse leucorrhea, caused by exhaustion and chronic metritis. Numbness, worse in groin. External
genitals, vulva feels as though wet. Quick jerking pain in left ovary. Tense, cutting pain above left ovary. Sterility
from ovarian atony. Threatened miscarriages. Habitual miscarriage at third or fourth month. Inefficient labor-
pains.
Food - No appetite. Loss of appetite during fever, desire to eat immediately after. Desire for warm drinks.
Desires lemonade. Desires cold drinks during chill. Thirst during chill and heat. Thirst before chill, none during.
Thirst with dropsy. Longing for hot drinks.
Head - Sick headache beginning in morning, worse afternoon and evening, worse in cold air. Left sided
headache with vertigo, as if falling to the left side. Pain from left shoulder to occiput.
Heart - Violent palpitations. Fluttering in heart and throat. Pulse accelerated and full.
Kidneys - Nephritis, with severe pain in back, after taking cold. Chronic nephritis. Deep, dull pain in
kidneys. Cutting pains. Diabetes insipidus. Dysuria. Insufficient flow, milky. Urine smells sweet. Urinary
Eupatorium purpureum stream smaller. Hematuria. Incontinence of urine, in children. Frequent effort with
passage of but a few drops of urine. Weak, tired and faint after urinary symptoms. Kidney and bladder stones.
Limbs - Tired, weak, uneasiness in limbs with numbness and gnawing pains. Rheumatic pains shifting from
place to place, always from below upward. Soreness of bones, aching of limbs as if bones were broken. Pains
come and go suddenly, very restless, but not better by motion. Pains in arms and legs before chill, limbs cold
during fever. Neuralgia of right shoulder or right knee, passing over to left.
Lungs - Dyspnea with dropsy. Sighing every few minutes. Strong desire to inflate the lungs, which she
continued to do from time to time without noticing particularly that she was doing so.
Male - Impotency from exhaustion or abuse.
Modalities - Worse from motion. Worse left side. Changing position ever so little causes chilliness down back.
Sensation as if falling to left side (Eup-per.).
Mouth - Tongue furred, brown along center. Tongue, prickling and stinging in tip, on back. Numbness of
tongue. Saliva abundant.
Nose - Coryza. Hoarseness. Hacking cough, in evening. Cough with soreness and heat in bronchi.
Perspiration - Sweats about forehead. Sweats on upper portion of body.
Rectum - Bilious diarrhea. Pressure and weight on rectum. Feeling as if bowels must be moved immediately,
without being able to do so. Bowels loose, during ague.
Sleep - Y awning, gaping andsighing. Sleepy and depressed. Sleep restless and mind disturbed, frightful
dreams.
Skin - Skin hot and dry with fever, hot to touch in face.
Stomach - Wants lemonade or cold drinks during chill. Much wind in stomach, belch- ings almost constant.
Nausea at smell or sight of food or cooking. Great nausea ht no vomiting, with chill. Vomiting with fever with
sick headache. Griping,
crampy pain.
Temperature - No thirst during chill, but much frontal ache. Chill commences in back. Violent shaking with
comparatively little coldness. Fever with protracted bone pains, nausea and vomiting, followed by slight sweat,
mostly about forehead and head.
Throat - Choking fullness, must swallow often. Burning, as if had swallowed some hot substance, most at back
of throat, worse swallowing. Pain left side of throat, causing pain on swallowing, before chill. Fluttering in throat
pit.
Vertigo - Light headed, dizzy, as if flying round and round. Vertigo as if falling towards left side. Vertigo worse
morning. Vertigo with illusions of sight and hearing.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Senec., Cann-s., Helon., Ph-ac, Triticum, Epigea. (2) Apoc. - dropsy., Apis.,
Cann-s., Canth., Cop., For., Hydre., Mit., Senec., (3) Vespa- kidney symptoms. (4) Caps.. Ph-ac. in
homesickness. (5) Eup-per., Colch. - nausea at smell of food.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Euphorbia Amygdaloides
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - euph-a. Euphorbia amygdaloides. Wood spurge. Euphorbia sylvatica. N. O. Euphorbiacae.
Middle and Southern Europe. Tincture of plant./fivtorica/ dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Antrum, pain. Anus, spasms, prolapse. Debility. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Hemorrhoids. Skin,
 eruptions. Smell, illusion. Spleen disorders. Throat, soreness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Produces irritation and burning sensations of the intestinal tract with vomiting and diarrhea.
Dark brown, watery, mucus stools, sometimes mixed with solid feces. Sometimes offensive with blood, mostly
in afternoon. Diarrhea, stools difficult with painful anal spasm.
If stool lasts two or three days there is prolapse returning very gradually, if replaced within half an hour the
bowel generally prolapses again. If the diarrhea lasts longer, external hemorrhoids appear, not returning
with the prolapse.
Rheumatic pains come on when heated. Malaise, tired weak feeling during and after walking. Restlessness all
night, turning about half awake and half asleep. Pain in antrum. Sense of taste blunted. Cold water relieves
burning in back of throat (Caps., burning worse from cold water). Skin disorders. Symptoms go from right to
left.
Abdomen - Tightness, stitch in region of spleen. Sensation as if a long worm writhing in region of transverse
colon or duodenum. Throbbing in groins.
Liver - Severe stitches in liver, when walking up a hill.
Lungs - Heat in chest, radiating from stomach. Feeling as if lungs remained partly inflated. Hoarseness.
Modalities - Better after eating. Worse evening. Worse from walking.
Rectum - Feeling or action of the liver, followed by griping and passing of offensive flatus. Offensive diarrhea,
followed by slight prolapse rendering sitting uneasy, going off gradually. Stool difficult from painful spasm of
anus, continued after the evacuation.
Sensations - Illusion of smell, “odor of mice.” Seething sensation in the head and thigh.
Stool - Dark brown, watery, mucus stool, sometimes mixed with solid feces, sometimes offensive. Feces small,
lumpy, slimy with prolapse, though there had been no straining. Diarrhea returns at lengthened intervals.
Stomach - Nausea, worse moving about indoors, better sitting still, from supper.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Euphorbia Corollata
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - euph-c. Euphorbia corollata. Large flowering spurge. N. O. Euphorbiacae. North America.
Tincture and triturations of the root. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Cholera. Cholera, infantum. Cholerine. Dehydration. Diarrhea. Gastritis. Nausea. Seasickness.
Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Euph-c. is a diaphoretic, expectorant and cathartic of the old school. It produces gastro-
enteric disturbances like other Euphorbias, but with peculiarities especially in the sequence and character of
the vomit.
Deadly nausea, sudden and powerful vomiting of food in stomach. Vomits large quantities of water mixed with
mucus, then of clear fluid like rice-water. Copious watery evacuations of the bowels.
Gastro-enteric disturbances with great anxiety, deadly prostration and cold sweat. Attacks recur after short
intermissions. Dehydration. Feeling of clawing in stomach, cold sweat (Verat.).
COMMENTS -Grimmerremarked “Euphorbia tends to particularly affect the gastrointestinal tract, copious
vomiting, rice water stools, cold sweat, prostration, wants to die, intermittent attacks.”
REFERENCES - Clarke. Grimmer.

name: Euphorbia Cyparissias
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-euph-cy. Euphorbiacyparissias. Cypress spurge. N. O. Euphorbiacae. Europe, North Africa.
Tincture of fresh plant. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Erysipelas. Miliaria. Vesicles.
HOMEOPATHIC - The effects of Euph-cy. have been observed on persons pulling the plants and getting the
juice on hands and face. Acts as an intense irritant of the skin and produces a feeling of chilliness.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Euphorbia Heterodoxa
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - euph-he. Euphorbia heterodoxa. Alveloz. N. O. Euphorbiacae. A soft resin insoluble in alcohol
or water. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.
HOMEOPATHIC - The resin has been used allopathically as an external application in cases of cancer and
has produced the most terrible pains. Euph-he. has been found to alleviate the burning pains of cancer in
 homeopathic potencies.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Euphorbium.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Euphorbia Hypericifolia
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - euph-hy. Euphorbia hypericifolia. Large spotted spurge. N. O. Euphoribi- aceae. Tincture of
whole plant. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Constipation. Headaches.
HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. True took the infusion and tincture of Euph-hy. and obtained symptoms from both.
Symptoms include headache in fore part of head, pain centering at crown with heat above the eyes and fullness
and oppression at epigastrium, followed by languor and drowsiness. Constipation.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

HOMEOPATHIC - Euph-ip. is a more active emetic than Ip. Long-continued vomiting with a sense of heat,

REFERENCES - Clarke. Grimmer.

name: Euphorbia Lathyris
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - euph-1. Euphorbia lathyris. Caper spurge. N. O. Euphorbiacae. A tincture of the whole plant is
made. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Cholera. Diarrhea. Dysentery.
HOMEOPATHIC - The fresh, milky juice is exceedingly acrid when applied to the skin and the fruit is highly
purgative and poisonous. The juice causes redness, itching, pimples, sometimes gangrene.
Poisoning from the seeds produces symptoms including retching, vomiting, and bloody stools with brilliant
eyes, flushed face. The abdomen is drawn inward.
The whole body is stiff and icy cold. Uneasiness. The symptoms point to its use in erysipelas, poison oak, etc.
Rheumatic pains during rest. Paralytic weakness in joints.
MIND - Delirium and hallucinations. Stupor, coma.
Eyes - Almost closed from edema of eyelids.
Face - At first ruddy glow on cheeks, afterwards death-like pallor. Cold perspiration in beads on forehead. Red,
puffed face and in spots suppurating. Erythema, beginning on face, gradually extending into the hair parts and
then spreading over whole body. Glossy eruption, rough edematous with burning and smarting, aggravated by
touch and cold air, ameliorated by close room and sweet-oil applications. Bran-like desquamation. Stinging,
smarting and burning of face when touched. Sensation of cobwebs.
Heart - Weak and fluttering.
Kidneys - Copious flow of urine.
Lungs - Labored breathing. Cold breath, musty odor. Cough, first hacking, as from inhalation of sulphur, later
on, regular paroxysms like whooping cough. Cough ending in diarrhea and vomiting, with sleepiness between
each paroxysm.
Male - Inflammation of scrotum, resulting in deep acrid ulcers with intense itching and burning, worse touching
the parts, or from washing.
Modalities - Better close room. Better sweet-oil application. Worse touch. Worse cold air.
Mouth - Tongue coated, slimy, acrid taste. Breath cold, musty odor.
Nose - End of nose very much inflamed externally. Very sensitive and edematous mucus membranes with
ulceration.
Pulse -120 beats, full, bounding, somewhat irregular.
Rectum - Drastic purgation from large doses, mild laxative condition from smaller doses, followed several
weeks afterwards by obstinate constipation. Stools of white, transparent, gelatinous mucus, later mingled with
blood.
Skin - Erythema, beginning on uncovered parts and face, and spreading over whole
body, glossy, rough, edematous with burning and smarting. Fine bran-like desquamation following in the wake
 of the erythema. Eruption rough, scaly, smarting and burning, when scratched forms deep, ragged ulcers.
Ulcerated skin remains red.
Sleep - Restlessness at night. Sleep disturbed, anxious dreams.
Stomach - Nausea and vomiting of copious, clear water intermingled with white, gelatinous lumps.
Temperature - Body bathed in profuse perspiration, standing out like beads on forehead. Cold, clammy
perspiration on forehead. Temperature increased.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Rhus-t. - skin symptoms. Verat. - vomiting, purging, cough and coma.
REFERENCES Clarke.

name: Euphorbia Peplus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - euph-pe. Euphorbia peplus. Petty spurge. N. O. Euphorbiacae. Effect of juice and local
application of leaves. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Ecthyma. Erysipelas. Sore, throat.
HOMEOPATHIC - The application of the juice and leaves sets up intense and painful inflammation,
erysipelatous, phlegmonous, pustular with intense burning pain.
COMMENTS - In one of the cases observed, the juice of the stem was applied to an inflamed gum. In another,
a boy applied the leaves as a poultice to a black eye.
Burnett produced a sore throat in himself by chewing the herb. He cured with the 3x a case of simple sore
throat with swelling and painful swallowing.
REFERENCES Clarke.

name: Euphorbia Pilulifera
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - euph-pi. Euphorbia pilulifera. Euphorbia hirta. N. O. Euphorbiacae. Tincture. Historical dose:
All potencies.
CLINICAL - Asthma. Bronchitis. Dyspnea. Gonorrhea. Hay fever. Leucorrhea. Sunstroke. Traumatism.
Urethritis.
HOMEOPATHIC - In the Medical Press of May 3, 1893, Dr. George Foy gave an account of this medicine.
Gray, in 1817, mentioned it as a remedy for syphilis and for venomous bites.
In gonorrhea, when there are intense pains at each urination, burning pains which oblige the patient to sit down
or to keep quiet, and violent desire to pass water (Cann-s., Canth.). Humid asthma with prostration and
restlessness. Hemorrhages caused by sunstroke or traumatism.
None of the irritant effects common to most of the Euphorbias were produced, but there was a powerful action
on the heart. First, an alarmingly quick pulse, and then a sudden chill.
Cardiac dyspnea, hay fever and bronchitis. Urethritis with intense pain on urinating and much urging. Acrid
leucorrhea, worse least movement. It has been used by the old-school practitioners in asthma, hay asthma
and bronchitis, chiefly in considerable doses.
COMMENTS - In the Universal Homeopathic Annual, Dr. Cartier gave this account: “Euphorbia pilulifera has
given excellent results in cases of acrid leucorrhea, aggravated by the least motion, especially useful forpale,
delicate and sensitive women” (Facaranda).
REFERENCES Clarke.

name: Euphorbia Polycarpa
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - euph-po. Euphorbia poly carpa. Golondrina. Euphorbiagolondrina. N. O. Euphorbiacae.
Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Snakebites.
HOMEOPATHIC - An antidote to snake poison, its use also renders the body immune to the influence of the
snake venom and thus acts as a prophylactic.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cedrón., The Euphorbias. (2) Euphorbia prostata - Used by Indians as an
infallible remedy against bites of poisonous insects and snakes, especially the rattle-snake. (3) Plumeria
celinus Tincture internally and locally every 15 minutes for snake poisoning, (Dr. Correa). (4) Micania guacho,
a Brazilian snake cure. (5) Selaginella - Macerate in milk, locally and internally for bites of snakes and spiders.
lodium, tincture for rattle snake bites externally and one drop doses every 10 minutes. (6) Gymnema sylvestre
will abolish the taste of bitter things, sense of taste altered, powdered root for snakebite, (7) Sisyrinchium -
Ten to fifteen drop doses of tincture for rattlesnake bites.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
 ***EUPHORBIUM OFFICINARUM
(Gum Euphorbium)
PHARMACY-euph. Euphorbiumofficinarum. Gum euphorbium. Euphorbia resinífera. The resinous exudation
or juice of Euphorbia resinífera exported from Morocco. Euphorbia resinífera is a cactus-like plant of the
Euphorbiacae. N. O. Euphorbiacae. Historicaldose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Blisters. Bone, disease. Cancer. Cancer, pains. Cataract. Coccyx, pain. Coughs. Crusta, lactea.
Diplopia. Erysipelas. Eyes, inflammation. Gangrene. Hay fever. Headache. Heartbum. Influenza. Peritonitis.
Sciatica. Syphilis. Teeth, disorders. Toothaches. Ulcers. Vision, disorders. Warts. Writer's cramp.
HOMEOPATHIC - Euph. is an irritant to the skin and mucus membranes, causing much secretion with a sense
of dryness. Terrible burning pains, as if a live coal were on or in the part. Burning pain in bones. Burning
pain in internal parts. Burning pains of cancer.
Pains in limbs and paralytic weakness in joints. Rheumatic pains of a tearing, pressing, and stinging character,
but only during rest.
Slow inflammations. Blisters. Gangrene of old persons. Everything appears larger than it really is. Convulsions
with loss of consciousness. Congestion of blood to head.
MIND - Acute mania with symptoms of violent cerebral congestion. Melancholy. Anxiety and apprehension.
Starting at night while lying awake in bed. Wants to be by himself and in silence. Quiet, reflective mood.
Inclination to work.
Temporary attacks of madness. Delusion he sees the same man walking after him that he sees walking before
him. Insists upon saying his prayers at the tail of his horse. Everything seems larger than it really is. Abdomen
- Excessive colic and tympanites.
Spasmodic, flatulent colic. Burning like fire in abdomen and stomach. Griping through whole intestinal
canal, followed by thin stool, with burning itching about rectum. Much rumbling, followed by emission of flatus.
Anxious sore aching in lower abdomen. Sunken. Feels hollow.
Back - Coccyx sensitive to touch. Pain in coccyx, worse on rising from sitting, worse after stool. Feeling of
pressure in muscles of back. Sensation in lumbar region or joints, as if paralyzed.
Chest - Burning and sharp pains in left side of chest, during rest, better motion. Stitch-like pressure upon
sternum while sitting and standing. Warm feeling in chest, as if hot food had been swallowed. As if left lobe of
lung was adhering. Heaviness in pectoral muscles, when turning body to right side.
Ears - Ringing in ears, also when sneezing. Roaring at night. Buzzing in right ear, can't sleep at night.
Eyes - Pale-red inflammation of eyelids with nightly agglutination. Swelling of lids. Heaviness of upper lids.
Biting in eyes, with lachrymation. Great dryness in eyes with profuse discharge. Eyes inflamed and
agglutinated in morning. Intolerance of light. Chronic ophthalmia. Eyelids itch severely, are wet and
agglutinated. Purulent discharge.
Face - Red swelling of cheeks. Burning in cheek, worse left. Eyes inflamed and agglutinated in morning.
Erysipelas. Yellow blisters.
Food - Great hunger. Thirst for cold drinks.
Head - Stupefying frontal headache. Constrictive headache in occiput. Violent, pressive headache. Erysipelas
of head and face, with digging, boring and gnawing pains. Sore pain as if beaten, in occiput, worse
morning. Bruised pain in head, in occiput and forehead.
Heart - Irregular, hurried pulse.
Limbs - Paralytic pains. Hip-joint as if sprained. Pain in hip joint and coccyx. Paralytic tightness in shoulder
joint, mornings, from moving arm. Cramp in muscles of right hand when writing. Paralytic pain in wrist on
moving it. Great weakness of legs. Cold sweat on legs in morning. Burning, at night in bones of hip and thigh.
Numbness of feet when sitting. Sciatica.
Lungs - Breathing oppressed as if chest were not wide enough. Violent, fluent coryza with burning and cough.
Spasmodic, dry cough, day and night with asthma. Constant cough with stitches from pit of stomach to sides
of chest. Croup, dry, hollow, cough. Warm feeling in chest, as if hot food had been swallowed.
Modalities - Better from application of oil. Better cold application. Better motion. Worse from sitting. Worse
rest. Worse beginning of motion. Worse mercury. Worse touch.
Mouth - Dryness of mouth without thirst. Mouth feels coated with rancid grease. Profuse saliva. Saliva tastes
salty. Mouth feels coated with rancid grease. Flat taste in mouth, after breakfast. White coated tongue. Much
tenacious mucus in mouth, after midday sleep. Salivation preceded by shivering. Teeth as if screwed together,
brittle, crumbling, decay.
Nose - Nasal itching with mucus secretions from naso-phary nx. Much abortive sneezing. Coryza with swelling.
Acrid ozaena. Violent, fluent coryza, with burning and cough. Coryza with watery discharge from eyes and
 nose.
Rectum - Burning, sore, around anus. Constipation from inactivity of bowels, hard stool, difficult to pass.
Griping pain followed by thin stool. Violent burning itching of rectum. Profuse diarrhea and vomiting. Diarrhea
with tenesmus, burn-
ing at anus and soreness in abdomen. Stools like glue, painful and flatulent, preceded by itching of rectum.
Stool first thin, then knotty. Stools fermented, profuse, clay.
Skin - Erysipelatous inflammation, especially of the cheek. Biting, stinging, red, swollen. Vesicular erysipelas.
Pustules, vesicles filled with yellow lymph or liquid. Carbuncle. Old, torpid, indolent ulcers with biting, sharp
pain. Gangrene (Echi., Sec.). Ulcerating carcinoma and epithelioma of the skin. As if thin cord lay under skin.
Sleep - Sleepiness during day. Sleeplessness with tremulous tossing about before midnight, roaring in ears,
unable to close eyes. Sudden starting up as from an electric shock at night, while lying awake in bed. Anxious,
vivid dreams at night, causing him to cry out, whereupon he awakes.
Stomach - Burning like fire in stomach and abdomen. Inflammation of stomach. Eructations. Frequent
hiccough. Erysipelatous gastritis. Profuse empty eructations. As if stomach were hanging loose. Nausea
with shuddering. Vomiting with diarrhea. Waterbrash.
Temperature - Chilliness and shivering over whole body, in morning. Chilliness while walking in open air.
Shivering over back with gio wing cheeks and cold hands. Constant chilliness with constant sweat. Coldness
of body with internal burning heat. Great heat. Fever with aversion to be dressed, clothing feels too heavy.
Heat only on head. High fever.
Throat - Burning as from hot coal in throat with pain and anxiety. Scraping and rawness in throat. Burning in
throat and stomach as if flame were rushing out. Burning pains with pain and anxiety.
Vertigo - Violent vertigo, when standing. Vertigo walking in open air.
Vision - Diplopia. Dim or feeble vision. Cataract. Lens milk white. Sees better on a dark day.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Camph., Op., large quantities of lemon juice. It antidotes: Ars., Nux-v. v.
Compare: (1) Euphorbia marginata, Snow on the mountain - Honey from the flowers is poisonous, detected
by the hot, acrid taste. The milky juice produces skin symptoms like Rhus-t. (2) Psoralea - A Columbian plant
- pains of cancer, ulcers. Leucorrhea fetid. Pruritus. Uterine tumors. (3) Crot-t., Jatr. (4) Colch., Elat., Ant-t.,
Verat. (5) Euphorbiacious plants Acai., Crot-t., Jatr., Mancin., Mercurialis., Ricinus, Yucca fil. It follows:
Graph., Lach., Puls., Sep., Sulph.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Euphrasia Officinalis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - euphr. Euphrasia officinalis. Eyebright. N. O. Scrofulariaceae. Tincture of whole plant.
Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Allergies. Anus, prolapse. Blepharitis. Cataract. Colds. Colic. Condylomata. Conjunctivitis.
Coryza. Cough. Eye, disorders. Glandular swellings. Granular, eyelids.Hayfever. Influenza. ïntis.Lachryma-
tion. Lips, stiffness. Measles. Nasal, catarrh. Nose, cancer. Parotiditis. Phlyctenule. Pimples. Ptosis. Prostate
gland, disorders. Scrofula. Staphyloma. Sycosis.
HERBAL - The common name of “eyebright” gives the indication for the use of this remedy. According to
Grauvogl, the plant has a “signature of a black spot in the corolla which looks like the eye's pupil.”
HOMEOPATHIC - Produces inflammation of the conjunctiva membranes and profuse lachrymation. It affects
the mucus membranes of the eyes, nose and chest, producing acute catarrh with free, acrid, watery secretions.
Irritation extends to the skin around the eye and nose, disorders of the external nose.
Allergies and hay fever. Tears are acrid, nasal discharge is bland, worse in the evening. Sensation as if
sand in the eyes. Acrid pus. Catarrh in the chest, producing hoarseness and cough with profuse expec-
toration. Hawking up of offensive mucus, may cause vomiting.
Cough after the disappearance of hemorrhoids. Colic, hemorrhoids and condylomata at anus. Drowsiness
without being able to sleep, frequent waking in the night as from fright. Symptoms are better in open air.
Frequent yawning when walking in the open air.
MIND - Taciturn and repugnant to conversation. Aversion to answering. Disinclined to talk. Hypochondriacal
mood, takes no interest in his surroundings. Indolence. Melancholy.
Abstraction of the mind. Weakness of memory. Confusion better cold bath, better washing face. Inclination to
sit. Starting from sleep.
Abdomen - Frequent colic. Pinchings in abdomen by short fits. Pressive squeezing and burning across
abdomen. Colic, alternately with disorders of eyes.
Back - Cramp-like, pressive pains in back. Swelling of cervical glands.
 Chest - Pressive pain beneath sternum. Transient sticking here and there in chest. Sharp pains under the
sternum during an inspiration.
Cough - Cough with easy expectoration, in daytime only, better lying down, better at night. Cough caused by
irritation in larynx. Cough with profuse expectoration of mucus. Cough from smoke of wood. Cough after
disappearance of hemorrhoids. Cough can be suppressed by a sip of water. Cough after influenza. Whooping
cough only in daytime, with profuse lachrymation.
Ears - Otalgia with piercing pains in the region of the tympanum. Earache. Impaired, during catarrhal fever.
Ringing in ear.
Eyes - Hay fever with watery eyes. Catarrhal conjunctivitis, discharge of acrid matter. Eyes water all the
time. Conjunctivitis with measles. Conjunctivitis instead of the menses. Acrid lachrymation, bland coryza
(All-c., opposite). Thick, acrid, yellow discharge from the eyes (Merc.). Profuse hot or acrid tears, worse
open air, lying or coughing. Sensation as if sand in the eyes. Little blister on cornea. Sticky mucus on cornea,
must wink to remove it. Frequent inclination to blink. Photophobia with spasms of the lids. Sharp pains in
eyeballs from bright light. Ptosis (Gels., Caust.). Burning and swelling of the lids. Burning, sharp pains in
eyes. Pressive, cutting pains in the eyes. Pain in the eye, alternating with pain in abdomen. Pressure in eyes.
Chronic sore eyes. Rheumatic iritis. Cataract with watery eyes. Opacities of cornea after injury.
Face - Redness of the face. Rash on face, itching in warmth, becoming red and burning when moistened.
Miliary eruption on the face with sensation of burning and redness, on wetting the face. Stiffness of left cheek,
tongue. Upper lip stiff as if made of wood. Shootings in the lower jaw and chin.
Female - Menses late, painful, flow lasts only an hour or day. Menses scanty, and short. Amenorrhea
with ophthalmia and ulcer on right side of the nose. Stitching pains and itching when walking in open air.
Condylomata.
Food - Better from coffee. Nausea and bitterness after smoking. Cough better eating. Tickling in trachea worse
tobacco smoke.
Head - Headaches with coryza. Pressive headache with photophobia and heat, chiefly in the forehead.
Sensation as if the head would burst. Catarrhal headache with profuse discharge from eyes and nose.
Shootings pain in the temples and in the forehead. Pulsations of head. Beating in the head, perceptible on the
outside. Dullness of head with pressure on vertex. Sharp pains in brain.
Kidneys - Frequent and copious emission of clear urine. Nocturnal irritability of bladder. Dribbling urine. Urine
too often and copious.
Limbs - Numbness in the arms and hands. Cramp-like pressive pains in the hands and the fingers. Fits of
(painless) swelling in the joints of the hand or of the fingers on moving them. Cramp pain in the metacarpus.
Torpor of the fingers. Shootings in the legs during repose. Stitches in the hip and knee joints when walking.
Tension, as from contraction of the tendons, Achilles tendon, on walking. Cracking in the outer ankle of left
foot, when stepping.
Lungs - Difficulty of breathing, shortness of breath, even when seated. Cough with suspension of respiration.
Cough with much, easy expectoration in day, less on lying down, at night. Frequent yawning when walking in
open air. Cough in the morning with copious expectoration of mucus and fluent coryza. Whooping cough only
in day with profuse lachrymation.
Male - Spasmodic retraction of genitals with pressure above the pubic bone. Retraction and tingling of the
testes. Prostatitis. Nocturnal irritability of bladder, dribbling urine. Lancination and voluptuous itching in the
glans and in the prepuce. Condylomata and sycotic growths, itching, stinging with sore and burning pain when
touched.
Modalities - Better from open air. Better winking. Better wiping eyes. Better dark. Better in bed or getting out
of bed. Better from coffee. Worse wind. Worse south winds. Worse warmth. Worse from sunlight. Worse
room, indoor. Worse evening. Worse after sleep. Lying down aggravates coryza, better cough. Cold air and
wind causes lachrymation. Walking in open air causes yawning.
Mouth - Paralytic stiffness of the tongue and of the cheeks, making speech difficult. Stammering and frequent
interruptions in the speech. Sensation of clucking, which mounts into the throat. Shooting pains in lower teeth.
Copious bleeding of gums. Nausea and bitterness in the mouth after smoking.
Nose - Hay fever and allergies. Profuse bland, fluent coryza, with scalding tears and aversion to light.
Profuse, blandfluent coryza. Fluent coryza by day, obstruction of the nose at night. Violent irritation to
sneeze, without cold or apparent cause. Excoriation and painful sensibility of the nostrils. Nosebleeds. Purulent
pimples on the ale nasi. Small red spots, like pimples, on upper right side of nose. Eruption on wings of nose.
Flat cancer on the right side of the nose.
Perspiration - Copious nocturnal sweat. Sweats, mostly on chest, at night during sleep. Sweat often has a
strong odor.
 Very offensive sweat and most copious on front of chest.
Rectum - Constipation. Hard and scanty evacuations. Dysentery. Prolapse anus. Pressi ve in anus while
sitting with hemorrhoids. Old flat condylomata at anus with severe burning, worse at night. Daily stool, but it is
hard and scanty.
Sensations - As if dust or sand in eyes, as if a hair hung over eyes. As if upper lip were made of wood, stiffness
of left cheek and tongue.
Skin - First stage of measles, eye symptoms marked. In measles with watery eyes and fluent coryza it is
sometimes the best remedy. Condylomata, itching when walking, burning when touched. Touching skin
produces aggravation. Consequences of blows, bruises and contusions. Fine eruption around eyes and on
nose. Warts.
Sleep - Usually worse after sleep. Yawning when walking in open air. Sleepy during the day. Frequent waking
(as from fright) at and after 3 a.m., lasting until 6 a.m., when he falls in a stupor from which he wakens with
many complaints. Frightful dreams with frequent waking and starting with fright. Dreams of fire, lightning,
flames, etc.
Stomach - Hiccough. Risings with taste of food. Nausea and bitterness after smoking. Vomiting from hawking
mucus.
Temperature - Chilly and cold. Chill in the forenoon. Descending fever. Attacks of heat during day. Fever with
redness of face and cold hands.
Throat - Gagging when clearing throat in morning. Catarrhal hoarseness, mornings. Irritation of larynx
impelling him to cough, followed by tensive pressure beneath sternum.
Vertigo - Vertigo with heaviness of head. Vertigo with tendency to fall.
Vision - Dim vision hysterical. Everything seems enveloped in a mist and to move. Blurred vision, better wiping.
Dim vision, as through a veil, in evening. Dim vision by candlelight, the light seems to vary. Light of candle
seems to be dark and to flicker, during headache. Obscuration of vision for distant objects, while walking
in open air.
COMMENTS - Great affinity for the eyes. Nonspecific organ remedy for the eyes. Good for concomitant
symptoms relating to the eyes, particularly tearing or watery eyes, unrelated to current condition. Great value
as an eye-lotion, can remove corneal opacities.
Allergy infections where the eyes are prominently involved, where the eye swells and waters. Watery, runny
eyes, the whites of the eyes are red. Copious tearing, hot, acrid tears that irritate the skin. Eyes smart.
Conjunctivitis (Arg-n., Puls.). Conjunctivitis with measles, eye problems since measles. Pink eye, with yellow
discharge, better walking around slowly (Puls.). Acute bacterial infections. Sensation that sand or gravel is
under the eyelid, constant irritation or itchiness.
For dry eyes or blocked ducts. Migraine headaches with eye symptoms. Whooping cough with lachrymation.
Photophobia. Colds, hay fever. Sneezing attacks. Coryza worse lying down, at night and in the open air. Worse
windy weather. Chilly.
Hering noted a cure of “flat cancer on right side of nose.”
Ames of Rockland, Ohio, recorded the case of an old man of 79 to whom he gave Euphr. 3x for lachrymation
and sneezing. It relieved him of those symptoms in addition to prostatic trouble he had for some years, which
compelled him to rise frequently in the night to urinate. This led Ames to give Euphr. in other cases of prostatic
trouble with good results.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Camph., Puls. Compare: (1) Hydrophyllum, Burr-flower, (catarrhal infl animation
of eyes, hot lachrymation with itching, swollen lids, dull headache, alsoforeffectsofPoison-Oak).(2)All-c.,Ars.,
Gels., Kali-hp„ Sabadilla. (3) Aeth., All-c. - tears bland of Euphr., corrosive. (4) Apis, Arg-n„ Ars., Hep., Kali-bi.,
Kali-i., Merc., Merc-c. (5) Puls.. Grat., Dig., Tab. Compatible: Aeon., Calc., Con., Nux-v., Phos., Puls., Rhus-
t., Sil., Sulph.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Eupionum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - eupi. Eupionum. Wood tar. On distilling wood tar of the rubber tree a volatile oil is obtained
which separates into a lighter and heavier oil, the heavier oil is Kreosote, the lighter is Eupion. Historical dose:
Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Cough. Cramps. Dreams. Glandular swellings. Groin, pains. Hemorrhages.
Headache. I^eucorrhea. Menorrhagia. Neuralgia. Nosebleed. Night-sweats. Ovarian, pain. Pruritus.
Toothache. Tuberculosis. Tumors. Uterine, displacements. Vicarious, menstruation.
HOMEOPATHIC - Eupionum is a lighter volatile oil obtained from distillation of wood tar. It was proved by
 Wahle in Rome, who also proved paraffin. The effects of Eupi. bear a close resemblance to those of Kreos.,
but are by no means identical with them.
Eupi. has a large number of symptoms centered in the female sexual organs. Uterine displacements. Pain
in back, followed by a bland leucorrhea. Menses too early and copious, thin flow.
Sacrum pains as if broken, backache extends to pelvis, better leaning against anything for support orbending
backwards. Cramps in calves at night. Intense sweat from slightest exertion. A sense in the feet as if walking
on needles. Sensation as if whole body were made of jelly. Disgusting dreams.
MIND - Cheerful, joyous disposition. Irritable, angers easily. Frightened on waking. Great weakness of
memory.
Abdomen - Stitches when walking in left anterior crest of ilium. Squeezing, pressing pain in left groin when
quiet. Pains better passing flatus. Contracting pain and twisting better by bending over, day before
menstruation. Cutting pains during menstruation, when the pains cease discharge is always copious, blood
red and very thin.
Back - Sacrum pains as if broken. Pressive heaviness in lumbar vertebrae. Severe backache, must lean
against something
for support. Pains extend into pelvis. Backache alternating with leucorrhea. Backache during menses.
Breasts - Breasts increase in size with pres- sive pains in them, as if something painful were drawn through
them, with oppression. Stitches under right breast.
Chest - Heaviness, oppression, stitches and tickling in chest. Stitches and pressure in sternum.
Ears - Pressing in ears as if the wind was blown forcibly into them for a long time, the external parts being
equally affected. Shooting and tearing in left ear, extending to external temporal region.
Eyes - Eyes weak, as if she had cried. Pressure above eyes as if the globes would be pushed out. Burning,
pressive pains in eye, copious lachrymation. Lachrymation worse in fresh air, better in room. Everything
appears pale, as if a thin veil were before eyes.
Face - Hard nodule, the size of a pea, on lower portion of inner side of right cheek. Upper lip fissured and
painful, as if raw. Lips and throat always dry, yet without thirst. Lips painful as if sore.
Female - Menses too early and copious, irritable. During menses, irritable and disinclined to talk, burning and
stitches in chest and heart. Gushing leucorrhea, yellow, staining. Leucorrhea with severe backache after
menses, when pain in the back ceases, leucorrhea gushes out. Sore pain between labia during urination.
Pruritus pudendi, labia swollen. Burning in right ovary. Chronic tubal disease. Uterine flexions. Uterine
displacements.
Head - Heat at vertex, stitches from vertex down limbs into abdomen and genitals. Sore painful spots on head.
Painful pulsation in forehead.
Heart - Palpitations with slow pulse, believes her heart must be heard some distance away. Severe palpitations
before menses, ceasing when the flow begins.
Kidneys - Frequent inclination, scanty discharge, worse when standing than sitting. Copious urine, lemon
color, chestnut brown before menses. Hot urine passed without pain.
Limbs - Cramps in the calves, worse at night. Paralytic, dislocation pain in right knee. Stitches in either knee.
Tearing in limbs and restlessness in legs preventing sleep. Dislocation pains in joints of right hand. Heads of
bones of fingers feel too large. Hands go to sleep easily.
Lungs - Crawling in upper bronchi causing dry cough. Rough, scraping, metallic, dry cough. Hard, suffocating,
dry cough with stitches in chest, returning every winter. Cough better by warm drinks, by sitting up on bed with
breaking out of perspiration.
Modalities - Bending forward ameliorates pain in abdomen. Bending backwards ameliorates backache. Rest
ameliorates headache and pains in abdomen, aggravates other symptoms. Coughing and sneezing
aggravates pains in abdomen. Cough returning every winter. Hot drink aggravates toothache. Worse morning
and night. Worse blowing the nose.
Mouth - Whole tongue red, covered with raised pimples like herring roe. Tip of tongue dry, back covered with
thin, dirty white coating. Anterior part of tongue rough like a grater. Insensible feeling in mouth, as if scalded
by fat. Pappy and sticky in mouth, early in morning. Sour, putrid taste after eating.
Nose - Sneezing, each time he blows his nose the sneezing reappears. Sneezing with fluent coryza in morning.
Left nostril cracked, bleeding. Bleeding, blood thin and fluid, when blowing nose. Menstrual flow intermits with
nosebleed. Soreness in upper nose on drawing air through nostrils in evening.
Rectum - Itching after stool. Ineffectual inclination and straining. Tenesmus, better when blood is passed, this
weakens her. Constipation, stool every three or four days with great straining and prolapsed uterus. Hard, dry
stools with great straining. Dark blood in painless stools.
Sensations - As if dislocation of joints. As if muscles torn from bones, as if skin and muscles were too short.
 Soles of feet numb as if walking on needles, sticking in heels.
Skin - Nodule on left forearm. Itching, biting in skin, in genitals, penetrating whole body, worse night, better
during motion.
Sleep - Yawning with chilliness and shivering. Sleepiness towards noon. Dreams of disgusting things, of naked
persons, anxious dreams of her child falling into the water. Frightful dreams, the same dream repeated, that
she is pursued, or falling into an abyss. Wakes bathed in perspiration.
Stomach - Region of stomach feels internally sore and distended, pains under both short ribs. Bloated and
sensation of fullness of stomach with internal chilliness in evening. Belchings tasting of food. Vomiting of food.
Vomit emanating from lower abdomen, dark green, tasteless mucus.
Teeth - The teeth stick together when the jaws are closed. Teeth painful as if loose, gums swollen, scorbutic,
worse by hot soup. Toothache-like numbness in carious molars, coming on immediately on lying down, better
on rising and moving about. Sensation as if gums swollen and teeth would drop out. Gums swollen. Painful
jerking-tearing in gums.
Temperature - Chilliness, with headache, stitching, better by warm drink. Dry heat towards noon. Foul smelling
sweat on least exertion, when eating, all night. Copious night-sweat towards morning.
Throat - Sensation below larynx as if something was sticking there, with a short, dry, hacking cough. In
morning, much white bad-tasting mucus in throat, expectorated after slight paroxysms of coughing. Sensation
of mucus in throat without being able to expectorate. Sensation of dryness of uvula.
Vertigo - Everything turns around on sitting up in bed.
COMMENTS - Menstruation is too early and too copious, thin and fluid flow. Cutting in abdomen ceases when
flow comes on. Nosebleed, when menstrual flow intermits. Yellow leucorrhea after menses, staining yellow.
Eupionum
Leucorrhea with severe backache, has to lean against something to give relief, when the backache ceases the
discharge gushes out.
Palpitation with slow pulse. Painless pulsation in the head. Pulsations all over body while sitting quietly. Sticking
pains in head and other parts. Cramps in the calves when accompanying uterine or chest complaints.
Weak eyes and obscured vision. Pressing in ears as if wind were blown in with force and for a long time. Teeth
stick together when jaws are closed in morning sensation as if teeth were embedded in some soft matter.
Tongue covered with raised nodules. Pain in inguinal region.
Nodules appear on inner side of right cheek, left side of neck and left forearm. Painful glandular swellings in
groins. Spasmodic, periodic pain an inch up rectum. Bloody stool.
Headache and chilliness. Coldness of whole right side of the body. Colliquative perspiration. Perspires from
least exertion, when eating, all night (with tuberculosis). Wobbling sensation in upper part of body, everything
becomes dark to her. Great irritability.
RELATIONS - Graph, antidoted the effects on eyelids. Compare: (1) Kreos. and the Carbons. (2) Lach. - pain
ceases when discharges appear.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak

name: Eyesenhardtia Polystacia
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - eys. Eyesenhardtia polystacia. Orteaga. Eyesenhardtia adenostylis. N. O. Anonaceae family.
Central America, western Texas. Tincture of the hardwood of the trunk. Historical dose: Tincture and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Cystitis. Headaches. Kidney, colic. Kidney, diseases. Neuralgias.
HERBAL - A small tree, belonging to the Anonaceae family, found in Guatemala and West Texas. Central
American natives used it for kidney diseases.
HOMEOPATHIC - The symptomatology was established by Egee in 1932, on seven provers, using the 6x
potency. Slow and difficult concentration. Sleepiness in the afternoon and evening. Neuralgia of the forehead
and eyes. Dull aching in the head, localized especially on the forehead and above the eyes. Eyelids heavy.
Throat dry. Burning pain in the thighs. Cystitis. Urination frequent, late and scanty. Kidney colic. Worse
between 4 p.m. and 6 p.m. Worse in the evening.
REFERENCES - Julian.

name: Fabiana Imbricata
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - fab. Fabiana imbrícala. Pichi pichi. N. O. Solanaceae. A South American shrub cultivated in
Southern California. Tinctureof thejuice. Fluid extract. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
 CLINICAL - Bladder, weakness. Cystitis. Dysuria. Gallstones. Gonorrhea. Jaundice. Kidney, stones. Liver,
disorders. Prostate, disease. Prostatitis. Uric acid, diathesis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Fabiana imbricata has been used as a terebrinthine diuretic. It has tonic and chologogue
properties, and is used in the treatment of nasal catarrh, jaundice, dyspepsia. Albert Schneider noted that it
increases the secretion of bile.
Liver disorders. Gallstones. Uric acid diathesis, cystitis, prostatitis, and dysuria. Bladder tenesmus and
burning after urination. Excoriating urine and kidney stones. Bladder catarrh with suppurative prostatic
conditions. Gonorrhea. Post-gonorrheal urinary conditions.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Fagopyrum Esculentum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-fago. Fagopyrum esculentum. Buckwheat. Polygonum fagopyrum. N. O. Polygonacae. Tincture
of the whole mature plant. The fresh mature plant is pounded to a pulp and macerated in two parts by weight
of alcohol. Historical dose: Tincmre and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Arteries, throbbing. Belching. Depression. Diarrhea. Eczema. Eyes, disorders. Genitals, sweat.
Granular, eyelids. Hands, sweat. Headache. Heart, disorders. Heartburn. Intertrigo. Itching. Leucorrhea.
Liver, disorders. Mumps. Nausea. Nose, crusts. Ophthalmia. Palpitations. Pruritus, pudendi. Pruritus, vulvae.
Rheumatism. Skin, eruptions. Styes. Taste, altered. Throat, sore.
HOMEOPATHIC - Fagopyrum, commonly known as buckwheat, acts upon the skin and the digestive organs.
It has had an extensive proving. Though there is little clinical experience with this herbal remedy on record,
some features are sufficiently well marked to justify their being classed as characteristics.
Itching, felt in different parts of the body, eyes, posterior sinuses, anus, deep in hands, legs etc. Intense an
itching of the arms and legs, becoming worse toward evening. Senile itching,pruritus.
Itching erythema. Blotches like fleabites, sometimes all over the body, sore to the touch and are multiplied by
scratching. Persistent eruptions. Large blind boils.
The itching of the face is especially marked about the roots of the whiskers. Persistent itching of the hands
which is “deep in,” being supposed to be the result of irritation of the coats of the arteries.
Offensive excretions. Fluent coryza. Postnasal catarrh, dry crusts, granular appearance of posterior sinuses
with itching. Pain in streaks. Visible pulsation of the carotids and other arteries.
MIND - Depressed and irritable. Irritable, cross. Exceedingly happy. Inability to fix attention, study or to
remember what has been read. Aversion to being spoken to. Confusion of mind better after eating.
Restlessness during mental labor, when attempting to study.
Abdomen - Abdomen distended with flatulence, worse by pressure of clothes. Soreness in hypogastrium.
Back - Stiffness and bruised feeling in the muscles of the neck with sensation as if nape would not support the
head.
Breasts - Breast less painful than usual before period.
Chest - Heavy feeling, bruised pains and stitches in chest. Twinges of pain up and down left breast, outer
side. Sharp, stitch-like needle prick in right breast on inspiration. After retiring, severe sticking through breast
from nipple backward, better by pressure.
Constitutions - Weak constitutions.
Ears - Itching in and around ears. Heat, itching and neuralgic pains in external ears. Itching along Eustachian
tubes.
Eyes - Eyes swollen, red, hot, itching, as if sand in eyes. Itching and smarting, swelling, heat and sorenéss.
Itching in the margins. Aching deep in eyeballs. As if eyeballs were pushed out. Lachrymation, worse by
reading. Pain along lachrymal duct. Meibomian glands of left lower lid inflamed.
Face - Face flushed. Soreness of left malar bone, also of temporal region. Lips dry and cracked, vertical crack
on upper lip.
Female - Itching, better by cold water. Pruritus vulvae with yellow leucorrhea, worse rest. Leucorrhea
staining yellow. Burning in right ovary. Pains in right ovary, on walking in afternoon.
Head - Itching in and around eyes and ears. Pains deep in head with upward pressure. Headaches with a
tired neck, better bending backwards. Head hot, better bending backward with tired neck. Occipital headache.
Bursting pains. Cerebral hyperemia.
Heart - Pain around heart, better lying on back, extending to left shoulder and arm. Palpitations with
oppression. Pulse irregular intermittent, rapid. Light feeling in chest. Throbbing in all arteries after retiring.
Kidneys - Stitching pains in region of right kidney. Cutting in urethra. Difficulty in voiding last drops of urine,
several drops pass after he thinks he has finished.
 Limbs - Stiffness and bruised sensation in the muscles of the neck, with sensation as if nape of neck could
not support head. Pain in shoulder with pain along fingers. Itching in arms and legs, worse towards evening.
Itching deep in hands. Streaking pains in arms and legs. Feet numb and pricking.
Liver - Pain in region of liver on stooping. Bruised, sore feeling at 10 a.m., worse lying on right side. Sharp
sticking through liver from the back.
Lungs - Touching the neck occasions a cough with a smarting sensation extending to the ear and throat,
under lobe of right
ear. Breath very offensive.
Male - Profuse offensive sweat of genital organs.
Modalities - Better coffee. Better cold water. Better cold applications. Better cold air. Better sitting still. Better
in a warm room. Better pressure and motion. Worse in the afternoon. Worse from sunlight. Worse walking.
Worse in bright sunlight. Worse from motion. Worse deep inspiration. Worse stooping. Worse ascending.
Worse writing. Worse scratching. Worse riding in cars. Worse lying on right side. Worse after retiring.
Mouth - Soreness of teeth on closing them, worse by cold water. Gums sore and bleed easily. Swelling in roof
of mouth. Bad taste in mouth in morning. Taste of ingesta after dinner, with belchings.
Neck - Parotid and submaxillary glands swollen, sore and painful. Stiffness of neck and soreness of all neck
muscles. Neck tired, as if unable to support head. Dull pain in back of neck, at base of occiput,’ better bending
head backwards.
Nose - Itching in posterior sinuses. Postnasal catarrh. Fluent coryza with sneezing, followed by dryness and
crust formation. Nose red and sore externally. Septum deeply cracked.
Rectum - Itching in anus. Burning in rectum after stool, creeping, urging, tenesmus. Diarrhea with tenesmus,
stools watery or pappy with flatulence, very offensive.
Skin - Eczema. Erythema. Intertrigo. Blind boils. Skin hot. swollen. Severe itching, better by bathing in cold
water, worse scratching, and touch. Itching of hands, deep within.Itching of knees, elbows and hairy
portions. Senile pruritus. Sore, red blotches. Vesicular, pustular and phlegmonous dermatitis.
Sleep - Constant desire to yawn and stretch, 5 to 6 p.m. Restless night, wakes 5 a.m. and sleeps again, many
dreams.
Stomach - Bruised, sore feeling in stomach. Uneasy, empty feeling in stomach. Belchings of scalding, hot,
acid, watery substance, better coffee. Drooling. Persistent nausea, better eating.
Temperature - Chills along back in afternoon. Cold, clammy sweat at night, very profuse. Sweat of hands,
though cold. Hands and feet alternately hot and cold. Soles of feet moist, disagreeable odor in axilla. Face,
head and hands burn in afternoon. Heat and restlessness after retiring.
Throat - Soreness and a feeling of excoriation deep down pharynx. Uvula elongated, tonsils swollen. Thick
mucus collects in throat on rising. Badly-smelling cheesy mass coughed up. Feeling as if a lump in esophagus,
painful on swallowing. Throbbing of carotids.
COMMENTS - Berridge recorded two cases in which Fago, was of service. The first case concerned a dull,
bruised pain in top of left shoulder, rather posteriorly, extending up neck, worse on moving the part, appearing
on waking, going off after breakfast and returning later in the day.
Constipation. Nausea a little before 11 a.m., afterwards dull pain in left temple and a feeling of heat all over.
After aggravating the pain in the shoulder, Fago, removed the symptoms.
In the second case. Fago, permanently removed, after a week's aggravation, sinking in the stomach about 6
p.m. or 7 p.m., and temporarily removed a chronic diarrhea about 6 p.m. or 7 a.m. The diarrhea was later
increased and was met by Lach.
Hale mentioned that there was a popular belief that indulgence in buckwheat cakes is a prolific cause of skin
eruptions. He found it curative in cases of eczema, erythema and intertrigo.
Deep-seated and persistent effects upon the head. Vertigo, confusion. Severe pres- sive or bursting pain in
many parts of head with upward pressure. Pain in forehead, back of eyes, through temporal region on either
side. Congestive headaches (Bell., Glon., Nux-v., Sep.).
Itching, smarting, swelling, heat and soreness in the eyes. Soreness in the ears. Erysipelas, frostbite (Agar.).
Swollen, red, inflamed and sore nose. Fluent coryza with sneezing, followed by fullness, dryness and the
formation of crusts. Burning, sore-
Fagopyrum esculentum ness and persistent pain from even gentle pressure.
The face is pale or unevenly flushed with dark semicircles below the eyes. Swollen, hot and dry, as though
severely sunburned, with cracked and sore lips. The mouth feels dry and hot and yet saliva is not wanting.
Soreness and swelling of roof of mouth. Tongue is red and fissured along its edges. Bad taste in the morning
(Puls.).
Soreness with pain in throat, just back of the isthmus of the fauces. Feeling of excoriation and soreness
 extending deep down in the pharynx. Elongated uvula, swollen and red tonsils. Sensation of rawness in the
throat (Phyt.). Scarlet redness of the neck below the mastoid process. Throbbing of the carotids. Neck feels
tired, the head heavy. Parotid glands are swollen and painful.
Persistent morning nausea, vomiting of pregnancy. Appetite improved by eating (opposite of Lyc., Nux-m.).
Empty or “all- gone” feeling at the stomach (Sep.). Fullness and pain in the abdomen, but no rumbling. Frequent
discharges of flatus. The region of the liver is painful, tender, worse from pressure, compelling the patient to
lie on the left side. Stools are pappy or watery, profuse, offensive, followed by tenesmus.
Scalding urine, pain extends from testicles to abdomen. Profuse, offensive smelling perspiration on the male
genital organ. Bruised or burning pain in the right ovary, particularly when walking. Pruritus with slight yellow
leucorrhea, more when at rest than when exercising.
Persistent, heavy, pulsating pain in chest, worse from deep inspiration. Dull pains around the heart, with
oppression and occasional sharp pains passing through the heart. Pressure with the hand increases the
oppression. Increased pulse, extremely variable.
Stiffness and soreness of all the muscles of the neck, with pain and a feeling as if the neck would hardly
support the head. Dull pains in small of back with stitching pains in the region of the kidneys. Pains with
occasional sharp stitches extend from the arms to muscles of both sides of chest.
Dull, aching, rheumatic pains in the shoulder. Stinging and burning pains extend the whole length of fingers,
aggravated by motion. Streaking pains pass through arms and legs with sharp pains extending to feet. Pains
extend from hips to small of back, frequently run down to the feet.
Sleepiness in the evening, stretching and yawning. Easily wakened when the mind is diverted, but soon falls
again into sleepiness. Sleep is disturbed by troublesome dreams and frequent waking.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Dolichos, Bov., Psor., Sulph., Urtica. (2) Rhus-t. - better by motion. Senega -
better bending head back. (3) Lyc. - hours of aggravation 3 to 6 p.m. (4) Puls., Polygonum. (5) Coffee relieves
stomach symptoms.
REFERENCES - Anshutz. Clarke.

name: Fagus Silvatica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - fagu. Fagus silvática. Beechnut. Fagus farfara. N. O. Cupuliferae. Fagaceae. Tincture or
trituration of the nuts. The beechnuts are pounded to a pulp and macerated in five parts by weight of alcohol.
Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Convulsions. Epilepsy. Headaches. Hydrophobia. Rabies. Vertigo.
HOMEOPATHIC - Knowledge of this remedy is derived from the ill effects of eating the nuts, among which are
dread of liquids and salivation, suggesting its use in hydrophobia or rabies. John Bauhin said that the nuts
would disorderthe head like darnel; hogs grow stupid and drowsy by feeding on them. Ray and Mangetus
agree.
Trembling, convulsions with periodic spasms, stiffness and coldness have been observed, pointing to nerve
irritation. Swelling of the mouth and headache were noted in one case. In some instances, death has resulted
from the effects of the nuts.
COMMENTS - Dr. E. Berridge contributed a case in which “a boy aged 13 had eaten four days ago a large
quantity of beech nuts. I found him in great pain, languid and terrified. Also, with apprehensions of present
death.
Pulse very unequal, sometimes extremely quick, sometimes languid and intermittent, skin burning violently,
mouth flowing with froth and saliva.
“Intolerable thirst, entreating fordrink, but so soon as any liquid was brought he seemed to shudder with equal
horror, as if he had been eating unripe grapes. Soon after eating the nuts he had been seized with torpor,
gloominess and dread of liquids. He had not been bitten by any rabid animal.
“Next day, early in the morning, he was the same, but seemed to talk more in his wildness and perturbation of
mind and his mouth flowed with foam more abundantly, the urine he had voided by night was red and fiery,
depositing a copious turbid white sediment, resembling an emulsion of beech nuts, subsiding as deep as the
breadth of the finger at the bottom of the vessel.
“A few hours before he died he vomited a porraceous bile after which he died quietly.”
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Epiphegus in headache and salivation, Epiphegus which grows on the beech
and partakes of its properties. (2) Rabies - Bell., Lyssin.
REFERENCES - Anshutz.

name: Fel Tauri
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - fel. Fei tauri. Ox bile. Ox gall. Bilis bovina. Bilinum. N. O. Ruminantia. Impissated gall triturated
with sugar of milk or lower dilutions may be made with water. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Asthma. Catarrh. Cirrhosis. Constipation. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Flatus. Gallstones. Headaches.
Indigestion. Jaundice. Rheumatism.
HOMEOPATHIC - Ox gall is a remedy of very ancient use. It is used in the old school mostly as a purgative,
for preventing putrefactive changes in the intestines, and for increasing peristalsis. It was proved by Buchner.
Disordered digestion, diarrhea, constipation. Chronic gastric and intestinal catarrh. Much flatus, ascites.
Diabetes. Obstruction of the gall ducts. Gallstones. Jaundice.
Cirrhosis of liver. Increases the duodenal secretion, emulsifies fats and increases the action of the intestines.
Liquefies bile and acts as a purgative and chologogue.
Nape of neck pains. Pains in joints and cramps. Headache. Tendency to sleep after eating.
MIND - Peevish, irritable mood. Greatly inclined to al 1 kinds of business, unpleasant impression did not affect
him.
Abdomen - Violent peristaltic movements. Rumblings and motions in abdomen.
Back - Tension in nape.
Chest - Anxiety in chest. Constriction, on walking at 3 a.m. cannot sleep again for tightness of breath and
cannot remain lying, it seems as though something in throat prevented free passage of the air, better by deep
inspiration and sitting upright.
Food - Increased thirst.
Head - Confusion. Violent headache in morning, on pressure upon right temple, extending to occiput and nape
of neck.
Kidneys - Urging. Offensive urine.
Limbs - Some tearings in left shoulder joint, extending up to nape of neck. Cramp in right toe.
Male - Scrotum itching, moist.
Rectum - Stool with urging and sensation of warmth in anus. Stool thin, pasty, followed by pressing, although
with crumbling feces.
Stomach - Gurgling in stomach and epigastric region. Odorless and tasteless belchings.
Sleep - Tendency to sleep after eating. Sound sleep in morning with some perspiration.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Merc-d. (2) Choi. in gallstones. (3) Calcul-b. - triturate Gallstones up to 10 to
12x.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Feldspar
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY -feld. Feldspar. Mineral varieties, containing alumina, silica and oxygen. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Arteriosclerosis. Fainting. Otosclerosis. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - It is a silicate compound containing potassium, sodium and aluminium. Kaolin is a
disintegrated feldspar which has lost its potassium and sodium but has retained the silicate of aluminium. It is
not similar to feldspar in its use.
The chemical composition suggests a use in arteriosclerosis and those illnesses showing sclerosis and fibrosis
of the tissue.
COMMENTS - Two cases of otosclerosis were cured clinically, both occurring in patients forty-one years old.
Both were nervous, disposed to tremble, and complained of weakness.
One said he felt if he had been struck on the head and was about to faint. He had sensations of heat on hands
and feet. His head pained on moving.
Both cases recovered after many weeks of treatment. These symptoms are common to silica and the kalis,
hence, the weakness is characteristic of Feld.
A woman age 38, had had varicose veins for many years. Her skin injured easily. Under Feld, she was freed
of the pains in the legs. The tendency of the skin to injure disappeared at the start of treatment, the varicose
veins remained.
A woman age 48, was given Feld, for retinal hemorrhages five months after the attack. At times she showed
glycosuria and was very nervous. After two months treatment, the nervousness and eye affects improved fifty
percent, and she experienced a feeling of general well being.
A woman age 53, received Feld, for fainting spells resulting from an arteriosclerotic heart. She suffered from
incipient arcus seniles; by resting in bed she regained normalcy, at least concerning her domestic work.
A man age 70, with an arteriosclerotic kidney, suffered from hematuria. Under Feld, he was on his feet again
 as an ambulatory patient.
A woman age 84, with marked arteriosclerosis, cardiac decompensation and edema received Feld, and a
decoction of Apoc. The dropsy disappeared.
Several weeks later the dropsy returned, gangrene of the foot developed, and she died.
A man age 70, with severe dropsy of both feet, received Feld, and Apoc. He recovered in two months. We can
only guess what the future holds in store for him.
A woman age 50, with high arterial pressure, spells of weakness, and nervous exhaustion, received Feld, in a
series of doses. Her complaints disappeared. Chronic cases improve slowly, quick results should not be
expected in these cases.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Sil., Calc-f., Calc.
REFERENCES - Thompson.

name: Ferrum Aceticum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ferr-acet. Ferrum aceticum. Iron acetate. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Asthma. Cough. Hemoptysis. Nosebleeds. Tuberculosis. Varicose, veins. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Especially adapted to thin, pale, weak children who grow rapidly and are easily exhausted.
Alkaline urine in acute diseases. Varicose veins of the feet. Pain in right deltoid.
Copious expectoration of greenish pus, asthma. Tuberculosis, constant cough, vomiting of food after eating,
hemoptysis. Nosebleeds. Worse sitting still, or lying down.
REFERENCES - Boericke.
