name: Glonoinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - glon. Glonoinum. Nitroglycerine. Spirits glycerinus nitrate. Dilutions with alcohol. Historical
dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL-Anginapectoris. Aphasia. Brain, congestion. Bright's disease. Colic. Convulsions. Epilepsy. Fright.
Goiter. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hypertension. Mania. Meningitis. Menses, suppression. Migraines.
Neuralgias. Nosebleeds. Palpitations. Paralysis. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Seasickness. Snow-headache.
 Strokes. Sun-headaches. Sunstroke. Toothache. Trauma.
HOMEOPATHIC - Hering said that Sobrero discovered nitroglycerine in 1847, but none could be obtained for
physiological experiment until Morris Davis, after long and laborious trials, and under Hering's own direction,
succeeded in producing the substance in sufficient quantities for a proving.
Nitroglycerine is an explosive substance, therefore its action is quick and violent, a tempestuous remedy. The
signature of this potent explosive may be said to be “bursting” and “expansion.”
The keynote action is the tendency to sudden congestion and violent irregularities of the circulation. Sudden
vascular congestion. Surges of blood. Violent pulsations, ebullitions and irregular congestions. Blood
rushes upwards, to head and heart. Small, wiry pulse, pallor, arterial spasm, anemia of brain.
Collapse, feeble heart, syncope, dicrotic pulse. Affinity for the arteries (Ham., for veins). Stimulates the heart
and circulatory system, usually going to the head and chest producing violent pain. Throbbing and pulsation
in the area. Quick and violent action.
Arterial tension, in chronic interstitial nephritis. Strokes. General pulsations throughout body, often with
numbness. Pulsating pains. Pains that come long after injuries. Burning in small areas or in a single parts.
Congestive headaches, hyperemia of the brain from excess of heat or cold. Bursting and expansion
sensations. Great vertigo on assuming an upright posture from rising up in bed, rising from a seat, etc. Heat
in the head, throbbing headache. Violent convulsions, associated with cerebral congestion.
Extreme irritability, easily excited by the slightest opposition, ending in congestive head symptoms. Intercranial,
menopausal disturbances or due to menstrual suppression. Convulsions, epileptiform from cerebral
congestion or suppressed menses. Eclampsia.
Sciatica in atheromatous subjects with cold shriveled limb. Itching all over body, with later acne and furuncle
formation. Old scars break out again. Clothing seems tight. Seasickness. Bulimia. Ailments from sunstroke or
heat, can't bear heat about the head, the sun, the heat from a stove.
MIND - Confused, bewildered. Mental confusion with dizziness. Confusion on waking, at night, better open
air. Conversation difficult, with confused ideas. Forgetful during headache. Worse mental exhaustion. Great
lassitude, no inclination to work. Disinclined to speak.
Ailments from mental excitement, fright, fear, mechanical injuries and their later consequences. Desires death
during headache. Suicidal, attempts to jump from window during headache.
Shock, sudden attacks of terror. Fear from sensation of swelling of throat. Apprehensive of approaching
death. Fears she has been poisoned. Fear of having a stroke on waking. Shudders and weeps during
intermissions of pain. Frantic with pain, attempts to run away or jump out of a window.
Very irritable. Dwells on past disagreeable occurrences, recalls old grievances. Aversion to husband,
dislikes her own children.
Dare not go out into the street. Sits with head on hands and elbow on knees. Familiar places seemed strange
after headache. Cannot recognize localities. Recognizes nobody. Loses senses, sinks down unconscious.
Delusion house is not in right place, while walking in street after headache. As if in a dream, doesn't know
where he is. Time passes too slowly. Delusion distances are enlarged.
Insanity from long continued heat of sun. Exalted ideas, thinks she is God and everyone her inferior. Unusually
bright and loquacious, with great flow of ideas. Desires room perfectly still, is worse noise. Abdomen -
Rumbling in lower part of the abdomen, principally when lying on left side. Rumbling in hypogastrium. Gallstone
colic. Colic, cutting pain principally below the navel, waking in the morning, before and after loose stools.
Back - Burning heat between the shoulder blades. Hot sensation down back, along the spine. Burning between
scapula. Pain in the whole spinal column or heat andchilli- ness. Stiffness, tightness around the neck, clothing
seems to be too tight. Neck feels weak and tired, cannot support the head.
Sensation of fullness, tension, pulsation. Stiffness of neck during headache.
Breasts - Throbbing pain begins in left breast, darts suddenly to head, worse motion.
Causations - Ill effects of sun, heat, bright snow, fear or fright, and jarring injuries.
Chest - Congestions to chest alternating with congestions to head. Oppression of the chest, alternating with
headache. Heat, rising from chest to face and head. Chest feels screwed together. Constriction. Numbness
moves upwards in chest and down left arm. Sweats on the chest.
Constitutions - Suited to florid, plethoric, sensitive women. Nervous, sanguine, readily affected persons.
Ears - Ears red. Sharp shooting pain behind ears. Throbbing, piercing from within outward in right ear, each
beat of heart is heard in ears, full feeling. Ringing, singing or cracking in the ears. Deafness, paralysis of
auditory nerve. Ears sensitive to jarring. Sensation of fullness in and around the ears. Mastoiditis. Menière's
disease.
Eyes - Eyes sunken, dry. Red, lower eyeballs or lids. Eyes protrude, look wild, upturned or rolled outwards
and upwards in convulsions. Sharp pain, soreness or pressure in eyeballs. Lids stick to ball. Photophobia.
 Pupils dilated, eyes rolled upward and outward. Pupils contracted in sunstroke.
Face - Redness of face, which comes and goes. Flushed face alternating with pale. Flushed, hot face.
Dusky face. Face bluish. Faceache with twitching of facial muscles. Pain at the root of the nose. Neuralgia of
face with pulsating pains. Chin feels too long. Trigeminal neuralgia, left side of face. Periodical attacks of facial
neuralgia. Lower lip feels swollen or numb. Jaws clenched in sunstroke. Pain in malar bones, ending in
headache. Veins of temples swollen. Cold sweat on face during congestion to head. Sweat on face.
Female - Delayed menses. Sudden cessation of menses with congestion to head and chest, with
headache and fainting. Menses scanty. Menses with lumbar pain. Headaches after profuse menses. Since
menarche, congestion to head, with loss of consciousness. Menopausal flushing. During pregnancy,
headache, congestions of blood to the head and chest. Eclampsia, unconscious, face bright-red, puffed, pulse
full, hard, urine copious and albuminous.
Food - Loss of appetite. Abnormal hunger. Wants cold water, dry parched feeling. Increased desire to smoke.
Alcoholic stimulants cause delirium, congestion, stupor, sleepiness and subsequent depression. Wine
aggravates all symptoms.
Head - Rush of blood to head. Cerebral congestion. Throbbing and bursting headache. Sudden, violent
congestion to head, throbbing felt with every pulse, at every step. As if blood were surging back and forth.
Waves of terrible, pounding pain. Cracking, snapping, shocks, explosions or soreness deep in brain. Head
heavy, but cannot lay it on pillow. Headache, before, during, after, or in place of menses. Headache with
nausea. Shocks in head, synchronous with pulse. Headache better from sleep. Holds the head tightly. Throb-
bingin temples, worse walking. Veins of temples distended. Neuralgia of head and face. Head feels large,
as if skull were too small for brain. Headache with protrusion of eyeballs. As if standing on the head with
expanding and contracting sensation. Headache and pulse increase and diminish together. Threatened
strokes. Meningitis. Cri encéphalique. Knocks head against wall, during frightful bursting headache. Sun
headache, increases and decreases with the sun. Sunstroke. Effects of sunstroke, heat on head, as in type-
setters and workers under gas and electric light. Headache from injury to spine.
Heart - Angina pectoris. Anxiety in précordia. Cardiac pain radiates to all parts. Heart pain, worse from wine.
Sharp pain in heart on stooping. Laborious action. Violent palpitations with throbbing carotids. Palpitations
with dyspnea with heat in face. Heart seems full, quivers. Boiling sensation in the region. Fluttering of heart.
Pressure in heart as if it was being contracted. High blood pressure
and headaches. Throbbing in the whole body to the fingertips. Purring noise at the region of the heart. Any
exertion brings on rush of blood to heart and fainting spells. Cannot go uphill because of heart pain. Full,
tense pulse. Venous pulse. Pulse rapid when walking. Pulse rapidduring headache. Pulse rises and falls
alternately. Pulse low and feeble in sunstroke.
Kidneys - Acute and chronic interstitial nephritis with high bloodpressure. Tubal nephritis with headache,
brought on by walking in sun, numbness in arms and hands alternating with intense tingling. Profuse pale,
albuminous urine, more frequent at night. Increased secretion of pale urine, has to rise frequently during the
night. Urine high-colored, burning while passing. Red sediment and muddy, reddish-yellow slime.
Limbs - Itching all over, worse limbs. Drawing pain in all limbs. Limbs feel bloated. Weak and tremulous feeling
in limbs. Numbness in left limbs. Sciatica better flexing legs on abdomen. Unsteady gait. Knees give way.
Thighs and knees weak and knock together during headache. Pain in left biceps. Trembling hands. Fingers
and toes spread apart during convulsions.
Lungs - Heavy, labored breathing. Desire to take a long, deep inspiration. Sighing. Numbness moves upwards
in chest and down left arm. Oppression of chest alternating with headache. As if a load on chest. Frequent,
expectoration of thick mucus.
Modalities - Better from open air. Better cold things, cold application. Better elevating head. Better lying still
(opposite Bell.). Worse bending head backward. Worse stooping. Worse left side. Worse motion,
shakingjarring. Worse stimulants, wine. Worse fruits, peaches. Worse gaslight. Worse cutting hair. Worse
weight of hat. Worse suppressed menses. Worse lying down. Worse from 6 a.m. to noon. Worse in sun.
Worse open fire. Worse heat on head. Worse becoming overheated. Worse hot weather. Worse from injury.
Mouth - Saliva increased, thick in a.m. Froth at mouth. Bitter taste with nausea. Aromatic, sweet, warm things,
leave a fatty taste. Lower lip feels swollen. Throbbing pain in teeth, teeth feel elongated. Pulsating toothache.
Itching of soft palate and throat. Hard palate sensitive as if swollen.
Nose - Nosebleeds on going out into the heat of the sun, face flushed, hot, red. Pain at root of nose. The
headache extends into the nose. Sudden sneezing, fluent coryza.
Pains - Bursting, throbbing, pulsative, tearing, piercing, stabbing, gnawing. Sensation of fullness.
Perspiration - Perspiration, principally in the face, after sleeping. Perspiration on forehead. Profuse sweat,
mostly on face and chest. Sweats principally on face, after sleeping. Sweats on hands. Perspiration relieves
 the nausea. Sweats alternates with chilliness. Feeling as if sweat would break out all over. Cold sweat on face,
during congestion to head.
Rectum - Constipation with itching, painful hemorrhoids, with pinching in abdomen before and after stool.
Diarrhea, copious black, lumpy stools. Diarrhea with sudden stoppage of menses. Morning diarrhea with sharp
burning with rumbling. Diarrhea evening and night after eating peaches. Stools, loose, scanty, with much
rumbling. Diarrhoeic stools with rumbling and discharge of flatus. Frequent passage of flatus during stools,
with a loud, sharp noise.
Sensations - Brain as if expanding, as if moving in waves, as if hanging with head downwards, as if something
were pumped into vertex, as if everything were crowded out at forehead. Sensation as if warm water were
running upwards from nape of neck. As if the neck were held by a hand. Sensation as if some one were pulling
eyes from within outward. Noise in left ear as if it came from heart. As if heart would rise to throat. Sensation
as if chin feels too long.
Skin - Itching all over, the limbs. Old scars break out again.
Sleep - Weakness as from loss of sleep. Yawning with the headache, congestion of blood to the head.
Sleepiness early in the evening. Difficult to waken. Awakes with fear of having a stroke. Confused dreams.
Dreams of homesickness. Dreams with tears.
Stomach - Gastralgia in anemic patients with feeble circulation. Faint, gnawing and empty feeling at pit of
stomach. Stomach pain in anemic patients with feeble circulation. Horrible faint feeling at the pit of stomach
with throbbing. Rumbling in hypogastrium, worse lying on left side. Nausea with faint feeling. Nausea and
vomiting in brain congestions or during sunstroke. Spasmodic vomiting in hydrocephalus. Seasickness.
Teeth - Gums swollen and sensitive to touch. Teeth feel elongated. Throbbing pain in the teeth. Pulsating
toothache with headache. Toothache from taking cold, after having been overheated. Stabbing pains in gums
right side passing to left, worse from hot, better from cold applications. Toothache after hitting, in chewing a
hard substance, a bad tooth. Teeth decay after mercury.
Temperature - Chill after getting heated, alternates with sweat, vomiting. Intermittent fever. Fever with hot
sweat. Heat in face, ascending from pit of stomach to head. Heat flushes. General warmth, flushes of heat,
waves of heat upward.
Throat - Throat feels full. Sensation as if the throat were swelling. As if string were tied around neck, which
prevented blood from returning to head. Collar must be opened. Chokes and swells up under ear. The soft
palate feels contracted and dry. Itching of the soft palate and throat. In the throat tickling, heat, soreness.
Tongue - Tongue is milk-white without coating. Tongue coated heavily at back. Tongue, heavy, cannot
protrude straight. Tongue numb. Tongue as if burnt. Tongue prickling, smarting, and stinging. Tongue feels
swollen and raw with spasmodic twitchings.
Vertigo - Vertigo on assuming upright position. Vertigo with confusion. Vertigo, worse from stooping or
moving head.
Vertigo in open air. Vertigo with nausea. Vertigo with dim vision. Vertigo with black spots before eyes. Vertigo
with headache. Vertigo with nausea. Vertigo in sunstroke. Vertigo after a head injury.
Vision - Dim vision during vertigo. Impaired vision during raging headache. Letters appear smaller. Sparks
before eyes. Spells of blindness. Black spots, during headache, when turning quickly. Black specks, sparks,
flashes, before eyes. Objects dance with every pulsation. Black floating spots on attempting to stoop.
COMMENTS - Guernsey recorded that Glon. is suited to troubles of the head in type-setters and in men who
work under a gaslight steadily, so that the heat falls on the head.
Severe, painful palpitations and sudden rushes of blood to the head with a threatened stroke. Palpitations with
trembling limbs. Heart attack (Aeon.). High blood pressure. Panic attacks when the blood rushes to the head,
can get painful palpitations and a fear of having a heart attack. Cardiac neuralgia (angina pectoris) with
radiating pains.
Vascular headache, with pounding, throbbing and a red face. Violent action of the heart, rush of blood to the
head. Vascular headaches due to high blood pressure with flushed face, dilated pupils, palpitated heart.
Bursting and throbbing headaches. Worse light touch to the head.
Sensation of waves in the blood with headache. Headaches ever since heat stroke or from exposure to the
sun. Sense of constriction in the throat with headache, throbbing carotid arteries. Headaches after having hair
cut (Bell.). Meningitis. Nausea and vomiting of cerebral origin.
Great sensitivity to the least motion. Will carry his head very carefully in order to avoid any motion (Bry.). The
headache is in the whole head, worse with exposure to the sun, better with pressure.
Pains appear in occiput and at the base of the brain. Gnawing in occiput, sore pain, pressure, severe pain
extending to the eyes and temples. Pains move from within outward, from front to back. Sensation of expanding
in head and body.
 Sensation as if something were moving in the nerves from the back of the neck upward to the head. The eyes
may be fixed or protrude. Aversion to bright light, black spots before sight. Both hands and feet are cold.
Flushes of heat rising from the chest to the head, then throbbing pain in head (Bell.). Heat stroke. For ailments
from working under strong lights or the sun. Faint from hot place.
Neuralgias are accompanied with throbbing, often worse at night, preventing sleep. Supra-orbital neuralgia,
pulsating, retinal congestion from exposure to strong light. Facial neuralgia, extending through head. Violent,
stabbing, neuralgic pains, so violent as to make patient frantic, he wants to escape to jump out of window.
Menopausal disturbances. Hot flashes with pulsation, heat, severe palpitation with wave sensation resulting in
headaches. Face is flushed or pale. Fainting, sudden unconsciousness, convulsions, especially during labor.
Horrible apprehension, fear of being poisoned. Ailments from fear. Loss of a sense of location. Bad effects of
having hair cut, of exposure to heat from the sun or fire. Ailments from too much riding or driving, seasickness.
Sensitive to alcohol (Zinc). Cannot bear weight of hair, clothing seems too tight.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Aeon. Camph., Coff., Nux-v. Compare: ( 1 ) Op., Stram.. Verat- v. (2) Amyl-n.
(3) Cimic. - waving in brain. (4) Petr, and Crot-h. - loss of location. (5) Bell. - cephalic cry but not as marked in
Bell., also Bell, has better bending head back and better covering head. (6) Glon. - better uncovered, Apis.
(7)Hyos. -fearsbeingpoisoned. (8)Gels. - inclination tojump out of window. (9) Stram., Sang. - headache with
the sun, ear sensitive to jar. ( 10) Nit-ac. and Bell. - sensitiveness to jar. (11) Meli. - headache with crimson
face. (12) Lyc. and Phos. - burning between shoulders. (13) Dig. and Dios. - headache extending into nose.
(14) Sec. - fingers spread apart.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Glycerinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - glyc. Glycerinum. Glycerine. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies. Pure glycerine in
teaspoonful doses, 3 times a day with lemon juice for pernicious anemia.
CLINICAL - Carbuncle. Diabetes. Influenza. Pneumonia. Pernicious anemia. Rheumatic pains. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Glycerine is a liquid obtained by the decomposition of vegetable or animal fats or fixed oils,
containing not less than 95 percent of absolute glycerol, a triatomic alcohol existing in fats and fixed oils in
combination with the fatty acids.
Dr. Wm. B. Griggs noted that potentized glycerine seems to act deeply and long, building up tissue, hence of
great use in marasmus, mental and physical debility, diabetes, etc. It disturbs nutrition in its primary action
and, secondarily, seems to improve the general state of nutrition. Builds tissue. Seems to affect most of the
organs and tissues of the body.
General sense of exhaustion. Neurasthenia. Headache with a sense of fullness in the head and throbbing,
aggravated by motion. Dullness of the mind, a sense of mental and physical weakness, restless sleep and
dreaming, much physical languor, almost to a state of utter prostration.
Balances the general metabolism. Loss of appetite, constipation, profuse urination with traces of sugar. Gastro-
intestinal disease. Senile debility. Acute catarrhal conditions of the mucus membrane of the naso-pharynx and
nephritis in the aged. Influenza, pneumonia.
Chest - Chest seems full.
Female - Profuse, long-lasting flow, with bearing down heaviness in uterus.
Head - Feels full, throbs, especially occiput. Mentally confused. Severe headache two days before
menstruation.
Kidneys - Profuse and frequent urination. Increased specific gravity and sugar. Diabetes.
Limbs - Rheumatic pains of aremittent type. Feet painful and hot, feel enlarged.
Lungs - Hacking cough with sense of weakness. Influenza pneumonia.
Nose - Stopped up, sneezing, irritating coryza. Sensation of crawling on mucus membrane. Post-nasal
dripping.
Stomach - Fermentation, burning in stomach and esophagus.
COMMENTS - Anshutz reported three cases. The first concerned a homeopathic physician in Philadelphia,
aged 61 years. He was refused insurance on account of albumen casts and sugar in urine, and had been
under his own care for months.
He developed a severe infection on his neck, six inches in diameter, a carbuncle was operated on by Dr.
Herbert S. Leopold very successfully. He had extreme nervousness, profuse urination with a specific gravity
of 1.030. Sugar, etc. in urine examined by a Philadelphia chemist, extreme debility, prostration, etc. Glyc. in
30c and 200c eliminated sugar and albumin in three months and the patient gained fifteen pounds.
The second case concerned Mr. S., baker, age 66 years. Diabetes for years, weakness, dyspnea, headache,
 urine with sugar, acetone, great debility. No albumin or casts. He was placed on strict diet and given Sulph.,
Ph-ac., Uran-n., Ars., Syzyg. and potentized blood. Glyc. was then given with the result that the urine cleared
up, a good appetite developed and after a period of two years sexual vigor returned.
Finally, the third case was C. H., a baby two years old. Drs. Yeager and Macfarlan assisted in the case.
Influenza pneumonia. Profuse coryza and dyspnea. Consolidation in both lungs, weakness and debility after
twelve days. Glyc. 200c was given and a complete recovery ensued with improvement at once.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lac-ac., Lee. Gels., Calc.
REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke.

name: Glycyrrhiza Glabra
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - glyc-g. Glycyrrhiza glabra. Licorice root. Liquiritia officinalis. Sweetwort. Europe and Asia. N.
O. Leguminosae. Papilionoideae. Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Addison's disease. Allergies. Athlete's foot. Arthritis. Asthma. Baldness. Bronchitis. Bursitis.
Canker sores. Catarrh. Chronic fatigue. Colds. Coughs. Dandruff. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Emphysema. Gastri-
tis. Gingivitis. Gout. Fungal, infections. Heartburn. Herpes. Hoarseness. Indigestion. Influenza. Liver
problems. Lyme disease. Menopause. Mouth, ulcers. Peptic ulcers. Prostate, enlargement. Psoriasis.
Shingles. Stomach, ulcers. Sore throat. Tendonitis. Tooth, decay. Tuberculosis. Ulcers. Viral, infections.
Yeast, infections.
HERBAL - Liquorice his one of the most commonly used herbs in herbal medicine and has a very long history
of use, both as a medicine and also as a flavoring to disguise the unpleasant flavor of other medications.
Liquorice was known to the ancients as far back as the third century B. C. for its efficacy in the case of dry
coughs. The Greeks, recommended it for the treatment of gastric and peptic ulcers. Later, Arab physicians
used Licorice to relieve coughs and side effects associated with laxatives.
It is a very sweet, moist, soothing herb that detoxifies and protects the liver and is also powerfully anti-
inflammatory, being used in conditions as varied as arthritis and mouth ulcers.
The root is alterative, antispasmodic, demulcent, diuretic, emollient, expectorant, laxative, moderately pectoral
and tonic. The root has also been shown to have a hormonal effect similar to the ovarian hormones.
Liquorice root is much used in cough medicines and also in the treatment of catarrhal infections of the urinary
tract. It is taken internally in the treatment of Addison's disease, asthma, bronchitis, coughs, peptic ulcer,
arthritis, allergic complaints. Exter
nally, the root is used in the treatment of psoriasis, herpes, eczema and shingles.
Licorice root has an impressive list of well documented uses and is probably one of the most over-looked of
all herbal remedies.
It is used for many ailments including asthma, athlete's foot, baldness, body odor, bursitis, canker sores.
Chronic fatigue, depression. Colds, coughs and influenza. Dandruff. Emphysema. Gingivitis and tooth
decay. Gout. Heartburn. Viral infections. Fungal infections. Ulcers. Liver problems, Lyme disease. Menopause.
Psoriasis. Shingles. Sore throats. Tendonitis. Tuberculosis. Yeast infections. Prostate enlargement. Arthritis.
Other uses of the plant include the treatment of hormone imbalances and menopausal symptoms in women.
RELATIONS - Compare: Ulmus fuva, Melaleuca alternifolia.
REFERENCES Murphy.

name: Gnaphalium Polycephalum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - gnaph. Gnaphalium polyceph- alum. Cud-weed. Old balsam. Gnaphalium dioica. Gnaphalium
uliginosum. Sweet- scented everlasting flower. N. O. Composite. Tincture of fresh plant. Historical dose:
Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Anterior crural neuralgia. Chills. Cholera. Cholera, infantum. Colic. Diarrhea. Dysmenorrhea.
Gout. Lumbago. Neuralgia. Night-sweats. Numbness. Polyuria. Prostate gland. Rheumatism. Sciatica.
HOMEOPATHIC - Gnaph. has been used mainly in disorders of the sciatic nerve, but it also has an action
on the abdominal organs, causing vomiting, colic and diarrhea, thus comparing with Coloc. in both spheres.
Sciatica and lumbago with numbness alternating with the pain. Intense sciatic pain (Mag-p., Rhus-t., Coloc.,
Hyper.), alternating with or followed by numbness. Lumbago with numbness of part. Rheumatism. Anterior
crural neuralgia.
Pain in joints as if they lacked oil. Pain worse lying down, motion, stepping, by sitting in a chair, better by flexing
the limbs on abdomen (Colo.). Sticking pain and numbness. Sharp, shooting pains, or electric-like sensation
down the backs of the legs.
 Offensive diarrhea with colic, worse in the morning. Polyuria. Weight and heaviness in the pelvis.
Dysmenorrhea with scanty menses, very painful during the first day.
MIND - Very irritable for two or three days after the diarrhea.
Abdomen - Colic, pain in various parts of the abdomen. Cecum is sensitive. Borbo- rygmus with emission of
much flatus.
Back - Chronic backache in lumbar region, better resting on back. Lumbago with numbness in lower part of
back and weight in pelvis.
Face - Intermittent pains of superior maxillary of both sides. Dull, heavy, bloated appearance. Neuralgic pain
of an intermittent from in both upper maxillary bones.
Female - Dysmenorrhea with scanty and painful menses. Sensation of weight in pelvis. Sensation of fullness
in pelvis.
Kidneys - Pains in kidneys with frequent slight pain in prostate gland. Sensation of pain and fullness in bladder,
even when just emptied.
Limbs - Rheumatic pain in ankle joints and legs. Intense pain along the sciatic nerve, numbness alternates
with pain. Feeling of weakness, as if incapable of raising the slightest weight. Rheumatic pains in elbows and
shoulders. Frequent pains in calves and feet. Cramps in calves of legs and feet when in bed. Gouty pains in
big toes. Gouty concretions. Anterior crural neuralgia (Staph.). Chronic muscular rheumatism of back and
neck. Pain in joints as if they lacked oil. Better drawing limbs up, flexing thigh on abdomen.
Male - Irritation of prostate gland. Increased sexual passion.
Modalities - Better from flexing limbs. Better sitting in a chair. Worse from walking. Worse lying. Worse cold
damp.
Mouth - Mouth feels parched and tastes badly. Flat, sweetish, sickening taste. Tongue covered with long white
fur, better
by thorough washing with cold water.
Rectum - First stage of cholera infantum, vomiting and purging. Rumbling in bowels with stool before breakfast.
Looseness of bowels with passage of pale-colored feces. Diarrhea discharge in morning and during day with
irritable temper. Dark-colored, liquid offensive stool in morning afterwards pain in bowels all day, in children.
Stomach - Vomiting and purging like cholera morbus in the night and all next day. Flatus, windy belchings,
nausea and hiccough.
Vertigo - Giddy, especially afterrising from recumbent position.
COMMENTS - Cramps i n cal ves and back of thighs, hamstrings. Sciatica pain in worse on lying down, by
motion, by stepping, better when sitting in a chair, better drawing up the limb.
Diarrhea is watery and offensive, occurs in the morning and is repeated during the day. Rumbling in the bowels,
colicky pains and the patient is cross and irritable. Urine is scanty. Appetite and taste are lost.
Dr. W. McGeorge recorded that Gnaph. has a reputation for colds, fevers and night-sweats. The last was
caused in one of the provers. It cured one case of chills. The periodicity appears in the intermittent neuralgia
of the upper jaws.
McGeorge noted a sense of “weight and fullness in the pelvis” for dysmenorrhea. Dysmenorrhea when the
menses are scanty and very painful during the first day.
Sexual excitement in male provers, pain and irritation in the prostate gland. Headache better by washing in
cold water. Fur on tongue removed by thorough washing with cold water.
McGeorge cured a very aggravated case of sciatica in a man, resulting from a strain. The left leg was cramped
and drawn up, worse in cold and damp weather.
Dr. George Shelton recorded two cases. The first, a clergyman, 27, had sharp cutting pains, starting from inner
side right thigh, just below Poupart's ligament, extending down course of anterior crural nerve to a
GnaphaKum polycephalum point about its lower third.
The pains were paroxysmal, came on when walking, occasionally when lying down. He had one or two attacks
in the pulpit. In several instances the pain had extended down the right cord into the testicle and caused him
to draw up the leg, flexing the thigh on the abdomen. This condition was also present in Dr. McGeorge's case.
A few doses of Gnaph. 1c cured him completely.
The second case occurred in a widow, 68, who had severe pains in the outer side of her right thigh for six
years, part of which she had been confined to bed. The pains were paroxysmal, cutting, tearing, extending
down the course of the sciatic nerve.
Attacks were worse at night and more frequent, causing her to roll about the bed and cry out with the pain. All
the resources of allopathy had been in vain. Rhus-t., Coloc., Sulph., gave no help. Bell, relieved slightly. Gnaph.
1c wrought gradual improvement, and in eight weeks the cure was complete.
Clarke had acase, cured with Gnaph. 30c., of a very gouty man, with the alternation of numbness with pain.
 RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Xanth., Cham., Coloc., Ip., Merc., Puls., Lyc., Caul.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Gorse
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - gors-b. Gorse. Ulex euro- paeus. Flowers from the bush are placed in a bowl of water and
allowed to stand in the sun for several hours. The strained water is used as medicine. Historical dose: Take
two drops from the stock bottle into a one ounce dropper bottle, (add brandy or alcohol, if this bottle will be
used for days or weeks). This is the dosage bottle, take a few drops straight into the mouth or as needed in a
little water or juice.
HOMEOPATHIC - This remedy belongs to Bach's group For Those who Suffer Uncertainty, along with Cer-
b„ Scler-b., Gent-b., Hom-b. and Wld-o-b. Forthose suffering from doubt, hopelessness, uncertainty and lack
of clarity of purpose in daily affairs.
Gorse
Will raise spirits in cases of true hopelessness, such as terminal illness. Lowered vitality and sinking of strength.
Sense of resignation to a hopeless situation.
MIND - Deep-hopelessness (Aur.). Calm, with underlying sadness and a sense of misfortune and suffering.
Denial and recurring disappointment. Negativity. Uncertainty about the future.
REFERENCES - Bach.

name: Gossypium Herbaceum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - goss. Gossypium herbaceum. Cotton plant. N. O. Malvaceae. Tincture of fresh inner root bark,
chopped and pounded to a pulp. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Chills. Dysmenorrhea. Fibroids. Infertility. Labia, abscess. Miscarriage. Morning
sickness. Nausea. Ovaries, pains. Pregnancy, vomiting. Retained, placenta. Tumor. Uterus, bearing down.
HERBAL - In herbal practice, Gossypium was used as a powerful emmenagogue.
HOMEOPATHIC - Goss, has been mainly used in affection of the female generative organs. It has been taken
in the form of the extract stimulate the uterus and ovaries.
Nausea with flow of saliva and inclination to vomit in the morning, before breakfast with sensitive uterine region.
Sensitive stomach with much gas. Vomits on motion or raising up. Morning sickness of pregnancy.
Hyperemesis.
Menses, late, scanty, watery. Tardy menses, with sensation that the flow is about to start and yet does not.
Bearing down pains in the uterus. ’Intermittent pains in the ovaries,” extending towards uterus. Sterility from
uterine torpor. Sensitive womb. Subinvolution. Fibroids. Tumors in breast with swelling of axillary glands.
Pain in neck. Sympathetic symptoms of stomach, heart, bowels and nervous system ari sing from disturbance
of uterine functions. Stinging, drawing, tearing and sometimes burning pains.
Pains extend from one place to another, jumping from one place to another. Move from above downward.
Abdomen - Sharp pain in right hypochondrium, lasting for a few minutes. Drawing pain from both
hypochondriac regions extending to stomach.
Back - Pain in back. Pain in cervical region with tendency for head to draw backward, with nervousness.
Backache, weight and dragging pain in pelvis.
Breasts - Tumor of the breast with swelling of axillary glands.
Constitution - Tall, anemic patients with nervous chills.
Eyes - Drawing pain over eyes with stinging pain in pupils.
Female - Labia swollen and itching. Suppressed menstruation. Menses too watery. Backache, weight and
dragging in pelvis. Intermittent pain in ovaries. Uterine subinvolution and fibroids with gastric pain and
debility. Retained placenta. Morning sickness with sensitive uterine region.
Food - Anorexia with uneasy, depressed feeling at scrobiculum cordis at time of menses.
Head - Pain in cervical region with tendency for head to draw backward with nervousness. Pain, first burning,
then stinging, extending from both temporal bones to middle of frontal bone.
Kidneys - Frequent desire to urinate with burning pains.
Limbs - Heavy feeling in both hands, better hanging them down, worse in warmth of bed.
Modalities - Pains are generally worse by motion, better by rest.
Nose - Nostrils swollen and inflamed.
Sleep - Caused her to sleep a great part of the time.
Stomach - Nausea with accumulation of saliva in mouth inclination to vomit before breakfast. Rotating pain in
 pit of stomach.
Temperature - General external chilliness, with internal heat.
Throat - Tonsils swollen, worse right side.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Action similar to Ergot when made from fresh green root. (2) Lil-t., Sabin.,
Cimic., Apis. Asar., Bell., Bry., Puls., Sec., Sep., Ust.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Granatum Pomegranate
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - gran. Granatum pomegranate. Pomegranate. Púnica granatum. N. O. Grana- tee. Lythraceae.
Homeopathic provings were made with a tincture or trituration of bark of root. Historicaldose: Trituration,
tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Ascarides. Emaciation. Gastralgia. Heart, weakness. Hernia. Jaw, cracking. Nausea. Tapeworm.
Toothache. Salivation. Vertigo. Worms.
HERBAL - Pomegranate is a well-known vermifuge, especially used for the expulsion of tinea. For this a
decoction of the rind of the fruit is used in the following manner: An alkaloid, Pelletierine, discovered by
Bertrand Pelletier, is obtained from the rind of the fruit.
After a mild purge the previous night in the morning, 30 grams of Sulphate of Pelletierine is administered in a
solution containing 50 grams of tannic acid. This is followed by a glass of water in ten minutes and a brisk
purge in half an hour.
Granatum is used as a vermifuge for the expulsion of tapeworm. Salivation with nausea and vertigo. Spasm
of the glottis.
HOMEOPATHIC - The provings bring out many symptoms of helminthiasis, including pale blue rings around
eyes, and itching, crawling and tickling of the nose. Ravenous hunger, craving for sourorjuicy things, fruit,
coffee. Loss of appetite. Emaciation.
Swelling of navel. Nausea, fermenting in abdomen, griping, dragging in inguinal region as if hernia would
protrude. Itching and tickling in anus frequently during the day. Discomfort. Great weariness and exhaustion,
scarcely able to keep upright.
Trembling. Convulsive movements. Itching of the skin of various places, face and body, as if pimples would
break out.
Biting and itching in palms of hands. Yawning. Great sensitiveness.
MIND - Great sensitiveness and impressibility. Fear, dread of work during headache. Confusion of mind after
a carousal. Stupefaction and intellectual embarrassment. Hypochondriacal.
Dejection and discouragement. Quarrelsome humor. Melancholy, gloomy temper. Irritability and arrogance.
Censorious. Reproaches others.
Abdomen - Pain in stomach and abdomen, worse about umbilicus (Cocc., Nux-m., Plum.). Ineffectual
urging. Dragging in vaginal region, as if hernia would protrude. Swelling resembling umbilical hernia.
Back - Pain between shoulders, even clothing is oppressive. Pain around shoulders, as if heavy load had been
carried.
Chest - Oppressed with sighing. Pain between shoulders, even clothing is oppressive.
Eyes - Sunken eyes, pupils dilated, weak sight.
Food - Ravenous hunger, craving for sour or juicy things, fruit, coffee. Loss of appetite. Great thirst for water.
Head - Feels empty. Stupefying pain and painful heaviness in the head, forehead. Pressure on the forehead
and the occiput. Acute drawing pains chiefly on right side of head shooting in forehead.
Limbs - Pain around shoulders, as if heavy load had been carried. Pain in all finger joints. Tearing pain in knee
joint. Convulsive movements.
Modalities - Better after dinner. Pain in abdomen is better after drinking cold water.
Rectum - Burning, itching in the anus, on the buttocks and perineum, scrotum and thighs. Diarrhea with
frequent stools. Evacuation of fecal matter and mucus. Pressure in rectum afterwards. Burning heat in rectum.
Prolapsed rectum during the stool. Shooting pains in anus and rectum.
Skin - Itching in the palms. Sensation as if pimples would break out. Jaundiced complexion.
Stomach - Constant hunger. Poor digestion. Loses flesh. Vomiting at night.
Vertigo - Vertigo very persistent. Vertigo during intellectual labor or in the morning on rising. Vertigo with
obscuration of the eyes. Vertigo with nausea and aching in the stomach.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Pelletierine - one of its constituents - an anthelmintic, especially for tapeworm.
(2) Cina, Kou. Ars., lod., Teucr., Cue.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
 ***GRAPHITES NATURALIS
(Black Lead)
PHARMACY - graph. Graphites naturalis. Black lead. Plumbago. Trituration of prepared from finest English
drawing-pencils. A modification of carbon. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies. Locally as a cerate
in sore nipples.
CLINICAL - Acne. Amenorrhea. Anus, disorders. Blepharitis. Breasts, cancer. Breasts, indurated. Cancer.
Catarrh. Chaps. Chlorosis. Colic. Constipation. Deafness. Dropsy. Dysmenorrhea. Ears, disorders. Eczema.
Erysipelas. Eye, disorders. Face. Erythema. Feet, disorders. Fissures. Gastro-intestinal disorders.
Glandular, swellings. Gleet. Gravel. Headaches. Hemorrhoid. Herpes. Hydrocele. Indurations. Influenza.
Irritation. Lachrymal duct, inflamed. Leucorrhea. Lips, cracked. Liver, indurated. Menstruation, disorders.
Leucorrhea. Nails, disorders. Noises, head. Nose, disorders. Nosebleeds. Obesity. Ovarian, tumors.
Palpitations. Paralysis. Parotiditis. Pityriasis. Priapism. Pruritus, vagina. Psoriasis. Ptosis. Rectum,
disorders. Rhus, poisoning. Scars. Scrofula. Seminal, emission. Skin, disorders. Smell, disorders. Stomach,
cramps. Stomach, pain. Sycotic, diathesis. Syphilis. Trichinosis. Tumors. Ulcers. Urine, disordered. Uterus,
cancer. Vaccination, effects. Wens. Whooping, cough. Worms.
HOMEOPATHIC - Graphites is a mineral carbon, related to Carb-an. and Carb-v. It contains a small
percentage of iron, and so is also related to Ferr. Weinhold first thought of using this substance as a drug. He
was led to it by seeing workmen in a mirror-factory use it as a local application for tetters. Ruggeri followed
him, using it both internally and locally.
Tendency to produce excoriations, cracks or fissures, at muco-cutaneous junction of eyes, nostrils, mouth,
anus, nipples, fingertips, folds of skin. Mucus membranes are cracked and fissured and have scanty secre-
tions. Excoriations between toes.
Thickening and induration of skin, glands, tarsi, nail, scars. Thick crusts on the skin. Tendency to callosities.
Aids the absorption of scar tissue (Thiosin.). Cancerous diathesis in old scars. Recrudescence of scars.
Syphilitic and constitutional ulcers. Tendency to grow cystic tumors, wens. Eradicates tendency to
erysipelas.
Watery hemorrhages. Dropsy. Edema. Paralysis or sensation of paralysis. Contractions of muscles. Cramps
and burning in different places. Offensive discharges and secretions. Discharges are, thin, foul, scanty and
acrid. Sweat stains are yellow, sour, offensive. Gushing leucorrhea. Swollen genitals.
Alternating digestive and skin symptoms. Gastro-intestinal disorders alternating with acne and erythema
of face, herpetic lesions or scrofulous hypochondriasis. Sourness of taste, belchings, stools, urine, blood about
teeth etc.
Frequently feels faint with partial loss of senses. Sensitive to cold. Cold aggravates bone pains, coryza and
stomach. Emanation of suffering parts. Sensation of burning, numbness and deadness. Pains go to parts not
lain on. General sense of uneasiness, tremulousness, which elicits groans. Sudden sinking of strength.
Cancer of pylorus. Duodenal ulcer. Infiltrations. Weakness, then a relaxed condition, anemia, and chlorosis.
Lymphatic glands are swollen. Take colds easily. Anemia with redness of face. Tendency to obesity.
MIND - Mentally sluggish, poor memory. Forgetful, makes mistakes in speaking and writing. Remembers all
the events of youth, recent events are forgotten. Fatigue from scientific labor. Dread of work.
Fidgety while sitting at work. Energized from work, followed by apathy, anxiety. Very irritable and fretful.
Obstinate and moody. Miserable and unhappy. Impulse to groan. Insolent. Offended easily. Periodic
depressions. Anxiety about spiritual welfare. Full of fear in morning.
Ailments from grief or fright. Sad, fearsome, irresolute, hesitates at trifles. Grief about slightest occurrences.
Internal grief and despair. Despair over trifles. Thinks of nothing but death.
Weepingameliorates symptoms. Weeping alternating with irritability and laughter at trifles. Weeps without
cause. Weepingfrom music. Weeping during menses.
Apprehensive, despondent. Fearofinsanity. Fears are better after weeping. Great tendency to start. Anxiety
in morning on waking. Excitement at night. Intense restlessness, which drives him out of bed at night.
Anxiety better warmth. Restlessness better walking in open air.
Persistent thoughts, haunted by unpleasant subjects, better walking in open air. Restlessness while working.
Dwells upon past disagreeable occurrences at night.
Slowness of purpose. Dullness in morning. Dullness after a siesta. Inability to think from weakness in
brain. Indolence, better open air. Feels indifferent to everybody and everything, from exhaustion.
Absent-minded. Unable to decide. Timid. Child impudent, teasing, laughing at reprimands. Anguish before
menses. Cataleptic conditions, consciousness but without the power to move or speak.
Abdomen - Abdomen distended, as from incarcerated flatus. Cannot bear tight clothes around the waist.
 Flatulence. Very fetid gas preceded by colic. Pain of gas opposite the side on which he lies. Intestinal torpor.
Pain as if intestines were torn. Nauseous feeling in abdomen. Cramp like pain in abdomen with deficient
secretion of urine, at night. Inguinal region
sensitive, swollen.
Back - Spinal pains. Pain in small of back with great weakness. Pain in the nape of neck and shoulders, worse
looking up and stooping the head. Sacral pains with crawling. Painless swollen glands on side of neck.
Numbness of sacrum, down the legs. Pain in the lumbar region as if vertebrae were broken.
Breasts - Induration of breasts and ovaries. Breasts swollen and hard. Cracks in nipples. Breast cancer from
old scars, remaining after mammary abscess. Nipples, sore, cracked and blistered.
Causations - Ill effects of grief, fear, over lifting, surgery.
Chest - Constriction of chest, as if too narrow. Feels as if about to suffocate when falling asleep, jumps out of
bed, takes hold of something and must eat something, worse after midnight. Cramps in the chest. Pain in
middle of chest with cough, scraping and soreness.
Constitutions - Suited to persons who have a tendency to put on unhealthy fat. Fat, relaxed, chilly and costive.
Defective animal heat from defective oxygenation, always cold indoors or out. Chlorotics. Affections of glands,
skin and mucus membranes, especially at orifices. Syphilitic and “constitutional” ulcers.
Coughs - Dry cough, troublesome with sweat on face. Cough at night, caused by deep inspiration. Loose
cough from tickling deep in chest. Cough with strangling, red face, watery eyes, straining all over. Fatiguing
cough, before and during menses.
Ears - Moisture and eruptions, fissures in and behind the ear. Thin, white scaly membrane covering the
eardrum. Eczema behind the ears. Briny otorrhea. As if hard body behind ear. Cracks andfissures behind
the ears. Feel stuffed at full moon. As if air inside, as if filled with water. Dryness of inner ear. Snapping after
every eructation. Hardness of hearing. Hears better in noise. Tinnitus. Hissing in the ears. Detonation in ear
like report of agun. Cracking in ears when eating.
Eyes - Recurrent keratitis. Blepharitis. Ophthalmia with intolerance of artificial light. Hot tears. Eyelids, red
and swollen. Dryness of the lids. Eczema of lids, fissured. Eyelids, heavy and falling. Cystic tumors on
eyelids. Sore or cracked outer canthi. Ingrown lashes. Phlyctenae. Sight vanishes during menses. Shuns
daylight. Photophobia. Letters appear double, when writing, seem together when reading.
Eace-Flushes of heat in face. Pale, bloated, haggard, flushed. Feels as if cobwebs were on it. Acne before
the menses. Itching pimples, moist after scratching. Moist eczema around the mouth, chin and nose.
Erysipelas, burning and stinging. Lips cracked and sore. Formication on lips during menses. Painful nodules
on the lower jaw. Barber's itch. Facial paralysis with distortion of muscles and difficult speech. Falling of hair
from chin.
Female - Menses, too late. Menses scanty, pale, irregular, painful. Sighing during menses. Hoarseness,
coryza, cough, morning sickness, sweats, swelling of feet or headache during menses. Leucorrhea, pale,
thin, profuse, white, excoriating in gushes with weakness in back. Leucorrhea worse before and after
menses. Leucorrhea in place of menses. Acrid, excoriating leucorrhea in gushes day or night, before and
after menses. Swelling and hardness of ovary (left) worse after menses. Induration of ovaries, uterus and
breasts. Pain in the uterus when reaching high with arms. Retro-version of uterus, heaviness in hypogastrium
with cutting pain down thighs. Uterus feels as if coming out through vagina. Vagina, dry, hot or cold.
Eczematous eruptions around the vulva. Great aversion to sex.
Food - Excessive hunger or no appetite, worse when hungry. A version to meat, fish. Aversion to cooked food,
salt. Aversion to soup. Sweets nauseate. Better warm milk, worse cold drinks. Desires chicken, beer, sweets.
Worse sweets. Worse boiled meat. Hot drinks disagree.
Head - Rush of blood to head, with flushed face, nosebleed or distention and flatulence. Burning on vertex,
in a small spot. Headache in morning on waking, mostly on one side with inclination to vomit. Headache with
nausea during menses. Heavy weight or dull pressure at the occiput, as if head is drawn back. Pain as if
constricted in occiput, which pains as if broken on looking up. Desolate, empty feeling in head. Rheumatic
pains on one side of head, extending to teeth and neck. Pressive pain or burning spot on vertex. Sensation
of cobweb on forehead. Skin of forehead as if drawn into folds. Brain feels numb. Humid, itching eruption on
hairy scalp, emitting a fetid odor. Much scaliness on head, causing distressing itching, becomes scurf,
which disappears on washing, and is then humid. Hair, matted, brittle or falling out of hair, worse vertex and
sides. Milk crusts. Eczema capitis, scabs sore to touch. Bald spots. Herpes. Hair falls out, even on sides of
head.
Heart - As if an electric shock from heart to neck. Strong pulsations in the whole body. Palpitations of heart
with anxiety with nosebleeds. Palpitations from least exertion. Cold feeling in precordium. Pulse slows
during day, fast in the morning
 Kidneys - Burning between acts of urinating. Biting pain in urethra after urination. Stricture of urethra. Pain in
sacrum or coccyx while urinating. Nocturnal bedwetting. Frequent urination at night. Dark brown urine. Urine,
sour smelling, turbid, stream slender. Urine turbid, with white sediment. Sour smelling urine.
Limbs - Edema of legs. Paralyzed feeling in the limbs. Cannot stretch enough. Burnings, cramps, jerking.
Arms and legs go to sleep. Excoriation of thighs while walking. Bunions worse fire heat, better pressure.
Burning in soles and heels. Feet cold, wet. Acrid, foot sweat, chafes the toes. Stiffness and contraction of toes.
Foul excoriating sweat, worse evening. Burning pressure beneath the armpit. Hands or feet either hot or cold.
Pain in thumb joint as if sprained. Nails, brittle and crumbling. Nails deformed,
Graphites naturalis painful, sore, thick and crippled. Nails, thick, rough ingrown. Horny callosities on hands
with cracks. Cracks and fissures in fingertips. Swelling of feet.
Lungs - Spasmodic asthma, suffocative attacks wake from sleep, must eat something. Dry, troublesome
cough with sweat on face. Lachrymation, worse taking deep breath.
Male - Herpetic eruption on organs. Hydrocele. Sexual debility with increased desire. Priapism. Ejaculation too
early or failing during sex. Cramps in calves during sex. Averse to sex, lack of sexual enjoyment. Impotence
from excessive indulgence or masturbation.
Modalities - Better in the dark. Better from wrapping up. Better after walking. Better in open air. Better hot
drinks, especially milk. Better eating. Better belchings. Better touch. Worse from cold. Worse drafts. Worse
warmth of bed. Worse night. Worse wet feet. Worse light. Worse motion. Worse scratching. Worse suppression
of eruptions or secretions. Worse during and after menses. Worse empty swallowing. Worse fats. Worse hot
drinks.
Mouth - Angles of the mouth ulcerated. Taste, sour like rotten eggs. Rotten, sour, foul odor from mouth. Breath
smells like urine. Salivation, at night. Dots of thick, white fur on tongue. Burning blisters on tongue. Teeth on
edge. Blood from teeth, tastes sour. Easy bleeding and swelling of the gums.
Nose - Stuffed coryza. Coryza from cold. Colds at menses. Chronic catarrh. Sore on blowing it is painful
internally. Discharge offensive especially during menses. Excoriated. Scabs and fissures in the nostrils.
Painful internally. Eczema of nose. Sneezing on opening the eyes. Smell acute, cannot bear the smell of
flowers. Dryness with loss of smell. Nosebleed with rush of blood to the head, worse before menses.
Perspiration - Profuse sweat at night. Profuse sweat during menses. Sweats often on front of body only.
Offensive, sour sweat, stains yellow. Cold sweat. Entire inability to sweat. Sweats from
slightest motion.
Rectum - Fissures of anus, cutting pain during stool, followed by constriction and aching for hours. Fissures
bleed and ulcerate. Constipation, large, difficult, knotty stools united by mucus threads. Chronic diarrhea,
brownish, liquid, undigested offensive. Stools, large, difficult, slimy coated or loose, brown, lienteric and very
foul. Lump of stool, conjoined with threads of mucus, masses of mucus. Stools are slender, pasty. Diarrhea
from slightest indiscretion in eating. Burning hemorrhoids, pain on sitting down or on taking a wide step. Anus
and pudenda, smarting, itching, sore, on wiping anus, before menses. Prolapse of rectum. Varicose veins of
the rectum. Tapeworms.
Sensations - As if skin of forehead was drawn into folds. As if a skin were before ear. As if a hard body as
large as an egg were behind ear. As of a cobweb over the face. As of a lump in stomach with beating as of
two hammers. As if intestines were torn, croaking as of a frog in abdomen. As if everything would be torn to
pieces during menstruation.
Skin - Dry, rough skin, irritable. Skin breaks easily and exudes a gluey honey like moisture, worse in folds
and slow to heal. Unhealthy skin, every little injury suppurates. Eruptions worse from heat. Eczema.
Pimples and acne. Wandering or recurrent erysipelas. Moist, crusty eruptions, oozing out a sticky
exudation. Phlegmonous erysipelas of face, burning and stinging pain. Rawness in bends of limbs, groins,
neck, behind ears. Cracks in nipples, mouth, between toes, anus. Old scars ulcerate. Burning pain in old
scars. Old scars with indurated base and margins with burning. Wens. Chronic poison oak. Psoriasis. Gouty
nodosities. Swelling and induration of the glands. Ulcers discharging a glutinous fluid, thin and sticky.
Sleep - Excessively tired and sleepy. Sleepy during day. Sleeplessness until midnight. Constant talking during
sleep. Nightly pains felt in sleep. Amazingly weary and sleepy. Does not feel fresh in the morning. Amorous
dreams with emissions. Horrible
Graphites naturalis dreams. Dreams about fatal accidents.
Stomach - Gastralgia with burning pains radiating through abdomen. Sour or foul belchings. Frequent
eructations, tasting of ingesta. Eructation of sour green water. Eructations while walking. Pressure in stomach.
Constrictive pain in stomach. Recurrent stomach pain with vomiting of food immediately after eating, stom-
ach worse by cold. Burning in stomach, causing hunger, better from eating or hot drinks especially milk, lying
down. Periodical gastralgia, with vomiting of food immediately after eating. Morning sickness during menses.
 Nausea like faintness, prevents sleep. Nausea with spasm in throat. Nausea during headache. Nausea with
sour vomiting. Vomiting of sour of food. Vomiting and purging and icy cold sweat with headache. Cancer of
pylorus.
Temperature - Chill in the evening worse eating better open air and drinking water. Chill with coldness of
whole body. Chill in morning in bed. Chill during menses. Wants covers in all stages of fever. Recurrent
periodical fever. Fever with restlessness, unable to sleep, or remain in bed on account of it. Flushes of heat.
Dry heat every evening and night. Burning heat in hands and soles and feet. Heat when riding in a carriage.
Throat - Chronic sore throat. Chronic hoarseness with skin disorders. Tonsils enlarged. Nodulated goiter.
Choking, on swallowing from goiter. As of a lump in throat worse empty swallowing, urging to swallow from
constant spasms. Asif food would not go down from spasms. Hoarseness as soon as he starts singing. Voice
lacks control, better using it. Ulcerative pain in throat when swallowing.
Vertigo - Vertigo, worse looking upwards, reading or sewing. Vertigo with nausea and sour vomiting. Vertigo
with hyperesthesia of eyes. Vertigo from overexertion of eyes. Vertigo from venous stagnation. Confusion and
vertigo in morning on waking.
COMMENTS - Hahnemann was quick to perceive that Graph, was much more than a mere remedy for skin
disorders, it proved to be a leading anti-psoric, similar to Sulph. Hahnemann's provings and observations de-
fined its powers over skin disorders.
The skin of Graph, is rough, hard and dry. Eczematous and herpetic eruptions predominate. Poor healing of
the skin, tendency to scarring, keloids. Impetigo, eczema. Psoriasis.
Cracks between fingers and toes (Petr.), behind the ears, in the bends of joints, folds of skin, around the lips
and anus, and margin of the hair. Intertrigo, infection in the folds of the skin, can fester and form pus. Yellow,
sticky, honey-like discharge underneath the scabs.
Pimples, acne. Wens. For the results of repelled eruptions of any kind. Fungal infections that deform the nails,
tend to split. Brittle, crack and split down the middle. Pus and infection under the nails (Ant-c.).
The circulation is at first excited, then there is a loss of energy and consequent venous hyperemia. Irregularities
in the distribution of the blood occur, leading to pallor of skin and mucus membranes.
Fainting readily occurs with great anxiety, motion is impaired and the tissues relaxed, but paralysis is not
complete. Characteristic rush of blood to the head with a flushed face. Hemorrhages.
Strong affinity for the breasts. Cracked nipples (Petr., Sars.). Blocked milk ducts, abscess of the breast. For
cancer, particularly of the breast, where the cancer occurs on the site of a scar, where the cancer regrows in
the scar of a lumpectomy. Also if there is a history of cracked nipples and abscessed breasts.
Pain under left breast at menstrual period, often waking patient in the night. Scanty menses, with headache,
skin-affection. Getting feet wet causes delayed menses. Hysterical melancholia with occipital headache.
Profuse, gushing leucorrhea, excoriating.
Cracks along the labia. Moist itching excoriation around anus and fissures. Very low sex drive (Sep.).
Uncontrollable sexual excitement with violent erections. Priapism. Impotence.
Clean tongue. Fishy taste in the morning, disappearing later in the day. Milk agrees, especially when hot.
Roasted, but not boiled meat or potatoes. Diarrhea, thin offensive, partly digested stools. Constipation, stools
coming in lumps coated with mucus and with mucus shreds. Anal fissures, can pass blood and painful stools.
Weak, exhaustion of whole body. Spasms, contractions of muscles, twitching of eyelids. Cataleptic condition.
Sensitiveness of internal parts, numbness in various parts, drawing pain in whole body. Bathing after measles
causes paralysis of face. Attacks occur during summer and autumn. Suffering parts emaciated.
General obesity with a thick, white, profuse irritating discharge. Suffocative spells which arouse the patient
from sleep, he must jump out of bed, worse after midnight (Lach., worse after sleep).
General condition is not sensitive (opposite of Hep.). Abnormally acute senses, cannot tolerate the smell of
flowers. Music causes weeping. Sadness. Ears feel stuffed during the full moon. Hardness of hearing is better
when riding in a carriage. Easy to over-lift.
Teste classed Graph, in the Puls, group with Sil., Calc., Hep. and Phos. It affects the nutrition in a peculiar
way, it is a remedy for those persons who have a tendency to put on unhealthy fat or for those who begin to
emaciate. Graph, is an anti-psoric.
Typically “fat, chilly and costive. ” Especially active in patients who are rather stout, of fair complexion with
a tendency to skin disorders and constipation, with a delayed menstrual history.
Hufeland related the cure of a lady, 41, by the internal and external use of Graph, of an acne rosacea which
had defied all other modes of treatment.
Kent and Grimmer noted cases of late stage breast cancer that they treated with high potencies. Graph, caused
the tumors, and in one case the entire breast, to slough off and heal.
Nash recorded a case of a child who was relieved of an eczema capitis under old- school treatment, whereupon
 entero-colitis set in and became so alarming that it was pronounced “tuberculosis of the bowels.”
Nash found the child greatly emaciated with little or no appetite, very restless, passing “stools of brown fluid
mixed with undigested substances and of an intolerably fetid odor.” Graph. 6,000c cured promptly.
Goullon cured two notable cases of cramps in the stomach with “improvement of the cramps by eating.”
Clarke cured two very severe cases of nosebleed in elderly people. In one case, there had been flushing of
head and neck for many months previous to the attack, and flushing preceded and accompanied each
occurrence of the bleeding.
In the other case, the patient said the precursory flush seemed to come up from his toes. He had his nostrils
plugged without avail. Graph, in a high potency, cured promptly in both instances.
When giving Graph, internally in cases of anal eruption, the external use of an ointment made with a drachm
of the 3x trituration to an ounce of Cetacean ointment is of great service.
Hirsh or Prague used Graph, locally in cases of disease of the nails with very good results.
RELATIONS-Antidoted by: Aeon., Ars. Nux- v. Antidote to: Ars-i., Rhus-t. Compare: (1) Petr., Lach., Carb-
v., Carb-a., Caust., Nit-ac., Rhus-t. - erysipelas, left then right, Graph., right then left. Ant-c., Rat., Peon, Nit-
ac., Sil. (2) In priapism. - Pic-ac. (3) In disorders of right ovary, Pall. (4) Aur, Puls., Lyc. Stram., Alum. (5) hears
better in cars - Nit-ac. (6) Obesity, Calc-a. Trichiasis, Borax. Fat constitutions, Calc. (7) Sulph. has margins of
lids reddened with Graph, they are paler then usual, Euphr. has thick, purulent discharge, Graph, has thin. (8)
Graph, is achronic or overgrown Puls. - but
Puls, has Worse and Graph, has better from milk. (9) The associated constipation with mucus-covered stools
and gastric flatulency should be taken into consideration and differentiate it from such remedies as Petr, and
Lyc. Complementary: Arg-n. - follows well in gastric derangements, Caust., Hep., Lyc., Ars., Tub. It follows:
Calc., Calc-f., Lyc., Puls., Sep., Sulph.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Gratiola Officinalis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-grat. Gratiola officinalis. Hedge hyssop. Herb of Grace. N. O. Scrophulariacae. Grows in moist
places. Tincture of fresh plant before flowering. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Brain disorders. Cholera. Coccyx, pain. Colic. Constipation. Cramps, Diarrhea. Dropsy. Eye
disorders. Gout. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Hydrocephalus. Hysteria. Mania. Masturbation. Mesenteric glands.
Nausea. Neuralgias. Nymphomania. Palpitations. Rheumatic pain. Stomach pains. Tetanus. Vision,
disordered.
HERBAL - Gratiola, “the Herbof Grace,” is one of the most important members of the great Scrophularian
group, which includes Dig., Euphr., Tab., Scroph.. and should be carefully studied with these.
Cooper used it with great success in a case of gouty acidity with great constipation and in the constipation of
cancer. He regards it as “the vegetable antacid.” It is said to have formed the basis for a once famous nostrum
for gout, “Eau Médicinale.”
HOMEOPATHIC - Symptoms of a fully developed, rapid attack of Asiatic cholera are produced. A large
proportion of the effects of Gratiola are expended on the gastro-intestinal tract. It is an inodorous plant of bitter
taste and very poisonous, causing violent colic, bloody stools, enteritis, jaundice.
Affection of the solar plexus. Constant sinking but cannot eat, bitter taste. Cramps beginning at pit of stomach;
pains radiating from stomach. Urine is diminished, reddish, turbid.
Diarrhea, yellowish, gushing, watery, as though rushing from a hydrant. Vomiting of yellowish fluid. Summer
diarrhea from excessive drinking of water whether cold or hot. Soreness, burning or irritation of anus follows
the stools.
Teste considered Grat, the Cham, of chronic diseases. Teste saw four cases of nymphomania in females to
whom herb doctors had given injections of a decoction of freshly gathered Gratiola. Burnett considered it
specific in female masturbation and nymphomania.
Especially useful in females, Nux-v.-like symptoms in females. Chronic catarrhal conditions, leucorrhea and
gonorrhea. Obstinate ulcers.
Trembling in limbs, convulsions, cramps, excitement and disordered condition of the sexual powers. Paralytic
pains and feeling of coldness especially in the abdomen. Cerebral disorders without fever. Nervous prostration.
Neuralgia due to abuse of coffee.
MIND- Anxiety, gnawing, empty feeling, rolling about in epigastric region. Peevishness. Confusion when lying
down. Ill humor, tired of life. Mental troubles from overweening pride. Answers, reflects long. Taciturn.
Great depression and disinclination to do anything. Weak will. Lack of perseverance. Ill-humor. Irresolution.
Violent anger from contradiction. Delirium tremens. Hysterical. Loquacity and gaiety. Delusion being
 diminished, smaller. Absorbed in reveries. Nymphomania.
Apprehensive about the future. Fear of eating when hungry. Hypochondriasis and hysteria arising from
abdominal troubles. Abdomen - Shooting pains in the abdomen.
Inflation of the abdomen. Rumbling with nausea, eructation and vertigo. Flatulent and pressive colic with
nausea and disagreeable risings. Feeling of coldness in abdomen, lasting half an hour.
Back - Pain in coccyx after stool. Neck as if seized by hands.
Breasts - Darting pain in breasts. Shootings in right breast, worse on rising during menses.
Causations - Coffee causes neuralgia.
Chest - Heat in the chest, then the head and hands with redness of the face. Pressure on the chest. Shootings
in the chest on breathing. Pimples on the chest, which burn after having been scratched.
Ears - Itching of ears.
Eyes - Eyes feel dry as if sand were in them. Dry, burning eyes. Itching about eyelashes.
Face - Burning heat and redness of the face. Sensation of tension in the face, it feels swollen. Swelling of
upper lip. Tearing on one side of face. Painful crack in left side of chin. Tingling, burning in malar bones.
Female - Menses too profuse, premature and too long. Persistent leucorrhea. Tendency to masturbation.
Nymphomania. Irritable condition of sexual organs with congestions.
Food - Hunger after a meal with feeling of emptiness. Craves nothing but bread. Worse during and after eating,
vertigo during and after a meal.
Head - Rush of blood with vanishing of sight. Sick headache. Tightness in forehead with wrinkles in skin.
Sensation as if brain was contracting and head became smaller.
Heart - Palpitations after stools, with oppression of the chest. Pulse small, intermittent.
Kidneys - Burning in the urethra during and after urination. Diminished secretion of urine. Scanty and reddish
urine, which becomes turbid on standing with cloudy sediment.
Limbs - Limb gives way with sciatic pain. Rheumatic pains in the shoulders, arms, fingers, particularly in elbow
and wrist joint. Itching in the palm of the hand.
Lungs - Dry cough, excited by a sensation of roughness in the chest in the morning or at night. Nocturnal
cough with pain as from excoriation in trachea, oppression of the chest and shivering.
Male - Painful rigidity of the penis after seminal emission, nightly. Stitches in left spermatic cord, ascending
though the abdomen up to the chest. Drawing pain in glans.
Modalities - Better from open air. Better rest. Worse from eating. Worse drinking too much water. Worse hot
or cold. Worse abuse of coffee. Worse dinner. Worse warm room. Worse summer. Worse motion.
Mouth - Accumulation of much saliva in the mouth. Mouth bitter or clammy. Fetid breath in the morning after
waking. Tongue rough, covered with mucus. Sensation of cold in the teeth. Nocturnal tearing or piercing in the
molars.
Nose - Frequent sneezing. Stoppage of the nose. Smarting, itching in left nostril. Pressure at upper part of
nose.
Perspiration - Constant vaporous exhalation from body.
Rectum - Diarrhea, green, frothy water, followed by anal burning. Diarrhea, forcibly evacuated without
pain. Summer diarrhea from drinking of excess of water. Rectum constricted. Constipation with gouty acidity.
Hemorrhoids with hypochondriasis.
Sensations - As if brain contracted, as if head grew smaller, as if brain would fall forward. As if sand in eyes,
as if throat contracted. As if a stone rolling from side to side in stomach.
Skin - Itching with burning after scratching. Running and corrosive eruptions, which resemble scabies. Small
boils. Miliary pimples with yellow tips.
Sleep - Insomnia. Irresistible drowsiness with yawning and involuntary closure of eyes. Great sleepiness and
lassitude after meals. Deep sleep, like stupor.
Stomach - Dyspepsia with much distention of the stomach. Emptiness after eating. Cramps and colic after
supper and during night with swelling of abdomen and constipation. Dysphagia for liquids. As of a cold water
or loose, heavy load in stomach.
Temperature - Tendency to chilliness. Chilliness in a warm room during sleep, after an evacuation, with the
hair standing on end. Heat ascending to the face with redness and increased external warmth.
Throat - Pressure in throat, as from thick mucus. Accumulation of mucus in throat. Phlegm in throat with
inability to throw it off. Pain in throat obliging one to swallow constantly. Stinging in throat. Tingling, roughness
and scraping in throat.
Vertigo - Vertigo during and after meals, hunger and feeling of emptiness after meals.
Vision - Myopia. Shortsightedness with burning heat in face. All objects seem white, even green trees. Mist
before eyes when reading or writing. Sudden vanishing of sight while writing or looking at light objects, better
 closing eyes, but constantly returns.
COMMENTS - Two excellent cures with Grat, have been recorded by C. W. Sonnenschmidt. The first case,
Mrs. C., 53, was attacked in June with diarrhea, yellow, watery, frothy stools gushing out with force. Severe
cutting pains in abdomen, rumbling of flatulence. Occasional nausea and vomiting. Coloc. and Ip. failed to
relieve. Then on close inquiry it was elicited that “a cold feeling in the abdomen” had been a feature throughout.
Grat. off. 3c, cured promptly.
In the second case, a three-weeks' old infant was attacked with diarrhea and colic. There were two or three
stools in quick succession and then an interval of an hour or two. Stools, green or yellow watery, frothy,
expelled suddenly. Nausea and vomiting. Severe pain before stools, relieved afterwards, for a short time.
Cham., Coloc., and Verat. failed, then Grat, rapidly cured. It also removed “redness around anus and on the
side an abrasion of half an inch in extent, which caused some oozing of blood.”
E. E. Case cured a woman, age 50, of hemorrhoids with Constipation, difficult stools. External hemorrhoids
from any exertion and after stool. Biting, stinging tension in tumors. During stool, a sensation as if the rectal
membrane was torn.
After stool, all the nerve of the pelvis seem in a high state of tension, the flesh on the perineum feels as if torn
from the bone. Sleepless before midnight, peevish, melancholy. Grat. 200c cured.
The left side is more affected than the right. The head and eye symptoms are of the first importance. Rush of
blood to head with vanishing of sight is a keynote. Heat ascending to face with redness and increased external
warmth. A number of pains are experienced in the coccyx. Chilly, shuddering on entering a warm room.
Constant vaporous emanations from body.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Caust., Bell., Euph., Nux-v. It antidotes: lod. Compare: (1) Dig., Euph., Tab.,
Cham., Am-c., Nux- v. Apis, Bell., Hell., Cham., Nux-v., Elat., Podo. (2) Hunger after meals with feeling of
emptiness, Lauro., Calc., Case., Chin., Cina, (3) Emptiness after stool, Petr. (4) Vanishing of sight and
headache, Gels. (5) Dig., Tab., Euphr., Scroph.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.
