name: Iodoformum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - iodof. lodoformum. Iodoform. Trituration. Solution. Historicaldose: Triturations, tincture and all
potencies, second trituration. Three grains on the back of the tongue will relieve attack of asthmatic breathing.
CLINICAL - Breast, pains. Chancre. Cholera, infantum. Coughs. Delirium. Diplopia. Diarrhea. Eczema.
Enteric, fever. Eye, disorders. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hydrocephalus. Locomotor, ataxia. Mania.
Meningitis. Paralysis. Tuberculosis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Iodof. was proved by Underwood and Haines. The proving symptoms were supplemented
with recorded effects observed on patients treated with it in old-school practice, as well as cases of fatal
poisoning.
In some instances, the symptoms of acute meningitis have been produced. Based on this, W. J. Martin cured
two cases of tubercular meningitis with Iodof. 2x. He put 4 grains in half a tumbler of water and gave a
teaspoonful every two hours.
One case was that of a child, fourteen months old, the symptoms including sleeping too much, constant
movement of the mouth as though chewing or sucking, boring head back and rolling it from side to side. Had
been ill twelve days.
Violent convulsions followed, face distorted, eyes squinting, head retracted, neck and back stiffness. Automatic
movement of one arm and leg. The child was expected to die that night, but Iodof. was given and improvement
set in. Fever abated, and in one week all symptoms had passed away.
Tuberculous conditions, especially tubercular meningitis (Bac.). Chronic diarrhea, stools, greenish, watery,
undigested with irritable temper, due to suspected
tuberculosis. Sub-acute and chronic diarrhea of children.
Failed sight due to retro-bulbar neuritis, central scotoma, partial atrophy of the optic disc. Pupils dilated,
contract unequally. Cannot stand or walk with eyes closed. Sleep interrupted by sighing and cries. Mesenteric
glands enlarged.
MIND - Apathetic. Irritable. Weak-minded. Forgetful. Amnesia for recent events. Did not recognize persons.
Nightly restlessness. Melancholia. Excitement. Anguish. Fear of death, bemoans her approaching death.
Drowsiness developing into perfect coma.
Hallucinations of sight and hearing, delusions. Screams out, leaves her bed but falls down after walking a few
steps. Talks nonsense. Excessive talkativeness. Sees double. Dresses himself in strange costumes. Imagined
he had the best tenor voice in the world and proceeded to hire a large concert hall. Abdomen - Flatulent colic.
Rumbling in abdomen. Scaphoid abdomen. Abdomen distended, mesenteric glands enlarged. Cutting in
abdomen. Warmth in abdomen. Right inguinal region, sharp pain, cutting, with desire for stool, sore pain.
Back - Contraction of muscles of neck. Bruised sensation in nape. Spine sore, does not wish it touched. Pain
along spine, along right side of dorsal vertebrae, in lumbar region, with weakness and straining. Sharp pain in
angle of scapula.
Chest - Sore pain in apex of right lung. Feeling of a weight on chest. Pain in left breast like a hand grasping
 at the base of the heart.
Ears - Sticking in right ear, sticking, then fullness. Ears feeling dry and feverish, and full. Neuralgic pains in left
ear. Dull hearing.
Eyes - Pupils, dilated, contract unequally, react poorly. Eyes bloodshot and painful. Sensitive to light. Vision
double. Failing sight due to retro-bulbar neuritis, central scotoma-partial atrophy of optic disc.
Face - Drawing, pressing pains in malar- bones, in zygomatic muscles, worse motion and bending forward.
Stiffness of zygomatic muscles. Twitching of facial muscles. Aching in right lower jaw. Lips
and throat dry, lips dry and stinging. Head - Meningitis. Sharp, neuralgic pain.
Head feels heavy, as if it could not be lifted from the pillow. Stitching in temples. Frontal pain, worse from
descending stairs. Headache on waking. Itching of occiput.
Heart - Sticking through heart.
Kidneys - Urine very yellow, smelling like saffron. Albumen and casts in urine.
Limbs - Legs weak. Weakness of knees when going upstairs. Cannot stand and walk with eyes closed.
Lungs - Cough and wheezing on going to bed. Cough from the dryness of throat. Hemoptysis. Asthmatic
breathing. Respirationirregular, deep inspirations alternating with apnea. Smothering sensation.
Modalities - Better by uncovering. Worse at night, warmth, touch, motion, riding in cars.
Mouth - Metallic taste. Sharp pain in upper teeth. Aching in teeth. Teeth feel sore and too long.
Perspiration - Sweats easily from motion. Sweats on head.
Rectum - Cholera infantum. Chronic diarrhea. Stools greenish, watery, undigested. Diarrhea with
suspected tuberculosis. Stool delayed, with feeling as if anus were drawn up into rectum.
Skin - Red rash over loins, back of arms and elbows. Fine eruption of macules, papules and vesicles. Diffuse
redness with edema. Horrible irritation all over body.
Sleep - Sleepiness. Very drowsy. Sleep interrupted by sighing and cries. Jerks and shocks in nerves when
trying to sleep. Wakefulness. Restless sleep, full of dreams. Confused dreams, of accidents.
Stomach - Nausea, at times.
Temperature - Susceptible to hot weather. Heat at night, keeps laying off covers. Temperature may be
elevated to 104 F° or more.
Throat - Aphonic disturbance of voice. Stitching in right side of throat. Dryness of throat, with bitter taste,
dryness with rawness on swallowing.
Vertigo - Sudden giddiness. Confusion with nausea. Feeling as if he had been intoxicated. Vertigo on sitting
up in bed.
COMMENTS - A boy of 10 had lodof. thickly applied to a point on an amputated limb at which the stitches did
not hold well. On the third day he was sleepy after a restless night with frequent sighing. The dressing was
renewed and on the same day, not having eaten anything since the day before, he had several attacks of
vomiting, bilious and easy.
All these symptoms increased during the next few days. The child was constipated and seemed to suffer from
his head. Nights very restless, sleep interrupted by sighing and cries like those of meningitis. Drowsiness
during the day. Pupils unequally contracted, reacted slowly to light. He was perfectly indifferent and did not
recognize those about him.
Later, nightly agitation was replaced by tranquil delirium. Pulse rapid and small. On the sixth day the dressing
was changed, on the seventh day the symptoms began to abate and disappeared after the ninth.
In one case of poisoning, a woman, 26 who had taken 42 grains of Iodoform in eighty days, suddenly after a
hot bath felt very dizzy and weak in the legs, felt unable to knit and diplopia set in. Symptoms of mania followed,
weakness, staggering on closing the eyes. For twelve days she was unable to walk alone.
In one case, that of a soldier who had Iodoform applied to his arm, a scarlatina-like rash appeared, spreading
from arm over the body and ending in desquamation.
Scarlatina was actually diagnosed, but some doubt was raised and suspicion being thrown on the Iodoform, a
piece of silver was placed in the mouth. Immediately a garlic taste was experienced, showing the presence of
Iodoform, which other tests confirmed.
In cases of medicinal poisoning, the symptoms sometimes come speedily and sometimes only after a long
period of medication. Symptoms set in with great suddenness and intensity. Symptoms are worse from heat
and damp.
Depression. Marked drowsiness. Malaise, loss of strength and of appetite. Occasional vomiting. Moderate
fever, rapid pulse. Eczema.
RELATIONS-Antidotedby: Hep., Sang. (skin). Compare: (1) Iod„ Kali-i., Merc.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
 ***IODUM PURUM
(Iodine)
PHARMACY - iod. lodum purum. Iodine. At. Wt. 126.53. Anelement. Halogens. Tincture. Historical dose:
Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Adenoids. Appetite, disordered. Arthritis, deformans. Atrophy. Brain, atrophy. Breast, disorders.
Cancer. Cachexia. Chilblains. Chyluria. Constipation. Coryza. Cough. Croup. Debility. Diabetes. Diarrhea.
Emaciation. Enteric, fever. Galactorrhea. Gland, disorders. Goiter. Headaches. Heart, disorders,
hypertrophy. Hemorrhoids. Hiccough. Hydrocephalus. Hyperactive. Infertility. Iritis. Jaundice. Joints,
disorders. Laryngitis. Leucorrhea. Liver, disorders. Lymphatic, swellings. Malnutrition. Melancholy.
Metabolism, disorders. Myocarditis. Ovaries, disorders. Ozaena. Plague. Pneumonia. Prostate gland,
enlarged. Restlessness. Rheumatic, gout. Rheumatism. Salivation. Scars. Seborrhea. Synovitis. Syphilis.
Tabes mesenterica. Tachycardia. Throat, disorders. Thyroid, disorders. Tonsils, disorders. Tremors.
Tuberculosis. Uterus, disorders. Voice, disorders. Vomiting. Weight, loss. Worms.
HOMEOPATHIC - loduretted solution of Kali-i. is said to expels tapeworms dead. Iodine tincture is an allopathic
skin disinfectant. Locally, it is an effective and easily managed microbicide. Ideal agent to keep wounds clean
and disinfected (Calen.). For gunshot wounds (Hyper.), and compound fractures. Bites of insects, reptiles, etc.
Great absorption action, rapid and intense absorption. Useful as a paint in all kinds of swellings, particularly
swollen glands. Given internally, the absorbents are stimulated to fresh activity; muscles, fat. tissues and
glands waste away and general emaciation is the result. New growths and hyperplasia are affected before the
normal tissues.
Especially affects all glandular structures, respiratory organs, and the circulatory system. Glands, thyroid,
testes, mesenteric and mammary, first swell, hard and heavy, then dwindle, atrophy. Goiter. Facial paralysis
or epilepsy from suppression of goiter. Atrophy or induration of testes, ovaries, uterus. Plague. Adenoid
vegetations.
Rapid metabolism. Loses flesh, yet hungry and eating well (Abrot.). Emaciation, weight loss with good
appetite, glandular atrophy. Hungry with much thirst. Better after eating. Great debility, the slightest effort
induces perspiration.
Wasting diseases of scrofulous patients. Patients are generally exceedingly thin, dark complexioned. enlarged
lymphatic glands, with a voracious appetite but remains thin. Tubercular type. Feels always too hot, craves
cold air.
Capillary congestion followed by ecchy- mosis, edema, hemorrhages and nutritive disturbances. Abnormal
vaso-constriction. Acute disorders of the respiratory organs. Pneumonia, rapid extension. Tuberculosis. Acute
catarrh of all mucus membranes.
Arthritis deformans. Acts prominently on the connective tissue. Acute exacerbation of chronic
inflammations. Trembling of limbs or body. Pancreatic diseases. Lead poisoning. Sluggish vital reaction.
Chronicity.
MIND -Anxiety when quiet. Anxiety about the present, no reference to the future. Anxiety during cough.
Intolerably cross and restless. excited, worse warm room. Hurried while walking. Feels better if busy.
Inclined to move about, not permitting to sit or sleep, but motion aggravates and exhausts. Desire to travel.
Forgetful. Constantly feels as if he had forgotten something, and doesn't know what. Fixed, immovable
thoughts. Does not understand why he has done something. Tendency to do some strange things without any
cause. Impulsive behavior. Sudden impulse to run and do violence, to himself or others, but worse motion,
which exhausts. Impulse to kill somebody, himself.
Anxious and worried if he does not eat (Cina., Sulph.). Anxiety as if going crazy.
Anxiety bettereating, when hungry, better walking in open air. Fear of people, of physicians, when anyone
comes near. Apprehends an accident from every trifle. Fear of evil. Fear with overcarefulness.
Melancholy. Depression, dejected with tendency to weep. Suicidal tendency. Irritability, with sadness.
Disappointed love. Aversion to company, to strangers. Shuns everyone. Can't bear to be looked at. Cheers up
in open air. Heart palpitations when thinking of real or imaginary wrongs. Thinks he is well.
Abdomen - Swelling and distension, or emaciation and sinking in of abdomen. Cutting pain in abdomen.
Trembling in abdomen. Incarcerated flatulence. Pancreatic disease. Region of spleen very painful. Enlarged
spleen, with salivation. Liver and spleen sore and enlarged. Violent throbbing of aorta abdominalis. Mesenteric
glands enlarged. Swelling of inguinal glands.
Back - Back pains like rheumatism. Sharp pain in small of back. Pain in sacrum and coccyx. Spinal complaints
with gressus vaccinus. Large boil between scapulae, with gangrene of legs. Swelling and induration of cervical
glands. Swelling of the neck when speaking, grows thick. Yellow spots on neck. Redness on neck and chest
as if ecchymosed.
 Breasts - Breasts hyperesthesia. Dwindling of breasts. Atrophy of breast glands. Breasts heavy, as if would
fall. Nodosities in the skin of breasts with black points. Tumors in breast. Excessive flow of very thin, watery
milk with great weakness and rapid emaciation. Suppression of milk with atrophy and relaxation of breasts.
Causations - Ill effects of nervous shock, disappointed love.
Chest - Burning, stinging tension in skin of chest. Sharp, quick, piercing pains. Tickling all over chest. Raw
sensation in bronchi. Great weakness about chest. Difficult expansion of chest. Clavicular region, on right side,
sunken. Pleuritic effusions. Swelling of axillary glands.
Constitutions - Suited to persons of dark
lodum purum hair and complexion, dark, yellow, tawny skin. Over-grown boys with weak chest and aged
persons.
Cough - Short, dry, irritating cough, worse at night, followed in morning by sweat. Dry cough in morning. Cough
from tickling in larynx. Cough as from a feather in throat. Croupy cough with difficult respiration, wheezing.
Wheezing, metallic cough. Cough from every effort to expand chest. Cough causing glowing heat in head and
face. Suffocating cough can hardly get her breath. Can't lie down from cough, sits bent forward.
Ears - Sensitiveness to noise. Reverberations in head. Buzzing. Hearing first sensitive, then dull. Catarrhal
deafness. Eustachian deafness. Chronic deafness with adhesions in the middle ear. Indolent ulcers of
membrana tympani.
Eyes - Pain in eyes. Protrusion of eyes. Dark rings. Dirty y ello wish color of sclera. Staring with wide open
eyes. Pupil dilated. Constant motion of eyeballs. Convulsive movements and quivering of the eyes, of lower
eyelids. Trembling of lids. Edematous swelling of lids. Eyelids seem to be retracted. Acute dacryocystitis.
Acute inflammation of lachrymal duct. Smarting pain, as from excoriation. Violent, profuse lachrymation.
Face - Face pale, sometimes yellowish or greenish, alternating with red. Withered, brownish, sallow or dusky.
Bluish lips. Coldness of face in fleshy children. Miserable look. Twitching of facial muscles. Facial paralysis
after reduction of goiter. Swollen submaxillary glands. Suppurating ulcer on left cheek.
Female - Chronic amenorrhea. Sudden appearance of menses, very profuse and with severe abdominal pains.
Great weakness during menses (Alum., Carban., Cocc.). Menses irregular. Menses, brown, renewed after
every stool. Violent dysmenorrhea with very scanty discharge. Uterine hemorrhage. Metrorrhagia, with acute
pain in breasts. Leucorrhea, acrid, eroding thighs and linen, worse during menses. Thin, yellow leucorrhoea in
scrofulous women, with induration and
swelling of os uteri, and swelling of vagina. Leucorrhea alternating with cough. Ovaritis with leucorrhea
(Apis., Bell., Lach.). Ovarian cysts. Dropsical swelling of ovaries with pressing down toward genitals. Great
sensitiveness of right ovarian region during or after menses. Wedge-like pain from ovary to uterus.
Miscarriage. Sterility from atrophy of ovaries and breasts. Cancerous degeneration at neck of uterus.
Food - Variable appetite. Ravenous hunger with great thirst. Loses flesh, yet hungry and eating well (Abrot.).
Only feels well while eating in any diseased condition. Gets anxious or worried if he does not eat. Food doesn't
nourish or strengthen. Desire for meat, spirituous liquors, acid things. Drinking cold milk helps constipation.
Milk causes vomiting. Heartburn after indigestible food.
Head - Dull pressure in frontal sinuses, during coryza. Headache at root of nose and frontal sinus.
Reverberations in head. Throbbing in head and all over body. Feeling of a tight band. Rush of blood to
head. Headache so violent it almost makes him crazy. Chronic, congestive headache of elderly people (Phos.).
Headache of elderly people, worse in warm air, fatigue, walking fast, riding in car. Brain as if stirred around
with a spoon. Atrophy of brain. Apoplexy. Falling off of hair. Scald head.
Heart - Great precordial anxiety, obliging him to constantly change his position. Violent heart action. Feeling
of vibration or purring over heart. Feels as if squeezed by an iron hand (Cact.), followed by great weakness
and faintness. Myocarditis, painful compression around heart. Tachycardia. Pericarditis in complication with
pneumonia. Mitral insufficiency. Dilatation of heart, after scarlatina. Palpitations, with faintness, worse least
exertion, warm bath, better cold bath. Intermittent action of heart. Pulsation in large arterial trunks. Pulse rapid,
small, weak, tumultuous, irregular, large, hard and accelerated.
Kidneys - Obstinate retention of urine. Stoppage of urine, or it flows, stops, and flows again. Stricture of
urethra. Uremia. Urination frequent and copious. Incontinence in old people. Urine dark, thick, ammoniacal.
Urine, dark, yellowgreen (Bov.), sediment like red pepper. Urine milky with variegated cuticle on its surface.
Milky white fluid runs from urethra after stool.
Limbs - Trembling and weariness in limbs and debility. Pulsation in large arterial trunks. Chronic arthritic
affections, stiff and enlarged joints. Joints inflamed and painful. Synovitis. Rheumatic pain in joints.
Rheumatic pains, nightly pains in joints and bones. Constrictive sensations, white swellings. Gonorrheal
rheumatism. Rheumatism of nape and upper limbs. Cold hands and feet. Subsultus tendinum of hands and
feet. Back of hands, brown, as if swollen, painful when turning hand, not when closing fingers. Acrid sweat of
 feet (Sil.). Edema of the feet. Painful corns.
Liver - Pains inregion of liverwithjaundice, emaciation. Hepatitis, with fever, dry tongue, restlessness, etc.
Jaundice, eyes, skin, nails yellow. Cirrhosis of liver. Liver and spleen sore and enlarged.
Lungs - Asthma, breathes heavily when quiet. Hay asthma. Shortness of breath at least exertion or talking.
Inspiration difficult. Raw and ticklingfeelingprovoking a dry cough. Difficult expansion of chest, blood-
streaked sputum internal dry heat, external coldness. Pleuritis effusion. Pneumonia. Right-sided pneumonia
with high temperature. Hepatization spreads rapidly with persistent high temperature, absence of pain in spite
of great involvement, worse warmth, craves cool air. Croupy cough with difficult respiration, wheezy. Croup
in scrofulous children with dark hair and eyes. Dry, morning cough from tickling in larynx. Cold extends
downwards from head to throat and bronchials. Cough is worse indoors in warm, wet weather and when lying
on back. Large quantities of transparent mucus. Tough, sweetish, yellow, tasteless mucus. Frequently blood-
streaked
mucus, with cough. Gluey, rusty yellow expectoration, mingled with blood streaks, dislodged with difficulty and
sticks fast to handkerchief.
Male - Testicles swollen and indurated. Painless swelling of testicles with offensive sweat. Offensive sweating
of genitals. Orchitis. Hydrocele. Sarcocele. Twisting pain in spermatic cord. Senile hypertrophy and induration
of prostate. Prostate gland swollen and indurated. Incontinence in old men with prostatic enlargement. Atrophy
of testes with loss of sexual power. Hypertrophy of testicles, with sexual excitement.
Modalities - Better from cold, air, walking about in open air, bathing, eating. Worse sitting up, ascending,
exertion, touch, pressure, right side. Worse from warmth, heat of room, wrapping up, rest, night, when quiet
in warmth, talking, fasting. Worse during certain moon phases.
Mouth - Offensive odor from mouth. Profuse, fetid, soapy, sweet saliva. Metallic, salty, soapy, sour taste, with
purulent stools. Mouth filled with mucus on waking in morning, with putrid taste, not better washing mouth with
water. Aphthae with putrid smell and profuse, fetid salivation. Foul ulcers and salivation. Glands on inside of
cheeks intensely painful as if sharp vinegar in mouth. Little blisters on gums. Gums loose and bleed easily.
Nose - Red and swollen. Profuse, sudden sneezing with dripping of hot water. Nasal catarrh thin,
excoriating. Sneezing with sudden, violent influenza. Acute influenzas with hot, watery discharge, pain at root
of nose and over frontal sinuses. Dry coryza becomes fluent in open air. Fluent, hot coryza with general heat
of skin. Blowing of much yellow mucus from nose. Chronic fetid discharge. Discharge of mucus from posterior
nares. Pain at the root of the nose and frontal sinuses. Nose stopped up. Acute nasal engorgement with
high blood pressure. Descending colds. Tendency to ulceration. Nosebleeds. Loss of smell. Alae nasi as if
spread wide apart.
Perspiration - Debilitating, sour-smelling sweats. Cold, viscid sweat. Sweats easily. Sweats with inclination to
uncover. Profuse night sweats with great emaciation and debility. Sweats, better in early morning.
Rectum - Burning and itching in anus. Hemorrhoids protrude and burn, worse heat. Constipation with
ineffectual urging, better by drinking cold milk. Constipation alternating with diarrhea (Ant-c.). Chronic
diarrhea of an exhausting character. Chronic morning diarrhea of emaciated, scrofulous children. Fatty diar-
rhea from pancreatic affections. Dysenteric mucus stools without feces. Stools, whitish, frothy, whey-like, fatty,
cheesy or lienteric, pancreatic disorders. Stools of watery, foaming, whitish mucus. Stools hard, knotting, dark-
colored, blackish. Hemorrhage at every stool.
Skin - Clammy, moist, hot, dry, dirty, skin. Yellow and withered skin. Brown spots on skin. Skin turns brown in
Addison's disease. Thickening of epidermis. Nodosities on skin. Tendency to papulae, small boils and
abscesses. Acne. Urticaria. Impetigo scrofulosa. Herpes. Ringworm. Fungus articularis after measles. Syphilis
with ulceration of skin. Bleeding ulcers. Ulcers with copious pus, bloody and corroding. Anasarca of cardiac
disease. Itching and pimples in old scars. Scars break open. Glands enlarged.
Sleep - Restlessness, prevents sleep. Sleeplessness after midnight. Restless sleep with vivid or anxious
dreams. Dreams of eating.
Stomach - Gastric derangement with constipation. Pulsation, throbbing in the pit of the stomach. Bitter taste
to solid food, not drinks. Hiccough. Sour eructations with burning. Empty belchings, as if every particle of food
were turned into gas. Sharp pains in stomach. Nausea, with spasmodic pain in stomach. Vomiting of bile with
violent pain in stomach. Vomiting of first water, thenfood. Vomit tasting salty, oily. Vomiting greasy substances.
Teeth - Gums swollen, red, inflamed, softening, receding from teeth. Gums loose and bleed easily. Absorption
of gums and alveolar processes. Small ash-colored ulcers on gums. Teeth yellow and covered with mucus in
morning.
Temperature - Shaking chilliness, in warm room. Cold chills run up back. Hands, nose, feet icy cold. Cold feet
the whole night. Chill alternating with heat. Flushes of heat all over the body, heat waves to head. Marked
fever, restlessness, red cheeks, apathetic. Hyperpyrexia or external coldness with anxiety or stupor. Hectic
 fever. Internal heat, with coldness of skin. Heat with inclination to uncover.
Throat - Great hoarseness or complete aphonia. Constriction, impeding deglutition. Burning and scraping in
throat. Raw and tickling feeling provoking a dry cough. Uvula swollen. Edema of glottis. Larynx feels
constricted. Pain in larynx. Laryngitis with painful roughness, worse during cough. Child grasps throat when
coughing (Samb.). Croup caused by long-continued damp weather. Ulcers in throat, with swelling of glands
of neck. Enlargement of tonsils and of glands of neck. Submaxillary glands swollen. Hypertrophy of thyroid
gland. Goiter, hard with sensation of constriction. Diphtheria. Rough voice. Voice has a deep, hoarse, rough
sound, becoming continually deeper.
Tongue - Tongue covered with thick brown, leather-like coating. Tongue brown in center, white at edges.
Tongue moist, with mucus streak at sides. Tongue, hypertrophied, painful, nodular or fissured. Sweetish taste
on tip of tongue.
Vertigo - Vertigo, worse from stooping, in warm room. Vertigo on active exertion. Vertigo with throbbing
headache, with throbbing all over body. Rising aggravates, and causes faintness. Confusion in head, with
aversion to earnest work. Very weak and tremulous.
Vision - Obscured vision like a veil before eyes. Optical illusions in bright colors. Small sparks, while sewing.
Flimmering. Diplopia.
COMMENTS - Scrofulous and syphilitic indurations, effusions, tumors and goiters. Affinity for the glands and
thyroid. Hypertrophy of the glands, and emaciation of the body. Hyperthyroidism. Goiters of the thyroid,
exophthalmic goiter (Grave's disease), where the eyes bulge out. Indurated goiters, thyroidcysts, swollen
thyroid. Facial paralysis and epilepsy, following suppression of goiter.
Tumors with keynote hardness and atrophy. Emaciation or enlargement of the glands. Hyperactivity with
swollen glands. Affinity for salivary glands and pancreas, especially when there is a diarrhea of milky, whey-
like stools.
Indurations or atrophy of testes, ovaries and uterus. Ovarian, uterine and cervical cancer. Atrophy of the
breasts. Characteristic one breast larger than the other. Failure to thrive in infants with emaciation and swollen
glands, always hungry. Emaciation of single parts.
Keynote ravenous eating, yet emaciation. Increases or decreases appetite. Severe hypoglycemia. Canine
hunger. Severe ranges of blood sugar, with erratic, manic behavior. Can get violent and angry when hungry.
Burning pains, better eating.
Produces atrophy of nerve and brain tissue, as well as of other tissues. Acute hydrocephalus. Pleuritic
effusions. Tubercular disease, tabes mesenterica, pulmonary tuberculosis, tuberculosis of rapidly-growing
young people, thin and dark.
Pneumonia and tubercular disorders with lung consolidation. Dyspnea, cough with blood-streaked
expectoration, tickling all over chest, weakness and emaciation. Symptoms worse in a warm room. Croup or
for a croupy cough (Spong., Brom.).
Heart disorders. Palpitation from the slightest cause, like lightning. Sensation as if being squeezed.
Hypertrophy. With the heart symptoms there is a “gone,” exhausted feeling and the patient is scarcely able to
breathe or walk.
Excessive weakness. Nervousness, restlessness, twitching, subsultus tendinum. Sense of trembling in inner
parts. Fainting on going upstairs.
Vertigo with throbbing in the head, agitated, vivid dreams and restless sleep. Nocturnal sweat, pulse quick,
small, and hard.
Rheumatism. Growth defects, curvature of bones, in children's ailments (follows Calc. well). Characteristic hot-
bloodedness. Sensitive to heat.
Irritable, cross. Anxious, apprehensive. Extremely restless, hurried, must move about. Tearful and sad. Shuns
persons. Effects of amorousness and disappointed love. Averse to all intellectual labor.
Excessive mental excitement. Panic attacks. Irresistible impulse to run. Feels she will fall if she walks. May be
useful for AIDS when there is psychosis with swollen glands and emaciation. Impulse to murder.
Clarke saw it given with excellent effect in the lower potencies when swollen and deformed joints have been
left behind after an attack of acute rheumatism.
He used it with excellent effect in the case of a young woman who had a nervous shock and had lost all
appetite and desire to live. She was much emaciated and had quietly made up her mind to starve herself to
death.
Clarke gave five drops of lod. 3x in a wineglass of water half an hour before meal-times and her appetite
returned with such vigor she could not choose but eat and was soon restored to a normal mental and bodily
state.
C.    S. McKay noticed lumbrici passed by an infant who had tasted iodine accidentally and used the
 experience in another case, giving a dilute solution (one part of the tincture to three of water of this three drops
every three hours) and produced the expulsion of lumbrici when Sant, had completely failed.
Grimmer wrote that when it is indicated it cures cancer of the breast and uterus.
Nash noted that lod. is one of the remedies affected by the moon's changes. In cases of goiter where it is
indicated, he gave a powder of lod. 100.000c. every night for four nights after the full moon.
RELATIONS - It antidotes: Merc. Follows well: Merc., Hep. (croup), Ars. Followed well by: Arg-n., Calc.,
Merc. Phos., Puls. Complementary: Lyc., Bad. Compare: (1) Thyr., Hep., Merc., Phos. (2) Abrot., Nat-m.,
Sanie., Tub. (3) Brom, has light hair and complexion, lod. dark. (4) Bor. - carrion-like odor ofulcers. (5)Chlor.,
Nat-m. -ravenous appetite yet gets thing - Nat. m. especially about the neck. (6) Kali-i. - talkative as if from
alcohol. (7) Bar-c. - tabes mesenterica, extreme hunger, emaciates, talkative, averse to strangers, Bar-c. suited
to dwarfish persons, has not the intolerable crossness of lod., which is worse than that of Ant-c. (8) Alum. -
apprehensive, fears. (9) Apis - in joint effusions, sensitiveness, hydrocephalus. ( 10) Cact. and Spig. ( 11 )
Hydr. - uterine affections.

name: Ipecacuanha
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ip. Ipecacuanha. Ipec root. Cephaelis ipecacuanha. Psychotria ipecacuanha. Uragoga
ipecacuanha. N. O. Rubiaceae. Tincture and trituration of the dried root. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture
and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Anemia. Anorexia. Asthma. Bronchitis. Catarrh. Chills. Cholera. Cholera, infantum. Colic.
Convulsions. Coughs. Cramps. Cyanosis. Deafness. Diarrhea. Drug, addictions. Drug, poisoning. Dys-
pepsia. Dyspnea. Dysentery. Enteric, fever. Eyes, disorders. Fever. Food, poisoning. Gallstone, colic.
Gastric, ulcer. Gastritis. Gastroenteritis. Hematemesis. Hemorrhages. Hemorrhoids.Hemoptysis. Hysteria.
Indigestion. Intermittent, fever. Menstruation, disorders. Migraine. Miscarriage. Morning, sickness. Nausea.
Nosebleeds. Opium, habit. Opisthotonos. Pityriasis. Pneumonia. Poisonings. Pregnancy, disorders.
Remittent, fever. Salivation. Spasms. Stomach, disorders. Tetanus. Toothache. Tuberculosis. Uterine,
hemorrhage. Vomiting. Whooping, cough. Worm fever. Yellow fever.
HERBAL - Ipecac is likely to be of help wherever ailments are associated with the presence of constant
nausea. Ipecacuanha wine has a well-known emetic effect. Mixed with oil, powdered ipecac has been used to
vesicate the skin and, diluted, the tincture is used for the bites of insects, bee and wasp-stings.
In material doses, it produces violent irritation of the skin and, between the acts of vomiting, an uncontrollable
desire to scratch.
HOMEOPATHIC - Persistent nausea and vomiting. Profuse salivation with nausea. Constant desire to
vomit. Disgust for food, empty vomiting, vomiting of bile or blood. Not better by vomiting. Immediately after
vomiting, instead of relief, there is the desire to vomit again. Characteristic feeling “as if the stomach were
hanging down relaxed.” Tongue is clean, or not very dirty.
Affinity for the pneumo-gastric nerve, producing gastro-intestinal disturbances and respiratory disorders with
continuous nausea. Nausea and shortness of breath usually accompany most of the complaints. Bright red,
gushing hemorrhages with nausea. Discharges are foamy and profuse.
Spasmodic disorders. Opisthotonos and emprosthotonos. Body rigid, stretched out, followed by spasmodic
jerking of arms towards each other. Awkward, stumbles against everything. Tetanic spasms from swallowing
tobacco. Infantile convulsions. Convulsions in whooping cough from suppressed exanthema from indigestible
food.
Oversensitive to heat and cold. Faints suddenly in summer or hot room. Morphine or heroin addiction
(Aven.). Especially indicated in fat children and adults, who are feeble and catch cold in relaxing atmosphere,
warm, moist weather.
MIND - Mental depression. Sad, morose. Dejected mood. Peevish, irritable, scornful mood. Impatient, fretful.
Full of desires, but do not know what they want. Hard to please. Holds everything in contempt. Disgust with
everything. Haughty. Censorious, critical. Intolerance of noise.
Wrapped in thought, taciturn. Moaning and sighing with the fever. Anxiety during fever. Restlessness during
the fever. Awkward and stumbles against everything. Shrieking before convulsions. Child cries and screams
violently and incessantly.
Delusion he is unfortunate. Hypochondriasis. Disposition to slander. Ailments from anger, mortification,
vexation and reserved displeasure. Irascible, restless, angry in suddenly appearing spells.
Abdomen - Cramps with nausea and vomiting. Flatulent colic with frequent loose stools. Colic of children
with diarrhea, restlessness, screaming and tossing about. Cold drinks or ice cream causes colic. Abdominal
 colic after sour or unripe fruit, beer, etc. Clawing pains as from a hand clawing intestines. Cutting pain worse
around the navel. Inguinal hernia. Griping, drawing or cutting pain about the navel. Pinching pain. Sharp pain
from navel to uterus. Diaphragm, as if pressed between two stones.
Back - Tetanic spasms of back which bends the back backwards or forwards. Pain in back, during urination.
Shooting from kidney region into thighs. Cramps between scapulae during motion.
Causations - Ill effects of vexation, reserved displeasure. Injuries, loss of blood, suppressed eruptions.
Morphine, opium and heroin addictions. Quinine. Foodpoison- ing. Indigestible food, rich food, pork, pastry,
fruits, candy, ice cream.
Chest - Constant constriction in chest and larynx, worse least motion. Chest seems full of phlegm, but does
not yield to coughing.
Constitutions - Suited to stout persons of lax tissue, to fair people, to women and children, to emphysematous
persons, to persons who have a history of nosebleed or other blood loss. Indicated in fat children and adults
who are feeble and catch cold in warm wet weather.
Cough - Suffocative, paroxysmal cough. Cough incessant and violent with every breath. Cough with
nausea and vomiting, or vomiting without nausea. Dry cough caused by tickling in upper part of lar-
ynx. Dry, spasmodic cough, after coryza. Cough producing sonorous and bubbling rales. Suffocative,
strangling cough with much mucus accumulated in bronchia. Henjoptysis. Cough with spitting of blood, worse
from least effort. Cough during fever. Whooping cough with nosebleed and bleeding from mouth. Child
becomes stiff and blue or red in face, stiffens out with cough. Cough in teething children. Dry, spasmodic
coughs of elderly persons, coming on in fits.
Ears - Cannot endure the least noise. Coldness and chilliness of the ears, during the fever.
Eyes - Inflamed, red eyes. Red circle around cornea. Yellow sclera. Dilated pupils. Eyes fixed and turned to
right. Conjunctivitis. Ulcers of cornea or conjunctiva. Pustular inflammation of cornea and conjunctiva. Cornea
dim. Profuse, gushing lachrymation with nausea. Shooting pains through the eyeball. Twitching of eyelids. Lids
red and swollen after catching cold. Eyes tire from near vision. Cannot move eyes without nausea. Nausea
from looking at moving objects. Photophobia without redness of eyes. Light, candlelight aggravates.
Face - Puffed or sunken. One side of face hot, the other cold. Pale, blue about the eyes or lips, white linea
nasalis. Redness of the skin around the mouth. Lips blue during chill. Lips covered with small aphthae and
eruptions. Rash in the face. Pityriasis. Periodical orbital neuralgias with some lachrymation, photophobia and
smarting eyelids. Convulsive startings of the muscles of the face.
Female - Menses too early and too profuse. Menses with cramps and constant nausea. Scanty menses
with great weakness. Menses return every two weeks. Prolapsed uterus worse during menses. Great debility
and leucorrhea during intervals of menses. Uterine hemorrhages, profuse, bright red, steady flow or
gushing with nausea and gasping with each gush of blood. Pain from navel to uterus. Cutting pain in uterus
from left to right. Dragging sensation towards uterus
and anus. Nausea and vomiting during pregnancy. Threatened miscarriage, often with sharp or pinching
pain around umbilicus. Hemorrhage following labor or after miscarriage. Hemorrhage from placenta previa.
Arterial bleeding from partial separation of placenta. Laborpains spasmodic, cutting across from left to right
with nausea and clutching about navel. Labor pains running downward.
Food - General loss of appetite as from weakness of stomach. Great disgust and loathing of any sort
offood. No appetite, earthy taste, stomach feels relaxed, nausea. Nausea from smell of food. Violent hunger
when nausea is over. Thirstlessness. No thirst during chill, but much thirst all through fever. Stomach
disordered by rich food, pork, pastry, fruits, candy, ice cream. Food poisoning. Desires or adverse to sweets
and dainty things. Worse cold drinks, black coffee, sour beer, smoking tobacco. Worse from fats, ice cream,
pastry, pork, unripe fruit, salads. Cold drinks or ice-cream causes colic. Cold water worsens spasmodic cough.
Head - Cold sweat on forehead. Heat and throbbing in head, with red cheeks. Aching pain, pressure in
forehead. Throbbing in forehead. Migraine or gastric headaches with nausea and vomiting. Headaches
with nosebleed. Headache as if brain compressed. Bones of skull feel crushed or bruised. Pain, bruised
feeling in brain. Pain in occiput, worse vomiting during chill. Shooting pain in vertex. Pain in the occiput and
the neck. Headache over left eye. Pain extends to teeth and root of tongue. Stinging pain with heaviness of
head. Hydrocephaloid, fontanels open.
Heart - Pain in heart, followed by dryness of mouth and great thirst. Pulse large and soft. Pulse accelerated
but weak, sometimes imperceptible.
Kidneys - Shooting pain from kidney, down the thighs to the knees. Ineffectual urging to urinate. Burning in
urethra during urination. Red, scanty urine. Urine turbid, with red sediment. Hematuria with nausea and cutting
in abdomen and urethra, with oppression in chest and short breath.
Limbs - Pains in limbs during chill. Numbness, as if joints had gone to sleep. Shocks in limbs on falling
 asleep. Body stretched stiff, followed by spasmodic jerking of arms towards each other. Pains as if bruised in
all the bones and joints. Femur as if dislocated on sitting down. Cold hands and feet. Coldness of one hand,
other is hot.
Lungs - Cyanosis. Dyspnea with constant constriction in chest. Attacks of difficult shortness of breathing.
Gasps for air at open window. Difficult expiration. Sighing. Shortness of breath as from inhaling dust.
Suffocative attacks from foreign substance in wind pipe. Threatened suffocation from accumulation of mucus.
Asthma with skin disease. Humid asthma from damp or sudden changes in weather. Spasmodic asthma after
suppressed eruptions. Croup. Bronchopneumonia. Pneumonia. Bubbling rales. Loose, coarse rattle in chest
without expectoration. Suffocative cough, child becomes stiff and blue in the face. Continued sneezing,
coryza, wheezing cough. Bleeding from lungs with nausea, feeling of constriction, rattling cough.
Hemoptysis from slightest exertion (Mill.).
Modalities - Better from open air, rest, pressure, closing eyes, cold drinks. Worse from drugs, morphine.
Worse after overeating, vomiting, lying down, motion. Worse from mixed or rich foods, ice cream, pork, veal,
candy, fruits, berries, raisins, salads, lemon peel. Worse cold, winter, dry weather, warmth, damp, external
heat, periodically. Catarrh, asthma andchill are worse in warm, moist wind. Summer heat or hot room causes
fainting.
Mouth - Mouth moist with much saliva. Saliva increased. Earthy, bitter, sweetish, bloody taste. Smarting pain
in mouth and on tongue. Child thrusts its fists into the mouth and screams during dentition.
Nose - Nosebleed, bright red blood. Nosebleed during cough, headache, every time the patient takes cold.
Coryza with stoppage of nose and nausea. Discharge of thin mucus with cough and expectoration. Sneezing.
Itching of nose. Loss
Ipecacuanha of smell.
Perspiration - Cold, clammy. Hands and feet drip cold sweat. Very profuse sweats, mostly during night.
Sweats with redness of one cheek and paleness of the other. Hot sweats, sudden attacks in room. Sour sweat
with turbid urine. Sweat stains yellow. Profuse perspiration after quinine.
Rectum - Rectal pain so great that it nauseates. Itching at anus. Hemorrhoids bleeding very profusely.
Diarrhea after overloading stomach with sweets or fat pastry. Diarrhea from taking cold, due to chill or from
emotions. Amoebic dysentery with tenesmus, while straining. Dysentery with head hot and cold legs. Cholera
infantum. Beginning cholera infantum, with nausea, vomiting, colic, diarrhea. Autumn diarrhea. Diarrhea of
teething children, yellow, white or green discharges. Worm and parasites.
Skin - Pale, lax. Miliary rash. Erysipelas. Itching, unchanged by scratching. Itching with nausea, scratches until
he vomits. Suppressed rash or eruptions. Delayed eruption in scarlatina. Rash in lying-in women. Herpetic
eruptions.
Sleep - Sleeplessness. Shocks in all limbs on going to sleep (Ign.). Restless, unrefreshing sleep. Eyes half
open during sleep with moaning and groaning. Starting during sleep. Loss of sleep that causes nausea and
fatigue. Frightful dreams, with frequent starts and terror during sleep. Yawning and stretching.
Stomach - Stomach feels relaxed, as if hanging down. Sinking sensation in stomach. Pressing pain in
stomach. Indescribable pain and sick feeling in stomach. Violent clutching and cramping pains. Attacks of
cramps. Dyspepsia. Gastritis, inveterate cases, not even a drop of water will stay down, continuous gagging.
Gastroenteritis. Eructations with rumbling in abdomen. Hiccoughs. Food poisoning. Loss of appetite and
frequent nausea. Horrid nausea, not better vomiting. Nausea, copious salivation, violent itching in the skin
and empty risings. Constant nausea and vomiting with pale, twitching of face. Incessant retching with
vomiting of watery fluids andcutting pain in belly. Vomits blood, bile, food, mucus. grass-green mucus, black
matter like pitch. Hematemesis of children. Bilious vomiting. Vomiting with thirst, sweat, and bad breath.
Nausea and vomiting with menses, cramps, during pregnancy. Nausea from smell of food, from looking
at moving objects, from slightest motion or cough. Retching, especially after drinking anything cold or after
smoking. Constant nausea and retching of hysterical women. Vomiting of infants at the breast. Morning
vomiting in weakly persons who are affected by worms.
Stools - Mucus fetid diarrhea, worse at night. Stools, brown, grass or yellow green, lemon colored. Stools,
painless, fermented frothy or bloody, slimy, pitch-like. Stools covered with red, bloody mucus, or lumps of
mucus. Stools like frothy molasses with griping at navel. Stools spurting out with much flatus. Stools very
offensive, putrid smelling.
Teeth - Teeth chatter, with chill. Toothache, with a jerk radiating to temples, better while eating. Toothache in
a hollow tooth as if it would be torn out.
Temperature - Chill alternating with heat. Short chill with long heat. Internal chill, with external heat. Chill and
much heat, nausea, vomiting, and dyspnea. Chill with nausea, vomiting, great lassitude, weariness,
oppression of the chest. Chills, up and down back. Coldness of upper part of body. Anxious dry heat in evening.
 Heat with or without thirst. Fever with nausea and vomiting. Catarrhal or gastric fevers. Intermittent fever,
irregularcases after quinine. Infantile remittent fever. Suppressed of mixed intermittents, nausea in all stages.
Relapses with improper diet.
Throat - Sore throat, as from swelling of the pharynx. Difficult swallowing, as from paralysis of the tongue and
of the gullet. Fauces, stinging, rough, sore, and dry. Pressure in throat with pains in diaphragm. Deep red color
of tonsils and pharynx. Tickling in upper part of larynx. Croup. Gagging and choking. Spasms of vocal cords.
Spasm of glottis, with
Ipecacuanha blueness of face and coldness of limbs. Spasmodic contractive sensation in the throat.
Hoarseness, especially at end of a cold. Complete aphonia. Voice hollow.
Tongue-Tongue clean, not coated.Tongue. dry, yellow, white, pale. Red, pointed tongue. Tongue coated in
middle, edges red. Flat taste, with white, thickly coated tongue. Smarting pain on tongue.
Vertigo - Vertigo with tottering and staggering. Vertigo when walking, when turning around, during pregnancy.
Vision - Obscuration of vision. State of vision constantly changing. Blue and red halo around light. Optical
illusions in bright colors. Spasm of accommodation from weakness of ciliary muscle.
COMMENTS - The stomach disgust of the remedy is depicted on the countenance, which expresses nausea.
Sickly, disgusted appearance. The corners of the mouth are drawn down. Blue rings around the eyes.
Deathly nausea (Tab.). Constant nausea, not ameliorated by vomiting. Can vomit blood. Salivation and
vomiting of white, stringy mucus. Vomiting can lead to shudders with a chill, severe spasms, convulsions. Can
be sleepy after vomiting.
Desire for fresh air, thirstless while nauseas (Puls.).Any condition with concomitant nausea and vomiting.
Vomiting after pregnancy. Sensation as if the stomach is hanging down (Sep.).
Corresponding mental state, “moroseness and contempt for everything,” “disdainful humor.” Irritability in adults,
crying and screaminginchildren. Restless and exhausted (Ars.). Disgust. Sensitiveness (Chin.), over sensitive
to heat and cold. Better by touch.
Exhaustion and an achy, bruised feeling. Sore pain in the shoulder blades. Bone pains in the head and
elsewhere. Pains as if bones were all tom to pieces. Keynote cutting pains in the left side of the abdomen over
to the right. Peripheral neuritis. Generally a left sided remedy.
Intermittent headaches. Migraine headaches. Bruised feeling, severe prostration. Headache “as if bruised, all
through the bones of the head and down into the root of the tongue.” Pain extending to roots of
teeth.
Headache with nausea. Gastric headache, originating in the stomach, nausea precedes the headache and
persists throughout. Desire to lie perfectly still. Meningitis with vomiting and a high fever. Tetanus, lockjaw with
severe spasms and retching.
Marked periodic action. Intermittent fevers (Eup-per.). Characteristic nausea through all the stages. Stages
can be completely mixed up, short chill, followed by long fever. Can have a pain in the upper back between
the shoulder blades with fever (Gel. has a chill).
Violent dyspnea with wheezing and great weight and anxiety about the précordia. Threatened suffocation from
accumulation of mucus. Loss of breath, pale, stiff and blue. Strangling with gagging and vomiting of mucus,
bleeding from nose or mouth. Coughing up mucus, gagging. Must stand by the window to get oxygen. Worse
damp weather and changes in weather.
Pneumonia and bronchitis with severe shortness of breath with rattling mucus (Ant-t.). For bronchitis in infants
with coarse rattling in the chest. Concomitant respiratory and gastric symptoms. For emphysema in theelderly.
Suffocative respiration (Spong.), but wet.
Asthma with a breathless feeling, nausea and vomiting, with thick, yellow mucus (Lob., Ars., Ant-t., Ant-c.).
Dry, spasmodic, constricted, asthmatic cough. Whooping cough. Characteristic spasmodic rigidity in whooping
cough.
Sub-acute inflammation of the cornea with intense pain. Pustular conjunctivitis, especially in children.
Inflammation with tearing pain and gushing of tears. Photophobia. Violent neuralgia of eyeballs, shooting in
the head with gushes of tears, nausea, etc.
Hemorrhage with bright, red blood (Phos.). Gushing blood, with sinking feeling and nausea (Ferr. is weak and
flushed with gushing). Nosebleeds with a sensation of nausea and sinking, or nosebleeds from coughing and
sneezing attacks.
Uterine hemorrhage. Threatened miscarriage, with a sharp pain around the umbilicus, running downward to
the uterus. Miscarriage due to spasmodic vomiting. Spotting blood before contractions. Hemorrhage after
childbirth with bright red blood, nausea, disgust and weakness.
Metrorrhagia after confinement with a low pulse, nausea. Steady flow of bright red blood, which may soak
through the bed to the floor or may run over the foot of the bed. Constant nausea and discharge of blood before
 the proper period. Menstrual cramps with nausea and vomiting, must lie still in bed. Copious menses.
Bloody diarrhea associated with nausea and vomiting. Constant urge to stool, tenesmus. Stools can be bloody,
burning, offensive, watery. Severe colic that is associated with dysentery. Suppressed skin eruptions that go
to the stomach and bowels and cause severe colic.
Stomach symptoms worse from ice cream, pork, and rich, fatty foods (Puls.). Bad taste in the mouth. The
thought, smell or idea of food causes patient to gag and choke. Anorexia.
Heroin withdrawal symptoms. J. R. Haynes used Ip. as an antidote to the opium and morphine addiction. He
gave five drops of Ip. tincture for every grain of morphine, or its equivalent in heroin or opium, which the patient
has been accustomed to take.
Jahr recommended that in all cases of intermittents in which no other remedy is particularly indicated Ip. should
be given. It will either cure the case or bring out more indications for another remedy.
Clarke frequently found this advice useful. As most intermittents have been treated with quinine, it is thought
the antidotal properties of Ip. may have good effects.
Allen noted that Ip. dilutions have helped granulations of the eyelids.
Cooper cured an immense uterine fibroid with persistent painful irritation of the skin. There was constant
retching and vomiting, made worse by eating. Vaginal irritation with thick leucorrhea and a feeling of
desperation.
Dr. Nancy T. Williams cured several cases of gallstone colic on the symptom “external chilliness with internal
heat,” with Ip. 6c. The relief was prompt and lasting.
Dr. Edwin Muskett noted its specific use for malignant pustule and anthrax, used locally and internally.
Hahnemann considered it a short-acting medicine.
RELATIONS-Antidotedby: Am., Ars., Chin., Copperfumes. Dulc., Ferr., Laur., Op.. Sul-ac., Tab., Ant-t.
Compare: ( 1 ) Lob., Emetin., Ars., Tab., Cham., Puls., Ant-t., Squil, Conv. - colic and diarrhea. (2) In asthma,
Lob., Blatta. (3) Typh. - dysentery, diarrhea and summer complaint. (4) Euph-hy. - very similar to Ipecac.
Irritation of the respiratory and gastro-intestinal tracts and female organs. (5) Lip. - persistent dry. hard,
bronchial cough-asthmaand chronic bronchitis. Complementary: Cupr., Am.

name: Ipomoea Purpurea
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ipom. Ipomoea purpurea. Morning glory. Convolvulus duartinus. Bind-weed. N. O.
Convulvulaceae, family. The mother tincture is prepared from the dried bark. Historical dose: Tincture and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Anorexia. Backache. Bilious, vomiting. Catatonia.Cholecystitis. Delirium. Epilepsy. Fever.
Flatulence. Headache. Insomnia. Jaundice. Kidney, colic. Kidney, disorders. Worms.
HOMEOPATHIC - Ipomoea is used solely as a drastic purgative in allopathic medicine; not one homeopathic
treatise mentions it as a remedy for constipation.
Castro carried out a proving in 1940, using the potencies lx, 2x, 3x, at the rate of 1-200 drops per day in
progressive doses.
Symptoms included fever, agitation and mental confusion. Delirium with hallucinations, excitability, and
mumbling. Predominant irritation of the brain. Epilepsy. Catatonia. Insomnia and delirious dreams.
Neuromuscular and arthritic pains. Aching in top of right shoulder, in small of back
Ipomoea purpurea and limbs. Pain in left lumbar muscles on stooping. Kidney disorders with pain in back.
Kidney colic. Much abdominal flatulence. Bilious vomiting.
MIND - Desire for solitude. Sadness, tears, hypersensitive to noise. Intense anxiety with palpitations.
Prostration. Loss of memory. Delirious dreams. Nocturnal terror in children, especially in the worm-ridden.
Abdomen - Abdomen distended. Sharp cutting pain in abdomen above umbilicus. Rumbling and grumbling in
epigastric region and lower bowels. Rumbling of flatus with pain in the colon. Sensation of heat in the
epigastrium before passing stools. Cholecystitis. Biliary sycosis syndrome.
Back - Heaviness of the back and neck, aggravated at night, on going to bed. Pain, aching in lumbar region.
Pain in first dorsal vertebrae. Itching over left scapula.
Chest - Thoracic spasms. Feeling of laryngeal and pectoral constriction.
Constitutions - Suited to neuro-bilious, hypersensitive types, prone to epileptiform fits. Useful for phospho-
fluoric types, syphilitic.
Ears - Buzzing noise in ears.
Eyes - Smarting pain in eyes. Itching of internal canthus of left eye. Pupils dilated.
Food - Anorexia. Aggravated by and aversion to fatty foods, meat and milk.
 Head - Great heaviness of head. Headache first in right, then in left temple. Headache with a unilateral
perspiration. Itching of scalp.
Heart - Palpitations with anxiety and hysterical spasms. Pulse accelerated with extra systole.
Kidneys - Severe pain in left kidney with nausea and occasional vomiting. Kidney pain spreading towards
the left ureter. Kidney stones. Kidney disorders or gravel with pain in back. Kidney colic, predominantly on
the left side.
Limbs - Limbs cold, sweating, heavy. Joints painful. Muscular spasms with fatigue. Pain in the left lumbar
muscles on bending down. Aching in top of right shoulder. Pain in left shoulder and arm.
Lungs - Irregular breathing. Disposition to cough with sneezing.
Modalities - Better from lying down. Worse in the morning, at night, from fatty foods.
Mouth - Mouth discolored, with a bad taste. Feeling of swallowing his tongue.
Nose - Smarting and dryness in nostrils. Purulent discharge from nose. Very acute sense of smell.
Rectum - Rectal tenesmus. Stools soft, orange-yellow in color.
Skin - Skin discolored, yellow, dry, despite cold sweating. Viral jaundice.
Sleep - Nocturnal aggravation, forcing him to get up.
Stomach - Acrid dyspepsia. Hiccoughs, thirsty for cold water. Yellow-green vomiting.
Temperature - Chilliness alternating with backache. Flushes of heat, followed by copious sweat. General fever
with total insomnia, cold sweats and contracture of the jaw muscles.
Throat - Pain in left tonsil. Throat dry, constant need to swallow, but swallowing difficult.
Vertigo - Vertigo with nausea, ameliorated by lying down.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1 ) Cresol. (2) Stram. - hallucinations, delirium with talkativeness. (3) Hyos. -
delirium, strips himself. (4) Agar. - muscular jerks in the lower limbs. (5) Nux- v. - abdominal distention,
neuromuscular over excitability.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Julian.

name: Iridium Metallicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-irid. Iridiummetallicum. Iridium metal. At. Wt. 193.10. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and
all potencies.
CLINICAL - Abscesses. Amenorrhea. Anemia. Axilla, abscess. Bronchitis. Cancer. Cerebral, hemorrhage.
Cramps. Eczema. Epilepsy. Exhaustion. Gout. Headache. Heart, disorders. Hemiplegia. Lupus. Multiple
sclerosis. Nephritis. Neuralgias. Numbness. Paralysis. Parkinson's disease. Rheumatism. Septicemia. Spinal,
paresis.
Trembling. Urticaria. Uterine, tumors. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Iridium is a rare metal of the platinum group, found in platinum ore. It is one of the heaviest
known substances. It shares with Osm., Pall, and Plat, a place in the treatment of rheumatism and gout.
Boring, contracting pains. Sensations of being swollen, blown up, heavy, full. Shocks and twitching. Epilepsy,
clonic, tonic, tetanic. Spinal paresis. Numbness and paralysis. Trembling. Parkinson's disease. Multiple
sclerosis. Lupus.
Anemia with decreased red corpuscles. Exhaustion after disease. Weakness, nervousness and
restlessness. Weakness after influenza. Cerebral hemorrhage. Congestion of blood. Affections of bones,
necrosis and inflammation. Abscesses. Septicemia. Intestinal putrefaction. Trypanosoma infections.
Glands swollen, inflamed, indurated. Problems with testes and ovaries, inflammations, cancer, cryptorchism.
Uterine tumors. Sterility, amenorrhea, metrorrhagia. Nephritis of pregnancy. Children who are puny, weak-
limbs and grow too fast.
MIND - Facilitates mental labor. Forgetful. Difficult concentration. Sensation as if mind were void. Confusion,
loses his way in well-known streets. Feeling of self confidence.
Anxiety on waking, as if something bad is going to happen. Clinging to persons. Bites nails. Averse to being
disturbed. Irritability from noise. Weeping after anger. Sadness, better walking in open air.
Abdomen - Dragging pain as if menses would come in abdomen.
Back - Spinal paresis, especially for the aged and after disease. Weariness in back and limbs. Weakness of
cervical region, as if it could not support weight of head.
Breasts - Piercing, gnawing pains in breasts.
Chest - Sensation of iron band around chest.
Ears - Feeling of numbness in ears and throughout the body lasting a short time. Heat of ears when lying
down. Sounds seem distant.
Eyes - Eyes red, heavy. Eye inflammations. Itching in morning on waking. Desire to close the eyes. Feeling
 as if eyes were being affected from below upward. Ingrown eyelashes. Far sighted. Visual disturbances.
Face - Face swollen. Sensation of swelling in morning on rising. Sensation of elongation of left side of face.
Numbness of lips. Stinging pain in the left malar bone. Pain, pressure in right malar bone. Animated expression.
Female - Swelling of ovaries without dropsy. Corroding and suppurating ulcers of uterus, bluish patches on
uterus. Uterine tumors with suppuration. Sterility. Amenorrhea, metrorrhagia.
Food - Desire for carbonated drinks. Aversion to brown bread. Worse from cold drinks, oranges.
Head - Right side of scalp sensitive. “Wooden” feeling in right side of head. Heaviness of head like liquid lead.
Swashing sensation. Numbness in occiput. Pains in middle of occipital bone. Open air and noise seem to
bruise the head. Pain, like cold metal pressing across forehead. Neuralgia of head especially temples, drives
one crazy.
Heart - High blood pressure. Heart weakness, infarction. Heart failure, pain. Pulse, too fast, too slow, full,
weak, irregular. Sensation as if an iron rod is standing straight in the heart region.
Kidneys - Weakness in kidney region. Nephritis during pregnancy.
Limbs - Neuralgia of the limbs. Dislocated feeling in left hip joint and dull pain toward left gluteal region.
Pressing in groin and left thigh. Tension in both thighs, especially left. Achilles tendon painful, aggravated by
walking. Achilles tendon torn from jumping.
Lungs - Difficulty breathing deeply. Short of breath, aggravated from climbing the stairs. Hoarse cough, worse
talking. Profuse, thick, yellowish discharge. Chronic laryngeal catarrh.
Mouth - Increased saliva, with sensation in malar bones, which is more perceptible on left side. One-sided
white discoloration of tongue.
Stomach - Cramps in stomach.
Nose - Posterior sinuses feel raw inflamed. Bridge of nose painful, feels too narrow. Profuse, watery coryza,
better indoors. Ozaena. Profuse, thick, yellowish discharge.
Vision - Colors look brighter. Everything looks golden. Zigzags, in shape of circle.
COMMENTS - A. J. Tafel took 20 grains of the 3c trituration. He experienced a number of symptoms, all within
two hours of taking the dose.
Prominent among them were a sensation of numbness in ears and throughout the body. A feeling as if they
eyes were being affected from below upward. A feeling as of a triangle in face, the based formed by the two
malar bones, the apex in the vertex. Cramp-like contractions in the right calf. The majority of symptoms
appeared on the left side.
Laboucher said it is “admirable in all cases of anemia.” He claimed it was better than Chin, for the aged and
persons exhausted by disease, for puny, weak-limbed children and for those who grow too fast. He mentioned
a particular alternation of symptoms or reaction. Painful weakness of lower limbs and kidney region, followed
by a favorable reaction, self confidence and facilitated mental labor.
Laboucher gave Irid. in the 4c potency, Pall, in the 3c, Plat, in 2c and Osm. in the 1c. He said Irid. is superior
to Pall., Plat, and to Osm. in uterine tumors.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Plat, Pall., Osm.. (2) In uterine diseases, Aur. and Aur-mur. (3) In exhaustion
after disease, Chin. Irid-m.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

author: Murphy

PHARMACY - iris-fl. Iris florentina. Orris root. White flag. N. O. Iridaceae. Tincture of fresh rhizome. Historical

HOMEOPATHIC - Iris-fl. gives an odor of violets to the breath and communicates to vinegar a flavor of
raspberries, hence is used in the manufacture of raspberry vinegar.
Powdered orris root has been used as an application to the hair and in some young girls has produced violent
 symptoms.
Headaches and giddiness occurred on waking in the morning. Complete paralysis of the right side. In one
case, convulsions and delirium from which complete recovery did not take place for three months.
1ELATIONS - Compare: (1) Verat., Sabad., Iris.
REFERENCES Clarke.

name: Iris Tenax
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - iris-t. Iris tenax. Iris minor. N. O. Iridaceae. Oregon. Tincture of the lower or bulbous stems.
Tincture of the whole plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Appendicitis. Fever. Headache. Homesickness. Ileo-cecal, pain. Intermittents. Mania. Peri-
typhlitis. Sleeplessness. Stomatitis. Vomiting. Xerostoma.
HERBAL - The herb Iris tenax “grows very luxuriantly in the clay ground and on the hillsides of Oregon.” The
tissue of the plant is so strong that it was used by Nati ve Americans for making cord and weaving into bags,
etc.
HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. George Wigg of Portland, Oregon proved Iris-t. in the later part of 1885. He published
the proving under the name of Iris minor. This, as Heath later showed, is a local name only, its true botanical
name is Iris tenax.
Dr. Wigg particularly noted the absence of saliva with dry mouth. Burning in eyes without tears. Pain in one
tooth only. Itching and burning of scalp without eruption. Chill at 2 p.m. Painful spot in ileo-cecal region.
Bilious vomiting, burning sensations (Iris.). Deathly sensation at point of stomach. Appendicitis. Gloomy, cast-
down, homesick feeling.
MIND - Gloomy, cast-down, homesick feeling.
Abdomen - Appendicitis. Pain in ileo-cecal region. Pains from adhesions after surgery.
Modalities - Sweet oil and camphor ameliorates burning in mouth and throat. Worse by sucking in cold air,
(burning in mouth and throat). Hot applications aggravates pain in bowels. Cup of tea aggravates vomiting.
Worse on waking.
COMMENTS - Dr. Wigg, age 44, took 5 drops to lx of the strong tincture. A female prover took repeated doses
of Iris-t. 2x and 3x. The order in which the symptoms occurred in Dr. Wigg's case is roughly as follows:
In the first fifteen minutes, there was burning in the mouth and throat. This passed off in the night, but was
intensified by each fresh dose. After the second dose, taken early the next morning, the burning was
reproduced, followed two hours later by dry mouth and absence of saliva.
This was followed by a mental gloom and homesick feeling, increasing towards midnight. Headache in temples.
Itching and burning of the scalp. Toothache. Sinking, all gone feeling. Abdominal pains, diarrhea. Desperate
exhaustion compelling him to keep in bed. Hard chill followed by rise of temperature.
 Wigg noticed the all-gone feeling particularly on standing up, on walking in the morning. Cold water did not
improve the burning in mouth and throat. A cold pillow improved pain in the temples.
The acute pains in the bowels passed off in the night, but for fourteen days there was a tender spot over the
ileo-cecal region and the bowels did not act normally for ten days.
In the female prover, it produced a strange
sensation in her mind: she though some of her friends had died, the next day she was unusually cheerful.
The most remarkable symptoms were the “fearful pain in the ileo-cecal region and the hard chill at 2 p.m.”
These indications led to the cure in the two following cases:
The first case concerned Miss A., a schoolteacher, who had for several years a pain beginning in right eye,
extending to the right half of her head. When the pain was most severe, she vomited a quantity of green bile.
When she did not vomit she had nausea and chill between 2 and 3 p.m. The pain passed off in sleep at night.
It always began on Saturday, before rising.
Iris-t. 30x every six hours commencing on Friday morning, was given and quickly cured after Iris., Aloe, Cimic.
and Kali-bi. had failed to give much relief. The relief from Iris-t. was so marked the patient thought she had
received morphine.
The second case concerned Mr. E., who drank a large quantity of buttermilk while in a state of perspiration
after walking thirty miles over a mountainous country in August. Four hours after, he was taken with fearful
pain in ileo-cecal region. This caused a deathly sensation at his epigastrium. Finally he vomited much dark
green bile without relief.
An old school doctor was called in and diagnosed obstruction with probable death in four days. He lingered
three weeks and was brought home to Portland where Dr. Wigg saw him and diagnosed typhilitis, badly treated.
Pressure on the ileo-cecal region caused the death like sensation at stomach pit. Pain continued until he
vomited a cupful of dark green bile. He was somewhat constipated.
Under Iris-t. 15x every three hours he commenced to improve at once and in two weeks was back at his
business.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Effect on cecal region - Am., Ars., Lach., Sil. (2) Headache - Gels., Grat., Iris.,
Kali-bi., Ign. (3) Burning not worse by cold, Caps. (4) Homesickness - Caps., Ph-ac.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Iris Versicolor
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-iris. Iris versicolor. Blue flag. Iris hexona. N. O. Iridaceae. Tincture of fresh root collected in early
spring or autumn. Trituration of the resinoid. Irin or Irisin. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Cholera. Colic. Diabetes. Goiter. Headaches. Indigestion. Leucorrhea. Migraines. Morning
sickness. Nausea. Neuralgia. Pancreas, disorders. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Thyroid, disorders. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Sick headaches. Gastric or hepatic sick headaches with blur before the eyes at the
beginning. Migraine headaches.
Great nausea and vomiting. Vomiting sour or bitter substances, excoriates the throat. Vomiting of stringy,
glairy, ropy mucus, hangs in strings down to receptacle on the floor.
Burning of mouth, tongue, and throat, can go into stomach, even the anus if there is diarrhea. Affinity for the
digestive tract, gastro-intestinal mucus membranes, thyroid, pancreas, and salivary glands.
Liver and pancreas affected, producing profuse secretions, which are sour, acrid and burning. Increases the
flow of bile. Oily nose, greasy taste and fatty stools. Cholera infantum and cholera morbus. Symptoms set in
suddenly, with a rapid elimination.
MIND - Mental depression. Despondency. Low- spirited. Dullness of mental faculties. Weak memory. Inability
to fix the mind on any subject. Wandering thoughts while writing. Muttering. Laughs at own actions.
Ill humor. Censorious. Easily vexed. Irritable mood, disposed to find fault, particularly in morning.
Restlessness at night. Nervous fretfulness. General appearance of anguish. Fear of approaching illness.
Abdomen - Cutting pain. Burning in epigastric region, with tenderness, vomiting of food. Awful burning
in region ofpancreas. Sharp griping pains in the bowels. Flatulent colic. Colicky pain before each spell of
vomiting and purging. Colic, better by bending forward, better by discharge
of flatulence. Pain in the abdomen, better by discharge of flatus.
Back - Stiffness in the back, increasing on sitting down. Crampy, in right lumbar region.
Chest - Rheumatism in muscles of chest, with acid indigestion. Cutting pain in left side as if ribs were pressing
against lung.
Cough - Dry cough caused by tickling in larynx with a dry, smarting or burning sensation in throat.
 Ears - Roaring, buzzing. Ringing in ears with deafness. Aural vertigo with intense noises in ears.
Eyes - Sunken with blue circles. Redness of conjunctiva. Inflammation of eyelids, from cold. Burning in internal
canthus. Violent supra-orbital pains. Periodic visual disturbances, blindness, hemiopia. with headache.
Face - General appearance of anguish. Pustular eruptions on face, around nose, lips and cheeks, secreting a
bloody, irritating matter. Dry, cracked lips. Neuralgia after breakfast, beginning in infra-orbital nerve and
involving whole face. Neuralgic pains in right side of face.
Female - Neuralgia and rheumatism of uterus. Menses regular, but excessive. Leucorrhea. Morning sickness
of pregnancy, vomits sour or bitter, with protracted nausea, profuse ropy saliva, tenderness over stomach.
Food - Hunger with inability to eat. Loss of taste and appetite. Bitter, putrid taste. Nausea and empty belchings,
from irregularities of diet. Chronic indigestion of milk. Intense and urgent thirst during diarrhea.
Head - Dullness of the head. Chronic pain in forehead. Dull throbbing or shooting pains in right side of
forehead. Tired headache from mental exhaustion (studying, sewing), worse coughing, cold air, better gentle
motion. Headache begins with blurring of vision, after relaxing from a mental strain. Frontal headache over
left eye with nausea. Headache alternating sides. Headache as if a band around head. Severe pains,
through temples and over
eyes, with vertigo, nausea and vomiting. Shooting pain in temples with contractive feeling of the scalp. Scalp
feels constricted. Sick headaches with diarrhea, in bilious subjects, worse rest, begins with a blur before eyes.
Reflex headache from acid stomach or irritation of stomach from acid secretion. Neuralgic pain usually
begins over one eye. Neuralgic pain, one-sided, with gastric symptoms. Right temples affected. Pustular
eruption on scalp. Scabs, yellow matter oozing from under crust, with matted hair.
Heart - Accelerated pulse.
Kidneys - Burning along the length of urethra after urination. Cutting and pricking pain in urethra while
urinating. Urine very high colored and scanty. Profuse, clear urine with headache. Diabetes.
Limbs - Sharp tearing, shifting, in joints. Shooting, laming pains along limb. Sciatica, as if left hip joint were
wrenched. Pain extends to popliteal space. Gonorrheal rheumatism.
Liver - Liver sore. Pain in the region of the liver, worse from motion.
Male - Coldness and itching of parts. Coldness and relaxation of scrotum. Excitement of genitals reflex from
excessively acid stomach. Nocturnal emissions with amorous dreams. Secondary gonorrhea or gleet.
Modalities - Better from gentle, continued motion. Worse in evening, night, after midnight, 2 a.m. to 3 a.m.
Worse from mental exhaustion, rest, hot weather. Worse periodically, weekly, spring and autumn.
Mouth - Burning in mouth and fauces as if on fire. Feels greasy, burnt or scalded. Stomatitis, with burning pain
in mouth and fauces. Tongue burns or feels cold. Greasy or sweetish taste. Flat taste. Loss of taste. Profuse
flow of saliva (Merc., IP., Kali-i.).Ropy saliva, drops when talking. Profuse salivation during headache.
Salivation after diphtheria, with swelling of parotids. Saliva tastes greasy, slimy. Mouth and tongue feel
scalded. Slight toothache in a warm room. Ulcers on mucus membranes of cheeks.
Nose - Oily. Constant sneezing.
Perspiration - Perspiration over the whole body, but principally in the hypochondria. Sweat smells of vinegar.
Sleep - Sleeplessness. Starting in sleep.
Stools - Stools watery, with burning at anus and through intestinal canal. Stools, bilious, acrid, watery, burn
like fire. Stools thin, tinged with bile, copious, in a continuous stream. Stools, green, undigested, mushy, pappy
with fetid flatus. Stools, fatty, fetid or coppery smelling.
Rectum - Acute mucus enteritis. Constipation with gastric derangement. Constipation succeeded by thin,
watery diarrhea. Sudden attacks of diarrhea. Painless cholera morbus. Periodical night diarrhea with pain
and green discharges. Summer diarrhea occurring in hottest part of season. Urging to stools with headache,
facial neuralgia and pain in teeth. Burning at anus during stool. Burning after stool. Anus feels sore as if sharp
points sticking in it. Distressed feeling as if rectum is prolapsed. Hemorrhoids.
Skin - Great itching at night. Fine eruption, showing black points after scratching. Eczema with nightly itching.
Herpes zoster and gastric derangements. Psoriasis, irregular patches with shining scales. Psoriasis on knees,
elbows and body. Pustular eruptions on scalp and face, around mouth.
Stomach - Burning of whole alimentary canal, not better by cold drinks. Burning distress in stomach and
pancreas, with watery diarrhea and great prostration. Sour, bitter belchings. Continuous nausea. Nausea
from riding, overexertion. Vomiting with burningpain. Vomiting of sweetish water, sour, bloody, bile. Bitter,
acrid, watery, sour vomiting. Vomiting during headache. Periodic vomiting spells, every month, six weeks,
lasts for two or three days. Protracted nausea and vomiting during pregnancy. Vomiting of sour milk in children.
Temperature - Chills with sleepiness. Chilliness during the whole night. Chills over whole body, even when
well covered. Head and face cold. Fever followed by
chill, with cold hands and feet. Bilious and typhoid fevers. Fever with muttering delirium and bilious diarrhea.
 Throat - Heat and smarting in throat. Burning from fauces to stomach, better inhaling cool air or drinking cold
water. Shooting pains in tonsils extends to ears. Vomit excoriates throat. Thyroid disorders. Goiter.
Vertigo - Aural vertigo with intense noises in ears. Immediate dizziness with pressure in forehead. Slight
giddiness, coming on suddenly while walking within doors.
COMMENTS - Migraine headaches, worse on the left side, over the left eye (Thuj.. Anae.). Sick headaches,
associated with dietary allergies. Sensation of a nail over the left eye, pain as if being driven into supraorbital
arch (Thuj., Sang, on right). Constipation preceding the migraine (Bry.). Buzzing and ringing in the ears
associated with the headaches.
Affinity for the pancreas (Spong., Con., Phos.). Diabetes. Characteristic burning. Stomach troubles
accompanied by burning of tongue, throat, esophagus and stomach, and burning of the anus if diarrhea is
present.
Nausea and vomiting, loss of appetite, constipation. The vomiting is not always sour, but may be bitter or
sweetish. Profuse saliva. Vomit or saliva may be white, stringy, or ropy (Ip.).
Nash once had a case of stomach trouble in a middle-aged woman. She had frequent attacks, vomiting a
stringy, glairy mucus which was very ropy. The vomit would hang in strings from her mouth to the receptacle
on the floor.
Then the vomit became dark colored, like coffee, she became very weak, vomited all nourishment. She al so
had profuse secretion of ropy saliva.
Thinking she had cancer of the stomach, she made her will and set her house in order to die. Kali-bi. was given
with no benefit, but Iris cured her completely in a short time and she remained well.
RELATIONS -Antidote: Nux-v. Compare: ( 1 ) Iris-fl. - delirium, convulsions and paralysis. (2) Iris-fa. -
headache and hernia. (3) Iris-g. - Blue Garden Iris - dropsy and freckles. (4) Pancreat. (5) Pep. (6) Ip., Podo.,
Sanguin., Ars., Ant-c.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Nash. Murphy. Phatak.
keynote:

CLINICAL - Cholera. Colic. Diabetes. Goiter. Headaches. Indigestion. Leucorrhea. Migraines. Morning
sickness. Nausea. Neuralgia. Pancreas, disorders. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Thyroid, disorders. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Sick headaches. Gastric or hepatic sick headache

name: Itu
author: Murphy
full:

potencies.
CLINICAL - Ears, noises. Hernia. Muscae, volitantes. Stiff-neck. Toothache. Vulvitis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Itu is one of the remedies proved by Mure. All he tells about the source of it is that “This
resin, which comes to us from the province of St. Paul is used empirically for hernia.”
Symptoms include a sudden report in the ear, with frightful pain extending to teeth for several minutes,
repeated as many as eight times in a day, profuse sweat after the reports. Earache when the least dampness
sets in. Toothache worse after a cold drink. Chilliness at hypogastrium, especially in evening.
