name: Kali Arsenicosum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - kali-ar. Kali arsenicosum. Potassium arsenite. Fowler's solution (the form in which Kali-ar. has
been tested, consists of 1 part arsenious acid, 1 part carbonate of potash, 3 parts compound tincture of
lavender, and 95 parts distilled water). Dilutions should be made from this. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL-Anxiety, attacks.Asthma. Bright's disease. Cancer. Deafness. Diarrhea. Dropsy Eczema.
Emaciation. Epithelioma. Exoph- thalmus. Eye, disorders. Faintness. Herpes, zoster. Jealousy. Measles.
Melancholy. Miliary, rash. Lung, disorders. Neuralgias. Neurasthenia. Palpitations. Panic, attacks.
Psoriasis. Skin, disorders. Tongue, neuralgia. Tremors. Varicose, veins. Ulcers.
HOMEOPATHIC - It is not possible to separate entirely the pathogenesis of Kali-ar. and Ars. Kali-ar. is the
favorite form in which arsenic is prescribed by the allopaths, consequently the bulk of observations from over-
dosing are due to this preparation, named Liquor arsenicalis, considered arsenic and nothing else.
Much of our knowledge relating to this remedy comes to us from the effects of overdosing and protracted use
of the medicine on patients suffering from chronic skin and blood diseases. The arsenic symptoms
predominate.
Epithelioma developed in a patient after prolonged treatment with allopathic Kali-ar. for psoriasis.
During treatment for right-sided herpes, patients noted color changes in their eyes and skin. Sclerotics became
thick and yellow instead of clear and bluish. The iris, which was blue, became gray. Skin, instead of being fair
and florid, became muddy and older looking.
Tendency towards anxiety and skin diseases. Restless, nervous. Great weakness. Emaciation, anemia.
Faintness. Neurasthenia. Chilly and sensitive to cold. Cannot get too warm even in summer. Tremors.
Sudden noise or touch throws the whole body into a tremor.
Inveterate skin diseases, malignant tendency. Intolerable itching, worse undressing, walking, warmth. Chronic
eczema. Psoriasis. Herpes zoster, measles, miliary rash. Epithelioma. Numerous small nodules under the
skin. Gouty nodosities. Rheumatic, gouty and syphilitic pains. Varicose veins. Dropsy.
Cauliflower-like excrescences of os uterus with flying pains, foul smelling discharges and pressure below the
pelvis. Black leg ulcer running bloody, foul water with cutting, burning, itching and dyspnea. Phagedenic ulcers,
 deep base and turned up edges.
Burning in throat. The tongue burns, numb. Tongue neuralgia. Exophthalmos, eye affections. Deafness.
Aching in stomach. Passes much gas, then diarrhea. Bright's disease. Palpitations with nephritis. All the
sufferings are worse at night.
MIND - Morose and quarrelsome. Scolding, retired and discontented. Jealous. Anguish. Face looks frightened
and anxious. Startled, fixed look, protruding brilliant eyes. Anxiety and panic attacks. Anxiety about health.
Anxiety on going to bed. Anxiety with difficult breathing. Hysteria.
Fears felt in the stomach. Fear of getting a life threatening disease, of high blood pressure. of having a
stroke, of heart disease, of getting cancer. Fear in a crowd, of being alone, of death, dying, of being murdered,
poisoned. Fear of thieves, burglars, at night, of evil. Fear that something bad will happen. Superstitious.
Mental and physical restlessness. Excitable. Great nervousness. Oversensitive to noise, especially to
voices. Starting from noises. Timidity. Capriciousness. Concentration difficult. Confusion. Weak memory.
Depression, melancholy. Sadness when alone. Despair of recovery. Suicidal disposition. Apathy. Indifferent to
everything, scarcely answered questions addressed to her or replies to them in a peevish tone. Aversion to
answering questions. Behaves like amad person. Delusion head is enlarged. Sudden impulse to kill.
Abdomen - Burning pain in bowels, unquenchable thirst, belly tense and painful involuntary watery stools with
sense as if a red-hot iron were in anus. Frequent griping pains in bowels and constant desire for stool,
considerable tenderness in whole abdomen, which is distended.
Back - Backache with sciatica, worse pressure. Much pain and tenderness down spine.
Ears - Otorrhea. Ear discharge bloody, fetid and yellow.
Eyes - Startled look with protruding, brilliant eyes, pale face and sunken cheeks. Eyes red. Whites of eyes
look thick and yellow. Jaundice. The blue iris becomes gray. Dark discoloration around orbit. Inflamed, itching
of conjunctiva. Conjunctiva glassy. Right eye weaker, watery, as after weeping. Swollen lower eyelids. Heat
and itchiness of lids, followed by swelling and tenderness. Eye sensitive to light.
Face - Face pale and waxy. Complexion muddy. Puffy under eyes. Old looking. Nodular eruption on face,
boils. Furfura- ceous eruption on beard.
Female - Cauliflower excrescences of uterine cervix with flying pains, foul smelling discharge and pressure
below pubis. Menses absent. Milk entirely arrested.
Food - Appetite lost. Aversion to fat, meat. Intense thirst. Drinks in small sips. Desires sweet, sour, vinegar,
fruits, lemon, refreshing food. Desires mustard, spices, milk, coffee, warm food, fat. Worse from milk, ice
cream, sour, fruits, melon, strawberry, alcohol, spoiled food.
Head - Headache from gastric causes or catarrh. Headache in left parietal bone, as if it was sore and pressed
upon by hand. Headaches worse after eating, lying, motion and noise. Headaches better sitting, external heat,
hot drinks and wrapping up head. Head as if heavy and enlarged. Constricted feeling in head, as if there was
a wound in the bone that was being scratched. Crusta lactea. Behaves like a crazy person.
Heart - Heart attacks with anxiety and fear. Palpitations with anxiety and fear. High blood pressure from
worry and fear. Weak heart. Pulse weak and contracted, small, scarcely perceptible, rapid.
Kidneys - Urine scanty with pellicle.
Limbs - Gouty nodosities, worse change of weather. Crampy feeling of lower limbs with partial loss of motion
and sensation, livid in places, tending to slough. Aching pain in right shoulder and elbow, followed by herpetic
eruption. Knees bent up so he could not move his feet. Swollen ankles. Palms and soles speckled over with
corns. Varicose veins of legs. Ulcers on legs with general psoriasis. Black ulcer on leg, running bloody, foul
water, with cutting, burning, itching and dyspnea.
Lungs - Anxiety with difficult breathing. Asthma with panic attacks. Asthma, rapid, anxious breathing, worse
2 a.m. to 3 a.m. Asthma better from sitting, worse lying down. Pneumonia with stitching pains in pleura.
Modalities - Better on rainy days. Aversion to open air. Worse touch, lying down, warmth of bed, warmth,
cold feet, noise. Worse after midnight, from 1 a.m. to 3 a.m.
Mouth - In middle, towards tip of tongue, a smooth, red spot with troublesome burning and numbness.
Toothache, better heat, worse eating, cold drinks and during menses. Pulsating and tearing pain, radiates to
ears, head and temples. Gums swollen and tender.
Nose - Colds. Hay fever. Sneezing. Watery, acrid discharge. Sinusitis. Chronic nasal catarrh. Nasal discharge
bloody, burning, excoriating, offensive, greenish, thick or yellow.
Perspiration - Sweats when walking.
Rectum - Discharge of much gas, followed by diarrhea. Violent diarrhea. Cholera. Diarrhea worse after
midnight, from milk. Stools white, watery, frothy. Foul odor, with cramps. Sensation as of a red- hot iron in
anus. Hemorrhoids, bleeding, external and internal, worse walking.
Sensations - The head feels larger. Protrusion of eyeballs. Burning and numbness of tongue. Tongue feels
 too large. Anxiety felt in solar plexus. Sensation of a ball rising from the pit of stomach to throat causing
suffocation. As if a red-hot iron were in anus.
Skin - Dry, scaly, wilted skin. Acne, pustules worse during menses. Chronic eczema, intolerable itching,
worse from warmth, walking, undressing. Psoriasis, lichen. Psoriasis in numerous patches, with great
itching. Discoloration of skin after psoriasis. Numerous small nodules under skin. Phagedenic ulcers. Fissures
in bends of arms and knees. Skin cancer, where suddenly an alarming malignancy without any external signs
sets in.
Sleep - Restless and anxious sleep. Sleeplessness, worse 1 a.m. to 4 a.m. Sleeps with hand over the heart.
Nightmares, vivid dreams.
Stomach - Anxiety feeling with palpitations from pit of stomach. Empty feeling in stomach. Sinking at
epigastrium with faintness. Weight in stomach after eating. Sensation as of a ball rising from pit of stomach to
larynx threatening suffocation, better by loud belching. Nausea and vomiting. Constant pain and nausea after
food, frequent vomiting of ingesta.
Temperature - Cold temperature on skin. Fever with lassitude.
Throat - Some gastric cough and frequent raking of throat and fauces of a mucopurulent secretion mixed with
specks of blood. Burning in throat. Sensation in throat and larynx as if forced asunder.
Throat dry and sore. Throat constricted with copious flow of saliva. Complete aphonia, following skin affection.
Tongue - Tongue clear, whitish, red like raw beef. Tongue coated on edges only with mucus stripes. Tongue
swollen, felt too large in mouth, numb. Neuralgic or burning in tongue. Smooth red spot in middle of tongue
toward tip that burns and is numb.
Vertigo - Vertigo while walking in the open air.
COMMENTS - Cases of Kali-ar. poisoning with massive doses present nothing to distinguish them from cases
of other arsenical preparations, but Kali-ar. has had a short proving and a number of cases of allopathic
provings are on record.
Jonathan Hutchinson recorded a number of cases of right-sided herpes. One of his patients observed that,
while taking Kali- ar., her sclerotics became thick and yellow instead of clear and bluish. The iris, which was
blue, became more gray. Her skin, instead of being fair and florid, became muddy and older looking.
This was a mystery to Hutchinson as he usually gave Kali-ar. to make the skin clearer, but he was compelled
to record the fact, though he did not apparently perceive the homeopathic solution of the mystery.
Hutchinson also noted cases of epithelioma developing after prolonged medication with Kali-ar. for psoriasis.
In another case, an attack of measles was almost exactly mimicked.
Useful as a backup for Ars., particularly if Ars. palliates or stops working.
Skin symptoms with a tendency toward malignancy. Psoriasis. Herpes. Itching, worse at night, on undressing,
and by warmth. Lupus. Indicated for the burning pains of dying cancer patients. Deafness associated with
constant sickness.
Asthma, worse 2 a.m. to 3 a.m. (Ars. worse 11 p.m. to 2 a.m.). Sinus problems. Shortness of breath,
hyperventilate with panic. Weak from going up stairs (Calc., Sil.).
Fainting spells and fear of fainting (Gels., Arg-n.). Pulsations in the body followed by shaking and trembling.
Sinking sensations. Fevers and shaking chills. Migraines, or fear of getting migraines, causing panic.
Panic stricken (Aeon.). Panic attacks, fear of having a panic attack. Chronic hypochondriacs, fear of heart
attack, high blood pressure, stroke or cancer. Fear of death. Agoraphobia, claustrophobia. Superstitious (Arg-
n., Zinc, Rhus-t., Ars.). Suspicious of others. Periodic rushes of adrenaline, pheochromocytoma. Ailments after
fright.
Panic with a burning or energy in the solar plexus area (Kali-c., Ign., Calc., Care.). Better when distracted from
panic attacks or fears. Despair over recovery. Desires company, insecure (Ars.). Hypersensitive to
surroundings (Phos.). Chilly, sensitive to drafts.
Restless and sleepless. Anxiety about dead people or dreams about dead people. May dream of fire and wake
up in a panic that the house is on fire. Can lie on their left and hold their heart when they sleep. May get
palpitations when sleeping on the right.
Lump rising from the stomach to the throat. Thirsty, but aggravated by cold drinks. Desires sweets, warm
drinks.
Marked periodicity (Ars.), symptoms were worse every other day in the morning, mind symptoms worse every
third day. Worse after midnight, on right side. The right-sidedness of Ars. was reproduced in the right-sided
herpes, repeatedly noticed by Hutchinson, but there was a left-sided headache.
RELATIONS - In some cases of overdosing, Kali-i. proved antidotal. Forother antidotes see Ars., which it
greatly resembles and with which it must be compared. Compare: ( 1 ) Ars., Lev., Nat-a. and other arsenic
compounds. (2) Chin. - periodicity. (3) Cic., Op. - fixed eyeballs. (4) Rumx. and Jug-r.-worse when undressing.
 (5) lod., Kali-bi., Merc-c., Kali-c.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Murphy. Phatak.
keynote:
PHARMACY - kali-ar. Kali arsenicosum. Potassium arsenite. Fowler's solution (the form in which Kali-ar. has
been tested, consists of 1 part arsenious acid, 1 part carbonate of potash, 3 parts compound tincture of
lavender, and 95 parts distilled water). Dilutions should be made from this. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL-Anxiety, attacks.Asthma. Bright's disease. Cancer. Deafness. Diarrhea. Dropsy Eczema.
Emaciation. Epithelioma. Exoph- thalmus. Eye, disorders. Faintness. Herpes, zoster.

name: Kali Bichromicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - kali-bi. Kali bichromicum. Potassium bichromate. Red Chromate of Potash. Bichromate of
Potash. Potassium dichromate. Potasse bichromas. Solution in distilled water. Trituration. Historical dose:
All potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne. Anemia. Asthma. Blotches. Bone, disorders. Bronchitis. Burns. Cachexia. Catarrh. Coccyx,
pain. Conjunctivitis. Constipation. Cornea, opacities. Colds. Coryza. Descemetitis. Duodenum, ulcers.
Dyspepsia. Ears, inflammation. Emaciation. Epilepsy. Eyes, inflamed. Farcy. Gastric, ulcer. Glanders. Gleet.
Gonorrhea. Gout. Hay fever. Headache. Intermittent, fever. Intestines, ulceration. Iritis. Keratitis. Leucorrhea.
Lumbago. Lupus. Measles. Menopausal, flushes. Migraines. Mucus, plugs. Mumps. Nasal, congestion.
Neuralgia. Nightmares. Nodes. Nosebleeds. Nose, soreness. Obesity. Ophthalmia. Ozaena. Polyps. Post-
nasal, catarrh. Pruritus, vulvae. Rheumatism. Rhinitis, atrophic. Sciatica. Scrofula. Sinusitis. Smell, illusions.
Sun-headache. Sycosis. Syphilis. Throat, sore. Tobacco, intolerance. Trachea, disorders. Ulcers. Urethritis.
Warts. Whooping cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - Kali-bi., with the other chromium preparations, Chr-ac. and Chr- ox., was introduced into
the Materia Medica by Dr. J. Drysdale. All chromium salts are derived from potassium bichromate, which is
manufactured in large quantities from chrome-iron-ore. The association of chromium with ferrum is noteworthy.
The bichromate is largely used in dying, calico-printing, wood staining, photography and as a solution for
producing the current in electric batteries. Many symptoms were obtained from workmen engaged in the
preparation of the salt, some of which had been noted before Drysdale studied the drug.
Drysdale published his first proving in 1844 in the British Journal of Homeopathy. The Austrian Society proved
it the following year.
Kali-bi. has an affinity for the mucus membranes of the air passages, nose, pharynx, stomach and duodenum.
Keynote thick, sticky, ropy, stringy, tough, yellow, green mucus discharges. The mucus adheres to the
part and can be drawn out in strings. Formation of crusts on mucus membranes and skin. Membranes look
furred.
Catarrh of pharynx, larynx, bronchi and nose and atough, stringy, viscid secretion is produced. Perforation
of the nasal septum. Chronic atonic catarrh. Ozaena. Shooting from root of nose to external angle of eye,
begins in the morning, increases to noon, and ceases toward evening.
Itching in vagina, ear, lungs etc. As if a hair on tongue, in nostrils etc. Sore throat. Yellowness of discharges,
eyes, vision tongue etc. Keratitis and iritis. Epilepsy, ropy saliva from mouth during convulsions. Dilatation of
stomach and heart.
Ulcers on the skin, mucus membranes and bones. Ulcers with dark dots, deep, perforating, round, punched
out with over-hanging edges or thick crusts. Septic or peptic ulcers. Stubborn suppurations, inflammations.
Polyps. Bone-pains and nodes.
Pains wander from part to part. Diagonal pains. Pains migrate quickly from place to place and finally attack
the stomach. Pains occur in small spots. Pains appear and disappear suddenly. Sharp stitching pains.
Neuralgia, daily at the same hour. Weakness and weariness after pains. Cracking of joints.
Alternating and shifting conditions. Headache alternates with blindness. Rheumatic pains alternate with gastric
symptoms or with dysentery. Ascending symptoms, gastric pains, chills, heat etc. Plastic or fibrous exudations
spread downwards. Sensation of heaviness in different parts.
Indolent or sluggish reaction in many conditions. Diseased conditions progress slowly but deeply, causing
great weakness bordering on paralysis but little fever. More adapted to sub-acute rather than the violent acute
stage.
Sickly, chilly and cachetic. Affections of autumn and spring. Complaints of hot weather. “
Great liability to take cold in open air,” and “ moderately cold air is felt very unpleasantly.” Eruptions begin in
warm weather (opp. Rhus-t.). Sun headaches.
Secondary and tertiary syphilis. Syphilitic rheumatism. Kali-bi. as “chrome-water” was also remarkably
successful. It been used as a local application for ulcers in very weak solutions, about 1 to 2,000.
MIND - Mentally ill-humored and low in spirit. Listless. Indifference to business affairs. Indolent, aversion to
mental and physical exertion. Weak memory, vanishing thoughts. Impatience. Irritability, sadness, better
after eating.
Anxiety arising from chest. Anxiety before menses. Anthropophobia. Avoids human society. Doesn't recognize
his relatives. Senseless staring at an object. Feeling as if losing their reason. Talks to himself. Abdomen -
 Stitches in region of liver and spleen, through to spine. Feeling of constriction from liver to shoulder (right).
Cutting pain in abdomen, soon after eating. Cutting pains to loins, cannot walk, extends to groins. Chronic
intestinal ulceration with vomiting and emaciation. Painful retraction, soreness and burning. As if something
eating in bowels.
Back - Violent aching. Stiffness of neck worse bending head forward. Stabbing pain from third cervical to fifth
dorsal vertebra. Stitches at lower angle of left scapula. Aching in back and down left side into hip. As if
something cracked across sacrum, worse stooping. Pain in coccyx and sacrum extending up and down, worse
walking, sitting and touching it. Coccyx pains before urination, better after. Cutting through loins, cannot walk.
Bladder - Continuous desire to urinate during day. Frequent discharge of watery urine, of strong smell,
awaking him at night. Burning in urethra. Stitches in urethra after urinating. After urinating a drop seems to
remain which cannot be expelled. Urethra becomes clogged up. Suppression of urine following cholera.
Breasts - Milk is stringy, watery. Causations - Ill effects from indulgence in beer and malt liquor.
Chest - Pressure and heaviness on chest, as from a weight. Stitches in sides of chest. Pain at trachea
bifurcation, on coughing from mid-sternum to back. Burning, pain at sternum. Rawness under sternum. Itching
behind sternum, causes violent, racking, paroxysmal cough.
Constitutions - Adapted to fat, fair, fleshy, light complexioned persons, subject to catarrhs or with syphilitic or
scrofulous history. Suited to sluggish people and fair-haired, fat persons, especially fat, chubby children.
Ears - Redness. Eruption covering both ears. Violent tickling in ears. Sharp stitches in ears. Swollen ear with
tearing pains. Pulsating in ears at night, external meatus swollen and inflamed. Stinging from external meatus
into internal ear. Lancinating pain, chronic suppuration. Thick, yellow, stringy, fetid discharge. Tympanum
perforated. Ulcers upon tympanum. Stitches in left ear and left parotid gland, during headache.
Eyes - Descemetitis with only moderate irritation of eye. Dense opacities of cornea. Ulcers on cornea, no
pain or photophobia. Conjunctiva, yellow, puffy, covered with yellow-brown spots. Conjunctivitis, granular lids
with pannus. Iritis with punctate deposits on inner surface of cornea. Slight pain with severe ulceration or
inflammation (Con. opposite.). Ropy and yellow discharge. Eyelids, swollen, winking during convulsions,
itching, granular. Eyelids twitch on opening. Supra-orbital neuralgia, right side. Photophobia only by daylight.
Face - Pale, yellowish, blotchy, red, florid. Acne (Kali-br., Kali-ar.). Mumps on the right side. Sweat on upper
lip. Bones sensitive, especially beneath orbits.
Female - Menses too early, with vertigo, nausea and headache. Menses with suppression of urine or red urine.
Membranous dysmenorrhea. Yellow, green tenacious leucorrhea. Leucorrhea, acrid, yellow, ropy with pain
across sacrum. Leucorrhea that can be drawn out in long strings. Subinvolution of uterus. Prolapsed uterus,
worse hot weather.
Pruritus of vulva, with great burning and excitement. Itching, burning of vulva with sexual excitement. Soreness
and rawness in vagina. Swelling of genitals. Vomiting during pregnancy.
Food - Desire for acid foods and drinks. Desires beer and malt liquors, but they aggravate. Dislikes water.
Cannot digest meat. Overeats.
Head - Periodical headaches with vertigo and nausea. Headaches, over eyebrows, preceded by blurred
vision. Headache with persistent retching and vomiting of food, bile. Migraines in small spots and from
suppressed catarrh. Violent headache from occiput to forehead if nasal discharge ceases. Blindness,
followed by violent headache, over eyebrows or outward along the brows. Headache, worse from cold, sinus
congestion. Headache better pressing at the root of the nose, better from warm soup. Sensation as if a solid
block in forehead. Sinus headache with stopped-up sensation in nose. Violent shooting pains from root of
nose. Aching and fullness in glabella. Sharp pains in bones. Bones of head feel sore. Frontal pain, usually
over one eye. Dull, heavy throbbing above eyes, as if head would burst. Supraorbital neuralgia, right side.
Eczema of scalp, raw and oozing a thin moisture which dries into yellow scabs. Eruption of painful small boils
on back of head.
Heart - Weak heart. Dilated with kidney lesions, insufficiency of aortic valves. Pricking in region of heart. Cold
feeling around heart (Kali-n.). Pressure on heart after eating. Pulsation felt in all the arteries. Palpitations with
rattling in throat, during cough. Pulse irregular, small, contracted, with nosebleed.
Kidneys - Heaviness sensation in kidneys. Constant aching. Shooting in kidney region with suppressed urine
and prostration. Sharp shooting, first in left then right kidney. Congestion of kidneys. Nephritis with scanty,
albuminous urine and casts. Pyelitis, urine with epithelial cells, mucus, pus or blood.
Limbs - Pain, swelling, stiffness and crackling of all joints. Pains fly rapidly from on^place to another (Kali-s.,
Puls.). Pains in small spots (Ox-ac.). Wandering pains along the bones, worse cold. Bones feels sore and
bruised. Tearing pains in tibia. Shin bones, painful, periostitis from blow. Very weak limbs. Paralytic weakness
of hands. Syphilitic rheumatism (Mez.). Rheumatic pains worse eating. Rheumatic pain in hip joints and knees.
Heaviness of legs. Left-sided sciatica, better motion and flexing the leg, worse standing, sitting or lying in bed.
 Pain in tendons of muscles of calf, as if stretched, causes lameness. Achilles tendon swollen and tender. Left
ankle as if dislocated. Pain along border of the foot. Soreness of heels when walking.
Liver - Soreness in right hypochondrium, fatty infiltration of liver and increase in soft fibrous tissue.
Lungs - Acute capillary bronchitis. Chronic bronchitis. Bronchial dilatation with fetid breath and expectoration.
Dry, metallic, hacking cough. Cough with pain in sternum, extending to shoulders, worse when undressing.
Profuse, yellow expectoration, very glutinous and sticky, coming out in a long, stringy and very tenacious
mass. Cough better expectoration. Membranous croup, extending to larynx and sinuses. Asthma worse from
sex. Wheezing, panting on awaking, then cough which forces him to sit up, bent forward. Wheezing at night
after whooping cough. Wheezing with retching and expectoration of tough mucus, which can be drawn in
strings to the feet.
Male - Pricking and itching at glans penis. Itching and pain of penis with pustules. Ulcers with paroxysmal
stitches, aggravated at night. Syphilitic ulcers with cheesy, tenacious exudation. Chancres ulcerating deeply.
Constriction at root of penis, at night, on waking. Gleet with stringy or jelly-like profuse discharge, clogging the
urethra. Prostatic fluid escapes during stool. Stitches in prostate when walking, must stand still. Erections (Pic-
ac.). Sexual desire absent in fleshy persons.
Mouth - Dry mouth, better by drinking cold water. Sticky mouth. Dry, viscid saliva. Sweet, metallic, taste.
Tongue glistens, cracked, red, dry, shining, smooth or heavy, lemon yellow, furred in dysentery. Tongue
thickly coated, broad, flat, indented. Tongue pains at the root when protruded. As of a hair on back part of the
tongue, not better by eating or drinking. Aphthous ulcers deeply corroding. Toothache, radiating with swelling
of the glands.
Modalities - Better from heat, wrapping up, pressure, motion, short sleep. Skin symptoms better cold weather.
Open air ameliorates, especially vertigo, but aggravates the gastric complaints and chilliness. Worse from cold,
damp, open air, spring, hot weather. Worse from undressing, stooping, sitting, after sleep, morning, 2 a.m. to
3 a.m. Worse from suppressed catarrh, protruding tongue, alcohol, beer. Worse by eating, causes cough,
weight in stomach.
Nose - Pressure and pain at root or bridge of nose. Nose feels heavy, dry. Sinusitis with distress and
fullness at root of nose. Chronic rhinitis. Profuse, watery nasal discharge. Nasal discharges, thick, stringy,
ropy, lumpy, sticky, greenish, yellow, acrid. Post-nasal drip of thick mucus (Hydr.). Much hawking of thick
mucus. Coryza with obstruction of nose. Ozaena. Suppressed catarrh. Fetid smell from retention of
discharge in nose. Loss of smell. Violent sneezing, worse in the morning. Tickling as from a hair in left nostril.
Inability to breathe through nose. Large mucus plugs. Tough, elastic plugs, leave a raw surface. Clinkers in
nose. Snuffles, especially in overweight children. Nasal septum ulcerates, round ulcer. Abscess. Thick, dark
red blood from nose. Nasal polyps. Sensation as if two loose bones were rubbing together on blowing the
nose. Nasal diphtheria. Expired air feels hot.
Perspiration - Cold sweat on forehead, hands, feet and thighs. Perspiration on back during effort at stool.
Profuse sweats while sitting quietly.
Rectum - Sensation of a plug in anus. Periodic constipation with pain across the loins and brown urine.
Dysentery, tenesmus, stools are brown, frothy. Stools, jelly-like, gelatinous, worse mornings.
Skin - Skin is hot, dry and red, better cool air. Brown spots. Acne. Lupus with burning. Burning, tingling in skin.
Herpes zoster. Blisters on soles. Skin eruptions, worse summer. Dryness of skin, with itching of whole body.
Itching with vesicular eruption. Papular eruptions. Pustular eruption, resembling smallpox with burning pains.
Pustules with black tops. Ulcers with punched-out edges. Ulcers with tendency to penetrate and tenacious
exudation. Ulcers painful in cold weather. Depressed, round scars after healing of eruptions or ulcers.
Sleep - Drowsiness in open air. Great inclination to stretch and yawn. During sleep frequent starts, incoherent
talk, tossing of arms. Unrefreshing, feels debilitated in limbs. Wakened by dyspnea, palpitation. Wakened with
desire to urinate. Worse on waking.
Stomach - Dilatation of stomach. Gastritis. Sore spot in stomach or food lies like a load. Feels as if digestion
had stopped. Round ulcer of stomach. Nausea with heat in the body, better eating and open air. Nausea
with burning in anus and erections. Nausea and vomiting after beer. Regurgitates liquids. Vomiting more than
he drinks of bright, yellow water. Gastric symptoms are relieved after eating, and the rheumatic symptoms
reappear.
Temperature - Hot flushes, followed by sticky sweat, then chill. Burning of upper part of body and face with
internal chilliness and violent thirst. Chilliness alternating with flushes of heat. Chill with sweat. Cold sweat on
hands and feet. Attacks of chilliness from feet upwards, and sensation as if skull on vertex became contracted,
in frequently returning paroxysms. Chilliness in back, with sleepiness. Chills with giddiness and nausea,
followed by heat. Sensation of coldness and trembling.
Throat - Dry, burning and rough. Burning, extending to the stomach. Fauces red and inflamed. Tickling in
 larynx with cough and belchings, then vertigo, worse eating, better heat. Fissured pharynx. Aphthae.
Something sticks in with pain into neck and shoulders. Throat pains when putting the tongue out. Voice is
hoarse, worse evening. Catarrhal laryngitis, cough has a brassy sound. Hawks up thick mucus, must wipe it
away. Diphtheria with profound prostration and soft pulse. Tough and stringy dischargefrom mouth and
throat. Sensation of choking on lying down. Uvula relaxed, edematous, bladder-like. Pseudo membranous
deposit on tonsils and softpalate. Parotidglands swollen. Tonsils swollen with deafness in children.
Urine - Scanty, high-colored urine, with a white film and copious whitish sediment and pain in back. Urine
alkaline and ropy. Ropy mucus in urine. Hematochyluria. Bloody urine and pain in back.
Vertigo - Vertigo in many complaints, on stooping or when rising from a seat. Vertigo with nausea and
inclination to vomit. Vertigo followed by vomiting of acid, white mucus fluid. Vertigo better from walking in open
air.
Vision - Dim vision, confused, during vertigo. Blindness before headache, sight returns with the increasing
headache. Vision seems crossed, better looking with one eye. Sees double. Figures vanish on looking at them.
All objects seem to be enveloped in a yellow mist. Yellow sight. Sees various colors and bright sparks.
COMMENTS - Characteristic formation of large mucus plugs orclinkers on membranes, especially in the nose.
This may be regarded as an advanced stage of the stringy mucus secretions. Formation of false membranes
in croup and diphtheria with hoarse, metallic cough. Formation of casts of the bronchial tubes in fibrinous
bronchitis.
Sinus infections, sinusitis, nasal discharges. Sinusitis after a cold, particularly if a history. Keynote of thick
yellow-green mucus that can be so thick that they may not be able to blow it out. Viscous, sticky, lumpy, stringy
mucus (Hydr., Puls., Merc.).
Mucus in lumps, can have blood. Jelly-like mucus. Loss of smell.
Severe pain at the root of the nose when the discharge stops. Sinusitis with bone pains in the face. Very severe
sinus headaches. Headaches over the eye or at the root of the nose. Severe headaches with suppressed
discharge. Blinding migraine headaches, severe pain (Iris, Nat-m.). Pains over either eye, often followed by
sinus congestion.
Mucus in the chest, difficult to expectorate (Caust., Ant-t.). Copious mucus in the lungs, especially in the
bronchioles. Gelatinous mucus in the elderly, coughed up in the morning, dark green, jelly mucus.
Cough with stringy, difficult expectoration. worse early morning. A pain from mid sternum through to back.
Brassy cough. Coughs up sticky mucus. Cough caused by eating. Sensation as if a hair on the back part of
the tongue or in the left nostril.
Wet asthma (Kali-c., Puls., Ant-t.). Asthma in children, stringy mucus that relieves. Otitis media with a discharge
(Merc.). Stringy vomit. Vaginitis with stringy discharge. Stringy breast milk.
Circular ulcers, as if someone punched them out of the skin. Ulcers from burns. Sores and ulcers that don't
heal with ropy mucus. Internal and external ulceration.
Shifting pains and sudden pains (Lac-c.). Pains appear and disappear suddenly. Diagonal pains. Localized
pain. Stinging pains all over. Pains in short jerks as if a nerve were suddenly pulled. Cramps in various parts.
Twitches in hands and feet.
Arthritis with wandering pains or pains in small spots. Joints crack with arthritis. Rheumatic-like or shooting
and pricking pains. Rheumatic pains were worse and the gastric pains better after eating.
Great prostration, discomfort, debility and desire to lie down. Neuralgic attacks, recurring every day, at the
same hour. Epilepsy with a flow of tough, stringy fluid from the mouth during the attacks. Vertigo with many
complaints, on stooping or rising from a seat.
Mentally ill-humored and low in spirit. Listless, aversion to mental and physical exertion. Weak memory,
vanishing of thoughts. Anxiety arising from chest.
Swollen abdomen immediately after a full meal. Food lies like a load, as if digestion were suspended. Weight
in pit of stomach immediately after eating, flatulence. Severe diarrhea, stools are lumpy, mucus and jelly- like
substances. Odorless stools.
Painful vomiting, sour, mixed with clear mucus, may be bitter from the presence of bile. Vomiting from attempt
to eat or drink, with distress and burning rawness about the stomach. Vomiting in alcoholics, especially beer-
drinkers. Gastric ulcers.
Aversion to meat, desires for beer, acid drinks. Beer and malt liquors aggravate, more pronounced in hot
weather, autumn, and spring. Chronic effects of drinking too much malt liquor, especially lager beer.
Some of the workmen found they could not drink coffee as it made them worse and they were obliged to take
to tea instead. This bears out Hering's dictum that “winedrinkers shou Id take coffee and beer drinkers should
take tea.” Coffee antidotes wine and tea antidotes beer.
W. J. Pierce recorded the case of James S., 40. For four months past, as soon as he swallowed food (not
 liquids), a tickling in the throat excited a severe cough, which stopped only on vomiting and was followed by a
watery coryza. This was so distressing that for two months he had eaten only two meals a day.
There was pharyngeal catarrh with stringy mucus hanging from naso-pharynx. Kali-bi. 1c, a tablet every two
hours, was given. He had no more vomiting and only coughed twice in the next five days and was soon quite
cured.
J. B. Garrison recorded the rapid action of Kali-bi. in two cases of intermittent fever on an indication given to
him by Martin Dischere. Dischere once mistakenly took an overdose of Kali-bi., which was followed by vomiting
of a large quantity of bright yellow water, tasting very bitter.
Garrison's first case was that of a laborer, ill amonth with fever, pains and paroxysm at 1 p.m. Just before
Garrison saw him he had vomited “a large quantity of bright yellow water.” Kali-bi. lx, one grain dissolved in a
tumbler of water, a teaspoonful every two hours, cured at once.
The second case was that of a woman who had been nine months under allopathic treatment. She had not
been out of the house for two months and had been told she could not recover. Among other symptoms, she
vomited much more than she drank. In the morning, she vomited a large bowlful of bright yellow fluid.
Goullon gave the case of an enormously fat man of “formless colossal body” who complained of chronic
accumulation of phlegm. He seemed fairly filled up with it, especially in the morning, for which all domestic
remedies and mineral waters had been given in vain.
Kali-bi. 2x was ordered, a few grains in hot water every evening. In two weeks, the patient could resume his
walks. He felt easy on his chest, the accumulation of phlegm disappeared, his bowels became regular instead
of constipated. Kali-bi. is particularly suited to fat people.
Storer cured with Kali-bi. a case of asthma in a man who noticed that the attacks were caused by and always
followed sex. Kali- bi. was prescribed on other indications, but this symptom must be noted. Marked worse
from sex and from emissions.
Nash related a cure with Kali-bi. 30c, in which a women had deep, punched-out ulcers with regular edges. One
of them had perforated the soft palate and threatened the whole palate. It had a syphilitic appearance and also
a stringy discharge, but not to a great amount. In three weeks, the local condition entirely healed and the
patient's general state improved correspondingly.
H. W. Champlin cited a case of chronic rheumatism in a woman over 70. She was restless and sleepless at
night and Rhus-t. relieved this somewhat. Closer investigation brought out that the pains changed rapidly from
one place to another and that they occupied small spots that could be
covered with the point of a finger. Kali-bi. cured rapidly.
Grimmer noted that the anemia and cachexia in its pathogenesis, together with the fact that it has cured lupus,
puts this remedy in the anticancer group. It affects the skin and mucus membranes (the internal skin) markedly.
Catarrhal and rheumatic states are prominent features calling for its use.
RELATIONS - Antidotes: Ars., Lach. Compare: ( 1) Ant-t., Brom., Hep., Ind., Calc., Ant-c. (2) In the
production of false membranes: Brom., Caust., Sul-ac., Ip. (3) Oxyg., Caust., Kali-c. - fat subjects. (4) Kali-
i.,Nit-ac. - syphilis. (5) Bor. - croup, fair subjects. (6) Mez., Sil., Phyt. - bone diseases. (7) Hydr. and Iris. -
viscous, tough secretions. (8) Sep. andTeucr. “clinkers.” (9) Puls. - wandering rheumatism, gonorrheal
rheumatism, pains worse in warm room, measles, catarrhal deafness, swelling of salivary glands. (10) Coc-c.,
whooping cough, mucus, clear stringy, Kali-bi. yellow stringy. Rhus-t. - better of pain on moving affected part,
Rhus-t. has better by warmth, eruptions of Kali-bi. begin in hot weather, those of Rhus-t. in cold. ( 11) Sulph. -
sensation of hair in throat.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Kali Bromatum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - kali-br. Kali bromatum. Potassium bromide. Solution. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration
and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne. Albuminuria. Alcoholism. Amnesia. Aphasia. Asthma. Backache. Cholera, infantum.
Chorea. Chordee. Colic. Convulsions. Delirium. Delusions. Depression. Diabetes mellitus. Epilepsy.
Erythema nodosum. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Imbecility. Impotency. Insanity. Insomnia. Laryngeal, spasms.
Laryngismus. Locomotor, ataxia. Mania. Manic depression. Melancholy. Memory, weakness. Menorrhagia.
Metrorrhagia. Nightmares. Night-terrors. Nose, eruption. Numbness. Nymphomania. Ovaries, disorders.
Paralysis. Parkinson's disease. Pityriasis. Polyps, rectal. Prostration. Psoriasis. Schizophrenia. Screaming.
Sebaceous, cysts. Seborrhea. Self-abuse. Senility. Sensibility, loss. Sleeplessness. Sleepwalking. Speech,
disorders. Sterility. Strokes. Syphilis. Tabes dorsalis. Tetanus. Uremia. Urine, incontinence. Uterine, fibroids.
Vaginismus. Vertigo.
 HOMEOPATHIC - Like all potash salts, this weakens the heart and lowers temperature. Causes brominism.
Symptoms of allopathic overdoses are added to the proving symptoms and the clinical experience of
homeopaths.
Alberton noted that Kali-br. has been given allopathically in epileptic and other convulsive disorders with the
idea of overwhelming the disease rather than of curing it. The effect has been to reduce or prevent the
recurrence of epileptic attacks at the expense of keeping the patient constantly under the influence of the drug
and producing a state of mental imbecility, “decreasing the excitability and power of the motor cells of
the brain.”
Hare noted that the keynotes for the bromides include general weakness and feebleness of the nervous
system, posttyphoid and post-puerperal insanity, senile softening of the brain and irritation of the gastro-
intestinal mucus membrane.
Kali-br. affects the mind and nerves, producing failure of mental power, loss of memory. Melancholy.
General numbness and anesthesia of mucus membranes especially of eyes, throat and skin.
Skin eruptions, psoriasis. Acne, especially at puberty and at the menstrual period. Clarke knew of no remedy
of such universal usefulness in cases of simple acne as in Kali-br. 30c. Moist eruptions and pityriasis of the
scalp. Seborrhea. Erythema nodosum.
Epilepsy, associated with sexual excess or abuse in men and with menses in women. Attacks during the new
moon, followed by headaches. Onset of diseased condition is slow without any pain. Convulsions. Parkinson's
disease. Numbness of whole
body. Symptoms of strokes. Paralysis. Aphasia, somnolence and stertor. Loss of sexual desire. Sexual
fantasies, satyriasis and nymphomania. Uremia. Albuminuria. Nodular form of chronic gout.
Kali bromatum
MIND - Brain fag from grief and anxiety. Failing brain-power (Anae., Bar-c., Phos.). Loss of memory. Forgetful
on waking in morning. Senile softening of the brain. Weak memory, confused thoughts. Perception slow,
answers slowly.
Mistakes in speaking or writing. Confusion as to his identity, over daily affairs. Amnesic aphasia. Aphasia,
from embolism of middle cerebral artery. Forgets how to talk, has to be told the word before he can speak it.
Ailments after emotional excitement. Nervous irritability from severe illness or death of a friend, loss of property
or reputation. Wrings hands, hands and fingers in constant motion. Feeling of helplessness, in afternoon.
Fits of uncontrollable weeping.
Extremely sensitive to pain. Fidgety, busy hands, fumbles in his pockets. Hurried when eating. Moves arms
about wildly. Headstrong and haughty when sick. Domineering. Loss of self-confidence.
Constant fear of breaking down under stress. Constant worry, fears to see people or to be spoken to. Fear of
being alone, of his own shadow, to walk past certain corners, of a ringing doorbell. Fear of new people. Fear
of insanity. Fear of being poisoned (Hyos.).
Sadness in morning on waking. Melancholy, much concerned about health, complains without cause. Deep
depression with painful delusions andpersistentinsomnia. Profound indifference and disgust for life.
Suicidal depression, mania with trembling. Manic depression. Schizophrenia.
Religious depression. Feeling of moral deficiency; want of moral feeling. Imagines he is singled out as an
object of divine wrath. Dread of impending destruction of all near to her. Remorse, wrings hands, bursts into
tears.
Active delirium. Delirium with delusions. Paranoid delusions, thinks he is pursued. Suspicious, delusions
of conspiracies, that his life is threatened. Delusion he will commit some great crime, that she will murder her
children or husband, that her child is dead. Delusion that he is a devil.
Hallucinations of sight and sound, with or without mania, precede brain and paralytic symptoms. Horrible
visions, can't be comforted by friends. Mental symptoms after a stroke. Chronic alcoholism.
Abdomen - Abdomen sunken, almost stuck to vertebral column. Retraction of abdomen with spasms.
Prostration. Ascites of hepatic or splenic origin. Flatulent colic. Colic in young children. Cutting colic. Internal
coldness of abdomen during painless diarrhea. Sensation as if bowels were falling out. Trembling sensation
in bowels. Enlargement of liver and spleen. Small tumor in region of spleen.
Back - Backache, tired lameness of legs. Tabes dorsalis from sexual excesses.
Causations - Ill effects of worry, anger, fright, emotional disturbance. Chorea from fright. Loss of business,
reputation and embarrassment. Illness or death of a near friend. Sexual excess, sexual abuse.
Chest - Burning in chest. Tightness of chest when breathing.
Constitutions - Nervous constitutions. Children who can swallow solids with ease from birth, yet choke when
they try to drink.
Cough - Cough dry, hard and almost incessant. Dry, fatiguing, paroxysmal cough. Dry, spasmodic cough in
 weak, nervous children. Dry cough due to reflex action from stomach, intestines or uterus. Hacking cough at
night. Whooping cough. Nervous cough during pregnancy.
Ears - Hardness of hearing. Ringing in ear. Sounds echo in ears, headache. Roaring synchronous with pulse,
at night.
Eyes - Eyes sunken, lusterless, gaze fixed. Eyeballs move in every direction. Squinting after night terrors of
children. Vision dim. Pupils dilated, with heavy lids and drowsiness. Vessels of fundus enlarged, conjunctiva
congested.
Face - Acne in young people. Acne worse before menses. Pimples on face, cheeks and forehead. Bluish-
red eruptions. Itching pimples, pustules leave scars. Complexion yellow, cachectic. Face flushed. Face
pale, appeared as one drunk
with hallucinations. Expression wearied, anxious, dull, stupefied, imbecile, expressionless. Papular rash.
Female - Menses scanty. Epileptic attacks at or near menstrual periods. Menorrhagia with strong sexual
desire. Headache, insomnia, and heat in genitals after menses. Metrorrhagia. Flooding in young women with
sexual desire. Sterility from excessive sexual indulgence. Sexual feeling lost. Aversion to sex (Sep.). Excessive
sexual desire during menses. Nymphomania during puerperal state. Pruritus of external genitals. Voluptuous
itching, tingling and irritation in external genitals. Ovarian neuralgia. with great nervous uneasiness from
ungratified sexual desire. Cystic tumors of ovaries. Ovarian swelling, tenderness of left ovary. Uterine fibroids.
Induration of uterus. Enlargement of uterus. Subinvolution. Vaginismus. Convulsions during labor. Painful heat
flushings and congestion to head during menopause.
Food - Taste foul, salty, lost. Intense thirst with dry mouth. Dysphagia of liquids (Hyos.). Troublesome pressure
at stomach after diner, lassitude. Anorexia.
Head - Heaviness of head, confusion, slow speech, staggers as if drunk. Numbfeeling in head, worse occiput.
Severe throbbing, aching, in occipital region. Headache from concussion of brain. Headache after epileptic
attack. Migraine with flushed face, throbbing temples, injected conjunctiva, photophobia. Congestive
headaches. Mercurial headache. Brain irritated. Anemia of brain from loss of fluids. Symptoms of apoplexy.
Constrictive sensation in brain as if too tight. Drooping of head, cannot hold it erect. Incipient meningitis.
Hydrocephalus. Scalp feels tight. Seborrhea. Pityriasis.
Heart - Weakens the heart and lowers temperature. Feeble heart with intermitting action. Action of heart slow
and fluttering. Heart's beat weak, sounds distant and feeble. Pulse, accelerated, later becomes slower and
small. Cardiac neuroses from spinal or uterine irritation.
Kidneys - Diabetes mellitus (Ph-ac.).i Urethra numb, sensibility diminished. Incontinence of urine. Involuntary
nocturnal emissions of urine. Neuralgia of neck of bladder. Urine profuse with thirst. Urine copious, pale,
abundance of phosphates. Urine scanty, even suppressed in collapse. Urine dribbling a few drops at beginning
of every stool.
Limbs - Jerking and twitching of muscles. Fidgety hands, busy twitching of fingers. Hands and fingers in
constant motion. Trembling of hands during voluntary motion. Unsteady gait. Cannot stand erect, legs weak.
Lungs - Asthma with dry cough, tosses arms about wildly. Asthma of nervous origin. Spasmodic asthma of
children. Infantile capillary bronchitis with severe dyspnea. Pneumonia in alcoholics. Great dyspnea, breath
hot, hurried. Spasmodic croup. Cough dry, fatiguing, hacking cough at night. Copious, whitish expectoration
in torpid cases of bronchitis. Reflex cough during pregnancy.
Male - Spermatorrhea. Chordee during gonorrhea. Effects of sexual excesses, especially loss of memory,
impaired co-ordination, numbness and tingling in limbs. Lessened desire, debility and impotence, with
melancholy, epilepsy, nervous prostration. Lascivious fancies and dreams. Erections at night, with backache,
uncontrollable fidgetiness. Impotence with melancholy, loss of memory, nervous prostration, epilepsy.
Excessive sexual desire with constant erections at night. Satyriasis. Sexual excitement during partial slumber.
Modalities - Better when busy mentally and physically. Skin better in cold weather. Worse from mental
exertion. Worse from emotions, anger, fright, worry, grief. Worse at night. Worse at 2 a.m. Worse periodically,
new moon. Worse at summer, hot weather. Worse from puberty. Worse before, during and after menses.
Worse unsatisfied sexual desire. Worse sexual excess. Cough worse lying down.
Mouth - Fetid breath, a peculiar sickening odor, profuse saliva. Suppressed salivation in teething children.
Foul, salty taste. Loss of taste. Numbness. Difficult speech, stammering.
Nose - Smell impaired. Erythematous swelling of nose. Coryza with tendency to extension into throat. Thick
mucus and yellow scabs in nostrils.
Perspiration - Sweat abundant, viscid, all over, long lasting and exhausting (ague).
Rectum - Asiatic cholera, first stage, vomiting, cramps, rice-water discharges. Cholera infantum with reflex
cerebral irritation, jerking and twitching of muscles. Persistent diarrhea, much blood expelled. Painless
diarrhea, with great chilliness, even in a hot room. Constipation, stools very dry, hard and infrequent. Painful
 hemorrhoids. Blind hemorrhoids, intensely painful varices with black stools. Fissure of rectum and painful
growths. Spasmodic stricture of sphincter ani. Rectal polyps.
Sensations - Parts feel as if growing large. Paroxysms of numbness, feels as if needles were pricking him.
Trembling sensation.
Skin - Anesthesia of skin. Skin cold, clammy .Acne simplex andindurate, bluish red, pustular, worse on face
and chest. Acne of face, cheeks and forehead. Pimples leave scars. Itching, worse on chest, shoulders and
face. Psoriasis, syphilitic psoriasis. Moist eczema of legs. Moist eruptions, scars remaining after eruptions.
Eruption of small boils in successive crops with troublesome itching. Large indolent, painful pustules, boils.
Seborrhea. Pityriasis. Rose-colored eruption on lower limbs. Long lasting scrofulous ulcerations. Sebaceous
cysts. Scars remaining after eruptions.
Sleep - Extreme drowsiness. Insomnia. Sleeplessness due to worry, grief and sexual excess. Sleeplessness
in anemic patients or nervous persons. Sleepless, restless can only calm herself by incessant occupation.
Sleeplessness during convalescence from acute diseases. Restless sleep. Deep,
profound sleep. Grinding teeth in sleep. Night terrors in children, awake screaming, unconscious,
recognizes no one, followed by squinting. Sleepwalking in children. Waking with severe headache in a child.
Horrible dreams.
Stomach - Dyspepsia. Weakness of stomach. Persistent hiccough (Sul-ac.). Vomiting of all drinks and
intense thirst, with cholera infantum. Vomiting with intense thirst after each meal. Vomiting of mucus. Hysterical
vomiting after exciting emotions. Vomiting of alcoholics after a debauch. Morning sickness.
Stool - Green, watery, rice-water stools with rapid collapse, painless. Frequent, green, water stools, with
violent abdominal spasms. Bloody mucopurulent diarrhea. Stools painless.
Teeth - Odontitis of children. Difficult dentition in children, with vomiting and diarrhea. Gums as if numb.
Grinding teeth in sleep with moans and cries.
Temperature - Body cold, skin corrugated and mottled. Cold limbs. Shivering with cold and cold skin. Heat
like cold stage, not very strongly marked. Head hot. feels as if in a furnace with coldness and chills. Chilliness
in a hot room and itching during high fever. Painful hot flushing of the face during menopause.
Throat - Congestion of uvula and fauces, then edematous. Anesthesia of fauces, pharynx and larynx.
Hoarseness, extremely painful and disagreeable. Dryness of throat. Dysphagia of liquids, can swallow only
solids, especially in children (Hyos.). Laryngismus stridulus, uncomplicated, from neurosis or reflex irritation.
Spasmodic croup. Chronic catarrh. Diphtheria with quick pulse, fever, dry tongue, and offensive breath.
Tongue - Tongue protrudes with a jerk, chorea. Tongue is red, brown, dry, enlarged, tender. White tongue.
Vertigo - Vertigo, as if ground gave way, worse stooping. Vertigo with palpitations, nausea and even
unconsciousness. Dizziness, noises in ear, nervous excitement, sleepless. Staggering gait.
COMMENTS - Kali-br. has a very profound action on the generative organs and the mental side of the
generative sphere causing sensual, lascivious fancies, satyriasis and nymphomania, and finally impotence
and wasting of the sexual organs.
Epilepsy, particularly cases associated with sexual excess or abuse in men and those in which the fits occur
during or near the menstrual period in women. Epilepsy after fright, anger, or childbirth. Can be affected by
phases of the moon. Headache after the attack.
Spasms from fright, anger or emotions. Spasms in nervous, plethoric persons during childbirth. Staggering
gait, ataxia, numbness and tingling in legs and spine with increase in sexual appetite.
Paralysis with twitchings of the limbs. Fidgeting of the hands and feet (Hyos.). Reflexes are diminished and
there is loss of general sensibility and also of certain parts, particularly fauces, larynx and urethra. Benumbed
sensation of the brain.
Schizophrenia, manic depression. Suicidal depression. Depressed, melancholic, uncontrollable weeping.
Laughing and crying fits. Disordered faculties. Fear of going insane, fear of losing mental or emotional control.
Memory loss, amnesia (Anae.). Aphasia.
Chronic insomnia, especially in the elderly (Calc., Ars.). Insomnia due to worry, mortification, grief, financial
shock and loss (Aur.). Restlessness and sleeplessness from worry. Drowsiness.
Deep sleep may be broken by a start, though waking is very difficult. Confused dreams. Night terrors in children
where they scream, without recollection of the terror (Tub., Calc.). Grind teeth and moan while sleeping.
Sleepwalking.
Cholera infantum with hydrocephalic symptoms. Dentition. Whooping cough. Bright's disease. Acne,
particularly relating to hormonal changes. Sebaceous cysts and wens. Growths.
Ovarian cysts, fibroids and fatty tumors. Uterine hemorrhage, with ovarian tumors.
Metrorrhagia or menorrhagia, may arise from reflected irritation and may be accompanied with sexual
excitement.
 Hering noted that Kali-br. is useful for “flooding, especially in young women.”
Amory Hare noted that pulmonary edema or suffocative bronchitis may develop in the lungs. The patient may
become cachectic and the condition can resemble typhoid fever.
Wenzel Heyberger recorded a case of diabetes in a woman, 68, cured with Kali- br. The patient had been ill
five months and was reduced to a skeleton. She first noticed a remarkably good appetite, but after meals had
heartburn and belchings.
She had polyuria and frequent disturbances at night to pass water. Weak in the head, confused, memory
impaired. Vision was almost gone. Rushing and roaring in ears. Tormenting thirst. Stools difficult and delayed.
Powders medicated with Kali-br. 2c were given, one every six hours.
The first night the patient slept without disturbance and the quantity of urine and proportion of sugar diminished.
After about six weeks, the improvement seemed to stop and Kali-br. was given in allopathic doses, but this
aggravated the condition. Kali-br. 2c was resumed and the case went to a cure.
Hale cured with Kali-br. many cases of cholera infantum and one case of “violent periodic umbilical colic,
leaving tenderness on pressure.” The characteristic hour of recurrence was 5 p.m.
Buford used it extensively in such cases and in potencies approaching the crude form. Kali-br. is more
particularly adapted to persons inclined to obesity, to children, and to nervous women. More symptoms have
been noted on the right side than on the left.
RELATIONS - Kali-br. is Antidoted by: Vegetable acids, oils, Camp., Nux-v., Zinc. It antidotes: Lead
poisoning. It follows well: Aeon, and Spong, in croup, Eug. in acne. Compare: (1) Camph. Am-br., Aur. (2)
Bor. - night-terrors. (3) Kali-c. - persons inclined to obesity, also Am-c., Calc., Graph. (4) Kali- i. - acne, syphilis,
Kali-p. and Calc. - night terrors. (5) Hyos. - mania, excited sensorium
without inflammation of brain, fears being poisoned, sees ghosts, sexual excitement. (6) Plat. - sees ghosts,
demons. (7) Arg-n. - fearful apprehensive mood, imagines cannot pass a certain point. (8) Glon. - fears being
poisoned, also Rhus-t. (9) Staph. - mental depression, weakness of legs from masturbation. (10) Gels. -
incoordination of muscles. (11) Con. - nervous cough during pregnancy. (12) Bov., Stram. - slow, difficult
speech, stammering. ( 13) Ip. - cholera infantum. (14) Zinc. - fidgety restlessness, Zinc, of feet, Kali-br. of
hands. (15) Tarent. - reflex symptoms, any little irritation such as dentition or indigestion may causes
convulsions. Fidgety hands.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.
