name: Kali Carbonicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - kali-c. Kali carbonicum. Potassium carbonate. Potassic carbonate. Salt of Tartar. Solution.
Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Anemia. Asthma. Axilla, perspiration. Backaches. Biliousness. Bronchitis.
Catarrh. Chilblains. Colds. Coughs. Debility. Dropsy. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspepsia. Ear, inflammation. Eyes,
inflammation. Face, blotches. Fears. Freckles. Hair, disorders. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hemorrhage.
Hemorrhoids. Hip joint disease. Hydrothorax. Hysteria. Kidneys, disorders. Larynx, catarrh. Leucorrhea. Liver,
disorders. Lumbago. Lungs, disorders. Menopause, disorders. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Pleurisy.
Pleurodynia. Pneumonia. Pregnancy, disorders. Premenstrual, syndrome. Sciatica. Sleeplessness. Spinal,
irritation. Stomach, disorders. Stomach, pain. Throat, sore. Toothaches. Tuberculosis. Typhoid. Urination,
frequent. Urticaria. Uterus, cancer. Wens. Whooping cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - Kali-c. is potassium carbonate. sometimes called “vegetable alkali," and existing in all
plants. It was originally obtained from the ashes left after burning wood and vegetable structures, although it
is not limited to vegetable structures.
Kali-c. is typical of the Kali group of rem-
Kali carbonicum edies. The potassium salts have an affinity for solid tissues and blood corpuscles. The
fibrous tissues and ligaments of the joints, uterus and back are particularly affected. Tissues are often relaxed,
joints give way, the back feels as if broken, the patient feels compelled to lie down or lean on something.
Goullon specifically mentioned Kali-c. usefulness in chronic laryngeal catarrh and knee conditions. Useful for
conditions of the uterus, heart, lungs, pleura, bronchi and larynx.
Keynote sweat, backache and weakness. Weakness of the muscles, heart, the back, limbs, weakness
of intellect. Useful for patients with vague symptoms, or for those who withhold their symptoms. Soft pulse,
coldness. General depression. Soporific.
Sharp stitching, cutting pains. Jerking, stabbing or catching pains, better by motion, worse during rest and
lying on affected side. Stinging pains from within out, in muscles and internal parts. Throbbing pains, numbness
or coldness of single parts, abdomen, fingers. Pain in small spot, on left side, on uncovered parts. Parts lain
 on are painful or go to sleep.
Twitching of the muscles, rigidity and atony of the muscles. Convulsions, seems to pass off with belchings.
Tendency to start with a loud cry, when touched, even lightly, especially in the soles, which leads a thrill
throughout the whole body. Giving- out sensation.
Tendency to dropsy. Bag-like swellings over the eyes, between the eyebrows and the upper lids. For fleshy,
elderly people with dropsical and paretic tendencies. Fatty degeneration. Hypothyroidism.
Tuberculosis. Tubercular diathesis. Old gouty cases, advanced Bright's. Discharges are profuse and acrid.
Sudden unconsciousness. Closing of ulcers or fistulous openings, catching cold and over strain. Disposition
to phlebitis.
Goullon noted the importance of this polycrest in female complaints. It is similar to Sep., although it differs in
having pains and trouble before protracted and frequent menses. Menopausal flushings, associated
with disturbance of the heart, violent palpitations. Miscarriage, and the consequent debilitated states. Useful
after labor.
Sensitive to every atmospheric change and intolerance of cold weather. Early morning aggravation.
Generally worse 2 a.m. to 4 a.m.
MIND - Obstinate and dogmatic. Narrowminded, rigid, strong imprinted beliefs. Deep desire for routine,
propriety. Impractical, stoic. Refusal to admit to sickness. May mislead others by acting healthier than they
are.
Antagonism with herself. Quarrels with family. Peevish and irritable, after sex. Impetuous. Desirefor
company, yet treats them outrageously and worse from consolation.
Alternating mood, at one time good and quiet, at another excited and angry at trifles. Frequently hopeful,
frequently despondent. Indifference with bodily exhaustion. Sadness in open air. Great depression. Want of
self-confidence.
Mental dullness. Weakness of memory for expressing oneself. Impaired intellect. Absentminded, forgetful. At
a loss to know how to say what she wishes. Sudden attack of unconsciousness. Sensation as if bed were
sinking. Desire to be carried.
Full offear and imaginations. Frightened from touch. Fear of death when alone. Imagines himself sick.
Fears of the future, of the unknown, of ghosts. Fear of losing control. Kleptomania.
Anxiety, in stomach. Anxious about his own diseased condition. Anxiety from flatulence when lying on right
side. Anxiety, excitement when hungry. Nervous excitability, hysteria, sudden shrieking.
Hypersensitive to pain, noise touch. Easily startled, starts when touched especially on feet, on dropping to
sleep. Starting from noise. Never quiet or contented. Admonitions causes weeping. Weeping when telling of
her sickness. Weeping with headache. Abdomen - Yellow, scaly spots on ab
domen. Distension and coldness of abdomen. Hard, tympanitic and cold.
Abdomen feels as if it would burst. Hard distension of abdomen with painfulness
Kali carbonicum of umbilical region. Throbbing at navel. Much flatulence. Incarceration of flatus with colic.
Pain from left side through abdomen, must turn on right side before he can rise. Cutting pain as if intestines
were torn. Feeling as if a cold fluid passed through intestines during menses. Sensation of a lump rising from
the abdomen, to throat and on coughing. Swelling of inguinal glands.
Back - Backache as if broken. Severe backache before and during menses, during pregnancy, labor or
after a miscarriage. Stiffness and paralytic feeling in back. Backache with weak feeling, must lie down.
Backache, must rise in order to turn over in bed. Lumbago with sudden sharp pains extending up and down,
back and down the thighs. Lower back feels weak. Burning in spine (Gua.). Spine painful while eating.
Pulsations in back. Gnawing pain in coccyx. Pain in buttocks and thighs and hip joint. Sharp pain in region of
kidneys and right scapula. Tearing pain in lumbar region, impeding respiration. Swelling of cervical glands.
Breasts - Fine stitches in breasts. Swollen, sensitive and painful breasts, before menses.
Causations - Ill effects of suppressions of eruptions in childhood. Never well since pneumonia, catching cold,
overstrain.
Chest - Angina pectoris. Stabbing, stitching pains. Cutting pain in chest, worse lying on right side. Sore pain
in chest. Coldness of chest. Lungs seem to stick to the ribs. Whole chest very sensitive during coughing.
Weakness of chest from rapid walking, also tightness and oppression. Dull, painful stitches in chest. Pressure
in thechest. Small pimplesonchestandback. Painful swelling of axillary glands. Sweat in axilla. Hydrothorax.
Pleurisy.
Constitutions - Suited to dark haired, aged persons of lax tissue, inclined to be fat. To diseases after childbirth
or after loss of fluids. Suited for those who are thin blooded, cold, sensitive to atmospheric changes to every
draft of air, always shivering with dropsical and paralytic tendency. Tubercular diathesis.
 Kali carbonicum
Coughs - Dry, hard, suffocative, choking cough about 3 a.m. with sharp pains. Tormenting cough,
wakens from sleep. Cough with acute pain in chest. Cough with relaxed uvula. Incessant, hard retching or
choking, futile cough, then vomiting. Spasmodic cough with gagging or vomiting of ingesta and sour phlegm.
Cough after measles, worse eating or drinking.
Ears - Stitches in ears from within outwards. Itching in ears. Purulent discharge from ears. Discharge of yellow
liquid cerumen. Right ear is hot, left is pale and cold. Itching, cracking, ringing and roaring. Noises in ear with
headache. Noise is disagreeable. Intolerance of human voice.
Eyes - Asthenopia. Sharp pains in eyes. Pressure in and above eyes. Eyes as if pressed inward, while reading.
Soreness of external canthus, with burning pain. Small round ulcers on cornea. Painful sensation of light
penetrating the brain on shutting the eyes. Deep pain in eyes, with lachrymation and photophobia.
Lachrymation when yawning. Lids stick together in morning. Swelling of eyelids. Enormous bag-like swelling
under and over eyes. Swelling of glabella between brows. Cold eyelids.
Face - Haggard, exhausted look. Bloated in morning. Pale, sickly, sallow with sunken eyes. Freckles. Light
brown spots, old warts, papulous eruptions. Pimples on face and eyebrows, with redness and swelling.
Inflammation and swelling of parotids. Swelling of lower jaw and submaxillary glands. Tearing stitches in cheek.
Cramps in jaws. Drawing pain in face. One cheek hot, the other cold. Scurf on upper lip. Lips peel, chapped.
Female - Amenorrhea with backache. Difficult first menses. Menses, delayed in young girls with chest
symptoms and ascites. Suppressed menses with anasarca or ascites. Itching of vulva before menses.
Premenstrual syndrome, swollen breasts, water retention. Menses irritating, pungent odor. Violent colicky
pain before menses. Menses, early with profuse discharge (Calc.). Menses too late,
Kali carbonicum pale, scanty with soreness about genitals. Profuse and long-continued menses of bright red
blood. Menorrhagia, better taking bath. Uterine hemorrhage, constant oozing after copious flow with violent
backache, relieved from sitting and pressure. Hemorrhages after curetting or other treatments. Leucorrhea
with labor-like pains causing itching and burning, better washing. Soreness of genitals during sex and during
menses. Uterine tumors, cysts. Eclampsia, better belchings. Impending miscarriage with pains from back into
buttocks and thighs. Labor pains inefficient. Labor pains felt in back, down the hips and thighs. Complaints
after childbirth or miscarriage. After miscarriage, when there is great weakness of back. Puerperal fever
with cutting pain in hypogastrium with black and scanty urine. Promotes expulsion of moles.
Food - Disgust forfood or ravenous appetite. When hungry, feels anxious, nauseated, nervous, tingling,
palpitation etc. Wants to eat frequently but least food oppresses her. Disgust for food. Milk and warm food
disagree. Diarrhea worse milk. Ice water disagrees. Aversion to meat. Desire for sweets or acids.
Head - Burning in top of head and soles of feet. Headache from riding in cold wind. Headache comes on
with yawning. Wakes from headache. Headache into eyes, worse motion, sneezing, coughing, stooping,
yawning. Headache better when raising the head and pressing the forehead. Headache on riding in carriage.
Catarrhal, congestive headaches, better free discharge from nose. One-sided headache with nausea.
Throbbing and humming. Sensation as if something loose in head, turning, twisting towards the forehead.
Aching in occiput. Sharp pains in forehead, temples. Pressing as of a stone in forehead and vertex. Pressure
and drawing tearing in forehead. Great dryness of hair. Hair, dry, falls out (Fl-ac.) from eyebrows, temples
and beard. Painful tumors on scalp. Wens on scalp.
Heart - Angina pectoris. Tendency to fatty degeneration of heart. Dyspnea with violent and irregular beating
of heart. Threatened heart failure. Insufficiency of mitral valves. Pulse is small, soft, variable, intermittent or
dicrotic. Weak, rapid pulse intermits, due to digestive disturbance. Heart's action intermittent, irregular,
tumultuous, weak. Arrhythmia. Palpitations, then weakness, in valvular disease. Palpitations and burning in
heart region. Palpitations on slightest effort. Violent palpitations, shakes the whole body, throbbing
extending to fingertips and toes. Sensation as if heart were suspended, seems to hang by a thread. Sharp
pains about heart and through to scapula.
Kidneys - Sharp pain in kidneys, going from buttocks to thighs. Burning in left kidney. Nephritis from
exposure to cold or injury. Pressure on bladder long before urination, the more it is pressed less the urine
flows. Slow urination with burning in urethra. Urine, foamy with thick red sediment. Rises several times at
night to urinate. Nocturnal bedwetting of adults. Involuntary urination when coughing, sneezing, etc.
Limbs - Arthritis. Deformative arthritis, worse in small joints. Rheumatic joint pains. Nightly rheumatic pains.
Sharp, aching pains in the joints and tendons. Pressive pain in joints. Limbs go to sleep easily. Back and legs
give out. Limbs feel numb and heavy. Uneasiness, heaviness, jerking, tearing and swelling in limbs. Limbs
sensitive to pressure. Jerks the limbs, especially when the feet are touched. Cold hands and cold feet in
bed. Sciatica, tearing pain in the thighs with jerking of muscles. Paralysis of elderly people and dropsical
disorders. Hip joint disease. Weakness in arms, feel numb, cold. Tearing in arms from shoulder to wrist.
 Lacerating in wrist joint. Pain from hip to knee. Knees painful, worse going downstairs or upstairs. White
swelling of knees. Soles very sensitive. Itching of great toes with pain. Spasmodic contraction of fingers and
toes. Tips of toes and fingers
Kali carbonicum painful. Burning like fire in fingers.
Liver - Sharp pain or soreness. Chronic liver troubles, with soreness. Jaundice and dropsy.
Lungs - Shortness of breath in morning. Dyspnea, as if no air could get into lungs. Labored breathing, after
paroxysms of cough. Arrest of breath awakens at night. Leaning forward relieves chest symptoms.
Asthmatic, wheezing, worse least motion or walking. Asthma, worse from 2 a.m. to 4 a.m. Asthma, alternating
with diarrhea with vertigo. Asthma, better when sitting up or bending forward. Asthma, better from rocking
back and forth. Asthma with loss of appetite. Tendency to colds, better in warm climate. Bronchitis, whole
chest very sensitive. Pneumonia. Pneumonia, after measles. Never well since pneumonia. Pleurisy. Pleuritis
with violent palpitations. Hydrothorax. Tendency to tuberculosis. Whooping cough. Expectoration must be
swallowed, cheesy taste, copious, offensive, lumpy. Expectoration scanty and tenacious.
Male - Copious, painful pollutions with painful erections. Strange, uneasy feeling in genitals. Chronic
gonorrhea, painful scanty discharge, burning during and after urination. Complaints after sex. Excessive
emissions, followed by weakness. Prostration after sex, often with shuddering. Sleeplessness and
uneasiness for 2 or 3 days after sex. Aversion to sex.
Modalities - Better in warm weather, warmth, open air, moving about, sitting with elbows on knees. Worse
from cold air, cold weather, draft, change of weather, after overheating. Worse 2 a.m. to 4 a.m., lying on left
side, lying on painful side. Worse exertion, sudden or unguarded motion, touch, stooping, sex. Worse soup,
coffee, water, loss of fluids. Worse since pneumonia. Worse before menses, after childbirth, miscarriage.
Mouth - Offensive odor from mouth every morning, like old cheese. Much saliva constantly in mouth. Bad,
slimy taste. Mouth covered with painful, burning vesicles. Aphthae. General dryness of mouth without thirst,
with stricture of
esophagus in gastritis. Sticking and biting in posterior portion of palate. Burning, soreness or painful pimples
on tip of tongue. Gums separate from teeth. Itching in gums, pus oozes out.
Nose - Swollen, hard, red, covered with pimples. Itching, burning in nose. Sore, scurfy, crusty nostrils.
Ulcerated nostrils. Dryness of nose alternating with obstruction. Chronic catarrh. Chronic colds. Breathes
through mouth. Obstruction better walking in open air. Stuffs up in warm room. Descending coryza. Coryza
during menses. Post-nasal dripping (Spig.). Fetid, thick, fluent, yellow-green, crusty discharge. Bloody nasal
mucus. Nosebleed on washing face in morning. Ulcerative pain in right nostril.
Perspiration - Offensive or sour smelling sweat. Scanty sweat, foul on feet. Perspires on slightest exertion.
General inability to sweat. Sweats on painful part, on affected part. Sweats mostly on upper parts. Sweats at
night, without relief, with cough. Perspires on every mental exertion, reading, writing. Perspires after
pneumonia. Perspires after eating. Easily sweats, excited by exercise during day. Warm drinks aggravates.
Rectum - Discharge of much flatus. Ascarides. Constipation, after or during menses, in women after frequent
miscarriages or multiple and difficult childbirths (Sep.). Constipation alternating with diarrhea. Ineffectual urging
to stool, rectum feels too weak to expel it. Chronic diarrhea of dyspeptics, only during the day. Painless diarrhea
with rumbling in abdomen and burning at anus. Stitching like fine needles during pregnancy or red-hot poker
in rectum, better cool bathing. Burning in rectum and anus. Itching of rectum (Ign.). Itching, ulcerated pimples
around anus. Easy prolapse of rectum (Graph., Podo.). Anal fistula. Hemorrhoids, large, swollen, painful, burn
like fire, Hemorrhoids extremely sensitive to touch, inflamed, bleeding. Pain in hemorrhoids when coughing.
Sensations - Sensation as if bed were sinking. Sensation of a lump rolling over on coughing, rising from right
abdomen to throat. Pulsative pains and throbbings. Burning sensation and burning pains. Whole body as if it
were hollow.
Skin - Skin dry, sensitive, itching, better scratching. Eczema eruption dry at first, but when scratched exuding
moisture. Burning as from mustard plaster. General itching or hives during menses. Nettle rash before menses.
Itching of warts. Tension, pressure, rending in scars. Herpetic spots on face. Ulcers bleed at night.
Sleep - Yawns with headache. Sleepiness during forepart of day and during day. Drowsy after eating, falls
asleep while eating. Sleeplessness from cough. Nocturnal restlessness before menses. Restless, dreamful
sleep during menses. Twitching of limbs, grinding of teeth, crying while sleeping. Talks in sleep. Wakes at 1
a.m. or 2 a.m., cannot sleep again. Wakes at about 2 a.m. to 4 a.m. with nearly all complaints. Horrid, anxious
dreams with frequent awaking and desire to urinate. Dreams of water, thieves, misfortunes, diseases, dead
people. Erotic, imaginative, fantastic, sentimental.
Stomach - Anxiety felt in stomach. Easy choking when eating. Gagging. Fullness even after little drink or
food. Feeling of lump in pit of stomach. Stomach feels as if it would burst. Constant feeling as if stomach
were full of water. Epigastric pain to back. Epigastrium is very sensitive externally. Gastric disorders from ice
 water. Dyspepsia of old people, burning acidity, bloating. Everything eaten seems to turn into gas.
Flatulence, distended and sensitive. Salty, sour regurgitation. Sour belchings. Sour eructations before
menses. Nausea on every inward emotion. Nausea with faintness and anxiety. Nausea, better lying down.
Nausea at sight of food, in morning. Vomiting of sour mucus, ingesta and slime. Nocturnal vomiting of food.
Nausea during pregnancy.
Stools - Stools, difficult, large, hard lumps, with sharp pains. Stool like sheep's dung. Large discharge of blood
with natural
stool. Stools followed by burning or torn feeling. Insufficient soft stool after much pressure most of it remains.
Teeth - Tearing, lancinating pains. Drawing pains. Tearing pain in teeth, jaws. Stitches in teeth with swelling
of cheeks. Toothache only while eating. Toothache, alternating with stitching pains in left breast, only while
eating. Looseness of teeth. Gums separate from teeth. Pyorrhea. Itching in gums, pus oozes out.
Temperature - Chills with dyspnea, hot hands and sleepiness in open air. Frequent shuddering during day.
Chilly in morning. Internal heat with external chilliness. Internal burning. Fever with surging of blood or
throbbing in blood vessels. Fever with dyspnea.
Throat - Dry, parched, rough. Hoarseness and loss of voice. Stricture of esophagus. Swallowing difficult,
food slowly descends, remains halfway in esophagus with gagging and vomiting. Small particles of food go
easily in windpipe. Sticking pain as from fish bone or splinters. Stinging pain when swallowing. Sore throat,
always takes cold and the cold settles in throat. Throat feels as if squeezed, as if lungs came into throat.
Catarrhal aphonia with violent sneezing. Scratching and stinging in throat and chest during cough. Hawks up
tough mucus in morning. Tonsils enlarged. Swelling of cervical glands.
Tongue - Tongue, gray-white. Tip of tongue burns as if raw. Burning, soreness or painful pimples on tip of
tongue. Tongue covered with painful, burning vesicles. Tongue coated gray, in sick headache.
Vertigo - Vertigo on turning around, when rapidly turning head or body, when walking. Vertigo from riding in a
carriage. Vertigo, as if proceeding from stomach. Must lie down as soon as vertigo comes on, otherwise he is
thrown down. Vertigo, as after intoxication.
Vision - Vision weak after measles, miscarriage, after sex. Spots, gauze and black points before the eyes.
Bright sparks, blue, green spots, drops. Muscae volitantes while reading or looking at a bright light.
Sees sparks, during cough. Can't fix sight of any object steadily without water running from eyes and feeling
of dizziness.
COMMENTS - Generally very sensitive to changes in weather, particularly sensitive in affected area. Chilly,
tendency to take cold. Symptoms worse when body temperature is low, aversion to open air. Very sensitive to
drafts, will catch a cold at every little draft. Cannot tolerate drafts (Nux-v., Calc., Hep., Sulph.).
Easily startled by any noise, especially if unexpected. Cannot bear to be touched, starts when touched ever
so lightly, especially on the feet. Generally right sided, particularly the base of the right lung, and the apices,
according to Goullon. Worse exertion.
Characteristic sweat, backache and weakness, particularly in conditions of debility from loss of fluids. Keynote
bag-like swellings or puffiness around the upper eye, eyebrow, can be between the eyebrows. Alternating
symptoms. Organ pathology due to suppressed mental symptoms.
Constant backache, with a giving out feeling in the back and legs, or as if the back was broken. The pain may
extend downwards to the buttocks and even to the knee. Pain from hip to knee (more especially if right sided).
Lower backache, especially during labor, menstrual cramps.
Lumbago. Hip joint disease. Spasms, puerperal convulsions and paralysis. Twitching of muscles, rigidity of
muscles, muscular atony. Disposition to over lifting.
Stitching pains, pulsations, better by pressure and by lying flat on the back. Sharp, stabbing pains that are
worse motion. Sticking, burning, sharp pains like knives or needles. Sharp pains, wandering and stabbing,
especially with arthritis.
Osteoarthritis, deformative arthritis and migratory arthritis, pains that go from joint to joint. Burning and stabbing
pains in the fingers and toes. Gout, gouty arthritis. Stiffness in neck and shoulders. Pain worse motion, with
sharp pains. Edema. Peripheral edema, varicose veins.
Affinity for tissues. Tumors, cancers and fibroids. Affects the blood and circulation. Anemia with great debility,
skin watery, milky white. Hemorrhages.
Dropsical disorders. Ulcers, bleeding at night.
Throbbing of blood vessels all over body and to ends of fingers and toes. Irregular heart. Fatty degeneration
of the heart and other muscles. Sensation as if the heart were suspended by a thread. History of heart attack.
Great affinity for the lungs. Pneumonia and pleurisy (Bry.), worse coughing or movement, better pressure.
Chronic respiratory problems in the elderly (Phos.). Sharp, stabbing, and stitching pains in the lungs.
Oppression of breathing. Shortness of breath. Asthma, better sitting up in bed or on all fours. May sit up in bed
 with pillows (Ars.), may sleep sitting up.
Coughs worse from 2 a.m. to 4 a.m. Dry, paroxysmal cough, loosens viscid mucus or pus which must be
swallowed. Spasms with gagging or vomiting of ingesta. Expectoration of hard, white or smoky masses, which
fly from the throat when coughing, with globules of pus.
Tendency to sinus headaches. Useful for sick headaches. Violent headaches about the inner temples, violent
stitching or jerking pains, on one side of the head or both. Onesided headache with nausea. Pressure and
drawing in forehead extending into eyes and root of nose. Congestion to head and heat of face often
accompany the headaches.
Toothache, only when eating. Easy choking, foodeasily gets into windpipe. Difficulty swallowing. Pain in the
back when swallowing. Fish bone sensation in the throat, general tendency to stitching pains.
Disordered digestion, flatulence, distention, constipation. Gas, bloating, craving for sweets (Lyc.). Intolerance
for milk, aversion to brown bread. Colic pains, severe colitis. Lack of muscular control especially with urologic
things. History of diabetes.
Premenstrual syndrome with bloating, water retention. Very sensitive breasts, painful before the period.
Backache with period, or
preceding period. Insufficient labor pains, transferred labor. Labor pains felt in back (Cimic., felt in thighs).
Insomnia, cannot relax, without reason. Unrefreshed sleep. Drowsiness, while eating. Worse after sex, feel
weak and prostrated (Sil., Calc.), sleepless after sex. Complaints after sex in males, especially complaints of
the eyes.
One case of a headache that Clarke cured was better by lying down, better by a tight band around the head.
A man had an ulcer of the right leg with swelling of the ankle and he complained of waking at 2 a.m. Kali-c.
30c cured, but in the meantime he developed a great weakness of the right thigh, as if it would give out when
walking.
The symptom “pain from the hip to the knee” led to a cure in a woman, 73, stout, short, pale and of very soft
tissue, who had for four months suffered from rheumatic pains, and an offensive vaginal discharge.
A local practitioner was consulted and pronounced it cancer of the womb in an advanced stage and gave her
four months to live. She described to Clarke the pain as being all around the lower abdomen and a ‘‘dull,
heavy, depressing, dead pain, commencing at the inner part of the top of the right hip, iliac crest and extending
to the knee.”
The pain was so severe it made her feel quite sick and faint. The discharge was very offensive like decaying
meat. Great weakness and trembling accompanied the discharge. Urine was almost like blood at times, and
had a sandy sediment.
Kali-c. 1,000c. was given and at once improvement set in. In a few months all the bad symptoms had
disappeared and never returned. The patient lived ten years after this episode.
Id of Stettin, Germany, recorded the case of a woman, 65, who suffered from chronic bronchial catarrh and
emphysema. In November, 1886, she had asthmatic complaints, depriving her of sleep with cough and mucus
expectoration difficult to raise.
She was so weary when eating that she fell asleep and could not finish her meal.
Tired after eating. In the morning, passed much flatulence. Kali-c. 10c removed the condition in a few days.
The following March after a cold there was a recurrence, but without the weariness, and Kali-c. failed. Ars. 15c
rapidly cured.
The same patient also had a toothache alternating with tearing, stitching pain in left breast and under left false
ribs. The side pains were worse at night, especially in evening as soon as she lay down, worse lying down,
particularly worse lying on the right (painless) side. Not influenced by pressure or motion.
RELATIONS - Antidotes: Camph., Coff. Compare: (1) Kali-sal. - vomiting, especially of pregnancy,
arteriosclerosis with chronic rheumatism. (2) Kali-sil. - gouty nodosities. (3) Kali-acet. - diabetes, diarrhea,
dropsy, alkaline urine, very much increased in quantity. (4) Kali-cit. - Bright's disease-1 grains to wineglass of
water. (5) Kali-ox - lumbago, convulsions. . (6) Kali-pic. - jaundice, violent belchings. (7) Kali-t. - paraplegia.
(8) Kali-tel. - garlicky odor of breath, salivation, swollen tongue. (9) Calc., Am-p., Phos., Lyc., Bry., Nat-m,
Stann., Sep. Complementary: Carb-v. - lowness of vitality may suggest a preliminary course of Carb-v. to
nurse up recuperation to the point that Kali-c. would come in helpfully. Follows: Nux-v. often in stomach and
bladder troubles.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.
keynote:
PHARMACY - kali-c. Kali carbonicum. Potassium carbonate. Potassic carbonate. Salt of Tartar. Solution.
Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Anemia. Asthma. Axilla, perspiration. Backaches. Biliousness. Bronchitis.
Catarrh. Chilblains. Colds. Coughs. Debility. Dropsy. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspepsia. Ear, inflammation. Eyes,
inflammation. Face, blotches. Fears. Freckles. Hair, disorders. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hemorrhage.
Hemorrhoids. Hip joint disease

name: Kali Chloricum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-kali-chl. Kali Chloricum. Potassium chlorate. Potassic chlorate. Trituration. Solution. Historical
 dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL -Albuminuria. Anemia. Aphthae. Asthma. Cancrum oris. Clumsiness. Colic. Convulsions. Crusta
lactea. Cystitis. Dysentery. Edema. Epithelioma. Facial, paralysis. Hangnails. Hematuria. Hemorrhages. Hem-
orrhoids. Hepatitis. Mercurial, poisoning. Mouth, inflammation. Nephritis. Neuralgias. Noma. Paralysis.
Pharyngitis. Pimples. Proctalgia. Purpura. Scurvy. Stomatitis. Syphilis. Tic douloureux. Toxemia. Ulcers.
HOMEOPATHIC - Kali-chl. is not to be confused with the chloride that constitutes Schiissler's Kali-m. Hering
amalgamated the symptoms of the two under the heading Kali- m., but Clarke kept them separate. Kali-chl. is
an exceedingly active poison. It has long been used in the old school in solution as a wash for sore mouth and
foul ulcers.
Hutchinson observed a number of cases in which it produced the very condition that it was give to cure, the
“most acute ulceration and follicular stomatitis. The whole mucus surface was red and tumid and in the cheeks,
lips, etc., were numerous gray-based ulcers.”
Fatal poisoning has occurred, death occurring in convulsions. The blood is disorganized and after death, the
liver, spleen and kidneys are found softened and filled with disorganized blood, this should give it a place in
cases of lardaceous and fatty degeneration of solid viscera. The mouth, hypochondria and rectum are the most
affected.
Profound prostration, coldness in different parts and organs. Easy hemorrhages, nosebleed, bloody stools etc.
Hemoglobinuria. Anemia. Septicemia. Noma. Discharges are fetid. Gray, white, plastic exudates.
Chronic nephritis. Parenchymatous nephritis with stomatitis. Acute ulcerative and follicular stomatitis. Scurvy.
Hepatitis. Lardaceous and fatty degeneration of liver, spleen and kidneys and other solid organs. Toxemic
conditions of pregnancy with urinary symptoms.
MIND - Cheerfulness alternating with sadness. Confusion while walking in open air. Confusion from wine.
Delusion he must starve. Refuses to eat. Desires death during chill.
Abdomen - Griping colic with shifting of flatulence and diarrhea, followed by continuous rectal pain.
Chest - Constriction of chest, as from sulphur fumes.
Face - Swollen, she can hardly see in the morning. Neuralgic pains, worse talking, eating or slight touch,
followed by numbness.
Heart - Coldness in precordial region. Right pulse full, left small. Coldness in blood.
Kidneys - Nephritis. Urine albuminous, scanty, suppressed. Albumin and bile, high phosphoric acid with low
total solids. Hematuria, diuresis.
Limbs - Ankles swell in the evening. Arms, feet cold.
Modalities - Better from nosebleed, mental symptoms. Worse from cold, coughing, sneezing, ajar, mercury.
Mouth - Whole mucus surface red, tumid with gray-based ulcers. Stomatitis, aphthous and gangrenous.
Fetor. Noma. Scurvy. Salivation, profuse secretion of acid saliva. Tongue, swollen, cold. Mercurial stomatitis
(as a mouth wash).
Nose - Bleeding at night, only from right nostril.
Rectum - Diarrhea, profuse, greenish mucus. Griping colic with shifting of flatulence and diarrhea, followed by
continuous rectal pain. Dysentery, much blood passing with mucus, profuse greenish. Cries with violent cutting
pain in the rectum in dysentery and diarrhea.
Skin - Cold. Jaundice. Discolored, chocolate tint. Pimples between lip and chin. Itching miliary or papular
eruptions.
Stomach - Sudden, incessant vomiting of all food, of offensive dark green mucus. Stomach cold. Sensations
of a weight in the epigastric and umbilical regions. Flatulence.
Throat - Cold feeling in throat.
COMMENTS - Rushmore recorded a proving of Kali-chl. in an unmarried woman, 50, short, brunette, who had
goiter in early life, which disappeared under the application of iodine. Later on, a fibroid tumor developed in
the uterus. For this the patient was advised to take crude potassium chlorate, dissolved in water, daily.
Symptoms observed included an increased moral irritability. Felt dreadfully dull and stupid. Dizzy on stooping
and rising. Slight headache over eyes, objects appear double, beside each other. Face swollen so she could
hardly see on rising in morning. Smarting of tongue.
Kali-chl. took away her desire for acids. Diminished appetite. Much commotion and flatulence in abdomen.
Increased urine.
Dreams of terrible things never thought. Great coolness, shivering on cold days, seemed as if it cooled off her
blood. Clumsiness. General bloated feeling.
In the provers, great weakness manifested. Rheumatic and neuralgic pains, many occurring in the facial
nerves. Facial paralysis. Pimples in various parts, between lip and chin. The heart was the seat of much dis-
turbance, and a coldness was felt about the précordia. Disordered stomach and bowels. Excited sexual organs.
 Allen credited Kali-chl. with the cure of “Dysentery with most violent cutting pains as from knives, frequent
stools, tenesmus, making the patient cry out, evacuations very small, almost pure blood, great prostration.”
Allen noted that it cured epithelioma of the face and of the great toe.
RELATIONS - Antidote to: Merc. Compare: (1) Especially Kali-m. (2) Caust. - facial paralysis. (3) Kali-bi. -
follicular pharyngitis. (4) Zinc., Cadm-s. and Cact. - asthma with great constriction of chest. (5) Graph., Kali-n.
and Nat-m. - cold feeling about heart.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Kali Chlorosum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - kali-chls. Kali chlorosum. Javelle water. Bleaching fluid. Formula variable, contains potassium
hypochlorate principally, chloride and some carbonate. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Aphonia. Asthma. Coryza. Diphtheria.
HOMEOPATHIC - The observations with Javelle water are from poisoning cases. The most notable symptoms
were watery eyes, pale, puffy face, and constriction of the throat and chest. Much sensitivity. Sensitiveness of
epigastrium and especially of larynx and whole anterior portion of neck. Cramps and restlessness.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Kali-chl., Calc- m., Chlor., Nat-hchls.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Kali Citricum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - kali-cit. Kali citricum. Potassium citrate. Citrate of potash. Solution. Trituration. Historical dose:
Trituration and all potencies.
HOMEOPATHIC - Kali-cit. has been used in solution (eight to ten grains to a wineglass of water) to assist the
action of the kidneys in sufferers from Bright's disease who were under the absolute skim-milk dietary. It has
also been used in the same way in old school practice, as a solvent for gouty concretions about joints.
COMMENTS - Kali-cit. has not been proved, but “Agricola” recorded the effect of a large dose given by an
allopath to a patient suffering from suppressed kidney action after influenza.
In three days the kidneys acted freely, but new symptoms were set up including tympanites, a constant flow
of mucus from the anus. Awful gastric and abdominal pains, “as if a machine were at work inside, skinning the
inside of the stomach and the whole length of the intestinal tube” (Nit-ac.). Flatus was constant and in great
amount, producing a pain of its own, which was a prominent feature.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Kali Cyanatum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - kali-cy. Kali cyanatum. Potassium cyanide. Cyanide of potash. Kali cyanidum. Kali cyanuretum.
Solution. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Aphasia. Asthma. Cancer. Cheyne-Stokes. Chills. Ciliary, neuralgias. Convulsions. Epilepsy. Eye,
disorders. Facial pain. Headaches. Memory lost. Neuralgias. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Speech, lost. Strokes.
Tongue, cancer. Vertigo.
HOMEOPATHIC - Commonly used in photography. As it is easily accessible, many cases of suicide and
attempted suicide have occurred by its means. It is from the symptoms observed in such cases, as well as the
provings by Lembke
and others, that this remedy is understood.
Agonizing neuralgias, especially of orbital and supra-maxillary with screaming and loss of consciousness.
Neuralgic pains are unbearable, more common in the temporal and facial regions involving the trigeminal
nerve.
Ciliary neuralgia, trifacial neuralgia, tic douloureux. Epilepsy. General convulsions. Sudden convulsive action
of whole body, about ten minutes after heart ceased to beat. Sphincters rigidly contracted.
Sudden sinking sensation. Sick headache. Stroke. Prolonged stupor. Intense vertigo, objects seem to be
moving around him. Head drawn backwards, unable to tolerate any covering on head. Convulsive motion of
eyelids and eyeballs. Pupils largely dilated and insensible to light. Obscuration of vision.
Cheyne-Stokes breathing. Asthma. Cancer of the tongue with indurated edges. Speech loss. Rheumatism.
Sciatica, unsteady gait.
MIND - Gentle disposition. Irritability with absent persons. Crossness almost uncontrollable on entering room,
but cold, open air produces good mood. Aphasia, inability to recollect certain words for several days. Lies on
 floor in a deep stupor.
Abdomen - A feeling as if bowels were about to act. Pains in abdomen and groin in afternoon.
Back - Vague pain in neck. Marked weakness in lumbar regions with dull pain and weakness of iliac region,
while walking and in afternoon.
Chest - Anxious feeling in the chest. Oppression of chest.
Ears - Rushing in ears.
Eyes - Eyes fixed. Eyelids began to open and shut alternately, eyeballs stared in different directions. Eyes
closed, but on raising lids the eyeballs were seen to be in uninterrupted convulsive motion. Swelling of upper
lids. Pupils largely distended and insensible to light. Obscuration of vision. Loss of sight, then double vision as
sight returns. Diplopia.
Face - Severe neuralgia in temporal region, recurring daily at same hour. Pain in orbital and supra-maxillary
region, with screaming and loss of consciousness.
Head - Head drawn backwards. Gnawing pain across temple. Sharp pains in occiput. Soreness of scalp over
parietal regions. Unable to tolerate any covering on head, whether in the cold or warmth, because it causes a
headache for months after.
Heart - Stitches in heart and lungs. Jerking stitches in heart on respiration. Palpitation of heart. Pulse at times
fifteen beats slower than usual.
Kidneys - Bladder distended by a large amount of urine, which has to be evacuated by a catheter. Urine came
away involuntarily.
Limbs - Unsteady gait. Limbs icy cold, rigid and convulsed. Limbs are flaccid with occasional convulsions
more like a shuddering than anything else. Tetanic spasms of muscles of arms and legs.
Lungs - Cough prevents sleep, respiration weak, cannot take deep breath. Hoarse voice. Loud mucus rattle.
Superficial respiration, slow and difficult breathing. Respiration nearly suspended, but thorax convulsively
raised, at irregular intervals, far apart.
Modalities - Better from motion in open air. Worse from 4 a.m. to 4 p.m.
Mouth - Cancerous ulceration of tongue with indurated edges. Tongue has peculiar dark ground seen
through heavy, white coating. Lips and mucus membrane of mouth pale. Slight frothing at the mouth. Difficult
speech, power of speech lost but intelligence intact.
Nose - Inside of nose is parched, hot and dry. Expelling blood, blood drying quickly in nose.
Rectum - Bowels obstinately constipated, feces came away involuntarily.
Sleep - Sleepiness during day. Restless, dream filled sleep all night, could not lie on one side for any length
of time. Dreams very lively, especially towards morning, can be horrid, exciting.
Stomach - Copious vomiting, followed by return of consciousness. Severe burning in stomach. Sharp gastric
pains. Great sensitiveness of epigastric region. Pain at epigastrium of a griping intermittent character.
Temperature - Hands and face covered with cold perspiration. Surface of whole body cold and moist. Shivers.
Coldness of limbs, pendulous and without muscular power. Chill on waking from naps, or wakes him before
he can get soundly asleep, followed by a very slight sweat. Wakes 6 a.m. with heat and disagreeable feverish
perspiration over whole body, except legs below the knees with flushed face.
Throat - Astringent sensation in throat with nausea, lasting until after midnight. Feeling of constriction about
fauces, with muscular tremors about throat, great stiffness in throat after. Patient was able to swallow as soon
as a large amount of fluid filled the pharynx, after every swallow the whole body was seized with convulsive
tremors and flushes of redness spreading over the face. Had no sensation of act of swallowing.
Vertigo - Intense vertigo, so that all objects seemed to be moving around him.
COMMENTS - Stroke and epileptic symptoms (Hydr-ac.), with pronounced, slow breathing. Strong tetanic
convulsions. Loss of consciousness and vision, vision returns doubled when consciousness returns. The chief
clinical uses have been in epithelioma of the tongue, apoplectic and epileptic conditions, respiratory disorders,
rheumatism of the joints and neuralgias.
In one poisoning case, the fingers were stretched out and spasmodically contracted.
In another case, after the failure of all efforts to restore the patient (a photographer) with ether injections and
repeated washings out of the stomach, he was placed in a hot bath and icy-cold water was poured over his
head and nape.
Each time water was poured on his head, the patient drew deep inspirations which gradually grew deeper and
more regular until consciousness was restored.
Kali cyanatum
He complained of sharp occipital and gastric pains. Convalescence was rapid, but a general muscular
weakness and impairment of speech lasted a long time.
Cattel recorded in the early volumes of the Brit. Jour, of Homeopathy several remarkable cases of neuralgia
 cured by Kali-cy. He followed Hering's guiding symptoms, “agonizing attacks of neuralgic pains between
temporal regions and ciliary arch and maxilla with screaming and apparent loss of sensibility, as if struck with
a stroke, pulse 84, face flushed.”
“Severe neuralgia in temporal region and left upper jaw, daily at 4 a.m. increasing until 10 and ceasing at 4
p.m. in the interval, anorexia, fever, headache.” The symptoms were worse in a room, worse immediately after
meals (fullness), and better by motion in open air.
E. T. Adams treated an inveterate whiskeydrinker, 55, for a swelling on the right side of the tongue, excavated
so deeply that the first joint of the thumb could be laid in it. It had been pronounced cancerous.
The patient could take no solid nutriment and fluids only with great pain. Under Kali- cy., he recovered rapidly,
was able to walk and to eat dry bread and cooked beef with comparative ease. Persuaded by his former
attendants to undergo operation, he died nineteen days after.
Pertroz was the first to give Kali-cy. 1,000c in cases of this kind. A woman had cancerous ulcer of right side of
tongue involving the root. With a view of relieving the woman's sufferings. Petroz gave her Kali-cy. 1.000c
once in four days.
In two weeks the suffering was much diminished, the tongue appeared less thick and speech easier. In another
fortnight the patient's countenance had lost its gray hue and drawn features and she could eat a crumb of
bread. The case went on to complete and permanent cure.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Plat., Stann., Cedr., Mez. (2) Mur-ac. (3) Hy-ac., Camph. (3) In periodic ciliary
neuralgia, Cedrón. (4) Neuralgiagradually increasing and decreasing, Stann., Plat. (5) Also, according to
Cooper, Sulph. (6) Sudden onset, gradual decfine, Sul-ac. (7) Fingers spread out, Sec.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Murphy.

Fatty and functional heart troubles. Pulse weak, small, irregular. Uterine symptoms with a bearing-down
sensation (Sep.) and gastric sinking. Profuse, pus-like leucorrhea with a passive hemorrhage.

name: Kali Iodatum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - kali-i. Kali iodatum. Potassium iodide. Kali hydroiodicum. Solution. Trituration. Historical dose:
Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne, rosacea. Actinomycosis. Allergies. Aneurysm. Anhidrosis. Arteriosclerosis. Asthma. Boils.
Bright's, disease. Bubo. Bunions. Cancer. Cachexia. Colds. Condylomata. Coryza. Coughs. Croup. Debility.
Decay, bones. Dropsy. Ears. pain. Edema, glottidis. Emaciation. Erythema, nodosum. Eyes, disorders. Facial,
neuralgias. Fibroids. Gland, swellings. Goiter. Gonorrhea. Gout. Hemorrhages. Hay fever. Housemaid's
knee. Influenza. Inter-menstrual, hemorrhage.Inris. Joints, disorders. Laryngitis. Liver, diseases. Locomotor,
ataxia. Lumbago. Lungs, disorders. Meningitis. Menstruation, disorders. Neuralgias. Nodes. Noises, ears.
Nystagmus. Odor, body. Pancreatitis. Paralysis. Pleurisy. Pleuritic, effusion. Prostate, disorders. Radiation,
poisoning. Rheumatism. Rickets. Rupia. Sciatica. Scrofula. Smallpox. Spine, curvature. Spleen. Syphilis.
Thyroid, disorders. Tic, douloureux. Tinnitus. Tongue, neuralgia. Tuberculosis. Tumors. Ulcers. Wens.
 HOMEOPATHIC - Potassium iodide was used as anti-syphilitic remedy and is also antidotal to mercury. Kali-
i. is perhaps more anti-scrofulous than anti-syphilitic. It acts best in scrofulous patients, especially if syphilis or
mercurialization, or both, are added. It also causes infiltration, edema and dropsy of various kinds. The blood
is acted upon and hemorrhage occurs, and purpura hemorrhagica.
Grimmer said Kali-i. cured many types of tumors and cancers generally based on a syphilitic or tubercular
miasms, and often there is a combination of both these in many cases of malignancy. Nightly aggravations of
complaints.
Hering spoke of Kali-i. as having been curative in pneumonia and Bright's disease. Specific for aneurysm. Has
been commended as a protective against foot and-mouth disease in cattle. In material doses, for fungoid
disease (thrush, ringworm, etc. ) and bacterial
diseases like tuberculosis.
Syphilis. In acute form with evening, remitting fever, going off in nightly perspiration. Second stage, mucus
membranes and skin ulcerations. Tertiary symptoms, nodes.
Glandular swellings. Glands enlarged and indurated. Glands are swollen or atrophied. Dropsy from
pressure from swollen glands. Infiltrations, edema. Profuse, watery, acrid coryza, especially when associated
with pain in frontal sinus. Discharges are copious, watery, acrid, salty, thick, green or foul. Spitting blood.
Exostosis, swelling of the bones and rickets. Feels used up. Crushing or sharp stitching pains. Diffused
soreness after pains of affected part. Pains long after injury. Coldness of painful part in bones.
Purpura and hemorrhagic diathesis. Diffused sensitiveness, of glands, scalp, etc. Rheumatism in neck,
back, and feet, especially heels and soles. Rheumatism, worse cold and wet. Contraction of muscles and
tendons, chronic arthritis with spurious ankylosis.
Weakness, emaciation. Arteriosclerosis. Cachexia. Actinomycosis. Fungoid diseases. Tea-taster's cough due
to inhaling the fungus. Craves motion in open air. Brings about often favorable reaction in many chronic
ailments even when not clearly symptomatically indicated.
MIND - Always troubled. Despondent. Tri vial details of life seem insupportable. Nervous, must walk.
Troublesome impressions easily become fixed ideas. Loss of memory. Cannot find words at the moment
wanted, cannot write, play music, or think.
Anxious. Fright at every trifle, starting from noise. Inclined to sadness and weeping, especially in the evening.
Half-mad all night, talkative and full of jokes. Dreads the return of dawn.
Restlessness during headache. Abusive, bad temper. Harsh tempered and cruel. Irritable, irascible, especially
towards his children, his family. Indifference to her children. Aversion to being touched.
Abdomen - Flatulence with air hunger. Squeaking or clucking noise in abdomen. Sudden painful bloating of
abdomen. Cutting and burning pain around navel. Swollen spleen after intermittent. Inguinal glands swollen.
Back - Small of the back as if in a vice. Bruised pain in lumbar region worse sitting bent. Pain in coccyx, as
from a fall. Sharp pain in small of back when sitting. Chronic rheumatism of chest and back. Chills from sacrum
up over back.
Breasts - Atrophy of breasts. Tumor of breast. Galactorrhea.
Chest - Air-passages raw. Chest pains go backwards. Pain from sternum to back.
Constitutions - Hemorrhagic diathesis. Gouty, rheumatic, syphilitic diathesis.
Cough - Violent cough, worse morning. Dry, morning and evening, with soreness of larynx, or rawness in
throat. Deep, hollow, with whitish and greenish sputum, and tearing pain starting from ensiform cartilage.
Hoarse, with pain through chest.
Ears - Tearing pain in right ear. Boring pain in the ears. Otitis media. Membranae tympani depressed with
adhesions. Noises in ear. Tinnitus. Deafness.
Eyes - Sunken eyes. Conjunctivared. Puffy, burning, watery eyes. Profuse lachrymation. Syphilitic iritis.
Pustular keratitis and chemosis. Glaucoma. Pustules on cornea. Constant oscillations of the eyeballs. Winking
is painful. Photophobia. Bony tumors of the orbit. Edema around eyes. Edema of eyelids with lachrymation.
Lower lids twitch.
Face - Red face, with anxiety and restlessness. Blotches on cheeks. Facial neuralgias. Sharp pain in upper
jaw. Tight pain at zygomata. Glutinous mucus on lips in a.m. Dry, chapped lips. Swelling and suppuration of
submaxillary glands.
Female - Menses late, profuse. Menses too scanty. Dysmenorrhea with great urging to urinate. Uterus feels
as if squeezed during menses. Leucorrhea, corrosive like meat washing. Leucorrhea watery, acrid, milky white,
green or yellow, purulent. Mucus discharge from vagina. Fibroid
tumors. Metritis. Severe burning, tearing and twitching, in ovarian region. Swelling and congestion of ovaries.
Food - Aversion to all food, to broth. Much thirst. Cold food and drink aggravate. All symptoms worse by
drinking cold milk.
 Head - Headache and heaviness in head. Severe headache with lachrymation. Bilateral headaches. Violent
headaches, as if screwed, through sides of head, worse warmth and pressure. Hard painful lumps on cranium
with headache. Congestive headache. Aching pain in sinuses. Intense pain over eyes and root of nose.
Sharp pain in forehead on stooping. Brain feels enlarged. Big head and small jaws, rickets. Pain in scalp on
scratching, as if ulcerated. Meningitis. Hydrocephalus. Scalp fissured and sore. Tender spots on head. Hair
changes color and falls off.
Heart - Heart feels very weak. Fluttering of heart with nervousness. Palpitations and darting pains worse when
walking. Aneurysm. Endocarditis. Valvular defects after repeated endocarditis. Pulse weak, slow, soft.
Kidneys - Darting pains in kidney region. Nephritis with pains in back. Urine increased with unquenchable
thirst. Painful urging to urinate, better appearance of menses. Frequent urination of copious, clear, urine, worse
before menses, at night. Nocturnal bedwetting.
Limbs - Severe bone pains. Contraction of joints. Periosteum thickened, especially tibia, sensitive to touch
(Kali-bi., Asaf.). Chronic arthritis. Rheumatic pains at night and in damp weather. Rheumatism of knees with
effusion. Pain in small of back and coccyx. Pain in hip, forcing limping. Sciatica, worse lying, on the affected
side, sitting, standing, wakes him at night, better walking and flexing legs. Formication of lower limbs when
sitting, better lying down. Tip of thumb ulcerates and turns yellow.
Lungs - Whistling asthmatic breathing. Asthma, of young people. Dyspnea on ascending with pain in heart.
Difficult breathing on waking at night, with loss of voice. Air hunger with flatulency
in a.m., wakes choking. Colds travels downward to chest. Dry bronchitis. Air passages raw. Violent cough,
worse in morning. Expectoration like soap suds, greenish. Pneumonia, when hepatization commences.
Pneumococcic meningitis. Stitching pains through lungs to back. Pulmonary edema with pneumonia. Pleuro-
pneumonia. Lobular pneumonia. Hydrothorax (Merc., Sulph.). Pleuritic effusion. Tuberculosis, exhausting
night sweats and loose stools. Sputum like soap-suds, green.
Male - Enlargement of prostate, with retention of urine. Chronic gonorrhea, discharge thick, green. Excoriation
by least friction. Penis swollen, inflamed. Paraphimosis. Spermatic cords thickened. Atrophy of testes with
diminution of sexual desire. Syphilis with indolent, swollen glands.
Modalities - Better from motion, cold, open air. Worse from heat, warm clothing or warm room, damp weather,
changing weather. Worse pressure, touch, jarring, mercury, seaside, sunset to sunrise. Worse cold foods,
especially milk.
Mouth - Offensive odor from mouth. Bitter taste, salty on waking. Increased saliva, bloody with a sweetish or
disgusting taste. Saliva smells like onions. Viscid, salty saliva during pregnancy. Heat in whole mouth with
swelling. Numbness of mouth, in morning on waking. Ulcers in mouth, as if coated with milk.
Nose - Red, swollen, especially the tip. Nasal catarrh involving frontal sinus. Burning, throbbing in nose
and sinuses. Tightness at the root of the nose. Violent sneezing. Takes cold from every damp day. Coryza,
descending, with salivation and dyspnea. Profuse, acrid, hot, watery discharge, worse coolair. Profuse,
greenish, non-irritating discharges. Discharge of watery, cool, greenish, irritating, corroding mucus. Stuffiness
and dryness of nose without discharge. Ozaena with perforated septum. Takes cold from every damp day.
Accumulation of very tenacious mucus in nostrils. Loss of smell.
Perspiration - Profuse night sweats, which relieve.
Rectum - Diarrhea with pain in lumber region, as if broken or as if menses would appear. Early morning
diarrhea of tuberculosis. Frequent stools. Light-green or yellow watery stools. Constipation. Stools scanty,
hard, difficult. Serous mucus from rectum. Cancer of rectum. Fissured anus of infants.
Sensations - As though head were enlarged, as if it were screwed in, as if a large quantity of water were
forced into brain, as if it would be forced asunder. As if a leaflet were at root of nose, as if a worm was crawling
at root of nose. Back as if in a vice. As of a tumor in ovaries. Pain in chest as if cut to pieces. Bruised feeling
in coccyx.
Skin - Acne, hydroa. Acne rosacea. Hives. Giant urticaria. Erythema nodosum. Rough nodules. Small boils.
Itching eruptions worse heat. Itching, generally better scratching, worse at night. Itching herpes on face.
Purple spots, worse on legs. Tendency to edematous swellings, eyelids, mouth, uvula, etc. Furuncular
eruption. Pustular eruption, leaving scars. Rupia syphilitica. Vesicular eruptions. Vesicles from exposure to
sun. Condylomata.
Sleep - Restless sleep. Frequent yawning without drowsiness. Sleeplessness from anguish. Weeps loudly
during sleep, unconscious of it. Horrid dreams.
Stomach - Faintness at epigastrium. Emptiness and qualmish feeling, not better eating. Heartburn with
flatulence. Throbbing, painful burning. Hiccough in evening. Sensation as if water brash is occurring. Nausea
and vomiting with salivation. Violent vomiting with copious salivation. Rumbling and shrill noises in stomach.
Ratulence.
 Teeth - Toothache nagging, as if a worm were digging in it. Toothache at roots of teeth. Jerking toothache
worse at night, better warmth. Teeth as if elongated. Teeth decayed. Gnawing pains. Gums recede from loose
teeth. Gums swollen. Gumboils.
Temperature - Chilly in bones. Chilly in painful parts. Uncovers, then chilly. Chills with drowsiness. Alternate
heat and chill. Heat with shudders. Fever in evening. Hot and dry, then drenching sweat. Fever with
shuddering. Flushes, with dullness of head.
Throat - Dryness and itching in throat. Stinging pain when swallowing or talking. Larynx feels raw. Laryngeal
edema. Loss of voice. Sore throat of speakers. Hoarseness with pain in chest. Nasal, catarrhal voice. Choking
sensation from increased mucus. Uvula swollen and elongated. Enlarged tonsils. Goiter sensitive to contact.
Tongue - Epithelioma of tongue. Blisters on tip of tongue, with burning pain. Tongue white, swollen, shows
impressions of teeth. Severe pain at root of tongue, at night.
Vertigo - Vertigo in the dark. Vertigo, worse railway traveling. Vertigo with reeling, after meals. Vertigo on
awaking, giddy, fluttering, must get up or smother.
Vision - Dim and foggy vision, after scrofulous ophthalmia. Blurred vision and diplopia, only notices when
looking to left. Complete blindness from effusion of water in brain. Blindness with dilated pupils, staring, watery
eyes.
COMMENTS-Kali-i. is used in both potency and the crude salt, the general explanation is that the solvent
action of the drug is most powerfully excited on new tissues.
Cancer. Tumors of the breast and uterus. Condylomata. Glandular swelling. Thyroid problems or goiter, with
green discharge. Enlarged lymphatic glands, syphilitic nodes.
Neuralgic or inflammatory conditions where there is heightened and diffused sensitiveness of the affected part.
Serous effusion on the brain, secondary to hepatization of the lungs. Relieves the throbbing, pulsative noises,
especially when the heart is hypertrophied and inclined to fatty degeneration.
Laryngeal and pulmonary tuberculosis. Deep, hollow, hoarse cough with pain through breast. Stitches through
the lungs in the middle of sternum, through sternum
to back or deep in chest while walking. Chest symptoms worse in early morning 2 a.m. to 5 a.m.
Expectoration is greenish, copious and looks like soapsuds. Chronic sinusitis. Thick, green mucus. Coryza
recurs repeatedly from every little cold and makes the nose red and swollen.
Coryza, discharge is acrid, watery, the eyes smart and are puffed. Lachrymation. Iritis, keratitis and chemosis.
Thick, green offensive discharge, ozaena and perforation of the bones may occur.
Scrofulous and syphilitic eruptions. Papular and pustular eruption, especially on scalp and down back, the
pustules leaving scars when they heal. Tinnitus aurium, sharp, shrill, hissing and piercing noises.
Terrible pain at the root of the tongue. Disordered digestive tract. Loss of appetite and indigestion with
flatulence and bloating (Lyc.). Loose stools at 5 a.m. (Merc.). May crave or be aggravated by milk.
Headache worse 5 a.m., worse after a night's rest. heat. The chill of intermittent fever is not better by warmth,
but many symptoms of the teeth and scalp are alleviated by warmth.
Rickets. Sciatica (Naphtin.). Burning, better slow walking, worse sitting, at night, lying on painful side, rest,
standing, heat (Rhus-t., better heat). General aversion to heat.
Motion aggravates, especially walking, after the first movement in the lower limbs it is more bearable. Sitting
hurts and flexing limbs helps some of the pains. Worse from touch. Great sensitiveness to atmospheric
changes, better in open air.
Especially suitable for pale, delicate subjects who flush easily and are manifestly plethoric. For a diffused
arterial vasiculosis or venous state. Warm-blooded, violent, destructive people.
Several cases of abdominal tumor were successfully treated with Kali-i. in 3x, 10c and 15c triturations. Two of
these had been unsuccessfully treated with the crude salt. Patients could not tolerate it on account of loss of
appetite and irritation of the mucus
membrane of mouth and throat.
One of these patients had a large tumor on the level of the great curvature of the stomach extending on both
sides, plunging into the abdominal cavity and extending into the pelvis, it was adherent and difficult to define.
She had ajaundiced, dirty-looking skin and loss of appetite and vomi ted most of her food. A suspicion of latent
syphilis led Gaudy to the remedy, which was perfectly tolerated in potency, though not in the crude. Health
rapidly improved and in three months there was hardly any tumor to be discovered.
Cooper reported a second case in which a patient's womb was packed with fibroids and there was pain in the
right inguinal region on exertion. Spirits were depressed, tinnitus like the buzzing of flies, constantly tired,
sleepy feeling down the limbs, hot burning feet, though sometimes intense shivering all over. Pains in the
breasts, which were tender.
Patient was unable to go long without food, constant distention as from flatus, sinking at scrobiculus cordis at
 11 a.m., dreamy sleep. Kali-i. 30c left the patient in absolute comfort.
Cooper pointed out the characteristic diffused sensitiveness over affected parts that appeared in the provings.
Hartlaub and Trinks noted the provers' experience of the painful scalp on scratching, as if ulcerated (after
eleven days). Swelling of the whole thyroid gland increasing very rapidly with some sensitiveness to touch and
pressure.
RELATIONS -Antidotedby: Hep., also Nit-ac. Antidote to: Merc., Lead poisoning. Compare: (1) lod., Merc.,
Sulph., Mez. (2) Chopheenee - a Hindu remedy for syphilitic eruptions, ulcerations and bone-pains, used in
tincture. (2) lod. - goiter, heart affections, worse from warmth, tuberculosis. (3) Caust. - worse by touch, syphilis.
(4) Kali-c. - worse firom sex. worse 2-4 a.m., extreme sensitiveness. (5) Lach. - smothering sensation on
waking and has hard lumps on scalp. (6) Kali-i. causes infiltration of bones as well as soft tissues. (7) Psor.
and Gels. - in hay fever, Gels, has more sneezing. (8) Merc. - syphilis, catarrh, sensitiveness to weather,
stitching pains through
lungs. Merc, in different directions, Kali-i. through sternum to back. (9) Erio. “Yerba Santa” - catarrhal
tuberculosis. (10) Ant-t. - threatened paralysis of lungs. (11) Ars. - catarrhal symptoms, wasting, restlessness.
(12) Bell. - brain congestion. (13) Apis - dropsy, worse by heat. (14) Lyc. - flatulent distention. (15) Mez., Puls.,
Sil., Sulph., Cimic., Chin., Nat-s. (16) Carb-s. - nisus in the ears. Follows well: Merc. Followed well by: Nit-
ac.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Kali Muriaticum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - kali-m. Kali muriaticum. Potassium chloride. Kali chloratum. Not to be confounded with Chlorate
of potash. Kali chloricum. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL- Acne. Allergies. Aphthae. Breasts, cysts. Bubo. Bunion. Bums. Cataract. Chilblains. Colds.
Constipation. Coryza. Croup. Cystitis. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dropsy. Dysentery. Ear, disorders. Eczema.
Embolisms. Eustachian, congestion. Eye, disorders. Glands, swollen. Hay ieser. Hemorrhoids. Hodgkin's
disease. Ingrown, toenails. Jaundice. Joints, stiff. Leucorrhea. Measles. Morning, sickness. Mumps. Nasal,
congestion. Rheumatism. Scorbutus. Shingles. Sinusitis. Smallpox. Sycosis. Tendons, creaking. Thread-
worms. Vaccination, effects. Warts.
HOMEOPATHIC - Schiissler introduced Kali-m. into homeopathy. His account of it is “it is contained in nearly
all the cells and is chemically related to fibrin. It will dissolve white or grayish-white secretions of the mucus
membrane and plastic exudations.”
When the cells of the epidermis lose molecules of Kali-m. due to a morbid irritation, the fibrin comes to the
surface as a white or whitish-gray mass. When dried, this forms a mealy covering. If the irritation affects the
tissues under the epidermis, then fibrin and serum are exuded, causing the affected spot on the epidermis to
rise in blisters. Similar processes may take place in and below epithelial cells.
Useful in catarrhal disorders in the subacute inflammatory states, fibrinous exudations and glandular
swellings. Whiteness of secretions, exudations, eruptions of tissues. Tough, fibrinous exudations and
discharges. Milky white, viscid, sticky, thick, slimy or lumpy discharges. White or gray coating of base of
tongue and expectoration of thick, white phlegm.
Blood clots too readily. Embolism, indurations, hard swellings. Hard deposits, glandular swelling. Sore, cutting
or sticking, shifting pains. Bursitis, patellar. Crawling and numbness. Crosswise symptoms. Slow reaction.
Stubborn infiltration.
MIND - Discontent, discouraged. Sadness alternating with cheerfulness. Fears evil. Sits in silence. Imagines
he must starve. Irritable and angry, at trifles.
Abdomen - Abdominal tenderness and swelling, fullness after eating. Flatulence. Tensive pressure in region
of liver, better emission of flatus. Pressing pain in region of spleen. Colic with shifting of flatulence. Colic with
diarrhea. Colic in pelvic region. Catarrh of duodenum from chill. Peritonitis. Suppurating buboes.
Back - Heaviness under right shoulder. Buzzing under right scapula. Lightning pains from small of back to
feet. Backache better lying down. Must get out of bed and sit up.
Bladder - Cystitis. Inflammation of bladder with violent fever. Acute cases of inflammation of bladder, when
swelling has set in and discharge is thick, white mucus. Acute and chronic catarrh of bladder. Dribbling
urination. Discharge of white, thick mucus. Itching in urethra.
Breasts - Breasts cysts. Soft, tender nodes or growths in breasts. Painful breasts before or at menses.
Causations - Ill effects of vaccination, sprains, burns, blows, cuts.
Chest - Rawness in chest. Flushes of heat in chest. Constriction of chest as from vapors of sulphur.
Oppression of chest with violent palpitations.
 Cough - Loud, noisy stomach cough. Cough short, acute, and spasmodic. Whooping cough. Sputum thick
and white. Violent cough during coryza.
Ears - Otitis media. Swimmer's ear infection. Earache with swelling of glands. Eustachian tube blocked.
Soreness of Eustachian tube. Glue ear. Great effusion about the auricle. Catarrhal conditions of the middle
ear. Deafness from catarrhal condition and occlusion of Eustachian tubes. Deafness from swelling of internal
ear. Sensation of a plug in ears. Snapping. popping noises in ear. Crackling noises on blowing nose or
swallowing. Swollen glands about the ear. Threatened mastoiditis.
Eyes - Trachoma. Cataract. Corneal opacities, pustules. Exudation in retina. Scintillations on coughing. White
mucus, purulent scabs. Superficial ulcer. Congestion to eyes, irritated. Redness with some pain. Sensation of
sand in eye. Edges of eyelids scabby. Yellow crusts of pus on edges.
Face - Bluish, sunken. Cheeks swollen and painful. Lips hot, swollen. Chapped lips from cold. Eruptions around
mouth. Pimples on forehead, face, lips and chin. Barber's itch. Swollen glands about jaw and neck. Face aches
with swelling of gums or cheek. Mumps without fever. Paralysis, following pain in face. Paralysis of right facial
nerve. Muscles of face twitch and tremble, worse eating, speaking or coughing. Lightning-like attacks of pain
in face.
Female - Menses too late or suppressed, checked or too early. Excessive discharge, dark, clotted or tough.
Menses black blood like tar (Plat.). Leucorrhea, discharge of milky-white mucus, thick, non-irritating, bland.
Morning sickness with vomiting of white phlegm. Threatened miscarriage.
Food - Habitual loss of appetite or refuses food. Fatty or rich food causes indigestion. Worse cold drinks.
Head - Confusion in head, also in occiput, with peculiar sensation in cervical muscles. Sick headache with
white-coated tongue. Headache with vomiting of white phlegm. Sinus headache with thick white
discharge. Headache with sneezing and coryza. Catarrh of frontal sinuses. Aching pain in temple. Stunning
shock in or a leaden load holds down occiput, better letting hair down and warmth. Brain feels loose. Meningitis.
Crusta lactea. Copious white dandruff. Perspiration on head.
Heart - Heart disease causing dropsy. Coldness in region of heart. Pericarditis. Palpitations from excessive
flow of blood to heart. Pulse accelerated, or soft and sluggish. Pulse not synchronous with beats of heart.
Kidneys - Kidney disease with dropsy. Catarrhal nephritis. Dribbling urine. Discharge white thick mucus.
Turbid urine, with dirty yellow sediment. Diabetes. Albuminuria during pregnancy.
Limbs - Rheumatic fever. Swelling around joints. Exudation and swelling around the joints. Rheumatic pains
felt only during motion or increased by it. Nightly rheumatic pains, worse from warmth of bed. Lightning-like
pains from small of back to feet, must get out of bed and sit up. Cramps in limbs. Twitching thighs. Tension
in leg alternating with tension in arm. Cutting in bones. Bursitis. Cold foot sweat. Cold hands and feet. Chilblains
on hands or feet or any part. Cracking of tendons in the back of the hand. Hands get stiff while writing or
knitting.
Liver - Liver disease with dropsy. Jaundice, caused by a chill, resulting in catarrh of duodenum. Sluggish
action or complete torpidity of liver. Pain in right side.
Lungs - Difficult or oppressed breathing. ■ Asthma with gastric derangements, mucus white and hard to
cough up. Rattling sounds of air passing through thick, tenacious mucus in the bronchi, difficult to cough up.
Catarrhal pneumonia. Bronchitis. Croupy inflammation of lungs. Mucus white, thick and hard to cough up.
Yellowish green mucus. Expectoration sticky, milky or flies from the mouth.
Hemorrhage from lungs.
Male - Chronic syphilis. Gonorrhea. Gleet combined with eczema, visible or latent. Soft swelling of buboes,
soft chancre. Condylomata. Hydrocele. Itching of scrotum. Orchitis from suppressed gonorrhea. Violent
emissions with voluptuous dreams. Violent erections with emissions. Sexual desire diminished, with chilliness
and apathy.
Modalities - Better from cold drinks, rubbing, letting hair down. Worse from open air, drafts, dampness, night.
Worse cold drinks, fatty, rich food or pastry. Worse motion, sprains, lying, during menses. Rheumatic
symptoms worse from warmth of bed.
Mouth - Aphthae. Thrush, white ulcers in the mouth. Eruptions around the mouth. Breath excessively fetid, in
ulceration and diphtheria. Profuse and acid saliva. Accumulation of mucus. Salty, bitter taste, with coldness of
tongue. Heat and dryness in mouth. Swollen glands about jaw and neck. Scorbutic gums. Gumboil before
matter forms. Toothache with swelling of the gums and cheeks.
Nose - Nasal catarrh. Stuffy cold in head. Hawking of mucus from posterior si- nuses. Phlegm or catarrh, white
and thick discharges. Vault of pharynx covered with adherent crust. Nosebleeds (Arn., Phos.).
Perspiration - Sweating of head.
Rectum - Constipation, light-colored stools. Diarrhea after fatty food. Dysentery, purging with slimy stools.
Hemorrhoids, bleeding, blood dark and thick, fibrinous, clotted. Anus sore, worse walking or after stools.
 Itching or crawling in anus after stools. Threadworms, causing itching at anus.
Skin - Chickenpox. Smallpox. Blisters arising from burns. Acne. Pimples on face, neck, etc. Erythema. Herpes
zoster. Vesicular erysipelas and shingles. Eczema from suppressed or deranged uterine functions. Vesicles
containing thick, white contents. Itching of whole body, in bed. Dry, flourlike scales on the skin (Ars.).
Greenish, brownish, yellow crusts. Branny. Proud
flesh. Carbuncles. Condylomata. Warty excrescences. Eruptions connected with stomach or menstrual
disorders.
Sleep - Restless sleep, startled at least noise. Anxious dreams, towards morning. Somnolence.
Stomach - Dyspepsia and indigestion, with a whitish-gray tongue. Cutting pain in stomach. Eructations
alternating with pains in chest and abdomen. Empty, sour eructations. Empty feeling in stomach. Pain in the
stomach with constipation. Bulimia, hunger disappears by drinking water. Sick feeling after taking fat. Fatty or
rich food causes indigestion. Morning sickness with vomiting of white phlegm. Nausea with eructations.
Nausea with shivers. Stomach heavy, at night. Vomits food. Vomiting of white, opaque mucus, blood.
Stools - Pale, light-colored, hard or flocculent stools. Stools clay-colored, white, or slimy. Painful stools,
passing nothing but mucus. Bloody stools, or bloody mucus. Stools so dry it almost crumbles.
Temperature - Shivering all over, or over back and neck, with warm feet. Continual chilliness with stiffness of
hands, with vomiting of white (not transparent) mucus, in open air.
Throat - Chronic sore throat. “Hospital” sore throat. Croup, membranous exudation. Loss of voice,
hoarseness. Follicular tonsillitis. Tonsils swollen, inflamed, swallowing excessively painful. Tonsils enlarged,
can hardly breathe. Grayish- white, ulcerated throat. Adherent crusts in vault of pharynx. Pharynx feels cold.
Eustachian catarrh. Hawks out thick, white mucus, cheesy.
Tongue - Grayish-white, sticky, thick, slimy, or dry coating on tongue. Tongue mapped, gray dr white at
base. Tongue white, or only in middle. Coating of tongue after diarrhea. Coldness of tongue. Sensation as if a
tumor were growing on the tongue. Glossitis. Burning, stinging blisters on tongue.
Vertigo - Vertigo after violent exercise. Vertigo with congestion to head. Vertigo during headache.
Vision - Scintillations on coughing or sneezing. Smoky and misty vision. Letters appear smaller when reading.
COMMENTS - Chronic catarrhal condition of the middle ear. Eustachian tube catarrh (Merc-d.). Closed
Eustachian tubes. Pain in ears during pressure changes. Snapping and noises in the ear.
Common cold with yellow or watery mucus. A milky, white, thick discharge, can be lumpy or stringy. Grayish
white, dry or slimy tongue. Bleeding hemorrhoids, dark, fibrous, clotted blood. Diphtheria. Rheumatic fever with
exudation and swelling around the joints. Better from cold drinks.
It is said to have cured cataracts after Calcfl. helped. Clarke cured with it rheumatism affecting mostly the left
shoulder and the elbow, worse in the morning on rising. There is some clinical evidence of helping breast
cysts.
Boericke and Dewey noted the “protruded appearance of eyes, white tongue, croupy, hard cough, harsh
barking.”
Hering added “cough, noisy with protruded appearance of eyes.” In one case, it caused a severe aggravation
in which the patient felt “as if eyes would be forced out of head with cough.”
Similar to Kali-chl, which has the keynote symptom “tendency to rush of blood to both eyes and light before
both eyes on coughing and sneezing.”
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Bell., Calc-s., Hydr. .Puls. Compare: ( 1 ) Bell., which Kali-m. follows well in the
catarrhal and hypertrophic conditions. (2) Kino - otorrhea with stitches in right ear. (3) Bry., Merc., Puls., Sulph.
(4) Kali-chl. in tough secretions, Kali-bi., Kali-c., Hydr. (5) in rheumatic affections, Bry., Rhus-t., Sulph. (6)
Merc-d. in the Eustachian tube and in inflammations of ear. (7) Graph., Nat-m., Nit-ac., Sil., Apis, Thuj. (8)
Puls, in worse from fatty food, worse from warmth. It follows well: Calc-p. Calc-fl., Ferr-p.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.
