name: Lac Vaccinum Defloratum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - lac-d. Lac vaccinum defloratum. Skimmed cow's milk. Dilutions. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Anemia. Appendicitis. Asthma. Breast, disorders. Bright's disease. Chilly. Colds.
Constipation. Coryza. Cramps. Delusions. Depression. Diabetes. Dropsy. Dyspnea. Eczema. Fainting. Flatu-
lence. Gastroenteritis. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Herpes. Leucorrhea. Lumbago. Malnutrition. Memory,
lost. Menses, suppressed. Milk allergy. Migraines. Morning sickness. Motion sickness. Nausea. Obesity.
Osteoporosis. Otitis media. Palpitations. Photophobia. Pimples. Sciatica. Sick headache. Sinusitis. Sore,
throat. Tonsillitis. Vertigo. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - The idea of potentizing skimmed milk originated with Swan upon reading Donkin's “Skim
Milk Treatment for Diabetes and Bright's disease.” Milks contain an essence of all the tissues and salts of the
animal that secretes it.
Lac-d. contains Nat-m., so it shares a thirst for large quantities, nausea and vomiting, and depression with
crying and palpitations.
Lac-d. is useful in diseases with malnutrition and anemia. Feels completely exhausted, whether she does
anything or not, great fatigue when walking.
Sick headaches with profuseflow of urine during pain. Headache ceases at sunset.
Sufferings from loss of sleep (Cocc.). Motion sickness. Dropsy from organic heart disease and from chronic
liver complaints. Obesity. Osteoporosis. Sensation as if cold air was blowing on her, even while covered up,
as if sheets were damp. Most symptoms occur in the morning.
Particularly useful for the symptoms caused by milk in some sensitive people, especially the violent headache
and constipation. For those who become sick on taking milk.
MIND - Vacillation of mind. Listlessness. Disinclination for bodily or mental exertion. Doesn't want to see or
talk to any one. Aversion to company. Loss of memory. Sadness before and during menses. Claustrophobia.
Unconsciousness on raising arms above head.
 Depression with crying, palpitations and fainting spells. Despondent, better conversation. No fear of death
but is sure he is going to die. Suicidal disposition. Imagines all her friends are dead or will die. Delusions,
thinks she will have to go to a convent.
Abdomen - Abdomen sore and sensitive to touch, worse pressure. Heaviness as of a stone in abdomen.
Drawing pain, across lower part of abdomen. Severe pain across umbilicus, during headache. Chronic
gastroenteritis, with chronic diarrhea and vomiting. Flatulence.
Back - Constant pain in lumbar region. Lumbago. Hardpressivepains, at fourth cervical vertebra. Chills
creeping along back between scapulae. Herpetic eruptions on sides of neck, with itching and burning after
scratching.
Breasts - Scanty flow of milk, restores the milk. Decrease in size of breasts during pregnancy.
Chest - Soreness of chest with great pressure. Tuberculous deposit in apices of both lungs.
Ears - Otitis media, worse from drinking milk.
Eyes - Eyeballs intensely painful. Photophobia, even candlelight unbearable. Great pain in eyes on first
going into light, soon passing off. Upper eyelids very heavy. Edges of eyelids feel contracted. Sensation as
if eyes were full of little stones during headache.
Face - Pale, sickly look. Dark stains beneath eyes. Flushes of heat in left side of face. Sallow complexion with
eczema. Pimples on face and forehead. Painless swelling of the face.
Female - Menses, delayed in girls who drink much milk. Menses delayed, with congestion of blood to head,
coldness of hands, nausea and vertigo. Menses irregular, sometimes very dark and scanty, sometimes
colorless water. Menses suppressed by putting hands in cold water. Pressing, bearing down pain in ovarian
region. Drawing pain across uterine region. Sensation of weight and dragging in left ovarian region. Slight
yellowish leucorrhea.
Food - Loss of appetite. Can neither eat nor drink during headache. Malnutrition. Great thirst for large
quantities, often intense. Drinking cold water causes nausea. Aversion to milk, causes sick headache. Smell
or thought of food causes nausea, during headache.
Head - Persistent headaches for years. Migraines, cease at sunset. Pain begins in forehead to occiput, in
morning on rising. Intense throbbing pains with blindness, nausea, vomiting and obstinate constipation.
Headache preceded by blindness. Throbbing frontal headache with much pale urination, worse noise, light,
motion. Sick headache, with icy coldness all through body. Sick headache with gastric symptoms, from
drinking milk. Headache over left eye and in left temple with profuse lachrymation,photophobia.
Headaches better cold applications, while generally better from heat. Head becomes sore on coughing.
Headache during menses, better by bandaging, conversation. Headache alternating with tonsillitis. Head as if
bruised, after headache. Distress in head after injury.
Heart - Pressure around heart with dyspnea, feeling that he is going to die. Sharp pain in apex of heart, as
if a knife was cutting up and down. Palpitations of heart and flushes of heat.
Kidneys - Constant pain in kidney region. Boring, sore pain in kidneys. Frequent and profuse urination with
headache or other pains. Frequent but scanty urination. Lack of sensation when the bladder is full. Urination
involuntary, while walking in cold air, while riding or when hurrying to catch a train. Albuminuria. Urine very
pale, can't retain it. Urine very dark and thick. Urine comes away drop by drop, or gushes out. Urine with a
sensation of very hot water passing over parts. Bedwetting at night.
Limbs - Osteoporosis. Weak bones. Fingertips icy cold, rest of the hands warm. Aching, in wrists and ankles.
Cold hands or feet during headache. Numbness and loss of sensation over outer and anterior surfaces of
thighs. Weakness and aching in ankles, puffiness. Skin thickened at edges of feet.
Lungs - Asthma attacks, so that he could scarcely breathe, accompanied by bloating in epigastric region.
Asthma worse from drinking milk. Short, dry cough with difficult expectoration of a small lump of mucus,
which ameliorates cough.
Modalities - Better from rest. Better pressure. Better bandage. Better conversation. Better profuse flow of
urine. Worse from cold. Worse least draft. Worse wet. Worse hands in cold water. Worse milk. Worse in
morning. Worse loss of sleep. Worse weekly. Worse motion. Worse walking. Worse sitting down. Lying down
aggravates the vertigo, headache, and urinary pain.
Mouth - Offensive breath. Mouth very dry. Mouth clammy and frothy during conversation. Grinding of teeth
during sleep.
Nose - Painful pressure or tightness at root of nose. Sinusitis. Colds. Children suffer from coryza from
drinking milk. Nasal catarrh, worse drinking milk.
Perspiration - Profuse, staining yellow, difficult to wash out. Sense as if sheets were damp.
Rectum - Constipation with ineffectual urging. Persistent constipation, better only by purgatives or enema,
with violent attacks of sick headaches. Large, hard stools, with great straining, painful, lacerating anus.
 Sensations - As though a knife was cutting up and down through the heart. As if head wouldburst.Asiftop of
head was lifted off. As if a ball of pain in center of forehead. As if eyes full of little stones. As if flesh was off
bones and edges were separated and sticking out. As if sheets were damp, as if a cold air blowing on her.
Skin - Very sensitive to cold. Face, neck, arms and body generally flush color of a red rose, with swelling, but
no itching or burning. Symmetrical patches, causing itching and burning after scratching. Skin thickened at the
edges of feet.
Sleep - Sleepy all day long. Great restlessness, extreme and protracted suffering from loss of sleep at night.
Worse from loss of sleep.
Stomach - Violent pain in stomach from fatigue. Cramps in epigastric region. Sour eructations. Nausea and
vomiting, with sensation of deathly sickness .Nausea from a recumbent position. Incessant vomiting with no
relation to eating. Vomiting first of undigested food, sour, acid, then of bitter water. Vomit looks like coffee
grounds. Morning sickness. Motion sickness.
Temperature - Always feels chilly. Very sensitive to cold. Very chilly when constipation is most persistent.
Hectic fever, malignant typhoid. Hot fever continues until near morning, wakes in profuse sweat, which stains
linen yellow. Sensation as if the sheets were damp.
Throat - Sore throat, worse when swallowing. Sore throat with slight, hacking cough. Sensation of a large
ball rising from stomach to throat, causing distressing sense of suffocation. Globus hystericus.
Vertigo - Vertigo, worse lying on left side.
Vertigo when moving head from pillow, opening eyes while lying, turning while lying, must sit up. Faintness on
extending arms overhead. Cannot stand, but falls backwards. Light-headed with throbbing in temples.
Vision - Dim vision, as if a cloud before eyes, can only see lights, no objects, preceding headache.
COMMENTS - The first proving was made by a woman in New York whose headache and nausea with
constipation were strongly marked. A subsequent, more extensive proving was made under S w an by Dr.
Laura Morgan. Hering noted that with but few exceptions the symptoms have received clinical verification.
Migraines, especially for people allergic to milk. Hormonal migraines. Throbbing, blinding headaches with
nausea and vomiting. Headaches, better pressure and bandaging. Periodic sick headaches in anemic women,
nausea, vomiting and obstinate constipation. Loss of sleep (Cocc.). Periodic symptoms, every eight days.
Intense thirst and emaciation with diabetes. Diabetes and nephritis, especially when aggravated by milk (Nat-
c.). Obstinate constipation. Nutrition is perverted. Weight loss or obesity. Dropsy. Fatty degeneration.
Severe vomiting with no relief (Ip.). Morning sickness with severe nausea and vomiting, acidic, bitter taste in
the mouth. The menses are irregular, sometimes very dark, scanty, sometimes colorless water.
Lac-d. cured a case in which menses were suppressed suddenly from putting hands into cold water. Great
pain in uterine region. Intense headache. Pains flew all over. Flushed face. The patient slept after first dose,
the next morning a slight flow appeared. A second dose brought back flow profusely and patient felt well and
the flow continued.
Burnett maintained that excess of milk in the dietary of children after they have cut their first teeth renders
them susceptible to colds. It may be well to recall that milk is one of the articles forbidden to hydrogenoid or
chilly patients.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Colos. - diarrhea in infants. Whole body smells sour. Colic. (2) Nat-m„ Lac-c.,
Lac-v-c., Lac-ac., Sac-1. (3) Vac., a cow nosode. (4) Nat-m. - diabetes, headache, constipation, heart. (5)
Cocc. - menstrual sick-headaches. (6) Cact. - heart, but Lac d. has not the “grasp” of Cact. (7) Nux-m. - head
heavy, tends to fall to left. Lac-d. to right.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.
keynote:
PHARMACY - lac-d. Lac vaccinum defloratum. Skimmed cow's milk. Dilutions. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Anemia. Appendicitis. Asthma. Breast, disorders. Bright's disease. Chilly. Colds.
Constipation. Coryza. Cramps. Delusions. Depression. Diabetes. Dropsy. Dyspnea. Eczema. Fainting. Flatu-
lence. Gastroenteritis. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Herpes. Leucorrhea. Lumbago. Malnutrition. Memory,
lost. Menses, suppressed. Milk allergy. Migraines. Morning sickness. Motion sic

name: Lacerta Agilis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - lacer. Lacerta agilis. Green lizard. Sand lizard. Large green spotted lizard. N. O. Lacertilia.
Europe. Tincture of whole animal. A separate preparation of the spotted lizard should be made. Historical
dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Blisters. Delirium. Indigestion. Skin, eruptions. Paralysis. Tongue, vesicles.
HOMEOPATHIC - The green lizard is usually considered to be non-poisonous, but Baldelli, who ate a lizard
cut into small pieces, developed some decided symptoms of indigestion, blisters under the tongue and skin
eruptions.
Lacer, has pain, swellings, numbness, left-sided paralysis, rigidity of the neck and jaw on the left side and
tender muscles. Motion causes excruciating pains in bitten limb. Touch aggravates. Symptoms of the proving
were better by drinking frequently vinegar and water.
MIND - Delirium with an alternating state of greatly increased mental acumen during intervals of reason.
 COMMENTS - A girl, bitten on the sole of the left foot by a “large green spotted lizard,” died of the effects of
the bite after twenty-one days of suffering. This is recorded in Allen's Appendix and comes from an American
source, so it is probably an American variety of Lacerta that is accountable for this.
RELATIONS - Antidote: vinegar. Compare: (1) Amph., Helo.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Lachesis Muta
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - lach. Lachesis muta. Bushmaster. Surukuku. Trigonocephalous lachesis. N. O. Ophidia.
Crotalida. South America. Dilution of the venom. Trituration. Dilutions. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Alcoholism. Amblyopia. Aneurysm. Appendicitis. Asthenopia. Asthma. Atheroma.
Bedsores. Boils. Bubo. Bubonic plague. Cancer. Carbuncles. Catalepsy. Cecum, inflammation. Cellulitis.
Chancre. Chilblains. Ciliary neuralgia. Cough. Cyanosis. Delirium tremens. Delusions. Diphtheria. Dog, bite.
Dropsy. Dyspepsia. Ears, disorders. Epilepsy. Erysipelas. Eyes, disorders. Fainting. Fistula lachrymalis.
Flatulence. Gallstones. Gangrene. Glanders. Gums, bleeding. Hay fever. Headaches. Heart, disorders.
Heartbum. Hemiplegia. Hemophilia. Hemorrhages. Hemorrhoids. Hepatitis. Hernia. Herpes. High blood
pressure. Hoarseness. Hot, flushes. Hysteria. Injuries. Intermittent, fever. Jaundice. Labor, pains.
Laryngismus. Laryngitis. Leprosy. Liver disorders. Locomotor, ataxia. Malignant, pustule. Mania. Manic
depression. Measles. Meniere'sdisease. Menopause. Mercury, effects. Morvan's disease. Mumps.
Neuralgias. Nymphomania. Otorrhea. Ovary, disorders. Paralysis. Perspiration. Phlegmasia albadolens.
Plague. Pneumonia. Premenstrual syndrome. Puerperal fever. Puimdnary, edema. Purpura. Pyemia.
Quinsy. Rabies. Scarlatina. Schizophrenia. Sciatica. Stings. Strokes. Syphilis. Throat, sore. Trachea,
disorders. Traumatic, fever. Tumors. Ulcers. Varicose, veins. Vertigo. Vicarious, menstruation. Warts.
Whitlow. Wounds.
HOMEOPATHIC - Lachesis was first introduced to homeopathy by Dr. Hering. His first experiments were made
when he was studying the botany and zoology of the Upper Amazon forthe German government. With the
exception of his wife, all those around him were natives, who told him so much about the dreaded Surukuku
that he offered a good reward for a live specimen.
One was brought in a bamboo box. Those who brought it immediately fled, along with his native servants.
Hering stunned the snake with a blow on the head as the box opened, then, holding its head in a forked stick,
he pressed its venom out of the poison bag upon milk sugar.
Handling the venom and preparing the lower potencies threw Hering into a fever with tossing delirium and
mania, much to his wife's dismay. He slept through the night and woke with a clear mind.
He drank a little water to moisten his throat and asked his wife “What did I do and say?” His wife remembered
and the symptoms were written down as the first installment of the proving. The natives crept back one by one
next day and were astonished to find Hering and his wife alive.
The snake grows up to seven feet in length. It has fangs nearly an inch long, with a reddish brown skin marked
along the back with black brown rhomboidal spots. Nearly all the provings of Lachesis were made with the 30c
and higher potencies.
Like other snake venoms, it decomposes the blood, rendering it more fluid. It has a marked hemorrhagic
tendency. Hemorrhages are thin, containing dark particles like charred straw.
Vicarious hemorrhages, nosebleed, bloody urine etc. Small wounds bleed a great deal. Hemophilia. High
blood pressure. Flushes of heat, rushes of blood. Useful during menopause and for those of a melancholic
disposition.
Malignant or septic states, gangrene, diabetic, traumatic, cancer, carbuncle, diphtheria, erysipelas. Purpura,
diphtheria and other low forms of disease, when the system is thoroughly poisoned with profound prostration.
Cellulitis with burning and blue color of the skin. Dropsy from liver and spleen diseases after scarlatina.
Discharges are acrid and offensive. The ill effects of suppressed discharges.
Intensively rapid onset of the disease with great prostration. Intense nervous irritability with restless tossing
and moving about.
Hysteria. Manic-depression. Hard throbbing or hammering pains. Neuralgic pains change locality with
palpitations. As of thread drawing the part or spreading over.
Epilepsy, comes on during sleep from jealousy, onanism, loss of fluids. Chorea from piercing the ears.
Delirium tremens with much trembling and confusion. Trembling of the whole body of hands, tongue, etc.
Catalepsy. Diphtheria paralysis and other disorders (Botul.). Diphtheria carriers.
Great physical and mental tension. Nerves become very sensitive, especially the cutaneous and vasomotor
ones. Excessive sensitiveness of the surface with intolerance of touch or constriction. Cannot bear anything
 tight anywhere. Sensation of constriction or tension, in the throat, abdomen, head. Sensation as if a
skullcap.
Ascending sensations in throat, from hot flashes, chills. Sensation of a lump in throat, abdomen, liver,
rectum, etc. As if a lump rolls about in bladder. Blueness of the affected parts of hands. Excessive painfulness
of throat, ulcers, spots on body. Drawing sensations in vertex, jaws, in the rectum.
Symptoms appear on left side, then go to the right, especially in the throat and ovaries. Left sided paralysis
after a stroke or cerebral exhaustion. Awkward gait, left side weak. Symptoms can develop in sleep and the
patient wakes up from symptoms, at any time, day and night.
MIND - Profoundly disturbed mind. Mental symptoms worse after sleep. Ill effects of grief, fright, vexation,
anger, jealousy, disappointed love, masturbation. Ailments from night watching, over-fatigue, loss of fluids,
over-study.
Rapidly alternating states, exalted mind, rapid succession of ideas. Mental confusion. Weak memory.
Frequent mistakes are made in writing and speaking. Very imaginative. Nervous, excitable. Restless, uneasy,
does not want to attend to business, wants to be off somewhere all the time. Undertakes many things,
perseveres in nothing.
Great loquacity, rambling, with mocking, jealousy, mistrust, haughtiness, satire and ridiculous ideas.
Frequently jumping from one subject to another, then sadness. Repeats the same thing over and over. One
word often leads into another story.
Irritable, irascible, peevish. Mischievous. Disposed to be morose or to quarrel. Complains of trifles. Irritability
alternating with loquacious delirium. Malicious, wants to get revenge. Passion, leading to anger. Hateful.
Malice. Violent anger and behavior.
Selfishness, possessive, jealousy, suspicion and violence. Insane jealousy and suspiciousness (Hyos.).
Quarrelsome from jealousy. Jealousy, as foolish as it is irresistible.
Chronic depression from long-lasting grief or sorrow. Intense sadness and anxiety. Weeps from anecdotes.
Grief andjealousy. Forsaken feeling in the morning. Sadness in girls before puberty. Depression worse
before menses, better during menses. Depression since menopause. Aversion to company during
pregnancy. Weary of life, suicidal depression.
Manic depression. Mania. Great mental activity, ideas crowd rapidly. Desire for mental work in evening.
Mania from over study. Mania for work, shopping, spending money. Necessity to do everything rapidly.
Schizophrenia. Paranoid schizophrenia. Persecuted feeling, thinks herself pursued, hated and despised.
Delusion of being followed by enemies who are trying to harm him.
Mental confusion or alienation. Feels as if he had two wills. Derangement of sense of time. Hysteria after
suppression of discharges. Memory active from suppressing sexual desire. Persistent erotic ideas without
ability.
Superstitious. Fear of snakes. Hydrophobia. Fear of being poisoned, refuses medicine. Fear of suffocation
(Puls.), that heart will stop, of death, of going insane. Fears going to sleep, lying down.
Delirium. Delirium and convulsions from night watching, over fatigue and anxiety. Visions and delirious talk
as soon as he shuts eyes. Ecstasy.
Talks, sings or whistles constantly, makes odd motions with arms. Incoherent speech, talks as it were in a
strange language. Crawls on the floor, spits often, hides, laughs or is angry during spasms.
Delusions and hallucinations. Feels full of poison. Nightly delusion of fire. Delusions of floating in the air.
Thinks there are robbers in the house and wants to jump out of window.
Religious insanity (Verat., Stram.). or mania. Religious affections in children. Continually moaning that
she was lost. Fear of being possessed. Thinks herself under super-human control. Persistent thoughts of evil.
Prophetic perceptions, predicts the future correctly. Thinks she is dead and preparations are being made for
her funeral.
Alcoholism. Violent alcoholism. Intoxicated state with fear, violence and mistrust. Intoxicated with jealousy,
accusations. Delirium tremens.
Abdomen - Abdomen hot, sensitive, painfully stiff front loin down thighs. Cannot bear anything around
waist. Tympanitic, sensitive, painful (Bell.). Cutting pain in right side of abdomen causing fainting. Burning like
fire in hypogastric and lumbar region. Shooting pain in region of spleen, worse walking. Acute cutting, stinging,
radiating from navel. Intussusception, threatening sloughing. Swelling in cecal region, must lie on back with
knees drawn up, appendicitis. Pain from anus to navel. Strangulated umbilical hernia. Appendicitis. Peritonitis.
Spasmodic colic, better bending forward. Incarceration of flatus.
Back - Backache with great restlessness. Small of back as if lame and weak, or as if sprained. Backache with
abdominal cramps and throbbing headache before menses. Neck sensitive to the least pressure. Neck stiff,
moves jaws with difficulty. Stiffness in sacrum. Neuralgia of coccyx, worse rising from sitting. Feels as if
 sitting on something sharp, must sit perfectly still. Myelitis. Sensation of threads stretched from back to arms,
legs, eyes, etc.
Breasts - Swelling of breasts. Breasts inflamed, bluish with blackish streaks. Fungus hematodes on right
breasts. Nipples swollen, erect, painful to touch. Extreme sensitiveness of nipples. Child doesn’t want to nurse.
Milk, thin, blue.
Causations - Ill effects of suppressed discharges, injuries, sprains, puncture wounds, bites. Ailments from
night watching, over-fatigue, loss of fluids, over-study. Ill effects of grief, fright, vexation, anger, jealousy,
disappointed love, masturbation. Never well since menopause. Alcohol, delirium, tremens.
Chest - Burning, stinging, like coals of fire from chest through to scapulae. Chest feels constricted. Oppression
of chest during sleep. Sensation as if a plug (Anae.), which moves up and down, with short cough. Blueness
of skin of outer chest. Scarlet, shining, herpetic eruption under breasts, worse scratching. Swollen glands in
axilla. Garlic odor of sweat in axilla.
Constitutions - Especially suited to alcoholics.
Cough -Tickling, dry cough, suffocative fits. Cough causes stitching pains in affected parts. Cough during
sleep without being conscious of it. Very exhausting cough, sometimes causing vomiting. Cough as if some
fluid has gone the wrong way. Cough after rising from lying position. Cough from smoking.
Ears - Earache with sore throat. Tearing pain from zygoma into ear, with sore throat. Pulsations in ear. Ears
sensitive to wind. Numbness about ear and cheek. Polyps. Earwax too hard, dry. Earwax like chewed paper.
Hardness of hearing with lack of earwax. Blockage of Eustachian tube (Kali-m.). Sensitivity to sounds. Roaring
and singing, better putting finger in ear and shaking it. Whizzing noise, as from insects. Cracking, whizzing,
drumming, with reverberation.
Eyes - Eyes watery from pain. Feels as if eyes were forced out on pressing the throat. Sensation as if eyes
were drawn together by cords which were tied in a knot at root of nose. Lntra-ocular hemorrhages. Detached
retina. Retinal bleeding.
green or dry. hard, crumbling, white clay, putty like. Bloody mucus stools. Burning at anus after stool. Milk
passes undigested in nursing children. Worms.
Sensations - As if everything was turning around. As if hair was pulled. As if white of egg had dried on face.
As if teeth too long. As if rectum pricked with needles. Back as if broken.
Skin - Hair and nails unhealthy. Earthy, sallow and parchment-like, emaciation. Sore, dry, sensitive to cold.
Violent itching and great dryness of skin. Itching vesicles on hands and fingers. Large nodosities between the
skin and the flesh with shooting pains. Nettle-rash with much swelling. Small painless, red tetters, which
exfoliate. Spreading blisters. Small blood boils. Corroding vesicles.
Sleep - Frequent and violent yawing. Inclination to go to sleep during day. Sleeplessness from flatus, from
cutting wisdom-teeth, exhaustion. Many anxious dreams, with talking, cries, and starting from fright.
Dreams of fire, flood, robbers, quarrels. Dreams of money, pleasures, misfortunes. Dreams of dead persons.
Awakes at 2 a.m. or 3 a.m. and cannot fall to sleep. Unrefreshing sleep, more tired in the morning than on
retiring.
Stomach - Sensation of emptiness in stomach. Constrictive pain in stomach. Pains, as from ulceration. Sour
eructations and heartburn after cabbage, potatoes, greasy food, or milk. Acid risings. Sour belching and
vomiting of bitter water. Eructations tasting of rotten eggs during pregnancy. Nausea and vertigo during a
meal, followed by retching, and vomiting of bitter or salty serum. Nausea and sour vomiting during pregnancy,
during colic. Vomiting of undigested milk.
Temperature - Chilly in evening. Chilly, takes cold, before menses. Chill running down back. Chill, better out-
door exercise. Fever at night, with night sweats and aversion to uncovering. Fever with dread of exposure,
restlessness, sweat on head, redness and burning.
Throat - Sore throat with shooting pain when speaking and swallowing. Sore
Magnesia carbónica throat, worse before menses. Sticking pain in throat, worse talking and swallowing.
Burning pain in throat and palate. Frequent rising of mucus in throat. Soft, fetid tubercles of color of peas are
hawked up. Hawks up cheesy masses from throat.
Vertigo - Vertigo, worse when kneeling. Vertigo in evening with swooning. Continual giddiness, can hardly
stand, with numbness of left arm. Vertigo, staggers in the street and fears to go out, lest people should strike
against her.
COMMENTS - Cooper said that water containing magnesia, and that coming from magnesia limestone
districts, is peculiarly soft feeling. It is often found that the physical characteristics of substances correspond
with their dynamic influences, so there is reason for supposing that this softness has a soothing effect upon
the nervous system when used in baths.
Mag-c. is to exhausted nerves what Chin, is to exhaustion from loss of fluids. Worn-out condition, often
 produced during pregnancy or menses as these are an additional tax on a women's strength.
Characteristic sensitiveness, mental and bodily, sensitivity to touch, to cold air. The least touch causes starting.
Sensitiveness passes into neuralgic pains of the highest intensity. Lightening-like neuralgia, worse on the left
side, insupportable during repose, must get up and walk about.
Tired and painful feeling, especially the legs and feet, aching, restless. Head injuries from shock, blows, mental
distress. Unrefreshing sleep, more tired on waking than on going to bed.
Periodic symptoms, every second day, every three weeks, “all symptoms worse every third week.” Worse from
touch and pressure, but pressure in abdomen is better during the menstrual flow. Pain is worse on the side
lain on. Smoking aggravates the headache.
Spasmodic disorders of stomach and intestines. Sourtaste, breath, belchings, vomiting. Incarcerated gas
causing severe abdominal pains. Colic with gas and bloating, cutting and stabbing pains in the abdomen
(Cham.),
Apoplectic retinitis, absorbs hemorrhage. Cellulitis of orbit. Conjunctiva yellow. Unsteady look, eyes roll
vacantly. Pupils at first contracted, then dilated. Photophobia. Pterygium. Fistula lachrymalis with eruptions on
face.
Face - Blue circles around eyes. Purple, mottled, puffed, looks swollen, bloated. Jaundiced, chlorotic during
heat. Pale. One cheek flushed, the other pale. Flushes of heat. Pain in facial bones. Trigeminal neuralgia, left
side, heat running up into head (Phos.). Tearing pain in jaw bones (Amph.. Phos.). Lower jaw drops during
coma. Itching of face. Enormous swelling of lips. Septic mumps. Submaxillary and cervical glands swollen.
Female - Acts especially well at beginning and close of menstruation. Premenstrual syndrome. Menses too
short, too feeble. Menses, black, scanty, lumpy, acrid, vicarious from nose. The less flow, the more pain.
Dysmenorrhea, on first day. Dysmenorrhea with pain in left ovary. Labor-like pains during menses. Uterine
and ovarian pains, all relieved by the flow (Eupi.). Menorrhagia with chills at night, flushes of heat by day.
Leucorrhea before menses. Leucorrhea, copious, smarting, staining and stiffening the linen greenish.
Leucorrhea thick yellow, milky. Ovarian tumors. Left ovary, swollen indurated, painful. Violent pain in left
ovary. Uterus feels as if the os is open. Sexual desire excited. Nymphomania. Menopausal troubles, like
palpitations, hot flashes, hemorrhages, headaches, fainting spells. Prolapsed uterus during menopause.
Food - Hungry, cannot wait for food, or loss of hunger alternately. Better after eating, after fruit. Craving for
coffee, which agrees. Desires alcohol, wine, oysters, farinaceous food, pickles, sour foods. Worse tobacco,
wine, alcoholic drinks, acids and sour drinks. Throat symptoms are worse by hot drinks. Thirsty but fears to
drink.
Head - Headache, heavy, bursting pain, down to nose. Congestive headaches, rush of blood to head.
Bursting or throbbing, in temples. Headaches with
flickerings, dim vision, very pale face. Pain through head on waking. Pain at root of nose. Weight, pressure
or burning of the vertex. Waves of pain, worse after moving. One-sided headaches. Migraine, pain extending
to neck and shoulders. Sun headaches. Sick headache, worse left side. Headaches before menses.
Headaches during menopause. Burning of vertex with menopause. Left-sided stroke, after abuse of
alcohol. Perforating tumor of the skull. Does not want hair touched. Sensitiveness of scalp. Falling of hair,
especially during pregnancy.
Heart - Anxiety about heart. Visible palpitations of heart. Palpitations with pain. Palpitations with fainting spells,
during menopause. Palpitations, worse warm room. Palpitations after sudden excitement. Palpitations in
morning on waking. Constricted feeling causing palpitations with anxiety. Heart seems to stand still and then
starts with a tremendous bound. Irregular heartbeats. Pulse, weak intermittent, slow, irregular. Restless,
trembling. Weak heart, turns over or too big. High blood pressure. Carditis. Pericarditis. Senile
arteriosclerosis. As if heart were hanging by a thread.
Kidneys - Sharp pains from kidneys through ureters. Small tumor in urethra causing retention. As if a ball
rolling in the bladder when turning over. Pressure in bladder, with frequent urging. Inefficient urging. Violent
burning during urination. No urine, no stool. Black, scanty urine with edema. Urine, frequent, foamy, dark,
strong odor. Dark urine, with brown, gravelly sediment, like coffee grounds. Bloody urine. Albuminuria with
hydrothorax. Dribbling after urination.
Limbs - Paralysis after stroke. Joints as if sprained, in morning on awaking. Bluish swelling of joints, after
sprains. Erratic pains in joints. Pain in tibia after sore throat. Shortening of tendons. Sciatica, right side, better
lying down. Sciatica, must lie still, worse by least motion. Rheumatism, with swelling of wrists and ankles.
Knees cold or as if hot air is going through. Cramps in calves from
fear. Toes feel broken. Foot sweat, foul or cold. Nightly burning in palms and soles. Tingling, pricking in left
hand. Trembling of hands in alcoholics. Cracks in skin at the corners of nails. Felon, bluish swelling. Left
arm numb, fingertips numb. Boils on thighs and fingers. Phlegmasia alba dolens.
 Liver - Liver region sensitive, can't bear anything around waist. Sore, festering, throbbing deep in liver.
Acute, in liver extending to stomach. Inflammation of liver with abscess. Hepatitis and abscess. Septic
gallbladder. Liver complaints of alcoholics. Cirrhosis. Nutmeg liver. Liver complaints at menopause or after
ague.
Lungs - Sensation of suffocation and strangulation on lying down, worse when anything is around
throat, compels patient to spring from bed and rush for open window. Wants to be fanned. Feels he must
take a deep breath. Cramp-like distress in precordial region. Breathing almost stops on falling asleep
(Grind.). Can only breathe in upright position. Sensation as of a plug (Anae.), that moves up and down with a
short cough. Large quantities of ropy mucus. Difficult expectoration, frothy, purulent, bloody with excessive
perspiration. Watery, salty mucus, which has to be swallowed again. Hay asthma. Asthma, suffocating
dyspnea. Asthma after scabies, if the itching ceases. Pneumonia. Hepatization, of left lung. Last stage of
pneumonia. Bronchial attacks with cyanosis and cardiac disease. Cyanosis. Cyanosis neonatorum. Dropsy of
lungs after scarlatina. Abscess of the lungs.
Male - Sore pain in urethra, in forepart of penis. Prepuce thickened. Scrotum swollen to enormous size. Buboes
suppurating a long time. Sycotic ulcers, with bluish areolae. Gangrene of glans. Strong sexual desire, ideas,
without physical power. During sex, the emission is tardy or does not occur at all. Semen with pungent odor.
Cheerful after night emission. Ill effects of masturbation.
Modalities - Better with the appearance of discharges, warm applications, bathing affected part, open air.
Better hard pressure, sitting bent, loosening clothes. Better cold drinks, eating, especially fruits, belchings.
Worse spring, summer, sun, cloudy weather, extremes of weather, heat of room. Worse from empty
swallowing, liquids, hot drinks, alcohol. Worse morning, after sleep. Worse from motion, standing or
stooping, closing eyes, slight touch, pressure of clothes, around neck, waist. Worse from suppressed
discharges, at start and close of menses, menopause.
Mouth - Copious, tenacious, thick, pasty saliva. Peppery, sour, coppery, nauseous taste. Bad odor from
mouth. Cannot bear anything before mouth. Burning, in mouth with swelling of lips and gums. Gums, bluish,
swollen, spongy, bleed easily. Aphthous and denuded spots with burning and rawness. Nursing sore mouth
with swelling of tongue and lips. Stammering. Thick, blundering speech, cannot open mouth wide. Speechless
after having a stroke.
Nose - Pain at root of nose. Cannot bear anything before nose. Hay asthma, paroxysms of sneezing (Sil.,
Sabad.). Stopped up coryza, preceded by headache. Complaints after suppressed coryza. Postnasal
discharge of mucus. Discharge with every cough. Offensive, bloody discharges, corroding nostrils and lips.
Blood and pus from nose. Nosebleed on blowing the nose. Nosebleed, blood thick, black. Nosebleeds with
amenorrhea. Nostrils sensitive. Vesicular eruption about nose. Red pimples on nose of alcoholics.
Perspiration - Hotflushes and hot perspiration. Bloody, sweat staining blackish, yellow. Garlicky odor of
sweat. Profuse sweats with most complaints. Copious sweats at night, about neck, wakes him from sleep.
Sweats in axilla.
Rectum - Constipation, offensive stool. Constipation, very hard stools, between menses. Constipation of
pregnancy. Diarrhea alternating with constipation. Diarrhea in hot weather, from fruits and acids.
Diarrhea after menses, during menopause. Diarrhea with frothy urine. Constant urging in rectum, not for stool.
Hemorrhage from bowels like charred straw, black particles. Anus feels tight, as if nothing could go through
it. Spasmodic pains in anus before and after stool. Burning in anus during and after stools. Burning, cutting, in
rectum worse standing. Darting pain up rectum every time he sneezes or coughs. Itching at anus, worse after
sleep. Discharge of blood or mucus from anus, during menses. Beating in the anus as from hammers with
menses. As if a ball rolling when turning over. Fistula in anus. Hemorrhoids protrude, become constricted,
purplish. Hemorrhoids with sharp pains on sneezing or coughing. Hemorrhoids with scanty menses, in
menopause.
Sensations - As if frightened by visions behind him. Feeling as if knives were being thrust into brow, as if
tongue bound or tied up, as if a part of right side of head cut away. As if neck constricted with a cord. As if
heart hanging by a thread and every beat would tear it off, as though heart turned over and ceased beating for
a moment, as if heart hadn't room to beat.
Skin - Dilated capillaries. Bluish, purplish appearance. Blue-black swellings. Cellulitis. Miliary eruptions.
Purpura with intense prostration. Senile erysipelas. Black measles. Scarlet fever and scarlet eruptions.
Pustular eruptions become black. Boils, carbuncles, ulcers with bluish, purple surroundings. Burning in ulcers
at night. Varicose ulcers. Fungoid ulcers. Ulcers sensitive to touch. Dark blisters. Bedsores with black edges.
Wens. Small wounds bleed much. Pyemia, dissecting wounds. Scars, redden, hurt, break open and bleed.
Sleep - Afraid to go to sleep for fear he will die before he wakes. Sleepiness, yet cannot sleep (Bell., Op.).
Wide awake in evening. Sleeplessness from cerebral irritation, burning soles, anxiety. Sleeplessness of
 alcoholics. Sudden starting when falling asleep. Children toss about moaning in sleep. Waking in fright at a
trifle. Short naps disturbed by frightful
dreams. Restless sleep, with many dreams and frequent waking, in morning is heavy and out of sorts. Frightful
dreams of snakes. Amorous dreams. Sleeps into aggravation.
Stomach - Can bear nothing tight over stomach, must loosen clothes. Pit of stomach painful to touch.
Soreness orcramp in epigastrium. Trembling movement in the epigastric region. Nausea from anything tight
on throat. Nausea after drinking ice water, after going to bed. Nausea with great flow of saliva. Any food causes
distress. Gnawing pressure, better by eating, but returning in few hours, especially with cancer. Belchings,
before epilepsy, at menses. Vomiting of food, bile, greenish matter, mucus, pus, blood. Vomits during menses
with headache.
Stools - Stool lies close to anus without passing and without urging. Thin, offensive stools. Stools watery, light
yellow, dark, chocolate-colored, grayish, like potter's clay. Stools hard like sheep dung, scanty and insufficient.
Cadaverous-smelling stool of decomposed blood. Stools mixed with blood and slime, worse at night, after acid
fruits.
Teeth - Teeth as if wedged. Chattering of teeth. Crumbling of teeth. Teeth feel too long in hollow teeth.
Toothache, pain extends to ears. Toothache from getting wet. Toothache during menses. Gums swollen,
spongy,bleed. Gums dark purples during dentition. Periodontitis with swelling of cheek.
Temperature - Chills begin in small of back, runs up back. Chills worse drinking. Chills with sweat. Numbing
coldness. Feet icy cold. Chills at night, flushes of heat by day. Internal heat, with cold feet. Shivering without
coldness. Shivering during fever. Heatflushes with menopause, on vertex, on waking, on falling to sleep.
Fever with violent headache, great loquacity. Intermittent fever every spring. Paroxysm returns after acids.
Throat - Throat very painful, worse slightest pressure, touch. Sore throats, worse left side, swallowing
liquids. Chronic sore throat with much hawking, mucus
sticks. Throat pain extends to ear. Collar and neckband must be very loose. Constriction, better eating.
Throat pit feels swollen or sore spot back of pit. Feeling as if something was swollen which must be swallowed.
As if a lump in throat, ascending and is swallowed back again. As if hot lump or soft body or crumb of bread.
Worse from swallowing saliva or liquids. Cannot swallow sweet or acrid things. Choking. Tonsillitis. Tonsils
purplish. Quinsy. Purple, livid color of throat. Diphtheria, dusky, black membrane,pain aggravated by hot
drinks. Septic parotiditis. Upper part of windpipe very sensitive to touch. Laryngismus stridulus. Larynx painful
to touch. Loss of voice from paralysis of vocal cords or edema.
Tongue - Tongue red, dry and cracked at tip. Tip red, center brown. Tongue mapped, dry, black and stiff. Dry
stripe in middle of tongue. Anterior half of tongue red, smooth and shining. Ulcers on sides of tongue. Blisters
on tip of tongue. As if tongue was going to peel. Tongue swollen, burns. Tongue trembles when protruded.
Tongue catches on teeth. Sudden forcible protrusion and retraction of tongue. Tongue as if bound or tied up.
Sharp, in root of tongue, when yawning.
Vertigo - Fainting with pain in heart, nausea, pale face, vertigo. Vertigo on closing eyes, from walking in open
air, before menses, and at menopause. Vertigo looking at the one and same object. Vertigo, relieved by onset
of a discharge (menses or nasal catarrh). Vertigo, worse turning to right.
Vision - Paralysis of accommodation, causes asthenopia. Flickering vision, as from threads, or rays of sun.
Dim vision with black flickering, often makes • reading difficult. Blue ring about lights, with fiery rays. Glimmering
vision, in sun, with headache. Sees zigzag figures during headache. Flickering vision with congestion of head.
Defective vision, after diphtheria, extrinsic muscles too weak to maintain focus. Blindness with lung or heart
affections.
COMMENTS - Characteristic aggravation from sleep. Nash noted the case of an old, syphilitic patient who
suffered from obstinate constipation and was taken with severe attacks of colic. The pains seemed to extend
all through the abdomen and always came on at night.
The man was not making any progress when, one day, he remarked to Nash, “Doctor, if I could only keep
awake I would never have another attack.” And in response to an inquiring look from the doctor, he added, “I
mean that I sleep into the attack and waken in it.” One dose of Lach. 200c cured the colic and the constipation
too.
High blood pressure. Hemorrhages contain flakes of decomposed blood, looks like charred wheat straw.
Hemorrhagic diathesis. Hemophiliacs, bleeding easily (Sabin., Phos.). Nosebleeds or heavy menses. The
heart feels too large, cramp-like pain in précordia. Constriction. Palpitations with numbness down the arm.
Cyanosis. Varicose veins.
Dark red eruptions, purplish swellings, black and blue spots. Small ulcers, sensitive to least touch. Buboes,
plague (Naja.). Snakebites and infected wounds. Rabies, with thirst, spasms, sensitiveness and nervous
prostration.
 Excessive sensitiveness of the skin with intolerance to touch or constriction. Sensitive because of uneasiness
from pain. Pain as if burnt or scalded on different parts. Pain in the shinbones. W. J. Guernsey pointed out that
such pains often occur concomitantly with throat affections, worse or began on the left.
Sun-headaches. Headache with very pale face. Rush of blood to head. Throbbing headaches in temple with
heat of head. Headache extending into nose, better when nasal catarrh comes on. Headaches, feels like the
head will explode with blood.
Fainting fits and vertigo on closing eyes, on looking intently at any object in morning on waking. Fainting
accompanying other complaints, with pain at heart, with nausea, with vertigo and pale face. Catalepsy.
Awkward gait, weak left side. Gressus gallinaceus.
Low, muttering delirium. Intermittent fevers. Torpid state with cold limbs, tremor ofbody andhands, tremor of
tongue. Tongue trembles, catches in the teeth or lower lip when the patient attempts to put it out. Numerous
disturbances of sight and hearing. Clarke cured noises in the ears when worse after sleep.
Tickling, irritating cough. Diphtheria, mercurial and syphilitic sore throat. Sore throats, worse after sleep, from
touch. Dark, bluish, purple color, with burning pains that are worse heat. Worse drinking liquids and better
eating solids. Sensation of a lump in the throat (Ign.).
Touching the throat can cause suffocative spasms, cannot bear any pressure about neck. Pain from empty
swallowing, liquids slightly easier, solid foods swallowed without pain. Prostration out of proportion to the
appearance of the throat. Symptoms are worse on the left side or proceeding from the left to right.
Threatened paralysis of lungs. Asthma aggravated by sleep, can wake up choking. The least thing coming
near mouth or nose interferes with breathing. Hay fever with a headache extending into nose, worse on sup-
pression of the discharge. Sore nostrils and lips. Pus and blood from the nose. Red nose of alcoholics.
Sensitiveness of the respiratory parts to touch, constriction and worse by anything tight around the neck.
Sinking feeling in the stomach, cannot go long without food. Symptoms are better after eating, especially after
fruit. Unquenchable . thirst, but nausea after drinking, worse by hot drinks. Desires oysters, wine, and coffee.
Alcohol aggravates. Everything sours, heartburn. Fetid breath. Acute pain in liver extending towards stomach.
Appendicitis.
Stitches in kidneys. Pain in the bladder and rectum. Desire to lift clothes up to prevent contact with the lower
abdomen. Sensation as if a ball were rolling loose in the bladder or abdomen on turning over.
H.     N. Martin noted that the urine has little black spots or flakes like soot floating in it. Urine is almost black,
frequent, foaming, dark.
Urge to urinate after lying down, day or night, especially after sleep, more frequent in the night.
Constipation. Atony of the rectum. Painful constriction of anus followed by collapse. Visible spasmodic
tenesmus in paroxysms from two to five minutes, extorting cries, passes blood and mucus. Diarrhea is fetid,
cadaverous.
Tugging upward sensation. Full feeling in rectum and sensation as of little hammers beating. Burning in rectum.
Stitch in rectum (upwards) when coughing or sneezing. Painful hemorrhoids, with scanty menses.
Severe premenstrual syndrome, energy before menses. Water retention and weight gain. Very sensitive, to
light and noises, cries easily and becomes irritable. All symptoms ameliorated from menses.
Violent menstrual problems (Sep., Med.). Severe menstrual bleeding, dark blood with clots. Become weak and
worn out from menses. Menses regular but scanty, pains better when flow is established. Symptoms occurring
in connection with menses. In a case of Clarke's, Lach. 12c postponed the menses for a week.
Lochia are thin, ichorous insufficient. Swelling, induration of the ovaries, especially on the left. Tumors.
Menopause, sensation of pulsating energy. Hot flashes. Varicose veins, the whole leg is swollen and aches,
sore and burning. High sex drive, or suppressed drive.
Breast cancer, with a bluish appearance. Obstinate and distressing eruptions on the nipples and areola. Milk
is thin and blue, nipples extremely sensitive to touch.
Better from the onset of a discharge or blood, worse from non-appearance of an expected discharge, as in
menopause. Suppressions, particularly suppressed discharges.
Sensation as if a ball, lump or plug. Dislikes pressure or touch around the abdomen (Lyc., Chin.), or neck.
Warm-blooded, worse heat. Symptoms begin on the left side and either remain there or proceed to the right.
Particularly suited to persons who have peculiar sensitiveness of the surface of the body. Debilitated,
weakened persons. Children and elderly people. Thin rather than fat persons, persons who have been
changed both mentally and physically by their illness. Women who have never been well since menopause.
Sufferers from effects of masturbation. Alcoholics. Persons who have been overdosed with mercury and for
syphilitic disorders. Persons who cannot stand the sun and who are worse in summer weather.
RELATIONS -Antidote to venom: Ars., Merc., Radiate heat outwardly, alcohol inwardly, salt on the effects of
bite. Antidotes to potencies: Alum., Bell., Cocc., Coff., Hep., Merc., Nit- ac., Nux-v., Ph-ac., to the visible
 spasmodic tenesmus of rectum, Sep. According to Teste the chief antidote is Cedrón. It antidotes: Bufo, Crot-
h., Rhus. Compare: (1) Puls. - menstrual cough, menses scanty, but pain worse as flow increases. (2) Con.,
Graph. - scanty menses. (3) Anthr. - carbuncles, boils. (4) Terebe., Kali-bi. - tongue glazed and shining, Apis,
Lach. (5) Phos., Sulph. and Mur-ac. - piles during menses. (6) Bell, and Dulc. - paralysis of lungs. (7) Iris-t. -
appendicitis. (8) Ph-ac. - disappointed love. (9) Lyss., Sabad. - throat affected left to right, S abad., more
chronic.( 10) Cot. - menopausal troubles. Nat-m., Nit-ac., Crot-h. (11) Amph., snake lizard - right jaw swollen
and painful, sharp pains, headaches, sharp pains. Eruption of vesicles and pimples. (12) Naja, Elaps., Crot-
h., Lepi. (13) Nux-m. - cough of pregnancy, Lach, has a cough at menstrual period when it is going off. (14)
Staph. - on swallowing, pain runs externally along parotid gland to the ears, perspiration impossible. (15) Sil.,
Caul., Sul., Ust. and Vib. - left ovarian and left inffamammary pain. Complementary: Crot-c. often completes
curative workofLach. Also Lyc.,Hep., Salam. Incompatible: Acet-ac., Am-c., Carb-ac.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.Phatak.

Crotalida. South America. Dilution of the venom. Trituration. Dilutions. Historical dose: All potencies.

Bedsores. Boils. Bubo. Bubonic plague. Cancer. Carbuncles. Catalepsy. Cecum, inflammation. Cellulitis.

name: Lachnanthes Tinctoria
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - Lachn. Lachnanthes tinctoria. Spirit-weed. N. O. Hemodoracae. Tincture of whole plant.
Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Chilliness. Cough. Delirium. Diphtheria. Headaches. Heart, pains. Nosebleeds. Pneumonia,
typhoid. Rheumatism. Sore, throat. Stiff-neck. Torticollis. Tuberculosis. Typhoid fever. Wry neck.
HOMEOPATHIC - Lachnantes grows in sandy swamps near the coast. The root is red and fibrous, sword-
shaped leaves, hairy stem, and yellow, woolly flowers. It belongs to the same order as Aletris and is allied to
the irises. A curious observation is that the white pigs and sheep of Virginia lose their hooves if they feed on
Lachnantes, while the black varieties eat it without inconvenience.
A remedy for rheumatic symptoms about neck. Spasmodic torticollis, painful torticollis (Caust., Mag-p.,
Rhus-t). Wry neck. Stiffness of neck, drawn over to one side in sore throat. Pain in nape as if dislocated,
when turning the neck or bending the head back.
Body icy cold, face yellow, tendency to sweat. Bubbling and boiling about the heart, rising to head. Bridge of
nose feels pinched. Feeling of icy coldness in mid scapular region. Successfully used for diphtheria, typhoid
fever, and typhoid pneumonia. Tuberculosis. Affinity for the head, chest and circulation. Very restless, throws
herself about, feels weak.
MIND - Restlessness, tosses about, with perspiration. Tossing about and whining. Ill-humored and sleepy.
Despondent, bitter crying spells during headache. Sees images, while dozing through day.
Great loquacity, afterwards stupid and irritable. Loquacious delirium with brilliant eyes and circumscribed red
cheeks, at night between 1 a.m. to 2 a.m.. Great hilarity, especially in the evening. Excited over a trifles.
Abdomen - Rolling of wind in abdomen and discharge of flatulency. Sensation of heat through abdomen.
Back - Burning in right scapula, in spine above sacrum. Burning in region of left kidney, extending towards
right side. Pain and stiffness in back. Chilliness between the shoulder blades. Sensation between the
shoulder blades as if wet with cold perspiration. Pain in nape, as if dislocated. Spasmodic torticollis.
Rheumatism of the neck. Drawn over to one side in sore throat. Stiff neck, the head is drawn to one side.
Wry neck.
Bladder - Pressure on bladder while urinating.
Chest - Sensation of fullness in chest. Stitches on left side of chest, under right breast and under clavicle.
Compelled to inhale deeply.
Ears - Singing in ear when walking in open air. Tearing in ears. Crawling and itching in ears, better by boring
with the finger, but immediately returning and feeling as if something had closed the ear. Almost complete
deafness during fever.
Eyes - Looks with fixed eyes. Bright, sparkling eyes with delirium. Pressing in eyes as from dust. Secretion of
white mucus from eyes. Violent lachrymation and burning of eyes, sensation of dryness. Obscuration of sight,
as if a cloud were before the eyes. Yellow spots before eyes. Eyes feel heavy, as if they could not be kept
open. Sensation of twitching in upper eyelids.
Face - Swelling with redness and blueness under eyes. Pale, sickly countenance, face and lips bluish, eyes
dull, feel thick and cold. Circumscribed redness of face with violent delirium and brilliant eyes. Yellow face.
Sensation as if something were crawling over face.
Female - Menses too early, viscid blood mixed with mucus. Profuse, bright red menstrual blood. During
menses, sensation of distention of abdomen, it feels as if it were boiling.
Food - Aversion to meat. Much thirst.
Head - Head feels heavy. Head feels enlarged, worse least noise. Circumscribed red cheeks, scalp feels
 sore, as if hair was standing on end, burning in palms and soles. Bridge of nose feels as if pinched.
Right-sided pain, extending down to jaw. Scalp painful.
Heart - Stitches in heart with anxiety. Frequent violent pulsations of heart, each beat is double, one hard and
full, the other soft and small. Trembling of heart with great debility. Sensation of heat, bubbling and boiling
around heart region, rising to head.
Male - Violent burning in left half of the scrotum, drawing toward right side. Tingling and itching of scrotum.
Perspiration of scrotum and penis.
Mouth - Saliva of tough mucus. Sensation if the mouth were sore and thick. Swelling and tension of the lips.
Lips red.
Limbs - Tearing from the shoulder, extending to finger joints. Tearing in elbow joints. Tearing in knuckles of
the middle fingers of the right hand. Thumb and index finger feel as if sprained. Burning of palms and soles.
Cramps in the feet during night.
Lungs - Cough worse in bed and after sleeping. Dry cough, as if it came from larynx with sore throat.
Expectoration streaked with blood with severe pain in chest. Pneumonia.
Nose - Profuse nosebleeds, pale blood. Bridge of nose feels pinched.
Perspiration - Sensation the skin is moist and sticky. Perspires freely after midnight. Sweats during cold.
Sweats with dizziness. Sweats in morning.
Rectum - Continuous stitch in rectum. Frequent unsuccessful desire to evacuate. Frequent stool, passes much
wind.
Sensations - As if head or vertex enlarged, as if split open with a wedge, as if hair standing on end. As if a
cloud before eyes, pressing as from dust in eyes. As if something had closed ear. Bridge of nose as if pinched.
As of something crawling over face.
Skin - Sensation in skin as if an eruption would appear. Pimples appear here and there, containing a watery
fluid. Itching and burning in the skin all night, worse after scratching. Stinging, itching and tingling on thighs,
legs, feet, arms.
Sleep - Sleepiness with yawning, eyes feel so heavy that she cannot keep them open. Cannot go to sleep
easily. Sleepless or restless sleep with distressing dreams. After waking and stretching, a shock followed by
chilliness and goose bumps all over.
Stomach - Sensation of qualmishness above navel, when walking in open air. Fullness in pit of stomach,
beating as from a pulse, as if a hammer were beating on an ulcerated spot.
Teeth - Pain in all the teeth when eating or drinking warm things. All the teeth feel loose and too long, worse
in bed.
Temperature - Continuous chilliness. Icy coldness of body, perspiration, principally on forehead. The skin is
cold, damp and clammy during the chills. Feels hot, but the chills run all over before the heat can develop itself.
Flashes of heat alternating with chilliness. Fever with violent delirium and brilliant eyes. Fever with somnolency.
Throat - Great dryness in throat, especially on waking in the night with much coughing. Sore throat with short
cough. Itching when swallowing. Sensation of swelling in pharynx with stiffness of neck and head drawn to one
side (diphtheria).
Vertigo - Giddiness in the head with sensation of heat in chest and around heart and perspiration. Vertigo with
icy coldness of the forehead.
COMMENTS - Hering said the Nati ve Americans chewed the plant when they met the “white man” to give
them a flow of language. Remarkable loquacity. Produces a desire to talk a flow of language and the courage
to make a speech.
Strong affinity for the head, chest and circulation. Sharp stitches in quick succession in the right side of the
chest below mamma. Sensation of heat, bubbling and boiling in chest and region of heart, rising to head, giddy,
breaks out into perspiration. Trembling of the heart.
Tuberculosis when the neck is drawn over to one side. Rheumatism of the neck and stiffness of the neck.
Stiffness of the neck with the head twisted to one (right) side, especially when occurring with a sore throat.
Much dryness of throat, worse on waking in the night with coughing.
Headaches of great intensity, generally right-sided. Sensation as if the head is split open with a wedge, with
icy coldness of the body, crying spells, worse by vomiting. Toothache, worse eating and drinking warm things.
Continued chilliness. Sensation as if a piece of ice was lying on back between shoulders, then a shock followed
by coldness over the whole body with goose bumps. Cold attacks occur on moving, better after going to bed.
During the cold sensation, the skin is damp and clammy.
Fever with loquacious delirium, brilliant eyes and circumscribed red cheeks. Blueness about face, under eyes,
and lips. Burning of palms and soles, under nail of left toe.
Arthur Dalzell reported the case of Mrs. B., 43, who had fibroid tuberculosis of both lungs, collapse of right
 lower lobe. Great prostration and night-sweats. The bowels were alternately relaxed and confined. Pain and
stiffness in the back, bruised all over, dry cough, roughness of throat, weak heartsounds. Bad sleep owing to
a cough.
Lachn. tincture, three drops every four hours, was given. In three days the prostration was diminished and the
cough was much better, night-sweats and bruised feeling gone. From this time an emulsion containing cod-
liver oil, liquor pancreaticus, eggs, cream, hypophosphites and eucalyptus oil were given in addition. The case
went on to recovery.
Dalzell also recorded the case of Mrs. R., 45, who was in the last stage of tuberculosis. Right lung consolidated,
left in cavities. This patient had circumscribed flush on face, brilliant eyes, throat felt rough, overall bruised
feeling. Remittent fever. Skin dry, except at night, when she had profuse perspiration. Constant dry cough.
Muco-purulent expectoration.
Lachn. tincture, five drops every three hours, relieved all the symptoms and procured euthanasia, the patient
dying quite easily twelve days later.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Dulc., Bry., Puls. (2) Fei. - nape of neck pains and great tension there.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Lacticum Acidum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - lac-ac. Lacticum acidum. Lactic acid. Milk acid. Lactis acidum. Dilutions. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Acidity. Aching, pain. Aphonia. Belchings. Bones, swelling. Breasts, disorders. Canker, sores.
Coryza. Cough. Debility. Diabetes. Foot sweat. Gastroenteritis. Glands, enlarged. Hoarseness. Indigestion.
Leucorrhea. Morning, sickness. Nausea. Nosebleed. Pregnancy, sickness. Rheumatic, pains. Rheumatism.
Sciatica. Throat, constricted. Throat, sore. Trembling. Vomiting. Water brash. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Hering noted that lactic acid was discovered by Scheele in sour milk, the result of the
spontaneous fermentation of sugar of milk under the influence of casein. It is also met with in many vegetable
products which have turned sour.
Reisig first introduced it into homeopathy. Lactic acid has been proved in both the lower and higher potencies,
but many valuable observations have been made on patients taking substantial doses for diabetes as it was
often given for diabetes in the past.
In these cases, the symptoms of rheumatic fever were directly traced to the acid. Pain, swelling, stiffness and
tenderness of joints, worse by motion (as with Bry., which antidotes Lac-ac.). Flying pains about limbs.
One pro ver had pain along the right sciatic nerve. The well-known effects of milk that has soured on the
stomach and remained undigested were produced. Nausea, vomiting, burning and sense of weight.
Weakness, as if from exercise, aversion to exercise. Rheumatic affections. Rheumatic pains in joints, knees,
worse by motion. Trembling of whole body, while walking. Debility, weariness of the limbs.
Acidity. Hot acrid belchings, worse smoking. Salivation, water brash. Morning sickness. Fullness or lump like
puff ball in throat.
Frequent passing of large quantities of saccharine urine. Diabetes. Sweaty feet. Breast troubles.
MIND - Confusion. Forgetful, can’t remember a thing an hour after it has happened. Dislikes to read or think.
Lazy. Aversion to business or what formerly was pleasant to do. Contemptuous. Sarcastic. Finds fault, very
exacting. Believes all she says is a lie. Great discouragement during pregnancy.
Abdomen - Pains across bowels and lower right side. Bearing down pain in upper part of abdomen. Sharp
pain across lower abdomen before stool. Left hypochondrium sensitive to touch. Sharp cutting pains and
jerking in muscle. Dull pain in left groin over hip bone.
Back - Pain in small of back, extending into shoulders. Sore aching in lower part of back, worse when walking.
Stiff neck. Stiff down between scapulae and across shoulders.
Breasts - Pain in breasts with enlargement of axillary glands.
Chest - Left side of chest sore and painful. Cutting or sticking pain in upper third of right side.
Constitutions - Suited to anemic, pale women. Large doses disagreed with melancholic, choleric constitution,
dark hair and eyes.
Cough - Hoarse, hard, dry cough with dryness of glottis. Spasmodic, ringing cough from irritation in throat.
Cough from hot eructations. Cough with nausea and constricted feeling in throat. Constant cough worse spring
and fall, with foot sweat. Cough worse from smoking.
Ears - Disturbed and troubled by noise. Roaring in left ear on rising, in afternoon. Singing, snapping in left ear.
Pain from parotids into ear, stiff feeling in parotids.
Eyes - Sensation of fullness in eyes with headache. Eyes feel tired. Eyes feel as if they would burst. Marked
 protrusion of eyes. Hyperesthesia of retina, steady aching in and behind eyeball. Pupils dilated.
Photophobia, direct light painful. Jerking of left upper lid.
Face - Face flushed or congested from headache. Erysipelatous redness on left cheek and side of nose. Small
vesicles on nose in morning. Parotids feel stiff. Pains from parotids into ear.
Female - Menses scanty, more profuse than usual. Itching of vulva during flow. Leucorrhea, staining linen
yellow, when checked, nasal catarrh ensues. Pain as if menstruating, sitting with feet high lessens uterine
soreness. Pain in small of back and lower abdomen. Aching pain in region of right ovary, worse by rapid
walking or exercise. Morning sickness with salivation, nausea and vomiting, water brash better by breakfast.
Food- Appetite impaired. Voracious appetite and great thirst. Eating generally improves symptoms. Nausea
on waking, better by eating in diabetes or pregnancy.
Head - Congestion of head, painless with strong pulsation of vessels of neck. Head feels very large. Headache
with sensation of fullness in vertex. Dull pain in forehead, just over eyes and extending into eyes. Pain in head
and back all night. Pain in occiput and alternating between there and forehead. Head sore to touch. Fine miliary
eruption on scalp.
Heart - Sharp pains around heart, causes palpitations.
Kidneys - Frequent pain in kidneys. Frequent desire to urinate large quantities. Urinates day and night, the
attempt to retain it causes pain. Copious urine, deep brownish red, with much reddish sediment. Sugar in urine.
Morning urine contained a large amount of salt, in evening a large excess of sugar.
Limbs - Limbs feel chilly. Debility, weariness of the limbs. Weakness as if from exercise with rheumatic pains
in the bones, aversion to exercise. Rheumatic pain in joints and shoulders, wrists, knees, with much
weakness. Joints swollen, not tender, stiff. Severe, sharp pains in joints, stiffness. All pains worse by
movement. Trembling of whole body while walking.
Lungs - Saw-like rasping sound. Frequent deep sighing inspirations and expirations. Spasmodic, ringing
cough, caused by irritation in throat.
Male - Annoying erections in morning, but loins ache too much to attempt sex. Seminal emissions three
successive nights.
Modalities - Smoking aggravates all symptoms.
Mouth - Mouth and fauces very dry and hot. Much saliva in mouth, tasting salty. Copious salivation and
water brash, especially during pregnancy. Acrid taste with nausea. Sour, coppery taste. Very sore mouth.
Roof of mouth dry, feels burnt. Canker sores.
Nose - Great sensitiveness of smell. Severe coryza. Stopped nose. Sneezing. Thick, yellow mucus from head
to throat. Dryness of posterior nares, with hawking of mucus. Nosebleed every morning.
Perspiration - Copious perspiration. Unusual perspiration of feet.
Rectum - Aching pain in anus. Soft, mushy stool, diarrhea. Greenish yellow stools with tenesmus. Very costive,
stool once a week, hard, black.
Skin - Skin harsh and dry, no sweat. Itching and burning, worse by cold. Red spots or blotches on various
parts of the body, particularly thighs and lower limbs.
Sleep - Stupid, drowsy all day, restless all night. Sleeplessness from vertigo, from backache. Dreams of sexual
intercourse, with erections, no emission. Horrible dreams, of abysses.
Stomach - Burning and weight in stomach. Burning, hot gas from stomach to throat, causing profuse secretion
of tenacious mucus, worse smoking. Hot, acridbelchings. Food sours. Uneasiness in stomach after food
and drink. Nausea with water brash or vomiting, better from eating. Nausea, morning sickness, especially in
pale, anemic women. Nausea on rising in morning. Nausea after breakfast, not severe, but very persistent.
Nausea like seasickness. Constant nausea, persisting for days.
Temperature - Cold and chilly at times, mostly on limbs. Flushes of heat with headaches.
Throat-Dryness of throat with hoarseness. Dryness and rawness, extending to larynx. Sensation of aplug
in the throat. Excessive hawking with or without nausea. Keeps swallowing. Difficulty of swallowing solids,
liquids more easily. Fullness or lump like a puffball. Sense of constriction low down in throat, rough and dry.
Intense burning in throat, fauces and esophagus worse by eructation. Fauces hot, dry and swollen. Aphonia.
Hoarseness.
Tongue - Tongue dry, parched, red and raw. Thick yellow coating on tongue with bad taste in morning. Tongue
sticky, coated thick white. Tongue sore on left side.
Vertigo - Vertigo when turning head suddenly, on stooping, on rising. Vertigo at night. Vertigo worse with heat.
Vertigo as if tossed on a rough sea. with nausea like seasickness.
COMMENTS - Cartier noted its use for acute gastroenteritis, six to ten drops in a small glass of water. It was
used locally in the tuberculous ulceration of vocal cords.
Nash regarded the concomitance of rheumatic pains as the chief guiding symptom here. He recorded a case
 of diabetes with rheumatic fever supervening, cured with Lac-ac. 200c.
Constant nausea, nausea on awaking, before rising. Nausea in diabetes, pregnancy, or rheumatism. Nausea,
better from eating, belchings, worse from smoking. Smoking
• aggravates the belchings. Diabetes.
Severe pains in muscles and joints after exertion. Chronic fatigue with flu-like symptoms since physical over-
exertion. Chronic fatigue with muscle aches. Inoffensive, copious foot-sweat (Sil.).
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Bry. (relieved sharp pains upper third right side, but soreness remained).
Compare: (1) Sarcol-ac. (2) Lith., Ph-ac. Lac-c., Lac-v-c., Lac-d., Sac-1. (3) In nausea of pregnancy, Nux-v.,
Puls., Ph-ac., Colch., Lyc., Lac-d. (4) Ip. - excessive hawking with or without nausea. (5) Caust. - phlegm in
throat, cannot be hawked up, causing nausea. (6) Diabetes, Ph-ac., Acet-ac., Lac-d., Uran-n.
(7)   Flying rheumatism, Puls., Rhus-t. (8) Great discouragement, Psor. Incompatible: Coffee worse
symptoms.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

potencies.
