name: Luna
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - luna. Luna. Moonlight. Moon's rays. Sugar of milk is exposed on a glass plate to the moon's
rays and stirred with a glass rod meanwhile. The sugar of milk so charged is dynamized in the usual way
(Fincke). Higgins made a preparation by exposing pure water to the moon's rays for three or four hours in
South America and then dynamizing the water so charged. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Acidity. Colic. Edema. Epilepsy. Female, disorders. Headaches. Heartburn. Inter-menstrual flow.
Insomnia. Menses, problems. Nightmares. Ovary, pain. Scabies. Sleep, disorders. Sleepwalking.
Somnambulism. Sycosis. Worms.
HOMEOPATHIC - Goullon contributed to the Rev. Hom. Beige, January, 1897, a notable article on “The
Influence of the Moon on the
Human Organism,” in which he mentioned, among other interesting facts, that sleepwalking is a lunar effect,
that worm disorders are most troublesome at the full noon, and that goiter changes more or less with the moon.
Epilepsy worse at full moon may need Luna (Sil.). Scabies and worm disorders, worse at full moon. Nervous
affections, especially in subjects of sycosis, influenced by the moon.
Excessive edema of face, neck and hands with neuralgic pains in the swollen parts. Skin diseases. Sour
belchings, especially if tasting of ingesta. Acrid yellow leucor- rhea through the day with backache. Pain in
right ovary.
MIND - Mental faculties, especially ability to receive, retain and express ideas, are most powerfully affected by
the full rays of the moon. Worse from exposure to moonlight. Worse from certain moon phases. Worse the
day before the full moon. Ailments from full moon.
Confusion of mind. Difficult concentration. Absent-minded. Forgetful. Mistakes in spelling, talking.
Mindnotclear. Spaced-out feeling. Feeling detached, disconnected. Apathy, lack of motivation. Disinclined
for mental or physical labor. Somnambulism.
Mood changeable, worse before and during menses. Sensitive, emotionally. Depressed and anxious. Dwells
on past disagreeable occurrences (Nat-m.). Irritable and impatient, easily angered, worse before menses.
Abrupt. Anger, in outbursts. Temper tantrums. Resentment, indifferent towards husband or partner. Irritable
towards own children. Weeping after anger. Irritability on being spoken to. Wants to be let alone.
Abdomen - Faint feeling in stomach on awaking. Sensation of great distention. Colic, commencing two inches
above umbilicus and seeming to pass directly upward to stomach, causing desire to bend forward. Pain around
umbilicus, better by belchings. Pain through liver and spleen, worse 3 p.m.
Back - Very severe pain in sacral region in evening.
Chest - After ascending stairs, a peculiar heating sensation, beginning at lower extremity of sternum and
extending outwards. Attachment of diaphragm on each side to a point under each arm, at same time warm
glow down arms to fingertips, most in left.
Eyes - Swollen eyes that burn and sting (Apis). Sharp stinging sensation, leaving a smarting. Stinging in right
eye. Weakness of eyes and feeling of sand. Swelling of eyelids and profuse discharge of purulent matter with
a painful smarting and profuse lachrymation without heat or change of color.
Face - Edema of face.
Female - Menstrual cramps with bearing down pains. Menses less free, strings of dark blood, colic pain above
umbilicus better by eructation. Mensesflow heavier. Menses returned two days after ceasing. Uterine
hemorrhage. Bearing-down sensation. Sharp pain left side vagina, then grows suddenly sharper, again
returning to vagina and passing through to rectum. Sharp pains fly from vagina through abdomen, ceasing in
stomach-pit. Pain better by passing flatus from vagina. Cramp-like pains in pelvic region, as if uterus were
being contracted by a strong electric current.
Food - No appetite, slight nausea. Desires something, does not know what. Immediately ejected cup of tea
during headache, the tea tasted sour.
Head - Slight giddiness with slight bitter taste on left side of tongue with increased saliva. Sharp pain just
above root of nose. Congestion of blood to head with sensation of great fullness. Migraine headaches. Pain
in occiput, changing to lame feeling on retiring. Headache before menses. Woke with very severe headache.
Headache better by magnetic passes. Severe frontal headache during menses.
Heart - Pulse rapid. Suffocative sensation around heart. On retching, peculiar feeling around heart as though
it stopped beating, better by belchings, worse by lying down.
Kidneys - Urine profuse, clear and watery, at times darker.
 Limbs - Swollen feeling. Slight rheumatic pains in shoulders, especially left. Sharp, quick pain in left cervical
nerve, intermittent every few seconds. Great lameness in anterior tibial region from walking. After retiring,
aching in bones of lower limbs with pain in lumbo-sacral region. Sensation as if tightly bound in right calf and
in hypochondria. Pain like growing-pain above left knee, better walking. Sharp pain in left great toe.
Modalities - Better by cold application. Pains, better in open air, belchings and by passing flatus from vagina.
Worse before and after full moon, during increasing moon, exposure to moonlight. Worse after sleep,
from milk.
Mouth - Bitter taste on the left side of tongue with increased flow of saliva. Increased saliva, all day, on waking,
with faint feeling in stomach, with stinging in right eye.
Nose - Sensation of a cold in head. Coryza, sneezing and pain in occiput. Discharge of yellowish-green mucus
from nose. Sensation of heavy cold in head with lachrymation, at 4 p.m.
Rectum - Urgent desire for stool, immediately better by passing flatus.
Skin - Unbearable itching. Stinging, itching right side of body as if an insect was biting the parts, felt most on
foot, leg and forearm. Eczema.
Sleep - Insomnia, worse moonlight. Somnambulism. Nightmares after exposure to moonlight, particularly
in children. Dreams of murder, death. Wakes after frightful dreams. Symptoms worse on waking. Felt as if had
not slept enough.
Stomach - Burning, worse after drinking milk. Flatulency with burning in stomach. Sour belchings, tasting of
ingesta. Woke at midnight with severe heartburn and great distress in stomach, had to get out of bed.
Temperature - Woke 6 a.m. with severe chill, after which he had headache, felt sick and weak all day, at night
had horrible dreams of death.
Throat - Some soreness in throat.
COMMENTS - Conditions affected by the moon, particularly epilepsy, migraine headaches, insomnia,
emotional and hormonal changes, neuralgic pains, and swelling of the hands and face. Conditions worse
during full moon (Calc., Sil., Arg-n.). Dreams and nightmares, particularly in children. Dreams of dying. Irritable,
unclear mind.
Increased worm activity. Growing pains in children, better walking. Swollen eyes that burn and sting (Apis).
Sensation of sand or grit in the eyes (Euphr.). Pain in the occiput. Menstrual cramps with bearing down pains.
Symptoms better in open air and cool air. Worse from sleep, milk.
According to Menuret, skin diseases are frequently influenced by the moon. He noted a case of eczematous
affection which increased with each waning moon and was at its maximum intensity at the new moon when it
covered the whole face and chest and was accompanied by unbearable itching. Then there was gradual
improvement and the face became smooth, but scarcely had the full moon passed when all began again.
Moritz Hoffmann observed a young girl (daughter of an epileptic mother) whose whole body became swollen
at every new moon, the swelling disappearing as the moon waned.
Mead told of a child who was subject to convulsions at each waning moon. Gale remarked that with weakly
persons' excitability is most pronounced at the new moon and the full moon.
Swan communicated a proving of Luna 1,000c. made on a female physician, Dr. S. J. W. The prover was
menstruating at the time the proving was commenced, but was otherwise in good health. Repeated doses
were taken for two days. The effects lasted four weeks. Swan cured, with Luna, a case of excessive edema of
face, neck and hands with neuralgic pain in the swollen parts.
Goullon quoted a remarkable case of sleepwalking from the Cercle Medical. “A youth of fifteen in good health
in other respects, had been withdrawn from his apprenticeship, on account of his nightly promenades
on roofs. He was put in a private asylum. Although his room was oriented so that no actual moon-rays could
reach it, the moon nevertheless exercised a potent influence upon him.
“As soon as it reaches the horizon he gets out of bed and carefully with closed eyes, moves towards a window,
so high that he has to jump in order to reach and open it. As it is barricaded with an iron trellis he gets down
and, crossing the corridor, goes to the outer door, above which is a window.
“With cat-like agility he climbs up to this, when he is seized by three warders, who take him back to his room,
where, only after the moon has set, can he lie down and go to sleep. In the morning he remembers nothing.
At full moon the symptoms are still more extraordinary.”
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aeth., Mag-c. - worse from milk. (2) Worse at new moon: Alum., Am-c., Bufo,
Calc., Caust., Clem., Cupr., Daph., Lyc., Sabal., Sep., Sil. (3) Worse at full moon: Alum., Calc., Cycl., Graph.,
Kali- n., Nat-c„ Nat-m., Sabin., Sep., Sil., Spon., Sulph., Teucr. (4) Worse during increasing moon: Am., Clem.
(5) Worse during waning moon - Dulc., Thuj.
REFERENCES - Clarke. Murphy. Swan.
 ***LUPULUS HUMULUS
(Hops)
PHARMACY - lup. Lupulus humulus. Hops. N. O. Cannabinacae of the Urticacee. Tincture of the seeded
spikes. Trituration. Tincture of Lupuline, small resinous granules covering the scales. Historical dose: Tincture
and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Alcoholism. Delirium. Diuresis. Dyspepsia. Dysuria. Excitement. Faintness. Gonorrhea.
Headaches. Insomnia. Jaundice. Nausea. Paralytic, weakness. Sexual, weakness. Vertigo. Vomiting.
HERBAL - The “hops pillow” as a remedy for sleeplessness is well known, and this sleep provoking effect
passes into delirium and stupefaction.
HOMEOPATHIC - Lup. has had a somewhat extensive proving, to the symptoms of which have been added
the effects of working with hops and of sleeping in rooms where hops were stored.
Giddiness and stupefaction. Drawing and twitching in almost every muscle. Nervous tremors, wakefulness
and delirium of alcoholics. Unstrung condition of the nervous system attended with nausea, dizziness,
headache following a night's debauch. Infantile jaundice. Urethral burning. Slow pulse.
MIND - Morbid vigilance. Highly excited. Confusion. Frequent starting from deep sleep with violent delirium
from which he could only be aroused with great difficulty, immediately lapsing again into stupor. Delirium of
alcoholics. Mental functions remained indolent several months.
Abdomen - Fermentation and dull pains in abdomen. Dull griping in lower abdomen with nausea.
Eyes - Pupils remained dilated for several months.
Female - Diminishes and allays sexual appetite.
Food - Appetite lost. Great thirst.
Head - Dull, heavy headache with dizziness.
Rush of blood to head and eyes. Heat in head and face with confusion and dull headache. Violent pulsating of
temporal arteries. Drawing and twitching in every muscle.
Heart - Slow pulse.
Kidneys - Diuresis. Urine retarded, dark brown, clear. Burning in urethra during urination, not better by coffee.
Limbs - Great twitching of tendons. Paralytic weakness.
Lungs - Respiration is deep, almost stertorous.
Male - Diminishes and allays sexual appetite. Painful erections. Emissions, depending on sexual weakness
and after onanism. Spermatorrhea.
Neck - Strong pulsation of carotids.
Perspiration - Perspiration profuse, clammy, greasy.
Rectum - Stool softer than usual with urging so great he could hardly reach the closet. Stool retarded.
Skin - Scarlatina-like eruption on face. Feels like insects crawling under skin, feels chapped, skin peels.
Sleep - Drowsy during the day. Sopor. Insomnia.
Stomach - Sensation of increased warmth in stomach. Nauseating eructations, tasting of hops. Nausea,
vomiting.
Tongue - Tongue thickly coated, dry.
Vertigo - Vertigo, stupefaction.
COMMENTS - A child of twelve, who remained several days in a room where hops were being picked,
experienced frequent starting up from deep sleep with violent delirium from which he could only be aroused
with great difficulty, when he recognized the bystanders, but immediately fell backward into stupor.
It was months before he recovered. The effects which remained included dilated pupils, mental indolence,
unsteady movements, and erythema.
Other symptoms are a turning sensation in stomach, fermenting in abdomen. Burning in urethra during
urination. Nausea and vomiting. Faintness better in open air. Twitching of tendons.
RELATIONS - Antidotes: Coff., vinegar. Compare: (1) Urt-u., Cann-i., Cann-s., Nux- v., Op.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
keynote:
PHARMACY - luna. Luna. Moonlight. Moon's rays. Sugar of milk is exposed on a glass plate to the moon's
rays and stirred with a glass rod meanwhile. The sugar of milk so charged is dynamized in the usual way
(Fincke). Higgins made a preparation by exposing pure water to the moon's rays for three or four hours in
South America and then dynamizing the water so charged. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Acidity. Colic. Edema. Epilepsy. Female, disorders. Headaches. Heartburn. Inter-menstrua

name: Lycium Barbarum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - lyci-b. Lycium barbarum. Goji berries. Chinese wolfberry. English wolfberry. Matrimony vine.
Chinese boxthorn. N. O. Solanaceae. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Anemia. Arthritis. Cancer. Cough. Diabetes. Nosebleeds.
HERBAL - The term “Goji” is the common name given to the Lycium barbarum berry by the Tibetans. Goji
usually refers to varieties of Lycium called in English wolfberry, matrimony vine, or Chinese boxthorn.
The berries flourish in the tranquil valleys that are naturally protected by the Himalayan Mountains, and have
 been treasured for centuries by the Himalayan people.
Traditionally it has been used to treat inflammations, skin irritations, nosebleeds and aches and pains, and has
also been used as a sedative. The fruit is the main source of medicinal extracts, although the leaves are also
sometimes consumed as food.
In China, it is often used in combination with other botanicals to treat poor vision, anemia, and cough. In the
tests, a polysaccharide isolated from Lycium has been shown to have anti-cancer effects. It also has some
immune enhancing properties.
COMMENTS - An evergreen shrub that is often spiny and grows in temperate and subtropical regions, the two
species most commonly used in folk medicine are Lycium chinense or Lycium barbarum, both in the nightshade
(Solanaceae) family.
One legend recounts that during the Tang Dynasty (around 800 AD), a well had been dug beside a wall near
a famous Buddhist temple that was covered with goji vines. Over the years, countless berries had fallen into
the well.
Those who prayed there had the ruddy complexion of good health, and even at the age of eighty they had no
white hair and had lost no teeth, simply because they drank the water from the well.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Crat., Sabal serr.
REFERENCES - Murphy.

name: Lycopersicum Esculentum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - lycpr. Lycopersicum esculentum. Tomato. Solanum lycopersicum. Love apple. N. O.
Solanaceae. Tincture of ripe fruit. Tincture of fresh flowering plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Backache. Catarrh. Coryza. Deltoid rheumatism. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Eyes disorders. Gout.
Headache. Leucorrhea. Lupus. Metrorrhagia. Obesity. Polyuria. Rheumatism. Throat sore.
HOMEOPATHIC - Clarke knew of one instance in which the slightest indulgence in tomatoes brings on an
attack of gout. Cooper commended the use of tomatoes in cases of obesity. Cooper gave Lycpr. in a case of
rodent ulcer and caused sharp pain and temporary spread of the disease.
Coryza, worse out of doors (All-c., better out of doors). Polyuria, with great thirst. Diabetes. Marked action on
deltoid and pectoral muscles, pain is better lifting arm upward and outward. Pains leave after influenza. Right
side principally affected, symptoms proceed from right to left.
MIND - Peevish about trifles. Very irritable, noises greatly annoy. Unusually mentally active for short periods,
followed by longer periods of mental dullness. Weak memory, forgetful. Thoughts disappear, worse when
leaning head against anything. Cannot keep mind fixed on work.
Abdomen - Great flatulency of abdomen. Back - Cannot get into a comfortable position. Backache in lumbar
region, making them gloomy and depressed. Rheumatic pain near attachment of trapezius muscle to spine.
Heavy dragging in right scapula.
Breasts - Sore and tender scirrhous breast.
Chest - Slight sticking beneath left side of sternum, without difficulty of respiration. Oppression in chest in
lower lobe of right lung.
Eyes - Dull, heavy, ache. Sore and burning. Pupils minutely contracted. Twitching in left inner canthus. Eyes
water on close work. Letters run together when reading. Keeps wiping eyes to see clearly. Light painful. Lids
feel heavy and swollen.
Face - Face flushed, pale. Pressure in right or left zygoma.
Female - Profuse leucorrheal discharge. Too frequent menstruation, brought on by free use of canned
tomatoes, the flow would return whenever this food was eaten for a few meals.
Head - Intense throbbing, bursting headache. Bursting pain in head, especially vertex and when coughing.
Dull, heavy pain in occiput. Headache in the occiput, spreads all over the head and settles with
great violence in temples, worse tobacco smoke.
Heart - Fine, stitching pains at base of heart. Lame pain in region of heart. Pulse 100, full and flowing.
Kidneys - Increase of watery constituents of urine, not of total solids. Must rise at night to urinate. Constant
debility when in open air, not at all in warm room.
Limbs - Intense aching, rheumatic pain in muscles of all limbs. Lame, tired feeling in all limbs with great
exhaustion. Intense aching pain in lower limbs. Sharp sticking pain along course of right crural nerve. Painful
sticking behind articulation of left hip. Sharp pain in right deltoid and pectoral muscles, worse lifting arm upward
and outward. Lameness of left wrist, hand and fingers, where it is painful even when not moving it.
Lungs - Coughs are deep, harsh, starting from irritation in lower chest. Explosive cough. Dry, hacking cough
coming on at night and keeping him awake. Expectoration white and in lumps, early in morning.
 Modalities - Better in warm room, from external heat. The headache in one instance was completely better by
tobacco smoke. Worse by noise, motion.
Mouth - Itching and tickling in roof of mouth. Tongue coated thick, yellow, white, more in center. Foul breath,
taste.
Nose - Stopped catarrh. Profuse watery coryza excoriating ale, drops down posterior sinuses, salty taste,
markedly worse out of doors.
Skin - Erythematous lupus much relieved (Cooper).
Sleep - Unable to fall asleep in evening tosses about, every position uncomfortable. Very restless sleep.
Frequent waking and tossing, limbs when pressed feel paralyzed. Confused, disagreeable dreams. Wakened
by insignificant dreams.
Stomach - Thirst for large quantities of water. Violent belchings of gas with taste of food. Great flatulency
between 10 a.m. and 11:30. Burning sensation in stomach towards evening and during evening.
Stool - Brownish, watery diarrhea, yellow, frothy, no urging, painless.
Temperature - Chilliness towards night, preceded by thirst for large quantities of water. Chilliness and sweat.
Sweat on awaking confined to a strip about four inches wide along whole length of back. Temperature from
100.5° to 101 °F.
Throat - The throat slightly sore on swallowing. Mucus membrane of pharynx pale, tip of uvula and arches of
pharynx red and inflamed. Burning raw feeling right side of throat, changing to left. Swelling of left tonsil.
Constant desire to clear throat. Husky voice. Hoarseness with constant tickling in pit of throat. Hoarseness
towards night.
Vertigo - Giddiness, with inclination to faint on attempting to walk.
COMMENTS - Gross made a proving of Ly- cpr., noting peevishness and loss of memory, sticking and pressing
pains, a sense of paralysis, pressing and boring pains in head, and stopped catarrh. Some women cannot eat
tomatoes without getting backache, leucorrhea or metrorrhagia.
In Gross's proving, the headache was worse in evening, she was obliged to rise in the night to urinate. The
mind symptoms were worse and the headache better by leaning the head against something.
Dr. Herbert H. Roberts of Derby, Conn., published provings made by himself, two with the 3x and two with the
30x tinctures. “The original tincture was made from the thoroughly ripened fruit, great pains being taken to
thoroughly macerate the seeds as well as the pulp.” The rheumatic and congestive symptoms were mostly
produced by the 3x, the nervous symptoms mostly by the 30x.
Roberts remarked that the natives of Mexico and California eat quantities of the ripe fruit to prevent
rheumatism. The right deltoid was very markedly affected and should make Lycpr. a companion to Sang, in
shoulder pains.
Headaches were intense and characteristic in some, great soreness remained after the pain had gone.
Dark-complexioned people seem to be suited to its action from two cases recorded by Roberts.
The first case concerned a widow, 50, dark complexion, large, stout, gray eyes. Sudden attack of grip. Very
severe aching pains all over, up and down back, limbs, head. Beating, throbbing in head, beginning in occiput,
spreading all over head, settling with great violence in temples.
Excruciating pain back of eyes and in balls as if they would burst with the pressure. Light causes pain. Delirium.
Severe, deep, racking cough. Thirst for large quantities. Pupils contracted.
Lycpr. 3x every hour cleared away the fever and acute symptoms by the following morning and rapidly cured
the remaining cough.
The second case was a man, 40, dark complexion, black hair and eyes, tall, thick-set. Severe bursting,
throbbing pain beginning in occiput and settling with great force in temporal and frontal regions, eyes painful,
worse from light, pupils contracted. Thirst for large quantities. Temperature 104° F. Pulse full flowing.
Lycpr. 3x every hour given in evening removed the headache before midnight. The next day, the right tonsil
was swollen and inflamed, sore on swallowing, feeling of a lump there. Temperature 101°. He recovered
rapidly.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Tobacco smoke. Compare: (1) Bell., Hyos., Dulc., Caps., Sol-t., Sol-n. (2) Ant-
t. - weakness of cervical muscles. (3) In coryza, All-c. but All-c. has better open air, Lycpr. worse open air. (4)
Contracted pupils. Op. (5)Deltoidrheumatism, Sang. (6) Diabetes. Uran-n. (7) Headache, sore throat, right
side. Bell. (8) Headache worse on coughing, worse in open air, Caps.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Lycopodium Clavatum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - lyc. Lycopodium clavatum. Club moss. Muscus terrestris repens. Pes ursinus. Wolfs claw.
 Lycopodii pollen. N. O. Lycopodiacee. Hilly pastures and heaths in Central and Northern Europe. Russian Asia
and North America. Common in Great Britain, especially the North. Its medicinal properties are disclosed by
trituration and succussion of the spores. Tincture of fresh plant. Etherial tincture of spores (ether dissolves the
spore cases). Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Abdomen, weak. Acidity. Albuminuria. Aneurysm. Angina pectoris. Aphasia. Asthma. Axilla,
perspiration. Belching. Biliousness. Borborygmi. Bright's, disease. Bloating. Cachexia. Cancer. Cataract.
Colic. Colitis. Constipation. Coms. Coughs. Cramps. Cystitis. Day-blindness. Debility. Diabetes. Diarrhea.
Diphtheria. Dropsy. Dysentery. Dyslexia. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspepsia. Ear, eczema. Eczema. Emaciation.
Epithelioma. Excoriation. Eye, inflammation. Face, eruptions. Feet, perspiring. Fibroma. Flatulence. Food,
allergies. Gallstones. Glands, swelling. Goiter. Gout. Gravel. Hematuria. Hair, loss. Hands, chapped.
Heartbum. Heart, diseases. Hemorrhoids. Hepatitis. Hernia. Hypochondriasis. Hypoglycemia. Hysteria.
Impotence. Indigestion. Influenza. Intermittents. Intertrigo. Jaundice. Labor-pains, abnormal. Lip, cancer.
Liver, derangement. Liver-spots. Locomotor, ataxia. Lumbago. Lungs disorders. Malnutrition. Menstmation,
disorders. Metrorrhagia. Miscarriages. Nosebleeds. Nymphomania. Otorrhea. Panaritium. Paralysis.
Parkinson's disease. Peritonitis. Phlegmasia, dolens. Plica polonica. Pneumonia. Polyps. Pre-senility.
Proctalgia. Prostatitis. Pylorus, disorders. Quinsy. Kidney colic. Kidney, disorders. Rheumatism. Sciatica.
Skin, cracks. Sleep, abnormal. Speech, disordered. Stage-fright. Strains. Sunstroke. Taste, abnormal. Throat,
sore. Tongue, coated, cramps. Tuberculosis. Typhoid, fever. Urine, abnormal. Varicose, veins. Warts. Water
brash. Whooping cough. Worms. Yawning.
HOMEOPATHIC - The Lycopodiums stand between the mosses and the fems. Fossils show that in past eras
they occupied an important place in the world's vegetation. This remedy is inert until the spores are crushed.
The spores from which the potencies are made have been called “vegetable sulphur” (probably on account of
their use forproducing stage-lightning at theaters).
In the old school the function of Lyc. has dwindled into its use as an “inert” coating for pills and an “inert”
powder dusting on excoriated surfaces. Earlier practitioners did not consider it by any means inert.
Lyc. ranks with Sulph. and Calc, in the central trio around which all the rest of the Materia Medica can be
grouped. Teste puts Lyc. at the head of a group containing Nairn., Viol. trie, and Ant-c.
Lycopodium is adapted more especially to gradually developing ailments, functional power weakening with
failures of the digestive powers, where the function of the liver is seriously disturbed. Deep seated, progressive
chronic diseases. Pre-senility. Cancer. Erectile tumors. Boils, recurring periodically.
Malnutrition, due to weakness of digestion. Affinity for the urinary organs, throat, chest, and ovaries.
Symptoms characteristically run from right to left. It acts especially on right side of body and are worse from
about 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. Descending symptoms.
Primary action on digestive organs and adjoining glands, on liver and larger intestines rather than stomach.
Aversion to bread, worse from eating bread, fermented foods and fermentable dough. Frequent and painful
belchings. Sour belchings, vomiting, distention. Alternate diarrhea and constipation.
Pains come and go suddenly. Oversensitive to pain, patient is beside himself. Sense of internal paralysis. One
side of the body hypertrophied at menopause. Atrophy of infants. The patient is thin, withered and full of gas
and bloating.
Acidity, sour, taste, belchings. Dropsy, ascites in liver diseases. Lithic acid diathesis. Kidney affections, with
red sand in urine. backache in kidney region, worse before
Lycopodium clavatum urination. Stones, gallstones, gravel.
Emaciation and debility from loss of fluids, in morning. Marked regulating influence upon the glandular
(sebaceous) secretions. Hemorrhages, dark blood. Poor circulation, cold limbs. Lacks vital heat, intolerant of
cold drinks, craves everything warm. Sensitive to noise and odors.
MIND - Failing brain-power (Anae., Bar-c., Kali-p.). Weak memory, confused thoughts. Dyslexia. Weakness
of memory for names of letters. Spells or writes wrong words and syllables. Cannot read what he writes.
Brain fag after influenza.
Concentration difficult during conversation. Confusion in warm room, better walking in open air. Confused
thoughts. Confused about common words. Hears wrong words and syllables. Speech indistinct, stammers the
last word. Lack of aptitude for finance and math.
Indecision. Timidity. Loss of self confidence. Loss of confidence in physician and remedies. Poor self-
esteem. Anticipation. Averse to undertaking new things, yet goes through with ease.
Great anxiety, in pit of stomach. Anxiety, as if about to die. Anxiety in house, with company, during stormy
weather, while walking in open air. Conscientious about trifles. Apt to worry about the future. Hurried when
eating.
Panic attacks (Ars., Phos., Kali-ar., Med.). Constant fear of breaking down under stress, fear of failure,
 public speaking, stagefright. Fear of men, strangers, to be alone. Fear of the dark, ghosts. Agoraphobia.
Fear of being unable to reach his destination. Frightened of everything.
Melancholy. Resignation. Sadness in morning. Ill-humor and disposition to weep before menses. Extremely
sensitive. Weeps all day, when thanked or meeting a friend. Sad, or cheerful, on hearing distant music.
Excessively merry and laughs at simplest things, alternating with melancholy and low-spirited.
Awakes, irritable, angry, sad and anxious. Defiant, arbitrary. Headstrong and haughty when sick.
Domineering.
Reproaches others. Love for power. Hateful. Miserly. Easily aroused to anger. Quarrelsome. Fault finding.
Suspicious. Distrustful. Hates being watched when at work.
Misanthropic, flees even from his children. Religious aversion to opposite sex. Aversion to company, yet
dreads solitude. Childish fantasies. Delusions that he has neglected his duty. Delusion of being in two places
at the same time. Delusion hears music in evening that was heard in the day.
Baby cries all day, sleeps all night. Cranky. Kicks, screams and very cross, on awaking from short, restless
naps. Indisposition to play in children. Child desires to be carried. Oversensitive to pain. Feels as if she would
die from weakness, when lying in bed.
Ailments from domineering parents or siblings. Ailments from abuse, mortification, anger or vexation.
Ailments from fright. Looks older than he is.
Abdomen - Bloated abdomen. Tympanitic distension with cold feet. Ascites. Brown spots on abdomen. Food
allergies. Gastroenteritis from fright. Epigastric anxiety, pressure. Sensation as if a band about waist.
Sensation of something moving up and down or as of a hard body rolling, when turning to the right side.
Shooting pain across lower abdomen from right to left. Tension and pain in abdomen from incarcerated flatus.
Hot pains flash across bowels. Bursting pain in abdomen, during stool. Fermentation in intestines like yeast.
Much noisy flatulence, pressing out, worse lower abdomen. Immediately after eating, abdomen is bloated
andfull. Flatulence before and after stool. Colic in babies with gas and bloating, worse evening. Diabetes.
Inactive intestinal tract. Hernia, right side. Colon cancer.
Back - Pain and stiffness in back. Bubbling sensation. Throbbing and pulsating in back. Rising of warmth along
spine. Lumbago, worse slightest motion, worse sitting erect, better urinating. Tensive pain in nape. One side
of the neck stiff and swollen. Emaciation about the neck. Burning, as from hot coals between the scapulae.
Pain in the back and right
side from congestion of liver. Back as if broken during stool. Stitches in small of back. Darting in right cervical
muscles from below upward. Swelling of cervical glands.
Bladder - Involuntary urination. Frequent urging to urinate, after taking cold, better riding in cars. Bearing
down over bladder. Stitches in neck of bladder. Urging to urinate, must wait long before it will pass. Urine
frequent and copious at night, scanty by day. Urine suppressed, retained.
Breasts - Stitches and burning pains in nipples, with discharge of blood and water. Hard burning nodosities in
breasts with stitching, aching pains and soreness. Rawness of nipples, sore, fissured, bleed easily. Delayed
menses with undeveloped breasts at puberty. Milk in breast without being pregnant. Child vomits blood after
sucking bleeding nipples.
Causations - Ill effects of fear, fright, abuse, anger, anxiety, embarrassment. Ailments from sugar, sweets,
tobacco chewing, wine. Ailments from fevers, overlifting, masturbation, riding in a carriage.
Chest - Tensive, constrictive, burning pain in chest. Feeling of tightness in chest with burning. Itching on chest.
Tension as of a hoop on chest. Constriction from right side all around short ribs. Difficult respiration due to
hydrothorax and hydropericardium. Stitches in left side with inflammation of lungs. Dilatation of air tubes.
Tearing and tension under clavicles. Foul, viscid sweat in axilla like onions. Swelling of axillary glands. Axillary
abscess. Hydrothorax. Boils. Brown yellow spots on chest.
Constitutions - Grauvogle's carbo-ni- trogenoid constitutions. Suited to persons of keen intellect, but feebler
muscular development, upper part of body wasted, lower semi-dropsical, lean and predisposed to lung and
hepatic conditions, herpetic and scrofulous constitutions. Weak muscular power, lack vital heat, circulation
poor, it seems to stand still with cold, numb limbs or numbness may appear in spots. Hypochondriacs subject
to skin diseases, lithic acid diathesis, much red sediment in urine, urine itself transparent,
sallow people with cold limbs, haughty disposition, when sick, mistrustful, low of comprehension, weak
memory. Weak children with well-developed heads but puny, sickly bodies, irritable, nervous and
unmanageable when sick after sleep cross, pushing every one away angrily. Old women and children. Persons
of dry temperament and dark complexion. Undernourished states. Old persons or who become old early, where
the skin shows yellowish spots, or to precocious weakly children.
Cough - Cough is deep, hollow. Tickling cough. Dry cough in puny boys with emaciation. Cough, worse eating
and drinking cold things, worse going down hill. Loose cough in daytime and suffocative fits at night. Night
 cough, tickling as from sulphur fumes.
Ears - Sensation as if hot blood rushed into ears. Itching in ear. Polyps. Thick, yellow, offensive discharge with
deafness. Otorrhea and deafness with or without tinnitus. Otorrhea after scarlatina. External meatus excoriated
by offensive discharge. Eczema, humid scurfs about and behind ears.
Eyes - Eyes sunken, blue rings. Eyes feel cold, hot, seem too large. Eyes painful as if bruised, and dazed
by light. Stinging and smarting, worse evening, in light. Photophobia. Sparks before the eyes in the dark.
Dilated pupils before menses. Cataract with suppressed menses. Inflammatory affections of eyes.
Ophthalmia neonatorum during suppurative stage. Lachrymal fistula. Nocturnal agglutination and
lachrymation by day. Ulceration and redness of lids. Smarting and burning of eyelids. Polyps on external
canthi. Recurring styes. Styes on lids near internal canthus. Eyes half open during sleep.
Face - Freckles. Silly expression. Face withered, shriveled and emaciated. Yellowish, pale, gray with blue
circles around the eyes. Grayish-yellow color of face with blue circles around eyes. Flushes of heat. Edema of
face. Itching, scaly eruptions. Herpes on face and corner of mouth. Small, white, pedunculated warts
Lycopodium clavatum on chin. Submaxillary glands swollen. Tearing pain in bones of face. Drawing or
lacerating pain in lower jaw. Dropping of lower jaw, in typhoid fever (Lach., Op.). Twitchings. Twists face
and mouth.
Female - Delayed menses with undeveloped breasts at puberty. Depressed mood and indigestion before
menses. Menses too late, with sadness. Menses protracted, too profuse. Menses partly black, partly bright
red. Menses of clots and serum. Menses suppressed for months, from fright. Chronic suppression of menses
from tuberculosis or cancer. Dysmenorrhea, violent with fainting. Labor-like pains during menses with
fainting. Discharge of blood from genitals during stools. Leucorrhea, acrid, with burning in vagina. Leucorrhea,
periodical, milky, worse before full moon. Pains in right ovary, from right to left. Ovarian tumors. Ovarian
dropsy. Dropsy of uterus. Cramps in uterus after stool. Flatus from vagina. Vaginitis. Serous cysts in vagina.
Vagina, dry, burning, worse during and after sex. Aversion to sex. Sex painful. Nymphomania. Fetus seems
to be turning somersaults. Disposition to miscarriage, moles.
Food - Malnutrition. Excessive hunger, canine hunger. Hurried when eating. Hypoglycemia, headache when
not eating regularly. Loss of appetite. Bulimia, with much bloating. Diabetes. Likes to take drink and food hot.
Desire for sweets, delicacies, pastries, alcohol. Food tastes sour. Food allergies, wheat. Worse from
breads, fermentedfoods and fermentable dough. Aggravated from alcohol, wine. tobacco, flatulent food,
cabbage, beans, oysters and onions. Aversion to sweets, bread, fermented foods, soup, meat, coffee.
Averse to boiled food, warm food, cold drinks or food.
Head-Right-sidedheadaches. Pain begins on one side goes to other where it is worse. Headaches over
eyes in severe colds. Headache with ravenous hunger, better eating. Frontal headache after breakfast.
Headache, worse if not eating regularly, lying down, stooping, better uncovering. Pulsating pain in occiput,
at night, worse
when hot. Pain in temples as if screwed together, worse menses. Catarrhal headache, worse when discharge
from nose is slacked up. Hydrocephalus. Meningitis, tubercular. Incipient paralysis of the brain. Shakes head
without any apparent cause or involuntarily, slow first, then rapid. Deep furrows on forehead. Eczema, moist
oozing behind ears. Dandruff. Hair becomes gray early. Hair loss, premature baldness after abdominal
affections, childbirth.
Hearing - Humming and roaring with hardness of hearing, every noise causes peculiar echo in ear.
Oversensitive hearing, to musical sounds and noise. Ringing, during stool. Singing noises as from boiling
water. Noise is intolerable after distension of abdomen. Impaired of lost hearing, with otorrhea, with or without
tinnitus. Deafness after scarlatina. Tearing pain in right or left meatus.
Heart - Aortic disease. Aneurysm (Bar-c.). Angina pectoris. Hypertrophy. Hydropericardium. Sensations as
if circulation stood still. Pulsating tearing in region of heart. Ebullitions of blood. Accelerated pulse with cold
face and feet. Pulse, fast, worse after eating, evening. Palpitations from overeating. Palpitations on turning
over in bed at night. Cannot lie on left side.
Kidneys - Aching in kidney, worse before and better after urinating. Kidney colic in ureter (right) to bladder.
Renal colic in ureter. Pain in back before urinating, ceases after flow, slow in coming, must strain. Retention.
Hot urine. Heavy red sediment. Disposition to calculi. Hematuria. Urine bloody with paraplegia or sometimes
with constipation. Child cries before urinating (Bor.). Polyuria during the night. Involuntary urination in fever
or from fright during sex.
Limbs - Limbs go to sleep. Numbness, drawing and tearing in limbs. Twitching and jerking. Cannot lie on
painful side. Rheumatism. Stiffness of all joints. Chronic gout with chalky deposits in joints. Pain in bones
at night. Curvature and decay of bones. Sciatica, worse right side. Varicose veins on legs. Cramps in calves
and toes at night in bed. Emaciation of one hand or
 Lycopodium clavatum one leg. Painful callosities on soles, toes and fingers contracted. Pain in heel on
treading as from a pebble. Profuse sweat of the feet. One foot hot, the other cold. Corns. Chilblains. Hands
and feet numb. Heaviness of arms. Tearing in shoulder and elbow joints. Axillary abscess.
Liver - Weak liver and poor digestion. Atrophic, nutmeg liver. Sensitive, congested liver. Sore, pressive,
bruised, in region of liver, on breathing, worse touch. Liver painful to pressure in spots. Liver complaints after
mortification. Chronic hepatitis. Hepatitis with pneumonia. Hepatitis of children. Jaundice with flatulence,
retarded stool, weariness and drowsiness. Violent gallstone colic. Dropsy, due to hepatic disease, after
abuse of alcohol. Ascites from liver diseases.
Lungs - Dull aching all over lungs. Craves air but is chilled by it. Shortness of breath. Difficult breathing due
to hydrothorax. Dyspnea, worse lying on back, during sleep. Short, rattling breathing, worse lying on back.
Neglected or unresolved pneumonia with great dyspnea. Catarrh of the chest in infants, seems full of mucus
rattling. Senile catarrh. Bronchocele on right side. Flying of ala nasi and presence of mucus rales.
Expectorations gray, thick, bloody, purulent, salty. Expectoration greenish-yellow, lumpy orfoul expectoration.
Abscess of the lungs, tuberculosis. Wheezing and asthma.
Male - Cutting pain in glans penis on urinating. Soreness between scrotum and thigh. Discharge of prostatic
fluid without an erection. Chronic orchitis. Enlarged prostate. Tumor behind corona glandis. Condylomata.
Sexual desire too strong. Performance anxiety. Premature seminal emission (Agn., Calad., Sel.).
Exhausting pollutions. Falls asleep during sex. Sexual exhaustion, weakness. Impotence. No erectile power,
penis small, cold, relaxed. Loss of sexual desire after gonorrhea or cystitis.
Modalities - Better by motion, belchings, urinating, after midnight. Better from warm food and drink, on
getting cold, being uncovered, cold applications. Worse
right side, from right to left, from above downward. Worse warm room, hot air, bed, warm applications,
except throat and stomach which are better from warm drinks. Worse from pressure of clothes, eating,
oysters, milk, vegetables, cabbage, beans, bread, pastry. Worse wind, wet, stormy weather, 4 p.m. to 8 p.m.,
awakening. Worse before or from suppressed menses.
Mouth - Mouth hangs open. Sore lips. Bad odor from mouth. Dryness of mouth and tongue without thirst.
Speech indistinct, stammers the last word. Saliva dries on palate and lips. Dropping of lower jaw in typhoid
fever (Lach., Op.). Mouth waters. Gums bleed when touched or cleaning teeth. Taste too acute, sour, bitter,
moldy. Blue lips. Ulcers on lips. Small tumors in mouth in various places.
Nose - Nasal troubles from childhood. Nose stopped up, snuffles, breathes through mouth, child starts from
sleep rubbing the nose. Fan like motion of alae nasi in brain, lung and abdominal troubles. Feeling of
dryness. Sore pimples on tip of nose. Crusts and elastic plugs (Kali-bi.). Ulcerated nostrils. Acrid ozaena.
Violent catarrh, with swelling of nose. Catarrh of nose and frontal sinuses. Discharge yellow and thick. Thick
yellow discharge, copious and fatty. Fluent coryza. Chronic coryza, blows nose often. Scanty excoriating,
discharge. Obstruction of nose during influenza. Sense of smell very acute.
Perspiration - Viscid and offensive perspiration. Cold, sour sweats. Foul sweat, smelling like onions, of
axillary, feet. Sweats from least exertion. Clammy sweats at night with coldness of face. Perspiration on chest
and trunk, face, about scalp and temples.
Rectum - Sharp pains and cramps in rectum. Aching and pressure in rectum, worse at night. Itching and
tension at anus. Chilliness in rectum before stools. Biting and burning pain in rectum during and after stool.
Rawness, great excoriations about anus, bleed easily, itching and moist. Hemorrhoids, aching, painful to
touch (Mur-ac.). Hemorrhoids, painful when
Lycopodium clavatum sitting, better hot bathing. Inactivity of bowels. Ineffectual urging from contraction of
sphincters. Cramps in rectum and small of back, like labor pains. Feeling as if much remained unpassed after
stools. Alternating diarrhea and constipation. Constipation, when away from home or traveling. Constipation
of children, since puberty, since childbirth. Constipation or diarrhea during pregnancy. Diarrhea after
suppression of skin eruptions.
Sensations - As if everything was turning around. As if brain vacillating to and fro. As if temples being screwed
together. As if head would burst. As if head opened. Pain in head as if caused by wrong position. As if
esophagus was being clutched and twisted. As if steam rising from stomach to head. As if something were
moving up and down in stomach. Asif stomach would fall down. As if suspensory ligament of liver would tear.
As if drops of water were falling down. As if heart hung by a thread. Tension as from a cord in diaphragm. As
if chest constricted with tight waistcoat. As if gimlets were running into spine. As if dogs with sharp teeth were
gnawing her.
Skin - Dry skin, shrunken, especially palms. Skin becomes thick and indurated. Dropsy. Rawness in folds.
Ulcerates. Ulcers fistulous. Fissured eruptions. Offensive secretions. Scabs do not separate. Abscesses
beneath skin. Skin hot. burning, itching when warm. Eczema associated with urinary, gastric, hepatic disorders.
 Chronic eczema. Psoriasis. Hives, worse warmth. Acne. Blood boils, remain blue. Varicose veins. Brown spots,
freckles worse on left side of face and nose. Nevi, erectile tumors. Lice, itching violently.
Sleep - Drowsy during day. Irresistible drowsiness after eating. Child sleeps all day and cries all night. Starting
up on falling asleep. Restless sleep. Laughs and weeps in sleep. Soporous sleep in typhoid and
exanthematous fevers. Confused, anxious, vivid dreams. Horrid dreams, of sickness, of fatal accidents.
Frightful dreams frequently awaking him. Wakes at night feeling hungry. On waking, the child starts,
becomes cross kicks, scolds
or holds his mother. Awakes terrified. Unrefreshed in morning.
Stomach - Sensation as if fasting after meals, but without hunger. Pressure in stomach with difficult breathing.
Churning sensation. Coldness in stomach. Wakes at night feeling hungry. Nausea in morning before eating,
with salivation. Hunger, but quick satiety. Eating ever so little creates fullness. Gastralgia and chronic
gastritis. Great weakness of digestion with much bloating. Dyspepsia due to farinaceous and fermentable
food, cabbage, beans, onions. Derangement of stomach from sweets and pastry. Cramps in stomach from
eating fruit. Constrictive pains. Burning pain. Gnawing pain in stomach, better drinking hot water. Stomach
pains better rubbing abdomen. Rumbling of flatulence (Carb-v., Chin.). Hiccoughs. Sour eructations, belchings.
Belchings rise only to pharynx. Vomiting of dark greenish masses, after eating and drinking. Vomits, food
and bile, coagulated blood, dark greenish masses after eating and drinking. Stomach cancer. Perforating ulcer.
Stools - Diarrhea from cold drinks, cold food, beer, milk, fruit, vegetables. Stool hard, difficult, small
incomplete. Stools, first part is hard is difficult to expel, last part is soft or thin and gushing. Stools pale,
putrid, thin, brown. Stools mixed with hard lumps, sand. Stools thin, yellow, or reddish yellow fluid. Stools
shaggy, reddish mucus, green, stringy, odorless mucus. Discharge of blood during stool.
Teeth - Teeth yellow. Front teeth feel loose. Teeth excessively painful to touch. Sensations as if teeth too long.
Grinding of teeth during heavy stupor, as when fully awake. Toothache when chewing. Toothache with
swelling of cheek, better warm application, warm drinks. Toothache at night, keeps her awake at night. Swelling
of gum above front teeth, with swelling of upper lip. Gumboils. Gums and soft palate covered with a lardaceous
coating. Gums bleed when touched or cleaning teeth. Fistula dentalis.
Temperature - Chill between 3 p.m. and 4 p.m., followed by sweat. Icy coldness, feels as if lying on ice. One
chill followed by another (Calc., Sil., Hep.). Body becomes cold during cough. Chill alternating with heat.
Periodic recurrence of chill. Fever, continuous, remittent intermittent. Fever and sweat every afternoon from
4 p.m. to 8 p.m. Old. broken down cases of malaria. Typhoid fever. Febrile attacks during tuberculosis.
Throat - Sore throat, better warm drinks, worse cold drinks, after sleep. Stitching pain in throat. Throat
feels cold. Dryness of throat without thirst. Inflammation of throat with sharp pain on swallowing and coughing,
begins on right side. As if a hard body in esophagus. Sensation as if a ball rose up in throat. Chronic
enlargement of the tonsils. Swelling and suppuration of tonsils. Tonsils covered with lardaceous ulcers.
Ulceration of tonsils, beginning on right side. Ulceration of vocal bands. Diphtheria, deposits spread from
right to left, worse cold drinks. Tubercular laryngitis, especially when ulceration commences. Food and drink
regurgitates through nose.
Tongue - Tongue dry, black, cracked, swollen. stiff and heavy. White coated tongue with a dry line down
center. Dryness of tongue, without thirst. Blisters on tongue. Tongue burning and thick, as after much
smoking. Tongue feels scalded and raw. Vesicles on tip of tongue, ulcers on and under tongue.
Convulsions of tongue. Tongue oscillates to and fro, trembles.
Urine - Urine, scanty, cries before urinating, must strain. Urine, milky, turbid, pale and clear, burning hot. Heavy
red sediment in urine, thick, purulent, nauseating smell. Hematuria from gravel or chronic catarrh.
Vertigo - Vertigo when looking at anything turning. Vertigo in morning on rising. Vertigo reels back and forth.
Vertigo in hot room. Gets hot during vertigo, face reddens, eyes water and become dim.
Vision - Day-blindness (Both.). Black, floating spots before eyes. Hemiopia, sees only one-half of an object.
Must wipe mucus
from eyes in order to see clearly. Letters run together or become indistinct while reading or writing, must vary
distance of page. Impaired vision seems as if one was looking through fine lattice. Flickering and dim vision
after a nap in afternoon. Nightblindness. In artificial light all objects tremble. Sees sparks in the dark.
COMMENTS - Lyc. was praised by Wedel, Lantilius, Gesner and others in cardialgía and flatulent colic of
children and young girls, diseases of children, and nephritic colic and stones. Merat and de Lens spoke of its
internal use in rheumatism, retention of urine, nephritis, epilepsy and pulmonary diseases. Diabetes, arthritis,
hypoglycemia, depression, and dyslexia. Useful for early stage alcoholics.
Teste mentioned that it is recorded that a decoction of the plant caused vomiting. The use of the powder in
intertrigo was not regarded as a physical one but as medicinal. In Poland it was used for powdering the hair in
“plica polonica,” a decoction being used internally and also externally at the same time.
 Apprehensiveness. Anxiety about performance, particularly sexual. Fear of public speaking, failure, success,
new situations, commitments and responsibility. Fear of being alone, of men, of his own shadow. Agoraphobia.
Hypochondriacs. Panic attacks (Ars., Phos., Kali-ar., Med.). Susceptible to causes of fear that make a profound
effect on bodily organs.
Profound sadness and inclination to weep. Poor confidence and low self-esteem. Forgetfulness. Peevish.
Avaricious. Imperiousness. Miserliness. Overly concerned with image. Love of power. Dictatorial tendencies.
Attracted to politics (Ign., Nairn., Calc., Lyc., Nux-v.), for the power and the stature, the ego, the class, society.
Can be domineering, aggressive.
Headaches, worse from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m.. eating, warmth of bed, becoming heated during a walk, heat in
general, mental exertion, better in open air, in cool place, by uncovering. Rush of blood to the head. Falling of
hair with crusty scalp eruption.
Face is pale and yellow, deeply furrowed, looks elongated. Inflammation of eyes and lids. Ophthalmia,
conjunctiva looks like red flesh. Sordes in teeth.
Facial neuralgias. Nodding and side to side movement of the head. Spasmodic movements of facial muscles,
angles of mouth alternately drawn up and relaxed and spasmodic movements of tongue.
The tongue cannot be protruded, rolls from side to side like a pendulum. Cramp in the tongue when speaking,
cutting off the end of every sentence. Rapid, fan-like movement of ale nasi occurring in cerebral, pulmonary
and abdominal complaints, not synchronous with breathing.
Sciatica, cannot bear to lie on painful side it is so sensitive, especially if on right side. Paralysis and paralytic
weakness of limbs, of brain. Heaviness of the arm. Contraction of the tendons, especially hamstrings. Right
foot hot, left foot cold.
Cutting pains shooting from right to left in any part (opposite of Lach.). Burning pains better by heat, burning
like hot coals between scapula. Burning stinging in breasts. Dryness of parts, of mucus membranes, of vagina,
of skin, especially palms. Suppurative conditions, even gangrene.
Characteristic suddenness, sudden flashes of heat, lightning-like pains, sudden satiety. Pains and symptoms
come and go suddenly (Bell.). Sensation as if a hand were in the body clutching the entrails (Bell.). Restless-
ness, better by motion (Rhus-t.).
Keynote worse from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. In one case cured by Lyc. it was “bad from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m.. better at 8
p.m., gone at 9 p.m.” Characteristic right to left movement. Better from uncovering, particularly headaches
(opposite Sil.). Better from loosening garments. Better from warm drinks, worse from cold food and drinks.
Desires fresh air (Puls.).
Excessive sensitiveness, worse touch and pressure. All soft parts are sensitive, gums, epigastrium, abdomen,
right side of chest, eruption around anus. Cannot bear any strong smells. Cannot endure noise. In the evening
she continues to hear the music she has heard during the day.
Deficiency of vital heat. Puerperal fever with sensation as though hot balls dropped from each breast through
to back, rolling down back, along each leg and dropping off heels, this alternates with a sensation as it balls of
ice followed same course. Phlegmasia dolens.
Respiratory disorders. Salt sputa, milky, greenish yellow, thick yellow mucus, pus. Dry burning catarrh of nose,
larynx, throat, chest. “Dry teasing cough in emaciated boys.” Cough provoked by irritation from deep breathing,
stretching out throat and by empty swallowing. Cough worse on waking.
Affects the blood vessels from the heart to the capillaries. Nevus, aneurysm, disordered heart. Varicose veins.
Weak digestive tract. Easy satiety. Sleepy after meals. Diabetes and hypoglycemia. Sinking sensation at
epigastrium, worse in the night, waking up the patient or worse in afternoon. Cord-like tension across
hypochondria. Great sensitiveness in liver region.
Borborygmi under left ribs in front. Sour stomach, sour taste, sour vomiting. Often thirsty, for small amounts,
but drinking cold water causes nausea. Great weakness with the vomiting. Craves sugar and starch (Kali-c,
Chin., Nat-c.). Aggravated by or averse to onions and garlic (Thuj.). Worse from flatulence foods, cabbage,
broccoli, and beans.
Kidney colic with stinging, tearing, digging pain in right ureter to bladder, as if some small calculus was tearing
its way to the bladder. Aching in back, kidneys, before urination, better after urinating. Pale, whitish, cloudy
mucus, urine often fetid.
Child cries before urinating, red sand is found in diaper.
Gas and bloating. Incarcerated flatulence, more in intestines than in stomach, painful with better by belchings.
Flatulence pressing outward, on rectum and bladder, sensation as if something moving up and down in the
bowels.
Pushing out in right inguinal ring. Right inguinal hernia, especially in children. Spasmodic constriction of
rectum. For constipation where purgatives have been abused. Constipation of infants.
 Extreme sadness and irritability before menses, ceasing with the flow. Menses are too early and too profuse.
Ill-humor. Bearing-down pains and headache. Intolerance of tight clothing. Left ovarian pain, dull aching, worse
on raising the limb or turning in bed. Nausea, varicose veins and excessive fetal movements during pregnancy.
Unsatisfactory labor pains.
Impotence, from masturbation, sexual excess, or age. Desire is strong but the power is absent, penis small,
cold, relaxed.
There was an involuntary proving of Lyc. from inhalation of the fumes in the course of a chemical experiment,
Lyc. powder being added to a boiling mass. The writer (apparently a medical man) had at times, while engaged
in the experiments, frightful headaches (occiput, vertex and through right eye).
S. A. Jones called attention to the irritability of Lyc. and noted the cure of a boy with typhoid with excessive
tympanites when the case seemed almost hopeless. The guiding symptoms were “when awake exceedingly
cross, irritable, scolding, screaming, behaving disagreeably,” which was quite different from his usual nature.
Lyc. 30c was given.
The “fan-like movement” of the ale nasi led Halbert to the cure of a case of nervous asthma. Mrs. S., 28, had
periodic attacks of spasmodic asthma, always ushered in by unusual excitement and attended by peculiar
mental depression. The attack for which Halbert saw her was induced by a violent fit of anger and persisted
longer than usual. Extreme despondency and melancholy, would have nothing to do with her friends.
Constriction of throat like globus, but always induced by regurgitation of food. Excessive appetite easily
satisfied. Fullness of abdomen with flatulence. Constipation, dry, hard stools. Dyspnea. Slight cough with chest
constriction, better in open air. All symptoms worse 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. Lyc. 6x cured.
A patient of Clarke's took Lye. 30c and developed a “pain under sternum as if food lodged there and she could
not breathe through it.”
Loosvelt found that “half-open condition of the eyes during sleep” is a strong indication for Lyc. and led him to
make cures in cases of bronchitis, pneumonia and typhoid when other remedies have failed.
Majumdar recorded the case of a boy, 14, who had general dropsy and anasarca consequent on the
subsidence of an enlarged spleen under allopathic medication. There was afternoon fever (worse 4 to 8 p.m.),
slight chilliness, but no thirst, difficult breathing on lying down, urine scanty and high colored, bowels
constipated, heart's action weak but regular.
Apis caused the urine to be more free, but a troublesome diarrhea set in. Apoc. 6x removed the diarrhea, but
had no effect on the dropsy. Lyc. 30c was then given purely on the symptoms and quickly cleared up the case.
H.    Goullon cured a case of cystitis in a man, 55, subject to attacks of enteralgia. He was seized two days
after such an attack with a severe cystitis with fever and palpitation of the heart. The calls to urinate were
increased and he could hardly reach the vessel quick enough to prevent premature escape of the urine, so
severe and sudden was the urging.
During, and sometimes after the passage, there was intense burning pain, “as if molten lead were flowing
through the urethra.” During the height of the pain he grasped his penis to obtain relief.
The urine, which was discharged in very scanty quantities, looked turbid, almost loamy, had a dirty brownish-
red color and a peculiar odor of malt. Lyc. 12c was given, six drops in half a wine glassful of water, a
teaspoonful every three hours. Cured in twenty-four hours.
Drysdale recorded the cure of a young woman whose hands were covered with warts. One 2 grains tablet of
Lyc. 6c trituration was given at bedtime. The warts soon began to shrivel and in less than six weeks were all
gone.
Clarke gave Miss E. Lyc. 30c for constipation. Soon after taking it she had pains in upper abdomen in all
directions, urging to stool without ability to pass it, much flatus which could neither be got up nor down.
Lyc. 1,000c. was now given, afew globules dissolved in water, a teaspoonful at bedtime. All symptoms
vanished. On rising, a second teaspoonful was taken and after this the bowels were well relieved.
On another occasion she took Lyc. 1,000c. in the evening and immediately felt her throat tight and
uncomfortable, but this passed, and she went to bed. At 5 a.m. she woke with choking and had the greatest
difficulty in getting her breath. She managed to reach a bottle of Bell. 3c and a dose of this relieved her at
once.
A patient for whom Lyc. 5c had, to her great delight, reduced the gouty swellings about her finger joints. Now
she could get rings on she had not been able to wear for years, but she was obliged to discontinue it on account
of the distressing headaches it caused.
RELATIONS - Antidotes: Camph., Puls., Caust. Compare: (1) Alum. - Lyc. is the only vegetable that takes
up aluminum (Allen). (2) Ant-c., Nat-m., Bry., Nux-v., (3) Both. - day- blindness, can scarcely see after sunrise,
pain in right great toe. (4) Plumbg. - a Brazilian plant. Costive with red urine, pain in kidneys and joints and
body generally, milky saliva, ulcerated mouth. (5) Kali-c., Nat-c.. Calc-c., China, Sulph. Complementary: Lyc.
 acts with special benefit after calc, and Sulph., lod.. Graph, Lach., Chel., Hydr. follows Lyc. in indigestion.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

 Lycopodii pollen. N. O. Lycopodiacee. Hilly pastures and heaths in Central and Northern Europe. Russian Asia
and North America. Common in Great Britain, especially the North. Its medicinal properties are disclosed by
trituration and succussion of the spores. Tincture of fresh plant. Etherial tincture of spores (ether dissolves the

author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - lycps. Lycopus virginicus. Bugle-weed. Virginia horehound. N. O. Labiate. Shady and wet
places in North America. Tincture of fresh plant in flower. Tincture of the whole plant by macerating one part
by weight of the fresh plant in two parts by weight of alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Aneurysm. Bright's disease. Cough. Diabetes. Exophthalmos, //eruoptysis. Headache. Heart,
diseases. Hemorrhoids. Malaria. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Pericarditis. Reptile, bites. Snakebites. Tarantula
bites. Tuberculosis. Typho-malarial fever.
HOMEOPATHIC - According to Hale, Lycps. is mentioned by Rafinesque as “partaking of the properties of
Digitalis, Sang., Cimic. and Spig.” and as being “one of the mildest and best narcotics in existence.”
Hale commended Lycps. as a substitute for Dig., having the advantage over it of being non-poisonous, as
useful in hemoptysis and “wherever it is required to quell inordinate motions of the blood.”
Briggs of Fort Lovell, related the cure of a patient of tarantula bite by application of a liquid made of Lycps. He
said the Cherokee Indians allow themselves to be bitten by rattlesnakes, centipedes and tarantula, chewing
as an antidote large quantities of lycopus and swallowing the juice.
H. W. Felter, an eclectic, is quoted as commending Lycps. in passive lung hemorrhage, wild, tumultuous
beating of heart, which often precedes the lung hemorrhage, cough of tuberculosis. Lycps. does not disorder
the stomach, he says, but acts a tonic and appetizer.
Morrisson made an extensive proving of Lycps. and developed unmistakable heart symptoms. Lowers the
blood pressure, reduces the rate of the heart and increases the length of systole to a great degree (Adren.).
Diseases with tumultuous action of the heart and more or less pain. Feeble heart, with distress and weak
pulse.
Cardiac irritability with depressed force, with or without organic disease. Hemoptysis due to valvular heart
disease. Passive hemorrhages.
Pulmonary complaints associated with loose stools. Hemorrhoidal bleeding. Characteristic cough with
hemoptysis associated with feeble heart action. Violent cough at night. Lying down causes cardiac depression
and lying on right side aggravates constriction of thorax.
Pains shift generally right to left. Exophthalmic goiter. Beneficial in toxic goiter used in the pre-operative stage.
History of suppressed discharges.
MIND - Increased mental and physical activity in evening. Nervous, hurried and tremulous. General
wakefulness and morbid vigilance. Instability. Irritability, unless spoken to very softly.
Mind wanders from one thing to another. Slow comprehension. Slight dullness of intellect with headache.
Stupefaction, as if intoxicated, during menses.
Abdomen - Tugging pain in spleen. Tenderness in left hypochondrium. Aching in inguinal canal, bearing down
as from hernia. Flatulence and rumbling. Severe colic followed by profuse, forcible diarrhea.
Back - Severe aching down spine. Acute pain at seventh cervical vertebra. Slight rheumatoid pain in left supra-
scapular muscles.
Bladder - Tenderness in bladder. Bladder feels distended when empty.
Causations - Suppressed hemorrhoidal flow.
Chest - Constriction across lower half of thorax. Pulmonary disease associated with looseness of bowels.
Ears - Burning in right ear.
Eyes - Protrusion, pressing outward, with tumultuous action of heart. Eyes feel weak, as if fatigued. Neuralgic
pain in right supra orbital region. Supra-orbital pain with aching in testicles.
Female - Menorrhagia and metrorrhagia. Menses intermit for ten or twelve days. Vagina very hot, os uterus
engorged and swollen. Puffing of parts on and around
pubes and vulva, dilated condition of vagina.
Head - Frontal headache, worse frontal eminences, often succeeded by labored heart. Pressure in forehead,
worse left portion. Noise and throbbing in head preventing sleep after suppressed hemorrhoids.
Heart - Precordial pain, constriction, tenderness. Rheumatoid, flying pains, associated with heart disease.
Cyanosis. Heart's action is tumultuous and forcible. Pulse, weak, irregular intermittent, tremulous, rapid.
Palpitation from nervous irritation with oppression around heart. Cardiac asthma (Sumb.). Rapid heart action
of smokers.
Kidneys - Profuse flow of liquid, watery urine, especially when the heart is most irritable, also scanty urine.
Urine is scanty, thick, muddy. Diabetes mellitus, great thirst and emaciation.
 Limbs - Muscular rheumatoid pains. Rheumatoid pains in forearm and wrists with trembling of hands. Hands
unsteady, writing difficult. Rheumatoid pains in knees, legs, thighs, wandering to back. Slight lameness,
unsteady gait.
Lungs - Asthma. Wheezing. Breathing oppressed. Cough with hemoptysis. Needing small but frequent.
Cough and irritation of lungs with irregular action of heart.
Male - Pain in testicles. Neuralgic pain in testicle with supra-orbital pain.
Modalities - Worse motion, exercise, walking, ascending. Worse at sunset, evening, morning, with aching
down spine, better after rising.
Mouth - Toothache in lower molars.
Nose - Nosebleed. Sneezing and slight nasal catarrh.
Rectum - Constipation. Diarrhea in jaundice from weakened heart. Diarrhea with griping and rumbling.
Bleeding from rectum. Hemorrhoids.
Skin - Prickings as if bitten by insects. Troublesome urticaria on left forearm and right leg, before retiring.
Sleep - Wakeful on retiring, though fatigued. Sleep restless, full of troublesome dreams.
Stomach - Circumscribed pain and compression in region of stomach. Indigestion with pain and distress in
gastric region. Gastritis, enteritis. Nausea with faintness. Diarrhea, dysentery.
Throat - Rawness at back of right palate, extending to left. Burning in spot on soft palate, following headache.
Vertigo - Vertigo, tends to stagger to right.
COMMENTS - The association of Lycps. with Dig., Cimic. and Spig. particularly shows a very clear insight into
the action of the remedy, which an experience of Clarke's seems to confirm.
Miss S., 25, came to him in October, 1899. About three years ago she had the first symptoms of exophthalmos,
which was ascribed by her mother to a prescription of Macrin. in low potency, taken for pains in the eyes and
continued for a long period.
The first symptoms were sore throat with ulcerations, then the goiter appeared and the heart became painful,
its action intermittent with breathlessness and inability to take exertion.
After a course of Thyr. and later of Thuj. 30c (she had been vaccinated), Lycps. 12c was given and this took
away all the heart pains. Attacks of influenza complicated the case and other remedies had to be given. The
patient then did well under Spig. 30c, as far as the heart is concerned, though no impression was made on the
goiter, which was small. The heart sounds were normal.
Characteristic shifting symptoms. Pains shift from heart to eyes, from head to heart, from heart to left wrist and
right calf, and back to wrist and heart. Proell noted two of his cases in which there was a shift from rectum to
heart and head.
Proell's two cases concerned suppression of hemorrhoidal flux. The patients were each 60 years of age, a
man and a woman, both fair with light eyes, tall, very irritable with weak innervation of the heart without decided
organic disease.
Both had, years before, hemorrhoidal flux which stopped suddenly. Both were hypochondriacal and had noise
in their left ear.
This last symptom was the chief thing the man complained of, along with throbbing in the head preventing
sleep.
Neither Cact., Kalm., nor Gels, helped radically. The night after taking Lycps. lx, the man was a little better and
in the forenoon bled from the rectum (about three table spoonfuls after defecation) with great general relief.
The woman had glycosuria, cataract of left eye and every third night was restless. Lycps. lx, one drop in the
evening. The following night she was excellent, and in the morning came an abundant bleeding from the rectum
with great relief.
Morrison noted a case cured with Lycps. in which the sufferings were associated with the menstrual period,
which was exactly regular but intermittent in flow. The first symptoms appeared within three or four hours of
the onset of the flow and was a deep-seated pain with heat in occiput. Then followed a train of symptoms,
among them nausea, and when the nausea came on the occipital pain was better.
Stanley Wilde cured a desperate case of pericarditis associated with bronchitis with Lycps. tincture, as well as
a case of palpitation with darting pain in the heart in a young woman, following an attack of acute rheumatism
two years before.
RELATIONS - Antidote to: Cimic. Compare: (1) Lam. - hemorrhoids, Oci. (2) Iber., Kalm., Spig., Crat., Cact.,
Dig., Hydr-ac., Laur., Prun., Spig. (heart). (3) Sang. (4) EphedraTeamster's Tea - in exophthalmic goiter, eyes
feel pushed out with tumultuous action of heart. (5) Fuc., Spartein, Crat., Adren.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

author: Murphy
full:

thrice daily in two cases of oxaluria. One case was in a young man, recent, and one in an old man, long
standing. In the second case, the distressing lumbar pain was removed by a few doses though it had persisted
for a number of days.
