name: Lyssinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-lyss. Lyssinum. Rabies nosode. Lyssin. Hydrophobinum. Trituration of sugar of milk saturated
with the saliva of a rabid dog. Triturations might also be made of the cultured microorganisms. Historical
dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Anxiety. Bubo. Clairvoyance. Convulsions. Corns, painful. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Esophagus,
stricture. Fever. Hair, oily. Headaches. Hydrophobia. Hypersensitiveness. Hysteria. Insanity. Leucorrhea.
Lys- sophobia. Mania. Nervousness. Neuralgias. Paralysis. Pregnancy, convulsions. Rabies. Respiratory,
paralysis. Salivation. Sciatica. Sunstroke. Tetanus. Toothache. Ulcers. Uterus, prolapse. Vaginismus.
Wounds.
HOMEOPATHIC - Hering, in 1833, was the first to prove and to suggest the employment of this nosode in
medicine. Later, it became notorious from the experiments of Pasteur. The pathogenesis of Lyss, is made up
partly of symptoms observed in rabid animals and human patients, but chiefly of symptoms developed in the
provings.
The remedy has been extensively used in practice, not only in cases of hydrophobia, but in many disorders in
which the keynote symptoms have been present. The effects of bites of non-rabid dogs have been removed
by this nosode.
Dysentery with pain and tenesmus on hearing water running from a tap. Copious viscid saliva. Thirst with
inability to swallow. Suffocating feelings. Sighing and sighing respiration.
Trembling or quivering sensation throughout the whole body.
Sensitiveness to breath of air, to bright objects, especially the surface of water, to sounds, and, most of all, to
the sound of running water. Convulsions brought on by dazzling light or sight of running water. Thought
of light or water is enough to bring on an aggravation or a convulsion.
Aching in bones. Bluish discoloration of wounds. Complaints from abnormal sexual desire. Senses become
over-acute. Noticeable rapid speech and impatience. Irritable, violent temper. Cannot bear the heat of the sun.
Symptoms are better from sweating.
A number of cures of hydrophobia have been reported from forced perspirations, especially from prolonged
and repeated use of the Turkish bath. This is known as the Buisson treatment from Dr. Buisson who originated
it.
MIND - Hyperactivity of the mind. Hypersensitiveness of all senses. Heightened awareness. Empathetic to
others pain. Clairvoyance. Emotions and bad news aggravate. History of physical or sexual abuse. Feelings
of isolation and of being ridiculed or tormented.
Anxiety, restlessness, with great prostration. Rapid speech. Roams about. Anxiety from hearing church
bells. Indecision even in small matters. Thoughts of something terrible going to happen come into his mind
against his will. Fear something bad will happen. Feels he cannot physically endure his fears much longer.
Lyssophobia, fear of insanity. Fear of driving, airplanes, injury, suffocation, choking, being bitten by dogs. Fear
of being alone. Claustrophobia. Agoraphobia. Hydrophobia. Fear of mirrors in room. Fear during pregnancy.
Strange notions and apprehensions during pregnancy.
Worse thinking of water, fluids, brings on convulsions. Irritability on hearing or seeing water. The sight
of water is intolerable. Wants water but can't drink it. Worse shining objects, mirrors. Copper metal, if in
his room, makes him restless and full of pains. Never well since having a dog bite.
Weary and incapable of mental exertion. Dullness and stupidity, at night restlessness. Depressed, as if
something would happen. Felt as if she was going to die, as if she was going to sink away. Loss of
consciousness.
Ill-humor. Irritable and critical. Impatient. Violent temper, impelled to do reckless things. Rude, abusive, bites
 and strikes, bites or stabs himself. Growls. Cursing. Insane ideas enter his head. Thinks he is insulted, has
suffered a wrong, that he is tormented. Anger followed by remorse.
Compulsive disorders. Ritualistic behavior. Excitement from hearing conversation. Can't bear to hear others
sing, or eat apples. Does not hear or see persons around him. Doesn't answer questions. Clairvoyance.
Abdomen - Distension of abdomen, every evening. Rigidity of muscles of abdomen. Swelling of inguinal
glands. Soreness in whole of lower abdomen. Pressing pain in right side, near last ribs with breathing in
hypochondria after quick walking. Throbbing pains. Tearing pain from left hypochondriac region to right.
Shooting pains in right side of abdomen. Drawing pain below navel. Colicky pain in abdomen.
Back - Great weakness in back, as if it would split andfall apart. Back extremely sore, as if beaten. Severe
backache with numbness of hands. Shooting pains through small of back. Weakness in back, during
copious menses. Considerable pain in lower part of back with soreness felt through to pubic region. Stiffness
in joints of back. Hyperesthesia of skin along vertebral column. Pressing in neck and up back of head.
Backaches with headaches. Pain in neck better bending head backwards. Stiff neck with shooting pains.
Muscles of neck contract spasmodically. Sternocleidomastoid muscle on each side stands out like a thick cord.
Breasts - Both breasts swollen when waking in morning.
Causations - Ill effects of dog bites, rabies vaccinations.
Chest - Burning, surging through chest. Burning, stinging in left side of chest, with palpitations. Chest and
abdomen feel expanded. Chest as if beaten, in evening. Rheumatic pains across chest when drawing in a
breath. Weakness of chest. Lump in right axilla.
Ears - Ears feel stiff. Itching of ear. Itching in a small spot in upper part of both ears, better scratching. Sharp
pains passing into in ears. Buzzing in right ear. Conversation in vicinity of patient may throw him into a most
violent agitation. Hearing water poured out in next room makes him very irritable and nervous. Clairaudient.
Eyes - Eyes are wild, rolling, staring and livid. Dilatation of pupils. Eyes bloodshot. Eyes congested and painful.
Itching heat in eyes. Burning of eyeballs. Stinging pain in left eye. Great weakness in eyes, without pain.
Sensitive to light. Eyelids feel paralyzed on awaking. Pain in small in spot over right eye brow, worse writing.
Face - Face pale and yellowish. Bluish pimples on face. Heat and redness of face. Face sweats with sensation
of heat with flushes. Countenance changes its aspect frequently. Quivering in face. Facial muscles become
contorted. Spasms with froth before mouth. Gnawing and crawling sensation in zygoma. Lower jaw stiff and
painful with inclination to yawn. Jawbones feel stiff, sore, aching in lower jaw.
Female - Menses frequent, protracted, dark, and at times fetid. Menses with hemorrhoids, pulsations in anus
and weakness of back. Menses with prolapsed uterus. Severe leucorrhea with pains in back and lower part
of bowels, sore vagina. Slimy leucorrhea, profuse, running down the legs. White discharge like leucorrhea,
weakening. Uterine sensitiveness, conscious of womb (Helon.). Uterus prolapsed. Uterine displacements.
Any change of position that would tilt or rotate os uterus would cause much pain. Sharp pain in uterus, shooting
down to labia. Pain in left ovarian region. Vagina sensitive, rendering sex painful (Berb.). Since childbirth,
more pain with sex and a dislike to it.
Food - Voracious appetite, swallowed wheat without chewing. Inability to take solid food or it is consumed with
greatest difficulty. Excessive desire for salt. Craves chocolate. Strange notions, desires or cravings during
pregnancy. Wants water but can't drink it, aversion to water. Warm drinks, such as milk, soups and wine,
are more easily taken than water. Aversion to apples, fat food. Worse after mutton. Excessive sensibility to
smell of tobacco.
Head - Headache from bite of dog, whether rabid or not, worse by noise of running water, bright light. Chronic
headaches from mental emotion or exertion. Sharp pain above eyebrows. Boring pain in forehead. Maddening
outward pressing pain in forehead, sensation as if head would burst. Severe pressing in left side of
head. Headaches with general weariness. Headaches with salivation. Headaches alternating with hot flushes
in face. Rush of blood to head, while lying down. Throws the head back when sneezing. Very sensitive scalp.
Dry hair becomes oily.
Heart - Heat and burning in heart. Violent pain in heart, as if it would burst or had needles running into it.
Sharp pains in heart while walking. Dull pain in heart all day. Heart pains with sighing. Feels beating of
pulse through whole body. Heart palpitated violently and felt as if it was coming up into throat. Palpitations
causes anxiety.
Kidneys - Dull pressure in region of left kidney. Flying pains in urinary organs, causes difficulty and heat in
urination. Desire to urinate on seeing running water, cannot urinate unless he hears water run. Urine too
scanty and high-colored. Urine dark, brownish, with whitish sediment. Profuse watery urine, in evening.
Limbs - All muscles feel bruised in morning. Drawing in back and limbs. Severe twitching in arms and legs,
resembling chorea. Weight and heaviness of legs and shoulders. Weakness in arms. Cramp in arms. Left hip
aches in bone. Along left sciatic nerve a dull pain. Weakness in legs
 when going up stairs.
Lungs - Spasmodic contraction of respiratory muscles. Difficult breathing and spasmodic sensation in
trachea. Dyspnea with flatulency, cough and rattling in chest. Breathing held for a time. Oppression in
breathing. Breathing, gasping, irregular and quite rapid. Barking cough with gagging. Sighing, groaning respira-
tion from cardiac pain. Frequent sighing and sobbing. Voice altered in its tone.
Male - Burning and itching on corona glandis. Strong erections, without sexual excitement or thoughts.
Complaints from abnormal sexual desire. Painful erection of penis and frequent seminal emissions. Semen is
discharged too late or not at all during sex. Pain in testicles after sex. Atrophy of testicles. Scrotum tightly
drawn up. Hydrocele. Discharge of prostatic fluid, smelling salty and musty.
Modalities - Better gentle rubbing, bending backwards, steam or hot water bathing. Worse glistening
objects, dazzling or reflected light, mirrors. Worse from sight or sound of running water, thinking of
fluids, pouring water. Worse from heat of sun, wind, drafts. Worse stooping, riding in a carriage, mental
exertion, bed news.
Mouth - Bitter taste in morning on awaking. Sore mouth, feels as if there were lumps in it. Feeling of coldness
in mouth like essence of peppermint. Saliva tough, ropy, viscid, frothy. Constant spitting. Froths at mouth.
Speech impeded from spasms of throat. Feeling of general malaise.
Nose - Nose stiff. Nose feels bruised. Itching in nose all day. Sneezing from tickling in nasal cavity. Frequent
sneezing, as if a coryza would begin and from every little dust. Coryza with tickling in roof of mouth. Fluid nasal
discharge. Great sensibility to smell of tobacco. Strong odors may start spasms.
Rectum - Darting pain into anus causes contraction. Difficult passage of flatus as if anus resisted expulsion.
Desire for stool on hearing or seeing running water. Tenesmus during and after stool. Straining to evacuate,
causes violent pain in small of back and in rectum. Constipation, stools
Lyssinum very dark. Difficult stool, hemorrhoids protrude. Passage of bright red blood, with terrible burning
and pricking in anus. Passes blood from anus during menses. Diarrhea worse hearing running water.
Profuse, watery stools with pain in bowels, worse evening.
Skin - Biting, itching in various parts of body, worse by scratching. Itching as soon as beginning to get warm
in bed. Malignant ulcersfrom bite of a dog. Bluish discoloration of bitten place (Lach.). Dark, livid-marks
where inoculations were made. Pustules. Cancerous sores.
Sleep - Inclination to yawn and stretch, with stiffness of lower jaw. Yawns frequently without sleepiness,
especially when listening to others. Insomnia, sleepless in spite of narcotics. Sleeplessness from excitement
or despair. Starting in sleep. Dreams of dogs, of high places, of insane asylums, churches. On waking, is
morose and inclined to be angry.
Stomach - Aching pain with coldness in stomach. Hiccough. Gagging when he forcibly attempts to swallow
water. Nausea with giddiness, headache and pale face after diarrhea. Nausea and vomiting, after diarrhea.
Nausea and vomiting of a foamy, mucus, dark-colored substance resembling coffee grounds. Vomiting of food
or fluid while drinking. Vomiting at night in sleep.
Stool - Tenesmus during and after stool. Dysenteric stools with tenesmus, renewed as soon as he hears or
sees water run. Diarrhea with much pain, followed by nausea as if she would have to vomit. Stools of bloody
mucus. Involuntary stools.
Teeth - Grinding of teeth. Teeth as if on edge. Painful sensation of coldness shooting into teeth. Frequent
shooting pains in teeth. Toothache during pregnancy. Drawing pains in gums. Aching in swollen gums.
Temperature - Paroxysms of intense coldness, with pain in spine. Chilly feeling. Chills mixed and followed by
heat and cold sweat. Cannot bear heat of sun. Intermittent fever. Fever every evening commencing at dusk
and lasting until bedtime. Fever during headache.
Throat - Sore pain, constant desire to swallow. Difficult swallowing, gagging when swallowing water from
spasms. Burning and stinging pain when swallowing water. Slight redness of palate and throat with spasm of
esophagus and difficult speech. Sensation as if uvula were too long. Cooling sensation in esophagus. Voice
altered in tone tones much suppressed. Hoarse, rough, harsh and weak voice.
Tongue - Tongue large, pale and flabby. Tongue coated with foam, with thin layer of yellowish white fur, in
center. Tongue dark red on sides. Pricking sensation under tongue. Cool feeling on tongue like after
peppermint. Pain or tickling in root of tongue. Root of tongue as if swollen.
Vertigo - Vertigo as if something was drawing around in a circle. Vertigo as if she could not hold her head
straight. Vertigo with inclination to fall to right when stooping. Vertigo with dim sight while walking and sitting.
Vertigo with chill and intolerable snappish headache. Vertigo with nausea, cramps in abdomen. Violent vertigo
during morning. Vertigo temporarily better by return of diarrhea.
Vision - Sees sparks. Something moves to and fro before eyes while sewing. Vanishing of sight. Impaired
vision with dilatation of pupils. Couldn't read longer than a few minutes at a time, when she would see letters
 double.
COMMENTS - Lyss, is a close analog of many of the animal poisons, especially Lach. Rabies (Bell., Stram.,
Canth.). It has been used as a prophylactic to prevent the development of rabies. Also, for the side effects of
rabies shots.
For the effects of bites from non-rabid dogs, especially headaches. Bluish discoloration of wounds (Lach).
Hydrophobia. Gagging, panic attacks at the sound or thought of water. Aggravated by shiny objects.
Photophobia. Mania, delusions, hallucinations.
Hyperesthesia. Violent agitation and severe convulsions from air currents, approaching people, slightest touch,
over hearing conversation. Convulsions from the thought of fluids, drinking, swallowing.
Convulsions from dazzling or reflected light from water or mirror (Stram.). Cannot bear heat of sun (Gels.,
Glon., Lach., Nat.).
Profuse salivation. Saliva tough, ropy, viscid, frothy in mouth and throat, with constant spitting (Hydr.). Sore
throat, constant desire to swallow (Lac-c., Mer.). Difficulty in swallowing. Spasm of esophagus from swallowing
liquids, gagging when swallowing water. Constant desire to urinate on seeing running water (Canth., Sulph.).
Urine scanty, cloudy, contains sugar.
Prolapsed uterus, many cases of years standing have been ctired. Leucorrhea, profuse, running down the legs
(Alum., Syph., Tub.). Sensitiveness of vagina, rendering coition painful. Complaints resulting from abnormal
sexual desire (from abstinence, Con.). Mental emotion or mortifying news always makes him worse (Gels).
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Canth., Bell., Hyos. Stram., Lach., Nat-m. (2) Xanth. - said to be specific for
hydrophobia and is recommended for chronic cystitis in women.
REFERENCES - Allen. Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Macrotinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - macrin. Macrotinum. Black cohosh resin. Macrotyn. Resinoid of Cimi- cifuga racemosa. N.O.
Ranunculaceae. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Backache. Dysmenorrhea. Eye, disorders. Fears. Headaches. Irritable. Lumbago. Melancholy.
Menses, disorders. Muscle, pain. Muscle, weakness. Neuralgic, pains. Rheumatism. Uterine, disorders.
HOMEOPATHIC - Muscular system exhausted after the least exertion. Muscular weakness. Excessive
restlessness, better by moving about in spite of the weakness. Melancholic and irritable. Dullness of intellect.
Symptoms generally improved by onset of menses. Symptoms of the mind, eyes and breasts are worse before
menses and better as soon as flow sets in (Cimic., mental symptoms worse during menses). Backache, better
after menses.
MIND - Great restlessness. Fear of impending danger or having an incurable disease. Melancholic, irritable,
better when menses come on. Dullness of mind. Sits for a long time thoughtless, moving hands and feet,
frequent sighing.
COMMENTS - C. A. Howell noted the case of a woman, 63, who after an interval of eleven year began again
to menstruate at 60, slightly but regularly.
Symptoms appeared suddenly at the time the flow was due, but failed to come on, including intense pain at
the occiput, worse at every throb of heart. Retraction of head and neck. Neuralgic pains in limbs. Pulse 96.
temperature 99.
Howell gave her Macrin. 2x, every two hours. The pain was relieved in a few hours and the menses came on.
REFERENCES-Clarke.

name: Magnesia Carbonica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - mag-c. Magnesia carbónica. Magnesiumcarbonate. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration
and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Acidity. Alcoholism. Antrum, disorders. Ascarides. Belching. Boils. Cataract. Catarrh.
Constipation. Colic. Coma. Cornea, opacities. Cough. Deafness. Debility. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Emaciation.
Epilepsy. Eyes, inflammation. Heartburn. Hernia. Hysteria. Indigestion. Insomnia. Leucorrhea. Malnutrition.
Marasmus. Menopausal, disorders. Menorrhagia. Menstruation, delayed. Metrorrhagia. Nausea.
Nervousness. Neuralgia. Neurasthenia. Pregnancy, disorders. Prostration. Regurgitation. Spasms. Spleen,
pain. Stomach, disorders. Taste, disordered. Tinnitus. Toothache. Tumors. Unconsciousness. Uterine,
disorders. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Nervous irritations and sleeplessness (Gels., Cham., Ars.), nerve exhaustion. Nervous
systems that demand a permanently soothing and sustaining influence. Nerve prostration.
 Numbness and distention in various parts. Intense neuralgic pains. Spasms. Epileptic attacks, while walking
or standing he frequently falls down suddenly with consciousness. Sensitive to least touch, noise or start.
Effects of shock, blows, mental distress. Ailments from excess of care and worry with constipation and
heaviness. Broken- down, “worn-out” women with uterine and menopausal disorders.
Dryness of mucus membranes, skin. Tendency to boils, especially in children. Enlarged glands. Affections of
the antrum of Highmore.
Malnutrition. Emaciation. Marasmus, children do not thrive in spite of feeding and medicines. Sour smell
from the body (Rob.), especially in children, with vomiting, regurgitation, stools etc. Catarrhal condition of
stomach and bowels with marked acidity. Tendency to constipation after nervous strain.
Walking fatigues, causes involuntary urination, prickings in rectum, smarting leu- corrhea. Symptoms worse
from cold winds or weather. Cannot bear hands covered, yet chilled by uncovering.
MIND - Mental exhaustion. Worse from mental exertion. Brain fag. Concentration difficult while writing. Absent-
mindedness. Industrious, mania for work. Indolence, aversion to work.
Confusion of mind, as if intoxicated. Dazed feeling, packs and unpacks her clothes without consciousness of
having done so. Automatic behavior. Aphasia. Slow learning to talk.
Trembling, anguish and fear as if some accident would happen, all day, better when going to bed. Anxious
with perspiration all day. Anxiety on waking from frightful dreams. Anxiety about the future. Anticipation.
Restlessness, nervousness in children.
Insecurity and fear with trembling and heat. Frightened easily. Fear of death, of misfortune, of robbers, of evil.
Fear something bad will happen. Hypochondriasis. Least touch causes starting.
Moods changeable, variable. Capriciousness with toothaches. Sad mood with indisposition to talk. Morose,
sulky, cross. Fretful, peevish. Ill-humor, in evening. Irritability during toothache. Censorious, critical. Abusive,
insulting. Angry, violent. Discontented, disgust with everything.
Sensitive, oversensitive, mentally and physically. Startled, as from a fright. Shrieking, screaming, shouting in
children, worse when touched (Cham.). Cannot bear to be looked at. Hysteria. Weeping, tearful mood during
pregnancy.
Despair with the pains. Despair of recovery. Moaning, groaning during sleep. Forsaken feeling. Feels unloved.
Homesickness, nostalgia. Desire to travel Alcoholism, dipsomania. Loquacity during drunkenness.
Unconsciousness, coma.
Abdomen - Great heaviness in bloated abdomen. Rumbling, gurgling. Dragging pain towards pelvis. Much
flatus in bowels, with diarrhea. Cutting about navel better
Magnesia carbónica passing flatus. Very heavy, contractive, pinching pain in right iliac region. Colic better
bending double. Cutting, gripping, pressing colic, followed by thin green stools, which aggravates. Colic
followed by leucorrhea.
Back - Pain in back and small of back at night, as if broken. Violent bruised pain in back at night. Stiffness in
neck. Tearing and pullings in nape of neck. Pain as if dislocated on raising arm. Shootings pain in loins. Sudden
piercing in coccyx. Contusive pains in sacrum and back, at night.
Causations - Ailments from injuries, accidents. Ailments from emotional excitement, mental distress. Ailments
from anger, fit of passion, vexation, fright or fear. Ailments from grief, sorrow, worry, care. Ailments from
pregnancy. Ailments from dentition, cutting wisdom teeth. Poor nutrition, milk.
Chest - Oppression of chest, with sensation of constrictions. Constrictive pains in chest with dyspnea. Shooting
pains in chest. Soreness in chest during motion.
Constitutions - Suited to ailing, worn out, nervous, flatulent and flabby persons, especially women, children,
nurslings. Persons of lax tissue and sour smell. Hering noted it for “persons, especially children or irritable
disposition, nervous temperament, lax tissue, sour smell.” Cooper indicated it for “worn-out women and dark-
haired, sensitive people, spare and thin.”
Ears - Inflammation of the ears with external redness and sensation of great soreness. Numbness of outer
ear. Feeling of distention of middle ear. Subdued tinnitus. Whizzing, buzzing, fluttering in right ear. Diminished
hearing. Deafness, comes suddenly and varies, on taking cold, cutting wisdom tooth.
Eyes - Inflammation of eyes with redness, shooting pain. Sensation of burning and confused sight. Eyeballs
sensitive to pressure. Eyeballs feel enlarged. Opacity of cornea. Cataract, lenticular. Dryness of eyes. Profuse
lachrymation. Lids agglutinated in morning. Black motes before
the eyes. Dimness of sight.
Face - Waxy pallor. Slovenly expression. Tension, as of white of an egg, dried on it. Tearing, digging, boring
pain on one side, must move about. Swelling of malar bone with pulsating pain, worse exposure to cold wind,
during rest and at night.
Female - Coryza and nasal stoppage before menses. Sore throat before menses appear. Menses preceded
 by labor-like pains. Menses like thick dark molasses, tarry, viscid. Menses too late and scanty, with dragging
pains. Menses flow only in sleep, more profuse at night (Am-m.). Falls down in a faint at each menses. Mucus
leucorrhea, white acrid, preceded by colic, regularly after the menses. Smarting pain when walking or sitting,
with leucorrhea.
Food - Nibbling appetite. Aversion to vegetables, green food, green fruit. Craving for meat, fruits, acids,
vegetables, bread and butter. Milk is refused, passes undigested in nursing children. Worse from milk. Worse
starchy food, potatoes, cabbages. Violent thirst for water, at night.
Head - Dullness of head from mental exertion. Brain heavy. Pulsation in forehead. Pressure, pain in forehead.
Pain above margin of right orbit. Pain in the head, as if the hair were pulled, worse stooping. Sinking of occipital
bone in marasmic children. Rush of blood to head when smoking. Hair falls out. Scalp is scaly, itching in wet
weather.
Heart - Sharp pain from within outward in precordial region.
Kidneys - Involuntary urination while walking or rising from a seat. Frequent emission of urine, even at night.
Sensation of burning and excoriation when urinating. Bladder and rectum become irritable. Urine, increased,
pale, watery, or green. White sediment in urine.
Limbs - Heavy, tired and painful legs and feet. Swelling in bend of knee. Cannot put left foot on ground when
walking. Tearing in shoulders as if dislocated. Right shoulder painful, cannot raise it (Sang.). Cannot bear
hands covered, yet chilled by uncovering.
Liver - Hardness and sharp pains in liver region.
Lungs - Craves open air. Tickling cough with salty, bloody expectoration. Cough from tickling in the larynx,
worse in evening till after midnight. Cramp-like cough at night. Expectoration of tubercles as big as a pea, very
offensive in smell. Expectoration of blood.
Male - Inguinal and scrotal hernia. Discharge of prostatic fluid when passing flatus. Diminished sexual desire.
Absence of erections. Frequent pollutions.
Modalities - Better motion. Better walking in open air. Better warm air. Cold water improves toothache for
a short time, then aggravates. Worse rest, warmth of bed, uncovering. Worse every second day, every third
week. Worse cold, wind. Worse change of weather. Worse drafts, night. Draft aggravates facial neuralgia.
Pains are worse by rest insupportable, must get up and walk about.
Mouth - Bitter, sour taste. Dry, at night. Sticking pain in throat, hawking up fetid, pea-colored particles.
Vesicular eruption, bloody saliva. Frequent, sudden stammering speech. Teeth feel too long. Toothache,
especially during pregnancy, worse at night, cold and quiet, better cold drinks. Ailments from cutting wisdom
teeth (Cheir.).
Nose - Vesicular eruption in nose with pressive pain. Chronic affections of nose. Dry coryza, breathes through
mouth. Coryza and nasal stoppage, before menses. Nosebleed in morning.
Perspiration - Sour, greasy perspiration, difficult to wash off. Sweat stains yellow. Sweats with thirst after 12
p.m. until morning.
Rectum - Constipation after mental shock or nervous strain. Frequent ineffectual urging, with small stools or
only flatus. Piercing pain in rectum, as from needles. Sharp pain in anus and rectum, with difficult stool. Stool
preceded by griping, colicky pain. Sour stools with tenesmus (Rheum.). Stools, frothy, greenish like water
like scum of frog pond. Stools, li- enteric with gelatinous fatty masses, grass
green or dry, hard, crumbling, white clay, putty like. Bloody mucus stools. Burning at anus after stool.
Milkpasses undigested in nursing children. Worms.
Sensations - As if everything was turning around. As if hair was pulled. As if white of egg had dried on face.
As if teeth too long. As if rectum pricked with needles. Back as if broken.
Skin - Hair and nails unhealthy. Earthy, sallow and parchment-like, emaciation. Sore, dry, sensitive to cold.
Violent itching and great dryness of skin. Itching vesicles on hands and fingers. Large nodosities between the
skin and the flesh with shooting pains. Nettle-rash with much swelling. Small painless, red tetters, which
exfoliate. Spreading blisters. Small blood boils. Corroding vesicles.
Sleep - Frequent and violent yawing. Inclination to go to sleep during day. Sleeplessness from flatus, from
cutting wisdom-teeth, exhaustion. Many anxious dreams, with talking, cries, and starting fromfright.
Dreams of fire, flood, robbers, quarrels. Dreams of money, pleasures, misfortunes. Dreams of dead persons.
Awakes at 2 a.m. or 3 a.m. and cannot fall to sleep. Unrefreshing sleep, more tired in the morning than on
retiring.
Stomach - Sensation of emptiness in stomach. Constrictive pain in stomach. Pains, as from ulceration. Sour
eructations and heartburn after cabbage, potatoes, greasy food, or milk. Acidrisings. Sour belching and
vomiting of bitter water. Eructations tasting of rotten eggs during pregnancy. Nausea and vertigo during a
meal, followed by retching, and vomiting of bitter or salty serum. Nausea and sour vomiting during pregnancy,
 during colic. Vomiting of undigested milk.
Temperature - Chilly in evening. Chilly, takes cold, before menses. Chill running down back. Chill, better out-
door exercise. Fever at night, with night sweats and aversion to uncovering. Fever with dread of exposure,
restlessness, sweat on head, redness and burning.
Throat - Sore throat with shooting pain when speaking and swallowing. Sore
throat, worse before menses. Sticking pain in throat, worse talking and swallowing. Burning pain in throat
and palate. Frequent rising of mucus in throat. Soft, fetid tubercles of color of peas are hawked up. Hawks up
cheesy masses from throat.
Vertigo - Vertigo, worse when kneeling. Vertigo in evening with swooning. Continual giddiness, can hardly
stand, with numbness of left arm. Vertigo, staggers in the street and fears to go out, lest people should strike
against her.
COMMENTS - Cooper said that water containing magnesia, and that coming from magnesia limestone
districts, is peculiarly soft feeling. It is often found that the physical characteristics of substances correspond
with their dynamic influences, so there is reason for supposing that this softness has a soothing effect upon
the nervous system when used in baths.
Mag-c. is to exhausted nerves what Chin, is to exhaustion from loss of fluids. Worn-out condition, often
produced during pregnancy or menses as these are an additional tax on a women's strength.
Characteristic sensitiveness, mental and bodily, sensitivity to touch, to cold air. The least touch causes starting.
Sensitiveness passes into neuralgic pains of the highest intensity. Lightening-like neuralgia, worse on the left
side, insupportable during repose, must get up and walk about.
Tired and painful feeling, especially the legs and feet, aching, restless. Head injuries from shock, blows, mental
distress. Unrefreshing sleep, more tired on waking than on going to bed.
Periodic symptoms, every second day, every three weeks, “all symptoms worse every third week.” Worse from
touch and pressure, but pressure in abdomen is better during the menstrual flow. Pain is worse on the side
lain on. Smoking aggravates the headache.
Spasmodic disorders of stomach and intestines. Sour taste, breath, belchings, vomiting. Incarcerated gas
causing severe abdominal pains. Colic with gas and bloating, cutting and stabbing pains in the abdomen
(Cham.),
with irritability. Diarrhea, green stools like the scum of a frog pond, jelly-like lumps, aphthae. Stool like chopped
spinach, green flakes in stool (Cham.). Stool smells sour (Rheum.).
Puny and sickly children, who refuse their milk and get pain in the stomach if they take it. Food passes
undigested in nursing children. Neonatal jaundice with gas, bloating and colic, light-colored stools and failure
to thrive (Aeth.). Marasmus. Inordinate craving for meat in children of tubercular parentage, averse to
vegetables.
Teething (Cham.), with colic. Cooper mentioned it as a possible remedy in pyorrhea alveolaris.
Menses preceded by labor-like pain, cutting colic, backache, weakness, chilliness. Menses late and scanty,
flow only at night or when lying down, cease when walking. Flow acrid, dark, pitch-like, difficult to wash off.
Vomiting and toothache during pregnancy.
Cooper gave the indication as a “worn-out women,” that is, the state of nervousness induced by excess of
cares and worries of life. Mag-c. 200c, repeated three or four times a day, has given untold relief to many a
patient of this kind. When constipation and heaviness are present these will be removed at the same time.
Two cases of neuralgia, related by A. I. Harvey, are quoted in Amer. Hom. The first case is that of a carpenter.
50, who had a light complexion, spare. He had facial neuralgia for two years coming in attacks, lasting from
three to seven days, at intervals of two or three weeks. Sharp pain, shooting from left side of face and head,
worse at night, from pressure, from jar. Mag-c. cured promptly after the failure of Spig.
The second case was that of a blacksmith, 22, who had a light complexion, full figure. For several years he
had attacks of facial neuralgia coming on after taking cold. Very severe pain in the left orbital region, shooting
down into the eye and face and back to occipital region. Begins in morning, grows worse until noon, then
subsides. No pain at night, rests well. Spig. and Kali-bi. failed. Mag-c., cured promptly.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Ars. and Cham, (neuralgia), Merc., Nux-v., Puls, and Rheum, (abdominal
troubles). It antidotes: Acet- ac. Compare: (1) Cham., Rheum., Kreos., Aloe. (2) Cheir. - deafness, otorrhea,
nose stopped up at night from irritation of cutting wisdom-teeth. (3) Mag-m., Mag-p., Aloe. (4) Ant-c. -
headache from smoking. (5) Calc, and Rheum. - sour stools. Nux-v. - sour breath. (6) Cocc. and Sep. - worse
from kneeling. (7) Ip. - nausea and grass-green stools. (8) Coloc. - griping pains with drawing up of legs, Coloc.
has not the green slimy stools of Mag-c. (9) Cham. - neuralgia, better moving about, anxiety, restlessness,
griping before stools, stools of Cham, more yellowish green like chopped eggs. (10) Calc. - sour stools,
intolerance of milk, imperfect nourishment: Calc, has head-sweat, cold, damp feet, enlarged abdomen. (11)
 Lyc., Nit-ac., Sil., Lac-c., Lac- ri. - intolerance of milk. Compatible: Caust., Phos., Puls., Sep., Sulph.
Complementary: Cham. Planets: Jupiter, Saturn.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.
keynote:
PHARMACY - mag-c. Magnesia carbónica. Magnesiumcarbonate. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration
and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Acidity. Alcoholism. Antrum, disorders. Ascarides. Belching. Boils. Cataract. Catarrh.
Constipation. Colic. Coma. Cornea, opacities. Cough. Deafness. Debility. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Emaciation.
Epilepsy. Eyes, inflammation. Heartburn. Hernia. Hysteria. Indigestion. Insomnia. Leucorrhea. Malnutrition.
Marasmus. Menopausal, disorders. Menorrhagia. Menstruation, delayed.

name: Magnesia Fluoride
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - mag-f. Magnesia fluoride. Magnesium fluoride. Remedy made from solution. Trituration.
Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Auto-toxins. Goiter. Chronic suppurations. Fatigue. Hyperthyroidism. Infections. Influenza.
Metabolic complaints. Neuralgia. Post-infectious conditions. Sinusitis. Staphylococcus. Streptococcus.
Thrombosis. Tonsillitis.
HOMEOPATHIC - There is no homeopathic proving for Mag-f., but Mezger established symptomatology based
on clinical usage and the characteristics of magnesium and fluorine.
Localized infections from bacteria. Streptococcus, enterococcus, staphylococcus. Nasal and pharyngeal
infections of the maxillary sinus of the nose and tonsils. Postinfection conditions following influenza, sinusitis,
tonsillitis, with fatigue, asthenia, nervous irritability, lack of appetite, muscu-
lar and neuralgic pains, pains in the ligaments and tendons and joint pains.
Metabolic complaints of senescence with cholesterol disorders. Action on the liver, pancreas, digestive
passage. Capillary and venous stasis. Venous thrombosis. Goiter. Thyroid problems with the tendency to
hyperthyroidism. Mag-f. is useful after the failure of Sulph. and Hep.
Modalities - Better from movement, in fresh air. Worse at 3 a.m., in the early morning, from sleep, especially
after lunch. Worse a few days before menses.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Sulph. - Autointoxication with fatigue. Itching emption, a alternating with other
complaints, redness of the natural orifices, weakness at 11 a. m., sudden diarrhea. The need for fresh air. (2)
Hep. - Tendency to suppuration. Hypersensitive, especially to the cold. Pain like that of a splinter. Skin
unhealthy. Scrofulous lymphatic constitution. (3) Bar-c. - Hypertensive heart - vascular sclerosis. Glandular
and ganglion hypertrophy. Cerebral slowness. (4) Stront. - Vascular and cerebral sclerosis. Pain in the bones.
Muscular cramps. (5) Cresol. - Indifferent state with loquacity, tremors, trembling, paresis, oliguria, joint
stiffness. Neuro-vascular sclerosis.
REFERENCES - Julian.

name: Magnesia Muriatica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - mag-m. Magnesia muriatica. Magnesium chloride. Magnesiachloride. Solution. Trituration.
Historiealdose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Biliousness. Bladder, paresis. Cardialgía. Chronic, fatigue. Cirrhosis. Cold. Colic. Constipation.
Coryza. Deafness. Diarrhea. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspepsia. Dyspnea. Fainting. Fatigue. Flatuence. Foot-sweat.
Globus, hystericus. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Heartbum. Hemorrhoids. Hepatitis. Hernia. Homesickness.
Hysteria. Influenza. Jaundice. Leucorrhea. Liver, disorders. Metrorrhagia. Milk, allergy. Nausea. Nerve,
disorders. Nocturnal, emissions. Ozaena. Palpitations. Pregnancy, nausea. Rickets. Smell, disordered.
Spleen, enlarged.
Stomach, disorders. Taste, disordered. Tinea, ciliaris. Urine, straining. Uterus, pain. Water brash. Whooping
cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - WhileMag-c. andMag-s. are recognized old-school remedies, there is no mention of Mag-
m. or Mag-p. in allopathic text-books. Mag-m. first appeared in Hahnemann's book Chronic Diseases. The
general features of Mag-c. appears in many Mag-m. symptoms, notably those of nervous disturbance and
hysteria.
Guernsey noted that Mag-m. is found in many mineral waters and in seawater. It has a very bitter taste and in
decomposed by heat. Mag-m. is similar to Nat-m. and Aq-mar. in their relation to seaside effects.
Constipation, “biliousness ” and generally disordered health, when conditions appear as soon as the patient
goes to the seaside. Ill effects of sea bathing. Excessive weakness after a sea bath.
General action on the liver and nerves, uterus and rectum. Cirrhosis. Chronic liver disorders with
tenderness and pain, extending to spine and epigastrium, worse after food. Constipation. Fainting, fits,
dyspnea, nausea and trembling occur after dinner, better by belchings.
Spasmodic, hysterical complaints. Globus. Soreness and sensitiveness to noises. Pains are boring,
spasmodic, contractive, crampy, darting. Burnings. Shocks through the body like electric shocks when wide
awake. Perversions of taste or smell.
 Especially adapted to diseases of women with a long history of indigestion and uterine disease. Children who
cannot digest milk.
MIND - Difficult concentration. Confusion of mind. Mental exertion aggravates. Aversion to conversation,
prefers solitude. Reserved. Dislikes confrontations.
Peevishness and chagrin. Obstinate, headstrong. Morose and sulky. Irritability, worse in morning. Moaning,
groaning during sleep. Grief. Homesickness. Nostalgia. Forsaken feeling. Sadness and depression. Manic
depression.
Capriciousness. Excited, unhappy, fitful, emotional. Restlessness, worse in evening. Uneasiness, nervous
excitability with ten-
dency to weep readily. Weeping, tearful moods with liver disease. Feels on the verge of a nervous breakdown.
Overwhelming anxiety. Anxiety and worrying at night. Anxiety during fever. Anxiousness in room, better in
open air. Fears associated with liver disease. Fear of animals, spiders. Fear of robbers.
Abdomen - Cramps in abdomen. Distended abdomen with constipation. Flatulence with distension. Great
flatulence, often incarcerated, causing numerous pains. Hysterical colic followed by leucorrhea. Colic,
can't endure covering. Dragging sensation when lying on left side. Tearing, sharp pains in loins. Tingling,
stinging in abdominal muscles.
Back - Bruised or burning pain in back after sex. Bruised pain in small of back and hips, during menses, better
pressure. Cramps in back worse walking. Contractive, spasmodic pain in lumbar region. Sharp, tearing and
burning pains in small of back. Throbbing below left scapula. Swelling of cervical glands.
Causations - Ill effects of sea bathing, especially weakness. Ailments from anger, vexation, sexual excesses.
Chest - Constrictive pain and tension in chest and scapulae. Congestion and soreness of chest, after sea
bathing. Sudden heaviness of chest, with oppressed breathing, at dinner.
Constitutions - Suited to diseases of women, spasmodic and hysterical complaints complicated with uterine
diseases. Women after suffering months or years from attacks of indigestion or biliousness. Puny, rickety
children during dentition. Liver disorders in children who are puny and rickety and have eruptions about the
eyes. Enlargement and congestion of liver. Men with disordered livers and sexual problems.
Cough - Cough, worse eating, fatty food, fruit. Spasmodic, dry cough at night, with tickling in throat, burning
and sore chest. Spasmodic cough, worse rest, sitting, lying in bed, deep breathing, air of room, ascending
steps, or speaking. Whooping cough.
Ears - Pulsations in ears. Itching of old herpes behind ears. Sensitive to noise. Deafness, as if something were
lying before ear.
Eyes - Yellow sclera. Lachrymation and burning of the eyes when looking at anything in broad daylight.
Nocturnal agglutination of eyelids. Tinea ciliaris with pimples on face.
Face - Pale, yellow. Eruptions on face, itching, burning vesicles. Pimples on the face and forehead itching
worse night, warm room and before menses. Chapped lips. Blisters on lips. Prosopalgia. Facial neuralgia
pains, dull, aching, worse damp weather, slightest draft, better pressure heat. Severe cramps in face.
Female - Menses, profuse, dark, lumpy like pitch, with cramps. Menses black, clotted, more copious when
sitting than walking. Great excitement at every period. Dysmenorrhea, better by pressure on the back or lying
on a hard pillo w. Headache at menstrual period. Gushes of leucorrhea, after abdominal colic. Leucorrhea
after exercise. Leucorrhea with stool. Leucorrhea followed by metrorrhagia. Metrorrhagia, worse at night.
Uterine cramps, extending to thighs. Ovary enlarged and tender. Bearing down pain in right ovarian region.
Pain in back and thighs. Labor pains interrupted by hysterical spasms. Tinea ciliaris, eruptions in face and
forehead worse before menses.
Food - Appetite poor, bad taste in mouth. Ravenous hunger followed by nausea. Hunger butknows not for
what. Inclination to nibble. Craves sweets, dainties. Better from lemons. Violent thirst. Worse from milk, salty
food, fat food. Cannot digest milk (Nat-c.), especially children, causes pain in stomach and passes
undigested during dentition.
Head - Bursting headache, worse motion, open air, better pressure and wrapping up warmly (Sil., Stront.).
Sensitive to noise with headache. Squeezing pain in both temples in evening after lying down. Beating in
forehead when pressing upon it. Tightness and pressure in forehead. Much sweating of head (Calc.,
Sil.). Thirst, belching during headache. Headache better lemons. As if boiling water on the side lain on. As
if hair were pulled. Nodosities on occiput, tearing, painful to touch.
Heart - Sharp pain in heart, arresting breath. Palpitations, worse while sitting, lying on left side, better by
moving about (Gels.). Pulse accelerated, with ebullitions while sitting. Heart disorders with liver
enlargement.
Kidneys - Numbness of urethra. In the dark one cannot tell whether one is passing urine or not. Urine can
only be passed by bearing down with the abdominal muscles, straining and pressure. Stricture after dilatation.
 Urine passes in drops, some always seem to remain. Pale yellow urine, followed by burning in urethra.
Limbs - Rheumatic pains in limbs, better motion and pressure. Pain in back and hips, in arms and legs. Cramps
in thighs, worse sitting. Thighs and calves tense, must move limbs. Ankles cold or nervous worse night. Cutting
pain in heels. Feet sweaty. Arms “go to sleep” when waking in morning. Fingertips numb.
Liver - Jaundice. Hepatitis. Cirrhosis of the liver with a sluggish feeling. Liver sore, enlarged with bloating
of abdomen, yellow tongue. Burning, tensive sticking in hepatic region. Pressing pain in liver, worse lying on
right side. Hyperemia of liver with constipation. Liver affections with tendency to hemorrhage from various
organs. Cramp in the gallbladder, better by eating. Pain from liver to spine or epigastrium, can only lie on back
or affected side.
Lungs - Oppressed breathing, globus hystericus. Bloody sputum or congestion and soreness of chest after
sea bathing. Purulent sputum, of fatty taste and offensive odor. Watery expectoration during day. Tough,
yellowish mucus.
Male - Pain in testes and cords worse after sex. Itching on genitals and scrotum. Congenital hernia of scrotum.
Scrotum relaxed and often covered with perspiration. Pain in testes and cords, worse after sex or after
unrequited sexual excitement. Burning in
back after sex. Frequent erections, early in morning, with burning in penis.
Modalities - Most symptoms, except headache, are better in cool, open air. Better from hard pressure.
Better lying bent. Better hanging down affected part. Better gentle motion. Nausea and trembling better by
belchings. Worse from sea bathing. Worse lying on right side. Worse touch, noise. Worse at night, mental
exertion. Worse immediately after eating. Worse salt, milk. Fainting worse at meals.
Mouth - Mouth dry. without thirst. Loss of taste. Bitter, sour taste at night. Continued rising of white froth into
the mouth. Blisters on lips. Gums swollen, bleed easily. Toothache, worse if food touches the tooth.
Nose - Red, swollen. Nostrils ulcerated. Sore and burning, in nostrils, worse deep breathing, sneezing or
touch. Acrid, crusty ozaena. Loss of smell and taste, following catarrh. Sneezing with watery discharge.
Discharge of yellow, fetid mucus. Coryza, with stoppage of nose, hoarseness. Nocturnal obstruction of nose,
must breathe through the mouth. Cannot lie down.
Perspiration - Sweats on head or feet. Sweats from 12 p.m. until morning. Thirsty with sweats.
Rectum - Diarrhea after milk. Constipation of infants during dentition. Absence of desire for stools. Only
passing small quantity. Stools are knotty like sheep's dung. gray. Stools crumbling at verge of anus. Painful
smarting hemorrhoids. Tape-worms.
Sensations - As if some one was running after her. As if boiling water was on side of head. As if hair pulled.
As if tongue burnt, mouth scalded. Stools as if burnt.
Skin - Formication all over the body. Sweat on head and feet. Blood boils. Abscess with yellow, thin, foul pus.
Jaundice.
Sleep - Sleepiness during day with yawning and sluggishness. Anxiety and restlessness of the body as soon
as she closes the eyes. Restless at night on account of heat and shock. Sleeplessness from spasms. Anxious
dreams with talking and crying out during sleep. Dreams of robbers in
the house, on awaking will not believe to the contrary until a search is made. Sleep unrefreshing, tired in
morning.
Stomach - Coldness and weakness in stomach. Pressing pain in stomach, disappear while eating and
reappear about an hour afterwards. Throbbing pain in stomach. Stomach pain as from ulceration, or from a
bruise. Regurgitation while walking. Continued rising of white froth into mouth. Hiccough, during and after
dinner, causes vomiting. Belchings like rotten eggs, like onions. Nausea and faintness, better eructations.
Nausea in morning after rising, with salivation, faintness, weakness in stomach.
Temperature - Chill even near a stove, better open air. Chilliness, during and after loose stool, in morning.
Sensitive to cold air, great disposition to take cold. Fever in evening, with aversion to uncovering.
Throat - Throat dry with hoarseness. As if a ball rising into the throat, better by eructation. Hawking of clammy,
thick mucus, often mixed with blood.
Tongue - Tongue feels burnt, mouth feels scalded. Cracks in tongue with violent burning. Broad, yellow,
scalloped tongue. Tongue large, flabby, white, tip and edges clean. Tongue coated white in early morning.
Vertigo - Vertigo during dinner, in morning on rising. Vertigo, better from open air.
COMMENTS - Liver conditions (Chel., Nat- s., Lyc., Ars., Nux-v., Phos.). Symptoms of liver deficiency or
weakness. Li ver disorders with enlargement and sensitiveness, worse from touch and lying on right side.
Cirrhosis, with a sluggish feeling. Hepatitis with total exhaustion.
Liver rheumatism, arthritic symptoms associated with liver weakness. Severe chronic fatigue since hepatitis.
Chronic neurasthenia (Sil., Phos.). Liver stasis, toxic feeling. Symptoms are worse in the morning, stiff, sore,
achy, better with motion or as the day goes on (Rhus-t.).
 Unrefreshed sleep. Generally sleeps on the left side, to avoid sleeping on the liver. Worse lying down, closing
the eyes. Difficultly getting comfortable, desire to keep moving.
May constantly wake in the night. Miserable in the morning, feel irritable and sluggish. Bitter taste in the mouth
on waking.
Sluggishness comes from the liver, not from the joints (as in Rhus-t.). Drag themselves around, as if hung-
over (Gels.). Heavy feeling, as if all their weight and energy are in the legs. Difficulty concentrating. Better
open air and motion.
Anxious, restless, always better by mental exertion. Aversion to work, apathetic (Gels.), but a desire to move
and keep busy. Bitter. Bilious, irritable temperament, dissatisfied look on their face. Passive, will avoid con-
frontation, complaining to others. Suffers when they see people arguing.
Influenza and mononucleosis with aching, malaise, sluggish, wiped out feeling, but also stiff, desire to move
and stretch (Rhus-t. and Gels.). Viral infections with a sluggish, toxic feeling.
Palpitations, worse when quiet, better moving about. Boring and spasmodic contractive pains, dragging down.
Marked hysterical symptoms, spasms, fainting, globus. Hysterical headaches.
Burning and heat. Numbness and heaviness of the extremities, with weakness. Burning in soles in the evening,
must put feet out of bed. Chilly, but with warm feet. Sweaty feet. Aggravated by salt, salty foods, air or sea
bathing. Can get headaches, red lips, and cracked corners of the mouth from salt.
Sweat about the head. Ozaena. Redness, swelling and scaliness of nose. Yellow tongue, imprinted with teeth.
Tongue is large, coated and indurated. Perversions of taste and smell.
Weak digestion, exhaustion. Nausea and belchings during or after dinner. Trembling and faint spells are better
by belching. Better from a light diet, generally vegetables, and fruits, aggravated from heavy, fried, fatty foods
and meat. Aggravated from milk.
Intestinal atony. Constipation, stools break off or crumble at the anus. Stool is knotty, conglomerate. Painful
urging before stool, burning in anus after. Tape worms. Bladder atony, urine can only be passed by bearing
down with abdominal muscles.
Bearing down in uterine region, uterine spasms. Menses black or pitch-like, accompanied by pains in back
when walking, pains in thighs when sitting. Leucorrhea after every stool or following uterine spasms.
Clarke frequently restored the loss of taste and smell after influenza with Mag-m.
Teste, who placed Mag-m. in his Ferrum group, noted that Mag-m. and Mag-c. “have been used for the cure
of cachexia occasioned by long and painful diseases.”
He said he saw Mag-m. produce great improvement in a case of “hydrarthrosis of left knee with emaciation of
left thigh, consequent on a wandering neuralgia, which after having commenced in the form of cystitis with
(non-venereal) discharge from urethra, had successively invaded the shoulder, left elbow, eyes and lastly,
knees, where it had become seated.”
R. M. Skinner reported a case in which a farmer had been treated allopathically for three months for chills,
which were checked, but the man did not feel well. Spleen was very large, sensitive, felt heavy when he walked
or rode.
He sought advice for his constipation, went three or four days without a stool. His abdomen was distended and
hard, especially in ileo-cecal region. Cold on the left side and a crawling feeling like a cold snake. Beating in
umbilical region as if his heart beat there.
Skinner gave him Mag-m. 200c, one dose on the tongue. At 8 p.m., the bowels began to act and went on
acting with the exception of one hour until 3 a.m. He complained the next morning that the medicine had
“almost killed him,” and he looked thin and tired. No further medicine was given and in ten days he had no
complaint, the spleen was normal in size and without tenderness.
RELATIONS -Antidoted by: Cham., Camph., Ars., Nux-v.Itantidotes: Merc, (metrorrhagia). Compare: (1)
Chel., Mag-c., Nat-m., Puls., Sep., Am-m. (2) Nast. (3) Hysteria, Mosch., Asaf., Valer., and Cast-eq. (4) Uterine
spasms, Ign., Caust. and Sec. - both have continuous spasm. (5) Erections and burning in penis, Pic-ac., Nat-
m. (6) Enlarged liver, worse
by touch and lying on right side, Merc. (7) Foot-sweat and head-sweat, Sil. is offensive., scrofulous and rickety
children, headache better wrapping, Sil. (8) Congestion of liver, enlargement, feeling of weight and pressure,
Ptel. is better lying right side. (9) Enlarged liver of children, Calc-ar. (10) Sensitiveness to noise. Ign., Nux-
v.,Ther. Compatible: Bell., Sulph., Nat-m., Puls., Sep.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Magnesia Phosphorica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - mag-p. Magnesia phosphorica. Magnesium phosphate. Magnesia phosphate. Trituration.
 Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Catheterism. Chorea. Colic. Convulsions. Cough. Cracks. Cramps. Dentition.
Dysmenorrhea. Facial neuralgia. Goiter. Headaches. Hiccoughs. Intercostal, neuralgia. Locomotor, ataxia.
Membranous, dysmenorrhea. Meningitis. Menses, painful. Neuralgias. Pains. Paralysis. Parkinson's
disease. Rectum, prolapsed. School, headache. Sciatica. Stomach, cancer. Spasms. Tic douloureux.
Toothaches. Twitching. Vaginismus. Whooping cough. Writer's cramp.
HOMEOPATHIC - Mag-p. is one of the most important of Schiissler's additions to the Materia Medica. It has
had a very fine proving in the potencies, conducted by H. C. Allen. Schiissler's picture of the remedy is
confirmed in every point by Allen's proving and by the clinical use of Mag-p. in the highest potencies. Moreover,
there is a very strong family resemblance between these features and those of Mag-c. and Mag-m.
But it is only right to say that Schiissler arrived at them by a way of his own, which shows that there are
other means besides provings of finding the keynote symptoms of remedies.
Schiissler stated that Mag-p. is contained in the blood corpuscles, muscles, brain, spinal marrow, nerves, teeth.
Disturbance of its molecules results in pains, cramps, and paralysis.
Useful for cramps, convulsions, neuralgic pains and spasmodic effects, showing its influence on nerves and
muscles.
Spasmodic effects. Cramping of muscles with radiating pains. The pains are shifting, better by rest, worse
at night. Pains sometimes tense in paroxysms. Neuralgic pains relieved by warmth. Parts are tender to
pressure and numb. Allen noted that the pains rapidly change place, that cramping is the most characteristic
type of pain.
Hiccough, yawning, chorea and hand cramps. Nervous, tense, sudden violent paroxysms of neuralgic pains.
Sharp, shooting like lightning pains, that suddenly changing places. Radiating, boring, constricting pains,
extorting cries, causing restlessness and prostration. Twitchings. Tics. Palsy. Parkinson's disease. Goiter.
Chorea better during sleep, worse at stool and emotions. Genet al symptoms are worse by motion, cold air,
draft of air, cold wind, cold washing, touch, uncovering, lying on the back stretched out, when eating. Dread
of touching the affected part, of moving.
MIND - Very forgetful. Indisposition to study, to mental work. Mental dullness and inability to think clearly.
Learning is difficult.. Ailments from mental work. Drowsiness on every attempt to study.
Capriciousness. Irritability. Ailments from suppressed anger, vexation. Mental depression and anxiety.
Discontented, dissatisfied. Sadness, despondency. Weeping, tearful mood, during convulsions. Sobbing,
crying.
Oversensitive to pain, noise, excitement. Restlessness and nervousness. Anxiety, depressed vitality. Fear
of others approaching. Fear of being touched, motion. Excitable during convulsions.
Anxiety from the pains. Despair with the pains. Startled from the pains. Screaming, shouting from pains,
cramps in abdomen. Hypersensitive to pain (Cham., Mag-s.). Complaining. Lamenting about pain in affected
parts. Always talking about the pains.
Talks to himself constantly. Sits in moody silence. Carries things from one place to another and back again.
Delusions, that he is about to die.Delusions, that another person is in the room. Illusions of the senses.
Abdomen - Abdomen contracted. Bloated, full sensation in abdomen, must loosen clothing, walk about and
constantly pass flatus. Severe, griping colic, at times shooting up towards stomach, better by hot applications.
Flatulent colic, forcing patient to bend double. Colic accompanied with belching of gas, which gives no
relief. Colic relieved by rubbing, warmth, pressure. Colic in babies (Cham.). Cutting pain into thighs.
Back - Stiffness of neck and back. Cramps in back. One vertebra seems absent. Sore pain in neck and lower
part of back. Very sharp, shooting, boring, shifting and remittent pains in nape. Aching pain in small of
back. Dorsal spine, very painful and sensitive to touch.
Causations - Ailments from suppressed anger, vexation, mental work, study. Complaints of teething children
(Cham.). Ill effects of overuse of muscles, standing in cold water, cold bathing, working in cold clay,
catheterism.
Chest - Darting pains in chest, worse right side, which radiate from pain in bowels. Intercostal neuralgia,
must sit upright. Oppression of chest, with desire to take deep breath, worse on first entering warm room,
worse walking.
Constitutions - Hering thought it suited to young and very strong persons, teething children. Allen said that,
though it is best adapted to emaciated persons, it acts promptly in stout, fleshy persons when well indicated.
Suited to tired, languid, exhausted subjects.
Cough - Dry, tickling cough. Spasmodic cough, worse lying down, better cool air. Spasmodic cough during
intervals of convulsions with contraction of fingers and staring, open eyes. Spasmodic, whooping cough
(Dros., Cor-r.), better cool air.
 Ears - Nervous otalgia, intermittent and spasmodic, better by heat. Severe neuralgic pain, worse washing
face and
neck with cold water. Neuralgic pain worse behind right ear, worse by going into cold air.
Eyes - Eyes, hot, aching, tired. Increased lachrymation. Twitching of eyelids. Photophobia. Nystagmus,
strabismus, spasmodic, ptosis, worse right side. Itching and heat in lower eyelid. Supraorbital pains, worse
right side, relieved by the warmth.
Face - Cracks in corners of mouth. Face blue and swollen from violent spasmodic attacks of cough. Face
distorted from pains and weakness. Lock-jaw, tetanus. Painful contraction of jaw joint with backward jerking.
Spasmodic twitching of facial muscles. Trigeminal neuralgia worse slightest touch. Facial neuralgia, worse
when body gets cold from washing or standing in cold water, better from warmth. Neuralgia on opening mouth
to eat or drink. Neuralgia on right side of face alternating with toothache, rushing about like lightning.
Female - Menstrual colic, pain precedes flow. Menstrual cramps, better heat, bending over and by flow.
Menses too early, dark, stringy, fibrinous, tarry. Menses flowing at night leaving a stain. Membranous
dysmenorrhea. Swelling of labia, at times extremely painful. Vaginismus. Ovarian neuralgia, pain shooting
and darting like lightning. Puerperal convulsions. Spasmodic labor pains, with cramps in legs.
Food - Appetite remains good. Thirst for very cold drinks. Food doesn't taste right. Acids taste stronger than
usual. Aversion to coffee. Craves sugar.
Head - Headaches after mental labor with chilliness, better warmth (Sil.). Headaches of students. Sensation
as if contents were liquid, as if parts of brain were changing places, as if a cap on head. Neuralgic or
rheumatic pains, better external application of warmth. As if an electric shock in the head extending to all
parts of the body. Boring pain over right eye, spreading over whole right side of head. Supraorbital pain worse
right side, better external heat.
Heart-Anginapectoris. Constricting pains around heart. Pulse irritable. Nervous spasmodic palpitations.
Kidneys - Bladder neuralgic pains after use of catheter. Spasm of bladder of neck of bladder, spasmodic
retention, tenesmus with constant and painful urging. Cutting pain in bladder before urinating. Nocturnal
bedwetting from nervous irritation.
Limbs - General muscular weakness. Violent pains in acute rheumatism of joints. Pains in lower limbs,
alternating sides. Sciatica with tender feet. Twitchings. Parkinson's disease. Involuntary shaking of hands.
Chorea. Tetanic spasms. Spasmodic convulsions with stiffness of limbs, clenched fingers and thumbs
drawn in. Cramps worse at night, in bed. Cramps from prolonged exertion. Cramps after prolonged use
of tools. Crampy contraction of fingers. Skin of fingers tight. Writers ' and players ' cramps. Cramps in
calves and feet. Runner's cramps. Cramps in limbs during pregnancy.
Lungs - Spasmodic nervous asthma. Asthmatic oppression of chest. Oppressed breathing, with desire to take
deep breath, worse on entering warm room, worse walking. Difficult breathing with intercostal neuralgia.
Modalities -Better by heat, warmth. Better hot water, bathing. Better from pressure. Better rubbing. Better
bending double. Better standing up. Worse from cold air. Worse drafts. Worse uncovering. Worse cold
water. Worse periodicity. Worse night. Worse exhaustion. Worse milk. Worse right side. Worse lying on right
side. Worse touch.
Mouth - Bitter taste. Taste of bananas. Food does not taste right. Swelling of tongue. Tongue, clean with
colic. Cracks in angles of lips. Painful contraction of jaw joint. Spasms without febrile symptoms. Spasmodic
stammering.
Nose - Alternate stuffing and profuse gushing discharge. Discharge of a white, thin substance, worse from left
nostril. Smarting and raw feeling in left nostril. Loss or perversion of sense of smell.
Rectum - Constipation in rheumatic subjects due to flatulence and indigestion. Constipation in infants. Torpid
stool. Stool expelled with force. Dysentery with cramp-like pains, better by pressure or bending double.
Dysentery with spasmodic retention of urine. Watery diarrhea with vomiting and cramps in calves. Stools
loose, watery, with urging. Diarrhea ceases, spasms or other brain troubles set in. Cutting, darting, lightning-
like pains in hemorrhoids. Itching and scratching feeling in anus.
Skin - Barber's itch. Herpetic eruptions with white scales. Rash on arms, legs and face, like insect bites. Rash
red when scratched. Pricking sensation all over.
Sleep - Sleepy when attempting to study. Spasmodic yawning as if it would dislocate the jaw with tears.
Sleepless on account of indigestion or toothache. Insomnia from exhaustion. Wakes at night with leg and
foot cramps. Sleep disturbed by troublesome dreams. Drowsy in morning.
Stomach - Stomach cramps. Intense cutting, shooting, cramping pains in region of stomach. Colic, better
eructation. Colic in babies (Cham.). Obstinate hiccough, causes long-lasting soreness. Hiccough with
retching day and night. Burning pain, vomiting and hiccough, better hot drinks. Constant nausea. Persistent
vomiting. Bilious vomiting, at times streaked with blood. Cancer of stomach.
 Teeth - Toothache, better by heat and hot liquids. Toothache, worse eating or drinking, cold things. Teeth
sensitive to touch or cold air. Severe pain in decayed or filled teeth. Neuralgic pain in a filled tooth. Ulceration
of teeth with swelling of glands of face, throat and neck. Complaints of teething children, spasms during
dentition without fever symptoms.
Temperature - Chilliness after dinner in evening. Chills run up and down the back. Chills with shivering,
followed by a suffocating sensation.
Throat - Soreness and stiffness, especially right side, parts seem puffy with chilliness and aching all over.
Spasmodic constriction of throat on attempting to
swallow liquids. Sensation of choking, of a corn-husk lodged in upper part of throat. Voice harsh, larynx sore
and raw. Nervous angina.
Vertigo - Vertigo on moving. Vertigo falls forward on closing eyes, better walking in open air.
Vision - Vision blurred. Dark spots before eyes on attempting to read. Colored lights before eyes. Sees rainbow
colors. Double vision during headache.
COMMENTS - Acute or chronic cramps and spasms. Writer's or musician's cramps, Charley horses. Acute leg
cramps in the elderly or in athletes. Lower leg cramps (Cupr., Calc-c.).
Paralysis, or cramping pains followed by paralysis. Cramps and spasms are better with heat, will often place
a hot water bottle on the site (Cham, will want cold), better from pressure. Generally right sided (Coloc. is left
sided).
Facial neuralgias (Kalm.) and sciatica, worse on the right side, better heat. Headache, better from applied
heat. Chorea, respiratory spasms. Spasms of the glottis, whooping cough. Hiccoughs (Nux-v.).
Lockjaw, tetanus. For teething children or toothache, better drinking something warm or from warm
applications. Useful for cracks at the corners of the lips. Allen's proving brought out canker sores in mouth,
sore lips and cracked lips.
Stomach cramps. Abdominal cramps radiated from umbilical region, better by bending double, heat,
sometimes with watery diarrhea. Colic in babies (Cham.), without irritability, better heat. Spasmodic retention
of the urine. Inguinal hernia. Nondescript menstrual cramps. Labor pains.
Cramping, burning pain, better from heat (Ars.). Pains are shooting like lightning or boring, often combined
with or alternating with a sense of constriction, at times wandering, better by warmth, pressure, worse by light
touch.
Attacks of pain, often with great prostration or profuse sweat, leaving the patient “languid, tired, exhausted,
unable to sit up.”
More often called for in men than Mag-c, but the indication “worn-out women” applies to both. Disorders are
often periodic.
Useful for complaints from standing in cold water, complaints of dentition, headaches of school children,
professional neuroses, after effects of catheter.
Clarke cured a very severe attack of chorea in a girl of six with Mag-p. 6x. The spasms were general, but they
affected the speech to such an extent that she could not make herself intelligible.
Rappaz ofMontevideo cured with Mag- p. a young man, 17, of cerebral meningitis which began with violent
pain and inflammation in his left eye with terrific pains in his head, delirium and intense fever. He was first
treated allopathically, without success.
When Rappaz first saw him, he was hemiplegic with frequent and alarming convulsions, violent crying out,
involuntary passage of feces and urine, dilated pupils, dropped jaw, escape of saliva, with difficult speech and
comprehension. Under Mag-p. 6x in water, general improvement set in. Later the 12x was given and in two
months he was well.
W. T. Ord cured Miss G., 48, of back pain extending down right sciatic nerve and up the back, following
influenza with Mag-p. 3x, 5 grain doses.
Skinner has cured with Mag-p. a case of prolapsed of rectum with feeling as if rectum were torn, the symptoms
being better by heat.
RELATIONS-Antidoted by: Bell., Gels., Lach. Compare: ( 1 ) Kali-p., Coloc., Sil., Zinc., Dios. (2) Cham. -
vegetable analog, but Cham, has worse from heat. (3) Shifting pains, Puls., Lac-c. (4) Neuralgia recurring
violently every night. (5) better warmth, Ars. (6) Dysmenorrhea, Caul., Cimic., Xan., Cact., Lil-t., Coloc. (7)
Colic better bending double, Coloc. (8) better from hot drinks. Lyc. (9) Meteorism, Lyc., cracks on lips, Nat-m.
(10) Headache from occiput to eye better warmth, Sil.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.
