name: Mandragora Officinarum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-mand.Mandragoraofficinarum. Mandrake. Atropa mandragora. Mandragora e radice. N. O.
Solanaceae. Europe. Tincture of the whole plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Allergic dermatitis. Backache. Blepharitis. Blisters. Boils. Chorea. Colitis. Congestive headache.
Conjunctivitis. Constipation. Coryza. Digestive, weakness. Epilepsy. Erysipelas. Exanthemata. Eye,
disorders. Gallbladder infections. Gallstones. Gastritis. Gout. Herpes. Hiccoughs. Hypersensitive.
Hypertension. Iritis. Itching. Keratitis. Leucorrhea. Liver, migraines. Lupus erythematous. Motion sickness.
Neuralgia. Night, sweats. Osteoporosis. Pancreatitis. Polyneuritis. Seasickness. Seborrhea. Shingles. Sterility.
Styes. Ulcers. Uric, diathesis. Writer's cramp.
HERBAL - The mandrake does not derive its name from the shape of the human body which the root of the
plant sometimes takes, but from the name by which it was known to the Greeks, Mandragora, and which
signifies injurious to cattle. It was used by the ancient Egyptian physicians for many conditions.
 The mandrake figures largely in legend and poetry. It is said to be the “insane root” spoken of by Macbeth and
it is mentioned
by name in Antony and Cleopatra and in Romeo and Juliet. Mandrake must not be confounded with
Podophyllum or Bryonia dioica, which are also sometimes called “Mandrake” in this country.
HOMEOPATHIC - Dufresne experimented with Mand. on himself and another by repeatedly smelling, at short
intervals, the expressed juice of the plant, “which has a nauseating odor like adder's flesh.” W. B.
Richardson also experimented with it.
There are two varieties of Mand., the vernal and the autumnal; Dufresne used the vernal. The symptoms were
very similar to those of Belladonna, to which it is botani- cally closely related. Mand. is like a cooled or
attenuated Bell.
Restless excitability and bodily weariness. Great desire for sleep. Striking tiredness, exhaustion, collapse.
Depressive condition. Nervous, hypersensitive to noise and odors, ameliorated by urination. Exaggeration of
sounds and enlarged vision.
Joint and muscular pains. The unpleasant symptoms go off at night in bed and are succeeded by a gentle
perspiration. Lingering uneasiness and coldness after removal of other symptoms.
Congestive headache. Ocular complaints with mydriasis and dimming of the field of vision. Herpetic eruption
on the face. Constipation. Inactive bowels with white, hard stools. Liver, gallbladder and stomach
complaints. Gout. Uric diathesis.
MIND - Alternating between good moods, euphoria, and depression, discontented. Depressive psychosis.
Restless excitability, hysterical. Very nervous and irritable, hypersensitive to noise, ameliorated by urination.
Poor powers of concentration.
Abdomen - Repletion and heaviness in the upper abdomen with dyspnea and palpitations, ameliorated by
moving and getting up, and by belching and expelling gas. Gastric, duodenal, pyloric ulcers. Diaphragmatic
hernia.
Back - Backache. Severe pain in the right shoulder and left wrist, worse with movement. Pain in the scapula
and right hand.
Blood - Arteriosclerosis. Hypoglycemia. High level of urea in the blood.
Chest - Angina pectoris. Constriction of the heart, as if the chest were clamped in a vice, ameliorated by heat
in bed and by rest. Anginal pain, lasting for an hour with cold sweat on the forehead.
Constitutions - Allergic and psoric constitutions. Arthritic tendencies. Uric diathesis.
Ears - Exaggeration of sounds. Persistent buzzing. Early otosclerosis.
Eyes - Red inflamed, tired, heavy. Pupils dilated. Conjunctivitis. Blepharitis. Keratitis. Iritis. Retinal infections.
Painful, irritated with photophobia. Enlarged and confused vision. Eye movements painful, worse when
reading. Eye neuralgia with spots before the eyes, dazzled and troubled vision. Stinging, smarting pains in the
eyelids, which are red, swollen and itching, worse on the left side. Styes.
Face - Sudden pallor of the face, feeling that the fingers are dead. Herpetic blisters, boils on the face. Face
dirty, seborrhea of the face and nape of the neck, clothes become dirty.
Female - Menses either a few days too early or late. Blood thick, sticky, dark. Brown leucorrhea with lumbar
ache and pains in the low abdomen, ameliorated in bed and by resting. Sterility. Post-menopausal
osteoporosis.
Food - Feeling of hunger quickly disappears after eating a little. Desire for spicy, piquant dishes, meat, cheese
and sweets. Desire for sweets, which are not tolerated. Aggravated by coffee and fats. Aversion to and
intolerance of alcoholic drinks.
Head - Head feels numb. Heaviness and confusion of head. Sense of fullness in vessels of brain. Headache
resulting form an empty stomach, ameliorated by eating. Morning headache following bad digestion,
accompanied by bad mood. Pulsating headache, as if in a fog and the skull seems enlarged.
Heart - Heaviness on the heart with paresis in the left shoulder and arm. Cardiac pains aggravated in the
morning, before a storm, by exertion or movement, ameliorated in
bed, by resting and in the fresh air. Arterial hypertension.
Kidneys - Kidney stones. Extreme atony of the bladder despite urgent pressing feeling. Urination difficult, must
force the last drops. Thick urinary stream. Urine copious, pale, milky from phosphate deposits, brown. Urine
with a strong odor, accompanied by conjunctiva jaundice. Nightly bedwetting. Amelioration of anger after
urination.
Limbs - Cramping pains in all the joints with feeling of heaviness and numbing. Sciatic pain, worse in the
morning on rising and letting the leg hang loose, better with heat. Muscular pains in the hips, thighs, legs. Legs
heavy, cold, walking is painful. Numbness, heaviness and coldness in the arms. Needle-like pain in the upper
part of the right arm, spreading to the hand with feeling of numbness. Cramps in the hands, causing great
 difficulty in writing.
Lungs - Slight cough with expectoration. Difficult breathing.
Male - Diminution of libido, aggravated after the proving. Sexual impotence. Prostatic adenoma.
Modalities - Better from discharges. Better menses, urine. Better after urination. Better from amelioration of
anger. Better from heat. Better continuous movement, stretching backwards. Better resting in bed. Worse from
the first movement. Worse dangling the legs, contact. Worse greasy food. Worse between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m.
Worse changes in the weather, storms. Worse from the cold, except for head congestion which is better by
the cold.
Mouth - Singular taste and sensation of acidity and dryness. Bad breath, which he notices himself. Lips, mouth,
palate, dry and painful. Tonguedry, irritated, as if raw, as if scalded by hot water, benumbed. Tongue covered
with a white coating. Aphthae on the tongue and inside of the cheeks. Ulceration of the gums and lips.
Hemorrhaging of the gums. Inflammation of the roots of the teeth, painful to the touch.
Nose - Coryza. Irritation of the nasal mucus membranes with discharge and sneezing. Nasal crusts in the
morning. Spasmodic rhinitis.
Rectum - Hemorrhaging recto-colitis. Spasmodic constipation. Bleeding hemorrhoids.
Skin - Skin itching. Allergic dermatitis. Erysipelas. Shingles. Lupus erythematous. Burning pain on the skin,
resulting from exanthemata and boils. Sticky sweating on the palms, forehead, and at the hairline. Nocturnal
sweating with strong odor. Exhausting, cold sweating from the trunk, around midnight, followed by feeling of
improvement.
Sleep - Desire for sleep. Insomnia between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m. Sleep disturbed by unpleasant or horrible
dreams, by muscular pains. Despite good sleep, feels tired, as if he had taken a sleeping pill.
Stomach - Cramping pains in the stomach, ameliorated by eating, drinking and lying down. Stomach painful
like a wound, sensitive to pressure and movement, stinging pain, better by bending double and by resting.
Hiccough with salivation, eructation and nausea. Travel sickness. Vomiting during pregnancy.
Stool - Inaction of bowels with white, hard feces when bowels are induced to act.
Temperature - Shivering in afternoon. Coldness remains after other symptoms. Febrile flush and pain in the
bladder. Sensation of fever, with shivering in the back and persistent, sub-febrile condition.
Throat - Hoarseness. Husky voice. Throat insensitive, as if anesthetized. Swallowing painful. Cryptic tonsillitis,
purulent with sore throat. Intense dryness of the larynx with irritating cough. Glairy secretion from the larynx
and throat. Chronic laryngitis.
Vertigo - Frontal congestive headache with vertigo, dizziness of the head and extreme tiredness.
COMMENTS - The effects of the provings were removed by free indulgence in wine, coffee, and cigars. With
regular dieting, the symptoms lasted much longer and were removed by Nux-v., Camph. and Bell.
RELATIONS -Antidotes: Nux-v.,Camph. and Bell. Compare: (1) Bell. - Hypersensitivity and hyper excitability
of all the senses, pupils dilated and fixed, photophobia. Dryness of the pharynx, pulse full and bounding,
menses too early, blood hot, abdomen distended. (2) Dios. - Violent abdominal colic, ameliorated by leaning
backwards, genital excitability, pains in the back and the right sciatic region, dryness of the mouth and
flatulence. (3) Sulph. - Irritation of skin and mucus membranes, hepatic and portal intoxication, plethora in
arthritis, sclerosis, fat or thin types.
REFERENCES - Clarke. Julian.
keynote:
PHARMACY-mand.Mandragoraofficinarum. Mandrake. Atropa mandragora. Mandragora e radice. N. O.
Solanaceae. Europe. Tincture of the whole plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Allergic dermatitis. Backache. Blepharitis. Blisters. Boils. Chorea. Colitis. Congestive headache.
Conjunctivitis. Constipation. Coryza. Digestive, weakness. Epilepsy. Erysipelas. Exanthemata. Eye,
disorders. Gallbladder infections. Gallstones. Gastritis. Gout. Herpes. Hiccoughs. Hypersensitive.
Hyper

name: Manganum Aceticum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - mang. Manganum aceticum. Manganese acetate. Manganous acetate. Manganum
carbonicum. Manganese carbonate. Triturations of the carbonate. Solutions of the acetate, according to
Hahnemann. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Addison's disease. Albuminuria. Amenorrhea. Anemia. Ankles, weak. Arthritis. Asthenopia.
Asthma. Bones, pain. Brain, concussion. Cellulitis. Coughs. Deafness. Dysmenorrhea. Ear, infection.
Gallstones. Growing, pains. Gout. Headaches. Heel, pain. Hoarseness. Jaundice. Laryngitis. Lichen.
Menopausal, flushings. Myopia. Nephritis. Palate, disorders. Paraplegia. Parkinson's, disease. Parotiditis.
Periostitis. Pityriasis. Psoriasis. Reflexes, exaggerated. Rheumatism. Scabies. Tongue disorders.
Tuberculosis. Wilson's disease. Yawning.
HOMEOPATHIC - Manganese was isolated in 1774 and was introduced into the Materia Medica by
Hahnemann, who made provings of the acetate and carbonate. The symptoms of the two have not been kept
separate.
Manganese is a metal having a remarkable affinity for and in some respects a close resemblance to iron, of
which it is an extremely frequent associate. Its medicinal as well as its physical relationship with iron is very
 close.
Symptoms of chronic manganese poisoning, according to Professor von Jaksch, were involuntary laughter,
weeping and
walking backwards. Exaggerated reflexes and physical disturbances, evidenced by men making fun of each
other's gait. Paraplegia progressive, wasting, feeble and staggering gait. Anemia with destruction of red blood
corpuscles.
Affinity for the inner ear, larynx, trachea, periosteum of shinbone, joints, ankles and lower limbs. Pain extends
to ear from other parts. Everything affects the ear. Yellowgreen lumpy or bloody discharges. Great
accumulation of mucus. Asthmatic persons who cannot lie on a feather pillow.
Bones are very sensitive, Painful, deep soreness of the whole body, every part of the body feels sore when
touched, ears, joints, skin. Weak joints. Chronic arthritis with infiltrated, glistening joints. Growing pains.
Diagonal pains. Wants to lie down in bed which improves all the troubles.
Cellulitis, sub-acute stage, promotes suppuration and hastens regeneration. Suppuration of skin around
joints. Necrosis and decay of bones. Malignant ulcers with blue border, following slight injury. Inflammation of
bones or joints with nightly digging pains.
Progressive muscular atrophy. Motor paralysis, ascending paralysis. Parkinson's disease, paraplegia.
Festinating, walks backwards.
Jaundice, nephritis with albuminuria. Fatty degeneration of liver. Gout. Typhoid fever, cases that are badly
treated with prolonged convalescence.
Syphilitic and chlorotic patients with general anemia and paralytic symptoms. For speakers and singers.
Valuable for boys and girls whose voices are changing.
MIND-Anxiety andfear. Anxiety as if something bad is going to happen, when moving in the room, better lying
down. Fretful. Weak and nervous. Peevish. Irritability in morning, during music, while talking. Hatred of persons
who had offended him.
Silent, reserved. Sad, weeping, silent. Depression, better sad music. Constant moaning or groaning. Confusion
while sitting. Involuntary laughing and weeping, better open air. Mental conditions are better
when lying down.
Abdomen - Pressing in stomach and abdomen while eating, worse cold food. Rumbling in abdomen, from
cold food. Abdominal colic, better eating. As if intestines were loose and shaking when walking about. Pain
and constriction at the navel. Cutting in umbilical region worse on taking deep breath. Flatulence.
Back - Tearing pain in whole spinal column, from above downward. Pain in small of back on bending backward.
Stiffness of nape. Red, swollen streak on left side of neck.
Chest - Heat, beating in chest. Sharp pains in chest and sternum running up and down. Bruised pain in upper
chest when stooping, better raising head.
Cough - Dry cough, incessant, from irritation about middle of sternum. Cough with aphonia. Cough better
lying down, worse evening, damp weather, loud reading, laughing, walking, or deep inspiration. Inclination to
cough in morning.
Ears - Everything affects the ears. Pain extends to ear from other parts. Swelling of the parotid glands in
fevers. Sharp pains in the ears from talking, laughing, swallowing. Feel stopped, cracking on blowing nose.
Whistling tinnitus. Deafness in damp weather. Blowing the nose helps deafness.
Eyes - Burning in eyes during day. Pupils much dilated or contracted. Field of vision contracted. Dim vision
during day. Eyestrain, with aching and pressure. Agglutination of eyes in morning. Eyelids swollen and painful
to touch.
Face - Pale, sickly. Stolidly mask-like. Ulcerated at corners of mouth. Twitching, jerking pain from lower jaw to
temples worse laughing. Cramp pain in upper and lowerjaw aftereating. Swelling of parotid glands, in fevers.
Female - Amenorrhea. First menses delayed. Menses, early, scanty, pale in anemic patients. Discharge of
blood between periods with pressing in genitals. Flushes of heat at menopause.
Food - Aversion to food from a feeling of satiety. Loss of appetite, in chlorosis. No thirst.
Head - Congestion to head, with throbbing, feels large and heavy, better open air. Frequent rush of blood to
head, with thirst. Headache with stupefaction and confusion of senses while walking. Headaches worse,
breathing, talking or laughing. Pains from above downwards, worse straining at stools, jarring, stepping. Sharp
pains like needles, worse jarring or stepping. Cold feeling at a small spot on vertex.
Heart - Sudden shocks at heart and in left side of chest, from above downward. Palpitations of heart, strong,
irregular, trembling. Pulse irregular, sometimes rapid, sometimes slow, but constantly weak and soft.
Kidneys - Darting in urethra on passing flatus. Cutting pain in middle of urethra between urination. Frequent
desire to urinate during day. Urine profuse, sediment violet, earthy. Addison's disease.
Limbs - Muscular twitching. Parkinson's disease. Inflammation of bones and joints with nightly digging pains.
 Bones very sensitive. Every part of body feels sore when touched. Shiny red swelling of joints. Periosteal
inflammation. Burning spots about joints. Suppuration of skin around joints. Knee pain and itching. Intolerable
pain in skin of lower limbs. Legs feel numb. Stiffness in muscles of legs. Cramps in calves. Rheumatism of
feet. Ankles painful. Children are unable to walk because of ankles are weak. Peculiar slapping gait,-walks on
metacarpo-pha- langeal joint, walks backwards. Tending to fall forward, walks stooping forward. Cannot
walk backwards without falling.
Liver - Chronic enlargement of liver. Jaundice.
Lungs - Every cold becomes bronchitis (Dulc.). Mucus difficult to loosen after long hawking. Difficult
expectoration of lumps of tough mucus in evening. Scanty mucus. Lumpy, yellow, adhesive mucus. Greenish
masses. Expectoration of yellowish greenish lumps, even with-
Manganum aceticum out coughing in morning. Bloody, reddish phlegm. Hemoptysis with stitching pains
through right lung and dry cough. Asthmatic persons who cannot lie on a feather pillow.
Modalities - Better from open air, sad music, eating, swallowing, lying down. Better or worse by change of
weather. Worse cold, wet weather, damp, touching with cold things, touch. Worse at night, speaking, laughing,
motion, bending backwards. Lying on the feather bed aggravates asthma.
Mouth - Dry, parched lips, with shriveling of skin, without thirst. Clear vesicles on upper lip. Nodes on palate
and tongue. Tongue sore and irritable with ulcers or warts. Flow of saliva, while speaking with colic, paralysis
etc. Oily taste. Toothache, worse anything cold, worse sucking, pain going up in the ears.
Nose - Crampy pain at the root of the nose. Dry, obstructed. Obstruction of nose and fluent coryza alternately.
Chronic catarrh with bleeding, worse in cold damp weather. Blowing is painful.
Rectum - Cramps in the anus while sitting, better lying down. Pain in rectum after dinner. Bowels are irregular,
with constipation or diarrhea. Constipation with difficult, dry, knotty evacuations. Stool yellow, granular, with
tenesmus and constriction of anus. Passes much flatus with stools.
Sensations - Head as if larger. Ears as if stopped. Throat as if excoriated. Trachea as if closed with a film. As
if pit of stomach enlarged. As if bowels drawn together. As if tendons shortened.
Skin - Red, elevated spots. Itching, better scratching. Itching of diabetes. Chronic eczema with amenorrhea,
worse during menses or menopause. Psoriasis and pityriasis. Dry hard ulcers. Burning around ulcers.
Suppuration of skin around joints. Rough, cracked (flexures), bluish. Deep cracks in bends of elbows, knees.
Sleep - Languor and sleepiness. Much yawning. Sleepy very early in evening. Many vivid dreams which are
well remembered.
Temperature - Shaking chills in evening, with shooting pains in head, without thirst. Chills with icy cold hands
and feet. Sudden flushes of heat in face in chest and over the back. Burning over whole body, in evening when
rising from bed.
Throat - Chronic sore throat, with cutting pain, as from excoriation, when not swallowing. Throat as if
excoriated. Throat dry, scratching. Laryngitis. Larynx dry, rough, constricted. Tuberculosis of the larynx. Sharp
pain in larynx when swallowing. Chronic disease of larynx, with Eustachian deafness. Chronic hoarseness.
Hemming and hawking all the time and annoying everybody. Low, monotonous voice. Rough voice better
smoking.
Vertigo - Vertigo when sitting or standing, nearly falling forward.
COMMENTS - F. H. Pritchard, in an article on Mang., cited the action of the metal, noting that the mucus
membranes are congested and secretions are increased or decreased. A powerful cholagogue, it induces
inflammation and fatty degeneration of the liver.
Destroys red corpuscles and causes anemia. Sensitive bones and periosteum, with periostitis. Paralysis and
progressive muscular atrophy of the cerebrospinal system. Fissures, excoriation, and suppuration of the skin.
Lippe noted the indication “Suppuration of skin round joints.” Pritchard quoted observations of Grille that
workmen in manganese mines do not get itch and those who come to the work with itch get cured of it. The
manganese waters of Cransac cause “Ill-humor, weeping, despondency, sudden palpitation.”
Guernsey noted that “The bones are very sensitive, red spots on the skin, which are elevated, owing to bone
disorders. Ankles are particularly affected, children may have this trouble and be unable to walk. -
“Typhus fever when the parotid gland is swollen and the bones are very sensitive to touch, disorders of the
internal ear, upper part of chest. Hoarse voice, drawing sensation of the muscles.”
Laryngeal tuberculosis, tuberculosis. Cough better by lying down. Deep cough, worse in damp weather. Single
nodes on the palate. Chlorosis, if gastric symptoms and loss of appetite predominate.
Skin will not heal, slight scratches ulcerate. Anemia. Menses too frequent and too scanty in anemic girls.
Boring, pressing headaches, proceed from above downwards. Headache like a concussion at every step or
movement.
Inflammation of bones and joints with insupportable nightly digging pains. Every part of the body feels
 extremely sore when touched. Rheumatic patients cannot beat any weight on their heels. Rheumatic
symptoms with dark, almost blue spots on skin.
Paralysis with inclination to run forward if he tried to walk. Paralysis which begins below, extending upward.
Paraplegia. Paralysis from degeneration of anterior portion of cord.
Clarke has frequently verified the “cough better from lying down,” and also this sensitiveness of the bones.
Where these occur in connection with any other condition indicating Mang, it is sure to do good.
Clarke cured in an elderly woman a flat growth on the center of her palate with Mang. 30c. Bluish nodes on
the skin, malignant ulcers with blue borders following slight injury.
Hansen cured with Mang. 6c a case of neuralgia of the tongue following the healing of a little ulcer on surface
near left border after an application with lunar caustic. Shortly after the healing, the patient (a man, 60) had
severe stinging burning at the left edge of his tongue and the inner side of his left cheek when touching the
tongue.
In this state he came to Hansen after allopathic treatment. Several medicines were given without result, then
Mang, was chosen and made a rapid and permanent cure.
A. W. Palmer reported a case of catarrhal deafness cured with Mang. 6c. Miss H., 38, had dull hearing, dry
throat with hoarseness, itching in ears, loud rumbling, worse night, right ear, crackling on blowing nose, and
deafness in damp weather. The last was the
guiding symptom.
Cooper gave several ear-cases in which Mang, proved curative. The first concerned a nodule appearance of
malleus handle, thickened irregularly, with history of bilious headaches and of previous discharges from the
ears.
The ear drum membrane had a granular appearance. Purple glazed appearance of the malleus handles, which
were thickened and very prominent, upper segment of membrane also purple and glazed.
The second concerned a case of chronic periostitis of the meatus and middle ear with otorrhea, left ear. Cooper
also noted a case of otorrhea with earache, pain shot up from teeth to ear, the earache was worse after early
dinner, up until 8 or 9 p.m. Pains extended to and concentrated in the ears from other parts.
The fourth case concerned sensitive ears, took cold and got a headache, history of gallstones and jaundice,
sleepy and headache in afternoon, bitter taste in morning, lips glued together, whistling tinnitus worse in a
cold, (explosions, Mag-carb., rasping, shrill tinnitus as well as cardiac tinnitus, pumping, Kali-i.).
The final case Cooper recorded was deafness in a woman, 36, which dated from when she was 14 from over-
strain in singing, when she lost her voice and hearing for six months. Her left hearing returned, right remained
deaf, worse after a cold or if over-excited or worried. Subject all life to bilious attacks which lasted twenty-four
hours and left suddenly.
Head throbbed, couldn't put it down on a pillow. Headache came on in morning on awaking and reached a
height at 3 or 4 p.m. and kept on until next morning. Bilious headaches went away and the hearing of right ear
improved under Mang. 200c.
RELATIONS - Antidotes: Coff., Merc. Compare: (1) Mang-coll. - Boils and other staphylococcal infections.
(2) Mang-m. - painful ankles, bone-pains. (3) Mang-s. - liver disorders, excess of bile, a powerful intestinal
stimulant. (4) Arg-n., Rhus-t., Sulph.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak

name: Manganum Muriaticum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - mang-m. Manganum muriaticum. Manganese chloride. Solution in water. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Ankles, painful. Ankles, weak. Belchings. Bone pains. Borborygmus. Constipation. Rheumatism.
HOMEOPATHIC - Mang-m. was proved by Lembke. The few symptoms obtained were manifested chiefly in
the cranial bones, stomach, left shoulder, right knee and ankles. Violent pain in front part of left shoulder joint,
worse by pressure and by any motion of arm. Violent drawing pain in inner side of the right knee.
Abdomen - Frequent rumbling.
Face - Pressive pain in right jaw joint.
Head - Boring in right cranial bones, tearing in right occipital bone.
Limbs - Pain in articulation of left thumb. Drawing pain with weary feeling in right thigh while sitting. Pressure
in right knee extending into leg, a bruised sensation remains in ankles, afterwards same pain in left ankle.
Pressure and drawing in ankle and ankle bones. Pressure in left foot.
Modalities - Stomach pains were worse by external pressure.
Rectum - Stool harder and scantier.
 Stomach - Sour belchings of air. Pressure in stomach, worse by external pressure.
Vertigo - Vertigo and reeling when walking in open air, worse looking down, on descending or stooping.
REFERENCES Clarke.

***MANGANUM OXYDATUM NATIVUM (Manganese Oxydatum) PHARMACY - mang-o. Manganum
oxydatum nativum. Manganese oxydatum. Pyrolusite. Native Black Oxide of Manganese. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Bulbar paralysis. Nervous disorders. Paralysis agitans. Parkinson's disease.
HOMEOPATHIC - Workers in Manganese binoxide are frequently affected with bulbar paralysis.
Mang-o. has some symptoms similar to Parkinson's disease, progressive lenticular degenerations and pseudo-
sclerosis. Peculiar slapping gait. Muscular twitching, cramps in calves, stiff leg muscles.
Pain in tibia. Dysmenorrhea. Colic and diarrhea. Easily fatigued and heated, sleepy. Stolid, mask-like face.
Low monotonous voice, “economical speech.” Occasional uncontrollable laughter.
REFERENCES - Boericke.

name: Manganum Sulphuricum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - mang-s. Manganum sulphuri- cum. Manganese sulphate. Solution. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Bile, excess. Gastritis. Liver, disorders. Toothaches.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cooper said, “This Salt of Manganese deserves more attention than seems to be at present
given to it. It has been proved to cause vomiting, paralysis without convulsions and inflammation of the stomach
and small intestines. As well as of the liver, spleen and heart.”
C. G. Gmelin, who experimented with it, recorded its property of causing such an extraordinary secretion of
bile that nearly all the intestines were colored yellow by it and the large intestines had a wax-yellow color
communicated to them.
According to Rutherford, Mang-s. is a powerful intestinal, but a feeble hepatic stimulant. Toothache in a bad
tooth, on right side, upperjaw. Shooting, darting extending up the whole side of face and head. Painful parts
tender to touch.
Ure found Mang-s. to act on man as a purgative and cholagogue in doses of one to two drachms in half a pint
of water. It has, however, caused vomiting and sweating as well as purgation and is uncertain in its action from
an allopathic point of view.
Mang-s. lx cured in one case of hepatic derangement where the stools were composed of large quantities of
bile.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Mangifera Indica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - mangi. Mangifera indica. Mango tree. N. O. Anacardiaceae. India. Historical dose: Tincture
and all potencies.
CLINICAL-Chilly. Colds. Coryza. Dyspnea. Hay fever. Hemorrhages. Itching. Nausea. Pains. Pharyngitis.
Rhinitis. Sneezing. Varicose veins. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - One of the best general remedies for passive hemorrhages, uterine, kidney, gastric,
pulmonary and intestinal. Mangi. has atonic conditions, poor circulation and relaxed muscles. Rhinitis, sneez-
ing, pharyngitis, and other acute throat troubles, suffocative sensation as if throat would close.
Hemorrhages ofall kinds. Varicose veins. Drowsiness. Relaxation of mucus membrane of digestive tract.
Chronic intestinal irritation. Catarrhal and serous discharges. Aching of left side of body. Chilly. Sticky mucus
discharges. Tendency to suppurations.
Pains in spots. Pains shifting suddenly, or coming and going suddenly. Hay fever with whitish, sticky and
stringy discharge. Dyspnea, starting with coryza. Skin as if sunburnt, swollen.
MIND - Ailments from anger. Easily offended. Feels like striking the person irritating her. Involuntary, sighing.
Weeps easily. Melancholy. Feels bored. Worse being alone. Wants to remain busy.
Abdomen - Heaviness of abdomen after eating.
Blood - Hemorrhage, venous blood with dark clots.
Face - Swelling of lips.

 Desires sour. Desire for sweets. Worse sour, spicy foods.

Worse change of weather. Worse air-conditioned room. Worse closed room. Worse stooping. Worse bending

Skin - Skin as if sunburned and swollen.
White spots intense itching. Itching of palms. Lobes of ears and lips swollen.
Stomach - Hyperacidity. Worse eructations.
Better drinking cold water. Burning behind sternum at 2 a.m. to 3 a.m. Nausea and vomiting in morning.

name: Mantis Religiosa
author: Murphy
full:
(European Praying Mantis) ;
PHARMACY - mant-r. Mantis religiosa. European praying mantis. N. O. Mantidae. Tincmres. Historical dose:
All potencies.

Weariness.
HOMEOPATHIC-Activity increased. Weariness with sleepiness. Lack of vital heat or heat sensation.
MIND - Hurry, haste. Anxiety alternating with cheerfulness. Anxiety about future. Fear bad something will
happen. Fear with heart complaints. Delusions, that he is pursued. Ailments from domination by others.
Contented. Cheerfulness, gaiety, happiness. Elated. Euphoria. Egotistic. Cheerfulness alternating with
sadness. Mood changeable, variable. Morose, sulky, cross, fretful, ill-humor, peevish. Indifference, apathy.
Unfeeling, hard-hearted. Sadness, despondency, depression, melancholy.
Concentration difficult while studying, reading, talking, when thinking. Memory weakness. Forgetful for what
he was about to do. Loss of memory. Makes mistakes in localities, talking, writing. Stupefaction, as if
intoxicated.
Abdomen - Bloating. Flatulence.
Back - Backache in dorsal, lumbar region.
Lumbago. Stiffness, tension.
Breast - Itching in breast, nipples. Breast, nipple pain, stitching.
Dreams - Dreams lewd, lascivious, voluptuous, perverse. Dreams of anger, brutality, violence, mutilation, rape,
war, escape. Dreams about children.
Ears - Noises in ears.
Eyes - Pain as from a foreign body. Burning, smarting, biting, pressing pain. Agglutinated inner canthi. Itching

Face - Dryness, especially of the lips. Eruptions, pustules.
Female - Menses too late. Herpetic eruptions. Sexual desire diminished or increased.
Food - Desires juicy things. Aversion to alcoholic drinks, worse from coffee.
Head - Headache in the forehead. Headache, worse from changes of weather, draft of air. Headache during
fever. Pain in spots. Dull, pressing, stitching pain.
Heart - Palpitations. Stitching pain in heart.
Limbs - Weariness with heaviness of limbs. Numbness, insensibility. Trembling. Weakness in the lower
limbs, especially in the right knee.
Modalities - Better open air. Worse draft of air, or change of weather. Weariness better from lying.
Mouth - Dryness with thirstlessness, especially tongue. Sore, bruised gums on touch. Bleeding gums when
brushing teeth. Scorbutic gums.
Neck - Pain in neck region. Stiffness, tension.
Nose - Coryza with fluent discharge. Watery discharge. Sneezing.
Rectum - Constipation.
Sleep - Falling asleep difficult or late. Bad sleep. Deep sleep. Position on right side, impossible to sleep on left
side.
Skin - Itching.
 Stomach - Heartburn. Acrid, sour belching.Pressing pain.
Teeth - Toothaches, pressing pain.
Throat - Rawness, roughness, scratching in throat. Sore, bruised pain. Throat pain during fever.

full:

CLINICAL - After, birth. Bites, snake. Bronchitis. Colds. Coughs. Dyspepsia. Fevers. Indigestion. Irregular,
heartbeats. Itching. Liver, disorders. Lung, disorders. Malaria. Poisons. Rabies. Tetters. Throat, sore.
HERBAL - A valuable herbal remedy in coughs, colds and lung infections. Sold as “Horehound ale,” a pleasant
tasting beverage. An infusion of one ounce to one pint of boiling water, taken in hot wineglass doses as needed
induces sweating. Horehoundcandies and cough drops are popular.
Marrubium is a bitter digestive tonic, expectorant and diuretic herb. It has a bitter, aromatic taste and odor.
Culpepper used it to repel the afterbirth, as an antidote to poisons, snakebites and to help indurated livers. It
calms the nervous heart. Irregular heartbeats. Reduces fevers. Malaria.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Black Horehound - Stimulant, anti-spasmodic and vermifuge. Dioscorides said,
“The leaves beaten with salt and applied the wound, cure the bite of mad dogs.”
REFERENCES Potter.

name: Matthiola Graeca
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - matth. Matthiola graeca. Stock gilliflower. N. O. Crucifère. Tincture of fresh plant. Historical
dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Abscesses. Cancer. Neuralgia.
HOMEOPATHIC - Cooper studied Matth., and considered a leading indication for it “concentrated juices,”
which should be compared with the action of its relative cru- cifere, Thlaspi., which has cured obstruction of
bile duct from inspissated bile.
He cured with it abscesses in neck glands that had been discharging for twenty-five
years, abscesses in hollow viscera, and one case of stomach cancer. Neuralgia of the left arm with numbness
and paralysis.
COMMENTS - Cooper related a case which seems to indicate that morphine causes neuralgia and that Matth.
antidotes morphine.
A man had neuralgia of his right arm from working in a damp house. Morphine was given. Then neuralgia of
the left arm came on with numbness and paralysis. Lob. gave some relief. One dose of Matth. tincture
completely cured. When the man came under Cooper's care, he was spending ten shillings a week on
morphine.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cheir., Thlaspi. and crucifère generally.
REFERENCES - Clarke. Cooper.

name: Mdma
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ecst. MDMA. Ecstasy (3,4 methylenedioxymethamphetamine). A synthetic psychoactive drug
similar to methamphetamine and mescaline. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Anorexia. Chills. Chronic fatigue. Attention Deficit Dehydration. Disorder. Drug, abuse. Empathy.
Exhaustion. Fever. Headache. Insomnia. Paranoid, states. Malaise. Manic depression. Migraine. Narcolepsy.
Nausea. Nystagmus. Restlessness. Tachycardia.
HOMEOPATHIC - MDMA produces intense activity, physically, mentally, psychically. Restlessness,
trembling. Exhaustion. Chronic fatigue. Chronic, influenza-like symptoms. Malaise. Analgesia.
Extreme sensitivity of the whole nervous system. Overstimulated mental states. All senses are enhanced,
especially those of touch and sound. Heightened sense of balance and physical agility. Oversensitivity to
environmental influences.
Tranquility. Reduces physical and emotional stress. Release of “body armor.” It has been used clinically, with
much success, with patients undergoing periods of great psychic change.
MDMA
MIND - Calmness. Pronounced feeling of personal well-being, at peace with the world. Acceptance. Deep
 sense of forgiveness and unconditional love. Feelings of bliss, ecstasy, euphoria, fearlessness. Empathy.
Emotional warmth. Ease of communication. Desire to touch and be touched. Introversion or extroversion. Easy
release of psychological trauma and deeply buried emotions.
Mood swings. Clarity of mind. Excessive loquacity. Inappropriate bonding. Racing thoughts. Difficulty in holding
concentration. Nervous irritability. Restlessness. Low-grade anxiety without obvious cause. Paranoia. Fear of
insanity, of losing control. Sudden depression. Chronic depression. Lethargy.
Abdomen - Bloating of abdomen.
Causation - Overstimulation. Over-work.
Sexual abuse. Abuse of drugs, especially stimulants.
Chest - Warm full, sensation. Swelling.
Ears - Enhanced hearing. Sensitive to slightest sounds.
Eyes-Dilatedpupils. Nystagmus. Increased clarity of vision. Colors look brighter, intense and painfully
pleasurable.
Face - Flushed face. Tension in jaws.
Female - Dryness of vagina. Lack ofclitoral response.
Food - Loss of appetite. Anorexia. Extreme thirstlessness. Intense thirst with dry mouth. Desire for cold,
refreshing drinks, fruit juices.
Head - Headaches, pounding, explosive, occipital. Migraine.
Heart - Raised blood pressure. Tachycardia, fast, pounding heartbeats.
Limbs - Relaxation of muscular tension. Muscle cramping. Seizures. Tremors in upper and lower limbs, hands.
Convulsive movements.
Male - Impotence with increased sensitivity. Orgasm impossible.
Modalities - Better fresh air, warmth, dancing. Better touch, stroking, massage. Worse alcohol. Worse sitting,
standing still, overstimulation, suppression of emotions.
Mouth - Dryness of mouth. Continual desire to swallow. Intensely bitter taste. Enhanced sense of taste.
Perspiration - Copious, easy sweat.
Skin - Sensitivity to touch. Warm sensuality-
Sleep - Tired and drowsy but unable to sleep. Sleepless from excessive thoughts. Narcolepsy. Restless
dreams, constantly changing.
Stomach - Nausea and cramping. Noisy eructations.
Teeth - Clenched jaws. Teeth grinding.
Temperature - Sudden chill, cannot get warm. Flu-like chills, alternating with flushes of heat. High fever.
Throat - Dry throat. Raw, scratching sensation. Constriction. Hoarseness, needs to keep clearing throat.
Vertigo - Dizziness on motion, with nausea.
COMMENTS - Ecstasy produces intensely pleasurable effects, including an enhanced sense of self-
confidence and energy. Loss of inhibitions. Transfixion on sights and sounds. Feelings of closeness with others
and a desire to touch others. Sense of peacefulness, acceptance and empathy.
Involuntary teeth clenching. Nausea, blurred vision, chills and sweating. Dehydration. Increases in heart rate
and blood pressure. Seizures. Muscular breakdown. Kidney, liver and cardiovascular failure.
Sleep problems. Anxiety, depression. Memory loss or weakness. Disruption of serotonin levels, affecting
mood, sense of pain, appetite, learning and memory.
RELATIONS - Compare: Agar., Anh. Hydrog., Nux-m., Salv-d., Sulph-ac., Tar- ent-h.
REFERENCES - Hammond. Murphy.

name: Medorrhinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - med. Medorrhinum. Gonorrhea nosode. Glinicum. Potencies of the bacteria. Historical dose:
All potencies.
CLINICAL - Abscess. Alcoholism. Allergies. Arthritis. Asthma. Backache. Bedwetting. Bi-polar. Boils.
Catarrh. Cellulitis. Clonic, spasms.Collapse. Condylomatas. Conjunctivitis. Coms. Coryza. Cystitis.
Debility. Diabetes. Drug, abuse. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspnea. Epilepsy. Eyes, inflammation. Favus. Fibroids.
Gleet. Gonorrhea. Gonorrhea, suppressed. Gonorrheal, rheumatism. Headaches. Impotence.
Incontinence. Infertility. Insomnia. Itching. Joint, pain. Kidney, pain. Leucorrhea. Liver, abscess. Lumbago.
Manic depression. Masturbation. Menstrual, colic. Metrorrhagia. Mucus, discharges. Nasal, congestion.
Nephritis. Neuralgic pains. Ovaries, pains. Pains. Pelvic, problems. Polyps. Polyuria. Priapism. Psoriasis,
palmaris. Ptosis. Rape, victims. Rheumatism. Sexual, abuse. Sexual, excesses. Schizophrenia. Sciatica.
Shoulder, pains. Sinusitis. Stage-fright. Sterility. Stricture. Sycosis. Tenesmus. Trembling. Tuberculosis.
 Urethritis. Vaginitis. Venereal, diseases. Urethritis. Urticaria. Warts.
HOMEOPATHIC - Medorrhinum, one of the most important of the nosodes, is prepared from gonorrheal
discharge. The nosodes may be used according to their indication in exactly the same way as other
homeopathic remedies and also for manifestations of the disease from which they are derived. At the same
time, a knowledge of the origin of obscure disorders, especially if hereditary, will often give the clue to the
remedy required.
Medorrhinum is a powerful, deep acting medicine indicated for chronic ailments due to suppressed
gonorrhea. History of gonorrhea, often restores a gonorrheal discharge. Poor reaction to remedies due to
gonorrhea history.
It affects the mind, nerves, and mucus membranes. Great disturbance and irritability of nervous system.
Intolerable pains, tensive, nerves quiver and tingle. Intensity of all the sensations. State of collapse and
trembling all over. Wants to be fanned all the time.
Arthritic, rheumatic pains. Chronic rheumatism. Diseases of the spinal cord, even organic lesions ending in
paralysis. Loss of power in the joints, joints feel loose. Many different kinds of pain, stiffness, aching, soreness,
edema of limbs, dropsy of serous sacs.
Disseminated sclerosis. Numbness, internal formication. Burning. Small, very sore aphthae, blisters.
Enlargement of the lymphatic glands all over the body with heat and soreness. Tumors, cancer, scirrhous etc.
with history of sycosis.
Profuse acrid discharges, causing itching. Fishy odors of the secretions. Nose dirty, tonsils enlarged, thick
yellow mucus from nostrils, lips thickened from mouth breathing. Chronic catarrhal conditions in children.
Chronic pelvic disorders of women. Offensive, sour odor of the body especially children and women, cannot
wash. Dwarfed and stunted children.
MIND - Sensitive, nervous, restless. Everything startles her. Hurried, anxious and irritable. Wild feeling in
head. Lack of self-control. Exhilaration at night. Cross through the day, merry at night.
Apprehensive, anticipates events. Anxiety if a time is set. Frighten, easily. Panic attacks. Stage-fright. Fears
going insane (Calc., Mane.). Fear in the dark and of someone behind her, of being alone at night.
Claustrophobia. Fear of animals. Fear of venereal diseases, cancer, misfortune, poverty.
Persistent ideas. Dwells on the past. Desperate. Sad, tearful and fearful. Melancholy with suicidal thoughts.
Sad, dismal outlook, better after weeping. Cannot speak without weeping, tells it over and over again. Cries
when telling her story. Great difficulty in stating her symptoms. Despair, hopeless of recovery. Suicidal
thoughts, tendency.
Difficult concentration. Weakness of memory. Loses the thread of conversation. Forgets names, word,
errands. Makes mistakes, reading, writings. Confusion of mind as to his identity.
Dread of saying wrong thing. Poor self confidence. Shuns responsibilities. Aversion to being touched.
Stupefaction, as if intoxicated. Mentally retarded, children.
Alternating or erratic states. Severe mood changes. Happiness alternating with gloominess. Contrasting
extremes in one person. Manic depression. Schizophrenia, paranoid. Abusive to others. Impulsive, abrupt,
rude, mean, cruel. Irritability, impatience over trifles. Censorious, critical. Jealousy.
Morbid impulses. Alcoholism and drug abuse. Fastidious. Bites nails. Cursing, swearing. Dictatorial,
domineering, dogmatic, despotic. Cruelty, brutality, inhumanity to animals. Sexual excesses. Wild, strong, high
sex drive. Sexual perversions, fantasies and masturbation. Ailments from sexual abuse, rape.
Sensibility exalted. Sensitive to nature, animals, beauty, flowers. Feels life unreal, everything seems unreal
like a dream. Things seem strange. Time passes too slowly (Cann-i., Arg-n.). Feels far off, as if things done
today occurred a week ago. Sees faces peer at her from behind bed and furniture. Clairvoyance. Feeling of
having committed the unpardonable sin and will be going to hell. Continually praying. Sensation of impending
death.
Abdomen - Heaviness in lower abdomen.
Rests more comfortably lying on abdomen. Grasping pain in liver and spleen. Burning in epigastrium.
Agonizing pain in solar plexus, applies his hands to stomach and to lumbar region. Left inguinal glands
sensitive and slightly swollen. Grinding colic better bracing feet, lying on abdomen. Bilious colic with frequent
vomiting and nausea. Flatulence with numbness.
Back - Spine sore and tender. Backache with burning heat in spine. Intense burning heat, commencing in
neck and extending gradually down spine. Chills up and down back. Cutting, burning, crawling above left
scapula. Drawing pain in cords of neck, causes desire to throw head back. Spasms of neck muscles, notably
sterno-mastoid. Pain from left to right shoulder. Lumbar vertebrae sensitive to touch. Tenderness of spinal
column when stretching. Pain
in sacrum and coccyx. Lumbago from lifting.
 Bladder - Cystitis with burning pains. Urethritis. Polyuria. Can't retain urine more than an hour. Nocturnal
bedwetting. Incontinence of urine on getting cold. Painful tenesmus when urinating. Urine flows very slowly.
Debility after prolonged or complete urination.
Breasts - Breasts sore and swollen between periods. Breast sensitive, cold, icy, the rest of the body warm.
Breasts and nipples sore and sensitive to touch. Sore, oozing or icy nipples during menses. Soreness of
nipples, a gummy secretion drying on orifice, when picked off, nipple bleeds freely.
Causations - Ailments from suppressed gonorrhea. Ailments from verbal, sexual abuse. Ailments from
anticipation, foreboding, bad news, rudeness of others.
Chest - Chest as if painfully contracted, when coughing. Sharp, along right edge of sternum. Pain and soreness
through chest and breasts. Chest sore to touch. As if a cavity in chest. Coldness in chest. Pain, heat and
soreness through chest.
Constitutions - Sycotic, rheumatoid and hydrogenoid constitution.
Coughs - Dry, hacking cough with weak, sinking sensation under sternum. Incessant, dry cough at night. Deep
and hollow cough. Cough, better, lying on stomach, worse from sweet things. Cough on entering warm
room. Cough and retching, at night.
Ears - Opening of ear is sore and tight. Quick darting pains, in right ear. Pain passes up Eustachian tube.
Aching in cartilage of ear. Aching or boring pain in left ear. Itching in left ear. Partial deafness, pulsation in
ears. Hears voices. Frying and hissing noises in ears, mastoid.
Eyes - Eyeballs ache. Feels as if sticks in eyes. Neuralgic pain in eyeballs. Objects look double or small.
Sees imaginary objects. Feels as if she stared at everything. Swelling under eyes. Lids irritated. Ptosis of
lids. Upper lid hard as if it had cartilage. Swelling of upper lids. Eyelashes fall out.
Face - Freckles. Pallor. Grayish, greasy, greenish, yellow at the edges of hair. Flushes of heat in face and
neck. Sweat on face. Blotches of red color. Acne, worse after menses. Small boils break out during menses.
Red spiderlets on face. Risus sardonicus. Rigidity of muscles of face. Lips thickened from mouth breathing.
Stiffness in jaws and tongue. Swelling of submaxillary glands. Warts.
Female - Dysmenorrhea. Intense menstrual colic, better pressing feet against support. Menstrual colic with
drawing up of knees. Menses offensive, profuse, dark, clotted. Menses stains difficult to wash out.
Metrorrhagia. Vaginitis. Leucorrhea thick, acrid, excoriating, fishy odor. Intense itching, vagina better rubbing
and by bathing with tepid water. Urethritis. Neuralgic pains. Sensitive spot near os uterus. Os uterus,
ulcerated. Ovarian pain, worse left side. Pain from ovary to ovary. Drawing in ovaries, betterpressure.
Infertility, sterility. Sycotic infertility. Sycotic warts on genitals. Gonorrhea, suppressed. Passionate, wild,
strong sex drive. Sexual perversions, fantasies and masturbation. Sexual excesses. Ailments from sexual
abuse, rape.
Food - Ravenous hunger soon after eating. Craving for ice, salt, sweets, sour things, refreshing things, green
fruits, oranges. Desires fat, fish, tobacco, ale. Craving for liquors, which she used to dislike. Excessive
thirst, dreams of drinking water. Water tastes like perfume. Nausea after drinking water. Cough, worse sweet
things.
Head - Head is heavy and drawn backward. Sensation as if tight band across forehead, worse bending
head forward. Burning pain in brain, worse occiput. Weight and pressure in vertex. Tensive pains in head
as if she would go crazy, can't read or use mind. Sharp pains, comes and goes suddenly, worse light and
coughing. Severe pain in back of head. Dull, aching pains. Aching, in base of brain with swelling of cords of
neck. Burning in brain. Intense burning in cerebellum. Headache over eyes and in temples, on waking,
worse sunlight. Headache from
jarring, exhaustion or hard work. Headache during menses. Hair dry, crispy. Itching of scalp, dandruff.
Heart - Sensation of cavity where heart ought to be. Oppression of heart with difficult breathing. Heart as if hot
and large. Heart with bursting sensation. Soreness in heart. Fluttering about heart. Heart beats very fast.
Palpitations after slight exertion.
Kidneys - Nephritis. Deathly feeling in kidneys. Creeping chills in region of right kidney. Kidney colic (Berb.,
Oci., Pareir. ). When stooping can’t rise again without violent pain in region of kidneys. Pain in kidney region,
better by profuse urination, with craving for ice. Bubbling in kidney region. Urine flows very slowly. Urine watery,
colorless, intensely yellow, covered with a thick greasy pellicle. Scalding, ammoniacal urine. Urine stains
clothes a dirty brown. Urinates frequently at time of menses. Passes an enormous quantity of high colored,
strong smelling urine in bed every night.
Limbs - Stiffness throughout body and limbs. Gouty concretions. Rheumatism. Edema of the limbs. Coldness
of legs, hands, and forearms. Legs heavy, ache all night. Legs, cannot keep them still (Zinc.). Cramps in
legs better stretching them. Ankles easily turn when walking. Heels and balls of feet tender (Thuj.), and
itching, cannot walk on them, had to walk on knees. Edema of feet followed and better by diarrhea. Soreness
 of soles. Burning of hands and feet wants them uncovered and fanned. Restless, better clutching hands.
Finger joints enlarged, puffy. Fingertips cracked and burn. Bites nails. Nails depressed, as if they were bent.
Liver - Hepatitis. Abscess of liver. Violent, grasping pain in liver and spleen.
Lungs - Desire to breathe deep. Air hunger, cannot exhale. Dyspnea, cannot exhale (Samb.). Wakes
gasping for breath. Much oppression of breathing. Asthma, only better lying on abdomen and protruding
tongue. Asthma, sycotic infantile. Rattling, wheezing or whistling on coughing
when lying on back or either side. Lungs feel stuffed up with cotton. Heat in lungs. Left lung very painful, feels
drawn towards right side. Aching in left lung under scapula. As if left lung were collapsed and paralyzed, after
talking. Darting pain through lung, causes startling. Painful shock at base of each lung on coughing. Bronchial
catarrh. Ropy mucus, difficult to raise. Incipient tuberculosis.
Male - Urethritis. Whole urethra feels sore. Heaviness of prostate, painful. Prostate enlarged with frequent
and painful urination. Gonorrhea infection. Gonorrheal flow thin, transparent, mixed with opaque, whitish
mucus, stains linen yellow. Gonorrhea, suppressed. Gleet, persistent, yellow discharge. Heaviness in
perineum. Sharp, cutting pains transversely across root of penis. High sex drive. Intense and frequent
erections day and night. Amorous behavior. Sexual perversions, fantasies and masturbation. Sexual
excesses. Impotence. Prostration after seminal emission. Nocturnal emissions, followed by great weakness.
Ailments from sexual abuse, rape.
Modalities - Better at the seashore, damp weather (Caust.). Better being fanned, fresh air, at sunset. Better
bending backward, stretching out, hard rubbing, lying on abdomen. Chronic rheumatism of joints is worse
inland, better near sea. Worse from damp, cold weather, before storm, heat, covering, closed room, slight
touch, after urinating. Worse 3 a.m. to 4 a.m., during daytime, from sunrise to sunset, when thinking of
ailments. Early morning aggravation. Salt-water bathing aggravates sore throat and colds in the head.
Mouth - Taste in mouth coppery, bad taste and foul breath in morning. Breath hot, feels so even when
breathing through nose. Exhalation hot. Mouth feels burnt. Dryness of mouth. Water tastes like perfume.
Copious salivation. Stringy mucus from mouth during sleep. Small very sore aphthae. Canker sores. Blisters
on inner surface of the lips and cheeks.
Nose - Soreness and crawling in left nostril. Numbness. Burning pain in both nostrils when breathing through
them. Coldness of tip. Intense itching of the tip. Obstruction at root of nose as if mucus membrane was
hypertrophied. Hay fever and allergies. Coryza, better sea bathing, with loss of smell and taste. Nasal catarrh
running down throat. Chronic nasal and pharyngeal catarrhs. Chronic sinusitis. Thick yellow-green
discharges. Posterior nares obstructed. Post-nasal discharge, thick yellow. Snuffles in children. Nose dirty
in children. Nosebleeds.
Perspiration - Great tendency to perspire on exertion. When asleep, day or night, no matter how short a time,
profuse sweat on face and neck. Night-sweats and hectic fever. Sweat easy towards morning.
Rectum - Anus is red, moist. Fiery, red rash about anus in babies. Intense itching of anus. Painful lump
sensation on posterior surface of sphincter. Heaviness in perineum. Sharp, needle-like pains in rectum.
Sensation of prolapsus of rectum. Dark fetid oozing moisture from anus of fish brine odor. Profuse bloody
discharges from rectum. Inertia of bowels, with ball-like stools. White diarrhea. Stools tenacious, claylike,
sluggish, can't be forced out. Can pass stools only by leaning very far back, then shivering. Cholera infantum
with opisthotonus. Diarrhea, and headache, from motion of cars.
Sensations - As if sticks in eyes, lids and inner canthi, as if cold wind blowing in eyes, as if upper lid had a
cartilage in it. As if something crawling in ear and nose. As if a lump in stomach. As if tumor in right side of
abdomen. As if left lung collapsed or paralyzed. As if an abscess between left pectoralis major and minor
muscles. As if the blood was boiling hot in veins. As if all bones were out of joint.
Skin - Pricking sensation all over body. Intense itching, sore, worse night and when thinking of it.
Continuous itching. Skin cold, but feels as if the blood is hot, throws off covers. Yellow skin. Yellow, copper
colored spots, remaining after eruptions. Sycotic red nodes. Deep red
Medorrhinum
spots. Boils. Condylomatas and warts. Small, pedunculated warts. Tumors and growths.
Sleep - Dreads night to come. Insomnia. Sleepless from intolerable pains. Sleep prevented by aching in lower
limbs. Spasmodic yawning, can't suppress it. Sleeplessness, falls asleep towards morning. Short sleep
seems like a long one, which is better. Sleeps in knee-chest position. Sleeps more comfortably lying on
abdomen. Can only sleep on back with hands over head. Asleep, but hears everything, answers questions as
if she was awake. Dreams of drinking (Ars., Phos.), walking. Nightmares, of ghosts and dead people.
Exhausting dreams. Wakes gasping for breath.
Stomach - Intense pain in stomach and upper abdomen, with sensation of tightness. Clawing pain in stomach
worse drawing up knees. Cramps in stomach as from wind. Burning, trembling in pit. Throbbing in sides of
 stomach. Agonizing pains in solar plexus. Ravenous hunger soon after eating. Sick or gnawing feeling, not
better eating or drinking. Coppery taste and belchings of sulphuretted hydrogen. Nausea in morning, before
eating, during pregnancy. Vomiting of thick mucus and black bile, without nausea.
Teeth - Pale gums. Teeth yellow, easily decay. Teeth serrated, soft, crumbling. Eyeteeth sore, feel soft. Teeth
sensitive while chewing.
Temperature - Creeping chills running down back and all over body in a zigzag course. Shivering chills with
boring pains in chest. Chills after urinating, great coldness and shivering. Chilliness when bladder is too full,
better urination. Cold skin but blood feels hot. Burning heat with sweat, wants to uncover, but is chilled. Flushes
of heat, alternating with chills. Great internal heat after dinner and after slight exertion, as if blood was boiling
hot in veins. Flashes of heat in face and neck. Wants to be fanned all the time (Carb-v.).
Throat - Great dryness of throat with swollen glands. Throat sore and swollen.
Larynx feels sore as if ulcerated. Pains on swallowing. Swallowing of liquids and solids impossible. Choking.
Spasm of glottis. Throat constantlyfilled with thick, gray or bloody mucus from posterior nares.
Tenacious mucus in larynx. Sore throat and cold in head better salt water bathing. Hoarse while reading.
Tongue - Tongue coated brown and thick. Tongue white, with papillae showing through. Base of tongue white
and foul. Tongue coated thickly in morning. Blistered tongue, canker sores. Skin peeling off in patches. Small,
very sore aphthae. Bites tip of tongue in sleep.
Vertigo - Intense vertigo from sensation of tightening in head. Vertigo, worse in vertex and on stooping. Vertigo
with sensation and fear of falling. Vertigo as if intoxicated, on waking. Walks zigzag.
Vision - Blurred vision. Objects look double or small. Many black, sometimes brown spots dancing over her
book.
COMMENTS - An often prescribed poly crest remedy, especially if there is a history of a gonorrhea infection.
Never well since suppressed gonorrhea. Symptoms are similar to Thuj. and Ars., but they work on different
levels and can interrelate. Generally, Ars is a less serious Med., and where Med. is given for an acute, Thuj.
would work for the chronic.
Confusion. Slow answering questions. Developmental problems. Difficulty concentrating. Restlessness.
Hyperactivity, wildness. Temper tantrums and fits. Intense nervous sensibility, especially to touch of garment
or a lock of hair by any one not en rapport. Sensibility is very exalted almost to clairvoyance.
Over excited. Starting at slightest sound. Spacey. Unpredictable, unstable, fitful and changeable. A
disintegrated person, unharnessed. Lack of purpose or function in their life, concerned with fulfilling passions,
particularly sexual passion.
Full of extremes. Can become obsessive, violent. Schizophrenia, manic-depression, depression with
uncontrolled nature. Often violent, paranoid, can have persecution complexes.
Anticipation or panic attacks. Fear of losing control, about their mind not functioning correctly, of going insane
(Cann-i., Calc-c.). Fear that something bad will happen, anticipates that something will go wrong, especially
with their health. Think themselves incurable. Children can have severe nightmares and deep fears about
monsters or people getting them. Delusion that someone is in their bedroom.
Exaggerated sexual development. Generally precocious children, may begin masturbating at an early age.
Chronic masturbation. Preoccupation with sex, sexual fantasies.
History of sexual diseases such as vaginitis, bladder infections, herpes, gonorrhea. Often a history of
promiscuity, history of gonorrhea. Attracted to the culture of sex, drugs, and wild behavior. Alcoholism. May
be helpful for AIDS, stimulates the immune function and lessons recurring infections.
Tremor, spasms. State of collapse, with a desire to be fanned. The pains seem to tighten the whole body,
especially the thighs. There is scarcely a spot on the body that is not full of pain. Acute arthritis with painful,
swollen joints. Obstinate rheumatism. Sequela of acute rheumatism.
Insomnia from too much energy. Blood pressure or heart conditions. Chronic, recurring infections. Discharges,
sensitivity. Conjunctivitis. Vaginitis, urethritis, uterine fibroids. Fishy odor to the vaginal discharge.
Multiple allergies, especially allergies with discharges since gonorrhea. Sore throats, earaches, sinus
problems. Severe asthma. Great sensitiveness to draft of air, takes cold easily. Cough is better lying on face
or stomach.
Generally worse motion, better rest. Worse stretching out, leaning head forward. Constipation is better leaning
far back, can only pass stool so. Worse storms and damp weather. Better by the sea.
Worse from sunrise to sunset, always brighter in evening, worse in early morning hours (Syph. is worse from
sunset to sunrise). Craves oranges and orange juice, particularly in children. Craves unripe fruit, alcohol and
marijuana.
Craves tobacco (Staph, Thuj, Ars.), often as a nervous habit.
Many cases of stunted growth and arrested development in children are due to latent gonorrhea and syphilis.
 On this hypothesis, Clarke cured extremely offensive body odors in children with Med.
Negerath of New York and Angus Macdonald in England have pointed out a causal connection between post-
partum pelvic cellulitis and latent gonorrhea in the husband. Macdonald published several fatal cases.
The effects of the poison, constitutional or acute, may be taken as data for homeopathic prescriptions, but the
virus also has had an extensive proving in the potencies and symptoms have been largely verified in practice.
Burnett noted several cures with Med. 1,000c, including fits at every menstrual period, coming on in the early
morning. Clonic spasms, the legs suddenly shoot up from the bed. Rheumatism of the right wrist.
Sycotic asthma, worse from 2 a.m. to 4 a.m. Psoriasis palmaris. Polyps having their origin in a chronic
suppurating discharge. Albuminuria where the urine contains some mucus as well. Masturbation in children.
Burnett regarded Med. as “a remedy of pus and catarrhs.”
Clarke cured with Med. 200c a most aggravated case of constipation on learning that the patient was obliged
to lean far back on the seat or he could not get rid of the stool. He was passing urine containing long white
mucus shreds. He had gonorrhea many years before.
Deschere published a Med. case in which Miss S., 23, had chronic blepharitis since eleven. Her suffering was
intense. Light, especially gaslight, was intolerable and this prevented her from going into society. She could
not read in the evening, and in the morning the lids would be closed and she suffered much on getting them
separated. There was much discharge.
Before coming under Deschere she had been under strict homeopathic treatment all the time. Deschere
remembered treating her father for gonorrhea before his marriage
Medorrhinum
and he suspected the taint had reappeared in this form. Med. was given in high potency, single doses repeated
as the effect of each wore off and she was entirely cured.
Skinner traced a case of favus to the same hereditary cause. It had resisted all the external applications that
allopaths could devise and which had such an appalling odor that the patient, a little boy, had to be isolated
from the family. It was cured with Med. 1,000c.
McLaren related in Hahn. Advoc. acase in which a young French Canadian of delicate constitution, after
working in a factory all winter, began coughing in spring and running down in health. He returned home and
came under McLaren's care in May.
The cough persisted and prostration increased in spite of carefully selected remedies and the patient took to
his bed. It was then observed by McLaren that the cough and general condition was better from lying on the
face. This, coupled with a knowledge of there being a syphilitic taint in the boy's parentage, suggested Med.,
which was given.
The next day a profuse gonorrheal discharge appeared and the cough and all the threatening symptoms
promptly disappeared. Exposure to contagion had occurred several weeks before, but from lack of vitality the
disease could not find its usual expression and was endangering the patient's life.
Ernest Nyssens quoted some important observations by old-school authorities on constitutional gonorrhea.
Wertheim, in a case of gonorrheal cystitis, watched the entrance of the gonococcus into the blood stream. With
the gonococcus taken from the blood of this patient he made cultures to the fifth generation.
A youth who had never had a venereal disease volunteered for inoculation with this. The sub-acute urethritis
which resulted was so grave and in spite of all, became complicated so cruelly with cystitis, epididymitis,
prostatitis, synovitis andpleuro-pneumonia, that Wertheim asked whether the gonococcus did not redouble
its virulence by passing into the blood.
Jullien and Sibut witnessed a case in Saint Lazare Hospital in which Louisa M., 17, entered the hospital June
8th with urethravaginitis and was treated with tampons of Ichtyhol dissolved in glycerine (1 to 5).
The urethritis ran a normal course until July 6, when the patient complained of sufferings in the abdomen. She
had them for the previous week, but had made no complaint until the pain became so acute that an injection
of morphine was needed.
Rectal temperature 100.2. Tongue coated. Right side abdominal pain. In spite of rigid contraction of the rectal
muscles there seemed to be a swelling deep down, but the observers were not certain it was not a swelling of
the muscles themselves. Intestinal functions were normal, rectum empty.
An eruption of roseola spots appeared on the body, abdomen and chest, so exactly like those of typhoid that
the possibility of this was discussed. There was also acute pain in muscle of right calf. This pain persisted the
following day when the abdominal pains had disappeared.
July 9, the right knee was painful, swollen. At the same time, synovitis of left wrist, dorsal aspect. Temperature
normal. July 10, very few and slight traces of the eruption. Right arm the seat of acute sharp pain, especially
at the level of the deltoid “V,” deep down near the bone at the insertion of the tendon, (probably a hygroma).
On examining the Achilles tendon, there was pain at the level of the left ankle, nothing to the right at the same
 level, but the pain was, above all, acute along the inner border of the right tibia to five or six centimeters from
the flat surface.
This part was edematous and painfully sensitive. Another painful spot in the abdomen was behind the right
anterior superior iliac spine and beside the navel (probably muscular). The urethral discharge contained
abundant bacilli beside only gonococci.
Treatment by daily injection of one centigram of Merc-c. was commenced. The next day there was sharp fever,
coated tongue. The abdominal pains were muscular. Trace of albumen in the urine.
The next night there was delirium and nosebleed in the morning. This case went on to recover.
Another case, also in a girl of seventeen of tubercular history, complicated with syphilis, presented the same
order of symptoms, along with the nosebleed, hemoptysis, albuminuria, endocarditis with suffocative attacks
and violent palpitations, ending in permanent disablement.
These cases may be regarded as provings of Med. from the homeopathic standpoint. The rheumatic symptoms
are of extreme intensity and Med. will cure many cases where the symptoms correspond. Following Burnett,
there have been cures of many cases of dysmenorrhea using it.
Gilbert traced rickets to hereditary gonorrhea. In these cases, there are often glandular enlargements and the
patient is better at seaside. In such cases he gave Med. When there was syphilitic paresis and the patient was
better in the mountains, he gave Syph. In acute bowel troubles in rickety children he found Med. of great value.
Thomas Wildes considered that favus, scald-head and ophthalmia tarsi simplex (margins scaly, scurfy, often
angry red, falling of lashes) were due to suppressed gonorrhea in one or both parents. The red, angry condition
of skin may extend from face or scalp, down neck and back to perineum and genitals.
A girl, 11, had been treated by many physicians with salves and ointments to the general impairment of her
health. Her face was mottled with a profusion of red scurfy sores, eyelids involved and nearly denuded of
lashes.
Hairy scalp was one diffuse mass of thick yellow scabs from beneath which oozed a highly offensive mixture
of ichor and sebum. Passing down neck, back, perineum and involving genitals and pubes was a fiery red
band as broad as the child's hand, oozing a pale yellow serum that caused the clothing to stick to the body.
Wildes told the mother he could cure the case, but it would certainly get worse the first three months. This was
not objected to.
Med. 100,000c was given, one dose on the tongue. The external appearance grew rapidly worse, but appetite,
sleep and general health steadily improved and in nine months she was completely well.
In another case, a child, 6, was, since infancy, horribly disfigured with tinea capitis. The scalp was a mass of
dense scabs exuding fetid ichor, the only semblance of hair being a few distorted stumps ending in withered
roots.
One dose cured in a few months and, when Wildes was writing, the patient was a healthy and extremely
talented young lady and the possessor of a luxuriant head of chestnut hair.
Wildes thinks that suppression of favus, when derived from gonorrhea in the father, leads to hydrocephalus,
capillary bronchitis, severe teething diarrhea, cholera infantum, etc. If derived from the grandfather, sup-
pression leads to tuberculosis and lingering diseases. A fiery red rash develops about the anus in babies a
few days old, constipation with hard, dry stools. “Baby's water scalds it terribly.”
Wildes regarded the latent gonorrheal miasm as the true explanation of many of the disease manifestations
included by Hahnemann under Psora. Burnett, in a way, confirmed this, as he traced gout to a sycotic origin.
Wildes regarded Med. too strong a remedy to give in acute cases whether of gonorrhea, rheumatism or
scarlatina, on account of the intensity of the aggravation it is liable to cause, though single doses are often
useful when there is a tendency to sinking in dangerous cases of cholera infantum.
Wildes traced to the same source vascular meningitis in infants and cerebrospinal meningitis. In the former,
the efficacy of Med. is doubtful, but in the latter it is very efficacious after Cimic. has allayed the first acute
symptoms. In the convalescent stage, Lyc. was his chief remedy.
Wildes quoted from old-school authorities the following conditions traceable to latent gonorrhea communicated
from husband to wife: ovarian tumors, endometritis, oophoritis, metritis, parametritis, salpingitis, and even
peritonitis.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Ip. (dry cough). Compare: (1) Thuj., Nat-s., Puls. (2) Pic-ac. - inability to walk
right, priapism. (3) Camph. and Sec. - collapse, skin cold yet throws off all covering. (4) Verat. - collapse with
cold sweat. (5) Syph. - reverse aggravation, sunset to sunrise. (6) as if in a dream, Ambr., Anae., Calc., Cann-
i., Con., Cupr.. Rheum., Stram., Valer., Verat., Ziz. (7) better by leaning back, Lac-c. (8) Fish-brine odor, Sanie.
(9) Breast-feeding - Galeg., Lact., Sulph., Zinc. Compatible: Sulph. (especially when stool drives out of bed).
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.
 ***MEDUSA
(Common Jelly-fish)
PHARMACY - medus. Medusa. Common jelly-fish. Arelia aurita. Sea-nettles. N. O. Radiata, class, Acalephe.
Tincture of living animal taken in summer. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Breast-feeding, disorders. Desquamation. Edema. Leucorrhea. Nettle, rash. Urine, suppression.
Urticaria. Vesicular, eruptions.
HOMEOPATHIC - The effects of encountering jelly-fish while bathing are well known and have been studied
experimentally.
The effects of drinking two cupfuls of a decoction, warm, by a woman affected with stomach disease and
leucorrhea was recorded. There was rapidly produced edema, anxiety and difficult speech. Secretion of urine,
which had been suspended for days, returned.
Secretion of milk re-established in the woman's breasts three years after birth of her last child, she had twelve
children and had not suckled any of them, having had no milk. Pricking heat and numbness of skin of face,
arms, breasts and vesicular eruption, followed later by desquamation.
Whole face puffed and edematous, eyes, nose, ears, lips.
MIND - Extreme anxiety, difficult speech. Aversion to change. Do not like a lot of changes and prefer pleasant
routine. Easily offended. Taciturn. Coldness, hatred of others who are enjoy ing life. Difficult sexual relations.
Love of music and dance (Sep.).
Breasts - Action on milk glands. Lack of milk production in breasts.
Ears - Eczema of ear.
Eyes - Eyes puffed and edematous.
Face - Face, eyes, ears, nose are puffed and edematous.
Food - Very thin, doesn't like to eat very much. Craving for salt, fish. Intolerance of fish.
Kidneys - Retention of urine.
Modalities - Better from sleep, movement and food.
Skin - Numbness, burning, pricking heat. Pricking heat, numbness and burning of skin of face, arms, shoulders
and breasts. Burning sensation very soon after contact. Burning more than itching. Vesicular eruption,
especially on face, arms, shoulders and breasts. Nettle rash (Apis., Chlor., Dulc.). Urticaria and vesicles.
Desquamation.
Sleep - Better after sleep. Need a lot of sleep otherwise they feel useless.
COMMENTS - Blackie wrote, “In looking at Medusa one must consider the two types of Sepia: [1] rather bright
patients who go off at the deep end at the slightest provocation and are exceedingly irritable, and [2] rather
stupid and tired out.
“Medusa is neither of these but fits somewhere in between. They can be silent and do not want to talk, they
never finish their history in one go and do not want to answer questions. They always think of something else
to add to their history.”
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Murx., Sep., Urt-u., Apis. (2) Pyrar., Physala-p. (urticaria), Hom. (3) Astac., Hom.,
Bomb-pr.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Mel
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - mel. Mel. Honey. Historical dose: Topically and internally taken as a food or medicine. All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Allergies. Athlete's foot. Asthma. Bites. Burns. Cough. Cuts. Diarrhea. Eczema. Fungal,
infections. Hiccups. Mouth, ulcers. Nausea. Psoriasis. Rash. Skin, disorders. Stings. Sore throat. Stomach,
ulcers. Sunburn. Surgery, effects. Ulcers. Vomiting. Worms. Wounds.
HOMEOPATHIC - Honey is a by-product of bees concentrating plant nectars. The medicinal quality, taste,
texture, color, aroma of honey differs according to the geographical area and the species of plants from which
it has been collected. The characteristic flowery taste of raw honey comes from the pollen it contains.
It contains a variety of sugars and minerals and has been shown to be low in calories and useful as a sweetener
for diabetics, people with heart disease or those who are overweight.
It was widely used in ancient Egypt as a food and as a remedy for many skin problems. Ancient Egyptians
used honey as an application for emergencies including burns, bites, stings, cuts, sores and ulcers. Useful
for many acute and chronic skin disorders including eczema and psoriasis.
To heal wounds and treat infections, most commonly used as an anti-microbial agent for dressing wounds,
burns and skin ulcers. A natural antiseptic, tonic and cleanser, it also is known for its antioxidant, antibiotic and
 antiviral capabilities.
Effective in the treatment of various wounds and infections because of its anti-microbial (antibacterial,
antiviral and antifungal) properties. The use of honey reduces odors, reduces swelling, and reduces scarring,
it also prevents the dressing from sticking to the healing wound. Postoperative wounds. Burns.
Modern research shows that honey blocks the growth of oral bacteria. Coats the throat and reduces throat
irritation.
Effective when used in the treatment of gastric or peptic stomach ulcers. Allows the blood to circulate better
and provide more oxygen to areas of the body such as the brain. Acts as a sedative and is very useful in
bedwetting disorders. Itching of anus and worms. Allergies.
COMMENTS - Honey is used to cleanse wounds. It initiates growth of healthy granulation tissue. Helps in
quick healing of deep wounds. Reduces the effects of poison. Honey is very good for the eyes and eyesight.
Bronchial asthma, cough. Hiccoughs, nausea and vomiting. Urinary tract disorders, worm infestations,
diarrhea.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aloe-v., Calen., Mel-c-s. (2) Ric., castor oil, tea tree oil. (3) Urin.
REFERENCES - Murphy.

full:
PHARMACY - mel-c-s. Mel cum sale. Honey with salt. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL-Allergies. Itching. Metritis. Uterus, prolapsed. Worms.
HOMEOPATHIC - Mel-c-s. has been used for prolapsed uterus and chronic metritis, when associated with
subinvolution and inflammation of the cervix. Uterinedisplace- ments and in the commencement of metritis.
Soreness across the hypogastrium from ileum to ileum. Sensation as if bladder were too full. Pain from
sacrum towards pubes. Pain as if in ureters.
COMMENTS - Dr. Farrington wrote, “Now there is a combination of honey with salt, known as Mel cum sale.
This was for years a popular remedy in Germany for bladder troubles and for diseases peculiar to women.
“I have used this remedy in prolapsus uteri and even in chronic metritis, especially when associated with
subinvolution and inflammation of the cervix. The special symptom which leads to the selection of the remedy
is a feeling of soreness across the hypogastrium from ilium to ilium.”
Dr. Jeanes used a preparation of honey with salt, in the third or sixth potency, for a feeling of soreness in the
uterus. Keynote feeling of soreness in the hypogastric region extending from ilium to ilium, especially in uterine
displacements and in the commencement of metritis.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Farrington.
