name: Melaleuca Alternifolia
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-melal-o.Melaleucaalternifolia. Tea tree oil. New South Wales, Australia. (Do not store in plastic
containers). The colorless to pale yellow oil. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Abscess. Athlete's foot. Arthritis. Boils. Cervicitis. Cold, sores. Colds. Corns. Cradle, cap. Cuts.
Dermatitis. Fungus. Gangrene. Hemorrhoids. Herpes zoster. Insect bites. Nail, fungus. Poison oak or ivy.
Pyorrhea. Scabies. Sore, throat. Sprains. Sunburn. Thrush. Tinea versicolor. Tricho- monal, infections. Ulcers.
Vaginitis. Warts. Yeast, infections.
HERBAL - The tea tree grows in the swampy areas of New South Wales, Australia. The oil contains terpenes
and terpineol which gives it a nutmeg-like odor. It contains viridflorene. Tea tree oil is has been used as an
non-irritant anti-septic, fungicide and disinfectant of great repute.
When applied to pus filled infections, will clean and dissolve the pus without irritating the tissues. Dental
treatment for pyorrhea and gingivitis. As a mouthwash or gargle for sore throats. In a vaporizer for congestions
and colds. As a shampoo for head lice, ticks, scabies and cradle cap. Skin emollient. Creams for dry and
cracked skin. Hand and body lotions.
HOMEOPATHIC - Skin fungus. Fungus of fingernails or toenails. Dermatitis. Poison oak or ivy. Tinea
versicolor. Bad breath. Diabetic gangrene. Yeast infections and vaginitis. Sprains and muscle aches.
COMMENTS - Combine one part tea tree oil to ten parts olive oil (also almond or avocado oil). Add ten drops
to an % oz. Votóle of Sham
poo, to a bath, humidifier or vaporizer. Avoid eye contact.
RELATIONS - Compare: (l)Caj., Cajuputoil made from Melaleuca leucadendron, White Tea Tree. (2) Ric.,
castor oil use topically for many problems. Calen. (3) Echi., Plan.
REFERENCES - Olsen.
 ***MELASTOMA ACKERMANI
PHARMACY - mela. Melastomaackermani. N. O. Melastomacee. Tincture of leaves. Historical dose: Tincture
and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Chills. Colic. Diarrhea. Edema. Headache. Palpitations. Prostate, disorders.
Prostration. Tenesmus. Vertigo.
HOMEOPATHIC - Mure described this plant and made a proving of the leaves. On the second day of the
proving, the prover lost an inveterate diarrhea with colic. The most notable Mela, symptoms were a pain in the
perineum and testicles and shuddering followed by heat without sweat. Prostration. Pains in perineum.
Diarrhea. Prostatic disorders.
Abdomen - Borborygmi. Pain in the abdomen.
Chest - Pain in the sternal region, in the morning.
Ears - Roaring in the left ear.
Face - Pale face.
Head - Headache with sensitiveness of the scalp. Lancination and prickings at the vertex.
Heart - Palpitations of the heart.
Kidneys - Pricking in the urethra. Profuse light-colored and foaming urine. Urine more cloudy and less foaming.
Urine deposits a white sediment. Red, odorless urine, with bloody clots. Fetid urine. Albuminuria.
Limbs - Edema of the legs. Pain in the loins. Weakness of the thighs.
Male - Hardness of the penis, without erection
Mouth - Looseness of the teeth. Digging pain in the teeth. White coated tongue. Copious flow of saliva. Bitter
mouth.
Rectum - Pain at the perineum. Fearful pain and pulling from the perineum to the anus, when sitting, not
ceasing in any position, lasting six hours. Lancinations in the perineum, urethra, and testicles. Heat and
pricking at the anus. Tenesmus, with constriction of the sphincter. Inveterate diarrhea and colic.
Skin - Eruption on the lips, especially the upper. Itching and heat at night. Pricking over the feet, ankles, and
wrists.
Sleep - Drowsiness in the daytime. Stomach - Sour stomach.
Temperature - Chills, followed by sweat. Violent chills for four hours, followed by heat without sweat. General
heat. Internal heat.
Vertigo - Vertigo and dizziness.
REFERENCES - Allen. Clarke.

name: Melatonin
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - melat. Melatonin. A pineal gland hormone. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amnesia. Breast, cancer. Cancer. Chronic, fatigue. Constipation. Depression. Drowsiness.
Fatigue. Headaches. Hyperactivity. Infertility. Insomnia. Jet lag. Memory, weakness. Night, terrors.
Nightmares. Night watching. Seasonal Affected Disorder. Sleep, disorders. Sleep, loss.
HOMEOPATHIC - Melatonin is a hormone made by the pineal gland. Melatonin has been used as a treatment
for a number of conditions, including jet-lag, seasonal affective disorder (SAD), depression and cancer.
Jet-lag, the desynchronization of the biological clock, drastic changes in the sleep-wake cycle. Night terrors.
Fatigue, early awakening or insomnia. Daytime drowsiness. Ailments from loss of sleep. Chronic fatigue.
Headache, fuzzy thinking, irritability. Dizziness. Mild depression. Low sex drive. Reduced immunity. Low blood
pressure. Nausea. Vomiting. Abdominal cramps. Constipation.
Side effects from melatonin are not uncommon, even at doses that are significantly less than the recommended
amount. When side effects from melatonin do occur, they may include an increase in blood pressure, fatigue,
depression and problems with fertility.
MIND-Confusion. Dullness of mind. Memory weakness. Hyperactivity. Irritability. Depression. Seasonal
Affected Disorder. Ailments from nursing loved ones.
Breasts - Breast cancer in women who sleep irregular hours, sleep with lights on, or work late hours, night
shifts.
Causations - Sleep deprivation. Ailments from nursing loved ones.
Female - Infertility.
Head - Headaches.
Heart - High or low blood pressure.
Stroke.
 Modalities - Worse loss of sleep. Worse working night shifts. Worse irregular sleep patterns. Worse
sleeping with lights on. Worse during winter.
Rectum - Constipation.
Sleep - Daytime drowsiness. Insomnia.
Severe sleepdisorders. Sleep deprivation. Altered sleep patterns. Sleep with lights on or work late hours,
night shifts. Vivid dreams. Nightmares.
Stomach - Nausea. Vomiting.
RELATIONS - Compare: Cocc., Care., Luna., Coff., Nux-v., Sep.
REFERENCES - Murphy.

name: Melilotus Officinalis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - meli. Melilotus officinalis. Sweet clover. Yellow clover. Melilotus alba. White and yellow
varieties. N. O. Leguminose. Papilionoideae. Tincture of whole fresh plant in flower. It would be well to include
a specimen of both plants in the tincture. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Blushing. Congestion. Coughs. Debility. Delusions. Dysmenorrhea. Epilepsy. Fears.
Hemoptysis. Headaches. Hemorrhages. Insanity. Leucorrhea. Neuralgia. Nosebleeds. Ovaries, neuralgia.
Pneumonia. Rheumatic pain. Shyness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Meli, was first proved by Bowen in 1851. A second proving was made by him fifteen years
later. He used both the yellow and the white varieties.
H. C. Allen published a further proving of Meli, alba, using the entire plant. His proving entirely confirmed
Bowen's and added many symptoms.
According to Allen the action of Meli, lasted about thirty days, the indolence and prostration being the first
symptom to appear and the last to disappear. Congestions especially to the head, and profuse, bright red,
hemorrhage which gives relief. Engorgements of any part or organ. Violent congestive and nervous
headaches.
Pain and debility. Coldness, but also increase of temperature, tenderness and pain. Muscular system
depressed. Spasms, eclampsia, convulsions. Epilepsy, from blow on head. Infantile spasms. Tired, bruised, ■
listless, sleepy, chilly. Feeling of rawness.
Dreams and emissions.
MIND - Irritable, impatient, discontented, faultfinding. Indolent. Unable to fix mind, stupid indifferent. Total
inability to study, memory will not retain anything. Omits words and letters in writing.
Shyness and blushing. Attacks of weeping without much depression. Religious melancholy with intensely red
face. Wants to kill himself or threatens to kill who approach. Furious, had to lock him in room. Loss of
consciousness.
Panic and fear. Fear of talking loudly, she whispers. Fear of danger. Fear of being arrested. Wants to go
home. Wants to run away and hide. Suspicious. Delusions, thinks everyone is looking at her, fears to talk loud.
Abdomen - Much distention, flatulent, worse during menses.
Back - Broken sensation in lumbo-sacral joint, on sitting and especially sitting upright. Constantly changes
position to get relief, wants to strike the part or press it, better standing or walking.
Chest - Weight on chest causing difficult breathing, sensation of smothering, frequently examined clothes to
see if they were not too tight.
Ears - Sensation of puffing of wind from ears. Each act of swallowing caused the wind to puff from both ears.
Eyes - Hot, heavy, blurred sight, wants to close them tightly for relief. As if they were too large. Eyes as if
pressed outward. Eyelids very heavy. Vision dim, blurred, rubs eyes. Unable to focus. Floating bodies before
eyes when studying.
Face - Intensely red and flushed with throbbing carotids and headache (Bell.). Very red before
hemorrhages from nose, lungs, uterus. Face hot, flushed, all day, feverish.
Female - Leucorrhea, pain and soreness in back and pelvic region, excited by walking. Menses scanty,
intermittent, with nausea and bearing down pains. Menses thin, watery, pale offensive. Dysmenorrhea. During
menses, headache, bearing-down pain in pelvis. Recurring, sharp, darting pain in vagina and vulva at close of
menses. Severe stitches or cutting pains through uterus. Ovarian neuralgia. Sticking pain in external parts.
Food - Ravenous about 10 a.m. with onset of frontal headache. Appetite capricious, especially in morning,
impaired.
Head - Rushes of blood to head. Fullness all over head. Violent, throbbing, nervous and periodical
headaches. Congestive headaches. Headaches are better nosebleed, menstrual flow, application of vinegar.
Sick headache, relieved by nosebleed or menstrual flow. Headache with retching, vomiting, black spots
 before eyes. Neuralgia around and over right side of head and neck. Scalp sore and tender to touch.
Headache alternating with backache.
Kidneys - Frequent and profuse urination. Urine profuse, watery and relieving the dull, congestive headache.
Limbs - Skin and limbs cold. Joints sore. Stiff and sore on rising, better by careful movement. Rheumatic pains
in joints on approach of rain-storm or in rainy, changeable weather. Uneasy sensation in large joints.
Numbness and aching in knee joints, right then left. Gnawing, throbbing in right knee joint, wants to stretch
leg, but
does not relieve. Arms heavy, too much prostrated to lift them without effort.
Lungs - Smothering sensations, cannot get air enough, from rapid walking. Cough harsh, dry, spasmodic,
horribly distressing. Cough from fullness of chest better by nosebleed. Hemoptysis, blood bright red.
Modalities - Better from bleeding, profuse urination, vinegar application. Worse rainy, changeable weather,
approach of storm. Worse motion, walking, 4 p.m., menopause.
Nose - Profuse and frequent nosebleeds, bright red blood with general relief. Nosebleed with high fever and
violent congestion of head and face. Stopped up, dry, must breathe through mouth. Excessive dryness of
nose, obstructed. Dry, hard clinkers in nose.
Rectum - Difficult, painful, constipated. Severe shooting cutting in rectum while walking, better sitting down.
Anus feels constricted, full, throbs. No desire until there is alarge accumulation (Bry., Alum.). Very difficult,
painful stool with constriction in rectum. Discharge of stringy, glassy, milk-white mucus. Heavy throbbing
and fullness in rectum from internal hemorrhoids.
Skin - Dry skin. Tendency to bruise and bleed easily.
Sleep - Drowsy, sleepy, stupid. Alternate sleep and wakefulness through night. Awakes regularly a few
minutes before 3 a.m. Insomnia, cannot sleep after 3 a.m. Head seemed too high (although he had no pillow).
Sleep prevented by unpleasant thoughts coursing through brain. Unpleasant dreams, of bickering.
Stomach - Gastric discomfort, flatulence, fullness and other symptoms appear when constipated. Acid
belchings all day, causing burning and smarting.
Temperature - Chilly 10 a.m., begins in back, loins or occiput, passing in waves up to vertex. Chilly 12 p.m. to
1 p.m. with sharp pains in cardiac region of stomach and much flatulence. Chilly all forenoon. Uncomfortably
chilly, feet and hands colds.
Throat - Throat sore, left side, swallowing difficult, painful. Tickling in throat with cough.
Vertigo - Vertigo worse on moving.
COMMENTS - Characteristic engorgement. Blood engorgement. Tending to hemorrhages, profuse, bright red,
which give relief. Intensely red or even purple face attending any disorder.
Headaches with blushing and nosebleed. Headaches better by lying down, profuse urination, application of
vinegar. Headaches more often in hot weather, worse after exposure or getting feet wet, on approach of storm,
in rainy, changeable weather. Sensation of waving in the brain.
Alternation of pains, from right temple to right knee, pains in head alternating with pains in back. Marked
periodicity. Generally better sitting, worse from walking, but pain in sacral region is opposite. Symptoms appear
in the forenoon and wear off during the day. Relieved by discharges.
Bowen used Meli, successfully in all kinds of congestive or nervous headaches, nasal and pulmonary
hemorrhages, congestion of spinal cord, pleura, lungs, ovaries, menstrual colic, palpitation and nervousness,
cramps in stomach, spasms, convulsions and for relieving brain-pressure and irritation in insanity. He always
gave it in pellets medicated with the 1c dilution.
In different cases, Bowen removed symptoms including a desire to run away, to hide, insists that everyone is
looking at them. Mania to escape and kill himself, with insomnia. Nervous and timid. Dares not talk loudly,
whispers. Vicious, threatens to kill those who approach. Thinks there is a devil in his stomach contradicting all
he says.
H. C. Allen relieved with Meli, a fear of danger, fear of being arrested in mental cases.
In a schoolboy, Clarke cured with Meli. 30c a very distressing recurrent headache, accompanied by an
intensely red face while the pain was on and with the same potency. Clarke gave great relief in a case of
melancholia in a young woman.
C. F. Barker recorded the case of Miss X, 19, tall, blonde, for several years had severe, nervous and congestive
headaches. The attacks recurred two to four times a month and were so severe that they compelled her to
keep to her bed twenty-four hours.
The pain, mostly in temples and forehead, was a congested, full sensation with flushed face, drowsy, stupid
feeling and sometimes much nausea.
Trivial things seemed to provoke the attacks. Spectacles had been supplied by oculists and teeth freshly
stopped by dentists, diet, rest from study and outdoor exercise had all failed to relieve. Meli. 4x was given and
 she had only two attacks in six months and those very slight.
A writer in Hom. News tells of a Frenchman who came to him complaining of an incessant headache so bad
that he thought he would die. A dose of Meli, was given on the spot and the doctor, thinking Nux-v. indicated,
went into the next room to get it.
He returned in five minutes and found the patient on his hands and knees shaking his head. The doctor,
thinking him crazy, asked what he was doing. He replied that the pain was entirely gone and he was only trying
various attitudes and motions to make sure.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Meli-a„ the white clover - has practically the same action. Hemorrhages,
congestive headaches,engorged blood vessels. (2) spasms: Bell., Amyl, Glon. and Sang, in congestive
headaches (but Bell, has worse lying down and worse from ap- plication of vinegar cloths). (3) In nosebleed
after headache, Ant-c. (but with Ant-c. the nosebleed does not necessarily relieve). (4) Waving in brain, Cimic.
(5) Rheumatic pains better moving, Rhus-t. (6) Hemoptysis, bright blood, Ip., Mill. (7) Discomfort from constipa-
tion, Op. (8) Congested head and nosebleed, Erig. (9) Red face with throbbing carotids, Bell. (10) Trif-r.
REFERENCES - Allen. Boericke. Bowen. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Melissa Officinalis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - melis. Melissa officinalis. Lemon balm. Bee balm. Sweet balm. N. O. Labiatae. North Africa.
Europe. Tincture from fresh leaves picked just before flowering. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Colds. Depression. Headaches. Herpes. Indigestion. Influenza. Insomnia. Nerves.
HERBAL - Avicenna recommended Melissa as a heart tonic, to make the heart merry and to lift the spirit. The
volatile oil has a sedative effects in small doses that is soothing to the nerves. Melissa oil is has been used in
aromatherapy for anxiety, nervousness, depression, insomnia and tension headaches. Infusions of lemon balm
after meals eases the digestion.
Melissa oil helps with all kinds of allergies. Cold sores and herpes. Hot infusions have been used for treating
colds and flus by inducing sweating. Depression, headaches and indigestion. Headaches and restlessness.
REFERENCES - Potter.

name: Melitagrinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - melit. Melitagrinum. Nosode of eczema capitis. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Crusta lactea. Eczema capitis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Skinner gave a brief account of this nosode introduced by him in Hom. World, xvii. 89.
He prepared fluxional centesimal potencies from the lymph and blood of a case of eczema capitis.
Dr. Theobald treated cases with Melit. Very severe cases were cured with Melit. 100,000c potency, given in
single doses at considerable intervals. In one case, there was an initial aggravation.
REFERENCES Clarke.

name: Menispermum Canadense
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - menis. Menispermum canadense. Moonseed. Yellow parilla. N. O. Menispermacae. Tincture
of root. Trituration ofMenisperminum. Historicaldose: Tincture, trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Backache. Dryness? Headaches. Itching. Spine, pain. Tongue, swelling.
HOMEOPATHIC - Menis, is botanically related to Cocc. and the backache recalls the spinal action of the latter,
but the Cocc. vertigo and intoxication were not elicited. Very considerable doses were taken in the proving of
Menis.
The most notable symptom was an intense headache combined with aching all down the back. Megrim,
associated with restlessness and dreams. Yawning and stretching were also a marked and frequent
concomitant of headache and backache.
Dryness, itching all over (Cocc.). Dry mouth and throat. Pain in spine. Legs sore as if bruised with pain in
bones. The pains were like those caused by large doses of quinine and were better by Chin. Restless, troubled
and confused dreams, sudden starting from sleep.
MIND - Laziness, absent minded. Low-spirited, but attends to business rapidly. Quicktempered.
Abdomen - Pain in umbilical region.
Back - Pain in whole length of back, with intense headache, yawning and stretching.
Eyes - Eyes feel dry and swollen during the night.
Face - Face hot. Pimples on face, bleed easily.
 Head - Headaches. Sick headache, pain in forehead and temples, moving to occiput. Pressure from within
outward, with stretching, yawning and pain down back.
Kidneys - Urine is high-colored and scanty, yellow, white thready clouds floating through.
Limbs - Pain in back, thighs, elbows, shoulders. Legs sore, as if bruised. Aching in thighs, elbows and
shoulders in external muscles of thigh and upper arm, also under left scapula.
Lungs - Hurried respiration during the night. Morning expectoration less and of lighter color.
Modalities - Better walking in open air. Worse at night, warmth of bed.
Mouth - Tongue coated yellow, thicker at back with raised papilla, dry and parched, swollen, as if burnt. Much
saliva. Mouth and throat dry during night.
Nose - Much sneezing. Discharge of nasal mucus, excoriating. Nostrils dry, especially the left, itch painfully,
are sore.
Rectum - Tenesmus with regular stool.
Skin - Chilly. Skin cold and dry with some itching. Itching all over body, especially buttocks, worse warmth of
bed.
Sleep - Yawning and stretching with backache and headache. Starting from sleep. Dreams of innumerable
rats which creep under clothes, of cannonading. Sleeps late and heavy in morning, disinclined to rise.
Stomach - Appetite and thirst increased. Some nausea on waking.
Throat - Throat dry and parched without soreness.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Bry., Chin. Compare: (1) Cocc., Bry.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Mentha Piperita
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - menth. Mentha piperita. Peppermint. N. O. Labiate. Brandy mint. Curled mint. Balm mint.
Tincture of whole plant. Dilutions of the essence. Essential oil. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Aphonia. Colds. Coughs. Dyspepsia. Flatulence. Headaches. Hoarseness. Indigestion.
Influenza. Itching. Stomach, pains. Throat, sore. Voice, weakness.
HERBAL - Demeures gave it to singers a short time before singing and it greatly helped them to hold the voice.
HOMEOPATHIC - A remarkable proving of Menth. was made by Demeures, who took a single drop of the
tincture, the effects of which lasted into the third month. After the proving, Demeures found that he could rise
earlier than usual and yet feel bright and fresh, whereas before it he could not.
Marked action on respiratory organs and skin. Stimulates the cold perceiving nerves so just after taking it a
current of air at the ordinary temperature seems cold. Herpes zoster.
Broncho-tracheal catarrh and diseases of the skin. Dry cough, excited by air entering larynx, exposure to cold,
reading aloud, shocks of any kind. Irritation in the suprasternal fossa. Dry, spasmodic cough which is worse in
cold weather, and following the influenza.
Stomach pain, flatulence, flatulent colic and hysteria, with nausea and vomiting. Deranged digestion. Vaginal
pruritus.
MIND - Mental dullness, which follows early morning rising. Insensible. Confusion of mind. Eager for work,
dispatches it quickly.
Back - Muscles around neck are painful to touch.
Ears - All day when walking, shooting from one ear to the other, as if abscesses were forming, worse left.
When writing, sharp lancinations extend from left ear to left teeth.
Eyes - Flashes before eyes when writing.
Head - Headache with tension toward both ears, worse on rising, better returning to bed. Acute lancinations
from ear to head, on stooping or turning head. Frontal headache from one temple to the other. Hair ceases to
fall out.
Limbs - Sensation under right foot at extremity of metatarsus, as if shoe sole was too tight there.
Lungs - Frequent coughs and colds. Dry cough, excited by merely speaking, expectoration every morning
of thick mucus like the core of a boil. Dry cough continues, not caused by titillation or mucus accumulations in
the bronchi, but merely by the passage of air into the larynx. Cough excited from least feeling of cold, reading
aloud, and smoke of all kinds.
Modalities - Better lying down in bed, while eating. Worse early rising, cold air, smoke. Worse stooping, turning
head, reading aloud, writing.
Mouth - Very severe toothache in lower molars when chewing a bit of sugar.
Nose - Tip of nose sore to touch, swollen but not painful.
Skin - Every scratch becomes a sore. Pimples with much itching near left ear with heat in part. Frequent itching
 behind right ear. Formication in arm and hand when writing.
Sleep - Sleep good, refreshing. Waking early.
Stomach - Indigestion. In evening, two hours after dinner, weight in stomach which seems to extend to ears.
Throat - Entire trachea from larynx to pit of throat painful to touch. Throat dry and painful on swallowing, as if
a pin stuck crosswise in pharynx. Momentary lancinations in parotids, better during breakfast and dinner.
Throat externally painfully sensitive to touch. Husky voice from reading aloud.
COMMENTS - A case of fatal poisoning with the essence is on record. The patient, a boy of six took between
1 and 2 ounces and died in two hours. When seen, he was insensible, eyes fixed, pupils were fixed, stertorous
breathing, cold skin and the lips were livid.
Demeures said he cured with Menth. every case of influenza that came under his care in the winter of 1847-
8. “It is to dry cough, however caused, what Arn. is to injuries and Aeon, to inflammatory complaints. It relieves
even the cough of tuberculosis patients.” A single globule of the 30c sufficed.
Gibson Millerrelated the case of a teacher, 43, who had a dry, spasmodic cough, worse in cold weather since
whooping cough in boyhood. The inhalation of the smallest quantity of smoke, either of coal, wood or tobacco,
at once induced a most distressing paroxysm.
Worse by the least breath of air or any fog. Scarcely any expectoration. Husky on attempting to sing.
Menth. 30c completely removed the cough and enabled him to sit in a room full of tobacco smoke and sing
with clearness.
Hansen commended it in bilious colic with great accumulation of gas, severe pain of shingles and as an
external remedy in itching of the vagina.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) The labiates. (2) worse from smoke, Ign. (3) worse fog, Hyper.
(4) worse rising, better lying down, Bry. (5) worse from cold air, Rumx.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Mentha Pulegium
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - menth-pu. Mentha pulegium. English pennyroyal. European pennyroyal. N. O. Labiate. Tincture
of plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Faintness. Headaches. Itching. Rheumatic, pains. Salivation, nocturnal.
HERBAL - Pennyroyal is a common herbal remedy used for menstrual disorders. It is a popular herb for the
uterus and acts painlessly and without much irritation or forcing down. Cooper noted that it often causes
faintness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Berridge's provings with the 40th potency were all made on men, so its properties in the
female sexual sphere remain untested. His proving brought out an affinity for the right side of the head, right
eye and left kidney, shoulder and hand.
Jerkings of whole body directly after waking. Rheumatic pains flying about, chiefly on the right side. Sensation
as of blood circulating quicker than usual. The symptoms were all worse when thinking of them.
Abdomen - Severe cutting pains in left groin and side while sitting. Sharp pains in the right hypochondrium,
sometimes in middle of sternal region.
Back - Bruised, stiff feeling in small spot, upper part of right scapula with aching and empty feeling in right side
of head. Sharp, cutting pains in region of left kidney, shooting up left side to left chest, better getting up.
Chest - Woke on right side and as soon as he had turned to left, sharp cutting pain in right chest for two
minutes.
Female - Popular for the uterus, acts painlessly and without much irritation or forcing down.
Head - Aching in bones of forehead and sides of head, worse right after sunset. Headache in right forehead,
forcing tears from right eye. Headache in right temple with pressing behind eyes, first right then both, worse
towards evening and in night. Empty feeling in right side of head. Itching all around base of skull and roots of
hair.
Limbs - Pinching pain in bones of legs and arms, chiefly right, better by a night's rest. Two sudden successive
jerks upward of left shoulder and upper arm while lying on left side. Unable to hold a jug with left hand when
pouring out water, hand trembles.
Mouth - Flow of saliva from left (side lain on) corner of mouth in night, waking him.
Sleep - Veins swollen at night, troublesome dreams.
Temperature - General creeping chilliness over back and half-way down front of left thigh.
Throat - Stitches down left eustachian tube into left side of throat, better pressing under left ear.
Vertigo - Faintness.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Hedeo., Menth. (2) In worse by thinking of symptoms, Pip- m., Ox-ac.
 REFERENCES-Clarke.

name: Mentha Viridis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - menth-v. Mentha viridis. Spearmint. N. O. Labiate. Mackerel mint. Mentha spicata. Mentha
crispa. Peamint. Yerba buena. Mint. Tincture of whole plant. Dilutions of the essence. Essential oil. Historical
dose: Tincture and all potencies.
HERBAL - Spearmint is a simple but efficient diuretic and febrifuge. Stimulant, carminative, antispasmodic.
Cases when
the urine is scanty and there is a frequent desire to urinate. Use the infusion freely. This herb is added to many
compounds on account of its carminative properties and its pleasant taste.
COMMENTS - Parkinson commended a decoction of spearmint to wash the hands of children when suffering
from scabs and blotches.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) The labiates. (2) Menth-p., Menth.
REFERENCES - Blackwood. Potter.

crispa. Peamint. Yerba buena. Mint. Tincture of whole plant. Dilutions of the essence. Essential oil. Historical
dose: Tincture and all potencies.
HERBAL - Spearmint is a simple but efficient diuretic and febrifuge. Stimulant, carminative, antispasmodic.

the urine is scanty and there is a frequent desire to urinate. Use the infusion freely. This herb is added to many

name: Mentholum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - menthol. Mentholum. Menthol. The stearopten from the essential oil of peppermint. Historical
dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Aphonia. Asthma. Cardialgía. Catarrh. Colic. Coryza. Coughs. Eustachian catarrh. Headaches.
Itching. Laryngitis. Migraine. Neuralgias. Pharyngitis. Pruritus, vulvae. Toothache. Vaginismus.
HERBAL - Menthol is anti-neuralgic, antispasmodic, sedative and a local anesthetic. Locally used for facial
neuralgia and migraine. Cardialgía. Gastric and intestinal catarrh. Abdominal fermentation occurring in the
stomach or intestines. Colicky pains and vomiting. Toothache. Pruritus vulvae. Vaginismus.
HOMEOPATHIC - Menthol, has proved curative in acute nasal catarrh, in acute Eustachian catarrh,
pharyngitis, laryngitis and neuralgias. Affects the mucus membrane of the naso-pharynx and spinal nerve
plexus. Neurotic pains and paresthesia. Itching, especially pruritus vulvae.
MIND - Mental confusion.
Abdomen - Intestinal catarrh. Abdominal fermentation occurring in the intestines. Colicky pains and vomiting.
Back - Muscular pain in cervical region. Soreness of lumbar muscles.
Chest - Cardialgía. Stabbing pains in the précordia, radiating over entire chest.
Ears - Eustachian tubes feel blocked and some deafness.
Eyes - Pain in eyeballs. Supra orbital pain over left eye.
Face - Neuralgia. Pain in face above zygoma with numbness.
Female - Pruritus vulvae. Vaginismus.
Head - Migraine. Headaches. Frontal headache, pain over frontal sinus, descends to eyeballs.
Lungs - Short, dry cough, worse smoking. Asthmatic breathing with congestive headache.
Mouth - Toothache.
Nose - Coryza with post-nasal dripping. Cold sensation in nose.
Stomach - Gastric catarrh. Fermentation occurring in the stomach. Colicky pains and vomiting.
Throat - Aphonia. Laryngitis. Tickling in the fauces. Pharyngitis.
COMMENTS - Externally for itching, use a 1 percent solution or ointment.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Kali-bi., Spig.
REFERENCES - Boericke.

name: Menyanthes Trifoliata
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - meny. Menyanthes trifoliata. Buckbean. Bitterklee. Bog bean. N. O. Gen- tianacee. Tincture of
whole plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amaurosis. Chest, disorders. Chilly. Cold. Cramps. Diabetes. Dyspnea. Fidgets. Headache.
Heart, pains. Intermittent, fever. Jerkings. Malaria. Paralysis. Tinnitus.
HERBAL - The Buck-bean, or “Bog-bean” as it is also called in Ireland and Lincolnshire, is a water plant and
abounds in the fen districts, where it is in great local repute as a remedy for malaria.
HOMEOPATHIC - Hahnemann proved it and well defined its sphere of action. The major features of Meny.
are chill, sensations and pains of tension and compression, and spasmodic jerkings and visible twitchings,
worse during rest and may be associated with neuralgia.
 Tensive and compressive pains. Tension in skin, as if it was several sizes too small and he was crowded into
it.
Shooting pains and pinching in limbs and joints, in arthritic disorders.
Jerking pain in outer parts, also pinching pain in outer parts. Spasmodic jerking and visible twitchings with
neuralgia. Jumpy, fidgety women with urinary troubles. Diabetes.
Great general debility, on walking often accompanied by shivering. Icy coldness of single or affected parts,
nose, ears, fingers, knees, abdomen etc. Intermittent fever, coldness predominates, felt most acutely in
abdomen and legs and tip of nose. Certain headaches.
MIND - Hurried. Anxiety and apprehension. Anxiety as if something evil were going to happen. Fear about the
heart, driving him from place to place. Buffoonery and excessive gaiety.
Confusion, better open air. Dullness of mind. Indifference to everything, alternating with great joy. Aversion to
amusement. Discontented with everything, with self. Dwells on past disagreeable occurrences. Taciturn and
self-reflecting. Tearful sadness.
Abdomen - Distended and full, increased by smoking tobacco. Distention of abdomen by abundant flatus.
Coldness, worse pressing upon it with hand. Pinchings in abdomen. Pain, as from excoriation in abdominal
tissues.
Back - Rigidity and heaviness in muscles of neck, throat and nape. Extremely painful tearing between the
scapula, extending downwards. Boring at scapula (left). Bruised pain in sacrum, worse stooping, walking.
Causations - Injuries to nerves (tooth broken in). Quinine.
Chest - Shooting compression on both sides of chest. Stitches in chest, worse during motion and when
breathing. Aching in chest after dinner.
Ears - Tinnitus, when chewing. Tinkling in ears. Cracking in ear, when chewing. Shootings in ears. Feeling of
coldness in ear. Discharge from ears (after exanthemata).
Eyes - Frequent spasmodic stiffness of eyelids. Pressing in eyes. Mist and flick- erings before eyes. Cloudiness
of eyes, when reading.
Face - Redness and heat of face during sleep. Heat in face with coldness of feet. Visible twitching of the facial
muscles, worse rest. Pain and cracking in the articulation of jaw when chewing.
Food - Ravenous hunger, passing away after eating a little. Troublesome confusion in head after a meal.
Desire for meat. Aversion to bread and butter. No thirst at any time.
Head - Bursting headache, pain ascends from nape, better stooping, sitting bent. Heavy, pressing pain in
vertex, better hard pressure with hand. Sensation as of weight in nape. Weight pressing on brain with every
step on ascending. As if cold wind blowing on it.
Heart - Stitches in region of heart. Slightest exertion causes irregular action. Drawing pain in précordia, worse
after eating. Anxiety about, as if some evil was going to happen.
Kidneys - Frequent desire to urinate with scanty urine.
Limbs - Cramp-like pains in limbs. Cramps in posterior thighs worse sitting. Cramps from ankles to calf (right).
Legs jerk and twitch, worse lying down. Shocks and convulsive movements in thighs. Paralytic tearing and
spasmodic drawings in arms, hands and fingers. Icy coldness of hands and feet.
Lungs - Stitch in anterior regions of larynx, impeding swallowing. Dyspnea. Spasmodic contraction of larynx
with excitation to cough, when drawing breath.
Male - Increase of sexual desire without excitement or erection. Both testicles drawn up, right more than left.
Spermatic cord painful to touch.
Modalities - Better hard pressure on affected part, laying on hand, stooping, motion, twilight. Worse light,
noise, during rest, walking, ascending, jar.
Mouth - Sweetish bitterness in mouth. Sensation of paralysis on left side of palate, when yawning and
coughing.
Nose - Cold. Tension in root of nose. Nauseous smell before nose like that of rotten eggs.
Perspiration - Perspiration in evening as soon as he lies down, continuing all night.
Rectum - Constipation. Hard feces with pinchings in the abdomen. Bleeding, hemorrhoids.
Skin - Feels tight.
Sleep - Agitated sleep with vivid dreams. Doesn't remembered dreams.
Stomach - Sensation of coldness extending up esophagus with great nausea, following pressure in stomach.
Heat in stomach, followed by excessive hunger. Contractive cramps in stomach. Continual rumbling in
stomach, as if it were empty. Frequent empty belchings.
Temperature - Predominance of cold. Icy coldness of hands and feet. Shivering with yawning. Chill, which is
better by heat of stove and only remains in back. Intermittent fever with coldness in abdomen. Pulse slow
during cold stage and accelerated during fever. Heat in evening, mostly on head with cold feet. Quartan
 malaria.
Throat - Dryness of palate, stinging when swallowing. Dryness and roughness in throat, which impede
swallowing of saliva, without thirst. When speaking hoarse and rough voice with obstruction of ears, as if
something had been introduced into them.
COMMENTS - Teste, who also proved it, found it very similar to Dros. Both these drugs caused in him, as one
of the first symptoms, obscuration of sight, a sort of white mist or vibrations, worse in open air or during a walk.
This was so intense that he did not dare to cross a street.
The pains of Dros. and Meny. were the same in character, but those of Dros. were more intense. This analogy
has not proved as close in other respects as Teste imagined it would.
“Jumps,” “fidgets,” and “urinary difficulties in women” are Burnett's leading indications. “
When sitting, the outstretched thigh and leg are four times spasmodically jerked up, but when standing or in
drawing up the knees towards him, this is not perceptible.”
Twitching in any part. Legs jerk and twitch, cannot rest when lying down. Stitches, numbness, tension. Tension
sensation, as if the skin were several sizes too small. Cramp-like and paralyzing pains.
Severe pressure in the head. Pressing in vertex from above downwards, better during hard pressure with the
hand, when ascending stairs, as of a heavy weight pressing on the head and brain at every step. Icy coldness
of the hands and feet with the headache.
R. Farley reported the case of Miss D. W., long a sufferer from spinal irritation, had terrible attacks of bursting
headache, a terrible tension in membranes of brain in paroxysms, which caused her to scream. Began in right
side of nape, ascended to forehead and then spread over whole brain.
Terrible sensation of loneliness with the pain, begged her mother to stay with her. Worse from light, noise, jar,
even if one walked lightly across the room. Better from sitting bent and by hard pressure on nape and vertex.
Meny. 30c every ten minutes relieved immediately and completely removed everything in two hours.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Camph. It antidotes: Effects of quinine and Chin. Compare: (l)Caps.. Puls.,
Calc., Ph-ac., Sang. (2) worse ascending, Calc. (3) Headache better hard pressure, Verat. (4) Weight on vertex
at every step, Cact., Glon., Lach. (5) Intermittent fever with cold limbs, Lach, (but Lach, has livid skin, great
prostration andfiliformpulse). (6) Icy coldfeet and legs, Calc., Gels. (7) Bursting headache pushing skull open,
Sil. (Sil. better warmth, Meny. better pressure). (8) Pressive headache, Puls., Par., Mag-m. (9) Fidgets, Psor.,
Caust., Zinc. (10) the gentians. Compatible after: Cupr., Lach., Lyc., Puls., Rhus-t., Verat.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Mephitis Putorius
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - meph. Mephitis putorius. Skunk secretion. Mephitis mephitica. Mus- tela foetida. Mustelina. N.
O. Mustelide. Alcoholic dilution of the liquid contained in the anal glands. Historical dose: Tincture and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Asthma. Blindness. Choking. Coldness. Convulsions. Coughs. Debility. Exhaustion. Eyes,
disorders. Laryngismus. Otalgia. Rheumatic, pains. Spasms. Trembling. Vertigo. Vision, weak. Whooping
cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - The dilutions of this medicine are prepared from the Equid contained in the anal glands of
skunk. Meph. was proved by Hering in the 30c. Should be given in the lower dilutions.
Meph. produced a suffocative feeling and spasmodic cough. Cough so violent, seems as if each spell would
terminate life. Whooping cough. Child must be raised up, gets blue in face, cannot exhale. Mucus rales
through upper part of chest. Asthmatic attacks.
Spasmodic effects. Trembling and choking with exophthalmos. Convulsions. Sensation of paralysis during the
pains. Rheumatic pains. Shifting pains with want to urinate. Fine vibrations causing great uneasiness. Internal
agitation of whole body with sensation of uneasiness.
Nervous exhaustion. Debility after severe illness. Great dejection and lassitude during which the muscles are
painful when touched or exercised. Indolence with desire to stretch and stretching. Wants to bathe in ice cold
water.
MIND - Excitement with heat in head. Talkative. Can neither sleep nor work. Unfit for intellectual labor, caused
by too lively an imagination. Full of fancies. Excessive loquacity, as from drinking too much. Disinclination to
work with inclination to stretch. Dejection with painful muscles. Ill-humor about trifles or imaginary troubles.
Abdomen - Pains in hypochondria. Aching and movements in abdomen, as if caused by a chill. Pains in
abdomen in evening.
Pains as from flatulency in left side. Aching in region of liver in with colic. Colic, as from diarrhea, but without
evacuation.
 Back - Pain and a sort of paralysis in back and in all limbs. Lancination in spine during motion. Pains in right
side of neck. Tension in muscles of nape. Contusive pains in loins in morning.
Chest - Pains in chest when touching it. Chest pains when coughing and sneezing.
Cough - Spasmodic coughs or whooping cough. Cough, violent suffocative, spasmodic, nervous,
worse at night, talking, loud reading, or drinking. Cough hollow, deep with rawness, hoarseness and pains
through chest. Whooping or any kind of cough which is very violent, coming on spasmodically, and seeming
as if each spell would terminate life. Cough with vomiting after eating. Loose cough, in morning, with some
expectoration.
Ears - Otalgia. Itching heat, redness, blisters and erysipelas in the external part of the (right) ear. Tearing in
the ears or in the jaw and teeth.
Eyes - Heat, burning and aching in eyes, morning and evening. As if fire in eyes. Conjunctiva red, eyes hot
and painful. Injection of veins in sclerotica. Lancination in eyes like the pricking of needles. Pain from
overexertion, blur, unable to distinguish letters. Inability to read fine print. Myopia. Nocturnal blindness.
Face - Bloated. Child gets blue in face and can't exhale with spasmodic cough.
Female - Burning leucorrhea. Excoriation of genital organs and swelling of labia majora. Soreness of genitals.
Swelling of labia and uterus.
Food - Hunger, alternating with absence of appetite. Absence of appetite in morning and repugnance to
tobacco-smoke. Painful weariness and desire to sleep after a meal. Desire for salted food.
Head - Violent pain in head as if a fullness were pressing upwards. Violent headache with sensation of fullness,
as if caused by a weight or by pressure, especially in the occiput. Pain above eyes. Headache from motion of
carriage.
Kidneys - Frequent want to make water, especially at night, with emission of clear urine. The urine becomes
turbid in morning, and deposits a sediment in evening after an attack of fever.
Limbs - Drawing and rheumatic pains in thighs, hip and foot, but chiefly in leg. Contusive pains in knee.
Rheumatic pains in arms with paralytic drawings, better by movement. Uneasiness in arm, as it were
insensible. Trembling in arm on resting upon it. Jerking in hand.
Lungs - Dyspnea and cannot exhale. False croup and cannot exhale. Sudden contraction of glottis, when
drinking or talking. Asthma, as if inhaling sulphur. Asthma, has to sit up in bed, worse ice water. Asthma of
consumptives or alcoholics. Foul expectoration.
Male - Itching in scrotum. Heat in genital organs.
Modalities - Better from cold, icy, weather. Better bathing, sitting up, motion. Worse night, daybreak, morning,
lying down , rest, touch, after menses, ice water.
Mouth - Metallic, coppery taste, as after eating onions. Foul breath. Painful jerks in root of teeth. Bloated face.
Nose - Dryness of the nose. Nosebleeds. Fluent coryza with pain, as from excoriation in the chest. Prolonged
inclination to sneeze.
Rectum - Evacuations infrequent, but liquid. Diarrhea.
Skin - Pimples on thighs, forehead, face, neck and nates.
Sleep - Short nap, seems to refresh. Awakes at night with rush of blood to lower legs. Vivid dream of water,
fire.
Stomach - Pressure in stomach, with colic. Belchings, better by discharge of flatus. Sensation of emptiness
in stomach and nausea. Vomits food hours after eating.
Teeth - Drawing and tearing in teeth. Sudden shocks in roots of teeth. Pains in carious teeth, molars, in lower
jaw.
Temperature - Coldness predominates. Less chilly in cold air, cold water is agreeable. Evening chilliness with
desire to urinate. Increased heat in morning.
Mephitis putorius
Throat - Tendency to choke when drinking and speaking. Food goes the wrong way. Nausea with scraping
in throat.
Vertigo - Violent vertigo, worse sitting, turning in bed. Vertigo on stooping suddenly, when moving the head,
when seated.
COMMENTS - Rush of warmth to various parts. Enables patients to endure extreme cold, makes them less
chilly in cold weather. Washing in ice water is pleasant. Awakens at night with congestion of legs. Legs uneasy,
as if they would become insensible. Fidgety feet. Short sleep seems to refresh.
Choking while eating or drinking. Cough on reading aloud, while talking and after drinking, caused by choking.
Lower ribs painful to touch or pressure, especially worse on coughing or sneezing.
Neidhard gave Meph. to “a young man affected with symptoms of tuberculosis,” in whom it produced “a
spasmodic cough with a crowing sound, lasting all night and returning several times.”
 This homeopathic aggravation suggested to Neidhard to use Meph. in whooping cough and his conclusion,
quoted by Hering, notes that “If the facts collected since 1851, which are numerous, do not prove that Meph.
will supersede all other remedies in whooping cough, it certainly may be considered a valuable specific. In
order to ensure its full success, it should be exhibited in the lower dilutions from one to three, at least in severe
cases.”
Guernsey gave it as: “Whooping or any other kind of cough which is very violent, coming on spasmodically
and seeming as though each spell would terminate life.”
Farrington said the note of Meph. is nervous exhaustion. In whooping cough the catarrh is slight, whoop
decided, worse at night and after lying down. Suffocative feeling, cannot exhale, vomits food sometimes hours
after eating. Asthma of alcoholics of tuberculosis patients (after Dros.).
T. M. Stewart reported the case of a man, 47, who had a constant hacking cough coming on during
conversation. For this the uvula was amputated.
When he recovered from the operation he had “Coughs after reading aloud or drinking any fluid, cough
spasmodic, hollow, hoarse, worse at night and on lying down, loose in mornings.” Amb., Cham., Kali-bi.,
Rumx., Phos., failed to relieve, Meph. 1,000c. cured promptly.
A. M. Cushing called attention to the possibilities of the remedy in weak sight and told of a friend of his who
had a dose directly from the skunk injected into his eyes “It was as though fire had entered his eyes.” For a
time he was totally blind, but when his sight returned it was so keen that he could count the panes in a window
said to be two miles distant.
In another case after getting the poison out of the eye, there was for weeks after a sensation on opening the
lids as of breaking glass. On Farrington's advice it was antidoted by Crot-h.
RELATIONS -Antidoted by: Camph., but only temporarily. Crot-h. relieved eye symptoms. Compare:
(l)Dros., Cor-r., Stict. (2) Whooping cough, Cor-r. has smothering before the cough and great exhaustion after.
(3) Dros. has frequent spells of barking cough, worse after twelve midnight, holds sides, vomits if cannot raise
sputa. (4) Cough worse from reading or writing, Aur., Nux-v., Plat. (5) Rumx. - cough at night, worse 2 a.m.,
Stict. with splitting headache. Aur. - awakes at night with congestion to legs. (6) Short sleep seems to refresh,
Fl-ac., Menth. (7) Night blindness, Bell. (8) Aversion to tobacco smoke, Ign. (9) Easy choking, Lach. (
10)Fidgety feet, Tarent., Meny ..Zinc., Caust., Ars., Asaf., Asar., Cimic., Aur. (11) Loquacity, Agar., Lach. (12)
Nervous symptoms generally, Cast-eq., Mosch. Follows well: Dros. (in cough of tuberculosis patients).
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

HOMEOPATHIC - The dilutions of this medicine are prepared from th

name: Mercurialis Perennis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - merl. Mercurialis perennis. Dog mercury. N. O. Euphorbiacae. Tincture of whole fresh plant in
flower. Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amblyopia. Amenorrhea. Asthenopia. Belching. Breast disorders. Colic. Coma. Conjunctivitis.
Diarrhea. Dysmenorrhea. Epiphora. Flatulence. Menses, late. Numbness. Palpitations. Pannus. Ptosis. Rheu
natic disorders. Spleen disorders. Tension. Tongue, paralysis. Trachoma. Vertigo.
HERBAL - Dog's mercury is a common plant with poisonous properties, on account of which it is avoided by
cattle.
HOMEOPATHIC -Meri, wasprovedby Hesse. Like other Euphorbians it has exceedingly acrid properties and
many of its symptoms resemble closely those of the more corrosive salts of mercury.
Meri, has disorders of the muscular tissues, stomach, intestines, and bladder. Great exhaustion and
drowsiness. Feeling of emptiness and weariness in the whole body. Persistent pains in muscles on motion.
Prevalence of burning symptoms, irritation of eyes and nose, tenesmus after stool. Tumor at ensiform
appendix, very sensitive.
Tension. Pain as if a band tied tightly across the forehead. Dragging, especially dragging down in small of
back with rectal pains in groins and thigh as if a hernia might appear. Amenorrhea. Scanty and delayed
menses. Dysmenorrhea, accompanied with orgasm, pains and swelling of breasts.
MIND - Hurry in movements. Excited mood like intoxication. Morose, quarrelsome. Fretful, ill-humored. Fear
of insanity. Indifference to everything. Indifference to external things. Difficulty in collecting his senses. Coma.
Abdomen - Abdominal pulsation. Violent twanging in left hypochondrium. Warmth, gnawing, and pressure in
spleen, worse lying down. Gnawing from pit of stomach to gallbladder. Rumbling, movings and workings in
abdomen, emission of much flatus.
Back - Flushes of heat in back. Aching in nape. Drawing tearing along right scapula, extending into upper arm.
Tensive dragging and dragging tearing in small of back, with anal symptoms.
Causations - Blow on the head.
 Chest - Sticking in left, throbbing in right chest. Pressure and painfulness on chest in forepart and in stomach
with dyspnea.
Eyes - Pain, burning, forcing-out sensation in eyes. Watery eyes. Dilated pupils with great sensitiveness of
eyes to light. Asthenopia, as of a cloud, veil or cobweb before sight. Eyelids feel heavy and dry, difficult to
move them. Weakness of upper lids. Trembling and twitching of upper lids. Blinking of eyes.
Face - Feeling of coldness, tension in face and head. Great redness of cheeks. Lips dry and parched with
increased thirst.
Female - Amenorrhea. Menses scanty and delayed. Menses shorter with abdominal cramp too late. Menses
profuse, violent orgasm of blood, great anxiety so that she nearly fainted, oppressed breathing, heat over
whole body, especially head and face, anxious sweat. Dysmenorrhea, accompanied with orgasm, pains and
swelling of breasts.
Food - Increased thirst with dry lips and mouth. Great dryness in mouth while eating. After eating, biting,
burning on tongue, nausea, vomiting.
Head - Head confused as if inflated. Tension and heaviness of head with sensation of heat. Burning on vertex.
Aching in forehead better by cold and pressure. Shooting in left forehead and temple, worse coming indoors.
Numbness of occiput and vertex after a blow on head. Scalp feels tense and numb, is moved with difficulty.
Heart - Orgasm in the heart region. Constriction. Whirling and rushing, throbbing in heart, stomach and upper
abdomen. Palpitations with oppression, as if chest would be constricted after stooping.
Kidneys - Burning, prickling, crawling in urethra and prepuce, with crawling in anus and tearing and dragging
in small of back. Frequent urging with burning, urination somewhat increased.
Limbs - Tired and weary. Weakness of arms and legs as if she would fall to left without vertigo. Tearing,
stitching, burning and smarting pains in limbs, almost in the skin, especially of hands and feet. Jerking, sticking,
drawing tearings throughout upper limbs. Pressive tearing pain in tibia. Jerking tearing in left patella. Painful
ache in knees.
Liver - Pressure in liver region extending to spleen. Sticking pain in liver.
Lungs - Breath hot, almost burning, lips almost made sore by it. stertorous, difficult breathing, especially right
side.
Male - Dragging in inguinal region, at times sticking pain, worse walking, at times extending down into
spermatic cord, sometimes one, sometimes both.
Modalities - Better by cold. Touch aggravates. Headache worse indoors. Sunlight aggravates the eyes. Open
air causes blinking.
Mouth - Dryness of mouth, difficult to move tongue, impedes chewing. Burning in mouth and tongue.
Nose - Crawling andburning of nose. Sensation of heat rising from stomach into nose. The breath from nose
is cold. Conscious of having a nose, nostrils feel sore. Feels as if she had two noses.
Rectum - Dragging, pressing in rectum, with pressure and tension in small of back. Dragging, burning,
crawling, itching, smarting in anus. Diarrhea with constant colic. Thin stools. Profuse, soft stool followed by
some straining.
Sensations - Heaviness in head as if pressed on pillow with a weight.
Skin - Pimples on chin with biting, itching. Burning, itching, tearing on skin.
Sleep - Frequent yawning and weariness. Dizzy sleepiness. Sleep unrefreshing, full of dreams, of animals.
Stomach - Chilly feeling or burning in stomach. Belching relieves. Vomits food as soon as eaten. Tumor inside
pit of stomach size of hen's egg, worse pressure, cannot bear clothing.
Temperature - Cold over the whole body with hot flush in face. Goosebumps on the cold right arm, extending
over whole
body. Chill on going to bed in evening. Heat with intense thirst, perspiration in morning.
Throat - Burning dryness in throat. Ulcers on palate, tonsils and back of pharynx.
Tongue - Tongue feels heavy and dry, numb, insensible, with loss of taste. Burning blisters on tongue, inside
of lips and cheeks, forming very painful spreading ulcers. Tongue painful if it touches palate as if there were
blisters on it.
Vertigo - Giddiness. Vertigo by going downstairs. Whirling vertigo. Vertigo as if intoxicated, following
headache. Feeling as if body would fall towards left side, when sitting, standing or even lying.
COMMENTS - Cooper said, “Compared with other Euphorbians, it dries up the mucus surfaces, causing
burning locally and a general drowsiness, while the other Euphorbians set up violent irritation and diarrhea
from the first. Moreover, its action is not expended on the skin so soon as that of the others.”
Remarkable dryness of the mouth and throat, even sugar refuses to melt in the mouth. Eating aggravates the
dryness. The breath from the mouth is hot and dries the lips. Hot or cold breath in the nose. Conscious of
having a nose, “she feels as if she has two noses.”
 Head confused as if inflated. Numbness of head and dullness of mind. Vertigo as if intoxicated. Vertigo by
going downstairs. Rolling, throbbing, trembling and orgasm in all the veins. The liver and spleen are influenced,
warmth in spleen. Tension in rectum and back.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Aeon., Bell. Compare: (1) Euph., Croto-t., Acai. (2) In worse descending stairs,
Bor. (3) Straining after stool, Merc. (4) Dragging pains, Lil-t. (5) Numbness of head, Graph, (feels like wood).
(6) Asaf., Caust., Kali-bi., Kreos., Lach., Led., Mag-m., Nat-m., Nat-ac., Nux-v., Nux-m., Rhod., Sulph., Thuj.

author: Murphy

HOMEOPATHIC - Hahnemann made a separate proving of Merc-a. which has furnished a few symptoms, not
greatly differing from those of Merc. Hahnemann noted a symptom referring to the menses which came on at
the new moon, four days before their proper time. The medicines whose action is influenced by the moon's
phases are not numerous and thus worth remembering.
Congestion with stiffness, dryness and heat of parts affected. Lack of moisture. Throat dry, talking difficult.
Throat lancinations, worse by coughing rather than by swallowing. Eyes inflamed, burn and itch.
Tinea capitis favosa, margin of ulcers painful. Chancre in urethra. Inflammation of the penis, worse cold water,
better bathing with tepid water. Pressure in lower sternum and dyspnea on standing erect.
COMMENTS-Hansen said that burning in the urethra during urination and at other times has been confirmed
in practice. He commended it in tinea favosa on a syphilitic base and for sharp pains in tabes syphilitica.
Donner of Stuttgart cured with Merc-a. a very painful syphilitic ulcer in the urethra.

name: Mercurius Corrosivus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - merc-c. Mercurius corrosivus. Corrosive sublimate. Mercuric chloride. Mercurius sublimatus.
Triturations. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Aphthae. Appendicitis. Bladder, disorders. Bones, disorders. Bright's disease.
Burning, pains. Cancrum oris. Chancres. Cystitis. Delirium. Dermatitis. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Eczema.
Edema. Esophagus, stricture. Eye, disorders. Fevers. Gonorrhea. Gums, disorders. Intestinal, fever.
Intestines, ulcerated. Intussusception. Iritis. Jaundice. Kidney, disorders. Labor, pains. Leucorrhea.
Measles. Miscarriage. Mouth, disorders. Mumps. Nephritis. Neuralgias. Paralysis. Paraphimosis. Pemphigus.
Perimetritis. Peritonitis. Phagedenic, ulcers. Photophobia. Prosopalgia. Puerperal, fever. Pyorrhea. Retinitis.
Rigg's disease. Syphilis. Tabes, mesenterica. Taste, disordered. Tenesmus. Throat, inflamed. Tongue,
disorders. Ulcers. Urethritis. Uvula, elongated.
HOMEOPATHIC - Merc-c. is a powerful disinfectant and has a greater rapidity of action than Merc., causing
violent effects. The chief effect of the chlorine element in this salt appears to be to intensify the mercurial
action. The burning of Merc-c. is more intense than other mercury salts.
Inflammation with swelling andfeelings of constriction. Internal burning in the throat, stomach rectum,
neck of bladder and kidneys. Constriction of throat, rectum, bladder. Severe painful cystitis. Bright's disease.
Albuminuria in early pregnancy, (Phos.). Destroys the secreting portions of the kidneys.
Dysentery. Severe tenesmus of the rectum, which is incessant and is not relieved by the stool. Tenesmus
often involves the bladder as well. Dysenteric straining is excessive, for this reason Merc-c. is more generally
prescribed in dysentery than Merc.
Syphilis. Gonorrhea, in the second stage with continuous tenesmus. Phagedenic ulcers. Chancres spread with
great rapidity. Discharges acrid, tears, nasal discharge.
Cracks on palms, soles, corners of mouth. Tibial pains. Lies on back with knees drawn up.
MIND - Restlessness at night. Anxious and restless, rocks back and forth. Anxiety during fever. Anxiety
during sleep after menses. Fear arising from heart. Fear of misfortune. Anguish with pain in abdomen. Ill-
humor. Irritability in daytime.
Absent-mindedness. Confusion of mind. Difficult thinking. Disturbed speech. Wandering thoughts while talking.
Stupid. Imbecility. Mind sluggish with torpid digestion.
 Coma vigil. Stupor. Stares at persons who talk to him and does not understand them. Delirium, springs up
suddenly from bed and escapes. Shouting, brain cry.
Abdomen - Bloated, very painful to least touch. Bruised sensation, cecal region and transverse colon painful.
Stitches in hepatic region. Pain in liver and right shoulder with frequent nausea and obstinate chronic
constipation. Cutting colic, below navel. Painful flatulence. Appendicitis.
Back - Pott's disease, lies on back with knees drawn up. Cervical glands hard and swollen. Dorsal decubitus.
Bladder - Severe, painful cystitis. Tenesmus of bladder. Intense burning in urethra. Stabbing pain up
urethra into bladder. Urethritis. Burning and painful urination. Dribbling of urine, worse sitting. Albuminuria,
during pregnancy, from abuse of alcohol. Urethra bleeds after urinating.
Breasts - Glandular swellings about the nipples. Nipples crack and bleed, pain worse when nursing.
Chest - Constriction of the chest. Stitches through side of chest. Frequent stitches shoot through thorax. All
glands about thorax swollen.
Ears - Violent pulsation in ears. Stitches in ears with inflammation. Fetid pus.
Eyes - Burning, soreness of eyes. Pain severe at night, burning, shooting, tearing. Pain behind eyeballs, as
if forced out. Iritis normal or syphilitic. Iris muddy in color, thick and neither contracts nor dilates. Retinitis,
albuminuria. Deep ulcers on
cornea. Acrid lachrymation. Ophthalmia neonatorum. Excessive photophobia. Objects appear smaller or
double vision. Eyelids edematous red, excoriated.
Face - Red, puffy. Edematous swelling of the face. Yellow face. Face pale and anxious. Pale about mouth.
Cracks in angles of the mouth. Lips, black, dark red, swollen, tender. Upper lip swollen and turned up. Jaws
stiff. Necrosis of lower jaw. Darting pains along upper jaw, gums and roots of teeth. Swelling and tenderness
of submaxillary glands. Facial neuralgia within the bones.
Female - Menses too early and too profuse. Burning heat and pain in genitals. Vaginitis. Urethritis. Mucus
discharge as thin as water. Leucorrhea, pale yellow with sweetish nauseous smell. Fibroid tumors with profuse,
muco-purulent, excoriating leucorrhea. Aching pain succeeding pressing or touching os uteri during sex.
Food - Attacks of violent hunger or no appetite. Great desire for cold food. Worse fat food. Unquenchable
thirst, for cold drinks. Fluids return through nose.
Head - Heaviness of head. Frontal pain, congestion of head with burning in cheeks. Drawing pain in periosteum
of skull. Pain in temples, worse looking sideways. Profuse sweat on forehead. Falling out of hair.
Heart - Tremulous undulating motion of heart, precordial anxiety. Pains in precordial region. Pulse rapid and
intermittent, small, irregular. Palpitations during sleep.
Kidneys - Nephritis. Bleeding kidneys. Gonorrhea. Paraphimosis. Tenesmus of bladder, rectum. Frequent
urine, pale, copious, dribbling, worse sitting. Urine hot, burning, scanty or suppressed. Albuminous urine.
Urine bloody, greenish discharge. Urine brown, with brick dust sediment. Urine contains filaments, flecks or
flesh-like pieces of mucus. Urine contains fibrin or fat globules. Urine passed drop by drop. Urethra bleeds
after urinating. Sweats after urination.
Limbs - Paralysis of limbs, trembling. Pains wandering from joint to joint, compelling him to stay in bed.
Rheumatic pain after suppression of gonorrhea. Coldness in limbs, look purple. Feet icy cold. Cramps in calves
in dysentery. Exostoses, on shin, sternum, ribs. As if legs had gone to sleep. Deltoid feels relaxed.
Lungs - Very difficult breathing. Slow, interrupted breathing. Sighing with palpitations. Burning and stinging in
trachea. Breathes as through a metallic tube. Breathes through pectoral muscles. Cutting pain in larynx. Cough
with bloody expectoration. Greenish mucus, worse at night. Asthmatic coughs, worse talking.
Male - Penis and testes enormously swollen. Chronic balanitis. Paraphimosis. Chordee, worse sleep. Painful
stinging in left testicle. Hard, phagedenic chancres. Greasy, fatty, offensive smelling discharge. Gonorrhea,
discharge thick, greenish. Urethritis. Urethra orifice red, swollen, glans sore and hot. Violent erections during
sleep.
Modalities - Better while at rest. Pain in hip joints better from motion. Worse after urination and stool,
swallowing, acids, fat food. Worse from sex, motion. Worse night, cold, open air, autumn, hot days and cool
nights. Dysentery and summer complaints from May to November.
Mouth - Salivation with salty taste. Metallic taste. Taste, astringent, salty, bitter. Discharge of albuminous
mucus from mouth. Burning, scalding sensation in mouth. Aphthae, ulcers. Pyorrhea. Gums, purple, swollen,
spongy with toothache. Teeth loose, nightly toothache. Necrosis of lower jaw.
Nose - Swollen, red nose. Rawness, smarting, burning and soreness of nostrils. Postnasal swelling, mucus
membrane dry, red and covered with bloody mucus. Gluey nasal discharge. Stopped-up feeling with running
of nose. Excessive coryza. Fluent, acrid coryza. Discharge excoriates upper lip. Ozaena with perforation of
septum nasi (Kali-bi.). Frequent epistaxis.
Rectum - Violent burning in rectum. Burning in anus during stool. Continuous urging to stool and urine.
 Dysentery, tenesmus, not better stool. Most extreme tenesmus, with scanty evacuations of mucus and blood.
Constipation, tenacious feces. Never get done feeling. Sweats before and after stool. Hemorrhoidal colic with
congestion of liver and abdominal venous stasis. Spasms of rectum during sex.
Perspiration - Perspiration after urinating. Sweats from every motion, partial worse forehead and lower parts,
foul, at night. Profuse sweat surfaces cold. Perspiration after urinating. Perspiration before and after stool. Foul
sweats. Perspiration at night. Offensive sweats, towards morning. Cold sweats, often only on forehead, also
general with anxiety.
Skin - Cold. Burning, stinging heat in skin. Burning and redness of skin with formation of small vesicles. Ulcers,
perforating, spreading, serpiginous. Scorbutic spots over whole body, mingled with itchlike eruptions. Herpes
and boils. Severe eczema from sweating parts of body. Condylomata. Nails gray colored.
Sleep - Frequent yawning and stretching. Sleepless at night. Starting from sleep. Sleeplessness from vertigo
or anxiety. Wakeful after 3 a.m. Violent hiccough during sleep. Disturbed by toothache with anxious sensation.
Frightful dreams.
Stomach - Burning gnawing, darting pains in stomach. Cramps in stomach and vomiting after eating rye bread.
Cramp in epigastrium, worse least touch. Epigastrium very sensitive. Distention and soreness of the pit of
stomach. Gastritis. Regurgitation, astringent. Spasmodic constriction of esophagus and stomach on attempting
to swallow a drop of water. Spasmodic and very painful retching. Incessant, green, bilious vomiting. Vomiting
of tenacious mucus with blood.
Stools - Stools, hot, bloody, slimy offensive, with cutting pains and shreds of mucus membranes. Stools
yellow, green, bilious. Stools pasty, dark green, blackish, offen- . sive. Oozing of corrosive ichor from anus,
excoriating external parts. Passes pure
blood or bloody water. Stools followed by slime and blood. Stools worse after midnight, worse autumn.
Teeth - Toothache at night. Teeth loose. Gums red and detached from teeth. Gums purple, swollen with
toothache and spongy. Gums bleed easily. Pyorrhea,
Temperature - Chilly from slightest exposure, exertion. Chills when rising. Chilly after stools. Profuse
perspiration, surfaces cold. Heat, fever when stooping and coldness when rising. Heat of skin causes great
restlessness at night. Fever with anxiety. Fever often temporarily better drinking cold water. External heat with
yellow skin.
Throat - Burning, sore, red, painful swelling, worse heat. Dark red color. Uvula, red, swollen, elongated.
Tonsils swollen, covered with ulcers. Glands about throat swollen. Swallowing difficult and painful.
Spasmodic constriction of glottis, on attempting to swallow a drop of liquid. Pricking in throat as from needles.
Postnasal discharge with sharp pains to ears, worse pressure. Pain in larynx as cut with knife. Hoarseness
quickly alternating with normal voice. Aphonia.
Tongue - Tongue coated and moist, with red edges. Tongue, patchy, swollen and inflamed. Papillae elevated,
strawberrylike. Tongue very red, with blackish coat. Tongue covered with a grayish white crust. Tongue
protruding from swollen lips. Tongue could not be protruded.
Vertigo - Vertigo with deafness when stooping. Vertigo with coldness, cold sweat.
COMMENTS - As with other ulcerating remedies, Merc-c. is a powerful antiseptic and disinfectant. Being much
less irritating than carbolic acid, it took the place of the latter as the leading antiseptic. Before the proper degree
of dilution had been ascertained many patients were poisoned by its external use.
In some of the poisoning cases, the bladder was found after death firmly contracted into a small hard lump.
Keynote intense tenesmus of bladder with intense burning in urethra and discharge of mucus and blood with
the urine or after it. Intussusception.
Tenesmus is worse or not relieved after the stdol. Tenesmus with dysentery. Diarrhea with a “never-get-done
feeling.” Membranous threads in stool, blood, weakness, faintness, shuddering. Urine is albuminous, scanty,
hot, bloody, may be retained or suppressed.
Gonorrhea. Greenish-yellow or bloody and watery discharge with violent burning, urging and painful erections,
dark purplish swelling. Glans has a dark red or gangrenous appearance. Phimosis or paraphimosis.
Rapidly spreading chancres. Serpiginous ulcers, ulcers with ragged edges that will eat away half the penis in
a few days. Skin disorders including syphilitic roseola, smallpox and condylomata.
Tibial pains, particularly when present in cases of enteric fever or after enteric fever, with symptoms of intestinal
ulceration. Rheumatism and rheumatic fever (Merc.). Raging thirst for cold things. Desire for cold food and
intolerance of hot things.
Sore throat characterized by the rapid spread of the infection and by the intensity of the burning pains.
Constriction of the gullet, any attempt to swallow solids or liquids causes violent spasms and immediate
ejection. Cutting pain, as from a knife in throat.
Thick and glue-like nasal catarrh, acrid excoriating. Tearing pains in bones and around eyes. Scrofulous,
 syphilitic ophthalmias. Burning, agonizing pains with excessive photophobia, causing excoriation of cheeks.
Clarke learned from Dr. McKechnie that long uvulas sometimes give rise to irritating coughs. If a low trituration
of Merc-c. is applied to the uvula on a brush, it will in many cases immediately, and often permanently, relieve
the trouble.
A patient of Clarke's who was treated under allopathic treatment with a solution of Merc-c. injected into his
urethra for gonorrhea, not only suffered intensely in the urethra at the time, but for years afterwards had a
painful spasm of the rectum every time he had sex.
Unna reported two cases of elderly women poisoned by sublimate lotion, lint and gauze after ablation of the
breast. The dressings were removed on the second day in each case. The first symptoms were intense irritation
of the skin and diffused redness of the part. The wounds failed to heal by first intention.
Widespread dermatitis followed and in the course of a few days a diffuse erythema spread over the whole
body, creeping onwards like “water on blotting paper.” Some fever, general malaise, nausea, restlessness.
In one case, the eruption lasted three weeks and changed its type, “scattered urticarial and erythematous
itching spots on all parts of the body suggested that there was at that period a poisoning of the more central
nervous system.”
R. C. Markham recorded a cure with Merc- c. after the failure of Merc, in a case of dysentery. The symptoms
were stool with bloody mucus, tenesmus after the stool, cutting colic below umbilicus, nausea, and perspiration
before and after stool, most pronounced on lower part of body and thigh.
The symptoms of colic and perspiration were not found under Merc., but were under Merc-c. The patient felt
better within ten minutes of receiving a dose of Merc-c. 1,000c.
RELATIONS - Antidote: Calc-s. is antidotal to bichloride poisoning. Use intravenous injection of 7 grains in 7
oz's. boiled water.
Compare: ( 1 ) Ars., Lach. (2) Leon., Mons. - an African plant belonging to the Germaniacee used for dysentery
in material doses.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Mercurius Cyanatus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - merc-cy. Mercurius cyanatus. Mercury cyanide. Bicyanide of Mercury. Solution. Trituration.
Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Anorexia. Aphthae. Bilious. Coldness. Cyanosis. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dysentery.
Edema. Enteric fever. Hoarseness. Hemorrhages. Keratitis syphilitica. Nausea. Nephritis. Phlebitis.
Pneumonia.Prostration. Salivation. Throat, sore. Twitching. Typhoid. Ulcers. Varicosis. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Merc-cy. is a valuable remedy for toxemia of acute infections, diseases, especially
diphtheria, when there is early rapid and extreme prostration with cyanosis, coldness and tremors. Its :ction is
similar to that of toxins in infectious diseases.
Acute infections. Great and rapid prostration. Livid states from great struggling, where suffocation is imminent
and paralysis of lung threatening, great sweat. Rapid local destruction. Syphilitic ulcers when a perforation is
threatening. Putridity. Hemorrhages of dark fluid blood. Twitching and jerking of muscles.
Affects most prominently the mouth, throat and larynx. Typhoid pneumonia. Cyanosis, rapid respiration and
heart action. Malignant diphtheria with prostration. Efficient prophylactic in diphtheria. Coldness and
nausea. Nephritis. Albuminuria.
MIND - Great excitement, fits of passion. Fury. Talkativeness. Frequent spells of unconsciousness.
Abdomen - Painful, tender to pressure. Back - Constricting, between scapula.
Eyes - Eyes sunken, fixed. Injected and staring eyes, with barking cough at night.
Face - Face pale.
Food - Thought of food causes retching.
Anorexia. Solids are swallowed better than liquids, which escape through nose. Milk relieves in general.
Excessive ill-humor, after eating a little too much.
Head - Atrocious headaches, worse night.
Heart - Weak.
Kidneys - Nephritis with great debility and chilliness. Suppression of urine. Amber colored urine, very painful,
albuminous, scanty.
Limbs - Varicose veins with great tenderness of leg (left). Cold limbs.
Lungs - Cutting pain in larynx. Croupy cough, causes suffocation. Hoarseness, talking painful.
Modalities - Better milk. Worse from speaking. Worse swallowing. Worse after eating.
Mouth - Astringent taste. Fetor of breath. Free salivation. Aphthae on tongue and lips, with a thick, yellowish
 white scab. Very painful, forming ulcers. Ulcerations of mouth with agray membrane. Pain and swelling of
salivary glands. Edema of soft palate. Gums swollen and covered with a white, adherent layer, under which is
found a violet border.
Nose - Profuse nosebleed, dark blood, several times a day.
Perspiration - Moisture, sweat with icy coldness of skin. Profuse, sticky sweat on upper half of body. Cold
sweat on forehead and cheek.
Rectum - Redness around anus. Intolerable pain. Frequent diarrhea preceded by severe colic. Stools are
offensive, green, slimy, bloody and black. Discharge of fetid liquid with gangrenous odor. Frequent hemor-
rhage. stools with tenesmus.
Skin - Moist and cold skin.
Stomach - Early and complete anorexia.
Incessant hiccough. Thought of food causes retching. Nausea. Bilious, bloody vomiting.
Throat - Intense redness of fauces. Feels raw and sore. Looks raw in spots, especially in public speakers.
Hoarseness and talking is very painful. Swallowing very difficult, cutting pain on swallowing. Much thick grayish
membrane in the throat. Mucus membranes broken down, ulcerated. Necrotic destruction of soft parts of
palate andfauces. Septic diphtheria. Diphtheria of the larynx and nose (Kali-bi.). Tonsils enlarged. Dark blood
from nose.
Tongue - Aphthae on tongue. Tongue pale with yellowish streak on base. Tongue swollen, edges red, tip dark
red. Tongue dark red, almost black.
COMMENTS - When Dr. Alexander Villers was an infant, he had diphtheria. Known remedies had failed to
arrest the disease. His father, Dr. Dominic von Villers, was in despair.
Taking counsel with his friend, Dr. Beck (of Monthly in Switzerland), the latter was struck with the likeness of
the case to the effects of Merc-cy. in some poisoning cases, reports of which he had just been reading and he
suggested the remedy.
A small quantity of the salt was procured and a potency was rapidly made and administered.
Improvement soon set in and recovered followed. Alexander Villers, saved by Merc-cy., lived to do brilliant
work with the same remedy when practicing in St. Petersburg.
Merc-cy. has taken a sure place at the head of remedies for diphtheria, and as an efficient prophylactic in
diphtheria cases. Villers had better results with the 30c than with any lower potency.
In the sensational New York poisoning case of February, 1899, Mr. Henry C. Barnett, the victim, was treated
for diphtheria by his doctors before the cause of the illness was discovered.
Nash reported as particularly indicating it a chronic sore throat of public speakers with rawness in spots and
abroken-down appearance, as if about to ulcerate and the feeling that “it hurts the patient to speak.”
Diphtheria membrane in throat, mouth and at anus. Swallowing is impossible or causes severe cutting pains.
Thought of food causes retching.
Beck noted the extreme feebleness, trembling, syncope. Profound prostration. Icy coldness, general coldness
with nausea. Dark and persistent hemorrhage. Varicose veins with great tenderness on left leg. Cyanosis.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Arum-t., Caust., Hep., Kali-bi., Phyt., Echi., Lach., Gels.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.
