name: Mercurius Dulcis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - merc-d. Mercurius dulcís. Calomel. Mercurous chloride. Subchloride of mercury. Trituration.
Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Aphthae. Blepharitis. Catarrh. Cirrhosis. Condylomata. Conjunctivitis. Constipation. Deafness.
Diarrhea. Dysentery. Ear, disorders. Eustachian, catarrh. Gastro- malachia. Glue ear. Jaundice. Meningitis.
Nausea. Otitis media. Peritonitis. Pharyngitis. Pleurisy. Prostatitis. Swimmer's ear. Throat, sore. Ulcers.
Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Merc-d. is responsible for a large amount of the mercury treatments of the past and for
some of the present. As a comparatively mild and slow-aching form of mercurial, it has none of the corrosive
effects Merc-c., but it has all the power of the metal in it, and it has had its own share of disasters.
It was at one time almost the only recognized remedy for constipation and any affection that could be ascribed
to the liver. Some homeopaths adopted a modification of this by prescribing Merc-d. lx in two-or three-grain
doses as a direct purgative. As Merc-d. has caused both constipation and diarrhea, it is probable that the
action is roughly homeopathic.
Keynote pallor, “pale as a corpse.” A flabby, bloated appearance, ill nourished. Pale mucus membranes.
Catarrhal inflammation of the ear. Eustachian catarrh and deafness (Kali-m.). Glue ear. Swimmer's ear
 infection.
Diarrhea with soreness of anus. Prostatitis. Inflammation with peritonitis, meningitis, pleurisy. Flabby,
bloated and turgid flac- cidity. Indicated in remittent bilious fevers in peritonitis and meningitis. Biliary stasis.
For scrofulous children who are liable to remittent bilious attacks. Pale, scrofulous children who have swelling
of cervical and other glands.
MIND - Bilious temperament. Moody, gloomy and irritable. Nervous, restlessness and agitated. Apprehensive.
Anxiety about health. Hypochondriasis. Fear of impending
disease. Whimpering. Desire to be silent, taciturn.
Abdomen - Violent pain in abdomen, griping, tenderness. Bloated, hot, painful abdomen.
Back - Swelling of cervical glands.
Chest - Great oppression in chest and heart.
Constitutions - Pale, scrofulous children, who have swelling of cervical and other glands.
Ears - Otitis media. Scrofulous otitis. Ear troubles of scrofulous children. Sudden fluttering. Itching in externa)
meatus. Closore of eustachian tubes. Eustachian catarrh (Kali-m.). Eardrum retracted, thickened and
immovable. Glue ear. Swimmer's ear infection. Deafness, occasioned by a swelling, which compresses
eustachian tube. Deafness from every cold of old age. Deafness of old age.
Eyes - Irido-choroiditis. Scrofulous ophthalmia. Ciliary blepharitis. Eyes, red, dry. Gummy secretion on edges
of lids, later, smarting and indistinct vision. Closure of lachrymal duct. Rapid winking. Symptoms worse after
exercise and when heated from exercise.
Face - Face flushed, pale as a corpse. Swelling of cheeks. Exfoliation of lower jaw and death.
Female - Broad, moist and burning condylomata around external genitals, perineum and anus of exceedingly
offensive smell.
Head - Painful scalp. Heaviness across forehead. Falling off of hair.
Limbs - Rheumatic stiffness and catching pain in muscles of legs and knee joints. Cramps in calves at night.
Trembling of hands and feet.
Male - Acute inflammation of prostate after suppressed gonorrhea. Burning, pressing pains. Stinging and
itching just back of corona glandis. Intense dysuria, urine scanty.
Modalities - Better from cold drinks, worse from acids.
Mouth - Offensive breath, salivation, sore gums. Constant flow of dark, fetid, putrid saliva, very offensive.
Ulceration of throat
with dysphagia. Granular pharyngitis. Aphthae on tongue. Tongue indented indurated, black. Ulcers in mouth,
bleeding throughout night. Difficult to open mouth.
Nose - Blows lumps of mucus from nose. Dry, crusted nostrils. Sore right nostril. Violent nosebleed.
Rectum - Obstinate constipation. Anus is sore and burning. Condylomata around anus. Tenesmus, constant
disposition to stool. Dysentery, small stools of mucus and blood, covered with bile. Diarrhea with vomiting.
Skin - Flabby and ill nourished. Swollen glands. Desquamation of skin, especially of hands and feet. Copper-
colored eruptions. Phagedenic ulcers with white bases and painful and inflamed margins in mouth, palate,
face, genital and other parts.
Stomach - No appetite. Urgent thirst. Weight and pain at epigastrium. Nausea and vomiting. Cyclic vomiting
of infants (Cupr-ar., Iris.).
Stool - Dysentery, small stools of mucus and blood, covered with bile. Black stools with great epigastric
oppression, sinking. Stools scanty, bloody mucus, with bile, and constant desire, without tenesmus.
Stools coppery green, like chopped eggs. Dark green, watery stools, with griping. Acrid, grass-green
diarrhea of infants, without tenesmus. Watery stools, colorless, or as if mixed with flocculent matter, or like
washings of meat, occurring most often at night.
Teeth - Violent burning in teeth. Teeth become bare, shake and fall out. Gums swollen and bleeding when
touched.
Temperature - Feverish heat, profuse nocturnal sweat, tearing pains in limbs, prostration of strength and
trembling. Fever, sometimes hot, putrid.
Throat - Excessive ulceration of throat. Difficulty of swallowing.
COMMENTS - Blocked Eustachian tubes. Eustachian catarrh (Kali-m.) and deafness. Otitis media with closure
of Eustachian tubes. Scrofulous inflammation in general, particularly of the eyes. Peritonitis. Soreness
around the anus.
Hale noted its use in dropsies due to combined kidney and cardiac diseases, especially with jaundice.
Cirrhosisofthe liver, especially in the hypertrophic form.
Calomel in old-school practice rapidly resolved and cured a violent meningitis with wild delirium in a girl of five.
In this case there was probably plastic exudation on the membranes. Inflammation with plastic exudation.
 RELATIONS -Antidotedby: Hep. Compare: (1) Kali-m., Hydr. (2) In stringy stools, Sul- ac. (3) Catarrhal
inflammation of middle ear, eustachian tube closed, deafness of old age, Kali-m.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

name: Mercurius Iodatus Flavus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - merc-i-f. Mercurius iodatus flavus. Mercury iodide. Mercurius protoio- datus. Green iodide of
mercury. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Blepharitis. Breast, tumors. Catarrh. Chancre. Crusta lactea. Diphtheria. Eyes, disorders. Goiter.
Intra-ocular disorders. Leucorrhea. Ozaena. Pregnancy, vomiting. Scabies. Syphilis. Throat, sore. Tonsillitis.
Toothache. Writer’s cramp.
HOMEOPATHIC - Merc-i-f. has had a valuable proving that developed adistinct individuality based on the
general Merc, characteristics. Some symptoms of Merc-i-f. are very similar to Lyc, and Lyc. relieved some of
the symptoms of the proving. The right-to-left direction was manifested in the throat and chest symptoms, but,
unlike those of Lyc., the throat symptoms were worse by warm drinks.
Merc-i-f. has a strong affinity for glands of the throat, lymphatic and breasts. Throat disorders with greatly
swollen glands and a characteristic coating of tongue. Sore throat, worse on the right side. Much
accumulation of tenacious mucus in the throat. Characteristic thick yellow coat at the base of the tongue,
anterior part clean and red.
Chancre induration remains a long time. Cervical and parotid glands enormously
swollen. Goiter. Swollen inguinal glands, large and hard. Breasts tumors with tendency to much warm
perspiration and gastric disturbances.
Pains in the eyes and orbits. Farrington mentioned “corneal ulcers looking as if they had been chipped out by
finger-nail.” Deep bone pains especially at night. Syphilis.
MIND - Capricious. Mood is changeable, variable. Moody and depressed. Anxiety. Full of cares and worries.
Fear in narrow places, claustrophobia. Fear of suffocation. Confusion in warm room, better walking in open
air. Confusion of mind, worse on waking.
Indolence, aversion to work. Irritability during pain. Destructiveness, can scarcely resist temptation to throw
lamp through window. Lively, merry, talkative. Elated. Loquacity.
Abdomen - Pain in abdomen with pain in heart. Hardness of abdomen, as from flatulence. Faint sick feeling
in hypogas- trium before stools. Burning at umbilicus as from a hot coal, worse when inspiring. Indolent buboes.
Back - Sharp pain in back. Neck stiff. Bruised feeling over entire scapular region. Throbbing pain between
scapula.
Breasts - Breast tumors with knots in axilla, blueness of the part, warm perspiration and gastric disturbances.
Causations - Cold draft when perspiring. Cold, damp weather, spring.
Constitutions - Suited to scrofulous and syphilitic patients, to mucus surfaces covered with squamous
epithelium, to effects of drafts while perspiring.
Ears - Sudden, sharp pain in ears, worse touch. Throbbing, boring pains from within outward, deep in left ear.
Eyes - Dark circles around the eyes. Keratitis, cornea looks scratched or chipped out by fingernail.
Photophobia. Throbbing, aching pains at night. Pannus. Ptosis, alternating with dimness of sight of left eye.
Granular lids. Swelling below right eye.
Face - Dull aching and soreness in bones of face. Stinging pain in left cheek.
Female - Yellow leucorrhea of very young girls. Copious, muco-purulent discharge from vagina.
Food - Appetite variable, worse sweets. Excessive thirst for cold water, sour drinks.
Head - Catarrh of frontal sinuses, with offensive discharge. Dull frontal headache with pain at the root of nose.
Throbbing, bursting sensation in temples. Shooting or sharp pains in temple. Soreness and stiffness in occiput.
Headache better when mind and body actively engaged. Head pain follows heart pain. Itching of scalp, worse
at night.
Heart - Pains in heart, preceded by headache. Suffocation about heart with nausea and dizziness. Palpitations
with dyspnea, worse lying on back. Feeling as if heart had jumped out of its place. Pulse weak, irregular and
labored.
Kidneys - Urine, copious, dark red, scanty.
Limbs - Excessive tired feeling of all limbs. Heaviness of limbs with indolence and drowsiness. Knees numb.
Laming pain in right arm worse writing. Pain in right forearm with pain in left hip.
Male - Hard chancres, painless, with enlarged inguinal glands, not disposed to suppuration. Dreams of
urination followed by seminal emission of which he knew nothing.
Modalities - Better from open air. Tired feeling in all limbs better lying on right side. Worse cold and damp
 weather, spring. Worse night, before 1 a.m., on waking, rest, lying on left side, warmth of bed, warm room.
Worse raising up, touch, pressure, odors, warm drinks. Faint feeling worse at church.
Mouth - Bad taste in mouth. Coppery smell from mouth. Mouth, lips and tongue dry and sticky. Fine bright red
eruption on roof of mouth. Stiffness of jaws, with inability to open mouth.
Nose - Mucus descends through posterior sinuses into the throat, causing hawking. Thick plugs of nasal
secretion, with severe frontal headache. Chronic catarrh of posterior nares. Nostrils dilated with every
inspiration. Shooting pain at root of nose, worse morning in waking.
Rectum - Diarrhea or discharge of fetid flatus, preceded by cutting, colicky pains. Frequent urging to stool.
Black discharges with or without stools. Stools tough, almost like putty, with much straining. Stools thin, light-
yellowish brown, frothy, soft, copious, dark.
Skin - Troublesome itching over whole body, worse at night. Persistent itching spots over whole body. Bright
red, fine eruption on chest and abdomen. Flat warts.
Sleep - Sleeplessness without restlessness. Restless sleep from constant itching. Amorous dreams. Frightful
dreams, nightmares. Dreams that he must urinate.
Stomach - Weak empty feeling in stomach. Burning at stomach with pain as from a blow. Sharp pain worse
pressure. Cutting pain with nausea and inclination to vomit. Nausea at the sight or odor of food. Persistent
nausea. Nausea with dizziness and suffocation about heart. Morning sickness.
Teeth - Desire to clench the teeth, jaw is stiff and tired from grinding, pain in teeth during sleep. Teeth sensitive,
worse heat, cold and sweets. Teeth feel too long, cannot eat. Toothache after filling. Pyorrhea.
Throat - Sore throat, goesfrom right to left. Swelling begins on right side. Tonsillitis. Tonsils swollen, better
cold drinks. When only the superficial part of the tonsils is involved. Constant inclination to swallow.
Sensation of a lump. Small ulcers on posterior pharynx. Easily detached patches on inflamed pharynx and
fauces, worse on right tonsil, much tenacious mucus. Cheesy exudates with offensive breath. Goiter with
suffocation.
Tongue - Tongue coated moist filmy. Tongue coated thickly, yellow at the base. Tip and edges may be red
and take imprint of teeth.
Vertigo - Faint or dizzy on rising from a chair or when reading.
Vision - Impaired vision with weakness of internal recti. Diplopia on holding eyes to left for some time. Distant
objects look blurred. Black clouds float before eyes
when lying on left side.
COMMENTS - Merc-i-f. a right-sided (Merc- i-r. is left-sided). Conditions can move from right to left.
Characteristic concomitants including a heart pain immediately followed by a head pain, simultaneous pain in
right forearm and left hip, and pain in heart with pain in abdomen.
Useful for abscessed tonsils, tonsillitis. Sore throats on one side with salivation and sweating (Merc-i-r.).
Swollen glands and sores in the mouth (Phyt.). The teeth feel too long, worse by closing the jaws. Irresistible
desire to clench the teeth. Jaw is stiff and muscles tired from clenching teeth in sleep.
Faint, sick feeling in hypogastrium. Nausea at the sight of food. Black stools. A cough worse by laughing. For
conditions from the removal of mercury amalgams, particularly severe fatigue or recurring infections.
Kent mentioned the cure of “an ulcerated indurated lump in breast, as large as a goose's egg with knots in
axilla, blueness of the part and no hope.” Merc-i-f. 100c, given as often as the pains were severe, cured.
RELATIONS-Antidotedby: Hep., palpitations, Lyc. Compare: (1) Plb-i. - in breast tumors. (2) Right to left,
Lyc. (Merc-i-r. to right). (3) Nausea in hypogastrium, Puls. (4) Black stools, Lept. (5) Cough worse laughing,
Arg-n. (6) Pains all around orbit, Cinnb. (7) Worse warm drinks and empty swallowing, Lach. Thick yellow
coating at base of tongue, Kali-bi. (Nat-p. golden yellow, Nat-s. dirty or greenish gray). (8) Worse lying left side,
Phos., Am., Spig. - opposite Merc., which has worse lying right side. Follows well: Lach, (scarlatina).
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Mercurius Iodatus Ruber
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - merc-i-r. Mercurius iodatus ruber. Mercury bin-iodide. Mercurius biniodatus. Trituration.
Historical dose: All potencies, third trituration.
CLINICAL - Adenitis. Antrum, pain. Asthma. Buboes. Chancres. Coryza. Diphtheria. Eczema. Eye,
inflammation. Hemorrhoids. Laryngitis. Liver, syphilis. Malaria. Nose, polyps. Nose, diseased bones.
Parotiditis. Postnasal catarrh. Quinsy. Rheumatism. Spleen, enlarged. Syphilis. Testicles, enlargement.
Throat, sore. Tonsillitis. Typhus fever.
HOMEOPATHIC - Merc-i-r. acts on cellular tissue. Affects the lymphatic glands, throat, but more on the left
side (Merc-i-f., right side). Wandering rheumatic pains with weariness. Much hard glandular swelling. Chronic
 suppurating buboes. Hard chancres. Old cases of syphilis in scrofulous patients.
Diphtheria and ulcerated sore throats, especially on left side with much glandular swelling. Early cases of cold,
especially in children. Oppressed breathing.
Cases have been recorded in which small doses of Merc-i-r. 3x or 2x have cut short an attack of asthma or, if
taken at bed-time, have prevented an expected attack from developing during the night.
MIND - Restlessness, nervousness. Better from occupation, diversion. Ill humor. Disposed tocry. Anxiety
during sleep. Confusion of mind. Delirium during fever, scarlatina. Indifference, apathy.
Abdomen - Distended abdomen about navel, with pain on pressure. Heavy, painful feeling in region of liver,
pancreas and spleen. Sudden cutting, in region of liver. Sore feeling all over bowels. Enlarged malarial spleens
and livers. Inflammation of inguinal glands.
Back - Stiff neck. Cervical adenitis. Spine sore and painful.
Causations - Exposure to wet, weather changes.
Chest - Constriction across chest. Sharp cutting pain in chest. Sticking pain in muscles of ribs. Suppuration of
axillary glands.
Ears - Itching in both ears. Pain in right ear. Increased earwax. Closure of eustachian tube, opens with a
pop. Dull hearing, better evening. Deafness, better after becoming warm on walking.
Eyes - Inflammation with burning. Stream of hot, acrid tears, mixed with yellowish flakes of fibrinous material.
Bright light irritates. Granular eyelids. Trachoma. Blepharitis marginalis. Old cases of pannus.
Face - Slimy, sticky lips on waking. Eczema on chin. Scabs on right side of face. Pain in jaws and temples.
Aching sore malar bones. Swelling of parotid glands.
Female - Profuse, acrid, green, yellowish leucorrhea. Stony hard fibroids.
Food - Desires food more salted.
Head - Heat and pulsation in vertex, worse evening. Painfully heavy occiput Frontal region as if bound by
the cord. Small pustules on head. Syphilitic tumors in brain.
Kidneys - Ulcers in bladder. Urethra indurated. Frequent desire, can't retain urine for a moment. Increased
flow of urine. Urine red, thick and dark when passing.
Limbs - Wandering rheumatic pains, especially muscular. Pain from calf up to sacrum. Middle humerus as if
about to break.
Lungs - Catching pain under right breast, oppressing breathing. Asthma. Cough from elongated uvula with
sore throat. Small quantity of loose, whitish, slimy sputum, with cough. Profuse, yellow mucus. Hoarseness on
getting a little wet.
Male - Sharp shooting, in end of penis through glans. Nocturnal emissions. Sensitiveness of right testicle and
cord. Sarcocele of testicles. Threatened gangrene of glans in paraphimosis. Stubborn suppurating buboes.
Hard chancres.
Modalities - Open air ameliorates the head symptoms. Getting warm, walking ameliorates deafness. Worse
empty
swallowing, swallowing food, after dinner. Worse touch, pressure, after sleep, afternoon and evening. Worse
weather changes, cold air, cold washing, getting wet, washing floor.
Mouth - Profuse saliva. Scalded feeling on tongue. Tongue, wrinkled stiff at base, pains when moving.
Aphthae. Gums swollen. Toothache. Lips slimy and sticky on waking. Lips stick together during headache.
Glands swollen.
Nose - Coryza with right side of nose hot and swollen. Hawks mucus from posterior sinuses. Boggy mucus
membrane of nose and throat, closure of Eustachian tube, opening with a pop. Turbinated bones swollen.
Perspiration - Copious, hot sweat. Night sweats.
Skin - Syphilitic chancre and ulcers.
Bubo. Hard papules. Pustules, with inflamed base, sore to touch. Freckles, liver spots. Lupus. Sarcocele. Small
fissures and cracks. Moist cracks on palms. Chilblains.
Sleep - Sleeplessness from pain in ulcerated throat. Restless sleep from 12 p.m. until morning, with
constriction in diaphragm. Lascivious, frightful dreams. Dreams of swimming, traveling.
Stomach - Pain in pit on pressure. Sinking at stomach and pit, with general sick feeling. Loud and bitter
belching. Nausea while passing diarrheic stool.
Temperature - Intense shivering followed by fever. Chilly at bedtime. Chilliness, followed by flush over face.
Flush of heat and feeling of being tickled.
Throat - Fauces dark red, swallowing painful. Diphtheria. Sore throat, goes from left to right side. Tonsils
greatly swollen, worse on leftside. Submaxillary glands painfully engorged. Parenchymatous tonsillitis. Cough
with sore throat. Phlegm in nose and throat. Disposition to hawk with sensation of a lump in throat. Hawks
much mucus from posterior sinuses. Laryngeal troubles with aphonia. Uvula elongated. Stiffness of muscles
 of throat and neck.
Vertigo - Vertigo, things seem to reel around her. Vertigo during influenza.
COMMENTS-The liver, spleen and pancreas are affected and also the bladder and male sexual organs.
Wandering rheumatism. Headaches, worse in open air. Eyes worse by bright light, psoric eye disorders. Right
side of nose is inflamed. Troublesome dreams.
Will often abort peri-tonsillitis if given frequently. It acts well in old cases of syphilis, particularly in persons of
lax tissue, scrofulous and those who have taken much mercury.
RELATIONS -Antidotedby: Hep. Compare: (1) In syphilitic eruptions, Bad., Carb-an., Nit-ac. (2) Ophthalmia,
Jeqol. (3) Wandering rheumatism, Kali-bi. (4) worse after sleep, left to right. Lach. (5) Dreams of water, Merc-
i-f.. (6) In disorders of antrum, Mag-c., Merc-c. Compatible after: Bell.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Mercurius Nitrosus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - merc-ns. Mercurius nitrosus. Mercury nitrate. Mercurius nitricus oxydu- latus. Liquor
Hydrargyria. Nitratis acidus. Unguentum hydrargyria nitratis. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Cachexia. Condylomata. Delirium. Eyes, disorders. Gonorrhea. Herpes. Impetigo. Leprosy.
Malaria. Mucus, patches. Ophthalmia. Photophobia. Psoriasis. Ringworm. Stupor. Symptoms. Syphilis.
Vegetations.
HOMEOPATHIC - The homeopathic authority for Merc-ns. is Hansen, who considered its special indication
sticking pains and sticking itching. Hansen said Donner commended it in syphilis of the nerves and bones.
The symptoms are compiled from poisoning cases, including cachexia, tremors, frequent fainting, pains so
intolerable he calls for a knife to kill himself. Coldness predominates, but there is the nitric acid flush of the
face.
Merc-ns. has achieved a reputation as “a stimulating application” to indolent ulcers to the eyelids in ophthalmia
and in a variety
of skin diseases such as herpes, ringworm, impetigo, leprosy, psoriasis, and rupia. Vegetations.
Eye disorders with burning, sticking pains, photophobia and epiphora. Mucus patches with sticking pains.
Gonorrhea with frequent burning, sticking itch on corona glandis and in the sulcus coronarius.
MIND - Memory poor. Extreme anxiety. Delirious. Rolled on the ground with excessive pain and called for a
knife to kill himself. Stupor approaching a narcotic state.
RELATIONS - Compare: (l)Merc-d. in stinging and itching behind corona glandis.
REFERENCES - Clarke. Hansen.

name: Mercurius Praecipitatus Albus
author: Murphy
full:
ALBUS
(White Precipitate of Mercury)
PHARMACY - merc-pr-a. Mercurius prae- cipitatus albus. White precipitate of mercury. Mercuric ammonium
chloride. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Blisters. Collapse. Dwarfism. Eczema, facial. Lachrymation. Nausea. Vesicles. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of Merc- pr-a. are taken entirely from poisonings. The most peculiar
symptoms are a green tongue, bilious stools scalding anus. Slight subsultus. Collapse.
A child who was poisoned with 20 grains underwent a remarkable change one night. In the morning the child
has changed to the appearance of an old man. During the night the child shrieked as from great pain.
Mossa related a case of chronic eczema of the face in an elderly man, a moistening eruption, worse in winter
and from exposure to cold, vesicles on a reddened, swollen skin, dry into scales which exfoliate. Eyelids,
especially the lower, edematous, the corners are reddened, lachrymation.
Ears involved, itching and burning on head preventing sleep. Merc-pr-a. 3 grains every third day was given.
First the burning itching ceased. Then formation of blisters abated. Exfoliation continued a long time, but the
skin finally became normal.
In another case, a girl, 2, had an eruption on face and large part of scalp, covered with thick yellow crust,
matter exuding from cracks. Offensive odor, swollen cervical glands. Merc-pr-a. 3 grains once in three days
cured in four weeks.
Abdomen - Pain in epigastrium, gradually spreading over whole abdomen. Great pain in abdomen, continuing
after taking any, even liquid, food. Constant griping. Whole abdomen painful to pressure.
Face - Very flushed, greatly swollen.
Mouth - Tongue coated with thick greenish fur. Gums much swollen.
 Perspiration - Cold, clammy skin, much congestion of cutaneous vessels. General perspiration.
Rectum - One copious stool with mucus shreds in some quantities, much dark blood. Numerous scanty stools
with much blood. Almost pure bile causing great scalding of anus.
Sleep - Drowsy, semi-comatose.
Stomach - Urgent thirst. Much pain at stomach. Nausea and vomiting. Vomits deeply blood-stained fluid.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Dwarfish children, Bar-c., Care. Syph. (2) Eczema, Mez., Aethi-a.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Mercurius Praecipitatatus Ruber
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - merc-pr-r. Mercurius praecipitatus ruber. Red precipitate of mercury. Red oxide of mercury.
Mercuriusoxydatus. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Anus, burning. Barber's, itch. Blepharitis. Chancroid. Chemosis. Colic. Convulsions. Cramps.
Diarrhea. Folliculitis. Gonorrhea. Mucus, patches. Otorrhea. Palpitations. Pemphigus, neonatorum.
Phagedenic, ulcer. Salivation. Trembling. Ulcers.
HOMEOPATHIC - This intensely irritating mercurial was investigated by Hahnemann, all the usual mercurial
symptoms were intensified.
Merc-pr-r. has produced suffocative attacks at night on lying down at the point of falling asleep. Patient is
obliged to jump
up suddenly, which relieves. Convulsions. Spasmodic contraction of limbs. Cramps of internal organs and in
legs. General trembling.
Gonorrhea, urethra felt as a hard string. Chancroid, phagedenic ulcer and bubo. Pemphigus, mucus patches.
Eczema with cracks and fissures. Barber's itch. Blepharitis internally and externally. Leaden heaviness in
occiput with otorrhea.
MIND - Apprehension.
Abdomen - Abdomen distended and painful to contact. Occasional pain in left hypochondrium. Agonizing
colic.
Eyes - Fierce intent look. Chemosis. Blepharitis.
Face - Dropsical condition of face. Remarkable redness of face and eyes. Cheeks and lips enormously swollen.
Heart - Violent palpitations that seemed as if it would burst the chest. Small, hard pulse.
Lungs - Larynx inflamed and swollen, even outside. Paroxysms of suffocation at night on lying down and while
falling asleep, obliged to jump up suddenly, when it disappeared. Oppression of chest.
Mouth - Strong mercurial odor. Profuse salivation. Blood and saliva of the most fetid odor flowed constantly
from mouth. Inside of mouth coated with a substance like decayed cheese. Mouth very sore, flakes of
epithelium separate. Burning in mouth and throat, pains prevent sleep. Itching over whole mouth without saliva-
tion. Inflamed gums. Anterior portion of mucus membrane of cheeks, gums and under the tongue sloughed
away and four teeth were lost in the process. As the parts healed the jaws became completely closed by
contracting scars.
Rectum - Constant urging, gradually became worse and spread over whole intestinal canal, with constant
sensation in anus as of a glowing hot iron moving up and down. Most excessive tenesmus with scanty
discharge of blood with cutting and burning pains. Diarrhea excessively violent with violent cramps. Stools
mainly blood involuntary, greenish and offensive.
Stomach - Unquenchable thirst. Pains in stomach and whole abdomen. Agonizing pain in stomach with
burning heat and nausea. Nausea, vomiting. Vomiting, with cutting in abdomen, black blood, bloody mucus,
followed by diarrhea.
Temperature - Cold, perspiring skin.
Throat - Throat inflamed. Burning like hot ashes on swallowing the powder.
Tongue - Tongue enormously swollen and protruding. Tongue was reduced and firmly adherent to floor of
mouth and cheeks. Two holes in tongue.
COMMENTS - Hansen used Merc-pr-r. in practice and gave as indications gonorrhea when the urethra is felt
as a hard string. Phagedenic ulcer and bubo. Indurated ulcer, deep with red, hard edges and especially when
spreading. Syphilitic iritis when the pains have ceased. Pemphigus neonatorum and intertrigo syphilitica.
Sensation “as of a hot iron in anus moving up and down.”
Mucus patches on scrotum and by anus with or without fissures. Eczema, acute or chronic, much sero-purulent
or purulent exudation, also externally (in ointment 1 to 40 of prepared lard). Tinea tonsurans, circinata and
sycosis. Folliculitis.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Merc-pr-a.
 REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Hansen.

author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - mere. Mercurius solublis hahnemanni. Mercurius vivus. Quicksilver. Argentum vivum. Mercurius
oxydulatus niger. Hydrargyrum. Triturations. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Abscess. Anemia. Aphthae. Appendicitis. Balanitis. Bone, disorders. Brain inflammation. Breath
offensive. Bronchitis. Bubo. Cancrum oris. Catarrh. Chancre. Chickpox. Colds. Condylomata. Congestion.
Coryza. Coughs. Dentition, abnormal Deafness. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Dyspepsia. Ecthyma. Ear, infections.
Eczema. Emaciation. Excoriation. Eyes, disorders. Fainting. Fevers. Fissures. Glandular, swellings. Gout.
Gum-boil. Gum, disorders. Heart, disorders. Herpes. Hydrophobia. Jaundice. Joints, disor
ders. Leucorrhea. Liver, disorders. Lumbago. Mania. Measles. Melancholy. Meningitis. Mucous, patches.
Mumps. Odors, offensive. Osteomalacia. Otitis, media. Ovaries, disorders. Pancreatitis.ñwÁinson's disease.
Parotiditis. Peritonitis.Perspiration. Phimosis. Pregnancy, disorders. Prostate, disorders. Purpura. Pyemia.
Ranula. Rheumatism. Rickets. Rigg's, disease. Salivation. Scurvy. Sinusitis. Smallpox. Sores. Stomatitis.
Suppurations. Surgical, fever. Syphilis. Taste, disordered. Teeth, disorders. Throat, sore. Tongue, affections.
Tongue, mapped. Toothache. Tremors. Typhus fever. Ulcers. Vaccination. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - There was a fitness in naming this metal after the mutable planet Mercury. It provides us
with weatherglasses and thermometers and likewise it turns those who are under its influence into weather-
glasses and thermometers.
Hahnemann invented Mercurius solublis in his pre-homeopathic days in response to a general desire for a
mercurial preparation which should be at once soluble and noncorrosive and it at once took its place in the
pharmacy, a place it has never lost.
The method of developing the medicinal power of metallic mercury by graduated trituration was a later
discovery, through there was a suggestion of it in the well-known Hydrargyrum cum cretâ.
Although Hahnemann proved Mercurius solublis, he recommended the use of triturations of the pure metal in
practice as being the simplest mercurial preparation and more easily obtained and equally available with Merc.
The potencies are prepared from soluble black oxide of mercury, originally prepared by Hahnemann from pure
metallic mercury.
There is no difference between the symptoms of these preparations, but it seems that when Merc, solublis
fails, when indicated, Merc, vivus acts. Hahnemann recommended Merc, vivus as a superior preparation for
homeopathic prescribing in his preface to the proving. No pains have been taken to keep distinct Merc, solublis
and Merc, vivus.
Merc, is Hahnemann's typical antisyphilitic remedy, as Sulph. is the typical anti-psoric and Thuj. the typical
anti-sycotic.
Every organ and tissue of the body is more or less affected by this powerful drug.
It transforms healthy cells into decrepit, inflamed and necrotic wrecks, decomposes the blood, producing a
profound anemia. Lesions, similartothoseofsyphilis. Hereditary syphilis manifestations. Often indicated in the
secondary stage of syphilis when there i s febrile anemia, rheumatoid pains and ulcerations. Ulcerations of
the mucus membranes, especially of mouth and throat.
Lymphatic glands are enlarged, glandular activity increase, especially of salivary and mucus glands. Livid
congestions. Destructive inflammations of bones, cellular tissues, and joints. Strictures after inflammation.
Indurations. Rheumatism. Sycosis, scrofula, bullae.
Suppurations, tendency to formation of pus, which is thin, greening, putrid, streaked with blood. Breath,
discharges smell foul. Secretions are watery, thin, slimy, acrid, burning, foul or thick greenish-yellow. Y
ellowness of eyes, teeth, nasal discharges. Biliousness, jaundice.
Tremors, convulsions. Tremblings, twitchings, disorderly motions of paralyzed parts. Cataleptic rigidity of the
body. Parkinson's disease. Paraplegia. Contraction of joints. Burning, stinging pains. Painful exostoses.
Softening of the bones.
Weakness with ebullitions and tremblings from least exertion. Exhausted and ready to sink down, worse after
stools. Restless and sweaty, complaints increase with sweat and rest, and are associated with a great deal of
weariness, prostration and trembling. Everything seems too short.
Redness. Swellings, edema, continued exudations. Parts are much swollen with raw, sore feeling. Profuse,
oily perspiration does not relieve. Salt-lips, taste, expectoration etc. Stomatitis. Emaciation, marasmus.
A human thermometer, extreme sensitivity to heat and cold. Worsefrom any change of temperature or
weather. Catches colds easily. Hypersensitive to external impressions. Unstable and variable in mental
and physical behavior, tremulous, weak and sweaty.
 MIND - Changes their mind constantly. Instability of ideas, which constantly drive away each other.
Irresolution. Precocious. Restlessness, is constantly changing from place to place, especially at night.
Uncontrollable desire to travel far away.
Heedless. Weak memory, forgets everything. Hurried speech. Stammering, nervous with tremors. Slow in
answering questions. Continuous moaning and groaning. Great anguish.
Apprehensive. Mistrustful, suspicious. Thinks he is losing his reason. Anxiety, anguish, trembling and sweat.
Senses impending evil. Thinks he will die. Fear with desire to escape. Fearof robbers. Involuntary weeping.
Ailments from fright, leaving one in a state of great anxiety, worse at night.
Moral dejection, with great listlessness, discouragement. Weary of life. Loss of will power. Poor self-
confidence. Disgust. Dread of labor. Indifference to everything, does not even care to eat. Indifference to
loved ones. Homesickness. Cheerful alternating with want of sympathy.
Ill-humor, disposition to be angry and to fly into a passion. Complaining of relations and surroundings. Agitation
with excessive internal torment, as if conscious of having committed some crime. Quarrelsome, mistrustful,
and suspicious. Raving.
Delirium, mental derangement of alcoholics. Confusion, loses his way in well-known streets. Weakness of
memory for time. Time passes slowly. Delusions that he is a criminal, that everyone is an enemy. Confusion
and vertigo in morning on waking. Loss of consciousness and of speech.
Fury, with dread of liquids. Filthy in mind and body, does foolish, mischievous, disgusting actions. Inclination
to catch passing strangers by the nose. Violent, horrid impulses, homicidal, suicidal. Suicidal thoughts during
menses, better weeping. Desire to kill the person that contradicts her. Postpartum mania, wants to throw child
on fire.
Abdomen - Pressive pain in abdomen, as from a stone. Boring pain in right groin. External abdomen cold to
touch. Stabbing pain with chilliness. Colic from cold.
Violent colic, with cutting and stinging pains, better recumbent position. Flatulent distention with pain. Shaking
sensation of bowels when walking. Bowels feel weak, holds them. Intestines feel bruised when lying on right
side. Intestines as if they fall to side on which one is lying. Appendicitis, better lying on back. Catarrh of pancre-
atic duct. Inguinal glands, pain on heavy pressure. Swelling of inguinal glands on taking cold. Inguinal glands
swollen or suppurating. Buboes. Herpes zoster.
Back - Bruised pain in small of back, especially when sitting. Stinging pain in small of back with sensation of
weakness. Violent pain in spine, worse motion and pressure. Burning pain in back, worse emission. Shooting
pain in sacrum on breathing. Pain in sacrum, as if one had been lying on too hard a couch. Pricking itching in
sacrum when walking. Tearing pain in coccyx, better pressing on abdomen. Pain forward from right scapula.
Neck stiff, cervical glands enlarged. Cervical glands swollen and inflamed, with shooting pains. Psoriasis on
nape. Herpes zoster.
Bladder - Great soreness in region of bladder when touching it. Frequent urging with copious or scanty urine.
Must hurry, otherwise can't retain urine. Frequent urination at night, even involuntary. Sudden irresistible urging
to urinate, passing large quantities. Burning in urethra on beginning to urinate, after urination, even when not
urinating. Intolerable burning in forepart of urethra when passing last few drops. Cutting, during urination.
Burning and stinging, with hemorrhage from urethra. Greenish discharge from urethra.
Breasts - Breasts swollen, become hard with ulcerative pain during menses. Swelling of nipples. Breast
cancer. Palliative in breast cancer. Breasts painful and full of milk at menses. Milk in breast instead of menses.
Milk spoiled. Milk in breast of boys.
Causations - Ill effects of fright, suppressed gonorrhea, foot sweat.
Chest - Burning or constriction in chest, worse night. Pain below breasts through to scapula, worse sneezing
or coughing.
Stitches from lower lobe of right lung to back. Feels as if everything in chest were dry. Sensations of bubbles
or as of hot steam in chest. Sweating on chest with old people, from opium. Stabbing pain in left side under
short ribs during every inspiration. Soreness from fauces to sternum. Cough with stitching pains in chest.
Constitutions - Suited to light-haired persons with lax skin and muscle, women and children. Scrofulous
children. Merc, has relation to psora and sycosis as well as syphilis.
Cough - Whooping cough with nosebleed (Arn.). Cough causes pressing pains in head and chest. Cough in
double bouts. Cough with hoarseness, salivation, vomiting, diarrhea. Cough with sensation as if head and
chest would burst. Tickling cough before falling asleep. Dry cough at night, yellow-green sputum by day.
Coughs only at night or only by day. Cough worse from tobacco smoke.
Ears - Otitis media. Chronic ears infections. Soreness and excoriation of inner ears. Otorrhea, thick yellow
discharge. Fetid and bloody discharges. Watery discharge and hemorrhage from ears. Very offensive pus
from ear, worse at night. Swimmer's ear infection. Glue ear. Red, hot swelling of external ear. Pains, worse
 warmth of bed, at night. Sticking pains. Tearing and shooting pains. Pains extend to ear from teeth, throat
etc. Sensation as if cold water running from the ear. Sensation of coldness in ears during pregnancy. Fungus
excrescences. Polyps. Boils in external canal (Calc. pic.). Sounds vibrate in ears. Ringing and roaring.
Whistling or running of trains. Deafness on becoming heated, better on swallowing and blowing nose.
Eyes - Conjunctivitis from taking cold. Scanty or profuse, burning acrid discharge. Iritis with hypopion.
Keratitis of syphilitic origin with burning pain. Retinitis when worse by firelight and at night. Ophthalmia
neonatorum. Arcus senilis. Optic nerve and eye disorders in those who work in foundries. Pupils dilated.
Burning in eyes. Stitches in eyes. Cutting, stinging
or aching pains when exerting eyes. Eyes draw together. Lids, red, thick, swollen, scurfy and swollen.
Agglutinated lids in morning. Lids spasmodically closed. Styes on upper lids. Twitching of lids. Photophobia,
worse heat and glare of fire of foundry men. Eyes sensitive to extreme heat or cold.
Face - Pale, earthy, yellow, dirty looking. Puffy under eyes. Cheeks, swollen, red, hot. Syphilitic pustules on
face. Mumps if suppuration threatens. Pimples on face. Corners of mouth ulcerated and painfully sore.
Yellowish scabs around mouth. Swelling or cracking of upper lip. Lips, salty, dry, cracked in angles. Lips burn
when touched. Swelling of cheeks during toothache. Aching in jaws. Spasms and immobility of jaws. Periostitis
of jaw, progressing to necrosis. Masseter muscles contracted. Lockjaw from glandular swellings, with stinging
pains. Aching in facial bones. Facial paralysis from cold. Trigeminal neuralgia from taking cold.
Female - Amenorrhea with congestions and ebullitions. Menses suppressed. Collapse and fainting at start of
menses. Menses irregular, or every two weeks. Menses too late and scanty. Profuse menses with abdominal
pains. Menses of short duration. Abscesses appear anywhere on body during menses and disappear after
menses. Leucorrhea, thick, white with itching, worse urinating and washing with cold water. Leucorrhea
excoriating, greenish and bloody. Leucorrhea in small girls, causing prostration. Sensation of rawness in
parts. Genitals feel raw. Vaginitis. Itching of vulva. Burning, throbbing and itching of vagina. Swelling of labia.
Pressure in genitals, obliging her to urinate often. Stinging pain in ovaries (Apis). Stitching, aching or boring
pains in uterus. Prolapse of uterus with vagina, better from sex. Cancer of uterus and breasts. Bleeding
excrescences on os uteri. Expels moles. Pregnant women with swelling of genitals. Edema, pruritus of vulva
during pregnancy. Morning sickness with a profuse salivation. Tendency to miscarriage from uterine weakness.
Infertility with
too profuse menses.
Food - Intense thirst for cold drink and beer. Great thirst for ice water, though it aggravates cough. Much
thirst day and night. Sweats when eating. Weak digestion with continuous hunger. Craving for lemons.
Appetite only for bread and butter. Bread tastes sweet. Aversion to meat, coffee, butter, oily things, sweets,
salt, strong cheese. Sweet things and milk disagree, though he craves them. Wine, spirituous liquors, coffee
and cold drinks aggravate.
Head - Catarrhal headaches, much heat in head. Catarrhal affections of frontal and maxillary sinuses. Burning
and pulsations in forehead. Tension about scalp, as if bandaged. One-sided, tearing pains. Headache with
ear and toothache. Headache alternating with foot sweat. Headache caused by suppression of foot sweat.
Headache with suicidal tendency. Child turns head from side to side and moans. External head painful to
touch. Stinging, burning, fetid eruptions on scalp. Scalp tense, fetid, sour smelling, oily sweat on head. Itching
of scalp day and night. Falling of hair from sides and temples. Exostosis with soreness. Anterior fontanels
open. Cerebrospinal meningitis from suppressed otorrhea. Hydrocephalus, Cephalhematoma.
Heart - Aching pain at apex and base of heart. Awakes with cardiac tremor. Weakness in heart as if dying.
Palpitations on slight exertion. Palpitations with cough and bloody sputum. Palpitations with fear, worse at
night. Pulse irregular, quick, strong and intermittent or soft and trembling. Pulse frequent at night, slower by
day. Pulse irregular, generally full and fast. Pulse with violent beating in arteries. Pulse imperceptible, with
warmth of body.
Kidneys - Dysuria. Greenish discharge from urethra, burning in urethra on beginning to urinate. Frequent
urging to urinate day and night with copious or scanty urine. Urinates more than drinks. Stream of urine very
small. Urine causes itching. Urine dark, scanty, bloody, albuminous. Hematuria, painless. Burning after
urination.
Limbs - Weakness and weariness in all limbs. Pains in limbs, worse night. Bone pains, deep or near the
surface, worse at night, must get up and walk about. Bones as if broken, joints as if sprained. Involuntary
jerking in limbs. Convulsions in limbs. Trembling limbs, especially the hands. Parkinson's disease.
Paralysis agitans. Stiffness and immobility of limbs. Osteoarthritis. Rheumatism of joints, with swelling and
sensation of coldness. Lacerating pains in joints. Tendency to complete destruction of joints. Abscess in joints.
Edematous swelling of hands, feet and face during menses, or with anemia. Phlegmasia alba dolens.
Sensation as if knees were larger. Fingers numb. Icy cold hands after emission. Cold heels. Cold, clammy
 sweat on legs at night. Patient very sensitive to cold. Oily perspiration.
Liver - Liver enlarged, sore to touch, indurated. Jaundice from gallstones. Jaundice in newborn. Deficient bile
secretion. Chronic atrophy of liver, with emaciation and desiccation of body.
Lungs - Dyspnea, when coughing or sneezing. Desire to take deep breath from anxious oppression.
Shortness of breath on going upstairs or walking quickly. Breathing difficult, worse lying on left side, but
cough worse lying on right side. Catarrh with chilliness, dread of air. Salty or bitter tenacious mucus. Easy
expectoration. Yellow muco-purulentexpectoration, with cough. Bloody expectoration on account of destroyed
lung parenchyma. Asthma, worse change of weather, better tobacco smoke and cold air. Emphysema.
Lungs as if heavy, in asthenic pneumonia. Pneumonia with cough and dyspnea. Pneumonia with jaundice.
Suppuration of lungs after hemorrhages, or after pneumonia.
Male - Sweat on genitals with soreness between scrotum and thighs. Cold genitals. Swelling of lymphatic
vessels along penis. Glans and prepuce inflamed and swollen, phimosis. Redness of meatus. Prepuce
irritated, itches. Children or adults pull and scratch at the genitals from a kind of itching which makes them do
so.
Orchitis (Clem., Ham.. Puls.). Testicles, swollen, hard with shiny, red scrotum. Dragging pain in testes and
spermatic cords. Sensations of coldness in testicles. Gonorrhea. Gleet yellowish green and purulent. Syphilis.
Vesicles on forepart and sides of glans ofpenis. Vesicles and ulcers, soft chancre. Herpes preputialis.
Condylomata. Lascivious excitement with painful nightly erections. Nocturnal emissions, stained with blood.
Emissions followed by burning pain in back and icy cold hands. Sexual power decreased, total loss of sexual
power.
Modalities - Better from moderate temperature, in morning. Better from sex, rest, scratching. Worse drafts,
taking cold. touching anything cold, cloudy weather, damp, rainy weather, wet feet. Worse changing weather
and temperature, heat, sweating, warmth of bed, warm days with damp, cool nights, Fall. Worse at night,
lying on right side, bending forward, during and after urination, before stool.
Mouth - Great thirst with moist mouth. Saliva increased, flows during sleep. Saliva yellow, bloody, bad
tasting offensive. Salivation, with nausea, waking her from sleep. Sweetish taste. Metallic taste.
Offensive,putridodor from mouth. Offensive breath during cough. Disagreeable, sweetish odor from mouth.
Mucus membrane bluish-red and spongy. Sore pain on touch and from chewing. Itching palate. Ranula with
salivation and sore gums. Confluent thrush. Aphthae. Stomatitis from chewing-gum. Painful ragged, swollen,
bleeding gums. Gums spongy, recede, bleed easily. Gumboils. Speech difficult from trembling of tongue.
Stammering. Loss of speech, replies by signs and grimaces.
Nose - Sinusitis and colds. Colds travel to eyes, ears or throat. Coryza profuse, fluent. Coryza, acrid
discharge, but too thick to run down the lip, worse warm room. Coryza with sneezing, sore, raw, smarting
sensation, worse damp weather. Copious discharge of corroding mucus. Yellow-green, fetid, pus-like
discharge. Acrid nasal secretions having the odor of
old cheese. Nostrils are raw, ulcerated. Frequent sneezing without coryza. Sneezing in sunshine. Pain and
swelling of nasal bones and decay with greenish fetid ulceration. Nosebleed when coughing, blood hangs
in dark coagulated strings. Nosebleed during sleep, at night.
Perspiration - General tendency to easy perspiration, but patient is not relieved from it. Excessive
odorous viscid perspiration, worse night. Oily sweat. Sweat, oily, foul, sour or with strong sweetish penetrating
odor, on head, on chest, stains indelibly yellow. Stiffening linen. Foul, sour perspiration or with strong sweetish
penetrating odor. Sweats immediately on drinking something warm. Profuse sweat without amelioration.
Perspires while walking, eating. Day and night sweats, though more at night. Falls asleep while perspiring.
Perspires easily during sleep, sweats through bedclothes. Profuse and very debilitating, at night. Sweats
with pains. Clammy and cold sweats, driving out of bed with thirst and palpitation or nausea. Sweats on
head, chest. Shriveling fingers.
Rectum - Rectal tenesmus with tenesmus of bladder. Great pressure at stool, as if bowels would be forced
out. Ineffectual urging to stool with protruding hemorrhoids, which are painfully sore. Rectal discharge
accompanied by chilliness, sick stomach, cutting colic and tenesmus. Constipation. Dysentery. Purulent diar-
rhea with chill between and hot flushes during stool. Long continued diarrhea. Diarrhea in children. Severe
pain in anus, during stool. Never-get-done feeling. Rawness, burning and itching of anus and adjacent parts,
after stool. Prolapse anus after stool. Constriction in rectum, causes faintness, after stool. Weakness after
stool. Hemorrhage from rectum after urination. Discharge of ascarides and lumbrici.
Sensations - Vibration in forehead. Head as if in a vice, as if growing large. Crackling in head as from metal
plates. As if weight on forehead, as if weight hanging on to nose. As of sparks being emitted from eyes, as of
a body underneath lids, as if
feathers came from corners of eyes. As if a wedge driven in ear, as if ice in it, as if cold water running out of it.
 As if teeth were loose, were fixed in a mass of pap. As if hot vapors rising into throat of worm rising into throat,
must swallow it down of apple core sticking in throat. As if everything in chest was dry. As if breasts would
ulcerate.
Skin - Constantly moist. Insensible skin. Itching, worse from warmth of bed, perspiration. Itching as from
fleabites. Jaundice with itching on abdomen. Yellow skin, tender, excoriated like raw meat. Scurfy eruptions.
Vesicular and pustular eruptions. Moist vesicles surrounded by dry scales, easily bleeding. Red spots covered
with small vesicles. Pimples around the main eruption. Phagedenic blisters. Moist eczema. Crusta lactea. with
yellowish-brown crusts, considerable suppuration. Herpes, burning when touched. Herpes zoster, burning
pains. Measles, tardy development. Nettle-rash. Buboes. Boils and abscesses form at the time of menses.
Ulcers, bleeding with cutting pains and proud flesh. Ulcers, irregular in shape, edges undefined.
Desquamation. Erysipelas of newborn children of syphilitic or scrofulous nature. Exanthemata spreading from
pit over abdomen and chest. Varicella, chickenpox, water blotches turn yellow and maturate. Variola in stage
of maturation.
Sleep - Excessive sleepiness day and night. Great sleepiness during day, not better long sleep. Sleeplessness
from nervous excitability. Sleepless at night from ebullitions of blood to chest and head. Sleeplessness from
pain or other troubles. Profuse perspiration without relief during sleep, with pains. Just after falling asleep,
pains become more violent. Dreams of water, animals, thieves, misfortune.
Stomach - Stomach sensitive to touch. Feels constricted. Pit of stomach burns. Pressure in pit with deathly
faintness. Heartburn all night. Heartburn during pregnancy. Frequenthiccoughs. Hiccough and regurgitation of
water and food. Acrid, bitter, putrid or rancid eructations, worse at night.
Nausea when coughing. Water collects in mouth, causes nausea and vomiting of a bitter substance. Inclination
to vomit while coughing. Nausea and vomiting during stool. Vomiting of bile and food. Morning sickness with
profuse salivation.
Stools - Stools with pain and tenesmus. Never get done feeling. Stools, painful, scanty. Greenish, bloody
and slimy stools, worse at night. Stools ashen white, gray, acrid, then tenesmus orchill. Mucus stools
preceded by chilliness, and followed by tenesmus. Stools like stirred eggs, pea green, slimy. Stools watery
and colorless, with greenish scum floating on surface of water. Stools acrid and excoriating, purulent. Stools
undigested, sour smelling. Stools pitch-like, tenacious or crumbling. Stools small, knotty masses, small like
sheep dung. Stools form a narrow ribbon.
Teeth - Grinding of teeth. Looseness of teeth. Teeth feel tender and elongated. Alveolar abscess, worse at
night. Inflammation of roots of teeth, which ulcerate and fall out. Toothache worse heat and cold, at night.
Toothache at night, followed by general chilliness, with swelling of gums and salivary glands. Teeth, decayed,
hollow, black. Crown of teeth decay. Gums spongy, recede, bleed easily. Gumboils. Large ulcers on
protruding gums. Swelling of gums every night. Shooting pains into face and ears, better rubbing cheek.
Temperature - Patient very sensitive to cold. Easily chilled or overheated. Creeping chilliness, worse in
the evening and into night. Constant cold hands and feet. Sense of coldness with tremors. Chilly within
abscesses. Debility, chilly and weakness. Cold, clammy sweat on legs at night. Chill alternating with flushes
of heat in single parts. Heat and shuddering alternately. Easily chilled or overheated. Catarrhal, gastric, bilious
fevers. Fever alternating with shuddering. Fever after midnight with violent thirst for cold drinks. Fever with
aversion to uncover. Fever in bed, chill when out of bed.
Throat - Glands swell every time patient takes cold. Lymphatic glands of throat hard and large. Sore throats
and colds.
Sore, raw, smarting, burning throat. Putrid sore throat. Burning in throat, as from hot vapor ascending. Painful
dryness of throat, with mouth full of saliva. Constant desire to swallow. Quinsy with difficult swallowing after
pus has formed. Tonsillitis. Whitish, smeary concretions upon tonsils. Tonsils enlarged. Ulcers on tonsils,
on pharynx. Bluish-red swelling. Stitches into ear on swallowing, fluids return through nose. Sensation as if a
foreign object or something hanging in throat. Uvulaelongated, enlarged, greatly swollen. Ulcers and
inflammation appearing at every change in weather. Hawks large lumps from throat. Complete loss of voice,
from straining voice. Hoarse, rough voice, worse least current of air. Chronic hoarseness with tendency to
sweat and profuse salivation. Aphonia from nervous paralysis.
Tongue - Tongue thickly coated in morning. Tongue heavy, thick, moist coating. Tongue, broad, flabby, yellow,
indented. Gray patches on edges of tongue, dirty- yellow coat on upper surface. Needle pricks at tip. Pricking
pain in tongue with swelling. Furrow in upper surface of tongue lengthwise, with pricking. Tongue feels as
if burnt with ulcers. Ulcers behind the tongue. Severe pain on side of tongue from contact of teeth.
Urine - Urine flows in a thin stream or only drop by drop. Urine hot, acrid, dark, scanty, albuminous. Urine
thick, white sediment as if flour had been stirred in. Urine yellowish, staining diaper, smells sour and pungent.
Urine, flesh-like lumps of mucus, pus. Painless hematuria. Urine remaining on parts after urinating cause
 intense itching, has to be washed off.
Vertigo - Vertigo, worse lying on back, as if on a swing. Vertigo after stooping. Vertigo with headache and
nausea. Vertigo with momentary loss of vision, everything turns black. Can't stand erect or even sit up in bed
for fear of falling.
Vision - Dim vision, with involuntary closing of eyes. Foggy vision. Black spots, flames, sparks before the
eyes. Sees green colors. Constant flickering and floating
black specks. Letters seem to move. Object as if small. Periodical loss of sight. Scotoma of right eye after a
fall.
COMMENTS - To the symptoms of Hahnemann's pathogenesis of Merc, solublis are added observed effects
of mercury in those engaged in working with the metal, patients taking mercury, and the effects on those
applying mercurial inunctions to patients.
Many people have been severely affected by absorbing it through their hands. An electrician, who at one time
was required to work with his hands frequently in a trough filled with quicksilver, thereafter could not bear the
slightest shock of electricity, though before he could stand very strong ones.
There is no difference between these effects and the symptoms of the proving so far as the general
characteristics are concerned, but in the finer characteristics there must be differences. The symptoms of the
proving are in general more particularly characterized than the effects of Merc, vivus.
The symptoms of nosebleed and the more finely characterized throat symptoms were produced by Merc,
solublis, as were the majority of the symptoms in the male and female sexual organs. Stitches on tonsils,
stitches into ear on swallowing, something hot rises into throat. This is not to say that Merc, vivus will not
answer equally well or even better for curing them.
Hahnemann's typical anti-syphilitic remedy. Affects the bones, glands and skin. Inflammation leads to
induration, then to ulceration. Merc, corresponds accurately to the true Hunterian chancre.
Pronounced tremors, usually commence in the finger. Tremor of weakness and paralysis. B. Cooper noted
that it may attack the heart and cause sudden death on the smallest effort. Great tendency to fainting. The
tremors may become jerkings and even convulsions. Parkinson's disease. Shaking and trembling with
exertion.
Dissolves the living tissues by inducing emaciation. Offensive, rapidly decomposing ulcers. Ulcers, gray, ashy,
lard or cheesy base, with burning or stinging pains. Obstinate varicose ulcers. Phagedenic ulcer that just gets
bigger and spreads to other areas.
General decomposition.
Bone ulcers, pains are deep and boring, aching. Deteriorating bones. The bones soften so that they will bend.
Bone pains at night in the legs. Wounds and sores that are slow to heal. Bruise easily. Injuries may open up,
ulcerate and discharge.
Scurfy, syphilitic, and pustular eruptions. Eruptions worse by warmth, at night, by cold. Moist, oozing, offensive
eczema. Shingles. Suppurative stage of smallpox. Itching, voluptuous itching. Soreness and sensitiveness.
Stabbing pains and stitches, burning, boring, digging, stinging and dragging pains.
Tendency to the formation of pus. Bloody pus, pus forms in cavities or abscesses that burn and sting.
Discharges are yellow-green in color. Discharges are acrid, excoriating, irritating, except for vaginal
discharges. Abscesses, boils, and ulcers with pus or pus with discharges that are yellow, green and acrid.
Chronic discharges from the lungs, nose and vagina, and colon. Gonorrhea. Vaginitis with yellow, green
discharge, acrid over the whole vaginal area. Burning, itching, stinging, very offensive, the glands in the
inguinal area can sweat.
Enlargement of glands with pricking pains, inflammation, suppuration. Chronic swollen glands. History of
infections. Weakness and exhaustion, shortness of breath. Emaciation, shaky and fragile (Gels., Sil.). Immune
weakness, AIDS. Allergies.
Suppressed measles or scarlet fever, causing acute problem with the brain, rolling the head back and forth,
with severe head sweats. Profuse sweat accompanies nearly all complaints. Sweat does not relieve, may
aggravate. Chronic night sweats. Nightmares and palpitations, wake up sweating.
Chronic colds (Psor.). Mono. Sensitive to every draft and yet worse by warmth, the nasal secretion is acrid and
the nose red and excoriated. Old, catarrhal smell in the nose, smarting and burning inside nostrils.
Aching, tearing and pressing out in the bones. Recurring otitis media with foul, green discharge that is acrid
and offensive.
Tendency to eardrum rupture. Sharp, stabbing pain in the ear. Fetid ear discharge.
Excessive saliva, bad taste in the mouth. Metallic taste in the mouth. Mercurial odor, offensive, breath
excessively fetid, sweat offensive, mawkish, sweetish. Throat dry and forepart of tongue moist. Characteristic
flabby, coated, teeth-indented tongue, foul breath and intense thirst. Mapped, cracked tongue.
 Sore and raw feeling in the back of the mouth. Sores in mouth and nose. Abscesses. Canker sores, bleeding
gums. Ulcers, white patches like thrush. Acute boils (Hep., Sil.). Children who get sores in their mouth while
breastfeeding. Acute sore throats with stinging, raw feeling.
Aphthous stomatitis, severe pyorrhea. Teething with swollen gums, drooling. Loose teeth, receding gums,
pockets of pus (Nit-ac., Hep.). Useful for the affects of dental work, especially if abscessed. Periodontal
disease. Jaws crack and pop a lot (Ign., Rhus-t., Caust.).
Congested, enlarged, inflamed liver. Stitches in the liver. Sensitiveness in the liver and inability to lie on right
side. Hepatitis. Disordered stomach. Thirsty, even with a moist mouth. Craves bread and butter. Aversion to
meat, wine, brandy, beer, coffee, greasy food, butter. Aggravated from milk, sweets, lying on the right side.
Food allergies.
Recurring bladder infections where indicated remedies don't work. During stool there is tenesmus, or tenesmus
and no stool. Just before stool a sick, painful, faint feeling comes on. Slimy stools, acrid, knotty, containing
pus, viscid. Diarrhea with slime.
Dysentery with much straining, never- get-done feeling when there is no more to come. Extreme exhaustion
after a stool. Not well since dysentery, with diarrhea, sweating and dehydration.
Affects the generative organs of both sexes. Stinging, cutting pains in the ovaries (Apis.), cutting pains from
left to right in lower abdomen. Burning and stinging in the ovaries with ovarian cysts. Breast cancer with
ulceration and foul discharges (Ars.). Milk in the breast of non-pregnant
women (Puls.).
Characteristic sensitivity to temperature changes, worse from both heat and cold. Sensitivity to draft. Creeping
chills, shivering, shaking, and shuddering. Drowsiness during the day, sleepless at night. Symptoms are worse
at night, particularly the bone pains. Aggravated by odors, noise, lights, changes of weather, exertion, cold.
Ameliorated by lying down.
Extreme restlessness, overreacts, hurried (Med.). The mind is as weak and tremulous as the body, everything
is done hastily. Lack of organized response. Speech and mind are slow. Slow comprehension. Time seems to
pass slowly. Imbecility. Inefficient (lod.), workaholics.
Desire to travel or change jobs because of instability. Homesick. Dreams of traveling, floods, delusions of
water. Atrophy and deterioration of the brain. Memory loss. Problems with communication, stuttering,
especially in children who have earaches (Caust.). Imbecility and senility in the elderly.
Difficulty adjusting to their environment. Tend to be closed, over protective. Anxiety, discontent. Can get
anxious and worried about their illness (Ars.). Laughing and weeping spells, break downs. Can be impulsive.
Impulses to kill, run away, fears people are after them. Murderous. Suicidal.
Guernsey noted it for “dirty-nosed children.” Also that “Merc, is rarely indicated in these troubles where there
is no slime.”
Kent noted that “Kali-i. is better for the same bursting in the face, running coryza and worse from heat and
warmth of the bed.” Kent noted that it is useful “whenever cold settles in the eye in gouty and rheumatic
patients.”
Guided chiefly by the indications profuse sweat with no relief and worse at night, Clarke cured many cases of
rheumatic fever with Merc, vivus 12c without any other remedy.
Hirsch of Prague related some striking experiences with a preparation of Merc, vivus that he learned from an
old allopath. Quicksilver is boiled in water for half an
Mercurius solublis hour, two teaspoonfuls being given every two hours.
Hirsch recorded cases of acute inflammation of the brain in which Bell, was indicated and in one of which Merc,
had already been administered in vain.
Hirsch noted a case in which a black-haired girl, age 9, had a malignant scarlatina, which commenced six days
before Hirsch (who came as consultant) saw the case. There were signs of brain inflammation that had set in
on the third day.
Hirsch found her unconscious, sharply defined redness of cheeks, pulse 120, skin hot. Piercing screams were
emitted from time to time, boring head in pillows, chewing motion of jaws, gnashing teeth.
Lips brown and dry, not much thirst, water not accepted readily, but milk seemed to be relished. Reddened
patches here and there, especially along neck. Under the “decoction,” which was given to the girl on Hirsch's
suggestion, she slowly but steadily improved and in a week was convalescent.
RELATIONS - Antidote: Hep., Aur., Mez. Compare: (1) Bell. - very close analog, often complementary,
commencing of abscess, difficult swallowing fluids, sharp pain through tonsils, pains come suddenly. (2) Hep.
- chilliness, something sticking in fauces. (3) Meny. - coldness in ears. (4) Puls. - thick yellow nasal discharge,
but that of Puls., is bland, otitis. (5) Nux-v. - coryza and sore throat, Nux-v. has scraped feeling, Merc, is always
smarting, raw, or sore. Dysentery with Nux-v. tenesmus ceases after stool, with Merc, not, there is the never-
 get-done feeling. (6) Aeon. - dysentery of hot days and cold nights. (7) Lept. - bilious troubles, horribly offensive
stools, the griping of Lept. continues after stool but not tenesmus. (8) Ars. - Merc, worse by heat of, but better
by rest in bed. Ars. better by heat of, but worse by rest in bed. (9) Ant-c. - dirty tongue, inflammation of eyes
worse glare of fire or sunshine. ( 10) Kali-i. - stitching pains through lungs, Merc, right or left and shooting in
different directions. ( 11 ) Bor. - sore mouth. (12) Cham. - diarrhea, dentition. (13) Syph. - syphilis, worse heat
of stove or bed, worse night. (14) Apis - stinging pain, fetid breath, ovarian affections. (15) Psor.and Med. -
foul body smell. (16) Mez. - decay of teeth, Merc, of crowns, Mez. of roots. (17) Chel. and Kali-c. - affect lower
lobe right lung, stitches through to back. ( 18) Pic-ac. - boils in auditory meatus. Complementary: Bad.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Mercurius Sulphocyanatus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - merc-s-cy. Mercurius sulpho- cyanatus. Pharaoh's serpents. Sulphocyanide of mercury.
Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Diphtheria. Esophagus, stricture.
HOMEOPATHIC - The well-known scientific toy called “Pharaoh's serpents” is composed of the
sulphocyanide of mercury. A boy ate one “serpent, ” and a man took one in water. The symptoms were
observed and included general prostration for some days. Heat and constriction in esophagus with difficulty in
swallowing and burning in epigastric region and nausea.
MIND - Excessive anxiety.
Face - Pallor, great weakness. Cold skin and frequent shivering.
Limbs - Pain in shoulder joint.
Lungs - Voice rough and hoarse. Tenacious expectoration.
Mouth - Constant salivation. Disgusting, metallic taste.
Pulse - Pulse intermitting every three beats.
Rectum - Bloody stools.
Stomach - Vomiting. Epigastrium painful to pressure.
Throat - Extreme redness of throat with white membrane on tonsils. Violent burning in fauces.
Vertigo - Vertigo on attempting to rise.
REFERENCES-Clarke.

name: Mercurius Sulphuricus
author: Murphy
full:
(Yellow Precipitate of Mercury) PHARMACY - merc-s. Mercurius sulphuricus.
Yellow precipitate of mercury. Hydrargyrum oxydatum sub-sulphuricum. Turpethum minerale. Turpeth mineral.
Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Cardiac, pain. Debility. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dyspnea. Dysuria. Edema. Hydrothorax. Rheumatic
pains. Sneezing. Ulcers.
HOMEOPATHIC - There is some confusion about the identity of this drug in books. Turpeth is correctly given
by Allen. Hering, who proved and introduced it, calls it Turpethum and Turpeth mineral.
The Pharmacopeia of the American Institute of Homeopathy describes the white sulphate, HgSO4, under the
heading Mercurius sulphuricus, but says it is mentioned in Allen's Encyclopedia, vol. 6., p. 325, whereas it is
Turpeth, the yellow precipitate, which is there spoken.
Merc-s. has intense dyspnea, must sit up. Respiration rapid, short, burning in chest. Cardiac pain and
weakness. Hydrothorax (Ars.). Debility with sleepiness. Rheumatic pains. Most pains feel as if a dull stick
pressed on the parts and were moving in diverse curved lines, feels as if this pain were in the bones. Edema
of legs.
Sneezing from direct rays of sun. Sore tip of tongue. Scanty, clear, scalding urine. Watery stools, burning in
anus. Diarrhea early in the morning, stool bursts out in a hot stream of yellow matter. Intense evacuations like
rice-water.
MIND - Morose. Low-spirited with chilliness and yawning. Di-humor after eating.
Abdomen - Coldness or burning in abdomen. Wakes at 1 a.m. with severe pains along duodenum to umbilical
region. Soreness in inguinal glands.
Chest - Pain in right side of chest, extending to scapula, can scarcely breathe, worse from 4 p.m. to 5 p.m.
Pain in chest prevents him from breathing. Pressure on chest. Burning in chest. Hydrothorax from liver or heart
disorders.
Ears - Burning in ears and in face after a chill.
Eyes - Oppression over eyes. Eyes worse from sunlight.
 Face - Pale, anxious countenance. Swelling of parotid gland.
Head - Fullness in head with occasional stitches. Soreness and heaviness through head, after breakfast and
when walking about. Sensation of giddiness while standing after headache. Violent itching of hairy scalp.
Kidneys - Diminished secretion of urine, does not urinate frequently, but has constant pressure. Increased
secretion of urine without a sediment. Urine dark, becoming turbid with a scum on it. Urine scanty and scalding,
but clear.
Limbs - Numbness in left forearm and hand, later numbness in right hand. Hands icy cold with blue nails.
Stiffness in arms. Pain in knees and lameness, especially when walking. Foot-sweat with soreness at ends of
the nails. Ulcers on ankles.
Lungs - Dyspnea in children. Sensation of heat in larynx. Increased expectoration of mucus from larynx and
trachea.
Male - Gonorrhea and syphilitic diseases with great congestions to the parts. Swelling of testicles. Involuntary
emission and lascivious dreams.
Mouth - Mouth clammy and full of mucus in morning. Salivation. Burning, smarting, stinging pain on tip of
tongue, left side in evening. Lips, gums, fauces, mouth and tongue swollen, look dry and black. Gums and
palate dark bluish (black), ulcerated margins.
Nose - Sneezing in sunshine with fluent coryza. Swelling and soreness of tip of nose. Itching of nose.
Rectum - After drinking coffee, pain in abdomen as if diarrhea would set in. Sudden and violent pressing to
stool while walking compelling him to stand still, with anxious perspiration. Stools forcibly gush out in a hot,
burning stream of yellow water, followed by great debility, hiccough and belching. Violent purging, rice-water
motions, some yellow. Stools soft and earlier in morning than usual.
After stools, sensation of fullness as from congestion to legs, especially feet, feel numb when standing.
Skin - Induration of the glands. Psoriasis, leprosy.
Sleep - Frequent yawning and great sleepiness in afternoon. Sleeplessness after midnight. Awakens with
headache in morning.
Stomach - Pain, weight in stomach, tenderness. Stomach so irritated nothing would stay on it an instant.
Violent yellow vomiting, diarrhea.
Temperature - Chilliness running up back with yawning and depression of spirit, followed by dull pain in
forehead, burning in face and ears and slight fever. Chilliness, restlessness and heaviness in upper part of
abdomen, frequent yawning and diminished secretion of urine, in afternoon.
Throat - Heat and sensation of constriction in throat. Burning in mouth and throat. Dryness of tongue and
throat. Roughness in the throat and hoarseness.
Tongue - Tongue, greenish yellow down middle, heavily coated white. Tongue yellowish at root. Enlarged
papilla stand up like red points with flat taste in mouth and a reduced pulse.
COMMENTS - Lippe is the chief clinical authority for Merc-s. He considered it as important as Ars. in dropsies
of the chest. The symptoms on which it has been prescribed are clinical and have been well confirmed. Among
them is “Pain in right chest extending to scapula, he can scarcely breathe, worse 4 p.m. to 5 p.m.”
When Merc-s. acts well, said Lippe, “it produces a profuse watery diarrhea with great relief to the patient.” It is
particularly suited to hydrothorax depending on liver or heart disorders.
Other confirmed symptoms include soreness of tip of tongue. Edema of legs. Scanty and scalding urine, but
clear. Worse in afternoon, 4 p.m. to 5 p.m. Better by profuse diarrhea (dyspnea). After diarrhea stools, there
is numbness of legs.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Merc-acet. - cutting in urethra when last drop is flowing out. (2) Cinnb., Aethi-
a. and other mercuries. (3) Hydrothorax, Ars. (4) Worse afternoon, Lyc. (5) Dropsy, Dig.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Lippe. Phatak.
