Tracheitis. Ulcers. Varicose veins.
HOMEOPATHIC - There are two sub-types of the nosode Morgan Pure, which is closest to Sulph. and
particularly good in skin conditions, and Morgan Gaertner, which is like Lyc. and is helpful in cholecystitis,
adrenal colic. It is often useful in hiatal hernia and diverticular disease.
Keynote congestion. Broncho-pneumonia, where the indicated remedy fails to act even in the acute state or
to clear up a residual infection. Selective on skin and liver in headaches with flushed face, aggravation from
heat and raised blood pressure.
Congestion of the stomach lining and the liver with dirty mouth, indigestion, and bilious vomiting. Gallbladder
conditions, constipation and hemorrhoids.
Pelvic congestion and dysmenorrhea. Hot flashes during menopause. Circulatory disturbances of the limbs,
blueness, chilblains, varicose veins, edema and hot feet, etc. Congestion around the joints in arthritis. History
of rheumatic fever.
Hyperemia of the surface circulation (Sulph.), deep internal venous stasis (Ham.,
Graph., Petr, and Psor.). Skin ailments with heat and itching. Eczema, red raw with exudate, itching and
bleeding.
Giving the nosode in 30c potency, followed by Sulph. in 3x or 6x tablets twice daily, can help the acute itching
in bad eczema or dermatitis.
MIND - Tense, active. Excitable. Introspective and anxious. Apprehensive about state of health, fear of
impending disease. Agoraphobia. Fears crowds but often shows mental anxiety if left alone. Fear of the
unknown, of the dark, that something bad will happen. Claustrophobia.
Irritable with a tendency to depression. Weeping, tearful mood. Sadness, despondency. Idiocy. Suicidal
disposition. Mental depression often with suicidal tendency by jumping.
Abdomen - Epigastric pain or discomfort. Tenderness in epigastrium. Pain right and left hypochondrium. Pain
right and left iliac fossae. Flatus. Redness and moisture at umbilicus, bad odor.
Back - Lumbago, acute or chronic. Arthritis spine, sacro-iliac joints. Pain generally better moving, worse on
beginning to move, heat.
Blood - High blood pressure. Varicose veins. Varicose ulcer. Cerebral thrombosis. Phlebitis. Sluggish
circulation. Easy bruising. Tendency to hemorrhoids.
Chest - Pleurodynia. Fibrositis of chest wall. Angina. Pain since shingles.
Constitutions - Red, coarse, blotchy appearance. Introspective, anxious about their health.
Ears - Otorrhea. Boils on meatus. Noises in ears. Meniere's disease. Catarrhal deafness.
Eyes - Conjunctivitis. Iritis, keratitis. Tarsal cysts. Styes. Lids granular. Spots before eyes.
Face - Acne rosacea. Eczema on chin and forehead, in ear passages. Cracks and eruption behind ears.
Eruptionpustular, weeping, scalding and very itchy. Eruption on margins of scalp, pustular, itchy and
scaling. Erysipelas. Hot, red, dry and fissured.
Female-Pruritus vulvae and vagina. Boils vulva. Menorrhagia and metrorrhagia. Fibroids of uterus.
Leucorrhea, corrosive, offensive, brown, green, yellow. Urethral caruncle. Bartholinitis. Pain on sexual
intercourse.
 Food - Desires fats, sweets, eggs and butter. Worse from fats and eggs, or avoids fats and eggs.
Head - Congestive headache with flushed face. Frontal, occipital headache, on vertex. Migraines. Weekly sick
headache. Headaches worse from hot atmosphere, thunderstorm weather, excitement, traveling in bus or
train. Scalp sensitive. Hair falling out. Complete alopecia.
Kidneys - Cystitis with frequency and pain. Urine of strong smell, corrosive, containing sugar.
Limbs - Osteoporosis. Rheumatic shoulders. Neuritis arms. Numbness and tingling arms. Rheumatoid arthritis
of wrists, thumb. Hands puffy, stiff and grip poor. Nodules on fingers. Finger joints swollen and painful.
Fingers stiff in morning. Lack of power in legs. Tingling legs. Growing pains in legs. Knee joints are large and
stiff. Pain in soles, heels. Thick skin soles of feet with cracked heels. Pes planus. Feet too hot, offensive foot
sweat. Chilblains.
Liver - Pain in liver and gallbladder. Gallstones. Congestion of liver. Attacks of jaundice. Bilious attacks with
severe headache, relieved by vomiting large quantities of bile-stained mucus.
Lungs - Suffocative attacks. Shortness of breath. Morning cough, dry tickling cough, loose or sticky.
Emphysema. Asthma. Congestion of nasal and bronchial membrane, especially in children, bronchi and lobar
pneumonia. Infantile asthma. Bronchitis, each winter. History of pneumonia or bronchopneumonia and never
well since.
Mouth - Salivation. Bad taste in the mouth, taste deficient or lost. Mouth and lips dry, lips stiff in the morning.
Angles of mouth cracked, lips very red. Ulcers. Jaw bones ache. Periostitis jaw.
Neck - Adenitis neck. Fibrositis neck and shoulders.
Nose - Catarrh. Post-nasal catarrh. Sinus and antrum infection. Dry mucus membrane. Cracks angle nose.
Sense of smell lost. Nosebleeds.
Perspiration - Profuse in axilla.
Rectum - Constipation. Bowel motion without help, loose, urgent in the morning. Bowel motion immediately
after food. Stool may be pasty, foul and contain blood and mucus. Hemorrhoids, bleeding itching or painful.
Itching of anus. Anal fissures.
Skin - Eruptions dry, cracked, fissured, weepy, itchy and burning. Tremendous thickening and congestions
of skin with deep cracks. Itching eruption, worse from heat. Raw, red eczema, exuding freely with itch and
heat, bleeding from scratching. Callosities. Herpes zoster. Skin sensitive to sun, prickly heat. Cannot wear
wool next to skin.
Sleep - Insomnia, light and restless.
Stomach - Burning in throat and stomach. Pain and acid, worse with food. Duodenal and peptic ulcer. Bilious
attacks. Water brash, heartburn. Sour, acid, bitter, mouthfuls. Belching and heartburn. Nausea, vomiting,
hematemesia.
Throat - Throat dry and burning. Throat parched, raw and granular. Apple core sensation, easy choking.
Pharyngitis, laryngitis, tracheitis. Recurring tonsillitis, cheesy pieces come out. Thyroid enlarged.
Tongue - Burning in tongue. Tongue raw and dry, coated, slimly, swollen. Tongue stiff in the morning. Warts
on tongue. Pain in the root of tongue.
Vertigo - Vertigo from high blood pressure.
COMMENTS - Congestion of gastric mucosa and liver. Heartburn. Dirty tongue, bitter taste in mouth in the
morning with accumulation of mucus causing gagging as soon as rises from bed.
Appetite absent in the morning but, by 11 a.m., a sinking feeling relieved by eating. Recurrent bouts of
indigestion, with vomiting of mucus and occasionally blood without
ulceration. History of bilious attacks, especially occurring at menopause.
A history of repeated attacks of congestion of the lungs or bronchi pneumonia in children is indicative for the
use of the nosode Morg. or one of the subtypes: Morgan-Pure or Morgan-Gaertner.
Dr. Sargunar, who used this nosode in 5300 cases, reported that Morg. relieved the attacks of bronchial asthma
as quickly as Adren. Chest infection where the indicated remedy fails to act or in cleaning up residual infection
after a bronchi pneumonia, especially in cases following Sulph. or Nat-s.
Dr. William B. Griggs said that he used Morg. from 200c to the 100,000c in cases of asthmatic children where
Nat-s., Ars. and various asthmatic remedies failed completely.
Dr. Griggs said, “Morgan Bacillus has been one of my most successful remedies in eczema of young children.
You take the moist type of eczema where the child scratches and has the exudate on its face and bleeds.
Clarke has seen Morgan clear that up after failure of Graph., Psor. and Med.”
RELATIONS - Miasmatic relation: Morgan has deep range of action covering the field of a number of anti-
psoric remedies. Compare: (1) Sulph., Calc, and Lyc. and also many carbonates.
REFERENCES - Bach. Paterson.
 ***MORGAN GAERTNER
(Bowel Nosode)
PHARMACY - morg-g. Morgan gaertner. A bowel nosode. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Alopecia aerata. Anal fissure. Anal pruritus. Angina pectoris. Asthma. Bedwetting. Bladder pain.
Blepharitis. Catarrhal, rhinitis. Chalazions. Constipation. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspnea. Eczema. Furuncles.
Gallbladder, pain. Hemorrhoids. Herpes. Intercostal neuralgia. Kidney, stones. Leucorrhea. Mastoiditis.
Myocarditis. Nasal polyps. Nephritis. Nosebleeds. Otitis. Palpitations. Pleurodynia. Polyuria. Psoriasis.
Pustules. Pyelo-nephritis. Rectal, prolapsed. Rheumatic, pains. Sinusitis.
Styes. Urticaria. Vomiting. Warts.
HOMEOPATHIC - Pale, impatient, claustro-
phobic persons. Subjects with fine brown hair. Polyarticular rheumatic pains of upper extremities specially of
the right side. Vesiculous, squamous, papulo-squamous eruptions. Pyelo-vesical burning congestion.
Dysmenorrhea.
MIND - Impatient. Tense, with strong reaction. Full of apprehensions, gets excited in company. Chews nails.
Irritable. Jealousy. Claustrophobia. Nocturnal fears cries out in sleep. Manic depressive psychoses.
Abdomen - Gallbladder painful. Intestinal lethargy. Flatulent dyspepsia. Flatulence of the left and right
hypochondrial region.
Back - Cervical rigidity.
Breasts - Warts on the breasts, nipples.
Chest - Intercostal neuralgia. Thoracic pain. Angina pectoris. Constriction in the chest, painful irradiation to
the left hand. Sensation of coldness in the chest.
Ears - Otitis. Mastoiditis. Furuncles in the auditive conduit. Buzzing in the ears.
Eyes - Chronic inflammation of the eyelids. Blepharitis. Styes. Chalazions. Ulcer of the cornea. Vitral opacity.
Face - Facial neuralgia, dominating left side. Sudden edema of the face. Herpetiform eruption on the left side
of the face.
Female - Irritation at the approach of menstruation. Painful menses. Dysmenorrhea. Thick, brown, corrosive,
bad smelling leucorrhea. Vulvar pruritus.
Food - Desire for sweets, salted things, fatty foods, eggs, meat. Sometimes aversion to fat, eggs, meat.
Heart - Myocarditis. Precordial uneasiness. Angina pectoris. Nocturnal palpitations, wakes up the patient.
Palpitations, better by eructations, better by emission of gas, better by movement.
Kidneys - Pain in the kidney region. Nephritis. Pyelo-nephritis. Pyelo-vesical pain, congestion. Kidney stones.
Bladder pain with frequent urination. Polyuria. Burning urine. Bedwetting.
Limbs - Nocturnal pains of the arms. Rheumatoid pains in shoulders, arms, elbows, wrists, deltoid muscles
(right).
Painful swelling of the thumbs. Knees, numb and painful. Excessive heat of the feet at night.
Lungs - Dyspnea. Shortness of breath. Pleurodynia. Asthma. Tickling cough morning and evening, while
walking up, while lying down.
Modalities - Better by movement, passing flatus, eructation. Worse in company, after meals, before menses,
at night, heat , of bed, right side.
Mouth - Bad mouth, bitter taste. Thick saliva. Tongue burning, as if pricked by needles. Inflamed gums,
pyorrhea. Cracks in corner of lips.
Nose - Sinusitis. Hypersecretion of nasal fossa and of maxillary sinus. Crusty coryza with ulceration in the
nose. Catarrhal rhinitis. Nasal polyps. Nasal herpes. Nosebleed.
Rectum - Constipation. Hard, dry stools with mucus. Spontaneous expulsion of mucus through rectum even
when the patient is not constipated. Rectal prolapsed. Anal fissure. Anal pruritus. Painful hemorrhoids,
bleeding, pruriginous.
Skin - Skin sensitive. Sudden edema of the face. Herpetiform eruption on the left side of the face. Psoriasis.
Eczema. Urticaria. Pustulous eruption on face, on brows, knees. Skin, oozing, crusty, desquamating with
fissures. Giant urticaria on arms. Warts on hands, big flat or lacerated. Erythematous squamous eruptions in
round plaques on elbows, knees, integument, sacral region, nails and heels. Herpetic eruption on soles.
Alopecia aerata. Loss of hairs in bunches.
Stomach - Fullness of the epigastrium without eating. Noisy eructations with bad smell. Vomiting of foods after
meals, afternoon or night.
Throat - Inflammatory congestion of tonsils. Edema of the uvula. Sensation of burning in the base of the throat
as if from acid.
RELATIONS - Compare: Lyc., Puls., Sil., Kali-bi., Nat-m., Nux-v., Sulph., Sep., Graph., Calc.
REFERENCES - Julian. Paterson.
 ***MORPHINUM ACETICUM
(Morphine)
PHARMACY - morph. Morphinum aceticum. Morphine. Opi um alkaloid. Morphinum muri- aticum. Morphinum
sulphuricum. Morphia. N. O. Papaveraceae. Trituration. Solutions. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Amenorrhea. Bradycardia. Chorea. Colic. Coma. Constipation. Convulsions.
Delirium. Delirium tremens. Delusions. Depression. Diabetes. Drug, addictions. Drug, overdose. Electric
shock. Eyes, disorders. Headache. Herpes zoster. Hysteria. Impotency. Infertility. Itching. Jaws, clenched.
Lightning-stroke. Nausea. Neuralgias. Neuritis. Numbness. Pains. Palpitations. Paralysis. Ptosis. Shock.
Sleep, disordered. Strabismus, divergent. Strangury. Tachycardia. Trismus. Timpanitis. Uremia. Urticaria.
Vertigo. Vision, illusions. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Morphine is the alkaloid of opium, which contains the most characteristic properties of the
drug. The alkaloid, the acetate, the muriate and the sulphate have all been used as painkillers and sleep
inducers.
Morphine bears a similar relation to opium as atropine is to belladonna, that is, it represents its nervous side.
It is less stimulating, less convulsive and more decidedly hypnotic. Constipates less and affects contractility of
the bladder more. It is less diaphoretic and more itching.
Restlessness, hyperesthesia, trembling, twitching, jerking, convulsions. Violent and sudden neuralgic pains
and sudden fainting. Multiple neuritis. Neuralgias after herpes zoster (Mez.). Extremely susceptible to pain.
Pain causes twitching and jerking of limbs. Sore feeling all over. Bed feels too hard.
MIND - Mental exhaustion. Incapable of thinking or fixing mind. Concentration difficult. Memory weakness.
Forgetfulness, hunting for words while speaking. Makes mistakes in writing. Makes gestures.
Indifference, apathy.
Great anxiety, thought she was going to die. Anxious, restless, ran about the room.
Ailments from fright or fear. Frightened easily. Shock induced by terror. Terror, cried out in great alarm.
Suspicious, mistrustful.
Emotions very easily excited. Hysteria. Excitable during childbirth. Flow of ideas rapid and pleasant, but without
control of the will. Lies, never speaks the truth, does not know what she is saying.
Ill-humor. Irritable, wants to be alone. Censorious, critical. Fault-finding. Anger at trifles. Intolerant of
contradiction. Deceitful, sly. Want of moral feelings.
Delirium, melancholic in character. Delirium during fever, sleep. Delirium, springs up suddenly from bed and
escapes. Howling. Delusions, sees faces, hears voices, perceives various odors. Sensation of death. Delirium
tremens. Drug addictions, overdose.
Profound depression. Sad, melancholy, despair. Despair with the pains. Could not describe symptoms
because tears and sobs. Suicidal disposition. Stupefaction, as if intoxicated. Dream-like state. Confusion of
mind. Unconsciousness, coma. Uremic coma.
Abdomen - Distended. Acute pain in abdomen and along spinal column. Tympanitis. Pain in umbilical region.
Colic better turning on back in morning.
Back - Great pain in back. Pain extending along spine. Pain and twitchings all down spine. Aching across
lumbo-sacral region, cannot walk erect (Cimic.). Weakness of the loins. Stiff-neck.
Causations - Ailments from fright or fear. Drug addiction, overdose. Electric shock, lightning-stoke.
Thunderstorms. Ailments from apoplexy, stroke.
Chest - Chest tight. Pain in middle of sternum. Ill with an indescribable sensation, worse then any pain, behind
lower half of sternum. Neuralgia after herpes zoster (Mez.).
Constitutions - Nervous constitutions.
Ears - Left ear throbs painfully, better heat.
Severe pain in left ear with pain at side of left eye all day. Seems to hear circulation all over body. Ringing,
surfing, roaring, tinnitus.
Eyes - Itching of eyes. Pupils unequally
Morphinum aceticum contracted. Paresis of recti internal. Staring, injected, diverging strabismus. Look
unsteady. Double vi si on with disturbed accommodation. Sight blurred, obscured by fogs. Delusion of vision
on closing eyes. Eyes feel too small for sockets. Eyeballs protrude. Bluish, drooping eyelids. Ptosis.
Nystagmus.
Face - Heavy, confused, wild, haggard expression. Intensely flushed face, puffed, livid, cyanotic. Dusky red
or pale face, lips tongue, mouth or throat. Trismus, teeth clenched.
Female - Amenorrhea. Menses too profuse, and too early. Infertility. Sexual desire at first increased,
afterwards abrogated.
 Food - Loss of appetite. Aversion to meat, pastry. Thirst, burning.
Head - Head dull, heavy as lead, hot. Bursting pain, head drawn back. Brain feels tense as though wound up
tightly. Headache with drowsiness. Congestions of head, palpitations of heart, starts in fright if approached,
touch causes cramp and twitchings.
Heart - Cardiac muscular tissue is intact, even if severely exhausted. Violent throbbing in heart and carotids.
Alternation of tachycardia and bradycardia. Palpitations. Pulse small, weak, dicrotic.
Kidneys - Suppression of stool and urine. Paresis of bladder. Prostate enlarged. Strangury. Uremia, acute
and chronic. Slow anddifftcult urination. Urine is turbid and slimy. Albuminuria. Diabetes.
Limbs - Tremors, twitchings, contractions, stiffness of limbs. Numbness. Cramps in several muscles. Violent
pain in joints. Staggering gait. Legs swollen. Wandering, sharp pains in legs and feet. Stiffness and pain in
arms after sleep. Icy coldness of left sole as if standing on oil-cloth.
Lungs - Faint and struggling for breath. Breathing is stertorous, difficult, slow. Diaphragmatic paralysis,
hiccough, dyspnea, paroxysmal, on first falling asleep (Lach., Grind.). Cheyne-Stokes respiration. Dry, hard,
teasing, exhausting cough, worse at night. Strangling cough with viscid mucus sputum, thin, scanty, but
sounds loose and abundant.
Male - Pain in right spermatic cord (Ox- ac.). Impotency. The sexual excitement, voluptuous sensations and
erections are incomplete or do not occur. Diminished desire.
Modalities - Better by coffee. Worse by eating, vinegar. Worse after sleep, in morning, slightest movement,
especially of the head.
Mouth - Very dry mouth, with thirst, nausea, bitter, sticky vomiting. Discharge of watery saliva from mouth.
Palate scarlet. Speech is hasty, stammering, embarrassed and feeble.
Nose - Sneezing in paroxysms, coryza. Tickling in nose and larynx as before a sneeze. Intense itching,
tingling, numb feeling on end of nose, rubs it constantly.
Perspiration - Profuse sweat. Cold, clammy sweat. Viscid, colliquative sweat.
Rectum - Stool retained. Constipation for a long time. Constipation, stools large, dry, knotty with tendency to
bruise and fissure. Diarrhea watery, brown or black with horrible tenesmus.
Sensations - Tight sensations in head, as if skull too small for the brain. As if brain wound up. Something shot
to head like lightning the instant the injection look place. Sight as if obscured by a fog. Ticking of nose and tip
of nose. Tongue as if thick. Teeth as if clenched. As if worms in legs.
Skin - Skin lost its elasticity. Skin deathly pale. Livid, purple spots. Eruption like herpes zoster, but without
pain. Itching is constant, violent, all over, nose, neck, loins, inside thighs. Urticaria appearing at the
menopause.
Sleep - Heaviness, drowsiness. Sleepy, but cannot sleep. Sleepless, restless sleep with frequent startings. Y
awning, drowsy, prolonged, deep sleep. Muttering in sleep. Dreams are pleasant, frightful. Half waking, half
stupid condition. Aggravation after sleep (Lach.).
Stomach - Pain in stomach, worse by eating. Constriction, pressure, cramps. Colic, crawling in stomach.
Belchings, violent, with much acid mucus. Nausea incessant and deathly, faintness, constant
Morphinum aceticum retching. Nausea and vomiting on rising up. Nausea with drowsiness. Vomiting of
green matter, sour, bright green fluid, bitter, greenish water.
Temperature - Icy coldness. Chills and rigors. Burning heat, profuse sweat. Heat, burning, itching, cheeks hot
and flushed.
Throat - Dry and constricted. Burning back of fauces. Hoarseness. Pharynx paralyzed, swallowing almost
impossible, better hot drinks, worse solids. Jugular veins swollen, carotid arteries pulsating.
Tongue - Tongue is dry, brown, red tip and margins. Tongue violet in middle, at times trembles on putting in
out.
Vertigo - Vertigo from the least movement of the head. Giddiness and drowsiness, everything turns around.
COMMENTS - Extreme susceptibility to pain. Cannot describe symptoms for tears and sobs. Neuralgia where
the pains are so violent as to threaten convulsions, pain causing twitching or jerking of limbs. Nervous spasms
brought on by lightning-strike, worse by any exposure to heat, better by cold.
Tremblings, twitching, jerking and convulsions, even tetanus. Marked clenching of the jaws. Restlessness and
hyperesthesia. Restlessness of legs, wants them held, feels as if worms in them.
Heavy and hot head. Intense drowsiness. Deep sleep, but also sleeplessness and restless sleep with starting
up. Half sleeping state, “a half-waking, half-stupid state, but with perfect ability to think of different things,
though at the same time he was busy with confused fantasies, limbs stiff.”
Green vomit is a constant effect. Nausea during pregnancy (Lac-d., Ip.). Sudden fainting. Useful for the after
affects of morphine, or morphine withdrawal.
Both the muriate and the sulphate are able to cure symptoms produced by Morph. In Clarke's experience, the
 acetate has produced much more violent gastric symptoms than the muriate, but not different in kind.
Rufus Thurston recorded a short but very important proving of Morph, on a patient who took a grain for
sleeplessness.
Among the symptoms he emphasized “vertigo from least movement of the head.”
Not long after, Skinner had a case of vertigo with the tendency to fall forward and become unconscious.
Symptoms were worse from movement of any kind, especially of the head, and by eating and drinking. Morph-
m. 500c cured the case.
Boger cured with Morph-s. 100,000c the case of Miss M., 22, who was dark and spare. She had a headache
with the sensation of being wound up tight. Sleepiness and numbness of lower limbs. Intense vertigo on least
motion of head.
Thurston also had a case with the “woundup” headache. That case also had sudden faintness.
That same symptom was produced by one-eight of a grain of the sulphate in a case reported by E. V. Ross.
Spells of feeling faint came on suddenly with great anxiety, as though he was going to die. Visual delusions
on closing eyes, “sees a man standing at foot of bed. The room seems full of white and colored babies.”
RELATIONS - Compare: Apom., Herin., Op., Nux-v.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.
keynote:
PHARMACY-morg.Morganbacillus.Morgan pure. Proteus morgani. A bowel nosode. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Alopecia. Anal, fissures. Arthritis. Asthma. Bartholinitis. Boils. Bronchitis. Callosities. Catarrh.
Chilblains. Cholecystitis. Congestions. Conjunctivitis. Constipation. Cystitis. Dysmenorrhea. Eczema.
Edema. Emphysema. Fibrositis. Flatus. Foot sweat. Gallbladder, disorders. Growing, pains. Headaches.
Hemorrhoids. Herpes zoster. Hiatal, hernia. High blood pressure. Hot, flashes.

name: Moschus Moschiferous
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - mosch. Moschus moschiferous. Deer musk. Musk. N. O. Mammalia. Rumi- nantia. Trituration
of inspissated secretion contained in preputial follicles. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Alcoholism. Angina pectoris. Awkwardness. Backache. Catalepsy. Choking. Coldness. Coma.
Convulsions. Coughs. Croup. Deafness. Diabetes. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspnea. Epilepsy. Fainting. Flatulence.
Globus, hystericus. Headache. Heart, failure. Herpes. Hiccoughs. Hypochondriasis. Hysteria. Impotence.
Laryngismus. Lungs, paralysis. Nymphomania. Palpitations. Pregnancy, complaints. Rage. Somnambulism.
Stings. Twitching. Typhoid. Vertigo. Whooping cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - Musk is a well-known perfume, which can produce fainting in some by smelling it. Useful
for all complaints that have easy fainting as a chief indication. Faints easily, faints dead away from the least
excitement. Faints while eating, during menses, from heart disease. Scolds and rages until she falls
unconscious.
Hysteria and nervous paroxysms. Faintingfits and convulsions, catalepsy. Globus hystericus ending in
unconsciousness. Spasmodic, nervous effects with a feeling of coldness. Twitching, choking. Epilepsy with
shuddering as from a rigor or chilliness.
Much nervous trembling and frequent fainting. Nervous, shuddering, laughter, hiccough etc. Tension in
muscles, skin, mind. Great flatulence. Parts lain on feel dislocated or sprained. Buzzing, squeezing, plug like
sensation.
Aggravation by cold, great sensitiveness to air. Coldness in general or of single parts. As of a cool wind
blowing on part. Wants to uncover. Poor reaction, diseases do not follow the normal course. Complains without
knowing what ails him. Imaginary diseases.
MIND - Absent-mindedness. Sudden loss of memory. Confusion ofmind. Mental activity with weakness, so
that everything falls from the hands. Awkwardness. Hurried, tremulous. Talks to himself and gesticulates.
Frightened easily. Anxiety with palpitations. Fear of noises, going crazy, something bad will happen. Fear of
dying, suffocation. Afraid to lie down, as they might die. Talks of death. Imaginary sufferings. Sexual
hypochondriasis. Nymphomania.
Censorious, critical. Abusive, insulting. Violent anger. Desire to break things. Deceitful, sly. Aversion to being
asked questions. Talks excitedly, raves, scolds, until mouth becomes dry, lips blue, eyes staring and she falls
unconscious. !
Hysteria. Uncontrollable laughter. Weeping, tearful mood alternating with laughter. One feels as if being
rapidly turned around. Delirium during convulsions. Sensitive to odors, to musk. Somnambulism. Coma vigil.
Alcoholism, dipsomania.
Ailments from domination by others.
Abdomen - Greatly distended. Tension in abdomen as if clothes were too tight. Incarceration of flatus.
Back - Backache. Tension in back, before menses.
Causations - Chills. Ailments from anticipation, deceived ambition, reproaches, domination by others.
Chest - Chest oppressed, hysterical spasms of the chest. Tightness of chest is obliged to take a deeper breath.
Constitutions - Suited to spoiled, sensitive natures and hysterical women and men. Girls who are selfish,
obstinate, self-willed and pampered, they resort to all kinds of cunning to have their whims gratified.
 Ears - Sounds as from report of a cannon. Rushing, fleeting sound. Nervous deafness.
Eyes - Turned upwards, fixed and glistening.
Face - One cheek red but cold, other pale and hot. Lips blue. Chewing motion of the lower jaw.
Female - Menses too early, too profuse, with disposition to faint (Nux-m., Verat.). Dysmenorrhea with fainting.
Drawing and pushing in the direction of the genitals, sensation as if menses appear. Sexual desire with
intolerable titillation in parts.
Food - Desire for black coffee, beer and brandy, stimulants. Aversion to food, everything tastes flat. Faints
while eating.
Head - Compressive pain over root of nose. Pressure on top of head. Headache with coldness, fainting,
involuntary stools, and polyuria. Shivering in scalp. Scalp sensitive.
Heart - Trembling around heart. Weak pulse and fainting. Anxious palpitation with fear of death. Hysterical
palpitations.
Kidneys - Diabetes. Copious, watery urine. Urine normal during day, but dark red, offensive at night.
Limbs - Painful, restless. Limbs, tense, feel too short. Coldness in tibia. One hand hot and pale, the other cold
and red.
Lungs - Sudden nervous suffocation, wants to take deep breath, worse from becoming cold, better after
belching. Difficult
respiration, chest oppressed. Spasm of glottis. Impending paralysis of lungs. Asthma with intense anxiety,
fear and smothering sensation. Hysterical asthma. Globus hystericus. Cough ceases, and mucus cannot be
expectorated. Cough with pain under left breast.
Male - Sexual desire increased with insupportable tickling in the parts and tensive pain in penis. Involuntary
emissions without erections. Erection with desire to urinate. Nausea and vomiting after sex. Impotence with
diabetes (Coca.). Premature senility.
Modalities - Better in open air. Better rubbing. Better smell of musk. Worse cold, open air, which is felt very
cold. Worse from excitement. Worse suppressions. Worse after and during a meal. Worse menses. Worse
from pressure. Worse motion, must lie down and lie still, but worse on side lain on. Vomiting worse after sex.
Nose - Bleeding with spasmodic jerking of muscles.
Rectum - Stools of sweetish odor. Stools are passed involuntarily in sleep.
Sensations - As if falling from a height. As of being turned about so rapidly he perceived the current of air
produced by the motion. As if cold air blowing on him. As if cold, wet poultices on head. Headache as if from
a heavy weight. As if larynx closed on breath.
Sleep - Sleepy by day, sleepless at night, awakes frequently. Somnambulism.
Stomach - Distended. Faints when eating. Spasmodic, nervous hiccough (Hydr-ac., Sul-ac., Ign., Caj.).
Violent belchings. Nausea, on seeing or thought of food. Anxiety in chest with stomach symptoms.
Temperature - Sensitive to cold air, which makes him shudder. Skin cold. Burning heat with restlessness.
Sweat smelling like musk.
Throat - Sudden constriction of larynx and trachea.
Vertigo - Vertigo with fainting, as if falling from a height, worse stooping, better rising. Vertigo on least motion.
COMMENTS - Tendency to faint often. Fainting spells (Am-c.). Spasms and twitches. Spasm of chest of heart,
general convulsions. Laryngeal spasm. Subsultus tendinum of fever. Tension in muscles in skin, in mind.
Tension in back before menses, tension in limbs, they feel too short. Pressure outward in heart.
Characteristic coldness in general, or it may affect single parts. Coldness with pallor. Sensation as if cool wind
blowing on parts. Coldness in tibia. Hysteria, laughing and crying fits. Sexual desire is much excited in both
sexes, even in the aged. Diabetes with impotence, with excessive thirst.
H. N. G. noted that it is useful “in nervous or spasmodic complaints where the patient feels very cold: in epileptic
fits where there is rigor or chilliness or shuddering as though the patient was very cold.”
RELATIONS - Antidotes: Camph., Coff. Compare: ( 1 ) Nux-m., Asaf., Valer., Sumb., Ign., Cast-eq. Planets:
Moon. Compatible: Ambr.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Mur- phy.

name: Mucuna Urens
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - muc-u. Mucuna urens. Horseeye. N. O. Leguminose. Papilionoideae. Venezuela. The
pulverized bean is macerated five times its weight of alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Hemorrhoidal discharges. Hemorrhoids.
HERBAL - In Ne w, Old and Forgotten Remedies is a letter by Delgado Palacios of Venezuela, pointing out
that the name Dolichos, given to Cowhage of Cow-itch in homeopathic literature is not in accordance with
 botanical terminology.
Cowhage is really a Mucuna, Mucuna and Dolichos being separate genera of the Leguminose. Allen gave
Linneus as the authority for the name Dolichos pruriens. There is no pathogenesis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Muc-u. is used for hemorrhoids and problems arising from
the hemorrhoidal diathesis. The keynote symptom is burning. There may or may not be bleeding. Affections of
liver, uterus, bladder and the testicles, when accompanied by hemorrhoids.
COMMENTS - Palacios said modern botanists consider Cowhage identical to Muc-u., but he does not name
his plant M. pruriens, an alternative name of Cowhage. He said, further, that M. urens is a “special plant which
grows in the calid regions of Venezuela,” and that the beans are “very difficult to obtain.”
Palacios used the pulverized bean for making his tincture. He gave one drop daily of the tincture and
sometimes made an ointment of it as well, He placed more reliance in it than in Ham. and Aesc. In Dol. the
entire pod is used, the stinging hairs being the most important part of it.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Murex Purpurea
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - murx. Murex purpurea. Purple fish. Murex purpureus. N. O. Gasteropoda. Trituration of
desiccated juice. Trituration or tincture of fresh juice. The fresh preparation is to be preferred, though the dried
is the usual one. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Breasts, pains. Cervix, disorders. Diabetes. Dysmenorrhea. Endometritis. Leu- corrhea.
Menopausal sufferings. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Miscarriage. Nymphomania. Pregnancy disorders.
Uterus, disorders. Uterus, prolapse.
HOMEOPATHIC - Petroz first proved Murx., which like Sep. produces the chief intensity of its action in the
female generative sphere. They are chiefly distinguished in that Murx. produces frantic sexual desire and tends
to have excessive hemorrhage with large clots, Sep. having in general a scanty flow.
Murx. is for sensitive, nervous, lively, affectionate women. Those who are very tired, weak and run down, must
lie down, which aggravates. Walking is difficult, all the joints are weak during pregnancy. Pains are diagonal,
ovary to opposite breast. Menopausal sufferings.
MIND - Great depression of spirits, a sort of deep hypochondriacal state. Great sadness, anxiety, and dread.
Imagines herself sick. Seemed to her she was hopelessly ill. Impatient. Memory weak, cannot find correct
words to express himself.
Conscious of uterus. Anxious, apprehensive, better leucorrhea. Sadness before menses.
Unconsciousness before menses. Wants to die, from intense abdominal pain during menses.
Nymphomania from suppressed menses. Nymphomania during metrorrhagia.
Abdomen - Painful weariness of loins. As if a weight in hypogastrium.
Back - Lumbago, sometimes burning and with pain like excoriation. On extending the body, pain in hips and
lumbar region. Pains in pelvic region. Sensation as if bones of pelvis getting loose.
Breasts - Benign tumors in breasts. Pain in breasts during menstrual period. Pain from right side of womb
to right or left breast.
Chest - Wheezing in chest. Pain in chest, as if it had been bruised. Sharp and burning pains below false ribs
on left side. Sensation as of a snake creeping over entire region of short ribs.
Constitutions - Suited to the melancholic or sanguine, lymphatic temperament. Especially adapted to
nervous, lively, affectionate women. Menopausal sufferings.
Ears - Cramp-like squeezing behind ears. Noise in ears with aggravation of heaviness of head.
Face - Burning sensation of one cheek, right in evening, left in morning.
Female - Conscious of a womb (Helon.). Pulsation in neck of womb. Feeling of protrusion. Prolapsed,
enlargement of uterus with pelvic tenesmus and sharp pains. Must keep legs tightly crossed. Sore pain in
uterus. Feeling as if something was pressing on a sore spot in the pelvis, worse sitting. Least contact of parts
causes violent sexual excitement. Desire easily excited, nymphomania. Menses irregular, profuse,
frequent, large clots. Dysmenorrhea and chronic endometritis. Leucorrhea green or bloody, alternate with
mental
symptoms and aching in sacrum.
Food - Hunger, sometimes in morning only and unfelt during a meal. Awful hunger and emptiness, even after
a meal.
Head - Squeezing at the back of head, better putting hand on it or by throwing head backwards.
Heart - Palpitations of heart and throbbing of arteries.
Kidneys - Constant urging (Kreos.). Slight discharge of blood while urinating. Urine frequent at night, smells
 like valerian.
Lungs - Cough in morning while fasting, dry, hard with oppression of chest.
Modalities - Better before menses, pressure support, putting head back, eating. Worse in sun, exertion, least
touch, sitting, lying down, night, after sleep.
Nose - Distressing coldness of the nose all day.
Rectum - Pressure in anus like painful lancinations. Sensation of heavy weight pressing on rectum. Swelling
of hemorrhoids. Difficultevacuations, constipation. During stool, bloody leucorrhea, discharge of pure blood by
vulva.                           >
Skin - Dry, as if about to crack. Hives.
Sleep - Urgent inclination to sleep. Drowsiness, sometimes with sadness. Sleep interrupted by pains.
Distressing dreams. Awakening with fright.
Stomach - Sinking, all-gone sensation in stomach (Sep.). Hungry, must eat. Violent hunger even after eating.
Throat - Voice changed, hoarse.
COMMENTS - Consciousness of the womb, sore pain in uterus. Cutting pains confined to the cervix and os.
Sensation of dryness and constriction in the womb. Feeling of bearing down and prolapse (Sep.).
General sensitiveness to touch. Feeling as if something were pressing on a sore spot in the pelvis. Pains are
frequently diagonal and shoot from ovary to opposite breast. Must lie down from weakness, but lying down
aggravates all symptoms.
The least contact with the parts causes violent sexual excitement. Cervix is sensitive to the examining finger.
The slightest touch causes bleeding of excoriation on cervix. Cauliflower excrescences.

***Hungry, sinking, all-gone sensation (Sep.).Diabetes. Excessive secretion of urine and frequent necessity to
rise at night to urinate. Great depression of spirits, a sort of deep hypochondriacal state, better when leucorrhea
is worse and vice versa.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Plat., Lil-t., Sep. the latter lacks sexual weakness of Murx. (2) Uterine congestion,
cervix affected, Sep. is passive, Murx. feels disgust and despair at her sexual desires. (3) Shooting pains in
uterus, prolapse, melancholy, Aur. has induration. (4) Nocturnal polyuria, Kreos. (5) Sexual weakness, Lil-t.,
Plat. Orig. (6) Dragging down, Bell. (7) Prolapsed uterus, Sec., Plat., Bell., Lil-t., Nux-v., Nux-m., Podo., Puls.,
Sep. (8) Consciousness of womb, Helon., Lyss. (9) Menopausal, Lach., Sep., Sulph. (10) Better throwing the
head back, Seneg.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Muriaticum Acidum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - mur-ac. Muriaticum acidum. Hydrochloric acid. Muriatic acid. First dilutions with distilled water.
Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Achilles tendon, disorders. Acidity. Alcoholism. Aphthae. Ascites. Anus, prolapse. Backache.
Bedsores. Belching. Carbuncles. Chilblains. Chorea. Cirrhosis. Deafness. Delirium. Diarrhea. Diphtheria.
Drug addiction. Dysentery. Feet, pains. Fevers. Flatulence. Hemiopia. Hemorrhages. Hemorrhoids. Hernia.
Impotence. Intestinal, fever. Measles. Mercurial, ulceration. Morphinism. Mouth, ulcers. Muscular,
exhaustion. Nosebleeds. Palpitations. Prostration. Septicfever. Scarlatina. Scurvy. Soreness. Stomach,
disorders. Stomach ulcers. Tongue, disorders. Typhoid, fever. Typhus. Ulcers. Varicose veins. Vomiting.
Whooping cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - The alchemist's'name of hydrochloric acid is the “Spirit of Salt,” which describes at once its
nature and origin. It is a colorless gas with a pungent, suffocating odor and acid taste, manufactured from salt
(Nat-m.) by the action of sulphuric acid. It is freely soluble in water and the saturated solution contains 43
percent of the hydrochloric gas.
Mur-ac. is aconsti tuent of the gastric fluids and must therefore be considered as allied to the sarcodes and
proximate principles of the tissues, e.g., Choi. Teste, who helped define the powers, groups it with Agn. and
Hyos. He considered its action to correspond perfectly to a typical case of typhus.
Mur-ac has an affinity for blood, producing septic conditions similar to that found in low fevers with high
temperatures and great prostration. Scorbutic states. Muscular exhaustion. Paresis of muscles, including the
heart, bladder, tongue, and, in particular, the mouth and anus.
Burnings and tearing pains. Dropsical swelling. Decomposition of fluids. Violent hemorrhages. Pulse rapid and
feeble. Pulsations in single parts. Soreness of the body causing restlessness. Frequently changes position,
but soon grows weak and very debilitated. Wants to lie down, slides down in bed, eyes fall shut, lower jaw
drops.
 Mucus membranes of the mouth and digestive tract are dry, bleeding, cracked and deeply ulcerated. Bloody
mucus membranes. Bluish tongue, hemorrhoids, ulcers. Involuntary discharges. Involuntary stools while
passing urine. Itching of anus and scrotum, not better by scratching.
MIND - Irritable and peevish, fretful. Sad and taciturn. Introverted. Suffers in silence. Loquacity. Muttering.
Loud moaning. Conscientious about trifles. Obstinate, headstrong. Great restlessness.
Indifference, apathy to pleasure. Discontented in open air. Delirium with fever, sleeplessness. Weary of life.
Absorbed in thought during menses. Anxiety during fever. Anxiety about future. Want of self confidence.
Cowardice.
Memory weakness. Absent-mindedness. Confusion of mind. Irresolution, indecision. Thoughts intrude and
crowd upon each other while at work. Stupefaction, as if intoxicated. Ailments from anger. Morphinism. Drug
addiction. Alcoholism, dipsomania.
Abdomen - Fullness and distention in abdomen from small quantity of food. Pressing pain and tension in
hypochondria. Liver enlarged, sore. Ascites from cirrhosis of liver. Cramp in abdomen, with griping in

***umbilical region. Empty sensation in abdomen, after stool, in morning. Rumbling. Flatulence with distension.
Hernia.
Back - Backache. Aching pain in back, as from having been having bent double for a long time or from a strain.
Shootings in shoulder blades. Furunculi in back.
Chest - Deep respiration with groans. Oppression across chest. Tensive pain in sternum. Incisive shocks in
chest. Sharp pains in chest.
Constitutions - Suited to persons of black hair and dark eyes.
Ears - Cuffing from mastoid to nape. Tingling, creeping, cold pain running up to vertex. Distant voice, talking
causes headache. Deafness.
Eyes - Eyes close on sitting from exhaustion. Vertical hemiopia.
Face - Dark or glowing red face with cold hands, but no thirst. Lips sore, cracked and scabby. Lower jaw fallen.
Pimples and freckles. Freckles due to exposure to sun.
Female - Leucorrhea with backache. Leu- corrhea during menses, soreness of anus. Menses appear too soon.
Ulcer in genitals. Pricking in vagina. Genitals very sensitive, cannot bear least touch.
Food - At times, ravenous appetite and constant desire to drink. Cannot bear sight or thought of meat.
Head - Occipital pains, leaden heaviness, worse looking intently at any object. Pain as if brain were crushed.
Periodical pain over left eye with numbness down right arm and aphasia. Sound of voice is intolerable. Hair as
if standing on head.
Heart - Shootings in region of heart. Shock in heart at night. Large full and soft pulse. Pulse, drops every
third beat. Pulse rapid. Pulse feeble and small. Palpitations felt in face.
Kidneys - Atony of bladder, must wait a long time, before urine will pass or has to press so hard that anus
protrudes. Cannot urinate without having bowels move at same time. Urine, red, violet, milky, copious, night
and day, escapes from passing wind.
Limbs - Heavy, painful and weak. Tottering gait. Staggers when walking from weakness of thighs and knees.
Pain in achilles tendon. Red, swollen burning fingers and toes. Eczema of dorsum of hands. Cramps in the
ball of thumb (right) when writing, goes off when moving it. Forearms heavy.
Liver - Liver enlarged, sore. Ascites from cirrhosis of liver.
Modalities - Better from motion. Better warmth. Better uncovering during fever. Better lying on left side. Better
after drinking. Worse from touch. Worse human voice. Worse walking, sitting. Worse before midnight. Worse
rest. Worse after sleep. Worse cold, drinks, bathing. Worse damp weather. Worse sun. Diarrhea worse after
eating.
Mouth - Dry. Fetid breath. Everything tastes sweet. Beer tastes like honey. Tongue, pale, bluish, swollen, dry,
leathery, shrunken or burnt looking. Tongue, heavy, stiff, hinders talking, paralyzed. Hard lumps in tongue.
Deep ulcers on tongue. Cancer of tongue, epithelioma, edges bluish-red (Carb-ac.). Aphthous mouth. Gums
are swollen, bleeding, ulcerating. Sordes on teeth. Teeth, worse acids and sweets. Lips, burn, heavy, bloated.
Glands swollen.
Nose - Nose stopped up. Coryza thin, acrid, excoriating, with itching, tickling and sneezing. Stinging pain in
sore nostrils. Nosebleed with much sneezing. Dark and putrid blood from nose.
Perspiration - Cold sweats, on feet, evening in bed. Sweats during first sleep, until 12 p.m., worse head and
back. Sweats at night and in morning. Aggravated when sweating, wants to uncover.
Rectum - Smarting and burning in anus. Anal itching and prolapsed anus while urinating. Involuntary stools or
prolapse of rectum, on urinating or passing flatus. Stools very difficult, as from inactivity of bowels.
Diarrhea with much flatus. Diarrhea with intolerable anal itching, not better scratching. Dysentery, blood and
 slime separated. Stools too thin, but round. Stools greenish in typhoid. Burning in anus after stool. Anus sore
during
menses. Hemorrhoids bluish, hot with violent stitches. Very sore hemorrhoids, better heat. Hemorrhoids
protruding like a bunch of grapes. Hemorrhoids most sensitive to all touch, even sheet of toilet paper is
painful. Hemorrhoids during pregnancy.
Sensations - Hair, as if drawn upwards, as if standing on end. Brain as if loose, beaten or torn to pieces, brain
clasped by a hand and bruised and torn. Occiput as if filled with lead. Deadness and numbness in forehead,
in fingers. Mouth as if glued up with mucus. As if some obstruction must be pulled out of throat. Burning as if
under skin of coccyx. As if place was jammed in Achilles tendon.
Skin - Papular and vesicular eruptions with greatitching (Rhus-t.). Eczema on back of hands. Scarlet fever,
livid with petechia, scanty eruption. Bedsores. Carbuncles. Foul-smelling ulcers on lower limbs. Ulcers throb
on walking.
Sleep - Great drowsiness during day, which disappears with exercise. Sleeplessness before midnight. Before
midnight, continued snoring, groaning tossing, talking and tendency to slide downwards in bed. Anxious
dreams. Frequent and early waking, caused by a coldness that is felt in bed.
Stomach - Achlorhydria. Lack of stomach acids and fermentation of food. Stomach will neither tolerate nor
digest food. Sensation of emptiness in stomach and esophagus, not better eating. Weak feeling in stomach
from 10 a.m. until evening. Acid reflux. Bitter, putrid eructations. Stomach ulcers. Burning pains. Vomiting
with belching, coughing. Gulping up of contents of stomach into esophagus, sometimes going down again.
Temperature - Cold in bed in early morning. Cold limbs. Intense burning heat with aversion to covers. Heat
without thirst. Typhoid types of fever, septic fevers.
Throat - Dry with burning in chest. Edematous, dark, raw. Ulcers and false membrane. Uvula swollen.
Involuntary swallowing. Attempt to swallow produces spasms and choking.
Vertigo - Vertigo, worse lying on right side.
Vertigo, occiput heavy as if filled with lead. Vertigo worse moving eyes, slightly. Vertigo lying on right side or
on back.
COMMENTS - Mur-ac. is a powerful antidote to Merc, (as is Nit-ac.), and it meets conditions caused by Merc,
as well as similar conditions. Like other disinfectants, it causes as well as remedies rapid decomposition of
tissues and dynamically cures low, putrid conditions met with in disease. Characteristic muscular prostration
from blood poisoning progressing to paralysis, finally of brain or heart.
Teste gave common features of the group in which he classified Mur-ac as a stupefying headache, obscuration
of sight and optical illusions, whizzing noises in the ears and hardness of hearing, nosebleed and loss of smell.
Rough, cracked lips and foul breath, scurvy of mouth, paralysis of tongue, loss of taste. Distended, sensitive
abdomen, pricking, bruised pain in abdominal walls.
Mucus membranes are very dry, bleeding, cracked and ulcerated. Burning, particularly burning eruptions on
lips. Ulcers. Eruptions and hemorrhoids. Varicose veins. Black pocks. Blind boils, frothy when touched. The
skin is sensitive to the sun, eczema solare and freckles.
Low, febrile states. Puerperal, diphtheria, exanthematous, and typhoid fevers. Fever with stinging heat,
frequent, small intermittent pulse, earthy or livid skin. Stitches about the heart. Excited sexual desires.
Impotence. Hahnemann noted a tendency “to slide down to the foot of the bed.”
Offensive, sour, acrid excretions. Offensive breath and body smell. Deafness, otitis and glandular swellings
about the ears. Sordes on teeth. Shrunken and paralyzed tongue, parched. Throat pains. Hoarseness,
spasmodic cough.
Serous, fetid diarrhea, not very painful. Involuntary stool. Paralysis of bladder. Prolapse of rectum, while
straining to pass water. Involuntary or difficult urination. There is straining and dribbling, and the straining can
cause a prolapsed rectum or involuntary stool.
Hemorrhoids like a bunch of grapes that look purple and burn when touched.
Cooper cured the case of a man, 52, whose sister had died of cancer, who had a hard, deep, warty ulcer, size
of a small bean on under surface of tongue, on the left side, with much surrounding hardness and little
discharge. Swollen tongue made his speech thick. It was ulcerated, especially on the right side that was hard
with swelling. This was followed by a lupoid ulcer on the corresponding side of nose, and had been going on
ten months.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Carbonates of alkalis and earths in poisoning cases, to small doses: Camph.,
Bry. Teste said the surest antidote is Ip. It antidotes: Merc., Op. It cures the muscular weakness following the
excessive use of opium (Hering). Compare: (1) Ph-ac., Ars., Bapt. (2) In typhoid state Bry. has worse motion.
(3) Rhus-t. - restlessness, better by motion, Rhus-t. has less debility. (4) Ph-ac. has less prostration is apathetic
indifferent. (5) Mur-ac. taciturn. (6) Apis has blisters on tongue and it catches teeth when attempt is made to
 protrude it. (7) Ars. has scanty evacuations. (8) Bapt. has besotted look tongue red on edges. (9) Bell, more
active, hyperemia. (10) Kaliperm. - throat symptoms, edematous uvula. Follows well after: Bry., Rhus-t.,
Merc.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Musca Domestica
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - musc-d. Musca domestica. House fly. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Arthritis. Awkwardness. Backache. Boils. Catarrh. Delusions. Dysmenorrhea. Eczema. Headache.
Herpes. High, fever. Masturbation. Memory, weak. Mumps. Rashes. Rheumatism. Salivation. Stupefaction.
Styes. Toothaches. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Lassitude. Heaviness, sensation externally and internally. Heaviness, internally, alternating
with lightness. Lack of vital heat. Heat alternates with a chill. Sensation of paralysis. Weakness, with
restlessness. Worse during a storm.
MIND - Fastidious. Conscientious, about trifles. Restlessness with pain. Restlessness, driving from place to
place. Desire for exercise and physical activity. Industrious. Elation. Extravagance. Irresolution. Impatience,
with children. Easily angered. Cursing.
Anxiety, with congestion, when alone. Fear of abandonment, sensation of isolation. Anxiety about health.
Anxiety about time. Fear of accident, sexual assault, men. Aversion to company, to certain people.
Memory, weakness. Forgetfulness, feels as if he had forgotten something. Confusion of mind. Rapid thoughts.
Confounds objects and ideas. Awkwardness. Mistakes in talking, words, localities, names. Confusion of mind,
identity. Stupefaction, as if intoxicated. Indolence.
Causeless crying. Tendency to weep. Sadness, before menses. Pities herself. Self loathing. Despair,
hopeless. Dwells on past disagreeable circumstances. Reproaches others. Desires sympathy. Worries for
others. Forsaken. Suicidal thoughts.
Delusion, that he died, and is alive again. That body and mind are separated. That he is being watched. That
fingers are scratching his body. Everything is dirty, foul. Visions of dead animals. Sees maggots, vermin,
insects.
Abdomen - Dull, knotting pain, sharp over bowel.
Back - Backache. Dull, throbbing pain. Pain in nape, neck. Neck pulling to left. Tension in neck, shoulders.
Pain in coccyx. Sensation of gap in mid-back. As if back were separated.
Breasts - Pain and swelling in breasts, before menses. Pain in nipples, in men.
Chest - Radiating pain, gas in center of chest. Aching pain, constriction.
Dreams - Dreams of sexual violence, abortion, sick babies, dying from cholera.
Ears - Cutting, aching pain. Oozing eruption on the earlobe. Sensitive to high pitched noise. Ringing noises.
Eyes - Dryness. Discharge in right eye. Stye, in right eye. Eyelid opens and shuts involuntarily.
Face - Eruptions, painful to touch, on forehead, eyebrows, over left eye. Herpetic eruption on lower lip, corners
of mouth. Inflammation of parotid gland.
Female - Painful menses, dysmenorrhea. Menses, profuse, brown discharge, spotting, intermittent. Pain in
lower vaginal region. Sharp pain in cervix, in left ovary. Herpetic eruptions. Boils on labia. Sexual desire
increased. Masturbation.
Food - Aversion to water. Desires chocolate, cheese. Desires bacon. Desires vinegar, sour food. Desires
coffee. Desires beer in the morning. Worse from cheese.
Head - Headache, frontal pressure. Pressure in temples, worse lying down. Dull aching in occiput. Dull,
gripping like too much caffeine. Throbbing head and above eyes. Head pain before menses. Dry, flaking, scalp.
Kidney - Musty smelling urine.
Limbs - Insensibility, limbs. Stiffness of limbs. Joint pain. Numbness in arms on waking. Aching pain, in upper
limbs, shoulders, upper arms, at night. Pinching, throbbing pain in wrist. Awkwardness, lower limbs, hands.
Throbbing pain in hip. Cracking pain in groin, worse walking. Lancinating pain in knee. Cold, numb feet.
Soreness in feet, soles.
Lungs - Greenish yellow expectoration. Shortness of breath.
Male - Pinching pain in testes. Sexual desire increased. Penis, flaccid. Impotency.
Modalities - Worse lying down. Worse from cheese.
Mouth - Profuse saliva, in gushes. Frothy mucus on waking. Salivation with mumps. Taste of lemons in mouth.
Breath, fetid odor. Bleeding, spongy gums. Lower gum line feels thin and stings. Chancre sore on tongue, lip.
Lip, split, cracked.
Nose - Obstruction. Catarrh. Acute sense of smell. Odors, imagined and real, fruit, peaches, sulphur.
 Perspiration - Night sweats.
Rectum - Constipation, must strain. Urging absent. Incomplete, unsatisfactory bowel movements. Excessive
flatulence, smelly. Stools are dry, pasty, soft, light brown, loose.
Sensations - Heaviness sensation. Alternating heaviness with lightness sensation. Paralytic sensation.
Skin - Greasy skin. Herpetic eruptions. Boils on right upper back. Flat, pink, scaly rash on chest. Eruption in
cervical area. Red rash above left axilla, after bathing. Eczema on hand. Raised red bumps on upper thigh.
Sleep - Snoring during nap. Overwhelming desire to sleep. Sleeping early. Sleeps in fetal position, right side.
Deep, soporific sleep. Recurring vivid dreams, of houses, fire, water, falling into water. Deep, unrefreshing
sleep. Restless. Waking groggy, late.
Stomach - Appetite wanting for dinner. Upset stomach, worse drinking cold water. Sharp pain, with belching,
gas. Sour eructations. Spikes or flashes of nausea.
Teeth - Toothache while eating chocolate. Pain in right lower teeth.
Throat - Sore throat, with tickling in the ears, worse tea. Mucus stuck in throat.
Vertigo - Light-headed. Drifts or falls, to the left, worse in morning.
Vision - Difficulty focusing. Blurry when reading. As if a bug was flying in peripheral sight.
REFERENCES - Sonz, Stewart.

name: Musa Sapientum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - musa. Musa sapientum. Banana. N. O. Palmacee. Araceae. Tincture of the dried flowers.
Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL-Anemia. Blood pressure. Brain, fatigue. Bronchitis. Constipation. Cystitis. Depression. Dyspnea.
Hangovers. Headache. Heartburn. Hemorrhoids. Morning, sickness. Mosquito, bites. Overweight. Pre-
menstrual syndrome. Seasonal Affective Disorder. Strokes. Tobacco, smoking. Ulcers. Warts.
HERBAL - C. Campbell commended bananas baked in their skins as an ideal food or even a “cure” for brain
workers, nervous persons and the anemic. A syrup made with the juice of bananas extracted by heat is
commended as a remedy in chronic bronchitis with insufficient expectoration and marked dyspnea.
Clarke had a case of profusely bleeding hemorrhoids, which had resisted every kind of treatment, showed
improvement and an ultimate cure.
HOMEOPATHIC - Jenner proved the tincture of banana flowers, producing costiveness and a sensation of
fullness about the anus in a person of regular habits. He cured a bad case of bleeding hemorrhoids with it.
Musa also produced pain in the bladder and passage of mucus with urine.
MIND - Brain fatigue. Depression.
Abdomen - Rumbling in stomach and bowels with expulsion of flatus.
Head - Dull, heavy, frontal headache.
Kidneys - Discharge of large quantities of mucus with the urine, with dull, aching pain in bladder region.
Mouth - Dry, rough and extremely astringent taste and feeling in mouth, tongue, and fauces, but afterwards
an increase of saliva.
Rectum - Constipation with feeling of fullness about anus.
COMMENTS - Bananas contain three natural sugars, sucrose, fructose and glucose, combined with fiber.
They also contain tryptophan, a protein that is converted into serotonin. Vitamin B6, which regulates blood
glucose levels and affect mood. High in iron, bananas can stimulate the production of hemoglobin. They also
contain potassium and are natural antacids.
Can be useful for depression, seasonal affective disorder and stress. Anemia. High blood pressure, strokes.
Premenstrual syndrome. Morning sickness. Hangovers. Constipation. Heartbum, ulcers. Neutralizes over-
acidity and reduces irritation by coating the lining of the stomach.
REFERENCES - Clarke. Murphy.

name: Muscarinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - muscin. Muscarinum. Muscarine. Muscarineis the alkaloid of Agaricus muscarius. Historical
dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Lachrymation. Perspiration. Salivation.
HOMEOPATHIC - Muscin. increases the lachrymal, salivary, hepatic secretions etc., but diminishes kidney
secretions. Salivation, lachrymation and excessive perspiration.
REFERENCES - Boericke.
 ***MUSTARD
(Bach Flower Essence)
PHARMACY - must-b. Mustard. Sinapis arvensis. The flower heads are picked above any seed pods and
boiled for half an hour. The water is strained and prepared as medicine. Historical dose: Take two drops from
the stock bottle into a one ounce dropper bottle, (add brandy or alcohol, if this bottle will be used for days or
weeks). This is the dosage bottle, take a few drops straight into the mouth or as needed in a little water or
juice.
HOMEOPATHIC - Must-b. belongs to Bach's group “Lack of Interest in Present Circumstances,” along
with Clem-b., Honey-b., Wld-r-b., Oliv-b., Wh-ch-b., and Ch-bd-b. Affects of head injury, nerve damage or
misalignment of the skull plates along fissures. Dampened consciousness (Hom-b., Scler-b., Wld-o-b.).
Depression and gloom. Lowered vitality, lethargy. Chronic fatigue and appetite disturbances (Chic-b, Crb-a-
b.). Solace found in eating and constipation (Chic-b., Will-b.), resulting in weight loss or gain. Sleep
disturbances (Pine-b., Wh-ch-b.). Disinterest in physical recreation and general decline in healthful interests
and habits (see Wld-o-b.).
MIND - Depression and gloom, with sensation of a weight or downward pull, better in the sun. Desires light.
Sadness, regret, weepy. Introverted. Absent-minded, disinterested in present circumstances. Lack of appeal
for
life. Boredom, sense of meaningless. Morose and ill-tempered. Sense of desolation, loneliness. Self-pity.
Withdrawal and joylessness in retardation (Horn-b., Wld-o-b.).
REFERENCES - Bach.

name: Mutabile Bacillus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - mut. Mutabile bacillus. Bacillus coli. A bowel nosode. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Asthma. Cystitis. Eruptions. Malnutrition.
HOMEOPATHIC - Mutabile bacillus is so named because it mutates almost as soon as it is sub-cultured from
a non-lactose to a lactose fermenter, and is of interest mainly from a bacteriological point of view as it is an
intermediary form between the B. Coli and the true non-lactose fermenting type.
This nosode is likely to be of value in treatment where there is alternation of symptoms. Associated with Puls.
Skin eruptions alternate with asthmatic symptoms (Calad.). Skin has a sallow color. Cystitis. Malnutrition.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Puls., Calad.
REFERENCES - Bach. Paterson.

name: Mygale Lasiodora
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - mygal. Mygale lasiodora. Black Cuban spider. Bird spider. Mygale avicularia. Aranea avicularia.
N. O. Arachnida. Latin America. Tincture of whole spider. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Chill. Chordee. Chorea. Convulsions. Dyspnea. Fever. Gonorrhea. Nausea. Palpitations. Syphilis.
Trembling. Twitching.
HOMEOPATHIC - The pathogenic data of Mygale consist of a proving by ayoung woman and the effect of a
bite on a man. In the latter case, inflammation ensued which spread along the lymphatics, violet and afterwards
green discoloration, chill followed by fever, dry mouth and great thirst, trembling, dyspnea, despondency and
fear of death.
The prover developed sadness, dry mouth, nausea with great palpitation, trembling, dim sight and great
general weakness increased flow of urine, hot, scalding with stinging in urethra. This last symptom led to the
successful use of Mygal. in gonorrhea, chordee and syphilis.
The “trembling” observed in the man suggests its use in nervous cases, but the sphere of Mygal. in chorea
has been developed from the clinical side. In the cases cured with it, twitching and contractions of facial
muscles have been very prominent, convulsive movements of head to right side, twitching of one side of body,
mostly right. The twitchings may be so violent as to prevent walking.
Chorea, especially of the upper parts. Constant motion of whole body. Convulsive, uncontrollable
movements of arms and legs. Twitchings and contraction of facial muscles and head, which is jerked to the
right side. Limbs are quiet during sleep, movements worse in morning.
Unsteady gait, limbs drag while walking. Mouth and eyes open in rapid succession. Words are jerked out in
the effort to talk. Nausea with palpitations and dim vision. Intense red streaks along lymphatics. Sexual
symptoms, violent erections, chordee. Weakness, nervousness, fear.
MIND - Sad, despondent with anxious expression. Fear of death. Delirious, talking about his business, restless
 all night.
Back - Pain in back, extending around to front.
Ears - Acute aching in right ear.
Eyes - Nausea with dimness of sight, weakness, palpitation.
Face - Twitching of facialmuscles. Mouth and eyes open in rapid succession. Hot and flushed.
Food - Excessive thirst. Aversion to food, no appetite. Better after eating.
Head - Head jerked to one side.
Heart - Strong palpitations, with nausea, dimness of sight and general weakness. Pulse frequent.

***Limbs - Constant motion of whole body. Twitching of limbs. Tremulous. Convulsive, uncontrollable
movements of arms and legs. Restless hands. Limbs drag while walking. Unsteady gait. Intense redness in
streaks, following course of lymphatics.
Lungs - Difficult breathing. Words jerked out when effort is made to talk.
Male - Violent erections. Chordee (Kali- br., Camph.). Protracted gonorrhea. Syphilis.
Modalities - Better during sleep. Worse in morning, eating. Legs in constant motion, worse sitting.
Mouth - Tongue dry and parched, put out with difficulty. Grating of teeth at night.
Sleep - Restless all night, with ridiculous dreams.
Stomach - Nausea with strong palpitations, dim sight.
Temperature - Severe chill lasting thirty minutes, then fever with excessive thirst and trembling of limbs.
Urine - Urine is increased, stinging in urethra, burning hot, scalding.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Agar., Tarent., Cupr., Ziz. (2) in chorea, Agar., Cimic., Ign., Stram., Ziz. Tarent.,
Ant-c.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Myosotis Symphytifolia
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - myos-s. Myosotis symphytifolia. Forget-me-not. Black-root. N. O. Bor- aginaceae. Marshy
places in Indiana. Tincture of fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Bronchitis, chronic. Bronchor- rhea. Coughs. Emaciation. Lung, disorders. Night-sweats.
Tuberculosis. Vomiting.
HERBAL - Hale collected some clinical experiences with Myosotis symphytifolia, which differs from Myosotis
palus tris in having large symphytum-like leaves, showing it to have a strong affinity for therespiratory organs.
HOMEOPATHIC - :Myos-s. affects the left lower lung. Chronic bronchitis and tuberculosis. Bronchorrhea.
Cough with profuse muco-purulent expectoration, gagging and vomiting during cough, worse during or after
eating. Pain in left lung (lower), painful while coughing and sensitive to percussion. Copious expectoration,
emaciation, night-sweats. Profuse sweat day and night.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Symph., Stann. - lung disease.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Myrica Cerifera
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - myric. Myrica cerífera. Bayberry. Wax myrtle. Candleberry. N. O. Myricacee. Tincture of fresh
bark of root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Achilles tendon, pain. Cancer. Catarrh. Conjunctivitis. Diphtheria. Headaches. Heart, disorders.
Insomnia. Jaundice. Leuc- orrhea. Liver, disorders. Pharynx, disorders. Stomatitis. Throat, sore, Urticaria.
HERBAL - According to Hale, though Myrica was known to old herbalists, it was Samuel Thomson, of lobelia
fame, who established its reputation. Thomson had a crude pathology of his own which served him to some
extent.
Myrica formed the chief ingredient in Thomson's once famous “Composition powder.” One of his ideas was
that the digestive tract was liable to become fouled with a copious mucus lining. This he called “canker” and
he stated of Myrica that it “has the power of disengaging the thick, viscid secretions of the mucus membrane
of the stomach.”
HOMEOPATHIC - The provings of Myric. confirmed Thomson's observation, that it produced a characteristic
abundant, offensive secretion of tenacious mucus in the throat, difficult to detach. Liver disorders with jaundice
and mucus membranes. Combined liver and heart disorders. Persistent insomnia.
MIND - Gloomy, despondent and dejected. Irritable, indifferent. Cannot concentrate mind on any subject.
Dull and drowsy state. Exhilaration, then excitement or depression, preventing sleep, with restlessness.
 ***Abdomen - Dull pain in the liver with pain under either scapulae. Fullness and burning in gallbladder.
Fullness in the stomach and abdomen. Flatus is passed continuously while walking.
Back - Pain under scapulae with liver complaints.
Eyes - Yellow sclerotica. Very red eyelids.
Face - Yellow, jaundiced. Itching and stinging. Creeping sensation.
Female - Acrid, fetid, thick, yellow, long lasting leucorrhea.
Food - Desire for sour things. Strong desire for acids. Imagines he cannot eat, the taste is so foul. Loss of
appetite, loathing of food.
Head - Pain and stiffness in nape of neck. Headache with drowsiness, yellow sclerotica, aching in eyeballs.
Pressure in vertex and forehead. Dull, heavy aching in temples and forehead on waking in the morning.
Scalp feels tight.
Heart - Pulse, slow, feeble, irregular Kidneys - Dark, frothy, scanty, high-colored, biliary urine.
Limbs - Pain under shoulder blades and back of neck, in all muscles, in hollow of right foot. Staggering gait.
Liver - Liver disorders with heart complaints, with urticaria with jaundice. Jaundice of infants. Liver cancer,
with bronze-yellow skin.
Modalities - Better from open air, eating, breakfast. Worse from warmth of bed, after sleep, morning, after
breakfast, motion.
Mouth - Dry, water relieves only partially. Tenacious, thick, nauseous mucus in mouth and throat. Taste
bitter andnauseous with offensive breath. Tongue, thick yellowish, dark, furred. Tender, spongy and bleeding
gums (Merc.).
Rectum - Urging to stools but passes only great amount of flatus. Constant discharge of flatus when walking.
Stools, foul, pasty, of gray color. Loose, light-colored stool, ash-colored and destitute of bile. Adhesive mucus
in stools.
Skin - Yellow and itching. Jaundice. Creeping sensation, as of insects.
Sleep - Drowsiness. Insomnia. Disturbed, bad dreams and frequent waking.
Stomach - Complete loss of appetite, but with a feeling of fullness in the stomach after a hearty meal. Weak,
sinking feeling in the epigastrium, approaching nausea increased after eating, relieved by rapid walking.
Throat - Constricted and rough feeling with a constant desire to swallow. Diphtheria. Stringy mucus, detached
with difficulty. COMMENTS - Long-lasting, profuse catarrhal discharges, offensive, tenacious and difficult to
detach. Leucorrhea, bronchorrhea intestinal catarrh, pharyngeal catarrh, stomatitis. Nasal obstruction, post-
nasal catarrh which often accompanies disordered liver.
Drowsiness, despondency. Weakness. Muscular soreness, aching in limbs. Sharp pains about the heart with
increased, audible pulsations, but slow pulse, worse lying on left side (Dig.). Pains in left chest and under
scapula (especially left) and pain in middle lobe of right lung.
Aching pain in liver, fullness. Jaundice. Itching of jaundice. Dull, heavy headache, worse in morning. Dirty,
yellow tongue. Yellowish white of eyes. Dirty, lids abnormally red. Ash-colored stools.
Douglass noted the case of Miss O., 18, who complained of itching and stinging on face, neck, right forearm
and leg. Sensation as if insects crawling on face, must brush them away. Skin yellowish tongue, thickly coated
yellow. Felt sick all over and rather irritable. Myric. 6x every two hours improved at once and cured in ten days.
Hale said it rivals Guai. as a local application in diphtheria. Burnett used Myric. with excellent effect with
jaundice, given in material doses. It has generally been given in the lower potencies.
RELATIONS - Antidote: Dig. - jaundice. Compare: (1) Ptel., Com., Chel., Lept., Fago.
(2) in tenacious secretions, Kali-bi., Hydr. (3) Jaundice, light-colored stools, slow pulse, Dig. (Dig. has pulse
irregular as well as slow, the tongue of Dig. has not the thick, tenacious coat of Myric.). (4) Liver, Berb., Chel.,
Chim., Podo., Hep., Merc., Choi., Hydr. (5) Urticaria
and liverdisorder, Astac. (6) Sore all over, Arn., Bapt. (7) Leucorrhea, Hydr. (8) Pain through left chest to
scapula, Ther., Anis., Pix.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Myristica Sebifera
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - myris. Myristica sebifera. Brazilian ucuba. N. O. Myristicacee. Brazil. Trituration of red, acrid,
very poisonous gum obtained by incising bark. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Abscesses. Arthritis. Boils. Carbuncles. Elephantiasis arabum. Erysipelas. Fistulas. Headache.
Injuries. Joints, disorders. Panaritium. Parotiditis. Suppurations. Traumatic, infections. Ulcers. Whitlow.
Wounds.
 HOMEOPATHIC - Mure proved and introduced Myris., which belongs to the same order as the nutmeg tree,
Nux-m. In the proving there was “pain in the fingernails with swelling of the phalanges.” This, apparently,
led to its use in whitlow in which many successes have been reported, including some from Chancerel
Pere.Spanish homeopaths used Myris. extensively. Olive of Gros reported cures of scrofulous osteitis, callous
ulcers, and phlegmonous erysipelas.
Works as an antiseptic. Inflammation of skin, cellular tissue and periosteum. Hastens suppuration and shortens
its duration. Traumatic infections. Panaritium. Parotiditis. Fistulas. Carbuncles.Phlegmonous inflammations.
Inflammation of middle ear, suppurative stage. Coppery taste and burning in the throat. Tongue is white and
cracked. Fistula in ano. Hands are stiff, as if from squeezing something a long time.
MIND - Heedless and careless. Indifference, apathy to business affairs. Stupefaction, as if intoxicated.
Concentration is difficult. Persistent thoughts. Vexed by a song which keeps running in his head. Excitable,
alternating with chilliness. Dreams of neglected business, quarrels, strife. Startled during sleep.
Abdomen - Sensation as if a foreign body, as large as a walnut, has lodged in left inguinal region, all forenoon.
Back - Pinching, right side of neck.
Chest - Hard pressure during night on both sides of chest, not affecting breathing.
Ears - Inflammation of middle ear, tympanum, myringitis. Suppuration of middle ear, tympanum. Abscess of
external meatus. Ringing noises.
Eyes - Redness of eyes and eyelids.
Face - Very red face.
Food - Thirst.
Head - Head heavy. Pain with pressure outwards. Headache in frontal eminence, at noon, better in open air.
Kidneys - Less frequent urination, scanty although he drinks much. Urine reddish yellow.
Limbs - Hands stiff as if from squeezing something for long time. Pain in left hand. Pain in hands worse when
they touch each other. Formication on left thumb joint. Pain in fingernails with swelling of phalanges. Pinching
pain in right calf.
Mouth - Tongue white and cracked. Whole mouth with tonsils and upper pharynx painful and sensitive to
contact, every mouthful seems to wound the parts when chewed or swallowed. Taste bitter of copper, which
excites spitting of blood. Palate insensible with loss of taste.
Rectum - Stools mixed with yellow mucus.
Skin - Malignant pustules. Abscesses. Carbuncles. Two pimples on left cheek, quickly disappearing.
Sleep - Cannot get to sleep. Restless sleep with unconnected dreams, about business, disputes, houses being
built commencing with top stories. Violent starting in sleep.
Throat - Burning at bottom of throat. Constriction at isthmus of pharynx, pain increases progressively. Difficulty
in swallowing saliva.
Urine - Red color.
Vertigo - Dizziness in morning. Vertigo, right to left on waking in morning. Vertigo, swaying toward left.
COMMENTS - Myris. is useful for abscesses from splinters and foreign objects, especially splinters under the
nails causing infection, pus and pain (Sil.). Suppuration of the joints. Kippax, according to Hansen, noted that
it is the principal remedy in elephantiasis arabum.
Cartier noted two cases in which he used Myris. The first was a young girl who had had her leg in a splint for
inflammation of the knee and doughy swelling of the entire limb for three months. Cartier came to the
conclusion that there was pus in the joint.
Myris. 3c, five drops three times a day, was given for three months.
Five months later, the swelling and inflammation were all gone, walking gave no pain, but the joint was
anchylosed.
The second case was an old man, 87, who was seized with sudden arthritis of the shoulder with intense fever.
Cartier was sent for and found the shoulder quite full of pus with a particularly painful spot on the scapula, at
a point where the bone was said by one authority to be attacked.
Myris. 3c, five drops three times a day, was given. In ten days there was no longer suppuration, the size of the
joint has become normal and the tender spot was gone.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Sil., Nux-m., Calc-s., Sulph., Pyrog.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

name: Myrrh
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - myrrh. Myrrh. Gum myrrh. Commiphora myrrha. Commiphora molmol. Balsamodendron
myrrha. N. O. Burseraceae. Middle East and Africa. Tincture from bush or small tree. Historical dose: Tincture
 and all potencies, third potency.
CLINICAL - Abscess. Amenorrhea. Anemia. Asthma. Bronchitis. Colds. Constipation. Coughs. Debility.
Dyspepsia. Flatus. Gastritis. Gum,diseases. Mouth, disorders. Pharygi- tis. Pyorrhea. Sores. Stomach,
disorders. Throat, sore. Thrush. Tonsillitis. Ulcers.
Myrrh
HERBAL - The Myrrh plant is a shrub or small tree. Myrrh is highly prized for its bitter, cleansing perfume. The
aromatic pale yellow, gum resin seeps out from fissures in the bark. It was part of the embalming mixtures of
the ancient Egyptians.
It is a stimulant, tonic and antiseptic. The tincture is used for sore throats, ulcers and thrush. Mouthwash for
infected gums or ulcerated tongue. The dry, powdered resin is often added to tooth formulas.
Myrrh is an excellent antiseptic, a slow and mild stimulant, possessed of moderate astringency, and acting as
a stimulating tonic. Its use occasions an agreeable sense of warmth in the stomach, large quantities causing
decided gastric excitement. It slowly increases the fullness and force of the pulse, and exerts a well-marked
influence on the capillary circulation.
It diminishes mucus discharges, leaves a sense of warmth in the respiratory passages, arrests decomposition,
and removes foul odors from sores. It is also a very good styptic in passive hemorrhages. Emmenagogue
properties have been attributed to it.
HOMEOPATHIC - Large doses of Myrrh quicken the pulse, raise the temperature, cause gastric burning, great
sweating, and prostration, vomiting and purgation may follow. Myrrh is a remedy for enfeebled states with
excessive mucus discharges.
Muscular debility. Respiratory weakness with difficult expectoration. Tonsillitis with large and infected glands.
Chronic gastritis and dyspepsia. Gas and frequent mucus stools.
Female - Dragging and weight sensation in the female pelvis. Leucorrhea. Suppressed menses in anemic
young girls.
Mouth - Pale tongue. Salivation. Abscesses.
Sores in the mouth. Inflamed and sore gums. Pyorrhea. Spongy and bleeding gums.
Throat - Sore throats. Pharyngitis. Infected and enlarged tonsils. Abscessed glands.
COMMENTS - As a local application in degenerate ulcers, it is of great value. Especially in phagedaenic,
malignant and fetid sores. Carbuncles, malignant scarlatina, putrid sore throat and diphtheria. After an indolent
bubo has been opened. In all such local cases it may be used in powder, tincture, or watery solution. It is a
favorite appliance in aphthous sores, and bleeding or spongy gums.
REFERENCES-Clarke.
