name: Myrtus Chekan
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - myrt-ch. Myrtus cheken. Eugenia cheken. N. O. Myrtacae. South America. Historical dose:
Tincture and all potencies.
HERBAL - The constituents and properties of chekan correspond with those which generally characterize the
family myrtacea. To this family belong cloves, allspice, eucalyptus and jambul, all possessing, in the part used,
stores of aromatic oil to which, at least, in great part, is due their valuable properties.
Dessauer considers it to possess tonic, expectorant, diuretic and antiseptic properties; he states that he has
used it with great success in bronchitis, vesical catarrh and other affections of the mucous membrane, also
that digestion is improved.
HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Dessauer, physicianin-chief to the German hospitals in Valparaiso, and Dr. Murrell, of
London, both were instrumental in introducing this remedy to the profession. Dr. Dessauer first had his attention
called to the plant by the successful self-treatment by one of his patients in a case of purulent bronchitis. He
then tried the chekan on members of his own family with equal success.
Myrt-ch. has chronic bronchitis with dense, yellowish sputum, difficult to detach. Copious expectoration keeps
patient distressed and coughing. Dr. John B. Garrison writes: “Myrtus chekan, should prove a valuable remedy
in bronchial catarrh.
The chief indications for its use are severe paroxysmal cough with dense yellow expectoration, which is difficult
to ‘bring up. * Sometimes the secretion is so abundant
Myrtus cheken that it rattles in the deeper bronchial tubes, but, owing to its tenacious character, only small
amounts are expectorated. Shortness of breath is also a marked feature, but the cough is the more important
of the two symptoms.
This remedy is not a ‘cure-all' for all forms of bronchitis, but only in those cases which present, at least, the
symptoms, ‘thick, yellow, sticky sputum, difficult to expectorate. ‘ Good results may be anticipated from its use.
In all elderly people who suffer from weakened power in expectoration and inability to thoroughly clear the
 bronchial tubes, Myrtus chekan is most reliable.”
COMMENTS - Chekan has done its best work in cases of chronic bronchitis associated with emphysema,
particularly in elderly persons suffering from ‘winter cough. ‘ As an example of this reference is made to
Murrell's report of fifteen cases of chronic bronchitis which were treated at the Royal Hospital for Diseases of
the Chest, London. All of the patients, with one exception, were men. The age of the woman was 51 years;
the ages of the men ranged from 36 to 58 years. They were all bad cases, many of them of many years'
duration.
Most of them had been attended at the hospital for some considerable time, and, almost without exception,
they had in former years undergone much medical treatment without much benefit. Their occupations exposed
them to cold, wet and draught, and in some cases they had the additional disadvantage of working in a dusty
atmosphere.
They complained chiefly of a paroxysmal cough with thin, yellow expectoration, and much shortness of breath
on exertion. On physical examination of the chest emphysema was detected, with, or without, a little bronchus
of the bases behind. They were, in fact, ordinary cases of winter cough.
REFERENCES - Boericke.

name: Myrtus Communis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - myrt-c. Myrtus communis. Myrtle. Closely allied to Granatum, the pomegranate tree. N. O.
Myrtacae. Tincture of fresh shoots and leaves. Tincture of fresh flowering shoots and leaves. Historical dose:
Tincture ahd all potencies.
CLINICAL - Bronchitis. Catarrhal, fevers. Chest, pain. Coryza. Coughs. Cystitis. Hemoptysis. Pyelitis. Syphilis.
Tuberculosis.
HERBAL - The leaves contain Myrtol and an active antiseptic.
HOMEOPATHIC - Myrt-c. is an unproved remedy, the symptoms are entirely clinical, of which Hering gives an
account.
Powerful action on the left lung, especially the upper part (Ox-ac., lower). Chest pains, as found in tuberculosis
patients. Incipient tuberculosis. Nerve sedative and stimulant to mucus membranes, bronchitis, cystitis and
pyelitis.
Breasts - Stitching pain in left breast, running through to scapula (Anis., Ther., Pix.).
Chest - Acute pressing pain in chest. Pain in upper part of left chest, through to shoulder, worse taking a deep
breath and making a strong motion. Stitching in left apex straight through to scapula, worse breathing, yawning,
coughing. Burning in left chest with throbbing, aching, tickling. Hepatization of lungs. Tuberculosis from
maltreated syphilis. Cough with tightness. Hemoptysis.
Lungs - Dry, hollow cough from tickling in upper anterior lobes of lungs, worse morning, better evening, great
lassitude in afternoon. Cough, coryza and catarrhal fever setting in with every atmospheric change.
Modalities - Worse from changes of atmosphere.
Nose - Coryza with cough.
Temperature - Catarrhal fevers with pain in elbow and knee joints, with dry, hollow cough, caused by tickling
in upper and front part of lungs, especially in morning, better evening, accompanied by lassitude
Myrtus communis in afternoon.
Throat - Dryness in throat, pains in throat and chest with expectoration of blood.
COMMENTS - Dr. John B. Garrison writes: “Myrtus communis, the common myrtle, was though highly of by
Hering, who made clinical tests with it, and found it to be useful in pain in the upper left lung, going right
through, from front to back, under the left scapula.
‘Great lassitude in the afternoon' he considered a very important symptom.”
Pain in upper left lung going right through from the front to the left scapula. The pain is mostly stitching, but
may be throbbing, aching or burning. It is worse in morning, better evening, worse by breathing, yawning,
coughing.
Cough is dry, hollow, excited by tickling in upper anterior lobes. Hemoptysis, Tuberculosis, lung syphilis,
hepatization. Cough and tickling in afternoon is better in evening. Every atmospheric change causes cough,
coryza and catarrhal fever.
Hering cured catarrhal fever with tickling cough worse morning and better evening with great lassitude in
afternoon.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Myrt-ch. (2) pains through left chest to scapula, Ther., Anis., Pix., Sulph. (3)
pain through lower lobe of left lung, Ox-ac. (4) Phos., Bry.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
 ***NABALUS SERPENTARIA
(White Lettuce)
PHARMACY - nabal. Nabalus serpentaria. White lettuce. Prenanthes serpentaria. Rattlesnake root. N. O.
Composite, suborder Chico- racee. Tincture of whole fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Constipation. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Dyspepsia. Emaciation. Headaches. Leucorrhea. Ophthalmia.
HERBAL - Nabalus is a Native American plant used in domestic practice for diarrhea and dysentery.
HOMEOPATHIC - There is only one proving with 1c and 3c dilutions by a married woman, age 19. The
symptoms somewhat resemble those of its botanical relative, Lact-s., especially in constipation and
somnolence. Susceptibility to magnetic contact and to the personal aura of others.
Pain in the abdomen and rectum, with emaciation. Dyspepsia with acid burning eructation. Craving for acid
food. Constipation and chronic diarrhea (Lact.), worse after eating, at nights and toward morning.
Leucorrhea with throbbing in uterus. Heaviness, as if blood vessels filled with lead, body heavy, she leans
about. Dull pains in joints and numbness on waking. Irritability of temper and occipital pain, worse in the
evening. Ophthalmia.
MIND - Continued melancholy. Depression followed by unusual buoyancy. Irritability of temper and occipital
pain.
Eyes - Great and lasting irritation of eyelids and margins, the margins sting and smart and are slightly swollen.
Sight weak.
Female - Sharp throbbing in uterus. Menses delayed. White, jelly-like discharge from vagina with weakness.
Food - Appetite and thirst diminished. Craving for acid food, lemons.
Head - Deep-seated frontal pains behind right eyeball and over eye. Occipital pains with stiffness in neck,
worse evenings. Headache with irritability and irritation of
eyes, throat and skin. Tipsy sensation.
Kidneys - Sharp, transient pain in right kidney. Diminished urine.
Nose - Right nostril sore. Smell and taste slightly impaired.
Rectum - Constipation, only three stools in twelve days, hard, painful, followed by prostration.
Skin - Subcutaneous glands irritated and swollen, especially behind right ear and in neck. Prickling as from
suppressed perspiration, general itching.
Sleep - Somnolence. Sleep prolonged, afterwards lighter and more broken.
Stomach - Burning belchings.
Temperature - Chilliness, not better by heat of fire. No febrile reaction except occasional flushes over head
and face.
Throat - Throat sore, tickling and scraping (left), worse lying down and swallowing saliva, then both eyes,
worse left.
RELATIONS - Compare: Lact-s.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Naja Tripudians
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - naja. Naja tripudians. Cobra venom. Cobra di capello. N. O. Elapide. India. The hooded snake
of Hindustan. Tincture of the fresh venom. Trituration of saturated with fresh venom. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Asthma. Collapse. Dysmenorrhea. Edema. Esophagus, stricture. Hay fever.
Headache. Heart disorders. Ovariesdisorders. Plague. Sepsis. Spinal irritation. Throat, sore.
HOMEOPATHIC - P. C. Majumdar noted that cobra poison had been used by Indian practitioners from ancient
times in many nervous and blood diseases. Naja, is not a hemorrhagic or septic medicine like Lach, and Crot-
h.
Naja, produces a typical bulbar paralysis. Causes no hemorrhage but only edema, hence the victims of this
reptile frequently bear very little sign of external injury, the only indication is often a small scratch or puncture.
The tissue lying beneath the wound is colored dark purple and a large quantity of viscid, blood-like fluid collects
in the
vicinity of the wound. The first symptom is an intense burning pain at the bite. There is an interval, usually an
hour, before other symptoms develop, after which they develop rapidly.
A feeling of intoxication is produced, followed by a loss of power over the limbs. Loss of speech, swallowing
and the control over the movement of the lips. Saliva is ejected in large quantities. The respiration gradually
becomes slower and slower and at length ceases. Victim remains conscious throughout.
 The action of Naja, settles around the heart, hypertrophy and valvular diseases. Affects medulla and
cerebellum, respiration, throat, ovary. Diseases primarily depending upon degeneration of motor cells. Sepsis.
Nervous, excited and tremulous with heart disorders, ojien reflex. Marked surging of blood upwards.
Heart is enlarged. Affections of heart with paucity of symptoms. Organs seem to be drawn together.
Constrictions in chest, throat. Concomitant with the heart symptoms are pain in forehead and temples.
Collapse. Swooning fits.
Feeling of intoxication. Loss of power over limbs and sphincters, unable to speak. Marked dyspnea, inability
to lie on left side. Insensible right side. Left sided symptoms. Very susceptible to cold. Sensation of wasting
away. Burnings as of hot irons. Screwed up sensation.
MIND - Absent-mindedness. Very forgetful. Stupid and confused feeling. Irresolution, mdecision. Wandering
of the mind. Brood- ng, over imaginary troubles and disease. Blurred speech. Insensible and speechless.
Aphasia. Aversion to talking. Affected easily by wine or alcoholic drinks.
Nervous, excited and tremulous. Wantof self confidence. Anxiety from pain in heart region. Forebodings.
Hypochondria. Fear of death, disease, being incurable, rain, accidents, misfortune. Dreads to be left alone.
Feels anguish for others. Anguish from pain in abdomen.
Melancholy. Sorrow felt in the heart. Depressed, as if everything were done wrong and could not be rectified.
Depressed with distress
about sexual organs, better in evening. Despair with the pains. Loathing of life. Suicidal disposition (Aur.).
Ailments from grief.
Insanity. Antagonism with self. Confusion as to his identity. Sensation of duality. Delirium during fevers, with
meningitis, typhus, typhoid fever. Sees images, phantoms. Delusion that he is a failure, that he has neglected
his duty, that he is being injured. Consciousness almost lost. Comatose.
Abdomen - Aching in loins. Cutting, twisting, griping pains. Much flatulence with rumbling and colicky pains.
Flatulence during day, at night with pain. Frequent cutting in umbilical region and small of back in afternoon,
then profuse and sudden leucorrhea.
Back - Rheumatic pains in neck and back. Cutting, aching in nape. Tired feeling in thoracic vertebra all day
with burning and exhaustion. Shooting from inner and upper angle of left scapula to front of chest. Pain
between the shoulders as if in spine afterwards involving scapula in morning on waking, worse moving arms.
Dragging sensation in spine between shoulders. Acute pain in small of back, gnawing pain.
Breasts - Milk decreased, next day returned freely, afterwards scanty. Occasional pain at top of both breasts.
Causations - Ailments from anticipation, grief, sorrow.
Chest - Constriction in chest, in evening. Oppressive weight on chest, as if a hot iron had been run in.
Uneasiness and dull, heavy pain in chest. Sharp pains, worse on deep inspiration. Ribs feel broken. Heavy
pain over lower half of right chest with stabbing on deep inspiration, cannot cough for the stabbing, worse lying
left side, better lying on affected side. Tenderness over sternum and in throat.
Cough - Irritating, dry cough. Cough from sticky mucus and saliva. Cough with tightness and fullness in
larynx. Cardiac cough. Dry, hacking cough with blood-spitting. Hoarseness, short, hoarse cough.
Ears - Burning heat of ear. Otalgia. Chronic otorrhea, black discharges, smells like herring brine. Noises in
ears. Whizzing in
left ear with insipid, almost nauseous taste in mouth. Noise as of a mill, waking him in morning. Illusions of
hearing.
Eyes - Fixed and staring, wide open and insensible to light. Pupils dilated. Loss of vision. Hot pains at back of
eyeballs. Ptosis of both lids. Heaviness in eyelids. Lids swollen in morning.
Female - Pain in left groin, especially in post-operative cases, seems to be drawn to heart. Neuralgia of left
ovary. Crampy pains in left ovary. Aching in left ovary with pains in heart, come on a week before menses,
grow worse until menses appear, then easier until next month.
Food - Loss of appetite. Thirsty. Craving for stimulants, which aggravate.
Head - Pain in forehead and temples with heart symptoms. Pain in left temple and in left orbital region,
extending to occiput with nausea and vomiting. Severe throbbing and aching in temples. Constriction across
forehead. Severe headache with intense depression. Headache supervening on cessation of menses.
Neuralgic headache extending backwards from orbital region. Shooting up occiput. Vertex sensitive to cold.
Aching in vertex with cold feet. Feeling as of a blow from behind on head and neck. Sensation as if brain
was loose. Entire head feels hollow. Confusion and dullness in head in morning. Sensitiveness of scalp. Hair
falls off the vertex
Heart -Acute and chronic septic endocarditis . Damaged heart after infectious diseases. Hypertrophy,
weakness. Valvular heart disorders. Heart lesions (Spong., Laur.). Low bloodpressure (Elaps., Vip.).
Visible palpitations. Palpitations prevent speech because of choking. Chronic nervous palpitations, worse after
 preaching. Threatened paralysis of heart, body cold. Sharp pain in region of heart. Angina pains extending to
nape of neck, left shoulder and arm with anxiety and fear of death. Heart symptoms with pain in forehead and
temples. Dragging and anxiety in précordia. Feeling of weight on heart. Irregular in force. Pulse slow,
irregular, weak, tremulous.
Kidneys - Uneasiness and pressure in bladder. Urine of deep straw color. Urine deposits red sediment, mixed
with mucus, loaded with gravel and mucus.
Limbs - Sudden loss of strength in limbs. Rheumatic pains in limbs. Drawing, lacerating, worse motion.
Cramps in shoulders, nape or thighs. Aching in ankles, lower part of thighs, wrists and shoulder joints, on
waking. Violent racking in marrow of thighs. Numb left arm. Puffy or sweating hands and feet with cough. Acute
pain under the left thumb nail running up the arm.
Lungs - Labored and difficult breathing. Gasping for breath. Puffing breathing. Breathing very slow, shallow
and scarcely perceptible. Suffocative spells after sleeping. (Lach.). Dry or empty feeling in left lung. Asthmatic
constriction of chest, cannot expand lungs, followed by mucus expectoration. Asthma preceded by coryza,
worse lying, better sitting up. Cardiac asthma. Expectoration of whitish viscid mucus in morning on waking.
Spitting of blood, which had no tendency to coagulate.
Male - Stinging, somewhat burning pain along right side of penis, immediately under skin, at night in bed and
in morning after rising. Increased sexual desire. Desire on going to bed with frequent waking, vivid
imaginations. Nocturnal emissions. Involuntary emissions, then prostration and distress. Peculiar distress,
great desire, but no physical power, with depression.
Modalities - Great relief of pain and breathing by lying on right side. Better from walking or riding in open
air, sneezing, smoking. Worse from stimulants, alcohol, cold air, drafts, riding in carriage, touch, pressure of
clothes. Worse lying on left side, after sleep, after menses. Headache worse at 3 p.m.
Mouth - Great dryness of the mouth. Wide open, flow of saliva. Foaming at mouth. Taste insipid, bitter, sour,
metallic. Tongue cold, coated thick yellow, white, dry, no thirst. Ulcers on frenum. Loss of speech.
Nose - Hay fever with dry larynx. Hay asthma. Flow of water from nose, then intense sneezing which betters
the breathing.
Rectum - Urging always sudden, whether followed by diarrhea or not. Sudden urging, then small, bilious stool.
Constipation, feeling of a large stool which when voided was small. Diarrhea with pain in abdomen, profuse,
sudden, slimy, white or green, bilious. Heat in anal region with itching, smarting at anus.
Sensations - Screwed-up sensations and crampy pains. As if head screwed together. As if heart and ovary
were drawn up together. Pains in temple and ovarian regions. Pain from heart to scapula. Sensation as if a
hair in larynx. Pain as from needles in tonsil. The left side is predominantly affected.
Skin - Itching scars. Creeping, itching and tingling sensation in skin. Skin swollen, mottled and of dark purple,
livid color. Gangrene. Small, white itching blisters on inflamed base, on neck, nose and body in afternoon.
Large pimples on inflamed base. Pimple on upper lip, on left ala nasi, on tip of nose, sore in consequence,
painful on brow. Boil-like swelling on back of middle phalanx of right little finger. Painful chilblains on feet.
Sleep - Yawning, great sleepiness. Dozing and moaning. Sleepiness in evening and weakness. Deep,
profound, comatose with stertorous breathing. Restless, disturbed sleep. Long and vivid dreams, little recol-
lection of the subjects, affairs of the day recalled with additions and new plans for the morrow. Dreams of
murders, suicides, fires, etc.
Stomach - Uneasy, disagreeable feeling in stomach, as from indigestion, pressure as from stones after a
meal. Acidity in stomach. Heartburn, belchings tasting like barley water or hot and foul. Nausea with faint
feeling, vomiting.
Temperature - Body cold and collapsed. Limbs very cold, icy coldness of feet. Very sensitive to cold. General
sweat, cold, clammy. Free perspiration. Flushes of heat in face at different times of day, worse left side. Head
hot and full of blood and much
sweat in palms. Feels very uncomfortable, hot and feverish. Heat, but he refused water, heat with prostration
with discomfort, dry lips and tender, hot mouth.
Throat - Roughness and scraping in throat. Soreness and pricking in left side of throat. Dryness and
constriction of throat and fauces. Dark red color of the fauces. Redness of left side in morning with pain on
swallowing. Irritation and tickling in larynx and trachea. Stricture of esophagus, swallowing difficult or
impossible. Grasping at throat with sense of choking. As a lump in throat. Much mucus in throat. Shooting in
left tonsil.
Vertigo - Vertigo, lasting a short time, followed by astounding pain in right side of head.
COMMENTS - Naja, was introduced into homeopathy by Russell and Stokes, who made the first provings
along with some forty other provers including Gillow, Pope and Drysdale. Provings were made with low
potencies.
 Majumdar had no success with Naja, until he obtained fresh venom from snake charmers and made potencies.
Previously the Naja, used by Indian homeopaths had been re-imported into India from England in the form of
potencies.
Deane, in his experience in the plague epidemic of 1899-1900, found Naja, prepared from the fresh venom
more efficacious than Lach.
Naja, has an affinity for the medulla oblongata and cerebellum. Heart failure and distress. Weak valves with
regurgitations, stenosis, prolapse. Acute and chronic endocarditis. Heart damage after infectious diseases.
Low blood pressure. Fluttering palpitation sensations outside the chest. Depression and weakness about the
heart. Inability to speak with choking, nervous chronic palpitations. Pulse is slow, irregular.
Severe pains in left temple, cardiac and ovarian region. Diphtheria with impending paralysis of heart. Sensation
of weight, of a hot iron, on the chest. Sensation as if heart and ovary were drawn together.
Pains about heart extending to nape of neck, left shoulder and arm with anxiety and fear of death.
Neuralgic pain in head, preceded or followed by nausea or vomiting. Severe throbbing in left orbital region
drawing back to occiput, from over-eating, mental or physical exertion. Headache after cessation of menses.
Dull, heavy constriction in forehead on waking.
Characteristic grasping at the throat with choking sensations. Esophageal spasms. Worse at night, patient
wakes gasping, surface blue. Worse by lying on left side. Useful for snake bites (Lach.).
According to Hering, nervous phenomena predominate in Naja, over other serpent poisons. It acts primarily
upon the nervous system, especially on respiratory nerves, pneumogastric and glossopharyngeal.
Majumdar related the case of a young woman suffering from a heart affection who had oppression of the chest
amounting almost to suffocation, feeble, irregular, almost imperceptible pulse, anemic appearance, inability to
speak.
One dose of Naja, was given, followed four hours later by a second. These sufficed for the cure. The next day,
when the doctor called, his patient addressed him in a loud voice, “Doctor, you gave me a poison last night.”
When asked to explain, she said that after the first dose she “felt awful heat in her system.”
Majumdar saved a number of apparently hopeless cases of cholera with Naja, in the collapse stage with lack
of pulse and difficulty of breathing.
In a case cured by Russell there was dragging and anxiety in the précordia occurring in great grief.
Andrew M. Neatby related a cure with Naja. 6c that had nervous palpitations and faintness, frequent sensation
of swelling, of “choking” in the throat, with dyspnea and occasionally of anesthesia down the right side.
Mahlon Preston cured himself with Naja. 30c of asthma with difficult breathing, worse lying down, better sitting
up. He cured many
cases of hay fever and autumnal catarrh that had a flow of water from the nose for a few minutes, then intense
sneezing, which relieved the breathing. After recurring for a few days, there is dryness in the lungs with great
difficulty of breathing, worse on lying down.
Bunn cured the case of Miss S., 22, who had dysmenorrhea since her menses were established. Dilatation,
galvanism., etc., had been tried in vain. She had shooting pain in the region of the left ovary and faintness.
Hypogastrium revealed nothing abnormal except sensitiveness of the ovarian region.
Extreme restlessness with the pain. During the menses the pains suddenly became very severe. The flow
stopped when the pain was at its worst and returned the next day with relief from pain. Naja. 30c was given
and the next period passed absolutely free from discomfort.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Ammonia, stimulants (effects of bite), tobacco (to potencies). Compare: (1)
Snake venoms. (2) Bung-f.- this venom produces a condition like an acute polioencephalitis and myelitis. (3)
Lach., Crot-h., Spig., Spong. (4) Depression and suicidal tendency, Aur. (5) Ulcer of frenum lingue, Nat-c.
Agar. (6) Headache from before backwards, Anae., Bry., Nux-v. (7) from behind forwards, Gels., Lac-c., Sang.,
Sil., Spig. (8) Diphtheria. Arum-t. (9) Heart, Ars., Cact., Iber., Lach., Spig., Dig. (10) Collapse, Carb-v., Camph..
Tab. (11) Mouth wide open tongue cold, Camph. ( 12) Loss of speech, Dulc., Gels., Caust., Hy., Laur. (13)
Dark red, color of fauces. Ail., Bapt., Phyt.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Naphthalinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - naphtin. Naphthalinum. Tar camphor. Naphthalene. Achemical compound from coal tar.
Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Amblyopia. Asthma. Bronchitis. Cataract. Diarrhea. Eczema. Flatulence. Gleet.
Gonorrhea. Hay asthma. Psoriasis. Retina, detached. Tuberculosis.
Typhoid fever. Whooping cough. Worms.
 HOMEOPATHIC - Naphthalene is a hydrocarbon obtained by distillation from coal tar. It consists of colorless,
transparent, lustrous scales or, when crystallized, of rhombic tables or prisms.
Naphtin. is an unproved remedy, though it has been used in old-school practice as an intestinal antiseptic and
vermifuge, as an expectorant, as a remedy for eczema and psoriasis, and as an antiseptic application to
wounds.
Naphtin. is for the expulsion of thread worms after the bowels have been freely opened by a cathartic, given
in doses of grains 1/4 to grains 1/2 four times a day for two days. The dose should not be given after a meal
and all fats and oils should be abstained from during the treatment, which may be repeated once or twice after
leaving a week’s interval.
Affinity for the eyes. Detachment of the retina, deposits an exudation in the retina. Opacity of cornea, cataract,
amblyopia. Long and continued attacks of coughing, unable to get a breath, sometimes so violent as to cause
perspiration. Whooping cough.
Abdomen - Incarcerated flatus in the transverse colon causing cardiac distress.
Eyes - Eyes inflamed, painful, bloodshot, in hay fever. Cataract. Amblyopia. Detached retina. Shiny bodies in
vitreous. White patches on retina of oxalate, sulphate and carbonate of calcium.
Face - Lips and face cyanotic. Face pale, yellow. Twitching of facial muscles.
Food - Loss of appetite.
Head - Headache with fever, drowsiness and loss of appetite.
Head - Saliva flows from the mouth.
Kidneys - Sudden, violent desire to urinate, urethra meatus red and swollen, prepuce edematous. Urine is
dark brown, becoming black after standing, albuminous. Incontinence of urine. Gonorrhea. Gleet.
Lungs - Breathing is labored and irregular, asthmatic. Cough in violent, incessant paroxysms almost arresting
breath, compelling the patient to hold his head for the pain. Cough with blue or purple face. Expectoration free,
thick, tenacious, almost
absent. Night cough preventing sleep. Male - Edema of prepuce.
Nose - Coryza, thin, excoriating discharge, much sneezing. Hay fever. Attacks of sneezing. Irritation of nose.
Rubs his nose to remove the irritation.
Rectum - Incontinence of urine and feces.
Thin, offensive diarrhea of tuberculosis. Skin - Eczema. Psoriasis.
Sleep - Very great drowsiness lasting some days.
Temperature - Sudden onset of a fever, with headache and loss of appetite. Temperature reduced in typhoid.
COMMENTS - Some cases of Naphtin. poisoning have been reported. Evers recorded chronic illness, loss of
appetite, headache and eczema over both legs as due to Naphtin. which was used as a moth powder and
sprinkled on bedding.
In another case, a boy, 12, came home one evening apparently drunk, semi-conscious, staggering, unable to
answer questions. He had eaten two candies which were really mothdestroyers, each tablet containing two
grams of pure naphthalin. An emetic was promptly administered and the next day the boy was still drowsy but
quite conscious. The drowsiness lasted four days.
Attacks of sneezing from nasal irritation, frequently attempting to remove the irritation by rubbing his nose. In
two hours incoordination had increased. Twitching of facial muscles. Saliva flowed freely from the mouth.
Lippincott was the first to use Naphtin. in cases of hay fever, having heard that hay fever sufferers who went
into factories where Naphtha was much used were always cured. His experience of its value was speedily
confirmed by other observers. Naphtin. lx and 2x were used in the first trials.
W. Louis Hartmann of Syracuse is the chief homeopathic authority for this remedy. His leading indications for
it are acute coryza with fluent excoriating discharge and much sneezing. Paroxysms of coughing, following
each other in rapid succession so that the patient is unable to take his breath (as in asthma and whooping
cough). He found it more often indicated than any other drug in whooping cough.
The spasmodic action and the cyanosis of the drug are good indications here, though it is not necessary to
wait until the child is blue before prescribing Naphtin. Followed well by Dros.
In a case of tuberculosis of the left lung, Naphtin. removed an inability to sleep for cough. Exhausting night-
sweats and offensive, thin diarrhea during the day.
In three cases in which Naphtin. had been applied to wounds there was sudden onset of fever, headache, loss
of appetite. In one of them, there was temporary mania with incontinence of urine and feces. In two of them,
albuminuria. All symptoms rapidly disappeared when Naphtin. was discontinued.
J. Meredith cured with the Naphtin. 6x incarcerated flatus in transverse colon causing cardiac distress.
Hartmann used the lx trituration, having been disappointed with higher potencies.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Salol., Carb- ac„ Anil., Methyl-b. and coal-tar products generally. (2) In coughs,
 Dros. which follows Naphtin. well. (3) Coc-c., Arn., Bell., Cor-r. Ip. (4) In tuberculosis, Petr., Basil. In eye af-
fections, Choi. (5) In gonorrhea, Thuj., Petros., Salol. (6) In hay fever, Psor., Sabad., Ars., All- c., Kali-i. (7) In
worms. Cina, Teucr.
REFERENCES - Anshutz. Clarke.

Typhoid fever. Whooping cough. Worms.

name: Narcissus Poeticus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - narc-po. Narcissus poeticus. Daffodil. N. O. Amaryllidaceae. Tincture of unexpended blossom-
buds, stem, leaf and flower. The young buds, stems and leaves are macerated in two times their weight of
alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Bronchitis. Coryza. Cough. Diarrhea. Whooping cough.
HERBAL - The name of the plant, Narcissus, is not from that of the fabled youth who fell in love with his own
image reflected in the water, but is from the Greek Narkao, “tobenumb, ”on account of the narcotic properties
of the drug. Theclassic Asphodel and the Narcissusare the
Narcissus poeticus same, from which it may be seen that the plant dates back as far as man’s records go.
Dr. Charge’s work, Maladies de la Respiration, quoted the great Laennec as an authority in regards Narcissus.
Fernie, in his excellent Herbal simples, also said “An extract of the bulbs applied to open wounds has produced
staggering numbness of the whole nervous system and paralysis of the heart. Socrates called this plant the
‘Chaplet of the Infernal Gods,’ because of its narcotic effects.”
He also noted that a decoction of the dried flowers is emetic and when sweetened will, as an emetic, serve
most usefully for relieving the congestive bronchial catarrh of children.
On the other hand, the alkaloid from the bulbs after flowering produces copious salivation, increases cutaneous
secretion, contracts the pupil of the eye, produces slight relaxation of the pulse and slight faintness and nausea.
Daffodil bulbs contain an alkaloid the action of which, according to authorities, varies as to whether the alkaloid
is extracted from the flowering bulb or from the bulb after flowering.
The National Dispensatory noted that “The emetic action of Narcissus has been used to break up intermittent
fever and relieve bronchial catarrh with congestion or obstruction of the air tubes. Like Ipecacuanha, it has
also been prescribed in dysentery, especially of the epidemic form. Its influence upon the nervous system is
attested by the vogue it has enjoyed in hysteria, chorea, whooping cough and even epilepsy.”
HOMEOPATHIC - The concluding paragraph in Fernie’s section on the Narcissus states: “The medicinal
influence of the daffodil on the nervous system has led to giving its flowers and its bulb for hysterical states
and even epilepsy with benefit.”
Narc-po. is peculiarly homeopathic to long-continued coughs, especially of nervous origin. Bronchitis.
Convulsive stage of whooping cough. Coryza, frontal headache. Faintness and drowsiness. Symptoms of
nausea followed by violent vomiting and diarrhea.
Eyes - Running at eyes. Pupils contracted at first, dilated later.
Head - Frontal headache.
Heart - Pulse increased.
Mouth - Increased flow of saliva. Free salivation of very ropy saliva.
Nose - Severe coryza.
Rectum - Diarrhea with severe aching below left free ribs. Stools are watery, relaxed, loose, some solid.
Skin - Erythema of a papular, vesicular and pustular types, aggravation in wet weather.
Stomach - Sinking, sick sensation. Rumbling. Heartburn. Hiccough. Vomiting.
Temperature - Hand which was quite wet with perspiration became dry in twelve minutes.
Throat - Dryness in throat.
COMMENTS - A patient of Clarke’s once had a very severe cough set up by daffodils used in some profusion
as a decoration of a dinner table.
A fatal case of poisoning from eating the flowers is on record. A salad of onions in which were mixed some
bulbs of Narcissus poeticus, caused burning, copious stools with dreadful griping, obtuse senses, fainting, cold
hands, and cold sweat. Symptoms were not distinguishable from the usual effects of Colch. and similar to
those of Narc-ps.
J. Meredith made a conserve of flowers, buds and stems by mashing them with six to ten times their weight of
sugar in a Wedgwood mortar with a wooden pestle. Counting this as lx, he made sugar potencies to 4x, and
with these he cured a case of bronchitis with continuous cough which had resisted many of the standard
remedies.
In Ringer’s experiments, the bulb preparation produced the greater number of effects including salivation,
sinking, vomiting and diarrhea. The flower preparation acted on the head and eyes and dried up a profuse
 perspiration of the hands.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) All-c., Colch., Lil-t. Narc-ps.
REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke.

name: Narcotinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - narcot. Narcotinum. Opium alkaloid. Noscapinum pura. Papaveraceae. Trituration. Historical
dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Bladder, paralysis. Vertigo.
HOMEOPATHIC - Narcot. has been rather extensively proved, but very few distinctive symptoms were elicited.
The most notable were dry, clammy mouth, thick indistinct speech and paralysis of bladder. The vertigo
symptoms were like those of Morph., and the general symptoms those of Op. and its other alkaloids.
REFERENCES-Clarke.

***NASTURTIUM AQUATICUM (Water-cress)
PHARMACY - nast. Nasturtium aquaticum. Water-cress. Nasturtium officinale. Roripa nasturtium. Roripa
aquaticum. N. O. Crucif- erae. Tincture of the whole plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Cirrhosis. Hysteria. Neurasthenia. Tobacco, poisoning.
HERBAL - Nasturtium is useful in scorbutic disorders and constipation, related to strictures of urinary
apparatus. Supposed to be an aphrodisiac.
HOMEOPATHIC - Nast, is antidotal to tobacco poisoning. Sedative in neurotic affections, neurasthenia,
hysteria. Cirrhosis of liver and dropsy.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Natrum Arsenicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - nat-ar. Natrum arsenicum. Sodium arsenate. Atoxyl. Hydric di-sodic arsenate. Solution.
Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Anemia. Asthma. Blepharitis. Conjunctivitis. Coryza. Cough. Diphtheria. Edema. Emaciation.
Esophagus, constriction. Eyes, inflammation. Granular, eyelids. Hemoptysis. Interscapular pain. Leukemia.
Miner’s asthma. Nose, disorders. Pityriasis rubra. Post-nasal catarrh. Testicles, neuralgia. Tuberculosis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Nat-ar. has been very extensively proved, notably by Imbert Gourbeyre. The principal
clinical useofNat-ar. has been in diphtheria, when it presents with a dark purple throat, great swelling, much
prostration, and not much pain.
Useful in disorders of the eyes and nose. Generally irritating effects. Miner’s asthma from coal dust. Lungs
feel as if smoke had been inhaled. Racking cough with profuse greenish expectoration. Oppression of chest
and about the heart. Nasal catarrh with headache, pain at root of nose, dry and painful eyes. Bronchitis of
children, chronic.
Feels tired all over. Psoriasis (Ars., Thyr.). Leukemia (Ars.). Emaciation. Edema. As if the thyroid gland were
compressed by a thumb and finger. Cartier noted that it facilitates the termination of a cold and conserves
strength and appetite.
MIND - Mental dullness, listless. Concentration difficult while studying, reading. Forgetfulness. Imbecility.
Timidity. Depressed, as if something bad impending. Lamenting, bemoaning, wailing. Hysteria. Ailments from
anger, vexation. Quarrelsomeness, scolding. Reproaches himself and others.
Conscientious about trifles. Fastidious. Nervous restlessness at night. Anxiety with palpitations. Anxiety
about the future. Frightened easily. Fear of impending disease, that something bad will happen, of evil. Fear
of people, in a crowd, anthropophobia. Aversion to company. Suspicious.
Abdomen - Pain from abdomen at times, shifting through bowels, better by passage of flatus or stool. Gas
forms rapidly, better when bowels move, colic from flatus and before stool. Pain in groin.
Back - Pain and soreness in back. Neck stiff and sore. Soreness at lower cervical vertebra down to joints of
scapula and under both scapula. Severe pain between scapula, better moving forward, worse from inspiration.
Pain in lumbar region.
Chest - Oppression of chest and about heart, worse exertion and full inspiration. Roughness and irritation in
bronchi mornings, with slight cough. Eruption on chest, dark brown scaly spots on a red base, no itching.
Coughs - Teasing, dry cough, during day. Dry cough, with feeling of tightness and oppression in chest.
Dry, hacking cough, from an uneasy feeling and soreness beneath ribs, worse any exertion. Racking cough
with profuse, greenish expectoration. Hemoptysis.
 Ears - Ears feels heavy and drooped.
Eyes - Catarrhal conjunctivitis and blepharitis marginalis. Dry, painful, burning, stinging. Eyes feel weak, soon
tire. Stiffness of eyeballs, feel too large. Smarting and lachrymation on going into open air. Agglutination in
morning. Tendency of lids to close, cannot open them as wide as usual. Edema of orbital region. Supraorbital
pain.
Face - Feels puffed, bloated. Swollen face. Hot and flushed. Malar bone feels large, as if swollen. Masseter
muscles stiff, painful to move jaw. Eruptions around mouth. Corners of mouth fissured.
Female - Menses protracted, scanty. Leucorrhea, thick, offensive, yellow.
Head - Heat and fullness in head. Floating sensation on turning head quickly. Aching pain in frontal region,
root of nose, and over orbits. Boring pain in temples. Headache, worse pressure. Headache from tobacco
smoke. Periodical headaches, worse noise.
Heart - Oppression about heart on least exertion. Can feel heartbeat through chest distinctly .Sounds heard
through nearly ev-

***ery part of chest. Pulse irregular, variable in volume. Pulse slower than usual.
Kidneys - Dull, aching pain in kidneys, with profuse urine. Sore feeling in region of bladder, worse urinating.
Urine copious, frequent, clear. Urine contains some epithelial scales, casts and fat globules.
Limbs - Neuralgic pain, recurring frequently. Pain in anterior crural nerves. Pains erratic, worse in joints and
on left side. Feels tired all over. Joints stiff. Knee joints crack. Aching in arms, worse in shoulder.
Lungs - Oppression of chest and about heart and also larynx. Pneumonia and tuberculosis. Lungs feel as
if smoke had been inhaled. Asthma, worse dust and smoke. Miner’s asthma produced by inhalation of coal
dust.
Male - Dull, cutting pain along inguinal ligament, followed by sickening sensation in left testicle as from a blow,
testicle very sensitive while pain lasts.
Modalities - Worse on moving, jarring, least exertion, pressure, during the day.
Nose - Feels stopped up, pain at root. Nasal catarrh, withpainatrootofnose. Coryza, worse open air, fluent
alternating with dry. Watery discharge, drops into throat. Post-nasal dropping of thick, bland, yellowish mucus.
Crusts in nose. Dry crusts, on removal, leave mucus membrane raw. Smell defective or lost.
Perspiration - Surface cool, covered with cold, clammy sweat.
Rectum - Diarrhea, alternating with constipation. Stool thin, dark, soft, followed by burning at anus. Yellowish,
watery, copious, painless, hurries out of bed in morning. Diarrhea worse at night. Diarrhea from milk.
Sensations - Some of the peculiar symptoms are wavering, floating sensation on turning head. Eyeballs feel
stiff, feel too large for lids to close over. Scratching beneath lids on rolling eyeballs. Pain at root of nose. Feeling
of lump in throat of blow on testicle, as if smoke inhaled into lungs. Feeling as if the body were compressed by
thumb and finger.
Skin - Squamous eruption, scales thin, white, and when removed leave skin slightly reddened. Scales cause
itching, worse getting warm from exercise.
Sleep - Drowsy, heavy sleep. Restless sleep, when aroused awakes nervously as from a fright.
Stomach - Stomach tender. Sensation of fullness. Sinking sensation, with dull feeling in supraorbital and
frontal region. Hematemesis. Belching and sour eructations.
Throat - Dark, purplish, swollen, edematous. red and glassy. Roughness causes hemming, with spasmodic
cough. Hawking of tough, gelatinous, greyish yellow mucus from throat and posterior nares. Dark slate-colored,
scanty mucus in larynx, detached with difficulty. Elongation of uvula. Sensation as if thyroid were compressed
by a thumb and finger.
Tongue - Tongue coated yellow, deep red, corrugated, anterior part fissured. Tongue large, moist, fissured,
flabby.
Vertigo - Floating sensation on turning head quickly.
Vision - Vision weakened, objects blur when he looks at them for a short time, eyes sensitive to light.
COMMENTS - Leukemia (Ars., Nat-m.), especially in children. Pain between scapula, better bending forward.
Headache, worse from heat. Restlessness, thirst, chilliness with a hot head (Ars.). Nasal obstruction and
chilliness, worse at night.
Sensitive to cold air. Itching is worse when heated, by exercise. Warm things cause burning in stomach, cold
drinks aggravate nausea. Wind causes conjunctivitis. Right side of head, left testicle and left leg are most
affected.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ars., Kali-c. - edema about eyes and face. (2) Apis - diphtheria with sac-like
swelling of uvula, but Apis has much pain, Nat-a. has not. (3) Arum-t. - diphtheria, Arum-t. has less swelling
and more pain. (4) Kali-bi. - tenacious mucus. (5) Nat-m. - throat. (6) Lyc. - stopped catarrh.
 REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

name: Natrum Cacodylicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - nat-cac. Natrum cacodylicum. Sodium cacodylate. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Dermatitis. Neuritis. Paralysis. Tuberculosis. Wrist-drop.
HOMEOPATHIC - This acid (and more particularly its sodium salt) has been used on the retommendation of
Armand Gautier, Professor of Chemistry at the Faculty of Medicine of Paris, as a “cure” for tuberculosis. The
non-poisonous nature of this salt enables the patients to take it in large doses, but it is not always harmless.
Cacodyl, which signifies evil-smelling, is like Cyanogen, a compound radical. It was first obtained by Bunsenis
1873 as di-cacodyl. It is a clear liquid that refracts light strongly, heavier than water, of insup- portably offensive
smell, its vapor being highly poisonous.
Cacodylic acid is a crystalline arsenic compound, soluble in water, odorless and, though containing 54.4
percent of metallic arsenic, not an active poison.
Useful for malignant diseases and growths. Tuberculosis. Foul breath and mouth with bad odor. Dry dermatitis
of the skin of abdomen.
COMMENTS - Murrell gave Nat-cac. in pills of one grain, three times a day, to a young woman, 21. Poisoning
symptoms set in suddenly after the eleventh dose, including constant vomiting, tongue like a piece of raw beef,
inflamed conjunctive, eyelids edematous. Breath of gangrenous odor, peripheral neuritis, wrist-drop, paralysis
of left leg. The odor was noticed on second day, the other symptoms came suddenly.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Natrum Carbonicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - nat-c. Natrum carbonicum. Sodium carbonate. The common “Soda” of the shops, purified, not
the Bicarbonate of Soda. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Acidity. Albuminuria. Anemia. Anidrosis. Ankles, weak. Backache. Belching. Bums. Candida.
Chills. Colic. Constipation. Cornea, ulcers. Coms. Coryza. Coughs. Deafness. Debility. Diarrhea. Dysmenor-
rhea. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Elephantiasis. Emaciation. Fever. Flatulence. Food, allergies. Glands, disorders.
Goiter. Hands, chapped. Headaches. Heartburn. Heat, flushes. Heatstroke. Heels, blisters. Herpes.
Hiccough. Hoarseness. Hypochondriasis. Hysteria. Ichthyosis. Indigestion. Infertility. Keratitis. Leucorrhea.
Lisping. Malassimilation. Malnutrition. Milk, allergies. Moles. Nausea. Nose, eruptions. Nose, swollen. Nose-
bleed. Ozaena. Palpitations. Photophobia. Post-nasal, catarrh. Presbyopia. Priapism. Rheumatism.
Ringworm. School, headaches. Scrofula. Stammering. Sterility. Sunstroke. Throat, mucus. Toothache.
Ulcers. Vertigo. Vomiting. Warts. Waterbrash.
HOMEOPATHIC - Nat-c. was proved by Hahnemann and is one of the anti-psoric remedies. All the natmms
stimulate cellular activity and increase oxidation and metabolism. It had been used in old-school practice as
an external application in solution to bums and eczema, and as a douche in nasal or vaginal catarrh.
The common practice of taking sodium bicarbonate for indigestion and heartbum is founded on a true
relationship (though Nat-c. is the carbonate and not the bicarbonate), but the indiscriminate and excessive use
of it only intensifies the trouble.
Nat-c. forms the alkaline basis in most soaps, excess alkali almost bums off the superficial layers of the
epidermis and leaves the skin dry and cracked. The provings confirm this irritating action. Nat-c. is particularly
useful for chapped hands and faces, rough, dry skin, eczema, herpes, warts
and scrofulous conditions of the skin.
Swelling and induration of glands. Exhaustion. Emaciation, anemia. Milky, watery skin. Very weak ankles.
Puffiness. Relaxation, easy dislocation. Twitching in the muscles and limbs. Contraction of muscles, tendons.
Pains cause tremors, cold sweat, anxiety etc.
Irritation of the mucus membranes. Irritation, vesicles, ulcers and catarrh in the digestive tract from the mouth
to anus. Keratitis and ulceration of the cornea. The nose is swollen and ulcerated with a thick yellow or green
offensive discharge. Thick, yellow, putrid leucorrhea (Sep.).
Oversensitive to open air, music, noise and dietetic errors. Worse from any physical or mental exertion,
strain, from the least effort, from sun and gaslight. Debility from heat of summer, every spell of warm weather
causes headache. Chronic effects of sunstroke. Headache from sun or working under lights.
Children when asleep, jump, cry, grasp the mother. Startled, nervous children. Children cannot tolerate milk
but thrive better on cereals.
 MIND - Mental weakness. Weak memory. Difficulty thinking or concentrating. Slow comprehension. Mental
work is impossible. Transposes words. Spacey. Stupefaction in morning on waking.
Impatience while reading. Restlessness better mental labor. Conscientious about trifles. Sympathetic. Mild
and kind. Pathologically cheerful. Tendency to sacrifice for others. Refined sensibility. Dislikes intruding on
people, bothering people (Staph., Sil.). Selective friendships, air of detachment.
Elusive nature. Strong sense of integrity. Humane, empathetic. Very self-conscious. Closed, controlled
emotions. Avoidance of stress. Meditative. Difficulty dealing with suffering and pain in the world.
Profound sadness, depression and melancholy. Constantly occupied with sad thoughts, though there is
also the opposite, great gaiety and talkative. Philosophical about grief, resigned. Internal sorrow, mel
ancholy. Suffers grief with dignity. Unassimilated emotions. Sadness from errors of diet. Thoughts of
suicide, overwhelmed with suffering.
Cross, irritable. Irritability during fever. Aversion to society, even that of their own family or spouse. Sensitive
to the presence of certain persons. Indifferent. Anxious and fearful. Anxiety, trembling and sweat during
pains. Delusions of being deserted, forsaken.
Very sensitive to noise, cold, change of weather. Worse thunderstorms, electric changes in the atmosphere.
Very nervous during thunderstorm, hides in cellar. Anxious and restless during thunderstorms. Desires to
be magnetized.
Starting from noise. Sensitive to music (Ambr.). Music causes tendency to suicide, sadness, religious
insanity. Playing on piano causes anxiety and trembling. Sensitive to sensual impressions.
Abdomen - Griping colic just after a meal. Abdominal colic somewhat better eating. Indigestion, gas and
bloating. Accumulation, incarceration, and painful movements of flatus in abdomen. Flatus changes places,
abdomen bloated here and there. Hard, bloated, swollen abdomen. Epigastrium painful to touch and talking.
Colic with retraction of naval and hardness of skin. Colic somewhat better eating and warmth. Pressure in
lower abdomen, as if everything in abdomen would fall out. Violent sharp pain in right hypochondriac region,
followed by griping in lower abdomen. Swelling of glands of groin and axilla. Itch-like eruption on lower part of
abdomen.
Back - Backache, violent pain in lumbar region after walking. Burning pain and distress along spine. Tingling
in back. Cervical glands swollen. Cracking in cervical vertebrae, when moving the neck. Boring pain at tip of
left scapula. Coldness between scapulae. Stiffness and drawing between scapulae. Pustules on lumbar region.
Causations - Sun, gaslight, heat, changes in temperature. Ill effects of sunstroke (chronic). Suppression of
sweat. Cold
drink when over-heated. Extreme sensitivity to electrical changes, like thunderstorms. Over-study, strains,
grief. Errors in diet, milk.
Chest - Chilliness in one side of chest. Pressing, sharp pains in chest. Burning soreness in right mid chest.
Constitutions - Suited to light-haired people and persons of leuco-phlegmatic constitution with aversion to
open air and mental or physical exercise.
Ears - Dryness and heat. Sharp stitching pain in ears. As if something moved in ear on swallowing. As if a
bubble bursting in ears. Oversensitive hearing. Sensitive to noise, music. Stopped sensation. Deafness with
recurring earache, with amenorrhea. Loss of hearing of right ear, sounds seem to come from left side when
they really come from right. Hardness of hearing and roaring in left ear, worse before menses.
Eyes - Burning pain in eyes, worse reading and writing, with dryness. Shooting pain from within outward.
Needle-like stitches in both eyes, after dinner. Ulcers on cornea, with shooting pains. Dim eyes, has to wipe
them constantly. Photophobia. Lachrymation during forenoon. Agglutination of eyes in morning. Eyes close
involuntary. Heaviness of upper lids. Lids swollen. Inflammation of eyelids with photophobia.
Face - Pale, withered, bloated face. Pale face, with dark streaks under eyes. Blue rings around eyes, swollen
lids. Freckles, yellow spots, pimples. Yellow blotches on forehead and upper lip. Burning crack in lower lip.
Lips swollen, particularly upper lip. Swelling of both cheeks, with glowing redness. Swelling of submaxillary
glands. Pains in bones of face, with chronic nasopharyngeal catarrh.
Female - Soreness. Deficient menses in adult females. Menses too early, late, scanty, like meat-washings
(Nit-ac.). Menses with pain in lumbar region and abdomen. Dysmenorrhea. Leucorrheal discharge, offensive,
irritating. Leucor- rhea thick, yellow, ropy. Leucorrhea better after urination. Profuse leucorrhea, after
frequent attacks of colic. Induration of
cervix. Bearing down sensation (Sep., Murx). Motion, as if fetus in uterus. Sterility. Infertility from non-
retention of semen. Promotes conception. Labor pains weak, or with anguish, sweat and desire to be rubbed.
Prevents false conception. Expels moles.
Food - Hungry at 5 a.m. Greedy, always nibbling. Very weak digestion. Food tastes bitter. Food allergies.
Oversensitive to errors in diet. Craving for sweets. Must drink in order to swallow solids. Aversion to milk.
 Worse from milk, causes flatulence, diarrhea. Children who can’t tolerate milk but thrive better on cereals.
Drowsiness after meals. Heartburn after fats. Diarrhea from starch. Indigestion is worse from vegetables and
starchy foods. Ill effects of drinking cold water when overheated.
Head - Head pains out through eyes, head bent backwards. Stupefying pain in forehead, with nausea,
eructations and dimness of sight. Headache alternating with digestive troubles. Headaches from slightest
mental exertion. Headachesfrom exposure to sunlight (Glon.), gaslight. Dullness of head when at rest or
when in sun. Headaches in hot weather. Head feels too large. Pulsating, in vertex every morning. Almost
painless boil on occiput. Falling out of hair.
Heart - Painful cracking in region of heart. Palpitations from noise, on going upstairs, when attention is directed
to something, when lying on left side. Palpitations, a general accompaniment of indigestion. Pulse excited at
night, with ebullitions.
Kidneys - Pressure in region of bladder. Burning in urethra during and after urination. Frequent need to urinate,
with copious or scanty discharge. Bright or dark yellow urine. Urine smells like horse’s urine, from vegetable
or milk diet. Involuntary urination at night.
Limbs - Great weakness of limbs, especially in morning. Locomotor ataxia, fulgurating pains better eating.
Heaviness of legs and feet with tension in them. Unsteady walk, small obstruction on pavement causes him to
fall, or falls without apparent cause.
Hollow of the knee is painful on motion. Popliteal, painful on motion. Legs are icy cold up to knees. Weak
ankles. Cramps from ankles to toes. Easy dislocation and spraining of ankles. Foot bends under (Caust.).
Old sprains. Heel and Achilles tendon affected. Tender soles, needlelike pain, burning while walking. Soles
of feet raw and sore. Burning wrists and ankles. Jerking of hand on going to sleep. Contractions of fingers.
Folds of fingers and toes sore. Chapped hands. Vesicles on tips of all fingers and toes.
Lungs - Dyspnea and shortness of breathing, from tension of chest. Short cough with rattling in chest. Cough
with rawness in chest, worse morning. Cough, dry, tickling, worse at 9 to 11 a.m. Cough with coldness of left
side of breast. Violent and dry cough on passing from cold to hot temperature. Cough with rumbling,
incarcerated flatus. Loose, hollow cough, with salty, purulent, greenish sputum. Bloody expectoration.
Male - Straining and tenesmus, with voluptuous sensation in genitals. Glans penis becomes sore easily.
Inflammation, swelling and easy excoriation of prepuce and glans penis. Prostatic affections, discharge of
prostatic fluid at stool and when urinating. Bruised pain in testicles. Heaviness and drawing in testicles.
Soreness between scrotum and thighs. Increased sexual desire with priapism and painful pollutions.
Incomplete sex, erection weak, emissions speedy. Nightly emissions. Sweats after sex.
Modalities - Better from eating, sweating. Better wiping with hand. Better boring into nose or ears with fingers.
Better rubbing, motion, pressure. Aversion to cold air. Worse from heat of sun. Worse drafts, damp weather.
Worse getting wet, change of weather. Worse extremes of temperature. Worse before a storm or during a
storm. Worse drinking cold water, cold drinks when over heated. Worse from vegetable diet, starchy food.
Worse milk, dietetic errors. Worse from music, noise. Worse mental or bodily exertion. Worse at 5 a.m.
Worse alternate days. Worse the
full moon. Worse sun exposure.
Mouth - Constant dryness of mouth end lips, which she was constantly obliged to lick. Saliva increased. Bitter
taste in the mouth, food tastes bitter. Taste perverted, too sensitive. Taste sour, metallic. Redness and
soreness of mouth, with flat, painful blisters. Vesicles and smooth ulcers in mouth with burning, mouth open.
Sensitiveness of lower teeth. Toothache, in lower jaw. worse eating fruits, sweets, better smoking. Nightly
pressing toothache with swelling of lower lip and of gums.
Nose - Swollen or peeling. Pimples and puffiness. Red nose with white pimples on it. Many troubles of external
nose (Caust.). Humid herpetic eruptions and ulcers on nose, around mouth and on lips. Ulceration high up in
nostrils. Nosebleed. Stoppage at night. Catarrh, post-nasal catarrh. Catarrh, foul, thick, yellow or green
discharge. Hawking mucus from throat, worse slight draft. Constant coryza, obstruction of nose. Coryza,
worse least draft, alternate days. Coryza, with burning in eyes. Bad odor of nasal secretions. Musty smelling
discharge. Violent sneezing. Squeaking sensation at root of nose.
Perspiration - Profuse sweat from the least physical exertion. Perspiration while eating, in morning. Patient
breaks into a cold sweat. Burning sweat on forehead where hat presses. Anxious sweat during pain, with
dreams. Perspiration all over, during fever. Night sweat alternating with dryness of skin. Perspiration in
morning.
Rectum - Sudden call to stool without result. Emission of much sour-smelling or fetid flatus. Stools escape
with haste and noise. Constipation, insufficient stool, with tenesmus. Constipation alternating with soft and
liquid stools. Gushing diarrhea, preceded by cutting pain in upper abdomen. Discharge of tinea during
evacuation. Diarrhea with cutting pain . Diarrheafrom starches, milk, taking cold. Burning and cutting pain
 in anus and rectum during stool. Burning pain in rectum after stool. Lancinations in perineum. Itching and
tingling in anus.
Sensations - As if head too large, as if forehead would burst, as if head would be drawn back. As if ears were
closed up, as of a bubble bursting in ear. As if tip of tongue were cracked. Dryness of mouth as if caused by
heat of breath. As if veins of right leg were bruised. Blisters on points of toes as if scalded. Motion as from a
fetus in uterus.
Skin - Dry, rough, milky, watery. Inclination to perspire easily or dry, rough, cracked skin. Full veins.
Formication. Itching as from fleas over whole body. Pustular eruptions. Blisters on small joints, tips of toes or
fingers. Red vesicles filled with fluid. Vesicles with shooting pains and itching. Vesicular eruption in patches
and circles. Yellow rings like remains of herpes. Herpetic eruptions, sometimes suppurating. Ulcers, burning,
pricking and pulsating. Ulcers, pus corroding, acrid, putrid and yellow. Ulcers, with swelling and inflamed
redness. Warts, ulcerate, sensitive to touch. Elephantiasis.
Sleep - Drowsy during day after meals. Falls asleep late at night. Sleeps with mouth open. Jerking and shocks
during sleep. Restless sleep with ebullitions, palpitations and nightmares. Pleasant, amorous dreams. Anxious,
frightful dreams. Dreams of traveling, floods, quarrels, robbers, devils, thieves, death. Wakes too early in the
morning. Sleepiness in morning.
Stomach - Stomach feels swollen and sensitive. Heaviness and pressure in stomach. Weak digestion, worse
from slightest errors in diet. Dyspepsia relieved by soda biscuits. Old dyspeptics, always belching, have
sour stomach and rheumatism. Gastric pains, better eating. Indigestion. Cramp in stomach, pressing,
drawing, cutting pain. Depressed after eating. Bitter taste. Acidity. Waterbrash. Heartburn after fats. Sour
eructations. Frequent hiccough. Nausea and retching, with pain and soreness in stomach. Violent retching in
morning, without actual vomiting. Vomiting of bile, bitter. Food allergies. Ill effects of drinking cold water when
overheated.
Stool - Stools, black, hard, smooth, crumbly. Watery stool. Yellow substance like pulp of orange in stool in
menopausal women. Discharge of ball of mucus like peas. Stool spotted with blood, discharge of blood during
stool.
Temperature - Sudden chilliness. Chill, without thirst. Shivering fits induced by over fatigue and anxiety. Chill
with cold hands and hot cheeks, or the reverse. Cold hands and feet, with hot forehead. Coldness of lower
limbs. Heat with great debility and sleep. Heat with perspiration over whole body. Febrile shuddering, with cold
hands and hot cheeks. Heat flushes, with aversion to uncovering.
Throat - Hoarseness with coryza, chilliness and scraping, painful cough. Throat painful when yawning and
swallowing. Must drink to swallow solids from roughness, dryness of esophagus and throat. Hawks much
mucus from the throat. Taste of blood, pus in throat. Glandular swellings in throat. Resistant swelling of middle
lobe of thyroid gland. Hard goiter, with pressing pain.
Tongue - Tongue coated, dry. Burning about tip of tongue, as if it was cracked. Pimples on tip of tongue, which
burns as if full of cracks. Affections of under-surface of tongue. Tongue heavy, immovable, with difficult speech.
Stammering on account of heaviness of tongue.
Vertigo - Vertigo from wine, mental exertion, exposure to sun, better from exercise in open air.
Vision - Dim vision, has to wipe eyes constantly. Can’t read small print. Sensation as if feathers before eyes.
Flashes and streaks of light before closed eyes at night. Dazzling flashes or stars before eyes, on waking.
Black spots before eyes when writing.
COMMENTS - Sensitive digestion (Nat-s.). Chronic dyspepsia, stomachaches. Very weak digestion, burning,
gas and bloating. Belching, ulcers, and indigestion. Heartburn with acid regurgitations and esophageal
problems.
Malassimilation, food allergies. Difficulty swallowing foods. Emaciation,
anemia, and bloating. May get bloated from starchy foods. Ill effects of drinking cold water. Worse from milk,
especially in children (Aeth.), causing diarrhea. Worse from wine.
Stomach problems will often alternate with headaches. Depression and irritability is worse after a meal, the
aggravation diminishing as digestion advances, “as the food passes through the duodenum.”
Characteristic blue ring around the eyes of children with allergies. Ptosis of the eyelids. Photophobia. Chronic
nasal congestion.
Women can have a “discharge of mucus after an embrace” causing infertility. Candida. Bearing down pain,
dragging feeling in the stomach (Sep.). Worse after sex, exhaustion. Emotional detachment.
Symptoms of hysteria. Contractions of muscles and tendons, relaxation of tissues. Twitching in muscles and
limbs. Paralysis of the left leg. Conditions resulting from malabsorption. Swelling and induration of glands.
Bone problems, curved spine. Stooping forward. Ankle joints are weak and burn.
Stitches go from within out. Right upper and left lower are particularly effected. Great debility from any exertion,
 unsteady walk, any little obstruction on pavement causes falling, or he falls without any apparent cause.
Aversion to exercise. Symptoms are worse from mental or bodily exertion.
Generally chilly. Worse extremes of temperature. Sensitivity to changes in atmosphere. Worse before a storm
or during a storm. Restless before a storm or with a storm. May get migraine headaches or stomach problems
before a storm. Conditions resulting from exposure in the sun. Heat exhaustion. Headache from mental
exertion, sun exposure.
Sensitivity to music, worse from loud music. Sensitive to particular things, not a general sensitivity (as is Phos.),
certain foods, people, sounds, light conditions. Pet peeves. Aggravations cause headaches, stomachaches,
heartburn, indigestion, depression. Aware of limitations and sensitivities.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Ars., Camph.. It antidotes: Chin. Compare: (1) Sodium bicarbonate - in
vomiting of pregnancy with acetonuria. (2) Nat-s. is preferable for yeastlike vomiting, with pallid, dirty, livid
tongue. (3) Nat-m. - hypochondriasis. That of Nat-c. keeps pace with indigestion, that of Nat-m. with degree of
constipation, head and face better uncovering, leucorrhea. (4) Caust., Nat-cac. (5) Sep. - Indifferent to family,
melancholy, apprehensive, worse by music, backache worse by sitting, bearing down, boring through from tip
of left scapula. (6) Pic-ac. - priapism, towards morning, emission and no desire. (7) Nux-v. - hypochondriasis,
morning retching, Nux-v., of pregnancy, or after debauch. (8) Phos., Rhod., Sil., Petr., worse from thunder
storm. (9) Lyc. - better uncovering, ulcer on heel. Lyc. on instep, right upper, left lower. ( 10) Debility from heat
of summer, Ant-c. (11) Headache from sun or gaslight, Glon., Lach. (12) Bearing down as if everything would
come out. Sep., Agar., Lil-t., Murx. (13) Easily sprained ankles, Stront., Led. Complementary: Sep., Kali salts.
Compatible: Calc., Nux-v., Puls., Sep., Sul.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

the Bicarbonate of Soda. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Acidity. Albuminuria. Anemia. Anidrosis. Ankles, weak. Backache. Belching. Bums. Candida.
Chills. Colic. Constipation. Cornea, ulcers. Coms. Coryza. Coughs. Deafness. Debility. Diarrhea. Dysmenor-
rhea. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Elephantiasis. Emaciation. Fever. Flatulence. Food, allergies. Glands,

name: Natrum Fluoratum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - nat-f. Natrum fluoratum. Sodium flouride. Triturations from the salts. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Constipation. Cramps. Diarrhea. Muscle, pains. Mydriasis. Proteinuria. Stomachache. Tetany.
Writer’s cramp.
HOMEOPATHIC - Nat-f., molecular weight 42, appears in the form of colorless crystals, cubic or tetragonal in
shape. The triturations were prepared from the salt. The work was completed in 1956 by Gutman New York,
on twenty-one provers. The proving lasted fifty days using a 6c in tablet form.
Due to the fluorine, the action of the remedy is myoneurotrophic. Sudden muscular contracture. Sudden
muscular pains, coming and going in the muscles and joints. Pains while resting or from lack of distraction,
reduced by pressure. Pains in the region of the left scapula.
MIND - Agitation and depression. State of stupor. Loss of ability to speak.
Abdomen - Gastric and intestinal cramps.
Back - Muscular, cramping, sudden pains. Pain in the shoulders.
Eyes - Mydriasis. Cramping pains in the eyelids.
Food - Lack of appetite.
Heart - Weak heart. Irregular pulse, rapid, weak, jumping.
Kidneys - Oliguria. Urine retention. Proteinuria.
Limbs - Sudden pains, coming and going in the muscles and joints. Hardening of the bones. Cramps in the
calves and cyanosed, bluish coloring of the legs.
Modalities - Better from pressure, distraction. Worse from resting.
Mouth - Pain in the mouth with salty or soapy-tasting saliva.
Rectum - Constipation or diarrhea with expulsion of wind.
Skin - Itching of the skin without eruption. Itching eruption in the left axilla. Passing eruption on the legs.
Copious, cold perspiration.
Stomach - Cramping pain in the stomach. Digestive heaviness and discomfort, nausea. Stomachache, painful
hungry feeling, not eased by nourishment. Blood- streaked vomit.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cupr. - Violent intermittent, cramping pains of the eyelids, stomach, calves and
feet, aggravated by the cold.
REFERENCES-Julian.

name: Natrum Hypochlorosum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - nat-hchls. Natrum hypochlo- rosum. Labarraque’s solution. Natrum chlo- ratum. Liquor soda
 chlorate. It comes from hypochlorite of soda or potassium-chloride water. Potencies of the solution. Historical
dose: All potencies. Fifteen to twenty drops of Labarraque’s solution in water.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Allergies. Anaphylaxis. Ankles, weak. Aphonia. Backache. Breast pain. Bronchitis.
Chlorosis. Cough.
Natrum hypochlorosum Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Eczema. Edema. Emaciation. Fainting. Flatus. Globus. Gravel.
Headache. Hematuria. Hemorrhoids. Hysteria. Kidney stones. Leucocytosis. Leucorrhea. Liver, disorders.
Metrorrhagia. Nephritis. Nosebleed. Ovaries disorders. Priapism. Proctitis. Scurvy. Smarting eruptions. Sub-
involution. Tongue, shriveled, swollen. Toothache. Uterus, water-logged. Vertigo. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Nat-hchls., the well-known disinfecting fluid, is one of Cooper’s additions to the Materia
Medica. His proving brought out some very characteristic features, although there is a close general
resemblance to Nat-m. The chlorine radical determines irritation of the skin and mucus membranes, the sodium
induces extreme sensitivity to humidity.
The indications are not the result of a Homeopathic proving, but the result of the information given by the
toxicology and the clinical usage of the remedy.
Nat-hchls. affects profoundly the entire organism and causes rapid emaciation, fainting, weakness with a
flabbiness most pronounced along the mucus tracts with a diffused hydrogenoid condition and a tendency to
leucocytosis.
Eczema and itching, more particularly localized on the upper limbs and the face. Anaphylaxis caused by
cutaneous intolerance of aproduct. Chronic catarrhal diseases of the middle ear. Phlegmatic. Congested and
atonic states of the uterus and its ligaments with hepatic disorders. Both hands swollen in morning. Depressed,
faint.
Abdomen - Swelling low in abdomen going up to chest and causing dyspnea, worse after eating with much
flatus. Bloated, tight feeling across upper abdomen.
Back - Much pain across small of back, worse morning on rising.
Constitutions - Phlegmatic, flabby, debilitated constitutions.
Coughs - Cough with aphonia.
Ears - Pain under right ear when swallowing with much tenderness and swelling up side of head.
Eyes - Eyes red, weeping, eyelids puffy, red and itching. Amelioration by cold compresses.
Face - Edema of the face.
Female - Violent metrorrhagia. Leucorrhea and backache. Womb is feels heavy, sodden with tendency to
prolapse. Feeling as if the uterus were pushed up on sitting down (Ferr-i.). Feels as if it opened and shut.
Passive, bearing-down pains from heavy condition of uterus. Subinvolution. Itching of the vulva, perineum, and
anus.
Head - Headaches. Swimming feeling, as if top of head would float off.
Kidneys - Much pain across small of back. Diffuse nephritis. Dark urine with albumen and casts.
Limbs - Extreme weakness in ankles and knees. Hands swollen every morning.
Lungs - Pulmonary edema, capillary bronchitis. Dyspnea, aggravated by the coughing. Dry, irritating, painful
cough in fits and then frothy, pink sputum. Cough with aphonia.
Modalities - Better after stool, from cold applications. Worse from eating or drinking, drinking least drop of
cold water, warm drinks. Worse by washing, damp, warmth, lying on either side. Worse before each menstrual
period, before stool.
Mouth - Putrid taste. Furred tongue, large, flabby indented. Flat ulcer on tongue far back towards root. Sore,
irritable spots along sides of tongue and throat. Gums sore, tongue swollen, aphthous ulceration. Stomatitis,
aphthosis.
Nose - Nosebleed, clots of blood.
Rectum - Anal and rectal burning, burning diarrhea. Proctitis. Hemorrhoids, anal fissure.
Skin - Generalized or localized itching, better by scratching. Recurring erythema with appearance of vesicles
filled with a whitish, oozing liquid. Weeping eczema. Dry eczema in nursing children.
Sleep - Drowsiness after meals. Drowsy by day, wakeful by night. Cannot sit down without falling asleep.
Disinclined to rise in morning. Child looks ghastly, as if dead, when asleep, his sleep is quiet.
Stomach - Drowsy after meals. Burning in epigastrium, with acrid vomiting, hematemesis.
Throat - Throat red and sore, with difficult swallowing. Burning in the pharynx with redness, choking cough.
Vertigo - Vertigo with aching across forehead. Swimming feeling, as if top of head would float off.
COMMENTS - Drowsiness, cannot sit down without falling asleep. A weight seems to fall from pit of chest to
pit of abdomen with aching, dull sensation on vertex. Vertigo causing falling. Paralyzed feeling in brain.
Sensation as if top of skull were about to float off, as though cranial bones were being crossed over each other.
Swelling, neuralgic pains and suppuration about jaws. Tongue swollen or shriveled at sides. Swelling low down
 in abdomen, going up to chest and causing dyspnea. Swelling of both hands in morning on waking. Gatherings
on fingers. Swelling on both hands in morning on waking. Pain in hip joint reflected from ovary.
Dr. Robert Cooper’s grand characteristic indication for Nat-hchls. is a water-logged uterus. The womb is
sodden, heavy, low down in pel vis, bearing down in pel vis with tendency to prolapse.
The state of subinvolution after confinement corresponds very closely to this and Clarke frequently saw Nat-
hchls. do good work in such cases.
RELATIONS -Antidotedby: Puls. - rheumatic and myalgic symptoms, Guai., also, probably. the antidotes to
Nat-m. Compare: (1) Aur-m. Nat-m., Calc., Sep., (2) Helio. - has uterine displacement with active bearing-
down sensation and loss of voice, membranous dysmenorrhea. (3) Nat-c., Nat-m., Kali-chl., Chlor. (4) In
uterine bearing down. Helio., Sep. (5) Womb feels as if it opened and shut Sep. has clutching and relaxing. (6)
Feels as if uterus were pushed up when ever she sits down. Ferr-i. (7) Uterine engorgement and induration,
Aur-m-n. (8) Bloated feeling after meals, worse by warm drinks, Lyc. (9) Easily overpowered with heat, Sep.,
Nat-m., Nat-c. Complementary: Sep.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Natrum Iodatum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - nat-i. Natrum iodatum. Sodium iodide. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Arteriosclerosis. Catarrh. Dyspnea. Endocarditis. Heart, disorders.
Rheumatism. Vertigo.
HOMEOPATHIC - Nat-i. has various symptoms, such as angina pectoris and vertigo. Dyspnea become less
marked after continued use. Chronic catarrhal affections, arteriosclerosis and rheumatism. Incipient rheumatic
endocarditis. Chronic bronchitis and tertiary syphilis.
Nat-i. will be found to give most excellent results where there is organic disease of the heart, associated with
the angina pectoris. There is an oppression in the region of the heart that is attended with a fear of death and
a feeling as if something dreadful was about to happen. Angina pectoris and dyspnea.
REFERENCES - Blackwood. Boericke.

name: Natrum Lacticum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - nat-1. Natrum lacticum. Sodium lactate. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Fatigue. Gout. Rheumatism. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Allen collected a few observation on the effects of large doses. Skinner removed with it in
potencies gouty or rheumatic concretions, “chalk stones” in fingers. Gout, rheumatism. Rheumatic pains.
Abnormal sense of fatigue, yawning and sleepiness.
Food - Unusual hunger and thirst.
Limbs - Great weakness of lower limbs after great physical exertion.
Sleep - Yawning and sleepiness. Sleep more prolonged and sounder.
Stomach - Vomiting from very large doses.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) I he lacs, Lac-ac. (2) In “chalk stones,” Lyc., Calc.
REFERENCES - Clarke.
