name: Penthorum Sedoides
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - pen. Penthorum sedoides. Virginia stonecrop. N. O. Crassulaceae. Pentho- raceae. Tincture of
fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Aphonia. Coryza. Diarrhea. Headache. Hemorrhoids. Hoarseness. Postnasal catarrh. Sacrum,
pain. Sinusitis. Varicocele.
HOMEOPATHIC - Hale said Pen. is reputed to be curative in catarrh and in diarrhea. A scalded sensation in
the tongue is one of the symptoms. A sense of levitation was also produced. The symptoms proceed from
above downward.
Chronic disorders of mucus membranes with irritability. Chronic post-nasal catarrh, chronic pharyngitis, mucus
membrane purple and relaxed. Coryza with rawness and wet feeling in nose. Hypersecretion of mucus
membranes.
Posterior sinuses feel moist and raw, nose and ears feel full. Throat feels raw. Aphonia, hoarseness, relaxed
vocal cords. Trouble in pharyngeal vault and Eustachian tube. Itching of anus and burning in rectum. General
malaise, headache, weakness of limbs inability to attend to business.
MIND - Dull, discouraged and despondent. Mind is dull, study impossible. Inability to attend to business.
Abdomen - A clawing, uneasy sensation about umbilicus, which gradually passed to lower bowel. Twitching
in muscles of abdomen. Parietes of abdomen felt thickened. Borborygmus.
Back - Aching through basilar region from back to front. Aching in sacrum and sacroiliac joint. Heat in sacrum
with headache.
Ears - Ringing and singing in both ears.
Eyes - Inner, upper tarsal borders itch and burn. Full sensation in supra-orbital region. On closing eyes, felt
like floating, vertigo.
Food - Appetite increased.
 Head - Dull, heavy headache with heat and soreness in sacrum. Catarrhal aching in forehead. Weight in
sinciput. Itching of hairy scalp.
Kidneys - Dull aching in kidneys. Bladder sore to pressure. Urine increased, alkaline, burning along urethra
when urinating.
Limbs - Arm numb. Hand felt swollen. Trembling feeling of legs for several days with soreness of knees.
Lungs - In morning a cough from deep in chest with soreness throughout chest.
Male - Sexual orgasm. Weakness, almost satyriasis, followed by long-continued depression, approaching
impotence. Varicocele.
Mouth - Prickling, burning sensation on tongue as though scalded. Increased flow of saliva (bloody).
Nose - Constant wet feeling in nose, which no amount of blowing will relieve. Discharge thick, pus-like,
streaked with blood. Posterior sinuses feel raw as if denuded of epithelium. Post-nasal catarrh of puberty.
Rectum - Constipation, an atonic condition of bowels and rectum. After being constipated, semi-fluid
evacuation next morning. Burning in rectum at stool, continuing after. Itching of anus, hemorrhoids with aching
in sacrum and sacroiliac joint. Crawling in lower rectum as though a worm tried to escape.
Stomach - Disgust and nausea. Forcible eructation and ejection of small quantities of odorless flatus.
COMMENTS - Pen. was proved by Dr. D. B. Morrow (twice), Dr. Scudder and a young man, who all took
substantial doses. The majority of the symptoms are Morrow's, including the catarrhal symptoms, which have
been verified in practice.
“A peculiar wet feeling in sinuses as though a violent coryza would set in,” but it did not, the secretion became
thickened and pus-like but not increased.
The same “wet feeling” was experienced at the same time in trachea and bronchi, which passed from above
down as if coryza would set in, followed by a slight feeling of constriction in the chest, which also passed from
above down.
The next day the nose felt stuffed. The third day the first symptoms were repeated and the discharge became
thick, pus-like and streaked with blood and there was an odor in the nose as if from an open sore.
Scudder had “fullness in nose and ears.” Morrow experienced itching at anus, hemorrhoids and pains and
sensations in rectum, sacrum and sacroiliac joints, his first proving cured “heat and soreness in sacrum with a
dull, heavy headache.”
Morrow reported two cures, the first, Miss P.. 17, blonde, had severe cough of several weeks' duration. Worse
by talking or singing. Frothy, greenish sputa. Puls, and Phos. failed, Pen. soon cured.
The second concerned a decrepit old woman, 75, suffered from eczema for twelve years. Previous winter
cured of asthma (probably from suppressed eczema) with Sulph. 100,000c. Now paretic right side, for which
Phos. was given.
But Phos. did not relieve a loose, continual, rattling cough, caused by tickling at bifurcation of bronchi with
raising much thick, frothy, greenish sputa. Pen. pellets quickly cured.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Pen. often follows Puls., Sang., Hydr. (2) Sedum acre.. Hydrang.
(3) In scalded sensation on tongue and in catarrh, Sang. (4) Catarrh, Puls. (5) Levitation. Cann-i., Cocc., Ph-
ac., Stict., Sulph., Thuj. (6) Jerking of limbs, Meny., Psor.
(4)

name: Persea Americana
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - pers. Persea americana. Avocado. Alligator pear. N. O. Lauraceae. Historical dose: Tincture
and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Arthritis. Coughs. Diarrhea. Emaciation. Gout. Hair, loss. Impotence. Infertility. Malnutrition. Skin,
disorders. Worms. Wounds. Wrinkles.
HERBAL-Throughout the Aztec empire, avocado was used as both a food and medicine. All parts of the tree
was used for medicinal purposes. Native Guatemalans have long used the avocado to stimulate hair growth,
repel worms, and treat diarrhea.
The fruit is highly nutritious, containing calcium, phosphorus, iron, and vitamins. Avocado is rich in potassium
 and vitamins B6 and E, which can help in relieving stress and sexual problems, such as infertility and
impotence.
Although many believe that avocados are fattening, they contain a high amount of mono-unsaturated fats,
particularly oleic acid, making it a powerful antioxidant foot. The oleic acid offers protection against heart
disease, strokes, and cancer. There is some evidence to suggest the fruit can help lower cholesterol.
The fats are also easily digestible and contain anti-fungal and antibacterial actions that, when pureed, make
an excellent food forinvalids, convalescents and sick children. In some parts of Africa, the fruit pulp is used as
a baby food.
Externally, the fruit soothes the skin, helps heal wounds, and stimulates hair growth. Avocado oil nourishes
and softens rough, dry, or flaking skin. Stimulates the production of collagen, helping reduce the appearance
of wrinkles.
Avocado leaves have anti-tussive properties and increase biliary secretions. The leaves and bark are used to
treat diarrhea, gas. and bloating, as well as to relieve coughs, liver obstructions, and clearing out uric acid.
They can also stimulate menstruation and induce abortion.
The rind can expel worms. The seed is rich in tannins, and used as a cloth dye or to treat diarrhea. The oil has
been used to help reduce gout pain. A decoction reduces arthritis pains.
REFERENCES - Murphy.

name: Pertussinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - per. Pertussinum. Whooping cough nosode. Pertussin. Coqueluchinum. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL-Anorexia. Asthenia. Bronchitis. Chemosis. Choking. Convulsions. Coughs. Cyanosis. Mastoiditis.
Myelitis. Nosebleed. Paralysis. Polyneuritis. Tachycardia. Vomiting. Whooping cough.
HOMEOPATHIC - Per. is taken from the glairy and stringy mucus containing the virus of whooping cough.
Introduced by Clarke for the treatment of whooping cough and other spasmodic coughs.
In Clarke's experience, it agrees well with all other whooping cough remedies and when their specific
indications appear he gave them in alternation or alone. Per. is an unproved remedy, except in the sense that
every case of the disease is a proving. Can be used a preventive in whooping cough or to treat the disease.
Spasmodic coughing attacks. Dry cough, spasmodic of different intensity, comes suddenly. Repeated
coughing fits which end in vomiting. Increasing jerking cough with cyanosis, with a phase of apnea followed
by the taking of respiration. Predisposition to tuberculosis.
Asthenia. Convulsions. Muscularjerkings. Neuro-motor deficit. Polyneuritis. Paresis. Paralysis. Myelitis.
Hemorrhage from the meninges. Anorexia. Sleepy and in a state of confusion. Troubles of conscience.
MIND - Psycho-motor or sensorial troubles. State of confusion. Restlessness. Troubles of conscience. Cries,
tears.
Chest - Stinging pain in or on the chest with cough.
Ears - Mastoiditis.
Eyes - Chemosis. Tears. Coryza with hacking cough.
Face - Intense flushing with cough.
Heart - Cyanosis, sweats, weakness. Tachycardia.
Lungs - Bronchitis. Dyspnea with cough. Whooping cough. Strangling sensation with cough on waking.
Spasmodic choking cough. Spasmodic cough with intense flushing of face. Hacking cough with coryza.
Deep-sounding croupy cough. Coughing in frequently repeated attacks. Cough provoked by intense tickling
in throat, fauces or trachea. Sobbing or sighing at end of cough.
Modalities - Worse by laughing, emotion, effort, rest or nervous shock.
Mouth - Itching of the palate on lying down at night. Ulceration of the tongue.
Nose - Nosebleed.
Stomach - Vomiting or nausea at end of cough.
Throat - Laryngo-spasms. Spasm of the glottis. Intense tickling in throat causing cough.
COMMENTS - Clarke gave the 30c every four hours in all cases of whooping cough, suspected or defined, as
a matter of routine, and as a rule it quickly assumed control of the case and did all that was necessary.
Dr. Sheppard wrote about giving Per. for whooping cough prophylaxis. “Pertussin 30c acts well as a protective
against whooping cough. 364 cases were given daily doses of pertussin for two weeks after contact.
“Many of these cases were seen in the day nurseries under my care and not one of these children developed
the disease. As twoof the nurseries took in children from two weeks old, it was most essential that they should
not be exposed to the infection, and it was gratifying to find that Pertussin was a means of preventing the
 spread of the disease.
“In another private school, a child came back after the holidays with a fully developed whooping cough, in spite
of carrying a doctor's certificate as being free from any infectious disease. All the twelve children in her class
were infected.
“The headmistress, on my advice, gave Pertussin 30 four doses hourly, and the children had the mildest attack
of whooping cough she had ever seen. She was grateful to Homoeopathy, and to the nosode Pertussin for
turning so serious a disease into a mild one.”
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Dros., Bell., Cor-r., Cupr., Napht., Meph., Passi., Coc-c., Mang-p.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Julian.

name: Petiveria Tetrandra
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - peti. Petiveria tetrandra. Erva de pipi. N. 0. Phytolaccaceae. Trituration of fresh root. Historical
dose: Trituration and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Conjunctivitis. Paralysis. Paraplegia.
HERBAL - Allen said that P. tetrandra is probably identical with the Mexican and West Indian species, P.
alliacea.
Mure's figure corresponds to this and he said the roots, which are branching and fibrous, “smell strongly of
garlic.”
P. alliacea, according to the Treasury of Botany is called “Guinea-hen Weed” in West Indies and “Raiz de
Guiñe” in Brazil. In Brazil it is put into warm baths to restore motion to paralyzed limbs. Mure did not mention
these names or this use, but his proving brought out some strongly confirmative symptoms.
HOMEOPATHIC - Mure's proving showed some strongly confirmative symptoms in numbness and paralytic
sensations, weariness and weight of eyelids. Cold saliva internal coldness, coldness inside bones were
experienced.
Modalities - Worse by movement, bending backwards, during and after dinner. Worse in the morning, on
waking and on rising, after breakfast.
RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Phyt. (2) Rhus-t. - In paralysis. (3) Cist. - Cold saliva.
REFERENCES Clarke.

name: Petroleum Oleum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - petr. Petroleum. Crude rock oil. Oleum petrae album. Kerosene. Coal oil. Trituration and tincture
of the rectified oil. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Allergies. Addison's disease. Albuminuria. Anemia. Angina pectoris. Anus, fissure. Bedsores.
Breath, offensive. Bums. Chilblains. Chlorosis. Constipation. Cracks in skin. Deafness. Diarrhea. Dysmen-
orrhea. Dyspepsia. Ear disorders. Eczema. Face, rough. Facial paralysis. Feet, painful. Fester, tendency.
Fistula. Frostbite. Gastric ulcer. Gonorrhea. Hands, chapped. Headache. Hemorrhoids. Herpes. Herpes.
Irritation. Jaw, dislocated. Motion, sickness. Myopia. Nose, sore. Otorrhea. Perspiration strong. Pregnancy.
Presbyopia. Prostatitis. Psoriasis. Rheumatism. Seasickness. Skin disorders. Sprains. Syphilis. Tabes
mesenterica. Tinnitus. Toothache. Urethra, stricture. Varicose veins. Vertigo. Vomiting. Warts.
HOMEOPATHIC - Petrolatum (vaseline) consists of hydrocarbons of the paraffin series, obtained from
residues after distillation of lighter oils from cmde petroleum, or deposited from crude petroleum on standing.
Petroleum is made by agitating the liquid commercial petroleum with sulphuric acid and then rectifying the
portion which this acid does not act upon. It is “a light oily fluid, colorless or of a pale straw color and strong
characteristic naphthalic smell. Dropped on white paper it evaporates completely, leaving no greasy stain.”
Petr, was proved by Hahnemann and is one of his leading anti-psorics, closely related to Graph. It is suited to
long lasting, deep- seated, wasting diseases, lingering gastric and intestinal troubles with or without ulceration.
 In Clarke's experience, no remedy corresponds to more cases of chlorosis in young girls, with or without
ulceration of the stomach.
The disorders met with in petroleum extractors and refiners are diseases of the skin and subcutaneous tissue,
depressed nutrition, anemia, dyspepsia, nerve troubles, irritability insomnia, respiratory disorders. In addition
to these is a kind of intoxication.
Petr, chiefly acts on the skin, especially folds, scalp, face and genitals, sweat and oil glands. Cracked skin.
Unhealthy granulations after severe bums. Discharges are thick, pumlent, yellowish green.
Car, train or seasickness. Ailments from riding in cars, carriages or ships. Long- lasting complaints follow
mental states- fright, vexation, etc. Ailments are worse during the winter. Dread of open air with shivering
when exposed to it.
Great weakness, fainting, tremor, twitching of limbs, catalepsy tonic spasms, left-sided paralysis. Tremulous
weakness. Wooden feeling. Bmised soreness, worse in joints. Internal itching. Coldness in spots, in abdomen,
in heart, after scratching.
Dryness in ear, nose, etc. Catarrhal condition of the mucus membranes, of stomach and bowels. Lingering
gastric and lung troubles, chronic diarrhea.
Strumous diathesis, especially the dark type, who suffer from catarrhal conditions of the mucus membranes,
gastric acidity and cutaneous eruptions.
Enlarged glands. Emaciation, especially of chest. Feels sick internally. Hemorrhages, blood light red, worse
lifting or riding. Dropsy. Burnings.
MIND - Mental weakness and forgetfulness, with deep-seated disease. Very forgetful, disinclined to think. Loss
of memory. Irresolution. Confusion while walking in open air.
Presence of strangers aggravates. Anxiety in a crowd. Worries but does not know why. Anxiety and
apprehension about his family. Anxiety with fear. Fear, long lasting. Anxiety increases until he becomes
inconsolable.
Feeling of helplessness. Low-spirited with dimness of sight. Sadness during menses, with weeping.
Melancholy. Feels that death is near and must hurry to settle affairs.
Irritable, easily offended, vexed at everything. Excited, irritable after sex with inclination to be angry and to
scold. Cursing. Intolerant of contradiction. Anger with fright. Quarrelsome in morning.
Sense of duality, thinks he is double of someone else lying alongside or one limb is double. Delusion there
are two babies in the bed. Delusion that she has a third leg which would not remain quiet.
Abdomen - Inflated abdomen. Sensation of coldness inside. Pinching colic, better bending double. Navel
ulcerated in infants.
Back - Neck, stiff and painful, cracks when moved. Weakness in small of back. Pain in spine and all over the
body with sciatica. Coccyx painful on sitting. Pain in sacrum, worse standing erect. Sharp pains shooting up
dorsal spine into occiput, in confinement.
Breasts - Itching and mealy coating of nipple.
Causations - Ailments from riding in cars, carriages or ships (Nit-ac has deafness). Vexation. Ill effects of
sprains or suppressed eruptions. Cabbage.
Chest - Oppression of chest, worse cold air.
Constitutions - Suited to persons with light hair and skin. For lean, slender persons.
Ears - Ears sore to touch. Dryness in ears. Eczema in and behind ears with intense itching. Moist spots behind
the ears. Fissures in meatus. Discharge of pus and blood from the ears. Itching deep in ears in Eustachian
tubes. Chronic Eustachian catarrh. Dry catarrh with deafness and noises. Ringing and cracking in ears.
Diminished hearing. Deafness with noises in ears in the elderly. Noise from several people talking is
unbearable.
Eyes - Inflamed tarsi. Fistula lachrymalis (of recent origin). Blenorrhea of lachrymal sac. Marginal blepharitis.
Canthi fissured. Skin around eyes dry and scurfy. Loss of eyelashes. Dim sight, far-sighted, cannot read fine
print without glasses.
Face - Dry, as if covered with albumin. Pale or yellow, hot after eating. Easy dislocation of jaw.
Female - Dry, obstinate eruptions. Genitals sore and moist. Aversion to sex. Before menses, throbbing in head
(Kreos.). Menstrual flow causes itching. Leucorrhea, profuse, albuminous (Alum., Calc-p.), with lascivious
dreams. Prolapsed uterus from constant diarrhea.
Food - Hunger, causing nausea, wakes at night. Hunger immediately after stool. Desire for dainties, aversion
to meat, fats, cooked or hot foods. Worse eating cabbage. Thirst for beer.
Head - Headache, worse shaking, while coughing, must hold temples for relief. Occiput, aching, heavy (Op.).
Head feels numb as if made of wood. Scalp, sore to touch, followed by numbness. Sensitive scalp, as if a
cold breeze blowing on it. Moist eruption on scalp, worse back and ears. Falling of the hair.
 Heart - Cold feeling about heart (Carb-an., Nat-m.). Fainting with ebullitions, heat and palpitations.
Kidneys - Cystitis, urethritis. Stricture from chronic urethritis. Acute sudden urging, if not attended to
immediately, will cause severe pain. Involuntary urine on rising.
Bedwetting at night. Dribbling of urine after urination.
Limbs - Limbs go to sleep. Chronic sprains. Cracking in joints. Joints stiff, particularly knees. Scalding
sensation in knee. Stitches, blisters, cracks in heels. Fingertips rough, cracked, fissured every winter.
Ragged, chapped hands and fingers, bleeding in housemaids. Psoriasis of the palms. Offensive sweat in axilla.
Lungs - Dry cough at night, coming deep from chest, waking the patient (in young girls and boys). Cough at
night or worse at night. Shatters the head, better pressing. Cough produces headache.
Male - Sweaty genitals. Herpetic eruption on perineum. Itching in urethra. Prostate inflamed and swollen.
Modalities - Better warm air, dry weather, lying with head high. Worse from motion of cars, trains, carriage,
boat. Worsefrom dampness, cold weather, winter, changing weather, before and during a thunderstorm.
Worse from mental states, vexation, sex, touch. Worse eating, cabbage.
Mouth - Dry. Offensive smell like garlic. Ulcers on the inner cheek, painful when closing the teeth. Soreness,
while chewing. Tongue, white in center, dark streak along edges.
Nose - Dry. Tip of nose itches. Nostrils ulcerated, cracked, burn. Ozaena with scabs and muco-purulent
discharge. Nosebleed.
Rectum -Diarrhea, watery, gushing. Diarrhea or dysentery during the day, worse cabbage, then empty feeling.
Itching of anus after stools. Hemorrhoids and fissures of anus with great itching. Herpes on perineum.
Sensations - Brain as if wrapped in a fog. As if everything in head were alive. As if head made of wood or as
if bruised. As if a cold breeze were blowing on head. As if head would burst. Veil before eyes, sand in eyes.
Jaw as if distended. As if something were tearing off from pit of stomach. As if a cold stone at heart. Upper
and lower limbs as if stiff without joints. Splinter in heel.
Skin - Eczema with cracks in skin, worse in winter. Psoriasis, especially of hands. Deep cracks in skin folds,
nipples, fingertips. Cracks bleed easily, worse in winter. Dirty, hard, rough, thickened like parchment. Skin
gets raw, festers or won't heal, worse in folds. Slight injuries suppurate (Hep.). Thick, greenish crusts,
burning and itching, redness, bleeding. Itching at night. Itching orifices with burning. Herpes. Chilblains,
moist, itch, burn and turn purple. Brown spots. Bedsores. Skin is extremely sensitive, all clothing is painful.
Sleep - Restless with frightful dreams.
Stomach - Feeling of emptiness. Stomach pain when stomach is empty, relieved by constant eating (Anae.,
Sep.). Ravenous hunger. Must rise at night and eat (Psor.). Smells of garlic. Distention. Heartburn, hot, sharp,
sour eructation. Pungent, acrid belchings. Nausea with accumulation of water in mouth. Vomits bitter green
substance. Seasickness and motion sickness. Nausea during pregnancy, must stoop.
Temperature - Chilly with dry mouth. Chilliness, followed by sweat. Flushes of heat, particularly of the face
and head, worse at night. Flushes of heat all over in frequent attacks during day. Palms and soles hot.
Perspiration, foul on feet and axilla. Sweat in spots.
Throat - Dry. Hoarseness (Carb-v, Caust., Phos.). Foul mucus in throat, hawks out in the morning. Croup and
laryngeal diphtheria.
Vertigo - Vertigo on rising, felt in occiput. Vertigo, as if intoxicated or as if seasick. Vertigo like that produced
by swinging motion.
COMMENTS - Kent suggested Petr, for low conditions in which there is an inability to throw out eruptions on
the skin or conditions in which an eruption has disappeared without improvement in health. Mucus membranes
have catarrh. Ozaena, intestinal catarrh. Soreness and cracks about mucocutaneous orifices.
Severe irritability of the skin. Affinity for the scalp, behind the ears, skin folds, scrotum, and genitals.
Eczema (Sil., Graph.), especially of the hands and toes. Psoriasis (Nat-m., Graph.). Severely chapped skin.
Chapped, rough hands.
Induration with cracks. Deep cracks that bleed. Painful cracks of the heels of palms of the hands. Fissures that
ooze clear or yellow fluid. Skin feels tight, like wrapped leather. Thickened skin, hard, splitting.
Fingertips crack and bleed. Nails split and turn dark. Cracked nostrils. A slight wound or injury can suppurate
easily. History of suppressed eruptions with unhealthy looking skin that doesn't heal well.
Marked burning sensations. Feet and palms burn (Sulph.). Severe itching, will scratch until the skin is raw and
bleeding (Sulph.). Itching without eruptions. Feet feel frozen, tingling, numbness. Diabetic neuropathies
(Agar.). Stinging and red. Very sensitive to clothing.
Scalp eruptions, moist and sensitive to touch. Athletes foot (Thuj., Sil., Graph., Psor., Sanie.), with offensive
foot sweats, deep cracks between the toes, burning and itching of the skin. Offensive, smelly feet (Sil.).
Genital heipes (Nat-m., Rhus-t., Apis.). Vesicles with yellow fluid. Crusty appearance. Vesicles with yellow
thick crusts that become moist, ulcerating, rawness. Sores pop, leaving a painful ulcer. Groin is itching and
 red. Groin eczema, fungal infections.
Chilblains. Frostbite (Agar., Zinc.). Intermittent claudication, painful cramps and spasms, burning in hands and
feet from poor circulation. Pain on touching something cold.
Skin symptoms are worse in winter. This modality gave Nash the key to several cases of eczema, chapped
hands, chilblains and one case of chronic diarrhea, as soon as he discovered that the patient had eczema of
the hands in winter. Petr. 200c was given.
A man, a patient of Clarke's who suffered from inveterate eczema and who had formerly been employed in a
factory where much petroleum was used, noticed that his eczema was much better while working with
petroleum.
He told Clarke that the vapor had the singular effect of making some of the workmen insane, causing desire
to kill, hallucinations, they will see things not actually visible, for instance, “they will see the rails in a station
when a train is on them.”
“Falling out of the hair.” Cooper clarified that Petr, “probably acts on the sebaceous rather than the sudoriferous
secretions of the skin and its local action is on parts where the sebum is abundant.”
Vertigo and heaviness, often associated with nausea and bilious vomiting. Useful for motion sickness or
seasickness (Tab.,Cocc.). Carsickness, feels as if intoxicated. Faint and weak. Pale, cold, cold sweat, sinking
nausea. Worse motion, better fresh air and cold water on face, closing eyes.
Headache in the occiput region with sickness. Heaviness like lead, pressure, sticking, pulsating, worse on
shaking head or any jar. Pain travels from occiput to eyes and is associated with temporary loss of sight and
fainting. Blocked Eustachian tubes and itching in the ears (Kali-m., Cham.). Dizziness, ringing in the ears.
“Oppression of the chest, worse in cold air.” Cough coming from deep down in the chest and frequently waking
the patient up at night, usually in children. Thick, purulent and yellowish green discharges.
Kent remarked on the awful ravenous hunger. Empty feeling, gnawing hunger, must eat small amounts.
Hunger immediately after a stool in diarrhea, nervous affections, spinal disease, etc.
Irritability of the mind. Excitable, angry at trifles. Characteristic illusion that there is another person or another
baby in bed has led to cures in cases of typhoid and puerperal fever with Petr.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Cocc., Nux-v., Phos. Antidote to: Nit-ac., Lead poisoning - one of the best
remedies. Compare: ( 1 ) Carb-v, Graph., Sulph., Phos. Complementary: before Sep. Compatible: Bry.,
Calc.. Lyc., Nit-ac., Nux-v., Puls., Sep., Sil., Sulph.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Kent. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Petroselinum Sativum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - petros. Petroselinum sativum. Parsley. Carum petroselinum. Apium petroselinum. N. O.
Umbelliferae. Tincture of whole fresh plant when coming into bloom. Historical dose: Tincture and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Blindness. Catheter, fever. Chills. Cystitis. Dyspepsia. Dysuria. Fevers. Flatulence. Gleet.
Gonorrhea. GraveL Hemorrhoids . Intermittent fever. Night-blindness. Polyuria. Priapism. Prostate,
enlargement. Urethritis. Urinary, difficulties. Urticaria.
HERBAL - Parsley tea is a recognized domestic remedy for gonorrhea. Parsley eaten after meals, with or
without salad oil, is reputed to act as a solvent on uric acid if there is a tendency to its formation in the urine.
Fresh butter and parsley applied warm is an old remedy for bruises.
Cooper noted that an infusion is given to all children recovering from scarlatina by the matron of a suburban
infectious hospital. An old gleet has been known to disappear from parsley infusion, and an Edinburgh surgeon
used to given it in all nephritic and bladder diseases that were chronic. Parsley is said to be poisonous to
ferrets.
HOMEOPATHIC - Hahnemann noted the usefulness of Petros, as agonorrheal remedy when there is a
frequent desire to urinate. Affinity for the genito-urinary sphere. The leading indication is sudden urging to
urinate and drawing, tingling, crawling or itching in navicular fossa. During urination, burning and tingling from
perineum through whole urethra. After urination, cutting and biting in fossa navicularis. Very painful urination
causing him to shiver, dance around the room in agony.
Gonorrhea with a milky or yellow discharge. Dysuria with prostatic enlargement. Urinary difficulties of babies.
Hemorrhoids with much itching.
Back - Jerking or bubbling sensation in muscles of back and arms.
Ears - Shrill singing in ears like a bell ringing out of tune, which affects the whole organism.
Eyes - Blindness at night with swelling of eyes.
Food - Thirsty and hungry, yet as soon as they begin to eat or drink they lose all desire.
 Kidneys - Tingling, lancinating, pressure and drawing in urethra. Burning, tingling from perineum throughout
whole urethra. Dysuria and polyuria. Frequent and almost fruitless desire to urinate, every half-hour. Sudden
urging to urinate, voluptuous tickling in fossa navicularis. Child suddenly seized with desire to urinate, if not
gratified immediately, jumps up and down with pain. Urethritis. Gonorrhea with intense biting, itching, deep
in urethra. Milky fluid, albuminous yellow discharge from urethra. Orifice of urethra agglutinated with mucus.
Male - Priapism, without curvature of penis. Urethritis. Pollutions, profuse emission toward morning.
Rectum - Whitish evacuations like clay, chronic diarrhea. Hemorrhoids with much itching. Burning at anus.
Skin - Urticaria.
Sleep - Sleep late, with many anxious dreams.
Stomach - Twitching, jerking pains in epigastrium. Flatulent belchings, colic, nausea and vomiting.
Temperature - Ague, especially quotidian, marked periodicity, regular stages. Acute fevers from defective
assimilation or perverted innervation, accompanied by flatulent dyspepsia. Intermittent fevers with abdominal
disorders. Fevers with traumatic or chronic inflammation of urethra or even stricture.
COMMENTS - Petros, was proved by Beth- mann. He obtained only thirty-six symptoms, all in the genito-
urinary sphere, but these were very characteristic and have given the remedy a definite place in homeopathic
medicine, especially in gonorrhea and gleet.
Farrington said Petros, is a great “baby medicine” for urinary difficulties. Hering collected symptoms from other
observers. It has cured many cases of intermittent fever and^raumatic or other urethral fevers.
Acute cystitis, urethritis. Burning and tingling in the urethra. Irresistible desire to urinate, frequent urination.
Children will scream and yell with the urge to urinate, anticipating the pain. Bladder infections in children.
Gonorrhea. Trauma to the urethra from catheters.
Clarke confirmed its efficiency in gonorrhea and gleet, giving ten-drop doses of the tincture. In a case of dysuria
from prostatic enlargement there was frequent urging to urinate every half to three-quarters of an hour with
burning pains in bladder and urethra.
Petros. 4x, three drops every hour took away all the pains and relieved the tenesmus in a few days. The
prostate gland itself was not influenced.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) In gonorrhea with sudden and frequent urging, Cann-s., Canth., Merc. (2)
Screams before urinating from irritation of mucus membrane, Aeon., Caust., Bor. (3) Sars., Lyc. and Benz-ac.
have screaming before urinating when due to gravel. (4) Gonorrhea, strangury, frequent urging to urinate,
white stools, Dig. (5) Dig. has slow pulse often puffed prepuce, Sulph. indurated prepuce. (6) Cystitis, Con. -
has intermittent urination, Petros, has inflammation that has traveled back, sudden, irresistible desire. (7)
Bubbling in back, urinary disorders, Berb. (8) Uric acid tendency intermittent fevers, Urt-u.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Phallus Impudicus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - phal. Phallus impudicus. Stinkhorn fungus. N. O. Fungi. Tincture or infusion of whole fungus.
Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Gastro-enteralgia. Sweat, viscid. Vertigo. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - Kalieniczensko took five or six teaspoonfuls of an infusion of Phal. in twenty-four hours and

name: Phaseolus Nanus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - phase. Phaseolus nanus. Dwarfbean. Phaseolus vulgaris. Kidney-bean. N. O. Leguminosae.
Papilionoideae. Trituration of the dried bean. Decoction of dried beans and pods. Historical dose: Trituration
and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Breast, tumors. Diabetes. Dropsy. Hematuria. Headache. Heart, disorders. Hernia.
Hydrothorax. Impotency. Palpitations. Pericarditis. Pleurisy. Prostate, diseases. Wounds, punctured.
HERBAL - Clarke included under Phaseolus both Phaseolus nanus and Phaseolus vulgaris. The New Eng.
Med. Gaz. published a translation of a pamphlet by Dr. Heinrich Ramm on the uses of “Bean tea.”
A woman whom Ramm had treated in vain for mitral valve disease with liver and kidney complications and
dropsy, presented herself one day apparently cured by drinking “Bean tea.”
This led Ramm to try it in other cases and he found that kidney and cardiac dropsies were speedily relieved,
 urine largely increased in quantity and in cases of albuminuria, where the albumen quickly disappeared.
HOMEOPATHIC - Some effects of eating mildewed beans in a child were recorded by W. Dale. A. M. Cushing
and Demeures both proved Phaseolus nanus, but Cushing only published the symptoms observed on the
heart.
Demeures, in his proving, experience severe headache from fullness in the brain. Breathing slow, pulse slow
or extinct. “Irregular, weak pulse and heart failure.” Soreness to touch in eyeballs, right rib, epigastrium, and
right humerus. Diabetes.
Cooper noted that the inside of the pod rubbed on warts is said to cure them. A decoction of the shells has
been used as a drink for diabetes, but can cause severe headaches.
Ramm noted it for dropsical effusion into pleural cavity, pericardium and peritoneum. Chronic disorders of the
urinary tract from kidneys to urethra, pyelitis, bladder catarrh, gravel, stones, uric acid.
Ramm considered Phase, an important remedy in gout and diabetes. He used a decoction of the whole dried
ripe pod “of the taller variety,” Phaseolus vulgaris.
MIND - Could only be roused by speaking loudly. Frightened by irregular action of heart. Feeling that she would
die with palpitations. Abdomen - Pressure on abdomen gave pain, child shrank from it and drew up legs.
Dropsy. Pain like hernia in right inguinal ring, lasting all day.
Chest - Breathing slow and sighing. Sick feeling about heart with weak pulse. Pulse rapid. Palpitations. Right
ribs sore. Dropsical effusion into pleura or pericardium.
Eyes - Pupils dilated, insensible to light. Eyeballs (especially right) painful to touch as from a blow. Scalding
pain in right orbit. Very smart itching in inner canthi. Pain over right orbit worse from mental exertion.
Face - Features expressed suffering.
Head - Aches chiefly in forehead or orbits from fullness of brain, worse any movement or mental exertion.
Heart - Fearful palpitations and feeling that death is approaching.
Kidneys - Diabetic urine. Bloody urine. Uric acid gravel.
Limbs - Pain to touch in extremity of head, of right humerus.
Lungs - Breathing slow and sighing.
Male - Complete impotence. Prostate enlargement.
Modalities - Headache was worse by movement of the head or any mental exertion, reading or writing.
Pressure aggravates.
Stomach - Pain in epigastrium when touched, especially in region of pylorus. Severe, dull pain in epigastrium,
vomiting.
Temperature - Cold perspiration.
COMMENTS - Cushing's proving recorded disturbance of the nervous system, genital organs, impotence,
stomach, bowels and kidneys and this symptom, which brought the proving to an abrupt close:
“I suddenly felt a curious sensation in the region of the heart. It was so sudden and strange I immediately felt
my pulse and found it very irregular and feeble, so much so I think I was frightened, at least, I did not take any
more of the medicine.”
Cushing used this in his case of a female doctor, 30, married, no children, never ill except with children's
diseases, had much mental trouble two years before and had done much cycling. Since then her heart had
given trouble. About five times in a minute the heart would give one hard, unpleasant throb, then omit one
beat. During the night it was much worse and prevented sleep. Phase. 10c was given.
Thirty-six hours later the heart would beat a hundred beats without varying and improvement continued, but
the patient had to give up the remedy on account of the headache it caused, “as if something were pressing
hard against each temple”, much worse after each dose of the medicine. The patient was never subject to
headaches.
He had another case, in which a man, 45, had dropsy, heart and other complications. Bean pod decoction
enabled him to lie down on a couch and markedly diminished the dropsy.
A clergyman, 69, many years invalid on account of heart disease after unusual exertion was greatly exhausted
and became entirely pulseless and so remained four days in spite of treatment until Phase. 9x was given. In a
few hours pulse returned. In thirty-six hours it was regular and strong and so remained until his death, which
oc- curred two weeks later.
In another case, Cushing observed a woman, 50, weak, tired, badly acting heart for some years. Phase. 9x
was given and in forty-eight hours “her heart wheeled into line all right and remains so.”
Another woman, 87, heart acted badly, every third beat omitted. After taking Phase, two days pulse quite right.
A nurse, 50, “had fearful time with her heart palpitating and feeling as if she should die,” Phase. 15x cured.
The patient “never took anything in her life that did her so much good.”
In a confinement case, with primipara, urine loaded with albumen, frightful convulsions, forceps delivery. Two
 hours later the heart failed and no stimulants would start it.
Phase. 9x was given and in ten minutes the heart was all right. Twice in the night the dose had to be repeated,
but that was all. The albumen rapidly disappeared and a quick recovery was made.
S. R. Stone reported the case of Mr. T., 69, whom he found semi-conscious, yet suffering severely, having
been seized with distress in heart region, respiration labored, pulse 51. He had attacks previously, but lighter
and the pulse in them had always been slow.
Phase. 6x was given, at first every halfhour, then every hour. The next day the patient was nearly well and
said he “could feel every dose working.”
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) The Legumi- nosae. (2) In heart, Dig., Crat., Spig., Lach., Thyr., (3) Punctured
wounds, Hyper., Led. (4) Diabetes, Syzyg., Nat-s., Uran-n.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Phellandrium Aquaticum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - phel. Phellandrium aquaticum. Water dropwort. Oenanthe phellandrium. Fine-leaved water-
hemlock. Horse-bane. N. O. Umbelliferae. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Bronchitis. Emphysema. Tuberculosis.
HOMEOPATHIC - Phel. acts on lungs and nerves. The respiratory symptoms are most important and have
been frequently verified clinically.
Catarrhal conditions of the respiratory tract. Bronchitis andemphysema. Offensive expectoration and cough
in tuberculosis. Hemoptysis. Tuberculosis, affecting gener-
Phellandrium aquaticum ally the middle lobes.
Everything tastes sweet. Hectic and colliquative diarrhea. As if all the blood vessels were in vibratory motion.
Feeling of tiredness while walking.
MIND - Peevish arrogance.
Breasts - Pain in nipples. Pain in milk ducts, intolerable between nursing.
Eyes - Only half open and look as if one has been crying for a week. Burning in eyes. Lachrymation. Ciliary
neuralgia, worse any attempt to use eyes. Intolerance of light.
Face - Livid red in the evening.
Head - Headache involving nerves going to eye. Clang like striking on metal in brain, waking him. Weight on
vertex, aching and burning in temples and above eyes. Crushing feeling in vertex.
Lungs - Expectoration, horribly offensive (like bedbugs), loose, profuse, smeary, causing dyspnea. Cough
compels him to sit up. Sticking pain through from left border of right breasts to between shoulders. Pains going
backwards through chest.
Modalities - Better while nursing. Worse air, cold, open. Worse from using eyes.
Sleep - So sleepy, would fall asleep while standing at work.
Stomach - Everything tastes sweet. Desires sour things, milk or beer. Aversion to water. Belchings smelling
of bed bugs.
Vertigo - Vertigo, dizzy when lying down.
COMMENTS - This remedy, proved by Nen- ning, has a few striking symptoms, although it is rarely used and
very little known. Generally right-sided.
Continuous cough for hours in the morning accompanied by dyspnea and prostration. Coarse rales, compelling
the patient to remain in a sitting posture. Bronchitis and tuberculosis. Last stage of tuberculosis when a cavity
has formed in the lungs and there is edema of the limbs. Diarrhea, difficult respiration and profuse sweat.
Affinity for the female breasts, specially the right one. The nipples pain each time the child is put to the breast.
The pain shoots inward and backward to the shoulder and to the sacrum.
Intolerable pain in the right breast along the course of the lactiferous tubes immediately after nursing, causing
physical and mental distress, loss of strength, and hysterical weeping. Removes abnormal sleepiness in
women after childbirth.
Usher reported a cure with Phel. in a woman, who would go off to sleep standing over her wash-tub.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Phenacetinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - phenac. Phenacetinum. Para- acetphenatidine. Derívate of anilinum. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Cyanosis. Face, eruptions. Fevers. Headache. Perspiration, excessive. Typhoid fever. Uremia.
HOMEOPATHIC - Phenac, belongs to the Aniline group and was introduced into old- school practice as a
 remedy in febrile states and neuralgias.
Clarke added a symptom observed on a young woman who had taken Phenac, for headaches. She had a
circumscribed rash on both cheeks which came out red, lasted four days and then peeled and as soon as it
was clear the process was repeated.
Clarke tried many remedies with varying success, but it finally disappeared under Alum. 30c, one powder at
bedtime.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Phenobarbitalum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - phenob. Phenobarbitalum. Phenobarbital. Gardenalum. Allopathic drug. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Acetonemia. Allergies. Asthma. Convulsions. Coryza. Digestive, disorders. Eczema. Edema.
Epilepsy. Erythema. Food, allergies. Headaches. Liver, deficiency. Phenobarbital, poisoning. Urticaria.
Vesicles.
HOMEOPATHIC - Phenobarbital is derived from phenylethylmalonylurea or gardenal.
Chronic poisoning from phenobarbital and the other barbiturates, especially in cases of digestive or skin
intolerance. Eczema,
especially weeping eczema. Food, allergies. Digestive complaints from intolerance to foods (fish, Crustacea,
cream). Physical and psychological depression, tiredness and sleepiness.
Liver deficiency. Alternation of classical allergic phenomena including asthma, eczema, and spasmodic coryza.
Nasal and pharyngeal itching. In the child, prurigo coexists or alternates with acetonemia.
Urticaria, either in patches, confluent or isolated. Vesicles dry or weeping when scratched with a syrupy liquid,
which is usually cloudy. Itching edema. Itching and often vesicular erythema.
MIND - Mental depression alternating with hyper-excitability. Hypersensitive. Acrimonious. Memory weak.
Abdomen - Abdominal heaviness. Intestinal sluggishness. Chronic or occasional hepatic deficiency.
Blood - Acetonemia in the child.

HOMEOPATHIC - Phosphorus was discovered in 1673 by Brandt, an alchemist ofHamburgh, and shortly
afterwards by Kunkel in Saxony. According to Teste, attempts were made to use it in medicine immediately
after discovery. Kunkel made it into his “luminous pills,” and Kramer claimed to have cured with it diarrhea,
epilepsy and malignant fevers.
Teste offered a list of old-school cures, which included continuous, bilious and intermittent fevers, general
edema, measles, two cases of pneumonia of the left lung with ataxic symptoms, chronic rheumatism of the
legs, strokes, hydrocephalus, periodic headaches, catalepsy, epilepsy, and chronic lead poisoning.
Hahnemann's provings have been added to by later provings, by numerous cases of poisoning and by the
effects on workers in match factories, most notably, necrosis of the lower jaw.
The vapor given off by unignited phosphorus is phosphorus oxide. The jaw affection, called “the phossy-jaw”
by the workers, is accompanied by profound adynamia and frequently ends in death.
The form of the disease differs according to whether the upper or lower jaw is attacked. In the former case, it
generally pursues a chronic and mild course, ending in exfoliation, scars and cure. In the latter, the necrosis
may be either acute or chronic, but is always severe and the patients usually die of “tuberculosis” fever.
Phos. irritates, inflames and degenerates the mucus membranes. It inflames the serous membranes, the spinal
 cord and nerves. It causes paralysis and destroys bone, especially in the lower jaw and tibia. It disorganizes
the blood, causing fatty degeneration of blood vessels and every tissue and organ of the body. It gives rise to
hemorrhages and hematogenous jaundice.
Phos. produces a picture of destructive metabolism. It causes yellow atrophy of the liver and sub-acute
hepatitis.

Back - Back pains as if broken, impeding all motion, especially during menses. Weak spine. Spinal irritation,

Bladder - Tension over region of bladder. Bladderis full without urging. Burning and twitching in urethra, with

Breasts - Stitching pain in breasts. Left infra-mammary pains. Nipples, hot and sore. Enlargement of mammary

Breast cancer with sharp lancinating pains or bleeding easily. Amenorrhea with milk in breast. Increased

Causations - Ill effects of anger, fear, grief, worry. Ill effects of exposure to drenching rains, washing clothes,
having hair cut. Tobacco. Iodine. Excessive use of salt or sugar. Electrocution.
Chest - Sharp stitches in chest, breathing quickened, oppressed. Stitches in left upper chest, rattling worse
cold drinks. Full, heavy chest, pains into throat, right arm, or alternating sides. Oppression, as if a great

Burning pains. Heat in the chest. Intense heat behind sternum. Dry, hot feeling in chest with cough, dry, then

Constitutions - Suited to tall, slender persons of sanguine temperament, fair skin, blonde or red hair, quick,

anemic. Persons of waxy, translucent skin, half anemic, half jaundiced. Tall, slender, narrow-chested,
tubercular patients, delicate eyelashes, soft hair. Tall, slim, dark-haired persons, especially women, disposed
to stoop. Nervous, weak persons who like to be magnetized. Hemorrhagic patients, slight wounds bleed
profusely.
Cough - Cough with burning dryness in throat. Dry cough, with pain in head as if it would burst. Dry cough,
waking from sleep. Hollow cough, mostly in morning in bed, also at night, prevents falling asleep. Cough in

Ears - Otitis media. Mastoiditis (Caps.). Polyps in the ear. Tickling and itching in ears. As if foreign bodies were

Eyes - Glaucoma. Cataract (Calc-f.). Vitreous opacities. Atrophy of optic nerve. Degenerative changes in

Aversion to light. Symptoms after an iridectomy. Eyes turned outwards. Eyeballs feel large, stiff. Fatigue of

Pain in orbital bones. Hollow, with blue rings around eyes.
Face - Pale, sickly complexion, blue rings under eyes. Puffiness under eyes. Color of face very changeable.
Hippocratic countenance. Skin as if too tight. Skin burns on shaving. Burning heat and redness of one or both
cheeks. Lips, blue, dry, cracked, sooty, scabby. Crack in middle of lower lip. Ulcerated corners of mouth. Facial

necrosis of lower jaw (Amph., Hecla.).
Female - Chlorosis. Amenorrhea with vicarious menstruation, with blood spitting, bleeding from the anus or
hematuria, or with milk in breast. Before menses, bearing down pains, nymphomania, weeping. Menses too
early and scanty, not profuse. Menses too late but very copious. Menses last too long. Leucorrhea, profuse,
smarting, corrosive instead of menses. Milky leucorrhea early in morning, when walking. Slight hemorrhage
 from uterus between periods. Frequent and profuse or short uterine bleeding in between the periods in nursing
women. Metritis. Uterine polyps. Condylomata. Cauliflower cancers bleeding profusely. Cancer of the uterus
with metrorrhagia. Edema of labia. Phlebitis. Aversion to sex. Vagina numb during sex in spite of sexual
excitement. Violent sexual desire during pregnancy and breast-feeding. Infertility from excessive
voluptuousness or with profuse or too late menses. Labor pains distressing, ineffectual.
Food - Ravenous hunger during fever, nightly, before the attack of sickness. Hunger soon after eating.
Hypoglycemia, low blood sugar. Loss of appetite alternating with bulimia. Headache from fasting. Craving for
cold, iced drinks. Craves ice during chill. Craving for ice cream, cold milk, carbonated drinks, refreshing
things. Desires salt, acids, spicy foods. Desires chocolate, candies, cheese, cucumbers, chicken, fish, wine.
Aversion to warm drinks, warmfood. Aversion to coffee, tea, boiled milk, puddings, sweets. Aversion to fruit,
garlic, onions, tomatoes, meat, salt fish, beer. Bad effects of eating too much salt. Unable to drink water
during pregnancy, the sight of water makes her vomit, has to close her eyes when taking a bath.
Head - Headaches, heavy, over one eye, with hunger. Sick headache, with pulsations and burning. Headaches
with weakness and strained feeling of eyes. Pains preceded by dimness of sight. Headaches with increased
sensitiveness to odors. Headaches before thunderstorm. Chronic congestion of head. Heat comes up from
Phosphorus spine. Burning pains in temples. Shooting pains from one temple to other. Pulsating, pressing,
boring and burning, in one or the other temple. Stupefying headache, in vertex. Vertex throbs, hot after grief.
Chronic meningitis. Neuralgia, parts must be kept warm. Burning pains. Brain-fatigue with coldness of
occiput. Softening of the brain with formication, numbness of limbs. Tendency to atrophy of brain in old age.
Periostitis of skull. Feels as if pulled by hair. Skin of forehead feels too tight. Clammy sweat on head. Copious
dandruff. Itching of scalp. Falling of hair in large bunches, in spots.
Heart - Anxiety about heart with nausea and peculiar sensation of hunger, somewhat better eating. Pressure
in middle of sternum and about heart. Pains go into right arm. Congestion of blood to heart, excited by sensual
impressions. Dilatation of the heart from fatty degeneration or endocarditis. Endocarditis or myocarditis during
course of acute inflammatory rheumatism or during pneumonia. Palpitations with anxiety while lying on left
side. Palpitations from least excitement. Palpitations during menses. Palpitations with numbness, stiffness
and coldness of left arm. Weak heart, pulse rapid, small andsoft. Blowing sounds in heart. Feeling of warmth
in heart.
Kidneys - Fatty or amyloid degeneration of kidneys. Dull pain in renal region. Burning pain in kidneys, can't
lie on back. Bright's disease. Nephritis with hydrops and diarrhea. Hematuria in acute nephritis (Canth.).
Hematuria with jaundice. Periodical albuminuria.
Limbs - Limbs heavy as lead. Tingling and formication in limbs, better rubbing. Muscular rheumatism.
Weakness and trembling from every exertion, can scarcely hold anything with his hands. Joints suddenly
give way. Ascending sensory and motor paralysis from ends of fingers and toes. Post-diphtheria paralysis
with formication of hands and feet. Hands and arms cold during diarrhea. Arms and hands become numb.
Stitches in elbow and shoulder joints. Tearing left shoulder at night. Paralyzing stitches in hips, then up back.
Pains in tibias, periostitis. Ankles, as if to break, easy dislocation. Burning of feet. Icy cold feet. Toes cramp.
Suppressed foot sweat. Cold feet and hands during menses. Can lie only on right side.
Liver - Acute and chronic hepatitis. Congested liver. Acute yellow atrophy of liver. Fatty degeneration of
liver (Carb-tcl.,Ars., Chlor.). Cirrhosis. Jaundice with pneumonia or brain disease. Jaundice during pregnancy.
Jaundice from nervous excitement, malignant, hematogenous. Liver weakness and sensitivity. Disordered liver
in men from tropical climates.
Lungs - Oppressive breathing, worse least motion. Tight suffocative breathing, worse cough. Congestion of
lungs. Bronchitis. Pneumonia of left lower lung, with oppression, worse lying on left side. Pleuro-pneumonia.
Lobular pneumonia. Threatened paralysis of lungs at an early stage of pneumonia in old people. Whole body
trembles with cough. Hard, dry, tight, racking cough. Sputa rusty, blood-colored orpurulent. Repeated
hemoptysis (Acai.). Easy sputum, frothy, rusty bluish, salty, sour, sweetish or cold. Nervous coughs provoked

after cough. Congestive asthma, worse lying on back or on falling asleep. Tuberculosis in tall, rapidly-growing
young people (Calc-p.). Pulmonary edema. Typhoid pneumonia, with sensitiveness and gurgling in ileocaecal
region and diarrhea.
Male - Constant discharge of thin, slimy, colorless fluid from urethra. Discharge of prostatic fluid during hard
stool. Ulcers on prepuce. Testes sore, swollen, painful. Hydrocele after gonorrheal orchitis, with sexual
weakness. Irresistible desire, but impotent. Erections feeble or none at all. Erection ineffectual during sex.
Impotence from or preceded by overexcitement of sexual organs. Premature ejaculation. Involuntary emissions
with lascivious dreams. Lascivious, strips himself, sexual mania.
Modalities - Better in dark, sleep, lying on right side, sitting. Better rubbing, massage, magnetism. Better
 eating, cold food, washing with cold water, cold, open air. Worse from the change of weather, windy, cold,
thunderstorms, lightning. Worse putting hands in cold water, getting wet in hot weather. Worse twilight,
evening, light. Worse from warm food or drink, salt. Worse lying on left side or painful side, on back. Worse
from touch, physical exertion, ascending stairs, shaving, odors. Worse mental exertion, emotions, talking,
puberty, sexual excess, loss of fluids.
Mouth - Much watery saliva. Salty or sweetish salivation. Taste bitter of rotten eggs in morning. Sour taste
after milk, bitter, sweetish, when coughing. Aphthous patches on roof of mouth and tongue. Itching of palate.
Abscess of hard palate. Gums bleed easily, sore behind central incisors. Persistent bleeding after tooth
extraction. Mouth drawn to the left. Speech difficult, stutters. Sore mouth from nursing.
Nose - Nose swollen, red, shiny, painful to touch. Ulcers in the nose. Decay. Periostitis of nasal bones. Nervous
fanlike motions of alae nasi (Lyc.). Polyps, bleeding easily (Calc., Sang.). Nosebleed instead of menses.
Nosebleeds in children, youths. Nosebleed, then pneumonia with cough during stool. Chronic catarrh with
hemorrhages, handkerchief is always bloody. Acute coryza, with dull headache. Coryza, alternately fluent
and dry, on alternate sides. Sneezing, worse odors, smoke with dyspnea, causes pain in the throat. Sneezing
and coryza on putting hands in water. Nose obstructed in morning. Oversensitivesmell (Carb-ac., Nux-v.).
Faints from smell of flowers. Foul imaginary odors (Aur.). Loss of smell and taste.
Perspiration - Cold, clammy sweats. Profuse sweat at night during sleep. Profuse sweat in morning. Early
morning, sticky sweats, without relief. Perspires on slight exertion. Sweat smells of sulphur. Exhausting sweats.
Perspires on head and hands, frequently alternating with coldness. Mostly sweats on head, hands and feet,
with increased urine. Perspires only on forepart of body.
Rectum - Urging for stool, on lying on left side. Stool difficult to expel. Stricture of rectum, stools flattened.
Great weakness after stool. Dysentery. Exhausting diarrhea. Dianhea during pregnancy or confinement.
Morning diarrhea of old people. Alternating diarrhea and constipation in old people. Nervous, involuntary stool
after fright. Anus open, prolapsed. Painful cramps in rectum. Needlelike stitches in rectum. Tearing in anus,
better warm cloth. Fissure of anus. Burning in rectum. Discharge of blood from rectum during stool. Bleeding
hemorrhoids. Hemorrhoids burn like fire. Polyps with proctitis.
Sensations - As if about to die. As if immersed in hot water. As if chair were rising. As if he had been lying at
night with head too low. As if everything had stopped in head. As if eyes would be pressed out or pressed
down by weight about them. As if painful nodes under scalp. Anxiety as if below left breast. As if great weight
lying on middle of sternum. Back as if broken. As if quicksilver moved up and down spinal cord. Coccyx as if
ulcerated. Soles as if he had walked too much. Feet as if asleep. Ankles as if sprained.
Skin - Anesthesia of skin. Burning in skin with restlessness. Scurvy. Jaundice. Pete- chia. Purpura
hemorrhagia. Ecchymosis. Wounds bleed very much, even if small. Woundswhich appear to have healed
break out again and bleed. Little ulcer outside of large ones. Ulcers bleed during menses. Thin foul, bloody
pus. Brownish or blood red spots. Red streaks after scratching. Psoriasis on knees, elbows, legs and eye-
brows. Blood-boils. Fatty cysts. Fungus hematodes and excrescences. Chilblains. Skin burns on shaving.
Sleep - Great drowsiness, especially after meals. Short naps ameliorates, frequently waking. Sleepiness
during coryza. Sleepy by day, sleepless before midnight. Sleepless, cannot close the eyes from internal heat.
Difficulty falling asleep on account of excitement. Sleeplessness in elderly people. Vivid dreams of fire, of
hemorrhage, ofbiting animals. Dreams of restless
Phosphorus work and business which he could not finish. Lascivious dreams. Sleepwalking. Goes to sleep
late and awakens weak. Feels in the morning as if he had not slept enough. Coma vigil.
Stomach - Tremors, fluttering or something rolling over in stomach. Sore spot in pit. Stomach cold as if frozen.
Empty, hollow feeling in stomach, as if hanging down, worse emotions. Gnawing pain. Pain in stomach, better
cold drinks. Burning in stomach, worse eating. Burning in esophagus. Gastritis with heartburn. Water brash.
Hiccough. Sour taste and sour belchings after every meal. Bitter, tasteless eructations. Nausea on putting
hands in warm water. Constant nausea with confusion of head. Regurgitates ingesta. Throws up food by the
mouthfuls. Water is thrown up as soon as it gets warm in the stomach. Vomiting of bile, blood, coffee
grounds. Post-operative vomiting, after chloroform. Stomach ulcer.
Stool - Very fetid stools and flatus. Long, narrow, hard stool, like a dog's. White, hard stools. Green mucus
with grains like sago. Stools hot, sour-smelling, corrosive. Painless stool, copious, gray, bluish, watery, pouring
out. Stools scanty, semi-fluid. Stools green, yellow, watery, with flakes of mucus and clots of blood. Discharge
of blood from rectum, during stool.
Teeth - Numb teeth. Rapid decay of teeth. Tearing and shooting pains in teeth, worse open air and warm food.
Toothache in morning when shewing. Toothache from washing clothes, from having hands in cold or warm
water. Persistent bleeding after tooth extraction. Inflammation of gums and gumboils in lower jaw. Gums
sore behind central incisors. Boring pain sometimes passing into numbness, worse cold, heat and chewing,
 with soreness and swelling of gums. Swollen and easily bleeding gums. Gums ulcerated. Irregular formation
of teeth of lower jaw of scrofulous children with mesenteric disease.
Temperature - Chilly every evening in warm room. Cold knees at night. Craves ice water during the chill. Chill
alternating with heat, at night. Chill descends, heat ascends (up back). Burning heat, up back. Internal heat,
with sensation of hot water in stomach. Flushes all over, beginning in hands. Profuse perspiration. Hectic fever
with small, quick pulse, viscid nightsweats. Fever in warm room, heat down back. Fever with anxiety, burning
in face and hands, flushed cheeks. Painless fevers. Fever on falling asleep. Fever at night, without thirst.
Stupid delirium.
Throat - Dryness in pharynx and fauces. Dry, glistening. Rawness, roughness and scraping in throat, worse
toward evening. Tendency to get sore throats that go into the lungs. Larynx very painful, sore, painful on
speaking. Feeling of rawness in larynx from passage of inspired air. Larynx feels as if lined with fur. Violent
tickling in larynx while speaking. Burning in esophagus. Stricture of esophagus. Tonsils and uvula swollen.
Uvula elongated. As of cotton or something hanging in throat. Pain in throat on coughing. Sweetish taste while
coughing. Low, hoarse voice, worse morning and evening. Hoarseness, worse evenings. Can't talk on account
of pain in larynx. Croupy voice, followed by bronchitis. Sudden aphonia. Aphonia, worse evenings, with
rawness.
Tongue - Tongue dry, smooth, red or white, not thickly coated. Tongue coated white, yellow, grey, with brown
center. Tongue coated only in middle. Tongue dry in middle, cracked, parched or glossy, with stinging in tip.
Burning pain on tongue. Tip of tongue somewhat swollen, with enlargement of its papillae and feeling as if it
had been burnt.
Urine - Constant discharge of thin, slimy, colorless fluid from urethra. Diabetes, sugar in urine. Turbid urine,
brown, with red sediment. Profuse pale, watery urine, then weakness. Urine acrid, smelling offensive. Urine
turbid, whitish, like curdled milk, with brick-dust sediment and variegated cuticle on surface. Pellicle on urine.
Albuminuria, periodical. Sediment white, sandy or flocculent, albuminous, containing fatty casts. Urinates pure
blood.
Vertigo - Vertigo with faintness, nausea and headache. Vertigo, floating sensation, on
Phosphorus waking. Vertigo after rising (Bry.), with weakness of legs. Vertigo on exertion of vision.
Vertigo, worse looking up or down. Vertigo from smell of flowers, gas, ethereal oils, turpentine, with fainting.
Vertigo of the elderly.
Vision - Narrow field of vision. Partial loss of vision from abuse of tobacco, sexual excess, lightning. Diplopia.
Amaurosis from sexual excess. Misty vision, with attacks of vanishing of sight. Retinal trouble with the lights
and hallucination of vision. Colors before eyes followed by migraine. Green halo about the candlelight
(Osm.). Muscae volitantes. Black points seem to float before the eyes. Letters appear red. Patient sees better
by shading eyes with hand. Sensation as if everything were covered with a mist or veil or something pulled
tightly over eyes. Blindness after lightning-stroke.
COMMENTS - Profoundly affects the nutrition and function of all tissues, notably the hardest (bone) and the
softest (nerve and blood). Causes irritation, weakness, exaltation of all the senses, and later a typhoid state
and fatty degeneration.
Pareira observed in phosphorus workers “a peculiar sallow, bloated complexion with dull expression of eye
and gastric derangement,” when there was no affection of the jaws. Wagner found Phos. symptoms long before
local disease appeared, e.g., cardialgía, anorexia, eructation of gas smelling of Phos., also dizziness, faintness
and cachectic appearance.
The first symptoms in the jaws are tearing pains, the teeth being sound, swelling and suppuration of the gums
and lessening of the teeth follow, and the bone becomes denuded. Langenbeck objects to the term “necrosis,”
stating that it is a periostatics in which bony deposit occurs, enclosing the jaws more or less as in a sheath.
There is no exfoliation. This osteo-periostitis may arise from rheumatism.
Painful burns and burning sensations. “Glowing sensation throughout the epigastrium and chest.” “A flame
seemed passing through me.” “Warming sensation right side of heart and below left clavicle. This heat spread
to apex of left scapula and to acromion, when it left the heart.” “From 11 a. m. until 4 p.m. remarkable numb
feeling in left leg from knee to toes, sometimes sensation as if hot blood flowed into it.”
Burning pains with inflammation. Burning between the scapula, burning in spots along the spine, feeling of
intense heat running up the back. Flashes of heat beginning in hands and spreading to face. Burning palms,
cannot bear to have the hands covered.
Nervous or hectic fever. Low delirium, muttering, stupid or violent or there may be a state of ecstasy or odd
ideas. In intermittents when there is heat at night beginning in the stomach, faint and hungry in night, heat in
hands.
Chilliness towards evening, icy coldness of hands, knees and feet, even in bed. Sweat is anxious, profuse,
 exhausting on slightest exertion, profuse at night, cold and clammy, smelling of sulphur or of garlic.
Fibrillary twitching of individual bundles of tissues in muscles. Numbness and formication in paralyzed limbs.
Spasms on paralyzed side. Uncertain gait, neuralgic pain and fuzzy feeling of the feet. Locomotor ataxia.
Epilepsy from masturbation. Petit mal, epilepsy with consciousness.
Sudden prostration from shock or malignant types of disease, either acute or chronic. Overly sensitive,
impressionable. Excitable condition, exaltation of mental faculties, and the condition that follows over-exertion.
Overextended feeling. Tendency to overreact in situations.
Sense of immediacy, living in the present. Anxiety. Lack of focus, spaciness. Can have a lack of direction.
Fears of death, solitude, darkness, thunderstorms. Better from company, extroverted. Sympathetic, tends to
nurse others.
Sensitive to effects of storms, especially thunderstorms. Headache with a thunderstorm. Blindness from
lightning stroke. Sleep relieves most symptoms. Refreshed from naps. Exertion, physical or mental, aggravates
complaints. Better from open air, warm wraps.
Heart palpitations and irregularities of the heart. Palpitations aggravated by lying on the left side. Peripheral
numbness, circulatory problems, Raynaud's disease. Stroke. Transient ischemic attacks. Panic attacks
associated with blood sugar and the heart.
Pulmonary hemorrhage and congestion. Nosebleeds, hemophiliacs. Hemorrhagic diathesis. Small wounds
bleed profusely. Bright red blood. Blood-streaked discharges. Blood-streaked or rusty sputa, tasting salty.
Acute pernicious anemia and bone cancer. Cancers that bleed profusely and persistently, bright-colored blood.
Tendency to bruising.
Ulcers, bleed easily at the slightest touch. Open cancers or fungus hematodes. “Large ulcers surrounded by
smaller ones.” Ulcers affecting the nails. Ulcers, psoriasis, lichen, eczema, blood boils, purpura. Eruptions.
Exanthema with pustules like smallpox.
Inflammation and eruptions around joints, particularly the hip and knee. Fistulae with callous edges from
glands. The left side of the lower jaw is more affected than the right. Decay and exostoses of spine (Calc-f.).
Rheumatism with great stiffness of the joints, more stiffness than pain. Paralytic rheumatism from exposure to
rain. Stiffness of old people. A drawing, tearing, tight feeling, in the girdle, pain of spinal affections, tightness
of skin of face and forehead.
“Splitting headache caused by cough.” Headache and other sufferings from grief. Hot vertex after grief. Shocks
in occiput, coldness in cerebellum, congestion of brain seeming to rise from spine into head. Neuralgic pain.
Impending paralysis. Attacks induced by mental exertion, worry, washing clothes and are worse by music,
noises, strong odors.
Cataract and glaucoma. Pustule on cornea. Burning pains. Retinal hemorrhage. Retinitis albuminuria from
suppressed menses. Halo around candle. Colors appear black before the eyes. Sees green. Letters appear
red while reading. As if a gray veil is over everything. Blindness after typhoid, sexual excess, loss of fluids, or
lightning. Twitching of eyelids. Suffocative pains in upper part of chest with constriction of larynx and
engorgement of lungs. Bronchial catarrh. Cough causes tearing pain under sternum as if something was being
torn loose. Mucus rales, panting andlaboredbreathing. Emphysema. Asthma after the cough.
Pneumonias. Indicated when the morbid action becomes localized in the right lung, particularly the lower lobe.
Hard, dry cough, rusty sputa, worse at twilight and until midnight. Worse lying on left side, better lying on right
side.
Tendency tocolds and sore throats. Tuberculosis florida. “Stomach” or “liver” cough. Cough comes on after
eating and starts from a tickling in pit of stomach. Cough worse when strangers enter the room, or from strong
odors.
Sinking, faint feeling in the abdominal cavity, head, chest and stomach. Violent tearing pains in esophagus,
chest, stomach. Bloating of abdomen, distended, sore, sensitive to touch. Hemorrhages from all offices.
Stomach ulceration with severe burning pains, hemorrhage, and persistent vomiting.
Tenderness of the liver. Disorganization of the liver and blood with jaundice, hemorrhages. Hepatitis. Acute
fatty degeneration of the liver and fatty degeneration of pancreas with gastric symptoms and oily stools. Fatty
and amyloid degeneration of the kidneys. Degeneration with engorgement of the lungs, particularly the right
lung.
Hunger with great weakness and faintness. Hungry soon aftera meal,hungry during the night. Hypoglycemia.
Ice cream ameliorates the gastric pains. Desires cold milk, which agrees. Wants to suck ice (Med.). Longing
for acids and spicy things, desires salt things (Nat-m.). Antidotes the effects from excess of salt in diet.
Desire for cold foods and preference for cold meat, may be vomited as soon as it becomes warm. Burning
thirst for cold water, which relieves, but as soon as it becomes warm in the stomach it is vomited.
Regurgitation of ingesta in mouthfuls. The sight of water causes vomiting during pregnancy. Nausea on putting
 hands into
Phosphorus warm water. Sneezing and coryza from putting hands in water. Vomiting and diarrhea. Typhoid.
Diabetes. Diabetic peripheral neuropathies.
Rectal, bladder, and uterine tenesmus. Stool voided with great difficulty and straining. Stools are long, tough
and hard, like a dog's. Stools offensive, involuntary, the anus appearing to remain open. Bloody stool, blood-
streaked stool, stool like shreddy membranes.
Diarrhea as soon as anything enters the rectum. Profuse diarrhea pouring away as from a hydrant. Watery
diarrhea with sago-like particles. Painless, involuntary stool during cholera, in the morning, of old people.
Burning in the anus, notably stitches shooting up rectum. Hemorrhoids.
Menses are profuse and long lasting. Vicarious menstruation in the form of hemoptysis, nosebleed or
hematuria. Leu- corrhea which causes blisters. Left ovarian pain (Thuj., Coloc.).
Burning, shooting, and cramping pains in the breasts. Breast abscess and fistula. Erysipelatous appearance,
red streaks starting from opening, thin, ichorous discharge. Morning sickness with nausea and burning.
Aversion to sex. Nymphomania.
Frequent erections in men and sexual thoughts entirely beyond the patient's control. Strong sexual desire,
constant wish for sex. Erections in spite of efforts to control passion in young men. Impotence from over-
indulgence or from celibacy.
A man, 48 inhaled the vapor of burning Phos. Among his symptoms was a sensation as if something twitched
under his skin or was creeping between skin and flesh. Twitching of single bundles of tissues at different times
like playing on a piano. Tongue often refused to move when speaking so that he stammered.
E. R. Heath had some decidedly “phosphorescent” symptoms. Darting, cutting pains, causing much distress,
starting from different points and flashing over the whole abdomen. He imagined an aurora borealis and
seemed to distinctly hear voices shouting “Beautiful, oh ! was not that splendid?” as the pains became more
severe and lasting.
He sprang from the bed and tried to collect his thoughts, had numbness all over with sensation of myriads of
needles slightly pricking him. Throat dry and parched, a flame seemed to pass through him. Feet seemed
glued to the floor.
With great difficulty he reached the vessel and as soon as the bowels began to act the pains changed to
cramps. Stools were like scrapings of intestines. They were almost constant, with tenesmus, for over two
hours. He lay down in bed after, weak, sore, and almost helpless.
Clarke reported a case of spinal decay with paralytic symptoms in a woman aged 67. She had a history of a
strained back thirty-five years before, and of lumbago and sciatica five years before he saw her. Pains in the
scapula and chest, she could not walk unless supported about the waist. She was cured with Phos. 1,000c,
the curvature remained, although the decay and paralysis were removed. The Phos. caused dryness of her
mouth, lips and throat.
W. A. Nicholas reported the case of T. B., 51, whom he saw after a four months' illness. The case began with
congestion of the brain on the sudden death of his wife and was followed by bronchitis. During all this time he
was heavily drugged. A rather long walk brought on a severe attack of angina pectoris. Bell, lx gave much
relief. Nicholas noticed the patient at times put his hand to the back of his neck. Phos. 1c relieved entirely.
Hansen cured a case of purpura in a girl of 10. The disease began with loss of appetite and pains in the
stomach, but as soon as the purpura spots appeared, the pains ceased and the appetite returned. The inner
thighs were affected. Phos. 2c cured.
Walker cured with Phos. 6c a large exostosis of the femur which had been pronounced as osteosarcoma by
old-school authorities.
In a case of rheumatism in an old woman who had a waxy pallor. Cooper gave Phos. and set free all the joints.
Dr. Mills related a typical case of thunderstorm effect. Mrs. F., tall, thin, dark of mild and gentle disposition,
was seen by the doctor during a thunderstorm. He found
her sitting on the stairs, trembling, cold, and bathed in cold, clammy sweat, full of nervous dread and almost
beside herself. One dose of Phos. 100,000c cured. Some weeks later she witnessed a storm with complete
unconcern.
RELATIONS - Antidote to: Phos. poisoning: Turpentine with which it forms an insoluble mass. Kali-perm.
Compare: (1) Tub. follows Phos. well and complements its action. (2) Phos-h. - crumbling of teeth,
hyperesthesia, locomotor ataxia. (3) Amph. - right jaw swollen and painful. (4) Thymol - typical sexual
neurasthenia, irritable stomach, aching throughout lumbar region, worse mental and physical exertion. (5)
Calc., Chin., Ant-t., Sep., Lyc., Sulph. (6) For pneumonia. Pneu. Pneumonia and paralytic phenomena, pleuritic
pain and pain in ilio-cecal region (Cartier). Complementary: Ars., All-c., Lyc., Sil., Nux- v. Phos. antidotes the
nausea and vomiting of chloroform and ether. Sanguis. 30c - Leech - persistent hemorrhages, effects of use
 of leeches. Phos-pchl. - great soreness of mucus membrane of eyes and nose, throat and chest sore.
Incompatible: Caust.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.
