name: Piper Augustifolia
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY-pip-a.(mati.).PipeR augustifolia. Matico. Artanthe. N. O. Piperaceae. Tincture of the leaves.
Historical dose: Topically a hemostatic. Tincture and all potencies.
HOMEOPATHIC - Pip-a. is an aromatic, stimulant and urinary tonic. Has been used in gonorrhea, hemorrhage
from lungs, catarrhal condition of genitor-urinary organs and gastro-intestinal tract. Chronic mucus discharges,
such as leucorrhea, gleet and catarrh. Difficult, dry, deep, winter cough. Hemorrhages. Locally usedforcuts,
wounds and indolent ulcers.
REFERENCES - Boericke.
 ***PIPER METHYSTICUM
(Kava-kava)
PHARMACY - pip-m. Piper methysticum. Kava-kava. Kawa. Macropiper methysticum. N. O. Piperaceae.
Tincture of fresh root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Anus, prolapsed. Arthritis deformans. Brachialgia. Brain-fag. Catalepsy. Chordee.
Colic. Cystitis. Dysuria. Eczema. Emaciation. Gonorrhea. Headache. Ichthyosis. Insomnia. Intoxication.
Leprosy. Liver, disorders. Neuralgias. Neurasthenia. Orchitis. Paraplegia. Prostate, disorders. Rheumatism.
Skin, disorders. Toothaches. Urethritis. Uric acid, excess.
HERBAL - Piper methysticum furnishes the root called Kava in Polynesia. The natives use it as astimulant,
either chewing the root or drinking a beverage made of it before undertaking any important business or religious
rites.
Kava causes exaltation of the mind, lively and inclined to work. Faculties sharpened, capable of working more
without fatigue or brain-fag. From increased doses, there is intoxication of a sorrowful, silent and sleepy
character, different from that produced by alcohol.
Excessive indulgence in it produces a skin disease like leprosy, calledTahiti Arevareva. Lutz described the
disease as observed amongst natives of the Sandwich Islands,
“The skin, par marked ichthyosis, associated with a certain degree of atrophy, such as is observed in senile
skin. There is an absence of inflammatory symptoms.”
HOMEOPATHIC - Kava-Kava is an intoxicant which produces liveliness and inclination to do more work
without fatigue. Silent and drowsy intoxication, with incoherent dreams, loss of muscular power.
Nervous system strung up to its highest tension. Trembling. Uneasiness and weakness during day with timidity
and apprehension. Weakness in morning, better rising and moving around. Want of tone and life in all functions
towards night.
Dizziness and vertigo, better on closing eyes. Full forehead, “solid with pain,” shifting to occiput and cervical
spine, where it became a compression, extending as a constricting sensation to stomach and chest. Marked
and persistent sensation of enlargement of head.
All the symptoms, especially pains are temporarily better by diverting attention, changing position or topic.
Arthritis deformans. Emaciation and decrepitude. Colic with flatulence. Urinary and skin symptoms have
been verified.
MIND - Mental symptoms, excitement or depression, and the headache, better by diversion of mind.
Amelioration of pains by diverting the attention. Restless desire to change position. Intoxication with
fantastic ideas and desire to skip about, although he cannot for a moment hold himself on his legs.
Exaltation of mind. Very sensitive. Mental tension. Lively and inclined to work. Faculties sharpened, capable
of working more without fatigue or brain-fag. Lazy and drowsy. Want of vigor, timid, apprehensive.
Back - Pain in back only felt on pressure.
Soreness about second dorsal vertebra.
Chest - Constriction of chest and stomach, extending from base of brain. Heaviness behind upper part of
sternum, as from wind that cannot be belched out.
Ears - Singular pressure in lobules of pinna of left ear.
Eyes - Conjunctivae red. Pain along right optic nerve when reading. Pain deep in left eye as if ball would be
pressed out. Dizzy blindness when dressing
Face - Pressure outward in face at 7 p.m.
Food - Appetite is formidable, but not able to eat much.
Head - Brain tired in morning on waking, better getting on feet. Heaviness of head. Feeling as though the head
were enlarged even to bursting. Headache with pressure in upper part of orbits with sleepiness.
Kidneys - Chordee. Cystitis. Burning in urethra during urination, gonorrhea and gleet. Urine increased, scanty
in morning. Urine nearly neutral, hot and over-acid at night.
Limbs - Numbness of the lower limbs. Weakness, as if unable to stand. Heaviness of legs when walking.
Sticking in left knee at 4 p.m. when walking. Pain in right arm. Numbness of right elbow. Pain in right wrist,
worse writing. Weakness of left hand. Hands feel paralyzed. Pain in the thumb joint.
Male - Shooting in penis. Pain in right testicle. Erection in afternoon, at night after an emission. Emission early
in morning without dreams. Amorousness.
Modalities - Better moving, open air. Better by turning mind to another topic, changing position. Vertigo better
closing eyes. Worse reading and thinking. Worse in open air, motion, walking. Going down stairs causes
symptoms to rush up. Sour belchings worse before meals. Burning in urethra worse urinating.
Mouth - Burning in whole mouth followed by numbness. Dryness of mouth on waking from afternoon nap with
 sweat (on a hot day). Salivation. Taste is nauseous, sweet, then piquant and sharp, pappy, everything
tasteless, lost to food, but ravenous haste in eating. Taste and relish to food not as usual, at noon, but appetite
usually good.
Rectum - Urging all day, every evening. Continuous desire, next day forced a large stool, which caused
prolapsed anus. Constipation, hard, large, light-colored. Stool difficult, large, soft. Pain after first stool. Burning
in rectum.
Skin - Dryness, especially where it is thick, as on hands and feet with scales, cracks and ulcers. Ichthyosis.
Leprosy. Scaly. Fall of scales leaves white spots, which often ulcerate.
Sleep - Difficult falling asleep. Sleepless. Sleepiness at 10 p.m., soon afterwards irresistible liveliness and
wakefulness. Restless sleep last part of night. Stupid sleep. Heavy sleep with disturbing but unremembered
dreams. Dreams are curious, nonsensical, wild, amorous of traveling by rail, active, vivid, last part of night of
a fire, heard the engines and firemen.
Stomach - Warmth in stomach. Crampy pain, better pressure against edge of table. Sour belchings, worse an
hour before meals.
Teeth - Teeth deep yellow. Teeth sensitive to cold water, cold air, brushing,
Tongue - Tongue feels as if covered with velvet or fur at night. Burning on tongue.
Vertigo - From 5 to 9 p.m. very dizzy, swimming sensation and faintness. Vertigo in morning in bed with frontal
pressure.
COMMENTS - W. N. Griswold proved the third and second dilutions and developed a large number of nervous,
mental and brain symptoms, among which are some which have proved to be keynotes. The mental symptoms
of Pip-m. or the “Intoxicating Pepper” are the most interesting feature of the drug's action.
Feeling of buoyancy, as if every nerve was strung up to the highest pitch, feels he can work without fatigue,
quickly followed by a feeling of tired brain and over-sensitiveness to all external impression.
Griswold cured a case having burning in chest, better by diverting mind, and three cases having “Agonizing
pain with tossing, twisting and writhing, patient driven irresistibly to change position, which generally gives little
or no better.” These cures were with the lx or tinctures.
Skinner gave fractional doses of tincture in water to a highly excitable young girl. She had severe toothache
and earache and had worn out her family by the incessant day and night attendance she required.
The pains were dragging, heavy, worse at night in bed and after or when eating,
forgets all about her pains if amused with anything, but directly she is tired of it she exclaims ‘Oh. my tooth or
ear!' ”
She had “Agonizing pain with tossing, twisting and writhing, irresistibly driven to change position.” The patient
slept well that night the first time for a fortnight and had no more pain. The remaining swelling was removed
by Puls. 200c.
Skinner also reported the case of Miss R., 20, who had a toothache in a decayed molar, better if attention is
diverted by anything, is diverted by anything sufficiently exciting. When pain is at all violent she has no rest in
any position, must keep continually changing it. Pip-m. 500c (F. C.) was given and there was relief very soon
after the first dose. A few doses completely removed the pain.
Farrington said convulsions simulating catalepsy are produced. Cerna, as a result of his investigations, found
Pip-m. a general and local anesthetic. It diminishes reflex action by its action on the cord and kills by paralyzing
respiration.
Cerna illustrated its relationship to Cub. by citing cases of gonorrhea, acute and chronic cystitis, gleet,
prostatorrhea, vaginitis, cured with it.
RELATIONS-Antidoted by: Puls, and Rhus-t. (partially). Compare: ( 1 ) Cub., Pip-n., Mati. (2) Is better by
diverting mind, Ox-ac. (3) better by motion, Rhus-t. (4) Feeling of buoyancy, Coff. (but with Coff. the reverse
condition of brain-fatigue does not quickly follow).
(5)   Neurasthenia, Pic-ac., Arg-n., Aven. (6) Unbearable pains, Coff., Aeon., Cham. (7) Chaul. (8) Bix.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak

name: Piper Nigrum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - pip-n. Piper nigrum. Black pepper. N. O. Piperaceae. Trituration or tincture of dried fruits,
peppercorns. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Anus, fissure. Blenorrhagia. Breasts, swelling, eruption. Constipation. Cough. Diarrhea. Dysuria.
Flatulence. Headache. Hemorrhoids. Menses, irregular, scanty. Milk, excessive flow. Neuralgia. Obesity.
Priapism. Speech, difficult. Teeth, decay. Tongue, eruption, heavy. Toothache. Tympanites. Uterus, cramps.
Worms.
 HERBAL - The Treasury of Botany noted that the peppers are tropical climbing shrubs. Pip. nigrum, yields the
pepperof commerce. When ripe, the fruit is red. Black pepper is gathered before it is fully ripe and spread on
mats in the sun, when it loses it red color and becomes black and shriveled. White pepper is the same fruit
freed from its outer skin by maceration in water and subsequent rubbing.
HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of the Pip- n. proving are Houat's. The only additional symptom is one
recorded by Berridge as having occurred in a woman on two occasions from taking a large quantity of pepper:
“Feeling as if temples and mal ar bones were pressed in, worse on left side.” Sensation of burning and pressure
everywhere.
Clarke can confirm the full, heavy headache of Houat's provings by personal experience. He gets the headache
whenever he takes food highly peppered and he knows of others who do the same.
MIND - Sad, apprehensive. Unable to concentrate, starts at any noise. Hot-headed, irascible and often gay.
Amorousness with hypochondriasis. Fear of being poisoned.
Abdomen - Disposition of abdomen to obesity. Abdomen swollen, hard, burning. Inflammation of intestines
with great thirst. Tympanites. Borborygmi. Colic and cramps, sensation as intestines would burst. Flatulence.
Back - Burning in loins and kidneys with contractive movements.
Breasts - Great flow of milk.
Chest - Dyspnea, cough with pain in chest in spots, feels as if spitting blood.
Ears - Crusty ulcers in concha of ears.
Eyes - Bursting aching in eyeballs. Eyes inflamed and burning. Lachrymation and photophobia. Lids ulcerated
and bleared. Dim sight and vertigo with headache, nausea and vomiting.
Face - Red burning face. Lips dry and cracked.
Female - Menses difficult, retarded, capricious, irregular. Menses with colic and black blood. Ovaries and
uterus congested with pricking and sharp pains. Burning and distending pains in uterus.
Food - Desire for coarse and extravagant food. Constant, unquenchable thirst.
Head - Heavy headache, as if temples were pressed in, pressure in nasal and facial bones.
Heart - Palpitations, cardiac pain, slow, intermittent pulse.
Kidneys - Bladder feels full, swollen, frequent inclination without success. Burning in bladder and urethra.
Difficult urination. Priapism.
Male - Inflammation and swelling of penis with priapism and burning pains. Burning, pricking, excoriating pains
in glans.
Modalities - Worse from change of temperature, damp weather, evening. Worse by motion.
Mouth - Burning dryness of mouth and throat. Heat and dryness of palate and tongue, as if burned.
Limbs - Inflammation and swelling of joints.
Lungs - Dyspnea and attacks of suffocation. Severe coughing, especially in evening and when going to sleep.
Cough is violent, occasionally spitting of blood, croupy, hollow.
Nose - Nose itches, sneezing, nosebleed.
Rectum - Inflammation of rectum, anus swollen and burning. Diarrhea. Fear to go to stool on account of the
difficulty and pain. Fissures in the anus. Long-lasting constipation, then involuntary, thin stools. Worms. Large
flowing hemorrhoids.
Sensations - Burning sensation. Pressure in nasal bones in temples and facial bones. Sensation of a foreign,
round body rising to stomach. Contraction of uterus and sensation as if something about to enter it.
Skin - Large pustules on face, leaving scars. Very tender skin. Itching, by scratching, heat and motion. Eczema
on lips. Crusty ulcers in ears.
Sleep - Irresistible drowsiness. Lethargic sleep. Nightmares. Wakens at night without being able to sleep
again.
Stomach - Full feeling. Gastric discomfort. Sensation of heat and dryness in stomach. Cramps and drawing
in stomach. Vomiting with great exertion, it seemed as if stomach itself would be vomited.
Teeth - Tooth decays. Violent toothache, worse in warmth and evening.
Temperature - Dryness and coldness of skin, heat with biting dryness. Heat in forehead with heaviness of
head and vertigo. Cold sweat with great heat through whole body. Sweat which seems to corrode the skin.
Throat - Sore, feels raw, burns. Burning pain in tonsils. Constant accumulation of mucus in throat and
expectoration. Paralysis of muscles of throat, can cry but not articulate intelligibly.
Tongue - Eruption of little vesicles on margin of tongue. Painful, heavy tongue, impeded speech. Whitish
coating on middle of tongue.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Piper-m. (2) Cub., also mental, genito-urinary, skin and general symptoms.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
 ***PIPERAZINUM
(Piperazidine)
PHARMACY - pipe. Piperazinum. Piperazidine. Diethylen-diamine. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Glaucoma. Gout. Lead paralysis. Kidney, colic.
HOMEOPATHIC - Pipe, is a synthetic product which was intended to replace Spermin and was named
Dispermine. It was found, however
to be a different body both in chemical and physiological properties.
It occurs in well-defined, colorless, acicular crystals (Helbing) or in lustrous tables (J. Gordon), is deliquescent
and mostly soluble in water.
It readily unites with uric acid, forming a very soluble compound (urate of piperazine). When taken by the mouth
it is not entirely oxidized, as part is discoverable unchanged in the urine.
John Gordon experimented with Pipe, and found that a 1 percent solution in normal urine at body temperature
dissolved to a large extent a fragment of uric acid calculus and converted undissolved portions to a granular
and pulpy condition. The amount of urea is increased in the urine of those taking it.
J. R. Hamilton of Hawick reported success in treating kidney colic with Pipe, and Walter of Odessa, cleared
up two cases of glaucoma, giving one grain daily in carbonated water, all the symptoms disappearing within
three weeks.
According to Cooper, a patient, after a teaspoonful dose of an effervescing preparation of Pipe., complained
that he was seized with a bad attack of acute gout, that was quite unexpected.
Helbing said it has been used with success in mental diseases and in a case of lead paralysis with “very
remarkable results.”
RELATIONS - Compare: Phlor., Hydrang., Urt-u.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Piscidia Erythrina
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - pise. Piscidia erythrina. Jamaica dogwood. White dogwood. N. O. Leguminosae.
Papilionoideae. Tincture of root bark obtained when the plant is in flower, before leaf. Historical dose: Tincture
and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Asthma. Bronchitis. Coughs. Fever. Insomnia. Neuralgias. Pains. Spasm. Sweat, profuse. Teeth,
decay. Toothaches. Tuberculosis.
HERBAL - This small tree has unequally pinnate leaves and entire, oval leaflets. The flowers are in lateral
clusters, and appear in profusion before the leaves. The bark of the tree is very astringent, and acts as a
narcotic poison. When Pise, is chewed, there is an unpleasant acrimony in mouth like thatof Mez.
Locally the tincture is used for toothaches in decayed teeth. Piscidia is sedative, hypnotic and narcotic. A
good nerve sedative and pain killer. The pounded leaves and young branches of Piscidia and some allied
species are used like cocculus, for poisoning fish hence the name Piscidia (Piscis-caedere).
HOMEOPATHIC - Excessive restlessness and insomnia. Insomnia due to pain, worry or nervous
excitement, it usually produces a quiet, deep sleep. Dysmenorrhea pains. Pains of irregular menstruation,
regulates the flow. Neuralgias, ovarian or uterine. Neuralgic and spasmodic affections. Tetanus.
Toothaches in decayed teeth. Spasmodic coughs, especially cough of phthisis. Bronchial catarrhs,
bronchitis. Asthma, nervous cough.
Fevers with a violent sensation of heat generally increasing in intensity, the sensation of burning gradually
extended to the surface and a profuse diaphoresis burst out from every pore.
COMMENTS - The experiment recorded in Allen is by W. Hamilton, who took a drachm of the Pise, tincture in
water for toothache and went off to sleep with great suddenness. Profound sleep, he remained motionless the
whole night, when he awoke, twelve hours later, he was still holding the glass and uncorked vial from which
he had taken the dose.
When he returned to consciousness, he was free from every pain or ache and without any of the unpleasant
sensations which invariably succeed an overdose of opium.
RELATIONS - Compare: Coff. and Op.
REFERENCES - Allen. Boericke. Clarke.

name: Pituitaria Glandula
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - pitu-gl. Pituitaria glándula. Pituitary gland. Hypophysis. The tincture comes from the gland.
 Sarcode. Prepared by maceration in a mixture of water and alcoholglycerine from the whole pituitary gland.
Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Angina pectoris. Anuria. Asthma. Backache. Bedwetting. Blood, clots. Breast,
disorders. Cardiac, neurosis. Colitis. Coryza. Delayed, growth. Dyspnea. Enterocolitis. Hair, loss. Headache.
Hypertension. Incontinence. Nephritis. Pharyngitis. Prostatitis. Recto-colitis. Septicemia. Stroke. Tachycardia.
Tonsillitis. Valvular disease. Vertigo. Vitiligo.
HOMEOPATHIC - The proving was established by the Hering Proving Committee in 1935 on five provers,
using the potency 12x.
George Fuller noted that Pitu-gl. exercises a superior control over the growth and development of the sexual
organs, stimulates muscular activity and overcomes uterine inertia. Uterine inertia in second stage of labor
where os is fully dilated.
Affects the female glands. Painful menses with disturbed cycle. Cervical pains. A vasoconstrictor and
parturient, used chiefly for its action on the uterus either to aid in childbirth or to check bleeding after delivery.
Cerebral hemorrhage. It will check hemorrhage and aid absorption of clots. High blood pressure. Chronic
nephritis, prostatitis. Bedwetting. Incontinence when the patient loses a few drops.
The action of this remedy has a clear antispasmodic tendency, especially affecting the vessels in the head.
Vertigo, difficult mental concentration, confusion and fullness deep in frontal region. Congestive headaches.
Pigmentation disorders and loss of hair.
MIND - Mental weakness. Difficult concentration. Nocturnal anxiety and anguish. Anxiety, aggravated at
nightfall. Weeping, the patient cries involuntarily and even without noticing.
Obsessive ideas linked to the uro-genital area; fear of impotence, of passing urine. Obsession of ideas,
especially of depressive, or of erotic, of impotence.
Abdomen - Enterocolitis. Recto-colitis.
Spasmodic colon infection. Inflammation of the gallbladder.
Back - Pains in the nape of the neck, spreading to the occiput and shoulders. Neck ache. Backache.
Breasts - Breasts hypertrophy or atrophy. Amenorrhea with breast atrophy.
Chest - Growth of hair on chest.
Constitutions - Phosphoric, flouric types, tubercular poisoning or syphilitic, with obsessions or depressive
complaints.
Ears - Earache. Buzzing. Deafness in the left ear.
Eyes - Mydriasis. Pupils very dilated. Weeping, the patient cries involuntarily and even without noticing. Styes,
especially on the left. Conjunctivitis. Blepharitis.
Female - Amenorrhea with breast atrophy. Menses late, cycle longer than 30 days. Menses scanty. Menses
with pain during the day. Menses very painful, especially the day before and the day after the start.
Dysmenorrhea. Uterine pains from muscular contraction. Painful uterine contractions during childbirth. Difficult
childbirth.
Food - Desires cold drinks.
Head - Congestive headache. Pulsating, throbbing headaches, related to hypertension. Headaches, starting
at the occiput and spreading towards the base, cervical column and shoulders. Headaches, aggravated by
heat, confined space, at the end of the day. Alopecia of the scalp, which is very dry.
Heart - Feeling of heaviness in the precordial region, aggravated by the slightest movement. The patient can
“feel his heart.” Sensation of heart constriction, aggravated by the slightest exertion. Arterial hypertension with
the feeling of pounding arteries in the temples and carotid arteries. Coronary arthritis. Angina pectoris. Valvular
disease. Cardiac neurosis. Arrhythmia. Tachycardia. Hypertension. Septicemia.
Kidneys - Nephritis. Anuria. Incontinence of urine, worse in the evening. Incontinence of urine in women with
fibromatous uterus, the patient loses a few drops of urine on rising. Presence of albumin in the urine.
Lungs - Asthma. Asthmatic dyspnea, accompanied by intestinal and rectal spasms. Dyspnea from anguish.
Dyspnea with abundant, watery, salty-tasting sputum, sensation of constriction in the thoracic cage. Laryngitis.
Tracheitis and bronchitis.
Modalities - Better from fresh air, open air. Worse from the heat, in a closed room, at the end of the day.
Mouth - Excessive salivation. Saliva tastes salty.
Nose - Coryza.
Rectum - Rectal tenesmus, the patient wants to pass stools, but cannot. Diarrhea with painful intestinal
spasms. Hemorrhaging recto-colitis. Proctitis.
Skin - Skin cold, discolored or strongly pigmented. Alternating white and dark patches. Vitiligo. Skin is swollen,
edematous, itching. Eruptions of aurticaria type. Skin very dry, scaly.
Stomach - Nausea and post-prandial distention, worse after the evening meal.
 Throat - Tonsillitis. Pharyngitis.
Vertigo - Vertigo when not moving body or head.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ign. - Cortical and visceral rhythm disorders, characterized by mobihty instability
and paradoxical, contradictory state of symptoms. (2) Syph. - Changing moods, forgets proper nouns,
obsessions, all aggravated at night. (3) Thuj. - Fixed ideas, sad, varicosities in the nostrils, skin sticky.
REFERENCES - Boericke.

name: Pituitaria Gland Anterior
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - pitu-a. Pituitaria glándula anterior. Anterior lobe of pituitary gland. Hypophysinum anterioris.
Adenohypophysis. Remedy made from the pituitary glands of sheep. Sarcode. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne. Backache. Breast, nodules. Constipation. Coryza. Dermatitis. Diarrhea. Dyspnea.
Headache. Hemorrhoids. Hormonal, disorders. Insomnia. Nausea. Obesity. Ovarian, pain. Photophobia.
Premenstrual syndrome. Sinusitis. Tonsillitis. Vertigo. Vitiligo. Vomiting. Warts.
HOMEOPATHIC - The homeopathic indications are based upon 5 years of clinical observations by Dr. David
Flores Toledo of Mexico, who named the remedy Hypo- physinum anterioris.
He wrote, in The Journal of the American Institute of Homeopathy, September, 1987, “Hypophysinum anterioris
may well become one of the great polychrests. but it needs a careful proving. Numerous cases of acne, obesity,
one of sterility, headaches related to menses, asthma, hemorrhoids, breast nodules, fungal infections of the
nails, recurrent tonsillitis, vitiligo, and warts have been resolved with this medicine.”
Hormonal, disorders. Sexual desire diminished, enjoyment absent (Sep.). Premenstrual syndrome. Hushes
of heat in young girls. Weakness and cold perspiration on rising. Obesity. Allergy, metal dermatitis (Morg-g.).
Worse before menses, headache, coryza, pallor of face, nausea, vomiting, distended abdomen, yellow
leucorrhea, pain in ovaries, pain in uterus, difficult respiration, painful swollen breasts, low backache,
sleeplessness. Better after menses (Zinc-p.).
MIND - Aversion to everything, to friends, husband. Dislike of oneself. Easily depressed and avoids her friends.
Fear to be alone. Anticipatory diarrhea before a date or engagement (Arg-n.).
Emotionally, worse before menses, fearfulness, irritability, sadness. Discouraged during menses.
Causeless weeping. Weeping at trifles. Desire to weep, but finds it difficult. Ailments from disappointed love.
Sexual desire diminished, enjoyment absent (Sep.).
Irritability before and during menses. Irritability at trifles. Anger during ovulation. Anger in morning on waking.
Anger from
Pituitaria glándula anterior contradiction.
Desire to strike. Screaming and crying from anger.
Abdomen - Distension, causing to bend double. Rumbling after eating, after milk. Flatulence, all food seems
to turn to gas. Flatulence from fruit, vegetables. Pain after eating, after milk. Pain before and during menses.
Back - Acne, on back and cervical region. Low backache before menses. Pain in sacral region, coccyx, during
menses.
Bladder - Involuntary urination when rising from a seat.
Breasts - Painful, swollen breasts before menses. Painful nodules in breasts.
Chest - Palpitations while lying on back. Eruptions, confluent acne. Perspiration in axilla during menses.
Eyes - Redness of eyes. Photophobia. Nausea preceded or attended by visual disturbances.
Face - Brown spots on face. Pale discoloration about eyes (Ptel.). Sensation as if face were burnt. Acne
before menses. Acne on forehead during menses. Cold perspiration on face before or at beginning of menses.
Female - Hormonal disorders. Premenstrual syndrome. Worse before menses, headache, coryza, pallor of
face, nausea, vomiting, distended abdomen, yellow leucorrhea, pain in ovaries, pain in uterus, difficult
respiration, painful swollen breasts, low backache, sleeplessness. Pain in ovaries before menses, worse
stepping. Menses brown at onset, clotted. Menses coagulated during first day and last days. Menses irregular,
protracted with clots. Lack of vital heat during menses. Offensive leucorrhea like fish brine. Metrorrhagia
between menses. Sexual desire diminished, enjoyment absent (Sep.). Sterility.
Food - Diminished appetite during menses (Mag-c.). Thirst for large quantities. Craving for cakes, sweets and
chocolate. Desires fried potatoes, fruit, solid food. Indigestion from eggs. Worse from milk, seafood, fruit,
vegetables. Worse from fats and rich food (Puls.).
Head - Headache before or at beginning of menses. Headache in temples at beginning of menses. Headache
worse light, noise, sun, warm room. Headache due to contact lenses. Perspiration on scalp at night.
Limbs - Discoloration, white, depigmen- tated burning spots on upper limbs, worse sun. Itching eruptions on
upper limbs, worse summer. Nails do not grow ( Ant-c.). Swelling of thighs before menses.
 Lungs - Asthmatic respiration in morning on waking. Asthma after anger. Asthma better copious expectoration.
Asthma sudden attacks, from change of weather. Difficult respiration and headache. Difficult respiration before
menses (Zinc.).
Mouth - Mapped tongue (Tarax.). Bad taste in mouth before menses.
Nose - Susceptible to sinusitis and obstruction to nose. Obstruction in evening, alternates with pain in root of
nose. Discharge watery with sneezing (Cob-n.). Pain as if nose were extremely dry. Nosebleed during sleep.
Perspiration - Perspiration of hands and feet during menses. Weakness and cold perspiration on rising.
Rectum - Hemorrhoids. Constipation. Bowel movement every two or three days. Stool large, dry and hard.
Stool like sheep dung. Anticipatory diarrhea before a date or engagement. Diarrhea from seafood, milk and
milk products.
Skin - Eruptions, confluent acne. Moist eruptions. Brown spots. Discoloration, itching white spots worse
menses. Vitiligo. Warts pedunculated, soft and small.
Stomach - Empty feeling in stomach without hunger. Nausea preceded or attended by visual disturbances.
Nausea on looking at or smell of fatty food. Nausea better after eating. Pains better after eating a little,
eructations, worse rich food (Puls.).
Throat - Susceptible to tonsillitis. Sore throat. Voice, hoarseness in hot weather. Hoarseness from talking.
Vertigo - Vertigo with tendency to fall, worse before and during menses. Vertigo with trembling. Vertigo as if
intoxicated. Vertigo worse entering dark room from
a lighter place, lying on back, moving head, rising from stooping, better when sitting. Perception of colors (pink,
red, yellow, green).
RELATIONS - Compare: Sep., Puls., Calc., Nat-m.
REFERENCES - Toledo.

name: Pituitaria Gland Posterior
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - pitu-p. Pituitaria glándula posterior. Posterior lobe of pituitary gland. Hypophysis posterium.
Pituitarum poste- rium. Neurohypophysis. Sarcode. From the pituitary glands of sheep. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Angina, pectoris. Arterial, spasms. Diabetes, insipidus. Diarrhea. Eclampsia. Edema. Heart,
attacks. Hemorrhage. Hypertension. Lactation. Moles. Salivation. Urticaria. Uterine, atony.
HOMEOPATHIC - The posterior lobe of pituitary gland releases the oxytocin and antidiuretic hormones.
Removal or injury to the posterior lobe will lead to the symptoms of diabetes insipidus. It acts upon the
parasympathetc center in the hypothalamus. Rate of secretion is controlled from the hypothalamic nucleri.
Antidiuretic hormone, or vasopressin, promotes the reabsorption of water in the kidneys. It raises the blood
pressure and plays a role in the water balance. Also affects the production of breast milk.
It constricts the arteries of the abdominal organs, therefore it use to stop hemorrhage involving abdominal
blood vessels. It may produce cerebral or coronary arterial spasms in large doses.
Oxytocin causes uterine contractions at term. Allopaths used it for the induction or stimulation of the labor. It
has been given to relieve painful breast engorgement. Promotes breast milk release during lactation. Also for
postpartum hemorrhage and uterine atony.
Its action is controlled in pregnancy by progesterone, which diminishes its action, and estrogen, which
increases it.
An enzyme in the blood plasma of pregnant women appears to mediate this control.
Mind, anxiety, Head, pain. Dropsy. Basal metabolism rate increased. Blood pressure elevated. Blood sugar
increased, Bloodvessels constricted. Pulse, slow. Weakness. Abdomen - Distention.
Bladder - Frequent or diminished urination.
Breast - Milk increased.
Chest - Bronchi constriction.
Ears - Noises in ears.
Eyes - Dilated pupils. Lachrymation. Vision loss.
Face - Dark discoloration, during pregnancy.
Female - Contracted uterus. Eclampsia. Weak labor pains.
Head - Headache in occiput, extending downwards. Hair falling out.
Kidney - Suppression of urine.
Lungs - Respiration difficult.
Mouth - Salivation.
Perspiration - Profuse perspiration.
 Rectum - Diarrhea.
Skin - Dry and red. Dark discoloration.
Coldness of skin. Moles. Urticaria. Angioneurotic edema.
Stomach - Nausea.
Urine - Copious urine, with albumin, sugar, increased levels of chloride, potassium and sodium.
COMMENTS - On the basis of these observations, Ghose made use of this sarcode in its 30th potency in
anginal attacks with coronary spasms.
Ghose's first case was that of a middle aged man of 45, suffering from diabetes for two years. He developed
mild anginal attacks after slight exertion and an occasional sense of heaviness in the precordium.
His cardiograph showed coronary disorder and was advised perfect rest. Blood pressure was more or less
normal, pulse was 72 bpm. He was apparently a well-built man and was on a restricted diet for a long time due
to diabetes.
Pitu-p. 30, three times a week, brought great relief of the precordial pain and heaviness; within a fortnight he
could walk about in plain ground without any discomfort.
Ghose also used it in a case of old man, 70, with dyspepsia who used to get severe attacks of pain in the heart
when walking, and particularly when getting up at night to attend calls for urination.
He was relieved with the very first dose of Pitu-p. 30 and could move about freely without any discomfort and
could also attend to his nature's calls at night without feeling any pain.
In a third case. Ghose treated an old man, 65, suffering from coronary thrombosis for about a year and a half.
He had W. R. 10/10 which was treated homeopathically.
He was living without any heart symptom for any other trouble for about a year, when suddenly he felt agonizing
pain in the heart at 11 o'clock at night, with severe dyspnea and moist sounds all over the chest. All these
symptoms pointed to edema of lungs. Pulse was soft and slow. Blood pressure was rather low.
Pitu-p. 30, repeated every half an hour, relieved the pain completely and made the dyspnea tolerable. A
sanguinous expectoration followed for which he was given one dose of Merc-s. 200 and later on a few doses
of Thyr. 200 which stopped the dyspnea completely.
RELATIONS - Compare: Pitu-a., Bell., Nat-m., Phos., Sec., Thyr.
REFERENCES - Ghose.

name: Pix Liquida
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - pix. Pix liquida. Pine tar. Liquid tar. N. O. Confierae. Pinaceae. A product of dry distillation of
various coniferous woods. Tincture. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne. Alopecia. Ardor urine. Bedwetting. Bronchitis. Chest, pain. Desquamation. Diarrhea.
Eczema. Eruptions. Hair, loss. Hands, eruptions. Itching. Psoriasis. Stomach, pain. Tuberculosis. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - In old-school practice, taris known as a “stimulant expectorant” in chronic bronchitis and
tuberculosis, and a stimulant to the skin in psoriasis and scaly eczema.
Tar and its constituents act on various mucus membranes.
Cough. Bronchial irritation after influenza (Kreos., Kali-bi.). Tuberculosis and chronic bronchitis. Pain at the
third left costal cartilage, where it joins the rib, pain of the left bronchus, with an offensive muco-purulent
expectoration the indications for Pix are complete.
Scaly eruptions. Much itching. Alopecia (Fl-ac.). Constant vomiting of black fluid with pain in stomach.
Abdomen - Excessive pain in bowels and loins.
Chest - Suppuration of left lung with pain at third rib. Pain at a spot about the third left costal cartilage,
where it joins the rib. Rales through the lungs and chest.
Kidneys - Ardor urine. Dark-colored urine.
Lungs - Chronic bronchitis. Cough chronic, worse night, expectoration purulent, fever at night. Muco-purulent
sputum, offensive odor and taste.
Rectum - Dark-colored stools.
Skin - Acute eczema. Acne. Desquamation. Skin cracked, itches intolerably, bleeds on scratching, with
sleeplessness. Eruptions on back of hands.
COMMENTS - Buckley recorded severe constitutional effects following the local application of preparations of
tar in skin disorders, including a high fever, black vomit, black stools, dark-colored urine, acute eczema, and
acne.
In the Hom. News., Raynaud noted a case of chronic bronchitis in a merchant, 55. The cough was worse
nights, breath short, copious expectoration, some fever and nightsweats. He had been ill three years and was
growing worse.
 Raynaud prescribed wood tar, a teaspoonful four times a day after meals and at bedtime, which cleared up
most of the symptoms.
Pix. often cures the bedwetting of children.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Terebe., Pin-s., Kreos., Eupi., Petr. (2) In chest pains, Anis, has pain at third right
costal cartilage, occasionally also left, Myric., Ther. (3) Desquamation, Chin-s. (4) Ter., Carb-ac.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Placenta Humana
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - plac. Placenta humana. Human placenta. Sarcode. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Abdominal, pain. Backache. Belching. Constipation. Depression. Diarrhea. Earache. Eyestrain.
Flatulence. Headaches. Night-sweats. Nightmares. Nosebleeds. Palpitations. Photophobia. Sciatica. Styes.
Toothache. Vertigo.
HOMEOPATHIC - Loss of energy. Weariness. Weakness and trembling. Restlessness, worse on waking.
Poor co-ordination with extreme tiredness. Lack of vital heat, sensation of coolness. Averse to warm stuffy
rooms. Worse on right side.
MIND - Apathetic and emotionless. No emotions, very little reaction to things going on. Calmness, almost to
the point of no reaction. Completely passive. Confused, dazed and distant. Confusion of identity. Feel isolated,
lonely, vulnerable and weepy.
Weak memory, forgetful. Concentration difficult with an inability for mental work. Sadness, depressed and
despondent. Nostalgia with flashbacks to past events. Feeling unappreciated, cross and sorry for self.
Irritability and anxiety. Anxiety, as if forgotten something important. Nervous anxiety about being on time.
Anxiety about family, finances, work, the future. Anxiety about health and heart disease. Ailments from bad
news.
Fear, as if something would go wrong. Fear of failure. Fear of closed places, sensation of claustrophobia, fear
of crowds. Fear of rats. Sexual thoughts increased.
Abdomen - Bloated and uncomfortable after eating. Bloated and tender. Lower abdomen sore and bloated,
better from sitting with legs wide apart. Abdominal
pain associated with distension. Rumbling. Painfulflatulence, with abdominal tension. Flatulence with short,
cramping, twisting pains making one double up. Shooting pain right to left, as if in labor when the head is low,
better for lying on abdomen. As if needed to pass stool. Stabbing pain to right of groin.
Arms - Heavy weight sensation in arms with numbness. Lancinating pain in right elbow.
Back - Lower backache. Back pain, worse from sitting and relieved when lying down, worse during menses.
Cervical and lumbar spine stiff. Right sided pains. Dull ache behind and between shoulder blades with twitching
muscles. Sensation of inflammation in back.
Bladder - Pain during urination. Offensive, strong smelling urine.
Breasts - Breasts swollen and tender, before period. Nipples sensitive and tingling, as if milk coming in. Left
nipple itchy with hard cheesy discharge. Shooting pains in right breast going through to back. Stitching pain,
left breast.
Breathing - Difficulty breathing, like old asthma. Accelerated breathing. Breathless on talking. Difficult
breathing on walking up the hill. Hyperventilation.
Chest - Constriction. Tight, suffocative feeling in chest, worse from emotions. Sensation of tight band around
chest, worse at night, extending into throat. Chest feels tight and wheezy. Sensation of a lump in chest,
extending to throat and back, worse swallowing, and pressure, better movement. Chest raw with a feeling of
warmth. Eruptions on the chest.
Cough - Dry cough with nasal discharge.
Ears - Earache, hot, painful, itchy. Aching, throbbing ear pain. Popping of ears with crusty discharge. Ears feel
hot inside with a low pitched hum and bloody discharge. Fleeting, sharp pains in right ear. As if ears had been
in the wind. Sensitive to vibrations.
Eyes - Heavy and aching. Soreness. Stabbing pain, better sleep. As if eyes strained. Must keep blinking. Hard
to open eyes. Puffy on waking. Dark eyelids as if punched,
worse right. Swelling of the eyelids. Styes. Photophobia during the day.
Face - Anxiety felt in face with a mild ache in cheekbones. Pain in right cheekbone. Aching. Dry, sore patch
right side of nose, dry and flaky. Worse left side, after exposure to wind and rain. Left temple, dry skin erupted,
lumpy. Numb patch. Tingly, numb sensation, below left eye. Right side of face numb. Red spots on the face.
Feet - Cold feet. Numbness, loss of sensation in feet. Pins and needles in feet.
Female - Menses delayed. Period heavy. Menstrual pain in back and abdomen. Cramps in uterus. Uterus
 aching and uncomfortable. Dragging period pains, better warmth and pressure. Painless period. Blood bright
red. Shooting pain in ovaries and fallopian tubesfleft side morning, right side evening) during ovulation, with
increased mucus. Right ovarian pain during ovulation. Streaks of blood at ovulation. Herpetic eruptions and
cysts on the labia. Itching. Less vaginal discharge than normal. Small amount of dark purple, sticky mucus.
Libido, strong. High sexual energy. Urge to have sex and reproduce. Strong feeling of pregnancy, as if baby
moving around in belly and sensation of breasts filling up with milk. Sexual when premenstrual.
Food - Lack of thirst. Appetite changeable. Appetite lost but better for eating. Appetite decreased. Reduced
appetite, increased after 6 p.m. When eats, feels sick. Easy satiety with difficulty eating. Snacks rather than a
meal. Snacking with weight loss. Obsession for the amount of food eaten. Increased appetite. Appetite
increased for breakfast and then reduced with weight loss. Desires spicy food, curry, delicate hot foods.
Desires sweets and chocolate. Intolerant to milk. Thirst increased for cold drinks, beer, carbonated drinks
and tea. Strong aversion to nuts. Strong disinterest in vegetables.
Hands - Itchy, flaky, dry, cracking and sore. Heels of palms of both hands hot, itchy, burning. Fingers as ifnumb
with cold. Pins and needles sensations. Right hand stiff and slightly painful, especially fingers.
Head - Headache, worse in the forehead, as if the head were in a vise. Headaches, worse noise, and on
right side. Dull, pressing head pain. Tightness. Pain in right temple. Bursting, stabbing pains. Sensation of
coldness on vertex. Head cold, body hot, better if head is wrapped. Hair greasy.
Hearing - Ears with pulsating blood flow. Noise, as if under water, with distortion of hearing. Sounds distinct,
more able to hear high pitched sounds. Sensitive hearing, particularly to the noise of children. Averse to loud
noises. Competing, conflicting noises irritates.
Heart - Sensation of heart on right side. Heart rushing. Accelerated heartbeat. Heart racing and palpitations
on going to sleep. Palpitations and breathlessness, feeling unable to breathe. Panic and palpitations with a
sensation as if heart would be crushed on sitting.
Hips - Muscular stiffness in left hip. Aching pain in bed.
Knees - Stiff knees, worse in one position too long, worse rising.
Legs - Shaking, weak legs. Legs heavy and uncoordinated. Pain in back of left thigh. Achy legs with pins and
needles in right leg. Muscle spasm in right leg muscles with twitching and jerking. Numbness in right calf.
Limbs - Sciatica. Trembling of limbs, worse sitting. Coldness and itching of the extremities. Burning pain in
the legs.
Lungs - Tightness of lungs in waves. Cough, worse deep breathing. Tickly cough, high pitched with a sensation
of hollowness in right lung. Slightly throaty, croupy cough when chest feels tight. Expectoration thick, stringy
and green.
Mouth - Tingling of the lips. Lips, redness and swelling, peeling and dry. Ulcerated lips with yellow crusts and
scabs, burning, cracking, sensitive to hot food and bleeding. Worse from eating, talking. Lips sensations,
tingling, pins and needles. Crack in top lip. Vesicles on the lips and aphthae in the mouth, on the tongue. Sore
lumps on roof of mouth with numbness. Gum ulceration, gums as though hardened
after a burn. Gums sore, not bleeding.
Neck - Neck feels knotted. Stiffness. Achy and sore, neck aches in waves.
Nose - Sneezing. Clear, watery discharge from right nostril. Clear catarrh. Copious discharge. Right nostril
runny, with clear discharge, while left nostril is blocked. Discharge that drips down the back of the throat. Thick
and green discharge. Lots of green, yellow, sticky mucus, worse at 3 p.m. Nosebleed on washing face. Pain
on bridge of nose, left nostril sore inside, as if scratched. Sensitive smell, worse perfume, people, body odor,
car fumes and dogs.
Perspiration - Night sweats.
Rectum - Sharp shooting pains, worse sitting, as if sword up inside. Sudden urging for stool. Constipated,
better from standing to pass stool. Constipation alternating with diarrhea. Soft and watery stools, alternating
with hard and dry stools. Diarrhea is gushing, watery, urgent, loud and explosive with abdominal pain. Bowel
movements increased to three a day. Burning and sensation of heat during and after stools.
Shoulder - Lancinating pain in right shoulder. Pain at base of left shoulder blade, worse breathing deeply.
Right shoulder blade aches.
Skin - Dry skin. Itching with and without eruptions. Painful warts. Wounds slow to heal.
Sleep - Disturbed and difficult to get to sleep. Deep sleep. Offensive perspiration during sleep. Vivid dreams,
nightmares, frightful and anxious dreams. Dreams of falling, of being pursued, of being raped, of dead people.
Waking after midnight. Restlessness, worse on waking.
Speech - Voice croaky, hoarse. Loss of speech.
Stomach - Nervous trapped energy in stomach. Stomach cramps, worse eating, at night. Cramping pain. Pain
top of stomach, connected to back. Burning stomach pain extending upward into the esophagus. Gas and
 acidity in stomach, worse wine. Heartburn associated with nausea. Belching. Deep, long, loud belch-
ing. A lot of wind. Hiccoughs on and off throughout day. Nausea on eating. Nausea, pill tasted bitter. Nausea
with sudden vomiting around midnight.
Stool - Large painful, dry stool. Loose and windy. Loose, fast stool, smelling of onions or garlic, 8 a.m. and 9
a.m.
Taste - Mouth dry, with a bad taste, and breath smells. Dry, metallic taste on front of tongue. Foul taste. As if
soaking up chemicals, smells and pollution. As if been licking metal.
Teeth - Teeth sensitive. Feel loose, difficult to bite. Bottom right side molar section loose, fell out. Toothaches.
Gums receding.
Throat - Hoarseness. Throat dry and tickly. Sore throat, dryness and rawness, worse on swallowing. Sore
throat with numbness, particularly on left side, worse morning, 3 p.m. Sore throat, on waking, better hot and
cold drinks. Sore, swollen and hot, better cold food. Sensitive to pressure. Stinging throat pain extending down
to the esophagus. Stinging from smoking. Pressing, choking sensation in throat, worse right side with a need
to clear it. Need to clear mucus from the throat. Mucus in back of throat. Loose phlegm at back of throat,
coughs to clear it, worse 10 p.m.
Tongue - Tongue is slightly red, but not sore, with ulcer under the right side. Tongue yellow and furry, big and
rough sensation.
Vertigo - Light headed. Vertigo on motion of head, worse sitting, worse on closing eyes and lying down. Vertigo
with fear of brain tumor.
Vision - Blurred vision. Lack of focus, has to keep blinking. Fuzzy, as if drunk. Heightened vision, more
sensitive.
RELATIONS - Compare: Care., Lyc., Puls., Sep.
REFERENCES - Biggs. Gwillim.

name: Plantago Major
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - plan. Plantago major. Plantain. Ribwort. N. O. Plantaginaceae. Plan, must not to be confounded
with Musa, sometimes called “Plantain,” which belongs to a different class. Tincture of whole fresh plant.
Tincture of the root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Ague. Bedwetting. Bites. Breast inflammation. Burns. Ciliary neuralgia. Chilblains. Depression.
Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Earache. Ears inflammation. Emissions. Erysipelas. Erythema. Frostbite.
Gumboils. Hemorrhoids. Herpes. Injuries. Impotency. Insomnia. Mastitis. Neuralgias. Otorrhea. Polyuria.
Pyorrhea. Rhus poisoning. Snakebites. Spleen, pain. Tetanus. Tobacco, habit. Toothaches. Urination,
delayed. Urticaria. Vaccinations. Worms. Wounds.
HERBAL - Plantago has a reputation in herbal medicine from remote antiquity, including for use in intermittent
fevers. In 1558 the Herbal of Dodoens commended the juice of leaves or roots for “toothache and bleeding
of gums.” External use in toothache in hollow teeth, otorrhea, itching and poison oak. Incised wounds.
John Parkinson, in his Theater of Plants (1640), said that “the root taken fresh out of the ground, washed and
gently scraped with a knife, then put into the ear, cures the toothache like a charm.”
Reutlinger noted that in Switzerland the leaf tissues were frayed out and put into the ear for the same purpose.
If they relieve the pain they “turn black” and have to be removed, if there is no relief the leaves remain green.
Hale summed up the ancient and modern history of Plantago Maj., the weed that furnishes food for cage-birds.
In herbal practice, it is constantly resorted to as an application in all disorders of the skin with irritation, pain
and heat, the bruised leaves being applied to the part.
HOMEOPATHIC - Hale noted that erysipelas, rhus poisoning, erythema, burns, inflammation of the glands,
bruises, incised wounds, animal bites, chilblains, and frostbite had all been relieved by its use.
Plan, has a considerable clinical reputation in the treatment of earache, toothache and bedwetting. Pyorrhea
al veolaris. Gums bleed easily. Sharp pain in the eyes, reflex from decayed teeth or inflammation of middle
ear. Eyeball is very tender to touch.
Affects the nerves, causing neuralgia of ears, teeth, face, of shingles. Pains are sharp, shifting, play between
ear and teeth. Can be applied locally for neuralgia. Inflammation of the breasts. Soreness. Sensation as of a
foreign body between ears in the groins, etc. Inflamed and painful hemorrhoids.
MIND - Great mental prostration, worse by mental exertion, which causes rapid breathing and anxiety. Mind
inactive with dullness. Confusion of thought. Irritable, morose, impatient. Restless mood with dull, stupid feeling
in brain. Despondency. Depression and insomnia of chronic nicotinism. Disgust for tobacco in chewers and
smokers.
Abdomen - Gone sensation. Severe pains in the hypochondrium. Violent griping in upper abdomen. Bowels
 seem cold. Distention with passage of fetid flatus. Colic, flatulent, better by eating.
Back - Cold sweat on sacrum. Pain in sacrum. Throbbing, pulsative pain between scapulae. Neck stiff and
sore. Stiffness of sternocleidomastoid mastoid.
Breasts - Inflammation the breasts. Erysipelas of breasts. Mastitis. Neuralgia of nipples.
Causations - Ill effects of bites, bruises, burns, cuts, punctured wounds, snakebites, stings.
Chest - Oppression, worse reading or talking. Sharp stitches. Orgasms of blood. Muscular drawing.
Ears - Sticking pain in ears. Otalgia with toothache. Neuralgic earache, pain goes from one ear to the other.
Pain in right ear with pains in teeth and face. Pains sharp, twinging. As of a foreign body between ears. Hearing
acute, noise painful. Loud noises go through body. Ringing in ears.
Eyes - Sharp pains in the eyes, reflex from decayed teeth. Dull, heavy ache in left eye. Eyes red, dim, inflamed,
sore. Aching deep in orbit. Lids sore, swollen. As of a hair before eye.
Face - Neuralgia of left side of face, pains shooting and tearing, extending from jaw to ear. Violent bruised,
aching pain, right face. Pain radiating to temples and lower jaw. Drawing in right malar bone. Lips livid, dark,
sickly, rough. Dry, scaly eruption on lower lip. Eruption on forehead.
Food - Appetite poor. Thirst. Causes disgust for tobacco in chewers.
Head - Dull headache. Headache with toothache. Sense of something lying in the head, through one ear to
the other. As if brain turned over. Itching of scalp.
Heart - Heat in précordia when walking in open air. Violentpalpitations on ascending stairs. Pulse strong, full,
intermittent.
Kidneys - Tenderness over region of kidneys on pressure. Irritable bladder with frequent urination. Urethra
tingling with unpleasant itching in meatus. Delayed, dribbling urine. Frequent passage of large quantity of pale
urine, worse night, with thirst. Diabetes. Profuse flow of urine. Nocturnal bedwetting from laxity of sphincter
(Rhus-a., Caust., Bell.).
Limbs - Disposition to stretch. Stinging, dull pains here and there. Numbness and trembling legs. Great pain
and stiffness in left leg and knee, worse stooping. Hard, white, flattened, papules on inside of thighs.
Lungs - Hoarseness. Cough in cold air. Panting breathing, inclined to sigh.
Male - Sexual debility. Unconscious emission in sleep.
Modalities - Better from sleep. Colic is better by eating. Worse at night, heat of room, heat and cold, cold air,
sharp wind. Worse contact, motion, mental exertion.
Mouth - Profuse flow of saliva. Saliva flows with pains. Dirty taste. Breath putrid. Tongue coated white, with
dirty, putrid, clammy taste. Food tasteless. Gumboils. Gums bleed easily. Aphthae in children. Swelling of
cheeks.
Nose - Red papules around nose. Sensation at bridge as if nasal bones being pressed together. Frequent
sneezing, with sudden attacks of profuse, watery, bland coryza. Sudden discharge of yellow colored water
from the nose.
Rectum - Wants to defecate, goes often, but cannot. Chronic diarrhea. Stools are brown, frothy, watery,
fermented, pa- pescent, excoriating. Cholera infantum. Dysentery. Worms. Painful hemorrhoids, bloody, can
hardly stand (used locally).
Skin - Sensitive skin. Burns. Violent itching, worse night. Burning, pricking, stinging pains. Burning after
rubbing where scratched. Redness, swelling, and vesicles on hands and face. Papules which exude yellowish
humor and form a crust. Erythema. Urticaria, chilblains (Agar., Tam.). Rhus poisoning (external use).
Sleep - Excessive and continued yawning. Insomnia from abdominal trouble. Grinding teeth during sleep.
Sleep restless, disturbed by dreams. Gloomy dreams exciting tears.
Stomach - Belchings, frequent, empty, tasting like sulphur, of carbonic acid gas. Nausea with drowsiness or
faint, tremulous feeling. Sinking sensation. Heaviness of stomach as from a stone, even after a light meal.
Teeth - Teeth feel too long. Teeth are sensitive and sore to touch. Rapid tooth decay. Toothache in decayed
teeth or shooting up left side of face. Toothache, better while eating. Toothache with reflex neuralgia of eyelids.
Sharp stabbing pains. Grinds teeth at night
Temperature - Chilliness with erratic pains. Chilliness on moving about, cold hands in a warm room. Chill
without thirst, with goose bumps. Coldness of body with shivering. Heat with thirst, and great excitability, mental
agony, restlessness. Sweat is cold over lumbar and the sacral region, heat of room unbearable, producing
perspiration.
Throat - Dry, parched throat. Scraping in throat. Profuse secretion of thick sticky, mucus with much hawking.
Soreness and swelling of submaxillary glands on both sides.
COMMENTS - The tincture has been extensively proved by F. Humphreys (who wrote a monograph upon it),
Heath and others. Neuralgic pains of teeth, ears and face were especially pronounced. Shingles, neuralgia.
Great surface sensitiveness. Tearing, boring, bruised pains. Pains come suddenly and are apt to be erratic.
 Unendurable pains. The left side is most affected. Snake bites, bee stings, animal bites. Burns. Frostbite. Loud
noises go through body. Sudden discharge of yellowish or saffron-colored water from the nose.
Toothaches, especially in cavities (Hyp. tincture, Hecla.). “Toothache with earache,” particularly if with
salivation. Toothache with boring and digging pains. A deep aching in hollow or rotten teeth. Neuralgic pains
shooting up the face, from the tooth area. Gumboils. Grinds teeth at night (Cina., Tub.).
Produces disgust for tobacco in chewers and cures neuralgia resulting from tobacco. Foul breath. Sinking and
weight in stomach. Offensive flatulence. Darting up and down the urethra. Bedwetting in children. Lax
sphincters. Very copious urine, with thirst. Diabetes. Diarrhea, dysentery. Worms. Painful hemorrhoids.
Clarke used it with success in numberless cases of toothache and earache. It has given relief in the painful
neuralgia of shingles and in pleurodynia.
F. P. Stiles related three cases of its use. Mrs. S., 39, had terrible neuralgic pain in the right side of her face,
shooting into temporal, superior, maxillary and orbital regions for 10 days. Plan, was applied locally to the
gums, temple and cheek removed the pain in a few minutes. Some days later a slight return was promptly
relieved in the same way.
Mr. R. had neuralgia in left superior maxillary and lower orbital region of long standing. Promptly relieved in
the same way.
Mrs. N. had neuralgia of the right upper jaw, unbearable pain, radiating to ear, temple and cheek. A tooth had
been extracted without relief. Plan, removed all the pain.
There is a case of one man who allowed himself to be bitten by arattlesnake. He cured himself by frequently
drinking the juice.
RELATIONS -Antidótelo: Apis, Rhus-t., Tab. Antidotedby: Merc, (toothache). Comparent) Punctured
wounds. Led., Hyper. (2) Wounds and bruises, fetid breath and flatus, Arn. (3) Earache with toothache
intolerance of warm room, Puls. (4) In neuralgias, Cham., Merc., Spig., Kalm., Coloc. (5) Wounds, Calen. (6)
Kalm., Cham., Puls. (7) Hemorrhoids, external and internal, Ham. (8) Equis., Bell., Caust. - bedwetting. (9)
Unendurable pains, Aeon., Cham., Hep.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.
keynote:

with Musa, sometimes called “Plantain,” which belongs to a different class. Tincture of whole fresh plant.
Tincture of the root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Ague. Bedwetting. Bites. Breast inflammation. Burns. Ciliary neuralgia. Chilblains. Depression.
Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Earache. Ears inflammation. Emissions. Erysipelas. Erythema. Frostbite.
Gumboils.

name: Platanus Occidentalis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - platan. Platanus occidentalis. Sycamore buttonwood. Platanus acerifolia. Platanus vulgaris.
London plane tree. N. O. Platanaceae of the Urtica alliance. Tincture of young shoots. Historical dose:
Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Cataract. Ichthyosis. Tarsal tumors.
HERBAL - Burnett named the remedy Plat, occidentalis, but his tincture was made from Platanus acerifolia. It
sheds its bark annually, which was the signature of its skin action.
HOMEOPATHIC - The tincture, applied topically, has been used for tarsal tumors, both acute and old,
neglected cases. It restored to practically normal conditions areas where destruction of tissue occurred and
scar tissue caused marked deformity. Ichthyosis. Must be used for some time; acts best in children.
COMMENTS - Burnett recorded a case of ichthyosis in an elderly woman in which Platan, caused considerable
improvement in the condition of the skin.
Another case of Burnett's was that of a girl, 5 1/2, “of the coal-black variety of the strumous, her forehead low
and projecting,” who was blind from double cataract due to the shock of a fall in the first instance, the
lenses having gradually silted up.
In this case Platan, was given, five drops night and morning, for a number of months, “with very evident
improvement in the nutrition of the child's lenses.”
REFERENCES - Boericke. Burnett. Clarke.

name: Platinum Metallicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - plat. Platinum metallicum. Platina metal. The element (Pt. At. Wt. 195.08) Trituration. Historical
dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Chlorosis. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions. Delusions. Dentition. Depression.
Dysmenorrhea. Fears. Gout. Hemorrhage. Hemorrhoids. Hysteria. Insanity. Lead, poisoning. Masturbation.
Melancholia. Menorrhagia. Menses, suppressed. Multiple personalities. Neuralgias. Neurasthenia.
Numbness. Nymphomania. Ovarian, disorders. Painter's colic. Pruritus, vulvae. Rape. Rheumatism.
Sexual, abuse. Sexual, mania. Spasms. Tapeworms. Uterus, disorders. Vaginismus. Vaginitis. Vertigo.
Yawning, spasmodic.
 HOMEOPATHIC - The original name of platinum was “Platina,” a Spanish word meaning “like silver.” The
metal was introduced into Europe from South America in the middle of the eighteenth century. It is always
found in association with other metals, chiefly rhodium, osmium, iridium, and palladium.
Hahnemann was the first to think of it as a medicine and his proving in the Chronic Diseases is the basis of
the knowledge of its action.
Strong tendency to paralysis, anesthesia, localized numbness and coldness are shown. Hysterical spasms,
pains increase and decrease gradually (Stann.). Tremulousness. Alternation of mental and physical
symptoms, as physical symptoms disappear mental symptoms appear and vice versa. Oversensitive mind,
emotions and nerves.
Plat, is pre-eminently a woman's remedy. Many and various symptoms reflex from ovaries and uterus or sexual
organs. Sticky discharges, tears, stools, menses, etc. Catalepsy during menses.
Hemorrhages with black clots with fluid. Irregular spasms, congestion of blood.
Violent cramping, squeezing, thrusting or numbing pains, then spasms. Hysterical spasms. Spasms alternate
with dyspnea. Tonic and clonic spasms with laughter. Violent shocks, as from pain. Contortions of limbs.
Epilepsy, catalepsy.
Painful tremors. Pains increase and decrease gradually. Bandaged feeling. Sensation of pricking. Localized,
coldness of single parts, eyes, ears etc. or numbness of scalp, face, coccyx, calves etc.
MIND - Alternate mental and physical symptoms. Physical symptoms disappear as mental symptoms
develop. Mental troubles better at twilight. Mental troubles with suppressed menses.
Changing moods. Cheerfulness alternating with depression. Weeps and laughs alternately. Whistles, sings,
dances. Laughs at wrong time. Irritability alternating with tenderness. Irritable about trifling things.
Morose and discontented mood, worse being spoken to. Sadness better open air. Sits in a corner, broods
and says nothing. Bad humor, yet weeps. Inconsolable weeping, worse when spoken to. Weeps with pains.
Unkind, abrupt and quarrelsome. Contempt for others. Faultfinding. Proud and erotic. Self-exaltation. Feels
tall and stately. Haughty, looks with disdain upon everyone and everything. Arrogant. Wounded pride.
Absent-minded and forgetful. Any serious thought is terrifying. Weary of everything. Alone, deserted feeling.
Indifference while in company. Past events trouble her. Everything seems changed or different. Feels she
does not belong to her own family. Thinks she has no place in the world. Forsaken, deserted feeling. Feels
everything seems changed. Disordered sense of proportion, objects seem smaller, strange, frightful.
Anxiety when speaking in company. Sensation of dread and horrors. Fears of death. Fear of imaginary forms,
ghosts. Thinks her husband will never return, something will happen to him. Screams for help.
Impulse to kill her own child, her husband. Aversion to children.
Delusion of superiority. Delusions she is alone in the world. Delusions she is not appreciated. Delusions she
is disgraced. Delusions everyone is an enemy. Delusion that all persons are devils.
Mental symptoms alternating with sexual symptoms. Sexual excitement brings on mental symptoms.
Religious affections alternating with sexual excitement. Inclination to embrace everybody. Perverted sexual
desire. Unchaste talk. Hysteria before menses. Nymphomania, worse during menses. Sexual mania.
Abdomen - Pressing and bearing down in abdomen, extending into pelvis. Constriction. Pinchings in umbilical
region. Pain in umbilical region extending through into the back, turns and twists in all possible positions.
Fermentation, much flatulence. Flatulent soreness towards hypogastrium. Colic from lead poisoning.
Back - Pains in back and small of back as if broken, after a walk. Bruised backache, worse pressure, worse
on bending backwards. Contusive pain in loins and in back. Sensation of numbness in coccyx, as after a blow.
Weakness and sensation of tensive numbness in nape of neck. Rigidity of nape of neck.
Causations - Ill effects of fright, vexation, bereavement, fit of passion. Ill effects of sexual excess, prolonged
hemorrhages and masturbation.
Chest - Sensation of weakness. Anxious oppression of chest with sensation of heat, which ascends from
epigastrium. Pain in chest, as if a weight were pressing upon it with desire to take a full inspiration. Tension,
pressure and shootings in sides of chest, which do not permit lying down on either side. Aching and dull blows
in the chest. Increasing to a certain intensity and gradually diminishing in same way. Dull lancinations in sides
of chest during an inspiration.
Constitutions - Suited to women with dark hair, thin, sanguine, bilious with too frequent and too profuse
menses, sexual organs exceedingly sensitive. Hysterical and hemorrhoidal patients.
Ears - Cramp-like twinges. Shocks in ears. Sensation of numbness and of coldness in ears, extending to
cheeks and lips. Gnawing tingling in ears. Roaring, whizzing and ringing in ears. Dull thundering, rumbling in
ears.
Eyes - Eyes feel cold. Cramp-like pain in orbits. Aching in eyes with sleep. Pain in eyes after fatiguing the sight
by looking attentively at an object. Objects look smaller than they are. Quivering and sparkling before sight.
 Confused sight, as if directed through a veil, often with painless twitchings around the eye. Twitching of the
eyelids (Agar.).
Face - Distortion of muscles of face. Grimaces. Coldness, creeping and numbness in whole right side of
face. Facial pain with numb feeling in malar bones, as if the parts were between screws. Pain at root of nose,
as if squeezed in a vise. Pains increase and decrease gradually (Stann.). Boring, cramps in the jaws. Lockjaw.
Smarting and sharp vesicles on lips. Numbness of lips, dry and cracked.
Female - Painfully sensitive genitals with itching, tickling or crawling. Tingling internally and externally (Kali-
br.). Pruritus vulvae with voluptuous angling. Excessive sexual desire that leads to masturbation.
Nymphomania, worse in puerperal state. Sexual mania. Frequent sensation as if menses would appear.
Menses with chilliness, sensitive genitals. Menses too early, too profuse. Menses dark, clotted, with spasms
and painful bearing-down. Dysmenorrhea with shrieks and jerks. Amenorrhea in emigrants. Leucorrhea like
white of an egg. Vaginismus from excessive sensitiveness of sexual organs, sex is impossible (Staph.).
Prolapse of uterus. Induration, uterine cancer. Fibroids. Ovaries sensitive and burn. Infertility from ovaritis or
excessive sexual excitement.
Food - Ravenous hunger, persistent nausea with anxiety and weakness. Hasty eating, eats everything
around her or detests it. Loss of appetite after first mouthful. Repugnance to food from sadness. Worse from
fasting.
Head - Constriction about forehead and right temples. Cramp-like, squeezing pain. Tensive confusion in
forehead, as if head were compressed in a vice. Tense, pressing pain, confined to a small spot. Pain in sides
of head, as if caused by a plug. Tense scalp. Constrictive headache, as if a tape were tightly drawn around it
with sensation of numbness in brain. Numbness with headache. Attack of headache with nausea and
vomiting. Headache with leucorrhea. Headache commences on waking. As of water in forehead.
Heart - Burning and sticking low down by heart. A dull pressure in region of apex of heart. Anxious palpitation
of heart.
Kidneys - Slow but frequent emission of urine. Red urine with a white cloud, or turbid and deposits a red
sediment.
Limbs - Limbs feel weary, numb, paralyzed. Tingling restlessness, sensation of weakness and trembling in
limbs. Paralytic weakness. Attack of spasmodic rigidity in limbs. Cramp-like jerking and drawing pains in limbs
and joints. Cramp in calves. Tightness of thighs, as if too tightly wrapped. Distorted fingers. Numbness of little
finger or fingers.
Lungs - Inclination to draw a long breath, prevented by a sensation of weakness in chest. Shortness of breath
with a constrictive oppression of chest. Short, difficult and anxious respiration. Short, nervous, dry cough with
palpitations and dyspnea. Walking against wind causes sudden arrest of breathing.
Male - Ill effects of masturbation before puberty. Perverted sexual desires. Unnatural increase ofsexual
desire with frequent erections, especially at night (with amorous dream). Sex, short duration with little
enjoyment. Flow of prostatic fluid. Burning pain and gnawing in scrotum. Voluptuous tickling, itching with
excessive sexual desire. V oluptuous crawling in genital organs and abdomen with anxious oppression and
palpitations, then painless pressure downwards in genitals with sticking in sinciput and exhaustion.
Modalities - Better from walking in open air, sunshine, stretching and motion. Obliged to stretch, which
ameliorates. Worse from emotions, chagrin, nerve exhaustion. Worse sex, during menses. Worse touch,
pressure, sitting, standing and bending backwards. Worse evening and night, in a warm room.
Mouth - Mouth feels cold. Sensation as if palate or uvula were elongated. As if tongue were scalded. Sweet
taste on tip of the tongue. Numb pain in left lower teeth. Cramp-like drawing in teeth. Toothache with pulsative
and digging pain. Fissures in gums.
Nose - Cramp-like pain with sensation of numbness in nose and at root of nose. Ineffectual want to sneeze
and tingling in nose. Dry coryza often semi-lateral. Corrosive sensation on nose, as of something acrid.
Rectum - Constipation after lead poisoning, sometimes very obstinate. Constipation of pregnancy.
Constipation of travelers, who are constantly changing food and water. Frequent want of stool, retarded,
feces scanty, evacuated with difficulty in pieces. Stool seems to stick to anus and rectum like putty. Crawling,
itching anus in evening. Voluptuous crawling in rectum. Violent and dull lancinations in rectum.
Sensations - As if her senses would vanish. As if everything about her were very small. As if she were
constantly growing longer and longer. As if she did not belong to her own family. As if head were enlarged. As
if parts of malar bones were between screws. As if throat constricted, palate elongated tongue scalded. As if
abdomen, chest, nape, limbs, thing, great toe, tightly wrapped or constricted. Back and small of back as if
broken. Crawling, tingling, numb sensations.
Skin - Tingling, gnawing with pain as of excoriation and itching or burning, pricking and shooting pain on
various parts of skin, which provokes scratching. Ulcers,
 on fingers and toes.
Sleep - Convulsive and spasmodic yawning, especially in afternoon. Great disposition to sleep in evening.
Sleeps with legs far apart. Sleeps on back with knees drawn up and spread apart, wants to uncover entirely.
Waking at night with frightful dreams, want of consciousness or with anxious, sad and distressing thoughts.
Anxious dreams of wars and bloodshed. Lascivious dreams. Prolonged sleep in morning.
Stool - Stool as if burnt. Stools hard, black passed in small portions with great straining, Stools adhere to
rectum like soft clay. Sticky stool. Tinea and ascarides are discharged from rectum. Worms.
Stomach - Aching, pressure in stomach, especially after a meal. Sensation of constriction in pit of stomach,
extending into abdomen. Fermentations in epigastric region. Ineffectual effort to belch. Empty, noisy belchings.
Continued nausea with lassitude, trembling and anxiety.
Temperature - Pulse small, feeble, frequently tremulous. Constant shivering and shuddering over whole body,
especially in open air. Chilliness predominates with low spirits, which ceases during heat. Heat with sensation
of burning in face without any visible change in color of face. Flushes of heat interrupted by chilliness. Gradually
increasing and decreasing heat. Perspiration only during sleep, ceasing as soon as one wakens.
Throat - Cramp-like drawing in throat like a constriction. Scraping and accumulation of phlegm in throat.
Hawking up of phlegm. Aphonia.
Vertigo - Transient attacks of vertigo in evening with loss of consciousness. Vertigo on sitting down or
ascending stairs. Vertigo as if torn and pulled with threads.
COMMENTS - Plat, has a lost sense of proportion in both ocular and mental vision. Objects look small or the
patient thinks they are small. Distortions of distance and size (Cann.).
Pride and hauteur, the patient (generally a woman) looks down on everything and everybody. Delusion of
grandeur.
Megalomania (Cann., Hyos.), but seen as arrogance, not insanity. Arrogant, proud, particularly after grief,
fright, rape or sexual abuse. Deep hatred for men.
Alternating between one mental state and another. Changing moods, sad and gay, laughs and cries by turns.
Laughs immoderately, but in the wrong place, laughs at serious things. Homicidal. Manic depression. Multiple
personality disorders (Anae.). Identity crisis, they forget who they are.
Jahr cured with Plat, a woman who had an inspiration to kill her child.
Jule Gaudy recorded the case of a woman who was tormented with an almost irresistible impulse to kill her
husband, whom she loved passionately and with whom she was perfectly happy. The sight of a knife had an
irresistible fascination for her and she was often obliged to leave the table to free herself from the impulse.
A few months before, she had lost achild a short time after confinement, which had been followed by profuse
and persistent hemorrhage. Recovering from this she became restless, irritable and her whole existence was
ruled by this terrible impulse. Plat. 6x and 30x relieved and finally cured her.
Kent recorded the case of a middle-aged woman, the mother of several grown-up daughters, who complained
of a fear in the absence of her husband, that he would never return, that he would die or be run over. She wept
all the time he was away.
Kent discovered that she had been treated for uterine displacement and was then wearing a pessary. This
was removed. Menstrual flow was copious, black, clotted. The external genitals were so sensitive that the
usual napkin was intolerable. Plat, cured the whole case including the displacement.
Nash cured a case of insanity of some duration with Plat., being led to the remedy by an alternation of the
mental symptoms with a pain the whole length of the spine.
Keynote occurrence of cramps, cramping pains and spasms, developing into convulsions. Cramping pains
causes numbness and tingling in the parts affected. Pains as if nipped, squeezed in a vice and these pains
increase gradually to a climax and then, as gradually, decline.
Cramping tendency, antidotal to lead poisoning. Tenesmus. Constipation, stools are tenacious and sticky,
adhere to the rectum and anus like putty or they may be hard as if burnt. Constipation comes on while traveling,
in emigrants, during pregnancy.
Spasms alternate between convulsions and opisthotonos, full consciousness. Spasms alternate with dyspnea.
Spasmodic yawning. Pains go from right to left. The right side is somewhat more affected than the left. The
symptoms are periodic and paroxysmal, as well as alternating.
Severe, painful menstrual cramps. Catalepsy during menstruation. With the menses, uterine spasms,
convulsions. Convulsions of puerperal state. Excessive itching in uterus, pruritus vulvae. Vaginismus. Severe
stitches in right ovary. Ovarian tumors.
Generally centers in and radiates from the sexual organs, male and female. The sensitiveness of the external
genitals is often so great as to make sex impossible (Staph., Cact.). Digital examining of such a patient causes
great pain. Prostate problems (Pall.).
 Masturbation before puberty and also to the effects of masturbation. Premature and excessive development
of sexual instinct and organs, before puberty. Severe vaginal irritation that leads to vaginal discharge and
masturbation in young girls (Med.).
Excessive desire, especially in virgins. Nymphomania, worse in puerperal state. Characteristic tendency to
uncover completely in sleep. It was one of Gallavardin's remedies for the impulse to pederasty and sodomy.
RELATIONS - Antidote: Puls. Plat, antidotes the bad effects of lead. Antidoted by: Puls., Teste, who classes
Plat. withThuj., Brom, and Cast., says Colch. is the best antidote to all four. Compare: (1) Rhodi., Stann.,
Valer., Sep. (2) Plat-m. (3) Sed-ac - sexual irritability, relieves irritation of nerve centers and gives rest. (4)
Self-pride, Pall., Plat, egotistical, despises others, Pall, easily wounded, attaches importance toothers, Lyc. -
imperious. (5)Spasms, emacia-
tion from pre-puberty masturbation, Staph. (6) Uterine affections, nymphomania, Aur., Sep. (the nymphomania
of Plat, is more intense. Plat, is intermediate between Aur. and Sep. in weariness of life, the uterine cramps of
Plat, are followed by numbness, those of Sep. are a clutching as if suddenly seized then suddenly relaxed. (7)
Hysteria indurated ulcers, Tarent. (8) Sees ghosts spirits and demons, Hyos., Kali-br. (9) Shamelessness,
uncovers, Phos., Hyos. - sees things larger. Plat, smaller. (10) Thinks death near and fears it, Aeon., Ars. (11)
Dark, stringy hemorrhage, Cham., Croc, has sensation of something alive. Complementary: Plat, and Pall,
both affect right ovary, but Pall, has better from pressure. Compatible: Bell., Ign., Lyc., Puls., Rhus-t., Sep.,
Verat.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.
