PHARMACY - prin. Prinos verticillatus. Black alder. N. O. Aquifoliaceae. Tincture of the berries. Tincture of
fresh bark. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Diarrhea. Fever.
HERBAL - The genus Prinos is very closely allied to the hollies. The Treasury of Botany reported that “The
bark of Prin. isbitterandhas been used in the treatment of fever and in the form of a lotion as an application in
cases of gangrene. The berries are tonic and emetic.”
HOMEOPATHIC - The only recorded experiment with Prin., swallowing twenty berries, showed the effect to
be vomiting, plus an extremely profuse greenish diarrhea. Prin. increased the appetite and produced a feeling
of well-being in spite of great loss of weight.
REFERENCES - Clarke.
 ***PROGESTERONE
PHARMACY-prog. Progesterone. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne. Amenorrhea. Bloating. Breast, disorders. Constipation. Cramps. Depression. Edema.
Endometriosis. Epilepsy. Fatigue. Hair, growth. Hair, loss. Headache. Hemorrhages. Hormonal, disorders.
Hot flashes. Infertility. Insomnia. Menopausal, disorders. Menstrual, disorders. Migraine. Miscarriage. Nausea.
Obesity. Osteoporosis. Premenstrual syndrome. Vaginal, dryness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Progesterone is a hormone secreted by the ovary in the second two weeks of the menstrual
cycle in reproductive age ovulating women. Progesterone, or progesterone-like substances called
progestogens or progestins, are ingested by women in birth control pills and menopausal hormone
replacement therapy.
Progesterone acts to stabilize the tissue lining of the uterus (endometrium) so if it is absent, such as with
ovarian anovulation, irregular and heavy menstrual bleeding often occurs after a period without any menstrual
bleeding. Thus progesterone is used to prevent this irregularity of bleeding if it is given continuously.
If, on the other hand, a onetime bolus of progesterone is given such as with a shot or with only 5 days of oral
pills, then the falling progesterone levels will actually cause an estrogen-primed endometrium to slough and
therefore start a menses.
It is sometimes used to induce a menstrual period or regulate abnormal bleeding problems if menses are
skipping or bleeding is irregular or prolonged. Progesterone has been used as therapy for premenstrual
syndrome and for women with infertility or frequent miscarriages.
Too much progesterone often causes tiredness and even sedation. This side effect can be beneficial in a
women who has epilepsy or even uterine irritability causing preterm labor because progesterone in high doses
can decrease seizure activity and uterine contractions.
Progesterone tends to promote vaginal dryness by counteracting the effect on lubrication of estrogens, and it
can also decrease the amount of menstruation or block it entirely by reversing estrogen effect on the growth
of the uterine lining.
Progestegens can cause some medical conditions to worsen, examples are asthma, heart failure, epilepsy
and migraine headache. Natural progesterone tends to have fewer side effects.
Progesterone can cause blood clots, particularly in the legs. Irregular vaginal bleeding. Breast tenderness.
Liver disease. Painful swelling of the abdomen. Bloating. Nausea. Constipation. Increased appetite. Weight
gain.
Headache. Insomnia. Hot flashes. Profuse sweat. Acne. Unwanted hair growth. Tiredness, irritability. Loss of
concentration. Depression, anxiety. Moodiness. Overly emotional.
MIND - Loss of concentration. Foggy thinking. Inability to make decisions. Inability to handle even the smallest
amount of stress. Anxiety, irritability. Anger. Anti-social. Panic attacks. Very emotional, feeling overwhelmed.
Mood changes.
Severe depression. Feeling of despair and hopelessness. Uncontrollable crying, immense sadness. Suicidal
depression. Psychotic. Delusion, feel like they are in another's body.
Abdomen - Bloating in abdomen, cramps, worse before menses.
Back - Back pain.
Breasts - Breasts tender and sore.
Face - Puffiness in face. Whole face broke out in acne.
Female - Premenstrual syndrome. Amenorrhea. Menses skipping, bleeding is irregular or prolonged. Infertility
or frequent miscarriages. Vaginal dryness. Menopausal disorders.
Food - Increased appetite. Craving for sweets.
Head - Sick headaches.
Limbs - Puffiness in hands. Joint pains.
Lungs - Shortness of breath.
Modalities - Worse heat, before menses, before menopause.
Perspiration - Profuse sweating.
Rectum - Constipation.
Skin - Greasy skin. Unwanted hair growth.
Sleep - Sleeplessness. Strange dreams.
Stomach - Sick feeling. Bloating. Nausea.
Temperature - Hot flashes.
RELATIONS - Compare: Sep., Foil., Estro., Lach., Puls., Aur.
REFERENCES - Murphy.
 ***PROPOLIS
PHARMACY-propo. Propolis. Red or brown resinous substance collected by bees from buds for use in
constructing hives. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL-Acne. Allergies. Bruises. Burns. Cancer. Chilly. Colds. Coughs. Earache. Fatigue. Fungus. Herpes.
Herpes zoster. Immune system. Influenza. Lung, ailments. Lung, infections. Nasal congestion. Polyuria.
Shingles. Skin, disorders. Sore, throats. Sunburns. Ulcers. Weariness. Wounds.
HOMEOPATHIC - Depending upon its precise composition, propolis may show powerful local antibiotic and
anti-fungal properties. Generally efficient in treating skin burns. Allergies.
Great weariness. More tired in the morning than usual, even after sleeping longer. Symptoms appear and
disappear suddenly. The action of the remedy is quick and violent. It can be compared with Aeon., Bell, and
Cham.
It may stimulate the immune system, but some warn that it should not be taken if the user is likely to have
severe allergic reaction to bees. Old beekeepers recommend a piece of propolis kept in the mouth as a remedy
for a sore throat.
Ears - Earache.
Facé - Herpes labialis. Red blotches and spots on face.
Food - Increased appetite. Desire for every kind of food, especially fruit, bread. On waking strong desire for
sweets. Increased thirst.
Head - Headache. V arious pains of the head, similar to sinus troubles.
Kidneys - Frequent urination at night in spite of normal intake of fluids.
Modalities - Weariness, cough, worse morning on waking.
Mouth - Bad smell from mouth. Tongue coated grayish, except for the tip of the tongue.
Nose - Watery discharge from nose, preceded by fleeting pain in frontal sinuses. Tingling in nose.
Sleep - Anxious dreams. Dreams of traveling. Dreams of quarrels. Awakes with anger.
Temperature - Chilly. Icy-cold hands. Coldness of fingers between 10 a.m. and noon. Freezing sensation over
whole body. Transitory chilliness at 4 p.m.
Throat - Dry sensation in throat and posterior nares.
RELATIONS Compare: Alf.
REFERENCES - Murphy.

name: Propylaminum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - prop. Propylaminum. Trim- ethylaminum. Found in many plants and in herring-brine. Solution.
Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Ankles, pains. Diarrhea. Fever. Joint, pains. Numbness. Prosopalgia. Rheumatic fever.
Rheumatism. Wrists, pains.
HOMEOPATHIC - Prop, is found in many plants (Chen-v., Crat., Phal., Pyrus-c., Am., Cot., Fagu., etc.) and in
theTrimethylaminum, which is, among other sources, prepared from herring-brine, and has a very unpleasant
and penetrating fish-like odor.
At one time it was regarded as a panacea in cases of acute rheumatism. Dissipates fever and pain in a day or
two in acute rheumatism. Rheumatic prosopalgia and rheumatic metastases, especially heart lesions.
Rheumatism, needle held in fingers gets too heavy.
Pain in wrists and ankles, worse slightest motion (Bry.), unable to stand. Tingling and numbness of
fingers. Great restlessness and thirst. Experiments show that Prop, diminishes the amount of urea excreted.
COMMENTS - Hansen indicated great pains in the wrist joints, also great restlessness. Pains in ankle joints
from standing, worse slight movement.
Dr. C. Smith noted “Rheumatism, when the needle held in the fingers gets so heavy she cannot sew.” “Copious
diarrhea with pains in ankle joints but not in wrists, thirst for large quantities of cold water like Bry.” Weakness
in lumbar and lower dorsal region.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Proteus Bacillus
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - prot. Proteus bacillus. Bowel nosode. Proteus bacteria. Intestinal bacteria. Bacillus proteus
mirabilis reltgeri. Nosodes. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne. Aerophagy. Agoraphobia. Allergies. Alopecia. Angina pectoris. Backaches. Blood, clots.
Boils. Convulsions. Coronary, disease. Cystitis. Diarrhea. Duodenal, ulcers. Dyspepsia. Food,allergies.
 Eczema. Edema. Gastric, ulcers. Headache. Hematemesis. Herpes. Hysteria. Indigestion. Intermittent,
claudication. Leucorrhea. Meibomian cyst. Melancholy. Ménière's disease. Meningitis. Migraines. Neuralgia.
Neurasthenia. Otitis. Phlebitis. Premature, senility. Pyelitis. Pyelonephritis. Raynaud's syndrome. Rhinitis.
Sciatica. Senility. Spinal, neurasthenia. Ulcers. Vaginitis. Vertigo. Worms. Writer's cramp.
HOMEOPATHIC - Culture of a bacteria of the Proteus genus: Proteus vulgaris, mirabi- hs, morganii, reltgeri.
Proteus, a bacterium frequently found in the intestinal region, is a nosode whose range of action concerns
essentially phenomena of digestive problems. G. Sevaus conducted a detailed clinical study, but there is no
homeopathic proving.
Digestive allergies. Sudden nervous symptoms. Extreme feeling of intra-cranial tension. Meningitis with
attacks of fever. Premature senility.
Convulsion, epileptiform fits. Cramps leg, calf. Neuro-arthritic diathesis. After-attack of phlebitis. Long, drawn-
out convalescence. Pain aggravated by effort. Intermittent claudication. Icy cold feet.
Morbid alternations (Psor., Sulph.).
MIND - Prostration of mind, mental exhaustion. Brain fag. Confusion of mind. Memory weakness.
Forgetfulness of words while speaking. Vanishing of thoughts. Premature senility.
Restlessness, nervousness. Feeling of extreme nervous tension and over-exertion. Cannot handle things
anymore, overwhelmed by stress. Anxiety in stomach. Anguish during discomfort. Ailments from excitement.
Melancholy. Sadness, despondency, depression. Suicidal disposition. Thinks about suicide without really
wanting to die. Weeping, tearful mood when telling about her illness.
Sensitive. Horrible things, sad stories affect her profoundly. Frightened easily. Fear of being alone, of the dark.
Agoraphobia. Fear something will bad happen. Fear of losing his reason. Hysteria.
Timidity. Want of self confidence. Offended easily. Fear of opinion of others. Aversion to company. Intolerant
of contradiction. Anger from contradiction. Tense, irritable. Quarrelsomeness, scolding.
Brainstorm, outbursts of anger. Anger, throws things away, impulse to kill. Temper tantrums.
Destructiveness. Hurls objects held in the hand, kicks out. Children rolling about on the floor when angry.
Abdomen - Hematemesis and melaena.
Aerophagy. Acrid dyspepsia. Gastric and duodenal ulcers. Spasmodic colon infections. Oxyuric diseases.
Back - Backaches. Spinal neurasthenia.
Hernia.
Chest - Eruptions, boils in axilla.
Constitutions - Allergic and psoric constitutions. Carbonic, flouric, and phosphoric constitutions.
Ears - Acute or burning pains like otitis, but without fever. Noises during vertigo. Ménière's disease.
Eyes - Burning pains. Acute pains, stitching. Pains ameliorated by pressure. Eyes red, tired by light.
Intermittent failing of sight. Meibomian cyst.
Face - Dryness of lips. Corners of mouth cracked. Itching of upper lip. Herpes about lips. Acne on chin.
Female - Blood-streaked, brownish discharge before menses. Menses regular, with blood clots for seven days.
Menses clotted, protracted. Fibrous blood clots at the end of menses. Leucorrhea before menses, between
menses. Leucorrhea, acrid, brown, copious. Leucorrhea offensive, thick. Copious white discharge, worse
during ovulation. Vaginitis. Metritis of the cervix. Vulvar pruritus. Anal and vulvar boils.
Food - Food allergies. Desires fats, butter, eggs, rich food. Desires sweets, sugar, salt. Aversion to butter,
pork, beef. Aversion to eggs, especially hard-boiled eggs. Aversion to cranberries, raw food, salads, green
beans, cucumber, onions, garlic. Aversion to chocolate, which he cannot digest. Worse fats, rich food, eggs,
garlic, cranberries, cucumber and chocolate.
Head - Digestive migraine. Frontal headache with feeling of heaviness, aggravated during the week
preceding menses. Headache in the morning. Headache with diarrhea and furred tongue. Pressing pains.
Beats head against the bed. Knocks head against things. Hair falls out. Alopecia.
Heart - Coronary disease. Angina pectoris. Feeling of weight in the precordial region. Palpitations after
excitement. Palpitations from the slightest emotion, when lying down.
Kidneys - Pyelitis. Pyelonephritis. Pain in the loin. Cystitis, after eating pork. Violent, burning pains in the
urethra. Urine cloudy and fetid. Whitish tissues in the urine.
Limbs - Arthritic diathesis. Sciatic pain. Intermittent claudication. Legs look bruised. Pain in the calf, pain
forcing him to walk with a stick, cramps in the legs. Pain in calves of legs after walking. Muscular cramps.
Functional or professional contracture. Writer's cramp, pianist's cramp, dancer's cramp. Spasms of the hands.
Flexor contraction of the little finger. Cannot close the hand. Awkwardness of hands, drops things. Moist
eruptions, eczema, on backs of hands. Coldness and blueness of
hands. Feet numb, as if frozen, aggravated by cold weather. Hammer-toes.
Lungs - Cough with sputum.
 Modalities - Better resting, lying down, one hour after rising. Better from stretching, eating, drinking whisky.
Better from mild temperature, in the mountains. Aggravation in the morning on waking, from exertion, from
climbing stairs. Worse from drinking wine. Worse in stormy weather, cold, winter, heat, exposure to sun. Worse
from lying down, at night.
Mouth - Aphthae and mouth ulcers. Taste of salt in the mouth. Gums sensitive. Cracking at the corners of the
lips, resistant to treatment.
Nose - Impression of greasy discharge at the back of the nose. Hypertrophic chronic rhinitis. Nasal blockage.
Nasal obstruction in warm room.
Rectum - Diarrhea from excitement. Diarrhea with headache and furred tongue. Alternation of diarrhea and
constipation. Constipation with empty urging. Sensation of a lump. Hematemesis and melaena. Presence of
oxyuris in stools. Stools yellow, soft, in the morning after breakfast.
Skin - Eczema. Itching vesicles. Boils maturing slowly. Herpes. Herpetic eruptions at muco-cutaneous
margins. Papular, pustular eruption, erythematous, dry, peeling. Severe pruritus. Nails split. Hair falls out.
Alopecia.
Sleep - Dreams of dead people, of death or dying.
Stomach - Stomach pain while fasting. Empty sensation in stomach, not better eating. Acidity, heartburn,
sourness. Acrid dyspepsia. Aerophagy. Gastric and duodenal ulcers.
Temperature - Copious perspiration from the axilla, falling in large drops, clammy hands.
Throat - Acute pharyngitis with difficulty speaking. Dryness during excitement.
Vertigo - Vertigo when looking at moving objects, while riding in a carriage, during railroad travel. Vertigo with
feeling that the ground is coming up to meet him. Vertigo, accompanied by colored lights.
COMMENTS - Keynote suddenness and
violence with nervous symptoms and spasm. Slow build up of stress with a sudden catastrophe. Emotional
hysteria (Ign., Nat-m.). Violent temper in a child with kicking.
Spasm in peripheral vessels, Raynaud's Syndrome (Sec.). Migraines headaches with blurred vision and
Meniere's syndrome. Petit mal attacks of epilepsy.
Herpetic eruptions with pain out of proportion to the lesion. Angioneurotic edema. Hemorrhage or perforation
without any previous stomach symptoms but with a history of nervous strain.
RELATIONS - Related: Ign., Nat-m., Apis, Cupr. Compare: (1) Psor. - Inhibition, chilliness, sadness, periodic
migraine, nocturnal need to eat, morning diarrhea, weakness in the back and joints, evil-smelling eruptions,
appearing in winter, disappearing in summer. (2) Sulph. - Allergic, psoric conditions, burning skin with eruptions
and itching. Impatient, quarrelsome, asthenic. (3) Tub. - Unstable, emotional, aggravated by physical or mental
effort, emaciation, sweating, morning diarrhea. Aggravated by damp and cold and weather changes.
REFERENCES - Bach. Julian.

name: Prozac
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - proz. Prozac. Fluoxetine hydrochloride. An allopathic anti-depressant drug. Historical dose:
All potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne. Allergies. Amenorrhea. Amnesia. Anemia. Angina, pectoris. Arthritis. Asthma. Belching.
Bi-polar, disorder. Blood, clots. Bronchitis. Bruising. Bulimia. Bursitis. Chronic, fatigue. Colitis. Coma.
Conjunctivitis. Convulsions. Cough. Depression. Dehydration. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Duodenal, ulcer. Eating,
disorders. Eczema. Edema. Gallstones. Gout. Hair, loss. Headaches. Heart, attack. Heart, failure.
Hemorrhages. Hepatitis. Hirsutism. Hives. Hypertension. Hypotension. Impotency. Indigestion. Influenza.
Insomnia. Itching. Kidney. disorders. Menstrual, disorders. Migraines. Miscarriage. Nausea. Nervousness.
Obsessive compulsive disorder.Premenstrual, syndrome. Psoriasis. Rashes. Salpingitis.
Seborrhea. Shingles. Skin, disorders. Spasms. Stomach, ulcer. Strokes. Tooth, problems. Tremors. Twitching.
Urticaria. Vomiting. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Changes in sleep habits. Increased fatigue. Difficulty concentrating. Slowed thinking.
Feelings of guilt or worthlessness. Suicidal thoughts. Decreased sex drive.
Involuntary movements. Lack of muscle coordination. Twitching. Tremors. Weakness. Vague feeling of bodily
discomfort. Nervousness. Drowsiness and fatigue. Headache. Flu symptoms. Sweating. Chills. Fever. Skin
inflammation. Hemorrhage. High blood pressure.
Enlargement of or increased activity of thyroid gland. Inflammation of the esophagus. Tooth problems.
Changes in appetite. Weight gain or loss. Fluid retention. Dehydration. Kidney disorders. Diabetes. Flatus.
Diarrhea.
Pelvic pain. Premenstrual syndrome, with anxiety, depression, irritability orpersistent anger, mood swings, and
 tension. Physical problems that accompany premenstrual, syndrome include bloating, breast tenderness,
headache, and joint and muscle pain. MIND - Changeable moods and emotions. Anxiety. Irrational ideas.
Agitation. Paranoid reaction. Hostility. Antisocial behavior. Nervousness. Obsessive-compulsive disorder.
Bulimia, binge-eating followed by deliberate vomiting.
Euphoria. Exaggerated feeling of wellbeing. Apathy. Confusion. Difficulty concentrating. Slowed thinking.
Amnesia. Depersonalization. Hallucinations. Delusions. Feelings of guilt or worthlessness. Suicidal thoughts.
Loss of consciousness. Coma.
Abdomen - Bloating and gas. Colitis.
Duodenal ulcer. Hemorrhage from intestines.
Bladder - Urinary tract disorders. Frequent urination. Hematuria, albuminuria, polyuria.
Blood - Anemia. High blood sugar. Leukocytosis. Leukopenia. Blood clots. Thrombophlebitis. Stroke.
Breast - Enlargement. Breast pain and swelling. Breast tenderness. Fibrocystic breast.
Chest - Angina pectoris. Severe chest pain.
Ear - Ear pain. Ringing in the ears. Deafness.
Eyes - Dry eyes. Dilated pupils. Conjunctivitis (pinkeye). Glaucoma. Bleeding. Amblyopia. Sensitivity to light.
Photophobia. Vision problems. Double vision. Nystagmus.
Face - Facia] swelling due to fluid retention. Excess growth of coarse hair on face.
Female - Amenorrhea. Abnormal stoppage of menstrual flow. Premenstrual syndrome. Menstrual disorders.
Painful menstruation. Excess uterine or vaginal bleeding. Miscarriage. Salpingitis. Decreased sex drive.
Food - Increased appetite. Lack or loss of appetite. Thirst.
General - Chronic fatigue.
Head - Headaches. Migraines. Hydrocephalus. Hair loss.
Heart - Angina pectoris. Low blood pressure upon standing. High blood pressure. Slowing of heart rate.
Irregular heartbeat. Rapid or throbbing heartbeat. Heart attack. Heart failure.
Kidney - Pyelonephritis. Kidney calculus. Limbs - Abnormal gait. Gout. Arthritis.
Rheumatoid arthritis. Bursitis. Bone pain. Tremors. Muscle spasm. Leg cramps.
Liver - Gallstones. Liver enlargement. Hepatitis.
Lung - Bronchitis. Cough. Asthma. Rapid breathing. Temporary cessation of breathing. Lung fibrosis.
Male - Abnormal ejaculation. Impotence. Decreased sex drive.
Mouth - Sores. Tingling sensation around the mouth. Dry mouth. Increased salivation. Bleeding gums.
Gingivitis. Inflammation. Stomatitis. Slurred speech.
Nerves - Neuralgia. Convulsions. Uncoordinated movements. Decreased reflexes.
Nose - Sinus or nasal inflammation. Nosebleeds.
Rectum - Inability to control bowel movements. Diarrhea. Dark, tarry stool. Bloody diarrhea.
Skin - Itching. Sweating. Skin discoloration. Acne. Eczema. Psoriasis. Hives. Shingles. Urticaria. Rashes.
Reddish or purplish spots on the skin. Bruising. Seborrhea.
Sleep - Drowsiness and fatigue. Yawning. Insomnia. Inability to fall or stay asleep. Strange dreams.
Stomach - Esophagitis. Gastritis. Indigestion. Hiccups. Belching. Nausea. Vomiting. Inflammation of the
stomach lining. Stomach ulcer. Vomiting blood. Hemorrhage.
Temperature - Reduction of body temperature. Chills and fever. Flu symptoms. Infection.
Throat - Sore throat. Difficulty in swallowing.
Tongue - Taste altered, lost. Inflammation, swelling of the tongue.
Vertigo - Dizziness.
COMMENTS - Muscle spasms and weakness. Muscle inflammation. Tissue inflammation, below skin. Skin
inflammation and disorders. Inflammation of eyes and eyelids. Fluid buildup in larynx and lungs. Spitting blood,
stomach and intestinal. Colitis. Female milk production. Stupor.
RELATIONS - Compare: Aur., Care., Staph., Anae.
REFERENCES - Muiphy.

name: Prunella Vulgaris
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - prune. Prunella vulgaris. Self Heal. N. O. Labiatae. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Headache. Leucorrhea. Sore, throat. Wounds.
HERBAL - Prunella vulgaris is useful in sore and relaxed throat. Astringent. Internal bleeding, leucorrhea, etc.
The infusion of 1 oz to 1 pt of boiling water is taken internally in doses of a wineglassful. Externally it is used
as a gargle and injection.
Culpeper wrote, “Here is another herb of Venus, Self-heal whereby when you are hurt you may heal yourself;
 it is a special herb for inward and outward wounds. Take it inwardly in syrups for inward wounds, outwardly in
unguents and plasters for outward. The juice thereof used with oil of roses to annoint the temples and forehead
is very effectual to remove headache.”
COMMENTS - There is an old German saying that “He needs neither physician nor surgeon that hath Self-
heal and to help himself. “
REFERENCES - Murphy. Potter.

name: Prunus Padusrheum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - prun-p. Prunus padusrheum. Bird cherry. Cerasus padus. Padus racemosa. Padus vulgaris. N.
O. Rosaceae. Tincture of leaves and bark of small twigs collected when in blossom. Historical dose: Tincture
and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Headache. Heart, disorders. Rectum, pains.
HERBAL - The fruit is small, black and nauseous to the taste. In Scotland it is known as the Hayberry.
TheTreasury of Botany noted that in the north of Europe it is made into a liqueur. The juices can also be
expressed and drunk with milk, while the residue of the fruit can be kneaded into cakes. The plant is now
classed with the cherries, but Clarke retained it under its old name.
HOMEOPATHIC - Lembke's proving of Prun-p. brought out marked symptoms in the head, rectum, chest and
heart. Pains were pressi ve in head and beneath sternum, sticking in rectum. Tumultuous heartbeats. The
symptoms were worse by pressure, sitting, standing, stooping and walking.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Heart, Crat., Prun., Prun-v., Laur.
REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Prunus Spinosa
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - prun. Prunus spinosa. Blackthorn. Sloe. N. O. Rosaceae. Tincture of buds just before flowering.
Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Appetite, lost. Ascites. Breast, pain. Cardiac, dropsy. Choroiditis. Ciliary,
neuralgia. Cystitis. Dropsy. Dyspnea. Dysuria. Earache. Eyes, choroiditis. Flatulent. Glaucoma. Heart, af-
fection. Headaches. Hernia. Herpes zoster. Leucorrhea. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Neuralgias. Sprains.
Strangury. Stricture. Toothache. Vitreous, opacities.
HOMEOPATHIC-Prun.wasprovedbyWahle. The symptoms resemble those of Prun-p. in general, but some
very strongly characterized ones were produced. Acts especially on the nerves, respiratory orbital and on
urinary organs. Special action on the urinary organs and the head.
Shooting from within out, from before backward. The pains were pressive, and out pressing and out-shooting.
Lightning like pains, wandering, causing shortness of breath. Spraining pains and pains which take away the
breath.
Pains are felt in the skull, eye, root of the nose and ears. The teeth feel raised out of their sockets. Glaucoma,
choroido-retinitis, irido-choroiditis, irido-cyclitis. Ciliary neuralgia (Spig.). Neuralgias. Nerve paralysis.
Anasarca and edema. Dropsy caused by defective heart. Ankle and foot feel sprained. Pains after shingles.
Cramps. Compensatory effects.
MIND - Restlessness, walks about constantly, cannot remain in one place.
Abdomen - Ascites. Cramp-like pain in bladder region, worse from walking.
Back - As of a lump below the left scapula.
Causations - Ill effects of sun, sprains, over-lifting.
Chest - Angina pectoris.
Eyes - Ciliary neuralgia. Shooting like lightning through the brain to occiput. Sudden pain in eyeball as if it
would burst, better by lachrymation. Irido-choroiditis. Opacity of vitreous humor.
Female - Menses, thin, watery, too early, too copious, with sacral pain. Leucorrhea, acrid, watery purulent,
staining yellow.
Head - Pressing, tearing pain beneath skull. Shooting from right frontal bone through brain to occiput.
Headache from heat of sun. Piercing toothache, as if teeth were pulled out, worse taking anything warm.
Heart - Hypertrophied. Cardiac dropsy. Angina pectoris. Throbbing of carotid arteries. Knocking at heart with
labored breathing, worse least motion. Furious beating of heart, worse slightest motion.
Kidneys - Neuralgic dysuria. Tenesmus of bladder. Ineffectual effort to urinate. Urgent desire to urinate, urine
reaches glans penis and then returns with violent pain and spasms and tenesmus in rectum. Cramp in
bladder from pressure of flatus, must double up to urinate. Glans pains on urinating. Must press a long time
 before urine appears. Pulsating pudendum. Stream of urine thin like a thread or forked.
Limbs - Edema of feet. Itching at the fingertips as if frozen. Thumb as if sprained, hindering writing.
Lungs - Oppression of chest, anxious, short respiration. Wheezing when walking. Short breath with pains.
Feeling as if air inhaled did not reach the pit of stomach, has to yawn and try to take a deep inspiration. Air
hunger.
Male - Pulsation in glans from jar of walking.
Modalities - Better from rest, doubling up. Biting the teeth together helps toothache. Worse stooping,
ascending, motion, jarring, must walk carefully. Worse by touch, pressure, night. Toothache worse from warm
food.
Mouth - Teeth feel pulled out. Toothache better by biting teeth together.
Rectum - Hard, nodular stool with rectal pain, as if angular body were pressed inward. Burning in anus after
slimy diarrhea.
Sensations - As if a sharp corner pressing against top of head. As is skull would be pressed outward by a
sharp plug. Headache as if from sun. As if inner portion of eye would be torn out. Eyeball as if crushed or
pressed asunder. Sighing as if climbing a steep mountain. As if small of back had been injured. As if right
thumb sprained, as if left ankle sprained, as if first joint of big toe pulled out.
Skin - Herpes zoster. Dropsy. Itching on fingertips, as if frozen.
Temperature - Night sweat.
COMMENTS - “Breath al ways seems to remain sticking in pit of stomach.” This symptom, with “pain as if
sprained in left ankle,” led Lippe to make a remarkable cure in the case of a young woman, 16, who jumped
from a carriage while the horse was running away and sprained her ankle. Left ankle and foot much swollen.
As swelling abated, breathing became rapid, great oppression with constantly recurring desire to take a long
breath, felt as if air inhaled did not reach pit of stomach and until she could force air so far down had to yawn
and try to take a deep inspiration. The tightness, stitches and sticking pains in chest have marked Prun. as a
remedy in many cases of neuralgic pains with or following herpes zoster.
“Flatulence presses on bladder and causes cramps in bladder so that he is obliged to double up.” Strangury.
Hurriedly compelled to pass urine, which seems to pass forward into glans penis and then return and cause
most violent pain in urethra.
Menses are too early, too profuse, last too long, and are thin and watery. There is lectureship, which weakens
and stains yellow. The right side is much more affected than the left.
C.   M. Boger gave the case of a man, 60 with enlarged prostate, had frequent urging to urinate, day and
night. Shooting pains in neck of bladder unless desire to urinate is at c nee gratified.
D.
Urination delayed if any great amount has accumulated.
Spasmodic tenesmus of bladder and rectum at close of urination with pains in glans. Pulsation in glans from
jar of walking. Prun. 1,000c. (Fincke) removed the symptoms.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Laur. (2) Prun- p., bird-cherry - sore throat, pressure behind sternum and sticking
pain in rectum. (3) Pyrus., mountain ash - irritation of eyes, constriction around waist, spasmodic pains in
uterus, bladder, heart, cold-water sensation in stomach, coldness extends up esophagus, neuralgic and gouty
pains.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
keynote:

Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Appetite, lost. Ascites. Breast, pain. Cardiac, dropsy. Choroiditis. Ciliary,
neuralgia. Cystitis. Dropsy. Dyspnea. Dysuria. Earache. Eyes, choroiditis. Flatulent. Glaucoma. Heart, af-
fection. Headaches. Hernia. Herpes zoster. Leucorrhea. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Neuralgias. Sprains.
Strangury. Stricture. Toothache.

name: Prunus Virginiana
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - prun-v. Prunus virginiana. Choke-cherry. Wild cherry. Cerasus virginiana. N. O. Rosaceae.
Tincture of fresh inner bark. Solution of concentrated resinous extract, Prunin. Historical dose: Tincture and
all potencies.
CLINICAL - Acidity. Anorexia. Bronchitis. Coughs. Dyspepsia. Heart, hypertrophy. Heart, weakness.
Heartburn.
HERBAL - Hale said the cold infusion of Prunus virginiana has been used from time immemorial for irregular
intermittent action of the heart with deficient impulse.
HOMEOPATHIC - Prun-v. is a heart tonic. It relieves the flagging and distended ventricle, irritable heart,
dilatation of right heart. Cough, worse at night on lying down. Chronic bronchitis. Weak digestion, especially
in elderly people. Increases muscular tone.
Hale noted it for cough, sympathetic with heart troubles, dyspepsia with tendency to acidity, slow digestion,
loss of appetite and heartburn. Excessive doses have caused a “dull, heavy feeling in head” like that of the
other Pruneae.
 COMMENTS - Seymour Taylor said it is especially useful in dilatation of right heart, whether as a result of
chronic bronchitis or of mitral stenosis.
Burnett used it for weak digestion especially of elderly people. He regarded it as a mild form of Hydr-ac.
Laidlaw gave as a particular indication persistent coughs acquired in winter, worse at night on lying down.
Spasmodic and asthmatic coughs. Attacks of wheezing and whistling in trachea and large bronchi and cough
left behind after an attack of influenza.
Laidlaw's first case was a delicate girl, 20, who took cold, which began with coryza and in a few days passed
into a cough with scanty expectoration and soreness under the sternum. Cough was persistent and annoying
at all times, but worse at night.
After many other remedies had failed, Prun., one grain every two hours, relieved in two days and cured in a
week. A recurrence some months later was rapidly cured by the same remedy.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Psilocybe Caerulescens
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - psil. Psilocybe caerulescens. Psilocybe mushroom. N. O. Strophari- aceae. (Agaricaceae).
Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Aphthae. Coryza. Delusions. Fatigue. Headache. Heat, flushes. Nausea. Palpitations. Salivation.
Sneezing. Tonsillitis. Vertigo. Weakness.
HOMEOPATHIC - Extreme weakness and tiredness. Weakness and nausea. Great weakness after eating,
desire to take a nap, better motion. Flushes of heat at night. Increased sexual desire at night.
Voracious appetite, gets up at midnight to eat. Sour eructations after spicy and fatty food. Sensation of
heaviness in stomach and indigestion, better drinking water. “Slow digestion with sensation of suffocation at
night, better cold drinks.” Thirst, not better drinking.
Dryness. Watery, mucus nasal discharge with sneezing. Throbbing headache, especially on the right side.
Great pain in right shoulder, as if covered with ice.Sexual desire increased, especially in females.
Pains appear and disappear suddenly. Pains pricking and stinging. Fleeting and erratic pains. Pain worse by
small movements rather than by big movements. Painlessness of complaints usually painful. Sensation of
strength.
MIND - Mental weakness. Absent-minded when conversing. Abstraction of mind and fixed eyes. Distraction.
Loses the thread of his conversation. Listens with interest but only some minutes later it occurs to him what
was said. Forgets everything, from lack of involvement, yet without feeling worried about it.
Sadness. “Great depression, recalling the past as if something was left undone, recalling occurrences with
great detail, making one melancholic.” Vindictiveness, “without knowing why or against whom.” “Want of ethical
and religious principles.” Indifference to everything around him.
Idea that one can be in several places at the same time and think differently in each place. Sensation of being
two or three personalities at the same time that cannot fuse, as if looking into several mirrors.
Telepathic speaking with superior spirits. Sensation of being in visual touch with God. Alternatively attracted
to God and the devil. Sensation of being possessed by a divine force.
Involuntary laughing. Feels that someone is spying on him from behind and to the right, which makes him turn
over in an summersault. Sensation of being in the moon. Sensation of being able to resolve whatever problem
of mathematics or being able to understand any language. Thinks he is well.
An old and badly dressed woman looks young and beautiful. Vivid hallucinations of luminous colors. Time
appears shorter, passes too quickly.
Suddenly changing delusions (Cann- i.). Delusion of having creative power. Delusion of being in
communication with God. Delusion of being under a powerful, superhuman influence, alternately by God
Psilocybe caerulescens and the devil. Delusion that he is hovering in the air like a spirit.
Abdomen - Pain in liver after cold food (Mang.).
Back - Coldness as from ice.
Chest - Sudden, paroxysmal palpitations.
Eyes - Sensation of enlargement of left eye (Arg-n.). Burning pain in eyelids on winking.
Food - Thirst, vanishing at sight of water. Worse cold food.
Head - Heaviness in forehead when stooping. Pain, headache, on head getting cold. Headache increasing
gradually. Headache simultaneous with other pains. Pain in forehead from sunlight (Ign.). Pain in temples while
chewing. Pressing pain as if by a band.
Limbs - Desquamating eruption of palms of hands, soles of feet. Itching of soles of feet. Wrinkling of fingertips,
as if dehydrated.
 Modalities - Better from cold. Worse cold, wet weather. Worse in the morning on waking, right side.
Mouth - Aphthae, bleeding easily. Salivation and dryness of tongue. Metallic taste, at tip of tongue, seemingly
originating from the teeth, with sensation as if esophagus were knotted up.
Nose - Violent attacks of coryza. Coryza in warm room. Obstruction and watery discharge. Sneezing in
morning, after rising.
Sensations - Sensation of flying. Sensation of obstruction of nose and watery discharge. Sensation of dryness
of mouth and salivation. Sensation of dryness of throat, not better drinking. Sensation of sweating around the
mouth, but the skin is dry.
Sleep - Falling asleep from weakness. Short sleep refreshes. Sleepiness during pain. Unrefreshing sleep.
Difficult waking in morning. Waking from hunger. Dreams of being robbed and attacked in his own house and
being incapable of defending oneself. Dreams of being chased by a vampire in a big house. Dreams of eating
frogs with thorns and waking up with epigastric pain.
Stomach - Emptiness, weak feeling, better pressure. Nausea, in morning on waking, from odors, while
smoking.
Throat - Sensation of mucus. Mucus in morning on waking. Pain when touched. Dryness of throat, worse
emotions, not better drinking. Inflammation of tonsils from smoking or from tobacco smoke. Constant
disposition to swallow from lump in throat. Weakness of voice after talking.
Vertigo - Vertigo and trembling, better sitting. Vertigo and momentary loss of consciousness. Sensation as if
the earth were slipping away under one's feet. Vertigo with weakness and trembling of legs, tendency to fall to
the right side.
Vision - Colors, black spots during headache (Meli.).
RELATIONS - Compare: Anh., Cann-i., Sulph., Lach., Agar.
REFERENCES - Murphy. Toledo.

name: Psorinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - psor. Psorinum. Scabies nosode. The product of “Psora sicca ” epidermoid efflorescence of
pityriasis by Gross. The salt from a product of psora by Hering. Nosodes. Triturations. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne rosacea. Adenoids. Allergies. Anus, itching. Anxiety. Asthma. Backaches. Bedwetting.
Blepharitis. Boils. Cancer. Cholera infantum. Colds. Cough. Constipation. Cornea, ulcers. Crusta lactea.
Crusta serpiginosa. Debility. Depression. Despair. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Emaciation.
Eruptions, itching. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Gouty. Hay fever. Headaches. Hemorrhages. Hemorrhoid. Hernia.
Hydrocele. Hypoglycemia. Impotency. Influenza. Injuries. Itching. Leucorrhea. Lice. Lienteria. Liver,
disorders. Malnutrition. Melancholy. Nose, redness. Odor, fetid. Ophthalmia. Otorrhea, fetid. Ozaena.
Pericarditis. Peritonitis. Plica polonica. Polyps. Psoriasis. Quinsy. Scabies. Sciatica. Scurvy. Sian, disorders.
Spina bifida. Spleen, disorders. Sprains. Syphilis. Throat, mucus. Tinea, capitis. Tonsils, concretions. Ulcers.
HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Hering prepared this nosode from the sero-purulent matter of scabies vesicles. The
therapeutic field of action is found in the psoric manifestations, when there is a lack of reaction in chronic
diseases, and when well related remedies fail to relieve or to permanently improve.
Psor. chiefly affects the folds of the skin, sebaceous glands, ears, bowels, respiration system and the right
side. Allergies and hay fever. Syphilis, inherited and tertiary. Cardiac weakness. Looseness of joints, teeth.
Prominent skin symptoms. Unhealthy skin. Severe itching, worse at night, heat of bed, worse from wool
clothing. Itching leads to despair. Eczema and psoriasis. Eruptions and rashes disappear in summer,
appear in winter.
Offensive discharges. Thick secretions. Secretions have a filthy smell. Foul discharges, odor of the body,
stools, eruptions, sweat, stubborn foot sweat. Profuse sweating. Easy perspiration when walking. Night-
sweats.
Otorrhea is horribly offensive. Emaciation. Cholera infantum. Diarrhea is profuse, watery, dark brown and even
black and is putrid smelling like carrion.
Debility independent of any organic disease. Prostration after acute disease or after loss of fluids. Feels
good and bad by turns. Feels sick all over. Recurrences of diseases. Hopelessness, despair of recovery. Lack
of reaction, when well-chosen remedies fail to act (Op.).
A cold medicine, wants the head kept warm, wants warm clothing even in summer. Extreme sensitiveness
to cold. Dread of least cold air or draft. Weak, tender and thin. Clothing seems large or he feels pushed
down when walking in the sun. Hungry or unusually well before an attack. Wants to wash parts constantly,
especially hands and feet.
 Scrofulous patients. Nervous, restless persons who are easily startled. Adapted to dirty people with a filthy
smelling body, even after bathing. Pale, sickly, delicate, unhealthy looking children, who have a disagreeable
smell around them.
Sick babies will not sleep day and night but worry, fret and cry or good and play all day, troublesome screaming
all night. Difficulty in breathing when standing in open air, wants to go home and lie down. Enlarged glands.
Often gives immunity from catching colds.
MIND - Dull, beclouded mind. Confusion, better open air. Difficult thinking. Stupefaction. Aversion to work.
Inability for calculating, due to confusion of senses. Vanishing of thoughts after over-lifting. Memory weak,
can't remember, doesn't even know his room. Anxiety and restlessness. Gestures, wringing hands. Anxiety
while riding downhill. Anxiety about salvation. Foreboding. Fears the business will fail. Fearoffire. Fear of being
alone, of becoming insane. Restless during a thunderstorm. Thought pains would drive him crazy.
Pessimism, thinks he is very ill when he is not. Despair of recovery. Despair from itching of skin. Constant
thoughts of dying. Religious melancholy. Horrid thoughts, suicidal tendency. Weeping at night.
Great depression during menopause. Hopelessness. Great despondency, makes one's own life and those
about him intolerable. Forsaken feeling. Sentimental. Melancholy and gloomy. Seeks solitude. Desires to
remain in bed.
Severe ailments from even slight emotions. Thoughts which he can't get rid of constantly reappear in his
dreams. Feels himself poor. Feels his business is going to be a failure, though it is prosperous.
Children very fretful, day and night. Children intolerably self-willed, annoying those about them. Peevish,
irritable, noisy. Easily startled. Irritability on waking at night. Irritability while talking.
Abdomen - Constant feeling of emptiness and looseness in abdomen. Pain in abdomen after eating.
Abdominal affections during menopause, with high degree of ill-humor. Chronic indurations of spleen. Stitches
in spleen better standing, worse moving, and continuing when again at rest. Stinging, sharp, in inguinal glands.
Inguinal hernia. Lumps in right groin.
preventing stooping. Pain through right groin when walking. Griping in abdomen and desire for stool while
riding. Painful bearing down with painful, burning micturition. Sensations as if intestines were hanging down.
Colic better eating and passing fetid flatus. Flatus like bad eggs. Flatulent symptoms with distension.
Back - Backache and debility. Severe backache, as if bruised, can’t straighten out. Backaches after
suppressed eruption. Spina bifida. Boring in vertebrae in morning with colic, as from rheumatism. Bruised
feeling in evening, cannot straighten it. Lumbar ache worse standing or walking. Pain in lumbar region, like
weakness, worse motion. Pressing pain in lumbar region, worse motion. Sticking in back. Drawing pain
extending to shoulder. Tearing and sharp pains between scapulae. Painful stiffness of neck, soreness and
tearing pain on bending backward. Swelling of glands of nape, with bruised pain.
Breasts - Breasts swollen and painful, nipples red. Burning and itching pimples around nipples. Eruptions on
breasts causing excoriation. Breast cancer.
Causations - Poor hygiene and diet. Ill effects of infectious diseases lasting for years. Over-lifting injuries,
blows, sprains, dislocations. Slight emotions cause severe ailments.
Chest - Hot sensation in chest. Pain in chest, better lying down. Feeling of ulceration under sternum. Knife-
like cutting pain in chest. Burning, pressing pain in chest. Dull pressure in right side of chest. Chest expands
with great difficulty. Soreness as if everything were torn in chest. Chest pain extends to shoulder, worse cold
drinks. Anxious oppression in chest every morning. Paroxysmal, in chest, with great anxiety. Eruption in axilla.
Constitutions - Suited to scrofulous, nervous, restless persons who are easily startled. Psoric constitutions,
lack of reaction after severe diseases. Complaints of psoric origin, patients emit a disagreeable odor. Pale,
sickly, delicate children. Peevish, unhealthy-looking children, who have a disagreeable odor about them. Dirty
people in whom the body has a filthy smell which no amount of washing can remove. Those subject to diseases
of the glands and skin and who have had eruptions suppressed.
Cough - Dry, hard cough with great weakness in chest. Severe, dry cough with pain as if everything in chest
were raw and scratched. Cough from tickling in larynx, with soreness under sternum and heaviness on chest.
Coughs a long time before expectorating. Cough from suppressed eruption, talking. Cough worse mornings,
evenings, lying down, drinking. Cough returns every winter.
Ears - Putrid otorrhea, with headache, with offensive watery diarrhea. Moistfetid pus from ears, brownish,
offensive. Ulceration of tympanum. Reddish wax. Raw, red, oozing scabs around ears. Eczema, humid
sores, behind the ears. Offensive discharge from eczema around ears. Intolerable itching. Itching in ears,
child can hardly be kept from picking or boring at meatus. Herpes from temples over ears to cheeks. Severe
pains. Sore pain behind ears. Illusory noises, as if he heard with ears not his own. Impaired hearing with
singing, cracking, humming, buzzing and ringing in ears.
Eyes - Recurring chronic ophthalmia. Acrid secretion. Profuse flow of hot tears. Sharp pains in eyes.
 Soreness of eyes and burning, must close them frequently. Lachrymation. Agglutinated. Gummy. Edges of
eyelids red. Pterygium. Everted eyelids. Blepharitis. Tendency to styes. Objects tremble, then get dark.
Darkness before eyes. Sensation as if something were moving or one were playing with his fingers before
eyes. Aversion to light. Photophobia when walking in open air, walks with eyes bent upon ground.
Face - Pale, delicate, sickly, dirty, fuzzy or puffy. Broad blue rings around eyes. Down on the face. Burning
heat and redness of face. Acne rosacea, red, small pimples, on nose, chin and middle of cheeks. Pimples on
forehead. Coppery eruption on face. Humid eruptions on face. Lips dry, brown, black. Swelling of the upper
lip.
Cheekbones pain as if ulcerated. Soreness of jaw, right side, could not open mouth. Painful tension and
pressure in right zygoma. Submaxillary and sublingual glands swollen, sore to touch.
Female - Amenorrhea. Menses, early and profuse. Menses delayed and scanty. Dysmenorrhea, near
menopause. Menstrual disorders during menopause. Leucorrhea and debility. Fetid leucorrhea, gushing,
lumpy, with violent pain in sacrum, with backache and debility. Pimples oozing an acrid fluid that burns and
excoriates the glands. Ulcers on labia. Pinching pain in pubic region. Obstinate vomiting during pregnancy.
Fetus moves too violently. Flow starts anew when the woman gets on her feet after a miscarriage.
Food - Canine hunger preceding attacks. Very hungry always, must have something to eat in middle of night.
Ravenous appetite, but grows thin. Hypoglycemia. Hungry during attacks of headache. Loss of appetite after
illness with great thirst. Anemia with aversion to food. Generally worse fasting. Desires beer, acids. Aversion
to pork. Dinner tastes oily. Thirst during dinner. Drinking causes cough.
Head - Migraines. Headache as from aheavy blow, follows visual disturbances, better nosebleed. Headaches
from suppressed eruptions, suppressed menses. Chronic headaches, hungry during attacks of vertigo.
Hammering pain. Awakens at night with pain as from blow on head. Dull, pressive pain in occiput. Pain
alternates with other complaints. Brain feels too large, worse change of weather. Head feels separated from
the body. Sensitive to drafts about head, wants it covered in hot weather. Twitching in temples. Whole head
burns. Viscid sweat about head. Humid eruption on scalp, hair matted. Pustules, boils on head. Spots of
white skin with white lock of hair. Dry, lusterless, rough hair. Tangled hair. Head lice. Scurfy eruption of
children.
Heart - Heart murmurs and mitral regurgitation. Gurgling in the heart, worse lying down. Purring in region of
apex, cyanotic lips. Pericarditis. Heart pains, better lying down. Thinks the sharp pains will kill him if they
continue. Stitches in cardiac region, for a moment breathing is impossible. Palpitations with anxiety.
Palpitations in those suffering from hepatic disorders. Pulse weak, feeble, irritable. Weak, irregular pulse.
Kidneys - Has to pass urine several times from weakness of bladder. Burning and cutting pain in urethra.
Frequent, scanty urine. Urine thick, whitish, turbid, red deposit, cuticle forms on surface. Escape of urine when
coughing. Obstinate bedwetting, worse full moon.
Limbs - Caries, rachitis. Chronic forms of rheumatism. Tearing pains. Joints feel loose, weak, as if they would
not hold together. Eruptions around joints, makes walking difficult. Eruptions around fingernails. Hot itching
soles. Fetid foot sweat (Sil.). Hands and feet feel as if broken early in morning and after a little work. Heat in
hands and feet.
Liver - Deep, heavy pain in region of liver, worse pressure or lying onright side, worse sneezing. Stinging,
sharp pain in region of liver and spleen. Flatulence with disorders of liver. Chronic hepatitis.
Lungs - Difficult breathing, when standing in open air. Dyspnea wants to go home and lie down. Shortness of
breath on walking in open air. Anxious dyspnea with palpitations and pain in cardiac region. Asthma with
dyspnea, worse sitting up, better lying down and keeping arms spread wide apart. Asthma, feels as if he would
die. Asthmatic attacks with hydrothorax. Hydrothorax. Tedious recovery in pneumonia. Allergies. Hayfever
returning irregularly every year. Bloody expectoration with hot sensation in chest. Green mucus sputa, worse
mornings when awaking and evenings on lying down. Tenacious mucus, difficult to expel. Green and yellow,
salty taste. Small lumps of mucus.
Male - Offensive genitals. Hydrocele. Inflamed ulcer on glans. Discharge of prostatic fluid before urination.
Chronic, painless discharge from urethra, staining yellow. Griping pain in testes. Drawing pain, in testes and
spermatic cords.
Chronic gonorrhea, painless discharge from urethra staining yellow. Aversion to sex. Impotency. Absence of
erections, parts flabby, torpid. Want of enjoyment of emission during sex. Excessive, uncontrollable sexual
desire.
Modalities - Better heat, warm clothing, even in summer. Better washing, hard pressure, rest, being inaroom.
Betterfrom coffee, profuse sweating, nosebleed. Better from lying with head low or quietly. Better when
eating, but rush of blood to head is worse immediately after. Worse from cold, open air. Worse changing
weather, storms, before thunderstorms. Worse evening, before midnight, night, morning on waking. Worse
 from heat of bed, wool clothes. Worse exertion in hot sunshine, walking, moving, washing. Worse pressure,
rubbing, scratching, touch, contact of own limbs, bandage. Worse from suppressions. Liver is worse lying
on right side. Over-lifting causes thoughts to vanish. Winter causes cough. Summer causes diarrhea, itching
eruptions. Bedwetting is worse periodically, yearly, at the full moon.
Mouth - Mouth inflamed, sore, worse warm food, not annoyed by cold food. Mouth dry, burning. Bad taste in
mouth, better open air. Bitter taste, better eating or drinking. Filthy taste. Tough mucus of foul taste adheres
to soft palate. Gums, bleed, spongy, settled away from the teeth. Pyorrhea. Cyanotic lips. Burning, painful
vesicles inside lower lip. Obstinate cracks in corners of mouth.
Neck - Glands of neck swollen, bruised pain extending to head on touch. Sticking in neck with pustules.
Herpetic eruption on side of neck extending from cheek. Nape excoriated by discharge from eczema capitis.
Nose - Recurring colds. Allergies. Hay fever, regularly returning every year. Hay fever coming on in August.
Watery acrid discharges. Dry, coryza with stoppage of nose. Coryza with loss of smell. Chronic catarrh,
dropping from posterior sinuses. Tough mucus in nose. Burning pain followed by thin nasal discharge, which
relieves. Nose sensitive when inhaling air. Bloody, purulent discharge. Smell of blood. Septum inflamed, white,
suppurating pustules. Small, red pimples. Acne rosacea.
Perspiration - Profuse sweats, improves all complaints. Colliquative sweats. Sour, clammy sweats. Easy,
profuse sweat, worse night. Profuse, offensive at night. Sudden outbreaks of sweat on slight exertion, which
is offensive, followed by debility and easily taking cold. Sweats easily on limbs. Sweats if he turns in bed. Heat
with steaming sweat. Sweats on face, palms of hands and perineum when moving about. Cold sweat, on
palms. Lack of perspiration and dry skin.
Rectum - Constipation with pain in lumbar region. Obstinate constipation with coryza and obstruction of nose.
Constipation of infants in pale, sickly scrofulous children. Cholera infantum. Chronic diarrhea, early morning,
urgent. Involuntary stools with sleep. Soft, difficult stools, has to go several times to pass normal stools. Hard,
difficult stool with blood from rectum. Desire for stool when riding. Soreness in rectum and anus when riding.
Burning in rectum. Burning hemorrhoids. Hemorrhages from rectum in old women.
Sensations - As if frightened. As if he would lose his senses. As if stupid in left half of head. As if brain had
not room enough in forehead. As from heavy blow on forehead. As if brain would protrude. As if sand in eyes.
Eyes as if pressed outward. As if he heard with ears not his own. Cheekbones as if ulcerated. Condyle of jaw
as if lame. Tongue as if burnt. Teeth as if glued together. Plug in throat. Throat as if narrowing. As if intestines
hanging down.
Skin - Unhealthy skin. Abnormal tendency to skin diseases. Sebaceous glands secrete excessively, oily skin.
Urticaria, worse exertion. Crusty eruptions all over. Herpetic eruptions, especially on scalp and bends of joints,
with itching. Eruptions bleed easily and constantly tend to suppurate. Dirty, rough, scabby, greasy, breaks out
in folds. Eczema behind ears. Pemphigus.
Psoriasis. Intolerable itching, worse heat of bed. Scratches raw or until it bleeds. Rubbing skin causes small
vesicles to arise. Condylomata on edges of skin. Pustules near fingernails. Indolent ulcers, slow to heal.
Suppressed eruptions. Enlarged glands. Scabies. Recurring body lice. Burning itching pustule after
vaccination. Skin troubles disappear in summer, only to occur again in winter.
Sleep - Easily started. Sleepy by day. Sleepless from anxiety and despair./rozn intolerable itching, from
congestion to head. Sleepless after 12 p.m. In morning lies in same position as when he fell asleep. On waking,
can't get rid of the one persistent thoughts from dreams. Vivid dreams, continue after waking. Dreams of
robbers, danger, traveling.
Stomach - Hypoglycemia. Very hungry always, must have something to eat in the middle of the night.
Weakness of stomach. Cramps in stomach. Sharp stinging pain in pit. Water brash when lying down, better
getting up. Sour, rancid belchings, tasting and smelling like rotten eggs. Eructations, sour, rancid, room is filled
with an offensive odor. Nausea after suppressed itch. Nausea all day, in morning, with pain in lumbar region.
Vomiting first of blood, then of sour, slimy fluid. Vomiting of sweet mucus every morning at 10 a.m. and in
evening. Nausea, vomiting of pregnancy.
Stool - Hot flatus, smelling like rotten eggs. Stools like rotten eggs or carrion, worse at night. Mucus stools.
Stools bloody, excessively fetid, dark fluid, brown, horribly putrid, gushing. Stools have a penetrating
odor, going through the whole house. Involuntary stools during sleep. Diarrhea after severe acute disease.
Fetid diarrhea during dentition.
Teeth - Teeth stick together as if glued, from tough mucus in mouth. Looseness of teeth, fears they may fall
out, worse touch. Sensations of soreness of teeth. Stitching pain in teeth from one side to other. Toothache
worse at night and from cold, better warmth. Gums bleed, spongy, settled away from teeth. Pyorrhea.
Temperature - Internal shivering, creeping chills and icy cold feet. Chilliness in evening, on upper arms and
thighs, with thirst. Sudden heat over whole body, with trickling sweat all over face. Fever with steaming sweat.
 Fever at night, with dryness of mouth. Fever when riding in a carriage. Thirst during chill and heat.
Throat - Throat burns, feels scalded. Tension and swollen feeling in throat. Dryness of throat in morning.
Recurring quinsy. Eradicates tendency to quinsy. Tonsils greatly swollen, painful swallowing with pain in
ears. Tonsillitis with swelling of submaxillary glands and fetid otorrhea. Profuse, offensive saliva, tough mucus
in throat. Hawking up of cheesy, pea-like balls of disgusting smell and taste (Agar.). Sensation as if a plug in
throat impeding hawking. Sensations of suffocation, with paroxysmal, dry, hacking cough. Tickling, throat as if
narrowing, must cough to better it. Hoarseness when talking, phlegm sticks in larynx. Voice weak, trembling,
talking very fatiguing. Herpetic eruption on side of neck extending from cheek.
Tongue - Tip of tongue feels scalded. Tongue thickly covered with whitish- yellow slime. Tongue, gums
ulcerated. Tough mucus of foul taste adheres to soft palate.
Vertigo - Vertigo in morning. Vertigo, objects seem to go around with him. Vertigo with headache, eyes feel
pressed outwards. Vertigo with confusion and drawing in forehead, and roaring in ears.
Vision - Sensation as if something were moving or one were playing with his fingers before eyes. Objects
seem to tremble for a few moments, then get dark. Obscuration, with ringing in ears. Fiery sparks. Misty, after
anxiety. Black spots or rings, flickering, dancing about of objects, before headache. Blurs and blue stars, during
headache.
COMMENTS-Psoric manifestations. Similar symptoms to Sulph., particularly for psora conditions, itch and
itch-like eruptions. Exceedingly chilly, likes to have a fur cap on in summer (Sulph. is hot).
H. C. Allen noted that Psor. is indicated in chronic cases when well-selected remedies fail to relieve or to
permanently improve (in acute diseases, Sulph.), and when Sulph. seems indicated but fails to relieve. Clears
up confused cases. Useful as an intercurrent, when indicated remedies palliate or fail to act.
Feeble reactions, lack of reaction. Weakness from loss of fluids, after acute disease, with or without organic
lesion. Debilitated, worse exertion. Weak since loss of fluid. Emaciation. Feels unusually well before attacks,
sense of well being. Lies with arms out, as if crucified (Puls.). Whole body painful, easily sprained and inured.
Unhealthy skin. Skin is dirty looking, scurfy. Sores refuse to heal. Severe eczema, psoriasis, dermatitis.
Scabies. Lice, worms, parasites. Bruises and scars easily (Sulph.). Rough skin, cracks and sores (Petr.). Scaly
skin. Skin will ooze and crust. Sallow and greasy face, several pustules on chin and neck that itch intensely
and bleed when scratched.
Constant irritation. Formication. Itch and scratch until they bleed (Alum.). Wandering itching. Tormenting,
despairing itching, drives a person crazy, especially at night and in bed. Can pick at skin. Can't stand clothes
or the covers. Skin problems along the hairline with inflammation and itching. Dry, lusterless hair, plica
polonica. Scabs, pus, seborrheic dermatitis (Graph., Mez.).
Extreme dullness. Fears inflammation of brain, better by nosebleed. Dull, heavy pain in the base of brain, in
the afternoon. Headache better by eating, nosebleed, suppressed menses. Very hungry during headaches.
Headache following darkness before eyes. Black spots before eyes.
Chronic colds from little drafts and getting chilled easily. Chronic bronchitis with severe shortness of breath.
Quinsy, throat burns, feels scalded. Tendency to quinsy. Cutting, tearing, intense pain on swallowing. Profuse,
offensive saliva, tough mucus in throat, must hawk continually. Hay fever. Allergies. Allergic to wool (Sulph.).
Sudden gnawing hunger. Wakes up in the middle of the night hungry. Large appetite, but loses weight.
Malnutrition. Starvation (Sil., Calc-p., Calc.). Low blood sugar. Aversion to pork (Puls.). Desires acids. Thirst
for beer. Chronic headaches with hunger (Anae.). Worms that irritate the colon (Cina.).
Sensation as though skin of abdomen was greatly relaxed and drawn down. Decomposition. Belching like
rotten eggs (Arn., Chin., Carb-v.). Flatus with pungent, carrion-like odor. Smell penetrates the room. Horribly
offensive, nearly painless, almost involuntary, dark and watery stool, only in night and most towards morning.
Cracking and bleeding anal fissures.
Vertigo with poor circulation. Dizzy after exertion. Great sensitiveness to cold air, change, storms, sun. Lack
of vital heat. Steaming perspiration. Restless for days before a thunderstorm. Symptoms are worse during
menses from fats, sugar, coffee, meat. Dislikes bathing.
Depression, mental anguish. Very insecure. Possessive. Sense of depletion. Anxious about health. Despair
about survival. Fear of poverty, of the future, of being forsaken. Ailments from illness, malnourishment,
nutritional weakness, lack of hygiene.
Sick babies will not sleep day or night, but worry, fret, cry or good and play all day, restless, troublesome,
screaming all night.
Clarke frequently saw Psor. develop its own symptoms in patients whom it has benefited in other ways. A man
who complained of “cloudiness of mind and difficult thinking,” and who had, among other symptoms, his “left
foot colder than right,” received Psor. 30c. It removed these symptoms, but while under its influence new
symptoms appeared, including a heavy headache across the eyebrows, and greasiness of face and forehead.
 Hahnemann noted the symptom “spasmodically contracting headache.” A woman to whom Clarke gave Psor.
30c complained that after each dose she had a feeling “as if something in the head were being screwed up
and drawn.”
A patient who took Psor. 500c complained that it had a “filthy taste.” Psor. 20,000c. has produced an eruption
of boil-like indurations in both axillae, first in the left then in right. The general symptoms were relieved at the
same time.
Clarke noted that Psor. cured more cases of hay fever than any other single remedy in his practice. Many
cases have a psoric basis and when the basic taint is corrected, the irritating agents have no effect. Nasal
polyps have also been cured with Psor. when the general symptoms indicate the remedy.
Hawley reported a case of cholera infantum that seemed to defy every remedy. Stools were very thin and
watery, dirty greenish, smelled like carrion. Child was very fretful and had no sleep for two days and nights.
Hawley gave Psor. 42,000c (Fincke), one dose in water. In two hours the child went to sleep, in four days it
was well without repetition of the dose.
Hawley also had the case of Miss N., 20, who had an eruption in the bends of elbows and knees. It was dry,
scaly, with little pointed vesicles around the reddened edges. It disappeared entirely in summer and
reappeared when cold weather set in. Violent itching, worse by warmth of bed or by scratching. Psor. 42,000c,
two doses at six weeks interval, cured, it did not return the following winter.
Wesselhoeft observed that headaches and eruptions were worse during changeable weather.
Miss C., when convalescing from typhoid fever, reported that she was “stationary, no appetite.” Psor. 400c
produced immediate change and ravenous appetite.
Mr. P., age 50, complained of nothing but weakness, no appetite, least exertion put him into a perspiration.
Psor. 40c cured rapidly.
Mr. X., age 21, was obliged one day to run until nearly exhausted. Though strong and well before, he now
became weak, perspiring easily, severe pains on right side, worse by coughing, laughing and motion. Psor.
40c cured rapidly.
Mr. C., age 43, was spare, dark. Hypochondriacal. “Nervous” nine months, had to give up business, took
quinine and other drugs. Complained of a very disagreeable feeling about the head and manifested mental
depression, thought he would neverrecover, lost all hope.
Could not apply his mind to business. Seemed confused, could not reckon. Numbness of legs and arms, worse
left side, worse going to bed, formication and crawling with prickling and smarting on scalp and on limbs.
Tongue coated white.
After three months, treatment was stationary. It was then ascertained that he sweated very easily on least
exertion and somewhat at night, and had loss of memory. Psor. 400c soon caused improvement and enabled
“the patient to return to business.”
G.      A. Whippy cured with Psor. 200c, a dose every third night, the case of acarpenter, 40, with a long-
standing discharge of reddish cerumen from left ear, worse at night. There was a sensation of a valve opening
and shutting in left ear, worse afternoon. Buzzing in ear, which stopped suddenly and was followed by violent
itching.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ped. - psoric manifestations in chi Idren. Eruption on dorsum of hands, feet,
neck. Prurigo, pellagra. Unusual aptitude for study and work. (2) Ped. - transmit typhus and trench fever. (3)
In lack of reaction compare Op., Calc, and Nat-ar. (4) Gaert. Complementary: Sulph.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.
keynote:
PHARMACY - psor. Psorinum. Scabies nosode. The product of “Psora sicca ” epidermoid efflorescence of
pityriasis by Gross. The salt from a product of psora by Hering. Nosodes. Triturations. Historical dose: All
potencies.
CLINICAL - Acne rosacea. Adenoids. Allergies. Anus, itching. Anxiety. Asthma. Backaches. Bedwetting.
Blepharitis. Boils. Cancer. Cholera infantum. Colds. Cough. Constipation. Cornea, ulcers. Crusta lactea.
Crusta serpiginosa. Debility. Depression. Despair. Diarrhea. Diphtheria.

name: Ptelea Trifoliata
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ptel. Ptelea tnfoliata. Hop tree. Shrubby trefoil. Water ash. Wafer ash. N. O. Xanthoxylaceae
of the Rutaceae. Tincture of bark of root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL-Asthma-AscarWes. Bilious,headaches. Constipation. Dysentery. Dyspepsia. Erysipelas.
Gallstones. Gastric, headaches. Headaches. Intermittent, fever. Jaundice. Liver, disorders. Nightmares.
Phosphaturia. Rheumatism. Spleen, disorders. Stomach,
Ptelea tnfoliata pain. Urticaria. Worms.
HERBAL - Ptelea is the Greek name for the Elm and was applied by Linnaeus to a genus of shrubs and small
trees, natives of North America and Asia and included in Xanthoxylaceae. The Treasury of Botany noted that
the fronds are bitter and aromatic, and have been used as a substitute for hops.
In Canada, the young green shoots of Ptelea are used as an anthelmintic in the form of an infusion. One of
the provers of Ptelea confirmed its anthelmintic powers by “a very copious expulsion of ascarides.”
HOMEOPATHIC - The proving was very thorough and extensive, and T. Nichol, Burt and Cowperthwaite were
 among the provers. Marked action on the liver and in those erysipelatous and urticaria eruptions that are so
often concomitant with disorders of the liver.
Ptel. is a remarkable remedy in stomach and liver disorders. Atonic states of stomach. The aching and
heaviness in the region of the liver is greatly aggravated by lying down on the left side. Stomach and liver
symptoms associated with pain in limbs. Worms. Ravenous hunger, empty sensation in esophagus and
stomach.
Taste bitter and belchings either bitter or like rotten eggs. Aching and heaviness in the region of liver worse
lying on left side. Headache with hunger, especially on awaking, may prove a keynote. Right (liver) side most
affected.
Asthma. Difficult breathing coming on as gastric symptoms improve. Alternating symptoms. Nervous pains
alternated from left arm to left eye and temple. Liveliness alternates with sadness. Sensitive to light, sound,
open air. Enlarged feelings, head feels large, fingers feel numb and large and clumsy.
Abdomen - Much weight and pain in right side, heavy, aching feeling, relieved by lying on right side. Retraction
of abdomen.
Ears - Swelling of gland under right ear, sharp pain behind ear. Shooting pains from left ear down spine.
Intolerance of loud talking. Roaring and singing in ears.
Eyes - Eyes heavy. Pressure over eyes, worse lifting eyebrows. Pains over eyes. Sensitiveness to light.
Face - Face pale, especially around eyes, sickly, yellow. Burning in face.
Food - Appetite voracious. Tired before finishing eating. Desire for acid food. Aversion to meat, butter and rich
food. Thirsty, drank much water. Absence of thirst with bitter taste.
Head - Feels dull and stupid. Pain from forehead to root of nose, pressing-outward pain. Frontal
headache, worse noise, motion, night, rubbing eyes with acidity. Temples as if pressed together. Headache
better after stool.
Limbs - Edema of feet and legs with liver disorders. Stomach and liver symptoms associated with pain in
limbs.
Liver - Liver congestion. Liver sore, swollen, sensitive to pressure. Weakness of liver.
Lungs - Feeling of pressure on lungs and of suffocation, when lying on back. Asthma, dyspnea, cramp-like
pain in cardiac region.
Modalities - Better eating sour, acid things. Better in cold air, morning and evening. Worse lying down, lying
on left side, after sleep, on waking, early morning, afternoon. Worse in hot room, walking, speaking, mental
exertion, moving eyes, raising eyebrows. Worse after eating, cheese, butter, meat, puddings. Worse before,
during, and after stool.
Mouth - Excess of saliva with dry, bitter taste. Tongue coated white or yellow, feels rough, swollen. Papillae
red and prominent (Arg-n.). Coating may be brownish-yellow. Breath, hot, burns the nostrils.
Nose - Sneezing. Nose stopped, sore, breath burns and irritates nostrils. Influenza.
Rectum - Pressure in rectum, urging to stool. Stool followed by tenesmus and succeeded by itching and
smarting at anus. Smarting in anus after hard stool, with diarrhea stool.
Sleep - Restlessness with frightful dreams, nightmares. Awakes languid and unrefreshed.
Stomach - Stomach feels empty after eating. Weight and fullness. Heat, dryness and distressing feeling of
emptiness in esophagus. Constant sensation of corrosion, heat and burning in stomach. Belching, nausea and
vomiting.
Throat - Dryness, roughness, heat, constriction in throat. Throat sore, ulcerated, worse right side. Burning and
pricking pains, especially in tonsils.
COMMENTS - Hale said Ptel. has not the violent action of Podo, or Iris-v., but “a slow, pervading” action and
causes chronic ailments. He found it useful in “bilious headache, dyspepsia, gastralgia, congestion of the liver,
chronic hepatitis and chronic erysipelas.” Others used it in chronic rheumatism, dysentery and constipation.
Hale said the oily constituent of Ptel. resembles turpentine and one of the most marked symptoms of the
proving is: “Pressure as from a stone in pit of stomach,” recalling Abies-n. and the conifers. In the proving, the
liver was swollen and tender, but it was better lying on right side and worse lying on left
H.    K. Leonard cured a seemingly hopeless case with Ptel. lx on the symptom weight, aching distress, dull
pain in hepatic region, better lying on right side, turning on left causes a dragging as if liver pulling on its
ligaments. The dull, muddled headed feeling is another liver symptom.
J.   Preston cured with Ptel. a case of jaundice following gallstones with great emaciation. Aching distress,
general aching and soreness, malaise.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Merc., Mag-m., Nux-v., Chef
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.
 ***PUERARIA LOBATA
(Kudzu Vine)
PHARMACY - puer. Pueraria lobata. Kudzu Vine. Kuzu. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Alcoholism. Anemia. Asthma. Bronchitis. Constipation. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Edema.
Enteritis. Fevers. Hangovers. Headaches. Hypoglycemia. Impotence. Infertility. Influenza. Insect, bites.
Measles. Migraines. Pneumonia. Sinus, problems. Snake, bites. Tonsillitis.
HERBAL - Traditional Asian herbalists have long valued kudzu's root and flowers for treating colds, flu, high
blood pressure, chest pain, allergies, and a host of other ailments. Research indicates that a compound in the
root (an isoflavone called puerarin) may also increase blood flow to the heart and brain which may explain
certain traditional uses.
In traditional Chinese medicine, kudzu has been used to relieve muscle pain. Animal studies and some human
case reports suggest that kudzu may have some antiinflammatory effects.
Chemicals in kudzu may also lower the heart rate and regulate its rhythm, as well as widen the blood vessels
near the heart and the brain. This may support its uses in heart conditions and for the treatment of migraine
headaches.
HOMEOPATHIC - Other medicinal uses for kudzu include influenza, cough, colds, tonsillitis, measles, and
fevers. Bronchitis, pneumonia. Asthma. Sinus problems.
Lack of energy. Sexual apathy, impotence, infertility. Muscle shrinking. Dizziness. Headaches, migraines.
Hangovers. Diaphoretic. Removal of excess fluids from the body. Anemia, internal bleeding. Snake and insect
bites.
Thirst, hunger. Bad breath. Diarrhea, dysentery, intestinal ailments, enteritis, constipation, and digestive
disorders. Diabetes. Can reduce blood sugar levels and result in hypoglycemia when taken in large amounts.
Strengthens the spleen, stomach and intestines, as well as the entire immune system.
RELATIONS - Compare: Nux-v., Sul-ac., Lach.
REFERENCES - Murphy. Yui.

name: Pulexirritans
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - pulx. Pulex irritans. Common flea. Insecta. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Abdomen, bloated. Headache. Leucorrhea. Salivation.
HOMEOPATHIC - Pulx. has marked urinary and female symptoms. Cannot retain urine, must attend the call
immediately. Stains of menses and leucorrhea are very hard to wash out. As if cotton ball inside the vagina.
MIND - Very impatient. Restlessness. Cross and irritable, does not want to be looked at or spoken to. Memory
confused. Cannot think. When walking has a sensation of lightness. Glad feeling, as though she had heard
good news. Felt a dread of going to bed.
Back - Backache (Ox-ac.). Back weakness. Drawing of muscles below scapula.
Eyes - Eyes feel as if enlarged.
Face - Face wrinkled and old-looking.
Female - Menses delayed. Increased flow of saliva during menses. Leucorrhea, profuse, foul, staining a
greenish yellow, stains of menses and leucorrhea very hard to wash out. Intense burning in vagina.
Food - Thirst, especially during headache.
Head - Frontal headache with enlarged feeling of eyes. Very impatient, cross and irritable.
Kidneys - Urine scanty with frequent urging with pressure in bladder and tenesmus in urethra. Cannot retain
urine, must attend to the call without delay. Irritable bladder before menses. Urine foul. Flow of urine stops
suddenly, followed by pain.
Modalities - Better sitting or lying down. Worse left side, moving about.
Mouth - Metallic taste. Sensation of a thread in throat. Thirsty, especially during headache.
Skin - Sore spots all over. Prickly itching. Skin emits foul odor.
Stomach - Breath and taste foul. Intense nausea with vomiting, purging and faintness. Stool very offensive.
Temperature - Feels a glow all over, like being over steam. Chilly, sitting near by fire.
Throat - As if a thread hanging in throat.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Pulmo Vulpis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - pulm-v. Pulmo vulpis. Fox's lung. Sarcode. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Asthma. Bronchitis. Dyspnea. Catarrh. Heart, disease. Lungs, catarrh. Lungs, edema. Shortness
 of breath.
HOMEOPATHIC - The uses of tissues and organs as remedies have thrown light on many curiosities of ancient
medicine. As the fox is probably the longest-winded of all animals, the doctrine of signatures pointed to his
lungs as a likely remedy for short breath.
Pulm-v. has persistent shortness of breath, causing a attack of asthma on the slightest motion. Strong,
sonorous bubbling rales.
COMMENTS - Grauvogl put on record his case of a women, 65, much reduced in flesh by a persistent condition
of humid asthma. It commenced with chronic catarrh and symptoms of edema of the lungs.
Strong, sonorous bubbling, rattling, whistling sounds over whole chest and at some distance away, perceptible
also to hand laid on chest. Accelerated short breath amounting to suffocation, even without corresponding
heaving of the chest, frequently with cough and inability to expectorate.
Sometimes in light cases, there is no catarrh present and only persistent shortness of breath, becoming a
paroxysm of asthma on the least bodily exertion. The patient could only live sitting up, bent forward, constant
lividity of face, lips and limbs and dropsy of legs.
Heart's pulsations irregular and death seemed imminent. Pulm-v. lx grains right was given and repeated in an
hour. Visible improvement set in but without increased expectoration. After a third powder the patient was able
to lie down and fell into a refreshing sleep lasting several hours. In eight days she engaged in her domestic
duties.
REFERENCES - Clarke.
