name: Ruta Graveolens
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ruta. Ruta graveolens. Garden rue. Bitterwort. N. O. Rutaceae. Tincture of whole fresh plant.
Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amblyopia. Anus, prolapse. Arthritis. Asthenopia. Backache. Bedwetting. Bone, bruised.
Bruises. Bursitis. Cancer. Carpal tunnel Cartilages, bruises, pains. Chest, pains. Constipation. Dislocated,
joints. Dyspepsia. Exostosis. Eye-strain. Facial paralysis. Fevers. Fractures. Ganglions. Hemorrhages.
Hands, pains. Injuries. Joint, injuries. Lameness. Nosebleeds. Paralysis. Perichondritis. Periostitis. Rectum,
cancer. Rectum, prolapsed. Restlessness. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Spleen, disorders. Sprains. Stammering.
Strains. Tendonitis. Tongue, swelling. Urination, difficulty. Varicocele. Veins, swollen, varicose. Vision, weak.
Warts.
HERBAL - The common rue is a native of southern Europe. Teste noted that it was formerly in great repute in
medicine for epilepsy, hysteria, hydrophobia and weakness of sight from excessive reading. Ozaena,
nosebleed, foul gumboils, flatulent colic, and inertia of the bowels have been cured with it empirically.
Teste added that Ruta graveolens was supposed to be a kind of universal antidote, “Even in our own time the
Roman ladies imagine that the most odoriferous flowers may be left in their rooms without the least danger
provided a bush of garden rue be amongst them.”
Practitioners have perhaps been deterred from employing it by the symptoms of acrid- narcotic poisoning
induced by an overdose. It is noted, in The Treasury of Botany, that locally applied rue is a powerful irritant
and one species, Ruta montana, is dangerous to handle even with gloves
Green’s Herbal mentioned that Ruta is “useful in feverish complaints, promotes perspiration and removes
noxious material in headache, nervous and hysteric complaints, weakness of the stomach and pains in the
bowels, suppressed menses and if taken for a long time it benefits epilepsy. The expressed juice benefits
nightmare.”
M. Helie indicated that, in large doses, it causes violent gastric pains, excessive and sometimes bloody
vomiting, profuse salivation and swelling of the tongue. Great prostration and confusion of the mind. Convulsive
twitchings and, in pregnant women, miscarriage.
HOMEOPATHIC - Hahnemann’s proving showed how largely the old uses were founded on a homeopathic
relationship. The vulnerary remedies indicate in symptoms of their provings the peculiar form of injuries for
which they are adapted.
Like the sprained pains of Rhus-t. and the bruised pains (in skin and muscles) of Arn., Ruta also has bruised
pains, but these are more particularly manifested in bones. Historically, it was used to ward off plague.
Affinity for fibrous tissue, flexor tendons, joints, ankles, wrists, cartilages, periosteum, uterus and skin. Acts
upon the eyes and uterus. Eyestrain. Overstrain of ocular muscles. Jaundice.
For injured joints, tendons, bones and especially bruised bones. Rheumatism. Tendonitis. Formation of
deposits or nodes in the periosteum, tendons and about the joints especially wrists. Brittle bones. Lain on parts
become sore, even in bed.
The pains are bruised, sore, aching with restlessness, a feeling of intense, painful weariness. Lameness
after sprains. Sprains with weakness in joint (Arn.). Complaints from straining flexor tendons especially.
All parts of the body are painful, as if bruised.
Heaviness, as of a weight in forehead or hanging to feet or lower limbs. As of a rough blunt plug in part, head,
nose etc. Paralytic rigidity. Distortions. Grating, burning pains, neuralgia.
MIND - Stupefaction. Thought and comprehension slow. Feeling of intense lassitude, weakness and
despair. Indifference. Disinclined to work. Quarrels and contradicts. Inclined to anger and vexation. Morose,
peevish, fretful. Disposed to weep.
 Frequent anxiety, with despondent thoughts and fear. Fear of death during fever. Anxious restlessness.
Anxious all day, as though he had done something wrong. Fear that someone will come to arrest him.
Melancholy, dissatisfied with life, and sad. Dissatisfied with himself and others. Mistrustful. Suspicious,
imagines that he is always being deceived. Delusion someone is behind him. Starting from sleep from slightest
touch. Desire for light.
Abdomen - Painful swelling of the spleen. Gnawing ache in region of liver. Gnawing and eating pain about
navel. Sick feeling in abdomen followed by soft stools. Pinching pain in abdomen after bread and butter. Cancer
of lower bowel. Colic in children, from worms.
Back - Backache from injury or strain, better pressure and lying on back. Bruised pain in coccyx, sacrum.
Spine and limbs feel bruised. Vertebrae slip out of place easily. Coldness of spine, downwards. Drawing in
nape of neck and in the shoulder blades. Tension and pressure in nape and shoulders. Pain in small of back,
groin and nape. Weak, bruised feeling in lower back. Lumbago worse morning before rising. Stitches in lumbar
region.
Bladder - Constant urging to urinate, can hardly retain urine. If urine forcibly retained, could not pass
afterwards, with severe pain. Urging with scanty urination. Sensations as if bladder were still full, after urinating.
Pressure in neck of bladder after urinating, painful closure (Apis). Sensations as if bladder is moving up and
down at every step. Scanty, green urine. Frequent urination at night. Incontinence at night, or even during day
when walking.
Causations - Ill effects of bruises, fractures, carrying heavy weights. Bone or joint injuries. Overuse of tendons.
Sprains. Going up and down stairs causes hamstrings
 _________________ Ruta graveolens to feel shortened and weak. Dyspepsia from straining stomach by
carrying heavy weights. Over-exertion of eyes.
Chest - Short breath with tightness of chest. Painful spot on sternum. Sensation of coldness or heat in chest.
Gnawing, biting and burning pains in chest. Tuberculosis after mechanical injuries to chest. Ill effects of
mechanical injury to chest.
Constitutions - Suited to robust, bloody persons and corresponds to hemorrhages from nose (with pressure
at root), gums, and rectum.
Ears - Earache with scraping pressure. Itching lancinations in ear. Cartilages of ears as if bruised. Pain in ear
and under mastoid process as from a bruise. Pain as from a blunt piece of wood.
Eyes - Amblyopia. Asthenopia. Weakness of ciliary muscles. Spots on cornea. Eyes burn like fire.
Lachrymation in open air, not indoors. Pressure deep in orbits. Eyestrain with headaches. Weary pain while
reading. Red, hot and painful from reading fine print, sewing (Nat-m., Arg- n.). Itching inner canthi. Tarsal
cartilage feels bruised. Spasm in lower eyelids, when it ceases, lachrymation starts. Pressure over eyebrow.
Face - Acne. Acne rosacea. Eruption of pimples on lips. Lips dry and sticky. Pain as if bruised in periosteum
of facial bones. Spasmodic tearing in cheekbone. Itching and gnawing at face and on cheeks. Coldness
beneath left eye. Erysipelas in forehead with swelling. Facial paralysis after catching cold.
Female - Menses very irregular. Menses scanty, lasting but two days, preceded and followed by leucorrhea.
Corrosive leucorrhea after irregular or suppressed menses. Symptoms worse at menstrual period. Vaginal
pruritus. Bearing-down pains. Prolapsed uterus. Metrorrhagia as a forerunner of miscarriage. Miscarriage, at
seven months. Lameness and soreness all over with feeble contractions during labor. Sterility.
Food - Appetite normal, but aversion to everything as soon as he begins to eat. Disgust at first mouthful with
a sensation of fullness and satiety in abdomen. Great thirst during chill. Violent thirst for ice cold water.
Headache from abuse of alcohol. Worse after eating bread, butter, eating meat, grapes, raw or indigestible
food.
Head - Heat in head, with anxious restlessness. Headachefrom eye-strain. Stitches, worse reading. Aches
as if a nail is driven into it. Pain as from a nail after excessive intoxicating drinks. Pressure over eyebrow.
Pulsative, pressive, in forehead. Head externally painful, as if bruised or beaten. Periosteum sore. Erysipelas
and swelling of forehead. Erysipelas of scalp, arising from wounds. Corrosive itching on scalp. Humid scabs
on head.
Heart - Anxious palpitations. Pulse somewhat accelerated only during fever.
Limbs - Bursitis. Cracking in joints, worse walking in open air. Paralytic weakness of legs after spraining of
the back. Sciatica, worse lying down at night, pain from back down hips and thighs. Hamstrings feel
shortened (Graph.). Great restlessness. Thighsfeel broken, worse when stretching the legs. Legs give out
on rising from a chair (Phos., Con.). Knees give way, while ascending and descending stairs. Pains as if
deep in long bones, must walk about. Tendons sore. Aching pain in Achilles tendon. Pain in bones of feet and
ankles. Ankles swollen from strain or injury. Contraction of fingers. Pain and stiffness in wrists and hands.
Ganglion of wrist (Benz-ac., Calc-f.). Nodes in palms.
 Lungs - Cough with copious, thick, yellow expectoration, chest feels weak after. Waking from cough, about
midnight. Violent cough, with expectoration of tough mucus and nausea. Shortness of breath from tightness
of chest.
Male - Varicocele following a strain. Injury to genitals, testes. Hematocele in which the effusion is small and
firmly coagulated.
Modalities - Better from lying on back. Better warmth, motion, rubbing, scratching. Worse from overexertion,
lifting, injury, sprains. Worse exertion, ascending or descending stairs. Worse lying down, sitting, stooping.
Worse eyestrain, reading. Worse pressure on an edge. Worse from cold air, damp, wind, wet. Worse during
menses. Worse from uncooked
Ruta graveolens or indigestible food. Warm stove causes chilliness.
Mouth - Woody taste. Dryness in mouth and throat. Mouth dry and glutinous. Profuse salivation and swelling
of tongue. Cramp in tongue, causing embarrassment of speech. Boring pains in lower teeth. Gums bleed
easily.
Nose - Pressive, hard aching at the root of nose, with nosebleed. Perspiration on back of nose.
Perspiration - Cold sweat on face. Perspires in morning in bed. Sweats after walking in open air.
Rectum - Constipation from impaction of feces following mechanical injuries. Constipation, alternating with
mucous, frothy stools, discharge of blood with stool. Difficult stool, evacuated only with straining. Feces often
escape when stooping. Protrusion of rectum when stooping. When sitting, tearing stitches in rectum. Urging to
stool, causing rectum prolapses. Rectal prolapse. Sudden prolapsus recti, with tenesmus, after eating grapes.
Anal prolapse on stooping. Anal prolapse after delivery, during hard or soft stools. Stricture of rectum. Cancer
affecting lower bowel. Nausea felt in rectum.
Sensations - As if a nail were driven into head. Head as if bruised or beaten. Eyes, as if strained, as if a
shadow flitting before them, as after looking too long and intently at an object, as if eyes were balls of fire. As
if one were digging about in the ear with a blunt piece of wood. As of a lump in throat. Bladder as if constantly
full. Spine as if beaten and lame. Pain as if from a fall in periosteum. As if pain were in marrow of bone or as
if bone were broken. Wrists as if sprained. Thighs as if beaten, as if weak. As if there were an ulcer on ankle.
All parts of body bruised at night, feeling as if it were time to rise.
Skin - Easily chaffed from walking, riding, also in children. Flat, smooth, painful warts, on palms. Warts with
sore pains. Corrosive itching over whole body, better scratching. Itching of skin from every attempt to eat meat.
Erysipelas after mechanical injuries of hands. Skin becomes easily chafed, from walking and riding.
Sleep - Sleepiness during day, with stretching. Yawns, stretches and extends hands. Yawning and stretching,
after eating. Frequent waking at night, as if it were time to rise. Vivid, confused dreams.
Stomach - Epigastric region sensitive. Aching, gnawing pains in stomach. Tension in stomach, better drinking
milk. Pains in stomach after eating bread or crude and indigestible food. Burning, gnawing pain. Dyspepsia
caused by straining stomach when carrying heavy weight. Frequent odorless eructations. Hiccough, with
depression. Sudden nausea when eating, with vomiting of food. Nausea felt in rectum.
Temperature - Coldness and shivering, with great thirst. Cold shivers run over back. Coldness running over
one side of head. Chills mostly left-sided, worse up and down back, shakes even near a warm stove. Heat of
face and dull head. Frequent attacks of quick flushes of heat. Glowing heat on face, skin etc.
Throat - Sensation as if a lump in throat on empty swallowing. Larynx as if bruised.
Vertigo - Whirling vertigo, which causes falling when rising in morning. Vertigo when seated, when walking in
open air.
Vision - Amblyopia dependent upon anomalies of refraction. Amblyopia from writing by artificial light.
Disturbances of accommodation. Obscuration of vision as if one had looked too long and intently at an
object. Blurred vision with burning, aching in eyes and strained feeling. Blurred vision from fine sewing, reading
too much, worse using eyes in evening. Letters seem to run together. Dim vision, as if a shadow were flitting
before objects. Green circle around light in evening.
COMMENTS - The vulnerary power of Ruta does not appear to have been known before the provings were
made, but an old use of the remedy for impaired sight due to eyestrain, corresponded to symptoms from the
provings.
“His eyes feel as if he had strained the sight too much by reading,” “weak, pressive-like pain in right eye with
dimness of surrounding
objects, as if from having looked too long at an objects that was fatiguing to the eyes,” “a feeling of heat and
burning in the eyes and pain in them when he reads (in the evening and by candle-light).”
Eyestrain, with burning and itching in the eyes. Eyestrain headaches (Onos.). Blurry vision. Contracted pupil.
Eyeballs ache. Paralysis of the eye muscles and neuralgias. Facial paralysis from catching cold in robust,
sanguine persons.
 Rheumatic paralysis of wrists and ankles. Affinity forthe joints, especially the tendons and ligaments. Joints
feel weak and bruised. Chronic weakness and inflammation. Structural abnormalities. Torn or overstretched
ligaments. Often ahistory of injury, remaining weakness in injured spot. Often follows or is complementary to
Rhus-t.
Twisting injuries to the spine (Arn., Hyper., Rhus-t.). Wrenching injuries. Injuries to the shin and face. Injuries
that are close to the bone. Bone injuries with tom ligaments, muscles or nerves (Am., Calc-p., Symph.). Hard
lump after injury (Am.).
Ovemse of joints, particularly the wrists. Dislocated joints, or the tendency to dislocate. Weak ligaments or
joints. Carpal tunnel syndrome (Caust.). Shooting pain in wrist (Rhus-t., Hyper.). Chronic shortening of tendon
due to ovemse. Fibrositis. Bursitis, tendonitis, from overuse. Chronic knee complaints. Frozen shoulder.
Thickening of the periosteum or nodules after injury (Bellis).
Stiff and aching (Am., Rhus-t.). Sharp pains (Hyper.). Deep, grinding pain. Sharp, tearing nerve pain. Drawing
pain, as if area is being pulled shorter. Feeling of lameness ever since injury. Worse sitting or lying down.
Chronic weakness after an injury.
Gnawing, grinding pains, especially in the shoulder. Pain worse in cold, damp weather. Stiffness, worse in the
morning, better from motion and heat (Rhus-t.). Coldness down the spine, leg or sciatic nerve. Tearing pain
down the sciatic nerve.
Great weakness, pain in limbs after a short walk. Limbs feel bmised, pain in small of back and loins. Tottering
as if thighs were weak. Uneasiness and heaviness in legs, difficultly finding a comfortable position. All parts of
the body on which he lies, even in bed, are painful as if bruised. Restlessness.
Sore spot on sternum. Pain below right scapula and stitches in small of back. Backache. Lying on back
ameliorates many conditions, has led to relief in cases of malignant disease of kidneys and bladder.
Cramp in the tongue with embarrassed speech. Swollen tongue. Toothache with digging pain. Dry sockets,
with achy pain. Slow pulse. Hangovers. Rhus poisoning, itching, inflammation, and rashes. Skin is red, swollen
with watery vesicles.
Rectal polyps. Constipation, since trauma to the area (Bell-p.), since childbirth (Sep.). Constipation from
inactivity of rectum or impaction of feces following mechanical injuries. Hemorrhoids and impacted feces after
an injury.
Prolapse of the rectum after confinement.
Prolapse is worse by stooping and crouching, comes on immediately on attempting a passage. Tearing stitches
in rectum when sitting. Tearing in rectum and urethra while urinating. Sensation of nausea located in the
rectum.
Rushmore cured with one dose of Ruta 900c (Fincke) a case of prolapse preceding a very difficult stool.
A prolonged use of Ruta 3x has cured ganglion in front of left wrist.
Cooper said, “It certainly acts strongly on deposits of scirrhus material in both the breasts and in the vagina
and sometimes lessens the size of these.” He used Ruta ointment, prepared by extracting the plant in warm
Vaseline, as an application in broken cancer of the breast.
RELATIONS-Antidbte'di’y.-Camph.Anrii/ote to; Merc. Compare: ( 1) Arn., Bell-p., Rhus-t., Hyper., Calc., Calc-
f. (2) Restlessness, effects of cold and damp, Rhus-t. (3) Eye-strain, Nat-m., Onos., Seneg. (4) Prolapsed
rectum, Aesc. Bell., Chin-s., Nit-ac., Podo. (5) Pain in back, worse in morning before rising, Pet. (6) Sore as if
bruised in parts lain on, Am., Bapt., Pyrog. (6) Constipation after injuries, Am. (7) Warts on palms, Nat-c., Nat-
m. - on backs of
Ruta graveolens hands, Dulc. chafing. (8) Arg-n., Con., Euphr., Lyc., Cham., Sep. (9) In diseases of bone,
Ang., Conch. Compatible: after Am. in joint injuries, after Symph. in bone injuries, Calc., Caust., Lyc., Ph-ac.,
Puls., Sulph., Sul-ac. - diseases of bone. Complementary: Calc-p. in joint disorders.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.
keynote:
PHARMACY - ruta. Ruta graveolens. Garden rue. Bitterwort. N. O. Rutaceae. Tincture of whole fresh plant.
Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Amblyopia. Anus, prolapse. Arthritis. Asthenopia. Backache. Bedwetting. Bone, bruised.
Bruises. Bursitis. Cancer. Carpal tunnel Cartilages, bruises, pains. Chest, pains. Constipation. Dislocated,
joints. Dyspepsia. Exostosis. Eye-strain. Facial paralysis. Fevers. Fractures. Ganglions. Hemorrhages.
Hands, pains. Injuries. Joint, injuries.

name: Sabadilla Officinalis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - sabad. Sabadilla officinalis. Cevadilla seed. Cebadilla. Asagraea officinalis. Scoenocaulon
officinale. Veratrum officinale. N. O. Melanthaceae of the Lili- aceae. Tincture of seeds. Historical dose:
Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL-Allergies. Ascarides. Chilliness. Colds. Coryza. Coughs. Debility. Diarrhea. Diphtheria.
Dyspepsia, pregnancy. Earache. Esophagus, stricture. Hay fever. Headaches. Imaginary diseases. Influenza.
Intermittents. Lice. Mania. Melancholia. Neuralgia. Nosebleeds. Pinworms. Rheumatism. Tapeworm. Throat,
sore. Toothache. Uvula, elongated. Vertigo. Worms.
HERBAL - Asagraea is a Mexican genus belonging to the Colchicum family, Melanthaceae. It has only one
 species, Asagraea officinalis, furnishing the cebadilla seeds from which Veratrine is prepared. According to
the Treasury of Botany, the seeds were formerly used to destroy vermin.
HOMEOPATHIC - Sabadilla first appears in homeopathic literature as one of Stapf s additions; Hahnemann
was one of the provers. Stapf s additions form a kind of appendix to the Materia Medica Pura. Stapf said that
the plant was first described by Monades around the year 1572. At first, it was almost exclusively used for
destroying lice and worms in putrid ulcers and the intestines.
Sabadilla has affinities for the mucus membranes of the nose, lachrymal glands, anus, digestive tract, and
the nerves. Coryza and symptoms like hay fever. Allergies. Chilliness, sensitive to cold.
Nerves are affected, producing weakness. Alternate nervous and bodily symptoms. Cutting pains in bones.
Formication. Worms. Reflex nervous symptoms with twitching, convulsive trembling or catalepsy. Children’s
diarrhea with constant cutting pains.
MIND - Nervous, timid and easily startled. Mental exertion aggravates. Thinking produces headaches and
sleeplessness. Feels miserable. Fright causes hysterical paroxysms. Unresponsive to questions. Loss of
consciousness, then he jumps up and runs recklessly through the room. Rage. Mania better washing head in
cold water. Delirium during intermittents.
Erroneous, fixed ideas about himself. Imagines he is very sick. Imagines that she is pregnant or that she has
cancer. Imaginary diseases. Imagines that parts are sunken, limbs are crooked, chin is elongated. That one
side is longer than the other.
Abdomen - Bowels feel knotted. As of a lump or thread moving rapidly in abdomen.
Back - Contusive pain in back and loins, especially when seated. Burning, tingling, stinging sensation between
scapulae. Stitches in rapid succession in right side of back.
Causations - Ill effects of fright, mental exertion, thinking. Worms, causing convulsions, nymphomania.
Chest - Burning sensation on chest. Pressure on the chest. Breathing obstructed, as if there were a stone in
the chest. Shootings in sides of chest. Inflammation of pleura. Red spots and points on chest.
Constitutions - Suited to sensitive persons of light hair, fair complexion with a weakened, relaxed, muscular
system. Children and old people.
Ears - Otalgia with troublesome pressure, with snapping as of electric sparks before ears. Tickling in ears.
Itching in ear, alternately with itching at anus. Burning, itching and shootings in tips of ears. Humming, gurgling,
and detonation in ears. Deafness as if there were a band over ears. Boring in parotids.
Eyes - Red, burning eyelids. Redness of margins of eyelids. Lachrymation, worse during pain, sneezing,
coughing, yawning. Pressure on eyeballs, especially when looking up. Weakness of sight.
Face - Lips hot, burn as if scalded. Heat of face with fiery redness, especially after drinking wine. Blue circles
around the
eyes. Boring in lower jaw and submaxillary glands. Cracking of the articulation of the jaw on opening mouth
wide.
Female - Menses too late, come by fits and starts, intermit, sometimes stronger, sometimes weaker (Kreos.,
Puls.). Nymphomania from worms.
food Thirstless. Canine hunger for sweets and farinaceous food. Desires hot things, milk. Loathing for
strong food. Aversion to all food, meat, sour things, coffee, garlic. During pregnancy, no relish for food until
she takes first mouthful, then she makes a good meal.
Head - Dullness and oppression. Unilateral head pains or alternating sides, worse thinking, better eating.
Burning, itching, crawling on hair and scalp, better scratching. Headache in schoolgirls.
Heart - Palpitations with pulsations through whole body.
Kidneys - Urgent want to urinate, especially in evening, with tenesmus and scanty emission. Increased
secretion of urine. Turbid, thick urine, like clay-water. Burning in urethra when urinating.
Limbs - Upward jerking of arms. Cutting pains in bones. Red spots on arms and hands. Yellow spots on
fingers. Swelling of feet with painful soles. Cracking of skin under and beneath toes. Inflammation under
toenails. Thickened, deformed horny nails (Ant-c.).
Lungs - Wheezing respiration. Short, difficult breathing. Breathing obstructed, as if there were a stone in the
chest. Asthmatic breathing with itching of skin, nose and anus. Violent coughing attacks, muffled, worse anger
with lachrymation. Hawking up of bright red blood, which comes from the nose. Cough dry with perspiration
and water in the eyes. Cough immediately on lying down. Pleurisy with great paralytic debility.
Male - Digging and pressive pain in testes. Tensive and painful erections, without desire for sex. Pollutions
with flaccidity of penis. Diminished sexual desire.
Modalities - Better from heat, warm food and drink, swallowing. Better being wrapped up, open air. Better
quick motion
of affected part. Warm stove ameliorates chilliness. Worse from cold air. Worse forenoon, new and full moon.
 Worse periodically, every week, two weeks, four weeks, same hour. Worse odors, wine. Worse undeveloped
rash. Worse mental exertion. Worse forenoon.
Mouth - Itching of the soft palate. Dryness of the mouth without thirst. Sweetish taste. Copious saliva, jelly-
like saliva. Cannot bear anything hot or cold in mouth. Lips as if scalded. Tongue as if burnt, as if full of blisters.
Pricking, soreness in tip of tongue. Cannot protrude tongue with sore throat.
Nose - Influenza. Hay fever. Spasmodic sneezing with running nose. Copious, watery, nasal discharge.
Coryza with severe frontal pains and redness of eyes and lachrymation. Fluent coryza, worse from the odor
offlowers, even thinking of flowers increases the discharge. Oversensitive to odors, cannot tolerate the
smell of garlic. Dry, itching, tickling in nose, rubs or picks at it. Tickling in nose spreads over the whole body,
then dyspnea. One or the other nostril stuffed up. Hawks bright red blood from naso-ph^rynx.
Rectum - Constipation. Stools burning, frothy, loose, brown, floating. Broken, hard, scanty stools. Itching,
crawling in rectum and anus, as from ascarides, alternating with itching in nose or ears. Pinworms, lumbrici,
tapeworm.
Sensations - As if things were turning around each other. As if she would fall if she did not hold on to
something. As if eyes went around with the whirling sensation. As if uvula were down. As if esophagus would
be closed. As of a lump in abdomen. As if a ball of thread were moving and turning rapidly through abdomen.
As if knives were cutting abdomen. As if abdomen were shrunken, were empty. Croaking as of frogs in
abdomen. As of something alive in abdomen. As if stomach were gnawed.
Skin - Parchment-like dryness of skin. Hot burning, creeping and crawling sensation. Itching with asthmatic
breathing. Tingling and burnings shooting under skin.
Red bands, spots, and points in different parts of skin.
Sleep - Great inclination to sleep during day. Sleep comes on when thinking, meditating or reading. Agitated
and unrefreshing sleep at night, with anxious dreams. Sleep retarded by a multitude of thoughts. Starts up as
from a fright in the morning.
Stomach - Spasmodic pain in stomach with dry cough and difficult breathing. Heartburn, copious salivation.
Cold, empty feeling in stomach.
Teeth - Toothache with drawing and pulsa- tive pain. Shooting pains in molars. Tooth decay. Pricking in gums.
Bluish gums.
Temperature - Chill predominates from below upwards. Heat in head and face, hands and feet icy cold with
chill. Thirstless, thirst after chill only. Lachrymation with chill. Shivering as a concomitant.
Throat - Chronic sore throat, worse from cold air. Sore throat, left to right, worse empty swallowing, better
hot drinks. Tonsillitis after coryza. Much tough phlegm. Sensation of a skin hanging loosely, must swallow it.
Warm food and drink relieve. Painful empty swallowing. Dry fauces and throat. Sensation of a lump in throat
with constant need to swallow.
Vertigo - Vertigo with sensation as though all things were turning around each other. Vertigo accompanied by
blackness before eyes and sensation of fainting. Vertigo, sudden on waking at night or rising from stooping,
better resting head on table.
COMMENTS - Stapf pointed out that the provings reveal strong febrile symptoms. Sabad. may be as clock-
like as Cedr., and is a leading remedy in intermittent fevers and neuralgias. Sabad. is a chilly remedy, the
symptoms, especially the coryza, are generally worse in the open air.
Intolerant of mental exertion, thinking causes a headache. Tendency to be startled. Erroneous impressions as
to the state of his body. Imaginary diseases, imagines parts shrunken. Imagines she is pregnant if there is
distention from flatus.
Giddiness, may cause staggering and even fainting. Objects seem to whirl around or to whirl around each
other. Sitting aggravates
vertigo. Rising from seat causes vertigo. Lying perfectly still ameliorates vertigo.
Severe catarrhal symptoms. Hay asthma. Allergies. Hay fever with itching and tingling in the nose (All-c., Ars.).
Tingling and numbness in the nose (Petros, in the urethra.). Itching in the roof of the mouth, rubbed raw by the
tongue (Wye. ). Spasmodic sneezing. Coryza, sneezing and runny nose (All-c.). Thick, yellow discharge, worse
stuff rooms, better fresh air (Puls.), alternates with watery discharge.
Sore throats characterized by a sensation of a lump or foreign body in the throat and a constant need to
swallow. Pressure on larynx causes sore throat. Lying down causes cough immediately, worse expectoration.
Kent said it is suited to “old, chronic sore throats that are worse from cold air. The patient is sensitive to cold
air. Every time he takes cold it settles in his nose and throat. Tonsillitis going from left to right.”
Desires hot drink (opposite of Lach.). Overly sensitive to the smell of garlic (Thuj.). Opening mouth wide causes
cracking of jaw joints.Disordered digestion and loaded tongue. Sinking at stomach and gnawing hunger.
Indigestion, during pregnancy.
 “Violent itching of hairy scalp, compelling her to scratch until blood comes.” “Itching of the vertex as if a quantity
of vermin had collected there, obliging him to scratch incessantly.” “Itching of anus and rectum as from
ascarides.” “Itching of anus alternating with itching of alae nasi and meatus auditorius.” Scratching ameliorates
itching of scalp, causes burning of anus.
Kent gave Sabad. to a pet dog which had great irritation of anus and soon afterwards the dog passed a very
large number of worms.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Camph., Lach., Lyc., Puls., Con. Compare:(l)Colch.,Nux-v., Bry., Arund. and
Poll. (2) Veratrina is alkaloid of Sabad., not of Verat., locally in neuralgias and for removal of dropsy. Five
grains to two drams. Lanolin, rubbed on inside of thighs, causes diuresis. (3) Phle. - Timothy-Hay - Potentized
to 12c a specific to many cases and evidently acts in a desensitizing manner. Cumin. - hay fever. Follows
well: Bry. (Pleurisy). FoUowedwellby: Ars. Bell., Merc., Nux-v. Complementary: Sep.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL-Allergies. Ascarides. Chilliness. Colds. Coryza. Coughs. Debility. Diarrhea. Diphtheria.
Dyspepsia, pregnancy. Earache. Esophagus, stricture. Hay fever. Headaches. Imaginary diseases. Influenza.
Intermittents. Lice. Mania. Melancholia. Neuralgia. Noseb

name: Sabal Serrulata
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - sabal. Sabal serrulata. Saw oalmetto. Serenoa serrulata. N. O. Palmace- ae. South Carolina to
Florida. The tincture must be prepared from the fresh berries to be effective. Historical dose: Tincture and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Appendicitis. Asthma. Atrophy. Backaches. Bedwetting. Breast, disorders. Bronchitis. Catarrh.
Cystitis. Debility. Dysmenorrhea. Dysuria. Epididymitis. Gland disorders. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Headache.
Hoarseness. Impotency. Infertility. Iritis. Laryngitis. Lumbago. Malnutrition. Menses, delayed. Neuralgia.
Neurasthenia. Obesity. Ovaries disorders. Peritonitis. Pharyngitis. Proctitis. Prostate, disorders. Prostate,
enlarged. Prostatitis. Puerperal fever. Rhinitis. Sexual, debility. School, headache. Strangury. Testes,
atrophy. Throat, sore. Tuberculosis. Urine incontinence. Uterus, disorders. Whooping cough.
HERBAL - Sabal serrulata was introduced into medicine by J. B. Read and A. A. Solomon, both of Savannah,
Georgia. Dr. Read gave a “Saccharated oil,” of which he said, “By its peculiar soothing power over the mucus
membranes it produces sleep and relieves the most troublesome coughs, promotes expectoration, improves
digestion and increases fat, flesh and strength.
“It has been used with benefit in cardiac asthma, tuberculosis, especially laryngeal, chronic bronchitis and
dilatation of the bronchial tubes. Sabal’s action in catarrhal disorders in rapid and permanent. A cold in the
head may be checked with two or three doses (of the saccharated oil) mixed with boiling water and used by
inhalation it has been found beneficial in chronic ozaena.”
HOMEOPATHIC - In the provings, the tincture or fluid extract were used, from 5 to 10 drop doses, repeated
two or three times
a day. A similar dosage has been adopted in the clinical use of the remedy.
Sabal is an organ remedy of great power, selecting the uterus and prostatic gland (which is the male analog
of the uterus), ovaries and testes and bladder. For irritability of the genito-urinary organs, especially the
prostate, ovaries, breasts, bladder and urethra. It is soothing to the mucus membranes and is tonic, nutritive
and stimulating to the overworked brain.
Prostate enlargement and weakness. Prostatitis. Epididymitis and urinary difficulties. Iritis with prostatic
trouble. Homeopathic catheter for retention of urine due to enlarged prostate.
General and sexual debility. Nervous irritability with loss of sexual desire in both sexes. Sexual neurotics.
Valuable for undeveloped breast glands. Small and undeveloped genitals.
Sharp, stinging and wandering pains. Languor, apathy and indifference. Fear of going to sleep. Promotes
nutrition and tissue building.
MIND - Difficult thinking, cannot grasp or re- memberwhatisread. Confused. Impatience, fretfulness. Irritability
and depression, particularly before menses. Irritability from loss of sexual desire. Dislikes sympathy, makes
them angry. Self-concentrated on their own sufferings, wants to be left alone. Apathy. Wants to go away and
die alone. Indifference to wants of others. Fears to fall asleep lest something should happen. Starts up with
fear as he is dozing.
Abdomen - Sudden, intense, cramp-like pain through abdomen. Sharp, stinging pains running up and down
front of abdomen, and also right side. Pain extending to thighs.
Back - Aching across lower part of back. Deep pains in lower back. Fearful backache, pain in sacral region,
before and at commencement of menses. Backache after sex.
Bladder - Feeling as if bladder too full. Heavy, aching pain and sense of coldness in bladder, extending to
external genitals. Painful starting the flow, as if forced through very narrow meatus. Feeling as of a stricture
about two inches down urethra. Urethra sensation of narrowness ( Arg-n.). Difficult urination, smarting, burning
 in urethra. Paresis of bladder sphincter. Cystitis from prostate enlargement. Painful urination, connected
with ovarian pain. Urinary sediment. Incontinence from any exertion, lifting, laughing. Constant desire to pass
urine at night. Bedwetting. Chronic gonorrhea.
Breasts - One breast smaller than other. Breasts shrink in size (lod., Kali-i.), or increase rapidly. Breasts,
sore, tender and full feeling, itching. Stinging in breasts, soreness worse after cold bath. Sharp pains in
mammary glands. Pain in breasts, worse coldness, pressure. Defective lactation.
Chest - Sharp pain in left side of chest, running through left breast.
Constitutions - Sycotic constitutions.
Ears - Chronic inflammation of middle ear. Fullness in nose and ears. Frequent sharp, stitch-like pains inward
from ears. Hearing diminished, voices seem far off.
Eyes - Iritis when prostate gland is involved. Dim vision during headache.
Face - Papular eruption on left temple and about mouth. Slight neuralgia in right temple and right jaw. Pallor.
Female - Amenorrhea. Ovaries tender and enlarged. Stinging pain in ovary, pains running down the thighs.
Stinging pain in uterus. Uterine tumor. Heavy feeling over womb. Vulva feels open. Sensation of coldness in
genitals. Awakened by a most distressing itching of labia majora. Furious sexual passion. Loss of sex drive.
Sexual neurotics with suppressed or perverted sexual inclination.
Food - Appetite poor and capricious. Malnutrition and great emaciation. Better from bread, milk. Constant
desire for buttermilk, milk (Rhus-t., Tub.), which is usually disliked. Aversion to mother’s milk. Worse meat,
pudding, vegetables.
Head - Severe headache with giddiness and dim vision. Headache of weak persons. Neuralgia in feeble
patients. Sharp, darting pains here and there, coming and going suddenly. Pain runs up from nose and centers
in forehead. Dull, aching pain
in right temple and on vertex. Pain and irritation at base of brain and upper third of cervical spine (Gels.).
Sensation as if something tightening in brain.
Kidneys - Pain or irritation in region of kidneys. Excruciating pain and fainting on being raised up to urinate.
Limbs - Pains into thighs, radiating in different directions, settling in ovaries. Sharp pain running down thigh.
Aching in knee and calf. Annoying eczema of hands.
Lungs - Chronic bronchitis (Stann., Hep.). Copious expectoration with catarrh of nose. Wheezing cough, worse
lying down, until 6 a.m.
Male - Coldness of genitals. Drawing pains in spermatic cords. Slight twisting chordee as if stretched from the
root. Atrophy of testes. Testes drawn up, painfully. Epididymitis. Gonorrhea. Impotency, loss of sexual
power. Hard erections. Semen thick, causes hot feeling along the cord. Sex is painful at the time of emission.
Loss of sex drive. Sexual neurotics with suppressed or perverted sexual inclination.
Modalities - Better after sleep, from milk. Worse from cold, damp, cloudy weather. Worse in early morning,
from rising, at bedtime. Worse from sympathy. Worse before menses. Worse from motion. Backache worse
after sex. Catarrhal symptoms are worse in cold, damp weather. Cough worse on lying down at night.
Depression worse before menses.
Mouth - Pungent, burning sensation in mouth and fauces, causing sneezing, coughing, and gagging. As if
mouth coated with fat. Burning on tongue as if scalded.
Nose - Pain at root of nose. Pain running up from nose and centering in forehead. Fullness in nostrils,
compelling him to pick them. Catarrhal symptoms, worse cold, damp weather. Sneezing and lachrymation,
coughing and gagging.
Prostate - Prostatitis. Emission of prostatic fluid during stool, on straining at stool, during urination. Prostatic
weakness with discharge of prostatic fluid. Enlarged prostate. Dull aching in prostate extending into
abdomen. Cystitis from prostate enlargement. Dribbling of urine from prostate enlargement.
Rectum - Constipation and enlarged prostate. Hemorrhoids with dryness of stool and pressure from within
out. Stools dark, almost black. Stools unusually easy, free from hemorrhoidal troubles.
Skin - Papular eruption on face. Eczema of hands.
Sleep - Fears to fall asleep lest something should happen, starts up with this fear when he is dozing. Wakes
from coldness. Awakened by stinging pains in ovaries, or by a distressing itching of labia majora.
Stomach - Sharp pain running through stomach. Severe pain in left side of stomach. Irritation of stomach.
Belching and acidity. Acute gastritis, fearful burning as from sulphuric acid. Could not take meat, vegetable, or
pudding, only bread and milk.
Throat - Voice changed, throat feels husky. Sharp pain in left side of throat. Pungent, burning sensation in
fauces, followed by smooth sensation, as if coated with oil.
Vertigo - Vertigo with headache from fumes of oil.
COMMENTS - In his book, Saw Palmetto, Hale put together most of the available knowledge regarding this
 plant. It is a dwarf palm with a creeping (or leaning), branching stem, the edges of leaf and petioles serrate,
roots fibrous, large, half exposed.
The fruit, so-called “berry,” is a one- seeded dupe about the size of an olive, dark purple when ripe, and ripening
in October and November. The fruit is richer in sugar than sugar cane and contains two oils, one volatile and
one fixed. The volatile oil is considered to possess the most characteristic properties of the medicine.
Hale described it as “yellow,” but he quoted John Uri Lloyd of Cincinnati, as writing to him, “The principal
constituent is a volatile oil. This oil possesses a deep green color.” And he goes on to say that the color is not
due to chlorophyll nor to the copper of the form used in condensing it.
This agrees with Estep’s contention that the preparation of Sabal should be darkgreen or grass-green. The
preparation
Estep used was a fluid extract prepared by Burrough Brothers of Baltimore from the “fresh green berries.” Hale
directs that the fresh ripe berries should be used.
Hale’s tincture was of fresh ripe berries and seeds, all crushed and macerated in 90 percent alcohol for fourteen
days and decanted. He noted that the fluid extract was “probably four times stronger than the tincture.”
C. S. Estep used a dark-green fluid extract that was made from the fresh green berries and as “almost as
green as grass and has an oily surface.” He made his dilutions from this. Other preparations disappointed him.
Oil can be prepared from the expressed juice of the fruit by allowing it to stand a few days. Saccharated oil is
one part of the oil to seven parts of cane sugar. Malted Sabal is one part of the oil to seven of Maltine. Aqua
Olei Sabal, for use as a spray, is a preparation suggested by Hale made by triturating 15 drops of the oil with
Mag-c. 3j., gradually adding a pint of distilled water and decanting.
The preparation used by Dr. Mullin’s prover was made by Boericke and Tafel. All are agreed that preparations
of the dried fruit and of the root-bark do not possess the curative powers of the remedy.
While on a trip through the wilds of Florida, Hale observed the great fattening properties of the berries on
animals. During summer, food is scanty and the wild animals become very thin, but as soon as the palmetto
fruit ripens they improve rapidly. In a few weeks have put on so much fat that they become easy prey. This fat,
said Hale, “consists principally of olein and will not make lard.”
Dr. Langton said that she gave 5 drop doses four times daily in cases of overworked brain and school-
headache for the “tonic, nutritive and stimulating” effect of the remedy. She gives the lx as soon as relief has
been obtained and she finds that the dilution often gives greater relief than the larger doses for the headaches.
Mullins said “I now found the use of the drug in the 3c and 6c potency curative in nearly all of the diseases of
the uterus and appendages. Also in headache from reflexes uterine troubles in breast abscess, mental
irritations and nervous debility.” He thought that it well deserved the name of “The Homeopathic Catheter,” but
he added that it must be given on its individual indications.
W. E. Rely published three cases illustrating the prostatic action of Sabal. The first, Mr. J., 56, was very
despondent, irritable. Sympathy seemed to anger him. Great tenesmus in neck of bladder with heavy, aching
pains with sense of coldness extending into external genitals. Occasional sharp pains extending up into
abdomen and down into thighs. Capricious appetite. Chronic constipation. Urination too frequent, disturbing
sleep.
Sabal tincture was given, five drops, night and morning. Steady improvement followed, and in eight weeks all
the symptoms had gone and with them an annoying eczema of the hands.
The second case was Mr. M., 45, who had increasing frequency of urination for a year. Despondent, distressed.
Capricious appetite. Vertex headache and gastric catarrh. Little sexual desire. Sex followed by digging pain in
back and tenesmus of bladder with difficulty in commencing to urinate.
Genitals were cold, dull aching in region of prostate, extending to abdomen and thighs. Sabal tincture gradually
relieved and cured in three weeks.
The third case concerned Mr. E., 35. He had frequent urination for one and a half years. Heavy, dragging
pains, extending into back and thighs, back pains much after sex. Considerable loss of prostatic fluid at times.
Sexual desire much impeded. Severe headache on vertex and gastric catarrh. All symptoms were removed
by Sabal tincture.
Hale said that E. S. Evans of Columbus, Ohio, considered Sabal “almost specific in iritis when the prostate
gland in involved. I have cured cases with the 3x which could not be relieved in any other way.”
A. L. Davidson related acase of impotence in a man, 51, who had difficult urination, tenderness of prostatic
portion of urethra,
loss of power. His testicles shrunk, penis shrunk and cold.
Sabal tincture, 15 drops, four times a day, was prescribed. At the end of the first week he complained of
drawing pains in spermatic cords, there was freer flow of urine, he slept better and felt better. At the end of the
second week the testes gradually increased in size. The urethral tenderness had nearly disappeared and
 erections were established. In two weeks more the cure was complete, the testes were even larger and firmer
than normal.
J. Martin Kershaw of St. Louis, treated a young woman, 23, who had great difficulty in controlling her urine all
her life. Undue exertion, lifting, straining, or laughing caused it to dribble away. Unless she rose several times
in the night, she was sure to wet the bed. Sabal tincture, one drop, four times a day, was given. In one month
she was much improved and under the same remedy she gradually got quite well.
Elias C. Price reported three cases. The first was a case of a very nervous, sensitive woman with chronic
inflammation of the bladder, frequent, painful urination, ten to twelve times in the night and every fifteen to
thirty minutes during the day. Spells of pressing pain on rectum, better by warm water enemas, which generally
brought away hardened feces.
Lil-t. 3x removed this temporarily. Rectal examination disclosed a hard, fleshy tumor the size of half a hen’s
egg on the posterior aspect of the uterus. Sabal fluid extract 5 drops, thrice daily, diminished the tumor by half
in two months and removed it entirely in three more.
Prices’ next case was of Mrs. X. who, five days after confinement after her first child, had irritation of kidneys
and a week later symptoms of pelvic peritonitis. Her uterus was much enlarged, very tender. She did not
urinate very often, but when she did the pain was so excruciating that she fainted away and sometimes did not
come to for an hour. •
For three days no remedy did any good. Then she had a violent pain on the right ^ide of her head above and
behind the
ear, and paralysis of her left arm and leg. She became unconscious and could not be aroused, at times would
talk of things that had occurred before her illness, insensible to external impressions.
She remained so for ten days. Sabal fluid extract, 20 drops, every two hours, relieved the pain on being raised
to urinate after the second dose. Recovery from the other condition was very gradual.
The third case was of Miss X., 22, who had irregular menses for years, having once gone nine months without
a period. When she came to Price she was three months past her time, one breast was much smaller than the
other.
Sabal fluid extract was given, 5 drops, thrice daily. In about a month the menses came on freely, lasting four
days instead of the usual two. Breasts began to increase in size. In three months one was as large as the
other. The following year she again missed her time and Sabal brought it right in a week.
Using Sabal, Price has cured cases of pelvic cellulitis, peritonitis, puerperal fever inflammation of uterus, tubes,
ovaries and even appendicitis and proctitis, especially if the prostatic gland is involved. Enlarged prostates.
Acute prostatitis. Prostate conditions relating to impotence. Prostate cancer (Con.). Frequent urination. Chronic
bladder inflammation. Benign prostatic hypertrophy.
Characteristic stinging pains. Wandering, radiating and cramping pains were also prominent. Sabal has several
groups of associated regions of pain: pains affecting head and ovary, ovaries and breasts, lower back and
right temple, prostate and eye. Mainly used in tincture.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Sil. - Sabal grows on the sandy shore. Puls, delayed menses, Puls, also grows
on sandy soils. Sabal. is most fruitful nearest the sea, compare Sil-mar. Compare: (1) Stinging pains in ovaries,
Apis, Merc. (2) Pain in right ovary and thigh, Apis. (3) Breasts painful, Con., Calc. (4) School-headaches, worse
by sympathy, Nat-m. (5) Prostatic affections, Ferr-pic., Cham., Arg-n., Dig., Solid. (6)
Prostate and eye, Solid. (7) Worse from sex, Kali-c. (8) Wandering pains, Kali-bi. the roots of Sabal. are very
rich in potash salts. (9) Over-worked women, Mag-c.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Hale.Murphy. Phatak.
keynote:

Florida. The tincture must be prepared from the fresh berries to be effective. Historical dose: Tincture and all
potencies.
CLINICAL - Appendicitis. Asthma. Atrophy. Backaches. Bedwetting. Breast, disorders. Bronchitis. Catarrh.

name: Sabina Officinalis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - sabin. Sabina officinalis. Savine. Juniperus sabina. N. O. Coniferae. Cupressaceae. Tincture
of the young, fresh tops of the branches. Tincture of the oil. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
Locally, tincture for warts.
CLINICAL - Abortion, effects. After-pains. Boils. Condylomata. Cystitis. Dysmenorrhea. Fibroids. Gonorrhea.
Hemorrhages. Inter-menstrual, flow. Leucorrhea. Menstruation, excessive. Miscarriages. Moles. Nephritis.
Nymphomania. Ovary, disorders. Penis, swelling. Phimosis. Retained, placenta. Rheumatic, gout. Strangury.
Sycosis. Toothache. Uterus, bleeding. Warts.
HOMEOPATHIC - Stapf made the first collection of the symptoms of Sabin., and Hahnemann and his son
were among the pro vers. A number of observations on women who had taken the drug to bring on menses or procure
miscarriage have also been added, and some cases of fatal poisoning are recorded.
A close botanical ally of Thuj., Sabin, is not too close to be complementary to that great anti-sycotic. Broad
 condylomata, fig-warts with much itching and exuberant granulations are characteristic. Like Thuj., it removes
wart-like growths from the mucocutaneous surfaces.
Cooper noted that Sabin, acts as a widespread irritant, inflaming the pyloric end of the duodenum and causing
patches of inflammation in other portions of the intestines, especially the upper intestines, the omentum and
the peritoneum. In addition, it affects the fibrous tissue of small joints, serous membranes and heels.
Pronounced action on the generative organs of both sexes. It produces fig-warts with itching and burning of
the external
genitals, phimosis of the male, swelling of the dorsum of the penis, and gonorrhea. Uterine hemorrhages,
abortion.
Hemorrhages, where blood is fluid and clots together. Hemorrhage is partly pale red and partly clotted,
worse from the least motion, but may be better by walking. The flow is in paroxysms and is accompanied by
labor-like pains.
Tendency to miscarriage especially at the third month. Warmth ameliorates pain of dysmenorrhea. The
dysmenorrhea pains were better lying on flat of back with limbs extended out. Walking ameliorates the
metrorrhagia.
Pain from the sacrum to the pubis. Pain increases suddenly and decreases slowly. Cold applications
ameliorates wandering pains in joints. Red, shiny, swelling of affected parts. Acutely inflamed arthritic nodes.
Violent pulsations, wants windows open. Heaviness and indolence of body, wants to lie down. Sense of
fullness. Lies on left side during sleep. Sleepless and restless after midnight.
MIND - Dejection, discouragement and sadness. Feeling of deep-seated trouble, which makes him melancholy
and sad. Sadness with great tiredness and laziness. Melancholy. Moroseness with dislike to conversation,
especially when exercising in open air. Weeping aloud. Desires repose and tranquility. Reserved while walking
in open air. Taciturn while waking in morning.
Nervous and hysterical. Great anxiety, fear and apprehension. Irritable nerves. Much irritability of temper.
Irascibility with tears and sobs. Listlessness. Weakness of memory. Hypochondriacal mood. Sensitive to slight-
est noise. Starting from noise. Music goes through bone and marrow. Music is intolerable, it produces
nervousness. Distraction from sound of piano.
Abdomen - Tympanitic distention. Congested. Quivering as if something were alive, resembling fetal
movements. Bearing-down, constrictive pain. Colic, mostly in hypogastric region.
Back - Paralytic pain in small of back. Pain between sacrum and pubis.
Breasts - Crawling, voluptuous itching in nipples. Stitches in left nipple.
Chest - Pressure on chest. Pressive, spasmodic tension in chest in middle of sternum. Trembling in the lungs
with dull rattling and crackling. Lancinations.
Constitutions - Suited to hot-blooded women with gouty or rheumatic diathesis, arthritic pains. For the chronic
ailments of women, tendency to miscarriage, hemorrhagic tendency, nosebleeds and hematuria. Farrington
said it is suited to “plethoric women who suffer from what they call rheumatic inflammation” of the heels.
Ears - Pinching in ears. Hardness of hearing. Gets deaf when tired, in foggy weather, or at any change of
weather.
Eyes - Tensive pain in eyes, as if muscles too short. Heat in eyes. Eyes dull and downcast. Clouds before
eyes. Smarting tears. Jerking quivering of lids.
Face - Pale with blue circles around eyes. Black pores in cheeks and around nose. Paralytic pain and pressure
in zygomatic process.
Female - Menses, too profuse too early, gushing of hot, watery, bright, blood, mixed with dark clots.
Dysmenorrhea, better lying flat on the back with limbs extended. Bleeding between periods with sexual
excitement. Increased desire for sex. Vaginitis. Leucorrhea from suppressed menses or copious menses.
Leucorrhea. foul, acrid, thick, yellow. Leucorrhea after menses, corrosive, offensive. Atony of uterus. Uterine
pains extend into thighs. Pain from sacrum to pubis and from below upwards. Shooting pain up the vagina.
Uterine hemorrhage, partly clotted, worsefrom least motion. Bleeding fibroids (Thalspi). Promotes expulsion
of moles from uterus (Canth.).Tendency to miscarriage, especially at the third month. Menorrhagia in women
who abort readily. Itching of pudenda during pregnancy. Retained placenta, intense after-pains.
Inflammation of ovaries and uterus after childbirth.
Food - Poor appetite. Bitter taste of food, especially milk and coffee. Desire for acids, especially lemonade.
Head - Rush of blood to head and face. Bursting headache, coming suddenly and going slowly. Splitting
sensation in forehead and temples. Pulsative headache with heaviness and stupefaction. Drawing pains in
masseter muscles.
Heart - Violent pulsation in blood vessels through whole body. Augmented and extended beating of the heart.
Pulse unequal, generally quick, strong and hard.
 Kidneys - Burning and throbbing in region of kidneys. Bladder inflamed, throbbing. Bladder irritability with
gouty diathesis. Inflammation of urethra. Bloody urine with much urging.
Limbs -Arthritic pain in joints. Red, shining swelling. Gouty nodosities (Am-p.). Gout, worse in heated room.
Knots and enlargements in varicose veins. Bruised pains in anterior portion of thighs. Shooting in metatarsal
bones. Shooting, intermittent aching in the heels. Swelling, redness and stitches in right big toe.
Lungs - Dry, hacking cough and tickling in the trachea. Hemoptysis. Expectoration of mucus streaked with
blood.
Male - Burning, sore pain in glans. Prepuce painful with difficulty in retracting it. Sexual desire increased with
violent continuous erections. Hard swelling on dorsum of penis. Sycotic warts, growths. Gonorrhea with pus-
like discharge.
Modalities - Better from cold, cool open air. Better exhalation. Worse from foggy weather, night. Worse heat,
warm air. Worse heat of bed or room. Worse exertion, stooping, least motion, taking a deep breath. Worse
letting limbs hang down. Worse pregnancy, menopause. Worse music. Worse by touch, though better
pressure.
Mouth - Drawing pain in the muscles of jaws. Toothache, worse only when chewing. Bitter taste to food
especially milk or coffee.
Nose - Dry coryza.
Rectum - Sense of fullness. Pain from back to pubis. Constipation. Hemorrhoids with bright, red blood, bleed
copiously. Hemorrhoids alternate with pain in limbs.
Sensations - As if she would fall. As if parts of temporal eminence were pressed asunder. As if skin had grown
fast in forehead. As if eyes would be pressed out. As if tooth would burst. As if he had to swallow over a foreign
body. As of a lump in throat. As if vomiting would come on. As if something alive in abdomen. Right shoulder
joint as if sprained.
Skin - Black pores in skin, especially face. Foul, itching, burning. Exuberant granulations (Thuj., Nit-ac.).
Warts. Fig-warts, moist with intolerable itching and burning.
Sleep - Sleeplessness and restlessness after midnight. Disturbed sleep with frequent waking. Talking and loud
snoring during sleep. Tendency to lie on left side when sleeping. Anxious, continued dreams, full of fanciful
images and intellectual efforts.
Stomach - Fullness and inflation of region of stomach. Pain from epigastrium to back. Stomachache. Acidity
in stomach after a meal. Empty risings and heartburn. Nausea with fullness in stomach. Vomiting of bile or of
food eaten the previous day.
Temperature - Intolerable burning heat of whole body, with great restlessness. Great chilliness through the
day. Chill in the evening with attacks of chilliness. Fever in evening, first shivering, then heat and lastly
perspiration.
Throat - Sore throat during deglutition, as from a foreign body or an internal swelling in gullet, with pressure
and choking. Dull lancinations in throat. Dryness in throat with drawing pain.
Vertigo - Vertigo with suppressed menses. Stupefying vertigo, leading to falling, with cloudiness of sight.
Giddiness with congestions to and heat in head.
COMMENTS - Characteristic pain from sacrum to pubis. Pains are paroxysmal and labor-like. Pain suddenly
increases and then slowly disappears. Wandering pains (Puls.). Numbness, goes through bone and marrow.
Inflamed sacrum, or severe aching pains in the sacrum. “Intermittent aching” in the heels. Tendency to bleed
(Phos.). Nosebleed (Phos., Ferr-p.). Tendency to warts, genital warts, venereal warts, and anal warts. Bleeding
warts (Nit-ac.). Gonorrhea, or a history of gonorrhea, with genital warts (Thuj.). History of vaginitis with genital
warts.
Hemorrhage of bright red blood, with clots (Bell.), comes in gushes. Heavy menstrual bleeding, with swelling,
fatigue and headaches, worse motion. Menses too early, too abundant, may last too long. Painful
dysmenorrhea with heavy bleeding, pains from the pubic bone back to the sacrum, better lying on the back,
limbs extended. Pains can be sharp and stabbing. Bearing down pains. Drawing pains.
Endometriosis (Med.). Pelvic inflammatory disease, with a throbbing uterus. Discharge of blood between the
periods with sexual excitement. Bleeding fibroids. Blood streaked leucorrhea. Vaginitis with offensive, irritating,
profuse discharge.
Severe morning sickness, spasmodic vomiting. Miscarriages due to spasmodic vomiting. Tendency to
miscarriage (Caul., Sep.), usually in the third month (Bell.), with bleeding, passing clots and membranes.
Retained placenta (Sec., Caul.). Hemorrhage after an abortion. Postpartum hemorrhage. Severe after-pains.
Hemorrhage during menopause. Pulsating sensation and hot flashes during menopause. Throbbing with hot
flashes. Turmoil in the circulation. Hot flashes, worse clothing, wants to take off clothing and fan themselves.
Desires fresh air. Irritable and ill humored during menopause. History of being worn out, overworked, with
 many children. Menopause brought on by a weakened uterus. Varicose veins.
Obscure abdominal pains due to inflammatory states of the peritoneum. Sensation of something alive in the
abdomen (Thuj.). Rumbling with indigestion and uterine problems, as if something is kicking or moving.
Bleeding hemorrhoids, especially with a history of constipation and uterine problems. Bloody urine.
Irritability, hysteria and hypochondriasis. Discouraged and adverse to conversation. Music is intolerable.
Overheats easily.
dislikes stuffy rooms. Desires juicy, sour things. Can complain that food tastes too bitter. Generally left sided.
Worse at night and from physical contact.
RELATIONS-Antidoted by: Puls. Compare: (1) Croc., Calc., Tril., Ip., Mill., Erig. (2) Hir. - the leech. (3) Rosm.
(4) Worse by music - Ambr., Thuj., Sep. (5) Inter-menstrual flow, Ham., Ambr. (6) Condylomata, Thuj., Nit-ac.
(7) Hemorrhage, worse from least motion, Sec. (8) Menses partly fluid, partly clotted, Ferr. (9) Retained
placenta, Caul., Sec. Promotes expulsion of moles or foreign bodies from uterus, Canth. (10) Better in fresh
air, desires lemonade, Puls. (11) Clotted hemorrhage, Mill., Plat, is dark, Sabin, bright red. Compatible: Ars.,
Bell., Rhus-t., Spong. Complementary to: Thuj., Nit-ac.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Sacharinum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - sacchin. Sacharinum. Sacharin. Benzoic sulphinide. Saccharine. Artificial sweetener.
Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Allergies. Bladder, cancer. Bladder, tumors. Hypoglycemia. Insomnia.
HOMEOPATHIC - This substance is a derivative of benzoic acid, and is made synthetically from coal-tar. It is
a white powder, readily soluble in warm water, but to only a slight extent in cold water.
Saccharin is the foundation for many low- calorie and sugar-free products and is used in table top sweeteners,
baked goods, jams, chewing gum, canned fruit, candy, dessert toppings and salad dressings.
Saccharin is about 300 times as sweet as sucrose, but has an unpleasant bitter or metallic aftertaste, especially
at high concentrations. Saccharin goes directly through the human digestive system without being digested. It
does not affect blood insulin levels, and has effectively no food value.
Saccharin is not recommend for children with “sulfa” allergies, and has been linked to
short-term problems with infant muscle tone, “lazy” eye, irritability, and insomnia.
Saccharin has been implicated in the development of photosensitive skin eruptions in humans, and as a
hypoglycemic agent in animals. Increased incidences of bladder cancer and tumors have been found in toxicity
studies.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aspart., Sac-alb.
REFERENCES - Murphy.
