name: Theridion Curassavicum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - ther. Theridion curassavicum. Orange spider. Latrodectuscurassavicus. N. O. Arachnida. West-
Indies. Tincture of the whole spider. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Anthrax, sheep. Bone, disorders. Decay. Menopause. Coughs. Dysmenorrhea.
Eye-teeth, pains. Fainting. Headaches. Hysteria. Liver, disorder, abscess. Marasmus. Ménière’s disease.
Nausea. Necrosis. Nose, catarrh. Ozaena. Photophobia. Pregnancy, sickness. Rickets. Scrofulosis.
Seasickness. Spinal, irritation. Tetanus. Toothache. Tuberculosis. Vertigo.
HOMEOPATHIC - Ther. was introduced and proved by Hering in 1832. The spider is found in the West Indies,
chiefly in the island of Curacao. It is about the size of a cherry-stone and is found on orange-trees. It is velvety
black when young with antero-posterior lines composed of white dots, on the posterior of the body there are
three orange-red spots and on the belly a large square yellow spot.
 The spider is very poisonous. It produces a highly sensitive, nervous condition with weakness, trembling,
coldness, anxiety, faintness and easily excited cold sweat. Venom produces hypersensitiveness of the

***nerves. Sensitive to noise, which penetrates the body.
It affects the teeth, causes nausea, chills and pains all over, strikes the painful parts etc. Nervous
hyperesthesia. Noises seem to strike on painful spots over the body.
Affinity for the tubercular diathesis. Tuberculosis, stitch high up in left apex (Anthr.). Where the indicated
remedy does not hold long. Rickets, decay, necrosis. Vertigo, sick headache, peculiar pain around heart
region, tuberculosis florida, and scrofula.
Spinal irritation. Decay and necrosis of the bones. Bones feel broken. Rickets. Burning pains. Water feels too
cold. Bounding internally, as of a child. Sense of duality. Effects of sunstroke. Hysteria during puberty and at
menopause. Infantile atrophy, glands enlarged with marasmus. Nodes on various parts especially buttocks.
Seasickness. Left side most affected.
MIND - Restless, finds pleasure in nothing. Time passes too quickly. Sensitive to slightest noise. Startled
by least thing. Confusion of mind, worse laughing. Insanity during menopause. Hysteria. Talkativeness and
hilarity.
Wantofself confidence. Aversion to work. Joyful during headache. Depression during headache. Weeping from
toothache. Feels and looks as if dying, but hears and understands all that is said.
Abdomen - Violent burning in liver region.
Abscess of liver. Pain in the groins after sex, motion and drawing up the limbs. Stinging pain on left side over
anterior aspect of spleen.
Back - Stinging pains. Spine is sensitive to pressure and jar, sits sideways in a chair to avoid pressure.
Sensitiveness between vertebra.
Causations - Seasickness. Washing clothes. Riding.
Chest - Stitches high up in chest, back through apex of left lung. Pain in upper left chest (Myrt., Pix., Anis.).
Pain in left floating ribs. Pinching in left pectoral muscle.
Constitutions - Tubercular diathesis.
Ears - Least noise, even sound penetrates her whole body, especially teeth. Rushing in both ears like a
waterfall.
Eyes - Glittering vision, on stooping. Luminous vibrations before eyes. Blurred vision. Sensitive to light.
Pressure behind eyeballs. Throbbing over left eye.
Face - Pale. Jaws immovable in the morning.
Female - Hysteria during puberty, at menopause. Menses suppressed.
Food - Constant desire to eat and drink but knows not for what. Craves oranges and bananas, acid fruits and
drinks, wine, tobacco smoke.
Head - Head internally hot, oppressed and heavy. Head feels thick, thinks it belongs to another, that she can
lift it off or she would like to remove it. Migraine. Headache, felt during sleep, worse jarring, with nausea and
vomiting, at menopause. Headache worse after stool. Cannot lie down with headache. Pain worse anyone
walking over floor.
Heart - Cardiac anxiety and pain. Anxiety about the heart, sharp pain radiates to arm and left shoulder.
Pulse slow with vertigo.
Kidneys - Increased urination, at night, does not pass much during day.
Limbs - Burning in upper arm. Restless feeling in hands, wrings them. Stinging from elbow to shoulder. Lies
or sits with feet crossed, cannot uncross them.
Lungs - Cough, jerks body together, head forward and knees upward. Too much air seems to enter the chest.
Breathing difficult going up and down stairs, hysteria. Tuberculosis.
Male - Gonorrhea. Prostate enlarged, sense of a lump and heaviness in perineum, worse at even step. Seminal
emission during afternoon sleep.
Modalities - Better from rest in horizontal position. Warm water improves nausea and retching. Warmth
improves. Worse touch, pressurerai, leftside. Worseleastmotion, exertion, stooping, rising, walking, going
up or down stairs. Worse sex, particularly groin pain. Worse on shipboard, riding in carriage. Worse from
noise. Worse from cold, washing clothes, sunstroke. Worse closing eyes.
Mouth - Mouth feels furred, benumbed.

***Froth before the mouth with shaking chill. Teeth feel as if cold water is too cold. Bites tip of tongue during
sleep. Lockjaw, morning on waking. Remains open involuntarily, cannot close.
Nose - Pain over root of nose. Ozaena. Chronic catarrh, yellow-green, thick offensive, discharge. Discharge
 is yellowish and offensive. Post-nasal catarrh (Puls., Thuj.).
Sensations - As if her head was another strange head. As if vertex did not belong to her. Like a pressing pain
in root of nose and about ears. As of a veil before eyes. As if something in esophagus were slipping towards
epigastrium. Like labor pains in lower abdomen. As if a child were bounding in body. As if bones were broken
and would fall asunder. As if dying.
Skin - Stinging, stabs everywhere. Itching sensations. Sensitive skin on the thighs.
Stomach - Seasickness. Nausea and vomiting when closing eyes and on motion (Tab.). Nausea worse least
motion, looking steadily at one object from noise. Nausea and retching better drinking warm water.
Temperature - Shaking chill with foam at mouth. Internal coldness. Cold sweat easily excited.
Vertigo - Faints after washing clothes. Vertigo with nausea, worse stooping, kneeling. Vertigo with nausea
and vomiting on least motion, worse when closing eyes.
COMMENTS - Grimmer stated. “The orange spider poison can cure when indicated on the totality of its
symptoms. Decay of bones, abscesses and cancer of the liver and lungs. It acts profoundly on the nervous
system, producing extreme sensitivity to noise the vibration penetrating to the teeth.”
Keynotes extreme sensitiveness to noise, worse by least noise, “sounds penetrate the teeth.” The
sensitiveness extends to vibrations of any kind, jar of a step, riding in a carriage or in a boat.
“Worse closing eyes,” especially in vertigo and symptoms of the head and stomach. Seasickness or sickness
of pregnancy. Severe headaches, affecting the eyes, especially the left. The ears are highly sensitive. Intoler
ance of light.
Frequent cough, convulsive, head spasmodically jerked forward, knees jerked up to abdomen. Hallucinations
of sight and hearing, luminous vibrations and rushing sounds. A kind of intoxication is induced, hilarity,
talkativeness. “Time passes too slowly.”
Burning pains and itching are common and a stitch high up in apex of left chest has proved a guiding symptom
for Ther. in the cure of cases of tuberculosis. “Burning in liver region” led to the cure of abscess and even
cancer of that organ.
H. C. Allen noted it for spinal irritation and disease of the spine and other bones. Decay, necrosis and
scrofulous disease of bones have all been cured with it. “In scrofulosis when the best remedies fail to relieve.”
Chackravarti related a case of headache cured with Ther. Mr. B., 35, well built of bilious temperament, had for
three months severe headache with nausea and vomiting like seasickness and shaking chills. Dullness and
fullness in the head with throbbing beginning in occiput, preceded by flickering before the eyes.
Head felt large and heavy. The pains began in the morning increase during the day and last until evening.
Excessive irritation with loss of sustaining power. Worse from least overwork and motion, better by keeping
quiet in horizontal position. Constipation, stools hard, small, dry.
Ther. 3x was given, one drop in water twice daily. The pain was much better the next day and was gone in
less than a week.
RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Aeon, (sensitiveness to noises), Mosch, (nausea), Graph, (more chronic effects).
Follows well: Sulph., Calc., Lyc. (scrofula). Compare: (1) Aran- d. and Spiders generally. (2) Hemicrania worse
closing eyes, worse noise, Sep. (But Sep. worse from noise is less intense). (3) Vertigo and faintness on
closing eyes, Lach. (4) Headache, nervousness, hysteria. Tarent. (5) Stooping down, violent stitch high up in
left chest, thence to back, Myrt-c. through to left scapula. (6) Time passes too quickly (too slowly Cann-i., Arg-
n., Nux-m.). (7) Vertigo
on closing eyes, Lach., Thuj. (on opening them, Tab., on looking up, Puls. Sil.). (8) Headache, worse lying
down, Lach.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Phatak.

name: Thevetia Nerifolia
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - thev. Thevetia nerifolia. Ahovai tree. Cerbera thevetia. Ahovai tree of the Antilles. N. O.
Apocynaceae. Tincture or trituration of the seeds. Historical dose: All potencies.
CLINICAL - Diarrhea. Somnolence. Throat, disorders. Vomiting.
HOMEOPATHIC - J. Balfour observed the effect of eating the seeds on two boys, age 7 and 8 years old. He
noted “A tendency to sleep, disturbed every three to four minutes by irritation in the throat and the discharge
of a mouthful of frothy mucus with a sort of gulp, then the child would lie down and close his eyes until again
disturbed.”
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Apoc. Stroph. Upa.
REFERENCES - Clarke.
 ***THIOSINAMINUM
(Mustard Seed Oil)
PHARMACY - thiosin. Thiosinaminum. Mustard seed oil. Rhodallinum. Rhodallin. Cruciferae. Allyl
sulphocarbamide, derived from Mustard seed oil. Trituration of the crystals. Solution in alcohol. Historical
dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Adenitis. Adhesions. Allergies. Alzheimer’s disease. Ankylosis. Arteriosclerosis. Arthritis. Carpal
tunnel syndrome. Cataract. Cicatrices. Contractures. Cornea, opacities. Deafness. Dupuytren’s, contracture.
Ectropion. Emphysema. Fibroids. Frozen, shoulder. Glands, enlarged. Glands, indurated. Indigestion.
Indurations. Keloids. Lupus. Lymphatic glands, enlarged. Ménière’s disease. Old, age. Otitis, media.
Otosclerosis. Painful, adhesions. Premature, aging. Rectum, stricture. Scar, tissue. Scleroderma. Senile,
dementia. Stiffness. Strictures. Tabes dorsalis. Tennis, elbow.
Tinnitus. Tumors. Urticaria. Uterine, tumors. Wounds.
HERBAL - Thiosinaminum belongs to the same chemical group as Urea. The colorless, bitter crystals are
soluble in water, alcohol and ether.
HOMEOPATHIC - Thiosin. has been effective in curing adhesions, scars, lupus and enlarged lymphatic
glands. It’s a dissolvent, externally and internally, for dissolving scar tissue, keloids. It has been used for
tumors, enlarged glands, lupus, strictures, adhesions. Inflamed, swollen glands, adenitis.
Ectropion, opacities of cornea, cataract, ankylosis, fibroids, scleroderma. Noises in ear. Tinnitus aurium,
deafness. Gastric, vesicle and rectal crises. Strictures of rectum. Tumors of the uterus appendages.
For tabes dorsalis, improving the lightning pains. Sensation of heat and burning in affected parts. Increases
body weight and reduces glandular swellings. Dr. A. S. Hard suggested Thiosin. for retarding old age.
MIND - Depression of spirits. Aversion to consolation. Moody, alternating moods. Alzheimer's disease. Senile
dementia.
Abdomen - Flatulence. Internal adhesions after surgery, after hysterectomy, etc. Intestinal strictures.
Back - Tom ligaments in the shoulder. Frozen shoulder.
Ears - Ménière’s syndrome, vertigo. Noises in ear. Tinnitus caused by fibrous bands. Formation of fibrous
bands impeding free movement of the ossicles. Otosclerosis. Suppurative otitis media. Thickened eardrum.
Catarrhal deafness with scar thickenings. Deafness due to some fibrous change in the nerve. Adhesions of
the Eustachian tube. Eustachian tube catarrh.
Eyes - Cataract of the lens or comea. Stricture of the lachrymal duct.
Female - Painful uterine adhesions, pelvic inflammation. Uterine tumors. Infertility-
Food - Increased appetite.
Kidneys - Strictures of the urethra and painful urination. Urine increased in quantity, no albumen or formed
elements. Increased urination at night.

***Limbs - Locomotor ataxia. Stiffness of joints.
Lungs - Accelerated respiration. Emphysema.
Nose - Allergies.
Rectum - Stricture of rectum.
Skin - Wounds that are slow to heal. Wounds that form a lot of scar tissue. Scar tissues. Granulations, scars,
keloids after burns, wounds. Inelasticity of the skin. Indurations. Urticaria. Lupus.
Stomach - Indigestion, flatulence of stomach and bowels, worse after eating. Pyloric stenosis. Stricture of
esophagus.
Vertigo- Arteriosclerotic vertigo. Ménière’s syndrome, vertigo.
COMMENTS - The mustard seeds of Sin-n. are of a reddish-brown color. Mixed with those of Sin-a., they are
crushed between rollers and subsequently powdered and sifted at least twice. A fixed oil is obtained by
pressure from the residue left on the sieve. The powdered mustard is mixed with a considerable quantity of
wheaten flour and a small quantity of turmeric powder.
The Treasury of Botany noted that “The term ‘flour of mustard’ is not quite accurate, as the mustard seeds
themselves contain little or no starchy material. The chemical ingredients are somewhat complex. Among them
are a peculiar acid called Myronic acid, noticeable as containing a large proportion of Sulphur. When mixed
with water and a peculiar substance called Myrosine, (analogous to albumen), also found in mustard seeds,
yields a volatile Oil of Mustard.
“This has no separate existence in the seeds, but is formed artificially in the manner just stated. This oil is very
acrid and has been used as a rubefacient. The fixed oil before mentioned as existing in the seed itself has little
or no acridity and has been used as a purgative and vermifuge.”
Scar tissue and adhesions. Ringing in the ears. Tinnitus or deafness in elderly people from otosclerosis. The
 bones of the ears get calcium deposits. Scarred eardrums or eardrums that thicken and cause hearing
difficulties. Chronic ruptured eardrums in children (Calen, acutely). Ménière’s disease
Thiosinaminum (Chin-s.). Vertigo. Opacities of the cornea, cataracts.
Torn ligaments, especially in the shoulder. Painful adhesions affecting mobility of a joint. Internal adhesions of
the uterus, adhesions after surgery. Strictures of the urethra and painful urination.
Dr. McCullogh found that it exerts a marked beneficial action on ear diseases accompanied by the formation
of new connective tissue. He believed that this beneficial action was due to an increased pliability of this tissue.
Its administration should always be accompanied by mechanical measures; better and more prompt results
may be obtained in recent cases.
McCullogh also noted a beneficial action on vertigo and better results may be obtained with it in the relief of
tinnitus aurium than with any drug used previously.
C. H. Pennoyer related the case of Mrs. C., 69, who had been ill for several years with gastric distress, sciatica,
pains in hips down to knees, worse by motion. She had indigestion, flatulence of stomach and bowels, worse
after eating. Pain in back. Inability to walk, much perspiration, depression of spirits and subnormal temperature.
Her father had died at 69 of stomach trouble, mother at 58 of stricture of the bowel.
Examination showed stricture of the rectum two inches above the anus, there being a tense fibrous band
forming a ring opening, which would not admit the index finger. Bougies and mechanical measures failed to
relieve. Weakness was so great, the patient would faint at stool. Nutrition improved under general treatment,
but the local condition was unchanged.
A year later the stricture was slightly increased. Thiosin. was then given, 2 grains, twice daily. The following
year the patient was found to be much improved. Examination showed that the scar band had gone, the
speculum could be introduced and the mucus membrane was normal in appearance, though not as elastic as
a normal rectum should be.
W. Spencer applied this property of

***resolving scar tissues in cases of tinnitus aurium “where the ossicles are bound down and the function of
the tympanic cavity so much impaired by fibrous bands or adhesions.” In such cases he had encouraging
success. Enlarged lymphatic glands have been reduced in the same way.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Sil., Calen., Sinapis and Cruciferae. (2) Uterine tumors, Thlaspi. (3) Diuresis -
also chemical. (4) Urea. Lup., Tub. (5) Scars. Sil., Graph., Fl-ac. (6) Affections of rectum, Nit-ac., Graph., Scirr.
REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Thlaspi Bursa Pastoris
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - thlaspi. Thlaspi bursa pas- toris. Shepherd’s purse. Bursa pastoris. Capsella bursa pastoris. N.
O. Cruciferae. Tincture of fresh flowering plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Colic. Cystitis. Dropsy. Dysentery. Dysuria. Fibroma. Fibroids, uterine. Flatulence.
Gallstones. Gonorrhea. Hematuria. Hemorrhages. Kidney, stones. Leucorrhea. Liver, disorders.
Metrorrhagia. Miscarriage. Nausea. Nosebleed. Ranula. Strangury. Urethritis. Uric acid, diathesis. Uterine,
bleeding. Uterus, cancer. Whitlow.
HERBAL - The Treasury of Botany noted that Thlaspi is “A native of Europe, it has accompanied Europeans
in all their migrations and established itself wherever they have settled to until the soil.” It does not refuse to
grow in the poorest soils, but it luxuriates in the richest.
Burnett noticed that it flourished best in the neighborhood of dunghills and the odor of the tincture is much
suggestive thereof. Some have seen in the seed-vessel the signature of the shape of the uterus.
Burnett found in it an organ remedy of vast importance. He said the tincture is the best thing to give for menses
that have been checked, for uterine hemorrhages he preferred the potencies.
Thlaspi bursa pastoris HOMEOPATHIC - Hemorrhagic and uric acid diathesis. Hemorrhages are profuse,
periodic, blood dark, clotted. Uterine hemorrhage with cramps and expulsion of clots. Hemorrhage from uterine
fibroid with aching in back or general bruised soreness. Bleeding fibroids.
Bleeding between the menses. Tendencies to miscarriage. Bleeding at ovulation or postpartum hemorrhage
of dark, red, oozing blood (Ham.). Passive bleeding. Hemorrhage with burning or a mild bladder problem.
Uterine hemorrhages concomitant with bladder infections. Albuminuria during pregnancy. Kidney and
bladder irritation. Kidney stone formation (Sars., Lyc.). Chronic cystitis. Craves buttermilk. The toes are
affected along with cramping pain in stomach. Chronic neuralgia. Aching between scapulae.
MIND - Impulse to walk far. Restless, goes from room to room. Agony because of pains. Spells of causeless
weeping. Stupefied and dull, as if she had not slept enough.
 Abdomen - Flatulence. Pain between end of sternum and umbilicus like needles or an electric shock.
Cramping pain, better bending over. Bloated after eating, with loud emissions of flatus; bowels feel as if drawn
down and out.
Back - Continued pain in small of back. Morning backache. Wakes with violent pain between the shoulders.
Weakness between scapula. Weakness between shoulders on rising.
Breasts - Milky water from right nipple. Shooting pains in right breast.
Causations - Suppression of hemorrhages or vaginal discharges.
Chest - Pulsative pain in left chest. Pain, uneasiness, and pressure behind the sternum.
Ears - Deafness and pain in left ear. Sensation as if something pushing in right ear. Spasmodic drawing from
right ear to right lower jaw. Dry eruptions behind the ears. Small vesicles, with yellow points, above right ear.
Scaly eruptions behind ears, with fissures in the fold. Sensation as of an insect entering the left ear, making
buzzing noise, relieved by boring in ear with fingers.
Eyes - Eyes puffy. Dusky eyes, shiny and with dilated pupils. Dull ache behind eyes on awaking in the morning
with aching in nape. Blurred vision. Sensation as if eyes are swollen, as if the ball was pressed inward.
Sensation as of dust in eyes, worse after sewing or using eyes.
Face - Eyes and face puffy. Face feels parched and dry. Miserable countenance.
Female - Menses bright red and profuse. Menses too frequent and copious. Every alternate period very
profuse. Menstrual blood stains indelibly. Leucorrhea before and after menses, bloody, dark offensive.
Leucorrhea stains indelibly, smells foul, excites itching. Scarcely recovers from one period before another
begins. Metrorrhagia. Cutting pain from side to side across pubes, worse by standing. Sore pain in uterus on
rising. Uterine bleeding with violent uterine colic. Uterine fibroids with cramps and expulsion of clots.
Sexual excitement.
Food - Aversion to the sight of food. Aversion to potatoes. Craves buttermilk, juicy fruits. Oat cakes are eaten
with a relish. Desire for bread and butter, which does not taste good. Nausea better after strawberries.
Head - Headache, with great fullness. Frontal pain, worse toward evening. Pain from above eyes up over head
to nape. Scaly eruption behind ears. Sharp pain over right eye, drawing eye upwards, behind right eye.
Heaviness over eyes. Pressing pain in forehead. Stupefying pressing pain in forehead. Violent headache,
lasting all night.
Heart - Feels large and sore, then throb- bings go up into back of neck. Stitching pains at the apex. Palpitations
worse in the morning in bed. Palpitation ending with cough. Pain left side of apex.
Kidneys - Chronic cystitis. Kidney colic and stones. Urethritis, urine runs away in little jets. Frequent desire.
Urine heavy, phos- phatic. Accumulation of gtave\,brick-dust sediment. Hematuria. Albuminuria during
pregnancy. Dysuria and spasmodic reten
tion, after forceps delivery. Dysuria in the elderly, with dribbling. Often replaces the use of the catheter.
Limbs - Weariness in lower limbs, can hardly stand. Drawing pain in left thigh like gout. Severe pain and
stiffness in right knee cap. Tearing, gouty pains left leg, worse in forenoon. Strained pain in right shoulder.
Gouty pain in arm. Tearing, gnawing pain from elbow to throat. Rheumatic pain in left arm and shoulder blade,
extending to throat. Hands tremble when holding anything. Swelling of veins of hand and arm. Tearing,
wrenching pain in left wrist. Redness around root of nails. Lame feeling in right forefinger. Pain in the
periosteum.
Liver - Gallstone colic, liver affection being secondary to uterine condition.
Lungs - Accumulation of phlegm in lungs. Convulsive cough, relieved as soon as phlegm is loosened.
Hemoptysis. Dry cough on lying down with aching under left breast. Cough with irritation behind sternum. Fits
of coughing as if the sternum pressed inward.
Male - Spermatic cord sensitive to concussion of walking or riding. Stitching in penis, running through to anus.
Soreness of prepuce with intense itching or cold sensation (Agar.).
Modalities - Better bending over. Better cold bathing, dampness, Better open air, rapid motion. Worse every
other month. Worse toward night. Worse suppression of hemorrhages or vaginal discharges.
Mouth - Bitter, slimy taste with dryness of mouth. Taste like bad eggs. Scratchy feeling in the palate. Mouth
feels raw, as if from smoking strong tobacco. Mouth cracked in right corner and sore. Upper lip cracked. Teeth
sore on closing jaws. Gums sore, neuralgic feeling in teeth.
Nose - Dull pain at root of nose. Gnawing pain in nasal bones. Soreness in nose, with tenderness on touch.
Dryness of nose, preceded by sensations of bleeding. Bruised feeling each side of bridge, with bleeding from
nose. Frequent nosebleeds. Nosebleed after nasal operations. Especially passive hemorrhage. Free
discharge of
blood and mucus from left nostril.
Perspiration - Sweat profuse at night.
 Rectum - Passage of blood. Diarrhea mushy, brown, dark, urgent, and sometimes with nausea. Diarrhea
yellowish color. Constipation. Slow and difficult stool. Obstinate slow stool with severe pressure and urging
without effect. Hard, difficult, dry stool, leaving anus sore. Bleeding after hard stool. Troublesome itching and
protrusion of hemorrhoids.
Sensations - Sensation as of needles or shocks between end of sternum and umbilicus. As if neck and left
shoulder would break with pain.
Skin - Skin dry, hot, even to burning.
Sleep - Restless tossing about. Frequent wakening. Sleeplessness. Sleepy after eating or falls asleep while
eating. Confused and unpleasant dreams when asleep.
Stomach - Sick, faint feeling in stomach. Emptiness feeling in stomach. Cramping pain in stomach, toes hurt
as well as stomach. Flatulence. Sour rising like heartburn. Attacks of nausea. Nausea so severe, could hardly
raise head from pillow. Tobacco smoke, of which she was fond, now nauseates her. Nausea in the forenoon.
Nausea with loathing of food. Vomited brown, sourish blood in the afternoon. Vomiting and purging, with great
debility.
Temperature - Alternate chill and sweat during headache. All night chills, with wakefulness and slight diarrhea
with swelling of tonsils. Chill at 9 a.m. or from 7 p.m. to 9 p.m. Chilly when uncovering during fever. Chill worse
from going into warm room during fever. Continued fever with quick pulse.
Throat - Hoarse in morning with slight sore throat. Soreness of upper part of throat. Swelling of throat and
face, worse left side. Tonsils swollen. Dry throat on swallowing. Dryness of fauces, with sensation of con-
striction of the throat. Dry sensation and scraping. Violent sore throat. Sensation as if the throat was laced
together.
Tongue - Tongue and palate feel as if scalded. Ranula, caused enlargement of submaxillary duct. Tongue
white, coated.
Taste like bad eggs.
Vertigo - Vertigo with sensation as if drunk. Dizziness in the forehead, like seasickness. Vertigo, worse rising.
COMMENTS - “Shepherd’s purse,” said Gerarde, “stayeth bleeding in any part of the body, whether the juice
or the decoction thereof be drunk or whether it be used poultice-wise or in both or any way else. In a clyster it
cureth the bloody flux, it healeth green and bleeding wounds, it is marvelous good for inflammations new
beginning and for all diseases which must be checked back and cooled.”
Gerarde added that the decoction will stop diarrhea, blood-spitting, hematuria and all other fluxes of blood.
Burnett noted it for the effects of suppressed uterine disease.
Burnett observed it cause sexual excitement like Canth. It aided him in the cure of an inveterate case of
gallstones, the origin of which he traced to the uterus.
Dudgeon reported the case of a woman who had recovered from jaundice. She then had a peculiar discharge
after the menses flux of a brownish-green blood which was attended with obscure abdominal pains. The cervix
uterus was swollen and soft but not ulcerated.
Dudgeon failed to cure this, but Rafin- esque of Paris, after trying other remedies, succeeded with Thlaspi. 6c,
which had an immediate positive effect. Rafinesque then gave the tincture, and then again the 6c, and in a few
weeks the cure was complete.
Dudgeon, in an article on Thlaspi., quoted a case of Rademacher’s showing the action of Thlaspi. on uric acid
excretion.
A woman whom Rademacher had relieved ten years before of a large quantity of urinary sand, again presented
herself; her abdominal cavity was full of water, extremely swollen and she was passing urine of a light red color
with bloody sediment. Thlaspi. tincture, 30 drops five times a day, was given solely with the idea of stopping
the hematuria. The result was a more copious discharge of urinary sand than ever before, the urine increased,
the dropsy disappeared and the woman was cured.
Dudgeon's own cases are no less striking. One such case concerned a woman, 76, who had rheumatic
muscular pains in various parts and an abundant secretion of uric acid, which passed away with every
discharge of urine.
Sometimes small stones formed and there was much pain in their passage along the ureter, but generally it
passed in the form of coarse sand, which formed a thick layer at the bottom of the utensil. This sand continued
to pass after the cessation of the rheumatic pains, which lasted six or seven weeks. Puls., Pic-ac., and Lyc.
had no effect. Thlaspi. 1c diminished the sand to an insignificant amount.
Dudgeon also noted the case of a man, 57, who, in addition to other dyspeptic symptoms, had unusually large
discharges of coarse uric acid, coming away in masses as large as a big pin ’ s head but without pain. Thlaspi
lx stopped this.
He also recorded the case of a woman, nearly 80, who suffered from the presence of a calculus in left ureter.
 She had previously passed much sand. Thlaspi. lx caused a great discharge of sand and a speedy relief of
her pain.
Dudgeon referred to a case of Harper’s illustrating the action of Thlaspi. on the bowels. An elderly woman had
suffered for years from a copious discharge of mucus, pus, sometimes mixed with blood, sometimes nearly all
blood, which passed from the bowels after each evacuation. She had been under high homeopathy, oxygen
treatment and for a long time under Harper’s care, all without effect. He then gave Thlaspi. tincture in 5 drop
doses and cured the case in a few days.
Clarke, with Thlaspi. lx, saved a woman who had been curetted several times with little success from a further
curetting, which was advised as being essential to the cure. Thlaspi. stopped the hemorrhages, restored the
periods to their proper term and the patient immediately began to recover her strength, which had been drained
to the last degree. There was no return of the trouble.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Urt-u., Croc., Trill., Mill. (2) Cruciferae, especially Sinapis. (3) Thiosin. - fibroma,
uterine tumors. (4) Matth. - inspissated secretions, grows near sewage stream. (5) Kidney stones, Oci. (6) Uric
acid, pain in shoulder, Urt-u. (7) Uterine hemorrhages, Trill., Vib., Ust., Senec. (8) Hemorrhages from bowel,
Merc., Nit-ac., Sulph., Caps., Merc-c., Phos.
REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

name: Thuja Lobbi
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - thuj-1. Thuja lobbi. Red cedar of Alaska. Thuja menziessi. Thuja plicata. N. O. Coniferae. The
tincture is prepared with the fresh leaves. Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.
HOMEOPATHIC-ThujalobbiorRedCedaris atree which is almost 50 meters high and which originates from
Alaska. From the heart-wood are separated out the Thuja plicines with antibiotic, as well as anti-fungal
properties. These substances also exist in Thuja occidentalis.
There is no homeopathic proving for this remedy, but Dano conducted a clinical proving with it in 1934. Thuj-
1. has emaciation and constipation. Chilly and the limbs are cold.
MIND - Anxious melancholy. Weeps and moans easily. Indifferent to everything except for his obsessions with
his own suicide. Depressive neurotic condition. Psychosis from anguish. Lack of will-power. Personality
problems with those around him. Hebephrenia.
COMMENTS - If the development within the compass of homeopathic remedies is followed, according to Roy.
Thuja lobbi can be situated on the line: Aur., Sep., Thuja lobbi.
The tendency to suicide, which is characteristic of Aur. and the indifferent psychological disposition which
characterizes Sep., can be anticipated in the development of a symptomatological picture for this remedy.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Tendency to suicide (Aur.) and indifferent disposition (Sep., Ph-ac.).
REFERENCES - Julian.

name: Thuja Occidentalis
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - thuj. Thuja occidentalis. Arbor vitae. N. O. Coniferae, Tribe, Cu- presineae. Tincture of the fresh
green twigs. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies. Locally, forwarts and excrescences, tincture or
cerate.
CLINICAL - Abdomen, distended. Anal, warts. Angina pectoris. Anus, fissure. Asthma. Balanitis. Bedwetting.
Cancer. Catalepsy. Chorea. Clavus. Colic. Condylomata. Constipation. Convulsions. Cysts. Diarrhea.
Dyspareunia. Dysmenorrhea. Ear, polyps. Emaciation. Epilepsy. Epulis. Eyes, inflammation. Eyes, tumors.
Fatty, tumors. Feet, fetid. Flatulence. Fibroids. Fig, warts. Ganglion. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Hemorrhage. Hair,
disorders. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Hernia. Herpes zoster. Ichthyosis. Intussusception. Joints, cracking.
Leucorrhea. Miscarriage. Moles. Morvan’s, disease. Mucous, patches. Muscae, volitantes. Myopia. Nevus.
Nasal, catarrh. Neck, stiff. Onanism. Ovarian, cysts. Ovary, pain. Ozaena. Neuralgias. Nose, catarrh, polyps.
Paralysis. Pemphigus. Polyps. Post-nasal, catarrh. Pregnancy, imaginary. Prostate, disease. Ptosis. Ranula.
Rheumatism. Rickets. Sciatica. Seminal, emissions. Sinusitis. Smallpox. Sycosis. Syphilis. Tea, effects.
Teeth, decay. Tongue, ulcers. Toothache. Tumors. Vaccination, effects. Vaccinosis. Vaginismus. Vaginitis.
Variola. Venereal, warts. Warts. Whooping cough.
HERBAL - Thuja was introduced to France from Canada during the reign of Francis I, and it now has an
honored place in many gardens and shrubbery. The native habitat of Thuja is not without its importance in
relation to therapeutics. It loves swamps, it is Hahnemann’s typical anti-sycotic and Grauvogl’s hydrogenoid.
HOMEOPATHIC - Thuj. is one of Hahnemann’s discoveries. Most of the remedies of his Materia Medica had
been known in a fashion before his time, but practically nothing was known of the therapeutic properties of
 Thuj. until Hahnemann proved it. Old-
school observers found in Thuj. an efficient hemostatic, locally applied, especially after tooth extraction.
Hahnemann foundThuj. to be an antidote to the sycotic miasm, meaning the constitutional disease resulting
from suppressed gonorrhea and having warty growths as its characteristic manifestation. Soft, spongy warts,
emitting a fetid fluid with a sweetish odor something like herring brine. Warts that bleed readily and having the
coxcomb or cauliflower form.
Thuj. acts chiefly on the mucus membranes of genito-urinary tract intestines, skin, mind, nerves, glands,
occiput and left side. Acts on skin, blood, gastro-intestinal tract, kidneys and brain.
Wart-like growths on mucus and skin surfaces. Soft, exuberant, fungoid tissue, polyps, condylomata, warts,
pediculated, black, suppressed. Spongy tumors, jig warts. bleeding fungus growths. Birthmarks. Moist mucus
tubercles.
Antibacterial action, as in gonorrhea and vaccination. Vaccinosis, never well since vaccination, neuralgia,
skin troubles etc. Variola, aborts the pustule and prevents the suppurating fever. Suppressed gonorrhea.
Crying babies with a sycotic taint from the parents. Complaints from moonlight.
Burning, sticking, numbing, drawing or wandering pains worse warmth. Sycotic pains, tearing in muscles and
joints, worse at rest, better in dry weather, worse damp humid atmosphere, lameness. Left-sided and chilly
medicine.
Great prostration. Rapid exhaustion and emaciation. Neurasthenia, prostatic weakness. The patient is
exhausted and soft, body feels thin and delicate, frail. Deadness of the affected part. Sensation of lightness of
body when walking.
Flesh feels as if beaten off the bones. Edema about the joints. Pains keep extending from original site.
Stitching, tearing pains in the glands as if they were being torn to pieces. Rheumatism. Paralysis. Jerking of
the upper part of the body of spinal origin, chorea. Discharges are foul, acrid, musty, rancid or of sweetish
odor. Oily, stools, skin, sweat. Trickling in urethra. Congenital inguinal hernia. Venous stasis. Aneurysm by
anastomosis, swelling of the blood vessels.
MIND - Introverted and private. Dullness of mind. Cannot concentrate. Speech slow, hunts for words. Hurried
with ill humor, talks hastily, swallows words. Makes mistakes in writing and talking. Uses wrong words or omits
words and syllables.
Confusion in morning. Loses his way in well-known streets. Cretinism. Imbecility of mind and loss of speech
after vaccination. Vanishing of thoughts while speaking. Disinclined to talk, worse on awaking mornings.
Sadness. Aversion to life. Depression, feels isolated and alone. Aversion to company. Feels isolated and
different from everyone, that they do not belong. Avoids the sight of people. Mental depression after childbirth
(Sep.). Irritable, jealous, quarrelsome towards husband or mother.
Self-contempt. Reproaches himself. Thinks she is ugly or unclean. Feels unlovable. Emotional sensitivity.
Music causes weeping and trembling. When spoken to answers with tears and sobbing.
Anxiety about salvation. Anxiety about health. Anger from contradiction. Overexcited, angry or anxious about
trifles. Restlessness with ill-humor. Walks in a circle in room. Talks hastily.
Fear of getting infections, diseases, germs. Despair of recovery. Fear of being incurable, of death. Thinks
his blood is dirty or poisoned. Insane women who will not be touched or approached. Fear of the wind.
Fear of strangers. Nervous, begins to twitch at approach of strangers. Mistrustful, secretive and paranoid. Fear
of being discovered, and their secrets will be revealed. Full of hidden plans and secrets. Tells lies to hide real
intentions. Manipulates others. Controls herself among strangers and doctors. Fanaticism.
Indifference to opposite sex. Fear of getting venereal diseases. Religious fanatics. Religious aversion to sex
(Puls.). Feels sex is
Thuja occidentalis dirty, shameful, sinful. Sexual perversions. Immoral sexual behavior. Secret and hidden
sexual activities. Many sex partners. Sexual desires excessive and strange.
Fixed ideas and delusions, as if a strange person were at his side. Delusions as if soul and body were
separated, as if something alive in abdomen (Croc.). Delusions, as if body were fragile, made of glass.
Delusion as if being controlled by a stronger power. Imagines himself double or treble. Sudden impulse to kill
herself. Time passes too quickly.
Abdomen - Distended. Indurations in abdomen. Intussusception of intestines. Flatulence and distention,
protruding here and there. Colic. Gurgling in bowels. Rumbling, flatulence, upper part drawn in. Movements
in abdomen, as if something alive, without pain (Croc.). Soreness of navel. Cutting and squeezing in
hypogas- trium. Ileus. Cutting, squeezing in hypo- gastrium, groin. Stinging as from needles. Hernia. Stitches
in inguinal glands. Soreness of navel. Yellowish or brownish spots on abdomen. Herpes zoster.
Back - Cramp-like pains. Drawing pain, when sitting, in sacrum, coccyx. Burning in lumbar region. Pulsation
in the back. Pressive, bruised sensation in back. Pressing pain over kidney region. Atrophy of long muscles.
 Spine curved. Spinal curvature after vaccination. Stands bent forward. Boils on back. Blood boils. Steatomous
tumors. Cervical glands swollen.
Bladder - Paralysis of sphincter of bladder. Bladder feels paralyzed, must wait for urination. Violent burning
pain in fundus of bladder. Burning in urethra. Urethra swollen, inflamed. Cutting pains after urination (Sars.).
Pain and burning felt near neck of bladder. Jerking, voluptuous sensation in fossa navicularis. Sensation as if
a drop were running down urethra, after urination. Urinary stream forked and small. Frequent urging to
urinate, with profuse flow. Frequent urination at night. Involuntary urination at night. Lithemia. Diabetes
mellitus.
Breasts - Aching, pressing pains. Drawing pains, with swelling of both breasts. Sensitiveness and heaviness
after the menses. Stinging and itching. Breast cysts, lumps and tumors. Indurations in left breast. Retracted
nipples.
Causations - Suppressed sycosis. Badly treated or suppressed gonorrhea. Syphilis. Vaccinations.
Sulphur, mercury. Sunstroke. Sexual excess. Tea, coffee, beer, tobacco. Sweets, fat meat, onions.
Chest - Stitches in chest, worse cold drinks. Chest pains take various directions. Pains radiating in various
directions. Sensations as if falling drops inchest. Skin of clavicles blue. Brown spots on chest. Brown spots in
axilla, like nevi. Skin on clavicles blue. Strong perspiration in axillae.
Constitutions - Suited to hydrogenoid constitutions. Strumous and sycotic pains. Lax muscles, light-haired
adults and children. Lymphatic temperament in very fleshy persons, dark complexion, black hair, unhealthy
skin.
Coughs Dry, hacking cough in afternoon, with pain in pit of stomach. Cough only during the day or worse as
soon as he eats or drinks anything cold. Constant cough without difficulty in breathing. Cough in morning after
rising. Cough evenings after lying down.
Dreams - Anxious dreams. Dreams of teeth breaking off. Dreams of falling, of misfortune. Dreams of dead
people, of bodies, of dying.
Ears - Chronic otitis, purulent discharge. Watery, purulent, putrid otorrhea. Chronic otorrhea after vaccination.
Ear discharge smells like putrid meat. Polyps. Cracking in ears when empty swallowing. Noise in ear as
from boiling water. Inner ear as if swollen with hardness of hearing.
Eyes - Conjunctivitis after vaccination. Blood-red eyes, full of tears, stand open. Styes and tarsal tumors
(Staph.). Eyelids agglutinated at night, dry, scaly. Burning and stinging of eyelids. Lids heavy as lead. Jagged
iris. Ciliary neuralgia. Iritis. Acute and chronic inflammation of sclera. Chronic scleritis. Chronic keratitis, with
excessive photophobia,
Thuja occidentalis after vaccination. Small brown spots on cornea. Exophthalmos from tumors behind
eyeball. Large, flat phlyctenules, indolent. Constant ache in eye, worse bright light. Feels as if cold air were
streaming out of the head through eye, better when warmly covered. Photopsies, beyond visual field. Floating
green stripes. Eye symptoms better warmth and covering.
Face - Pale, waxy, shiny, dark under eyes. Greasy skin of face. Light brown, freckles on face. B loated.
Edematous erysipelas of face. Eruptions leaves livid spots. Lips pale, swollen, peeling off. Twitching of lower
lip. Warts. Tumor on cheek. Blood vessels of face and temples distended. Netted with spider-like veins. Boring
in malar bones (left), better by touch. Face aches. Burning heat and redness of face. Neuralgia from
suppressed gonorrhea or eczema of ear. Cracking of joint of jaw.
Female - Sweaty genitals before menses. Bearing down pain during menses. Menses too early, too short.
Scanty, retarded menses. Burning in varicose veins of genitals during menses. Leucorrhea, profuse, thick,
greenish leucorrhea, from one period to the next. Vaginitis. Vaginal itching. Vagina very sensitive, prevents
sex (Staph., Plat.). Venereal warts. Fistula of rectum and vagina. Whitish ulcers on labium majorum. Warty
growths on vulva and perineum. Uterine polyps, fleshy excrescences. Cauliflower excrescences, bleeding
easily. Ovarian cysts. Severe pain in left ovary and left inguinal region. Chronic ovaritis after gonorrhea.
Ovaritis, worse left side, at every menstrual period (Lach.). Erosion of cervix. Fetus moves violently, awakes
her. Prolapsed uterus. Miscarriage in the third month. Labor pains weak or ceasing.
Food - Complete loss of appetite. Craving alternating with want of appetite. No appetite, with mental
depression. Unable to eat breakfast. Aversion to fresh meat, potatoes, onions and garlic. Desires chocolate,
cold food, drinks and salt. Worse from beer, wine, acids, tobacco, onion, sweets. Bread tastes dry and bitter.
Tea-drinking dyspepsia. Thirst increased,
Thuja occidentalis __________ at night.
Glands - Adenitis. Tearing pains in glands. Enlarged, swollen glands.
Head - Left-sided headaches. Pain as if pierced by a nail (Coff., Ign.). Pressing in vertex, as from a nail.
Tearing, jerking pain. Headache, worse sexual excess or tea, better bending head backwards. Feeling of
numbness in brain. Sensation as if parietal bones were being knocked to pieces. Heaviness of occiput. Boring
 through the temples. Meningitis. Neuralgia from tea (Sei.). Wants head wrapped up. Honey smelling sweat.
White scaly dandruff. Dry hair, splits and falls out. Warts.
Heart - Anxious palpitations, on waking in the morning. Stitches in region of heart. Cramp in heart. Visible
palpitations, without anxiety. Excitement and pulsation of arteries before menses. Palpitations during menses.
Palpitations from ascending. Violent pulsations in evening. Pulse full and accelerated in evening. Pulse slow

Kidneys - Nephritis with swollen feet. Pains from left kidney to epigastrium, worse motion. Lithemia. Diabetes
mel- litus. Cutting, squeezing in bladder and urethra. Urethra swollen, inflamed. Forward cutting in urethra on
urinating. Desire sudden and urgent, but cannot be controlled. Frequent urination, with profuse flow, with pain
in other parts. Urine burns, dribbles, foul, foamy. Sensation of trickling after urinating, as if drop running down
urethra. Involuntary urination at night, when coughing.
Limbs - Cracking in joints when stretching them. Muscular twitchings, weakness and trembling. Limbs feel as
if made of wood or glass and would break easily. Limbs feels paralyzed. Hip joints give way when walking.
Restless knees. Coxalgia with tender soles. Pain in heels and Achilles tendon. Foul, acrid foot sweat. Ingrown
toenails. Nails brittle, ribbed, soft, distorted, discolored, crumbling. Crawling or inflamed finger or toe tips.
Trembling of hands and feet. Fingers cold, numb, as if dead, on waking at night.
 _______________ Thuja occidentalis Lungs - Asthma with red face. Asthma in children (Ars., Nat-s.),
especially vaccinated children, worse at night. Dyspnea from mucus in trachea. Short difficult breathing, worse

Male - Balanitis. Burning between glans and prepuce. Itching in glans and prepuce. Inflammation, swelling of

emissions followed by heaviness and ill-humor. Offensive semen.
Modalities - Better on left side, drawing up limbs, crossing limbs. Better motion. Better pressure, rubbing,
scratching. Better wrapping, warmth, air, wind. Better free secretions, sneezing. Worse from cold and
dampness. Worse sun, bright light. Worse at night, closing eyes, from heat of bed, left side. Worse from
increasing moon, moonlight. Worse at 3 a.m. and 3 p.m. Worse periodically, yearly. Worse touch, stretching.
Worse after breakfast, after eating, chewing. Worse during menses. Worse urinating, sex. Worse after
gonorrhea, after vaccinations, after suppressed warts.
Mouth - Aphthae, ulcers in the mouth (Bor.). Varicose veins on tongue and mouth. Mouth becomes dry while
chewing food. Mouth as if filled with blisters. Mouth as if it has been burnt. Sweetish taste with gonorrhea.
Taste as of rotten eggs, in morning. Teeth decay at the edge of gums, crumble, turn yellow. Gnawing pain in
teeth, worse cold, tea and blowing nose. Gums, very sensitive and retract. Pyorrhea alveolaris. Drinks fall
audibly into stomach.
Nose - Warts on nose. Nose red and hot. Sinusitis. Chronic sinus infections. Chronic catarrh after measles,
scarlatina, variola. Chronic catarrh, thick, yellow-green mucus, blood and pus. Coryza fluent outdoors, dry
in room. Violent, sudden coryza. Dryness of nasal cavities. Painful pressure at root of nose. Pain in teeth on

fish-brine or sour beer.
Perspiration - Profuse, sour. Sweetish and strong, smelling like honey. Sweat is foul, oily, pungent, sweetish,
sometimes garlicky. Staining brownish, yellow. Profuse sweats at night, staining clothes yellow. Profuse sweat
on genitals, gushing, worse company. Sweats only on uncoveredparts or all over except head, when
sleeping. Cadaverous exhalation of skin. Profuse, oily sweats, after asthmatic attacks.
Rectum - Constipation with violent rectal pain, causing stool to recede (Sil., Sanie.). Chronic diarrhea, worse
after breakfast. Diarrhea after vaccination. Diarrhea periodically returning at same hour. Noiseless emission
of flatus. Moisture oozing from anus, moist perineum. Ana/fissure, painful to touch. Ana/ warts. Condylomata
at anus. Venereal warts. Red blotches at anus like fig warts. Swollen hemorrhoids, pain worse sitting with
stitching. Hemorrhoids sensitive to touch. Burning pains at the anus. Burning in perineum. Perineal fistula.
Perineum moist.
 Sensations - As if a strange person were at her side. As if under the influence of a superior power. As if soul
and body were separated. As if whole body were very thin and delicate, as if its continuity would be dissolved,
as if frail and easily broken, as if made of glass. As if a nail were pressing into vertex, as if a nail were driven
from within outward in vertex. As if abdominal muscles were being pushed out by arm of a child. As if a living
a animal were in abdomen. Legs as if made of wood when walking. As if lower limbs were elongated. As from
flea bites.
Skin - Skin very sensitive to touch. Skin as if pricked with needles. One side cold. Dirty, hairy, dry skin with
brown spots on hands and arms. Freckles and blotches. Eruptions itch or burn violently, worse cold bathing.
Eruptions only on covered parts, worse after scratching. Herpetic eruptions. Herpes zoster. Polyps. Ring-
worm. Violent itching on different parts, as from fleabites. Pemphigus. Smallpox, useful during suppurative
stage. Chickenpox. Warts. Warts in ano-genital region. Warts, large, seedy, pedunculated, oozing moisture
and bleeding easily. Impetigo, with itching. Epithelioma. Sarcoma. Nevi, Birthmarks. Carbuncles and ulcers,
in anal-genital region. Ulcers flat with bluish bottom. Foul pustules with sunken apices. Luxuriant growth of hair
on parts otherwise not covered by hair. Nails crippled, brittle and soft.
Sleep - Persistent insomnia. Sleepless when lying on left side. Nocturnal sleeplessness with agitation and
coldness of body. Sleeplessness after menses. Nightmare after menses. Dreams of death, of corpses or dead
people. Dreams of falling from a height. Lascivious dreams without emission of semen with painful erections
on waking. Awakens from too violent movements of fetus. Heavy sleep, can’t get awake in morning.
Stomach - Cutting pain in epigastrium. Indurations in stomach. Sinking sensation in epigastrium before food,
thirst. Flatulence, pain after food. Noisy swallowing, loud belchings. Gulping up of large quantities of acids.
Eructations rancidor acrid. Eructations afford instant relief. Rancid belch- ings after fat food. Pressing in
stomach, with retching, during menses. Vomiting of mucus, or of greasy substances.
Stools - Stools gurgle or pop out, hard, oily, black, lumps. Painless, grass green stools, mixed with gushing
water. Stools hurried, explosive, gassy, spraying. Tenesmus of stool with rigidity of penis. Hard stool followed
by soft stool. Hard balls. Large, hard stool coated with blood.
Teeth - Very sensitive teeth. Gnawing, in teeth, worse cold. Toothache before and after menses. Toothache
on blowing nose. Teeth crumble, turn yellow. Teeth decay next to gums. Gums retracted. Gums swollen,
inflamed, dark red. Pyorrhea alveolaris.
Temperature - Chilly from least change of weather. Shaking chill with yawning, worse urinating, not better by
heat. Chill, beginning in thighs. Chill without thirst. Coldness of one side. General coldness during menses.
Shivering from slightest uncovering in warm air. Heat rises into chest with icy told hands, nosebleed or cough.
Orgasm of blood in the evening with throbbing in the blood vessels. Intermittent fever with chronic gonorrheal
contamination.
Throat - Throat dry and rough. Polyps of vocal cords. Papilloma of larynx. Chronic laryngitis. Much mucus in
throat, hawked up with difficulty. Painful swallowing. Sensations as if constricted when swallowing. Sensations
as if a skin in larynx. Much mucus in throat hawked up with difficulty. Mucus tubercles in fauces.
Tongue - Tip of tongue very painful. Tongue as if it has been burnt. White blisters on side close to
root,painfully sore. Ranula, varicose veins on tongue and mouth. Frequently bites tongue, from swelling of
tongue. Tongue swollen, worse right side. Ranula. Varicose veins on tongue and mouth.
Urine - Foamy urine. Split, small stream. Urinary stream forked and small. Discharge of glutinous moisture
from urethra. Weak stream. Urine becomes
Thuja occidentalis cloudy after standing. Urine yellowish or wine-colored. Urine dark red in morning. Urine
deposits abrown mucus. Urine with dark, cloudy sediment, in rheumatism. Urine highly colored and of strong
smell. Urine profuse, light-yellow. Urine bums, dribbles, foul, foamy.
Vertigo - Vertigo as from motion of a swing. Vertigo everything seems tojump. Vertigo on closing eyes. Vertigo
looking upwards or sideways. Reeling, as after turning in a circle. When rising from sitting; on stooping.
Vision - Shortsighted. Diplopia. Amblyopia with blurring, better rubbing. Misty or obscured, with dilated pupils.
Dim vision as from mist or veil, in open air, with confusion of head. Flickering vision. Sees flames of light like
fire-flies. Sees clouds and streaks. Muscae volitantes. Streaks of light or sparks passing downward. Objects
appear smaller.
COMMENTS - Millspaugh noted that the American Arbor Vitae is a “spiry evergreen attaining a height of from
20 to 50 feet, though generally not above 40 and a diameter of about 10 to 20 feet through the greatest breadth
of foliage. It assumes a conical form with such true lines as to appear ‘clipped.’ thus forming one of our most
valued high-hedge trees.
“It abounds in the northern zones of North America from Pennsylvania northwards. There it “often forms what
are commonly known as cedar-swamps. It grows upon the rocky banks of rivers and in low, swampy spots,
blossoming from May until June and maturing its fruit in autumn.”
 Teste remarked that in the period when the doctrine of signatures prevailed, the “Resinous callosities of the
stems and leaves of Thuja might have seemed an indication that the plant was the specific for sycosis and
warts.” Teste dismissed this idea, but he did ask whether resinous substances that have the power of modifying
vegetable juices in a peculiar way may not affect the animal fluids in the same manner.
He included Castoreum canadense in his Thuj. group and followed by giving an instance in which it acted on
fig-warts.
Castoreum canadense is the product of an animal that subsists on the bark of resinous trees.
Hering described Thuj.’s action on fluids as “dissolution of fluids of the body, which become acrid, probably
caused by Thuja perverting lymphatic secretions, disturbs digestion and sanguification.”
He went on to discuss Thuja’s action in the vegetative sphere: “A surplus of producing life, nearly unlimited
proliferation of pathological vegetations, condylomata, warty sycotic excrescences, spongy tumors and spongy
pock exudates which organize hastily. All morbid manifestations are excessive, but appear quietly, so that the
beginning of the diseased state is scarcely know.”
Boenninghausen found Thuja both preventive and curative during an epidemic of smallpox. It aborted the
disease process and prevented pitting. In veterinary practice, Thuja has proved curative in farcy and in
“grease.”
These clinical uses point to Thuj.’s affinity to vaccinations. No one has written more forcibly or lucidly on this
than Burnett did in his book, Vaccinosis and its Cure by Thuja. “Arbor Vitae: nomen omen,” said Burnett on his
title page. In his hands, Thuj. proved to be a tree of life to numberless sufferers from the vaccination miasm.
By “vaccinosis” Burnett meant the disease known as vaccinia, the result of vaccination, in addition to “that
profound and often long-lasting morbid constitutional state engendered by the vaccine virus.” Thuj. is
homeopathic to this state, and therefore curative and preventive of it.
Burnett made the observation, which Clarke confirmed, that the vaccination does not need to take in order to
produce the vaccination miasm. Many people date their ill health from a so-called unsuccessful vaccination,
so vaccinosis may exist apart from vaccinia. The anti-vaccinosis action of Thuj. is part of its anti-sycotic action,
therefore vaccinosis is a sycotic disease.
Burnett noted the case of an infant, ten weeks old, whom he was called to see as it was supposed to be dying.
He found it ghastly white and in collapse. There was Thuja occidentalis nothing to account for this except
that the baby had its wet-nurse changed two or three days before.
The wet-nurse was questioned and declared herself quite well and looked it, but “her arm was a little painful.”
She had been revaccinated in the Marylebone Workhouse the day before she took charge of the patient.
Burnett found the vaccine eruption just turning into the pustular stage. He concluded that the infant was sucking
in the vaccine poison with its nurse’s milk.
He gave Thuj. 6c to both infant and nurse. The baby gradually improved the same day and the next morning,
though still pale, was practically well and the vaccine vesicles on the nurse’s arm had withered.
Burnett quoted a case of vaccine rash in an infant following the vaccination of its mother, who was nursing it.
The effects of chronic vaccinosis are protean. Prominent among them are asthma, neuralgias, skin disorders,
indigestion and constipation, warts and new growths of many kinds. Emaciation, brain damage, epilepsy and
blindness. Hyperactivity, attention deficit disorder and autism.
In these effects, a favorite method of Burnett’s was to give a course of twenty- four numbered powders, only
three or four of them medicated with Thuj. 30c, one to be taken at bedtime.
With the same prescription, he cured many cases of paralysis; his indications included paralysis of left side of
body, very chilly, worse in morning, in wet weather and in cold. Burnett also found enlargements of the spleen
to dissolve with these indications.
The first case Clarke treated homeopathically was one involving new growths. There was a cluster of small
warts on the forehead of a boy that had lasted eighteen months, following a cat’s scratch. Thuj. in small doses
and tincture painted on permanently cured in three weeks.
A gentleman, about 50, consulted Clarke about a wart on the right side of his head. He was then bald and the
wart developed in the same locality soon after and has since remained. The patient had been twice vaccinated.
Clarke gave him Thuj. 30c, twenty-eight powders, one in seven medicated, one at bedtime. In one month there
was much reduction, Thuj. was repeated and in little over two months the wart was goift.
Burnett suggested Thuj. for fatty tumors, which he regards as sycotic in nature. Thuja not only produces
symptoms of the secondary stage of gonorrheal and vaccine affections, it also produces urethritis and a
variolous eruption.
Dudgeon reported acute urethritis with yellow discharge lasting altogether a fortnight as the result of chewing
a Thuja cone.
Goullon cured a lady who had a headache for a year. On waking, she felt as if a tight hoop enclosed her
 forehead, not passing away until noon. Eyelids heavy as lead. Thuj. lOx, one dose at bedtime, permanently
cured.
Robert Farley related the case of two children, age 5, who had what he graphically termed “urinary tantrums.”
Two hours after being put to bed they would wake kicking, crying and refusing to answer a question. This
lasted an hour or more. Asked if they wanted to urinate they would refuse to answer, strike at attendant, or
even say “No.”
Finally it was found that if they were taken up and put on the closet they would urinate and then go to sleep
readily. One of the children developed signs of incipient inflammation of the left hip joint. The totality led to the
selection of Thuj., which was given in the 200c.
After the first night there were no more “tantrums,” and in two months the child was perfectly well. This child’s
father had gonorrhea, treated by injection, some years before the patient was born. But the other child’s father
had not had gonorrhea. In the latter case, which was exactly like the former, the cure was immediate, in the
former case relief occurred on the second night.
C.    W. Roberts found Thuj. in five to seven drop doses at bedtime, to control nocturnal seminal emissions
better than any other
remedy. “Nocturnal seminal emission” is an emphasized symptom.
Percy Wilde recorded the case of a young married woman who had a large epulis on her lower jaw, rapidly
increasing in size, ulcerating on the surface, very painful and filling the mouth with an ill-smelling secretion.
The entire tumor was removed by operation and also the subjoined bone.
Three weeks later the tumor was as large as before and increased daily. Thuj. lx was then given. The growth
stopped immediately, ulceration ceased, and the pain disappeared. In three weeks the gum was healthy and
remained so permanently.
Villers related a case of scalp tumor in a youth of seventeen. The tumor had existed for two years and had
somewhat the appearance of a bean. It was situated about the posterior edge of the parietal bone, was devoid
of sensation and the hair had disappeared from it, making it very conspicuous.
Thuj. 30c was given, a dose every twenty days. In four months the youth was almost cured, entirely so in five
months, and the hair grew again completely covering the spot.
George Royal related a case of persistent cough cured withThuj. Miss X., 19, fair, had for three months a
painless, dry cough. The irritation was only in the throat. There were six small growths at the back of her throat
and one near the vocal cord. She had never had a cough before. She also had green, excoriating leucorrhea
and menses that were a little too early. Thuj. 30c cured the growths and the cough in about three weeks.
R. B. Johnstone offered some indications for Thuj. in hernia. He found it particularly useful for women with a
sycotic history who have a tendency to left-side inguinal hernia after labor. When babies cry a lot, the umbilicus
protrudes, growing red and sore, especially when the father has a sycotic history. Left inguinal hernia in infants,
child cries all the time and is only quiet when the left inguinal region is relie ved from pressure or the thigh is
flexed on the abdomen.
Burnett recorded a case of lichen urticatus in a boy of 14, which came into his hands after a long course of
treatment, external, internal and dietetic, at the hands of allopathic specialists without result.
The rash came periodically in warm weather; the patient literally tore himself because of the irritation. The rash
was worse on the left (vaccinated) side. Thuj. 30c was given in infrequent doses. The spots continued to
appear for a week and then disappeared. The skin remained clear in spite of the patient indulging in all kinds
of previously forbidden foods.
Birthmarks and stains (Sep., Care.). Birthmarks and moles in children with a sycotic history. The skin is mottled
and discolored, brown or red mottled spots, discoloration of the backs of the hands and feet. Tendency toward
acne and greasy skin. Blood blisters. Spider hemangiomas. Benign tumor growths. Polyp formation,

Severe left ovarian pains, sometimes burning, extend down thigh. Pains worse from any attempt at exercise,

Gonorrhea with yellow-green discharge. Vaginitis and cervicitis with yellow-green discharge (Puls.). Chronic

Ailments due to vaccinations (Sil.), especially smallpox. Ailments from gonorrhea or suppressed gonorrhea.
Sycotic gonorrhea miasm. AIDS.
Belief that they are somehow separate, that they are different (Nat-m.). Tendency to conceal themselves,
cautious as a form of protecting themselves. Difficulty trusting or relying on other people. Self doubt, poor
confidence. Don’t trust themselves.
 Elusive, changeable personality, often distorted. Evasive. Possessive, manipulative (Ars.). Calculating. Males
tend to be more reserved, distant, aloof, and manipulative; while females are manipulative, but spacey and
soft, with poor confidence.
Distorted sexual desires, often with high
Thuja occidentalis sex drive. Tendency to hide their sexual past or desires. Can have a history of sexual,
physical (Anae., Staph.) or verbal abuse (Lyc., Nat-m.). Secret obsessions. Can be secret drinkers ordrug
users. Fixed, distorted ideas. Distorted perceptions (Med.).
Fear of going crazy, or losing control. Fear or sensation of leaving their bodies (Cann., Med.), fear they will not

name: Thymolum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - Thymol. Thymolum. Thyme camphor. A phenol from the essences of many Labiatae,
Lamiaceae or some Um- belliferae. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL - Adenoma. Colitis. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Enterocolitis. Fainting tendency. Hookworms. Laryngitis.
Leucorrhea. Migraines. Neurasthenia. Sexual weakness. Whooping cough.
HERBAL - Thymol exists in the essences of certain plants belonging to the Labi atae family or to the
Umbellifers. It is a phenol made up of para-isopropyl-metacresol. Thymol can be extracted from them by
combining with alkaline lye (soda or potash). It is used therapeutically as an intestinal anti-septic and as
vermifuge against tapeworm.
HOMEOPATHIC - The proving was conducted by Griggs, on eight pro vers, six males and two females, as
well as one control using a placebo, in 1940-41. The experiment began by using 3x for two weeks, 2x for the
next two weeks and lx for about ten days.
The provings show an action limited to the sexual organs, producing a typical sexual neurasthenia. Thymol’s
general action is on the stomach, genital organs and to a small extent, on the central nervous system.
Genito urinary diseases. Pathological emissions, priapism and prostatorrhea. Nightly seminal discharge.
Blood-streaked leucorrhea. Glairy or membranous diarrhea. Hookworm disease (Chen-a.).
General weakness with headaches. Constricting headache. Skin blue, cold. Spasmodic laryngeal cough.
Excessive salivation with nausea. Frequent urination with compelling urging. Pains in the dorsal and lumbar
region, spreading to the buttocks.
MIND - Irritable, arbitrary, must have his own way. Uneasy feeling and agitation. Nervous agitation, loquacity,
mental confusion. Bewildered state. Craves company. Morose, sad, uneasy. Energy gone.
Abdomen - Enterocolitis.
Back - Tired, aching throughout lumbar region. Worse mental and physical labor.
Back pain during the headaches. Pain in the lumbar and sacral regions, spreading to the buttocks.
Ears - Noises in the ears. Buzzing in the ears. Sound like bells. Temporary deafness.
Female - Brown, blood-streaked, evilsmelling, watery leucorrhea. Menses thick, scanty, drawn-out. Pains
before and during menses in the ovaries and uterus. Pain from hypogastric heaviness. Metritis of the cervix.
Cancer of the uterus or cervix.
Head - Headache with sadness. Constricting pain in the temples, in women, ameliorated when lying down or
from external heat. Bilateral temporal headache and at the occiput. Menstrual migraines.
Kidneys - Pains in the kidneys, spreading to the buttocks. Retention of urine. Frequent urination with urging.
 Increased urination at night. Urinary burning and subsequent dribbling of urine. Urine copious, proteinuria,
hematuria. Urates increased; phosphates decreased.
Limbs - Cyanosed limbs. Numbness at the limbs. Chronic lumbar rheumatism.
Lungs - Dyspnea. Irritating laryngeal and tracheal cough. Whooping cough.
Male - Increased sexual desire. Priapism. Seminal discharge when going to stool. Nightly seminal discharge.
Profuse, nightly, seminal emissions with lascivious dreams of a perverted character. Ejaculation with erotic
dreams. Prostatitis. Adenoma of the prostate gland. Cancer of the prostate.
Modalities - Better from eating. Worse mental and physical labor. Worse from tobacco.
Mouth - Salivation reduced when eating. Watery salivation with nausea. Ptyalism. Nauseating belchings.
Pulse - Pulse weak, slow or rapid.
Rectum - Hookworms. Diarrhea after constipation. Glairy or membranous diarrhea. Anal pain following
diarrhea. Mucous, membranous stools, gray in color.
Skin - Skin blue and cold. Scarlet fever-like or pustulous exanthema.
Sleep - Awakes tired and unrefreshed. Lascivious and fantastic dreams. Erotic
dreams.
Stomach - Acrid dyspepsia. Glairy belching with sensation of burning in the stomach, nausea and gastric
heaviness. Nausea, ameliorated by eating. Vomiting.
Throat - Spasmodic laryngitis. Irritation of the larynx and trachea.
RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Carb-tcl. (2) Canth. - Irritation and inflammation of the digestive, urinary and
cutaneous mucus membranes. Intense burning in the digestive passages with frequent, compelling need to
urinate. (3) Merc-c. - Burning pains in the pharynx, painful, frequent urination, urine comes drop by drop,
diarrhea with tenesmus. (4) Ter. - Irritation of the digestive and urinary mucus membranes with tendency to
hemorrhage.
REFERENCES - Julian.

name: Thymus Serpyllum
author: Murphy
full:
PHARMACY - thymu. Thymus serpyllum. Wild thyme. N. O. Labiatae. Tincture of the whole plant. Historical
dose: Tincture and all potencies.
CLINICAL-Asthma. Respiratory, infections. Whooping cough.
HERBAL - Thymus serpyllum belongs to the mint family; all the members have a marked action on the urinary
organs and especially on the elimination of uric acid. It contains a volatile oil thymol, tannin, a gum and woody
fiber. Thymol is a very powerful germicide, killing the germs of typhoid fever in thirty minutes.
HOMEOPATHIC - Respiratory infections of children, dry nervous asthma, whooping cough, severe spasms
but little sputum. Ringing in ears with feeling of pressure in head. Burning in pharynx, sore throat worse empty
swallowing, blood vessels distended, dark.
COMMENTS - Small doses of Thymu. act as a sedative and contra-stimulant, the depressive action being
preceded by a period of excitation. Large doses dull the nerves and produce motor incoordination and sleep.
Animals poisoned by Thymu. sleep standing and are insensible to the prick of a pin.
They have muscular contraction and tremors, vertigo and turning movements.
Increase of diarrhea, vomiting appears, prostration is extreme, the skin becomes cold and death sets in with
all the symptoms of a depressant position and with complete anesthesia. These final symptoms are due to the
thymic acid, which is a camphor.
REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke.
